column9: Hazelnut (Filberts) in a fragile crescent shaped tea cookie.
column10: Delicate ground hazelnut cookies for a Ladies tea, NOT for children or most men! Appreciated only by sophisticated palates, because they are neither cloyingly sweet or fatty. Set these aside for unexpected guests you'd like to impress.

Amazon sends you TWELVE boxes of these fabulous cookies and each box disappears FAST - in fact, DO NOT sit down with the whole box nearby or you will munch thru all of them without stopping! They are delicately sweet, crunchy, and buttery - without being at all greasy. You've been warned!

column9: what a little wonder this is!!!
column10: this is a very awesome product good for the money, was shipped well before time and packed greatly with care!!! let me tell you some great quailities for one i had an aweful sinus infection that wolud not go away my ears popped every time i swallowed and headaches... this flour of the gods cleared my head better than exspectorant, and if you need energy this will do the trick!!!

column9: Not bad, in the second tier of Chef Tom's Rubs
column10: As Chef Tom says, 'Don't be afraid of curry!'.  There's a light but distinct curry scent to this mix that works beautifully on shrimp, scallops, and white fish (catfish, orange roughy, red snapper).For those of you who who don't like the 'burn' curries can impart, no worries - the bark is definitely stronger than the bite in this case. It fades to practically non-existence on more distinctly flavorful 'red' fish such as salmon and tuna.  It's too weak for pork, let alone beef. (To be fair though, it wasn't really designed for these types of meat).This spice isn't quite as good as the two knockouts in Chef Tom's collection: Chef Tom Douglas Rub With Love Salmon Rub, Chef Tom Douglas Rub With Love Chicken Rub  - but it is yummy.  I suggest drizzling this into your potato or pasta salad instead of paprika to give things an exotic punch!

column4: C. Crisp Martin "The Loosely Bound Sisters"
column10: I tried this seasoning after buying it at the local market and now they don't carry this one! It is so good, I now buy it through the mail. It has a great combination of seasoning and I use it all of the time on salmon and other cuts of fish.  Just rub it on the fish and bake.  It is wonderful. I have also used the steak rub and the salmon rub.  I actually prefer the seafood rub over the salmon rub when I cook salmon. The steak rub is very good on pork chops and chicken too!

I ordered these supposedly sweet peas from this seller and couldn't wait to try them.  They sprouted well, but were bitter.  I originally thought I had done something wrong in the sprouting process, but I decided to try an unsprouted dry seed.  I rinsed it and it was bitter before I even started the sprouting process.  I contacted the seller directly to let them know they may have a bad batch.  The seller told me that some people rave about the sweetness of her peas and some say they are bitter.  I've gardened for years and the only time peas are bitter are when they are overripe.  The seller should be tasting and testing the batch before buying it.  She did not apologize at all.  The garbanzo bean sprouts I bought tasted fine so I think it's this batch of peas.  I wanted to get a replacement, but was afraid it would be bitter as well.  The seller was nice enough to check the lot number for me and it was the same so I decided to go for a refund instead which I needed to do through Amazon.
Bitter tasting peas.Mine came with the hemp bag as a sample and I'm definately not buying these.The company should stop sending these as a sample.
These were nice and sweet. They grew pretty quick with little effort on my part. I highly recommend them to anyone from beginner to advanced.

We bought this 12-pack of truffle bags with the intention of giving them as gifts to friends for different events throughout the year... it's been a few months and were down to 2 bags left and if memory serves, I don't think we gave a single one away to friends. We just keep eating them.If you haven't had a Lindor truffle before, it's a very-very creamy/clean/rich chocolate taste. The dark-chocolate (Blue) tastes like milk chocolate, the milk chocolate (red) tastes like white chocolate and the white chocolate (Yellow) tastes like sweet and condensed milk. It's really really delightful chocolate and I'd rather have these around for quick treats to pop in my mouth than a cake or cookies or something else with a ton of carbs in it.I'm usually a pretty classic-desert kind of guy (Twix, Snickers, etc.) but these are delicious. You can buy this 12-pack as gifts for others or just keep them around the house yourself -- either way it's a great buy.

I gave this 2 stars not because they're poor quality but because they are being sold for an insanely high price. I know that this is for 12 bags but that still leaves each one at a price above $6. I have seen and purchased the same assortment and size of milk, white and dark truffles of this same brand at grocery stores for $2 less per bag. Which doesn't seem like much but in the end would save $32 as compared to buying from here.

column9: This made for some delish black beans and rice
column10: This Sazon has no annatto and no MSG. That's not easy to find! The "big" brands (starts with a "G") all have MSG, which I don't like.I used half a packet to make black beans on rice. Here is what I did and I think this "sazon" is very good. Here is how I made the black beans1 15.5 oz can black beans or equivalent of cooked dried black beans1 small yellow onion small dice1 med green pepper, small dice2 cloves garlic chopped finesome olive oilhalf a packet of "Sazon Tropical"1/2 cup vegetable broth or water1 tsp oregano1 tsp red wine or cider vinegarMethod: Saute in oil: the onion, pepper and garlic until soft. Add in beans plus their liquid, if using canned, add about 1/2 cup of the black bean cooking liquid if you cooked up dry beans,  and the broth or water, seasoning and cook 20 min until liquid thickens somewhat. Serve over brown rice, a dab of sour cream or Greek yogurt and chopped cilantro is really nice.
Had dinner out and the rice was seasoned with this.  Had to get for cooking at home. The chicken was delightful.

column9: Received a batch with different taste
column10: I am a fan of these chocolate milk and a subscriber on Amazon. After stopping my subscription for a few month due to moving, I receive a 12 pack box in March. The packing has changed slightly that the place where to straw goes in has become a small hole just big enough for the straw.However, the most important thing is it taste different now. It seems to be less sweeter, but I don't like it. It taste more like Costco's Kirkland version.Otherwise, by mistake, I also receive another box of 18 from Amazon, and these have the same packaging as I used to get. The milk taste just as it used to be. I continue to order the 18-pack boxes and they have tasted the same so far. So I am not sure why the 12-pack taste different.
Great product.  Love the ability to keep it in the pantry until I know I will be drinking it.  I use this for a quick post-race drink.  Delicious and good for you.

column9: Our kid's favorite snack drink for the summer!
column10: I've bought several cases of this brand and several of it's "competitor" on Amazon and this tastes better.  My kids prefer this, I prefer it, just has a much better chocolate flavor and not so much of that funny taste you get from this type of packaging.  Love it.

My kids love this milk.  I like that I can put them in their lunch pails and I can store them at room temperature in the pantry -- what convenience!  My kids prefer the chocolate milk best cold, so I keep some in the fridge, too.  It's a great way to get them some calcium and protein on the go.
My daughter loves milk, but this is her favorite! I love to drink the chocolate as well!Its also cheaper buying it in bulk..

We have a three-year-old toddler. He's a somewhat picky eater and it's always hard to tell just what he might like at any particular time. One thing is certain, no matter what food mood he might be in he will almost always accept milk. Of the various milks available, he likes the flavored varieties best and chocolate milk is his first choice. At first we were buying it in large containers. Then we switched to these small Horizon 8-ounce aseptic cartons. They're just about the right size for a serving. Plus, they're easy to store. Furthermore, I can easily transport them about for a snack on the spot. Just today, for example, we took him to a restaurant and, as you might guess, he would have none of it. Well, I reached in my pocket and pulled out a chocolate milk for him. That solved the lunch problem. We like the size and the convenience. The kid just loves the product, especially the chocolate. Having them around makes for a great snack for the rest of us too.Gary Peterson

I am partial lactose intolerant and this the yummiest and healthiest milk for my body that doesn't disturb my stomach.  It tastes great and at a fair price. I love that it is offered in a variety of choices and has low fat options.  I also love how you do not need to refrigerate it and I can bring it in my lunch bag for lunch.

I'm always looking for healthy alternatives and these definitely fit the bill.  I got to try these out for free from Bzz agent and I was so excited!  They taste great and the kids love them.  They are also low fat and organic-great bonus.  I love that they don't have to be refrigerated so you can take them anywhere or pack them in lunch boxes without having to worry.
Horizon has the best milk for kids. The taste is smooth and not medicine like others. We would not go without it.

column9: Converted My Husband to Chocolate Milk
column10: After decades of never touching an ounce of chocolate milk, Horizon converted my husband to chocolate milk so intensely that he now goes through his carton in the fridge faster than I go through mine.  I have had to resort to putting my name on one container and his on another so that he doesn't drink mine too (I am a lifelong chocolate milk fan and this is my favorite brand).  This size, by contrast, is ideal for him to carry to his work fridge or alongside him when he is going elsewhere. Although the sugar content may be high, I've discovered this milk pretty much eliminates the need for both of us to wolf down chocolate bars.  So we are both getting a lot more calcium and protein, plus reduced fat, than we were with our chocolate bar binges.
My daughter and grand-children loves this milk and its good for them.It's great for putting in lunch boxes.I also bought this at Amazon.com

MMMMMMMMm, SOOOO delicious!My sons love it! Milk's Carton fits great to their lunch bags.Price is pretty acceptable considering that you don't have to:1. leave the house,2. carry the shopping bags,3. buy gas for car trip :-) to the store,4. spend the time on shopping5. break your mind on what to put in kids lunch bag as healthy drinks.
Check out the sugar content before you buy!  27 grams/box!  This is ridiculously high for something that you think is going to be healthy!

Don't waste your money on this disgusting product. No chocolate taste at all, tastes like the plastic lining of the paper carton. They're using milk treated at ultra high temperatures and this is not like fresh milk at all. Just go get some fresh milk and a can of Hershey's syrup if you want chocolate milk.

I love that the cartons don't have to be refrigerated.  They actually taste better at room temperature than they do when cold.  The flavor of the chocolate just seems too strong somehow when its cold.
We purchased from the original website 8 flavored sugars all but the raspberry was worth the money the rest had little or no flavor at all! It was expensive and not worth the money.
Product was exactly as it was described. I am a regular purchaser of Christmas puddings and this was very good. Was sent promptly. I would order from this company again.
A christmas pudding that is just the right size for one. Good flavor and keeps well.
I was pleased with the excellent service and the product was exactly what I wanted.  Thank you!  I would definitely buy from you again.

I bought these for my little chihuahua/Jack Russel mix? and she loves them.  They're just her size.  I do watch her when I give her one as she does have a tendency to gulp everything she chews on (and that includes everything.) but so far so good and she hasn't had any stomach problems. So I recommend these, but with a little caution.

column9: Awesome Coffee - careful of seller though
column10: This coffee is great!  We got it at Target on clearance and figured it was worth a try.  I"m sooo glad we did.  This coffee goes head to head against Community Coffee which is/was our favorite coffee.So i give this brand a total 5 stars and now it's time to experiment with the various blends.DO be careful though.  Look at this seller... they want only $.99 for the item and then $21.00 for shipping!  Amazon should not allow this for this is how they sell on eBay, not here on Amazon.  It's a total scam.Point is, coffee is quite excellent but do becareful with where/whom you buy from.T

Great Coffee! Item was shipped quickly and as presented in the description. The pricing was a deal. The coffee is priced much higher in the market. Even with the shipping, I saved money.I would make this purchase again.
I bought this gum for my sister who says it helps her breathe better. This is the best price that you can buy this gum instead of in the stores
Yummy!  Tried this at a farmers market and loved it.  Have made several unique dishes by simply adding the packet of spices to "wow" friends with at dinner parties.

I love St. Dalfour's.  It is lighter than some other morning black teas, but the doesn't detract from the complex flavor.  As an organic black tea, it doesn't turn acid in the stomach, nor does it get bitter when you leave the tea bag in the cup.  I also like the fact that they do not use metal staples in the bag, tag or string.  No tainting of flavor, better for my compost and no sparks if I (gasp) microwave it.

For many years I've been drinking Twinings Irish Breakfast Tea but not any more. I like this tea much better. I do add sugar and creamer so it changes the taste a bit but if you like your tea that way too give this a try.
My daughter and I love St. Dalfour's tea.  We literally drink it morning, noon and night.  We particularly like the fact that it's organic, and we love the slightly astringent yet comforting flavor.

I agree with all the previous reviews. This tea is by far the best black tea I have tasted. Even though the manufacturer's recommendation for steeping is 1 - 3 min upon personnel preference, it won't get bitter if you leave the bag in the cup for longer. (Since I like my tea strong, I often leave it there for 10 min or even just forget about it... ) I absolutely love the rich flavor! First sip usually brings complex notes of fruits and spices. I personally feel it's less astringent than Twining Dajeeling. It has a subtle lingering aftertaste which is never bitter or rough. So I feel it kinda deserves an extra star for this. It's hard to describe a tea that is this rounded yet complex. Since I am no pro, I am not sure if this complexity is achievable without blending teas from multiple origins but the net result is great. I like it with or without milk. Both are so delicious that sometimes I just gulp it down...

I am both a tea and coffee drinker.  But since introduction to this tea, this has been the morning drink of choice.  I've been an avid drinker of St. Dalfour, Classic Breakfast tea for 5 years now and will be for the next years granted me.  This tea is a delicious blend of black tea with a smooth and soothing mix of clarity -enjoy!

We have been using this tea to make our batches of kombucha, and it turns out delicious, and slightly bubbly.  We are pleased with it as well as reassured that it is certified organic by several organisations instead of just one.It also drinks very well as a traditional breakfast tea.  It seems to have a bit less of the bitterness of standard black teas, espcially if one accidentally lets it steep a little too long.  The cost is reasonable, since you get more bags per box than with some of the other gourmet teas.By the way, they have this nifty way that they have attached the string that encloses the string in the bag and it is attached in the bag's seal.  You just gently pull the tag, it is pulls out of the bag - no staple to hold it in place, therefore no metallic taste or residue in the tea.  Very nice:)Subscribe ans save will be an excellent way to keep this regularly coming to the house.  Thanks again, amazon!
This wonderful French breakfast tea is fabulous...very smooth, but lots of full body.  Can't beat it!  I have tried a number of St. Dalfour teas and this is my favorite.

column9: Makes great ice tea as well
column10: Classic Breakfast makes great ice tea.I use two tea bags in a pitcher of hot tap water.Allow it to brew for 3-4 hours, refrigerate and enjoy.The tea will stay clear for days.Use more tea bags if you want a stronger tea.This process is similar to some who make sun tea.  IMHO the sun does nothing for the tea, it is just the slow brewing process with warm, not hot water which makes sun tea taste so good.The use of boiling water brings out the worst in tea...the brew gets cloudy and will develop a film on the surface.
In my opinion, St. Dalfour is the best brand of tea.  I love that it is organic.  Their English Breakfast tea makes excellent iced tea.

I use to be a bigelow tea drinker, but was getting tired of the increasing amount of cloudy stuff coming off the steeping tea bag. I noticed the more cloudy the tea bag the worse the taste. Also, couldn't steep it for long before it'd develop a raunchy taste. None of that w/ this tea. This tea can & needs to steep for several minutes...otherwise it's a bit weak..but, it will steep to a nice full flavored tea. I brew 1 tea bag in 1 cup water, let it steep 15 min., then pour it over a big tall glass of ice..perfect ice tea. This tea is crystal clear, never cloudy, & doesn't develop the "raunch" no matter how long it sits out.

I first tried St Dalfour when I bought some at a discount store. I was very surprised how much I enjoyed the flavor. I am not sure if it will be available in the future as it might not be in business or imported anymore. The store I bought it from the first time no longer carries it and I notice it is getting harder to find on line.
This is very high quality saffron. The only reason I didn't give it 5 stars is because it is so costly. Loved the jar!

Yes !  This 2 lb block is awesome !  I have bought this many times and its not processed cheese;  its the real deal aged sharp cheddar made in Waterloo WI.  I found this during last holiday season & love it;  not too nippy and not too mild.  Just deliciously great and a very large serving block of 2 uncut pounds.  Nutrition is :  for a 1 inch cube:  calories 110,  fat 9 grams, sodium 180 mg, cholesterol 25 mg, 1 carbs, zero trans fats, saturated fat 6 grams, protein 7 grams.  This is EXCELLENT to chop up for appetizers and party trays due to the extra large block size or cut into sandwhich size slices as its a huge thick block.  PERFECT as uncut and unprocessed.  Very nice product here by Deli Direct and compliments all their cheese spreads too on wraps and rolled sandwiches.  5 if not ten stars on this as I have been a consistent customer for 6 months now.

This candy is definitely not Chick O Sticks. There isn't any coconut surrounding each piece. The candy I received was extremely hard with a very faint taste of peanuts. I would never recommend this candy.

For the last few years, we had tried different combinations of gluten free flours to come up with the best sugar cookie dough for cut outs for Christmas......I had purchased some of this mix mid-way through this past year and had used it for other types of cookies.  We decided to give it a try today for holiday cookies and it is the best! So easy to work with and great flavor.........I will stop trying to reinvent the wheel and will be using this mix going forward!!

I am the mom of a 5 year old celiac, so it is very important to be able to make cut out sugar cookies and have them be decent. I have tried MANY gluten-free sugar cookie doughs. I have labored in the kitchen for hours mixing my own flours only to suddenly not have enough energy to actually bake something once I've finished.This mix is quite the blessing!! It makes a dough that is actually very easy to work with (not sticky at all like with other mixes). Mix it up, and don't even bother putting it in the fridge for hours! I roll it out between two pieces of parchment paper, make my cut outs (even the more detailed cutters work!), peel up the dough between the shapes, slide the piece of parchment paper onto a cookie sheet, and minutes later I now have the perfect cookies!! We roll ours out a little thick because we like them soft, and even then, the details of the cutter remain.And for the cookie artists out there, this mix works well with the cookie craft books, which I also highly recommend....Cookie Craft: From Baking to Luster Dust, Designs and Techniques for Creative Cookie Occasions

This sugar cookie mix is awesome.  I made these up and they taste very close to the real thing.  No crazy aftertaste.  They froze well...the only problem???  They didn't last...they were eaten very quickly!  In fact, so quick we didn't even have the time to make frosting.

This is the third product that I've tried from the "Gluten Free Mama" company; and boy am I pleased!Tonight I made this fairly easy cookie mix for the first time.  It actually needed a little more milk than the recipe called for (2-3 TBSP).  I think it ended up being around 1/2 cup or a tad over.  I didn't use an electric mixer, so maybe that would have made the mixing easier than it was for me.  Instead of just grabbing a TBS of mix and putting the round ball on the cookie sheet, this recipe actually tells you to roll out the dough and use a cookie cutter.  Because I didn't have one, I ended up using the mouth of a plastic champagne flute.  I guess you're supposed to have 15 cookies (depending on the size of the cutter), but I had a few more.  You also might have to put it on for a couple of minutes more than what is said (12-14).  Make sure that the bottom doesn't overly brown- even if the top doesn't look like it.The cookies are mouth-watering on their own (by the way, there's also a "snickerdoodle" recipe on the back); or you can make a little homemade frosting/glaze.  I made a lemon frosting for mine (powdered sugar, milk, lemon flavoring, lemon juice).  ...I absolutely love the ingredients of all the "G F M" mixes I've tried!  There's no corn meal, or anything to make it have a gritty texture (like some gluten free mixes).  I had really favored the "Betty Crocker" Gluten Free Chocolate Chip mix before I tried this.  Now while I still love the "B C" GF mix; I'm leaning more towards this mix!  The mix is so versatile, that if you wanted chocolate chips in it, I don't see what harm it would do by adding some!! (I'll have to try it next time, and update my comment..)I really hope that Amazon will start selling this mix soon!  By the way, the previous 2 products from "G F M" that I've tried (and love) are the "Pancake & Waffle Mix", and the "Coconut Flour Blend".  The pancakes are the absolute best that my family and I have tried, and the flour blend is so versatile (we've used it in sweet breads, & a cake mix)!  I actually first started using it as an alternative to dusting my chicken pieces before I fried them.  It doesn't have any weird taste; in fact the unsuspecting taster would swear it was normal flour!

This mix is easy to use and delicious.  I added ground chia seeds (grind in the coffee grinder) to up the nutritional value and put colored sugar sprinkles on top to up the fun for the kids.  My gluten free daughter and non-gluten free son both love these.  I have tried some not so fabulous mixes and this is absolutely wonderful!

column9: Very good but watch out for sodium content
column10: I like this tomato soup a lot. It's smooth and has a sweetness to it that is very pleasant. I can't say it tastes or looks very much like tomato soup I've had before, but it's still very good. The color is more orange than you might expect, making it look like carrot soup. The third ingredient is evaporated cane juice, which is unusual.Hot or cold, this soup tastes good. The carton is made of paper (environment-friendly) and has a resealable lid. column9: Good Product at a Good Price
column10: After a lot of trial and error I have decided that Stevia is the best substitute sugar product for me. Reading about stevia I found out that the basic powder or liquid form is better for your health and I find the taste just as good.In our house we use SweetLeaf for coffee and tea, of course, but also cereal, oatmeal, fruit desserts and plain yogurt.  We have not missed regular table sugar.
I've tried them all and this is the best.  I typically use this to sweeten berries,greek yogurt, oatmeal.  I've also used it in recipes.  It's very good.

I've been using Sweetleaf Sweetener for more years than I care to mention. They've perfected Stevia a great deal since the early days when I would dip a toothpick into the bottle and still use too much. It's still easy to use too much, and I've gotten pretty good at judging when a whole packet is called for or whether to sprinkle out less into my drink or whatever.I grow Stevia, just because I grow herbs, and it's a nice plant to have, but I've not been successful at drying the leaves for my own use. Even when I grind them in the coffee grinder, the powder just floats on top of my drink.There are controversies over the use of Stevia, just as there are over everything from eggs to green tea. I just know I can't use the artificial sweeteners like aspartame as they immediately give me migraines, as does anything sweetened with corn syrup. I sweeten with Agave Nectar, Stevia, local honey, and occasionally organic raw cane sugar. These work for me. Mostly it's just a matter of trial and error to find what works for each individual, but I would vouch for Sweetleaf Sweetener, and I try never to run out of it.

I can't believe anyone is paying this price for this 3 pound bag of Natures Variety Frozen Raw cat/dog food.  Wow!!!Just go on line to the Nature's Variety Web site and check retail locations to see if there are any retail outlets in your area.  You'll find a much better price.

My 4 1/2 month 3.7lb yorkshire terrier LOVE!LOVE!LOVE! this food. It is easy and convenient, yet is best for dogs. I love that my dog now eats excitedly and looks forward to meals. He started eating raw and this is the first Nature's Variety flavor he tasted. He now has finished his 3 lb bag and moved on to try the beef. I plan on having him try all flavors. So far I am very impressed. His pooped is so much smaller than when he was on kibble. His coat is so shiny and soft. The goop in his eyes is almost disappeared. I would definitely feed this food to any future dogs we may have.

I'm a cat breeder, and believe in the healthy advantages of some raw food in my queen's and kittens' diet.  This product is convenient, healthy mix of primarily organ meat, high in calcium, and I don't have to worry about too-long exposure to air, etc. during prep time.  It's pricey but worth it!  Amazon's price is lower that some of the pet specialty stores.

column9: Agree, Price is WAY out of line
column10: I agree with the previous poster, the prices for these 3 lb bags are WAY out of line. I love this cat food, and thought that ordering it online would be much more convenient than driving to the closest store that sells it here. (Quite a distance.)  3 lb bags of beef or non-organic chicken usually run about $14.00.  Me thinks that who ever set up their on-line Amazon account put the price for the next largest size bag.  I certainly hope that they are not trying to gouge the customer with  such an enormous mark up.
I have tried a number of MREs now, and the others may have better snacks, but this one has the best meal. If you haven't tried one before, go with this one and avoid the ones like omelette.

Hershey's sugar-free chocolates are the worst of all the sugar-free chocolates I have tried.  Don't bother with these or any of the other Hershey sugar-free products.  Not only is the flavor poor, the texture is horrible.

column9: Orange Mango has replace my long time addiction to Coca Cola
column10: I found this product at a local store and then discovered Amazon's program to deliver to my home monthly.  I signed up for home delivery and received a partial order.  Now it's out of stock.  I do hope this is only a temporary situation.I tried other Ice flavors but none appeal to me like the orange mango. I've tried for years to find a replacement for Coca Cola in attempts to get off sugared drinks and been unsucessful until now. Ice has good carbination, appealing flavor and no sugar although it does have sucralose, an artifical sweetener, also known as Splenda.  At this time, sucralose appears to be less problematic than high fructose corn syrup in soft drinks so I'm sticking with Ice.

column9: I'm Swigging It As I Write This
column10: I'm drinking it warm because my new order just arrived and there wasn't time to chill it.  I think I'm becoming an addict.  What else can I say, just please see my review of the Pink Grapefruit flavor.  Ditto on all of that except it doesn't taste like the last precious drops of a pink grapefruit.  That would just be wrong.  But love it for what it is in all its orange-mango-y goodness with zero calories.  I'd love it even if it were fattening but I'd drink it maybe once a year.

column9: Love Sparkling ICE Brand (Stay away if you're sensitive to Splenda)
column10: The Sparkling ICE line up are all extremely addicting, this one included. I love that they are all flavorful, calorie free (and carb free, gluten free, caffeine free), and carbonated. I used to have periodic cravings for one of my husband's cokes and always hated myself for giving in. I always thought it was the sugar I was craving until I tried these a year ago and realized that it's actually the carbonation I would crave. These are a guilt-free way of feeding those cravings.The only thing I would note is that it is sweetened with Splenda. Splenda doesn't bother me at all but my husband can instantly tell the difference and ends up with a stomach ache any time he consumes it so unfortunately these can't help me to get him off his soda kick. So if you are also sensitive to Splenda, this isn't the product for you.The Orange Mango flavor isn't one of my absolute favorites (that goes to Sparkling ICE Mountain  Spring Water, Pomegranate Berry, 17-Ounce Bottles (Pack of 12) and TalkingRain Sparkling ICE Lemonade, 17-Ounce Bottles (Pack of 12)) but it is delicious all the same. I think it comes across as being more mangoish than orangish as well.

I'm really happy with this Sparkling Ice water. The orange mango has a nice flavor, light carbonation, and it's not as sweet as Vitamin Water. Per bottle, you get 20% of your daily B-vitamins, Vitamin D, and Biotin. There's also green tea extract that adds a little antioxidant.I like the bottle, too. It's 17 oz, but it's a longer, thinner bottle than Gatorade or Vitamin Water. So, for my small hands, it's easier to hold. That might be a silly thing to share in my review. But I think ergonomics do matter!Overall, this is a very good product. And the shipping from Amazon was very fast. I'm looking forward to trying the other Ice flavors.

column9: Love Ice - wish it were on sale in my area
column10: I found this product in OH when I was there visiting family. Zero cal, naturally flavored and sparkling! Loved it. Came home to MA and its no where near me. So I ordered it on Amazon! I got enough to get free shipping. It took quite a while to get to me, but I'm down to only having 2 left and I'm saving them :)

Since I joined Weight Watchers I have been trying to find better ways to get my "hydration" because I simply do NOT like plain water.  A coworker introduced me to Ice in many flavors. I am a Mango FREAK so I usually go fo the Mango. They carry it at Publix but it's regularly $1.30 plus tax so getting it on subscription via Amazon is a DEAL!!! I love this stuff.........

column9: Best Flavored Water I've Ever Had!
column10: So far the Orange Mango is my favorite flavor but I haven't tried them all yet.  Pink Grapefruit is good, too.  With no calories and no carbs it has now replaced my diet coke as an everyday beverage.I have no problems with the tall 17 oz bottle. Makes it easier to fit more in the fridge or ice chest.
I have been trying to give up soda and I found that the Sparkling Ice Spring Water is a great Substitute. Love the taste!!!! Bob
I have tried the other flavors and this was a good addition and I like this product and would buy all that they make .  it makes you burp and has a great taste.

Sparkling ICE Orange Mango is a delightfully refreshing bottled water!  Lightly effervescent, high in citrus mango flavor, it quinches thirst without calories ! There are several flavors of this product, with Orange Mango being one of my favorites.  I was disappointed to have it discontinued from my "Subscribe and Save" selections. I'll keep purchasing this delicious drink wherever I can find it.

column9: Sparkling ICE Spring Water, Orange Mango, 17-Ounce Bottles (Pack of 12)
column10: I like this product over others in the same category. It's fresh and clean and adds no sugar to my daily diet.

I live in Guinea Africa and we order products that are delivered by boat every 3 months and sometimes I am very disappointed BUT NOT THIS TIME !!Zero calories  Zero Carbs  100% Taste  Great Price and Zero delivery costs with Prime.I ordered 3 different flavors but this one is my favorite.LOVE IT

This is the first flavor I have tried, and it's simply amazing.  I picked one up from my local Wal-Mart (they carry four flavors at my local store), and I have yet to try the other three.  If they are as good as this one, I'm hooked.  I already ordered a case of these here because it is slightly cheaper on Amazon.com.

I have tried both the Black raspberry and the Orange/mango and loved them both. I didn't care much for the pineapple/coconut or the Strawberry one. But the Black raspberry and Orange are both a great addition if you want something other then regular water but don't want pop.

I like this one so much I have it on subscription.  It's the first flavor I tried and the one that I liked on the first swallow.  It tastes very natural. My second favorite is the Lemon Lime, but the Black Raspberry and Coconut Pineapple are not bad. I will try the other flavors because the Sparkling Ice drinks are a nice change from non-carbonated flavored water. Since I don't drink sodas this is a nice treat. No calories is a major plus.
Very tasty beverage. Has replaced my Pelligrino for now. Carbonation is great and the flavor hits the spot! Repeat buyer!

This sparkling water is truely the best Ive had so far.  My kids love to chill this water until it turns into a slushy and wow is it great.  The flavors really comeout and this is a great chilled product in this hot weather.  Will buy more.

column9: a little sparkle with no calories - fabulous!!
column10: Husband and I are so happy we found this beverage. We each drink one or two per day .. also like the lemon-lime and black raspberry. These beverages will be perfect on the boat this summer.

I found this at a deli one day and a friend and I immediately fell in love. This successfully helped me get off soda, which I only really like for the carbonation. I didn't want to drink club soda because, well, that just tastes bad, and I was not going to invest in a soda stream. The ICE drinks are perfect! They're carbonated but just enough so that if it happens to get warm before you can finish the bottle, it doesn't burn your throat, unlike soda. The added bonus is the green tea, a great little mid day kick.My only complaint is that they use sucrose. I wish I could get more stuff sweetened with stevia.
This is one of the best flavored waters I have found! And it's affordable!! It's a tie between the mango-orange and the black raspberry for the best flavor.

Not sure how many people will understand this but after my first taste of ICE sparkling water, I had a flashback of my childhood. I swore I was drinking a New York Seltzer water. Ive been morning the loss of NY Seltzer since it was discontinued over a decade ago. And now...ALL IS RIGHT WITH THE WORLD AGAIN!!!

This is on my subscription products and if you could sign-up for weekly deliveries I would...that's how good it is. Okay, maybe not weekly, but I usually can't wait between my monthly deliveries and order an extra delivery each month. It's just the right combination of Orange and Mango -- not too mango-y, not too orange-y! Refreshing! Ahhhhhhhhhhhhhh!

Love these drinks, I get them in several flavors.  One thing:  I wish they didn't have to add artificial colors. Really there is no need, it tastes great on its own.I also wish they were more readily available at the local stores.

This stuff is 'finestkind'! The slightly tart flavors of tangerine and mango were positively inescapable, whilst the carbonation was quite crisp. The added Splenda provided just the right touch of sweetness, without crossing the line. I think a touch of key lime would put this drink over the top, but I recommend it highly, as is.

I discovered the Sparkling Ice beverages about month or so ago. They're quite good and come with a variety of characteristics I like. They're zero calories which is good for my weight watching. They are ever so slightly carbonated but nowhere near the typical carbonated soda. They're only slightly sweet. I tend to like the much lower sweetness Even no sweetness might be better. The taste is mild but excellent and I like the Orange Mango better than the other two flavors I've tried (lemon-lime and raspberry). The bottle is 17 ounces so you can go it alone or easily split it for two. I bought it at a local store but things have a way of appearing and then disappearing, so it's good to know it's available on line. Good product! Light and refreshing!Gary Peterson

Sparkling ice drinks are so good and a guilt free treat!  I love all of the flavors i have tried. I have never been able to find the coconut pineapple so haven't tried it.  I particularly like anything with mango flavor.There are only a few stores in my area that stock this and half the time, they are out of it. For a comparable price, I just order them from Amazon .  Be careful with the black raspberry and open it over the sink.  For some reason, this flavor in particular seems to be high pressure and I have had it squirt all over the place when opening even though it had not been shaken or moved prior.  I am assuming  it is because it is  a lovely shade of red on tan carpet.

My first time buying this was at a local grocery store. They were on sale 10/$10.00. I have been hooked every since.  What a wonderful drink to have, especially when it is cold.  This is a refreshing drink to have in the summer during one of those hot days.  I thoroughly enjoy it.  One of my favorite flavors.  Now if they would only make a peach flavor.
At this time this water is my favorite drink.  The orange mango flavor is, in my opinion, the best flavor.

my daughter and i were looking for something refreshing to drink that wasn't plain water or something filled with chemicals.  we are very pleased with the taste of this beverage and have purchased other flavors as well.

This Orange-Mango Ice is the most delicious carbonated beverage I've ever had. It's made with sucralose, which I trust to be safer than other artificial sweeteners. My whole family, including kids from the age of 22 down to six, love it too.

Can't say enough good things about the water. However, I've noticed most people either love it or hate it and if they hate it, it's due to the carbonation and after drinking it a couple times, they love it. I drink 3-4 of these per day and hope they never stop selling them. Got me totally off sodas.
I LOVE the mango ICE.  It's so fizzy and sour and satisfying, with NO calories...(I hear you can find it at Costco in some markets, but I haven't found it yet).  I highly recommend ICE.

This stuff is great! I've had the black raspberry (really great), the pomegranate (pretty good), and the lime (not the best). Orange is definitely my favorite though. I've been trying to drink less pop, and after trying a few alternatives, this is probably what I'm going to settle on. Only complaint would be the Splenda (trying to avoid that as well), but until I can get straight down to water, this is the next best thing. It seriously tastes great, try it out.UPDATE: Ok, seriously Amazon...when are you getting this back in stock? It's been out for almost a month now...
Very, very good.  Try the pink grapefruit for a slightly lighter, true fruit taste.  All of the Sparkling Ice flavors are far better than any other similar drink I have tried.

I fell in love with this when they used to sell it at Costco. Then Costco started carrying a different brand, which was not even very good, so I shop at Costco a lot less nowadays. I'm so happy that I can at least order this on Amazon, though I would love to just pick up at my local grocery. Tastes great & No Cal!

column9: Something good for you that tastes good, too!
column10: I love all the flavors of this water, but I think this might be my favorite.  So refreshing.  Great stuff and love that it's carbonated.
I love this stuff.  My local jewel stopped carrying it -I am not sure why-it seemed to sell.  Glad I can still get it.

column4: Lingering Lethal Poisonous Lene of Death
column10: I got this on a lightning deal, not knowing anything about it. I was pleasantly surprised. The taste is strong, and you can taste both the orange and the mango. I wish I could buy it with only orange taste, but I can live with this. I would recommend drinking this cold, it's less refreshing warm.I have purchased a variety pack to see if I will like the other tastes.

I tried the Lemon-Lime and is was ok but when I tried the Mango, it tasted ok but as I swallowed it, it began to burn all the way down my throat and into my stomach.  I did not have this problem with the other flavor and my husband did not have a problem with the Mango he drank.  Perhaps it was a bad bottle.  It has been over a week and with eating very bland light meals, my throat is finally feeling close to normal.  I'm sure this is a good product, I must have gotten a bad bottle.

column9: currently has maltodextrin in it, so it's negative despite its great taste
column10: It is too bad this very tasty, refreshing sparkling water has maltodextrin in it.  If you are sensitive to maltodextrin, this isn't for you.  Maybe the manufacturer will sweeten with something less negative.Ingredients on the label are currently:Carbonated mountain spring water,Orange juice concentrate,Citric acid,Natural flavors,Potassium benzoate,Gum Arabic,Sucralose,Green tea extract,Ester gum,Biotin 1% Trit (maltodextrin)Yellow #6,D Calcium pantothenate,(B5)Yellow #5,Vitamin B12,Mannitol,Vitamin D3,Pyridoxine HCL. (B6).......If you are sensitive to:Maltodextrin and artificial colors,  then this product, in spite of its refreshing taste, isn't for you...one can always hope that other coloring agents, and sweetening agents, will be put into this by the manufacturer.Genuinely sorry to have to point  out about the maltodextrin, about which you can find info on the internet; maltodextrin is cropping up in everything these days, but is considered to have negative effects...  There are other sweeteners...good luck with this...

column9: Fine if you like artificial sweet!
column10: This product, though sounds great, is VERY sweet and does not have the thirst quenching ability that other drinks on the market have.  I have to admit I am not in to the artificial sweetners now, so this was an immediate turn off for me.  Plus, I am use to drinking a product with no sweetner, only natural.  So for me....this was a big NO.

I mix three Sparking ICE Spring Water, Orange Mango, 17-ounce bottles with a single 51oz bottle of Highland Spring Water used for brewing 12 bags of Green Tea (extending what is already an ingredient in this drink, Green Tea). I then replace the water lost in the discarded tea bags with Lakewood PURE Lemon Juice. Yum! Now, they are great straight as well. NOTE: an 18-bottle pack of mixed flavors is available from Costco for just $9.99. BTW, the subscribe and save option doesn't work (I've only ever gotten excuses and never any product).

column9: Love this - zero calories and tasty!
column10: This is my new favorite go-to carbonated beverage.  It does have a super fake-sugar aftertaste, so that's always a plus for me.  So far, I have only tried the orange-mango flavor, but I also ordered the strawberry kiwi, seeing as I love this one so much!  To top it off, the shipping on this was extremely fast!

column9: WATCH OUT instant STOMACH ACHE from this water!!!
column10: I so wanted to love this... like the flavor and zero calories - what could be better, but oh! the instant stomach ache is NOT worth it. Drank it for three days before I made the connection between the water and the constant feeling of bloating and pain in my stomach. Soda does not do this to me, so I'm not sure if it's the fake sugar or what, but consumer BEWARE!

column9: Best of the Belgian Machine-made Chocolates
column10: Introduced to Leonidas several years ago, on successive trips to Brussels I returned with the two other, more well-known brands (Godiva and Neuhaus), when I couldn't get to Leonidas before my plane left. My wife advised me that in the future it was Leonidas or nothing.They are machine-made so the price is not bad (as opposed to the hand-made varieties), but they are also made fresh without preservatives so they need to be eaten or refrigerated quickly. In this house, the refrigerator rarely sees the package.They are excellent and a treat you owe yourself.

We have lived in Belgium for 8 of the last 24 months.  There is no question that the cheapest Belgian chocolate is better than anything you can buy in America.  It is tough for us to gag down American chocolate anymore.  They grind the cocoa beans finer and use less fat and less sugar, so it is much better for you. I am diabetic and it does not send my sugars up.Belgians have very strong opinions when it comes to which chocolate is "best".  They don't always agree, but more Belgians said Leonida's was the best than any other single brand we heard.  This is not something you eat. You savor and treasure every piece.  The price is good and you will not be disappointed.

column9: Best chocolate I've had in many years!
column10: I had an excellent shopping experience with Leonidas. From my experience, I can assure you that if you ever have any problem, Leonidas will be courteous and considerate in dealing with you. As for the chocolate, my husband and I are very fond of dark chocolate and have tried many brands before. We found Leonidas ideally bittersweet in its taste and also generous in quantity. In fact, the best of all the European brands we've tried in our five years of dating. It's the kind of chocolate that you not only would buy for gifts but would also want to buy and keep for your snack.

If it is possible to fall madly in love with a box of chocolates, then the assortment is the perfect place to start such an adventure. These chocolate are named after Leonidas Kestekidis, who definitely knew how to create chocolates for the true chocolate connoisseur.When he moved back to Belgium he not only married his true love, he created chocolates the world now adores. When you taste these chocolates, your taste buds will also finally know true chocolate happiness. Whether you try one of these with a cup of coffee or tea or enjoy one as a daily indulgence, these will impress.If being "in love" gives you a zest for life, then the "I Love You" chocolate with dreamy lemon filling embodies this sentiment. Each chocolate has a unique design and the I Love You chocolate has two hearts, ribbons and a seal. After you sample the variety of chocolates, specific flavors will stand out as favorites.Here are my favorite creamy fillings (ganache and butter cream) which come in dark, white and milk chocolate depending on the selection (dark if you order this box):Antoinette - A smooth Brandy flavored ganacheLingoit Lait - Absolutely delicious vanilla flavored fresh butter cream filling. Time definitely stopped while tasting this chocolate.Irrésistible - Dark chocolate and Strawberry sauce.For ever - If you love coffee this may be one of the most delicious milk or dark chocolate chocolates ever made as it is filled with a special coffee cream that has hints of caramel. I ordered an entire box of these and they come in a variety of flavors. The milk chocolate and cherry filling is like Claude Debussy's Rêverie. It is difficult to describe besides saying it is like a delicate cherry icing wrapped in milk chocolate.Merveilleux - Milk or dark chocolate filled with coffee ganache.Europe - Dark or milk chocolate filled with rum filling.Ganache - Milk or dark chocolate with pure ganache.Tosca - Milk chocolate with a special ganache.Poésie - Dark chocolate and a Cointreau filling.Antoinette - Delicate caramel hints in the milk chocolate coating mingle nicely with the vanilla filling.Eve - Milk or dark chocolate with a creamy dreamy banana filling.Alexandre le grand - A milk or dark chocolate with caramel cream.Also Recommended:If you wish to also try the Napolitains, I'd suggest the 1 pound sampler Ballotin with six varieties. You may also want to look for the new Palet d'Or. A deeply delicious and strong bitter chocolate filled with ganache. The center is made with butter, cream and chocolate and the outer coating is a masterpiece with gold decorations.Leonidas now has over 1700 stores and sales locations worldwide and they offer over 80 varieties of fresh chocolates. The chocolates are air freighted weekly from Brussels so you will always find the quality to be superior.My chocolates arrived fast and were as fresh as if I had purchased them in Belgium. They were carefully packaged in the famous gold boxes with signature/seasonal wrapping and a ribbon. The boxes were then placed in protective Styrofoam containers to protect the chocolates during shipping. The expedited shipping is recommended from May to early September.~The Rebecca Review
It was much better than I thought it would be for the price, a true value in chocolate. Outstanding shipping as well. I enjoyed it so much that I ordered more for holiday gifts ...
I purchased these for my dark chocolate fan (hubby), and he said that it was excellent candy. "They have nice texture, rich and delicious"!!! says the hubby. "Definatly a five star candy".

column9: This was a great gift for a party!
column10: This was a great gift for a party. The dark chocolate is not bitter like many others. I've had many different types of chocolate from Belgium and all over, and can guarantee that Leonidas is the best af all of chocolatiers. Great sampling of ivory, milk and dark chocolate. If you love chocolate try it. You will not regret it.

Through no fault of Leonidas there was a delay in the delivery of chocolates to my sister for Christmas, Leonidas was fully responsive in covering the order as quickly as possible. I am told the choclates are delicious!

This chocolate is so, so very good. Really. And it was delivered super fast in a protected container. The variety and utter wonderfulness of the chocolate itself, however, causes immediate addiction. So beware!
Unfortunately I never had a chance to try these chocolates. However, I sens them to my boss and my uncle just a few days back and both of them said, these are GREAT!

I recently bought this item for a friend whom I rarely get to see because we live far away from one another.  Her birthday was coming right up, and I found out from another friend that she loved dark chocolate.  Amazon.com shipped the item very quickly.  I had been contemplating sending the item with expedited service, but ended up assuming my friend wouldn't care one way or the other if the item arrived on time for her birthday.  In fact, the item showed up just two days later, ON TIME for her birthday, when I had just paid for standard delivery.  My friend immediately sent me a very excited e-mail thanking me for the present, and said that she loved it.  Thanks, amazon!

It's plain and simple....my wife goes "ga ga" over these chocolates. For a beautiful 5' 4" 115 pound woman...she has devoured almost 5 pounds of these delicacies over the past few months.For the Love of Chocolate...Thank goodness for Leonidas!!!
A generous assortment of dark chocolates; each rich and tasty. An excellent buy. Just pace yourself when eating and share with others.

i have to disagree with the reviewer who said these are not as good as godiva - no disrespect to godiva chocolates, i enjoy them, but imho these bury godiva or any other dark chocolate i have ever had.  i treat my self to 1/night.  great chocolate!
This was a Christmas gift for my husband.  He says its one of his best gifts ever; every evening he looks forward to "rewarding" himself with one of these chocolates.

Finding a gift for a son in law is not easy.  So often I think the shirt I sent or the gloves or scarves got filed away without enthusiasm even though I always received a grateful note.  The chocolates prompted an immediate phone call and a "wow."  My recipient and I were thrilled.

Let me first say, I have never written a review on amazon.  I didn't even buy my chocolate from amazon but from the the Leonidas website directly.  It is phenominal.  It is delicious.  It is the best chocolate ever!  The dark chocolate assortment is my favorite.  The fillings are like little clouds of deliciousnesss!These chocolates are so good, I sought out a place to rave about them.

column9: This will keep your mother in law happy
column10: This is a cheap price to score some points.  It comes in a box that you get to unwrap and untie the bow. This chocolate is the best ever and after tasting and finishing off the entire box we couldn't wait to get another. That will have to wait though for the price but it was worth what we paid. Do yourself a favor and pay the price just to try it out. I really didn't know much about this type of chocolate and took a chance and got a box. This was a Christmas present for my wife but after all the good stuff we read we had to break into it a month early. I thought to myself how much differently could this really taste than the American chocolate I am used to.

Yes, twin brother Keith sent his twin sister, Cheryl, Leonidas Belgian chocolate for her birthday, in a heart-warming act of sibling sentiment. It seemed to work extremely well, as his twin noted an unassailable urge to consume the entire box, ruining her fitness regime for many weeks. Keith plans to write an extremely positive review about his clever and thoughtful gift, which apparently hit the spot. Stay tuned for his final installment.

I really didn't know much about this type of chocolate and took a chance and got a box.  This was a Christmas present for my wife but after all the good stuff we read we had to break into it a month early.  I thought to myself how much differently could this really taste than the American chocolate I am used to.  It comes in a box that you get to unwrap and untie the bow.  This chocolate is the best ever and after tasting and finishing off the entire box we couldn't wait to get another.  That will have to wait though for the price but it was worth what we paid.  Do yourself a favor and pay the price just to try it out.

This year we ordered these dark chocolates and also bought a package of dark chocolates from Godiva. The Godiva dark chocolate box is $36 for 10.5 oz. (really, it's on their website). These are the same price for a full pound. And they come from Belgium, where people are very fussy about chocolates, and proud of their chocolates. It is not just the price. The taste difference is amazing. These are the real thing, a pleasure from first to last. We lived in France, where chocolate shops abound, and Leonidas was quite competitive against the artisan shops.

I ordered these for a friend who had travelled extensively in Europe and loves dark chocolate.  These arrived fresh, on time, and in perfect shape.  She was impressed with the packaging and said that she'd had dark chocolates in Belgium but these were the best she'd ever had.  Thanks, Leonidas and Amazon!  I'm very satisfied with this order.

I ordered a box of these chocolates as a part of my girlfriend's Christmas present. When they arrived they were a bit battered, but still taste great.I emailed the seller, not for a replacement, but just to say that the chocolates were really good but the packaging left a bit to be desired.The seller over nighted a replacement box to us. Great customer service, and very enjoyable chocolates. I will definitely buy from them again !Thank you !

Leonidas is some of the best chocolate in the world, and this is a very good way to get it.  They ship overnight, so it arrives fresh.  It is not shipped in any special insulation beyond a hefty Styrofoam insert that holds the chocolates inside the shipping box, so you definitely want to order this during the cool months--I'm sure it will melt en route during the summer.

I give these chocolates to others for special occasions as gifts. They have never let me down. When you say Belgium, I say Leonidas. Dark chocolate can be an aquired taste, to know what is good. This dark chocolate is superb! In bars you can tell the crisp fresh break of quailty dark chocolate and the aroma and the taste. These creams just blend their ingredients with the dark chocolate to create an exquisite taste. Bottom line, They don't skimp on the ingredients and as long as they don't, I will continue to buy their products. The packaging is great because it comes gift wrapped already. I would like to see how its made and the people who make it.Cheaper than a ticket to Belgium and always delivered fresh!

column9: My brother in law got these for me
column10: My brother in law got these for me.  He instantly rose in esteem.  These are by far the best chocolates on the market in the U.S.  Godiva seems like Hersheys in comparison.  I was used to to mixed Leonidas collection (white and mild), but the dark chocolate is heaven and even better.

These chocolates are very tasty, and maybe I just don't have that discerning a palate, but they seem awfully expensive for what you get.  Most were very good, but some were so so and a few were downright disappointing.
great present for my dad, who is a dark chocolate-aholic.  he loved them.  arrived quickly and in great shape.  would buy again.

I Googled best dark chocolate and Leonidas was among the results. Their wonderful, personal touch customer service (rectified a delivery problem immediately) and the BEST dark chocolate I've tasted (as a dedicated, life long chocolate snob) make Leonidas Belgian chocolates a keeper. column9: A solid, stately flower that needs a little attention . . . at a great price
column10: Tulips are clever.  You can arrange them just so in a vase and find out next day that half of them are sprawling over the lip of the vase, possibly even getting entangled.  They're not fatigued -- they just have a tendency to follow the light.  Tulips are not only heliotropic (following the sun's arc when possible) but phototrophic (they keep growing under almost any kind of available light).When I received my most recent bouquet of 30 tulips from ProFlowers on May 17, 2012, I followed Amazon's instructions and clipped a small amount from each stem (diagonally under running water is a good idea) and let them soak up cold water for eight hours in the plastic collar designed to keep them bunched tightly.  Then I retrimmed them and put them in a vase with floral preserver.  Had I wanted to keep them standing straight up I would have kept the bottom string tied and used a smaller vase (see below).There are also plenty of vids and information sites on the web about these slightly tricky but very rewarding blooms.  Click on the ProFlowers homepage under "Flower Care" for verbal instructions.  This time, through LOTS of online shopping I was able to get the 30 tulips plus the pictured trumpetlike "amethyst" vase* (which really is purple, despite the photographic process showing blue) and a small box of chocolates (only eight pieces, but they were delicious) at just under forty dollars plus S&H direct from ProFlowers.  (*You will probably just get a clear glass vase.)I am basically satisfied but cannot give this bouquet five full stars because:.  In this particular case the tulips consisted of eight red-and-yellow tulips (which I later learned are called "Flair"), with most of the rest white or pale pink.  This is fine, but the Flairs were running about a day or two ahead of the rest, bloom-wise.  There should have been better synchronization (tulips are not as long-lived as, say, ProFlowers' own roses or Peruvian Lilies).  I have appended a photo of how they looked on the second day..  Despite my every Internet order saying "Carrier: Please Ring Bell!"  FedEx left these at the door at 9:35 a.m. without ringing.  We were home.  How hard is it to press a button?  IMO this is the source of a lot of one-star ratings of ProFlowers deliveries -- the product being left for too long in extreme heat or cold -- and ProFlowers should really address this issue.If you want an economical bouquet that needs lots of water initially but opens up slowly and lasts a long time (I have a two-week-old bouquet on my bookcase as I write this and it it just now time to 'pull the plug'), try ProFlowers' Peruvian Lilies.

column9: Starbucks comes to Keurig at last!
column10: Partisans of Starbucks coffee have been waiting a long time for it to be released in the K-cup delivery system.  Coffee drinkers who like the Starbucks approach to dark roasting will not be disappointed.  The brew is strong but not bitter, slightly smokey but not excessively so, and with a pleasant flavor palette that, to me, seems dominated by chocolate.I've been a coffee fanatic all my life.  Many coffee fanatics take delight in denouncing Starbucks for a variety of reasons, some valid, some mere pretense.  I'm the first to say that Starbucks is not the best coffee in the world and that the Keurig brewing system does not produce the finest cup.  However--and this is a significant however--when one considers the time saved, the hassle avoided, and the waste eliminated, I find this a very satisfactory way to produce a fresh cup when I don't have time to fire up my grinder and brew the in the conventional way.I won't give up my freshly roasted beans, my dripper pot, or my grinder but I will certainly drink--and enjoy--Starbucks K-cups when the time is just not right for a meticulously hand-crafted pot.

column9: Two hours on the couch unable to move later...
column10: I had seen ghost chile's all over tv so being a hot food fanatic I had to buy some. I was not disappointed. I blended them up and put some in a hot sauce and it had a perfect heat. But unless it's with a lot of other flavors and cooked they are KILLER. I just chopped one up and put it in an omelete. column9: On those youtube videos, they aren't exaggerating!
column10: First of all, I am not really into all that really hot, spicy food. Some spiciness is alright, but bland food is fine with me. Here at the house we were watching some funny videos on youtube, people eating these, and after some talking about it, I bought this 15-pack, and I have to say, the people in the videos weren't trying to be funny; this stuff is unreal!If you just hold it by the stem and bite a piece off, you'd better have a butt-load of bread and dairy products on hand, because the experience is something you'd never expect. I chewed it on the left side of my mouth, and quickly felt like there was a blow-torch searing my tongue and inner cheek. It took my breath away for a moment, and I lost my voice. Then my throat started to burn, and I could feel the heat radiating from inside my body. I drank some 1% lowfat and then got the cold sweats. It definitely is a different experience.So if you want to make your prepared foods with an extra punch, or are just into some college-hazing type pranks, this is doubtless something to consider. It's amazing that something this volatile is even edible.

column9: fast shipping and hot hot peppers!!!
column10: Very fast shipping! Product was exactly as described. Im new to jolokias and these have me hooked. I received them monday and today (wednesday) they are all gone! grind them up in a blender and sprinkle them over your food and hold on! i will definitely be buying more of these very soon!

Peppers are like a box of chocolates, you never know what you are going to get. Every pepper is different. I can tell you the bright red ones are the hottest. The orange ones are about as hot as a habenero. But if you want the full effect, eat a bright red one and chew it for 30seconds - 1 minute then swallow. Do not wash it down until after you swallow it. By doing this the heat stays in your mouth and not so much in your stomach and you wont get sick. The red ones are also very fruity tasting. It is quite good until your taste buds disintegrate from the intense heat. Your ears will then feel like they are bleeding. Then when the heat hits its highest point and you cant take it anymore...it starts getting hotter. I ate 2 of them before I got a hot one. About an hour later the heat is gone, but your entire body feels like hell. The effects are completely gone about 3 hours later. Thats if you get a really hot one and follow these instructions. But like I said, every pepper is different. Overall very satisfied for the price. I just chopped a half of one up and seared them in a pan with 2 chicken breasts and it was delicious.

These were HOT HOT HOT HOT HOT OMG! I got these to make salsa for others, and my brother tried a pod straigh. I was ROLLING on the floor, it was so funny watching his reaction. I wouldn't dare eat one straight though. The salsa I made..my mouth was on FIRE. Love these! Will order again

column9: Good Value For Home Gelatin Desserts/Snacks
column10: This bundle is a good value for the home consumer if you are not frightened away by the package size. Each bag contains 24 oz. of gelatin mix, and, if you read the directions, makes a bit over a gallon of prepared gelatin. That is too much, at one time, for the average family (unless you are having a party!)If you keep the unused portion in a zip-lock bag, you should have no problem storing the left-over gelatin mix.Here is the recipe I use for home preparation:Place 3/4 cup of the gelatin mix in a large bowl (at least 1 1/2 quart size.)Add 2 cups boiling water (allow the water to come to a full boil.)Stir until the gelatin is completely dissolved (about 2 minutes.)Add 12 large ice cubes and stir until all the ice has melted.Refrigerate until firm. (Typically 3 - 4 hours)(Alternately, you can stir in 1 1/4 cups cold water in place of ice cubes, but it will take longer for the gelatin to set.)This recipe will make about a quart of prepared gelatin.

Found apple nectar in an Asian grocery once and tried it. It was another brand and it had the taste of squished apple seeds in it...you know, the bitter taste. Tully's Kona is a wonderfully smooth coffee.  Kona coffee in general is outstanding.  If you have never had Kona coffee, you must simply try this K-Cup.  Tully's Kona coffee gives you a bit more robust flavor than a Columbian coffee, without the bitterness of a darker or more bold coffee.  It is smooth and tasty.

I picked this coffee up at a local store where I found it on the clearance rack.  I wasn't too sure if it would be any good since being on the clearance rack usually means "old" and "not too good".  However, after enjoying a cup of Tully's Kona blend I'm confused.  The coffee flavor was exactly what I would expect from a Kona blend: smooth, mellow delicious coffee without the bitterness of Columbian coffees.  It had a great aroma.  The k-cups keeps the coffee fresh, so, even though it's pushing it's "sell by" date, it tastes like the beans were freshly ground.If you expect this to be just as good as the Kona you got during that Hawaiian vacation, lower your expectations just a little.  This coffee is really good, but it is still a blend.
I have been drinking Kona for many years, paying up to $30.00 for 12 oz. The Tullys kona blend is as good as any kona coffee out there. The kcup is the best invention for the coffee drinker.

column9: The new Kona Blend is horrible.

I used to grill mys steaks and use my own spices from scratch. When my friends would come over for a cook out they would ask what I was using and I wouldn't tell them, pretending it was a secret. Then, one day, I went to my friend's cook out and I swear I tasted my own steaks. When I told him that he just laughed and threw me the bottle of Montreal Steak spice. The coarse salt, black and red pepper, garlic, sunflower oil, and paprika were the spices that is in this bottle that I used all the time.  I was actually happy that someone came up with the idea to pre mix all of these spices because it really is a time saver. This really gives steaks, burgers, chicken, and even potatoes a little bit of zest to the flavor. I have also tried the spicy version, but nothing beats the original recipe. Just wish I would have bottled it first. Great product!

column9: Burgers, Steaks, Chicken + Mccormick Montreal Seasoning = Amazing
column10: Mccormick Montreal seasoning is one of the simplest, best tasting, and versatile seasoning on the planet for virtually any meat. It's awesome on burgers and steaks, but it's also very good on chicken, vegetable kabobs, pork chops, and virtually any other meat. I mix it with soy sauce for burgers, and consistently get asked by my guests what the secret is. They can't believe it when I tell them how simple it is! I also use this in the broiler with a little olive oil with great results.There are few ready made seasonings that I will use when I grill (I prefer to use homemade dry rubs or marinades) and this is one of them. It is the best of the best, and I can heartily recommend it for grilling.

I first came across this product watching one of Rachael Ray's "30 Minute Meal" shows. I thought the recipe was nice, so I picked up a container of McCormick's Montreal Steak seasoning.  And I've continued to use it since.It is especially nice when grilling, as its placement in the "Grill Mates" line would suggest. I use it on hamburgers, on steaks, and on pork when I grill out.  I also will use it when baking or frying such meats inside.It adds a nice little bite to the taste.Components? Coarse salt, spices (such as black and red pepper), garlic, paprika, and sunflower oil. Simple ingredients, but they work well together and end up adding a pleasant taste to whatever one might be cooking.So, I'm a fan and recommend this to those who would like a little something extra on their meat.

I sipped Chardonnay one Saturday as a lone Jiffy Pop package laid relaxed on my counter, waiting for heat. As the evening gave way to night, and the wine found its better home, I found in my moonlit kitchen that I was its suitor. I had fire.Like Chopin finding music, I discovered inspiration that brightened and enlightened my heart. Thoughts of hot corn, popped into a new shape, tickling my tongue, excited me into a rush. Heating the aluminum, shaking it from many angles, I danced, my smile shining up from the polyurethane floor.For a minute, maybe two, nothing, until the first kernel said hello, rebirthing from harsh and hard to kind and soft.The foil rustled softly like a fresh-pressed cotton sundress, as popping corn made its plea of escape. More, then silence. Escape was found with my lacerating finger piercing and pulling open its silver veil. Steam now relieved, I bathed in the scent of butter, until a wispingly swift move delivered me from wanting to eating.Try Jiffy Pop. May you too have fire when the Jiffy Pop needs heat.--Brockeim

column9: An unexpected treasure: Russell's Reserve Rye 6 is a diamond in the rough.
column10: A moderately inexpensive, relatively young, rye whiskey from a mainstream American mass market distiller... yawn... right?  Wrong.  Prepare to be impressed by the smoothest, creamiest, yet most floral, sweet, and interesting rye you've ever tried.A lovely rich golden amber in the glass.  The nose, after extended air (10-20 minutes) is delicate yet rich with honeysuckle, vanilla, lanolin, mineral and some sweetness with a vegetal components - alfalfa treacle?  It's a light and lovely smell that is soothing and yet appetizing.Entry is off-dry (slightly sweet) with dry cereal and a peppery quality that almost feels like the effervescence of soda.  Midpapalate expansion is sweet with rich cereal sugars, oak vanilla floral essences, some sherry toffee notes, and a big dose of cream.  The creaminess carries into the long and elegant finish with more peppery notes balanced by that sweet floral cream, fading into light wood tannins.Lithe, fruity, floral, sweet and kissed with clean oak; Russels 6 takes rye into a sweeter, lighter, more feminine place than I usually experience rye.  I like it...  Wait, I LOVE it.  A quiet and unassuming knock out.

It wasn't until I bought a bag of these when I finally learned what good potato chips taste like. It's sort of like the epiphany you have when you think American cheese is the best cheese you've ever had until you actually try smoked gouda. I know that sounds like an overstatement, but that's how good Herr's Heinz-flavored ketchup chips are. Once you try these, all of your previous favorites will start to pale in comparison."What's so darned great about them?" you are probably wondering. What's gotten everyone in such a tizzy? Why the rave reviews and the almost cult-like devotion to these chips? It's not just because they taste good. It's because Herr's is one of the few snack makers that bucks that shady practice so many of them engage in now, especially Pringles. You know what I mean-- that cute, little trick of advertising their chips as literally bursting with flavor, when in reality the chips are so lightly dusted that there's barely any flavor to them. Herr's philosophy in terms of chip-to-flavor ratio couldn't be more different. Open any one of their snacks-- especially this one-- and the chips are so covered in powder that it's impossible to not have it cake up on your finger tips without constantly cleaning them. These Heinz ketchup flavored chips are so heavily dusted, in fact, that you'll wind up with red-stained fingers for a few hours after gorging on them. It makes for a messy experience but in the end, getting a moutful of flavor with each bite makes the hassle of cleaning up all worthwhile!Sure, this excessive powder doesn't exactly make Herr's the healthiest of snack choices, but what snack is? It's all gonna kill us, anyway, so really-- all this really comes down to is choosing our poison. My poison happens to be these chips, and will most likely be yours once you taste them and subsequently become hopelessly addicted like me.

Glad these chips are available here in the U.S. and uses great flavoring with Heinz brand ketchup. It doesn't have that strong of a overwhelming ketchup flavor on the chips, which is great, reason many of my friends like themIf really want a stronger ketchup flavored taste, I personally recommend get a bottle of Heinz ketchup and dip your ketchup flavored chips into some actual ketchup, like you would with fries.

These are pretty much the best chips i have ever eaten right above hot cheetoes. Try them and then try putting them down. Heinz Ketchup chips are like crystal meth in a bag,.....Its crystal meth in a bag......Heinz ketchup chips is crystal meth!
