This was a wonderful addition for Christmas Tea time. It is not like the usual American fruit cake.  This was  Delicious with Marzipan &  icing on top. The Recipe is as they have used in Europe for many years. Next  year ordering more.

A good rich moist cake, although deceptively small. Walkers are a quality product and this is no exception. As is customary in parts of the UK, this rich cake is complemented if served with a nice mature hard cheese. I will purchase again.
I was really pleased with this product. I had tried grocery store fruit cakes which were terrible. This one was most like the kind my mother used to make.

The icing is a little too thick for my liking and the cake has too much candied fruits that there's barely any cake. I prefer the Bronte brand as it's got slightly less fruit and just the right amount of icing. The cake texture of both brands are about similar (that is, if you can find the cake in the Walkers brand!). I am apt to think that the Bronte brand is just a little more moist although English fruit cakes are aged and not supposed to be that moist anyway.
We use this all the time, soups, chicken, burgers. We always appreciate Organic products, and love that we can purchase them through Amazon.
This seasoning is great!  Cant beat the price for Organic either.  You may want to invest in a holder for the seasoning...

On a trip to the grocery store a few weeks ago I picked up a bag of these Pretzel Crisps in the original flavor to try out, while my mother grabbed a bag in the garlic parmesan flavor. A few days later we each brought our new pretzels to one of my daughters softball games to snack on. As I ate mine, my mother insisted I try hers. Oh wow are these garlic parmesan ones good! It's not even a flavor I would normally have thought I would like, as I tend to like simpler flavors. But these are just so good, even a picky eater like myself love them. So on my next trip to the store I picked up 3 bags for myself and I'm snacking on them now.If you can envision a pretzel that has been rolled out flat with a rolling pin, that's what these are like. You get more of the crispy outside and much less of the white flour center you usually have with pretzels. Because they have a flat design, they even work as crackers. So you can top them with cheese, meats etc and use them with dips, just like you would a cracker, only they taste even better. They are very crispy, but don't crumble or fall apart when trying to eat them. The bags are resealable, and the seal works extremely well. The best part is since they have so much flavor, you can eat just a few and it feels like you've eaten a lot more. Lots of flavor is a smaller package.The nutritional info is:Serving size: 10 crackers/pretzelsFat: 1.5g per servingCalories: 110 per servingCarbs: 22g per servingSodium: 410mg per servingAnd there is a warning that these are made in a facility that processes milk and soy, for those with allergies to them.

column9: Greenies Keep Your Dog's Teeth White
column10: My Italian Greyhound (they're known to have problems with their teeth) is 5 years old.  She eats one greenie a day.  Her vet tells me its rare for an  Italian Greyhound to have great teeth .  She doen't even need to have her teeth professionaly cleaned.  The greenies take care of keeping her teeth clean.  She also loves them.
Tasted a bit stale.  Not nearly as good as the "waffle" cookies that I loved in Europe, but maybe the product was just not as fresh?

column9: Dog Food recommended by Leader Dogs for the Blind
column10: My daughter recently got a Leader Dog for the Blind and while at the training facility, she was informed that this was the primary dog food recommended for all service dogs they train. I purchased this product from PetCo thru Amazon's web site and was pleased with the price and delivery time. I definetly recommend this dog food for any active dog.

I tried so many different foods for our 2yo Siberian Husky, but with every product we tried Boo retained his penchant for clearing rooms with near bio-weapon lethality. This food has saved our lives! (or our noses) if I could give it 6 stars I would. Also our other two dogs love it.

For most of my life I'd eaten two types of pasta "sauce": 1) My mom opened a can of tomato sauce, added a spice or two, poured it on the pasta and said, "eat it - it's good," or 2) When I finally moved out I bought the cheap, store bought pasta sauce - Prego, Ragu, etc. I thought Prego was the best (far superior to the red tomato stuff I had at home), and that there wasn't anything else out there for me to try.Well, I guess that was like thinking that The Olive Garden is the best Italian food restaurant in the world, because one day in a Cost Plus I bought one of these Gia Russa Hot Sicilian pasta sauce jars on a whim while trying out new things. When I tasted it for the first time, it was like a set of revelations - "This is really, really good. I have to get more of this." Then... "Wait - what the hell have I been eating all this time? Prego SUCKS..." Then I started to read the ingredients on my old sauces and I could see why: tomato paste, corn syrup, etc. "No wonder"... Gia Russa is made with just raw food stuffs - actual tomatoes, no sugars/corn syrup, etc. - like you would think all spaghetti sauce should be.Now before I start to sound like a blind fanboy of this product, I'm not saying that this Gia Russa Hot Sicilian is the BEST in the world (I'll never assume that again about any food in a jar.) It may not even be the best Gia Russa sauce (the harder to find Spicy Alla Vodka - the white label with red font - is equally excellent), but this Hot Sicilian IS that far superior to all of the usual mass produced sauces. (Not all of Gia Russa's sauces are great, either.)Also, there's the price - it's 2x-3x the cost of the cheap stuff.With that all said, however, this stuff is worth every extra penny you pay because you get at least 2x-3x the flavor back. Instead of using cheap sauce, I have actually cut back on the amount of pasta I eat simply because I can't afford to eat it the right way - with a real sauce like this.Bottom line: If you've always gone cheap with your pasta "sauces", you HAVE to try this sauce once. Barring a life or death famine situation, I will never eat Prego, or Ragu, or any other cheap sauce ever again. Sauces of this caliber will be my staple from now on.(Notes:* A Wal-Mart near us carries it, and it may well be the best quality product in that entire supercenter.* What else have I been eating that I thought was real food but isn't?)

column9: The only pasta sauce for me.
column10: I discovered the Gia Russa Hot Sicilian sauce when I moved to Ohio and it is the only one I eat.  Any other "spicy" sauce is a wanna-be, imitation! It is perfectly spicy and the tomatoes and herbs make a great symphony of flavor. I have bought this sauce for friends as a gift and advise them to exercise their best judgment when preparing it. The longer it simmers the spicier it gets.  The sauce tastes like a long held family recipe. I have been a loyal customer for 6 years and have since moved out of Ohio. If the makers of this pasta ever read my Amazon.com review please send me a coupon as I empty out the grocer shelves whenever these babies go on sale as it is a pricey item.  Sadly, it's an addiction to deliciousness.
Possibly the worst sauce I've ever tried. No flavor, period. I could have started with pure tomato sauce and done better. I'll never buy this brand again.

I found this at Costco and I can't get enough of it.  A must have in the household just like ketchup and mustard.  I wish my Costco didn't stop selling it.  Why is the shipping so expensive on here?  Amazon prime where are you? :(
I'm very pleased with the Wilton Halloween Nonpareils (5.25 ounce jar).  These were used on cupcakes and cookies and tasted great.  You definitely get your money's worth!

This was final purchase of the ingredients in an effort to duplicate at home the Iced Carmel Macchiato that my wife loves at our favorite Specialty Coffee Store. As it is the exact same product that the store uses, the drink turns out the same as at the store. Success!! And a Happy Wife. Always a good thing.

I found out from a coffee shop I frequent that this is what they use. I use it in my coffee now. I love it....and stopped paying $6 for a coffee everyday. It's also great on ice cream and anything else you want with caramel. Great product!!

I dont know what to say besides the fact that this is the best sauce. I have tried ghirardelli, torani, ect. This one is so smooth and tasty mmmmmm... I make caramel mochiattos with it but it would be delicious on ice cream or any dessert for that matter.

column9: Good saffron for an great price
column10: There's really not much else to say about this - it's an incredible deal when compared to normal retail prices for saffron.  The saffron is good quality and noticeably fresh (the use-by date on mine was three years away) and it's a fraction of the usual cost.  One thing I particularly liked and that isn't made clear by the description is that this product is actually five one-gram boxes and not one five-gram box, so the saffron in the boxes you haven't opened yet will stay fresh longer.  Still, if you only use saffron every once in a while you'd be better off buying a smaller quantity even if you pay a little more by weight; this is a considerable amount of saffron.  I cook with it regularly so it's great for me, I'm very pleased with this purchase.

column9: Good Saffron at a budget that you can afford.
column10: This saffron quality was really good. And it comes in affordable price. 5g is not so small. Saffron is really light weight stuff like cotton. So 5 g is really a lot.
If you need a lot of saffron or want to stock up this is a great value. Grocery stores only offer a couple pinches for $6. This is substantially more.

Will not buy this item again. Although some reviews on Amazon said the saffron was not what they expected. I went along and bought it anyway. I usually buy saffron from Indian stores. This one is not the greatest quality pretty dull color. No smell at all. Will not buy this item ever again!!!!!
This is the fourth time I've ordered this product. I love the smell and taste of saffron-infused dishes and this brand is particularly good. Well worth the cost. Will definitely keep ordering it.
Product arrived in a timely manner, just exactly as described. It tastes like the true Spanish Saffron, completely diffferent than the cheap Mexican type. Well worth the price.
Large quantity for the money and quality threads. Would buy again. Comes in a nice plastic box for storage. Also would be a good gift for friends.
Fresh fresh fresh. This Saffron release very good color and aroma. Long strands. Good quantity and price is also reasonable. I would recommend this product.

column9: A much better deal than the grocery store
column10: I cook a fair amount of Indian food, which requires saffron, a pretty expensive taste! I have been buying my Saffron at the grocery store, for a highwayman's ransom, and was delighted to find this product, packaged in five small plastic boxes, through amazon at a fraction of the cost. The Saffron is great, and I might use the saved money to buy a recipe book with more recipes for this fragrant spice.
The saffron arrived with a strong chemical order. It may have been stored close to insecticides.Cooking did not remove the odor. We decided not to use it.
Another reviewer said she got 5 one gram boxes, I got one 5 gram box, I would have preferred 5 boxes...so be aware you will get one large box of saffron not 5 little ones.

The pass review mentioned that the 5g saffron came in each gram with separated pack and put into one acrylic box. The product I received is all 5g saffron in one plastic bag put inside the acrylic box.

[...]This goes a very long ways.  I bought 8 grams and will be using it for several years.  I made saffron bread with it which I didn't love.  The saffron taste was good, just my bread recipe was maybe the wrong one.  Next time I will use a different recipe.  I haven't used it for tea.

When I ordered this product I was under the impression that there were 5 one gram boxes....In fact, it was stated as so in the first review.When the product came, it was on big plastic clear box with all 5 grams.Let's hope the saffron is good.

Although I still have a bit left (purchased in Turkey), I recently bought 5 grams of 200+ Spanish "Coupe" saffron at Costco for US$21.99Perhaps not quite as good as real (fresh) Iranian Beluga caviar (best thing I have ever tasted), but close.
It's all that they say it is.  I like the product very much.  I made several things and everything came out great.  I will absolutely reorder.  Next time the bigger 25# bag.

We first came across this flour in the fall at a Gluten Free Expo.  After using it, we have become hooked.  We are using it on a regular basis it can be substituted for regular flour and it cooks great.  People don't know they are eating gluten free.
The flour is amazing but the customer service sucks. I have emailed and called the company numerous times with no response.
Domata Living Flour has worked very well in all of our regular recipes that we have used it in.  Cookies, biscuits, whatever, have not needed any adaptation.

I was first introduced to this GF flour at a local GF Expo in Oct 2011.  A free 4-lb. bag!  It was like winning a small GF lottery.  I used almost all of it in my baked goods.  It wasn't my favorite but it was still good.  I'm glad I didn't buy more.  See [...]  I haven't contacted Domata about the claims of dangerous potassium sulfide used in their flour but, I intend to do some research before I buy anything from them.  Please do some research before you buy and post your review here.  Thanks!

I love this flour a lot. I use it for everything except breading and pancakes. I use a different blend for that. But the biscuits? OMG - AH-MAZING! It's the recipe off their website, Tennessee Cat Head Biscuits. Really really fluffy and are a great alternative to those morning biscuits I used to love so much before being dx with celiac. I use it for cookies, muffins, cakes, etc.

I've been buying fruit cocktail in 8 oz cans and while it's good if you close your eyes the fruit tastes the same....probably from the canning process.I was browsing the fruit section on Amazon and noticed these because they are an 8 ounce portion which is double the little 4 ounce ones. The fruit is in large segments and a fantastic orange flavor. Polar advised me they are shelf stable (no refrigeration) if stored in a cool locaation for up to a year. Believe me, these are so-o-o good they won't last that long. A bit on the expensive side but really worth it.

column9: love this wild rice just use at least 3-3 1/2 water:1 part rice
column10: I love this rice, I cook it in a rice cooker, I found that using at least 3 parts water, or 3 1/2 parts to one part rice is the way to go. Add a little sea salt, and a little Ghee, it's great.PS wild rice is a seed actually, very nutricious

column9: Huge shipping errors and Customer Service in India
column10: I ordered this as a case of 40. I got 1 envelope. The customer service is in India and they don't understand much. They kept insisting that my one envelope was a case. Silly them. It took several phone calls over a couple of weeks since I placed the order and now I have my gatorade but it came in multiple flavors that I don't want and a different package size that I don't want. Cest la vie, eh? I will never order from them again.

column9: My finicky felines were won over by Aristocats!
column10: I tried to turn on my older cat, an 8-year-old Siamese, to wet food several years ago, because I believe a balanced wet-dry diet is best for cats. I gave him a couple flavors of Fancy Feast, which he tried a couple bites of, the first couple nights; then the novelty wore off and he rejected it outright. So I gave up on him... However, recently I got a new kitten, and decided to try wet food on him. So I bought a couple cans of the Aristocats brand, on sale for 39 cents each. At first, the kitten had no interest in it - but ironically, the older cat did! He loves the stuff and begs for it as a treat in the mornings and evenings. The kitten saw his "big brother" enjoying the Aristocats so much, he started eating it, too. So now both of my "boys" are getting some wet food in their diet, and loving it. I bought the 24-can pack, once their enjoyment of the Aristocats brand was established, and am now well set for a while with wet food for them. I am very happy with the product and recommend it highly for owners of finicky cats who might not have eaten other brands of canned cat food.

column9: Cat was allergic to something in it.
column10: Normally we feed our cat a popular store brand that is more expensive than Disney's Aristocats but we thought we'd save a little money and give it a try.  Within a few days, our cat's lips were swollen and red and she developed lesion like scabs on her neck and face.  It took us a few days to think of the new cat food and when we went back to her old, it was almost an immediate improvement.

We have been a kitten rescue foster home for years, and it wasn't until just recently that I discovered this cat food.  We buy the seafood box of 24 cans, and our kittens have learned to eat very early in their lives.  We have bottlefed up to 21 kittens at a time, a chore when they are hungry all the time.  At age three weeks, we start with this food, continue bottle-feeding unti they self-wean,and add dry (Iams Kitten) around five or six weeks.  The only drawback is feeding ten or eleven kittens each day, as I go through a case of 24 cans every other day. Sure wish they'd make it in larger doses!  Otherwise, our kittens fly out the door at Adoption Days, and are wonderful pets.  Thanks to Disney for this product!

We have been gluten free for over 2 years.  It is difficult to find a bun that doesn't fall apart or that doesn't taste bad.  Udi's delivers on this product.  They taste great, hold up while eating, and are even better toasted.  I would recommend this product to anyone that is gluten free.

These are coarse, grainy and a poor substitute for the real thing.  I finally found Schar rolls which a cut in-half & toast. Excellent texture & taste! & their smaller size makes for good portion control.
Buns arrived quickly. They were fresh! This was important to me because a previous order I placed with UDI'S wasn't either of those. My thanks to the seller for making my 4th of July!!

Usually, I'm forced to put my burger on a plate when I go to a cookout. Now, I am bringing the buns! A considerate friend who knew that I was gluten-free bought these buns for her cookout yesterday and it was awesome to eat a burger on a bun like everyone else. Some gluten-free breads taste like cardboard but this one did not. I didn't even have to toast it.

column9: THE BEST POP IN THE WORLD
column10: This stuff is GREAT like sweet fizzy apple juice. Good with Tequila too. HIGHLY RECOMMEND !

column9: Taste is delicious, but shop around
column10: There seems to be some price gauging online with this. If you live near a mexican grocer its more than 50% lower in price for a 1.5 litre.  GREAT soda though.  Green apple is just as good, too.

Recently I made yet another stop at JIM'S APPLE FARM (just south of Jordan, MN), and this time I found this wonderful apple flavored soda made in Mexico.  In essence, it tastes like a very light apple juice that has been sweetened with cane sugar and carbonated.  Simply put, it's a good product!  According to information that I've read, this product was first introduced to U.S. markets in the late 1980's.  However, at least in this part of the country, it hasn't made much of an impact.  Now that I've been introduced to this beverage, I'll be keeping an eye out for it.  I highly recommend giving it a try.
This tastes awesome. And I agree about the pricing online. That doesnt take away fromt he fact that this soda tastes amazing. I also like to collect the bottles.

You will never go back to drinking another soda again.But if you want to buy this for $1.50 just go to any hispanic store.They have these everywhere. $4.00 seems a bit much for something you're going to enjoy every day.

I can't quite describe the taste of this soda, but I'll try. It's fizzy and apply, and it kind of reminds me of Dr. Pepper a little bit, except it's lighter in flavor. It's just really, really good and refreshing. And it is made with real apple juice and cane sugar, so there's that too. If you get an opportunity to try it, do so. It's good!

column9: I  wanted  to  try  this  drink  after  watching  Semi  Pro. Try  it,  and  it  was  soo  good
column10: The  night  I  went  to  see  Semi  Pro  in  the  theather  like  opening  weekend.  The  scean  where  the  NBA  Commensor  and  his  family  are  gathering  around  the  TV  set  to  watch  The  Tropic game,  and  they  go  to  commerical.  The  commerical  they  were  watching  was  for  Sidral  Mundet  apple  soda. But  after  waching that  movie  with  that  commerical. I  really  wanted  try  that  soda  to  see  if  it  was  any  good. None  of  the  groccery  store  near  by  where  I  live  don't  have  it  anymore. So  if  you  love  apple  made  into  any  apple  product  like  pies  and  butter. Then  this  is  the  drink  for  you. Just  beware  that  this  product  is  brewed  in  Mexico. But  I  get  this  again  every  fall  to  stock  up  for  my  halloween  party

Rustic crust pizza shells are quick and easy to make, yet have great flavor and texture, and hold up well to a vast quantity of toppings.  I like to keep a supply in the freezer and throw on a bit of cheese and whatever we have in the veggie drawer.

column9: Hard to find item but good
column10: Good price for this hard to find candy.  Tastes just like it used to. Personally I like the pink ones better though .Shipping was quick.

My cat loves him some shrimp.  Imagine his and my face when we opened the shrimp tube and saw shrimp dust.  Little guy couldn't eat the dust without inhaling or blowing.  Keep thy feline off the drugs and say no to this product, it can only be snorted.. Total waste.

column9: My dogs fly when they hear me open the package!
column10: I have chihuahuas so we need smaller treats.  One is losing her teeth and she is still able to eat these treats because they are soft.  They are also easy to break in two, since I give them each just half of biscuit as a treat.I appreciate the quality of ingredients and that they are made in the USA.  If you've ever researched the ingredients in most pet foods and treats, you'll understand why this matters.  The resealable package helps keep them fresh.  The dogs know the sound of the bag opening and they go nuts!

To say my dog loves these is a huge understatement. She knows the sound of the bag now and will sit staring intently and can barely contain herself when she sees someone getting one out. As soon as the bag opens her little nose starts twitching like crazy.  She is not like this with many treats! We call them "peanut butter men" and she now knows them by name. I'm tempted to try one myself to see what all the fuss is about. And they are made in the U.S.A!

I started training my puppy with these and he absolutely loves them. I bought some other treats from the pet store but my puppy does not like them. Since my puppy is a small breed I cut each treat into four. Every time my puppy sees the treat bag he starts barking and gets so really excited I am curious on trying a treat myself.

Great product for walking the dog! I walk my Benny for hour a day and put four in my pocket and when he jumps over a stump I always give one! He loves all the flavors but peanut butter is the favorite and they are chewy and not crispy like how some dogs do not like baked or crispy snack. 4 bags for a good price and last a long time it seems! Great treats for your dog and great for training and quick rewards.

This a a great product and the best deal online!  I have been feeding my dogs these treats for over a year and they love them.  The price is the best I have found yet and they show up right to my door! Huge savings! Love Amazon!

Our dog is quite picky when it comes to her treats.  I was thrilled to find a treat for her with decent nutrition, no red food coloring AND she would eat.Great for stuffing into Kongs because they are soft.Perfect for training, I can break one treat into several small morsels.  As opposed to dry hard treats that crumble. So far we have tried the chicken flavor and Peanut butter, both winners!

column9: My Dog Would Kill You For One
column10: I originally bought these in a local pet shop only to find them on Amazon.com later at a much better price!  They were strongly recommended by many dog owners at the local dog park.  My dog loves em, their dogs love em... they're freaking awesome.  You should buy these for your dog and give your dog at least 5 a day.

These are one of the few treats my dog loves that are not bad for him. It's like semi-healthy junk food for dogs. Alot of the other treats you have to be careful about. Some are made in China from sawdust and flavored with beef and chicken broth. Beware of ANYTHING mande in China. ANYTHING!!!  Do your homework before buying treats and other things for your pets!!!

column9: Cloud Star Soft & Chewy Buddy Biscuits from Amazon
column10: I received the first order from Amazon and the biscuits were so dried out that I couldn't even crumble them.  They sent me a replacement order and it was still very dry.  I could, with great difficulty, crumble them for my older dog but I doubt that I will try getting them through Amazon again.  When the biscuits are fresh, they are terrific for small or older dogs.

I bought these thru warehouse deals and they seem soft and smell good for dog treats so I cannot really tell if they were old.  The expiration isn't until the end of the year.  I have two golden retrievers and they seemed to like these.  To me the only drawback is they are very small; about an inch, inch and a quarter tall so when I give these to my dogs, I have to give them two or three at a time.  I guess I am use to bigger treats for biggers dogs.  Either way, the price was reasonable and they do like them so I am pleased and I think so are the dogs.
Amazing price but for some reason the peanut butter treats are a bit hard/stale. My pup doesn't notice but I bought two other varieties and they are noticeably softer.
I love the fact that these treats are made with wholesome, natural ingredients and MADE IN THE USA!  Plus, my dog absolutely loves these!  What more can I say?!

column9: My pup will do anything for one.
column10: My Wheaten/Poodle, Rahn, loves these miniature gingerbread men. About one inch tall, they're soft and crumble a bit. To make one treat last for at least "sit, down, and play dead," I'll break up the gingerbread into a few pieces. Otherwise, these treats will go quick! A pack of 4 is almost necessary since Rahn seems to think they are absolutely delicious. You can also buy one pack at Target for about $3.99.

These treats have helped us through the training process with our 9 month old husky mix. They are easy to break up into smaller pieces, and she loves the flavor. She can chew the small pieces pretty quickly too. For the price, its a nice treat to mix in so they don't get bored with the same old Kibble.
My dogs love these little treats.  As other people have said, they smell strongly, but in a good way.  I like that they are easy to break apart into training sized portions.
Since my dogs like smelly treats these work well to get their attention while training them. They don't have an offensive odor but do smell meatier than dry treats so my dogs prefer them.
My dog loves these chewy biscuits.  And since she's on a special diet and we usually really limit her treats, the smaller size is actually perfect for her (even though she's a bigger dog).

column4: E. J. Rummel "Wild Horses Chinese Cresteds"
column9: Our Chinese Cresteds give these a paws up!
column10: Our Chinese Cresteds do agility and though they are very food oriented, it's important to have a variety of special treats to keep them interested.  These surely fit the bill.  Since our dogs are small, the size of these treats and the fact that they are soft makes them just what we're looking for, too!  The 4 pack is a good value.

These Dog Treats are the absolute favorite of my Shih Tzu, Coco.  She looks at me with her big brown eyes, pouring on the guilt until I go to the cupboard and get her some Peanut Butter Madness Buddy Biscuits.  She deserves the best!In addition to "good girl" treats, I use these treats to hide her medication.  She never even knows she's taken her medication!  Great job, Buddy Biscuits!

column9: Never Met a Dog That Didn't Love These
column10: I give these as gifts to dog owners.  So far, I'm told, every dog has absolutely loved them. I know my dog starts wagging her tail when she sees these treats in my hand! Doggies love peanut butter.
My dogs absolutely LOVE these chewy treats.  They go absolutely bananas for them.  We purchase many different Buddy products from cloudstar and are never disappointed.

I love this pasta!If you like whole wheat pasta you will LOVE this brand. If you have never tried whole wheat pasta buy a single box and give it a whirl before you committ to a case. I think the flavor is richer than regular pasta. I like mine with simply olive oil or butter and salt & pepper.Better ingrediants and it makes your body happy! Yummy!!

column9: Acceptable substitute for fiber free pasta-
column10: Our family is trying to introduce more fiber into our diet, and I have purchased several Gia Russa whole wheat pasta products.  They are all great - although I offer advice for anyone considering trying it:Cook it longer than you think!  The grainy texture of whole wheat pasta is a huge adjustment when cooked al dente.  This is much better cooked longer.  It is starchier, but not greatly so.  We eat it heavily sauced and also lightly oiled with parmesan.  Try it - it's good for you and also good!

Since Postum is no longer made and I sometimes can't drink coffee I've been trying alternatives.  I really like Cafix, has a good taste and feel in my mouth, its a little better than standard Pero and maybe even a little better than Dark Roast Pero too.
I was diagnosed with acid reflux/gerd, but I love my hot beverages. This product really hits the spot without the gerd acting up.

column9: Not Postum, but a good alternative!
column10: I ordered Cafix because a search for my old standby Postum was not being made anymore.  It is a grain hot beverage, non cafeinated, good with milk and sugar and even the kids can drink it.  This product is totally a good substitute for Postum, which I laughed at my Grandma for drinking...her "ole lady" coffee.  Now I'm the "old lady!"

Sometimes in the evening after dinner I crave something like chocolate or ice cream, but may not want to actually eat some. That's where Cafix comes in. I make it strong,  add some half and half (and lately a slight bit of sweetner), and it satisfies the craving. I think this is a delicious drink, much better than others I've tasted in it's class.
Why do most Gluten free items have GMO's (genetically modified foods) in them? Non-organic Canola oil is GMO! Do not eat GMOs. [...]

I love this product. I cannot eat gluten, and it is so nice to have a really good product that I know is gluten free. I eat some every morning mixed with Ciobani Yogurt and fresh fruit - I look forward to it every day.
This is the tastiest, crunchiest gluten-free cereal I've ever eaten and I've tried all of them.  A little pricey, but when you're gluten intolerant, there are not many choices for breakfast.
Love this cereal.  It is very tasty and filling.  I also love to have it for a snack sometimes too! Even my children like it.

Looking for a delicious and gluten free selection to snack on while hiking, camping, or any other time you're on the go? Udi's Gluten Free Original Granola is an excellent choice! Great in yogurt, cereals, and many other favorite recipes, this granola is also wonderful when eaten by itself. This granola, mixed with dried banana chips, pistachios, raisins, walnuts, and almonds, is loaded with a myriad of delectable goodies and coated with honey.Ingredients: Certified Gluten Free Oats, Wildflower Honey, Canola Oil, Raisins, Banana Chips (Banana, Coconut Oil, Sugar, Natural Banana Flavor), Walnuts, Cashews, Almonds, Pistachios.Disclosure of Material Connection: I received this product free from Udi's Gluten Free Foods. I was not required to write a positive review. The opinions I have expressed are my own. I am disclosing this in accordance with the Federal Trade Commission's 16 CFR, Part 255vf: "Guides Concerning the Use of Endorsements and Testimonials in Advertising."
Good flavor and it's a "clean" breakfast for our resident celiac. It's a favorite, basic breakfast. Good to use for desserts & other recipes as well.

This is the best granola I have ever tried... and I have tried many.This has the best flavor, and consistency.  Does not clump like many others.Great for yogurt, oatmeal, or just plain out of the bag!The Udi's Original is my favorite.  Just ordered another 3 pack.
This is my favorite flavor so far. Good flavor and crunch without being too crunchy or too sweet. The only thing that would make it better would be substituting the yucky canola oil for coconut oil.

Around 6 months ago I purchased the Udi's sample pack of gluten free granola and I like the "Original" version the best.  The vanilla was too sweet, the cranberry was just OK, and the Au Natural too bland.  This is now the only one I order.  Thank you, Amazon, for periodically offering special deals on gluten free products.

Unlike other gluten free granola's, this granola is not all greasy! It is crunchy and flavorful. I love this granola, I've subscribed to this flavor on amazon as its cheaper than the grocery store. I love how it has a variety of nuts and fruits. It's great as yogurt topper or cereal.
i don't like sweet cereal and this granola is not too sweet. good texture and perfect with yoghurt. i would buy it more often but it is quite pricey
A great way to start your day that really fills you up! Tastes great and it's gluten free!! Thanks Udi's!

column9: Taste's so good, you'd never guess it is gluten-free!
column10: I would eat this granola even if I wasn't following a gluten-free diet. You can't tell that the oats are gluten free and the taste and texture are just like other non-gluten-free granola. Tastes great sprinkled on top of yogurt, etc. I wouldn't consider it a cereal though, the bag would only be a bowl or two.
I love these, they are a salty, cheesy snack and really quite addictive!  But, for $21+, I'll buy them at the store, where they're far less expensive.  It even says $2 on the bag...

column9: The softest, puffcorn snack from Frito-Lay. So Delicious!
column10: So Delicious! This product is a spin-off of Cheeto's and utilizes the mascot, Chester Cheetah. This puffcorn snack is really soft on your teeth while you watch your favorite movie on television. No hulls,  No kernals. Nothing burnt. No butter. No Peanuts, No cholesterol.  No Trans Fat. Nice cheesy taste. As of this writing, in the store, it might cost you $2.00 for a single bag 4.5 oz, but you will eat these corn meal puffs so quickly during your movie, you are going to want more. They are addicting.  From Amazon, you can buy 12 bags (4.5 oz.) in one shipment.  Use your Amazon.com gift e-card balance for this one.

column9: Fantastic Product But Horribly Overpriced Here
column10: I love this product as it is a soft, melt in your mouth variant of popcorn that poses no threat to the teeth for those of us 'past a certain age'. (i.e. no threats of teeth chipping kernels, etc). I would love to have the convenience of purchasing it via Amazon, but not for this inflated price. The shipping charge I understand, but not $5 over the price on the bag.

column9: Not as good as the other MoJo bars
column10: So I really love the mojo bars, they really hit the spot when you are not in the mood to make a lunch or need something light in the tummy.  I haven't tried them all but the ones that I have tried have been amazing.  I really love the trail mix, chocolate coconut almond, peanut butter pretzel, and the smores. My favorite being the peanut butter pretzel and I add chocolate chips with every bite lol  I wanted to like this one because I have had such success so far with the other mojo bars but this one was not a winner in my book.  I mean it is nutritious but really lacks in any sort of flavor.  It is niether sweet or salty and is just kind of bland.  The nuts dont even really give it much taste but do add a nice crunch.  You are getting protien and good fats but you can get that with other more flavorful bars.  If you are the type that likes something very simple with no flavor then this is ok, but try the other mojo bars that I recomended so you wont be turned off by sampling this one first.200 calories12 grams of fat8 grams of sugar3 grams of fiber8 grams of protien190 mg of sodiumIngredients: Organic Brown Rice Syrup, Soy Rice Crisps (Soy Protein Isolate, Organic Rice Flour, Calcium Carbonate), Almonds, Organic Cashews, Organic Pecans, Organic Pretzels (Organic Wheat Flour, Salt, Organic Canola Oil, Organic Malt), Organic Macadamia Nut Butter, Organic Oat Syrup Solids, Hazelnuts, Vegetable Glycerin, Sea Salt, Organic Gum Arabic, Organic Sunflower Oil, Natural Vitamin E (antioxidant).

Bought a bag of this brand of Taffy about 6 weeks ago.  Had all varieties of this particular taffy in it including the watermelon taffy.  Just loved the watermelon taffy so much, came to Amazon.com to see if it was available all by itself.Now that I've had the candy for a couple of weeks almost, I must say the thrill is gone.  Not as excited about eating this candy.  For some reason still manage to pop a couple of pieces in my mouth daily, just can't resist it.  :)This candy has a strong candy/watermelon smell to it, will have you licking your chips as soon as you unravel the wrapper.  Chew slowly, it's soooo good!!

I haven't been able to find long fusilli pasta in stores where I shop locally. I was so excited to find Anna's Long Fusilli. It's great quality & delicious! And even though I thought 12 bags of pasta was a bit much to buy at once, I'm glad to have it on had & have been enjoying it often!

This is one of my families favorite macaroni and have found it diffcult to find in Oklahoma. I still follow the family tradition of  serving gravy (sauce) and macaroni (pasta) on Sunday.  This is even great as a leftover for a lunch pasta salad.
The Fusilli came in excellent condition, not one was broken.  The product is very good.  It was bought as a birthday present for my daughter.
Not always easy to find this great tasting pasta so we order it by the case, always fresh and always fast service.

This order was handled in the most efficient manner.  And the product was just as described.  We have purchased this very same product in a very nice upscale grocery, where they sell many imported food products.  It was so nice to just be able to sit at my computer, easily find this specialty pasta, and receive it on our doorstep in just a few days.  In fact we were able to send a few packages home with our visiting children.  And it was so well packaged, every bag of pasta was filled with unbroken fusilli.  What a treat! I will not hesitate to order more in the future!
This Fusilli is very near and dear to my whole family. We were missing this because we can not find it at any of the local MEGA stores. Now we eat it everySunday.

I love this type of pasta and it is not very easy to find here in Florida.  While looking up the name of the type of pasta  (fusilli) on line Amazon was one of the retailers that sold it.  I placed an order ( free shipping at the time) and in a few days a few likeminded friends and myself were enjoying one of our favorite italian dishes.

Wow! Great product. Excellent quality. Our family, especially my daughters, love this type of pasta. I have been looking for it for a while until I found it at Amazon. We'll definetly continue to purchase it to enjoy at home. Thank you.

This type of spaghetti pasta is my family's favorite. However in the area where I live, it is not available in any of the local super markets. Thus, I started an internet search and found Amazon selling Anna's at a very good price that included shipping. Trusting Amazon and being a frequent Amazon customer, I purchased a case. It arrived quickly and in perfect condition. As for the pasta itself, it is from Italy, is delicious, and  cooks up quickly. I highly recommend this item.

Long fusilli is hard to find in commercial grocery stores where I live, and the specialty Italian imports are 3x the price.  This was a great find as my husband loves the dense "toothy" feel of fusilli.  This is definitely dense, so if you're used to spaghetti, then this will probably be very chewy to you.  We eat "macaroni" every Sunday, so getting 12lbs at a time is great.

This product was recommended by some Italian friends and they were spot on.  Excellent pasta  Taste texture and the unique shape makes it a nice change. Kids enjoyed it too.  I like the fact that it is quite healthy as well
Hard to find product in local stores. When I do find it, it's at least a $1.00 more per lb. Will order again soon.

While the novelty of all the curly pasta is fun, I was not especially impressed by the taste. It was about the same as the Barilla pastas we get in our local market. There was no recommended cook time on the bag and no matter how long we cooked it, it always seemed just a little too chewy.
Hard to find product outside urban areas.  happy it was available on Amazon.  Would buy it again.

I just got a new puppy (chihuahua) and at 7 1/2 weeks, I gave him one. After that one, he wanted more. Although he is really tiny at just over 2.1 lbs, he had no problems eating a whole one, although I usually break it in 1/2. They are ideal for small dogs and puppies.
We bought this when we visited Jamaica and loved it!  I put it on chicken, pork, and spicy dips.  I hope I can buy more online.  Will be awhile before we're back in jamaica.

Terrific authentic jerk flavor, and wont overpower you with heat, but its there And its not as messyas the wet Jerk Rub the Grace company sells, and it won't turn your chicken, pork, or fish green either.Use liberally, rub it in and put in a ziplock bag overnight if you can wait that long. This is one of myfavorites, alongside Prudhomme's Poultry Magic on days when you just need some more heat in your dishes.Also great sprinkled in soups or directly on white beans, pintos, or collard greens. Good stuff!

I love this jerk seasoning , I used it alot on my tilapa, or in my jerk meals . You can taste the ginger and other spices in this seasoning. I highly recommend this product if your not into real hot spices.

The first shipment of two bottles didn't make it. The only thing that made its way to me was the packaging. When I saw that empty envelope without my Jerk Seasoning enclosed, needless to say I was confused, then crushed when I realized someone at the post office probably sliced open the package and absconded with my Jerk Seasoning!! What is the world coming to?? Anyway, I shouldn't be telling anyone this because I should be keeping this a secret only for me, but this jerk seasoning is all that!!! I contacted the seller and explained what happened. They responded promptly and sent out another shipment. The second shipment arrived with the seasonings safely packaged. I am now able to continue to Jerk season pretty much everything, fish, chicken, pork, and shrimp. I would definitely purchase Jerk Seasoning from Koko's again, really soon at the rate I'm using it.

We first bought this seasoning based on a recommendation from a Jamaican restaurant we visited.  It did not disappoint.  It adds flavor to virtually any meat without too much heat, but is especially good on pork and chicken.  I use it on meats that I then put on a smoker, and the combination of the smoke flavor and seasoning is just perfect.

Put this on some Ribs. Turned out good. Use it somewhere between sparingly to moderate. It will quickly over power anything with the heat. That is unless you like really spicy food. The holes are a bit small but i think thats good in a way since the bigger hole would release too much of the hot peppers which are bigger in size. If used in the right amount it will a a nice kick without been to spicy.

Pretty good seasoning, but I have to say it's been so long that I don't remember what authentic jerk chicken taste like. None the less I still enjoyed this seasoning. It has a unique citrus taste? The only con about this product is that the holes at top are too small to allow all the spices to come out.

Even though these are reduced sugar, they still are very tasty and sweet. There are three varieties in the pack. The peanut butter version is my favorite in the assortment, but the chocolate chip and cookies & cream versions are also quite tasty.I like that the texture is a little firmer than the regular Quaker bars. Still soft and chewy, but the bar holds together better. It's also less sticky than other bars I've tried (although it still is sticky to the touch).While the nutritional content is certainly far from perfect, it's a much better snack than a candy bar, especially with regard to calories (100 to 120 per bar depending on the variety). Definitely worth a look if you want a lower cal but still tasty snack bar.

column9: QUAKER CHEWY GRANOLA BAR VARIET PACK RED. SUGAR
column10: I PURCHASED THIS PRODUCT IN THE PAST. THIS PARTICULAR PURCHASE WAS FOR A GIFT FOR MY DAUGHTER TO USE IN HER LUNCHES.  RELIABLE PRODUCT ...EASY TO TAKE WITH.

column9: Zesty spearmint and lemon are modulated by green tea into a substantial potion!
column10: Zen brews up to an golden amber liquor.  The aroma is sweet spearmint.  The blending of this tea is excellent--spearmint could be overpowering but they use just the right amount of it.  Slightly sweet spearmint is the primary flavor, then you taste a hint of lemon.  The green tea provides an herbal base for these two flavors that makes the intial impression of zesty spearmint and lemon modulate into a substantial potion.  Very nice and satisfying with a clean spearmint aftertaste.Remember that this tea does have caffeine--however, it does not say how much on the box.  A good estimate might be 30 mg--compared to 90mg for the average cup of coffee.  Make sure you time how long you brew this tea because if you brew too long it becomes bitter.  Four minutes is ample.
Light, sweet and oh so good is how I would describe this tea. I first had it at a hotel at the complimentary breakfast and loved it so much, I went to Amazon and ordered more that same day.
This Passion tea is used at Starbucks. We mix it with two Lipton tea bags for iced tea. Really good, fruity flavor. Great for summer!
The vendor is fast and dependable. The tea is simply the best way to relax and great tasting too. Highly recommend !!
This tea is amazing. I drink it iced with sugar and lime. It will blow your mind. The taste is similar to a flavor of kool-aid that I had as a child. I can just drink glass after glass of this tea.

Sharp orange flavor with a tolerable spearmint taste. I've tried many of the less expensive brands and haven't liked any other except this one and Good Seasons Tuscany. I'm not crazy about all of the Tazo drinks, but this one is nice. I love drinking this tea with chocolate. It comes in an orange package. You can also smell the other spices. Don't make the mistake I make, by adding too much water. As with many products, amazon is over charging.

column9: Great fish food for algae eating fish
column10: I bought sea veggies mixed flakes for my fish tank of algae eating silver dollars  and they love it. These flakes are a must for algae eating fish like silver dollars,angel fish,algae eaters, etc. feeding your fish these mixed algae flakes promotes the health of your fish and makes their color sharper too. Much recommended.
After trying Petromalt and the other pet store and vet retail products, I found this initially in my local grocery store. It worked for my longhair tabby, who was vomiting hairballs 1-3 times a week.
I have used this product for many months and my cat never got tired of it...he loves the taste and eats it like a treat.
Product works really well on hairball problems and my cat will come back to get more if she's constipated and it seems to take care of that problem also.

Imagine a cat actually wanting to eat medicine.  It's so strange.  My cat is really finicky about what he eats (He's the type who has to have his canned food heated up or else he won't touch it), and he begs for more of this stuff.  He acts just like it's another treat.

I have two cats, one who needs hairball help, the other who just gets it because he is the Alpha Cat and it is all about him. My fussy eater cat has hairball trouble & is so fussy about scents, flavors. She loves the Hartz product, esp salmon flavored. It is easy to administer. Her sidekick gets some too just to be fair. They will also use malt flavored but the salmon is the favorite and we like being able to order rather than go out to buy it.
This is the only hairball medicine my cats will eat.  It has to be Hartz and it has to be the Salmon flavor - they turn their noses up to the Malt.
Bought and sent these as a care package for my child at college. Now I'm one of the most adored parents to the dorm where he lives. Great product, quick service, highly recommended.

This bread is excellent. This bread is different and less dense than their other breads.  It is closer to the texture of traditional bread.  But it is still an excellent bread.  I have not tasted a bread made by Health Express that I have not liked.  I would eat this bread even if it weren't for the low-carb factor. I prefer it to regular bread and it's a lot healthier, even if you don't need a low-carb bread.
I believe taste is such a personal thing but I really did not care for the taste of this bread.  It is spongey to me and a little on the tough side.  I will not be reordering this product.

This is my first try at low carb bread.  I'd like to make low carb a way of life and can't imagine never having bread again.  I tried this because reviews said it was not as heavy as other breads in this category.  This tastes dry, dry, dry.  Bland.  Don't think I can make it through the loaf.  May try it for french toast.

I have tried several low carb breads in my search.  This has proven to be the best one so far.  It has a regular bread texture and works just great for sandwiches. It is so nice and tender. I just toasted a piece and it was good toasted also.  This is the low carb bread for me.  My husband is not on a low carb diet and he thought his sandwich this noon was very good on this bread.  I think the texture is perfect.  Some of them are too course for sandwiches.

column9: Expired date, gave me the runs
column10: Expiration date on bottles August 2009; got diarrhea so didn't drink anymore! Could be good product if new.

This is an easy-to-make dish that takes macaroni and cheese to the next level.Likes:- Easy prep.  Everything cooks in one pan.  No need to cook noodles separately.  Took 5 minutes to prep and 15 minutes to wait while it simmered.- Makes a lot of food.  Our family of three was stuffed and we still had a lot left over.  This really does make 5 servings.- Flavor is good. This is a comfort food.  The addition of lean ground beef really adds to the flavor.- Nutrition is good if you use extra lean ground beef (except sodium.. see below).Dislikes:- A little high in sodium (38% RDA / 850mg / serving).  This is very common for these sorts of meals.Other thoughts:  If you use 90% lean ground beef, you get 9g fat per serving, which isn't too bad.  We used 95% so had more like 5g fat per serving (estimate).

column9: Heavy Duty Food for a Heavy Duty Appetite.
column10: Summary:  Prepared as directed it's very satisfying but fattier than I'd like.It's super-deluxe cheesy-beefy-mac!This type of meal is fattier than I usually eat but I prepared it as directed (adding a full pound of beef) to present a fair review.  Tastes really good.  The seasoning adds something that you wouldn't get just by adding hambuger to mac&cheese.  And this is really good mac&cheese as well.  Delivers a satisfying feeling of satiation without eating a large portion.  Real comfort food.Preperation is a snap.  After simmering 13 minutes it looked like there was too much water left over but by the time the food was served it had congealed enough not to be runny.If I were to try this again I'd use ground turkey instead of beef and less of it.  Maybe 12 oz instead of 16 and add a bit more mac to make up for it.  But if you want a satisfying, beefy meal you can't go wrong these Cheeseburger Skillets.Box says fat is 9g a serving, 3g of it saturated.  That would vary depending on what type of meat you added.  Sodium is 850g.  Highish but not unusual for this tupe of prepared meal.  Unlike the the fat, it won't be easy to lower the sodium by fiddling with the recipe.Box suggested topping the finished dish with lettuce and tomato and that worked VERY WELL.

As a confirmed Hamburger Helper junkie, I was very curious to see if Velveeta had the goods to dethrone "The Helping Hand" as my comfort food of choice. First off, I'll say this: The ULTIMATE CHEESEBURGER SKILLETS DINNER does, indeed, taste remarkably like a real cheeseburger. Going beyond just offering cheese-covered noodles and ground beef, there are hints of ketchup and mustard and onions, among other tantalizing tastes. My Wife, who is not a big fan of Hamburger Helper, stopped after a few bites- The mustard taste was too much for her. My eight year-old Daughter, not a huge fan of meat of any kind, loved it. For my part, I ate my first helping with gusto, but by the time seconds rolled around, the spice mixture was getting to be overpowering and a bit sickening. I scrapped the noodles and ate the rest of the ground beef. It wasn't bad, but the spice mix wasn't something that made me want to keep eating it. I'll happily try other Velveeta Hamburger Helper knock-offs, but this one didn't quite hit the spot the way I'd hoped.

This cheesy skillet dinner kit is very, very tasty.  Meant to be served with ground beef, if you happen to be a vegetarian, it can stand on its own as a main course.The macaroni is high quality (made with enriched wheat flour), tender and plump.  The seasoning has a tang of onions, cheese and tomato - a mild Southwestern flavor, I would say.  And when it's all done cooking, the Velveeta creamy cheese sauce then gets added.  It comes in a nice large pouch, is rich and thick and really finishes this dish off in good style.Other ingredients (less than 2%) include mustard seed, garlic and "natural flavors."  I wonder what these natural flavors specifically are.  Whatever they are, they certainly are tasty.The box contents make about five one-cup servings.  So I had leftovers for another meal.  It says you can customize it by adding chopped tomatoes and shredded lettuce.  I suppose that would enhance it, but they are not necessary.Calory-wise, listed are 220 calories as packaged, 350 as prepared.  Total fat is 9g.  Sodium 850 mg.  There are some vitamins too:  15% calcium, 6% iron, 2% vitamin A and 8g protein.So I'm really impressed and enjoyed this meal.  I would definitely purchase it in future.

We had the Kraft Velveeta Cheesy Skillet Dinner Kit this evening. The directions are easy to follow and would be a great dish to make with a child. I cooked it a little more than on the recipe and it was still a bit soupy. While it was tasty (like a cheese burger) it was very, very salty. I had added a tiny bit of salt to the ground beef but not enough to make the whole dish salty. The box makes more than enough for two adults when you add a fruit and vegetable to the total dinner and still leaves a lunch portion left over. If you are dieting this is not the dish for you. A serving size is 2.5 oz which they say is about a cup and that is 350 calories and 9 grams of fat. On the other hand there is 8 grams of protein in that serving.The clean-up after dinner was a bit difficult. The cheese is really sticky and preparing the dishes for the dishwasher took a lot longer than usual. I am still waiting to see how the silverware fares. I had to hand wash the fry pan because I knew the dishwasher would not get all the cheese off, although I rinsed it in hot water several minutes before deciding to hand wash it.

My husband loves Hamburger Helper, and he also loves the Velveeta Shells and Cheese.  This product seemed a natural fit for his tastes.  So I was surprised that he was disappointed.The directions are almost identical to HH products - very quick and easy to make with either a pound of ground sausage or ground beef.  The prices are also comparable between the two products; each running less than $3 a box.  The cheesy skillet includes a foil packet of Velveeta to add at the end of preparation (just like the foil packet in the shells and cheese). It makes a good amount for 2 people for a dinner.  My husband usually gets a dinner and a lunch for the following day with HH and we did the same here.  Only unlike HH, the skillet does NOT reheat well.  The cheese sauce separated somewhat, despite thorough mixing.  The cheesy skillet is best eaten when it's freshly made.  On a picky note, the skillet also has much larger elbow noodles than the HH cheeseburger.  We preferred the smaller noodles.  I also noticed that the cheesey skillet has significantly more fat and calories as prepared than HH does.Overall, though it wasn't bad, we'll stick with the Hamburger Helper brand.

I fixed this today with Morningstar Crumbles for a meatless dish along with asiago artisan bread and fresh corn.The Cheeseburger Skillets dinner is a traditional one-dish meal, and actually works well for casual dining, especially for kids. It was easy to fix and had a nice balance of flavor including the spices that are a part of this meal (and that dress it up from simple mac and cheese with ground beef). Since everything cooked in one pot, clean-up was easy. (I use t-fal and had no problem with anything sticking).Adding the bread and corn upgraded the meal, but it still fell under casual dining.As an individual allergic to sulfites, I was grateful that this particular dinner was sulfite-free.

This was actually better than I thought it would be.  The cheesy taste is good, and the pasta is as well.  You need to add your own ground beef.  This is great when you're short on time and need to cook something up fast or if you're just not into cooking.  I would give it 5 stars for taste and 3 stars for nutritional value -- so my rating average comes out to 4.

I know Macaroni and Cheese is supposed to be cheesy, but somewhere along the line this product became a bit too rich. The liquid cheese mix alone isn't bad, but the seasoning or spices included in the package were too much. If you put them both in the macaroni, they don't mix well. In fact, I ended up eating the macaroni with orange "spice" powder on the pasta. The taste isn't horrible, but it's not as good as the Kraft Macaroni and Cheese I'm used to. Oh, by the way, this set does not include cheeseburger - it's just the Mac & Cheese.

I remember the glory days of Hamburger Helper and all the rest from the 70's.  As children we all thought it was some of the greatest stuff on earth- HH and some Rice-a-Roni made me a happy camper.  So in the spirit of that nostalgia I picked up the Velveeta Cheesburger Skillet Dinner... and discovered some things are best left in the past.Inside the box you get a small bag of elbow macaroni, a packet of cheese sauce and an envelope of 'seasoning'.  Brown up a pound of ground beef, add 2 cups of water and bring to a boil, add macaroni- you know the drill.  Time to add the 'seasoning'... which turned out to be 100% Genuine Artificial Cheese Flavoring.  Wouldn't be surprised if it was made with HFCS.  Dumping it into the pot raised a cloud that made me sneeze. Once the macaroni cooks it's time to add the Cheese Sauce- after all, you can't have a cheeseburger skillet dinner without submerging everything in... CHEESE.All of this turned the entire contents of the skillet into a decidedly unappetizing sickly yellow color.  The box photo does not do it justice.It did give me a few moments of nostalgia as I said before.  Growing up poor we had a lot of these quick & easy no-frills meals, and one bite made me want to watch an episode of Good Times.  This is the stuff that gets bulk ordered for food pantries, soup kitchens and military mess halls.  Best suited for when you're on the couch watching corny movies or sports highlights.  Definitely not for the squeamish or health conscious.

column4: Marshall Carter "Ornery Gamer, Fiend Club Member"
column9: Not awful, but nothing special either; file this under "Glorified Hamburger Helper."
column10: The Kraft Velveeta Ultimate Cheeseburger Skillets dinner kit strikes me as a slightly upgraded Hamburger Helper, only in this case, you get the Velveeta cheese pouch. It's basically a quick, easy, one-dish meal. You brown the beef, add the water, spices and cheese pouch and then simmer until it's done. All-in-all, it's not bad (kind of tastes like a cheeseburger...go figure) and makes a convenient, quick meal. That said, it wasn't notably better than similar Hamburger Helper dishes, which I generally add real cheese to (better than the Velveeta pouch in my humble opinion), despite the fact that it's more expensive. Also, with most pasta dishes, it's very often better after cooling-down and reheating. That's not the case here as the cheese sauce seems to separate a bit, so the reheated product is a bit of a mess (and less appetizing than the first go-round). It's best to finish this off when first made. This isn't a bad product, and I would eat it again, it's just nothing out-of-the ordinary.

I'm a fan of Velveeta cheese and even enjoy their shells and cheese, so I had high hopes for this. Although my 6 year old daughter liked it, I am not a fan. It's okay at best. The flavor does not accurately represent the deliciousness of the original Velveeta cheese. I would suggest you at least give it a try. I will purchase it since my daughter enjoys it, but it will not be a staple in our household.

Velveeta Cheesburger Skillets is not a product I'd generally buy. Mac and cheese is easy enough to make from scratch, using ingredients with no added chemicals/flavorings/preservatives. Considering that this is not the case with Velveeta, this particular processed dinner was good, very quick to prepare and flavorful. I can't say that it tastes like cheeseburgers, though, and it's high in salt and fat.

Ultimate cheeseburger skillets dinner is a perfect dinner fix for my family.  It is easy, convenient, quick, and at the same time, it is something that is filling and tasty for them.  Sometimes I don't have time to make a thorough home-cooked meal, but this is just about as good as home-cooked.  It is just as hardy, but without all the extra hard work that a totally home cooked meal would take.  This is a lot quicker, but without the sacrifice.My family loves this cheeseburger skillet dinner.  Needless to say, it got eaten very quickly.  I had never had this brand before, but I will be buying it all the time now.Thanks for this wonderful meal that I can fix for my family, and that they can eat and enjoy.

This boxed dinner looks so good on the package, I couldn't wait to cook it up.  It's easy to prepare, just add meat. I was sure I would love it.  The noodles came out perfect, just a bit firm, but the spices and cheese sauce were  bland.  I was disappointed that it did not have a cheesier taste, and other similar products out there taste better to me.  My daughter's unsolicited opinion was that she was disappointed as well.  It's certainly not awful, and it doesn't have a bad taste, just too little taste.

I'll make this easy:This is a Kraft/Velveeta version of Hamburger Helper. The twist is that this has both a dry seasoning/cheese packet, and a gooey packet of Velveeta cheese product. The latter makes this a bit more cheesy than the Betty Crocker alternatives.Taste-wise, it's okay. I didn't hate it, but I can't see myself craving it, either. The cheese sauce totally overpowered the ground beef's flavor, and the dry packet added a little spicy kick. In the end, I think I could have used tofu or some other nearly-flavorless filler instead of beef, and I'd have been just as happy with the end result.The noodles are big and decent quality. Cooking time is acceptable. The only problem I see is the price; It averages out to about two-fifty per box in US dollars. This is obviously competing with Hamburger Helper, and I can get a box of `Helper for a little over a buck, or less if I get the store brand instead of the Betty Crocker variety. I fail to see how this is worth more than the competition. The cheese sauce packet doesn't make enough of a difference (It's just Velveeta, not real cheese, and I could buy a huge brick of Velveeta and add it to the competition's mix, and still spend less money).If you find it on sale, I'd say go for it. It's good. I just don't think it's "two dollars and fifty cents per box" good. I'd pay half that for it. I think Kraft is dreaming when they price a box of noodles, powder, and Velveeta at double what the competition is asking for essentially the same thing.Still, maybe it will make you feel special spending more. That's up to you. The quality is decent. The taste is fine. It's worth a shot if you don't mind the price.

When I saw that this product was in the "helper" category, I did not really get excited.  These types of meals are designed for speed and ease of cooking, not really for their top tier flavors.  I chose this product due to the Velveeta branding and thinking that this would make for a great Mac and Cheese dish.  After following the directions for preparation, I found the product to look exactly like any other "helper" product I have tried before.  Upon tasting it, I did not feel that it differentiated itself from its competitors and that the seasoning provided in the package was too salty (Nutrition: over 25% Saturated Fat - over 25% Sodium - etc).  If I were to ever make this product again in the future, I would probably skip the packaged seasoning and just stick with the Mac and Cheese version.  I might even try one of the suggestions about turning it into a sort of salad.  In any case, this item did not bowl me over with flavor and I would not go out of my way to choose it over the other available "helper" products.  The 3 stars is for Average and Expected.

column9: Too much cheese and no other flavor
column10: Velveeta seems to be getting into the packaged meal business late and they're offering little in the way of either innovation or flavor in doing so. The Cheesy Skillets meal I had was so bland that I had to put katchup on it to give it any kind of flavor. Cooking the beef, adding the sauce and then waiting at the end to add the cheese just meant that the elements didn't really have time to work together. Plus, the Velveeta itself just lacked a lot of flavor. I would most likely stick with other meals that add some kind of savory flavor to their contents.

column9: Never Let Your Pantry Be Without This!
column10: As an Amazon Vine participant, I often get to review some tasty items, and this was no exception!This is about the easiest skillet dinner I've ever made! It is quite literally the one pan wonder, and has dinner on the table in less than a half hour! Plus, the kids all love it!!! [They'll probably be asking for more!]This package, with one pound of browned, lean ground beef, makes about 5 one-cup servings. Add a side dish of veggies, and your dinner is complete! Or, the box suggests adding chopped tomatoes and lettuce for a complete meal in one dish!It's simply a meal worth having often on your family's list of favorite dinners!I give this dinner Five Stars and my Thumbs Up Award!

column9: It tastes like a McDonald's cheeseburger...
column10: This is a very simple boxed meal. It has been years since I have used a box meal kit, because I usually cook everything from scratch with real ingredients. Even so, there are nights when things don't go as planned and you need to feed the family.Kraft Velveeta Cheesy Skillets: Ultimate Cheeseburger Mac does taste like a cheeseburger. After I browned my ground chuck and added the "spice" powder package, it instantly smelled like a McDonald's cheeseburger! The kit contains pasta, "spice" powder and a Velveeta cheese sauce pouch. You have to supply one pound of ground chuck and two cups of water.Taste Test: It's definitely not the most exciting meal. My daughter (2) gobbled it up, like she does everything. My son (7) liked it okay, but he said he liked it "just a little bit". My husband and I instantly agreed it tasted liked McDonald's-not Burger King or Wendy's-but McDonald's.It's about 350 calories for a one cup serving. The health benefits are minimal and it has partially-hydrogenated stuff in it. I doubt I will eat this again, mostly due to the processed nature of it. The taste was mediocre.It's ready in 20 minutes, but I can make risotto in 18 minutes, and I would MUCH rather have that!

Kraft Velveeta Ultimate Cheeseburger Skillets Dinner is like Hamburger Helper--only better! The cheese sauce is wonderfully creamy and tastes just like Velveeta! The dinner is incredibly easy to prepare. I only wish it came with more macaroni; there's an ample amount of sauce, and more pasta would help it to stretch a little farther, especially when you're trying to feed a hungry family! Still, this is a great, tasty product that I could see myself using again and again.

The Velveeta Cheesy Skillets Ultimate Cheeseburger Mac will be on my shopping list when I am in the market for such a product. It lives up to the hype on the package in that it is quick and easy to prepare, and tastes much better than similiar products by other companies. The reason for the superior taste is the cheese sauce, which unlike many other cheeseburger mac products is not powdered. Having an actual sauce instead of a powdered mix makes for a more natural taste, and, combined with the seasoning package, it has a tang to it that keeps it from the blandness of similiar products. In addition, because it is a real sauce instead of a powder, it is reconstituted with water instead of milk. How many times have you gone to prepare some dish and found that you did not have a key ingredient, including milk? Even though it is prepared with water instead of milk the sauce is still creamy. For those who like to use packaged dinners from time to time, this is a winner!

column9: Overall good, but some modifications are require.
column10: First off, you don't need 1lb of meat.  My wife and I used the recommended ingredients, and we found that 1lb was too much.  We actually couldn't finish our initial portions because it had too much meat.  Also, we didn't use all the cheese; between the two of us, 3/4 of the Velveeta cheese was enough.Other than that, it was a great cheeseburger skillet meal with that great Velveeta cheesy taste we all like.  Took a little longer than 20 minutes between the two of us, but it turned out great in the end and we ended up with leftovers for another meal or two.

I like the convenience of this. I felt the seasoning packet was a little overwhelming. I think it would have been better just to add the cheese sauce and maybe a tiny bit of the seasoning packet. It cooked well in the time suggested. The pasta was done just right. It was very creamy, more than other cheesy box dinners. I would buy again, and just change the seasoning as mentioned. Good family dish. I think kids would like.

Convenience is not to be dismissed as a small consideration for many families today. This was an item I wanted to try on my own, especially my pasta-heads, those connoisseurs of all things cheesy, quick and calories be banned. If you have teens or visitors who can eat through a well stocked refrigerator in an afternoon then keep extra convenience foods like this on hand. In lieu of ground beef we used ground turkey (some concessions to health perhaps) as well as their favorite spicy sausage (cooked and crumbled)and I think further experimentation is more than possible. Comments from the hungry horde: better than regular Velveeta packaged pastas, thicker and a smoother texture with a powder pack that apparently added just the right extra kick to make the skillet dish hefty and capable of holding its own with all the additions we tossed in (ie. onions, red pepper cubes, the meats). This is meant to be an upgrade, straight from the box, and while it may never pass Emeril's lips what we found was alot more available versatility from this version of the well known staple. I have suggested we try such novelties as steamed broccoli, wine-glazed mushrooms, perhaps shredded smoked provolone tossed in at the last instead of the meats for veggie version. It is pretty much anything you want it to be, it can be dressed up or served as is; both are a major selling point in our household.
A pouch of Velveeta cheese sauce differentiates this dinner from the usual skillet dinner. Added after the meal is cooked, the sauce does make for a saucy and tasty dish.

A dinner in a box!! Velveeta makes it super easy to get creative with this boxed dinner. If you don't want to brown your meat, then just open a can of chicken or tuna and use that.  You can even add some cooked vegetables to make additional servings.  I like the idea of adding cracker crumbs on top too.

I used to love Hamburger Helper as a kid so I had to try this out, usually I try to eat healthy and as close to the ground as possible without ingesting too many refined products but once in a while it's okay to indulge in some cheesy goodness, and this was pretty nice.  A little salty but I do like salt and often have to hold back, it's a nice change from a regular protein free macaroni and cheese when I truly don't have time or energy to whip up a whole meal from scratch. This is best eaten from a bowl on a couch in front of the tv followed by a nap! Yum and cozy but definitely not for every day.

This product was okay taste-wise. It leaned a little on the salty side, but wasn't intolerable. The best part was that it was quick and easy to make. I would recommend it if you're in a pinch and want to make a quick meal.

My daughter is really into mac and cheese these days, so we decided to try on this sucker.  Very simple to prepare and the instructions are easy to follow.  It's simple yet cheesy meal. Needless to say that my daughter really really enjoyed this simple meal.  Btw, you do need to add meat to make it the cheeseburger skillet.

column9: Pretty good for what it is
column10: Don't buy this if you love to make every meal from scratch from natural fresh ingredients or if you can't stand McDonald's - I'll just start out by saying that.  Me, I have the eating habits of a 6 year old and rarely introduce something new to my diet, I'm an incredibly picky eater, so I thought this cheesy skillet meal was pretty good.  Definitely give this a try if you're like me, or if you have a kid who only wants mac 'n' cheese and you're going out of your mind trying to get some protein in their diet.
I expected it to be made and taste like the competition. It wasn't and it didn't. Smelled a little strong during the later stages of cooking but turned out to be pretty decent.

My family is a long time lover of Hamburger Helper and other complete meal options.  This is one of the best I have every had.  It is just easy to make and tastes better.  However, my only problem with them is that they are so much  more expensive and not worth the additional cost to me.

If your a cheese lover then your ship has come in... you are gonna love this product; especially if you add ground beef or turkey to it.  My daughter says it taste like McDonald's hamburgers... if she eats it then I know it's going to be a winner on your dinner table;

column9: Just Add Hamburger to Your Original Velveeta Shells and Cheese
column10: Not that I was really expecting anything spectacular with this (in fact I think I ordered it on the vine program when I was hung over and in dire need of something heart stopping and liquor absorbing), but honestly, this is basically just Velveeta Shells and cheese with a little packet whatever spice it is that pasta dinner manufacturers add to give it that generic, pseudo "kick".  In short I was underwhelmed.  The original velveeta shells and cheese is pretty spectacular (that is, if you're in the market for something unspeakably unhealthy but infinitely comforting) and in my opinion, if it's not broke, don't fix it.

column9: Beef with noodles and creamy cheese sauce, YUMMY!
column10: You can make this meal in less than 20 minutes and the best part is that you do not need any milk!  Velveeta comes to the rescue for those of us who are in a hurry because they provide us a large cheese sauce pouch in this box.First, before preparing this meal, you can choose either lean ground beef or something with a higher fat content like 80/20.  To test it out, I bought 1lb of 80/20 ground beef and prepared my Velveeta Cheesy Skillets Ultimate Cheeseburger Mac with it instead of the recommended beef.  The only real thing I changed with the quick preparation recipe was to also add some Cajun certified spice.  While mixing in the creamy Velveeta cheese, also sprinkle in 1 tablespoon of Southern Cajun Seasoning Low Sodium to give your meal a real spice kick without all that salt.I prepared my meal for a group of four adults, we finished it off quickly, even with a side of Green Peas and bread service.  If you have a growing, hungry family, then I suggest preparing two of these meals at once to have a little extra for lunch the next day.Overall, I was very satisfied with the cheesy flavor and noodles of this Cheesy Skillets meal.  Practically anyone can cook it so why not try it out for yourself today!

This was really good. Being a single guy, the easier the meal the better and this was super simple to make and tasted wonderful. If you like Velveeta and Skillet dinners then you will love this. I also tried the broccoli flavor and it's great too. I'm glad I tried this product. It makes dinner easy.

I decided to try out the Cheesy Skillets after being charmed by the goofy ads on TV. I discovered that this product does not need any doctoring at all, it's got plenty flavor. Maybe a little too much flavor. When I added the sauces, my elderly mother wanted to know who was burning garlic. The man of the house loved it though. So I'll probably wind up getting some more of this. It is very cheesy tasting, not too cheesy for me, but the garlic and onion flavoring did turn out kind of extreme for my taste buds. I'll try a different version than the Cheeseburger Mac next time out.
