I drink about 3 cups of this a day and don't tire of the flavor. I like it far more than the comparable Tazo flavor, which is not normal since normally I prefer Tazo to Lipton.When I get close to finishing off the tea I have now, I think I'll order this on a subscription and save 15%
This one has a little stronger taste than the Twinings green tea K cups, but still, I love both. This is a staple that you'll want as part of your collection!

This is the best green tea I have run across, cause they say we got a drink it, you know? It has a fresh mild taste, but does not have that grassy taste like you're drinking something that was part of your lawn. Therefore you can drink a bunch of these through the day without upsetting your stomach like with coffee. I think the instant hot water makes it taste better than tea bags in the microwave. A box shows up really fast UPS if you have Prime Shipping. Good stuff.

column9: mild taste, a great morning tea
column10: This is my favorite morning tea. I've tried others, but keep coming back to this one. It's also good with a touch of honey.
I have tried other green teas but the Bigelow brand is the best.  Give it a try, you won't be disappointed.

We really love our Keurig, and the best place to buy the k-cups are at Amazon. I have purchased the tea, cocoa and the coffee. This is the best price and fastest shipping. The green tea is the only type my husband will drink and Amazon sells the best flavor.

My wife's parents are Russian and are staying with us for the Summer. They drink these green tea cups everyday and love them. If it passes the Russian test, I say 5 stars! ( They are BIG tea drinkers. )
So hard to find this tea in stock but as usual amazon came through.  This is my fav green tea.
I bought these because they won't get green tea at work, only those sample packs with crappy teas.This is delicious! I highly recommend it!
We really enjoy this tea after dinner.  It is light and soothing.  Love the Kuerig and now that I can have my green tea it's even better.

I used to use Bigelows green tea in tea bags. After purchasing  a Keurick Kcup machine I finally found their Kcups on Amazon . For me this tea is just right at 12 oz. If I want it a little stronger I just cut back on water. A little squirt of lime juice makes it perfect. I receive my orders from Amazon fast, as I have 2day shipping. I will continue to use Amazon and Bigelow tea in future.

column9: This tea is the Bomb dot Com!!!
column10: One word:  YUM!!  I will never drink coffee again. It is subtle, refreshing and benefecial to your health.  It tastes great with two packs of sugar or sweet n low and coffee creamer.  Green tea is also very beneficial to your health (cancer fighting agents).  For the Keurig machine, I recommend doing the small cup- to get all of the flavor.  When I chose a medium cup, a lot of the tea seasoning was lost.  We go through this stuff like candy in our office YUM YUM YUM :)

My husband works a high stress job. He comes home at night and instead of a glass of wine, he now has green tea. Naturally his online studies after work have improved and he sleeps better. Thanks. Phyllis
Perfect cup of green tea for every meal. I love green tea And this kind is perfect and handy to have ready when you need it.

Wonderful tea that is consistent in its great taste. Nice flavor, easy to work with the Keurig brewer. Did have one container that came apart and got jammed in the brewer, but took a little extra effort to remove. Life should be so simple.

column9: green tea was a great deal
column10: This purchase was a great deal in terms of price and product.  Love green tea and it is so healthy for you.
I have been drinking green tea for years, but this product had a lot more flavor.  I am enjoying very much.  I will order more tea probably in a different flavor, to expand my tastes.
This green tea has a really nice lite flavor and aroma. It's not overly strong, but that's how I like it.
I love green tea. This brand is delicious i just wish it came in decaf. Still i love the taste of this tea.
Green Tea for the Keurig is hard to find so this works out well.  Arrived on time and with 2 packs, it should last a while.

column9: I love the smell of hay in a barn, but....
column10: I do not like to sip it.  Maybe I received a poor batch of tea, but I found this to have too much of a straw/hay taste to suit me.  My favorite green teas have more of a vegetal taste.  I guess I will try Celestial Seasonings' version next.  I wish more companies would make tea in K-cups....Tazo China Green Tips would be nice!
This is my favorite Green Tea. It has just the right strength when brewed on the biggest cup. This particular tea has no after taste.

column9: not the best green tea, but better than Lipton
column10: I am a fairly sophisticated tea drinker and I prefer good Taiwanese green tea (which is 100 times better than tea from China).  This particular k-cup is o.k. but it is more of a Japanese green tea like flavor (darker green).  If you like a good cup of Japanese tea then this is o.k.  I have not found any good k-cup green tea but again even these are much better than Lipton.
Not a connoisseur.....Just know what I like....I drink this tea just like I drink my coffee...straight up. Brew and go....Very Good !!

I have been using the Bigelow Green Tea Bags with my Keurig machine.  Bigelow Green Tea Bags provide great taste.  And when you buy in quanity with the subscribe and save option the cost is a fraction of the cost for the Bigelow Green Tea K-Cups.  I use the Keurig machine solely to get the hot water to brew the tea.  I have not tried the K-Cup Bigelow Green Tea, but I am wondering if the taste using the K-Cups justifies the much greater cost?  I am giving a 3 rating since I do not think the cost would be justifed to use the K-Cups in comparison the the Bigelow Green Tea Bags.  I welcome feedback from individuals who have tried the Bigelow Green Tea and the Bigelow Green Tea K-Cups.Please read my updated comment.  I tried the K-Cup Variety and found no difference in taste between the K-Cup and tea bag variety.

I bought some of these from a vending machine at my work today. I want my quarter back. I tasted a red one. It tasted like how horse manure smells. I have no clue why they'd call these Lotsa Sours when they aren't sour in any way shape or form. I thought maybe one of the other flavors would be better. I was wrong. The green one had a slight hint of possibly a different fruit flavor, but it was still overshadowed by that same much stronger flavor remeniscent of roadapples. I handed the rest over to my boyfriend who eats anything including old leftovers rescued out of the garbage. Even he thinks they taste terrible.$45 spent on buying these in bulk is $45 spent on something you'll probably be spending the rest of your life trying to get rid of. Just taste them before you buy them, and you will know precisely what I mean.
I bought these from a vending machine at a local place of business and I want to go back to that place just for the candy! Purple ones are awesome

This is a favorite of ours and we have ordered it several times because of the unusual and delicious flavor. The price can't be beat (at least not by our local stores) and it is so convenient to have it arrive within a few days. These are crunchy and tasty.

I was looking for something healthy to eat with salsa and these are it! 19 chips are only 120 calories, I usually just eat 10 so that's even less. Oven baked, low sodium, and low fat, what's not to like? Get it!

column9: Fabulous! I dare someone to find a better one!
column10: These are simply the best little snack cracker I've ever tasted, and wonderful holders for toppings of anything you choose--fish, cheese, salsa, etc. (Only slightly less delightful is the wasabi cracker--not enough "bite" for me, but still great.)Like most of us, I need to watch what I eat so I can maintain my weight. I think the flavors in this cracker are better than any I've ever tasted of this genre (although I still like cheese-nips and rye crisp--other animals, so to speak), and they really fill me up at snack time.Warning: do not leave outside or rodents come and open the plastic to get to these gems! (I have used them, the spilled leftovers, successfully in a mousetrap--they aren't as dumb as we think!)Unless I find something tastier, these will be in my pantry forever! Please try them. Worst that can happen is that everyone BUT you will love them, but I'm fairly confident that if you like nori, you will LOVE these crispy treats! Not too hard to bite into, few if any crumbs, and, satisfaction-wise, 100% better than any rice cake cocoction to cross my lips. I wish I could give them 10 stars!

I love the Ka-Me seaweed flavored rice crackers.  Until now I could only find them when I visited Florida.  Now that I can order them on Amazon.com, I will be doing it regularly.  As a bonus, they are less expensive ordering them than purchasing them in the grocery store.
SIT BACK, RELAX WITH A COOL DRINK, CHEESE & KE-ME CRACKERS. WHAT MORE COULD YOU ASK FOR TO START HAPPY HOUR? TO MAKE IT EVEN BETTER, BUY FROM AMAZON & INVEST YOUR SAVINGS

These are the best rice crackers I have ever had. They were difficult to find in stores and I used to eat these years ago.. Not too salty and yet flavorful enough for any type of topping..even just plain sour cream.  They were so fresh, I could eat the whole case and my kids love them, too!Delightful cracker...Never get tired of them..
I find that my kids really like the Kame seaweed crackers and must admit I do enjoy them myself. A tasty treat to have on hand at any time.

I ordered these crackers because I love the taste of seaweed. You can see specks of it in the crackers but there is absolutely NO flavor of seaweed. These are very bland so they aren't too great on their own. However, they are crispy. I can't see eating something with no taste. They need some sort of topping.
Peiffer French Salad Dressing is the best. We could no longer find it in stores. Happy to find and purchase it from online Amazon.

Wonderful French dressing that is not overly sweet. Find other French dressings loaded with sugar and more like eating dessert. This is a classic sweet/sour which does not hide the taste of the  salad itself.
This is a fantastic french dressing...I have been unable to find it in grocery stores.  I was excited to find it on Amazon and I thought the price was very reasonable!

I'm from Buffalo where Pfeiffer originated and I've been eating it my whole life.  I was disappointed when they stopped carrying it in our local grocery stores a few months ago.  I seriously called every grocery store within 20 miles.  I was ready to call the company and try to order it through them.  I was so happy when I found it on Amazon, although, I was a little weirded out ordering food via the internet.  Everything is fine though, there was nothing wrong with it and it's best buy date is not for about 7 months.  The only problem is the price, I used to pay $1.50 per bottle but with shipping it equaled out to more than $5.00 per bottle.  It's worth it.

column9: Why is it so hard to get???
column10: Pfeiffer French salad dressing is absolutely the best. I don't eat salads much because the acid in most dressings tends to wilt the greens before I'm finished. When on a diet, I have "Monster" salads with hard boiled eggs, tomatoes, turkey, Cheddar cheese and pretzels (For crunch).  Worried about calories? Use half Peiffer and half Salsa.  I'm sure a doctor would not endorse this kind of diet, but I lost 60 pounds in 8 months.So why are Peiffer products so hard to find?

Cute idea and would have made a great Christmas gift if the pretzels hadn't been in a million pieces.  Not more than a dozen of them were recognizable as a Christmas shape.  Needs WAY better packing.  Guess we'll be making a lot of pretzel crusted chicken.

Be aware that this review regards Stagg's "Classic" style chili, as they make several varieties. We prefer the "Silverado" style, but Stagg made the labels so close we bought the wrong one. So we made the best of it, and it's not bad, but... the first thing you notice is the difference in how much grease has congealed to the top of the can, which is fairly considerable. If you like your chili greasy, scrape it off of the lid and dump it in. If you have heart concerns and/or for whatever reason do not want enough grease to free-up your average M-16 jam, just throw that lid away. Stagg Chili is still the best game in a can, but the "Silverado" is far and away the best, "Classic" comes in a fading second. More flavor than Hormel (same company owns both, but apparently does not make both in the same facility), but every bit as much grease. It may also be worthy of note that when our local Sam's Club gave us a (typical and by now anticipated) ration of BS (half-answers, 'get-back-to-ya's' and outright lies) about why they weren't going to carry our chili anymore, we gave Amazon a shot. We not only got our chili for about the same price, but also got it delivered to our door. If we can regularly make the same progress with the rest of our shopping list, it's finally "C-ya" to the Sam's Club BS for $36/year and hello 30 minutes on the computer and done.

This chili actually surprised me...I'm glad I decided to listen to the reviews! I make almost everything my family eats from scratch, but lately we've been super busy and I was looking for some "convenience" foods to have on hand. I chose chili for hubby's lunches and chili baked potatoes for dinner, and this chili did not disappoint! Yummy!

column9: The Best Chili You'll Ever Eat In Your Life.
column10: I would go so far as to say this chili is better than mine by a long shot and I can't believe it is made by the Hormel Company.They used to sell it at Safeway Stores and now sadly you can only buy it online.What a tragedy because this chili is the best you'll ever eat bar none.
I will no longer make my own chili.  This has large chunks of meat, large chunks of tomatoes, two kinds of beans and the right amount of bite.

column9: Lentils are terrific - Price is a JOKE it's so highj
column10: From the time we discovered this product 2 or 3 years ago at a local store (Costco) we loved the product.  Then discovered Amazon, and the Tasty Bite Lentils was one of their Subscribe & Save items, allowing us to set up a purchase schedule and receive a 15% discount and free shipping, making the full purchase price around $26.Then, earlier this year Amazon removed it from the Subscribe and Save and the prices went completely nuts.  The lowest price on Amazon is now close to $37, and believe it or not, you can pay as much as $89 on Amazon for the identical package!  Is that crazy??Costco stocks it regularly in their stores for $6.99 for a package of 4 10oz envelopes.  So for 12 envelopes (the same ones that you can buy here for $37), you can purchase 3 boxes of 4 at Costco for $21.  That is 44% Cheaper than Amazon, I won't bother to compare with the $89 price on the linked product!  Make up your own mind.Tasty Bite Madras Lentils Entree, Heat & Eat, 10-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 12)
Perfect one portion size.  Quick and easy to make.  Great source of fiber and protein and low in fat.  Great and spicy tasting!!

column9: Madras Lentils a good side dish
column10: I've been eating various Indian retorted veggie entrees for a while now -- we use them as side dishes when I cook main dishes that may be, but aren't always, Indian. The Madras Lentils remind me a lot of really good Louisiana Red Beans (as in Red Beans & Rice--with or without sausage). Very flavorful and actually a bit meaty in taste. I first encountered them at Trader Joe's but it seems that they are going over to their own labels and they wouldn't admit that they were using TastyBite (see someone else's review of Punjabi Eggplant)so I'll stick with the original. I've also tried, and liked, the Punjabi Eggplant.

column9: Good, but this makes it better
column10: Add a can of red kidney beans to get the most out of this entree.

I tried a demo of Tasty Bite Entree Madras Lentils in a supermarket, and absolutely fell in love with it. Everything in it is healthy stuff, and it's a wonderful thing to use as a topping for baked potatoes or rice.Use your imagination! Add sliced chicken, top it with cheese, mix-in tofu -- the world is yours!Every Tasty Bite Entree I've purchased was really good and worth the price and can add amazing variety to your meals.

I must reiterate what another reviewer said.  Tasty Bite Madras lentils do taste an awful lot like beef chili, a perfect alternative for those who love chili but want a vegetarian alternative.  They also have a similar mouth feel and a nice hearty spiciness.  What they do not have is a lot of excess calories.  One can eat the whole pouch (2 servings worth) and only ingest a mere 240 calories.  That can't be beat!

column9: Nice spices - add rice to make a hearty meal
column10: Madras Lentils are my #2 favorite Tasty Bite entree. Compared to some of the others, it's a little more soupy; I add one GoGo Organic Brown Rice bowl to the mix and put it all in the microwave together for a very filling, very satisfying meal. It does rank on the medium spicy range so if you are averse to a little heat with your meal I would suggest one of the other more benign Tasty Bite meals (such as Agras Peas and Greens). I like that the sodium content is not too high (34% of the RDV if you consume the entire packet yourself) and that the taste is so interesting and complex, given that it is an "instant" item. A friend who hails from south India tried this at my urging and was absolutely delighted by it - she and her Morrocan husband both really enjoyed it and went on Amazon to buy their own stash! I whole-heartedly endorse this particular meal on the merits of its simplicity, too - no crazy preservatives or chemical ingredients.As with many other Amazon offerings, the price they give is not entirely representative of a good deal - the Tasty Bite website offers 1 package for $1.99 each. Where you make out well is when you combine the purchase of several with free shipping here on Amazon and the occasional sale.One last note of caution - be careful of a bit of splatter when opening the vacuum sealed pouch for the first time.

Once sampling this wonderfully flavored lentil bean entree at Costco, I had to buy a package.  Once that was consumed, I had to find more packages, which I found on Amazon.com.This very tasty entree is sooooooo easy to store, fix (microwave 1 to 2 mins) and serve up.Serve:1. Alone as a bowl of beans or soup2. Over a bed of white riceCampers and backpackers...this would work very well for you.[ASIN:B0007R9L4MTasty Bite Entree, Madras Lentils, 10-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 12)]]

While visiting my family, my sister gave me a bunch of food, and shoved a box of madras lentils in my hands. Indian food is good and all, but I was never a big fan of beans. I went ahead and took it anyway. One night I had nothing in my cupboard, so I went ahead and gave it a try. Boy was I glad that actually I had. As soon as I took my first bite I was flabbergasted that I was actually eating beans--and loving every bite of it. It has just the right amount of spices. It's so creamy and scrumptious. Tasty bite is quite a good description of how delicious this meal truly is. If you like Indian food and lentils, I would recommend this dish. You don't have to be a vegetarian to enjoy this. This Indian food does not mess around. Hell, it tastes better than meals I've tried at authentic Indian restaurants. Buy it! You won't regret it.

column9: One of the best of the Tasty Bite meals - Nutrition Information
column10: The Madras Lentils may dethrone Tasty Bite Entree, Punjab Eggplant, 10-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 12) as my favorite Tasty Bite meal.  Just finished eating it for dinner and it was perfect for the winter storm weather because it tastes exactly like chili.  I served it over a little rice to soak up the excess gravy and topped it with fresh chopped jalapeño and a dab of sour cream with corn tortilla chips to eat with it.  Yummy!  Instead of serving it over rice, you could also add some leftover beans or lentils of any kind.The flavor is excellent and the lentils and red beans retain their texture.  I have finally figured out that Tasty Bite does a passable job with beans and lentils as opposed to softer vegetables that end up mushy and flavorless and swimming in sweet sauce.Also, Tasty Bite has finally moved towards eliminating the cardboard boxes that the flexible retort pouches have been packaged in, saving trees and lots of energy in package production and shipping.  Thank you Tasty Bite!Nutrition Facts from labelNet weight 10ozNOTE:  Double values if you serve the entire pouch as a single meal for one because:Serving size 1/2 pack / 5oz / 142.5gAmount per serving:Calories 120Fat calories 40Total fat 5gSaturated fat 3gTrans fat 0gCholesterol 3mgSodium 450mgTotal carbohydrates 14gDietary fiber 5gSugars 2gProtein 6gVitamin A 6% of Recommended Daily AllowanceCalcium 4%Vitamin C 4%Iron 16%While it is relatively high in sodium, there is also a good bit of fiber and iron present in this meal.Another good vegetarian substitute for chili is Kitchens Of India Ready To Eat Rajma Masala, Red Kidney Bean Currry, 10-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 6).

column9: Makes a great base for lentils and beans!
column10: I bought this because the picture looks great and I wanted to eat more lentil and bean based dishes.  On its own I think its just ok but it does make a great base when you add additional lentils and kidney beans it also increases the serving size substantially and makes it worth the price. I saute a 1/4 cup of chopped red onion with 1 chopped garlic clove and 1 tablespoon of olive oil until the onion is tender.  Then I add 2 cups of water and bring it to a boil. I reduce the heat and add a pinch of salt and 3/4 cup of French lentils. Cook the lentils until just tender and stir in 1 can of drained kidney beans plus 1 Tbsp  butter and the contents of the package. Heat thoroughly.  You can add vegetable broth or water to adjust the consistency. Tastes great as a soup or side dish and is great with salmon and adds some variety to my meals.

These Indian-style Madras lentils have a little bit of a zing, but they're not spicy. One minute in the microwave and they're ready to enjoy. Not only do they taste great, but they're also very healthy. The only serious criticism I have is that the packaging is a little excessive and should be reduced; the food itself is nutritious and delicious.

This is now one of my favorites.  Had it for lunch as a soup.  I do think that the Tasty Bite portions are on the small size for claiming two servings (unless you're serving it with other food items) but they're always just the right amount to fill me up.  This one in particular I found to be extremely filling.  Tastes just like a mildly spicy beef chili without the beef.  Tofu and an extra can of kidney beans stirred into the mix could easily make this a filling meal for four.

column9: Tasty Bite Madras Lentils are in fact tasty!
column10: With my daughters decision to eat vegetarian, it has become a small struggle to find healthy, filling foods to stock in the pantry for her after school.We recently had the chance to sample Tasty Bite Entree, Madras Lentils, 10-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 12) and I was very surprised at how good it was. Unlike my daughter I do not normally care for any type of Indian cuisine, but I liked this. It can be best described as a meatless chili, but with better flavor and texture than most vegetarian chili. It also had a nice level of heat to it.  Enough to notice, but not enough to be unpleasant.Serving suggestions were to use as a filling for tacos or over basmati rice. So far my daughter prefers to just eat it by itself.Now that we have found Tasty Bite brand products, my daughter is looking forward to trying out some others.  I think Tasty Bite Entree, Kashmir Spinach, 10-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 12) will probably be next.

column9: Great office food, tasty for what it is
column10: I buy these all the time.It's GREAT for office food. I heat up a container of Annie Chun's Rice Express Sprouted Brown Rice, 6.3-Ounce Microwavable Bowls (Pack of 6), combine it with the contents of the Madras Lentils in a deep microwaveable bowl, give it 2 more minutes in the microwave and I've got a hot tasty filling filling, low fat high fiber meal (filling enough in fact that I often end up eating 1/2 and saving the rest for later). Both of these products require NO refrigeration so they are perfect for keeping around the office, at ~$5.50/meal if you eat it all at once, $2.75 if you split it between two meals.I also eat it at home.From a Weight watchers standpoint, the rice and the lentals add up to 10 points total, but like I said its filling enough for 2 meals.I will say, this is Indian food Lite, as in its processed food, and the spicing is mild. But it's very tasty

column4: R. W. Taylor "Wil O' The Wisp"
column10: I recently paid $4.80 for a 4-pack (same size packs, same product). The product is pretty good... kind of a dal-sort-of-thing, but I cannot see forking over such $$$ here for it. Look elsewhere!

We were at Costco one day and they had a sample table set up with these.  We tried them and really liked them and so did our two year old, who is a fairly picky eater.  So we bought a box and now I wish I had gotten more!  I have eaten them straight, over baked potatoes, and tonight mixed with some sauteed chicken over a bed of peas and brown rice.  It took me all of ten minutes to cook (the chicken was cut into bites and the rice was instant).  We are going next week to Costco and stocking way up.  I would buy them here, but this is not a good price at all.
I love these lentils! They are tasty and filling. I am of an Indian descent and they remind me of the lentils that my mum makes!
Reminds me of chili...without all the calories. I might add 1 oz. of some lean ground turkey next time.

I came across this product at Costco when they were giving out samples.  I hate lentils (I thought), but the sample was free & I was hungry.  What a surprise!  This tastes a lot like really good chili!  It tastes like beef chili, though it doesn't have meat.  My husband likes it too, and he's not big on vegetarian meals.90 seconds in the microwave is perfect.  It doesn't seem like there are two servings in the pouch, but we poured it over slices of homemade bread, and it was very filling.  I'm looking forward to trying out more Tasty Bite flavors.  I hope they have a variety pack.

I really like this product a LOT, and though for my taste it is a bit too spicy. I consider  this is my BEST "find" for this year!  I keep this stocked in my pantry all year-round!  I find this product is a great base for a very nourishing meal shortcut.  So, if you're not into spicy food like me, use two of the packets as a base and add one 14 oz. container of chicken stock, add a cup of cut potatoes (I use the plain Ore Ida hash brown cubed potatoes from the frozen food section of the market) and add one small can of kidney beans and finely chopped carrots and celery and slow simmer for about 45 minutes (or use a fuzzy logic rice cooker on the soup setting if you have one) and you'll have an incredibly easy & hearty meal good for 2 large or 4 smaller bowls.  Add to it a loaf of crusty bread, some wine, and Fontina or other favorite cheese and you'll be healthfully well-fed!

column4: Doris R. Kem "cat n' dog lover"
column10: This is a great tasting product!  It's not too high in fat, either.  Does kind of taste like coney sauce--but not exactly.  I absolutely LOVE it!  My non-vegetarian husband also likes it.  You won't be disappointed if you order this.  I will definitely be reordering.

I tried this because I was looking for something easy with lentils.  The picture looked yummy on the box and spices sounded great.  Was I suprised.  It was delicious and easy to prepare.  I love spicy meals and this hit the spot.  (I couldn't believe there was no meat in this dish.)

This was a very pleasant surprise. I am Puerto Rican and very partial to prepared beans. This product was very good and will buy lots of it. The flavor was excellent and would not hesitate to use it with some of my own ethnic dishes. I highly recommend this product.

column9: Delicious and taste almost as good as homemade
column10: The madras lentils are very delicious and does not taste like it came out of a box. My husband and I love them and if we are too tired to cook, this is the perfect, quick solution with a satisfying taste.

column9: Price on this product is ridiculously expensive!
column10: This is a great product, but at a price that is ridiculous.  Costco was offering this product at 6.99 for a box of 4.  That is $1.75 a packet.  Why is this vendor selling this same product at over twice the cost, when they probably have half the overhead as Costco.  I love the product, but refuse to buy at this price.

column9: Food is delicious but way overpriced compared to local supermarket
column10: It is as yummy and nutritious as all the other reviews claim. You don't have to like Indian food to like this product and it does remind me of a good chile.Regular price at Stop & Shop is $3.69. I thought that was expensive so I decided to look for it online. The price on Amazon and other online retailers is so ridiculously expensive that I'm going back to the supermarket to stock up just in case they priced it wrong.
It's got a good flavor but it tastes nothing like Indian food.  It tastes exactly like coney dog sauce.

Perhaps I got a bad batch.  This wasn't at all like the madras lentils enjoyed at Indian restaurants.  It was watery, too salty, and there were not many lentils.  It was like a watery soup, and not like the picture on the package or like a lentil stew.

Where a 4-pack of these tasty lentils & such is cheaper. A great flavor and not as pronounced a scent if you're eating at your desk and/or worried about affecting the microwave's essence in the staff cafe.

Bought this at Costco, perfect!!  4 pack for 7 dollars, so this is not the best price out there but I don't think Costo will carry it forever.  Thinking about a subscription once Costco runs out of stocl, one taste and it is a favorite!!!
I eat these almost every day. They are so quick and easy. This is a fast meal, but I don't feel gross after eating this microwavable meal.

I did not expect this item to taste so good. It really impressed me. I dipped warm naan (Indian flatbread) in it to get the excess broth and it was delicious. It does taste like Chili. I wish I had the recipe.

My family generally likes Indian food so it isn't surprisingly that we like this. However, my 7 year old announced today when he got off the bus that he could eat lentils and rice until he had a stomach ache and then he would still eat it! I had sent warmed left-overs with him to school. The product isn't cheap, but it is a great stand-in when you are out of ideas or need a quick dinner. Two pouches of the lentils and one of chick peas do my young family of 5 easily with 1.5 servings left-over. If you were feeding teenagers, I'm sure you'd need a heck of a lot more. With rice, and a salad or fruit or veggie, it makes a fabulous, quick meal in 20 minutes, (just for the rice, or course). I keep several tasty-bite products on hand for such times.

I bought this at Costco yesterday after trying a sample. This is something I will keep in my pantry. So good! Only 2 Weight Watchers points per serving. I don't like Indian food so I would have never tried this without sampling first. It just taste like a really good chili. My husband couldn't believe that there isn't any meat in it. I have friends on the Weight Watchers plan that also have to eat "gluten free" and I can't wait to tell them about this.

column9: Love it! Love it! Love it!
column10: I'm a big fan of Tasty Bite and I've tried a lot of their offerings.  My absolute favorite is the Madras Lentils. (With or without rice) Than the Channa Masala and Punjab Eggplant. Beans Masala & Basmati Rice Ready Meal s also very good. The ones that I didn't like sooo much were the Jaipur Vegetables, Vegetable Korma, and Kashmir Spinach.  I really wanted to like the Bombay Potatoes but even over a generous helping of rice it's just too spicy, It has a good flavor but there's just too much heat in the mix. As a little side note, it looks like Tasty Bite is in the process of changing their packaging from envelopes in boxes to just envelopes. Good for the environment but WOW! the edges will cut you up. I'm still nursing a good size cut  from simply turning the package over to read ingredients. Hopefully they work on the design a bit more.

column9: Really good and good for you, too!
column10: A friend at work gave me one of these entrees and I was hooked. It's not really spicy, just tastes like chili. It's great with a couple of slices of toast or a few crackers. Since it does not have to be refrigerated, it's nice to keep a couple in my desk drawer at work to have. I also love the fact that is has no preservatives. Highly recommended!

Madras Lentils may easily be eaten alone for a satisfying meal with little clean-up. When eating this as a family meal we like to add one can of pink beans, one can of finely diced tomatoes, and a little frozen/fresh spinach to two pouches of Madras Lentils. We serve it on top of rice. Easy, fast, no MSG too!!!!

This is great to take to the office, especially for those days when you can't get away.  It is convenient and a perfect portion size for a "not too full" feeling.  It is very tasty and has good texture.
Very nice. Not spicy, not too salty, lots of protein (12g for the whole packet), soft and mushy (in a good way). The balance between sauce and solid stuff (lentils and kidney beans) was good too.

This is my favorite Tasty Bite meal out of the 4 I've tried (I'm in the process of trying more). I take this to work a lot with some naan or pita, and rice works well, too. It's like Indian-spiced chili - yum! This is a very hardy and satisfying vegetarian meal. Another reviewer suggested adding kidney beans - I might try that.

I am a great cook so I generally make things from scratch.  This is something I never would have tried had it not been for [...] giving out samples.  I couldn't believe that it not only tasted good, it also has a simple ingredient list with no additives.  Only wholesome things like tomatoes, lentils, red beans, onions, cream, salt, butter, sunflower oil, chilies and cumin.  That's it--really.I bought it with a quick lunch in mind--brown rice with the Madras Lentils on top, but I have also used it as a base for a dinner meal adding ground turkey sauteed with fresh tomatoes, green peppers, onions and garlic.It is delicious either way.

column9: High Fiber Low Fat entire package 4 points on weight watchers
column10: These lentils are very tasty, not to spicy.  They are great if you are on a diet.  Great Price.

column9: Absolutely Delicious - my favorite Tasty Bite
column10: I love tasty bite as a product.  I'm mostly vegetarian (I try to avoid as much meat as I can), and I love savory and spicy foods. I've tried at least 15 Tasty Bite varieties (mostly Indian varieties, a couple of the Thai ones), and Madras Lentils is my favorite by a long ways.- It is very flavorful - rich, savory- It is a satisfying comfort food- Good source of protein and not too high in fat or sodium- It is very versitile.  I usually eat it plain (almost like a soup/chili) but you could also serve it with rice or naan or even Tortilla chips.I once held a party where the attendance list surprisingly filled up as people brought more friends that I was expecting.  I took two boxes of Madras Lentils, microwaved them in a ceramic bowl, garnished with a little cilantro, and surrounded with tortilla chips.  My guests didn't quite know what it was ("some sort of lentil/chili dip") but it went FAST and received a lot of compliments (and helped me quickly extend my food offerings).You'll like this one!

My whole family loves to eat this.  We eat about 50% vegetarian and this makes a very tasty and quick meal for us.  I just cut up some tofu for extra protein and stir in a pan.  Ten minutes later we have a healthy and yummy meal that even my kids (age 4 and 2) LOVE!  And if you buy this through Amazon's Subscribe and Save program, the cost for each pouch is only $2!  I usually use 2 bags for dinner and 1 container of tofu.  So I just fed my family of 4 for only $7 :)!P.S.  My son says that this tastes just like the chili from Wienerschnitzel :).

The lentils are good, but you get a box of 6 10oz bags of lentils for over $30.  That's over $5 a 10oz pouch.  You can get them at Costco for about $6-$7 for the same box of 6 pouches. Don't waste your money.  Find a different source for these.

IF YOU'RE LOOKING FOR  SOMETHING EASY TO PREPARE,MEATLESS AND VERY HEALTHY,IT'S THE MADRAS LENTLIS ENTREE!! iT'S SUGGESTED THAT YOU HEAT IT BEFORE YOU EAT IT, BUT I'VE NEVER GOT THAT FAR............I LOVE IT COLD! MADRAS HAS MORE ENTREES, BUT I'VE ONLY HAD THIS ONE.  iT'S WONDERFUL! YOU MUST TRY IT. THE AMAZON SHIPPING WAS GREAT AND TRUSTWORTHY!

column9: Tastes like Hormel chili with beans
column10: That is to say, it's pretty tasty.  A little hard to get the lentils out of the bag/sleeve, but a delicious afternoon meal.

I cannot tell that this is a vegetarian dish, it is that good! It is thick and hearty and tastes just like a delicious bowl of mildly spicy chili. However, if you have plans involving other people the next day, you might also consider buying a bottle of Beano tablets. ;)

I don't understand why I had to wait almost two months to receive this case order. Delicious, easy to prepare item.  Best if you add your own additional lentils since there aren't that many in the sauce.  The sauce is wonderful and spicy.

I was really expecting a more "berry-like" tea.  The color and smell of the tea is wonderful.  However, it is more like a hibiscus tea than a fruity berry tea.  Still a delightful tea.  Found it was good hot or cold.  Also, makes a nice cocktail drink by serving cold with a little vodka over ice.  This one I used a little sweetener to bring out all the flavors of the tea.

This is a very flavorful, fruity tea. It's good hot or cold, and really needs no sweetening. I often add some hibiscus when I brew it, which makes a delicious combination.Compared to similar teas you can find in most supermarkets (Celestial Seasonings, Bigelow, etc.), this tea is a great value. You can actually identify this tea's various components, where the supermarket teas are often "tea dust."Give it a try. It's a very tasty tea.
I really like this tea.  You don't have to use much and it is naturally sweet.  My grand children love it.  Beats giving them yuckie coolaid and soda pop.
guys this is not a very fruity tea as i expected tho good its a bit bland for my taste does have a nice spring garden sent just not much berry flavor

Flavor:This tea is very tasty. The flavor matches the name, "Herbal Berry Essence". I hope you like Hibiscus though. It has a good tang to it. If you don't like the tang, sugar smooths it out real nice.Packaging:Surprisingly well packaged for what the picture shows. I got mine in a nice resealable pouch. Will buy again and try flavors. Thanks Davidson's

I had just come back from NYC and had dilled green tomatoes.  I was craving this food.  I did research and this item seemed to be what I was looking for.The picture is misleading.  I got my package.  I was horrified.  I was expecting large, crunchy dilled tomatoes.To my great disappointment.  The tomatoes were cherry tomatoes.  The tomatoes had no crunch and very little dill.  I spat out what was in my mouth.  I am, also, upset for you cannot return the product unless their error.Do not waste your money on this product.
What is there to review? They're little plastic aliens in little plastic eggs that you put in a vending machine. Pretty much exactly what the product description says they are.

This is one of the best k-cup coffees I have tried. Rich smooth flavor. I love it. For those that say "it is not a K-kup" are off base. This is a K-cup, just without the outer plastic shell, which makes it a much greener option. If you cut a regular plastic K-cup open, you will see this..... coffee in a pod filter. Why have your coffee surrounded by plastic when it is absolutely unnecessary? This is a GREAT cup of coffee. If you like Starbucks, you will love this. May even be better.
Great coffee taste is excellent and price is rightWorks very well in my coffee machineI would buy this again

It's a decent coffee. The Fog Chaser from S.F. Bay Coffee is a better choice.  This is what people consider a "bold" blend.  That means it has harshness that hits you over the tongue like a hammer.  It's not smooth by any sense.  I usually enjoy my coffee black but this one is good with a flavored creamer to take the bitter edge off.

This is the second box that I ordered. My husband and I love it.  It is rich and bold. Being it was so good, we went ahead and tried the decafe as well.Much to our surprise, it was just as good. You can't beat the price for either one of them. I would recommend it to anyone!Pat C.

this coffee is excellent and the price can't be beat the cup looks different from most kcups but it works perfect and is really good coffee.I have it on auto shipments and that makes it even a better buy. Try it you'll love the taste and value

column9: Simply The Best "K Cup" Cup Around
column10: I'm a serious coffee drinker. I like it strong, rich and interesting. My wife prefers a good but milder variety. We've tried many, many K-Cup varieties and found several one or the other of us enjoys, but until now none that pleases us both. SFB's Rainforest does and in spades.This, to me, is simply the best "K-Cup" coffee around.  The details of the packaging are described elsewhere, but (to me)the biggest difference is that these 'not quite K-Cups' have more body than the regular fully sealed type - and lack of "body" is (again, to me) the biggest single failing of even the best K-Cup coffees.Great coffee. Ready in minutes. At a fair price. Doesn't that beat all? :)
This is the best coffee we have ever had - made for the keurig brewers. The flavor is very full bodied with NO bitterness.
I am not a coffee drinker but my wife says it's some of the best coffee she has tasted. She also likes the more compact size and the fact that they are more biodegradable.
I know organic has a different taste, but this is bad. Couldn't get even one cup down. I won't buy again.

The least expensive KCups I've found, and very good coffee! I was skeptical about auto-ship, but since I can modify my order as needed, it turns out to be a no-brainer for me. I HIGHLY recommend this product.

I have subscribe to these to get that extra discount which makes them a not bad price compared to others one cups. As most others have pointed out this is not a true K-cup as the base in not plastic. These make a nice strength of coffee for your medium cup size. It is a little weak coffee for me on the larger size. They come in three bags and I do wish that they could be resealed but I solved the problem by placing them in an air tight container. When I opened the bag of coffee I was hit by the smell of fresh ground coffee. I hadn't realized how much I have missed that smell. You don't get that with the plastic cups. Over all I thought it was a good price and makes a nice cup of coffee. I will be keeping my subscription.

I like all types of coffee, so I was surprised that this blend just didn't suit my taste.  Not sure what the flavor is - woodsy comes to mind - but not a favorite for me.  My daughter really liked it, so I gave her the box.  I like their otherblends, so this is just me not liking this flavor.

column9: I am in love with this stuff
column10: I loved my Keurig before San Francisco Bay, but now I am a little obsessed.  I find myself waking up earlier and earlier just so I can have my first cup of morning coffee...  yum!  I look forward to opening that ziploc bag and smelling the coffee goodness waft out.  I am definitely in love with the price.  The ONLY thing I am not in love with is the decaf selection.  I would drink even more decaf (i drink plenty now...) if there were more options!Yes, as others have said, this is NOT A K-CUP! This is a mini-filter, so you have to keep it sealed or refrigerated until you use it.  It contains more coffee, for a bolder, more delicious cup than the k-cups usually offer.  I can hardly go back to k-cups anymore.
By far is one of the better coffee's out there- Matter of fact so is the French Roast.Getting ready to buy more rain forest blend today!

column9: Great coffee, great price - and a great design . . .
column10: Not only was this item priced well, but I really appreciate not having to throw all that plastic in my trash.  Very reasonable priced too.  I've purchased additional quantities at my local supermarket on a sale.  I intend to buy more.

Strong yet smooth. I tend to lean toward dark roasts, but this has a strong smooth taste with none of the bitterness associated with say a French roast. Good coffee, like the filtered kcup San Francisco Bay coffees uses.

I've been a longtime Starbucks fan, but this is my new favorite! Because of the new, environmentally friendly kcup design, you get the heavenly coffee aroma from the second you open the vacuum sealed bag, a bold cup of coffee that wakes up your tastebuds and lingers on your tongue; it holds up to creamer too and the price can't be beat, as far as I can tell. If you are looking for a robust cup of coffee you won't be sorry.

column9: At last!  Good coffee for the Keurig!
column10: I love coffee.  Good coffee.  For many years, I have bought high-end beans, stored them carefully and ground them right before making a pot of coffee.  My husband and I have a fine dining restaurant, and the coffee we serve there is simply wonderful, because I carefully sourced the coffee we buy to get the best possible flavor.So, when I was given a Keurig as a gift, I was not exactly thrilled.  I am the only coffee drinker in our house, and I thought it would be wonderfully convenient, although I was concerned about the quality of the coffee available for it.  I had no idea it would be as bad as it was.  I know you have to kiss a lot of frogs before you meet a prince, but I sure didn't think I would buy and taste so much pitifully poor coffee in my search for something good.  I tried so many of those environmentally-unfriendly little plastic cups, and even the five-star ones were ... meh.  I even bought several contraptions that let you use your own coffee, but they were more trouble to use than making a whole pot of the stuff, defeating -- for me, at least -- the whole purpose of having a Keurig.  I seriously considered just giving the thing away.Then I saw these lower-priced, more environmentally-friendly pods from San Francisco Bay.  I read the reviews and decided to give it a try.  When my pods arrived, I opened the bag and was greeted by the wonderful aroma of GOOD COFFEE!  My hopes soared.  When I tasted my first cup, I was so happy that I went through my office giving pods to my coffee-loving friends (we use Keurig at my day job).  It's still nowhere near the coffee in our restaurant, but I can at last have GOOD COFFEE at work!  The fact that these are more environmentally friendly and cheaper than the bad K-cups I've bought in the past is just a bonus!I bought several varieties and am happy with all of them, though the Rainforest Blend is my favorite so far, rich but not bitter and with wonderful coffee flavor and aroma.  It's a bit of a pain to keep them in a ziplock bag, but you get used to it, and the coffee is certainly worth it.FWIW, I also tried another environmentally-friendlier pod, Cameron's, and found it not nearly as good as the San Francisco Bay coffee.  I'll stick with SFB from now on, and I'm keeping the Keurig.
Nice strong brew.  Don't be fooled by the shape of the coffee container.  The price is awesome.  I'm really happy I tried it.

column9: Neat new more enviromentally friendly K-Cup Option
column10: I was initially shocked when I initially opened my parcel and found these very cool new San Francisco Bay Coffee Organic One Cup for Keurig K-Cup Brewers, Rainforest Blend, 80-Count. First this is a great value at $33.00 including free shipping with my Prime Account. For those of you who have not tried Prime membership it pays for itself in between 60-90 days with moderate use and I believe Amazon still offers a 30 day free trial which is worth looking at to experience the benefits. I've had my membership for 3 years and its a great value! Enough for the the Amazon commercial back to the coffee. Price per cup is the lowest I have found anywhere at just under 42 cents. The normal K-cups are all plastic while these have a plastic ring with a fiber filter bag. Its not 100% recyclable but its a big step forward as the filter will break down quickly and the coffee grounds will then fall out allowing those to decompose as well. That leaves a small plastic ring (which looks recyclable) and foil top left. To assist to keep your coffee fresh you receive a reusable lightweight recyclable plastic tub with an airtight lid that holds about 8 K-cups for peak freshness. In addition each 8 K-Cups is sealed in a vented recyclable bag inside the box so you open one and put them in the storage tub after. Nice touch.This is a robust organic coffee with a smooth finish, its gives me above average caffeine buzz, please note I am not big coffee drinker, more a 1-2 good cups a day guy and I like to have variety, thus my move to a Keurig system (which I love and have spread this to 6 others in my family as well as many at my office). Thi is a good coffee with nice flavor and I also like the fact its organic, a little more recyclable and a good value. A++++

I think this coffee was delicious and I love that I'm wasting less plastic with it.  Once you open the pack of 12, you do want to put it in a ziploc bag to keep it fresh. My favorite part about this coffee was every time I opened the bag, it smelled so good. I've missed the smell of coffee with the usual K cups. I will definitely be buying more of this.
Probably to bold for the average coffee drinker, but great for that first cup in the morning or when you first get to work in a high stress environment. Love IT! Best 1 cup coffee ive ever drank

column9: Great coffee, strong enough for Re-brew
column10: We use this coffee in our Keurig.  My husband likes strong coffee and I like weak.  These pods give us both what we want... he brews his cup then I brew the same pod again and it is still coffee, just weaker.  It saves us money... most of the other pods we've tried aren't strong enough to do a re-brew.
This is a great coffee at a great price.  We love it.  Be careful to keep it in an airtight container so it doesn't lose flavor.

This coffee is inexpensive, and tastes more like old-school coffee maker or instant coffee than the Keurig qualitywe are used to.  That being said, at 41 cents a cup, it is a good option for offices, waiting rooms, and other places you may want to offer coffee but not spend a fortune.

Great coffee!  I stumble on this product searching for discounted K-cups, the price is good so I gave it a try.  I highly recommend after the first cup.  It fits as well as a Kcup! Incrediable Flavor!

Very strong but good cup of coffee.  I actually brew 2 cups from 1 Kcup into a pot and drink this because the coffee is plenty strong.The Kcups are a little different, smaller, but less plastic waste, and work just as well.Nice to get organic coffee for this price.Great deal!

I used to buy these coffee beans in the 3 lb bag till I got my Keurig coffee maker. The freshness of this coffee is amazing no longer need to grind my own beans. I put these pods in a clear canister next to my Keurig. Really a great product.
Tried this as opposed to Foggcutter because I thought it was equal in boldness, but it is not.Flavor very good, just not the boldness I was looking for.

I have tried just about every brand and this is one of my favorites.  The price is realistic for those who drink alot of coffee.  And you can't beat the convenience of having it delivered monthly.  I highly recommend this coffee and this service offered through Amazon.

This is the second time I have purchased this product.  I like the flavor and the ease of use.  It is more convenient that the K-cups and the fact there is less waste.  I will continue to purchase this coffee
Great full bodied flavor. Not bitter. A great value for the money. I have tried Rainforest, French Roast and Fog Chase. They are all excellent. I am looking forward to trying Hazelnut Creme.
This roasting is bold, and I have ordered another lighter roasting for breakfast.  However, I love the reduction in unneccesary packaging.  Fresh grind, excellent brew!
Great flavor, great packaging..everything's good..will order more, have others by this company onauto-ship and will probably add this one also.

liked the flavor and aroma of the coffee a lot! The only drawback is that it comes in a bag that has to be cut open, then needs to be put in a baggie of some sort to be kept fresh. A better design would be to ship the product in a resealable bag or container of some sort. The difference in price between this and the plastic pods makes it worthwhile.

San Francisco Bay's Rainforest coffee is absolutely delicious! I had stopped using it in favor of another SFBay flavor, however, I had forgotten how wonderful, rich, and bold it is! I also love that the bottom of this K-cup is not made of paper but of a more environmentally friendly filter=type of material. All in all, I give this coffee an A++.

column9: Anxiously awaiting more like this - awesome new cup design!
column10: The San Francisco Coffee Company has a fan here.Let's face it, what used to be an economical way to have a perfect cup of coffee has nearly become an all-too-expensive luxury.When I got my first Keurig coffeemaker years ago, (free from Green Mountain - the very first model made) I was impressed that I could get a consistently delicious and hot cup of coffee that compared with coffeehouse coffee for about 25 cents per cup at home. As the prices have risen over the past few years, we have cut back and use it probably half as much as before. Unfortunately, it is not the coffee but the packaging that costs so much more.Now that prices for many K-cups have risen to close to a dollar apiece, I was extremely pleased to see that someone has begun to offer a more economical and eco-friendly cup for the Keurig. I ordered a 36-pack of the Rainforest Blend to try it out at about .40 per cup - a reasonable price, in my opinion. The coffee is delicious (I will review the coffee itself after sampling some more) and the cups work without issue. In fact, I hope to hell Green Mountain licenses these guys' design to cut the costs of their products (maybe then I will start buying theirs again.)An added benefit is that it is MUCH easier to open the cup and efficiently remove the grounds for composting, before trashing the remains. I would guess I could fit the remains of 1,000 of these cups in the same garbage bag space as 100 of the conventional K-cups. Do yourself (and the world) a favor and start composting now.

column9: The smell of real coffee that's very good!
column10: I think I read every single review here before ordering. At the low, subscribe-and-save price with free shipping, it was a no brainer to give this coffee a try. They arrived quickly and were packed in sealed, thick plastic bags. When I opened one of the packs, I was in heaven over the fresh smell of coffee! I have missed that with the conventional plastic k-cups. I don't know why more coffee companies wouldn't want to use the filtrated type k-cup method over the plastic. It's more natural and I don't see an issue with losing the freshness of the coffee if stored in a zip lock bag or container. Some complained of sediment in the bottom of their cup. I have not had this issue. Nor do I have those few tiny grinds floating in my coffee anymore as I sometimes had from brewing from the plastic k-cups.As for the taste of the coffee: I am a coffee snob. I admit it. I wouldn't be caught dead drinking convenience store coffee or Maxwell House type coffee! This is a smooth blend with no bitter aftertaste. It smells heavenly as it brews and is not weak. It tastes like a medium blend with slight hints of a dark roast. Some days I like it that way and other days, I run it through the Keurig twice for a lighter, yet still smooth taste. I end up with a large mug of coffee for (at this current time on subscribe & save pricing) less than twenty-five cents a cup!I can't imagine ever wanting to have my coffee brewed through a plastic k-cup again or paying sixty cents a cup for other k-cups.Enjoy this fabulous coffee and bravo to this coffee company for coming up with this far superior filter-style k-cup!

The coffee's OK, but the little pod gets stuck up in the machine. It's not impossible to get out, but takes effort and patience - I bought these as a gift for my brother who LOVES coffee, and his Keurig machine, but definitely doesn't have the patience to work with the stuck pod - too bad, too, because I really loved the idea of putting a lot less plastic into the landfills!

I really like this coffee.  I purchased a package at my local grocery store and it's great.  The coffee is about a medium roast, but very bold and full bodied in flavor.The design of the OneCup works perfectly in my Keurig and I've had no troubles thus far with it.  I'm betting the OneCup design is a little more eco-friendly as well.My suggestion to the manufacturer would be to make the plastic bag resealable so that I don't have to transfer the OneCups to a Ziplock container.  Other than that, a great product, deserving 5 stars!
I was skeptical to buy this because I've bought "cheap" coffee before I'm always disappointed with its taste.  This tastes great and the environmental factor is just a bonus for me!

I love my Keurig, but the k-cups are so expensive, so I shopped til I found this one at a great price.  I knew I was taking a chance, but I wasn't disappointed.  The coffee is a little strong for my taste, but adding a bit more milk mellows it out very well.  Also like that they've done away with the outside (plastic) shell, making this 'greener'.  All in all, it's a great coffee at a great price, and I'm ordering more.

Bought a box of these from BJs before I found them on amazon. Let me tell you this is one GREAT cup-o-joe. I was a bit skeptical because of the kcup redesign but it brews perfectly in my B70.  I've been brewing kcups almost exclusively for the past few years, and as another reviewer noted I didn't realize how much I missed the smell of a freshly opened bag of coffee. These things smell Fantastic!  They come packaged in multiple vacuum sealed bags of 8 or 12 depending on the size box you order, I put mine in a vacuum sealed canister to store them on the counter once I open a bag due to the open bottom design of the kcup.  I'm really impressed at how full bodied this coffee is, I absolutely love it, kinda reminds me of a toned down version of  Timothy's Midnight Magic.  I think the thicker nature of the filter and open cup design allows for a more efficient extraction because this coffee turns out perfectly every time.  I also subscribed to the "fog chaser" variety which is very good but a slightly less robust cup.  For now I'm hooked on the rainforest!08/11/2012  Still loving the rainforest blend.  This is by far my favorite k cup of all time. This is the closest you'll get to a fresh cup of "coffehouse" coffee from a k-cup.  I just wish they would come out with a decaf blend also.

I am normally a breakfast blend drinker. I decided to try this because bb wasn't available. Although my friends and family like it I felt it too strong. Packaging is great and price is too. I'm ordering breakfast blend today and hopefully that's good for me.I'm giving it five stars though because it is good quality.

I've been a huge fan of k-cups for several  years now, but have always felt bad about the environmental impact of the plastic cups (I even tried to figure a way to recycle them for crafts!) These little "suspended filters" are AWESOME and the coffee it equally AWESOME.  The flavor rivals my favorite Newman's Own or Green Mountain k-cups.  I have already turned several friends on to this coffee!

I bought these K cups because I got an email alert that they were on sale. So I took a chance and purchased them. They are awesome. Love the new style of k cup with less plastic and the flavor was amazing. I would definitely purchase these again .
The coffee is good and whenever I can find coffee for my Keurig at a good price, that makes me happy.

column9: Coffee great, Cup does not fit Keurig machine well
column10: A friend gave a few cups of this to try.  Coffee was great.  The cup did not fit my Keurig Special Edition (a few years old) model well.  It did not fully seat in the cup holder and top would not close completely unless one held it down during brew cycle.Too bad, it seems like a nice lower waste design for the coffee holder cup.  But it simply did not fit my machine properly.

I have purchased and used just about ALL the brands and flavors of pods available and, until now, they all tasted like watered-down coffee.. These pods make a truly strong, full bodied, and aroatic cup of coffee, even when you use the "mug" setting.  I will never buy any other pods

RainForest is a mild coffee good any time of the day. All the coffee from San Francisco Bay are excellent. In my opinion there cup design is supperior to the plastic cups by Keruig and others. I have never had a failure or grind of coffee in my cup while using this product. You will not be disapointed in this product.

I think there has been enough written about the cup style ( yea lets go greener)  thought I'd talk about taste. Rainforest blend is medium roast a bit on the dark side has a bit of a smokey taste with dark chocolate at the end if you like sweeter fruiterer mild chocolate taste get the breakfast blend PS if you try the fogchaser or French roast leave a taste comparison. Thanks
Nice, full body coffee. I like it! I would definitely recommend adding it to your rotation! It is stronger than some might prefer but I think most would enjoy it.

This was a great bargain for the K-cups. It was less than half the store price, these funny cups use less plastic but still work in the machine and they were delivered very quickly. The coffee is a little stronger, I think since there is a filter bottom instead of just 1 hole so more coffee seeps out. I just run the machine cup-less for hot water and dilute it myself.

The cups are different. They have a paper filter that doesn't get punched like regular K Cups.In my opinion they make much better coffee than the others. Rainforest blend is my favorite,but the other blends are good too.

I was a bit skeptical about trying this product.  I wasn't sure if it would work in my Kuerig.  It is like the k-cup without the plastic cup.  It works just fine & is more environmentally friendly.  The coffee is bold the way I like it.  I would compare it to Emerils big easy bold.  K-cup prices have gone through the roof so it is nice to find an alternative.  I would recommend this if you like a bold cup of coffee.San Francisco Bay Coffee One Cup, Rainforest Blend, 36-Count

Tried because this was much cheaper than an original K-Cup.  Comes in a plastic airtight bag, but once you open it, you have to put it in a ziploc.  This coffee was stronger than I like, but I'll try another flavor.  The pod design is pretty cool.

We've been using the Keurig for a few years, shortly after they became available for home use. We've tried many brands of K Cups and these, to me, are the best!The coffee is shipped in vacuumed  sealed plastic bags and once you open them, the  aroma is quite intense and intoxicating. After enjoying a few heavenly whiffs, be sure to get a BPA free plastic container that locks air tight. This will ensure that these new style cups don't get stale.Of course, the coffee is sooo good that they likley won't be around long enough to get stale!The flavor is rich and full bodied. It's strong, but not in the bitter or acid tasting sense, only in richness. My 18 year old daughter loves it as does my husband who general prefers breakfast blends that are lighter. I am so happy to have found this and thankful for the other reviewers whose reviews encouraged me to try this. We used to have many great options with the Subscribe and Save offer and a variety of coffees, but since Green Mountain has bought up all these coffees and refused to allow Amazon to do Subscribe and Save anymore, it's just ridiculously expensive to buy them if you have multiple coffee drinkers in your house.
Very good coffee. I especially like the packaging of the pod. Less waste... At first I was confused, but when it worked I was delighted.

column9: San Francisco Bay Coffee ( Eco Friendly)
column10: This is a very innovative idea no cup just the exposed pod.  This product fits perfectly in the Krieg, it did arrive in a plane Box with Three individual bags with vents, and after opening I placed the remaining pods in a zipper bag to preserve the freshness.  I do go through them very quickly, I don't really have to worry about them going stale.  For the price of this it is totally acceptable.  Its a Dark smooth roast, I'd call this a Medium roast very good even at the largest setting, not watered down.  I will recommend this to my friends.  Great product & good Price.  A new Favorite of mine I will defiantly reorder.

column9: Too strong/Same taste as Organic with the yellow cap
column10: This brew is just Ok I will not buy again. I love the packaging, less waste and cups brew just like original keurig. The taste however was not to my liking. It was just like the organic blend with the yellow lid except with a little less bitterness and just a little less burned taste. The aroma and basic taste however were the same. I read on here in another review that they may stop making that brew so if you liked it this will be a very good alternative for you. But for me this is not pleasant. I may try another flavor because I do like the packaging. That is the reason for the three stars not the coffee..

1.  I adore the flavor. I find it well balanced and smooth but bold with a slightly toasted flavor. Do not let the pictures deceive you, the pods work perfectly in my Keurig B60 machine.2.  It's comparable to the Newmans Own Extra Bold organic with less intense bitterness. If you like your coffee strong and bitter this may not be for you.3.  The packaging is fine. It comes in vacuumed sealed bags. The pods are hard topped with a tea bag type of material bowl bottom that will allow the coffee to steep when the water is injected into the pod. This design leaves the coffee vulnerable to air and dust if not stored properly.  It's an easy fix. I just toss them into a ziplock bag when I open a vacuum sealed pack of pods. Not a big deal.4.  It seems like the pod design is why the coffee comes out so well. It is ultimately more like how a traditional auto drip maker produces coffee without the wait or waste.5.  Considering the quality you cannot beat the cost.

column9: Very Good but With An Earthy Flavor
column10: I'm not a coffee connoisseur so this description may not be technically accurate. The coffee was very good but had a very "earthy" flavor. The coffee pods worked perfectly in my Keurig coffee maker and I would probably purchase this blend again.

I had no problems with their unusual cups working in the Kuerig.  The coffee was good, nothing remarkable but enjoyable.  I do plan to try some of the other San Francisco blends.  It's certainly worth a try.

column9: San Francisco Bay Rainforest Blend.  Great Coffee
column10: After reading several other peoples reviews of this coffee I decided to try this myself.  Good choice. The San Francisco Bay Company gives a great cup of coffee for a very reasonable price. I will buy more, also recommend to other K Cup users. Do not be concerned about the "new " cup design it works perfectly.
A really good cup of coffee.  I bought this for my husband, who is fussy about his coffee.  The "pod" cups fit great in the Keurig.  The price was good as well.

After making it about halfway through a box of 36 of these pods, I feel qualified in saying I do not like the flavor.  It tastes burnt.  My wife and I have taken to referring to it as "that cat p___ coffee." Good price but yuck coffee.  I do like that the pods use less plastic than "regular" k-cups, but bad coffee's bad coffee.

I would rate this coffee as very good if you like your coffe on the strong side.  I wish Starbucks was not so expensive. I amnot willing to pay the extra cost of Starbucks even though I like their coffee.

I absolutely love this coffee.  I have purchased the French Roast, the Rainforest Blend and the French Roast Decaf.  I love the aroma, deep color and superb flavor of these coffees.  I savor every step of the preparation in my Keurig coffee maker.  I inhale deeply from the canister I store them in, I smell the pod before placing it in my Keurig,  I relish the heady aroma as the coffee brews and then immerse myself in the exquisite flavor which is so deep, rich and intense.  If you love full-bodied coffee then this brand is the one for you.  Excellent!

Very impressed with this alternate to a k-cup that fits in a keurig brewer!  I think the coffee tastes great and is not watered down as other reviewers said - even on the largest setting!  Will be trying other types and putting this on monthly order!

Good coffee, even better product design. My one complaint against the traditional K-cups is that there is so much wasted material for a single use product. This is a great step in the right direction. And the coffee's quite good too!
The design of the pod is awesome. Reduced packaging is awesome. PLUS the bags the pods come in have a fresh lock - good stuff
I bought a case for work. Very tasty coffee. Very strong coffee. I thought it was a medium body but is a bolder type coffee. Tastes good and no after taste.

column9: Best K-Cup Coffee...And less plastic to waste.
column10: No worries about not being full plastic K-Cup. It is basically a plastic ring with the foil top. A "mesh" filter bag replaces what we are used to being a plastic cup in traditional K-Cups. I guess this means less plastic waste. In the future, I plan to try to compost the mesh bag part. Haven't figured that out yet. No matter. It works just fine.This Rainforest blend has quickly become my favorite coffee. I'm no coffee geek, but if pressed, I'd call the flavor full and round. Not bitter. Not too strong, not too weak. I drink my coffee black, and this one does it for me.If there is a negative it is that the enviro-friendly packaging means that, once opened, you have to keep the un-used coffee in a plastic bag. We use one of those K-Cup Caddies, and this coffee sits on the counter in a plastic bag...next to that caddie. Small price to pay, I think.

column9: Great tasting economical alternative to k-cup!
column10: Smells good, tastes good, and the price is right! I love the cup design- it's not a k-cup but is compatible and it seems more environmentally friendly- the top is the same and the bottom is a sturdy filter instead of a plastic cup, I actually prefer this design. This is our new coffee!

column9: Good coffee, good price, less packaging to throw away!
column10: I haven't found a downside to this coffee.  Bought it after receiving email from Amazon highlighting the San Francisco brand, which I had never heard of.  (Since Green Mountain instituted multiple price increases in 2011, and discontinued Hazelnut Dark Roast and a couple other favorites of mine, I have been seeking other alternatives.)  This was a much better price so I decided to try it.Didn't even pay attention to the photo that shows it is a bit different from a regular k-cup.  Surprised at the lack of the plastic cup portion, and very pleased.  My first thought was less crap to throw out into the environment.  Because it is not in a sealed plastic cup, and the plastic bag does not reseal, you need to store in an airtight plastic container or Ziploc bag, as others have mentioned doing.  As G. Eppinger said, the price justifies a little less convenience, and I am happy with less waste.I thought the flavor was great.  I buy only the extra bold flavors of whatever k-cups I purchase, and I did not find this to be weak.I would recommend this coffee, plan to buy it again, and will probably end up putting it on subscribe-and-save.  Green Mountain can keep raising their price if they want, I've found something new.

I ordered this coffee along with the Tree Hugger...(i want to support fair trade and i prefer organic coffee.) Wasnt sure this was going to live up to Tree Hugger but both my husband & I agree this is a very delicious cup of coffee..Since i recently gave up putting any cream/milk in my coffee i find i can drink this coffee black, and enjoy every sip..i prefer a med/bold cup of coffee and this fits the bill perfectly. I like the "pod" type cup....more eco friendly than the totally plastic Kcups........I will be purchasing this coffee from now on!

I bought these "kcups" to save money as the cost on my usual Kcups rose to 51 cents a cup on subscribe and save and I could not find them cheaper anywhere else online or locally. These ecocups produce a nice cup of medium strength coffee (not as strong as a regular Kcup). I use the Fog Chase and French Roast on the 12 ounce setting but the Rainforest is too weak to use  so I have to use the 8 ounce setting. The Big plus with these ecocups is that they are really good for use with your own coffee! I use DisposaCup Lids to refill these ecocups over and over again! That's a great vaule at 38 cents a "Kcup"!! DisposaCup Lids - 100 Disposable Replacement Lids for Use with Any Keurig K-cup - BOX of 100 LIDS
this is a great coffee and I have enjoyed it verry much  I am going to reorder this in 4 weeks.  my friends love it.

I am very happy with this coffee!  It works great in my Keurig and the flavor is awesome!  I can brew an extra large cup without losing flavor and the price is right.  I subscribe to automatic deliveries and I normally avoid doing that.
Great bold flavor. I love this brand, their French Roast is great as well. The cups come in minimal plastic which is great, I always feel bad about all the waste some of these K-cups produce.
Love this coffee, have recommended and shared with friends. Good smooth, strong and delicious flavor at an excellent price. I will definitely purchase again and again.

I was skeptical about this coffee, but not any more!!!!  This is the best coffee I have had in my Keurig EVER!!!!  I am not a fan of really strong coffee and this coffee is perfect for me.  After I opened my bag I put the rest of the coffee in a resealable FoodSaver bag.  PERFECT!!!  I don't think you can go wrong with the taste, or the price!!!
i really love the coffee, the "cup" is interesting but it works and the less expensive price is better than regular K cups..

column9: Better than I thought it would be
column10: Even though these are not traditional K cups, they do make a good strong cup of coffee. You need to put them in a sealed container once you open the bag, so they stay fresh. But, I was pleasantly surprised at how good the coffee was. I prefer a strong cup of coffee and these are strong enough for me. Overall a great value compared to regular K cups.
the coffee was to strong and bitter we used the k cup twice trying to make it a little weaker but it was not good for people who  like strong coffee thats the one to buy

column9: Not a K-cup but works in a Keurig
column10: As the other reviewers have said, this is not a K-cup! I uploaded an image of one of these pods next to a K-cup for comparison. The difference is the filter is exposed in these pods as opposed to being fully sealed in a K-cup. Since the coffee is exposed to the air when you open the package, you will have to seal them with a clip or put them in an airtight bag or tupperware to prevent the rest of the pods from loosing freshness. Having said that, in my experience they are a great inexpensive alternative to use in your Keurig brewer. The 36 count boxes arrived as unmarked brown cardboard boxes, not the colorful retail packaging shown on amazon. Inside each cardboard box, there are three clear heavy duty plastic bags, each of which holds 12 of the pods. The bags are not resealable!

I picked up this coffee for my husband because we recently was given a Keurig coffee maker.  I walked into the house this evening and he started raving about this coffee.  I was told that it is full bodied yet very smooth.  There is a slight astringency that adds a kick to the coffee.They aren't actually in cups but rather little bags with a hard top.  And it comes in 3 bags of 12 rather then in a box.  I can appreciate this fact especially since the savings is passed on to me the customer.  Now if only they would also make an iced tea.

My first surprise was opening the box and finding a different configuration from K-Cups.  The individual package has a plastic ring at the top for sturdiness, covered with foil (as is any K-cup; but from there it is completly different.  There is no plastic cup, only a very fine filter material holding the coffee in a space that is half of what a k-cup would use.  I have seen some reviews that assume this means there is only half of the coffee of a k-cup; but it brews a rich full cup.The first thing that I did was try to find my refillable k-cup to hold it.  Doesn't fit.  Next, I tried placing it into the metal filter for the refillable k-cup.  Doesn't fit.  So I threw caution to the wind, placed the little packet into the b-75 as if it were a real k-cup.......guess what.....it is.  It worked great, will probably keep the lower piercing needle from plugging and made a very nice cup of coffee witout all of the high tech k-cup innards.  Since the is a green mountain compny. i guess they are trying new configuraions.  This one works; but it will require smaller stocking orders much more often to maintain freshness.........a major plus for the original k-cup.I am a strong advocate of sustainable agriculture and fair trade for the farmers.......+++ with this line

This is a favorite here.  I don't notice an after taste, but I am a heavy cream user.  Love the simple mesh cups and the full flavor as well as the fact that when I order the 36 box they are packaged and sealed in set of 12.  so some of the things other commentors didn't like are actually why I like these.  Will set up an autoship option and save even more on the 36 pack offer.  It makes this the best priced K-Cup I have found.

column9: Wonderful smooth brew,  lingering aroma at excellet price!
column10: I dont't normally leave a review,but due to the costs of the kcups, i recently purchased an ekobrew reusable filter for my Keurig.
