Well, the other day, I was at Whole Foods, looking for gluten free bar options for my purse (emergency snack ration options), and decided to give it a go, despite the soy. And whoa, liking it.If you just care about taste--this tastes good.If you're a crunch fiend--let's say that you like chocolate crunch candies or bars--this fits the bill.I have used Larabars, Quest bars, Kind bars, and Paleobars, and now I can add this to the arsenal of "What can I dump in my purse when I'm out on a day of errands to stem temptations for utter crap when I'm hungry."Wish it was just whey in there, but at least the soy is non-GMO. :DVegan, gluten-free, kosher, dairy-free, low sugar, moderate-carb, high fiber, with protein and real dark chocolate.... and tasty. That's pretty durn good for a processed, convenience food.Here are the stats:Calories  180  Calories from fat  55Total Fat 6g  9%  Saturated Fat 2.5g  13%  Trans Fat 0gCholesterol 0mg  0%Sodium 135mg  6%Total Carbohydrate 21g  7%  Dietary Fiber 9g  36%  Sugar 2gProtein 15gVitamin A 0%, Vitamin C 0%, Calcium 6%, Iron 8%Hope that helps. Be well..

I've searched long and hard and tried dozens of protein bars. Some taste bad, some have tons of fat, some have tons of sugar, some have the even worse sugar substitutes (and claim they are low carb!).Enough is enough!Here is the answer, here is what you need. These are protein packed, low sugar, gluten free, delicious bars that - after one taste, has me convinced I've found the only bar that I'm going to eat so long as the rest of the market is saturated with faux-health bars.
This is the James Earl Jones of nutritious snack bars.We're talking deep, dark, and robust.Tasty and gluten free don't always end up togetjer. They're together here.

We love dark chocolate, so this bar tastes great to us. It's low calorie, only 2g of sugar, 15g of protein and 9g of fiber and it's gluten free! It kind of reminds me of the Hershey Krackel candy (only in dark chocolate). My 9 year old loves these. It makes a great snack. She likes it even more then the other Nugo Dark Chocolate crunch gluten free protein bars.I'm not a big fan of many protein bars with crisped rice or many different nuts. This one tastes like a candy bar, only I don't feel bad eating it, since it's only 2g of sugar, lower fat, loaded with protein and it's dark chocolate.Raspberry flavor is good too, if you like raspberry with dark chocolate.

Most low-carb/high-protein snacks and sweets are full of chemicals - these bars are the opposite! OK, perhaps they don't taste like "real chocolate" but they are tasty enough, satisfy sweet-tooth cravings, and thanks to the protein+fibre content, actually make you feel quite full! In my opinion, they are great! And unlike most low-carb sweets, they are actually good for you and made with simple ingredients - NO artificial sweeteners and NO sugar alcohols!!!
Not too sweet, dark chocolatey, gluten-free and no artificial sweeteners; and it really holds the hunger at bay.  A handy snack or mini-meal that I much prefer over the typical low-carb bar.

This bar has great texture and contains stuff I wanted, and is free from stuff I don't want in a bar. Basically, it's a fairly healthy alternative to some other bars. However, it tastes a little weird and is not something I'll get again. It's not terrible, but a little blah.

column9: Good product but bitter tastes turns one off to health benefits.
column10: Same as the Raspberry and Dark Chocolate product-you really can't enjoy product because you feel like yo are taking medicine instead of having a Protein bar.
Simply Delish!!!  The ingredients is what makes this so good and the fiber well you can't beat that. I have tried so many bars nothing beats the flavor and it's gluten free, just amazing

Definitely not a favorite of mine. They were dry and flavorless in my opinion. It does have that "crispy" texture but fails to deliver in the taste department. I guess some might appreciate these if you aren't into "sweet" chocolate. They aren't sweet but they are rich... so consider yourself warned. The taste is almost like the fake sugary sweet-n-low sort of taste but not overwhelming - just fake. Either way, not what I prefer and I'll try another bar.
wasnt a big fan of these, maybe other flavors are better but this one didn't really do much for me as far as taste goes. They were a bit dry for me. I will stick to my quest bars, much better.

I am a big fan of NUGO dark chocolate bars. These have more protein then the others but I think there is chocolate overload in these and it is tough for me to say that because I love dark chocolate. I probably will stick with the other NUGO dark chocolate bars. I gave these a 4 because of the overload but if you really really really like dark chocolate these are for you. Also what is good about these is that they provide the protein without the high sugar content of other bars on the market. I may buy these again after eating a few more of them but I was surprised with the first one at the strong chocolate that make up these bars. Usually I have cup of coffee after eating a NUGO bar. Maybe with these a cup while I eat them would make more sense.

Being a Diabetic it's hard to find a protein bar that is not loaded with fat and sugar.  This is a perfect in-between snack with very low sugar which is all natural.  Low calorie and low fat, no artificial sweeteners.  Just wish I could find these in the stores, but Amazon does have the best prices.  They also taste great, have to hide them from the kids.
I bought this soup in the store before purchasing it on amazon.  I thought it was wonderful.  Nicely seasoned, excellent taste.
We love the no salt soups offered by Health Valley but this one is very bland and does not have much flavor.

If you are used to commercial soups, you will find this VERY bland because it has no salt. If you are on a low sodium diet, however, this soup is perfect esp. for a cold winter day. The mushrooms impart a mild earthy flavor and the barley is decently toothsome considering it's canned. Enjoyed this with a sprinkling of Mrs. D-- and it was actually the base for a delicious light supper. This variety has a great comfort food appeal that makes it a good choice for those late evenings when you want something warm and filling, but easy on your stomach.
if u want a healthy soup this is it! the barley pieces are great, flavor good-great, overall excellent a great way to get barley

column9: Delicious - perfect of parties or Halloween
column10: My children crave lollies, but we don't do artifical anything.  These are delicious!  I had one or two myself :)

With so many foods (especially lollipops) that target children and are loaded with artificial colors, flavors and corn sirup, this is a great alternative.Yummy Earth taste (and smell) great, and are an instant favorite among children. These lollipops prove that good-tasting stuff can be made from all-natural and organic sources. Five stars!

This is an easy to make meal that is different from your garden variety meal-in-a-box.  I tend to use smoked sausage with the mix.  The sausage is precooked so it soaks up flavor from the mix as the whole thing simmers.When I had more time, I tried mixing smoked sausage and grilled chicken.  The chicken was marinated with an off-the-shelf louisiana cajun style marinade and then grilled.  Slice and put the chicken in at the end when the rest is done (or the chicken will dry out being "cooked" a second time) and it was fantastic.  Since the point of this meal is to be quick, I only did this method once, but it was great.Only downside is that the meal is a bit oily, and leaves a residue at the bottom of your dish.  This just reminds you that this dish is better served as a guilty pleasure than an everyday meal.

column9: A Family Favorite ... And Easy, Too!
column10: In our house, we're big fans of Cajun fare. However, I don't often have the time to spend making homemade gumbo or jambalaya. Zatarain's mixes are pretty darned good everyday substitutes.When we make this jambalaya at home (at least once a week), we add chicken, as well as some fresh andouille sausage that our local grocery makes. I often have people beg me for the recipe, then have to tell them that it was a mix. Not only is this a great-tasting, hearty meal, it couldn't be easier to prepare; and it only takes about 30 minutes! And with the $10 discount that Amazon is offering right now, the price on this 12-pack can't be beat.

column9: Y U M M Y......R I C E....!
column10: The ONLY reason I give ZATARAIN'S NEW ORLEANS STYLE JAMBALAYA MIX, 8-OUNCE BOXES, (PACK OF 12), four stars instead of 5 is because one must buy 12 boxes together, here on Amazon.  It's scrumptious rice, but I must agree with another reviewer who said his family got tired of it after "only" 3 boxes, and the rest is now sitting on the shelf. Too much of anything -- even something as delicious as this rice -- does get tiring after a while.  Of oourse there are all kinds of customers who buy from Amazon -- some people are lucky enough to have friends, family or neighbours to share the large quantities, and prices, that Amazon puts into it's quantity packages.But others, like myself, have only two -- or only one-- person for whom to buy food.  Thus, I think that BOTH large quantity packaging, (12), and small quantity packaging, (4?), should be made available.As for the product itself, it is truly superb!  It has just the right amount of spice, and just the right kind of spice.  It will not burn your taste-buds as some overly-spicy rice does...nor will it bore your taste-buds, as too-plain rice does.  To quote Goldilocks: "This one is JUST right!"Totally yummy!  But I don't want to have to eat quite so much!

This is the best jambalaya! I add in chicken, shrimp, sausage - whatever meat I have. I also add in frozen chopped spinach and frozen mixed veggies. I add some shredded cheese and sour cream so it is not so hot. My kids love it! And it is the only way I can get them to eat protein and veggies and dairy without them noticing they are eating it. I love it too!
Not that I would microwave this dish, but if I were to do that should I really microwave it on high for 25 minutes?  I think it would definitely be blackened.

column9: Effortless Meal / Adds Flavor to Vegetarian Diet
column10: I've enjoyed eating Zatarain's New Orleans Style Jambalaya Mix for a few years now. I'm a vegetarian, so like anyone with a restricted diet, I found myself getting into a rut with my meals. I gave this a try, because I was looking to add some variety to my meals. It is wonderful.MY FAVORITE MEALFirst, I fix the rice. That only takes about 25 minutes and is nothing more complicated than boiling water. Then, in a separate pan I cook some kind of vegetarian sausage (I used to use boca sausage, but that seems to have been discontinued). I usually season it with pepper, a bit of soy sauce, and garlic. I prefer to wait for them to get crispy on the verge of burnt. That seems to help them keep their flavor. After that, I put some green peppers, onions, and spinach in with the sausage. Finally, I put it all into the pot with the rice. I cook the vegetables/sausage separately from the rice because I want them to retain their flavor. It gives the jambalaya a more complicated taste.Make space for this in your pantry. One box serves six (not counting whatever meat/vegetables you add), so for an individual you'll have 72 meals with this! If you only fix this meal once or twice a week, you are looking at about a year's worth of jambalaya. It's a great value :)

After trying it once, I keep my pantry stocked with Zatarain's Jambalaya mix.  Making Jambalaya from scratch can be daunting but this is perfectly seasoned out of the box.  I've tried using a variety of meats, chicken, and sausage and never tire of the flavor.This is a "must have" for those who love authentic Jambalaya but don't want to make it from scratch.

Bought this product from our local Publix where it's often buy 1 get 1 free.We ate it a couple of times and I must saw we did like the taste.One day I tore open the packaging when my son started crying. I went to him and left the packaging on the counter. I came back a minute later and my countertop was crawling with tiny little bugs that could have been mistaken for spices if they weren't moving! I emptied the back in a zip-loc and it was full of these little bugs crawling around. If I would of put the packaging directly in the water i'm sure the bugs would have died instantly in the water.I was completely disgusted and called the company. The woman on the line was completely unfazed saying it seemed that my product was contaminated and that these things happen! Happen to who?!!She continued to say she could send me free boxes or some coupons if I would provide my address.I informed her that the last thing I want is an other box of this stuff in my house and hung up.DO NOT BUY!

We loved Zatarains pre-mixed jambalaya with sausage that you just warmed up and it was ready to eat. Absolutely delicious. This product has absolutely no resemblance in taste to that product whatsoever. It doesn't even hold a resemblance of taste to jambalaya in general. I made the mistake of buying a dozen boxes and they are all in the trash now. NEVER buy a Zatarains product again.

This is an excellent alternative to the "real thing".  If you don't have time to prepare the ingredients from scratch, this is a great substitute. Being Creole, I am an expert on Louisiana/Cajun spices.  This mix is pretty close to the real thing. Even though the box calls for one pound of meat, I recommend using 1lb of sausage, 1lb of shrimp or crawfish tails, and 1/2lb of chicken. Laissez Les Bons Temp Rouler!!!

column9: Should have gotten a smaller pack
column10: It's an OK product, but we got tired of the taste after 3 packages and the rest just sits in the cabinet.

column9: There's no real meat in this.
column10: Cats are obligate carnivores.  They have to eat meat, and the more veterinarians learn about cats with impaired kidney function, the more into question the conventional wisdom that such cats should avoid protein is called.  This product is mostly corn and by-products.  My vet advised me to mix this half and half with Hills Prescription w/d dry and then mush it up with canned Hills k/d or Purina DM to get something that my feral queen (1) will eat and (2) can keep down.
My dog has cardiac issues. My vet researched pet food and this was the best for him. Extremely low salt and phosphorus. My dog loves it. He sits by the bag and guards it from my other dogs.

column9: Great candies, but overpriced on Amazon ...
column10: I love these candies and so does everyone I've ever given one too!  They make a great gift and come in this festive little box with individually wrapped Raffaellos, every one a work of art to die for!  So what's not to like???  Well, how about the fact that you can get this same product at Walmart for about $3-4.00?  Knowing that, do you really want to spend $10.00 plus shipping for a few pieces of candy???

these candy were very good. there was only one thing i didn't like about these. there is no carmel drizzle over the top like the ones that come in the big mixed box of 24 with the 3 different kinds. but these are still very good and worth the money and would def buy them again.
I never knew coconut was soo delicious!!! I gave these as a gift to my fiancee, turns out these are her favorite chocolate! Definitely a re-buy in the future!

column9: no tamper seal - and the company thinks that's ok.
column10: While this stuff may be fine, I'm not going to risk my life to it when it comes already opened.There's no way to tell if a few people might have taste tested this stuff before it got to me...  or what else they may have done to it.Do you want to test your kharma on it?

I've been a "connoisseur" of dark-chocolate-dipped apricots for years and this is the first time I've ordered them from Amazon.This brand, Old Naples, was a real disappointment.The apricots have an artificial flavor, a strong aftertaste, and a stale, jelly-like texture.  It was not at all the melt-in-your mouth, sticky-sweetness that I have experienced from other brands.The chocolate layer is thin but more importantly, it's cheap chocolate. It's a waxy, flavorless, too-sweet chocolate that barely even looks like dark rather than milk chocolate.On the positive side, each one was individually sealed in cellophane so they weren't as messy as I expected, and the simple gold box was attractive.I would not order these again.
Delicious but messy; chocolate mostly off apricots but still very tasty;  package must have gone through a tumbling dryer; apricots still out of this world
Simply delicious! Moist, soft and rich! Totally delectable and satisfying... I'd order them again. These have always been a favorite of mine and my family.

These are sweet, delicious, addictive and quite expensive at approximately $5 per piece.The apricot flavor is explosive and natural tasting to me.I disagree with the reviewer who said they are "artificial flavor, a strong aftertaste, and a stale, jelly-like texture." The chocolate is dark chocolate, not milk chocolate, and it does appear to have a higher cocoa butter content to make it more firm on the moist apricot, but I would not describe it as "waxy".I highly recommend these as an occasional indulgence.

column9: If I only could have these delivered automatically every week!
column10: Very, very high quality and extremely delicious! I can't indulge in them as often as I'd like but would if I could. The dark chocolate is rich and flavorful and the apricots are succulent. Enthusiastically recommended!

I order these chocolate covered apricots over and over again as gifts and for my own indulgence.  Such plump and moist apricots---never dry or stringy in tecture.  Love both the dark and milk chocolate dipped.  Wish they had white chocolate, too.  An assortment of milk, dark and milk chocolate dipped apricots would be even better!A Very Satisfied Customer

column9: Tasty! Best way to do your ACV
column10: I don't know how they prepare it, but somehow, this drink is much tastier than anything I can ever make myself with the same ingredients...ACV, honey and water. How do you do it, guys?Anyway, this stuff is the best workout drink ever. Whatever magic ACV has, if I start getting fatigued during an intense workout, a sip from a bottle of this acts like some sort of reset and lets me keep going, amazing stuff. I take it on the bike, too! Instant recovery after climbing a steep hill.Hippocrates apparently knew something, alright.

I was pleasantly surprised with the taste of this drink. It actually "taste" good and it is refreshing. After drinking one sixteen ounce bottle I saw the same results that I saw when I mixed the honey and apple cider vinegar with distilled water myself. However, my mixture did not taste anywhere as delicious as this drink did. The only drawback is I believe that the seller are asking too high a price for the convenience of having this drink already prepared for you. It is much more economical feasible to buy the vinegar, honey and distilled water and mixed it yourself. I purchased four bottles but will not reorder as it is too expensive.

I have used Braggs vinegar for leg cramps for years and it works.Now this great tasting drink makes it even easier and it taste great.And the grape flavor is really good too and both really quech your thirst.

My last order I purchased 10 of these and will be getting more. I would recommend this product to anyone who loves this type of drink but to be honest my wife hates it as she doesn't care for Vinegar. So if you do like Salt & Vinegar potato chips or Vinegar then don't buy this. Save the bottles and then when you make your own you'll have something to put it in. Try it , you'll like it, I did..Will update later.
tHIS ORGANIC DRINK WAS NOT MY CUP OF TEA...THERE WAS A STRONG VINEGAR TASTE... TOO STRONG FOR ME...HOT OR COLD ..THE SMELL AND TASTE JUST WASN'T THERE...i DID NOT LIKE IT...
Everyone commented on the good quality of the filet mignons.  Made for a great barbecue!  They were delivered right on time. Omaha Steaks Filet Mignons, (4) 5 Ounce  BK
Good steaks, but too much bother when I can get the same thing in a local store for less cost, considering shipping etc.
The Omaha Steaks were ordered as a Christmas present and the person who got them loved them!  They may be expensive, but wow are they good!

My parents love steak and I wanted to gift them nice, yet affordable fancy steaks. I looked at Omaha's bacon-wrapped filets and decided against those due to a few ratings. These filets had better ratings, most importantly by my elderly parents, who aren't into local, grass-fed, trendier steaks that cost more.

I bought these for my parents and in-laws for Christmas. The steaks arrived on time, and everyone was "over-the-moon" with the gift. I'll do it again next year. I gave it 4 stars because of price. I'm pretty sure this isn't Kobe beef, but maybe I'm wrong. It had better be Kobe for the price point.

column9: Surprisingly light taste for a dark roast
column10: I was looking forward to trying this since I've heard good things about Raven's Brew. It was offered on the Amazon Warehouse for a steep discount, so I gave it a shot.Very surprising taste. It's a dark roast, and I was expecting a heavy taste. Instead, it's quite light. Good, but if you're looking for a deep, rich flavor this will disappoint. Personally, I'm partial to medium roasts that have a fairly deep taste but avoid the burnt undertones often found in a dark roast. Even so, this was a bit too light for me. I'll certainly drink what I have, but I don't think I'll be ordering it again.I enjoyed it more when mixed with some dark roast Columbian from Coffee Bean Direct. It made for a nice blend.  On it's own, I got the best results brewing it as a pour over. It came out somewhat sour tasting when done in a French Press.I did get a chuckle from the description provided by Raven's Brew for this, especially the following: "Toffee like flavors form a base to definite higher notes of tangerine and lemon flower just on the edge of jasmine."OK, I get the toffee-like flavor part. Maybe - just maybe, I can see the tangerine and lemon being apt since there is a bit of a lemon-ish quality to this. But "just on the edge of jasmine"? Come on now!Their fanciful language aside, I'll give it four stars with a big caveat: Be sure that a light taste is what you're looking for. If not, give this a pass.

column9: If you have no means of making this dish yourself, buy this subsitute
column10: I was surprised that these Habichuelas con Dulce do not taste subpar at all! I actually think they taste about average, but I'm disappointed by the lack of yams, raisins, and other tasty complements that are usually found in this dish!
The best I have tasted yet and the price was right. This is the only one I plan to order from now on in the 80 count size.

Love, love this coffee......Morning Blend is very similar to Donut House......I like the idea that there is no plastic cup to throw away.....I would highly recommend it to everyone....will purchase another 80 for that great price and with no additional cost for shipping and handling....
I am enjoying the reasonably priced Breakfast Blend. It is strong enough without being bitter and good for early morning pleasure.  I also liked the French Roast.Sara

Based on previous reviews and the fact that it seems to use less plastic in the k-cup packaging, I tried this coffee.  In general I prefer a fairly bold coffee and I am very impressed with the flavor of this coffee.  I prefer it to the Donut Shop coffee and find it comparable with the Starbucks coffees I have tried.  The pods work terrific in my Keurig.  There have been no leaks, explosions, etc.  Although I still feel guilty for the waste I'm creating with all of these individual pods I'm throwing in the trash, I don't feel as guilty as I did with the full plastic pods from other manufacturers.  I actually just went in and subscribed to a monthly shipment.  You can't beat the price for the quality and convenience.

We have been buying kcups for over a year now, trying different brands to narrow down our likes/dislikes. Bought a small box of the Fogchaser initially, which we really liked. I read the reviews for Breakfast Blend and ordered the 80 count box. We hands down; absolutely love this particular one. The packaging is phenomenal and the coffee stays strong, fragrant and robust.We just truly love the assertive, but smooth taste of this brew. Nice move to get around using all that plastic, I'm sure these can be used as mulch if you just cut the top off, which can be recycled. Win-win!!

If you like the Coffee People coffee you will love this coffee at a better price for 80 K-cups. This is now my morning brew. I use to have Starbuck's Cafe Verona or Donut Shop Coffee People as a choice.  Now it's just my Breakfast  Blend that gets me going.

I TRIED THIS Item San Francisco Bay Coffee , it was something new to me and the price was awesome , so I gave it a try . I tried BREAKFAST BLEND and RAINFOREST BLEND and its nice strong cup of coffee but awesome taste . I'll be re-ordering  a lot more , great buy and flavor . P.S.  if you wish you could use it a second time , still great cup of coffee . YOU'VE NOTHING TO LOOSE , GIVE A TRY !!!!!!!!!!!!!
Really like the taste of the San Francisco breakfast blend.  It does tend to leave a "thicker" last swallow in the bottom of the cup,though.  Works for us, will continue to buy.

column9: So good that I'm angry at myself
column10: For four years, I've been drinking another brand's Donut-shop blend, because I thought it was good. It turns out I've been drinking substandard coffee. San Francisco Bay Coffee's Breakfast Blend is exactly what I wanted. I'm a big fan of Dunkin Donuts and other similar roasts of coffee. The breakfast blend is exactly that, but better! It's really fresh, packaged as little pouches of eight single-serve individual filters, but if you put it in a little airtight leftover container after opening the pouch, you can keep it even fresher. This makes a better cup of coffee than any other brand I've tried. If you want something bolder, go with the Fog Chaser blend, but I will stick with this one from now on.

column9: Excelent coffee to start your day!
column10: When I saw the advertisment for the San Francisco Bay Coffee- first I couldn't believe the price and then I couldn't believe the amount of coffee pods that was listed.  I ordered it thinking I would get some cheap coffee.  Well, I was completely wrong!  The breakfast blend is so good.  It is mild just as I enjoy mine and the amount of pods for the price is amazing!  I shared a pkg with a friend, now she wants to order her own box.  All I can say is give it a try if you enjoy a mild breakfast blend.

I love these.  Not only is the coffee fantastic, but the product uses less plastic in each k-cup.  The coffee is smartly divided in sealed packs of 8, to keep it fresh (that's in a case of 80).  I will be switching to this coffee and I hope they have more varieties soon.

I must say, it is some of the best coffee I have ever tasted.  I use each pod twice, because the coffee is so fresh and delicious I can get 2 cups.  I never tried it with any other pod because I never thought I could get 2 cups out of a pod.  DELICIOUS!!!

When I ordered this coffee, I wasn't sure it would be as good as the k-cups I had been using.  I was pleasantly surprised at the flavor and the freshness!  Of course the price was the best part. I will definately buy this product again.

The San Francisco Bay coffee "K" cups are unlike the others.  They are in smaller, fresher packs instead of plastic cups.  They are also kept in smaller plastic bags so they stay fresher longer.  Super coffee!!
For the price, the coffee was good. I don't like the taste as well as other brands though.  I do like that there is less waste since the bottome of the cup has no plastic.

column9: The best Coffee I ever order from Amazon
column10: the San Francisko Bay produce this taste delicious coffee and We love it.We decided to order ore cups and i found that value is really good.
This was my first time buying san fransico coffee cups and I couldn't be happier w them. Flavor and price were very right.
I was a bit skeptical, since the price is half of what I had been paying.  Product is great!  I will order again.

I was pleased from the moment I opened the box. The aroma made me instantly want a cup, and my first sip was a delight.  Really good and fresh coffee at a reasonable price.  You won't regret purchasing the breakfast blend.

I bought the 36 serve pack just in case I didn't like it.  BUT not only is it delicious, it is much cheaper than the traditional all plastic K-cups.  Saving money and helping the eco system, while enjoying a great cup of coffee.  a win, win, win..  I just ordered the pack of 80.  I will be a repeat customer.

Awesome!Simply Put, Totally Perfect! A Wonderful Cup Of Coffee. Mild and Smooth!No reason for coffee prices to be so high. Just more people switching to this coffee method for many reasons and retailers know this so they are jacking the prices. The way this product is made saves money for everyone and is designed to fit K-Cup dispensers. My Rating: 10/10Please don't raise the price one people get hooked!

My first box just arrived in the mail yesterday.  I love K-cups, but don't love paying for them, and had been using a disposable filter for awhile.  I like that, but it still doesn't seem to work quite as well as the original cups.  These work amazingly well and are so much more affordable.  Not only that, but the coffee itself is great.  I will be recommending this to all my K-cup loving friends!

Initially I was not sure what to expect (due to the differences in design in contrast to K-cups), but this coffee is great! I normally do not bother to review, but it is so enjoyable that I felt obliged to. It is flavorful, but not too bold. It is crisp, but not too tangy. This breakfast blend is great for not only the morning, but anytime of the day! You can tell it is made better than other coffees available to Keurig owners. I would highly recommend to any coffee lover!

30 years ago, I worked as a teenager for Dunkin Donuts, where I was introduced to coffee with fresh ground beans.  That smooth wonderful taste sold me for life.  I never understood the appeal of the burnt taste of Starbucks coffee.  Painful to drink.In recent years, my daily routine was grinding my beans, boiling my water in an electric kettle, and brewing into a thermos.  Bit of a pain, but great tasting.  My roommate bought a K-cup coffee maker, and I tried just about every type of coffee available.  Nothing was any good. UNTIL THIS ONE.This flavor is the closest to the coffee I would make every morning.  A little more expensive, but worth the cost for the convenience of having a cup in 30 seconds!Smooth, not burnt, not too weak.  Just PERFECT and delicious.  Also love the fact that I'm not wasting all the plastic that other K-cups use.
The san Francisco Bay Breakfast is truly a great blend.  Smooth, and delicious..  Thanks for this item.Will definitely reorder.

column9: San Francisco Bay Morning Blend K-cups
column10: We stumbled upon a great coffee.  It might say morning blend but our family and friends think it's the best yet.

I couldn't pass up the low price so I ordered 2 boxes (80 per box).  When I got them, I was surprised  to see they weren't like the normal K-cups.  They are shorter and instead of the rigid plastic bottom, the coffee is encased in a rounded filter.  I was ready to return them to Amazon.  I couldn't imagine them working with my Kuerig because of the different design, but thought I'd try anyway.  I found that they actually work quite well.  The coffee is good and because of the filter, there are never any stray coffee grounds that escape the pod.  I can't say it's the best cup of coffee I have ever had, but for the price, it's darn good and always fresh!
I am enjoying this coffee and I plan to continue to buy/use it. It is strong but not too strong and is not bitter.

The coffee taste fresh......it is alittle bold for my morning hours, but I still like the overall taste and aroma. For those of you that want a fresh, good flavored, bold coffee in morning. This is it.
The fitst time everyone in the offtce tried this coffeethey raved about it, and a week later they asked me tore-order this one.

I must confess I bought this coffee for it's price but was I surprised.  It is really good.  Full body, will make a large mug of strong and clear coffee.  I drink it black, so the body of the coffee is important to me.  Try it, a great way to start the day.

Nice robust flavor especially for a morning blend. The price is incredible, about a quarter cheaper per cup compared to a standard k cup. I was a bit nervous about how they would work in my cuisinart brewer. Not a problem, they work flawlessly. I'll be ordering a lot more.
These coffee k-cups are just the best...the smell when you open the bags will awaken you before you have your first cup!  And the price can't be beat!

column9: Great coffe for Keurig Brewers-Innovative design
column10: The coffe pods are quite different from the traditional all plastic k-cup design and fit perfectly, Best of all, they brew a consistently great cup of coffee and I am able to put them in our recycle unit. I get this coffee from my Amazon subscribe program and the price is excellent.
Based on previous reviews, I tried the San Francisco bay coffee and they are excellent.  Love the plastic free pods.

I love this brand and prefer them to even to other kcup brands. I am not going to spend time talking about this type of kcup. However if you keep the open bags in a zip lock they will not get stale for a week or so. You get multiple packages in the box so you do not have to worry about that. These taste great however I prefer french roast and foghorn more. While these are still bold they are not as complex as the other two. Give me them  try.
Good coffee Great price. Doesn't look like the kips but works just as well. Needs to be stored in an air tight container. I will purchase again

This is an exceptional value for really, REALLY good coffee.  It's just what a breakfast blend should be - a bit mild, but with enough "oomph" to kickstart your morning.  Out of all of the coffees I've tried, this is hands-down my absolute favorite. I was a bit leery after trying, and not caring for, the Rainforest blend, but this is nothing at all like that blend, it's just perfectly suited for my tastes.UPDATE: I've moved onto Fogchaser now, which is just a tiny bit stronger, and have a new favorite. ;)

I am very pleased with the San francisco Bay Coffee Breakfast Blend-the coffee has a nice flavor and it makes me very happy to know that the company utilizes less plastic in the manufacturing of this product.  It works well in my Keurig with no issues, and I have not had a bad cup to date.  I have previously had issues with some of the traditional K-Cups dumping grounds and occasionally not working correctly, but I am on my second box of these and not one has been defective.  Ordering with subscribe and save makes this a fantastic value as well!

I've always really enjoyed San Fransisco Bay's Breakfast Blend but I was doubtful that the exposed filter One Cup would brew as good of a cup of coffee.  It's just like grinding my own beans!  Excellent and much more affordable choice over the brand name K-Cups
My wife and I love this coffee.  It smells fantastic as soon as you open the bag and the flavor stand up to any brand I've ever tried.The price is just an additional bonus.

I've owned a Keurig coffee maker for years and always thought the price of the K cups was too high. Well, these San Francisco One cup breakfast blend k cups are not only very inexpensive, (compared to the other k cups), but they taste better! Excellent cup of coffee. I will reorder when I finish this 80 count box! Love it!
My sister recommended this product when I purchased my Keurig coffeemaker. It is a good price for my everyday coffee needs. Also, although they are not in a cup it works in my Keurig.

Thought about not leaving a review, because I don't want these pods to get too popular and increase in cost. The coffee tastes wonderful and the pods fit perfectly into my machine! Can't wait to try other flavours will be ordering this coffee monthly!

column9: Great Price + Great Flavor= Exceptional Coffee
column10: THis makes a good cup of coffee at an exceptional price. I will definitely purchase again or try a different flavor.

I've been purchasing K-Cups from Amazon for about 6 months now since I found the pricing to be cheaper than what I can get in the stores (even if I clip coupons and look for the sales.)  I was excited to see how cheap these were per cup when I first ran across the SF brand.  I read a number of reviews and was skeptical of the "cupless" style of packaging.  I have to say that I took the chance and I am very happy with the product.  First the coffee is very good to me.  That's a matter of taste, but I think you'd have to be VERY picky about your coffee to say that this is a bad flavor in any way.  There are 10 cups in each clear bag.  8 bags in my box.  I simply cut open the bag and transfer to a ziplock.  I have no grounds in my coffee at all.  The cups are very clean - no additional mess in the machine at all.  Overall, a great product.
This coffee isn't bad, it is a little stronger than Kurig breakfast brand. However I don't like the filter type packaging. I am getting coffee residue back into the water somehow.

After reading reviews, I decided to try this coffee. Little nervous, but worth a shot for the price. I am so pleased. The coffee is great and what you get for your money is amazing. I am very happy with this product and will most likely continue to buy all future regular coffee from this provider.

This caught my eye because of the price; it's at least $1-$2 cheaper than the Green Mountain/Starbucks brand for 12 cups. When I took it out of the box, I was surprised to only see a mesh basket, not the plastic cups that the other brands have. However, it worked beautifully in my Keurig and produced very good coffee. Granted, I take my coffee with cream and sugar but it tastes like well-brewed coffee. It's not bitter, or too dark. This blend has a slight nutty flavor and it's very smooth.
Great price, coffee taste I would rate a 7 1/2. I will try another blend the next time I purchase
This coffee is very mild with a slight aftertaste.  The pods don't fit snugly into my Keurig, so I have to push them in hard.  I probably won't buy these again.
unlike the other san francisco bay blends. this was very weak flavour even on the 6 oz mode. will not buy again.

My husband really likes this wonderful coffee. I'm on S&S which tells you that we will continue to purchase this brand of coffee. I also like that there are 8 sealed packages of 10 coffee pods, It keeps the coffee fresh. I would recommend that you give it a try. I have bought many other brands and for the money this is very pleasing to our family. Like I said give it a try.

column9: Excellent coffe and great value at Amazon
column10: This is wonderful coffee and the best value K cups I have found.  They offer a great variety.  This will be the only K cup coffee I purchase!

I also subscribed to this companies decaf.  I figured it was good, so let's try the regular.  I am not disappointed in the price or the taste.  It's a bold taste for those of you looking for single size description words.  And they both work perfectly in my K-Cup brewer.You will like.http://www.amazon.com/gp/product/B007TGDXMU/ref=cm_cr_rev_prod_img

column9: Love the coffee and the packaging.
column10: Great coffee - rich, full bodied but not bitter. I especially appreciate the minimal plastic used in the cup. Cups don't fit 100% in my Keurig storage turntable but they do fit. They just fall out a bit more easily.

column9: UPDATED Review - Decent Brew on 12 oz setting
column10: I am not one for coffee that is over roasted or extremely strong.  But after reading other reviews and seeing the prices, I signed on up to try both the Breakfast and Rainforest blends.  Some said they were similar to other Kcups they had used, like Donut People, and I have to disagree.  Even upon receipt I could smell the over roasted aroma, but gave it a try.  Luckily we'll have enough company to kill 160 of these things...and I will suffer through a few 12 oz brews (to get it as weak as possible) myself.If you like Green Mountain Kcups, stick with them...this is not what you are looking for.****Updated August 26, 2012****I always try to be fair in my reviews and while I purchased two blends from San Francisco Bay Coffee for my Keurig and am not crazy about them, I must say that my opinion of the Breakfast Blend has changed enough for me to update this rating and review.  I still do not like the Rain Forest Blend I also purchased, but decided I would force myself to drink these as I had bought such a large box of both.  What I have found is that on a 12 oz setting the Breakfast Blend is not too bad.  It took a few days to get used to, but I am now good with it.  Heck, for the price over Green Mountain K Cups, I might even buy this one again.  In the end I am getting a 12 oz cup of coffee vs 8 oz and like I said, the flavor grew on me once I had been drinking it for a few days.

This alternative to the traditional plastic K-Cup caught my eye immediately because of the price.  I have been buying the basic Ks from Amazon for years, always pretty much around the same price, and have been eager to see the drop in prices once Green Mountain's patent expires on the technology.  This company found a unique way of getting around the patent with these filter-exposed cups.  To our benefit, this brand sells more for less, and that to me was worth the try. I chose the Breakfast Blend because I normally drink the Coffee People Donut Shop, which I too love, and I thought this would be the closest match.  This turned out to be true, both are smooth and not too strong or robust.  Both have good flavor without being over the top.  As for the style of the cup, as all others have said, it does not have the plastic canister look, but rather just the filter, which I personally like.  Unlike the traditional cups, you get a whiff of coffee just before you put it in the machine, which is a nice tease.  I just filled up a Ziplock bag to keep them fresh and it's easy enough.  I'm also keeping the spent cups to use for fertilizer, just cut off the top, dry out the grounds and pour them around your garden.Overall I'd highly recommend this, the price is great and the coffee is very good.  If you are a Coffee People Donut Shop fan like me, you'll enjoy this Breakfast Blend.  If you prefer jet fuel, this will not appeal to you.

I must say, I was concerned.  I had purchased the smaller boxes, and was pleased with that, however I was worried that the large 80 cup package wouldn't be packaged to preserve the flavor, but I was wrong!! There are 10 sealed packages inside the box with 8 cups in each!  Excellent idea!! Less plastic!!The flavor is phenomenal, probably one of my favorites!! Nice and bold without bitterness!!May 29, 2012 --- edited to add, I love this so much I just put it on auto ship!! Love love love it!!
In simple words the best so far! Fast delivery ....can't go wrong. Nothing to envy other brands. Def. will buy more. Happy.

The first San Francisco Bay k cup I tried was the Fog Chaser. It wasn't bad...I loved the way these k cup type pods work in my Keurig! I have absolutely no issues with them not being standard k cups and having less plastic. Perfectly functional with less waste and a better price. So we tried the Breakfast Blend---great flavor,smooth coffee. I am a person who orders coffees from places like Coffees of Hawaii and Joe's Coffee so I am pretty picky about flavor. I am quite satisfied with this coffee as an everyday brew.For comparison? My mother is a Donut Shop and  Green Mountain k cup user and says this is very much like the Donut Shop- we both brew it on the largest or next to largest setting every time and it is a strong, solid cup- never weak. Freshness? I read concerns about the coffee staying fresh because of the filter type bottoms of the cups- have never had an issue with this.Each sealed bag has 8 cups in it and we have always used them before they had a chance to get stale! This is a loved coffee in our household! I now have this on subscribe and save and am considering changing the delivery to more often!

column9: Breakfast Blennd is good coffee and more earth friendly
column10: I was initially shocked when I initially opened my parcel and found these very cool new San Francisco Bay Coffee One Cup for Keurig K-Cup Brewers, Breakfast Blend, 80-Count. First this is a great value at $33.00 including free shipping with my Prime Account. For those of you who have not tried Prime membership it pays for itself in between 60-90 days with moderate use and I believe Amazon still offers a 30 day free trial which is worth looking at to experience the benefits. I've had my membership for 3 years and its a great value! Enough for the the Amazon commercial back to the coffee. Price per cup is the lowest I have found anywhere at just under 42 cents. The normal K-cups are all plastic while these have a plastic ring with a fiber filter bag. Its not 100% recyclable but its a big step forward as the filter will break down quickly and the coffee grounds will then fall out allowing those to decompose as well. That leaves a small plastic ring (which looks recyclable) and foil top left. To assist to keep your coffee fresh you receive a reusable lightweight recyclable plastic tub with an airtight lid that holds about 8 K-cups for peak freshness. In addition each 8 K-Cups is sealed in a vented recyclable bag inside the box so you open one and put them in the storage tub after. Nice touch.This is a lively coffee with a velvet like finish, its gives me an average caffeine buzz, please note I am not big coffee drinker, more a 1-2 good cups a day guy and I like to have variety, thus my move to a Keurig system (which I love and have spread this to 6 others in my family as well as many at my office). This is a good coffee with nice flavor and I also like the fact its a little more recyclable and a good value. A++++

Ive enjoyed the coffee. I was a little skeptical but the coffee tastes great, the pods work great and it is a much cheaper alternative to K-cups breakfast blend or donut shop. Don't be hesitant--go ahead and buy it.  I just bought my second one!
My wife loves this coffee over any of the other cups. Have to keep them in tight container for freshness but it's a small bother. Definitely plan to keep on auto delivery

column9: Smooth, better flavor, and less waste.
column10: Had to try this coffee brand for my single brew machine.  Glad I did.  This is what fresh coffee should taste like.  Also like the idea that there is less plastic- don't want items brewed in plastic!  The flavor is the best- smooth and so fresh!I hope they will consider making flavored coffees- vanilla, etc.

column9: Finally an affordable alternative to over priced K-cups.
column10: Over the last six years that I've had my Kureig brewer I've seen the price of K-cups steadily rise along with it's popularity.  Finally someone has come up with an alternative that is just as easy to use, tastes great and is substantially cheaper.  THANK YOU San Francisco Bay Coffee for marketing this product.  I got the breakfast blend which is actually stronger than the Green Mountain version I normally buy.  I compensated by increasing the size of the cup from the regular mug to the travel mug size.  Now I'm actually getting a larger cup of coffee for less money.  Yippee!

I'm quite pleased with this. I wondered how the less-plastic design would work, but it worked just fine. The coffee is bold without being a dark roast. So there is no problem using the large cup setting. The price per cup is the best I've found. It seems they economize with the k-cup design and not by skimping on the amount of coffee. Of course you're buying 80 cups, so you hope you're going to like it. So far, I do.

column9: please do not order this coffee!
column10: Every time I fall in love with a product it seems to get really popular and sell out quickly. I think about my first cup of coffee before I even go to sleep! This is just that good.It seems to be a bit stronger or bolder than GM Breakfast Blend wich I enjoy. I do like medium roast coffees and this fits the bill.So in closing please DO NOT ORDER THIS COFFEE! Then it will sell out and I won't get any.. You DO NOT want to meet me in an alley if I haven't had my coffee!

I tried this version of K-cups to determine how it compared with other brands.  I was somewhat skeptical of the coffee not being in an air tight container.  This coffee has a filter covering the bottom and therefore not sealed.  The taste of the coffee is great.  We typically stay with the medium type blends and stay away from the bold flavors.  This coffee is a little on the strong side so when I brew, I just use more water and the flavor is as good as or better than the other brands (Emerils, Newmans, etc.).  As far as keeping the coffee fresh, we use an air tight container.  This coffee comes in sealed bags containing 12 or fewer cups.  Cost is much less than the standard k-cups.

Generally I avoid 'breakfast blends' because they are, usually, pretty wimpy in flavor.  I actually ordered this by mistake - thought I was ordering one of the other San Francisco Bay coffees (that I love).  Having said that - I got it - tried it - and it is surprisingly good.  Not at all wimpy in flavor and it is becoming one of my favs.

I tried the San Francisco Bay Coffee One Cup for Keurig K-Cup Brewers, and was PLEASANTLY surprised with the quality and price and enviromental advantages.  No plastic cup, just a cute little filter full of wonderful coffee and still disposable.  Costs half the price and every strength and flavor of coffee you can imagine.  LOVE IT!!!

Very happy with the flavor of the coffee.  Have purchased both the Breakfast Blend and the Fogchaser.  The Breakfast Blend is a lighter roast while Fogchaser is more full bodied.  Very happy with the flavor of both.  Coffee doesn't come in traditional k-cups but arrive in sealed bags containing 5 each of the containers.  The filter are exposed but the tops fit in the udual holder.  This arrangement of holders reduces the cost to approximately half the cost of a regular k cup.  Very pleased with the purchase.
I'm happy with the taste of the coffee, the packaging, but mostly the price!  Its a winner.  More flavors, please :)

When I opened the box of coffee I thought I had ordered the wrong product. But after closer inspection and trying it in my K-cup brewer. I found out it worked great and I love the mesh bag the coffee is in. The taste of this coffee is fantastic.

After buying a keurig coffee maker this summer, we've been on a search for the perfect morning breakfast blend--our search is over! If you like Newman's Own...or Tully's then you will probably love this blend. It's a nice cup of coffee--strong but not burnt tasting like some I've tried. I have a 16 oz travel mug, and I can actually brew 10oz, then run another 6oz of water through the same kcup, and it is perfection! One more thing to mention, these are not like regular k-cups in that they arrive in sealed bags with little cups that have a top of the cup similar to reg k-cups, but the coffee is not encased in a plastic cup, they are in a thick rounded filter material. Looks different, but works perfect in the coffee machine. I love that it is less plastic waste to end up in the landfill. Oh, and if you're still 'on the fence', consider the price of these VS regular k-cups---definite savings!
tried this coffee out it was worth ordering comes prepackaged in 8 pack cartons to keep it fresh I will reorder again

column9: Good for me, Excelent for the enviroment! Thumbs up!
column10: I like the idea of using less plastic. They keep in a bag with 10 each, so it keep fresh and flavor. They are also cost much less than the ones with the cup. At first I was surprised with the "missing cup" but later I realize what's good for me, for my pocket and for the nature needs a thumbs up!

column4: Dave "Brevity is the soul of wit"
column10: What some think is residue is actually crema, though not as heavy as in an espresso shot. Crema is a flavorful, aromatic, reddish-brown froth made when air bubbles combine with fine-ground coffee's soluble oils. The strong presence of crema indicates a quality, well-ground coffee Crema helps give espresso a fuller flavor, longer aftertaste than drip coffee. This is excellent coffee and the crema makes it better.

I usually buy the Coffee People Donut Shop Blend. This tastes just as good and the price is so much BETTER!!! I'm glad I took a chance on them and I will definitely purchase them again through subscribe and save! Don't waste your money on the way overpriced k cups...try these instead!

This is a wonderful coffee for the k-cups. At 34 cents a cup the price is great too. It's in my opinion just as good if not better than the traditional k-cups from Green Mountain and others that cost so much more.

I like the San Francisco Bay cups because they have a "paper" bottom, which means less plastic (better for the environment????).  I think the paper allows more water to flow through, thus the coffee is a bit stronger.  They appear to be a bit less expensive also, which makes sense since there is less plastic.

column9: Great coffee at an excellent price
column10: I ordered this coffee hoping to like it as the price for 80 cups was a mere $33 shipped!  When it arrived the box was a little beat up and the bottom was half opened but no product was lost so not too big of a deal. I opened the box and there are 10 packages with 8 cups in each. As this coffee pod doesn't have the protective plastic cup around the filter you save on the cost and it helps the environment. The coffee smelled great and my husband and I each brewed a cup. I added cream and sugar and while I liked the taste it isn't my absolute favorite blend. My husband on the other hand LOVED it. He drank five cups and told me to be sure to order more when we run out. He said it wasn't as bitter as some of the other K-cup flavors he has tried like Donut House blends. I can't wait to share it with guests and  tell them the bargain price.  The only caveat is that the bags of pods are not sealed so they can go stale if you don't keep it in a plastic bag or a bowl with a lid.
THIS COFFEE IS GOOD BUT I BOUGHT IT FOR A CHANGE I USUALLY DRING DONUT HOUSE BUT THIS IS GOOD ALSO.
This is the best coffee I have ever had. I have had Keurig coffee maker for several years and I tried many different brands and flavors and San Francisco Bay Breakfast Blend is the best.
First of all the "k-cups" were weird and the taste was not what I thought.  I would not buy this product again.
Good price, good quality with convenience.  Fully met my expectations.  Would recommend.  The breakfast blend was mild and a nice start to the morning.

column9: THE Alternative To High Priced K-Cups You've Been LOOKING For!
column10: You love K-Cups, but get annoyed with paying $1.50+ apiece? This product is for you. It's not a K-Cup. So my guess is that they don't pay royalties to Keurig. And they pass the savings along to you.So if it's not a K-cup, what is it? Too hard to explain. It's like a cross between a tea-bag and a K-Cup.Here's all that matters: it fits in your Keurig machine--no problem. They package it in a way that it stays fresh. And it brews as good of a cup of coffee as any K-Cup.But it's WAY cheaper.Try it. You'll love it!

I'm not a big fan of the green mountain coffees, because they all seem to be bitter.  This is a nice brew that is strong enough for me without being bitter.  Their version of the K cup works great in my Keurig machine, 70+ cups without a hitch.  They come nicely sealed in 10 separate 8 count packages.  I just opened my last package and it tastes as good as the first.
I liked the idea of less plastic with my K-Cup, and got the added bonus of a delicious cup of coffee!I won't buy anything else now...I'm hooked!
San Francisco Bay Coffee Company makes the best coffee for the Kuerig by far.  It's also half the price.  It's always nice to have someone break a monopoly.

I was a little hesitant to purchase these 'K-Cups"....because they are not made the same way as the traditional K-Cup (the plastic cup). Rest assured that these little babies are foolproof and taste GREAT! We purchased the Foglifter and the Breakfast Blend....both are excellent. The packages maintain freshness well. I will be purchasing more of this product.

Coffe tastes good when package is first opened. The second day, probably due to flimsy paper covering, tastes stale. Only good when plastic package is first opened. I've ordered twice--will not order again.

I ordered the SF blend instead by not paying attention to the order.  I must have been in a FOG.  Well,  I'm not disappointed in the error  of my way.  The blend is actually an excellent choice as this coffee is smooth and  very San Francisco Bay Coffee One Cup for Keurig K-Cup Brewers, Breakfast Blend, 80-Countflavorful.  Will definitely order again.  Thanks SF coffee. The delivery arrived in great condition in only two days.

I tend to like my coffee with more body than this "Breakfast Blend", but this is a perfectly good cup of coffee to start the day.  The packaging of eight (8) cups per sealed bag was unexpected (as other packaging options bag twelve (12) at a time), but this isn't a problem when I transfer them to my airtight container in my kitchen next to my Keurig brewer.

A little hesitant even though all the reviews were all mostly good ones, but WOW! What a pleasant surprise to see and taste. Excellent coffee flavor and aroma. Just place the open bagged contents in a ziplock bag. How easy can that be! The price is right and glad to see and innovative way to use my beloved Keurig machine! Cant wait to try all the other types. How could you beat the subscribe and save program too!

I originaly bought this based primarily on price and shipping cost. I was a little skeptical when I saw the design of the pods, but was willing to try something new. What a pleasant suprise. This coffee is the best k-cup brew I have experienced, and is the best value. Great flavor. Fantastic!!!!

column9: Not Bad Coffee for the Price, Howerver
column10: The coffee taste great and for the price you cannot beat it. However, not sure yet how well it works in our Keurig coffee maker. It seems to me the flow is somewhat restricted. Maybe it has something to do with the K-cup design. This k-cup is not made of plastic. Instead it is a filter(mesh)like material.
I was pleased with the amount of coffee pods you got for a great price.  A bit on the strong side, but full of flavor.

The San Francisco Bay Coffee Breakfast Blend K-cup is a robust cup of coffee for a supposed Breakfast Blend.  I bought this as a standby when I need K-cups quickly and my Green Mountain Coffee, Breakfast Blend K-Cup Portion Pack for Keurig Brewers, 50-count was running out.  We normally drink Green Mountain coffee but I was intrigued by the low environmental impact packaging of these individual portions, so I decided to give them a try.  Really, really great.  I only wish more companies would offer this type of packaging ... it makes a great, fresh cup of coffee.When brewed, the coffee is a little heavier than I am accustomed to for a Breakfast Blend (I drink my coffee black).  I can actually get two cups out of one K-cup/pod - one on the tallest setting and one of the shortest setting.  For a black cup of coffee, it is still relatively robust even for that smaller cup.I like these K-cup pods a lot.  I think they make a lot more sense packaging-wise.  These came in a box with 8 baggies of 10 K-cups.  The bags keep them fresh and are necessary for that.  Unlike a regular plastic K-cup, if exposed to the elements they will go stale quickly.  I have a sealed coffee jar I keep the pods in that keeps them fresh cup after cup.Coffee has gotten a lot more expensive but for 80 portions, this is a great buy.  Love these.  I wish that Green Mountain would package them like this!

I have had my keuring machine for about 2 years now and had always bought my coffee locally, getting small boxes for a large price.  I found this product - 80 k-cups for a wonderful price and decided it would be worth it to give it a try.  We ordered one box to sample.  It was much more economical than the small boxes we had been buying.  The box was received in less than a week and we tried the coffee immediately.  It has a robust flavor without any bitterness.  Great coffee!  I would recommend this product and this merchant to anyone.

First, just love the Keurig coffee maker.  So, so easy to use.  Makes a cup of coffe quick.  These individual cups are easy to use and the flavor is great.  The shipping was super quick.  Great service.

column9: Something is just not right with this coffee
column10: When I first got the pods I loved them but after a couple of weeks in opened or unopened packages these pods must have lost their freshness because the coffee does is just not the same and it's pretty much awful at this point, I am sorry I went ahead and purchased 160 more pods after the first 36 because now I'm stuck with them and I can't stomach them nor can anyone in my family.

I am now a huge fan of this Breakfast Blend coffee. I  love that they ditched the plastic K-cups and it still fits perfectly in my Keurig. The price for 80 cups is fabulous compared to the other brands and the coffee tastes and smells wonderful.
The packaging was great as we traveled to another state and the coffee tasted ok, I like my coffee stronger, so I liked the French Roast better...
First time we ordered or bought anything but Keurig K-cups. This coffee is worth the cost which is less than K-Cups but I rather have new Orleans Blend.Sal Reale
Ordered this coffee when it first became available on Amazon and was really surprised how good it was.  The Fog Chaser and Breakfast Blend are my favorites and the price is really great!

I stopped using my Kreug coffee machine because I did not want to pay $150 a month for coffee. This coffee is less than half the price of other coffees. The taste is fantastic and meets my needs. I would recommend it others.

This coffee is very good, a bit stronger than most of the breakfast blends I have tried. I was surprised at the strengh,  but still very good.  I like the fact that is has less waste than other k cups. I will buy again as the price is superb. I am looking forward to trying the other blends by this company.

The coffee is good coffee, packaged in much more environmentally friendly containers than K cups!  The coffee comes in vacuum sealed bags of 10 or 12.  Each cup has a plastic ring which holds it in place in the keurig machine and the coffee is held to the ring by a strong filter. Once the cup has been used, I cut the two apart, compost the coffee and filter and the ring is rinsed and put in recycling. The only slight drawback to this packaging is that you need to brew the coffee in a reasonable amount of time once the vacuum seal has been broken.
I love the concept of this coffee pod and feel good that I'm not contributing so much waste to our landfill. The coffee isn't bad either, a smooth, mellow blend to start the day.
This coffee is little stronger than DD coffee. As another reviewer said, i can easily make a 12 ounce coffee with only one pod. Plus, this uses less plastic and it smells good.

I'm not generally a huge fan of Keurig coffee makers because they and their K-cups are so expensive. But my girlfriend has one and she ran out of coffee for it. I looked around Amazon and found this item. It sounded promising so I decided to try it. It is the best K-cup of coffee I've ever had (it has a strong, mellow medium roast flavor). And it's also the least expensive I've found. I signed up for a subscription and will probably keep it going. Yum.

this coffee is a great deal and tastes just as good as Green Mountain or Donut Shop Coffee's.  Its medium bold.  The new type of cup was not an issue at all in my Keurig, and i like not using as much plastic for the environment.  My sister also ordered this coffee and likes it as much as i do.

column9: Low Cost Per Cup, Great Taste
column10: Unique packaging that delivers a better cup of coffee. Can't beat the cost per cup. My friends love it.  I will reorder it for sure.
Great coffee, smooth, no bitterness, THE best K-cup breakfast coffee I've tried and I've tried all of the main k-cup brands.

I really like the flavor of the Breakfast Blend, and I will try the Fog Chaser next. However, I also like the unique cup, which uses considerably less materials than traditional K cups. Although the bottom is a filter, it is not wet when it comes out of my Breville K Cup machine.

I tried this coffee and did not expect it to be very tasty.  Well I love love love it.  The company packs approxitmately 10 individual coffee in a wonderful plastic bag which is of high quality.  My order consisted of several of these bags.  The manufacturer places the coffee in plastic to keep it fresh.  The coffee has a different bottom than the keurig coffee.  However, it fits into the keurig  platinum series coffee maker.  Be aware the new keurig vue brewer  coffee pods will not fit into this machine.  All the pods we are used to do not fit into the new machine.  This just a gimmick to sell more and slowely replace the machine we are used to.

column9: San Francisco Breakfast Blend Coffee for Keurig
column10: This is a coffee on the light side between a mild and medium roast. It is just right for a wake-up in the morning. We will continue to buy this blend at the subscribe and save rate. The price for the 80 count is excellent and, in all ways, it seems to be an great purchase.
I am very pleased with the taste and quality of this coffee.  It is smooth and mellow.  I also like the fact that there is greener packaging.

column9: GREAT PRODUCT AT A REASONABLE PRICE
column10: Iam a shopper for QUALITY for less.  This coffee is a EXCELLANT value as it has a great coffee taste. I hope this company comes out with some flavored coffees for my afternoon treat.
These aren't real k-cups but the knock-off mesh kind. My coffee was filled with grinds. You're better off with instant coffee.
Great tasting coffee and love that it comes with no plastic bottom cup. Less trash to throw away. The auto ship program is perfect!

column9: Cooking this may take a small amount of trial and error, but for Celiacs, it's the best I've found
column10: A friend found this pasta in the discount bin at a discount grocery--shiver.  I looked at it, instantly had hope and then considered it carefully before even testing it.  I cooked it and like the tasteless brown rice pasta I can get at Whole Foods, there's a lot of paste in it.  I rinsed with cold water after cooking, like you're supposed to do with any pasta, and ignored the cooking times, because like any "bread," you have to cook pasta with an eye to the way it absorbs water(barometric pressure, viscosity and a host of other variables can affect this).  What I ended up with the first batch, was an under cooked pasta that at least didn't soak up salt too much like the brown rice pasta did.  There was a corn taste I covered with cheese or a meat sauce I made.The second try went much, much better.  I was only diagnosed last year, so I'd cooked pastas for over a decade.  The first time I cooked spaghetti was when I was probably 5 years old and I assure you, my first pass at this stuff was far better than the mess that 5 year old made.  Salt, a small amount of olive oil and a large open sauce bot for the boiling helps.  Boil for at least 5 minutes, and then start testing the shells with a pair of tongs.  Pull up on shell and flex it with the tongs.  When the consistency is where you want it, quickly remove the pot from heat and strain the pasta.  While the pasta is still in the strainer, rinse with cold water to stop the cooking process.  The sauces that go with this pasta are the key.1.  I make an Alfredo sauce I thicken with potato starch (don't use corn starch here, you have enough corn already)2.  This makes the best Gluten-free Mac and cheese I've found.  Do not use young cheeses if you can help it.  I prefer sharp cheddar and a touch of Parmesan.3.  Meat sauces.  I've noticed many Celiac are vegetarian or even vegan, but for those of us who aren't, this pasta tastes the best in a marinara reduction that has at least two kinds of meats folded into it.  Boar's head bacon and ground beef, with sweated onions added to two cans or 3 or 4 fresh diced and sweated tomatoes, add a teaspoon of potato starch to thicken and a diced clove of garlic and you have a sauce that worked with the brown rice pasta but is literally golden with this corn stuff.4.  Butter, garlic, salt, pepper, and lemon or lime.  Simple, sweet and remarkable.Can horrible things happen with this pasta?  Oh yes, but that's not the pasta's fault.  You can burn toast and scald yourself boiling water, but this is the best thing on the market for a gluten free pasta.

column9: The real stuff.  Shark brand Sriracha loses the artifical qualities of Huey Fong but has all the fire and yum.
column10: I've been a rabid fan of Huey Fong Sriracha sauce for years, so when I saw authentic Thai Sriracha sauce here on Amazon my interest was piqued.  I wasn't disappointed.  Shark brand Sriracha sauce really does come from Thailand and it really is sriracha sauce.  It's the same hot chili loaded with garlic and yummy sweetness - but there are plenty of differences.  Where Huey Fong is dark almost crimson red (and looks a tad fake), Shark brand is brick tomato red and clearly looks natural.  Huey Fong lists preservatives, Shark does not.  Unlike Huey Fong, Shark is freely runny and comes in a glass (not plastic) bottle without a flow limiting top (so watch out!)Tasting notes:  Shark is hot, sweet, and garlicky.  Compared to Huey Fong it is less sweet, with a more open tomato-like flavor component.  Vinegar is a more noticeable flavor element with Shark brand.  The texture is looser; and the product separates more in the fridge (and, yes, it requires refrigeration) and requires that the bottle be shaken before use if it's sitting for more than a week.  Is Shark yummy?  Yes - it's probably the second best hot sauce I've tried.  Is Huey Fong yummier?  Yes, in my opinion Huey Fong's added sweetness and thickness and less vinegar taste is more yummy - but it's not a slam dunk.  Shark brand feels more real, more homemade, and more authentic (as it probably is). Huey Fong has preservatives and has a color and texture that are a tad artificial.  I find myself going back and forth.  On top of a burrito I prefer Huey Fong.  In soup I prefer Shark.  I certainly do not regret having this stuff.  Highly recommended for the sriracha obsessed.FYI - full ingredient list:  "Chillie" 35%, Water 25%, Sugar 20%, Garlic 10%, Salt 5%, Vinegar 5%.  Sounds like you could almost make it at home.  Manufacturer:  Kosol-Ampa Co. LTD.  OFF: 804D Chet Cham Nong Rd. Cholburi, Thailand 038-282710 (That's the phone number).

I ordered this never having tried sriracha sauce before. I am trying to eat more veggies and greens. Most Americans are more familiar with the Huey Fong Sriracha Hot Chili Sauce (17oz) version of Sriracha sauce with what I jokingly called the "screaming chicken" hot sauce you see in Asian restaurants.  The Huey Fong version is fairly thick and somewhat sweet that makes it more palatable to American tastes.  I came across Shark Sriracha somewhat by accident and I quickly remembered the wide variety of sauces and cuisines that vary by region and had to remind myself that it's a matter of taste and preference.  For some, Shark Sriracha will be quite shocking as it is prepared in the more traditional Thai manner, meaning it is runnier and more piquant.  Many Americans may be put off by all the foreign language labeling and fearful of the contents, but don't worry, it's not as hot as you think.  As with so many things I was put off by, I'm kicking myself now that I've tried it, as Sriracha sauce isn't that hot and in fact has a nice touch of sweetness to it that makes it a great addition to Thai and Chinese dishes.  Truthfully it's nowhere near as hot as Tabasco sauce and on the Scoville Scale of hotness it ranks only at the 1,000-2,5000 range making it medium (Tabasco is the next level up).  As a self-confessed hot-head hot sauce lover I have to admit Shark Sriracha has a much more blendable consistency which works easier when cooking and blends well in many Asian dishes.  I typically love northern Thai food and Shark Sriracha works well with it and with Szechwan as well.  Shark Sriracha gives a nice pop of hot without being overpowering like some hot sauces or the truly hot Thai chilies that rate up at 50,000-100,000 on the Scoville scale.  If something is a bit too bland for my taste usually a bit of Shark Sriracha gets my mouth watering. Don't let your fear of the unknown scare you off of Shark Sriracha as you don't know what you're missing!
