these are the best animal crackers i've ever tasted! the chocolate simply adds to the deliciousness. they taste like mini-cookies. they are vegan and thus cruelty-free! organic and yummy. what more can be asked of an animal cracker!

This review comes with a mild warning: Moxie is a decidedly acquired taste.I was introduced to this soda when I was about 7 years old, by a friend of my parents', and I'm sure I wasn't at all taken with it at the time; but I felt compelled on subsequent visits to request that 'Jack' give me another glass of the stuff. Over time, it became one of the foremost memories of growing up, and is now a big part of my Yankeeism. I search it out when I go home for visits; crow triumphantly if I find it in a chain grocery; and feel a little more happy and at home if I manage to have any in my abode out here, where nobody has even heard of it.I did a little research on it before writing this, and discovered that it was first developed (apparently without fizz) in 1876, modified later on as a bubbly soda, and heavily promoted in New England with the "Make Mine Moxie!" advertisement. As I said, it's an acquired taste; with a base of gentian root, it's rather like the Guinness Stout of colas, thick and dark, with a bitter undertaste that the novice might not care for at all. The adventurous and those looking for new soft-drink experiences will find it very different from Coke, while it remains a cola of sorts. Once you have been hooked, however, nothing else will quite fill the place of it. A friend shipped some out for me this year, and it was the best present I had under my tree.

I am a soda fan, and I order unique sodas from all over the place. I just love to try the neat regional sodas that you just can't get anywhere but a limited area. Moxie fits that bill, as it might not be found in the local grocery. Having heard about America's longest continually produced soda from 1884 for many years, I finally determined to try one. They say it takes nerve to drink a Moxie. I learned you can throw all of your normal conceptions of soda out the window when it comes to the taste of Moxie.It has less carbonation than most sodas, so some people think it goes flat fast. It is just that is has less fizz to begin with, and that is OK since too much fizz actually masks the flavor in many sodas. It also has much less sugar than most sodas, only 25 grams per 8 ounce serving rather than the 40 plus grams of most sodas. The flavor is spice, as in pepper - not Dr Pepper but peppery. It has a strong hot bite to it that some people say reminds them of medicine. It has a strong aftertaste. And that aftertaste stays with you for awhile, which is good if you like the flavor. I like Moxie better when I first taste it in my mouth as that is when the sweet part hits you, (it seems at first like Mr. Pibb) rather than a few seconds after I drink it until you get used to it. The taste is unusual enough that I hear New Englanders pride themselves on their ability to get used to the taste and like it. It is definitely an acquired taste. I myself noted that it tasted better the second day than the first, and the next day and so forth. Of course this is how we learn to like the taste of things like coffee. It is very dark like a cola, and it has caffeine. Today it is owned by Monarch in Atlanta, Georgia now. For another unusual but delicious regional soda at Amazon, try Cheerwine.

I was surprised to find Moxie at our local Walmart (upstate NY) and decided to take a chance on a 12-pack.  The first taste was a bit bland, however by the end of the first can, I found myself really liking the taste.  It's a bit like root beer mixed with cola and just a bit sweet.  What started out as a "oh what the heck" purchase has turned out to be my favorite soft drink and now I check the shelves every trip to Wally World for a re-supply.
Ordered a case of Moxie for my mother-n-law. Box was well packed and arrived quickly. Since the purchase went so well, i'll be ordering a case about once a quarter.
Great item Great service would recomend and purchase thie Moxie over and over again.Brings back memories of when I used to live in great State of MAINE

I bought this to send to the west coast because it's original to New England. I live back east and the family met for a graduation in Oregon-they sure were surprised.  This was a lot easier than lugging it on the plane!!Oh Yea!!!  We live Moxie!!
This is worst-tasting soda I've ever had.  I can't see how anyone could like it, but I guess there is something out there for everyone.  I imagine it's what tar tastes like.

An update for July 2012Have ordered this assortment 4 times since my original review which I deleted to edit and add a new review.The company is now listing what you get in the package.........................Case of 60 Assorted Snack Size Bags. The snack size bags range from 3/4 oz to 1-1/4 oz. The assortment includes Regular, BBQ, Sour Cream & Onion, Salt & Vinegar, Crab and Kettle Classic potato chips, Thin pretzels, Cheese Curls, White Cheddar popcorn and Party MixI am very glad to see this.Its no longer a wait and see what you get purchase.However you do still get more of some types than others.A very good product but the dates usually range from 4 to 8 weeks.Could be longer but still a great price and the few that I have eaten after the past best by date I could tell no difference.I hope these stay on site for sale because they have become a regular purchase for me.

I ordered this because my husband is from Pennsylvania, which seems like to only place I can find Utz's chips. The only reason this rate 4 stars for our family is because we only seemed to have gotten one bag of the nacho chips, few of the plain or kettle cooked chips, and a TON of the regular bbq or salt and vinegar chips. If it had an even number of bags per product, we could enjoy this more. But overall these are the chips my hubby and kids love.

I wasn't a fan of this "variety" pack. Only 1 or 2 bags of my favorites, and over 10 bags of BBQ. Granted, 3 different kinds of BBQ, but they all tasted the same to me and I didn't like any of them. Also included were 3 bags of pork rinds which I also don't eat. Ended up giving away over half of the case to friends. Waste of money for me, won't be ordering this pack again.

Ordered this for my boyfriend for his birthday as he is from Baltimore and missing UTZ chips as they are not sold in California.  Shipped in a very good manner for chips, all were in solid condition.  Great mixed selection as well, not too many of one flavour and he was happy with all the flavours, especialy the Crab Chips!  I like everything they have to offer as well since UTZ seems to have fresher, healtheir chips.  You cannot feel the oil all over your hands when you are done eating these!  Will order again later this year I am sure when we run out.

I ordered the mix and match 60 item pack that was on sale expecting to get a decent size package and a reasonable value. Instead I got snacks that were priced at .25 per package suitable for vending machine use and of less face value than the purchase price. Even Amazon's free shipping can't offset the overpricing and if you order direct from UTZ the shipping doubles that overpriced amount.Definitely not worth the price particularly when local retailers sell the same brand product at 4-5 times the size for under a dollar.This multipack is in my opinion just UTZ's way of maximizing unwarranted profits from unknowing online customers. Seriously, 'buy direct from us for double the price anywhere else' just doesn't work for me.They have just informed me by email that they will stop putting in the marked packages - so you won't know what the retail value is of what you are buying.  You are better off, in my opinion, buying this product in the store, if you must have it, or out of a vending machine than from Amazon or even direct from UTZ.
Very good products and very good assistance for the shipment when there was an initial problem!!! Thank you very much!!

column4: SBPrincess "Spoil Me! You know you want to"
column10: I feel like a kid in a candy store with my box of chips... lol great!

Deluxe raspberry & pomegranate fruit spread is to die for! I purchased several flavors just to try and I am hooked. These are not the horribly sweet Smucker's variety at all; these taste like fresh fruit and go perfectly on biscuits. Deluxe Fruit Spread, Red Raspberry & Pomegranate, 11.5 oz (325 g)

I love Paprika for cooking.  I do quite a bit of home Barbeque and most rubs and mops use a lot of Paprika and they need to be fresh.  Paprika just adds a lot of color and good mild pepper taste.  The Durkee is nice and fresh.  Where I live there are very few stores that carry enough Paprika so I have to order it and it has always been really good.  Priced right as well.

I use a lot of Paprika in some of my recipes and buying at my local market is extremely expensive.  So I was happy to find a good quality sweet Paprika available in large sizes.Good sweet taste and brick red color - exactly what I wanted.  Will buy again.

column9: Nice deep red color, great flavor
column10: This is really good quality paprika. It has the deep red color you look for when garnishing things like deviled eggs, and a fresh sweet pepper taste.Paprika is essential for for rubs and seasoning in barbecuing. And if you do a lot of it, you'll appreciate having it on hand in quantity like this.It's also great on roasts, in stews and soups, and with dozens of other things.It's interesting how many people see paprika and think "hot pepper," but paprika isn't hot at all. It adds a nice touch of sweet pepper flavor, not hot.

All I can say is freakin' awesome. It was worth the shipping fee to receive them next day still frozen. It took only a few minutes sitting on my granite counter top to fully defrost and be perfect for eating! Highly recommend this companies Whoopie pies.

Almost as good as my mother use to make when I was a kid growing up in Maine.  My son ordered these for me as a Christmas gift in 2005 and they were delicious.  Delivery was very prompt.  Pies were fresh.  They didn't last long.

We LOVE the peanut butter puffins, but the chocolate peanut butter puffins are just not as good.  It's not that the chocolate parts are not chocolately enough, they are for a natural cereal.  It's just that they are small and kind of stale-tasting.  I don't know if it's because it's bulk packaging or what.  It doesn't take the family long to burn through a box so I know they haven't been sitting around my house...either way, I think I'll stick to the peanut butter puffins.  They are delicious!

I love Peanut Butter Puffins, but this is not it... nor does it taste particularly like chocolate either.  It's rather bland, neither of my kids liked it.  I gave the rest to a friend, and she didn't like it either.

I've always loved peanut butter and chocolate cereals, but they tending to be ridiculously sweet. I grew up eating Reese's cereal. I've been buying Barbara's Peanut Butter Puffins for years, but I had never seen the pb and chocolate until recently. They're great! Their sweetness is akin to Kix, I'd say, but with a much better flavor (being more of a dessert combination of flavors). I'm not sure what the other reviewers saw when they wrote their review, but Amazon actually has them for a very good price, especially with subscribe and save.

I never had this cereal before but I figured a chocolate peanut butter combination is impossible to screw up.  This thing was very bland and not sweet at all.  I bought the 4 pack set from amazon and maybe after the second box I began to appreciate it.  It's definitely an acquired taste.  I wouldn't buy it again :/

column9: Just OK compared to Peanut Butter Puffins
column10: I'm obsessed with the (original) Peanut Butter Puffins from Barbara's Bakery, but for some reason this PB & Chocolate variety is NOT the same. Not only are the puffins pieces smaller, but the flavor itself is lacking. Both the PB and Chocolate pieces are very BLAND and the cereal lacks an essential saltiness found in PB flavored products.The only good thing I can say about this variety is that it IS just as crunchy as the original Peanut Butter Puffins. ...but that's about it.Bottom line: I wouldn't buy it again.

Once I saw peanut butter and chocolate cereal, I knew I had to try it. I'm so pleased that I can eat chocolate for breakfast and not feel guilty. My two kids love the cereal as well. Great to eat alone or with your favorite milk product and/or yogurt. I mix it in with homemade granola as well.

column9: Ok, but nearly as good as their peanut butter only cereal
column10: I've really enjoyed Barbara's PB Puffins as a tasty low(er) sugar alternative, and was excited to find a variety here on Amazon that had chocolate in it. Unfortunately the chocolate pieces don't live up to their expectations. They are somewhat lacking in flavor, almost "stale" as another reviewer stated. I'm definitely going back to the regular PB only cereal. Too bad, I miss choclate in my low sugar diet.

I was looking for a snack to feed a teen that was somewhat sweet and satisfying without being too awful for him, and this really does the trick.  They are very tasty and just a handful does the trick  He's happy (and so am I)a

Recently I was forced to be on a gluten and dairy free diet for a few months.  I have two young children and I'm busy and finding quick, relatively tasty and easy gluten and dairy free options is tough.  I LOVE Thai food but never harbored any false notions that this would taste remotely authentic (when was the last time you tasted something out of a package that tasted authentic - or even remotely good, for that matter)?  Also, I tend to stick with whole foods and avoid packaged/processed foods (no matter how healthy) as much as possible.  Anyway, I was surprised that I enjoyed this. (I still eat them and I'm off the restricted diet.) Salty, yes (but I love salty foods).  And you have to have a microwave that can adjust it's power to 20% (most do these days). And they talk about the noodles "fluffing up" which mine never did. Lastly, it isn't cheap and it is definitely a small meal.  But, at the end of the day, it's a tasty option for those who can't have gluten or dairy products.  (It's actually vegan, too!)

Most of Dr. McDougall's stuff is OK.  It's convenience food so I never have high expectations.  However, this is an exception. I made this using the boiling water method.  This is the same method I used for his other products.  I let the product sit for 6 minutes.  Stirred it up and tasted it.Oh my God it was so nasty.  I let sit some more.  Still nasty.  Honestly I couldn't eat it.  It tasted so bad, to me, that I just threw it out.I've tried a couple other of his Asian Entrees and they are not too bad. But, they are NOT entrees, not by any stretch of the imagination.  It's a 1/2 container of noodles and whatever powdered stuff is added.Beware when ordering the Asian Entrees.  The only one that tasted like I would eat it again is the Thai Peanut Noodle.  The Soy Ginger Noodle is just passable.  I don't think I will be wasting any more money on the other Asian Entree varieties.

This didn't taste like other (fresh) pad thai noodles I've had, but they were still delicious. They have a tanginess from the tamarind that I like. I add about a teaspoon of crunchy peanut butter during the final stir, kicks up the richness a bit.
I sort of expected this to be more than it is.  Just a mushy little dab of noodles.  Tastes fine but doesn't make a meal.

I wasn't expecting much from these noodles but they really didn't taste anything like any pad thai I have ever tried. There was too much seasoning and it didn't dissolve very well so the "sauce" was kind of chunky. I found that by using only about a third of the seasoning packet they were edible (though bland) but this is not something I would purchase again.
I have had many flavors of Dr. McDougall, Asian and regular lines both. They have all been great. The tofu and seasonings in this Pad Thai has made it especially amazing.

I made this preparation using boiling water from my electric kettle. The noodle constistency was good. I haven't tried microwaving but I think this would contribute to "mushy" texture that some have mentioned and so I would avoid this cooking method.Overall the taste/flavor is pretty good. Its obviously not going to beat traditionally prepared pad thai but this is above average for an instant low calorie meal in its price point.Note: High marks as a vegan offering but too much salt to be called "healthy"
This has no flavor. The noodles are disgusting. It tastes absolutely nothing like Pad Thai. This was more than disappointing.

column9: Way too much sodium for a Dr. McDougal product
column10: As of this review, I've also tried Taste of Thai, Thai Kitchen and Thai Pavilion versions. For a Dr. McDougal product, the amount of sodium is inexcusable. Taste of Thai was the lowest in sodium (and best tasting of all, by far) clocking in at just 320 mg. Next in the sodium ladder is Thai Kitchen at 650 mg., then Thai Pavilion at 810 mg. The Dr. McDougal version, which the label says has 480 mg. is for a very small serving size, less than half a serving compared to all the others. So, multiply the McDougal version by 2 to get the real comparative sodium and you're at 960 mg. Like I said, inexcusable and from supposedly a "healthy" product. All I can say is watch your blood pressure folks.

I've tried a couple of other Dr. McDougall entrees that were pretty good for fast food in a cup where you just add boiling water.  But this one really misses the mark.  First, the mushy little noodles don't taste anything like Pad Thai.  It looks and tastes like some brown gravy-ish thing, not particularly terrible but not particularly great either.  When I first opened the cup and saw less than 2 inches of noodles on the bottom, I thought, "Wow, these things must really expand a lot to fill the cup!"  But after adding the powdered sauce packet, pouring in the boiling water, and letting it sit for about 5 minutes....nope, still about 2 inches of noodles and that was it!  Way overpriced for just under $2 per cup.  I think Dr. McDougall needs to go back to the test kitchen on this one.

I love the Pad Thai noodle soup and always have a few in my kitchen and my desk at work. Boil water and let it sit for a few minutes, it's that easy. Great flavor and holds me over until the next meal.

I followed the microwave directions precisely. To be more precise, I followed the microwave directions on the outside cheapboard package. The directions on the styrofoamish cup were different.This product is in a standard cup, the kind you add water to and heat in the microwave. But the food, prepared, only takes up about half of the cup. Specifically, you will be getting about two inches of food.Two inches of food... for 200 calories!! If you pop an Amy's Bistro Burger between two slices of Udi's bread and add a bunch of healthy condiments (lettuce, tomato, ketchup), you will have eaten 50 more calories and have had an actual meal. It is deceptive that this product uses the word "entree" in the title. It isn't really even a snack.It does, however, taste good, which is why I gave it two stars instead of one. It is rather a bit spicy and has a strong aftertaste. But it is good. There is just not enough of it to justify the price or the calories.

Dr. McDougall is famous for his diet, as well as his health program at the St. Helena Hospital. He has his own line of health food products, which I've enjoyed since my college days. He's locally based out of the Bay Area, in Santa Rosa. His Asian entrees are a delightful addition. They're healthier than mainstream Ramen noodles, that are usually loaded with sodium, MSG, and other goodies.The Pad Thai entree is deliciously spicy... I put some Huy Fong, Sriracha Hot Chili Sauce, 17-Ounce Bottles (Pack of 6) on it, and made it even more fiery!There's one major drawback.. there's not much in it. Annie Chun's Pad Thai Noodle Bowl, 9.1-Ounce Units (Pack of 6) has much more, and Annie Chun is based out of nearby San Rafael. Dr. McDougall's is just what the doctor ordered!

I have a 12 year old golden retriever.  I have been feeding him Happy Hips treats for almost a year hoping the glucosamine helps with his arthritis.  He eats the treats like crazy.  I like the fact they are apple, banana, chicken and sweet potato.  They are healthier than store bought treats.  I have the same hope for the chicken & oats dry dog food. This dog food came the other day, I cut the bag open to dump it into a plastic tub and by mistake I tipped it over a little and some of it went scattered all over the floor.  Well, my dog with the arthrtis jumped right up and cleaned up the floor in no time, tried sticking his head in the bag and then wagged his tale licking my face.  If this is as good as the treats, I know it will help with his arthritis.  Amazon is the cheapest I have found for this food, plus the free shipping is a bonus.  I bought mine when Amazon had a 20 percent promotion so it was an added bonus.  Thanks Dogswell and Amazon.

Because of allergies to wheat and corn I decided to give Dogswell products a try. This is the first dry dog food my dogs will eat without adding gravy or meat or veggies or leftovers and they do so eagerly. It smells good enough for me to eat and they haven't scratched since they started on this product. Amazon's price is cheaper than I can get locally so not only is the food good, it's a bargain at that. I love you Amazon!

I was so happy to find this product online, it is difficult to find consistently in stores.  My two dogs showed noticeable improvement (after 2 weeks) from stiff joints.  A healthy 15 year old with the expected stiff hips and a romping 9 year old who has dry joints (who doesn't?).  They both love the taste and I'm happy not to have to crunch up the supplements into their food everyday.  I love the healthy ingredients and lack of fillers, I believe that is why my dogs live long lives. I put it on auto ship!  Yay! No more trips for the forgotten dog food!!  Thanks Amazon!

Really like this dog food. I am aware of what goes in pet food but I am also on a limited income so finding good quality pet food at a reasonable price was challenging. Glad I found this product and my dogs love it! Their coats are shiny and soft. Thanks Dogswell!

It's simple really, My dog is a very picky eater, not to mention she's allergic to so many things. We tried a lot of the name brand dog foods out there (Iams, Avoderm, Science Diet). Nothing worked, so then one night when she was out of food I went to the store and grabbed two small bags of dog food. Happy Hips was one of them. She immediately wanted to smell the bag right after opening it (which she never did before), and as soon as we put it in her bowl she devoured it. With all of the dog food we had previously given her we always had to mix it with something just to get her to eat it, that wasn't the case with Happy Hips, she ate it dry the first night and is still eating it dry 2 months later. She always got bored with the other dog food, after a couple weeks she would stop eating and/or put her nose up to it. She doesn't do that with Happy Hips. She absolutely loves it. Plus it's all natural and made in the U.S.A. You pay more for it, but it's well worth it. If you have never given this to your dog, it may be best to start them off with 4 pound bag or find somewhere you can get a free sample. But I would strongly recommend this to anyone who has a dog. I have also found that Amazon is so far the cheapest place to buy this dog food, and when I buy it, I get the free shipping as well.

I first found this product about a year ago through their free "mini-bag" giveaway. Nookie, my malamute, is a large dog that is susceptible to hip issues. I first had switched her over to the Happy Hips formula and saw that she walked without a limb for the first time in over a year. This took about six months, but was noticeable after about 4 months of eating Happy Hips. I was so pleased with the outcome that I transitioned my smaller, older dog to Happy Hips. My little dog, Steeler, was having back issues as she is getting older. After about 6 months eating Happy Hips, she is out running around like a puppy...she is now 13 years old. I would recommend this product to anyone who has a pet with joint problems or may have those issues later down the road.

column9: Very Satisfied with this dog food
column10: Our dog kept shedding really bad so we switched to this food and it has basically stopped her shedding!  We love the price of it since we have a large dog and go thru a bag a month.  We will recommend this dog food to others.

column9: Happy Hips Dog food is a life saver
column10: My dog can't walk with out this dog food!  I am not sure what is in it but she starts limping if she is without it for longer thatn a day or so!  I am so thankful to find it on Amazon.Dogswell Happy Hips for Dogs, Chicken & Oats Dry Dog Food, 22.5-Pound Bag

I was leary of tryin a new food for my 15 yr old dog. She has been on a prescription food for a sensitive stomach for 2 years. Happy to report this food has not upset her stomach and she running like a puppy again!!
My dog, a corgi mix (~ 28lbs) loves the food. His coat looks really good.I switched from his old food without any issues.
I highly recommend this food and the treats as well.  All dogs like it and it is really good for them.

I bought a small bag of this on sale, by mistake at Pavillions but when I went back it was not in stock. I searched it out on line as Jake loves it... Mysteriously his limping has all but vanished.There is no non nutritious corn filler,,, and lots of chondroitin and glucosamine ... and I don't have to carry it in and out of my car.... YAY

column9: This food really made a difference in my dog's joint health/pain
column10: My dog was 8+yrs old when I first bought Happy Hips by Dr. Dogswell for him to try - within a week my dog went from stumbling and walking slow, and occasionally buckling in the front shoulders during tight turns, to frisking like the younger dog he used to be - no buckling, back to a trotting gait, and no evidence of pain!  I've kept him on the food for the past two years, occasionally mixing in other food for variety - but this stuff really made a difference for my dog, so I'm swearing by it and recommending it to others.  I had been supplementing his previous food (Pedigree) with expensive pills that promised improved joint health, and they never seemed to do anything.  Now my dog is just primarily eating the Dr. Dogswell food (no supplements, but occasional mixing in of Newman's Own or Rachel Ray's food for variety) and he's still doing great.
My dog has had problems with his cruciate ligaments and this food seems to help him.  He also loves the taste!

I am delighted with this food. It looks nice, smells really great, has a smaller size kibble for my old dog's teeth, and comes in a ziplock pouch. More importantly though, my old dog who was getting a little lame has suddenly gotten frisky again since starting on this chow. We have also noticed that the terrible flatulence he had daily is gone too. To be fair, at the same time I switched his wet food to Harmony Foods, so that may also be a factor. I am extremely happy with this food and will continue to buy it.

column9: My 10 year old Dachshund acts like a puppy again.
column10: following through on a recommendation for Happy Hips was the best thing for my aging Fritz.  He's so painfree & agile now.  I love the result & he does, too.

After watching my dog sufffer from itchy skin for 5 years and hundreds of dollars on useless VET bills, I finally figured out that my dog had food allergies. Go figure..... HAPPY HIPS makes my baby very happy which in turn makes me VERY happy......

column9: Happy Hips makes my dog happy
column10: My dog loves this dog food - i had to switch her from another joint supplement food because of unavailability issues - and Lucy loves this!!

My dog is very picky about her food and she has a lot of itching problems.  We have been told many time that her skin problems may have something to do with her diet.  We have tried many types of food, but this one seems to work best.  She really likes it and, although itching problem hasn't gone away, it does seem a little better. I am no health food expert, but based on what I am told by some Vets, this is a healthy product.  Final assessment: The extra cost of this food is worth the benefits of her eating more regularly; that she is eating a healthier food; and her itching seems to be somewhat relieved.  Also, I like having the bag delivered to my house at no charge in 2 days.  Schlepping big bag of dog food from the pet store  to my house is a pain.

column9: My Juvie, Standing With Comfort, at Last!
column10: I was looking for dog food from Amazon.com so I wouldn't have to drive so far when I noticed this Happy Hips dog food.  I take care of my daughter's dog.  She lives in an apartment with her cat and couldn't take this sweet chow mix home with her when as a stray she entered her work place and make a bee line right to my daughter.  We are all dog people and so she asked me to take in another stray.  Soon after our little Juvie began to drag herself around.  We took her into the vets and her hips are really out of whack.  There was nothing we could do or afford.  She seemed happy but very inactive.  After I began feeding her the Happy Hip, which she loves, she began standing more and even playing with the new puppy.  I began feeding my other dog (he is two years old now), mixing the old food with the Happy Hips.  He will eat all the Happy Hips and leave the old food until I admonish him to finish his dinner.  Both dogs are really happy with Happy Hips.
I love this dog food and so do our 2 pekes.  I love how moist the food is.  Normal kibble is very dry.
Our "senior" dog quit limping around(arthritis) after a week or so of eating this stuff! Plus the bits are a good size, like marbles, not too big like some foods we've bought in the past.

column9: My dog enjoys it and it helps her hips.
column10: My dog was diagnosed with hip dysplasia as a 6-month old puppy.  The vet said it was the worst case he'd seen in a puppy her age and we were told that she wouldn't be able to walk by the time she was three if we didn't have an expensive surgery done.  I've tried various supplements and foods over the years and although she may sway a bit when walking and tire easily she's now 8 years old and we frequently go on short hikes together.I started feeding her Happy Hips about 4 months ago.  Since that time I've cut out any other supplements and paid close attention to how she does.  She readily eats the food and doesn't gorge herself when eating.  She seems to have more energy and stamina now.  I don't want to push her too hard but last weekend I took her on a 4 mile hike over aggressive terrain, much more than we normally do, she led the pack the whole way and even jumped in the truck quickly when we were done.  In the past I've had to lift her into the truck at the end of any hikes.  She spent the rest of the day sleeping but the next day was up and going again.  Overall I'm very impressed with my dog's health and since this has been her food over the last several months it has to be a factor in how she's doing.  I originally was going to rate this 4 stars but really have not complaints at all and my pup is doing great so I upped it to 5 stars.As a side note I read reviews online before feeding my dog this food and found that it is rated well by a few independent review sites.

column9: Great food dog loves it and he feels great.
column10: Great food for the price. My dog feels great after try a few different affordable higher quality foods that caused him to shed profusely. On this food it stopped and he is full of energy for a 9 year old lab.
Our dogs were feeling their ages until we began feeding them Happy Hips dog food. Now they feel GREAT! And ordering it from Amazon.com was easy and convienient.  Try it, you'll like it!

I have a 2 year ol shepherd that had to have hip surgery when he was a puppy due to getting hit by a car. Also its well documented that have hip problems anyway so this enhanced my concern. in addition to the fact that they also have digestive issues as well. I saw a small bag of this at my local giant eagle an thought i would try it. well, he loved it! so i searched it out locally an couldn't find it. i wish the shipping options were a lil better an cheaper. overall its a great dog food. not full of all that garbage other manufacturers use! i totally recommend this for your dog. My chopper loves it!

This dog food is fantastic. Just the amount you pay and the amount you get aren't quit up to par. I am switching to nutro natural dog food cause for $40 I get 1.5 month supply. Happy hips is $38 for a month.

My overweight little girl not only got down to a healthy size; but was cured of her lameness thanks to this food. Several years ago, she began walking on three legs.  The leg pulled to her body didn't seem to cause her any acute pain--she just didn't want to use it.  Vets and specialists armed with x-rays and other tests conferred and couldn't decide what was wrong with her.  A $7000 surgery was suggested; but I tried this food fist (coupled with Happy Hips chicken jerky treats).  After SIX months of being lame, within three weeks she was walking on all four legs and never had the problem again.  She has a shiny coat, bright eyes and lots of energy (she's nine years old).I would be a wreck if this ever went off the market.Also of note, this food seems super-healthy: no by-products, no fillers, no yucky things.  It seems as whole and healthy as you can get whilst using a manufactured dry food.  And even better, it has all her favorite table foods to eat--blueberries, chicken, sweet potatoes, apples, carrots, etc.There's a serving suggestion on the back of the package.  My dog is about 10 pounds and I feed her 1/2 cup of food a day.  (1/4 cup in the a.m. and 1/4 cup in the p.m.).  When she's super active (or seems terribly hungry), I give her more.  Also remember I supplement her diet with Happy Hips chicken jerky treats and the occasional raw fruit or vegetable when I'm cooking.  In short, a 4-pound bag lasts her three weeks to a month (if you're wondering how much to order on the subscription plan).Let me know if you have questions.

Our 12+ yr old lab has been a finnicky eater for the past few years.  I've tried anything and everything to get her to eat. This food was new at our grocery store and I thought I'd give it a try.  She loves it!!!  This is the first 'dry'  dog food she eats without any extras ( fruit, veggies, meats etc)  Yesterday, the first day, she ate approx 4 cups of this food, typically she doesn't eat that much.  Well, let's see if that was a fluke, this morning she ate another 2 cups.  This food isn't really dry, it's a bit moist.  It smells great.  I can't believe our dog is eating it, much less so much of it.  I plan on getting the larger size bag from Amazon and trying some of the treats.

column9: This won't be in the rotation
column10: I've complained about the expiration dates when ordering from amzaon. This had the same problem. While the ingredients look decent, even though it has chicken meal, my dog was not thrilled with this food at all. She's 9 yrs old and I thought the Glucosamine would be beneficial to her. So even though the dog food is going to expire in 4 months, I've ended up having to give it away to someone else as she just looks at the food and back at me like "Really you expect me to eat this" I will say that she is a very picky eater. So it maybe great for others, just not for my dog.

I had my dog on this food until he developed an infection in his anal glands. My vet told me not to use this food anymore because it is made in china and the glucosamine in the Happy Hips formula provides no benefit to my dog because the amount of glucosamine is too small and its not a high quality. He had us switch to Royal CaninRoyal Canin Dry Dog Food, Giant Breed Adult 28 Formula, 35-Pound Bag - so far our dog is doing really well with this food, firmer stool, loves to eat it, etc. And for the glucosamine/chondroitin/MSM we are using DasaquinNutramax Dasuquin with MSM for Large Dogs - 150 Tablets which is a pharmaceutical grade supplement, same manufactorer makes a supplement for human consumption as well.Do yourself a favor- buy a solid supplement and a dog food that is not produced in China.

column4: Silvia Bridger "Publisher of The Truth About ...
column10: These cereal bars are perfect for on-the-go snacking.  They're like a gluten-free version of Nutrigrain bars.

My 2 year old has an allergic condition called eosinophilic esophagitis; he's allergic to all sorts of foods including dairy, eggs, and wheat. Also because of inflammation in his throat from EoE, he cannot often tolerate hard or gritty foods. He's also a 2 year old, so that means of the few things he can eat, he's picky. Some days I would write obsessive lists of every single bite he ate trying to make sure he was getting enough calories, and then we discovered these breakfast bars. They are pretty pricey, but for a gluten free product they are surprisingly soft and don't have the terribly gritty texture and my son absolutely LOVES them! Obviously they aren't comparable to regular breakfast bars, but when compared to other gluten free products available, these are really good. They are portable, don't need to be heated or cooled, taste decent, and have totally saved my sanity.
I have never been too fond of breakfast bars in general, but these apple bars make a great snack to grab...not too sweet, mushy or chewy, these bars are just right...

My 5 y.o daughter loves these. Pricey, but these are so good for on the go snacks! They taste great, too. They are a little thicker than Nutra-Grain bars, but after going 8 months w/o them, my daughter doesn't know the difference. We always have these on hand for car trips or feild trips.
I have tried lots of GF snacks so I can be pretty picky but these were definitely too sweet for me to eat for breakfast.

column9: better than average for gluten free bars
column10: Glutino breakfast bars are much better in taste and quality of ingredients than many similar products for gluten free diets. They are easy to carry if you are not sure of finding safe food away from home.
These are wonderful- not crumbly, nice flavor (reminds me of apple pie).  A great food to take while traveling.
Hubby eats these and says they are good snacks for the morning. Not too over done on the apple flavor
this is great to toss in my bag and have for me or my little girls
These are a great product for people who need to eat gluten-free and are on the go for breakfast.  The taste is good and they are most importantly gluten free and quick to eat.

Although I didn't LOVE this product (I don't like cereal bars anyway), it was a good substitute for those on a GF diet. My son, 15 mos old, loves these bars and eats them almost every day! Very good, healthy, and you cannot tell it's gluten free.

I recently found out I was allergic to gluten and went looking for granola bars. This was the closest I could find, and I was very very disappointed. They taste horrendous. I took one bite and had to throw the rest out. It's a shame, but I recommend finding another brand, because even by GF standards (which I consider lower than wheat containing standards) these are really bad. Try Udi's GF granola that comes in a bag if you're looking for something sweet for breakfast. It tastes great.

This is the most popular Glutino Breakfast Bars around here.  Not just my family but also the young boys (5 and 6) that I sometimes care for, who don't have issues with gluten, ask for them.  It is less sweet than the other flavors, and Glutino Breakfast Bars are in general not as sweet as other brands.  It also tastes very wholesome and natural, almost like fig bars but with less over-powering filling, made of apples.  We have tried other flavors---blueberry is pretty popular here too, but not cherry and strawberry, they taste more like flavoring than real fruit to us.  The bars are soft but not too crumbly and easy for even 3 or 4 year olds to hold.  We always have a couple of boxes because we go through them quite quickly, and have not gotten tired of them!

column9: So sweet doesn't taste like apple.
column10: Never liked regular breakfast bars when I tried them because the filling was so sweet. These bars follow in the footsteps of regular ones. The surrounding pastry was tasty though.

column9: A bit sweet, but still good
column10: I was looking forward to eating these bars for breakfast, but when I bit into one, I was surprised by the sweetness. I wouldn't eat these for breakfast every morning, I don't know if I would eat them for breakfast at all, but they are good, just a bit on the sweeter side. This is not the first glutino product I have tried, but it is the first cereal bar from glutino I have tried. I would buy them again but maybe get a different flavor, like strawberry or blueberry. These bars taste a lot like fig newtons. Overall, good.

column9: Great Bars Are Easy on the Stomach
column10: We are an always busy famiily of four, with two of them teenagers, and we eat a LOT of bars, with different people having different favorites. Our daughter does not have celiac disease, but has an easily upset stomach, and likes these Glutino Gluten Free breakfast bars best. I like all kinds of bars, but I've also noticed that Glutino bars (of whatever flavor) satisfy me whether for breakfast or a snack AND at the same time do not make my stomach feel like there's a lump of food in it. I think this is due to the lack of gluten, because I've also noticed that gluten-free muffins do not make my stomach feel full the way a regular muffin made with flour does.In addition, the Glutino bars have no cholesterol and very low sodium.Here's some basic nutritional information on the Glutino Apple bar. I saw that it actually has several good reviews but this was one of the most disgusting things I ever tasted. This was the first gluten free product I tried followed by a sandwich with brown rice bread. I thought I would end up starving because it all tasted like sawdust. I did make myself eat the whole cereal bar but it was horrible. I kept the box sitting on my desk because I hated to throw away a $5 box after eating one. Yesterday after them sitting on my desk for over 4 months I finally threw them in the trash yesterday. I was very sad & disappointed. I was looking for something quick, easy & tasty & this was far from tasty. I haven't found a good cereal bar yet but I find plenty of alternative things to snack on & eat that taste better. I definitely suggest you start with 1 box & make sure you like them first.

column9: Love Glutino but not this product
column10: After going on an anti-inflammation diet, I was forced to find substitutes for almost everything I was used to eating.  I've had lots of success with Glutino products, but this is not one I would recommend.  The bar itself isn't too bad, but the filling is pretty awful.  It disintegrates into a nasty, almost grainy paste.  The apple taste is ok, but the texture of the filling was very hard to swallow.  I tried this for the first time on my morning commute, and had I not been on a crowded bus I would have likely spit it out. I definitely will not by these again and am not sure that I can bring myself to finish the box.  However, definitely check out Glutino pretzels, wafer cookies, and other products!

column9: This is not the bar for you.
column10: These bars crumble and the apple filling is very sour. The taste is awful I could only eat half of the bar before throwing it away. I will never buy this brand again. Such a waste of money, not to mention food.
I thought that these were dreadful to the point that I simply could not force myself to swallow them.  I REALLY wanted to like them & they smelled quite good, but overall-yucky taste.
The bars are good but not great.  They are handy and useful.

Surprised pleasantly by this product which I originally purchased locally here in AZ for $1.39 a package [got two for the trial]. Liked it so well that the Maggi search took me to Amazon. The product was available at a very reasonable price and no s/h charge for a case. Ordered two 48 package cases which arrived quickly and in excellent shape. We follow a Maggi Hot & Sour Soup technique of adding a well stirred egg slowly  in to the soup [stir in one direction] about two minutes before it's finished. You'll soon ask the question - where did all those noodles come from? HA! Enjoy a treat...
Move over Mrs. Grass...this is the best Chicken Noodle Soup I have ever had (next to homemade).  I have turn many freinds on to this also.  Good Stuff!

This syrup is yummy! It doesn't taste of fake or chemicals like other brands of watermelon flavoring that I have tried. I will definitely buy this one again!. I made watermelon lemonade for the kids and I used this in watermelon margaritas for the grownups. Great for a summer party. I think it would be nice to use in a wine spritzer too instead of grenadine for some color and better flavor.

//This soup is actually tasty, but is not gluten free. Less than 10 ppm?? Give me a break!! I have tried this soup twice on my 3 yr old and both times he has a instant reaction. Call the phone number on the back of the can and you get a person that doesn't have a clue and literally will read you what the back of the can says. Couldn't even tell me if it was processed in the same facility with gluten. His exact words "Ma'am, it says gluten free on it." Useless. Do some digging on the internet and you'll find a company statement saying "natural flavors and spices might contain traces of gluten". Put it on the can!! Just wanted to write a warning to all the sensitive Celiacs out there.//

I love cashews, but not all cashews are created equal.  I've had cashews that are too gummy, too brittle, too roasted, too salty, not salty enough, too sweet, or not sweet enough.  I've even had (supposedly unflavored) cashews that have tasted strangely like BBQ.  Gross.  Planter's always gets it just right with their cashews, and these convenient little bags are the perfect size for a snack.  Highly recommended for nut lovers.

I bought these cashews in a 48 count pkg & was disappointed in a few points. First the cashews were mainly pieces & few whole cashews & they were small in size. Second the taste of the cashews were ok but not great. For nine dollars a pound, these cashews were not worth the price. Will not purchase these particular nuts again.D.MartinezDearborn Heights MI.

column9: Delicious, perfect snack size package, stays fresh
column10: I love these cashews. They're Planters, so they taste great. These snack sized packages cost more than buying a larger container but they have three significant advantages that make the extra cost worth it to me: 1)Portion control. I only eat 1 ounce because I only eat what is in one packet. I like knowing that I'm only eating a 160 calorie snack. As healthy as nuts are, I really don't need to be eating more and I don't think I'd be as disciplined with a 16 ounce tub of cashews sitting between me and a television. 2)Freshness. I find that by the time I get towards the bottom of a larger container, the cashews are always soft to some extent. To make things worse, I find myself hurrying through the last of the container before they get even softer (so they taste worse and I'm eating more...) This won't happen when each ounce is individually sealed. 3)Portability. I'm not much of a take-my-food-with-me type of person, but if I'm hungry and in a rush to get out the door, grabbing a packet if these and an apple goes a long way. One other thing I like about these snack packets is that they open easily and down the long side of the packet, so the cashews inside are easy to get to. I ordered with 'subscribe and save' and enjoy having a pantry stable delivered to my door on a regular basis -- thanks Amazon!

column9: Great Snack On The Go, Or For Portion Control
column10: I love cashews and was thrilled to find the one-ounce packages for a reasonable price on Amazon.com. I have no complaints; they came well-packaged and are very fresh. I keep some at home and at work for a quick snack. These bags are "wholes and pieces", if that matters to anyone; it doesn't change the taste.

I wish you could buy less than 4 of these coffees @ a time . I'd like if you could buy 2 of one flavor and 2 of another . At any rate , this is a scrumptious coffee . If you prefer your coffee strong then use the amount you normally would for a pot of coffee . If you're not into strong coffee than use less until you find the exact amount thatsuits your taste . Personally I like this coffee iced . In my opinionit brings out more of the flavor . But that's my taste . I have triedseveral other favors of Coffee Masters and enjoyed them all . Creme Brulee is yummy , as is the Amaretto , and Caramel kiss . I just love when I open a new bag and get that 1st whiff . Mmmmmmmm . I recommend this and other Coffee Masters Coffee very highly .

I have purchased this product previously and have found that the delivery is great and value is even greater. My wife loves turtle sundae flavored coffee and at the local coffee store it is $12 a pound, I save about$4.50 a pound purchasing this way and product is excellent.Coffee Masters Flavored Coffee, Turtle Sundae, Ground, 12-Ounce Bags (Pack of 4)

My husband and I owned a retail store in 1990 amd we used to buy the coffee wholesale from Coffee Masters to sell in our store. We even visited their manufacturing plant and it was a class act and the owners were great people.  Whole bean coffee was not "popular" back then as it is now.  When we sold our store, we missed having all their great coffees at our fingertips.  When I found out they sell coffee on Amazon, I was delighted.  It is several dollars cheaper than the Millstone brand that you find in the retail stores and it is a far better product.  We have our account set up on auto-ship and with that program you get a discounted price.  The excellent thing about this program is you can cancel at any time, change the type and flavor of coffee you want and change the delivery times.  It is a win-win situation because you get excellent coffee for an excellent price.  Thank you Coffee Masters for making your product available on the internet.  I will be a customer for life!Diana O'Rourke
This coffee does have a nutty chocolate flavor so if that is what you are looking for this should do the trick.
This is a great price if you want to grow your own sprouts.  Saves a bundle compared to buying sprouts at the store.

column9: I consider this purchase SAVING money
column10: I am still trying to find a local store that offers certified USDA sprout seeds. But until I do I continue to order here on Amazon...and these seem to be the best pick I've found.If you love the health benefits and/or taste of sprouts on your sandwiches, salads, casseroles etc. this is the best way to go. Not only do you SAVE money by growing your own, you can't beat the fact that you are getting organic, guaranteed pesticide-free ones here that you grow in your own kitchen. I am a sprout lover and find these far more full of taste, freshness, and crispness than even those that I buy in the organic grocery stores so I much prefer to grow 'em on my own.Too, I have found these to offer a good bounty of sprouts. Once grown, they'll last far longer than the store bought was well. (You are avoiding the transport and storage time prior to purchase of ready-grown sprouts which is probably part of the reason for that.)Not to mention it's kinda fun to see em grow!Only negative I'd have for the seeds is the cost of shipping to Austin. I wish these were on the free shipping program from Amazon and I'd just buy enough to get the free shipping. But even so, it's a cost savings and a taste bonus that makes it well worth it!
Very fine alfalfa seed, very helpful and decent company.  They helped me greatly with an order I sent to a friend that she was unable to pick up.
I bought these Alfalfa sprouts for my grandmother who cannot get out to the organic grocery anymore. She loved them! Great product, would recommend company to anyone.
Good seeds. They grew fast and tasted great - fresh. Because they are growing in the kitchen, they are right there, ready to grab and add to many dishes.

column9: Exactly what I was looking for!!
column10: I love growing my own sprouts at home; you can't get them any fresher than that!  Highly recommended product, and the company has many great products for all sprouting needs.  Highly recommended.

Other alfalfa seed that I have had did not mold. This seed molds after the sprouts start to grow. It is okay, I will just have to get food grade peroxide because it happens with about every type of seed.
I love these seeds, they make tasty sprouts and can be grown with so much ease. I can have greens in Winter and without the toil of a garden.
I greatly appreciate the speed of delivery and quality of the alfalfa sprouts I purchased.  Excellent company!  I love growing sprouts!  Thank you!
I am no pro at growing alfalfa to really judge quality or otherwise, but at least I have plenty to experiment with and so far I am happy with the outcome.

column9: Seeds are good... shipping too much.
column10: Seeds are nice and tasty... However, shipping almost doubles the price.  Found a local organic seller of seeds and the price is much better.

column9: Printed paper in the middle of the organic seeds.
column10: Why would you want to buy seeds that are rubbing against a piece of colored printed paper that was obviously folded and inserted by someone. Organic seeds shouldn't have foreign substances in them period. Think about it. To tell you the truth they shouldn't even be in a plastic bag. Paper bags like the one's that Eden uses for their beans would be perfect. Plastic is nothing more than petroleum.

column9: Chestnut is too soft and doesn't taste roasted!
column10: Maybe it needs to be a little hot for it to taste like the real thing!  sigh! I'm stuck with 11 more bags lol.

ingredients: sugar,brown sugar,molasses,soy lecithin, salt, artificial flavors, fd&c yellow no. 5(e102) fd&c red 40(127), fd&c blue no. 1 (e133)it makes a brown very slightly sweet popcorn.  its ok.  clean up is easy even if you burn the sugar.

column9: A little too spicy for me, but still good
column10: I only use about 1/2 the packet of the powdered soup base and it almost makes me start to sweat. I will be getting some Knorr cubes to try and cut the spicy down a hair, but other than that, these are great!!Chunks of onion, what looks like lettuce (possibly seaweed), and some ther vegetables make these far superior to Maruchen in my opinion.When you are deployed to Afghanistan and the chow hall choices start to get a little old, these area a great alternative. I usually go to the chow hall and pick up a little meat to cut up and stick in these and if i can find other suitable vegetables; I'll toss a few chopped up in and it makes for a great little meal. Now if I could only get my hands on some fresh eggs to make an "egg drop" variation; that would be fantastic!
i ordered the soup because the food in the mess hall over here in Afghanistan is real badso i use some chicken and add it to the soup.

These noodles are easy to prepare, flavorful, and good at lunchtime - or any other time. I often use Tabasco to give the noodles a bit more kick, but they taste fine without it, too. I have no regrets about buying the pack of 12 bowls of soup.

column9: Not as good as the old Spicy
column10: Not as good as the old Spicy with the seafood, I had this on subscribe and save but received an email saying the product changed to Beef and Picante. I do not like the new packaging or the new flavor :(

column9: Nongshim Hot and Spicy Noodle Bowl, Beef and Picante, 3.03-Ounce (Pack of 12)
column10: Plain tasting and not spicy. Get the chicken flavor which is much tastier. Leave the Beef flavor one alone unless you plan to add some meat or additional seasoning to it.

column9: Not really that different from other cheap cup noodles...
column10: Nong Shim's noodle that you need to boil to eat, it's good. But these ones, the noodle's texture is totally different . It's the same as those cheap ramen noodle. The seasoning is not good either. I will never buy this kind anymore.

column9: Handy. Tasty. High On Sodium. Low On Protein.
column10: A few weeks ago I picked up a couple noodle bowls that I can keep in the pantry for occasional lunches or things like that. One was the Nongshim Bowl Noodle Soup Hot and Spicy (Beef Flavor). It's real easy to prepare and I just follow the simple instructions. I use the microwave method and it's ready in a matter of minutes, The flavor is good. It's spicy, but not overly so. Strangely, although it doesn't seem overly spicy to the taste, if I inhale the fumes it irritates my nasal passages somewhat. I have had to learn to eat it without inhaling. The sodium is high so I don't like to have things like this very often and I'm careful of sodium the remainder of the day. The protein content is too low for a complete meal, so I add a few protein items. Today, I added a couple pieces of beef jerky. All in all, I'd say it's one of the better beef-flavored bowls I can remember. It's good to have a few handy things like this around but I wouldn't want them to become a major part of my diet..Gary Peterson

None of the asian super markets around me sell the old style anymore. I am so damn sad. This new bowl it comes in doesn't hold back the heat and is very hot to touch. The flavor is so damn bad. Bring back the old regular hot and spicy picante please... PLEASEEEEEEEEEEEE.

I recently purchased three different Nong Shim noodle packs: their big kimshi bowl, ~2.6 oz shin bowl, and this beef and picante one.  This one tastes awful in comparison to the other products I mentioned above.The noodles themselves tasted very weak/strange and you can see little bubbles on them when you bring them up into the light.  I have a feeling it's because whatever they did was most definitely not how these noodles or the base were meant to be created.This is NOT a very spicy product compared to the other two and I felt kind of ripped off being that the main reason I bought this was because I wanted very spicy noodles as they were advertised as.Furthermore they leave an unsettling after taste that I only receive when I'm eating laboratory created sweeteners and things like that.  That being said I didn't have this aftertaste when eating the other bowls.I read all the reviews before I bought this product and urge you guys to try one of the other bowls.  This isn't just worse than the previous recipe they had for this bowl, but against all the other full msg bowls as well.Don't drink all the soup base if you want to reduce you sodium intake, eating this is just a disservice to you taste buds.I suggest the kimchi and shin bowls (kimshi being the best) they are both very very good, unlike this one.

I've tried many many ramen over the years and this is the BEST by miles! It's flavorful, fast and easy to make, good substitute if you are on a budget. If you have a local Asian supermarket in you neighborhood then you should drop by to check out the prices there. I am in Socal and I saw they had it on sale for $7/pack of 12, regular price for $9.
My husband loves these soup bowls for a quick lunch.  It's hard to find the spicy flavors in the store, so I was glad to find them here for a good price!

I love these noodles and convenient. Only reason i limited the noodles in my diet was MSG in those. This new version does not have MSG! People here say this new version is not as good as the previous version. I dont see a big difference.
The old seafood flavor of this had a much better taste.  While I like the new packaging and that it is quicker to prepare I still don't think I will buy this again
Pro tip:  Break an egg into the soup when it's still really hot and the noodles need a few more minutes of softening.  Adds a little protein to what is otherwise almost entirely fat and sodium, lol.

column9: Nong Shim Hot and Spicy Noodle Bowl
column10: I've eaten a lot of Ramen in my time as well as Cup-of-Soup and others. The one thing I did like about this product was that it was spicy - not overwhelmingly so, but just enough to give a nice little burn going down. Unfortunately, that was the only good thing about this product. The rest of it was bland and tasteless - no flavor, just spicy - and lots of sodium. They need to think about adding some flavor to the spiciness so that you want to buy it again. When they do, I'll try it again; until then, once is enough for me.

column9: Great but Goes Stale Really Fast
column10: This product is being sold as BULK.Therefore, it will go stale really fast, esp. because it was stored in warehouses for a long time. The expiration date for the Reese's Puffs is extremely short for cereal!Avoid.
I've never purchased cereal online before and wasn't sure the quality i'd be receiving. Everything was fine, fresh and not damaged.
I would purchase this product again.  My two sons 14 year old twins ate it in about 2 weeks.
Why is this cereal $16 a box??? Is there something I'm missing? I know prices have been rising, but not THIS much..

I like how thick this sauce is, it really sticks to the meat. I use primarily on chicken, but also like to make pulled pork if I have some leftover tenderloin and cook some cocktail wieners in it for parties.

column9: Buy the BIG one...you're gonna LOVE it!
column10: Sweet Baby Ray's Barbecue Sauce - 2/40oz This is one barbecue sauce that won't leave you wishing you'd put something else on your meat at the barbecue.  Sweet, yet tangy, this award-winning sauce is sure to win the taste test with your family.  My grandkids wouldn't touch the brand my daughter brought home from the store after finishing my bottle of Sweet Baby Ray's. So now our family's motto is "don't give me nothin' if you don't give me Baby Ray's"
This is some good sauce for chicken. It is a bit sweet for pork or beef, but it does have a bit of kick.

Having tried most of the commercially available BBQ sauces out there, this brand gets really high marks from me.  It is Kind of spicy, definitely tangy, and sweet all at the same time. It has a thicker consistency and really sticks to pork or chicken. I even like using it as a dip.  A tablespoon or two mixed with ranch dressing creates a spicy salad dressing that works well on salads. This really kicks it up  when eating BBQ.

I am from the midwest and my job transfer to me to the south. For the past few years I have always had this sweet baby ray. In my years of cooking the there no other barbecue i would use. My family and I look in each local store to find tiny small bottles that was way over priced. With our adventure to the south we are finding  out that amazon carry alot products we are use too. Again this is my baby ray saucue and would have it any other way....
Very good barbecue sauce, very tasty and at the same time nothing extra in it, so it just add very good flavor to the meat.
Received in a very timely manner thru Amazon.com.  This is one of my favorite rib sauces. Too much is just enough.

corn syrup flavored bbq sauce- I tried it from all the raved reviews and the award winning sticker on the bottle. Yuck- not for me I'm more of a salty gal.update- I added honey to it- and it's good I know I said it was sweet but this way is much better.

My daughter has liked all the earth's best foods that she has tried, and this is no exception. It isn't a favorite, but she likes it well enough and eats it without incident. It is rather runny so adding cereal is a must.

column9: So Runny I used a straw
column10: I love Earth's Best line but this one is an exception. It says it's for 3rd stage, but it's so runny that it's more like 1st stage, with the exception of carrot bits in it. It was so runny I used a straw. The taste isn't bad, but this is more like soup.
Skip this.  Your baby will not like the consistency.  However, it is useful to blend with other food instead of adding water to the blender.

column9: Best Candy Melt to work with in my experience
column10: I recently decided to jump on the bandwagon and give cake balls a whirl for a July 4th Party I was having. I had never even seen, much less heard of candy melts prior to this undertaking. Of course, where do I go first when looking for something? Amazon.com! Now...I live in Texas and it's H-O-T right now, so I was concerned about product "meltage" during shipping. I drove myself on over to Michael's and purchased a plethora of Wilton Candy Melts. Well, I couldn't help myself...based on the positive reviews of the Mercken's Candy coatings, I decided to go ahead and order some White (5 lbs)5 LBS. Merckens White Coatings and Blue (1 lb.) 1LB. Merckens Blue Coatings Candy Coating. To my surprise, both arrived without melting...shocker! A few days later, I ordered Yellow Mercken's (1 lb.) 1LB. Merckens Yellow Coatings and Paramount crystals Paramont Crystals, 1 lb.  , along with a couple other items. This shipment came and the candy melts had, well, melted! The Paramount Crystals were also a melted mess, but I figured since it was going to be liquified anyway...no harm no foul (or is it "fowl'?). I wasn't surprised by this...have you ever BEEN to Texas in late June? As my late Grandmother would say "It's as hot as Corn Liquor!" (not that she knew how hot that was, since she NEVER drank alcohol in her 94 years!) So, I will not remove a single star from my rating based on this product melting...after all, it is INTENDED to melt! ***take note those of you who remove stars based on issues irrelevant to the item itself, you know who you are, you're the people who rate a PRODUCT based things that don't speak to the product...such as shipping speed, poor customer service or other acts of God which have nothing to do with the actual worthiness of the product itself. Rant over.Okay...now that I got the "back-story" out of the way...the actual review! I set about making chocolate cake balls to make a r/w/b flag and some cheesecake balls, which were oh-so-yummy, but a big, fat, time-consuming pain, to put on a stick, coated and decorated with sprinkles. I also was going to be dipping pretzel rods and Oreos...a regular "dip-fest" as it were. Being one to experiment until I find the best/easiest method...I melted some white almond bark (I'd used almond bark in the past for white and choc dipped pretzels with good success), Wilton's Candy Melts, Ghirardelli White Chocolate (the bars for baking $$$$$), and finally the Mercken's Candy Melts. Of the 4, the Mercken's was the "winner" as far as ease of dipping, smooth consistency and taste. I hesitate to put taste in there, because it's so subjective and besides, they all tasted good to me. But, I do realize taste is an important consideration for most people. Really, the Ghirardelli had the best taste, but the cost and the difficulty in it "setting up" as nicely gave the edge to Mercken's for this project. The Mercken's did edge out the Wilton candy melts as far as MY taste buds go. Your mileage may vary. The Almond Bark was the least expensive, slightly more difficult to work with for this project, not real white, very yummy. Mercken's is available in many colors, is readily available (in Dallas), is less $ than Mercken's and certainly the Ghirardelli, but not quite a smooth and a tad more difficult to work with.Since this review is for the yellow coating, I wanted to mention you might consider purchasing a large quantity of the white candy coating, since it can be purchased in 5 lb. bags, and just use Candy Food Coloring Wilton Primary Candy Color Set to tint it to a shade you like.  Regular food coloring does not work...it must be specifically for candy.If you're particular, like I am, and the extra cost doesn't bother you, go with the Mercken's . If this is a project with and for the kiddos, the Wilton melts will be hunky dory. It's not that Mercken's are head and shoulders above Wilton's candy melts, just moderately so. Wilton's are certainly more widely available, cost less and come in more colors.Bottom line (for me) is that Mercken's was easiest to work with and that was/is the biggest factor in my preference. With the sprinkles and candy coating...all the desserts I was serving were so uber-RICH and sugary, I rightly figured the cake-pops and such wouldn't get eaten as much as they would be looked at for their decorating value and cuteness factor. My soiree hosted no kids...just a a house full of (thirsty) adults who were more focused on the offerings of adult beverages and jello shots than they were the desserts.***Note, I have pretty much the exact same review for the 1 lb. white, 1 lb. blue and 1 lb. yellow Mercken's Coatings, thanks to "Cut and Paste", to spare myself the trouble of re-writing the same review. Therefore, there is need to read my reviews for those items.

column9: Not a good substitute for Quaker Crunchy Corn Bran
column10: I am a fan of Quaker Crunchy Corn Bran and have been having trouble finding it in stores for the past few years, so I was overjoyed when I found this cereal on the shelf of my local HEB. It sure looks like exactly the same cereal!Well...it isn't. I just finished a bowl of the stuff, and while it's not _bad_, it's not great either. These corn bran puffs are not as well-milled as the Quaker version, and it shows: I've got bits of fibrous "roughage" stuck in my teeth. They also don't absorb milk very well, which is good if you hate it when your cereal gets at all soft, but is kind of bad if you actually like it to soften just slightly without getting soggy -- something the Quaker Corn Bran did very well. These Puffins are also not as sweet -- I mean, I don't like super-sweet cereal, but I thought the Quaker variety hit that balance just right. With these, by the time I was halfway through the bowl I regretted not having added a tiny sprinkling of sugar.So, on the whole, Barbara's Puffins (Original) aren't terrible. They are a decent cereal. They are just not a good substitute for Quaker Crunchy Corn Bran, is all -- so if that's what you are looking for, just go ahead and order the real thing online.
