I picked up a bottle of the Thick and Spicy at my local grocery store but boy was I surprised when I tasted it. It was great! It has the rich sweet taste you expect in a BBQ sauce (thanks to Splenda) and packs quite a punch. The thick and Spicy is definetly for people who are a fan of spicey hot BBQ sauces.I would definetly recommend this product to anyone who is following the low carb diet or is just watching your calories.I don't often rate things 5 stars, but for zero calories and high on flavor and kick this deserves it.

Yeah, yum.. If you like candied liquid smoke. I've never tried Walden Farm's before but the idea of 0 calorie, scratch that, *TRACE* calories and zero carbs. Wait, there's Splenda and it has half a carb per serving, plus tomato paste which also has carbs and other things on the ingredients that you can't de-carb.Anyways, I digress, the idea of very little calories and very little carbs sounded too good to be true and yep. I drizzled it onto a grilled chicken wrap and bit in. Oh my god. The first thing to hit was a overly sweetness and not a real one, the chemical kind, bletch. The next thing to hit was a smokey taste, and again, not a very good one. It was way too strong and chemical tasting.It ruined my wrap. I should have tasted it separately, but I thought for sure it couldn't be that bad, plus the taste of the Cajun seasonings on the chicken would help hide the taste. I was wrong. By the time I got to the end of the wrap where the liquid fool's gold had collected and bit through, it was way too much. I spit it out and threw the rest away. And all this from a small drizzle down the middle, after all, I was trying it.I couldn't imagine pouring this on something and grilling that nastiness into it.The other reviewers who gave it 5 stars. I don't know what they were thinking. Or maybe Walden Farm's changed the recipe but I didn't get spicy at all in this. It was a bottle of chemically candied chemical smoke flavor.Absolutely horrid. I'd advise staying away unless you like wasting money, not just on this bottle of septic tank juices, but anything it touches. I must now to gargle Listerine and brush.

I took one sampling of this barbecue sauce after opening the bottle and immediately threw it away.  The taste is really disgusting, nor is the consistency anywhere close to "thick."  Using this product with any type of meat (pork, chicken, beef, etc.) will absolutely ruin what you're eating.  I should have done a better job of reading the other reviews, since they are dead-on.  You can find a number of low-carb barbecue sauce recipes on the web - I'd try that instead of this product.

I am currently doing the HcG Diet and cannot have anything extra with calories, fat, or sugar.  This barbeque sauce is perfect!!!  I used it last night and WOW! It tastes so good!  It's not thick like traditional bbq sauce, but it is for dieters.  It's sweetened with Sucralose which is an HCG diet no-no, however I didn't stall.  It is tangy, sweet, and barbequey.  I couldn't ask for more.  I have tried Walden Farms Balsamic Vinagrette (which is good), the Honey Dijon (yuck), the Sesame Ginger (so-so), the Ranch (yuck), Peanut Spread (sweet, but not peanut butter tasting), and the Blueberry Jam (good) and I have to say that so far this is the best that they have to offer for dieters.  I don't understand the 1 stars people are leaving (they probably aren't really dieting!).  My coworkers who are also doing the HCG Diet along with me LOVE this bbq sauce, they almost stole my bottle.  I am ordering more now so I don't run out!!!
I've lost 17 lbs in 23 days eating steak, this delicious barbeque sauce and other Walden products.  I eat it still even when I'm not still dieting.

Yup it's calorie free and carb free and boy can you tell!!  I tried this twice, wanted to really like it but it was horrible.  I threw it out.  I guess if you want BBQ sauce that's really going to taste good, you'll have to take the calories and carbs.  It's too bad, but this stuff was awful.  Wasted my money.

Give Walden Farms credit for making a no-carb sauce. It's just a shame it doesn't taste better. Still, I do buy it on occasion and mix it with other tastier sauces to lower the over all carb content. However, the smoke taste is so overwhelming that more than a proportion of 1:4 leaves only the taste of this product in your mouth. This product cannot begin to compare with the taste of the now-defunct Kraft's low-carb barbecue sauce. Mostly, I make my own low-carb sauce from scratch and then just add a bit of this to get the smoke taste, but too much and even the best batch of homemade sauce is ruined. However, if you are on an extreme low-carb diet (such as Dr. Bernstein's) this may be the only product that fits.

When I purchased this sauce to aid in my Atkins diet, it was shown CLEARLY to be a 6 pack.  The title said it, the photo had one of those little text bubbles on it that said "6 pack" and the shipping weight was listed at like 5 pounds or something.  TITLE AS LISTED: "Walden Farms Sauce Barbecue Thick Calorie Free, 12-Ounce Bottles (Pack of 6)"One (1) bottle arrived, so I called the shipper who said the listing was wrong, and not their fault.  They said Amazon writes the listing (Lies) and to contact them.I called Amazon, they said no, they couldn't possibly be responsible for the misprint on the ad, as they sell millions oof products for tens of thousands of companies, and each company writes their own ads for their own products. (Truth) and that I should make every attempt to resolve the conflict with the seller.After several more "going nowhere" calls with the supplier, they said the only way they would do anything is to submit it for resolution with Amazon, and I'd probably get my money partially refunded.Amazon ended refunding all of my purchase price and shipping.I can't wait to never buy from All Star Health , ever, ever again.  I hope my review inspires you to look elsewhere as well. Bad, poor, lousy, unpleasant, untruthful customer service.By the way, the sauce is good, and I have since found it available in my local CUB Foods grocery store in their diabetic section.

You know, when they say it's sugar free, carb free, you tend to think it'll be taste free.  Being a diabetic, I was desparetly wanting some flavor on my chicken wings, and I thought I'd give this a try.  I was pleasantly surprised.  It tastes pretty good!  My only negative would be that its a little runny, but I can live with that.

column9: Need a bleach mouthwash after eating!
column10: It's not just THIS Walden Farms product, but every one I've tried. Syrups, marshmallow dip, Ketchup, Cocktail sauce.....!! You'd think after wasting so much money on them (not to mention the taste that leaves your mouth feeling like a chemical sewer!) I'd learn but kept hoping ONE item would be salvageable. No. They are so bad I almost considered gargling with bleach to erase the taste. There are no words for what these Walden products taste like: not any that can be printed on Amazon, at any rate. (shudder)

The other reviews of the Walden Farms BBQ Sauce made it sound like something you would scrape off the bottom of your shoe, wipe on your meat and promptly barf.  I, however was pleasantly surprised to find the Original Sauce to be very tasty.  The spice level was well balanced with the acidity and sweetness.  No chemical aftertaste of Splenda.  I am a foodie, but my doctor has me on a ridiculously low calorie diet for the next few months.  After the past three weeks, I was desperate for variety and this fit the bill perfectly!  Bare in mind, this is NOT regular barbeque sauce though.  It is thinner, but what would you expect from a no calorie, no carb sauce?  If you are needing variety in your menu, give this a try.  You might just find an unexpected delight!

This is by far the nastiest thing I have ever put in my mouth...My husband who will eat anything and I mean anything, even if he doesn't like it just so food doesn't go to waste, could not even stomach this. He told me to take it out of the fridge and just dump out the entire bottle.

column9: I tried it because of the ratings
column10: I tried this sauce with high hopes because so many people raved about it. All I can say is....YUCK! It tastes like ketchup with cinnamon. I was very disappointed and will never purchase this product again.

column4: Barely There "Never regret anything that made...
column9: Awesome. I like a sweet n hot BBQ sauce;  this is it!
column10: Could the sauce use a little help? Sure.  I added roasted onions.I roasted some chicken tenders on the George Foreman Grill , added some onion and grilled then...then served with a little of the Walden Farms Calorie free Thick N Spicy BBQ. tasty...and I licked the sauce with my fingers...(he he).This is not "thick". If you want THICK./..roast & then puree some onions, green pepper, garlic, and even lettuce in the blender...VOILA. That thickens "spagetti" sauce or whatever (if you are on the HCG diet).I bet a little of the sauce would make a nice marinade.IF you are NOT on the HCG diet..then try something with more calories.But if you want zero calories and like HOT Tangy & sweet..this Walden farms can't be beat.IT is fantastic for what it is...I downgraded to three stars due to their refund policy... and it is  just OK.UPDATE: KEEP YOUR RECEIPT.The product is guaranteed...but the process to get a refund is onerous (in my opinion)."I am sorry that you were not satisfied with our Mayo.  Please send a proof of purchase, a note with the expiration date of the product and an explanation as to why you were not satisfied to the address below and we will gladly refund your money.  Thank you and again, my apologies.Walden Farms1209 W St Georges AveLinden, NJ 07036"

I normally love Walden Farms foods, but this sauce is not at all what I expected. It has a very bitter, acidic taste to it. If you're looking for a substitute for sweet barbeque sauce, this is not it.

This sauce is gross!  I bought it knowing that it was a "diet" food, but didn't expect it to be that bad.  It didn't taste anything like BBQ sauce.  I can't even describe how awful it tasted or what it tastes like. Luckily I bought it at a local store, and didn't pay the higher rate on here or shipping.

I've tried three flavors now and like the honey the best. The thick and spicy is just that - great, but a bit too smoky and hot for me. Keep these coming, Walden Farms! Makes those bleak diet days a whole lot brighter!

column9: Good on calories, bad on taste
column10: Not recommended for those with taste buds.The only reason I'm giving it 2 stars is because it's 0 calorie - so it has every right to taste awful.Would never buy again. Please god don't ever let me buy again.

i love spicy and this BBQ sauce is definitely spicy. I cant believe its zero yup zero calories. Its mind blowing. We all pour on the sauces and the calories add up quickly but not with Walden farms. I love them.

I haven't purchased this item here, I get it at my local grocery, however, I love the stuff.  I do not use it as BBQ sauce though.  I agree with some of the comments stating that it is a bit thin, and not really BBQ flavored.  However, I do use this more as a condiment, instead of catchup or 57 sauce - for THAT purpose, with zero cal,carbs, etc...it is an awesome product! :D I also really enjoy the flavor.  But taste is completely individual.  It is def. worth a try if you are watching carbs or looking for easy places to cut a few calories from your diet. :)
My husband absolutely loves this sauce and we've already gone through 5 of the 6 bottles I've ordered - time to order again.
This is delicious! Tastes a bit like A1 steak sauce. I am a low carber & this is a godsend. I love Walden Farms, they help keep me skinny....AND satisfied.

column9: Welcome taste relief in my diet
column10: I am on a low carb and sugar diet, and needless to say I have been craving some of my old foods. My expectations were medium to low, but I am very surprised by this stuff, it helps me so much. Its a bit runny which sort of stinks, but the flavors are pretty good considering it has no calories and is made out of some suspect stuff. I season my protein more to kick up the flavor a bit more, but I enjoy it. Its not the best BBQ sauce ever but for not having calories it rocks. I like this the most of all the walden farms stuff I have tried. Look at a grocery store for a price cut; I got mine at Albersons.
its a little watery, but wow, it has tons of flavor. and a tad bit spicy. I'm on a cutting cycle and bought a bottle for Shiz and Gigs, and im thouroughly impressed. i just bought 3 more :)

I absolutely LOVE Walden Farms' salad dressings.  However, this product was not appetizing to me after the tasting it and it has a very unpleasant, lingering aftertaste.  I tried to doctor it up a bit so that the aftertaste wasn't so undesirable.  Nothing really worked.  Additionally, the smell is unappealing.

There is only so much grilled chicken with spices you can endure before you start losing your mind and your will to keep dieting. This sauce suprised me on its flavor. It was nice and smokey and sweet. It is thin, but, do you want that many chemicals in your food to make it thick? Great change of pace!

column9: Sugar Free Part is Okay, But the Recipe Isn't
column10: I buy sugar free products a lot, and it is hard to find sugar free barbecue sauce.  I held out hope for this, and indeed did use the whole bottle.  I hate to waste things, and I am generally very easy to please.  I won't buy another though because the stuff just doesn't taste like barbecue sauce.  In my opinion, it has nothing to do with the artificial sweeteners either.  Whatever they are doing with the rest of the recipe just isn't getting the job done.If you have NO other choices, maybe you could give it a try yourself.  I do see some others love it, so maybe you would, too.  However, if you have a choice, choose the other brand(s) first before bothering with this.
The barbeque Sauce Honey from Walden Farms has a great taste with no calories, no sugar.  Great product, I would recommend to anyone.

I don't like BBQ sauce that much, but my husband loves it. Our diet doesn't allow us to have the caloric stuff anymore so I thought I'd try this one out. It does have a strong hickory smoked flavor and smell to me, but my husband said it was quite good and wants me to order it by the case. If he had written the review it would have gotten 5 stars.
At first I thought it tasted ok.  But after a few bites, it began to taste chemically.  My husband doesn't like it either.
Yum! I love this stuff. Gives steak a sweet tangy kick without the carbs. It's not as thick as real BBQ sauce but it tastes just the same to me:)

I just bought this at Wal-Mart today. I put it on some nice pork I had cooked in my crock pot looking for that "shredded pork with bbq sauce" effect. It is thinner than your typical sugary sauce but that's nice because a little goes a long way. The flavor is smokey with an unexpected but nice maple flavor. I think I am going to try to add a little hot sauce next time. It's not exactly like a thick gloppy sugar laden sauce, but it does help the craving. I plan to buy it again.

column9: Walden Farms Thick and Spicy BBQ Sauce, Sugar Free, Calorie Free, Fat Free, Carb Free, 12 oz.
column10: Unfortunately I do not have much to say the product never made it to me. And I never got a refund so I am out the money and I have no clue what it taste like. Very sad would have loved to try it. I can not get a hold of anyone to get this resolved. Do not order this you might get your money stolen.

I ordered this for my husband who is in Afghanistan.  I was contacted by the seller right away that my order would arrive much more quickly than promised, and sure enough he got it in about 1 week!  He enjoyed the contents and I would definitely recommend this!

====================HERMIT REVIEW====================As a professional sweet tooth, cookie connoisseur, and general baked-goods aficionado I can wholeheartedly recommend the Cinnamon Hermit.I tried my first one a few months ago and have been hooked ever since. I was strolling through the grocery store looking for something new when the Hermits caught my eye. (They look like something my grandmother used to make.) I normally don't buy organic cookies, and these seemed a little pricey (almost $5) - so this was a total impulse buy. But I'm glad I gave them a try. Within a week these replaced my nightly bowl of frozen yogurt (which is a net tradeoff/savings of more than 150 calories.)Hermits have a very unique taste, so it's hard to compare them with something else. But the main characteristics are:1. OUTER COMPOSITION: soft, slightly moist texture juxtaposed by a light coating of crunchy granular sugar2. INNER COMPOSITION: dense, almost chewy consistency and a generous amount of plump, sweet, ripe raisins3. DOMINANT FLAVORS: dark molasses; cinnamonAnd like so many other foods from the Newman's Own brand, the Hermit also has a fantastic "harmony of ingredients." When you bite into one, you just feel like you're eating an American classic.====================AMAZON PRODUCT REVIEW====================In addition to all the great taste qualities mentioned above, this particular Amazon.com product (the 6-pack) has the absolute lowest *price-per-cookie* that I've been able to find anywhere. Single packages at grocery stores run between $4.75-$5.95. But at $21.60 (+ free shipping) this 6-pack comes out to $3.60 per package. (Or $3.06 if you do the "Subscribe & save" thing, which I did.) So it's a no-brainer.But try them out first; grab a single package next time you're at the store. Just make sure you get the Cinnamon kind. I haven't tried the other two yet (Original and Ginger), so this review is specific to the Cinnamon Hermits.

column9: Love Hermits, but these were dried out!
column10: I love these Newman's hermits. They are like fig newtons but way better and more indulgent, at 80 calories per piece. This variation is delicious.Problem is, I ordered 6 packages of these cookies from Amazon and they are way more dried out than the ones I bought at the store locally. I suspect they have spent too much time in a warehouse.I want to buy as many groceries as I can from Amazon, but this huge difference in quality between supermarket and Amazon makes it harder to do so.I recommend heating them up in a microwave oven for 5-8 seconds to restore their moisture, right before you eat them.

This was my first time trying a hermit cookie and my first Newman's Own cookie.  We really like them.  It is a rectangular shape, a bit bigger than a Fig Newton.  It's a softer cookie and held together with each bite.  Inside the soft cookie are bits of raisins.  All I could think of with each bite is how awesome it would be with a 'Christmas spice' added to it.  I just found the Ginger Hermits and ordered those, I think they will be just as good.  I can only liken the taste to a soft, oatmeal-type cookie but without the oatmeal.  I've never had a cookie like this so it's hard to explain for me.  I would order them again and I don't eat a lot of cookies...they are that good.A thought: you could put a white icing glaze on top and some sprinkles to dress them up for a holiday occasion - people wouldn't know you didn't bake them yourself.

Although I love tea (being English), I have always avoided herbal or floral ones. Something about the description for Hibiscus tea enthralled me.  The package came beautifully wrapped (with a re-sealable bag to keep it fresh)!  Anyway the most important thing is the taste...which is delightful hot or cold.  Nice and fruity and not too sweet.  LUV it!!!

This is the only hibiscus tea I've ever had so I don't have anything to compare it to.  I don't really care about the taste, I drink it to lower my blood pressure.  It does a great job. Systolic and diastolic are both down 10 to 15 mm/Hg.  I drink it 2 to 3 times each day.

I love this tea. It has a light, fruity and sweet taste that doesn't need a lot of sugar to taste great. Makes fantastic iced tea. I take it to the gym to drink after my workout. Very refreshing. Not to mention the price is far less expensive than buying smaller quantities.

I love the flavor! Also, I reallty apreaciate the careful packaging, the resealable plastic bag to keep al the little tea bag shows their attention to detail and ho wmuch they want to please their customers. Will order again.

I first tried this tea in Mexico whose locals swear by the healthful qualities of Hibiscus tea.  Having researched the internet for the best options, I came across the Davidsons site. I could not be happier. The shipping was prompt, the packaging very nice and the product for the price was excellent. Best of all, the taste, so refreshing, so clean.
Rich flavor, deep red in color and very pleasant taste.  According to Dr. Oz this tea will lower your blood pressure is drank twice a day.
Showed up on time, product was as stated. Had a great taste with very little sugar needed. Have not used it long enough to see if blood pressure is down. But I will be ordering again.
Tea was well packaged and it arrived promptly. The flavor of the Hibiscus tea was delicious whether hot or iced.
If you like hibiscus tea or you just want to try it then you should look at this one. The quality and the price are both good, and with free shipping you can't go far wrong.

We purchased this tea from Amazon and received it fast and the pricing was good.This item brews a quick cup of tea and you can quickly make it from weak to very strong depending on your taste. My wife said it tastes like medicine, but we both drink it for our health.R.E.H.

I'm a big hot tea drinker and am always looking for new kinds to try. I had high hopes for this tea, but just couldn't stomach it. Of course, I have no other Hibiscus tea to compare it to.I guess it just wasn't my cup of tea :-)
These are 100% natural  which makes them an excellent choice for all breeds. This is nice for dogs with allergies.  A great value

column9: The only biscuit my dog will eat
column10: I have the world's pickiest dog. (Well, judging among dogs who've been raised on dry food and not, say, fresh shrimp.) He's turned his nose up at dog biscuits since puppyhood, but I've never given up. Earlier this year, I found these on sale at a local store (that, alas, carries them no longer) and picked up a bag on a whim for my now nine-year-old fellow to try. Voila: the magic dog biscuit. Since then I have also tried him on Newman's Own Organics Chicken Treats for Dogs, and he will happily devour them both, though he seems to have a slight preference for the peanut butter. I don't know what it is about these that he finds particularly enticing or tasty, but I'm glad to have finally found something he enjoys.

column9: Excellent, healthy treats that are much loved by my dog!
column10: Our dog is hardly a "picky eater"....but he does show a marked preference for these organic peanut butter treats and they are difficult to find in our community.  We are delighted to be able to get them for him from Amazon....and at a much better price than that which we were formerly paying!

column9: Great Treats, but they arrive broken (what a waste)
column10: My dogs are addicted to these treats.  I often give them after doing unpleasant things to my dogs (nail clipping, ear wash, etc)... and they're so crazy about the treats that they actually ask to be clipped so they can get one.On the down side, my last two orders of these have arrived pretty pulverized, and I'm running out of patience (with no one to complain to except you. Sorry about that part.)

column9: My puppy loves these natural treats
column10: I always liked the brand Newman's Own for "people food", so when I realized they also made dog food/treats with healthy ingredients I was excited to try it for my 6 mos old puppy. I decided to purchase the treats first (haven't branched out further just yet) and am thrilled to report that he enjoys these so much! I will definitely continue to purchase this brand for him.

I feed my two dogs organic food, so it makes sense to serve them organic snacks. My dogs love these heart shaped, peanut butter biscuits.  I want to give my cherished pets only the best and hope they live a long life; therefore Newman's Own Dog Treats provides them with their nightly snack.  For smaller dogs, these biscuits can easily be broken in half.

Having purchased several brands of dog treats for an English Bulldog puppy, we settled on Newman's Organic Treats.  Excellent size, easy to halve and above all the puppy likes them!  Will continue purchasing thses treats made in Canada until Orijen (Champion) releases a treat late 2011.  Highly recommended.
My english bulldogs love these cookies. They are soft and they look forward to them each day! Great price!!

I received these the other day and was very impressed with how they looked and how easy they were to break.  Unfortunately, "Joey" wasn't.  He ate them, but they made him sick and he only had maybe 1 1/2 of them over a 24 hour period because I was continuing his other treats to make a smooth transition.  I then ordered and tried the turkey and sweet potato formula and had the same reaction.  Maybe it is just too rich for him.  I wanted so badly for these to work for him too!  As usual, Amazon was ready to help me.  I don't think you can go wrong ordering from Amazon because of their superb customer service and products.

column9: Great for dogs with sensitive tummies
column10: I have a rat terrier with a very sensitive stomach; this treat doesn't upset him and he loves them!  Highly recommended.
My dog likes them. I haven't gone so far as to taste one but I have sniffed and can smell the peanut butter. I also like the size, not too big and not too small.

column9: Another way to support Newman's Own!
column10: Our dog loves the treats, plus we feel good about the product and where the money goes.

My picky little hound couldn't care less for these... she takes one sniff and puts her nose in the air.... I was hoping she would take to these, since she really loves peanut butter.... alas.My other hound - who eats absolutely anything - likes them just fine.
My Eskies loves these.I love anything from Newman's Own®Organics Dog Treats for Small Size Dogs, Peanut Butter, 10-Ounce Bags (Pack of 6)the Newman's line
I am very pleased with this product I purchased. My dogs love these treats and I feel good knowing I am giving them something that is good for them.

My dog has a liver problem and for 3 years I have been cooking special food for her.  I wouldn't dream of ever giving her either commerial canned or  dry food again, even from the vet.  But I do trust the Paul Newman products and these cookies have not caused any problems for my dog - she loves them. And I love them because I love her so much and I want to give her treats with no additives that are dangerous for many dogs,not just those on special diets.  I wish I knew when our dog adopted us what I know now.  If I had been feeding her as I am now she probably would never have developed this liver problem.

We ordered these cookies for a "Down on the farm" birthday party and they were a huge hit! The children loved them. They were shipped promptly and arived without one broken cookie...would order again!

Our puppy got one of these just as we were leaving the house as a change from his stuffed Kong.  They kept him busy so he wouldn't fall apart about being alone and were one of the cheapest alternatives to the Kong.  No digestive problems, no chunks to worry about like you would get with rawhide.  And no smell.If they lasted longer than ten minutes, they'd be perfect.

These are so nice and natural without any smell.. My dogs never choke on these.  They go crazy for them.  They won't leave any stains anywhere either.  We even have 2 kittens that like to take them to their room and torture our dogs!!  They are really a nice treat for your dogs....My small dog usually finishes one in 30-45 minutes.

column9: Dogs like it but dont expect it to act like a chew
column10: My dogs certainly liked it, but dont buy it as a chew at all. My guys had eaten their pieces within 2 minutes or less.

column9: Made in the USA.  Or at Least Some of Them Are
column10: My two pups, a small (15 pound) JRT-mix and mid-sized, 25-pound Poodle, both liked these chews.  They are fluffy (puffed actually) and easily chewed, which is both good and bad from a human perspective.  The good part is that a wide range of dog sizes should be able to enjoy them, and bad because they don't last all that long. Depending on your pup's mood, just a few minutes.So Summary Time:THE GOOD--liked by both of my dogs--I think even very small dogs, who might not be able to deal with Bully Sticks, might enjoy these--very little smell--not messyTHE BAD--don't last long--sort of expensive, given that they don't last longOTHER POINTS--The Lambs' ears I purchased at the grocery store were made in the USA.  This, of course, is because many people -- us included-- wouldn't think of buying a food product, even for our pets, from China because of their lack of regulation and low standards.However I think this is a recent change, and I don't know how any of us are going to be able to tell if Amazon has the 'good stuff' or older stock that was made in China.Recommended with caveat.Pam T~mom and fur-mom

My dog loves these, and he is an 11 year old corgi shelti mutt.  He likes the puffed base of the ear part the best and leaves the very ear tips behind. They are usually about 5" long by 2.5" wide.  They don't smell bad and are small enough for him to eat as a snack in one sitting.  He could probably be done with one in 30 minutes (leaving the ear tips),so this is a treat, not something that will keep him busy the whole evening.

Bought these for a change of pace for our 10-year old German Shepherd with aging teeth.  He loves them, but in spite of his worn teeth, he can finish one of these in about 1-2 minutes--tops!  They are rather small and of a puffed, crunchy texture.  Easy to chew, but don't last long.  So far, no stomach/allergy issues from these.  Don't leave stains and not much of a smell.  Rather expensive.  Wish they came bulk for a much cheaper price.  Would buy again, if the price is better.

column9: Great for dogs with sensitive stomachs
column10: I must say these are the best puffed lamb ears we've tried and my dog who normally has a very sensitive stomach can eat as many as she wants and never gets ill from them. They are crunchy and fun and smell good too; all the things a dog likes in a treat. We buy them all the time.
my dog loves theseits the only raw hide type product that doesn't give him diarrheaand they don't have a nasty smell

I think my dogs jaw line never fully fused together in the front so I can see it flex when he's chewing on hard bones. Since I can't afford to put him through surgery I did some research on what people give older dogs with dental issues and these lamb ears were mentioned several times. My little guy loves them and it takes about two days for him to eat the whole thing. I can see the ears soften up as he's slobbering on them and that gives me a little peace of mind knowing he's not putting excess pressure on his jaw like other bones did.

Our dog loves lamb dog food so I thought this would be her favorite treat.  However, it tends to get a little stringy and chewy and she was choking on it.  So we aren't using them any more.  I'm sure they would be fine for a larger dog (ours is 13 pounds).
My dog loves this crunchy treat. It is like a chew treat so it lasts longer.

My husband I recently ate at an outside cafe in Geneva, IL.  It was late afternoon so we just wanted something light to eat with a glass of wine.  We ordered a cheese plate that include a choice of three cheese.  One of the choices on the menu was a blue cheese listed as "Pointed Reyes Original Farmstead Blue".  It was exceptionally good completly outshining the sharp cheedar and the mild Wisconsin Gouda. So much so that I asked to take a copy of the menu home so I could order the cheese on the internet.  Not as easy as I thought, but I did find it on Amazon and ordered it, after I corrected the spelling to "Point" Reyes rather than "Pointed" Reyes Blue Cheese. column9: Healthy Alternative to Kibble, Canned or Raw Diets
column10: Actually, Sojo's strongly recommends that the meat you add to their mixes be raw, but it an be cooked as I choose to do.  My dog arrived with coccidia and giardia as a puppy. Part of his treatment has been a homemade diet of Sojo's and meat plus no medications.  I'm extremely pleased to report he has had no GI episodes in over 6 months and has reached a point where I consider him healthy.  His coat is glossy and much fluffier than before he's finally at a good weight.  I have before and after photos that show a dramatic improvement,much of which I credit to Sojo's.It does take some extra time to prepare as opposed to kibble, but I make 4 days worth at a time. To be completely honest, I'm not thrilled about cooking for my dog but I am thrilled with the results. The bag of Sojos was almost one year old and there was no way Amazon kept track of that.  I got a refund from Amazon with no question and very quickly, but Amazon needs to keep control of the "use-by" dates of food they offer on their site.

I have a now 8 month old male Shih Tzu.  When I brought him home from the breeder, I kept him on the 'Pro Plan Puppy' tiny dry kibble until the bag was almost finished.  There was about 2 cups left in the bag and he began walking away from his bowl as soon as I put it down.  As a test, I rolled a few morsels across the tile floor in the kitchen to see what would happen...he'd eat about 10 pieces and go bring me one of his squeaker toys to play with. (Which I was happy with, as I don't want to 'play' with his food as a game to get him to eat).  I went and got him Blue Buffalo dry puppy food (lamb and oatmeal formula), which had bigger size kibbles.  It seemed that he liked the bigger sized items to chew on and the harder antioxidant bits, since he was teething and chewing on his dentabones, venison antler, lamb lung chips for comfort.  Again when I got down to about a quarter of food left in the bag, he would walk away from the bowl---this went on for almost 3 days.  He was still having small bowel movements, urinating, drinking water and playing, running and continuing his successful training exercises; called the vet and they wanted to give me wet venison formula by Science Diet/Veterinarian's Diet after the exam, which showed nothing physically wrong.  The one vet tech said that Shih Tzu's tend to be picky eaters.  I didn't pick up the food at their check out counter, left and began some of my own research into the breed itself and a more natural diet.  I know from some of our outdoor excursions that he's attracted to road kill (he'll sniff the air, and want to lunge for it and would probably eat it if left to his own devices...but I won't allow it).  I remember being a kid in the late 60's early 70's and all my friends who had dogs fed them 1 of 2 choices available back then: Gravy Train or Alpo and they mixed meat or the drippings from the meat; they ate bones, etc and all lived into their late teens.  One of my friends small mutt lived to be 24 years old!!!  I never saw these dogs itching or digging at themselves other than the usual ears or if their was a flea problem, since I grew up in a rural area and most often that was a common occurrance.  Well, I read up on the more natural diets and decided to get the Sojos and ground beef and some boneless chicken thighs/breasts.  My Weston isn't a big fan of totally raw meat, but when browned (I put it in the toaster oven and add 1/4 tsp of 'Missing Link' to the meat portion) with the soaked Sojos Original, he eats with gusto!!!  From his early days, I would play with and take his food away, so he's not food aggressive.  He eats the recommended portion for his size and walks away when done.  Weston then wants to play hard, train hard, take a nice walk and nap.  His coat is soft and easy to keep brushed and groomed.  The droppings are nice sized and easy to clean up.  I just had him neutered 2 days ago and he ate this Sojos mix with the same gusto (even with the e-collar to challenge him).  So I am a fan and we are finished with the second 2.5 lb bag and I just ordered another one.  Hope this helps someone with a picky eater; I know another reviewer mentioned their Shih Tzu not liking it, but this shows you that dogs have certain tastes different from each other, much like us humans.

column9: I wouldn't buy any dog food made by Diamond (chicken soup is only one of many)
column10: Let me preface this by saying I LOVE AMAZON. They are an amazing company and I will always shop online with them.I had been feeding my older dogs Chicken Soup for the Dog Lover's Soul (Senior) for about a year. And about two weeks before the "voluntary" recall came out in April of 2012, my dogs were both extremely violently ill (vomiting, diarreah and no appetite that lasted a week - until I got them help). Both had to be seen by the vet and both were perscribed antibiotics. Shortly after these bouts of illness I learned about the salmonella tainted food in the South Carolina plant. Diamond Dog Food (the manufacturer of many foods including Chicken Soup for the Dog Lover's Soul) had denied that any dogs were sickened by this food but I am 2000% positive that they were. They said they would not accept responsibility unless I could prove it. But I couldn't because I didn't save any of their poop to have it tested (my vet's assessment was not enough for them to accept responsibility.) Also be aware that they were also involved in a recall back in 2005 (I think that's the year) that killed several dogs due to their neglegence. So this isn't the first time Diamond has harmed dogs. I personally will not forgive what they did to my dogs and to me. I also know that my dogs were not the only dogs sickened. They currently have a class action lawsuit against them for sickening HUMANS, but sadly there are no attorneys willing to represent animals in this matter.What I find even sneakier on the part of Diamond was the timing of their recall. column9: High fiber isn't necessarily a good thing!
column10: I recently cut fiber one bars out of my diet after I noticed that I get all the fiber I need in a day just by eating whole wheat bread, fruits, vegetables and nuts. If you don't have many of the aforementioned foods in your daily diet, then one or two of these a day may be a good fiber supplement. However, this comes at the cost of making you extremely gassy all through the day, which can be embarrassing and sometimes even annoying when it's more frequent than the occasional toot that slips out. IMHO, it's better to get the daily dietary fiber your body needs via the more natural means that I mentioned above.Another thing to keep in mind, especially when dieting, is that these bars are pretty high in sugar. (As much as 10g added sugar per bar!) Considering a "healthy" amount of added sugar per day maxes out at about 40-50g per day, eating a few of these bars will chew right through that cap in no time. There's also emerging research showing that eating high-sugar foods (like fiber one bars) will make you crave more sweets, leading you to eat or drink even more unhealthy things like candy bars and sodas. So if you're on a diet, eating these bars probably aren't as great for your diet as you think!I've been fiber one free for two weeks now and I'm happy for the decision. (And so are my friends!)

One day while grocery shopping, I saw Fiber One and Kellogg's fiber bars, tried them and put myself on a three-a-day ration.  Actually, I'm doing this more for medicinal purposes than for taste.  I do like the bars, however, and they're a great replacement for dessert and/or sweet tooth. Now I'm ordering different flavors every three months in bulk (it's cheaper).  It took my body about six weeks to become accustomed to the increased fiber, but well worth it.  The bars do produce a lot of intestinal gas, so one needs to start introducing the added fiber slowly and then try to maintain a goal of 30 grams a day.

column10: I have searched many different sites for this brand and Amazon was the only one that offers free shipping. Wellness is more expensive (and healthier) than store brands, so to get free shipping is a huge plus. I purchase this item all the time now online.

The only problem I have with these is the price.  I agree with the person who said they are like Fruit Roll-Ups.  The seeds are slightly crunchy in these, but they have no taste.  I will continue to buy these occasionally, as a treat and as a break from the way I take my chia seeds.
These FruitChia bars are delicious & nutritious! We have ordered them a few times, and share them with friends. They like them as well.
Don't get taken in by the picture they show where it advertises that you get an entire package of many bars BUT you only get ONE small bar. Shame on me but SHAME on you for showing false advertising.

column9: Read The Title, don't look at the picture
column10: So I purchased this thinking it was gum, looking at the picture you might think so too, however upon close reading of the title, it does indeed say it's a fruit and seed BAR. So oops at me, but either way on to an actual review of this. It's not tooo bad, it has that "health food taste" if you bite it, but if you just like lick at it, it kinda taste the same as if you were to take a fruit roll up and just shove the whole thing in your mouth then just lick at it. Though once you bite it, it kinda has a "prune mixed with other dried fruit" taste, though what could you really expect, the ingredients are:Apple Puree, Apple Concentrate, Strawberry Concentrate, and Chia Seedsso eh, it's alright for being a natural bar thingy, however i wouldn't have paid 2 bucks for it if i'd known what it was.
This tea had a horrible taste so I threw it out in the trash.  Thank heavens I found another ginger tea here on Amazon which is truly a wonderful ginger tea.

This ginger tea is amazing! You can see that the tea is made of small chunks of ginger. I started by boiling ginger root to make tea to try and settle my baby's tummy while breastfeeding and this tea is the perfect alternative. It is fragrant and potent, I will buy it again! This seller was very fast to get the tea to me, I have other Triple Leaf Teas I plan on buying from them as well!
True REAL ginger tea...fabulous!  My Acupuncturist turned me on to this tea and I love it.  It is real ginger...

This is a high-quality product, and I agree with the first reviewer:  it would cost as much, if not more, to make this yourself from the same oils from retail bottles and jars. I've been making my own mayonnaise for years and while homemade is my favourite; with the price of top-quality, extra virgin olive oil right now, it just doesn't make any sense. And I'd hate to compromise with a lesser oil.This mayo is tasty as is and also takes very well to additions of lemon juice, minced garlic, dill, tarragon, and capers; as well as pureed roasted peppers, garlic, sea salt and cayenne pepper. I even use it for spicy tuna hand rolls:  mix finely chopped, sashimi-grade fresh tuna with some of this mayo, a bit of Nama Shoyu, Umeboshi plum vinegar, hot pepper toasted sesame oil and minced hot red chiles and scallions to taste. Now I'm all hungry.This is a great staple to have on hand, and will adapt to whatever you throw at it. Best of all, you can feel peaceful about eating the health-promoting fats in this mayo and avoiding the soy, canola, chemically treated salt and preservatives in the other brands out there.

I know you are thinking $10 for mayo!!!It is crazy ,but the mayo is soooo good and made with the best fats around. I am a low carber so I eat alot of mayo so I need it be quality. It would cost about the same to make it homemade, if you bought the ingredients used in this mayo individually. Give it a try it won't dissapoint.

Wilderness Family Naturals offers many delicious products.Life's too short to ruin your body with junky/trans/soy/canola....stepped-on, over-processed and extensively GMO'd.Their mayo is the best I've EVER tasted. The fats are all high-caliber.Yes, pricy, BUT look at what you are getting. Balanced fats formulated with Mary Enig in mind. If you don't know who she is, get educated about good fats, then buy this and taste a great mayo.

I'm surprised there aren't a thousand reviews on this product which symbolizes full bodied, fueling flavor. It does have a quality collection of deserved praise, and a well earned, excellent sales rank.This product's information and ingredients disclosures are refreshingly clear, reading like a gourmet ad for rapture in texture and taste.The reality of receiving and using this mayo goes well beyond reflecting the truth in every word in its description.My beloved mayo was the first food I noticed, with grieving horror, which had been altered in the marketplace, in the name of heart "health."  When I realized what the change was truly in the name of, I didn't want to hold that sick awareness in my mind. Read THE DARK SIDE OF CINDERELLA by doctors Mary Enig and Sally Fallon, if you want a clue.The disappointed had gone to soul level, which I felt when seeing the oil switch in ingredients lists of nearly every mayo-type condiment stocked on supermarket shelves.The joy felt was absolute, when I discovered and experienced this family's courage to provide an alternate choice of a heavenly recipe.Sometimes what is done in the name of "health and public safety" has to be undone in the name of reality and sanity.Bless those who return dark machinations to right, light, and yum.I can't count the number of favorite food preparations I began to discontinue when I discovered that mayo had been brought away from its original healthy [IMO] recipe by the soybean push. Now I don't need a cosmic level calculator. I can return to the healthy spice of life in full measure... at least in uses of my beloved mayo.Thank you Amazon and Wilderness Family,Linda Shelnutt
I like this stuff but I wouldn't buy it all the time.  To much money.  I would recommend it since it seems like good quality
I really wanted to like this, but I just can't.  I've gone back to making my own from a mix of coconut oil and olive oil or buying Hain's safflower mayo at my grocery.

column9: Crystal Light On The Go White Grape, 10-Count Boxes (Pack of 4) (Purchased on 09/06/2011)
column10: I received what I purchased from this vender expeditiously and in great shape.  It actually came within a matter of days. Thanks for offering.

column9: Why can't I get this anymore???
column10: Love this stuff (especially in the canisters) but it's getting almost impossible to find anywhere.  This is the ONLY Crystal Lite I buy because the flavor isn't overwhelming and doesn't stain if you spill it.

I USED TO FIND IT IN THE STORES BUT THEY STOPPED CARRYING THE WHITE GRAPE. I THINK THIS TASTES THE BEST OF ALL CRYSTAL LIGHT PRODUCTS. NOT TOO SWEET BUT STILL FULL OF FLAVOR. ANOTHER PLUS, NOT A LOT OF ARTIFICIAL COLORING.
I love this product but it is almost impossible to get it. I was thrilled when I found it here. Thanks for the fast service.
The item came as described and rather quickly, which I was pleased with. Can't complain about this purchase at all.

The FedEx truck just dropped off my shipment about 10min ago. I couldn't help myself but open up the Cookies & Cream pint right away.The first thing I noticed was the top was REALLY hard to open. I had to almost rip it to get it opened. Actually I did rip one side of the cover.The second thing I noticed was the color, it looks like a light colored black bean mush. Yeah, I know weird right?But I mustered on.Picked up my spoon and tried to dig in. And tried and tried ... nope, the spoon only made a teeny tiny dent. So I nuked it for about 15secs. Finally I was able to get a taste.Hmmm... can't really figure out what the taste actually is. Really, I'm not joking. It definitely does not taste like C&C. Don't get me wrong, it's not horrible or extremely unpleasant but definitely NOT C&C. It also has an after taste. I wish I could pinpoint what it tastes like but I really can't. Sorry.Then the last thing I noticed was after I nuked it for 15 sec, the melty product was a bit stringy. Rather strange.I'm disappointed in the C&C flavor.  I haven't given up on this product line yet because:1. It has 32% of your fiber in the whole pint.2. On a bad day with the kids, I can see wanting to eat a whole pint of ice cream by myself and this might just save me from that.3. You'll work off the calories you eat just by scooping the frozen "ice cream" from the container... :DOn to the Strawberry.I finally had a chance to try it after it sits in our freezer for a couple days. I found that I had to let it sit on the counter for awhile again before I could scoop it out.The taste is a little bit better than the C&C. It has a tiny bit of the strawberry taste but definitely not like strawberry ice cream in any way or form.It's more the consistency of a sorbet than ice cream.I probably will try the other flavors to see if there is one that I could strongly recommend. However, if these are the only 2 flavors available I really wouldn't recommend it to anyone based on the taste and cost.
I love this ice cream so creamy my kids love it also they don't even know its good for them.

I had not tried the strawberry yet and it is great.  The cookies and cream is one of my favorite flavors!  Yum!  I like this product after it has softened up a little.  It is great to just eat out of the pint, indulgent! :)

While the taste of these cookies is spot on and worth the price, the structure of these cookies does not serve them well for travel.  Each of the four boxes of my cookies were in pieces.  Not even one cookie was whole out of the four packages.  Buyer beware if you are planning to give any of the boxes as gifts, which I had planned on doing.

Walkers shortbread thins are a favorite at my house but hard to find. I was thrilled to find them on Amazon even though the price was more than a retail store. But the shipping was free in this case so I bought them. The cookies arrived bundled in a set of 4 boxes as expected. However, every cookie in each box was broken. This does not change the quality taste of these cookies (butter, lemon and raspberry choices) but it definitely limits serving options. I will not likely serve broken cookies at a party or special occasion. I was very disappointed that all the cookies were broken, none were intact. I will be highly hesitant to buy them through Amazon again.

Yummy cookies.  Since they are subscribe and save, they arrive at my door every couple of months and are a nice surprise.  Only problem is that many cookies are broken.  Broken cookies are fine for me . . . taste really good anyway, but wouldn't want to serve them to the tea group!  Hu-m-m-m . . . more for me?

I bought this product at Cost Plus World Market, so I can not comment on how they survive shipping. However, the ones we bought were not broken. They were in perfect cookie shapes! I can not comment enough on how wonderful the crystallized lemon zest is in this cookie. I love lemon flavored cakes, cookies, etc...and these exceeded my expectations. Soft vanilla, lemon flavor--almost like a nice lemon pound cake--mixed with the buttery-ness of shortbread and bits of sweet chewy lemon zest! Absolutely not bitter, sour, or harsh. We also got the walker's stem-ginger shortbread (crystallized ginger pieces)! Perfection! I highly recommend both for fans of good quality, Scottish, shortbread cookies.

column9: Walkers is the leader in shortbread
column10: I  wish I could bake shortbread as tender and good as Walkers! Then I wouldn't  purchase so much Walkers for Mom. I purchased these as a Mother's Day gift. Mom decided she prefers the original Walkers so I reordered.When she received the plain ones, she appreciated the individual paks, especially during the summer.It is breakfast with tea for her (without baking in this heatwave!)The lemon cookies are good though with lemon peel in them. Mom is a purist  who likes plain shortbread.....so I guessed wrong...oh, well.

DON'T BUY  Walkers Shortbread Lemon Thins, 4.2-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 4)March 23 2012Walkers lemon thins should never be shipped. They arrived in nothing but broken pieces and where is the lemon taste????? I feel like I threw my money away. Never again.

column9: Delicious tart, thin cookies arrived broken
column10: Walkers Shortbread Lemon Thins, 4.2-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 4) are outrageously delicious thin shortbread cookies, but when ordered in this manner, many were broken.  That doesn't detract from the taste, but it definitely is not great when you need each cookie to be intact for presentation purposes.  It makes for a more expensive desert because more boxes are needed.  On the plus, you can eat the broken bits and they are still delicious!  I recently baked lemon butter cookies which everyone thought were fabulous, but the Walkers thins are more tart and the larger shreds of lemon zest put mine to shame.  I will use this discovery to increase the grated size of lemon peel in my next batch of lemon butter cookies, but will not be baking them for some time because we will be enjoying the Walkers cookie pieces instead.  (Had to go to the store to buy more!)  The whole shortbread is attractive and tasty, so I'll be continue to purchase them in local markets now.  The general consensus around here is that they are even better than the other Walkers Shortbread cookies we've tasted, because the tartness and texture of the lemon zest takes the shortbread to the next level.  Because the others are thicker and less delicate, we'll continue ordering them from Amazon.  These thins are a definite winning treat to dunk in a cup of tea or include with a frozen desert.  Highly recommend these packaged cookies.

The cookies are excellent -  the manufacturer packaging leaves a lot to be desired.There are twelve cookies in a box - three rows of four each - the top cookie on eachrow is broken.  Too much movement in package.  Used some of them for friends intheir Christmas box of goodies from the Longs.
I mean cookie pieces very embarrassing gifts. I will not being buying from this product line EVER again...Walkers Shortbread Lemon Thins, 4.2-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 4)

The lemon is not overpowering, though I wish it did have a bit more tartness. If I'd known I was missing out on something this good, I would have purchased them sooner. It's a good thing I bought 4 boxes.

column9: Tasty but too many broken cookies
column10: Cookies were tasty, but half of them were broken.  They were packaged very well, but when I opened the boxes and pulled out the tray of cookies, they were mostly in pieces.  I still have 2 more boxes to open so we'll see how those are yet.  Probably would not buy them from this seller again.

While it is true that items like these tend to be a little riskier in shipping, mine came in perfect condition, not a broken cookie to be found.  However, that's likely luck of the draw when you're talking about a cookie like this that's so easily breakable.The cookies, though, are delicious.  The "thins" in the name scared me a little, wondering if the buttery flavour might be lost in a thinner form because they might have to be cooked longer for crispness.  No worries there.  This cookie is all Walkers, and the lemon flavour was fantastically distinct without being overbearing or overwhelming.  This is perfection for afternoon tea (low tea) or just a lovely cup of tea whenever you choose to take it, and the balance of tart and sweet is great whether you prefer the English tea blends or something like a fragrant jasmine green.

column9: Delicious treat for fans of lemon & shortbread
column10: I love Walker's shortbread, and I love lemon desserts (lemon meringue pie, lemon bars, mmmm!) I never knew these existed until it popped up as a lightning deal recently. As it happens, there was also a special offer for a discount on Walker's shortbread going on at the time. I saw the previous reviews that suggested the flavor might be a little TOO lemon-y and that there had been shipping issues, but due to the discounts I decided to give it a try. I had already decided it was likely I'd be the only one eating them -- the rest of my family is not so interested in lemon -- so I wasn't concerned if the cookies were broken. As it happened, the box they were shipped in did have some damage, but it hadn't actually touched the cookie boxes inside. The 4 boxes come shrink-wrapped in a cube shape (2 stacks of 2 boxes), which may help protect them somewhat. I've only opened one box so far, but ironically since I don't actually care if they're broken or not, all of the cookies in that box were perfectly fine & unbroken. I don't know if they've improved their shipping/handling process or if I just got lucky.As far as taste, if you like lemon dessert and shortbread, I think you'll probably like this as well. Since it's shortbread, it's not overly sweet as some lemon treats are, but I thought the shortbread and lemon flavors went together extremely well. I did notice some very small granules of chewier bits (probably pieces of the lemon zest) which may have been what the earlier reviewer's relative noticed. I thought it actually gave an interesting texture to the cookie. It's fairly subtle. If I have a complaint, it's that each box contains a total of 12 cookies -- pretty pricey on a per-cookie basis.I had thought i might take some of these with me to share when we visit family over the holidays, but honestly I don't think they're going to last that long!

I'm going to have to order more.  Just looking at the photo as I write this review, I'm starting to drool.I love shortbread cookies but I'm too lazy to make them.  I'm a perfectly capable baker, and when I retire, I will bake my own.  I forget what brought these to my attention, but I ordered them and they were a hit at home and at work.  OK, those heathens at work never met a cookie they didn't like, but they SCARFED them!Thin, crisp, light and buttery, with really yummy lemon flavor.  Not one person said anything about the lemon rind.  It's so fine you have to try to feel it in your mouth, but it sure tastes good.Some of the cookies were crumbled or broken.  This does not affect the flavor!  And they were shipped from Scotland.  Considering how easily shortbread breaks, I think they made the trip very well.I have to stop writing now, or I'll order more this instant!
I'm sure this is excellent fennel pollen.  however, I just don't feel the power.  This is supposed to be some chef's secret amazing ingredient and I just don't see it.

column9: The best bread crumbs...you'll never go back
column10: Panko bread crumbs are just awesome.  When used for breading they make a light yet crispy coating...The are different than traditional *american type* crumbs in the way that soft powder snow is different than heavy packed snow.  The crumbs themselves are larger and irregularly shaped so as they lie on eachother they don't form a dense compressed breading but one with substance that still remains airy.  Their flavor is very light and seasoning is needed but this is a plus for me as I can season to taste.I have also mixed these with traditional bread crumbs at times as these tend to be expensive for a lighter style coating but still essentially very much like all panko dishes.  I tend to use a light egg wash with these as I find using just eggs to dip the meat/poulty/fish in a bit heavy for these crumbs.  In general I find these far superior for coating food.  These aren't the kind of bread crumbs I use for adding bulk (ie meatloaf, meatballs etc).  I have been using these for a few years now an there is a huge difference between these and the others.  I think if you try them you will really enjoy the light crisp crusts you can achieve...

This is the Japanese version of breadcrumb (pan=bread, a Portuguese loan-word, and"ko-"  is "child of" or of "derived from".) Panko are used for katsudon, tonkatsu or cutlets served on rice or in soups. The cutlets, pounded chicken or pork, are coated with these light and crispy crumbs and fried. They are not gritty and dense like regular crumbs. They are very nice on deep fried shrimps and decorative for a more gourmet touch.
Hard to find. It is the one I was looking for. Delicious for fried foods for just a light breading.
I purchased 2 bags, and one bag was just crawling with bugs.  I contacted the company, and they did nothing!

The product contained MANY ant fragments, still identifiable with pieces such as thorax and legs, or head with mandibles still visible. The insects were cooked INTO the paper sheets, and hadn't merely gotten into the package during shipping. I understand that almost all food products have some trace pieces of insect, but if your product has that many, you need to redefine how you transport and manufacture your food products.
I double them so that I get twice the enjoyment. Makes great spring rolls

I have used this brand of rice paper many times. It is by far my favorite. They are tasty and pretty forgiving of my clumsy efforts to roll the perfect spring roll.I read with dismay how a customer found ant parts cooked into a package of them. I've never seen this, and I hope that the customer notified the company. They make a good product, and I am sure that they would want to know about any problems.
Sadly  these rice papers were very fragile.  They ripped in every roll.  I have one package that I haven't used and probably not going to use.

Seller packaged this item well for shipping, but the spring roll wrappers are terrible!This is not the first time I have used rice paper spring roll wrappers, but it is my first (and last) time using this brand!A few wrappers were damaged.  I expected that, and discarded them.  Many had holes in them.  I wasn't pleased about that.  I searched through the package, and found perfect ones, placed them in a pan of water, and watched two inch long cracks appear in them.  ABSOLUTELY UNACCEPTABLE!!!  I threw away the first 7-8 that formed these giant cracks in the water - and eventually just gave up and put two wrappers in the water at a time (rotating one by 90 degrees - so the cracks were in different directions).Please understand - they are not splitting because I was rough with them; or because I used something sharp to pick them up; or because I overstuffed them... they are splitting in the warm water.  The wrapper appears fine when it goes in, and as it softens, multiple large cracks (1/2" to over 2" long) split the wrapper.  Maybe the machine that pressed the pattern into them wasn't calibrated properly?  Don't know...Sure - you can use them... but you have to use two at a time.  It is like making a sandwich and having to use 4 pieces of bread to hold it together.  Ridiculous!

Clipper is my favourite brand of Earl Grey tea.  I've tried many brands over the years.I used to stick with good old Twinings, but they seem to have changed their UK Earl Grey flavour in the last few years (it's now less appealing to me) and their US Earl Grey flavour is different (and inferior, in my opinion) to their UK Earl Grey flavour.  I once wrote to their customer service department to ask about the US and UK Earl Grey flavour differences, and they told me that their flavours are modified based on what the consumers in each country seem to like.I don't know if Clipper varies their Earl Grey UK and US flavours similarly, or not.  Up to now, I've only bought it in the UK.  I would go out of my way to find it there, because not every supermarket would carry the Earl Grey flavor by Clipper.I'm considering buying this pack of 6 in this listing, but I wish I could get just one box first, to make sure I like the US version (if indeed there is any difference).I had never seen any Clipper teas in a US store until last week, when I found a lone box of Clipper Chai tea (my favourite chai) in a small TJ Maxx store for about two dollars, and I snapped it up!  I've been back to the store to see if they have any more on display, but they don't.One difference I noticed between the UK Clipper Chai and the US Clipper Chai is that the US Clipper bags are individually wrapped in a little paper cover, whereas in the UK, tea bags that come in a box (of, say, 20 or 50 or 100) are usually not wrapped in their own individual covers.

column9: Great shelf-stable meal replacement when you have no time.
column10: These are like the Carnation Instant Breakfast packets that you mix with a glass of fresh milk - in fact, when I last checked, the nutritional profile was nearly the same. The bonus is that you can keep these in your pantry!  They taste MUCH better when served on ice. I send these to my son's college dorm, since he sometimes forgets to eat. (Maybe I would be as thin as he is, if I had that problem!)Of course, you should search for the lowest price available (including shipping); consider looking for these at a local store. Giant food stores in Virginia often carry them.

My wife's nutritionist recommends this product and it's at the top for anyone that needs an added boost loaded with vitamins. This price is great; but not when you add in the shipping cost that adds up to almost $36.  I get that it's heavy for shipping, but my local super market sells it for $27/case and sale price of $22/case. Do the math.
I love, love, love this sause/marinade for meat.  It makes the meat fall apart.  I would buy it at my local store but they don't sell it anymore.  I now buy it through the Kikkoman website. [...]

column9: There is none better and the other reviews are absolutely correct.
column10: I discoverd this marinade by accident in a high end, high price, one of a kind specialty grocery store. They don't have it anymore and I have been looking for it ever since. I used this merinade on 4-5 T bones for a family gathering and assumed, like most, that they really don't do all that much and you need to leave them on longer. The meat was almost mush . . . almost . . . but extreemly good. Comments were made, "We've never had steak like this before!". (A good thing.) Everyone raved about the meat. You almost didn't need a knife! The other reviews are correct. I would definately NOT apply this over night. I'm wanting it now for Tri-Tip, which I usually salt cure for as much as 24 hours. I guessing that this marinade would turn a Tri-tip into a Felit. If you can find this merinade it is the bomb. I highly suggest following the instructions the first time just so you know what it does. I more the doubled the time and almost had baby food. GREAT STUFF AND I WANT IT! Time to call Kikkoman!

I have been using this marinade for years and lately I have been finding it hard to find in my local supermarkets.  That's why I'm on the internet trying to shop for it.  It makes any steak so much more tender in just ten minutes.  I am very busy and don't plan my dinners well ahead of time to marinade overnight.  This just takes 10 min. and the results are excellent.

I pride myself on my ability to marinate meat.  Of course, all you do is dump the marinade over the meat and you're done, so my pride is kind of simplistic, but the right marinade is the key to making everything else fit together. Usually, I buy marinades and combine five or six (or more) different ones, adding spices and whatnot, until it tastes just right and then adding it.  This is the only marinade that I won't add anything to and, unbelievable to me the first time I used it, not only do you not have to add anything to it, but 10 minutes later, the meat is ready to go. No overnighting it! This marinade made one of three steaks I've ever eaten that I didn't use any steak sauce with. For those of us who require steak sauce, this statement should be "enough said".

Curry powder is a blend of several spices. If you're looking for authentic Oriental Curry flavor this is the stuff. No American Curry powder comes close. Anything else is just... disappointing. If you're making Indian curry then perhaps there are alternatives.
It's not bad, but not what I'm used to getting from a friend in Singapore. I had to add more cinnammon and fennelto get the taste I enjoy. But it is much better than Indian Curry.

I LOVE this curry powder!  It has a strong flavor and scent with a touch of sweetness.  I've tried other curry powders in my favorite curried dish and they don't come out near as good!  A definite buy for curry lovers!

I love this Worcestershire sauce! It's made with yummy ingredients, and I think it tastes better than the kind with fish in it. It doesn't seem as salty, and it has a nice, deep flavor. I use it to make my own BBQ sauce for tofu and seitan cutlets. If you want to add flavor to your own sauces, go for it!! I recommend it all the way.

Brodies Scottish Breakfast Tea in Drum (50 Tea Bags) This is my all time favorite breakfast tea.  Makes a perfect cuppa anytime of day.  Have not been disappointed with any  tea bags or loose tea made by Brodies.  I first discovered Brodies while on a trip to England/Scotland in 1998. So thrilled when Amazon offers this tea since it has been hard to find online over the years so I stock up whenever I find it.
My husband was bemoaning the fact that he could not find any gum drops so I looked on Amazon and here they are - now if they would just make the little ones with Prime shipping I'd be happy too!

For large jelly drops, these have a surprisingly good consistency. They also have a nice texture -- soft but firm enough. Other brands I've tried have hard spots, usually around the edges, or the texture will vary from drop to drop. Not these.

This product -eg the 35 lb bag- just DOUBLED in price, from 35 to 63$ for a 35lbs bag.
