I'm very picky about my candy, especially my gummies. Some gummies are too sticky and get stuck in your teeth, some are too sweet, and some are so difficult to chew that my jaw will ache after a while of munching. These blue gummy sharks by Farley and Sathers are none of the bad, and all of the good that I find in gummies. They're soft with just the right consistency, and sweetened to the perfect level. I'll be purchasing these again and again for sure!
I love these gummies! They have a really great flavor blueberry/blue raspberry. It has been my favorite candy ever since I was a child. Yummy Gummies!

column9: Good, but not as soft as others

Davidson's Earl Grey tea is a little different than other Earl Greys I have experienced.First of all this tea has a smoky flavor to the tea itself, which not unpleasent is not what I have come to expect from the black teas used in other Earl Greys.Also the bergemont in this tea seems to have a more lemon flavor than the citrus blend of others. column9: It's brown but is it tea?
column10: I was so looking forward to a nice cuppa of Earl Grey but I had no idea what I was in for when I brewed my first  pot of Davidson's organic Earl Grey tea. It was the worst cup of brown liquid I've ever put in my mouth and as my granddad used to say, 'everybody has to eat a peck of dirt before they die.' The Bergamot oil was foul and the tea itself was sour, bitter and tasted of chemicals. I'm not picky, but DAMN!
As a tea junky, the quality of the product and the shipping/handling were great. I enjoy the tea and would buy more from them for sure.
Great flavor and wonderful aroma. I'm looking forward to trying Davidson's Tea Bulk, Earl Grey with Lavender, 16-Ounce Bag
Bought this as a present for my wife, an Earl Grey fiend.  She says it's VERY GOOD and so I'll be getting more soon to slake her infernal desires....

I have been buying tea from another supplier for years, but the shipping has become too expensive.  So, I decided to try this tea.  The cut of the leaves seems good although the color is darker than expected and seems over dried.  I will be going back to my old tea. The tea lacks a full bodied flavor.  The overwhelming taste sensation is a sense of bitterness with not much else.  If I had saved the bag, I would return it.

column9: Absolute Best Earl Grey I have ever tried
column10: Wow, so deep, rich and bursting with flavor from the first sip to bottom of the cup. I love that it is Organic and such a great price.If you look at the boxes with the little individual tea bags, you will find you are paying $ 60 a pound for the tea your drinking. No wonder those big name tea companies make so much money. Plus I do not care for the waste with all that packaging.I think the negative reviews on here are because this tea has wonderful Bergamont flavor - bitter orange - duh. I love it......This tea is a real brain booster. A nice perk me up at any time of the day. I enjoy it hot or cold from the frig.Okay, I confess I have been emailing friends about this tea. I've bought this tea a couple of times now, and I really like it. I'm no fancy pants tea connoisseur, but I drink at least 4 cups of this tea a day, and certainly enjoy it. Definitely a good every day tea and at a good price! I'll buy it again when I'm out.

I have enjoyed Earl Grey tea from several companies but thought Davidson's Earl Grey to be the very best.  The aroma, flavor and clarity of the tea were all excellent and the price was very reasonable.  I have several of Davidson's tea but think their Earl Grey will remain one of my favorites.
Nice flavor and aroma.  Good hot or iced. I had to quit drinking it because it was making my feet swell; but I did enjoy it other than that.

The main thing I like about Davidson's teas is that they are certified organic. I have been buying these teas from Amazon now for a few years and with their "subscribe and save" program you can get automated delivery at a reduced price and if you are a "Prime" member you get free shipping as well! column9: Excellent tea at an affordable price!

Tulsi Tea is made by Organic India. It is the finest organic green, black, or herbal teas imbued with Tulsi, which is known as holy basil, the queen of herbs.It is said to have many healthful and medicinal qualities.I've been drinking Tulsi Tea for 2 years now, and must say I've been extremely resistant to colds and viruses.I totally crave a huge mug of Tulsi when I come in from walking my dog in wintery rain(ugh!)If I start to feel like a cold wants to come, I start pumping the Tulsi Tea.I buy Tulsi Green Tea, and Tulsi Marsala, which is a chai-flavored tea-ginger, cinnamon,along WITH the tulsi and black tea.MMMMM.Being a heavy user, I have trouble with the $5+ price of a box of Tulsi Tea.My daughter told me she buys her Tulsi from Amazon, at a better rate.So voila!I highly recolmmend!

For many years I was drinking Costco's Japanese Green tea.  And even though the medicinal qualities are evident in most chinese/japanese green teas (especially the soothing after taste), I wouldn't describe your typical green tea as a flavorful experience.  Enter Tulsi!  Add a small amount of honey and kick back with your feet up on a cold winter day.  This tea is what you always expected green tea to taste like: complex, aromatic, very flavorful....extremely satisfying.

This Green tea blend is SERIOUSLY smooth and delightful.  It is my favorite tea ever.  Ever.The blend of Tulsi and Green tea is a perfect example of something being greater than the sum of its parts.  Plain Tulsi (Holy Basil) tea tastes like grass to me; plain green tea is bitter to my taste (yes, I prepare it properly).... but when you combine the two you wind up with a wonderfully mild, slightly sweet, yet still undoubtedly green concoction that is nothing short of addictive.  I almost can't help but guzzle it.  I got my mom hooked on this tea as well and I have to buy her a bunch from my local Co-op every couple of months and mail it to her!Try this tea.  Then hate me for getting you addicted.  Then stock up if you find it on sale!  Then try the other Organic India teas... they are ALL wonderful... and you will be supporting an environmentally responsible product and the farmers that produce it.But seriously... the Green tea blend... buy it.  As fast as you can click your way through checkout.

column9: Perfect for adding flavor to dry food. Our little dog loves this stuff
column10: I don't know a lot about dogs but I thought they ate anything. The dachshund we had growing up would eat banana peels if you left them out. We rescued a Maltese (5 years ago now) and while he is healthy, he eats when he's hungry and leaves the rest.  He's never like doggy treats, bones etc. and prefers human food/meat to anything for dogs. Since I've read dry food is best for dogs we feed him dry but again, he eats when hungry but doesn't lick his chops. Cesar is the best dog food I've found to add to the dry for taste. We get at least 4 feedings from one container, which make it pretty cheap. We simply mix a spoonful into the dry food for flavor and he's got the best of both worlds. If I could find a dry food tasty enough to be served solo, I would buy it but he eats such a small amount of food I don't mind making it tasty.

column9: Very poor quality; little real meat;
column10: There is very little meat in this food and there are toxic chemicals.Various Meat By Products--lower quality than whole meat or meals and harder to digest than actual meat.Caramel coloring is only necessary when there is not enough meat.  Caramel color may be carcinogenic."Liquid Top Sirloin flavor"  "Grilled chicken flavor"--  Flavoring is only necessary when the product has insufficient meat.  Top Sirloin flavoring is made from manure of cattle.Carageenan causes cancer, including breast cancer.  Read an interview with Joanne Tobacman, MD, professor of internal medicine, University of Iowa at [...]There are no vegetables in this food.Cesar has repeatedly stated that his entire goal in coming to the United States was to go to Hollywood and be famous.  I think that that focus on fame (and money) is apparent in his approach to dog food:  Give crummy food nice packaging and an appealing name.That one's dog will eat it is no advertisement.  First, the only thing one really has to do to sell dog food is make it so the dogs will eat it.  That the dog will eat it is no measure of the quality or benefit of the food.  Dogs eat anything--including manure, which is part of this food as the meat flavoring.

column9: We're both happy at long last!
column10: I have two dogs, but only one of them eats Cesar chicken "in meaty juices" (it HAS to be the "in meaty juices kind!) and she GOBBLES IT. after years of searching for a food she'll eat to enjoy, not just eat to survive, we've finally found a winner! Gigi is a 9-year-old Papillon mix who is both dainty, firecely independent, and plain fierce when she's disturbed, while 1-year-old Mini-Dachshund Sophie is a happy, bouncy, and utterly addicted to attention. Gigi spends her time under the bed, Sophie is wherever I am. What Sophie eats is actually still TBD. This is Gigi's review.Both of them have been picky eaters. Gigi went years on starving herself until she couldn't hold out any longer, then deigning to eat the dry food we supply between wet food dinners, even as we tried all kinds of different foods to tempt her. Beneful Dog Food Prepared Meals Beef Stew Dog Food, 10-Ounce Plastic Containers (Pack of 8) used to work now and then, and though it was expensive, we could get 3 servings from it. However, even though it had a lid, it would often grow moldy even before the next meal. So even though she liked it, it was wasted and really too expensive anyway.When Sohpie arrived, we'd been serving Mighty Dog Hearty Pulled-Style Chicken Dinner In Gravy, 5.5-Ounce Cans (Pack of 24) with the longest sustained success yet, about a year. Only chicken, mind you, and it had to be the chunky in sauce kind, NOT the pate kind. Well, along came the puppy, and Gigi expressed her distaste by wasting food again.Finally, I've found Cesar. And oddly, now it has to be the pâté kind, I.e. "in meaty juices" NOT the chunky kind! But AT LAST we've found a dog food that The Mrs. will absolutely SNARF ON. She doesn't come up for air when I put any chicken-based "in meaty juices" Cesar dinner in front of her, which I cube into bite sizes.The added bonus is that I can hide pills in the cubes. Gigi's been diagnosed with congenital heart failure, and she's on 3 different pills, 3 times a day. Dinner is the easier dose, because I just push the little pills into the soft pâté, and she's none the wiser because she swallows the cubes almost whole! Sadly, we won't probably have Gigi with us for the fourteen or fifteen years I've been blessed to have spent with my previous dogs. But I'm determined to make sure she's as healthy and happy as possible in the time we have. She may be feisty, prickly, and a loner, but when I *can* catch her, she does love to snuggle with her mama.Cesar "in nearby juices" dog food might just give me a few month's more snuggled than we'd otherwise have.

High quality dog food, I feed lamb as it is easier on their disgestion, I highly recommend this if you have small dogs..

I mix it with a for or my hands (so he doesn't just eat the Cesar and walk away). He gets the benefit of dry food for his teeth etc and the tastiness of Cesar's wonderful flavors.
This is one of the best and safe products made in the USA

column9: Very poor quality; little real meat;
column10: There is very little meat in this food and there are toxic chemicals.Various Meat By Products--lower quality than whole meat or meals and harder to digest than actual meat.  Lamb is listed after various by-products, indicating that most of the protein a pet will be exposed to in eating this food is not lamb and thus not easy on the stomach as lamb is stated to be.Caramel coloring is only necessary when there is not enough meat.  Caramel color may be carcinogenic."Liquid Top Sirloin flavor"  "Grilled chicken flavor"--  Flavoring is only necessary when the product has insufficient meat.  Top Sirloin flavoring is made from manure of cattle.Carageenan causes cancer, including breast cancer.  Read an interview with Joanne Tobacman, MD, professor of internal medicine, University of Iowa at [...]There are no vegetables in this food.Cesar has repeatedly stated that his entire goal in coming to the United States was to go to Hollywood and be famous.  I think that that focus on fame (and money) is apparent in his approach to dog food:  Give crummy food nice packaging and an appealing name.That one's dog will eat it is no advertisement.  First, the only thing one really has to do to sell dog food is make it so the dogs will eat it.  That the dog will eat it is no measure of the quality or benefit of the food.  Dogs eat anything--including manure, which is part of this food as the meat flavoring.

column9: Don't worry about it being too strong
column10: It's got a really good flavor but it's very, very weak. I left the teabag in for the entire half hour or so that I was drinking it and it was never really strong enough. column9: My new favorite but cheaper at the grocery store
column10: This is a really rich, dark coffee and lives up to the Starbucks name.  While I have used k cups for several years, it has been hard to find one that was bold enough.  I liked Emeril's Big Easy Bold for a while and still like Green Mountain's Espresso Blend but neither have the richness that this one from Starbucks has.  Right now though the Amazon price for 30 is 48.98!  For a pack of 16 it is $9.99 at my local grocery store and Bed, Bath and Beyond carries them for $14.99 but you can use their $5 off or the 20% off coupons which are everywhere.  So until the price here drops some, I will pick it up at my local store.

Yes, it's expensive, but it's really the best Sumatran k-cup.BTW, so you know where my preferences lay, the k-cups I prefer are the Starbucks Verona, Sumatra, and Pikes Place, along with Van Houtte's Mexican Dark Roast, and Tomothy's Columbian LaVareda (NOT the Dorado).

column9: Gives Cafe Verona a run for the money!
column10: I have been buying the Starbucks Cafe Verona K-cups at Costco since they came out.  I love them.  I would give them 7 stars if I could.  I found these Sumatra K-cups at Amazon Warehouse and got them for an average of $.65/cup, which I think is fair.  I had never tried the Sumatra, but glad I did because they are very good.  Very bold, very smooth, not so bold it tastes like you're drinking from an ashtray.  Amazing how Starbucks gets their K-cups to taste pretty dang close to the real thing.

column9: GREAT TASTE, NOT SO GREAT PRICE
column10: Cheaper at Target. $14.99 for an 18 count. I thought for sure it would be cheaper online, but I was wrong.

I love dark roast coffee, served with or without cream/sugar, and this Sumatran k-cup is most assuredly a dark roast, but I found the flavor and aroma of this product to register as slightly bitter/burnt.  It did not overwhelm my senses, and it was easily alleviated and made better with the use of creamer, but it still wasn't my favorite of the K-Cups that are available.  I thought it was "okay".My husband didn't enjoy the Starbucks version of Sumatra, stating that he felt it had a somewhat chemical-like aftertaste even with cream and sugar.  We used over half of the box, to make sure that our opinion wasn't perhaps based on a faulty serving or two, but ended up giving the remainder to our neighbors; unfortunately, this Sumatra just didn't work for us.

This is the best K-cup coffee I have found yet.  The Pike Place is a close second, but the Sumatra holds up well to a larger cup (either the mug or large mug size).  If you're using a travel mug, stick with the dark roasts.  Wish it came in decaf - I love my Keurig, but I can handle only so much caffeine!Also, I have found the Starbucks K-cups disassemble easily (more so than some of the other brands), the foil removes very cleanly, you can compost the grounds and paper filter, and recycle the plastic.

column9: Bold, and full of flavor, good flavor
column10: My husband loves the Starbucks Sumatra K-Cup. Of all the samples of bold coffee for the Keurig he has tried, this is by far his favorite. It has just the right amount of flavor and strength for his taste.

I prefer grinding my own coffee and using my Aeropress to the K-Cup for single serving brews. When I heard Starbucks was coming out with a K-Cup I was genuinely excited! For two years I've dealt with weak "dark" roasts. Iced coffees with a K-Cup are a joke. While nothing will come close to espresso out of a Keurig (I recommend the Mypressi Twist V2 if you are on a budget), the Sumatra Dark from Starbucks is the best K-Cup yet. It is smooth, dark and even brewed with crema. This is not acidic like many of the South American blend K-Cups. It is slightly more expensive, but it has made me start using my Keurig again. I would have given it 5 stars, but one cup of the 5 I've made so far came out a touch weak.Do yourself a favor if you shelled out the cash on a Keurig. Get the Sumatra!!!

So far, I've only tried this one and Pike's Place (see my review for that here) and I have to say the Sumatra is superior to Pike's Place, with a satisfyingly rich, bold flavor. In the coming days I'll try their House Blend and French Roast to compare and post quick reviews on them as well.

column9: Excellent K cups if you get it at a good price

column9: Not as good as the 'regular' version nor Hawaiian Punch On-the-Go's
column10: I've been drinking the Kool-Aid singles for over a year now, thinking that there wasn't a good alternative.  D'oh!I just tried Hawaiian Punch and like them a lot more as they just have more flavor -- in the case of both the regular-sugar and diet versions -- and less diet sweetener weird aftertaste -- in the case of the diet versions.As I said in my Hawaiian Punch review, I think the difference is the Citric Acid that HP uses, versus Kool-Aid's use of Maltic Acid. If you like to dunk your cookies, look no more! They melt in your mouth!

column9: Made in the US version, not the same recipe as Imported from Austrailia version
column10: I thought, wow, bulk Lucky Country Red Licorice, sweet, but alas no, it is a mass produced Americanized version from Lucky Country's new US manufacturing plant.  The recipe is completely different from the Lucky Country Red Licorice (same brand, same name) that is Imported from Australia.  The original recipe has more real licorice despite being a red licorice, and is much softer.  The Made in US version is your typical chewy waxy candy licorice with barely a hint of licorice, just pure sweet.  Shame on Lucky Country for taking a high end sophisticated product and watering it down like every licorice sold in every drug store in the US.  I'm heading back to Target or Trader Joe's for the real thing.

This is the only place where I can find the pineapple flavor. The product is great!
Good - but not as good as the Australian licorice that actually have strawberry seeds in it.

This stuff has no distinguishable flavor to it, just a stagnant sweetness.  It is just terrible.  Black cherry, my arse.  Yuck!  And, these are its good points.

I have only tried the strawberry flavor, but it has a rich taste, and is a "soft" but still good and chewy licorice.  I love it. This candy is the best I have ever tasted, my last order was my third (3rd), it is realy good and may be habit forming to your tast buds.There are several items to choose from, which can be confusing. I did not send the 1.5 lbs bag back, it wasn't worth my time, and I do like the candy...I live in Gainesville FL, not Zoe KY.

column9: I LOVE the Black Cherry and the Black!
column10: Yummy, chewy, filled with flavor in every bite.  I've also had the Green Apple and while good, not quite as satisfying.  The Black Cherry is devine!  The Cherry flavor pops with the first nibble; rich and full.  Now I need to try the other flavors.  Lucky Country is sometimes sold at Walmart (Black only) and used to be found at Costco....but is generally difficult to find.  Amazon has a great selection!

column9: Aussi Licorce made in the USA
column10: Does not seem as soft or as intense with flavor as the black licorce. However,some guest and friends prefer it over the black.Quite different than the traditional Strawberry---seems to have more of a multi-berry/cherry flavor to it..
I'm a big fruit flavored candy fan and this is wonderful!! Really good flavor and nice and soft, great texture! I loved it - I only wish it came in more flavors! I recommend it highly!!
I ordered Lucky Country Licorice Black Cheery 16 oz tubs (Pack of 4) and that is not what I received. I was sent Black Currant which is awful so now what do I do?

I had purchased the Black licorice and thought it to be some of the best I'd ever had, and I do love licorice.  Ordered this only because the Black was not available, but found it tastes more like Grape, of which I am not fond.
My favorite. Soft, just chewy enough, and very flavorful. Not sure how this price compares to Costco.

column9: did not taste like the one we bought in Costco
column10: this candy was ok, but it had a different taste than the one we had previously bought at Costco, even though it was supposed to be the same flavor. But, the one in Costco said "new improved recipe" perhaps this one was the old recipe. I was disapointed. But the quality of the candy was fine. Just not the same as the one I already had. So, this candy is not being eaten any nearly as fast.This candy was a brighter red color, and not as soft. However, this candy did have a stronger strawberry flavor.
For a licorice addict this will do, but it isn't any better than Twizzlers, and might be worse.

I was not satisfied with this purchase.  The advertisement was for a bulk container and the licorice came in 5 plastic bags.  2 of the bags were torn open as a result of the shipping process.  The licorice itself is an excellent product but the item identified was not as ordered.I will not purchase this item here again.

column9: Awesome gum for those who love Hot Tamales candy
column10: I love spicy anything and Hot Tamales is no exception. The gum is a little harder than original candy but the outside coating and flavor is the same. It will eventually get a little rubberier than, say, Ice Breakers Cubes after chewing a while. No real complains about this gum, though. Recommended.

I ordered this along with some other sugar free stuff.  This gum has a great tamales flavor.  It has a waxy outside so the gum doesn't stick to other pieces etc.  It is definitely spicy.  I put two pieces in my mouth at once and definitely needed a beverage!  Will continue to order this product

column9: By far the best gum ever.
column10: The best gum ever. Does not lose its flavor or softness.  Found it one Easter for kids baskets and have not seen it in stores since.  Wish they would sell it in stores.

Like every other Dr. Oetkar product I have tried, it is great! I've bought it from Wholefoods and it was on sale,it ended up $3.5 per box of 8oz which is cheaper than what you can get here. In terms of product quality, it is great. Price, you may want to consider buying it from store.
We love this lava cake but can not locate it at stores locally.  We are so glad we can get it on Amazon.  We always serve it with ice cream-yummy!  It's the best dessert ever!!
Had trouble finding this locally, very happy to find it on Amazon.This is our favorite relish, I just wish we could have purchased less than 12.

The first sip taste weird, then after that it taste like strawberries and raspberries with nice vanilla undertones. I classify it as semi - sweet, the food editor at my paper thought it was very sweet like preserves.Really good with grilled food,cheddar cheese and those hershey with almonds bars. It brings out all the individual flavors of whatever you are eating. It is really good on a picnic. You don't need a corkscrew, just take the plastic off and give it a couple good twists and your done.It is really hard to find, though. Two stores told me they have been waiting 3 months to get there shipment because the warehouse is out. Another manager seriously told me this wine is frowned upon in the world of wine and only lightweights and only low class people drink it. Whatever,she is full of it. Because this older couple really enjoyed it when I sent it to them in Florida. And they happen to be serious wine people.

column9: Price gouging to a ridiculous degree
column10: These 12 oz bags are $5.00 list price at Bare Naked's website.  This seller is marking up 100 PERCENT.....then charging shipping.  Shameful!!!
Bear Naked is supposed to sell for $5 per 12 oz bag.  Plain and simple this seller is doubling the price + shipping!!!!!!!!!GO somewhere else and buy it!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

I have a very picky 7 yr old. His new food kick is granola. All kinds.... plain, with milk, in his yogurt. Chocolate is his favorite thing so when I saw this I had to buy some (already had other Bare Naked granola so know its GOOD stuff) Its a HUGE hit!! I try to limit his candy & chocolate but this will be a nice treat for him, he loves it and its better for him than candy!!

column9: Great for making your own fish sticks and chicken nuggets!
column10: These crumbs are perfect for breading.  My son was actually nervous about trying the pork chops I breaded since he doesn't feel well after eating "normal" breaded dishes.  I used Pam as the glue to make it stick (my son can't have eggs) and it worked really well.

I love the product, Major Grey's Chutney by Crosse and Blackwell, however my 6 pack arrived with one bottle that had the cap seal popped, meaning that in shipping the jar was probably jiggled and the top lost the air seal. I notifiied the vendor and they promptly credited my account through Amazon. Alas, now I am left with only 5 bottles!

None of the super markets carry this product so I stopped looking.  Then it occured to me that Amazon might have it.  I was amazedand thrilled that  they carried it.  It's a six pack so I don't have to reorder every time a bottle gets low.  Thanks Amazon!

I tried this product in my pursuit of the best seaweed snack for flavor and price.  This one rated higher than some, but still not the best.  First, the flavor is ok, not too fishy, and the texture while thicker than some, and a little chewy, isn't bad.  The packaging consists of 80 strips to a jar, which is convenient and you get 6 jars to an order, so the cost isn't bad.  the calories are good, you get 10 pieces to a serving, a good size and it only has 10 calories.  So 1 calorie per piece w/no fat is great.  As far as carbs go, there is less than 1 carb per 10 piece serving.  Can't beat that.  Some seaweed snacks have a carb per piece.  Overall this isn't bad, but it's still not great.  Perhaps another flavor would be better.  While some seaweed snacks are so bad, I'd never try another flavor, this one is worth checking out a little more.

I buy my seaweed snack from Costco but there is so much packaging!! So I decided to try this one.All three of my children love the costco one but only one will eat this one :/ It it chewy more so than the other kind and they said it smells more fishy. I tend to agree with them.It's not horrible and if you like chewy, you will love this.

I have had this brand of seaweed snack before and it still lives up to its standards. It was shipped quickly and is just as good as when I bought it at the store. I'll definitely buy again when I run out.

we usually buy trader joe's brand which we love - this brand isn't as crispy - much softer and as a snack for the kids to eat in the car, it's actually less messy.  i don't find it quite as tasty, but the kids love it.  when i first tried it i thought maybe moisture had leaked in, but on opening other jars realised it was just a different texture and it definitely grew on me.

column9: Rock hard marshmallows bring this snack down
column10: I love Smores, the combination of chocolate, marshmallows and graham crackers are outstanding. I also love Emerald nuts, so when I saw this at my local grocer, I had to try them.  Right away, the biggest problem with this snack is the marshmallows, if you can even call them that.  The marshmallows look like erasers from a pencil, and they are as hard as a rock.  I am not exagerrating, I nearly broke a tooth the first time I tried to bite one.  Are they stale?  Expiration date says September of 2012. I am not sure, maybe I got a bad package of these.  I am hesitant to buy another box.  The rest of the snack mix is fine, the cocoa walnuts, honey roasted peanuts, m&ms, graham chunks and oat clusters all tasted as they should.  But the most important part of the "smores", the marshmallows, was a major letdown.

I love these breakfast nuts, I eat a bag every morning as I don't spend a lot of time in the mornings before I leave for work.My girlfriend loves the other flavors w/ apple slices, but this is my favorite flavor. Just wouldn't suggest paying the price Amazon is asking for them, when you can get them a lot cheaper at Food Lion.

I love the Berry Nut Blend and the Breakfast Nut Blend variety of Emerald Breakfast on the go!, but found the S'Mores Nut Blend to be gross. The marshmallows had a very mushy texture, similar to a soggy version of marshmallows found in some cereal. I found the chocolate to be overwhelming with having chocolate candy pieces (similar to M&Ms) and cocoa roasted almonds. I did like the coconut flakes and graham cracker squares. I will not buy this blend again.

Crunchy, Nutty, Sweet, Salty and a nice hint of the "Smores" Goodness all in this bag.Delicious! As one user said, The Marshmallows are "HARD" but hey its a trail mix! I enjoy them and the Graham cracker pieces which are very crunchy too!

column9: Tangerine are great; watermelon are better!
column10: These are DELICIOUS! They remind me a lot of Wonka Jaw Breakers as far as taste, but they are soft and powdery instead of hard. I prefer them over conventional candy and while they are obviously a bit more expensive they are worth every penny and you don't get that nasty sugar rush then crash that you get with conventional candies. Enjoy!! They're great!

Placed the order on Friday, got the shipment yesterday (Tuesday), so I tried it today. Its pretty good. Healthy breakfast for less than $1.25. Its pretty tasty too. Just open up oatmeal pour hot water wait for 5 mins and enjoy. The dried apple pieces gets chunky and tastes good.

column9: Cannot believe how good this is
column10: I have high colesterol and was told oatmeal is great to lower it.  I have tried many oatmeals and hated all of them until this one came along.  It is really good and I recommend it highly. I also have a very particular grandson who also loves it...Really good, try it.

These oatmeal cups are great for the working person!  They're very convenient, taste great, and better than any drive-thru fast food breakfast! I keep them in the office for those days that I'm running late and have no time to eat.  I think they're a little pricy, but I guess we're paying for the convenience :)

This Quaker oatmeal has the best flavor.  It is so convenient to just add hot water or warm in the microwave.  Perfect for breakfast when you are in a hurry, or even when you're not and want a really flavorful hot cereal.

This is a great tasting oatmeal that is very easy to prepare.  I have tried all 3 flavors and of course this is the best.  I have also tried Seneca oatmeal in a two pack but they were really bad compared to this.  My problem is that stores around here only cary the brown sugar flavor so I either have to order this online or visit Tarket which is 80 miles away.  Everyone in my family really enjoys this and someone in the house is always having oatmeal.

column9: A Big Hit At the Office
column10: My husband took a box of these to work.  Now all his work colleagues are addicted.  They are fast, easy and everyone loves them!

column9: A great way to start the day!
column10: This oatmeal is not only portable and handy, it tastes great! The apple bits add lots of flavor and are not too sweet as to overpower the oatmeal itself. The servings portion is just right. I've tried all three flavors of the Quaker Express, baked apple, maple, and cinnabon. These tie with the maple for taste and consistency. The cinnabon is a little too sweet for me, but I recommend you give them a try and make your own decision. They are all very easy to prepare. Just remove the top, fill the cup to the indicated water line, and zap in the microwave for 1:15. Perfect every time! Great for a quick breakfast or office snack, and healthy too!

column9: Great deal for a handy product
column10: I bought this when there was a special on Quaker products here on Amazon making it even a better price!This is a great product, a good size for a quick breakfast.  Like others have stated, I too keep some of these in my desk at work.

I really like this product. I keep it in my desk drawer at work and eat one every day without fail. I only whish I could find it in the stores. However, when you can find the bowls, they don't have the apples in them. Anyway...great product!John
I love this oatmeal.  It's handy to store, good to eat and so very easy to take with you when running late to work, going out of town, or for an evening snack.

column9: meh... not a fave, prefer the other blonde
column10: When Starbucks came out with the "blonde" roasts, I got pretty excited because I prefer lighter roasts (as do 40% of coffee drinkers, according to the barista at the store)... light roasts are a little earthier, not as burnt tasting.  So I scored a bag each of the Willow and Veranda.This one, the Veranda, didn't do a lot for us.  Subjectively speaking, it was so smooth it was boring... it had no snap, and was kind of mixed and mushy, not a definitive flavor.  It's supposed to have "delicate nuances of soft cocoa and lightly toasted nuts" - really?  We missed that.On the other hand, we really liked the Willow, which had a brighter citrus-y note and was more flavorful.  The taste was (for lack of better words) clear, defined.  You buy a light roast to taste the bean, not the roast.  The Willow was flavorful, not acidy, and had a clean finish.Your tastes may vary, but if you like a snappy light roast, or a "breakfast roast" the Veranda probably won't be your pick, but do try the Willow.

.Recently on a relaxing vacation, I discovered that I had neglected to bring my favorite coffee.  Although I usually avoid buying coffee in a supermarket, I was stuck.  So I shopped a local grocery store to purchase enough coffee for my vacation.  I looked for a Kona blend with a higher percentage Kona than I usually find without luck.  Then I spotted this Starbucks blend that I have seen advertized and decided to try it.Starbucks Blonde Veranda coffee is a light roast coffee that is advertized as having lighter body and mellow favors.  Starbucks claims that roasting for less time frees "nuances" of cocoa and toasted nuts.Not as sharp and energetic as my favorite dark roasts, yet still flavorful.  Blonde Veranda Blend is soft and gentle like cool drink on a summers day.I enjoyed this experience and recommend Starbucks Blonde Veranda Blend for those who like light roast coffee, and maybe, for those who love dark roast, as an occasional treat.

I like coffee so dark that "light cannot escape its surface." (To paraphrase a Simpsons line.) However, I did get a bag of Veranda Blend and drank it for a solid 2 weeks. It is very sweet-flavored, not very bitter but there is a note of "woodiness" to the coffee. It even can stand up to milk and sugar, though I really think it is best drunk black.If you do not like that typical burnt flavor in Seattle-type roasts, you may well enjoy this blend. It is definitely a blonde. For those who like donut-shop blends, this is rather similar but I find it a bit less acid. And it has none of the burnt flavor for which dark roast is criticized.I just got a new bag of coffee-FRENCH ROAST. Light is not escaping its surface. You know where I fall on the spectrum of coffee roasts. Dark, darker, DARKEST. My fling with a Blonde is over. I'm back to my brunette roots.

column9: A perfectly pleasant cup of coffee
column10: I am not the type of person who wants her coffee to bite her back as she sips.  I want to simply enjoy the flavor.  I found this cup of coffee to be very nice.  I would have liked a touch more robustness, as it lacking a bit in flavor (which is why I am giving it 4 stars).  It isn't bitter.  It isn't harsh.  It doesn't taste burnt. I don't have to wince while I drink it, and to me, that is something.  I appreciate a lighter roast.  It's a nice cup of coffee.

I am a Coffee addict...I admit..as such, I spent much time from deception to deception at the coffee ally, hoping not to waste my well-earned money on yet another bitter coffee blend...and then I found VERANDA..simply awesome...smooth, mild yet tasty and powerful flavor and aroma. I like strong coffees, but it took me years to realize that strong and extra toasted don't mean the same. Less water? more powder? not really, just the perfect blend and there is not much to it. after all, give the blondes a try, it may be the smartest decision after all!! PD: Bear in mind before judging a coffee product that the coffee maker and the water used DOES make a difference too. By the way: veranda blends are becoming more difficult to find, hope they don't go off the market, it  would be a shame.

column4: Christine "If at first you don't succeed, try...
column10: I purchased the Veranda Blonde at my local Starbucks because they were offering it at a good sale (1 lb for $9.98).  Nasty, weak, and practically tasteless.  I prefer light coffees to most others -- -- don't do the dark coffees at all and only a few of the medium ones (like House Blends).  I like the other light coffees that Starbucks and Seattle's Best offer, but this brew has absolutely no substance.  Because I paid for it, I'm going to keep drinking it until it's gone, but never again.  Weak.

column9: Finally, a coffee with a focus on flavor.
column10: I have always felt that Starbucks' coffee was too strong, until now.  I love this new blonde roast.  It focuses on flavor rather than strength.  If you need the bragging rights for strong coffee, you will need to stay with Starbucks original blends.  However, if you really want a good tasting coffee, I recommend this one.Allow me to say, that I had always thought Mc Donald's regular brew beat anything Starbucks had to offer.  My mind might be changing on that now.

This is great coffee. It's smooth and definitely not for those who prefer strong coffee. But i wanted to let everyone know that Starbucks stores are now offering free taste testing of the bold, medium and blonde flavors of coffee. Also they are giving away samples of blond coffee (8-10 cup packs). So hit all the Starbucks in town and score some free coffee! I don't know how long the promotion is going on but I am sure there are more details on their website. Happy Coffee Drinking!

column9: The only word for this is awful
column10: I bought four packs of the Veranda blend without tasting first, and I'm going to throw three of them away.  Imagine dishwater.  Imagine dishwater in your coffee cup, ruining the most blissful part of your morning, and you have the Veranda blend.  Maybe it's for people who don't like coffee?  It doesn't taste anything like coffee (especially not the coffees served in a fine restaurant to which it was compared by another reviewer).
The True Lime 10.7oz Shaker is perfect.  The taste is identical to fresh lime.Try dissolving first into a small amount of warm water before adding to a cold beverage.

column9: Big flavor, little calories, no added sugar!
column10: Sprinkled on sliced apples, mixed with water, or just a pinch straight up, True Lime is a tasty, healthy alternative.  Highly recommend for those trying to watch (but not eliminate) their carbs.
We were very surprised that this stuff existed, but have used it in lots of places.  It's great to add to soda or in your cooking.  100% recommend it.

This product (and True Lemon) are fabulous. They give you a real lime taste, unlike lime juice from the grocery store and leave out the bitterness that you get when you using a fresh lime. I use it in water and drinks, I use it to sprinkle on top of tacos and soup. It is a must have seasoning in my pantry, as well as True Lemon.

column9: Just what I was looking for!
column10: I do quite a bit of Mexican cooking and limes are not always available, plus I never know when I will need one.  When I found this dried lime I thought I would give it a try.It is great.  Easy to use and always on hand.  Takes a very small amount to add the finishing touch to a lot of Latin recipies and others as well.  Showed this to my friend in Australia and she ordered some too.  Plus some of the Real Lemon as well.If you need the flavor of fresh limes and don't want to keep them on hand.  Try this True Lime Shaker.  I would/recommend it to anyone, it's the perfect solution.

True Lime has the flavor of fresh lime juice and when dissolved with a little water can be used 1:1 for the fresh juice. This is actually more covenant than fresh as it keeps well (just keep the humidity out of it!) and transports easier. If you purchase the packets of True Lime, it goes where ever you go; and for men, just put a couple of packets in your wallet and go!

When I stopped drinking diet sodas, I really didn't like substituting water. However, a friend introduced me to True Lime packets, and I started using them. It made all the difference in the world. I now enjoy water! When I found the Shakers on Amazon, I started ordering them. I keep a large gallon container of water with True Lime in my refrigerator at all times. My guests also love the flavoring and a side benefit is that it is healthy. For me, water is now a pleasure to drink due to True Lime. The amount I use is geared to my taste. That is one of the benefits of using the Shaker,you are able to use measuring spoons.

Excellent economical product for a summer or anytime drink.Half gallon water1.5 teaspoons true Lime.i teaspoon stevia powder..Try mixing in a little water then add to the rest.Its a really good drink.Experiment for sweeter if you like.the True Lemon was kind of bitter to my taste.

I am such a fan of the peanut butter snickers that were around in the 90's but the new snickers peanut butter squared just isn't the same. (I think it's the ratio of peanut butter to chocolate) Anyway these little santas are spot on. If you enjoyed the snickers peanut butter eggs that were out this past Easter you'll love these!

Another hit for me from Red Leaf!  Red Leaf is a great vendor that supplies a premium product at reasonable prices.  This is a delicious matcha that goes incredibly well in my morning smoothies!  This is a great sweet matcha that is enjoyable both cold and hot!  If you're looking for a matcha that will add some fruity kick to your day - this is it :)

Simply follow the directions on the box, drink it at night, and it will work the morning after you drink it. Sometimes, you may feel some slight cramping, but then you know it is working. However, it is not good to use daily as your body will come to rely on it. Use sparingly and you will be pleased.

column9: This Product works So BUY IT.
column10: The title says it all. Before I bought this product, I honestly didn't think it would work but I said hey I would give it a try since other people gave it good reviews on Amazon. I picked it up at my local grocery store. The tea taste REALLY good. It is just a regular tasting mint tea. The box says the product works in 6-8 hours. I found this NOT to be true but the product DOES work. I took the tea at around 4pm in the afternoon (although it tells you to take it at bedtime) and for me It didn't work until around 9am the next day. So for me it took around 17 hours to work but it will probably be different for everybody. Just make sure you have access to a toilet. You may or may not experience some "SLIGHT" cramping for an hour before of after your restroom break. Notice I said Slight not horrible or unbearable. This tea is in my opinion better than OTC products such as Miralax. Like I said I highly recommend this product because let's face it I wouldn't waste my time writing a review for a product that I didn't either really like or really hate. You can order it at Amazon or pick it up at Walmart or Meijer.

column9: Great product  - works well and pleasant tasting
column10: This product is marvellous. It works well and tastes good as well. Very well priced.

I recently gave up red meat and it caused me to skip almost 3 days before I could go... Anyway, this tea is amazing. I am not sure if that is a good thing or a bad thing but in any case, it works! I have also tried the Detox tea and it does the same for me. I just prefer the taste of this tea better. Great purchase! Way less expensive on Amazon than in the local stores. About a 40% savings.
I have chronic constipation and this tea is a life saver! One cup in the morning with a little lemon juice squeezed in it does the trick. I only wish I had tried this product earlier!

I love the entire YOGI TEA line. What ever it says on the package is exactly what it does and you can trust in that. This tea is no different. What is different is how great it tastes. When its time for the effects to kick in its natural and not crampy like many I have tried in the past. This is a pain free tasty solution to getting regular :-)

This tea definitely works. I have frequent problems with irregularity, bloating, and constipation and this tea worked overnight. It definitely gets things moving. I even felt like I had a "skinny" day the next day! i LOVE Yogi teas. They taste great too!

I was never a tea drinker so it took some getting used to at first, but the yogi "get regular" tea really works... just once before bedtime works for me!  I've even eaten loads of vegetables, exercised, drank lots of water, etc. trying to "get regular" and this tea does the trick... Amazon has the best price on these teas. OOOXXX

column9: It works in a gentle way....I'm switching
column10: I have been using different supplements and medications to keep myself regular throughout my life.  Some over the counter medications are very harsh, they sometimes make you want to go at the time you are not supposed to.  Some would give me terrible cramping and keep me in the restroom for a long time.I was using some natural supplement capsules before I discovered Yogi.  The capsules worked fine but are more expensive than Yogi taa.  Yogi gives me the predictable results the next morning.  I usually bring a few my favorite tea bags for a trip.  Now I bring a couple of this Yogi tea bags in case I get irregular during the trip.

I was previously using Kleritea which was recommended by a pharmacist. Kleritea worked but was expensive and did not taste good. I decided to try this tea by Yogi since it is more reasonably priced. It works just as well as Kleritea and tastes much better! I recommend it...it does the trick.

This stuff works, it does what it's supposed to do within 8-12 hours for me. It tastes really good, just like slightly sweetened peppermint tea, it goes down easy and things come out easy. Amazon also has it for a great price, all the local stores in my area sell it for around $6 or $7 a box so getting 6 boxes for under $15 is a total steal.

column9: the get regular version is nice!
column10: this to me is more of a stool softner i cant describe it any other way. i drink one each day and i go twice a day now and i feel better all around.

column9: I don't really like the taste of it, but works.
column10: I like the taste and flavor of Yogi teas but this is not one of them.It definitely causes me pretty bad cramping but finally gets the results. I do not think I will be using it on regular basis, rather use Miralax with a lot less discomfort and good results.
My poor mother has struggled with irregularity all her life. This tea gives her natural relief within 24 hours. You have to like anise, or the smell may bother you.

I got this laxative tea for a cleanse I was going on. I chose it over the other main brand Traditional Medicinals Organic Smooth Move Herbal Stimulant Laxative Tea, 16-Count Wrapped Tea Bags (Pack of 6) because, though the ingredients are mainly the same, the other tea contained fennel which I can't stand. This tea tastes fine. I don't like mint flavoring, and you can taste the mint, but it is subdued. I even drank this tea for pleasure once on a cold day when I had nothing else warm and calorie-free in the house.This tea definitely performs the stated purpose. It does get things moving. The active herb is senna, which contracts your digestive muscles to get things out. I find it causes me to cramp just a little too much, however I'll happily take a natural remedy to constipation that makes me cramp if it means I don't have to put the totally bizarre ingredients in over-the-counter laxatives in my body. Overall I'd definitely recommend it.
My wife had problems with constipation in the past.  When she started using "Yogi Get Regular" tea, her problem was solved with pleasent results.

I have been using this tea for irregularity a few times a week.  I find the taste to be palatable and can drink a cup in the evening.  It does not work as well when taken in the morning so I recommend only in the evening. You need to experiment regarding how many tea bags to use and how long to steep the tea.I recommend this tea as it works.

My mom uses this tea daily to alleviate surgical complications that have left her with digestion problems and swears that it's the only product, medicinal or herbal, that's ever worked. However, in this order, it was packed with one box of the 'Fasting' tea. So, the Yogi product is still wonderful, whoever packed the shipment, not so much...
Great price! Warm, comforting taste. And, it works gently and thoroughly. I love the Yogi Teas. I think they're well formulated, and mostly tasty to boot.

I started a new high protein diet and have been less regular than usual, and was getting bloated from all the waste building up. I decided to try this as a "natural" way to deal with this issue. I drank one cup last night at about 9pm. This morning when I got up around 6:30, I had moderate stomach cramping. It was a strange feeling and I know now from reading that senna products can cause this. Anyhow, about an hour or so after getting up I had a "soft stool" and thought that was it. However, I have had continuing mild stomach cramping along with diarrhea a few times since that first BM (its about noon now). Anyways I suppose the tea did it's job as I am definitely getting "cleaned out" - its just a bit more uncomfortable than I was hoping for. Perhaps I am just more sensitive to senna?The tea tastes great though, just like normal peppermint tea. I will probably continue to use this occasionally in the future, knowing that the following day might be uncomfortable and just planning for plenty of toilet access!
The tea arrived on time and even earlier than expected.  The tea is great to regulate the digestive tract and it is strong, so be careful.  The deal on amazon was great for the money!

This tea is very effective for constipation.  It usually works for me within 12 hours of taking it.  However, the issues I have with this tea is that it causes major cramping and the taste is awful....but, I will continue to use it because it works so well.
No bitter after taste, not too fruity so you can drink 5 cups a day. like all tea it helps with my weight control, i can't eat when i'm drinking :).

I felt literally poisoned by this tea. I made it extremely weak and I was still terrified that if I went to sleep the night I drank it, I would not wake up.I threw up an hour or so after drinking it.I went to sleep sweating and shaking.I slept 14 hours straight.I felt ill the next day. Not just my bowels, but my entire body including my brain.I was unable to leave the house for the next 24 hours because I could not stay out of the bathroom for over 30 minutes.One star for relieving my constipation!Try some wheat grass or something like that. I hope you find this helpful.

I love that I can buy this product on Amazon!  It is delicious, and very addicting.  Use it once and you will be trying to figure out what else you can use it on.  No grillmaster should be without it.
Not really much to explain, whatever the special ingredients are work perfectly together. I have never found a better steak marinade!
Im not crazy about salmon. This product totally improves the flavor and makes it a delite to eat. I strongly recommend it.
Good quality, mild lentil style bean. cooks quickly not as strongly flavored as urdh  which is one of our favorites. Soup, bean burgers, ethnic dishes.  High protein.
Spicy World Masoor Dal (Indian Red Lentils) 4 poundsItem arrived exactly as described packed very well. Just what I had hoped for. Would definitely recommend to a friend
I prefer these to the darker lentil - tastes wonderful and is quick and easy.  I recommend it for a great bean to add to your diet and health.

I was tired of paying $$$ for dal at my local "gourmet" grocery and too home-bound to travel up to the Indian part of town, so I bought these online. Later discovered the same lentils much more reasonably priced in the aisle with the Mexican food.
I don't know that much about lentils, but these do not taste like the ones I used to buy in India and Mauritius, so I'm disappointed.

column9: Some of the most naturally flavorful coffee beans you've ever tried!
column10: Philz carefully selected blends of high quality coffee beans are spectacular.  Until my first trip to one of their retail locations I had no concept of just how complex the subtle flavors and differences existed within drip coffee.  Their well-roasted, and creatively blended coffee beans have changed all that.  The range of naturally occurring flavors from blend to blend is unbelievable.

column9: My favorite coffee, bold and full of flavor
column10: Sumatra has a full, syrupy body with virtually no acidity - so the coffee's intensity lingers in your mouth. The concentrated spicy, herbal notes and earthy aroma are the telltale signatures of this well-loved coffee. This is by far the best cup of coffee that I have found so far.

I took a chance and ordered the two 4.5 lb. bags of the Albanese brand since the price was considerably lower than others. They arrived soft and fresh, and I'm very happy with the product.If you've never tried peach rings, I'll try to describe them. They have a melt-in-your-mouth sugary coating which gives way to the sour tart peach flavor of the candy. These are actually a bit more tart than others I've tried, but I like that.

column9: Not a peach ring, but rather a rubber jelly.
column10: This ring didn't taste like a peach ring at all.Rather, it was probably the worst jelly I have had in my entire life.Though for those who hates sweetness might find this jelly tasty, I stronglydiscourage anyone who tries to buy this yucky stuff.

column9: Always A Tasty Treat, even throughout the years
column10: Needless to say, when i saw these, i instantly started remembering the gummi peach rings the local pizza polar had for 0.50 when i was a young boy, and even more-so when i tasted them for the first time in years, i even gave the other bag to my one of cousins, and i must say, thats the first time in many years i think he's had a happy thought about his childhood,(i think i even saw a small tear in his eye) almost as if it brought back some of his innocence and happiness of youth, before the breakups of girls past, broken hearts and deadlines, before the hassle and worry of everyday life, back when you could see people outside and a $25 spot gave you a full tank of gas, back when hard work got you somewhere good,  back when no one had to worry about lead painted toys from china or terrorist attacks on the news or the TSA frisking and slowing you down, Back when you could walk around with a smile on your face . . .Its always that sweet gummie and peach taste that makes me miss the old days past

Sorry, but it does not pass my taste test. I've always liked the Haribo brand gummies, but the Albanese brand just does not cut it. The peach flavor of these gummies is the wrong type, in addition it is not sour enough (not sour at all for my taste). I wish the company can send me some citric acid to add to these gummies.
This may be the best candy I've ever had.  If you went to a candy store at the mall and bought 9 pounds of these...you'd spend nearly $100

column9: Better Than Other Gummi Rings - Juicy Peach Flavor
column10: I am so in love with Albanese Gummi Bears.  The consistency is not too soft and not too hard.  So, I decided to try the Albanese Gummi Rings in Peach for a change.  The consistency is quite gummi and not like a fruit slice, but the flavor just was not what I expected.  They are a tad bit softer than a gummi bear.  I expected a fresh taste like a juicy peach right off the tree.  There is definitely a peach taste, but not a fresh real peach taste.  It is not horrible and I enjoyed them to some extent.  Two gummies at a time were enough, any more and it was too much.  I suppose calorie wise, that is a good thing.I'm going to give these four stars as I do like them, but probably would not buy them again.  I can see other people enjoying these more than me.  I think really that it is a consistency thing.  To compare this to other types of gummi rings, I would say these are definitely better.  If you are a gummi ring lover, I would say that you would enjoy this candy.  The price is phenomenal.  You get two bags of 4.5 pounds each for a total of nine pounds!  That's a lot of candy.  I always have candy out in pretty clear containers at my home so that my friends will feel comfortable taking what they want.  My guests really enjoyed these rings and my stash went very quickly.The gummy rings were shipped in perfect condition and there was no melting and I am in Florida.  They were a bit warm, but they quickly come to room temperature and are perfect.These would be cute for wedding treats and a candy bar too. This is a candy everyone can enjoy, young and old!
I purchase these for my boyfriend, he absolutely LOVES them.  Not to mention, he's crazy about having a bulk supply on hand, lol.  Amazon rocks!
Lots of candy to enjoy at a low price. I found myself with no candy rather quickly. Absolutely nothing to complain about.
These peach rings are pretty decent. The flavor is a bit too sweet, but overall OK.Sadly, these were not sour as I had thought they were.

column9: MY SON SAYS THESE ARE THE BEST PEACH RINGS!
column10: I bought these for my son.  I admit I also ate some and they are so flavorful. They have just a little tartness to them but not too much for me. I really like them too.  He ate them up pretty fast although not as fast as the gummi bears.  He has requested I order more of these now though  instead of gummi bears. Fewer of these seem to satisfy. They were very fresh as well. I am happy with the seller.

Our family buys these gummi rings all the time, and now we have gotten our friends hooked on them, too!  First, the quality is amazing.  We actually took a trip and visited the Albanese Factory where these rings are made.  All of their products and flavors live up to expectations.  Also, the variety of flavors is awesome.  My favorite is the peach, because it reminds me of being on some tropical island.  When I'm craving something sweet I can pop one or two of these and be satisfied rather than go through a whole package of M&Ms.  The value is unbeatable.  I tried pricing these rings or similar kinds at those candy bins at the mall or even at the grocery store.  You get so many and they keep very well in zip-lock bags.  Our family keeps coming back for more!!

What makes Albanese gummis extra good is their softness and absolutely genuine fruit taste. The peach gummis are the best in my opinion. The only gummi better is the Haribo Peach Gummi. I couldn't give this one 4 1/2 so I gave it 5 stars.

We had the pleasure of hosting an exchange student from Aragon, Spain last year. One of the many wonderful, small pleasures he brought to our lives were these Christmastime confections from Spain.They seem incredibly simple to make: confectioner's sugar, ground and chopped almonds, cinnamon, lard and flour mixed and baked in small ovals and rolled in more sugar and cinnamon when warm. Yet I have used every recipe I can find and nothing compares to these amazing treats. La Estepena is the Spainish company that bakes them, they are imported and sold in the US by La Tienda.We were so lucky to get two large boxes in early December--but we went through them in less than a week! We ordered two more from La Tienda and they arrived before the holiday.If you can imagine eating something that is crumbly, sweet, crisp and nutty and so incredibly rich that you must stop at three cookies, order these. La Tienda's stock is fresh and arrives in excellent condition.

The ingredients listed by amazon are inaccurate.The number one ingredient on the product I received was "Invert Sugar"; Amazon is currently listing "Organic Sugar" as the number one ingredient.From my label:Ingredients: Oganic Invert Sugar, Oganic Cocoa, Water, Oganic Vanilla Extract, Salt, Xantham Gum.According to Wiki (so it must be true) Invert Sugar is: "a mixture of glucose and fructose; it is obtained by splitting sucrose into these two components. Compared with its precursor, sucrose, inverted sugar is sweeter"As I was most concerned with the "Fructose" in the High Fructose Corn Syrup alternatives I was very sorry to see that the number one ingredient contains fructose.Regardless of the ingredients my main concern with this product is that it just does not taste "right". It's not exactly bad tasting but in chocolate flavor is somewhat light and there is a weird taste that reminds me more of ovaltine or maybe molasses.I'm not sure what I'm going to do with six bottles of this stuff. Right now it is the chocolate syrup of last resort when we run out of our sugar cane juice powered organic chocolate milk.Why the 3 stars if I'm so unhappy with the syrup? Tastes are subjective, not everyone is concerned about fructose consumption and bravo to Santa Cruz for making one of the few organic chocolate syrups.

column9: No High Fructose Syrup - Best Tasting Syrup
column10: I have searched for tasty chocolate syrup made WITHOUT High Fructose Corn Syrup and this is without a doubt the BEST tasting syrup available.  Made with all natural ingredients, I feel good making chocolate milk, or hot cocoa with this product for my son.

Our family started using this product because we were tired of using chocolate sauce with all sorts of artificial ingredients and high fructose corn-syrup.  This tastes great and we don't feel like we are ingesting a science experiment full of ingredients that we can't pronounce.
Kids love to use this to make chocolate milk. It tends to be on the thick side if you are used to a Hershey's like consistency. Also wonderful on ice cream.

I ordered this chocolate syrup to share with a neighbor, we order a ton of stuff off Amazon. For some reason my order did not ship for 7 days and I am on the Prime 2 day shipping. I called to find out what the deal was and was told they could not ship the product as it was close to expiration, it would ship when the fresh syrup came in a few days from the Vendor. I am very happy that Amazon is getting better at not shipping grocery items that are about to expire. I previously received 9 bags of organic corn chips that were close to expiration and after complaining they promptly refunded my money. I would rather wait  than to receive bulk groceries you can not possibly use before the expiration date as that defeats the purpose of bulk buying. Amazon is a top notch online way to shop for low sodium and organic foods for those of us living in rural areas. I am pretty impressed and I order here constantly. I will review the product for taste as soon as I get the shipment, but I will say all the Santa Cruz products I have tried so far have been excellent quality.

This product is way too pricey to have so little chocolate taste. The predominate flavor is grape which isn't on the list of ingredients. Unless invert sugar is derived from grapes?? Definitely not recommended.
I loved this gummy. I had bout the green one ..Very tasty and delicious! I would buy it again. Thanks!

column9: Thank YOU, Elastijoint! (Cue studio audience applause)
column10: Don't look for this to work right away.  It was a couple weeks before I really noticed any difference. Definitely gave me a leg-up (no pun intended) when I had knee trouble.I've tried both flavors and unless your base for comparison is sodas or sugary-sweet drinks, both are far from terrible.  The taste is better than any other supplements I've ever had to choke down.Excellent product.

I have been popping Vicodin like candy to alleviate some of the pain in my knees, hips and ankles after a long day.  Carrying too much weight, a family history of osteoarthritis and a year old knee injury, there are days I ache so much I am in tears.  Since I started taking the ElastiJoint three days ago, I am down to 1-2 vicodin daily and the only pain I have felt is in my old injury.  My other joints have been stronger and much less painful, despite that I have been running around town the last couple of days getting kids ready for school and whatnot.

In theory the product is excellent for those with joint trouble.I have been taking Optimum Nutrition's Glucosamine + CSA for years now and wanted to give something else a try.  I tried it for a month and can not say that this product is any better or any worse than the Optimum Nutrition product I've been taking.It was however more expensive on a per serving basis and it DID NOT mix well in a shaker cup.  In fairness, the label says to mix it with room temperature water and NOT TO USE A SHAKER CUP.  I tried mixing with a spoon but that was just laughable.In cold water the taste was actually pretty good, but in room temperature water (as the label recommends) it tasted terrible.I would never ding a product because of taste (unless it was totally unpalatable), and I am not saying this is necessarily a bad product.  For me it was simply not a good value when compared to other options available and I did not experience a benefit to justify the increase in price over those other options.

I've been taking this for about two weeks now and I can feel a difference in my knee joints.  I wore my knees out running too much and ever since my knees have been achy.  Since drinking this the pain in my knees has subsided a lot although it is not completely gone, so elastijoint definitely helps.  As for the flavor, it doesn't taste good but after the first two times it's not horrible either.  It tastes like grape flavored cough syrup or bitter jello mix.  Just a really strong artificial grape flavor and medicinal flavor.  I make three servings at a time and chill it so it's easier to drink and the flavor is milder.  If it were a pill I would give it five stars but since it doesn't taste great and I have to blend it I give it four.
My husband had knee surgery and has been taking this product since and feels it has helped make his recovery much easier and his knee much stronger.
I definitely noticed an improvement in my joints, but the taste is horrible.  For that reason alone it gets only 3 stars.

Very surprise about this product! During the first week of taking this product, all my joint pain have deceased alot. I started exercising again without the soreness. I will reorder this product. Definitely!!

I have been purchasing there products for 2-3 years now. Not always, but sometimes the box contains bugs inside the bones, that make my dog sick. After further examination it seems the bugs come inside hte box. Today I opened a new one only to find it full of bugs to, I threw them all away and probably wont purchase again. I dont urge you to stop buying the product but rather check it thoroughly before giving it to your dog. If it does contain bugs contact the company and tell them where you bought it.
Last shipment was full of bugs.  Not getting any more.  Maybe I was just unlucky but there was no excuse for this.

column9: Medium Sized Treat, Big Yummy Taste
column10: Milkbone Original Crunchy Treats / B000EBKSCUMy puppy just loves these Milkbone treats. Though the box says "Great for Training", they are a bit too big for proper treat training (which involves slicing the treats very thinly so that the dog doesn't get satiated or fattened up) because the treats are very hard and cannot be easily sliced into smaller pieces.However, they are uniquely good for training "Leave It!" - I can drop it on the floor and the puppy immediately notices the smell and comes over to investigate. And if he decides to ignore my "Leave It!" command, the treat is big enough and hard enough that it survives in his mouth long enough for my to reach in and grab it and start over - no rewards for ignoring "Leave It!", or he'll ignore it always. After only a few weeks of training, "Leave It!" is well-understood and almost always obeyed, thanks to these yummy Milkbones.Also, since these are larger and more satisfying that his usual treats, he also gets these at crate time. When Mommy says "Crate!" that means he snuggles into his crate and waits anxiously for his Milkbone treats. He absolutely adores them, and loves gobbling them up happily.These came carefully packed from Amazon with no shipping problems. The bulk price on Amazon is much cheaper than anything I've found locally and much more convenient.~ Ana Mardoll

My Border Collie mix 7 month old puppy loved these treats. I used them for training and playing games with my puppy like "find the treat". I would order these again but I've switched my pup to Pup Corn treats made locally, cheaper and healthier too but still eats milk bone biscuits. The free I.d tag is promotional is a pretty good deal and I plan to order Oreo one.

column9: My dog never tires of eating these treats...
column10: This pack of six boxes is a great bargain.  Although I've been trying to buy more nutritional and healthy treats, I still keep a stash of these because my dog likes them.  I would be happier though if the manufacturer didn't use artificial coloring, and I'm somewhat suspicious of the little pieces of hair I've seen embedded in the "marrow" part.  I haven't seen any bugs that other reviewers have mentioned.

This is the only dog treat that my Cocker Spaniel enjoys.  My local vendor does not do a good job keeping this item in stock so I was very happy to be able to buy a case of them so that my four legged friend will have the treats she deserves.

These are nice, small treats that my dog enjoys very much. Only reason that it gets 4 stars rather than 5 is because of the "great for training" call on the box. As one reviewer already said, these really aren't very good for training. They are too big to work well - the dog looses focus and they are too crunch to cut up and use in smaller bits. However, with that being said, my dog loves these! I'll continue to pick them up as general treats or as a big treat at the end of a training session.

Our dogs love the basted gravy bones by milkbone.  The only problem is they are not readily available to buy in the stores!  Most biscuits they eat leave little "land mines" all over the carpet.  Not these bones, I don't think the crumbs even hit the ground before they are lapped back up by our Boxer and Parsons' Russell!
I got this for my yorkie-poo puppy at target and my puppy hates them! Another con is that every time my puppy ate one she threw up! I will never give these to my puppy again.

column9: Milk-Bone Original Biscuts for puppies Cavalier King Charles
column10: We have two King Charles Cavalier Puppies that are the best behaved puppies we have ever seen, so I tend to want to reward them more than I should.  I found other rewards gave them loose stools and did not last.  The Milk-Bone Puppies are perfect so we got the automatic ship and it works perfect.

My Yorkies love these treats.  They are the perfect size for smaller breeds, and the crunchiness helps to reduce tartar.  Apparently they taste pretty good, too, as they will all do just about anything to get some!  The boxes arrived well packaged.
Great offer- bulk dog treats for a decent price.  Others reported bugs in the boxes, but these were clean.

We got these for my fiances lab (my lab too thru him) and we use them as occasional treats and for training purposes. For some reason, I thought they'd be bigger than they were, but I'm okay with the size that they are. I read that some people had bugs in their boxes, no bugs here!! Thank goodness!! She likes these treats, but she also eats deer poop in the backyard and anything on the floor, sooo I can't guarantee that the taste is great, but if she eats them, then that's all that matters! LoL. As humans, we'll never know, and I'm not trying them!
With the subscribe and save option these are MUCH cheaper per box then my local stores. I did open the box to discover the flavor treats, but my puppy isn't complaining a bit!! ;)

column9: Can anyone help me find these Milk Bone Biscuits
column10: I am desperatey trying to find Milk Bone Chicken&Rice Biscuits for All Size Dogs.  There is a picture of a Cocker on the box and the biscuits are shaped like a chicken drumstick--they are hard rather than soft.  For years I have been able to find this product at my local Target or Kroger stores, but not now.  My little Sophie is almost 15 and just loves these treats.  If you can help, please let me know.
My dogs just love these bones.  This was such a great deal compared to the cost in the grocery store that I just couldn't pass it up!  I highly recommend this vendor and product!

column4: My 2 Cents "A penny for your thoughts"
column10: I've never found a dog biscuit my little Maltese likes so I knew I was taking a chance. Still,  I'm VERY disappointed that there are no returns for the 11 unopened boxes.  I wouldn't try them if you have a finicky dog or a small eater. They are bland. There's no tasty smell, I mean nothing. The cardboard box smells as appetizing. I realize my dog is hard to please so I won't blame it all on MilkBone. He's not a big eater and has never been a chewer (never chewed on furniture, shoes etc) so although he won't grab ANY bone, he does enjoy them. Most beef bones are too large but he crunches lamb or pork rib bones up completely.  There must be SOME kind of biscuit to keep a small eater's teeth healthy.
Lucky, our St Bernard, loves these treats.  While they are a little smaller than his "good boy" Extra Large Milk Bones, the Gravy Bones provide him a little variety and there are never any crumbs!
These biscuits have bran in them and seem to keep our dog regular.  Just make sure that your dog has plenty of water to drink with them.  Buying in bulk from Amazon saves us money.

column9: Tasty Treat For MY Little One
column10: This is a tasty treat for my little guy.  He is a Brussels Griffon and weighs in at 8.5 lbs.  They are perfect size for his little mouth.  He enjoy's them daily as a reward and a special treat.

column9: The only treat my pup wants
column10: This small treat became the only treat my cocker/springer would eat.  She will refuse others.  I sure hope it never goes out of production.
Based on the reviews, I will not even buy this on-line.  Amazon - would do you continue to sell these knowing there is such a problem?

First of all, I have no idea who in their right mind is trying to sell pudding for 22 dollars; I bought this at Walmart for 1 dollar.Second of all, there is nothing new about this product. I don't know what I was expecting for it to taste like, but basically it's chocolate-vanilla-chocolate pudding.
I found these candies to be both tasty and refreshing.  Quite the step above "Good N' Plenty" candies which I also enjoy.  The licorice taste is excellent.

I normally buy Mee Chun fermented black beans from a local store (a tiny family run placed called "Nak's Oriental Market" in Menlo Park by Oak Grove). Those have a wonderful strong flavor and nice texture. I thought these would be similar. They are not. They are also NOT like in the photo.The photo makes them look just like Mee Chun beans, but they are not like those beans. They are dryer and lack the flavor of Mee Chun. These are not as salty as Mee Chun, but they do not add to a dish at all. In fact, they detract from it. If anything, the flavor of these is a bad flavor.The little market (Nak's) I go to normally has 8 oz Mee Chun for less than $1 each package (it even used to be $0.69 per 8 oz), but it is not close to me now, so I ordered these from Amazon because all Amazon vendors of Mee Chun charge an absurdly high amount for Mee Chun.Back to Nak's for me. It is worth the trip to get the real deal. I do not recommend these at all.

Love this coffee!  My wife's sister sent us Highlander Grogg from a different coffee company (she lives in St Louis, and we are in VA), and I loved it.  When it ran out, I had to find a replacement, and this turned out to be the perfect answer.  Great flavor, good price.  Definitely recommend it.
I have been trying several different coffees, thus far this is the best one I have had.

My husband and I love Highlander Grogg and have been drinking it for years.  However, we have trouble finding it locally so placed an automatic ship order for these beans.  We have received 3-4 shipments now.  At first, we found its flavor good for the price.  However, this last shipment was completly lacking any of the Grogg flavor, just tastes like strong coffee.  I'm not sure if it's sitting on a shelf somewhere too long, but we are cancelling our order and trying something else.

This coffee is tolerable, but not a true "highlander grogg". Another reviewer compared it to Kaldi's in St. Louis, which I think is the best Grogg out there, and I have to say I tried this brand based on that review. Boy was I wrong to do that! This is nothing like Kaldi's, and is at best, an imitation of even a mediocre Grogg.

Spent more and purchased this because of glowing reviews.  Drinkable only if you use a lot of flavored creamer.  Best results for me come from Irish Cream or Creme Brule creamer flavors.  I won't serve this to company.

My wife and I were looking forward to a great cup of Highlander Grogg after all the great reviews, however, the flavor of this coffee was very disappointing. I have been drinking various Highlander Grogg coffees since the early nineties and this is not it. The HG I have come to know has a very recognizable caramel-butterscotch-rum-nutty flavor. The coffee beans are over-roasted and taste like burnt nuts with not a hint of the other before-mentioned flavors. I was also disappointed with Coffee Bean Direct's version of HG. So far, only Grounds For Coffee and Cameron have the right recipe. We would have given it another star had we enjoyed drinking it even a little bit. The search goes on.
