My husband is the coffee lover in our family, and he ordinarily doesn't care for flavored coffee. I'm just an occasional coffee drinker. When I read the description and other very positive reviews of this coffee, I thought we'd give it a try and am so glad we did. We absolutely love it. The beans as beautiful and glossy when you open the package. The aroma when grinding the beans is fantastic. As other reviewers stated, the flavor holds up to brewing; this is one of the few coffees we've tried that tastes as good as it smells. Guests in our home have raved about this coffee and we have been asked repeatedly where it was purchased. The price with Subscribe & Save is close to what we'd pay in the grocery store for beans of lesser quality. We are repeat customers, and I suspect we will be for a very long time.
this is wonderful coffee and all we drink now, more expensive than basic coffee but way worth it. It comes quickly in the mail with free shipping from Amazon

These are out of this world.  A welcome treat everyday!  Best 120 calorie snack out there, by far!  Hard to just eat one pouch...but the convenience of small packages help with portion control!  I'm not on a diet....but these are my splurge every day to help maintain my weight and still get my chocolate fix!
I love these low calorie snacks. I count calories and these are so delicious they are great for that 3p snack.

These are awesome!  It's a challenge to not tear open a 2nd pouch!  Each serving/pouch is 120 calories & worth every one!  Contains 9 grams of sugar and they taste very sweet. I've never done Weight Watchers, but the box says they are 2 points.  They remind me of 100 Grand candy bar because of the crispies & caramel -  but not as "dense". So far, Skinny Cow items are impressive (I've tried the ice cream cones in mint & chocolate - awesome too).  And Skinny Cow items supposedly contain fiber - these dreamy clusters contain 3 grams of fiber.

The clusters are my favorite treat.  I have been counting calories for close to a year and these are my savior.  I love candy bars but average sized ones are usually 300-400 calories or more.  These satisfy that same craving at 120 calories.  They are sweet, crunchy, chewy and even a little salty.  The portion is just right. One of these a day keeps me on track- totally worth $3.50 a week any way you look at it.
They arrived in good shape.  Tasted fresh and very yummy.  Love the small packs so I'm not tempted to have more.

My only complaint about these is how small the packages are. These are incredible and I am waiting for the 240 calorie packages! In all seriousness I buy these almost every time I go to the grocery store and they are the perfect little treat after a meal or after my kids go to sleep.
My co-worker let me try these today and they taste just like Turtles! I couldn't believe how delicious they were. They are little bite-sized Turtles.

I'm a chocoholic, but am very picky when it comes to my sweets.  I love these SKINNY COW CLUSTERS, which were created to be similar to a turtle without the nuts.  Since I'm not a fan of nuts in my candy, the crisped rice that is used as a substitute for pecans, is a welcome addition.  The candy is sweet, without being overly sugary and the milk chocolate has a nice smooth flavor to it.  The only reason I am giving this 4 stars instead of five is that I wish there were more than 6 packages in each box.  While one package is meant to be one serving, it's not unreasonable to eat two packages at a time, which means there are only 3 servings per box.  Making different sizes available (may an "economy" 10 package box?) would be a welcome addition.  Other than that, these are a big hit and come highly recommended for the candy lover or fellow chocoholics out there!

column9: Fast shipping. Exactly as it should be.
column10: Item was in perfect condition, and arrived very quickly. Packaged perfect, exactly as described. Very satisfied. Bought for a school event donation, perfect amount and great container.

If you are a twizzler lover you know the good and the bad.  The bad is that they will get jerky with time.  Not these.  They are individually wrapped for freshness. These are the ones to buy if you are an addict of them.
Yummy twizzlers our favorite red licorice twists all 180 count of them. Great gift to send off to a kid at college too.

column9: Used for a wedding candy bar
column10: Perfect! We love twizzlers and wanted to include some in our wedding "candy bar" (This was where our guests filled some plastic bags with candy, cookies and treats that we provided... sort of like a mini Sweet Factory if you are familiar with that store). We had 150 guests and we offerd 11 different treats on the candy bar table. I bought this trifle bowl for the twizzlers and they fit perfectly:Luigi Bormioli Michelangelo Masterpiece 8-1/2-inch Trifle Bowl with Lid I liked that the twizzlers were individually wrapped, perfect for a self-serve situation! They also arrived in 48 hours and were fresh!

Twizzlers are so much better when they are individually wrapped and this product hits the nail on the head.  It ships fast, stores great anywhere in your house, and is really nice when you get a craving for that red rope like candy!

column9: Wonder if it's really a twirler?
column10: Each licorice is very thin and hard to open.  I wonder if it is really a Twizzzler or some kind of knock-off.
I bought this because of the brand, but they feel very narrow.  Perhaps if you get 1/2 size larger they'll fit better.

When the cashew butter arrived, I was pleased to note that it was made from roasted cashews, because I think roasted nut butters have more flavor.I had looked for nut butters without a lot of additives, so I was concerned to note the additon of corn oil.  But then I realized that without it, the butter would have been so dense I would have had to spread it with a trowel.My first taste dispelled all concerns.  Spread on a rice cake or some toast, this is going to make some late, sleepless nights almost enjoyable.
yummmy.. very good stuff.  I purchased this to make cashew chicken but fear I will have it eaten before I get to it.

The cashew butter arrived very quickly and was super delicious. We ate half of the container in sandwiches and smoothies, and by the spoonful. The rest was used to make delicious flourless cashew cookies. They turned out so yummy, and here is the recipe I made up.  One cup Fastachi Roasted Cashew Butter, one cup organic coconut sugar, one large egg slightly beaten and one teaspoon vanilla extract. Mix well with a mixer or spoon, and place clumps of large walnut size batter on a dark ungreased cookie sheet, leaving a little space between each clump of dough.  Bake for 10 to 12 minutes at 350 degrees (no longer or the bottoms will burn) Remove cookies with a spatula and place on foil or a dinner plate to cool. They are soft and chewy and what a yummy treat they make. The recipe makes about 18 to 20 cookies. You don't have to flatten them to cook them, it's better if they are clumpy. This cashew butter does have little bits of cashew nuts in the butter and is not entirely smooth. It is not real oily and has a "freshly made" taste. It's a little pricey, but I will definitely order again! You can use this recipe with other nut butters and if you like can use regular sugar instead of the coconut sugar (coconut sugar is metabolized slowly, and Amazon sells it too!)

So these are obviously huge! If you like regular smarties, you'll love these. They have a slightly different taste, but they are relatively loyal to to overall smartie flavor and will still bring out smiles :)
FABULOUS, YUMMY AND WOW!!!!! I HAVE ALMOST EATEN THE WHOLE BOX BY MYSELF. WILL NEED TO REORDER SOON!  CAN'T GET ENOUGH OF THEM!!

These are a great gummy candy because their consistency is just right: pleasantly soft, but still chewy. But I'd say they're on the softer end of the gummy spectrum, eg: softer than then those two layer gummy frogs (which I also enjoy). I'd describe the taste, but I can't place it myself. The most specific I can be is to say they have a light fruity sweetness.A fun surprise is that these ones are quite a bit larger than those found in retail stores. I'd estimate the normal ones between one and two inches, but these are a full three and half inches in length.

column9: Absolute YUM and no agave nectar!! PERFECT.
column10: DELICIOUS.  Totally tasty.  These bars are well made, they travel very well, they are not too sweet, and the ingredients are just what they need to be. I'm thrilled that they don't use refined sugar or agave nectar.  Just about everything is (over) sweetened with agave nectar these days and the last thing I need is another high-fructose processed food pretending to be good for you.  Kudos to coconut secret on making a great product.  Turned many people on to them! They should be called Coconut no-longer-a-secret-because-everyone-loves-us.

I love this little pig timer! it is so cute and the timer actually works.  The detail is really nice and is everything as described.  The amazing thing about this order is that I received it very quickly.  I have previously ordered items directly from Collections Etc and it seems to take forever to receive my orders.  However, I don't know if it was just a fluke or because I ordered from Collections Etc THROUGH Amazon but I received the item in just a matter of 2-3 days. I am very pleased with my item and even more pleased with the short time of delivery.  I highly recommend!

I purchased these "Dried Blueberries", but they aren't what I expected. The blueberries are coated with sugar and sunflower oil. They are really chewy.While the price was attractive, I feel this product is mislabeled. It should be labeled, "Candied Dried Blueberries".

Red & black German raspberries are definitely one of my favorite candies. They have a clear chewy gelatinous center that is coated with crunchy red or black sugar spheres. They're very sweet tasting, with a slight flavor of the berry they represent. The black ones are a bit less sweet than the red, with a barely noticeable hint of bitterness.

These are really cute candies. Each drop is wrapped into hundred of crunchy round bits, just like a real berry. Oozing with flavor and enticing aroma. The gummi part is found inside. Although the Haribo bears are my ultimate favorite, I find this one a bit too sweet for the taste.

I have tried Bacon Salt in the BIGS brand Sizzlin' bacon sunflower seeds.  I love this item.  It tastes exactly like the name says.  Bacon flavored salt.  I love both and now I can have them both in 1.

column9: Tastes like someone wanted it to taste like bacon
column10: It's okay, but doesn't capture the actual taste of bacon.  If you like having many spices, this is a good one to add to your rack.

I first heard about Bacon Salt several years ago, and promptly went out to find a bottle.  Since it is a Kosher, vegetarian product, it was a nice fit for me, as I was really trying to eat less meat, and a much lower fat diet.  I eat a little more meat these days, but still prefer the lower-fat option of a sprinkle of Bacon Salt on my turkey sandwich...and my tuna sandwich...and my salad...and my eggs.  Wicked good, and if I hadn't tried it, I wouldn't have believed it.

BaconSalt is exactly what you think it is. It literally makes everything taste better. Try it on anything, it even goes on popcorn! I got it as a gift and I'm going to give it as a gift. Everyone needs to try it, and since there is no fat, no calories and it is kosher, it is for everyone!
Bacon salt? Nah, this isn't it. It's more like jerky seasoning. Not bad but it's got gluten in it so I can't use it. I'm not taking points off for that though, just mentioning it.

I went by the reviews on here and wasn't disappointed. Now I regularly sprinkle this on my eggs, whether they're scrambled, fried, or deviled. It's also good to use as an extra spice on salads, veggie's, and frankly, just about everything!

column9: Only suggests the taste of bacon...
column10: This is a product with a lot of promise - low sodium, no fat, shakes on anything... But it ultimately fallls short. It just does not have  flavor that evokes real bacon. It is a halfway decent general purpose seasoning (think of another take on traditional seasoned salt) but it's a far, far cry from real bacon flavor. I would rank this at about 20% accurate bacon flavor, the venerable artifical bac-o-bits we've all had over the years are just about as authentic tasting, maybe even slightly more. If you can manage to use real bacon bits, there is no comparison. Still, I applaud them for trying, and I'll give any revised formula a try if and when they come out with it.

I have wanted to try Bacon Salt for years.It does not taste like bacon.The tastes are hickory and garlic. The people who created it thought giving it the flavors normally associated with bacon would make it taste like bacon. It doesn't. It makes it taste like bacon seasoning. The flavor is good, it just isn't bacon. The two flavors are ingredients right on the label. Imitation Bacon-Bits have more of a bacon flavor. If they had just added the flavoring from them (even if it made it no longer vegetarian) it would have worked much better.It works better wet. Dry, you can barely taste it. It might make a good steak rub, I didn't try. $5 for the small container isn't bad, however the prices going for the large container are just a ripoff. There is definite salt in this. It's the first ingredient, sea salt, so bear this in mind if you are using it to season something.The flavor is good, I just cannot rate it higher as it does not taste like bacon, what it claims to and is named after.

I purchased 2, 3 ounce containers of flavored salt on September 26. After paying more than $10 to ship $11 worth of merchandise, I AM STILL WAITING. These people do not seem very interested in customer service.

Ok let me start by saying we were intruduced to peachy penguins during the holidays as a gag gift, but now we are addicted. Not only are they gummy and cute( why penguins are peachy I don't know), but so flavorful. OH one or five are not enough. This sellers packs the gummy goodness in 1/2 brick size package and delivers proptly to your home. If you like gummys and you like peach flavor this is for you! yum yum

This is definitely a cute product to order.  You get a nice amount of candy for your money, the candy comes wrapped in a cute bag with a nice sticker on it and it is very fresh.  This makes a cute stocking stuffer for anyone!

column9: A new FAV for my lil man
column10: I noticed these on the shelf at the local baby store and as has become my custom I opened the package and handed one to my son.  This sounds tacky but I will buy it either way I just like to see how he likes a new snack and since its a great way to occupy his attention in the grocery cart, win win win basically.  Anyhow he loves these, there is another flavor too that he loves even more but I do not see them here on Amazon.  My only complaint is that they are way too expensive,  its literally less food than a can of pringles for $9.00 ?!?! thats crazy.  I know its organic but come on people its a rice cake.  I would give 5 stars if it were not so expensive.
You can buy this at the source for 4$ and at other stores for 3-5$' so why is it so much more on amazon???

I bought these while on vacation in Florida at Toys R Us for 3.50. My son LOVES these, but the price on Amazon is ridiculous. I buy all his formula and most of his snacks online (including munchies organic sweet potato puffs = great!) but these are WAY overpriced here. Too bad, I was hoping to order the packs of six like I do for all his other snacks. Product = 5 stars, price on Amazon = 1 star.

column9: 12 cans of pure bright yellow toilet love!
column10: Ever get up in the middle of the night, can't find the light switch, gotta pee but are worried about getting it all over the place?  Yea, well no more!  One can just before bed, and you will be carrying around your own personal firefly juice.Kinda sucks when you miss, but it is easier to clean up in the dark.Keep up the great work Monster!
This snack is interesting and certainly different from the usual. I enjoyed the crunch and the taste ... in fact, I am ordering several packages of it to have on hand.

column9: Oversweet Disappointment.  Not dark at all.  :(  :(  :(
column10: These sounded divine.  I ADORE dark chocolate, and Dove is one of my favorites.  However, these are soooooooo sweet that tiger almost hurt my mouth.  Vague Raspberry taste and much more of a milk chocolate flavor tgan a dark one.  I recommend if you like extra sweet chocolates or if you like milk chocolates.  If you, like me, like wonderful dark chocolate flavors, this will likely disappoint.

Dove's Raspberry Chocolate pairing is just fantastic.  The chocolate is smooth and the raspberry flavor compliments the dark chocolate flavor so well.  I'm not a real dark chocolate fan, but this combo really works!

I love these things, and haven't been able to get them in my local stores anymore.  I was recently diagnosed with high blood pressure and had to cut back on sodium.  One serving (5 pieces--I usually don't eat that many!) only has about 1% of your sodium allowance for the day.  I've had to give up a lot of my favorite treats, so it's great to be able to indulge myself with these.

column9: the best oils for my holiday candy
column10: I have never had such great turnout for my Christmas candy until I  ordered these this holiday season! They are really great and a lot of the people I gave to as gifts commented also!!As long as Amazon can supply me I will get from them!!

My company replaced the Keurig with a Flavia machine. Only good thing about this is that the lines at the machines are empty instead of 2, 3 deep.  Anyhoo---tried the French Vanilla. It's extremely weak and tastes overwhelmingly like coconut for some reason. I like coconut flavored things, but not my coffee.  Tried it twice, weeks apart. Same thing. Not a fluke.
I was anticipating this product would arrive 3 weeks from date of order and it came in almost a week after I placed the order.  Greatly appreciated!

I discovered these yummy chips, they are actual pieces of kale with a yummy coating of vegan cheese and brewer's yeast. I think they may have some added nut protein as well. They are truly delicious you can't eat just one or two bites. The vampire killer leafy kale is also great, really my favorite but you will reek of garlic afterwards. These chips are a really great, guilt-free snack but they are overpriced and that is why they shouldn't get 5 stars but for taste they do.

While I agree with others that making you own is much more cost-effective, sometimes I need a quick, raw snack that I don't have to make myself.  I just found these at my local store for half the price on Amazon- they should be ashamed of themselves charging over $11 for these.  They are seriously yummy though in my opinion.

I was wandering the aisles of my local Wegmans supermarket recently and saw Brad's Raw Leafy Kale--Naked flavor on the shelf. We use fresh kale all the time for our smoothies, but I haven't been able to get myself to eat "raw" kale, like just-picked-from-the-garden-that-we-use-for-our-smoothies kale. So when I saw this "raw" kale snack I thought, they're not really "raw." They are dehydrated (under 115˚F) and seasoned, to make them palatable. And they are DELICIOUS. I love them. I am hooked. They have a slight crunch, but not a chip crunch, more like a firm bite. My kids like the initial taste but don't like the aftertaste. I love the whole thing. The problem is that they only come in a 2.5 ounce clear plastic container (supposedly 2.5 servings), which I can easily eat in one sitting. " If you look at the nutrition facts, you'll notice they're not totally healthy. They have 9 g of fat per serving, or 22.5 g of fat per container, which realistically is what I could eat at a time if I were hungry. They are also a bit pricey (I paid $7.50 for the one package). Surprisingly, Amazon's price is higher, so I'll have to buy them directly from Brad's website, or from Wegmans or Whole Foods. If these were cheaper, I'd buy them all the time. But for now they're more like a "treat myself" kind of snack.

Brad's Raw Leafy Kale Chips are very delicious and even my husband who is fussy liked them.  However, they are so expensive I would not buy them again and will make my own.  Brad would sell a lot more if he came down on his price.  When they are homemade they are very inexpensive.

In order to be a successful chip substitute, kale chips need to have:1) Crunch and/or crispness2) Salty flavor3) Appropriate price for the increase in healthSadly, these "chips" do not meet the standards I've outlined. First, there is so much gunk on them that they aren't even all that crispy. Dried nori is a better solution, which is crispy and crunchy. Secondly, the kale isn't even that salty! Weird, yeasty veggie taste? Check. Salty goodness? No. Well, one can assume then that at LEAST these chips would get the third point right, having the healthy benefits of being kale right? Wrong again! These chips have a surprising amount of calories because, well, of the gunk. Apparently in the gunk is sugar and sunflower seed paste which, not surprisingly, bumps up the calories and sugar content significantly.Are they better than doritos? Yes, but barely and not enough to justify the loss in taste or increase in price. My suggestion is to make your own chips, find another brand that stays more natural, switch to popcorn, or try dried nori as a healthy salty alternative.

All I can say is wow! These kale chips were subpar. I make my own kale chips, and they're not hard to make at all. If you're going to pay $7.99 it should be worth it. They taste horrible. So I give these a big thumbs down.

I'm a gal who LOVES her sweets - and I had one of these babies just early today HOLLA!!  Twix hit a grane slam with this addition to the Twix family.  I remember when the two varieties of Twix were the original caramel and the peanut butter - both featuring the same kind of regular cookie base.That was then and this is now!  These aren't your fathers peanut butter Twix.  With the new kind, you'll find a chocolate cookie base, and the difference is truly impressive.  This is uniquely different Twix flavor - and the spookiest chick around recommends them like nobody's business.  Just don't overdo it or you'll be passing gas more than usual.

Apparently the ORIGINAL Twix Peanut Butter (PB) bar has been discontinued and was replaced with this inferior version (I guess at least a couple of years ago).  Wish I had known that before ordering these bars!  Yet another perfectly GOOD product needlessly messed up by the manufacturer!  This version has a dark chocolate cookie, which I guess is okay; but it does not taste near as good to my tastebuds as the original PB bar with the standard cookie!  I guess I will have to look for something else the next time I get a peanut butter candy/cookie urge that needs satisfying.  Again, for whatever reasons, companies just can never seem to leave well enough alone, go figure?
Got a case of these fit my hubby for Christmas, because I can't usually find them in the stores here West of Atlanta. They are delicious shipping was quick!
The Twix Peanut Butter Cookie Bar is really quite good, but not as good as the Original TWIX COOKIE BAR.
This oil is delicious on salad or cooked. I prefer to use on the salad because you can really taste the basil flavor and it is outstanding. Gives that extra oomph and kick to the taste.

I finally tried the Basil Olive and was disappointed. It had a bitter taste.  I bought the 4 piece sampler from Mantova and was very happy.  I used it on cold pasta and veggies, and bread and all four were delicious. Since I especially liked the basil I ordered the larger bottle. I'm not sure why the larger bottle had a bitter taste. I did use half basil and half a extra light olive oil when I served the samplers, so I'm not sure if that had anything to do with it or not. I'm going to try that and see if it works.  If it does I'll amend my review. If not then I'm afraid I'll have to stick with this one and won't be ordering it again.

This basil-flavored extra virgin olive oil is perfect for my dietary consumption. I only use this product to flavor any food items (e.g., rice, pasta, vegetables) that call for butter, margarine, etc., which are dietary destroyers.

column9: Great product at a good price
column10: This product was just what I was looking for.  I had to satisfy a taste for truffles after vacationing in Tuscany and going through withdrawl.  This truffle cream was great and the price was the best I could find.  It makes a fantastic base for bruschetta when topped with crispy fried fresh sage leaves and pecorino romano cheese.If you love truffles, you'll love this product.  If you haven't tried truffles then don't - because you'll become addicted.I must add a comment regarding the service as well.  In the first shipment I received, one of the jars got broken.  I emailed Amazon's customer service and within an hour I had a reply that they were sending out a replacement that same day.  In a world where customer service can sometimes be non-existant it is worth noting when a company stands behind what they sell and responds so efficiently.  Bravo Amazon.

I bought this since it had some pretty good reviews. I'll keep this short. It's good for cream based sauces and for pasta. The smell is great and very earthy. The paste it self does have it own characteristic flavor. Overall if you want a nice flavor of truffle I suggest buying a high quality white winter truffle oil to finish the dish off with!
I made my own alfredo sauce for the pasta, added a few spoons of this and it tasted heavenly!Even after putting the leftovers in the fridge and reheating in the microwave, it maintains its taste. :)

Delicious truffle cream that is hard to find.  First tasted in Seattle and loved it in soups and sauces.  I put it in fridge after opening and it keeps well. I cook a lot and all my guests have really enjoyed it so far. Highly recommended!

I originally bought a jar of this at a marche' while vacationing in St. Maarten.  I have served it with pasta, with shrimp and chicken.  It is so yummy!  I have used it simply by mixing it with evaporated milk.  I am buying more jars today.  Opened, it kept for one year in my fridge.  I used the last of it tonight.  I woudld say each jar makes enough to sauce 4 large servings.
received 2 pack and seal was broken on 1. one phone call, quick replacement with shipment of 2 more, no problems, very happy w/transaction and seller. Can't wait till my next order arrives.
The best of the best.  Soft, chewy, perfect.  I cannot describe it any better.  I have been searching for these since i found them at hershey park in the summer.  Absolutely love them.

column9: The Best of the Jolly Rancher Candy Line
column10: Im a fan of Candy in general, but these are addictive. I can't get enough of them, they're sweet and tangy, and with a good texture. I was skeptical, but now I'm hooked, ive ordered numerous boxes and keep coming back for more. This is definitely worth a try. Its also a great deal!!! they are usually 1.25 at 7/11.

These candies are okay and definitely appeal to my younger daughter.  The candy has a sour presence and then once you eat the candy, it is sweet.  Nice flavor combination too.  Chewy.  Note:  The initial flavor of the candy has a somewhat odd plasticy(?) taste to it which I attributed to the packaging.  Once you bite into the candy or dissolve the sour crystals on the outside, that taste goes away.  My problem with this product had to do with the delivery.  I ordered a box of 18 individual bags.  The box I received was open (not sealed) and there were only 17 bags of product.  I did not keep the purchase but instead purchased a small bag at my local large retailer and tried them from there.
Good Orgin Moyobamba Peru Coffee was very good.  Would buy again.  Very good taste. Packaged in small packages - that way you don't open too much at a time.

I really like this coffee: it is flavorful, robust yet smooth, and not overpowering.  It's taste is distinctive; it is not overly acidic.  It is a coffee which I actively recommend to my guests, friends and relatives.  I give this coffee a "strong buy."  Whole beans allow me to capture the freshness of this coffee every time I make it.

I think that this Horn and Hardart coffee is a winner. It has all the characteristics that I have sought for coffee: strong, smooth, not acidic.I have compared it with some of my old favorite coffees over the last couple of weeks and I keep coming back to Horn and Hardart. I am going to be enjoying this for a long time. Thanks!

column9: Another great tea from Earth Mama Angel Baby
column10: I love Earth Mama Angel Baby teas.  They have a chart on their boxes telling you if they're safe for nursing and/or expecting mothers.  This tea tastes delicious and it's organic which is another plus.  I drink this whenever I just want to calm down or am not feeling well.  It's supposed to be for Monthly Comfort, but it tastes so good I drink it all of the time.

column9: Could not live without this tea!
column10: I literally could not live without the Monthly Comfort tea. A friend recommended it to me for "the time of the month" and I tried it skeptically - especially as I am not a mother, a soon to be mother, or motherly at all. I start drinking at least a cup of this three to four days before my cycle, and find that most of the monthly annoyance of being a woman subsides. What was a week of unpleasantness, with two days of insomnia because the pain is so bad has no turned into a day or two max of light cramps, with no bloating either.To me it tastes like cinnamon and ginger, with raspberry undertones. It tastes delicious enough that I often have it all month long, not just on my cycle. It's especially pleasant on a chilly morning.I buy this in bulk now, because running out is simply not an option!

I've battled horrific periods for years, especially after the birth of my second child.  I wish I would have known about this many years ago!  This tea is absolutely fantastic.  I typically have issues with gaining upwards of 10 lbs of water weight during my menstrual cycle - not this time.  Cramping is significantly reduced, water weight is non-existent, even my husband commented on my much improved monthly demeanor.The tea is easy to make, though I would certainly recommend steeping for a solid 15 minutes for best results.  I drink two cups of this tea each day (morning and afternoon) starting a few days before my cycle and all the way through.  I do not normally enjoy tea, but I have to say, this is delicious.  I didn't even need to add sugar or other sweetener to mask the taste.I have used most of the Earth Mama tea products, and have been impressed by the high quality, delicious flavors, and natural remedies for my ails.  I highly recommend giving this product a try.
It smells like raspberry and cinnamon and is not too strong. It is great on cold nights to help warm you up.
This tea is wonderful, I'm so glad I received it as a gift when I was pregnant and now I drink it every day.  Incredibly fast and free shipping makes it awesome!

My boyfriend loves white gravy but I have a hard time finding one without trans fat at the grocery store. I found this and thought it would be perfect. It's 20 calories per serving with 0 grams of fat. I gave the him the taste test and he said it's more gooey and less flavorful than normal white gravy. (maybe that's why they pump it with trans fat) I think it could taste a little closer to the original with spices or cream, I just haven't found the right combination yet

I've been using this gravy mix for years, but it's nearly impossible to find it in stores these days. So I was very happy to find it on Amazon (at a great price). In addition to making quick and delicious white gravy, I use it to thicken the broth in my chicken and dumplings... Yum!!

I have to admit that this is a great addition to the kitchen.  My daughter-in-law introduced me to sticky rice.  My wife and I were on vacation at the time and when we got home the first thing I did was look for the tools to make it.  I found this product and am extremely pleased with it.Shipping time was great.  I think it was only about 3 or 4 days for it to come all the way across the country.  Nothing was damaged and nothing was missing.  The aluminum cooker, bamboo basket and cheesecloth were all there along with the bag of rice.  Instructions were included as well.  I think we made our first batch the very next day.  The cheesecloth keeps everything in place and keeps the basket from getting messy.  Cleanup is easy too.If you want to try sticky rice or just need a replacement this will be a great addition.

column9: Excellent product but could get it cheaper at the seller's web.
column10: Excellent product. Remember to soak the sticky rice for at least 4-5 hours. The product could have been purchased through the seller at a cheaper price, but I like Amazon because I could always track my purchases easier.

When I was in college, some missionaries once introduced me to sticky rice balls served with sweetened condensed milk (or hot sauce). I haven't had it since then, until I saw this kit. I have to make it on a day I plan to be home because the rice has to soak for 4-6 hours before it's steamed. And then the rice has to steam for 45 minutes. But the end product is delicious... Enjoy.

I have had a desire for Sticky Rice for many years, ever since my time in South East Asia in the early 60s. Until I came on this product, and the rice from Import Foods, I had almost forgot how it was supposed to taste. This kit brought all the memories back from those days, and the food taste from that region that I really love. I can see no other way to make rice taste like it should.
I love this product and the company.  Shipping was fast.  I had to order from them again.  I received what was pictured.

column9: Easy and tasty way to make sticky rice
column10: My daughter and I love sticky rice.  This kit makes rice that comes out the same texture as the sticky rice we get in restaurants.  There are a lot 'sauce' recipes out there so you can make the rice in this kit and then find a sauce recipe that suits you.I soak the rice overnight or set it in a bowl on the counter when I leave for work.  After the soaking period, it's super simple.  Put it in the basket covered with cheese cloth and let it cook.  That's all there is to it.

This is delicious and easy to cook. My family asks can we have sticky rice often. I make it about once a week. Everything you need comes with the order. Great price. I prefer to cook the rice without the cheesecloth, though the bamboo basket gets a little dirty when you don't use cheesecloth. I do choose to cook without the cheesecloth and it is not hard to clean basket. I assume the cheesecloth is for easier cleanup. I found a sticky rice dipping sauce recipe online and it is so good. Enjoy
the item came quickly and wasn easy to use making great rice.

column9: Twice the price but convenient for travel and back-up
column10: The price on Amazon for these ready to use cans (16 8-ounce cans) fluctuates from 25 to 29 cents per ounce, which is a little more than double what you would pay for the most economical container of powder Enfamil formula (approximately 11 to 13 cents per reconstituted ounce).  Sometimes the convenience is worth the extra money.  Every other evening I mix about 40 ounces of formula at a time for our infant son, but these cans come in handy if I forget to do it or if we are on the road.  These cans are now an essential part of my diaper bag, because when you need formula immediately, waiting for someone to bring you a cup of water can be a challenge!

column9: Bottle not compatible with standard nipples.
column10: We use Enfamil, so no complaints about the formula, but don't buy these if you are planning to travel with them. Bought the eight oz bottles with the intention of using them on a road trip we have to take. Figured these are 8 oz bottles, ready to use for older infants, just like the 2oz nursette bottles, right? Nope. That would make sense. So, the ready to use BOTTLE is just saving me the oh-so-tedious task of mixing the formula. Still need a bottle to pour it in, since the opening is clearly not designed for a standard disposable nipple. You'll have bring along your own bottles (and wash them in your hotel room sink) or buy disposable bottles. Nice work Mead Johnson.

I pump breast milk for my child, but when supply was low from being sick for a week I bought this.It was very convenient, price was right, no tax, plus free shipping to my door.  I haven't needed to use all the cans yet, but its good to know I have an emergency plan.No mixing powder w/water or measuring.  Just shake can, open, and use.My son eats Oatmeal which I mix with breast milk.  When I was sick there wasn't enough breast milk to store, bottle feed him, and put in his Oatmeal cereal which he loves to eat.  So I used half a can to mix in his cereal.The price was cheaper on Amazon compared to Costco and Walmart.

I used Enfamil RTF with my first son and I now use it with my second son.  It's a great product and a great value.  The 8 oz. size is perfect for traveling or just on the go.  It's more convenient than toting around a 32 oz. can.  My son seems to really enjoy it.  I tried the Newborn formula, but since it only comes in 2 oz. RTF and powder, I opted to switch to Infant which is available in more convenient RTF sizes and my little one had little to no problems when we made the switch...maybe a little gas the first couple of days, but can't be sure it was from the formula.

This is a great product. My little one guzzles it too no problem. It is quite heavy because it is pre-made naturally but is still practical when on the go. Just pop one open and poor it in the bottle and it is done. Does not need to be heated either. I give it 4 stars though because it is a bit expensive but it is actually the cheapest I have found here on amazon, so I try to buy it here whenever possible instead of Walmart and the like.
Purchased ready to use 8 ounce packs specially for air travel. It worked out great, passed through TSA, very easy to use. You can store in cold pack for few hours.

column9: Easy to use and highly recommended
column10: These cans are great, and the price here is good.  The cans are so easy to use, and this was the most recommended formula for my son.  I have received many shipments and did have a problem with one that arrived with some cans broken, but Amazon replaced them for me at no charge.

This is the perfect product for our little girl.  We tried many different types of powdered formula's that seemed to upset her little stomach and then found this product!  She liked it and it didn't seem to have any adverse affects on her developing digestive tract. Definitely worth every penny if your newborn has challenges digesting powdered formula as a supplement to breast milk and you don't want to use a soy based product which can have other effects later.

column9: A good purchase for the price.
column10: I bought this formula for my two month old daughter for night time feeding. It is good to have this present at all times. I just have to put it in the bottle and give it to her. No fuss no mess.
I have been purchasing this rice from Amazon for the past few years after buying it at a local grocery store.  It tastes wonderful with salmon, and I can't recommend it more!

column9: Thai Garlic Basil Coconut Jasmine Rice
column10: This rice is great, if you are tired of the same old plain with rice. I tried making it with coconut milk like the box suggested and it turned out pretty creamy. Very easy to make in the microwave.

We love this rice dish. My daughter describes it as yummy. Quick and easy for our family of 2. We use auto delivery for this and get a bigger savings. It's cheaper on Amazon than at the retail store and it comes right to my door. We find that the seasoning in the silver package is too strong for us so we only use 1/2 of it. I would recommend that and then add more if you like a hotter taste.
The first time I made this I didn't think was so spicy, second or third was!  Very, very good! All the ingredients are packaged individually in the box, fresh tasting!

I drink alot of tea to keep warm, and we had this tea at my work one afternoon... I thought it would be a very odd tea, but when I drank it, I surprsingly really liked it! I tasted the chocolate flavor which I thought wouldn't compliment the green tea flavor, but I loved it together.

Disappointed that I could no longer find Twinings Blackcurrant tea on the supermarket shelves, I was glad to find that I could order it on line. It is the only Twinings black flavored tea that I like--not too fruity, but with just a touch of berry flavor that adds to, rather than detracts from, the basic black tea. It leaves no bitter taste and the aroma is inviting.  Wish the markets would start carrying it again.

I'm a big fan of Peet's Black Currant Black Tea, which only comes in tea leaves in a tin. I use it at home all the time and I love it, but at home I can make it in a teapot and I have a personal-sized one that makes two mugs.  So I wanted black currant flavored black tea in teabag form for use at the office, where I just make one mug at a time.  (The teapot shtick is too much trouble at work and takes up too much time.)  So I found this black currant tea and figured it would be good -- it's Twining's after all -- and I went for six boxes of 20 teabags each.  Now I realize -- I probably should have paid closer attention to the illustration of the box -- that it's artificially flavored.  These teabags smell artificial compared to Peet's, and the black currant aroma of these teabags is faint compared to what I experience when I open a tin of Peet's.  When I brew a mug of tea, it has adequate flavor, but the black currant flavor is overshadowed by the artificial boysenberry-like flavoring they've added and that detracts.  I don't want my black currant flavored black tea to smell and taste of artificial boysenberry  I expect better from Twining's.  I'll stick with Peet's and I'll simply drink it at home and have another kind of tea at work.

This and Twinings Pomegranate Delight, 1.41-Ounce (Pack of 6) are my favorite easy-to-find, flavored black teas.  I originally got hooked on Twinings when I found a box of the Pomegranate Delight at Walmart a couple of years ago.  Since then it is really difficult to find that flavor so I usually get the blackcurrant one.  Both are really good!I solely use them to make iced tea and use 2 bags of one variety of flavored black tea in one container and 2 bags of one variety of flavored green tea in another container.  The best green teas for mixing & icing that I've found are the Lipton variety such as Lipton Green Tea, Mixed Berry, Tea Bags, 20-Count Boxes (Pack of 6) or Lipton Green, Superfruit, Black Currant and Vanilla, 20-Count  Tea Bags (Pack of 6). They are affordable and have less bite/tartness and floater powdery stuff that sinks to the bottom than other brands.Let the containers cool and put it in a 32 oz to-go cup in the refrigerator and my work day is set for success!  Some teas I feel like get gross or funky after a day or two sitting in the fridge.  This one is still delicious the next day or two if I don't drink it all the first day.  Subscribe and save makes them cheaper than constantly hunting down sales at the grocery store.  And I have a six month supply!  Win-win, thanks Amazon.
I brew two of these bags with two Lipton bags and make a pitcher of iced tea.  FANTASTIC that way.
Very smooth, with a light current flavor; not at all bitter.  One of the best I've ever tasted -- this and a good Darjeeling are my favorites.
Every 6 to 7 weeks I buy a case of this tea because I like it very much.And I do recommend it to all tea lovers.
i don't like black tea because they have a bitter taste. i love this tea. it has a really good flavor and smells nice too. there is no bitter taste.

column9: My favorite tea, delivered to my door.
column10: A strongly flavored black tea. The blackcurrant flavor is strong enough to overpower the tea - do not over-steep this. 3 minutes is usually good; anything past 5 is going to be very strong. I take mine with milk, but it's certainly fine without it.I started having a hard time finding this tea several years back, when Whole Foods pulled it from its shelves. It turns out the blackcurrant flavor is partly artificial, so it doesn't meet Whole Foods standards. Since then, I looked all over Austin, Texas for another supplier. Never found one, but getting it 6 boxes at a time works pretty well.

column9: Nectar of the angels if not the gods
column10: Still delicious after all these years and the recent tweaking of the formula and name.  Even though I think there's a tad less fruitiness about it, it remains my go-to hot drink in the mornings and in the evenings.  And if you have a sweet tooth like me, go hogwild and add a dash (or a glug) of French vanilla creamer, and you have a warm black raspberry milkshake kind of deal.  All the Twinings teas are worth the search and the price.

column4: E. K. Miller "cook, lawyer, knitter, mom"
column10: This is my favorite afternoon tea.  I sweeten and lighten it, but in the summer, it is great iced and plain.

column9: My family goes bonkers over this tea.
column10: My entire family goes crazy over this tea. It's the first Twinings tea I tried and while I order other Twinings tea flavors I always include a few boxes of Blackcurrant Breeze with every order. I personally like it hot with no sugar (it's already sweet) but my wife and daughter have a sweet tooth and do add sugar. Every single time they take the first drink they do this squinty-faced happy dance while giggling. In all seriousness, every time. I might be forced to admit to an occasional grin of satisfaction myself when I drink this concoction.It also makes an incredible iced tea...hopefully that doesn't get any English knickers in a bunch.
This is my favorite black tea. And it is not available in most of the grocery stores by me. So it is noce to beable to get it in bulk through amazon.
This tea is delicious.  It's slightly fruity and has a wonderful aroma.  A great tea for relaxation.  It slightly reminds me of the "Mighty Leaf- African Nectar" tea.
I have been drinking this tea for 20 years!!!  Can't live without it - add a little cream and it's a real treat -

column9: When the going gets tough, the Tough Drink Tea
column10: I, too, had a lot of difficulty finding this tea and was glad to see it on Amazon.  I was introduced to this tea in the 1980's by a friend who recommended adding a little maple syrup to it.  That got me started, but I no longer add syrup. The balance and blend of this tea is just too perfect to distort.  For my taste it is superior to any of the flavored or plain black teas I have tried.

column9: Good Base for Summer Iced Tea
column10: How pleased I was to find Twinings Black Currant tea in the Amazon listings.  I've lookedbefore, and it was evidently discontinued for a while.  It hasn't been available on my local marketshelves in about 10 years.  Now if we could just get Delaware Punch back in California again.  Too bad Ireally can't afford that hefty weight shipping price on canned beverages. (sigh)Very compatible if you sweeten your tea or add lemon, I've been using honey in tea and coffee foryears in  defiance of  allergies.  Less mess and easy access is also a pinch of powdered Citric Acid 100% Pure 4 Ounces

This tea is amazing, ever since I had this tea at one of the Walt Disney World resorts I have become a fan and finally I found it for a decent price on Amazon.The price is just right and subscribe and save discount is awesome.

This Twinings Tea Blackcurrant offer is just great (from Amazon), the 20-Count Boxes (Pack of 6) is an offer we cannot let it pass by, product is excellent, I got this idea from a family member who showed me an empty back, and ask me to get more, so I ordered for me too.Great product for a very low price. Thanks.
It was great to find it someplace I could buy a nice quantity (the stores around here run out quickly), at a great price!

column9: Great for Gluten-free, Dairy-free kid's diets!
column10: My 4 year old son has mild autism and many of his symptoms are controlled with a GFCF diet (he also has a dairy sensitivity). When we first started it, I felt awful because he LOVES milk. I bought this as a way to transition, and he chugged it like he'd never had a drop to drink! LOL My 1.5 year old also LOVED it. We've tried several varieties and all of them have been a hit. It's a little too pricey for us to use as a complete substitute (we use almond milk), but I often pick it up as a treat or for when they feel icky. AWESOME, kid friendly product that I would highly recommend!

These BRAT drinks are just what they say...a FEEL BETTER DRINK! I love that they not only rehydrate my kids' bodies when they are sick (and won't drink stuff like Pedialyte), but that it actually helps to calm their tummies and help stop diarrhea/vomitting!  Best of all for our family, my kids have several food allergies but we have nothing to worry about with the ingredients within this awesome product.  Very cool, too, that these feel better drinks are equally effective for adults with other type of stomach problems (eg morning sickness and digestive problems).

Gevalia Dark Roast coffee is one of my favorites.  Couldn't believe I foundit at Amazon at such a reasonable price.  I used some in Christmas basketsand have heard nothing but compliments.  Thanks, Amazon, for making thisavailable.
No sugary junk here. Pure water and mint, nothing else, SPLENDID! If you are used to drinking sodas you probably won't like the pure taste here.

I saw the company was offering a "buy-one-get-one-free" coupon offer on their website and although I did not partake on it, the offerings interested me greatly. Two Whole Foods and a gourmet deli search later, I found a local place that finally had it in stock. They did not have the flavor I wanted but I chose this instead.I don't like the taste of flavored waters most of the time but I was in need of a beverage after a long work day and I was glad to have found it. Upon opening a bottle, I suggest smelling it! The aroma is a precursor of the natural thrill to come. I am not a fan of anything minty, but when I began to drink it I was taken aback by how smooth and refreshing it really is. The tastes are of a medium distinction so if anyone is concerned about the strength I suggest you shouldn't worry.The best part was the clearing of my nostrils afterwards! I couldn't believe that part. I look forward to trying the others (if I can find more places near me). I give this a "yea"!
i love this water!! it is so refreshing and has a fresh powerful mint taste! also cant beat this price!

I love the Metromint water in the two mint flavors. They are refreshing and give your mouth a clean, freshly brushed feeling. I don't usually drink bottled water for environmental reasons, but this is one product I treat myself to every now and then. It's especially wonderful after a long, hot sweat session at the gym.My only issue (and this is not directly related to the product) is that I wish Amazon.com offered these cases of water in a Subscribe & Save option. I order 1-2 cases per month and would love the option of an automated regular monthly delivery.

I really though that this was gonna taste kinda funky..  I mean, I hate flavored water in general.  This spearmint Metromint water was a GREAT surprise!  Drinking it cold was so amazingly refreshing; it also helped relieve mid-day hunger because of its flavoring.  I think it would be a great weight-loss supplement.I haven't tried any of the other flavors -- I thought chocolate was a little too crazy -- but now I'm definitely going to.  Thanks @ Dallas, too, for the info on the chocolate water.  Can't wait to give it a shot.
If you are looking for that stuff full of sugar and corn syrup, this is not what you want. This is pure, clean, water and mint, period. Spectacular!

column9: Love this stuff--mint and water---how smart and refreshing...
column10: Best bottled water variation on the market. Good flavor varieties and just the right balance of flavors. Love the easy to hold skinny bottles too. Just wish it was sold at more grocery stores. Hard to find unless ordering online and have to pay for shipping.
I agree with another reviewer that it taste like Ande's chocolates.  It's pretty yummy and I have enjoyed the taste very much, makes me feel like I am curbing my chocolate craving

I love this stuff, and was able to provide it to my sister when she came down with gestational diabetes. As a major sugar fan and chocoholic, she said this helped the craving a little, while not affecting her blood sugar at all. Fantastic!-1 star due to spendiness (but it's not really cheaper at the stores, it's just a spendy product)
This product tasted horrible and I would not recommend to anyone ever. It says cherry-mint, it should say toothpaste.  If you want water that tastes good and better than this drink water.

I found this in a airport and although it was priced at 2.99 which I thought was expensive, I decided to go ahead and try it.  It has a very mild taste of spearmint that goes away quickly but leaves you feeling as if you have good breath.  However, spearmint is not something I enjoy tasting outside of gum so I am going to try the chocolate flavor.
Nothing compares to the satisfaction of drinking plain water. Just a tinge of mint - flat taste, Waste of money. All 89 reviews so far have given 5 star, makes me very suspicious.

I bought this thinking it would taste like a peppermint patty, like another reviewer said. It tasted so overwhelming bad that I literally could not take a second sip. The mint taste is extremely strong. It's almost as strong as drinking mouthwash! And that's exactly what it tastes like.Completely undrinkable.

column9: FINALLY!!  I'm so glad to finally see this on Amazon!!
column10: I'm so glad to finally see that Amazon is selling and fulfilling this product themselves.  I've been buying this at Albertsons lately and getting it 2 for $3.00 which is roughly about the same price on Amazon but of course now I won't have to pay the sales tax and I get it shipped to me via UPS 2nd Day Air for FREE since I'm an Amazon Prime member. column9: Not bad, but not the best metromint product
column10: I love metromint water, and I was really excited to try the new one. It tastes kind of like a minty bubble gum. It isn't bad, but it doesn't have the same intense mint flavor that makes the other ones so refreshing.

I like this drink a LOT.  I don't like artificial sweeteners but I don't always like to just drink water.This drink is really refreshing - the water tastes really good and the mint is like....not too strong...but it somehow makes me think I'm drinking something sweet.  It actually quenches my thirst too, unlike the soda drinks.I imagine that it is a lot better for my teeth too.I'm a big fan of mint and I love chocolate mint.  This is just right.That said, my husband and son don't like mint and hate the drink, but that's ok, for once they leave my drinks alone!

column9: Yummy! Like a peppermint patty with no calories.
column10: I love the original Metromint Peppermint water but this my new fave! Mellow chocolate flavor with a hint of mint. It sounds a little gross before you try it but tastes like peppermint patty chocolate candies and super yummy! Very refreshing and no calories or artificial sweeteners.

I have really enjoyed this flavor of Metromint water. I used to make a pitcher of ice water that I added a couple of cut up oranges and a couple of sprigs of mint. I no longer have the orange tree or the mint patch, so this water is the next best thing.Keep several bottles in the refrigerator, already chilled and you're ready to go. This drink is so very refreshing, everyone in the family likes it.

column9: Cool and refreshing - even when warm!
column10: I have loved Metromint water for years and Peppermint is my favorite.  It has such a cool minty taste that I can drink it warm and still find it refreshing!I often chill it and drink it but it really comes in handy for sitatuions like:- keeping it at your desk at work- keeping it next to your bed for a drink- taking it on tripsBecause it tastes cool when warm, you can get by without chilling it.  Of course, you have to like the taste of mint.I have tried other flavors and they are all tasty too. I am not a big fan of the spearmint and the chocolate but that is a personal taste issue.I was going to order more and saw it was out of stock!  I am so disappointed as it is hard to find in the stores.

This is the perfect drink for working out. It is refreshing and tastes really good.  It sounded terrible when my daughter first bought it but once I tasted it I was hooked. It always quenches my thirst. It beats every water I have ever had!

Love, love, love metromint water!  Chocolatemint is my favorite!  I like to drink water and don't like calories from what I drink!  I despise soda!  Metromint water has no calories and tastes great!  It is extremely refreshing, especially on a hot day!  I can take my own water in my sigg bottle, but metromint is so refreshing and my go to drink when I want to splurge and not tap out my own water!  If it were less expensive, I would purchase it more often!

column9: Who knew mint could taste like this?
column10: Wow! Metromint is able to get real mint in a fabulous water without any calories! I especially love the spearmint when I am working out and the chocolatemint after dinner. I first found them at Whole Foods, but love that Amazon ships right to my door.

column9: Great taste and no calories - without all the Chemicals!
column10: The Metromint products are all awesome. Perfect for someone trying to eliminate chemicals from their life but wants something a little more interesting to drink than straight water. I love reading the ingredient list - usually only two ingredients (max of 3).The way I enjoy Metromint: I get a wine glass, fill it with Ice, and then poor in the Metromint. Really excellent that way! I like all the flavors though the Orange Mint, Peppermint, and Chocolate Mint are my favorites. The aroma of the Chocolate Mint reminds me of a York Peppermint Patty when I drink it. Again, really excellent over ice. Using subscribe and save is less than it costs at my grocery store and conveniently arrives on my doorstep without shipping costs. Much better than buying from the manufacturer and saves me lugging product home from the store. I highly recommended product and it is a good value when using Subscribe and Save.
This is a DELICIOUS change from plain bottled water.  It is refreshing right from the bottle (no need for ice) & calorie free!
I wasn't a fan of drinking this as it is, so I added some stevia, and it was perfect.  A nice way to get my chocolate fix without consuming any calories.

I love metromint products. I've never really liked drinking water, but metromint is so much more refreshing than regular water and doesn't add any calories or chemicals to my diet. The peppermint is by far the "mintiest" flavor they make. It tastes kind of like drinking water while chewing a strong peppermint gum. I keep it at my desk at work because it doesn't need to be refrigerated and still feels cool because of the mint. This is a wonderful product for mint lovers, but if you don't like a strong mint flavor, the fruity metromints are not quite as strong.

column9: Metromint Chocolatemint water is delicious, refreshing, and it's calorie free
column10: This Metromint Water, in the Chocolatemint flavor is terrific. It is so refreshing, especially now that warm weather has arrived. The chocolate flavor is very true as well as the mint flavor.The water is not sweetened. With its delicious taste, it doesn't need to be sweet. I like to chill it well in the fridge rather than serving it with ice. I don't want to dilute the taste with melting ice.One of the other reviewers described the taste perfectly when he said this water tastes as if you had just eaten an Andes Mint and then had a sip of cold water. Very, very refreshing.

I've been trying to eat and drink more healthfully since I'm pregnant and I can't find a lot to drink without having a lot of sugar or artificial additives or caffeine or SOMETHING I shouldn't be consuming... I was getting really tired of plain water, then Metromint water came to the rescue.  All natural, not boring, no sugar.  Love it.

I currently reside in rural NE MO. The water ...well, tapwater, anyway, leaves much to be desired. I'd actually rather NOT drink it.(or bathe in it...) THAT said, while I try to steer clear of bottled waters, esp *trendy, designer waters* as a rule, or too much in the way of pre-packaged anything, I have to say I really enjoy Metromint and will continue to purchase as long as it's available, esp. with Amazon's free shipping offer. Ordered two cases here recently; same price as in store, with the bonus of saving gas $ for the two hour round trip drive had I purchased it up North. (haven't seen it locally.) Very refreshing, wonderfully clean, calorie-free natural chocolate-minty "essence" in a bottle. I was skeptical until I opened my first one; *new* loyal customer! Perfect for quashing that sweet craving or quenching your *more discerning* thirst.

I have tired all of these flavored waters but my favorite by far is the chocolatemint.  It is so tasty and refreshing!  I love that I can get it from amazon now by the case.  Was paying $2 each at the local health store.  0 Calories, 0 Carbs, 0 Sugar.  Just water with a great refreshing flavor.  The chocolatemint especially helps me curb my chocolate cravings and snacking in the late afternoons.  Love this stuff!

column9: Tastes like a squirt of toothpaste mixed into a bottle of water
column10: Not for me.First, the positives: 0 calories, trendy/cool presentation, no preservatives nor artificial sweeteners.The downside -- the taste is just awful.  In terms of a flavor, spearmint isn't my first choice in gum, yet I find it tolerable.  The spearmint flavor here was faint and vague to the point that it annoyed my taste buds because it was just mild enough to feel like I'm awkwardly drinking a squirt of toothpaste stirred into 16 ounces of water.

Ok so I don't really like this product- which may be a me problem, and not a problem of the product itself.I love Metromint in Orange Mint, Spearment, Chocolatemint.  Peppermint isn't bad, but a little intense.  I do not like this flavor, it's too weird, minty with a slight cough syrup tang to it.  If you like cherry flavored cough syrups and mint, then maybe it works for you.If not, don't give up on Metromint, just go get one of the other ones.I wasn't a huge fan of the Lemon one either, and there is another berry one that others have reported tastes like minty fruit gum.  I'd skip those.This is a great product for diabetics.  My sister came down with gestational diabetes, and I bought her the chocolate mint.  She loved it, and it had no affect on blood sugar.
