column9: not the best but you get what you paid for
column10: Not the best but you get what you paid for. It's a very good deal if there is a big discount.

column9: Still "Mmm-Mmm Good" After All These Years!
column10: I typically like to make my own soups, but when I want bean with bacon soup, I buy Campbell's Bean with Bacon. I can't seem to replicate the flavor of this, and prefer it to my own version of bean with bacon soup. I've been enjoying this Campbell's flavor since I was about 12 years old when I first had it, and it's still one of my favorites.This comfort-food-feeling soup has a hearty flavor and density that keeps me full for hours. In the thick broth, there are little soft bits of bacon, as well as tiny pieces of (soft) carrots. The main attraction of this soup, the beans, are plentiful, have a great flavor and are nice and soft. Nutrition fact wise, the total fat per serving is only 3 grams of fat, calories per serving 160 grams, protein: 8 grams and 5 mg of cholesterol.Not only for the great flavor and protein, but also because this is a relatively healthy soup, I recommend this to anyone that needs food every now and then :)As a side note, it's a nice little bonus that each Campbell's soup can has a 5 points "Labels For Education" label which is worth actual money (5 points = 5 cents) to participating schools.

column9: Some of the best we've ever had!
column10: My husband and I have tasted potato chip brands from one end of the country to the other, but these are absolutely THE BEST!  I agree it is hard to consume only one serving at a time... hubby and I ate the whole 5 oz bag!  And we are not big eaters of anything - haven't done something like this in years, but then we've never had such tasty chips ever.Highly recommended!

I happened upon these chips at a local discount store and thought that I'd give them a try. These are the first chips that I could really say "You can't eat just one". I went back and bought all they had left. Then when they were gone, I was thrilled to find them on Amazon. Try them - you will not be disappointed.

When local stores stopped carrying these, all the other neighborhood noshers and I almost starved during the Packers games (the package even has Packers colors!), but even fans of the B**rs and V**ings forget the colors when they take the first bite.Allegedly, olive oil actually helps with blood cholesterol.The main problem is trying to keep from eating the whole bag after the first bite.Tip to Luker and others who complain instead of using an obvious simple solution to their problem:  Open the BOTTOM of the bag (Hint: It's very similar to the top, except on the other end of the bag).  Eat from that end to get rosemary more evenly distributed with every chip.

These Good Health All Natural Kettle Style Olive Oil Potato Chips are beyond delicious. In fact, we found it difficult to consume one serving size.At first, we were hesitant about purchasing this because often one never knows what they are buying by a limited description alone.  However, we were glad to have assumed the risk with these.The flavor balance includes a perfect amount of salt (not too much), healthy olive oil (non-greasy), and a hint of something special. This simple treat will greatly reward your taste buds, if they are attuned with ours.

column9: Usually excellent product; POOR quality this order
column10: We have ordered cases of the Sea Salt/Olive Oil chips and they have been well liked.  A good balance of crisp, salt, oil flavor and appearance of pale yellow potato like chips. This case of chips was completely un like previous product.  The chips were greasy to feel, oily in appearance, so oily they were transparent and looked like oiled sponges.  I don't know if this was just a bad batch, poor qualilty control or a change from a good product to not good at all.  I will hesitate before re-ordering the chips again.  Such a shame, when most people at least did not feel quite so bac eating what seemed a more healthy chip.  Now they look so saturated with oil that no one would eat them.

I love, love these Good Health Kettle style olive oil potato chips with sea salt.  They are crunchy, but not as greasy as the Kettle Brand chips that I also love.  They have just the right amount of sea salt.  I normally do not eat potato chips except once or twice a year in very limited amounts.  I ordered them for my grand children, but ended up eating most of them myself.  So good.

My, is this an interesting product. Officially called olive oil potato chips with cracked pepper and sea salt. I have sometimes had chips that feature sea salt and cracked pepper. An odd combination; pepper does not seem right on a chip! But, oddly enough, it does work.The salt and pepper actually seem to complement one another, each adding its own taste and creating a tasty crunchy treat!If one take a look at the nutritional information, this isn't so bad for one! No trans fat and rather little saturated fat. Cholesterol=0. This is certainly not hesalth food, but--for comfort food--one gets a nice taste and lower levels of the negative nutritional effects that often go with chips.

Not sure about the "Good Health" part, but these are SO tasty...perhaps my favorite chips ever! The chips are the delicious kettle style - crispy yet oily, well-done, not pale and wan, with plenty of chips that have curled into themselves in that mysteriously addictive way. There are liberal amounts of rosemary on each chip, but it is not at all overpowering.

These are excellent for anyone on a low-salt, low-fat diet.  Sea salt and olive oil.  The lowest sodium content of any chips I've found.  Very crunchy, good flavor.  I've sent cases as gifts to friends on low salt diets.  The rosemary flavor has higher sodium content and a lot of the rosemary falls off, thus the flavor is mild.  The peppercorn is the favorite at our house.

Delicious, light.  Like Lay's.I am allergic to soooo many foods, including most cooking oils and table salt.  This is one snack I can have because they use only potatoes, olive oil, and sea salt.  It may not be very healthy, but it's a great treat for me.

column9: I can recommend these Potato Chips :-)
column10: I like these potato chips. They are very tasty and natural... I can not find them in Russia, and so I will order again and again from USA... :)
I can't eat less than a whole bag.  Once I open it, it's gone.  It's my kryptonite.  I buy it two cases at a time.

After deliberating we chose the sea salt flavor. I'm not big on seasoned chips and my husband and I decided if we wanted rosemary on them, we could just shake some into a bag. We are very pleased. Lightly salted and extremely crunchy, these satisfy without us having to worry about soybean or inferior oils.Very pleased.

column9: Doctors orders: Olive Oil is the only oil in my kitchen
column10: That said, these chips are delicious! But for years I didn't buy chips because all are fried in high omega 6 veggie oils. Now I can have potato chips that taste great AND don't raise my health risks as corn-oil products do. Thanks Amazon!

I first found these chips at Ocean State Job Lot and just had to have more but they don't stock them anymore.  They are super delicious with a good amount of cracked black pepper which I love!Well I found them here and ordered 2 cases and they were gone in 2 weeks, yes, I'm the guilty party.  Anyway, I'm ordering 2 more cases today.  The thing I like about them is of course the flavor and the fact that they are all natural.  The best chips I've ever had!  Keep them in stock, Amazon, cuz I'll be back again for more.

column9: Good Health Olive Oil/Rosemary Potato Chips
column10: I seldom purchase items as common as potato chips on-line since they are so readily available.  That being said, I ordered two cases of Good Health Kettle Olive Oil & Rosemary potato chips when I found them on Amazon. These chips used to be available at Costco in large bags and we bought a bag to try.  One bag was all it took, we were hooked.  then as with numerous things at bid warehouse stores, the product we came to love was no longer to be found on the shelves.  Enter Amazon.  Our cravings have been assuaged.I love the ease and convenience of ordering from Amazon.  The chips were here within the time specified, arrived in excellent condition, and the shipping was free.  I will continue to order as needed.  Good Health Kettle Style Olive Oil Potato Chips, Sea Salt, 5-Ounce Bags (Pack of 12)

column9: a hit at the Senior Center
column10: I am the shopper, spotter and saver and contribute to the little convenience store in the facility.  When I bring in a new item, especially committing to a case of 12, it do take a chance.  I first sampled these chips and was delighted in the taste, quality, lightness and dainty size of these little curled chips. At the Senior Center, an 88 year old proclaimed  "it's a chip you remember the taste afterwords-a good snack".  Maintenance bought a bag, shared it, then Accounting came in and another bag sold.  A finicky senior 'splurged' on a bag and said that the 'olive oil chips' (as they are now called) were "very good". Time to restock soon !!

I have often wished I could find an olive oil/sea salt chip.  No where to be found until last week when my husband and I went to a local discount grocery store. We went back to get more and could not find them with the regular chips.  I asked a store clerk and he said that what is left would be down 2 isles.  My husband and I purchased all seven bags because the clerk mentioned that it was not one of their regular items.  I'm sure that these seven bags will last us 2 months or more depending on if we have much company coming.  When they are gone we'll be on the hunt for more.  We may have to order on line.
I love thses chips.  I buy them by the case from Amazon. com.  They are lower in salt and the olive oil is very healthy.  Try them.  You'll like them.
These Olive Oil Potato Chips are delicious!  Crispy, crunchy and mildly salted, they are NOT too salty, very fresh tasting. I'm eating these chips as I write my review, yummy.
I love these chips; only 3 ingredients which makes them a good addition to a healthy lifestyle.
Maybe a little too good as the box seems to be getting empty.  :) Definitely will reorder these!
Great tasting, and they go well with any sandwich. And that hearty crunch is doubly satisfying. Highly recommended.

These Olive Oil Potato Chips with Rosemary were SO GOOD at one time when produced under the name of SOLEA.I bought them frequently, first at Whole Foods then online.  They were large heavy chips that one could easily tell were cooked in Olive Oilwith just enough Rosemary on them to give a great distinctive taste. Now they have been RUINED.The chips are smaller, lighter with less Olive Oil and the Rosemary is piled up at the bottom of the bag(instead of on the chips)!Oh, did I mention they are virtually TASTELESS as well?  And I have a box of 12 bags!  UGH!!DavidWashington, DC
The taste of rosemary is overpowering, especially in the bottom half of the bag.  Same chips with sea salt are significantly better tasting.

I can't get enough of these.  I have tons of food allergies and these are something I can eat because they are made with olive oil instead of all the other oils I can't eat.  They are light and tasty.  I eat them every day with my lunch.

I am NOT a huge Kettle Chip fan, but I was hooked on these after my first bite!! Hands down - my all-time favorite chip - PERIOD!! The Rosemary does tend to settle to the bottom of the bag, so I simply shake the bag each time I go to eat one, or two, or three...OK, who are we kidding here??.....a few handfuls!! I like to take my time eating these because they are so good, and this 5 oz bag usually lasts me 3-4 days with my casual munchies.My young kids do not like these at all (they have a very strong Rosemary flavor & are definitely GROWN-UP CHIPS), which thrills me to know that this is my very own bag ...and I savor every last chip in there! When you get to the bottom of the bag, you find a huge pile of Rosemary sprigs & a few  little chip crumbs that have marinated in all this rosemary-goodness!! YUMMY!!! You HAVE to try these!! You will never buy another bag of Lays.

Our son gets a bag of these chips out of the pantry EVERY time he stops by for a visit. I have to hide some for us. The ingredients are simple. Nothing in them is questionable. The flavor is amazing. It's a great chip.

They are pretty decent chips but when you get down to the bottom crumbs, just throw it out. They have so much rosemary on them, they're not edible. I will probably buy this brand again, just not this flavor. It's somewhat bland but still not bad. I much prefer the salt and cracked pepper.
These chips are amazing, I first purchased at my local health food store then decided that I wanted a whole case for my family to share. Shipping was prompt, I will definitely purchase again!

column9: Good Health Kettle Chip with Sea Salt
column10: The sea salt chips are simply outstanding, they have a fresh slighly salty taste and are crisp. Good Health chips have ZERO trans fat. Excellent buy!

Olive Oil Potato Chips are hard to find in my area, so I was delighted to find them at quite a reasonable price via Amazon. They are tasty and crisp, salted to perfection with sea salt! I heartily recommend that you give them a try. You won't be disappointed!
These are the best chips because they are perfect.  Not too salty, very crunchly, great taste, no after taste and somewhat healthy !!! Amazon's price was just right.  BCM

column9: Besides all the positive health factors, they JUST TASTE SO DARN GOOD!
column10: So read the other reviews that point out all the important things you should know about these chips. That's already quite impressive. But the true test comes with the taste. All I can say is the taste ranks 11 on a 10 scale. So now you're curious? Buy a pack. I won't spoil the ending.

column9: Good Health Olive Oil Potato Chips
column10: Very good for a potato chip with salt on it. They were cooked in olive oil and they have sea salt on them. They are good for a change from the usual. They are very crispy. They seem to be a little bit thicker than most potato chips. Update: For my own personal use there is way too much salt. Sorry I can't handle all of the salt. But at least I tried them.

I am a big fan of salt and pepper chips, but had never heard of this brand.  I was curious and ordered a batch.  Exceeded my expectations.  Perfect blend of salt, pepper and olive oil.  Good crunch, not overwheleming.  I could eat a whole bag in a sitting, but theres enough in one 5oz bag to last you a few days. My local grocery store needs to stock these ASAP!  In the meantime, amazon has a good deal on these chips.

I have been looking everywhere for olive oil and rosemary potato chips since my local Italian grocer stopped carrying them. Was so surprised when I accidentally ran across them at Amazon and haven't been able to stop eating them since they arrived. These are the best chips I think I have ever had--fresh, crunchy, lightly flavored with rosemary, and best of all--made with heart healthy olive oil. I know that olive oil doesn't outweight the negative of eating these chips---but who cares--they're awesome!

See our other review of the Good Health All Natural Kettle Style Olive Oil Potato Chips, Sea Salt.The rosemary in these light, scrumptious chips, is in fact, REAL (not an imitation). Just when we thought the rosemary is too much, the flavor disappeared and did not leave us with an aftertaste or unpleasant "snacking" feeling.  These chips are airy, delicious, seemingly healthier than others, and of course, highly recommended.

I love love love chips.  I found these to be marginal and a bit greasy.  Bought on a recommendation, but only regret is that it came in a case of 12.  Wish I had only tried a bag as tastes clearly differ.  Oh well.
What i would do, if you are reviewing this, is, come one line and buy this product that comes without a broken potato chip Mmm,Mmm,Mmm.

column9: Paid for a special potato chip & received unremarkable product
column10: I am very disappointed in this product. I thought this was the same brand of 'olive oil rosemary' potato chip I had purchased (These chips and packaging look the same as others I have purchased.) and loved in the past.... but this product is inferior. I would not recommend this product unless you plan to eat them with sometype of sour cream dip, they are not very flavorful.....
I use the Torani sugar free flavorings in all types of Protein drinks and different recipes. Since having Gastric Bypass it is an added benefit for flavor.

We love sugar free Torani syrups.  Now Strawberry Sugar Free is our favorite!!  We are putting it in yogurt, and making smoothies!!!  It's great. And the best thing of all....it is sugar free.  It still tastes wonderful.
I bought these syrups for Protein shakes.. I like the taste, there's not a nasty aftertaste.. not as sweet as I thought it would be, but i like it.. all for no calories.

column9: Great taste, can't even tell it is sugar free
column10: I used this syrup to make strawberry ice cream in my ice cream maker, and it tasted great! Definite keeper.
This candy is absolutely wonderful. Just like I remember from when I was a kid. The item was shippend quickly and the candy was fresh

I gave this product as a gift to some clients as a change from Dean and DeLuca...not a good idea..My clients loved the gift box, the crackers etc. were very good...BUT, the smoked salmon was not high quality.I would not suggest this item for the food, but the box is nice.

column9: oh sure, buy the little one first, you'll be back for the largest
column10: So you've bought "chocolate worms" at the grocery store, PLEASE do not assume this is that type of low quality product. This is the finest chocolate sprinkle you can find. The flavor is excellent and when you buy the big one, the price is most reasonable per ounce. I first bought these at a specialty market over a decade ago, and found them fabulous. My kids would even eat it by the spoonful. I use them as decoration on top of cakes, cookies, ice cream. I also bake with them. Add 1/3 cup to your brownies for a much superior flavor and moisture. I also use 1/3 cup instead of chocolate chips in cookie recipe and they are a big hit. I now buy the big containers and give them as gifts and EVERYONE I give one to is now as addicted as my family...you too can enrich you life with these yummies

I really think this cereal tastes awesome. Yeah, the chocolately pieces aren't "real" chocolate. And sure, they sink to the bottom, but seriously, is everyone too lazy to go fishing for them with their spoon? I think the chocolate Special K is much better than the Strawberry kind!

You need to try this cereal in order to form your own opinion.  I eat this cereal every single day for breakfast.  It is my favorite cereal and I absolutely love it!  I have never thought the chocolate tasted waxy.. I make sure to eat every last chocolately piece in my bowl.  My husband doesn't like it, and I buy the Vanilla Almond for him, and I've talked to other people who don't like it, but my personal opinion is that it is absolutely yummy.  They usually have it on sale at Rite-Aid for 2 for $5 every couple weeks or so, and that is when I stock up on it.

I realize that many people don't like this cereal because the chocolate is too "waxy" -- and I agree that it does have a waxier consistency than regular chocolate. But for some reason, I absolutely love this cereal and buy it constantly. I don't mind the consistency of the chocolate pieces when I'm eating it all together with the flakes and milk. I've really been hooked on this cereal for more than a year now, though I realize that it's not for everyone.

column9: Pretty good, if you have realistic expectations.
column10: Come on folks, this is cereal.  What's more, it's supposedly "healthy".  Don't expect it to taste like a bowl of Ben and Jerry's.I am a 20 year-old male college student, I'm not exactly a calorie counter, and I still think this stuff is delicious.  I usually eat it with chocolate soy-milk.  The flakes are extra-crunchy.  Much more crisp and substantial than say, frosted flakes (they stay crispy longer as well), but not terribly sweet.  Yeah, the chocolate is pretty lame if you eat the pieces by themselves (although I wouldn't call it "gross" at all) but when you eat it with the flakes, this cereal tastes pretty great.

column9: A healthier alternative to the kiddie chocolate cereals
column10: This is not an overwhelmingly chocolatey cereal, like many of the kid cereals.  It does have a chocolate taste that is reminiscent of Cocoa Pebbles to me.  I love chocolate, but I also love fitting into my pants, so this is a great compromise.  It's got enough of the little chocolatey squares to make it sweet and to satisfy my chocolate craving, and I actually do quite enjoy the crunch wheat and rice flakes; they stand up quite well in milk.  One caveat: this is NOT real chocolate, hence the title of Chocolatey Delight (rather than Chocolate Delight).  This is made of out partially hydrogenated soybean oil rather than cocoa butter and solids, which does add .5 g of the dreaded trans fat per serving (despite the fact that the nutrition label says 0 trans fat; you only see it at the bottom of the list of ingredients).  It doesn't quite taste like real chocolate, but neither does any other breakfast cereal that I've ever tasted.  I did not find it to be waxy, so maybe that's just a personal taste issue.  It's quite good, however, and has earned a place on the top of my refrigerator for those days when I'm seriously craving chocolate at night but don't want to blow the day's diet.  Give it a try for yourself; I really enjoy it!

I thought this was actually pretty good. The chocolate pieces added just enough chocolate taste to enjoy. I did not have any issues with 'waxy' taste. This is not baking choclate that melts in your hand so don't expect it to be. It has to hold up in the milk as well as on the shelf. I will definitely purchase again.

Is this like having a bowl of chocolate ice cream?  NO.  How about a bag of chocolates?  Again, NO.  But, it is a sweet alternative to eating the above.  The cereal is sweet enough to satisfy my sweet tooth cravings and while the chocolate does not rival Hershey's, it is still sweet enough to believe I'm eating something close to the real thing.  I like it and am glad it is an option...otherwise I'd still be eating the ice cream and ruining my diet!!!  Thank you, Special K!!!!

column9: Perfect for that late night chocolate craving!
column10: This is the BEST cereal!  When I have a chocolate attack this is the snack I reach for. Give it a try; low fat and calorie and best of all guilt free!

I love this cereal because I usually have it with warm soy milk(you can also use regular milk) which melts the chocolate chips and makes the milk deliciously chocolatey. Great for those cold mornings to warm up the tummy before leaving the house or those cool evenings right before bed. Or just because it's doggone yummy.

column9: I don't want to complain, but...
column10: I bought this cereal recently. The flakes are good-they don't get too soggy. The chocolate, not so good. It left a thick waxy coating on the roof of my mouth. I didn't think the taste was bad overall, just didn't like the waxy feeling. I will finish the box, but I doubt I'll buy it again. I guess that's what I get for trying to eat chocolate for breakfast!

column9: Great tasting, not so much fiber though
column10: This is a great tasting cereal, but needs more nutrients.I ended up having half a bowl of this and half a bowl of my high protein/fiber cereal to supplement this.Really great value though, and was packaged safely!
The flakes were not bad at all, but the chocolate pieces were awful. Almost no flavor and very waxy tasting. Would not purchase again.

I love me some Special K! This is a great way to get that chocolate fix, but still cut back on fat. It's a perfect balance! One complaint I have though, is that the chocolate bites tend to sink to the bottom. But I don't think there's another way you can fix that issue. Unless you fill the chocolate with air :) ohhh idea!

For all you guys complaining about how the chocolate pieces sink to the bottom... well, duh. More mass has been packed into those chocolate chips than anything else in that bowl. It has more mass than the milk and the flakes, so they sink. Anyway, it's actually pretty good in my opinion... I would definitely buy it again. And the chocolate is fake because it's Special K... You know, like the diet cereal. It wouldn't really be Special K if the chocolate was real Hershey's milk chocolate, now would it?

Chocolate Special K is my night time treat.  I am always hungry before I go to sleep for the night, and have come to depend on Special K Chocolate as my nighttime delight.  Actually it has become my treat whenever I am looking for something crunchy and sweet.  Try it, the calories are not too much different than your favorite cereal.

This cereal is great.  The chocolate taste like real dark chocolate to me and I don't feel like I am biting into wax. It is not Gharadelli chocolate, but it is not milk chocolate either.  I would recommend it highly.  I have been eating it for a couple of years and I eat it late at night when I need a snack, not for breakfast, but it would definitely be good to eat there also.

This special k has bigger crunchier flakes that hold up to the milk regular special k flakes get soggy in milk the chocolate pieces are big but that makes them sink to the bottom of the bowl but I enjoyed this cereal very much

Yes, there is no real chocolate in this cereal, but to me, this cereal is still very delicious. Glad that there's a cereal out there that tastes good without having an insane amount of sugar in it. This cereal also fills me up pretty well along with the fat free milk I use, so I'm glad about that. I really enjoy the little chocolate pieces that can be found within, and the crunchy flakes, as said in other reviews, hold up very well in the milk. I'd definately recommend this flavor ofSpecial K.
It is like eating slivers of candle wax in your cereal. I like the other flavors of Special K, but the chocolately delight is one of the worst culinary, much less cereal, experiences I've ever had.
Anything that contains fake crap like this chocolatey junk doesn't get my vote. It's so bad they can't call it chocolate legally so they call it "chocolatey". Shame.

I saw a box of this on sale at a local store, so I thought I'd try it before committing to an Amazon subscription pack.It's a decent version of Special K, with tiny little bars of chocolate mixed in with a good ratio. Still, the problem with having actual chocolate in the cereal rather than baked into it is that once the chocolate comes into contact with the cold milk, it hardens and you end up with the typical chunky chewed up bits of chocolate you get when eating chocolate and drinking milk. The chocolate bits sink to the bottom and so while you can keep your ratio nicely proportional by making sure to scoop the bottom, if you're not paying attention you can end up with a bunch of little chocolate bars.So while it tastes good, it's not good enough for me to want to buy it regularly.

column9: Proper name. It is a delight
column10: This is one of the best cereal flavors ever. And with the pack of 4 it is excellent value for money too. If you love chocolate flavors and are tired of other flavors out there, this is the one for you. Won't disappoint.

I tried enough breakfast cereals. I get tired of almost all of them after a week. But this product is an exception. The taste of the flakes are NOT too sweet. The chocolate chips are also pretty fine. Every morning this product doesn't let me down!
Special K Chocolatey Delight Cereal, 13.4-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 4) I ordered this because of my granddaughter.  It is a healthy breakfast for her, and one her papa lets her eat.

column9: This cereal rocks, I have to agree that the bad reviewers are crazy! lol
column10: I have been eating this cereal since it first came out. It absolutely helps me curb those late night cravings, which is my most vulnerable time for eating unhealthy. It satisfies the crunchy & chocolaty cravings.Yes the chocolate pieces sink to the bottom of the bowl, but this is usually when you have only a few spoonfuls left, otherwise the flakes help hold the pieces up ontop. I actually like that at the end I get a spoonful of like 5-6 pieces of chocolate. The Chocolate does have a "waxy" type coating...but thats so it doesnt melt in the box during transportation...I have never had a negative opionion or even thought about the texture of the chocolate before I read the negative reviews here, but that's because it just tasted good and I enjoy the taste and texture. So I have to disagree with the negative comments on the chocolate pieces...sure, it's not quite like biting into some Dove chocolate, but this cereal tastes great and satifies a chocolate fix with less fat and calories that Dove chocolate!The cereal is made with whole grains and does provide some fiber, I use the cereal as more of a chocolate snack than as a meal for breakfast. I prefer higher fiber content in my breakfast, helps keep me fuller longer so I don't snack all day. So while this cereal is perfect for a late night fix as it has the crunchy and chocolate craving satisfaction down...I think there are much healthier breakfast cereals out there like Kashi or high fiber oatmeal! Other than that this cereal tastes awesome and has helped me lose weight by giving me a better choice for my cravings. :)My husband also loves this cereal, he is often "stealing" a bowl of it when he's home, so I started buying 2 boxes at a time, when I saw the price on Amazon I about flipped! I pay the same amount for 2 boxes at my grocery store as the Amazon Subscribe and Save for 4 boxes! Twice the amount for the same price, yes, please! Love Amazon!
very good transaction. Got the product in time. may do another transaction when the supply is over. for the users, i forgot to keep the product in cool place and left in my car. chocoloate melts.
I tried this cereal and it's just okay.  I love chocolate, but this has a little to much in it.  I wouldn't buy it again.
I really like many of the Special K products, but this one is lousy. The chocolate tastes very chemical-y, and I'm just thankful that my kids will eat it so I don't have to throw it all out.

column9: Chocolate doesn't really go with cereal and is a bit waxy
column10: The first time I tried this cereal was when I bought a sample pack sort of thing of Special K. My first impression was pretty good. This time around, I wasn't as impressed. Don't get me wrong, it's a good tasting cereal, but it doesn't really work. The combination of chocolate and cereal isn't that great. Also, as some other reviews pointed out, the chocolate is a bit waxy. It's not a big deal, and it makes sense considering that they need to make it so it doesn't melt in the milk, but still it's not necessarily pleasant. Out of the whole Special K range, this is the 4th best, falling behind the vanilla/almond, berry/yogurt, and strawberry.

One of my least favorite Special K cereal. It's definitely edible but don't expect it to be "chocolatey" or "delightful." I read the other reviews and thought I'd give this 3.5-star cereal a try anyway. The rice/wheat flakes itself are less sweet than those in their Red Berries Special K Cereal. I guess they sprinkle them with less sugar to compensate for the "chocolate." The chocolate is 1) not melty, 2) sinks to the bottom, 3) taste close to semi-sweet chocolate morsels but 90% less melty, 4) hard. The chocolate chips reminds me the Ex-Lax (laxative) chocolate. I just eat the flakes and throw away the chocolate; they edible (not disgusting) but I don't find them enjoyable to eat.
The chocolate tastes waxy, fake, and gross. It's NOT like little Hershey's bars in your cereal. It's not horrible, but I disliked it and greatly prefer Special K Red Berries.
I really like the crispy flakes but the chocolate pieces are rubbery.  Kellogg should use something on the order of Nestle chips but since that's a competitor I don't think that will happen.

This cereal is pretty good, as far as healthy(ish) cereals go.  But I was overwhelmed by the amount of chocolate pieces in the box.  I find myself picking out about half of them each time I pour a bowl.  They are also bland tasting - not like I expected at all.  I am disappointed that at the taste of the chocolate and that are are so many pieces, which I assume is because of the weight of them.  A box of regular Special K that has the same weight is considerably larger than this box because the heavy chocolate takes up so little space.  Even if the chocolate were great tasting, the chocolate pieces to flake ratio is way off.  I might purchase them again, but only if I find them on sale for a great price.  If not, I can easily live without them.
The caloric content was what made me choose this product. The chocolate pieces were not good. They weren't real chocolate. I found myself not eating them.
This is my favorite cereal so far.  I do wish they'd put more chocolate squares in there.  There's never enough, so what I do:  I buy the dried strawberries from [...] and add them in.  Great combo.

column9: LOVE THIS CEREAL - CHOCOLATE IS DELICIOUS
column10: I love this cereal...It tastes so wonderful.  I enjoy so much, I sometimes crave it.  I can eat it all day.

So, I bought this hoping it would make the milk chocolately.  It doesn't.  Nor does the chocolate taste very much like chocolate.  However, it is one of the tastiest cereals I have ever had.  I can't figure out what makes it so yummy, but it definitely is delicious.

I like Special K and I love chocolate so when I saw the two together I thought, why not try it? Well, I did and I love this cereal! I could eat this for every meal of the day. But something that I found out when I first tried this cereal: don't pick out the chocolate pieces to eat separately because they'll taste funny to you. You have to eat the cereal all together because the flakes have a little chocolatey flavor to them and it adds to the flavor of the chocolate pieces. So if you love Special K and chocolate, you should give this cereal a try.
I didn't think this was very good.it had actual hunks of chocolate that sink to the bottem and the tha chocolate get very hard do to the cold milk.
special k chocolatey pieces was a little waxy tasting but when you are cutting out extra chocolate it is a great substitute.
IT GETS YOU STARTED IN THE MORNING, AND SOMETHING TO EAT LATE AT NIGHT THAT WON'T SPOIL YOUR DIET.

column9: The best cereal I have ever tasted!
column10: I am a chocoholic person..but I am also watching my diet. This chocolate cereal satisfies my both needs. I usually eat this as snack more than breakfast. It fulfils my chocolate craving and I dnt feel the guilt of eating chocolate and gaining calories. The chocolate flakes here dont taste very good but afterall it is just to give the flavor..so it works great for me!!

Seeing as to how I'm a chocaholic, I thoroughly enjoy getting my morning fix with my cereal.  As a kid I'd break Hershey's Chocolate into chunks and drop them in my Frosted Flakes....had I only thought then to patent that idea as Kellogg's has done I'd be rakin' in all the dough....  :D

column9: Not All It Is Cracked Up to Be
column10: I am a huge Special K fan. Especially Red Berry, but at heart I am a chocoholic. I was so excited to hear they had a chocolate version and I ran right out to try it. It is your average Special K flakes but with the addition of "Chocolate Pieces". The problem is they leave a horrible waxy coating in your mouth because of the poor quality chocolate. I am sure this is because it has to stay healthy but I would rather have a Fat Free Chocolate Jello 100 calorie pack then deal with the feeling it leaves in your mouth. So back to red berry for me!

Bought this item and a few other cereals a few weeks ago and half the box is tiny mashed up pieces and not enjoyable to eat. Would be a great deal if shipping item didn't cause half the cereal to be what you normally find on the very bottom of a box of cereal.

column9: If you like to eat crayons, you'll like this cereal
column10: I like special K cereal. I like the bars, too. But this flavor of their cereal is just gross. The flakes are alright on their own, but the pieces of chocolate are totally unedible. They are big waxy chunks, and you can barely taste any chocolate flavor in them. I don't know what they are made out of, but it's not real chocolate. They get stuck to your teeth and you just have a mouth full of brown waxy bits by the time you're done with a bowl of this cereal. I'm a huge cereal fan, and an even BIGGER chocolate fan, and you couldn't pay me to eat another bowl of this crap!

column9: You can do better than this, Pacific Foods!
column10: I am no stranger to Pacific Foods or soup products in general.  I eat a lot of this manufacturer's items and I consume many varieties of soup.  Of late, Pacific Foods has been producing many new flavors of soups that lack attention to taste and consumer friendly packaging.  This rosemary potato chowder is one of these newer soups and it was a big disappointment for me.My dislike of this soup began with the packaging.  It is one of those fold and tear type of cartons where you pop the sides up and take a knife or pair of scissors and cut off the top to remove the contents.  These cartons are not consumer friendly.  It is difficult to remove the product without some of the contents spilling as you tear off the top.  Pacific has soup containers which come with a capped spout.  The capped spout on other containers allows the consumer to pour what they need and refrigerate the rest.  Alas, with this container, you need to pour all of the contents and put what you don't need into a tupperware dish -- thus creating more dirtied dishes in your life.The second disappointment was the appearance upon pouring.  I definitely eat food first with my eyes.  When I poured the soup into a bowl, there were giant curds intermingled with oily broth, carrots and celery.  This soup is made with milk so I am guessing that was what caused the curds.  I had to use a whisk to break them up.  After heating the soup, the base was still very oily.  See a photo of the soup in the product image gallery.The third disappointment was the taste and texture of the soup.  The soup is oily, filmy and I don't think it is thick enough to be called a chowder.  The manufacturer was very light on the use of rosemary.  I wouldn't call this a rosemary potato chowder.  I would call this flavored liquid with some finely diced potatoes and a dash of rosemary.The fourth disappointment was the nutritional profile.  This container has 2 one cup servings.  Each one cup serving has 230 calories, 8 grams of fat, 25% of your daily saturated fat (5 grams) and 30% of your daily sodium.  See a shot of the nutritional profile in the product image gallery.If you have the time, I would make your own potato soup.  Imagine Soup carries a large line of soup bases, including a potato flavor.  If you add potatoes, onion, carrots and some spices, you will have a soup that is much more texturally appealing, flavorful and nutritional (that soup base has 110 calories per cup).This product is vegetarian.This product is made in the United States.

I've had some of the other Pacific Natural brand products, and enjoyed them.  This one however, I just didn't care for.  It wasn't as good as some of their other chowders, and even though it was a lot of food, it wasn't satisfying.Since the flavor was potato rosemary I expected those to be the predominant flavors.  And they were to an extent, especially the rosemary.  There definitely was that piney flavor that permeated the soup.  The potatoes took a back seat though and while they represented most of the texture, they didn't really have that potato-like taste.  I also thought it was somewhat watery and nothing like the texture of a chowder at all.  There were other vegetables included, but you really couldn't taste them.  Another note on the texture, I encountered some rosemary sprigs that were tough to chew.  It didn't bother me, but I know it bothers a lot of people.The ingredients were pretty good.  Only a few things are in this including water, potatoes, cream, onion, celery, carrot, cornstarch, sea salt, garlic, rosemary, and natural flavor.  So really, not that much at all.  Which is good, I hate when they add fillers and at least with sea salt it's a healthier salt than normal.  Calorie wise its about 230 per serving, and there are two servings in the box.  I of course ate both servings since I had nowhere to store the rest at work, but even so it made up a pretty large portion that I almost couldn't finish.  It just wasn't satisfying as said before.  Fat is 8 grams per serving and sodium 730 mg per serving.  There are some vitamins, but I don't think they were added in intentionally, just a product of the food contained within.I wouldn't buy this flavor again.  Too watery and the taste wasn't that fantastic.  I'll stick to the other flavors from the brand.Review by M. Reynard 2012

They have this widely in stores there, since they didn't have fresh milk available where I was.  So when I came back to the US I had to find it to make my yogurt and I found it at Amazon.  It is also good for making pudding.

column9: Time changes but quality remains high
column10: Today food prices increase and quantity, quality decrases. This product in its format is excellent if you have the right type of water (unfluridated).

The verdict is in and my 2 tiny chihuahuas love this food. I made the switch from Beneful due to all the dyes and crummy ingredients. Diamond is much healthier, comes right to my door and is comparably priced. Good deal!

My dog doesn't like dry food, but I make him eat it anyway.  He gobbled this food at first, then slowed down (it's his way), but he like this better than any I've tried - and I've tried many different types/names.  Not sure if it's because the pieces are small or the taste, but he liked it.  Never noticed if his coat and skin improved though.

column9: If its from Cornzapoppin then its going to be great.
column10: It does not matter which kind you order from Cornzapoppin, its going to be great!

I absolutely love these rice snacks.  My husband bought himself a bag and I snuck a few just to try them and finished the whole bag!  I wish they came in a larger bag but I will continue to buy the smaller ones.  Sometimes our grocery store has them on sale for $1 which is perfect.  There is also garlic and onion powder but it's not overpowering in my opinion. I am trying to watch my weight and this is a great alternative to chips with sandwiches. I think they are definitely worth a try for all.

column9: The taste is more like onion and garlic than sea salt and black pepper
column10: I love sea salt and black pepper on just about everything -- popcorn, baked potatoes, chips, everything!  So when I saw these I had to order them -- they are reasonably low in calories, and I figured they'd make a good snack (not fried, not greasy, and the sea salt and black pepper would avoid the chemical taste found in some of the other flavors of this product).Boy, was I wrong!  While there is a subtle taste of black pepper, it's actually more of a background flavor.  What you taste first is the oniony/garlicky powdered substance that coats the little rice cakes.  If there's sea salt in there, it's completely overwhelmed by the onion/garlic flavor.I have no clue why these things are covered in onion/garlic powder.  Nowhere on the label does it mention onion or garlic, but it does say (in pale-colored type), "Flavored with OTHER NATURAL FLAVORS" (the capital letters are theirs) and onion powder and garlic powder are listed in the ingredients on the back of the bag.  Had I known this, I would not have ordered them.Generally, I like rice cakes.  They are crispy and light, and they satisfy that urge for something crunchy that hits you every now and then.  The cheddar cheese flavor isn't bad -- a bit too much of the orange powdery substance that is supposed to be cheese, but I like cheese and it's no where near as irritating as the stuff that's sprayed on Cheetos or Doritos.  Unfortunately, I'm not a fan of garlic powder or onion powder, so there was no way these were going to work for me.I would have given these one star (since Amazon won't allow NO stars!), but my husband does like them, so I figured I'd go with two stars.  But there's no excuse for not making it clear on the front of the bag that these are ONION & GARLIC Rice Snacks!  That's not cool, Quaker!

If you are a salt fanatic and chips are too high fat then I recommend this alternative.  They have the peppery flavor I crave, the only reason I gave them 4 stars instead of 5 is because they always give me a stomach ache and chips don't.  Not sure why but then I eat way too many, they are that good, IMHO! :)

column9: Quakes-sea salt and cracked black pepper
column10: I am a big fan of Quakes as they are low in calories and pack a mean flavor punch. I usually stick with the cheddar cheese flavor because they are my favorite, but my local store was having a sale to benefit the USO, so I bought 10 bags of different flavors. This was one of the new ones I am trying out. I have to say that my first rice cake was extremely like a sour cream and onion flavored potato chip, which I don't mind at all because I like that flavor- I was just not expecting it! There is definitely a onion-y powder used in this. I found it to be nice and subtle throughout the serving. I like to keep myself at 10 rice cakes per serving, and the first rice cake was heavily flavored, while the rest imparted a more pepper and salt type of flavor, with the onion as a side note. I suspect the reason for the first cake seeming so powerful is because it was the first to hit my palate, and not because of over powdering. As the palate acquires the onion flavor, it will bring itself down. This is my observation anyway.Overall, I was not expecting much from the flavor, but was pleasantly surprised! I would recommend this to people who enjoy sour cream and onion flavored items. I am happy with this flavor.

Thought I'd never eat anything with "rice cake" on the label...hated the whole concept since the 80's.However, they were sampling these at my Costco in Seattle and I hadn't eaten all day.  O.M.G. Delicious!  Lots of flavor, lots of crunch, mostly light and crispy but with some harder, crackly bits here and there which mixes up that texture a bit.  They have a really nice, lingering black pepper burn (don't be scared, it's about the equivelant of 1/2 star if you're thinking Asian food spice level)!They apparently have a little garlic and onion flavoring, as well as yeast (nice umami quality) and there's some corn too, which probably explains the harder crunchy element.The first ingredient is germless brown rice.Costco has them in 17oz bags for around $4 or so...can't remember exact price.Love them!

column9: One Of The Worst Food Items I've Ever Eaten
column10: I saw many other flavors available, but I thought the sea salt and black pepper would be the minimalist choice as far as flavors went.  It fails to tell you that it also includes onion and garlic flavoring.  Don't get me wrong.  I season all of my meat with salt, cracked pepper, onion powder and garlic powder.  However, the combination on a rice cake is horrible.  The onion powder tastes like the old onion powder I had to throw out last year.  I'm known for continuing to eat somethat that tastes bad to me.  However, I can't this bag and neither will my family.  They really went wrong with this one.  I'm not afraid to try the Quakes, but none of the other options appealed to me.

After spending more on allergen-free food from my vet than I spend on groceries for myself, I looked for a reasonable option for my special-needs kitty who is apparently allergic to something in regular cat food.This food is way cheaper than specialty food from the vet, and my cat's allergic reactions slowly went away after we switched. It smells like death, but it works.

column9: Healthy Cat Food, less stinky outcome
column10: I love Fionna, really I do. She is sleek and black and such a cat. However, her daily doody brought tears to my eyes. Company would suddenly remember forgotten appointments. It was enough to wake me from a sound sleep....in my three story house. I also noticed bloody poo some of the time. My daughter had similar problems with one of her cats. Her vet recommended NB Cat Food. It is the best!! Both of my cats looooooovvve it! While I cant' say the litter box is completely odor-free, the aroma is much more tolerable and within normal range of kitty smells. Both cats are grateful for the change. I highly recommend Natural Balance Green Pea and Salmon Cat food. The one made with duck makes my cats quite happy, also.

My three picky cats have finally all agreed on one they love!  I have been feeding them this for about 8 months now and they are happy and healthy.  They don't vomit as much after eating and their output is not as large.  Their coats seem nice.  I ran out of this and gave them a grocery store brand again and only one ate some (without enthusiasm) and the other two just looked at me like I was crazy.  Lol.  Had to run to petstore to get this :-). Amazon is cheaper than petstore though and there is no tax & free shipping (prime).

I can't believe I found one food that works for all three of my cats...Our youngest "baby" has suffered with painful bowel problems and we have decided that she's probably allergic to poultry.  Thankfully she's adjusted well to this Natural Balance Green Pea & Salmon food.  No more kitty suffering makes me a happy lady...  And has helped to properly potty-train a little one who no longer associates the litter box with pain.My older kitten with no health problems also loves the food and has maintained a healthy appetite and weight.Incredibly, though, this has turned out to be a perfect food for my 12 year old obese kitty also.  She's been on high quality "lite" food nearly her whole life, but she was continuing to gain weight on very small amounts of food and always "starving".  Her sister, adopted by a friend, had the same difficulties.  They were finally able to begin losing weight on a prescription diabetes food (although they don't have diabetes).  But my girl hit a plateau and continued to complain daily that she was *hungry*.  With the Green Pea & Salmon food, though, she doesn't complain unless we're late providing her meal (despite being fed a small amount) and is gradually losing weight.  Her arthritis seems to have disappeared and she's more playful and happy.The only thing I'd change is that I'd like to be able to buy a bigger bag...  Buying only 10 pounds at a time is not as cost effective as I'd like.  The food is quite expensive, but worth it for the health of my three girls.  I just wish I could get a little price break by buying in a bigger quantity.

column9: The perfect food for my cat
column10: For many years, I fed my now 10 year old long haired male cat a mainstream brand of cat food that I believed was high quality.  Over the past couple of years my cat started having stomach problems and was throwing up excessively...to the point of needing to be rehydrated at the vet at least once a year.  I tried canned wet food but it made the problem even worse.  Every time my vet would simply recommend a sensitive stomach dry food but it never worked long term. We were caught in a terrible cycle and I felt awful for my poor cat!After doing some research on my own, I determined that my cat may have a grain sensitivity.  I decided to try a limited ingredient diet and chose Natural Balance (salmon and pea).  After 3 months on Natural Balance, it is like I have a different cat!  Immediately, he enjoyed the food so no issue there.  His coat improved after 1 month and it is so shiny and smooth.  He has not gotten sick once except for the occasional hair ball, which is even less frequent now (1 every 2 weeks).  We have started supplementing with NB LID wet canned food and he loves it as well!I cannot say enough about this wonderful food.  If you have a cat struggling with tummy problems, give this a try!  It solved our problems AND I feel great about feeding him this high quality, nutritious food.

I truly believe I am not exaggerating when I say this food saved at least one of my cats' lives, if not others.  I have seven, so finding food that pleases all of them can be a challenge even though they really aren't picky eaters.  I had been feeding them Iams since my husband and I adopted our first two cats in 2000 until finding out Iams had been sold to another company.  We noticed a change in quality and one of my cats stopped eating and became very ill, which I remain convinced is partially the fault of the food.  After his death to cancer a year later, and much research on the benefits of a raw or at least wet food over dry food diet, I switched them to a mostly chicken canned wet diet until I could gather the supplies I'd need to make raw food.The kitty gods were not smiling on us, however, as one of my cats developed severe itching and scratched his chin and near his ears bloody.  He was allergic to chicken.  I immediately switched them all to the Duck and Green Pea formulation, which he (and most of them) loved and tolerated well.  Unfortunately our newest kitty, who is barely over a year old, is tiny.  And I do mean TINY.  She barely tops the scale at 3 lbs.  And she decided she did NOT like the duck.  Even worse, Jinx's allergic symptoms began to return.  He seems to be allergic to all poultry.  So we switched them again, to the Salmon and Green Pea flavor.  The difference is astounding!  Tinycat loves it and has gained a significant amount of weight (that she needed), the overweight kitties seem trimmer and their coats brighter and softer, and most importantly, Jinx is rapidly improving from his allergic symptoms.  I would still prefer to feed them a raw diet but with so many cats and many of them approaching middle-age or older, there are too many factors to manage, not least of all Jinx's problems.  Natural Balance has saved his life (and perhaps Tiny's as well!) not to mention my sanity.

I've got a cat with a SEVERE food allergy.  Her face just scabs right up and she gets staph and ringworm everywhere.  She'll scratch where it itches, and then her paws would abscess after that.  We spent record amounts of time at the vet and she was constantly taking antibiotics and getting steroid shots.  I was getting scratched ALL the time because she was grumpy (steroids) and I had to pill her one zillion times a day!  LOL.  I tried a lot of foods recommended by the vet, and the Science Diet and Royal Canin had awful ingredients at a premium price.  The Z/D did nothing for her symptoms even though it had "Tiny proteins that wouldn't exacerbate the problem".I was very pleased to try out NB for less than half the cost of these other options.  She loves it, the other cats don't mind munching on it either.  The ingredient list is one I can stand behind, too.Just in case you were wondering, it creates feces of a very mild and unassuming odor.  Even the wet food isn't bad at all.

column9: helped our cat with ear infections
column10: One of our cats had suffered from constant yeast infections in his ear since he was a kitten.  We switched their food to this product, and now we can touch his ears without him violently shaking his head.  He doesn't have black goop building up in his ears a week after we clean them.  I would definitely recommend this for a pet that is having problems that you suspect might be related to food allergies.  We also feed them the same brand of wet food, and the allergic cat is fine with that as well.

In the past year, my senior cat (almost 17 yrs old) developed GI problems, including daily diarrhea and vomiting. She didn't have any infections or diseases, but seemed to have developed significant food allergies.  She couldn't keep anything down and lost weight.  After much research and trial and error, I found she could tolerate Natural Balance limited ingredients formulations.  She really seems to not tolerate any foods with grains, which is a significant filler for many brands of cat foods, even the "organic" and "natural" brands.  Her diarrhea and vomiting problems significantly improved after about 6-8 weeks on a strict diet of Natural Balance limited ingredient duck and pea dry food, mixed with organic pumpkin (no spices or salt), and some feline probiotics.  She managed to gain weight after that, and has been doing well since.

I bought this cat food for a cat that has a chicken allergy.  This brand cat food along with the green pea and duck are the only type cat food that he can keep down without vomiting.  I won't buy anything else for him, and it's great for any other cat with food allergies.

column9: My sensitive, finicky cat loves it!
column10: I have 3 cats; 2 of them suffer from allergies, and the other 1 eats too quickly. After a lot of worry and vet bills, I decided to try this food out. Everyone absolutely loves it! The allergy-ridden cats benefit from its limited ingredients, the fast eater benefits from the smaller kibble size and its easy digestibility, and they seem to really enjoy the taste. High recommended. : )

We adopted the SWEETEST little orange tabby kitten from the Humane Society. He has the most awesome personality of any cat I have ever had....and so I was very persistent in trying to get to the bottom of what is wrong with his tummy! His daily bowel movements were so frequent(5-7 times a day), loose and had a strong "acidic" (horroble) odor. I even paid top dollar and switched his food to EVO innova grain free dry kitten food for a couple months and only saw a slight decrease in frequency of bm's, but still diarrhea-looking and stinky stinky. The vet mentioned that he may have a food allergy. He said "when a cat has a food allergy it is almost always the meat source." I don't know if this is true but I thought it would be worth a try to change food again. So since EVO's top meat sources were chicken and turkey, and the Humane Society had him on purina kitten chow (meat source chicken) I turned to this NB limited ingredients diet with salmon as the only meat source.I slowly mixed a small amount with his old food and it didn't even take 12 hours to notice a BIG change. Now it's only been 3 days- he's not even fully switched over to NB L.I.D. exlusively and he only has had ONE bowel movement a day. And let me tell you people who may not be aware- one BM a day is how it is suppose to be! The litter box odor is way way down. I can only imagine that my little Cheetoh's tummy feels loads better too!The price may seem high, but for any grain free kibble you are going to be paying more because there aren't fillers like rice and corn, etc in it. I am grateful for this dry cat food. I would recommend giving it a try to anyone who is considering spending a small fortune at the vet to figure out why your kitty has a "sensetive stomach."

column9: Great until they stopped eating it
column10: This is a great food, and my cats loved it...for 3 bags. After that, they simply refused to eat it anymore. I don't know why. Looks like I'm going to have to switch again.

I normally don't take the time to write reviews but I am so grateful for this cat food.  My poor three year old tuxedo cat Sophia would vomit every day.  After trying countless expensive high quality dry and wet food brands I tried NB Salmon and pea.  She hasn't thrown up since, is looking and feeling fantastic.  She's always been sweet, but a little shy.  But now she's much friendlier and outgoing and playful, the way a healthy cat should be.  THANK YOU Natural Balance!!!!  I highly recommend this product, will never use any other cat food.  PS. My other cat likes it too!

column9: My cats stomach jumped out her mouth and said hello
column10: I picked up a sample of this stuff at a health fair and figured that I would just use it as treats and keep my cat on her Iams.  I came home and gave my cat her normal "welcome home" snack which she normally eats with a standard amount of cat excitement.  I actually thought that she would be disappointed-- it's just cat food, after all, akin to giving a 5-year-old a carrot when he's expecting an Oreo (right?)Not the case.  When I gave her a piece of this food she went bonkers.  She even jumped on the shelf and knocked over the container to try to get more out and continued with this behavior for an hour until I hid it in my sock drawer.  the next morning when I opened the sock drawer she ran right up and demanded more NOW.  I have never seen her love a food so much!  It's crazy, I feel like I am living in the middle of a cat food commercial for this stuff.I notice that most people seem to be buying this food for health reasons, but I am buying it because I am afraid that my cat is going to murder me in my sleep if I don't.

Finally found a food that my 2 Maine Coon kittens will eat that does not cause runny poop....which they would step in and track all over the house.....and we all have suffered for months having to bath them several times a day to clean their oh so much long hair backsides and paws.....I tried Blue Buffalo and Holistic Select and they continued to have this problem....Tried this Natural Balance based on reviews and limited ingredients...they both love the salmon and the duck....as does my 9 year old calico....all poop immediatly changed to solid after feeding Natural Balance. I believe they may have a problem with chicken or with grains. I haven't tried the NB chicken yet....too happy with the improvement to try anything different! Sigh of major relief!! Thank you, thank you, Natural Balance!!

column9: Really good cat food for my two guys with very diferent problems!
column10: I bought this because I have two cats; one of them recently-diagnosed diabetic and both eat the same food pretty unavoidably. My guy who isn't diabetic has a sensitive stomach, used to vomit a lot and tends to go disastrously off his feed (have almost lost him this way twice because he just shuts down and won't eat anything). On the Natural Balance Limited Ingredient, my diabetic cat is very well-controlled with a protein content his kidneys can handle and my sensitive-stomach guy maintains a good weight, seems to enjoy this food quite a lot and no longer vomits daily. IT WORKS! Both are hale and healthy with issues under control. They are 14 years old, but you'd never know it to look at them or watch them, despite their difficulties. I highly recommend this very high-quality, and apparently quite appealing cat food. I buy it on Amazon all the time because it's less expensive, and, with my Prime membership, it shows up at my door w. no shipping charge two or three days after I order it, so I do less running around in my car.

This is the only food we have ever feed our now year and a half old cat. Liliath is strong, happy, healthy with an awesomely shiny silky coat. Her potty never smells, she is never gassy and also she has only ever had 1 hair ball. I started feeding her Natural Balance LID when she was 8 weeks old because I had fed the doggy version to my lab who had allergies and he loved it and I wanted to feed our new kitten a high quality cat food that I knew she would never have issues with. Liliath is so picky she even turned her nose up at some Fancy Feast a friend tried to give her. I love that with this food it feeds them their entire lives...no need to ever switch from kitten formula to adult.
Our cats were gassy.  We threw out the Meow Mix and began feeding them this cat food instead.  Problem solved!  Saved us thousands in vet bills, and we can enjoy our pets again.

I had been a little nervous about this cat food as other reviewers mentioned stinky litterboxes. Its been quite the opposite for me. When I adopted my cat, the spca had him on friskies which reeked like hell on the exit. Also, he had pretty bad dandruff, which i know from past pets can be due to a food allergy. We very gradually switched over. He likes the food, and the litter box is far less stinky. He also likes the wet food of the same variety, and its very convenient to have Amazon ship it all. Best part: the dandruff went away, and he's far less itchy.

column9: Absolutely Amazing!! Fixed our kitty's mystery chronic diarrhea!
column10: Our recently adopted cat had been having diarrhea for the entire two months we've had her. We kept taking her to the vet who would run fecal test after test to try to determine if she had parasites, a bacterial infection or something else. Every test was negative and every medication we tried had absolutely no effect. We also tried fiber and bland diets with no change. It was becoming a pretty severe situation as every day we dealt with stinky surprise accidents on our furniture and carpet. Finally our only option was to *maybe* see if she had a food allergy or do a $600 biopsy. This food absolutely saved us all! I'm assuming chicken or grain was what was giving her issue, but with only 24 hours of eating this food and her stool is 100% normal! She is peppy, happy, and no longer stinky! It's like night and day...amazing!!! If you are struggling with these issues give this food a try. I hope that it can work as amazingly for you as it did for us!!!

My cat loves this food! She has never eaten a lot of dry food, but now begs for this! Previous to the food she had hairballs at least 3 times a week, she has not had any since switching to this new food!

We brought home a young female cat from the local shelter. Poor little one had runny poop when we got her and couldn't even make it into the litter box in time. She also ate like she was starving all the time and when she went outside we couldn't stop her from eating every weed she could find. Luckily when researching "runny cat poop" I found the reviews on this cat food. I'm so very glad to report that after slowly switching her food to this over a period of 10 days, she is now having regular bowel movements. Oh my, what a relief! I never thought the highlight of this year would be finding solid cat poop when cleaning the litter!!! And our other cat loves this food too - a double blessing. Hope it works for your cat too if it has this problem.

column9: Healthy catfood my cats really like!
column10: I am tired of cleaning up cat food around my house that my cats could not digest. I've tried other dry products to help my cats eat healthier but they would not eat them.  This food agrees with all three cats and they eat it!

I am the proud momma of three amazing kittens. Ages 2,3, and 6 months. I have been stressing what to feed them and how to find the 'kitten fountain of youth' Bella has dry skin issues, it didnt seem nearly as bad one this food so obviously, I wanted to like this food, i got a good price on it (sticker on the bag at petco was 5 dollars off, and it was sale) I got it home and opened it up, and man did it stink! I ended up giving them the whole bag (I'm not about to throw money away) but, since i bought a big bag, i can safely say the next two months where quite... strong. Used a lot of air freshener, even with twice daily scooping.Maybe with another kind of flavor, I plan to give it another go once the Purina runs out.

column9: can't rate it lower than one star
column10: Both of my cats developed bladder problems on this food where previously they had none before. Then changed to the chicken natural balance with the same issues again. Will never use this brand again, probably should be recalled

I introduced this expensive dry cat food to my four little ones yesterday, and all night long they were jumping around on the bed waking me up (they only do this when their feeder is empty) because they were hungry and didn't want to TOUCH this food. Only one of them (who will eat practically ANYTHING) is okay with it. The rest nibble a bit, and then shove it around on the floor in front of their bowl. I read the reviews and thought this would be an instant hit - so what am I doing wrong? Should I mix it with some of their old kitty "junk" food (aka Purina One) or is it a lost cause? Please help, I want my babies to be healthy!PS. I will change my rating if they actually start eating it, but until then it's one star for the 1 out of 4 cats that are eating it. One of my cats would rather eat foam peanuts than this food (NOT good or healthy)...
smell is Very good. taste is Pretty good.  sometimes i mix it with half reg coffee, so its not so fruity.  for the price, it is very good.

I love fruit-flavored coffees, especially blueberry. I also like darker roasts, and unfortunately, fruit flavors often have to be light roasts for the flavor to come through. This brand pulls off the "Blueberry Muffin" taste very well, while still being a medium roast that hasn't lost it's coffee-ness. I'm impressed!
This is good coffee with blueberry flavor. I would buy this again. If it comes in decaf I'll buy both regular and decaf to blend.

I heard all about this coffee and I thought I would give it a try being I love Blueberry....Well Let me tell you I Love it and I have my Husband turned on to it too...I mean I don't drink it everydayI rotate between different ones but this is one of my Favorites....it is really Good Coffee for something different...

I first tried blueberry coffee at Dunkin Donuts and I would always get it unsweetened. I was looking for something with a similar taste and this product is exactly it!! It tastes even better then the one DD'S has. Amazing!

column9: Want a pleasant way to start off your day?
column10: Want a pleasant way to start off your day?  If your answer is yes, then start it off with a big cup of Paramount's Blueberry Muffin coffee.  I find the Paramount brand of coffee to be of very good quality and taste.  So far, Blueberry Muffin is my favorite but I am looking forward to trying their Cherry flavored coffee next.  Enjoy!

This is the way to go if you want that great tasting theater papcorn but before you buy it here at this price which I did. I paid $10.72 for it and then found it at a local Cash & Carry store which caters to restaurants for only $2.65.

column9: THIS is the movie theater taste!
column10: This is the stuff!! If you want to make real movie-theater tasting popcorn at home, THIS is what you need! And unless you make tons of popcorn every day, this will last you for yeeeaars.With a good popcorn popper, such as the whirley pop, use about 1/2 cup of popcorn kernels. Put in ~2 Tablespoons of coconut oil, and at most 1 teaspoon of flavacol and BAM, movie theater popcorn at home.

This is absolutely the best popcorn flavoring I have ever had. It tastes like the best movie theater popcorn you've ever had. And since you just made it, it's fresh and tastes absolutely phenomenal. I've made several batches so far. My 4 year old loves it, my teenager loves it, and I think I loved it the most.  A definite must try. I followed the directions exactly. My popcorn machine doesn't recommend using anything but olive oil, but I think I'm going to test out the coconut oil and see. If it was as good as it was and I left out that signature ingredient, I can't wait for the next batch!
Makes it taste just like the popcorn you get at the movies. Dont need alot to do the job so this carton should last along time.
The flavacol flavoring is why I eat popcorn! Wouldn't do without it! The best of the best! Why use anything else!??!

I read the reviews, figured I'd give this a shot. Tastes great, adds an amazing flavor to your popcorn. Nice finely grounded salt and buttery flavor. You can't go wrong with this. Just don't forget to have an extra shaker around. It's kind of hard to pour out of the container!!

column9: Great stuff - but one carton will last a lifetime!
column10: When I was much younger, I actually popped popcorn for a living! For both United Artists theaters and General Cinema. This salt is, as far as I can recall, exactly what I used there, and in my own experiments this salt creates the correct color and taste in your movie theater style popcorn.But, and this is a big but, I only used 1/2 teaspoon for a typical "large bowl" batch of popcorn. Any more and the flavor became too salty IMO. For a camping trip recently, I popped about 10 pounds of popcorn for my campmates over the course of 4 days, and I still have at least 4/5 of the 35 oz carton left. Your mileage may vary, but I think one of these cartons would easily flavor about 30-40 pounds of popcorn.So, my advice is definitely get some of this salt, but get one carton and order more later if you really need it.I rated the product at 4 out of 5 stars because the quantity in a 35 oz carton is simply too much even for wild popcorn maniacs, and it is not obvious from their description of the product how much you should really buy.

column9: Just VERY finely milled salt with yellow coloring
column10: Firstly let me say ...... this comes in a quart milk carton container.  Mine arrived a disaster ......all bent and leaking and dirty.  As always, Amazon took care of the situation.  This quart container is enough to last a lifetime...no joke.  1/3 TEASPOON is enough for a huge bowl of popcorn.  Frankly....I don't think this stuff tastes like movie theater popcorn at all....and I even used coconut oil to make the popcorn.  It's a lot of hype about nothing.  Disappointed.  Just goes to prove that even if every review is a perfect 5 star...the product can still not be right for everyone.

column9: Will last me forever, but it's so good
column10: I bought this because I got one of those novelty theater style poppers for Christmas, and I heard this stuff tastes like the movies. Then I place a funnel in the top and dump in one scoop. Usually I will need to shake or tap the funnel to get the powder to pass through. Then I screw the top on and shake well. I have found that if the water is very cold the powder will clump more often and mix poorly. Room temperature water or water that is cool but not ice-cold works best. I use a wine fridge to keep the water at 50.( I don't like clumps) Note: The consistency is exactly like water, if your expecting this to be a thick or heavy drink then will be disappointed.I found that if you live in a humid state like Florida you will need to make sure that you screw the lid to the protein power on tight.
