I asked the waitress what kind of mayo it was, and she told Blue Plate. Not living in the South at the time, I couldn't buy it at the store, but never forgot it. When I moved to the Florida Panhandle (L.A. - Lower Alabama) they had it there, and I was in heaven. Now in West-Central Florida, it's not in the stores here, but I was excited to find it on Amazon. I'll never use anything else again!

We have been a Hellmann's family for decades but the reviews for this mayo were very good and the price and convenience with A. Prime made me give this a try. Not disappointed. I like it a bit better. It's a bit thicker and richer tasting than Hellmann's. Of course, as with any food, it's always a matter of taste.

When I left New Orleans after the hurricane, moved to Memphis, at least I could find Blue Plate at the grocery store.  I have moved to State College, PA and knew I wouldn't be able to find Blue Plate at the stores.  So happy Amazon carries Blue Plate mayo.  3 things I can't live without being from New Orleans, coffee and chicory, Blue Plate mayo and Camellia beans.  At least with the internet, I can find these items.
I lived in Louisiana for years, and this is the kind they use there. It is the best Mayo that money can buy.Love it!!

I am 65 years old and have always been very fussy about my mayonnaise. I live in California and my favorite has always been Kraft. In my old age I have decided it's time to try making changes. so after reading positive reviews from customers about this mayonnaiseI thought I would give it a try. WOW. it was even better than I thought it would be. I received it Prime Eligible and subscription so I got a great price in a great mayonnaise. It has a very rich full taste. I really research customer reviews and I outweigh the good against the bad. please take my word for it you will love this mayonnaise, just give it a try. Also prompt delivery and very well packaged. 5 stars all the way Thank you. Also it is in plastic jars not glass. I like the change. If you or the kids drop it? No worries!

Growing up in Alabama, this is the brand of mayonnaise that my mom always bought. After growing up and trying new things, I still don't love any other mayo like I love Blue Plate. And just a few months ago I discovered they are making a LIGHT version now, which tastes the same as the regular! Definitely the best mayo ever!

column9: Blue Plate Mayo, Simply the best
column10: I am from the south and Blue Plate mayo is what we used all of our lives. When we moved to Texas it is not available over here or in the northern states.I am so glad that I can get it from you all. It is the best. We used to drive back to Mississippi every few months and buy as many jars as we could.Thanks. amazon
I had never heard of this brand of mayo, but from the reviews I thought I would try it.  This is the very best mayo that I have ever eaten and it will be my only mayo from now on.

Let me begin my review by stating that I have been a Helmann's mayonnaise devotee for the better part of my lifetime. I have tried many other brands, mainly out of curiosity, and found all of them inferior. Recently, a friend recommended Blue Plate brand. To be honest, I had never even heard of Blue Plate Mayonnaise. To my surprise however, on a recent trip to my local Publix, there it was, in an unassuming blue, yellow, and red container, tucked away on the bottom shelf. Given my frequent disappointments, I was skeptical to say the least.My fears were soon put to rest, however.  Upon first taste, I immediately thought of Helmann's. Blue Plate had a nice, slightly acidic tang that I was familiar with. There was no sweetness whatsoever. The Blue Plate had a nice clean aftertaste, and no heavy off-oil flavor, common to many lesser brands. (Even the much vaunted Duke's brand, which I tried with high expectations, let me down in this department. It tasted heavily of cheap oil.) While the taste is very similar, where Blue Plate is leaps and bounds ahead of Helmann's is in the texture department. For those of you who have ever made home-made mayo, you are familiar with the wonderful, velvety texture that is created. There is a nice sheen, and a good white (not yellow) color. Blue Plate reminded me of this exactly. Unlike Helmann's, there is no "whipped" thing going on here - very little air in the mixture, which added to the outstanding, home-made experience. I can see why Blue Plate has been a staple in Cajun Kitchens for the better part of a century.  For those of you who take your Mayo seriously, I strongly recommend Blue-Plate. I really believe you will not be disappointing.
There is no better store bought mayonnaise.  It is as good as Best Foods. I would buy it again online.

Blue Plate mayonnaise tastes better than Hellman's.  We can't get Blue Plate in the stores here in the Northeast so it has to be mail ordered.  No worries though.  It ened up being cheaper than if I had gotten the same number of jars of Hellman's locally.  Go figure.

SUPER FAST SHIPPING!!!!! AMAZING!!!!! I have eaten Blue Plate Mayo for as long as I can remember.... I am so happy I can still enjoy its great taste even here in Virginia.... Thank You Amazon for allowing me to be able to purchase it through you and Thank You Blue Plate company for making it available on amazon now I can continue to have my Mayo of choice!!!

I used to love this mayo and ordered it on shop and save and got it twice a year. The last two shipments have been a disappointment. It now has a strong soybean oil taste. I don't know what in the process has changed. I thought it might had been only the one shipment but the last batch tasted off as well.  I no longer order this.

I had heard, and read, favorable reviews about this product so I decided to try it.  It is not available here in Michigan, only in the south. It is primo, and arrived in time for the wrap up of the BLT season.  Best mayo I have tasted.
I love the flavor of Blue Plate. I'll do whatever I need to do to keep my pantry stocked with it!

When I hear someone talk about how good Hellman's taste I just know that they have never tried Blue Plate. Honestly, until you try it you don't know how good a commercially prepared mayo can be. It is as simple as that. Do yourself a favor and buy one of the best things to come out of New Orleans ever. You must taste it for yourself. Highly recommended.

column9: This is one of the best mayonaise
column10: Before I read about Blue Plate mayonnaise being one of the best mayonnaise in the nation my family had already known this and my parents had already known this. As children, we always loved a sandwich made with Blue Plate mayonnaise.I couldn't resist ordering the 4 pack just so I wouldn't run out.  This is something that the last person in the house never says we're out of.

My wife and I are picky about mayonnaise and have been Hellmann's loyalists for over a decade now.  However, after seeing that this product was top rated we decided to give it a shot via Amazon (since this is not sold in the Northeast).  The price was very good - including shipping, so it was not a big risk on our part had we not liked the product.Well my wife was sold after one taste, while I waited a bit before making my vote.  But there is no denying it, this is a better product.NOTE:  We have ordered this twice through Amazon now, and each time the expiration date of the product was over a year out - so they are not shipping items on the verge of expiration.  4 containers still too much for you?  Find a friend and split a 4 pack.

I bought this item as I had read that it was the best mayo sold in the U.S., yes, even better then the worlds favorite Hellman's.  Well, my review that it is just as good if not a 'bit' better then Hellman's.  In fact I put it into an empty Hellman's jar and said nothing to my family and they never knew the difference.
This mayonnaise is delicious, but in a side by side taste test, I would have to give Hellman's the edge.  Hellman's has a richer, eggier taste.

I was hoping this mayo was super awesome cool, since it's famous in the south, but it's ok.  I wont be buying another CASE of it.  It's good, but not good enough to stock in my pantry just because they don't sell it in my local area.  It'll prob take til next year to finish the one I bought anyway. lol.  But Hellmann's can strongly compete with this mayo...which is surprising.

I've been a fan of the Turbo Tea drinks for a while, but Diet Green Tea is my favorite. The taste is really good and it doesn't make me jittery or give me a stomach ache like some other energy drinks.

I like all the diet turbo teas for a good energy pick up without the jitters and crash that you feel with other caffeine energy drinks. This flavor taste a little like apple juice. Although not bad, I still like the lemon flavor the best. Great product!

I like this product and frequently make it as a special week-end breakfast, adding either frozen blueberries or strawberries.  I like the taste and the texture.  I find it filling without getting the bloated feeling that I sometimes experience with regular-mix pancakes.  I usually serve it with margarine and sugar-free applesauce on top rather than syrup.  That said, I'll admit that my wife doesn't care for the texture or taste.  I am able to buy it locally by the box at a lesser cost than the case price listed.

I bought this after reading the nutrition information. If it tasted good, it would be a wonderful breakfast, especially on the week-ends or you could even use it as a dinner entree because it has only 2 grams of fat/serving, 5 grams of fiber and 10 grams of protein. Unfortunately this mix tastes ghastly and the texture of the pancakes is kind of "pebbley" and just not what I've come to expect from a pancake. Also, the pancakes are very fragile and hard to turn. If you make the mix as directed the pancakes are thick and take a very long time to get done and end up too brown. This happened even after I thinned the batter with a bit more milk.And speaking of milk....with this mix you have to add milk, oil and eggs. With my regular mix, I only have to add water or milk and they taste alot better than these do.I thought maybe I could salvage it by mixing it with my usual brand of pancake mix but even at a 40/60 ratio (40 of this mix, 60 of my usual brand) it just tasted awful and again with the yucky texture. Since it doesn't taste sweet to me, I tried mixing it up with some spices, bread crumbs and a bit of flour and dredged a few chicken tenders through an egg and then in the mixture and then I fried them in canola oil. It was not too bad however, it wasn't good enough for me to want to keep this mix or to ever buy it again especially since I almost never fry chicken anymore. One last thing: I read that once you heat flax seed to a certain temp, it looses it's "goodness" so I think you probably lose that healthy aspect of this mix.Bottom line: This is too expensive, tastes awful and has a horrible texture. I won't ever buy again and I ended up throwing away the last half of the package.

Before joining the military back about about a bazillion years ago, I wasn't a coffee drinker.  Never cared for the stuff.  As fate would have it, my first duty station was in Germany, and required many long shifts at odd hours.  I begrudgingly began to drink the stuff (and surly everyone has heard about military coffee, all of it is true). By accident I happened across Jacobs coffee, and began to drink the stuff for pure enjoyment.  Drank it by the pot, I did, loved the stuff...And then I rotated back to the states.  This was before the days of the luxury of the internet, and my beloved coffee was not to be found...  After 911, I went overseas again, and managed to bring back some Arabic coffee, but it was a poor substitute.  And then I found amazon.com.  Love this site, and the things I can find on it.  I'm reviewing this purchase not for the coffee (which, by now, I think I've gotten the point across that I love to death), but rather the grate deal I got on it.
We love this cofee,in Europe we use it a lot buy it and you will see the difference!We are so happy that we can find this brand on AMAZON,thank you very much.
Best coffee. I love this one. It is strong but has a mild taste. I dring this coffee every day 2-3 times a day and I really love it. Thanks!
This is the only coffee we will drink (for us it's German coffee or nothing). Fabulous, powerful taste, I highly recommend it.
The price is absolutely a complete rip off! This is normally about $13.95/lb at the store or direct from Peets.
I am not sure who is ever going to buy this. This product is way too expensive than the market price.
this is a fantastic product..just loved it...eat it whole..perfect not too sweet not too hard...love it..have been hunting this for days after a friend introduced me to it...

If you found, as I did, that it was too hard to peel off the paper wrapper, try eating it!  I think it's meant to be eaten and is very good.  It dissolves in your mouth.  The product is absolutely delicious!

Update on 09-03-2010:  I recently learned (by reading) that the natural sweetener Xylitol is poisonous for dogs to ingest.-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------Too bad I can't rate this product with ten stars! Manufactured in Sweden, these are appreciated around the world. Why do I appreciate them so much? What are they like? Well, here goes:Sugar free with only 3 calories per serving, they are sweetened with xylitol, which occurs naturally in the fiber of many fruits and vegetables. Xylitol has virtually no aftertaste, and doesn't impact blood sugar, so diabetics can enjoy them. With these, I haven't noticed any tummy discomfort as I do with Sorbitol or Aspartame. I don't really consider these as candy in the normal sense, but more as a refreshment. These pastilles are a wonderful treat that can help prevent cavities by keeping the saliva flowing. This is especially helpful for those of us who are stressed, have a medical condition or take medications that can cause dry mouth. These pastilles are firm but chewy, and also melt in one's mouth. There are no sharp edges which can occur with some hard candies.The taste is distinctive, rich and pleasurable, with notes of licorice and menthol.  A serving is two pieces, with a total of 12 servings per box (which is small enough to discreetly carry in a pocket or purse.)Lakerol Special Licorice pastilles come in handy, too.  Ever need to change the subject in a hurry? Offer one of these. Got the munchies at 2:00 a.m. but want to wake up free of guilt? Forget the cake and have a couple of these instead! Mouth going dry on your way to the principal's office? (Or enrolled in a speech class?) No problem. These will help!  Bored stiff trying to do your taxes? Lakerol and a stroll away from your desk will help refresh you... and with luck you will think of a couple more deductions.If you suffer from arthritis or any other source of chronic pain as I do (ankylosing spondylitis), these may help distract you from the pain and help you proactively focus on doing something kind and positive for yourself, such as gentle stretching or a hot bath.These do have menthol, but are not overwhelmingly strong, which is a nice plus. If you have a sensitive mouth, as I do, this can be very comforting. Also, I'm a chocoholic, but more often than not these stop those cravings and reframe my feelings to something more positive.My husband and I both love these and wouldn't want to be without them. Whoever invented them must be a genius! I've ordered them multiple times through Amazon.com and am extremely satisfied.  My order often arrives within four days or so. What more could I ask for?  I hope you try these if you haven't before.... they really are special.

I can't believe the one star review. These candies are delicious. I'm diabetic and dislike no-sugar items; however, these leave NO aftertaste! The licorice is soothing rather than overbearing, and the menthol is very subtle. I wasn't especially fond of the lemon flavor, but that's why there is chocolate & vanilla! I've let friends try the licorice, and several have asked where they can buy them. 5*****
No sugar; no calories; taste is pretty darn good.  Can't go wrong with this as it helps any cravings.
This is my favorite Lakerol.  A strong flavor of Licorice and Menthol, with very little sugar.  Nice texture.  A nice vice without the consequences ;-)

I think I first had the licorice menthol ones as a child.  I have loved them from the beginning.  Was so happy to find them a few years ago at the WORLD MARKET however they have now discontinued carrying them. I am now having to order them on line. Thank goodness. I know some people hate them - don't know why that is.  I can't get enough.
I first had these in Sweden years ago and I love them in all the flavors.  Lemon is my least favorite, but they are all good.

I am an a'cappella singer and I use ONLY Lakerol Special Menthol liqorice lozenges to soothe my throat - and they are sugar free!  I have tried other lozenges for dry, scratchy or sore throat, but others have sugar in them, which also irritates my throat.  Lakerols are also small in size and work very quickly to soothe and moisten.  With other lozenges, I have to deal with a large piece of candy which takes much longer to melt and to work.  I cannot use any other kind of lozenge for singing except Lakerols.
Licorice and menthol in one great package. My sons and I love these. They are not your everyday black licorice but I highly recommend them.

Phlegm is a constant problem for singers, especially the lead, who must sing with clear, strong tones for the other three to match.  For the past ten years, I have sung with the comedy quartet, Lilac Crazy.  (We chose that name, not because we're crazy about the color lilac, but because we LIE LIKE CRAZY!)  The bass singer always offers me one of her Lakerol lozenges before we sing, and I always accept it, plus two or three others.  The lozenge soothes my throat and helps my voice sound more clear.  Finally, I ordered a case from Amazon.com, and I no longer have to "bum" Lakerols from her.  I probably owe her a case of them by now.  Ordering them from Amazon.com is so easy, that won't be a problem!

column9: Weird, addictive, gives you a bit of gas
column10: These are crazy addictive little buggers. The menthol flavor doesn't appeal to many folks: I've tried to give some away with few takers. These do not give you the horrendous gas that the alcohol sugar treat give you but they do give you some. I probably won't buy these again.

All I can say is I love Lakerol Special Menthol Liqorice throat drops.  I hope this product will always be available through Amazon.  I can't find this product anywhere else.  If Amazon stops carrying this product, I will be without my favorite throat drops.  This product cures my cough quicker than any other throat drop on the market.  The liqorice taste is very pleasant and doesn't seem like medicine at all but rather like candy.

I was surfing Amazon for sugar free items and found these. I love licorice and I also love menthol so I decided to try these never having had any. I was very happy that I did. They freshen and waken your mouth delightfully. I hope other flavors are forthcoming !

I embrace everything licorice.  When I quit smoking it was either go through a bag of the real deal and turn into a fattie or buy a carton of these puppies.  Lakerol won and so did my conquest against smokes. xx
If you like licorice and menthol, you can't go wrong with these semi-soft, sugar-free candies.  They're vaguely reminiscent of Sen-Sen.

My friend had a pack at her house that she purchased from a fundraiser.  I noticed the little box sitting on the table and inquired, as I like licorice.  Well I pop one of these minis into my mouth and thought hard perhaps stale?  Strong menthol, kind of gross tasting, and lastly that I love them anyways and need a lifetime supply, so thank G-D for the internet.  Everyone I know ends up liking them, though they are not sure why?  :-)

column9: Smoke a pack of Menthols and chew on a dirty tire at the same time.
column10: I had to put in a review of this product after I read the previously entered 5 star reviews. I purchased some tonight at World Market and I must say that this is absolutely the worst tasting candy that I have ever come across. Believe me, I have done some serious traveling, everywhere from Canada, across the US, Mexico, South America, Jamaica, Britain, Belgium, the Philippines, Dominican Republic, Guam, and the Cayman islands. I have tried food and candies from each one of those locations, and I have never tasted anything like this candy. Please do not waste your money and buy this. The candy is so bad that most people I have given it to could not keep it in their mouth, but rather spit it out on the floor. I could not believe the taste when I tried it. Imagine if you will cramming an entire pack of filter-less menthol camel cigarettes in your mouth and smoking them, while at the same time chewing on a dirty tire and drinking water from a dirty ashtray... That may come close to the flavor of these little bad boys. These candies are made in Sweden therefore I have come to the conclusion that Swedish people have no taste buds. (I'm Joking, I love Swedes).
Have bought this in the small jars 3-4 times, but this is much more economical. Use it just about every morning in an egg white omelet and it adds great flavor to anything you put it in.

column9: Beware of Quantity - read the small print!
column10: I received an email from Amazon promoting this item and since my husband loves them I went to the website.  Not reading all the detail I assumed I would get three boxes for $7.73.  They are around $3 a box at the grocery store.  So I ordered 2 thinking I would get 6 boxes - a good deal.  Not so, one box for $7.73 - crazy.  My error for not reading the small print but the picture is deceiving and when ordering on a phone one doesn't pay as much attention.  Lesson learned but am going to try to return anyway!!!

You like eating a sponge? Good. This is like chewing on a sponge that stinks of Fruity Pebbles.We've all eaten Rice Krispies treats; those are good, those are slightly crunchy. This is just a dense gummy mess that tastes like it has zero natural ingredients in it, entirely a science project affair. I could deal with the astronaut food consistency of the product if it tasted good. It probably would have been smarter marketing to associate this with the Jetsons rather than the Flintstones.On the bright side, each unit has only 90 calories. The ingredients boast of no high fructose corn syrup, gluten free, and 10% of the FDA vitamin D requirement. But I get the impression that these benefits are as illusory as the products that shout, "Sugar Free!" while loading you up with sucralose, aspartame, or whatever test tube agglomeration it is that conjoins scientists and marketers like siamese twins.I confess, I didn't look at the label until after I put it in my mouth. Well, actually, I didn't look at the label until just now as I was writing this. Apart from a few recognizable elements including vitamins or minerals, the ingredients include a laboratory soup of red 40, niacinamide, reduced iron, zinc oxide, turmeric oleoresin, yellow 6, yellow 5, blue 1, palmitate, blue 2, marshmallow (corn syrup, sugar, gelatin, natural and artificial flavor), hydrogenated vegetable oil (coconut and palm kernel oils), partially hydrogenated palm kernel and palm oils, dextrose, glycerin, soy lecithin. Any vestige of nutrition that these bars might contain presumably comes from the manufacturer artificially adding in vitamins and minerals.It's hard to consider this a food product. One could imagine the day will arrive when any organic substance found in the average kennel could be processed to contain a soft creamy multivitamin center so the packaging could boast that it contained 100% of FDA daily requirements. Until that day arrives, this product should suffice.

I thought I dreamed these up until on a whim I did a search online and found out they were real, so I ordered them through Amazon. Two days later they arrived. They are a bit small. They are like Rice Krispie treats, in that they are a block of cereal held together by sticky "marshmallow". They are tasty, but there is this smell that is terrible about them. I don't know what it is. Maybe it's the "marshmallow". Whatever it is, I had to put the wrapper on the bar while I ate it because I didn't want my hand to smell from holding it. I thought maybe I got a bad batch, but I found a friend who found them in a store and tried them and said the same thing about the smell. You don't really taste the smell unless you inhale with your mouth while you have a bite of the bar in it. It's too bad because they would have been a treat I would have purchased more of.

If you're going to have a snack, it might as well be healthy.  I am diabetic and use these products as a snack.  I would prefer them to have fewer calories but before I went on a diet, I was eating Lays chips every night.  These are certainly better for me.  They are a "little" pricy, I believe, but I use Amazon for almost everything so they just get delivered straight to my home...................easy!

In general, I'm not a fan of gift baskets. They often contain sub-par items that are not of good quality, nor do they taste good. This basket from Wine.com is a big exception, and it was really a very pleasant surprise. Every item in this basket was tasty, and thoroughly enjoyable. The pink color on most of the items makes me think it might be a more appropriate gift for a woman than a man, but the treats would appeal to anyone. The basket was lovely, and could be used long after the food is gone. I'm always watching my calorie intake, and all the food in this basket, individually, fit into my daily plan as a snack without too much adjustment.In many cases, I wind up giving away or throwing out the food that comes in pre-made gift baskets that we might receive during the holidays. Many times I take one bite of food and throw it out because the poor quality is just not worth it. However, had I received this basket as a gift I would have been pleasantly surprised and I would have kept all the food. (And eaten it!)

It's a little hard to judge this item because I don't know what price this will be offered at, and with an item like this that does make a difference. It certainly is a nicely packaged item that makes a nice presentation, and I could easily see giving this to a wide variety of people I might not know well because who doesn't like a bit of sweets, especially for a special occasion? But there's not really a whole lot here, it's more of a "sampler" package, so I would give it as a gift for a maximum of 2 people, not for a family to share. As far as the sweets themselves, they were all right, but not great. I thought the fudge was a bit grainy, and the cookies were ok but there are certainly better quality sweets out there that I would give to people I know and care about more.For presentation it's a 5, but for products about a 3 to 3.5.  At this point, I think I would give this as a hostess gift or to a manager for a holiday or special occasion, but for true friends and family I would spend the extra bucks for higher quality products.

This pretty gift basket contains 8 samples of morsels that are great to go along with a cup of coffee. They are in a pretty basket with a gold ribbon / bow. It contains the following: Kettle Fresh Chocolate Fudge; Truffle Cookies; Caramelized Belgian Cookies; Chocolate Milano Biscotti; Cashew Roca; Dolcetto Cookies; Sweet Butter Cookies and Chocolate Chip Cookies. This would make a great gift for a friend.

I love to put together gift baskets and goodie bags for special people. I also love to receive them! The "Delight and Enjoy" gift basket more than lives up to its name--I was smiling all over myself before I even removed the user-friendly plastic wrap. This presentation is truly the "total package". The color scheme is deep pink with black and gold accents--pretty, but not too frilly. I adore the oval basket with the wooden handles, and my first thought was "great bread basket". It's long enough and deep enough to make a generous serving basket. The big golden bow tied around the package added a touch of elegance, and it could be reused in many different ways. The deep pink shredded paper filler is very colorful and added enough cushiness to keep everything safely in place. This type of filler is also reusable and is much preferable to many other types of filler. On to the good stuff! "Delight and Enjoy" offers a variety of sweet treats, from creamy chocolate fudge to crispy little spice cookies. Claeys Kettle Fresh Chocolate Fudge is not overly-rich, and it is really melt-in-your mouth creamy. The Primo Dulce Truffle cookies are rich, but still light, and the chocolate coating lands on the tongue just right. Brown & Haley's Cashew Roca was crunchy butter toffe with a light coating of chocolate and chopped cashews. Beth's Heavenly Little Chocolate Chip Cookies are crispy cookie bites with a touch of chocolate and a really good flavor. The Dolcetto European Style Wafer Rolls are ultra-light, but still richly flavored. Angelina's Sweet Butter Cookies are simply buttery sweet and good. The Torani Chocolate Milano Biscotti is darkly rich and was perfect dipped in a cup of vanilla cappucino. Everything was scrumptious, but my favorite item was the Biscoff Caramelized Belgian Coookies--Yum! It's been a while since I had this type of cookie--lightly spiced, thin and flavorful. These cookies are individually wrapped and would be perfect portables. This is a wonderful gift basket for tea and coffee drinkers who love a good cookie plate along with their cuppa!

column9: Really really delicious, gorgeous packaging, awesome gift idea
column10: The packaging was so beautiful, all color coordinating, high color graphics, very artistically created and arranged. They were all designed with the feel of old world European elegance.  (Perhaps the color palette and design motifs from the era of what we associate with Marie Antoinette.)  All the cookies in the assortment were fantastically delicious.  We gobbled through them all in two days.  (most were petite size in packages with 2 servings each approx.) These were more what I would call European biscuit type cookies that you might find enjoyable with afternoon tea (ie. more like shortbread cookies, nibbly, not chewy, and not overly sweet - how refreshing!).  These cookies were all very fresh, made with very high quality ingredients, and a true pleasure to enjoy.  I would highly recommend this gift basket to anyone.  The entire thing was delivered well wrapped and not one cookie was broken on the inside.  The basket was made of very high quality and can be reused as a fruit basket or a bread basket etc.  I can't say enough good things about this gift basket of cookies.

This basket is very attractively packaged; the sweets are well displayed and the basket is fairly nice, as this sort of thing goes.  The bow is attractive enough to save, and the basket holds a good variety, from biscotti to candy.  The frustration-free packaging was easy to open and protected the contents very well.The contents made nice snacks paired with coffee, with flavors running from very good to just so-so.  The Cashew Roca is delicious, as Roca-brand treats always are, to my taste.  The chocolate chip cookies barely earn the name, as they are very sandy shortbread (a texture unlike any I expect when I think "chocolate chip cookies") with tiny, scarce chips too small even to taste chocolaty.  The fudge is tasty, although there are only two small pieces.Therein lies my chief complaint:  All of the items are very over-packaged for the amount of food they actually contain, making the basket appear much more generous than it actually is.  For example, the fudge box measures 3 x 4 inches (that's it on the right in the picture of the filled basket), containing two pieces of fudge that measure just over an inch square:  12 square inches of box for about 2 inches of fudge.  The Roca box (on the left in the picture) is 6 x 3-1/2 inches, with three small pieces of Roca in it.  The cookie box was about 24 square inches, containing 2 ounces of itsy-bitsy cookies (each is about the size of a quarter).There is no dishonesty in advertising here, as the basket clearly lists contents of just 11.9 ounces.  However, the appearance is one of a large, bountiful basket full of treats, but it actually doesn't contain very much once all the packaging is disposed of.At the right price, I would suggest this as a nice, small gift with an interesting variety of treats -- emphasis being on small.

There are eight items in this basket all of them sweets.  There's a nice blend of tastes both for chocolate lovers and non-chocolate devotes.  Most of the individual packages contain two to eight pieces.  The basket the items come in is cute with two small side handles, not of the type that's reusable except for very light items and for a decorative purpose, not for hard use.  The color of the boxes range from white, to beige to pink.  There was a gold bow tied around the cellophane covered basket with pink paper shreds on the bottom.Here is a breakdown of the individual items you'll receive:Beth's Chocolate Chip CookiesAlmost bite sized cookies that have a shortbread texture.  There are VERY few chips in them but that was fine with me because the cookies were delicious.  I love that style of texture and taste.  The box contained about eight to ten cookies.  I'm not sure if it was the packaging or the style of cookie itself but they were a bit pulverized.4/5 starsBrown and Haley's Cashew RocaOne of my favorites!  There were three individually wrapped, larger than expected cookies.  They were extremely fresh which meant they had a slight crunch but they were easily chewable without sticking to your teeth.  The chocolate was soft and melty.5/5 starsClaeys' Chocolate FudgeI'm not fond of fudge because it's so sweet.  The package contained two individually wrapped pieces.  For me this was just ok.3/5 starsDolcetto's Chocolate CookiesThese are the rolled, Italian like, flakey tube cookies and the outside was chocolate as well as the inside.  Very fresh and though they were all in one package the flaking damage was minimal.  The fudge inside was soft and gooey.  Nice blend of soft and crunchy.4.5/5 starsTorani Chocolate Milano BiscottiYou receive one large biscotti.  The chocolate is in the brisket itself as opposed to being a coating, it's almost a bitter taste though not unpleasant, and it has a few nuts mixed in.  The consistency is a bit too crunchy to my taste.2/5 starsPrimo Dolce Truffle CookiesThere are two large cookies individually wrapped and oh my Goodness they're good!  Each wrapper contains two thick wafers sealed together with chocolate; chocolate also surrounds both of them. Along with the Cashew Roca this was my favorite in the basket.5/5 starsAngelina's Sweet Butter CookiesYou receive ten average sized cookies, 4 round, two oblong, two pretzel shaped and two donut shaped. They're good; a nice relief from chocolate (is there such a thing?).3.5/5 starsBiscoff Caramelized Belgian CookiesYou receive six individual wrapped small rectangle shaped cookies.  Very nice taste with no cloying sweetness.  I would think these would go well served with Earl Grey Tea or black coffee.4/5 stars

Depending on who you're buying this for, it may not be such a big deal that there's more packaging than food in this basket. Where packaging is concerned, it is done well with a bow and all. The basket is very nice and can be re-used. Like the picture shows, most of the boxes are very pink!But on to the contents. Here's what you get (8 boxes total):- Dolcetto Chocolate Cookies. 3 of them, each looks like a cigar with chocolate inside. Nice and tasty.- Claeys Kettle Fresh Chocolate Fudge. 2 individually wrapped pieces. Also very tasty.- Brown & Haley Chashew Roca - 3 individually wrapped (small) pieces. Not too bad, sticks to the teeth though.- Primo Dolce Chocolate Dipped Truffle Cookies. 2 individually wrapped (medium size) cookies. Nice and tasty.- Angelina's Butter Cookies. A tray of different types of butter cookies (like the kind you get in a tin). Pretty good.- Torani Chocolate Milano Biscotti. Just one of these. Has nuts in it and made with bitter sweet cholocate. Very filling and okay (not so tasty).- Beth's Chocolate Chip Cookies. A packet filled with about a dozen small cookies. Nice. They crumble easily though.- Biscoff Carmelized Belgian Cookies. About 5 individually wrapped cookies. It sounds better than it tastes, but still not too bad.Overall this basket has very good presentation value (looks really nice). Most of the food items are good, but there's not as much as food as it looks like when you open it all up. It leaves you feeling a little bit gypped.
This is a great gift item. A good-looking woven basket, with non-perishable, good tasting food treats. All this at a good price. Loved it!

column9: microwave your own tapioca puddingl  please try that instead
column10: This is puzzling, since the pudding by Thankyou is currently not available, because I did receive it via Amazon about two weeks ago.  Well, it would have been terrific to give this product lots of stars and kind words.  For several reasons, i can't praise this product except to say the label is very pretty, the can has a ring that holds well when you open the can, and the manufacturers use real sugar, not some corn-chemical sweetener.I did open a can of this; the product is pale, liquid, and uses tiny bits of tapioca.  No eggs,although eggs are traditional with tapioca pudding.  If it's used again at our house, (bought a six-pack of this) some kind of protein powder to perk this up will be needed, and how do you keep it from making your stomach burn again?The product is "a product of its time",  meaning it is an artificial pudding, very liquid, with artificial colors like tartrazine or yellow number 5, and sunset yellow, or yellow number 6. So now you know that if you invite friends and family for dinner and some in the group are on the Feingold Diet and are sensitive to and trying to avoid artificial colors and flavors, you cannot serve them this.  Sorry.  In trying to make things easier, looks like  we have made them difficult in other ways.  It might be  really neat if you made your own tapioca pudding rather than using this product, and I'm sorry if that sounds  like a lot work, but  you might enjoy it;  it might take about ten minutes in the microwave, eggs, milk, sugar, tapioca, salt, vanilla. Recipes with how many and how much are on the internet. Or it can be made in about twenty minutes uninterrupted using a saucepan on the stove,  Stir  in a figure-8 pattern to avoid scorching, and remove from heat when mixture just comes to a boil.  It thickens as it cools. As for separating egg yolk from white, for the fancy meringue version of tapioca pudding, it's a skill that gets easier with time. One may just crack the eggshell and, while not puncturing the yolk at all,hold the yolk in half the shell while the eggwhite slips away by its own weight.  Maybe this skill isn't the same as sinking a three-point shot from way out; nevertheless you might enjoy cooking your own pudding.  Very sorry could not recommend this canned Thankyou product.

I was excited to purchase this product because gluten free oat bran has not been available in the US until now...gluten free oats, yes...but not oat bran.  For the past two years, I have been purchasing my gluten free oat bran from Canada and have been very pleased with the quality of the product and their customer service.  However, I thought I would try this company to minimize my shipping costs.I received the product quickly; however, when I opened the plastic bag which contained the oat bran, there was a faint, but distinct, odor that I can only describe as sour milk.I notified the company via e-mail through their website and questioned what I might be smelling and whether I received oats that may have gone rancid.  When I did not receive an answer after a few days, I notified them again and added my complaint of poor customer service.  I received an e-mail and a telephone message assuring me that their oats were fresh and had a shelf life of another eight months.  She further explained that they were raw, unprocessed, unsteamed oats and very nutritious.Okay, I thought, so maybe oats that are raw, unsteamed, unprocessed and nutritious have an offensive odor. I am always open to eating foods in their most natural state.  For a few days, I ate the oat bran each morning even though it had a sour, as well as a sweet taste that I am not accustomed to.  I e-mailed the company again to let them know that the odor and taste did not seem right to me.  I asked if they would describe to me the odor of raw, unprocessed, unsteamed oats; but after a week, they have not responded.So either raw, unprocessed, unsteamed oat bran smells like sour milk and has a sour/sweetish taste or the oat bran that I received was rancid.  I guess I'll never know since they won't describe to me what it should smell and taste like.  Whatever the case, I won't buy it again.  I didn't enjoy the taste, as well as the odor.

column9: One of the most disgusting snacks on the market
column10: Bought these at a Target store, and ate two of them thinking the first one might have been defective.  Yes, it tasted that bad.  First, let me discuss the appearance. A little citric acid would have improved flavor, added vitamin C, and not added calories.  One other thing:  These were expensive!  They cost too much for what they are.Overall, I disliked this snack so much I felt the need to go online and write a review.  That alone should tell you to avoid this poor product!

column9: Too many culls, substandard processing, inconsistant moisture content.
column10: Despite how many regions of the USA can grow pumpkins, the market for roasted in-shell pumpkin seeds is dominated by David (Conagra) due to their distribution abilities.  Although David's seeds are too salty, they are a consistent product with good flavor, dense nut meats and well regulated moisture content.  And yes,did I mention that they are too salty.  So when I came upon the high praise given to these seeds, I bought a 12 pack.  As noted, the price on these is significantly lower than Davids.However, I am disappointed with the product.  The first issue I noticed was the lack of grading.  Fallow seeds (flat seeds with no nut meat) and other irregular seeds are included in quantities which vary from pack to pack, but there are too many.  Additionally the nutmeats are quite inconsistent in density and moisture content.  Some nut meats have little density and just crumble during the shelling process. The shells are quite a bit thinner than the David brand, which causes them to collapse, rather than cleanly splitting, when pressured on the edges.  This transfers a lot of the salty shell into your mouth.  So although these have less salt on them, more salt is ingested in the process of eating them.You might be happy with these if you are looking for a cheaper product than the David brand, but I was looking for a superior product and these are not it.

I have eaten many David's pumpkin seeds, but I find them too salty.  I bought a case a month of Klein's for a couple of years, and I thought they were much better.  Amazon stopped carrying the Klein's I was buying, so I tried these.  Wow  - they are even better.  They taste almost exactly like what my own roasted seeds taste like around halloween.  Smaller than the Kleins, but tastier IMHO.  Probably in between Davids and Kleins on salt, but I don't have the packaging to confirm that.Will definitely order again.
I've had David's and a couple other brands pumpkin seeds, ranging fro decent to horrible, but Good Sense far and away has the best pumpkin seeds I've bought.  Love them.

column10: This was the only tea I was able to find at three grocery stores that consisted of only sugar, water and tea leaves.  As an added benefit I believe that everything in it is organic as well.  I was surprised to find that all of the other tea at the grocery store contained 15 plus ingredients, most of which I'd never heard of, with tea leaves not being in the top 5 ingredients.  I do find the tea to be a little sweet for me, but I normally take my tea without sugar.Overall I'd give this 4.5 out of 5 stars.  If you're looking for iced tea that consists of tea, sugar, and water and tastes good you can't go wrong.

This is the best tea I've ever had in my life.  It is perfect, not too strong, not too weak, not too sweet, but sweet enough.  And the flavor is superb; I don't know if they slow-brew it, or what, but whatever they do is perfect.  It gets and A+ from me!This particular tea is the original type.  There are other varieties in which there are added flavors, such as peach, lemon, etc, and I do love those, too, but my favorite type is the original.  And the reason is, I love to taste the tea without any other flavors in the way.  Now don't get me wrong, like I said earlier, I do love the flavored teas, also, and I do drink them.  But this original variety is my favorite of them all, so, therefore, I do drink this type the most (but I also drink the others).  I love to be able to just taste the tea and no other flavors, because, to me, tea itself is an awesome flavor.I guess anybody can brew tea, but I do think this brand is the best I've ever had that is store-bought.  I absolutely love this tea!This tea is organic.If you love tea, then I think you would love this tea.

My family loves this tea because it tastes good.  I love it because when I bought it, it was $13 and change for subscribe and save.  Right after I had it delivered, the price went up $10.00.  What the heck???  Guess I will be cancelling my subscribe and save, unfortunately.
This is my favorite tea.  No artificial anything.  It tastes like down home sweet tea from the old days. My favorite on a hot summer day.

For bottled tea, the Original Sweet Tea is the best I have found so far.  It has a very good, fresh tea flavor and nice tea smell.  Nothing funky, just tea, sugar and water.  Organic if that matters to you.  This tea is the only one that actually tastes like homemade tea (that I have found so far).  It's a bit expensive, but very good.My current favorite, for sure.9-28-2011 Update:  Have now consumed several cases and this is still the best.  Tastes like the tea my mother used to make. ;)11-24-2011 Update:  I continue to enjoy this very fine tea.  Panicked when Amazon was out of stock for awhile, as it's hard to find locally.  Good news is the price actually has dropped - woo hoo!
My family really enjoys this tea. There's no added junk and it's not overly sweet. This is probably my favorite bottled tea beverage.

I fell in love with this product, and have ordered it several times. The only thing holding me back is the high S&H rates right now. I'm hoping the tea will be offered again at the lower price. It's delicious !
Now I drink a lot of tea, I mean a lot. When I opened this bottle my taste bud nuts! Great tea, not too strong, a hint of honey for extra delicious goodness.

I was looking for a good organic black tea made with honest to God natural cane sugar (not some processed version sweetener) that tastes great. I am not into a lot of flavored teas so finding a simple but good sweet tea like grandma used to make has been a challenge. This tea is perfect!!! Sweet Leaf Tea, Original Sweet Tea, 64-Ounce Bottles (Pack of 8)

column4: Desert Gypsy "A Brooklyn Girl Out West"
column10: This is some really great tea; I *LOVE* that it is organic and no junk in it just tea, water, and sugar. Not too sweet, and just the right strength of tea taste. Just like a really good home-brew when served plain and is even better served icy cold with a slice of fresh lemon or lime.The subscribe and save option is a ridiculously good deal at the time of this review (about $1.70 per bottle) and having this shipped to my door could not be cheaper or easier.Very pleased with this purchase and highly recommended!
We love this tea in my house! I feel great letting my family drink it as well since it is organic. My fave is the Unsweet citrus tea!

My husband and I tried this tea when visiting family in Florida.  This was probably the best sweet tea that I've tried that was both sweet enough for my husband yet not overly sweet to me.  It had a pure taste to it without any acidic aftertaste from citrus or chemicals which I find with other bottled sweet teas that even state "sweetened - no lemon".After about a year, this is slowly making its way to the grocery chains in Arizona and mainly found in the "organic food" aisles, but they only carry the smaller 20oz(?) bottles instead of the 64oz bottles.  Therefore, Amazon is still my "go-to" location to purchase this in bulk in the size I prefer.

column9: Delicious and Cheaper Than At Whole Foods
column10: I love this stuff! Unlike Snapples, these have a light, crisp sweetness. I think it's because it uses cane sugar. Great for summer!

column9: This tea is over price here on Amazon!
column10: This tea sells at Walmart for $1.98 per 64 ounce bottle. There is no free shipping it is already added into the price. This is the is the best tea but this is not a good price at all. 8 of these bottles would be a little over $16.00 with tax at Walmart.

column9: Tasty & convenient but  at $3.21 a package, not the best value available
column10: Daverat's Wife speaking:  I made this for my husband and it was very easy to prepare in the microwave.  He enjoyed the meal and stated that he'd love to have them on hand if the price point was more reasonable.  He ate his  Fusilla & Veg Marinara with a large salad seasoned only with some balsamic vingar and had it for his dinner meal.  To use the Chinese food cliche, he told me an hour later he was hungry again so I made him a grilled chicken breast.  That got me to thinking that the packaged meal alone wouldn't work for us as a stand-alone  meal.  We'd have to add to it for it to work.  If these were a dollar per package cheaper after Subscribe & Save, they might make a good shelf stable meal to which you could add cooked chicken strips, canned chicken, black beans or even a high quality pouched tuna.  On it's own, it's not filling enough nor nutritionally complete.Right at this moment, Amazon is showing me an offer for a $5 off Amazon coupon which when applied, brings the price point after Subscribe & Save down to $2.38, which is  quite a bit better and rather tempting.  However, after seeing this, I asked my husband if he wanted me to order some for the pantry and suddenly he wasn't as in love with the product any more.  Oh well!  When you add in the cost of a small salad plus some lean protein such as the gilled chicken breast, even with the $5 off, it brings the per meal cost back up to around $4.60.  That may sound like a bargain if you eat out often or grab fast food a few nights a week but we don't.  I plan our meals out for the week and even sometimes for an entire month ahead of time to get the most from every grocery item we buy and I could make this same dish using Barilla High protein pasta, my own vegetable marinara with veg from my gardens and come out quite a bit cheaper.  I also think I could eliminate some of the high sodium contant and bring down the fat in the dish as well.I gave it four stars, however, because hubby liked it, it was simple to prepare and even a starving teenager can toss in some chicken strips of canned chicken to make it a more filling meal.  There's enough sauce in the meal to coat a moderate amount of added chicken or meat.  I could see this being a good pantry staple for a college student or a busy single person. As shelf-stable meals go, even though I wasn't all that impressed with the sodium count and fat, this brand compares quite favorable with other shelf-stable meals. It could be a good choice for folks in ned of something o brag and nuke quickly at the end of a long day and in place of ordering in restaurant food.  For a family on a budget.. not so much of a deal.

column9: Tasty Whole Grain Fusilli with Veggie Marinara in 60 Seconds!
column10: Whole Grain Fusilli with Veggie Marinara microwaved in 60 seconds is al dente pasta and tasty marinara, so yummy and quick! Discernible pieces of tomato, zucchini, bell pepper, carrots, onion and eggplant make a tasty Marinara sauce. It's neither too sweet nor acidic, just right for my personal preference. But it made me crave sausage and/or meatballs lol. The 60 second microwave time delivers firmer, al dente, 51% Whole Wheat Fusilli. Add a teaspoon of water and another 30 seconds in the microwave delivers a softer pasta. Only 320 calories for the 9 oz serving!The 2-stage plastic film venting and removal is a bit tricky. The unique packaging separates the pourable sauce cup from the pasta so it doesn't get soggy/squishy while cooking. Follow the directions AND steady the container or be prepared to clean spilled sauce.  This item is not something I'd just put on the pantry shelf without explaining the cooking process to my non-instruction-reading offspring.Really disappointed Amazon Prime doesn't currently have this in stock; I'd order it for my lunch/dinner this week. The current available offerings are cost prohibative...it's really good but not worth $40-ish expenditure!

Barilla Whole Grain Fusilli with Vegetable Marinara is tasty and has an excellent chunky vegetable marinara.  I just wish there was more of it.  If you aren't starving or on a diet, the 9oz serving is enough for lunch although you might want to add a piece of fruit to feel full.  The whole grain fusilli cooked to al dente tenderness following the instructions and the chunky marinara sauce is so good that I wished there was more of it.  Rarely do I eat sauce alone but this sauce is good enough to.

Love the idea of ready in a minute pasta and for that alone this product gets praise.  The pasta is whole grain so that's a big plus and it actually comes out al dente.  The vegetable marinara sauce is tasty, but has a high salt content - 710mg for a 9 oz. serving.It looks like much thought and testing went into creating the packaging, but I found it challenging.  You need to pull back the film to expose the sauce tray -- and not spill it.  I had to pull hard on the film, which made the sauce cup wiggle.  Easy to work around, but tricky nonetheless.All in all a step up from usual microwave in a minute fare.

I am usually hesitant to buy ready made meals due to the quality of the food.  This on the other hand had a surprisingly healthier than expected nutrition content.  It had lots of fiber.  And due to the way the meal is prepared, the pasta & other ingredients tasted very fresh!  I usually don't buy stuff like this, but I would buy this again.  When I need an easy lunch to take to work, I am going to buy some more of these.

Barilla Whole Grain Fusilli with Vegetable Marinara Sauce is very good.  It needs no refrigeration, so you can toss it into your kitchen cabinet, your desk at work or leave it in your briefcase.  It's quick to fix - only taking ONE MINUTE to heat in the microwave, you'll be eating before you know it.  And it's quite tasty!  Not something you just nuke and scarf to fill your belly.  The 9 ounce size is filling, but you can add a salad and bread if you're really hungry.  The pasta has a nice al dente chew to it and the sauce is really flavorful.  I love that this meal is only 320 calories and made with healthier whole grain pasta.  I will definitely buy these to keep on hand when I need something quick and tasty!

I give this 5 stars if you like the taste of whole grain pasta... whole grain pasta has a pretty strong, distinctive flavor if you're used to regular ol' non-whole-grain pasta, and that flavor isn't hidden by this sauce.  If you already know that you don't like the taste of whole grain pasta, these meals aren't for you.  I'm a picky eater so I couldn't really get past the whole grain pasta, but my husband ended up eating all of it and he really liked it.This cooked quickly (which is great on lunch break!) and the sauce and the pasta cook separately, then you mix them together when they're hot.  I like this preparation, as it kept the pasta from getting gummy.  The pasta was nicely done, slightly chewy, and the sauce was good and there's plenty of it (other reviewers have said that there wasn't enough sauce, but that wasn't the case for me, and I like it saucy).This isn't really the most economical pasta & sauce lunch option, I'm sure getting a pound of pasta, cooking it, and adding a jar or two of pasta sauce would be cheaper, but these Barilla meals are about convenience.  I'll buy a few of them and have my husband take them to work to keep in his desk, for those days when he forgets to grab his lunch bag from the kitchen counter on his way out the door in the morning.

This was just awful.  I love pasta and whole grain pasta.This had an awful smell, the color was horrible and the texture was bad.  The taste was even worse.It was so bad that I could only take a forkful of it and then I had to heave it.  It was really, really bad.

If you want a quick meal, this is it.  I was disappointed that it says "made with 51% whole grain pasta" as the name leads you to think it is all whole grain pasta.  It tastes great and is quick and easy to make. Add a salad or veggie and you have a meal. Would be great for dorm room meal if you have a microwave.

I tried this for lunch at work once, and I regretted not bringing something else. The sauce is great, it doesn't taste like a ton of preservatives nor does it leave an aftertaste like these kinds of sauces often do. The real problem is the pasta. It tastes, to put it bluntly, like cardboard. I've had whole grain many times before, and I know it doesn't normally taste like that. I wasn't so disgusted that I couldn't eat it, but the whole time I wished I had something else.The serving size was an additional problem. Maybe good for a really light lunch when you're home, but no good when you've been at work and you'd like something to satisfy you. When I finished this I had to run out to buy something else because I was still pretty hungry. It felt like I had a snack more than anything.

First off, I guess I didn't catch that this was whole grain - I don't much care for whole grain pasta, though this is no worse than any OTHER whole grain pasta.  That pretty much spoiled the whole thing for me. The packaging is clever and convenient, and the heat was perfect for eating IMMEDIATELY after microwaving (I mean, after completing the microwaving and mixing in the sauce.)The big problem for me was that it is pretty light on the marinara sauce - there's just enough to flavor all the fuselli - which might be ok if you like the taste of whole-grain pasta - but as aforesaid, I don't!  I thought the FLAVOR of the sauce was OK, and if there had been enough to drown the flavor of the pasta, I'd have no complaints!

column4: Glenda Boozer "Live, live, live! Life is a ba...
column9: Quick food you don't mind eating.
column10: Barilla Whole Grain Fusilli with Vegetable Marinara is a decent light meal with whole grain and veggies - you even get your lycopene. In 60 seconds, you get al dente whole-grain pasta and sauce with diced vegetables. There are directions for softer pasta, but I like it fine the 60-second way.

You don't need to refrigerate this Barilla, Whole Grain Fusilli. Keep in in the pantry. Take it out, pop it in the microwave for a couple of minutes, take it out, peel back the cover, pour the upper container of sauce  over the steamed tender whole grain noodles, and there you have a fresh tasting, whole grain macaroni dinner.It's not quite as good as a pasta dish at your favotite Italian restaurant ,  but it's close - and you don't need a reservation, not do you need to tip the waiter.

Having always been partial to Barilla sauces, when I saw this whole Grain Fusilli offering on the Vine program, I gladly ordered one.And we were not sorry. This was a nice "fast" food dinner, without the extra calories or fat.The sauce in this case was a little sweet, but it was a good meal. Thanks Barilla!

column9: chewy pasta, tasty spice sauce makes a winner
column10: In an era of "quick and easy-to-prepare" food, the microwave is a time saver but one must take care what to buy. Is it tasty? Is it easy to heat? Barilla's whole grain fusili with vegetable marinara sauce meets the needs of the "on the run" pasta lover. No cholesterol, a dab of sodium (710 mg), this microwave chewy,  "al dente" fusilli has a snappy marinara sauce which makes it a fine purchase for the solo eater. One caution: be careful with the nifty container when removing its plastic covering, the pull back disguises a small white tray for the sauce which can tip and spill. Heed the instructions. Otherwise, this is a fine nutritious meal for the solo eater. I intend to buy more.

whenever you buy these types of microwave meals you go into it not expecting much.  Often, they're not very flavorful and the pasta tastes llike cardboard.  Well this product didn't disappoint.  The sauce was rather bland and eating the noodles was like eating paper. Quite honestly I would never try this again.

column9: Tasty, high fiber, vegetarian convenience food
column10: As long as you enjoy the dense heartiness of whole grain pasta--I prefer it--this is delicious. It has a whopping 11 grams of fiber, that's 44% of the Daily Value, which is partially achieved by the addition of oat fiber so it should be a good choice for people who want to lower their cholesterol. The field for tasty, healthful,  vegetarian convenience foods is pretty sparse, so this is a welcome addition. Besides all the fiber, it's got 10 grams of protein, but with no legumes or dairy that protein isn't complete and you may want to add something with complementary amino acids to your meal. The calorie total is 320, so  that something extra shouldn't wreck a diet.Because it's manufactured on equipment that processes food with eggs, vegans and people with an egg allergy may want to avoid this product. One negative is that the sodium is a little higher than I like to eat in a meal, 710mg, but for a prepared food that's not bad. Also, the film covering the tray was difficult for the starting-to-age joints in my hand to pull back so I had to enlist my boyfriend. It's a slightly tricky move too, because you are at risk of jolting the sauce out of its tray and onto the counter or floor, but I'm sure people with average dexterity will have no problem.

What's not to like?  You're getting a healthy Italian lunch, low fat, easily stored (I usually eat at my desk at work and keep meals like this in my desk drawer), ready for the microwave, and a meal that is natural and whole-grain.  A lot of similar packages are loaded with unpronounceable chemicals, but not this one.  It's lunch without worrying about what you're putting in your body.  A bit high in the sodium dept, but otherwise this is all-around a great way of getting lunch.

column9: Better than the regular Barilla pasta bowls
column10: I've actually been eating these Barilla pasta bowls for a while. Yet, it wasn't until this Amazone Vine offering that I realized that these convenient lunches came in whole grain since my local grocery store does not carry them for some reason.These pasta bowls aren't by any means amazing, but they aren't bad for something you can just pop in the microwave for a minute and have lunch. It's perfectly portable for work, easy to make, better than many of the other microwaveable lunches I've had and -the best part -it doesn't require the freezer or refrigerator. And the whole grain pasta is considerably better than the regular pasta. The marinara sauce isn't bad either, and it actually has small pieces of veggies in it.The only problem I have with these bowls is that they just don't fill me up. I'm a small person, and I don't even eat a lot, but I could easily down two of these in one sitting without a problem. This bothers me because every other microwaveable lunch I've tried can fill me up without having to pack other lunch items. I guess this can be something of a personal preference, but I would rather just throw the pasta bowl in my bag and go instead of having to pack other items.

After trying Barilla's Whole Grain Fusilli with Vegetable Marinara, one may say that not any one microwaveable meal is the same.  From the ability to open the package with ease to warming the meal in only 60 seconds, Barilla provides a satisfying experience for the hungry consumer.  And in addition, the pasta meal is delicious, the tomato sauce is perfectly placed and not messy to prepare, and nutritious, especially with the variety of choices that Barilla offers.  The meal is convenient for anyone that has to eat on the go or simply want a simple lunch or small meal anytime of the day.

column9: Barilla Whole Grain fusilli with Vegetable Marinara
column10: If you like pasta, then you should try this. I liked it because it contained whole grain, and it was so easy to make.

This is the second of these Barilla microwaveable pasta dishes I've tried, and I enjoyed it as much as the other (the penne with tomato and basil sauce).You store these meals at room temperature, yet they taste as good as any premium frozen pasta entrees I've ever tried.In addition, the manufacturer claims to use NO artificial ingredients or preservatives.I'm not sure what alchemy makes all this happen, but one secret of the superior flavor and texture of these pasta dishes lies in the packaging: the plastic pasta tray has a removeable "sub-tray" in the corner that holds the sauce separate from the pasta.This enables the pasta to remain al dente.Heating these dishes is very fast and easy as well.  Just peel back a corner of the cover to vent the sauce and pop the dish in the microwave for sixty seconds.I'm also impressed to see that at Amazon's prices, these dishes aren't horribly exorbitant either.  More expensive than Chef Boyardee in a can, but probably a bit less than a frozen entree.My only quibble is I really wouldn't call one of these dishes a "meal."  The portion size is nominally 9 ounces, but I would consider this a light lunch at best -- and I would probably be starving by tea time.Nevertheless for pasta fans looking for a quick and delicious pasta fix, these Barilla dishes are definitely worth trying.PROS:* Great taste and texture.* Fast and easy to prepare.* Store at room temperature; no need to use up valuable freezer space.* All natural ingredients with NO preservatives.* Reasonably priced for the quality and convenience.CONS:* Portion a bit skimpy for a meal.* One must wonder if chemicals from the plastic cooking trays will leech into the food.

column9: OK, but NOT that easy to prepare.
column10: I really like pasta, so I'm probably not a good judge of what's "good" in pasta - I like it all.  That said, I liked this product as far as the food, the taste, etc. goes.  However, I have to say that I really prefer the packaged pasta dishes that Hormel puts out.  With the Hormel products everything in the package is already together.  All you have to do is throw them in the microwave for a bit and you're done - and flavor/product-wise the Hormel packages are just as good as this.  So, in a nutshell - while I liked this product, I really like the Hormel pastas better and will probably stick with those in the future.

Of the different varieties I tried of these Barilla pasta meals, this was just okay.  The wheat pasta was a bit mushy and I didn't like the texture/taste.  My sister and niece (who I was sharing this with) agreed that the pasta could have been a little more al dente, but they liked the pasta and thought this was better than the other ones we tried.  We all liked the sauce - sweet with chunks of vegetables.Overall, the one minute in the microwave was plenty of time - meal was hot enough.  The top - a sealed piece of plastic that you peel off over the sauce to cook then fully remove to pour the sauce over the pasta - is a bit difficult to remove.  I slopped some sauce trying to get it off so if you're making these at work, be careful.Calorie wise, this was just over 300 calories and had 11 grams of fiber.  The portion is very generous (I thought...) and the sodium content, while not low, isn't too bad (around 700 mg).  Though I would not buy this flavor again, I will buy some of the others.

The ease of preparation for BARILLA's fusilli w/veggy marinara is more than offset by aroma and taste.To prepare, a corner of the top seal is lifted to vent a sauce tray. Nuked for a minute, everything's hot.When you peel back the rest of the cover you're hit with an unsavory odor, can't call it an aroma, that doesn't stimulate the appetite.Lift the sauce tray out, spoon the gravy over the pasta, and there isn't enough to cover all. ehThe first bite reveals that the smell you immediately noticed is part of the food's taste. This stuff's edible, but only if there isn't something else available.NUTRITION FACTS: 50 of the 9 oz. serving's 320 calories derive from fat, mostly saturated. It's a good source of fiber (44% RDA) has 57 grams of carbs, a zero cholesterol rating (despite saturated fats), and is high in sodium (710 mg, or 30% of RDA). One serving provides 25% of your Vitamin A needs, 15% of iron, 6% of calcium.And yet, after my free Vine serving, I would never buy BARILLA's nukeable pasta and wouldn't eat it again if comped in advance.

I try this Arbucle pumkin coffee and when I tasted... WOW!!! I also bought the Amoretti pumkin spice syroup and pour a teaspoon of it in every cup, HEAVEN!!!!!!I highly recommend this product, My friends LOVE IT!!!!!

I hadn't had bit-o-honey since I was a little girl, my mom used to get the bars, and she'd give me a bite of it for a treat.  Heard someone mention them and I just had to get me some... Glad Amazon had them to buy. Thanks Amazon., well worth it!!!
I remembered eating Bit-O-Honey as a child but could not find it in stores; so I shopped on-line and found it and ordered five pounds. It is as good as I remembered it - a verty tasty taffy.

Great little party favors.  I used it for a retirement party for a Butcher.  I also personalized the label and everyone thought it was the most creative thing ever.  It cost me a little over $40.00 for 72 personalized party favors.

I do not know why this oatmeal is better than any other I have ever had. It looks and seems just like the others, but it ends up with this perfect texture, on the stovetop or following the directions on back for the microwave. I love oatmeal, as does my family, and we have tried many brands over the years. This kind is by far the best, IMO. My 9 year old daughter agrees. Won't even eat, for example, Publix's old fashioned organic oatmeal, which turns out too mushy for our tastes. My 70 yr old aunt also loves oatmeal and this is the only brand she has found that does not cause her indigestion (don't know why!) Regarding the weevils comment by another reviewer, the comment kept me from purchasing this from Amazon for a while. But, I did order it from them months ago. Went through the entire 12 boxes without a single weevil. Also, it was totally fresh, just as if bought from Whole Foods, but for less money. I highly recommend this delicious oatmeal.
I purchased a case.  The first box I opened was full of weevils, disgusting!My money was refunded, but I will never buy this product on-line again.
The tastes of rye and pumpernickel and caraway seeds make your salad an event you'll anticipate!  Wish my store still stocked them.

I love these croutons, even though the wife laughs at me for ordering them by mail. They are a combination of different breads incl rye and pumpernickel, and the flavoring is not overpowering. they're pretty large, and soak up a lot of dressing. Mmmm...

Authentic and flavorful. Just mix with yogurt, EVOO, and a little vinegar. Let chicken marinate in this mixture at least an hour and then pop chicken on grill or in a 500 degree oven until done.  That's it. Final product is not bright red like many tandooris, but there is no artificial red color in it like in many other tandoori preparations.

We love Tandoori Chicken with Basmati Rice. This seasoning mix is so perfect and allows us to enjoy a Restaurant Quality meal at home.Since we don't have a Tandoor Oven, we cook the skewers of chicken on our gas BBQ (at very high heat) with the lid closed. (We often use boneless/skinless breasts, cut into large chunks.)We use the left over marinade to baste the chicken twice (once when first placed on the BBQ and then when turned the first time). Just remember that the marinade was originally soaking in raw chicken. So, to make sure any harmful bacteria are killed, baste early and then let the high heat do its job.When cooking for just the two of us, we cut the marinade recipe in half and only use half of the seasoning packet.Enjoy

column9: Easy to make - Great reviews from guests
column10: One Saturday I was watching Aarti Sequeira's show on Food Network on Tandoori Chicken. It looked great and her guests loved it.  The only problem for me was getting ALL of the various spices, measuring them and putting it together.I found this product on Amazon and it has a few very good reviews. Since I wanted to cook something different for my guests, I gave it a try.First, it was super easy!  Yogurt and the Arora Creations Tandoori Chicken spice packets was all it took.  I did a double batch. Total prep time was under 20 minutes. I let it marinate five hours. I used skinless, boneless chicken thighs.  On a hot BBQ prepared with lump hardwood charcoal (not briquettes), I cooked each side for about 3 minutes. It had a wonderful char.On the same grill I cooked Naan bread. The bread, tandoori chicken and a light potato salad was a huge hit.  We have guests coming over this month. Two of them were here for the tandoori chicken. They told the rest of folks coming and begged me to make it again.Yes, you can buy all the tandoori spices and measure them out, but why? This is easy and delicious.

If you want authentic and extremely tasty Indian tandoori chicken (be it bone-in or boneless, this is the way to go! It is very easy to prepare and no matter how you cook the chicken (last night I baked it in the oven) it turns out so good! Prepare it with Naan found on the allrecipes.com website and you'll have yourself a wonderful meal. Now we just need to find some mint chutney for the naan and mulligatawny (sp?)!I recommend this whole-heartedly!
I love this brand of white beans and have not found othersthat are as good. Could not find them in any stores in myarea, so tried Amazon. Very pleased.

Needed some bulk quantity jelly beans to fill small jars for baby shower favors.  Buying them this way saved a lot of money over buying them by the pound at the local candy store.  As stated in another review, the jelly beans just come in an unlined cardboard box.  This seemed a bit odd, but there were 2 sheets of wax paper, I guess to prevent dust, etc from getting into the box through the top and bottom.  Not much else to say, they're Jelly Belly's at about half the cost of the local guy!

column9: I wouldn't buy this product again!
column10: My review on this is not based on actually trying the product and this is because the bag it came in looks like a regular goody bag which they just attached their packing labels on, which usually wouldn't bother me, but it was sealed with red tape! I just like my products to be sealed more professionally! =/
Passable, not as bad as Mariani Mediterraneans, but not nearly so good as California Blenheims. Would I buy them again? No.  Did we eat them all? Yes.

Wanted apricots to try making gluten free granola.While I would have preferred unsulphered apricotsthey are so nasty looking I didn't think my familywould eat them!  Everyone loves these!  Very goodprice too.

These are the best dried apricots I've found.  This is the 2nd year I've bought them, and I'm still impressed.These apricots are much softer/juicier than the tubs found at the grocery store (which tend to be over-dried & more like shoe-leather, in my experience!)These may be a seasonal item.  I tried to pick some up last summer, but they were not listed.  They were relisted in November.
The taste was good but it developed these huge sugar crystals after less than a month in the fridge! Not what you want when you want a cold cup of chocolate milk.

We buy this all the time and haven't had any problems with it crystallizing.  We use it fairly quickly since my son drinks chocolate milk as one of his few protein sources (recommendation from the dietician!).  Its pretty rich, so we don't use a full 2 Tablespoons.  My complaint here is that it costs more per bottle than I can get it for at that national grocer otherwise known as whole paycheck.

If you like gingerbread, then this is one of the only gingerbread pancakes mixes I could find.  As I am a ginger lover, they are a bit mild for me, but I think right for most tastes.  I like them for a change of pace from regular pancakes, especially with powdered sugar on top!
These are the best pancakes ever. Not too sweet and not overpowering. I know they are good with fruit but I love them with honey. If you like pancakes at all you have got to try these, simply heaven.

column9: My dog wouldn't even eat it...
column10: I have two overweight cats and they were put on a high protein diet to lose weight. I was looking for a high protein cat food that I didn't have to purchase at the vet. My cats are not picky eaters and they hated it.  I had to wash the dishes before they would even consider eating another food out of them. My dog wouldn't even clean up the pieces that were on the floor. It is also crumbles very easily so there is a powder residue everywhere.

I was cat sitting and decided to try some of this for my kitties, and they love it and never looked back!Before I was giving them the Wellness Indoor health cat food (which I still stand by), but I found my 2 cats who are quite picky eaters actually prefered this new food, and willfully ignored their old food unless they had to eat it. In 2 weeks time I have seen their consumption go down (aka less litter presents) as well as their coats seem shiner. I also think they prefer the softness/shape better as they don't throw the food out of the bowl as they try to munch it up like before.

column9: A Good Ginger Chew, If You Like Peanut Butter.
column10: The Fresh and Easy Neighborhood Market nearby has a variety of gourmet candies and I enjoy trying them. Many, if not most, are imported. One of the types they have are three different kinds of Chimes Ginger Chews. I tried two of the kinds and enjoyed them very much The third was a Peanut Butter Ginger Chew. Somehow, the idea of ginger mixed with peanut butter just wasn't all that attractive to me. Finally, I got around to trying them and purchased a 1,5-ounce bag. Well, they're a good candy, but I'll go along with my instincts and say that they aren't as good as the other two varieties.
