column10: I bought these on a whim. The mix sounded interesting and the reviews were outstanding. Wow, this stuff is so good. Not only are the flavors great, but the popcorn itself is the perfect consistency. Just very fresh tasting. I read other reviews on here that described the mix as more sweet. That is not my experience. The cheese popcorn may be a little lighter than you would expect (and by that, I mean not laden with tons of salty orange powder), but it definitely makes its presence known in the mix. Will most certainly order again.

I order the chicago mix and wow...incredible.  Best popcorn I have ever had.  Everybody who comes by my house for parties just freaks out at how good it is.  Ordered the case and had 5 bags gone (not just me) in 3 days.  Highly highly recommended.

This stuff is amazing! The combination of the cheddar and caramel is so delicious.  I honestly wish I never bought it because I cannot stop eating it. At this rate, the entire 12 bags will be gone by the weekend (and it's already Thursday).

Yummy, Yummy!!  I'll never be a size 4 anyway.  Our local Costco had this & I got hooked.  I subscribed when they stopped carrying it.  The best part is that it is gluten free and it doesn't taste like it.  Added bonus is that the cheddar doesn't come off as much like Popcornopolis does.

Cretors carmel-cheese popcorn is awesome!  I live outside Chicago, so we can get Garrett's Popcorn.  And if I am going to eat it all while it is warm then fine.  But Cretors really is as good and it keeps way better and is way cheaper.  I can have an open bag for two weeks and it is just as good.  I just saw that Amazon will be carrying it and am waiting for it since Costco no longer carries it.  Their loss, and mine.  Hopefully Amazon will HURRY!!!  Keep in mind though that the though there is not tons of carmel corn there is enough and it mostly settles.

column9: just like being at Garrett's in Chicago!!
column10: I've been to the famous Garrett's in Chicago and had the REAL cheddar cheese/ carmel corn mix and would have to say that I was delighted to find this popcorn in our local stores!  The minute I tried it, I loved it!!

I'm not a very big fan of cheese popcorn,but the combination of the caramel corn and the cheese popcorn make for a great combination,my wife and I love the Chicago Mix alot,whenever we have a snack,Chicago Mix it is.

This is absolutely the best bagged popcorn I have ever tasted.  My whole family loves the freshness of it; the texture of it and the taste of it.  Not only that but this popcorn is made with the finest ingredients!  Only a few natural ingredients make this popcorn the best available on the market...and I have done my share of taste tasting.  My only hope is that they come up with more varieties.  I have purchased the Chicago Mix and simply Kettle so far...
AWESOME stuff.  We host war room for EOQ at work and go thru cases of this!!!  the sweet with the cheesy - you can't ask for anything better!!!
If you like the original Chicago Mix by Garrett from Chicago, this comes pretty close! Love the sweet and salty mix of cheddar and caramel popcorn.

This popcorn is excellent.  I ordered it previously and my son loved it.  So when we were down to one bag left he asked if I could order some more.  This is always a favorite when we have people over or my son has friends over and they watch a game or a movie.

Love Cretors Popcorn.  I had never had it before until my brother brought me a bag.  I then ordered a 12 pack through Amazon.  Best snack ever.  If you haven't  tried Cretors Popcorn you don't know what you are missing.  Chedder and Carmel Corn is my favorite!!
My family loves this popcorn mix and we can not buy it in the south. It is so yummy! You will not go wrong buying this mix.

This is great popcorn, all of it. None of it gets caught in-between your teeth. There are no husks or whatever the corn terminology is for those little bits that you find floating in your mouth afterwards. And it tastes great. Glad I found it.
It is the next best thing to gettig a fresh bag of chicago mix from garretts. Don't forget to shake the bag first to mix.

column9: delicious & different flavor combo, plus GMO-free!
column10: We had the pleasure of sampling all of the G.H. Cretors' popcorn varieties. The Chicago Mix was by far the favorite with both adults and kids. I never would have thought to pair sweet caramel corn with tangy cheese, but it's a winning combination. My kids became quickly obsessed with this one, and I was so glad to find a GMO-free treat. Added bonus for the inclusion of lower-glycemic brown rice syrup.

This popcorn is definitely really tasty.  I am knocking off ONE star for the relatively small quantity in the bag (open it and it appears almost halfway empty, which is probably a good thing because it's delicious and I tend to eat the whole bag in a couple hours).  I agree that it seems heavier on the caramel corn, and I'd prefer a bit more cheddar corn.  Overall a delicious product though.  Tastes very fresh, and few hulls.

I just bought some today from World Market because I was craving popcorn. My favorite popcorn happens to be cheddar and caramel. I really like how it is all natural and instead of using corn syrup for the caramel popcorn they use brown rice syrup. Its a very tasty snack and is highly addicting! I recommend buying this you wont be disappointed! I just wish more stores where I lived carried the other flavors too.

column9: Be careful - this stuff is so good that it's dangerous.
column10: I ordered this popcorn after falling in love with Garrett's Popcorn in Chicago/NYC.  While this popcorn isn't quite the same, its still really, really good.  The caramel corn does tend to sink to the bottom but it's so well packaged that almost every kernel was perfect.  I was shocked that popcorn could look so nice after shipping.  If you're a fan of Chicago style popcorn and have any type of self control, order some of this right now.  If you don't have self control you should still order it but make sure you subscribe and save!

column9: Better than Garret's | Excellent Value for Price | NOT Greasy | BEST popcorn ever
column10: I never write reviews, but this popcorn left me speechless.I'm actually don't like popcorn, and have it at the movies in limited quantities. Then, I tried Garret's chicago mix and have been craving it for a while now. I almost ordered from Garret's online but the cost with shipping was ludicrous. So I searched Amazon and found this gift from popcorn heaven.Why I liked it?- Excellent quality: Takes garret's recipe and makes it 100x better.- Low Price: I know it's 30 bucks, but it's worth it. But you get 12 huge popcorn bags!- Not greasy: No grease, no bad odor, and man they look good.Thank you G.H Cretors and Amazon...made me realize popcorn heaven is for real.

I snagged a bag of this at Fresh Market and was so absolutely hooked from the first bite that it wasn't even funny.  I have had popcorn this good before when I was in Chicago and had it freshly made, but it's never as good after a couple of hours. This popcorn is cheesy without being salty and has just enough of the sweet with the caramel to mix it up in your mouth.  I have ordered a case of this and a case of the Just the Cheese to store for our monthly family movie nights.  A few bags aren't going to make it because I can't stop sneaking some for me.

OMG! I just came from "The Fresh Market" tonight and happened to pick up G.H.Cretors' Chicago Mix of Caramel and Cheese Popcorn......Did I say OMG!?Oh...My...God!!!!!The BEST EVER!I'm not even exaggerating. I almost finished the entire bag and this is messingme up for dinner tonight. lol. I'm about to be too full. Ok - just picture, ifyou will - the BEST caramel corn you've ever had - combined with the BEST cheesecorn you've ever had. Now put those two tastes together...sprinkle some MMMMMMMMon them - and there you have G.H. Cretors!Delicious!!!!I'm hooked.Ok - that is all.

I brought a bag home with me one day. After eating some of it, I knew that it would have to fill the Christmas stocking of my entire family. Everyone loves it! I have sent other popcorn items in the past, from "Moose Munch" on down and nothing beats this.  If you like a sweet and salty corn with few hulls and large fluffy kernels, then this is the product for you.The only con is that it disappears so fast! Glad Amazon sells it in a case of 12 bags.

This popcorn is the best!!  My husband & I are totally addicted!  I can't get it in the stores around here, so online ordering works for us.  It was supposed to be for Christmas but it's almost gone so we will need to order more.

LOVE ... LOVE ... LOVE THIS POPCORN!  So sad Costco stopped carrying it, but I understand from Cretors they will start again in September '11.  A little hint, shake the bag up everytime you go to eat some.  The caramel corn sinks to the bottom as it sits and this mixes it back up.  I find the best ratio is 2 cheese to 1 caramel.  It's addicting ....Marilyn

First found this popcorn at our local Costco and by far the very best bagged popcorn mix you will ever have.  Been in contact with Cretors and informed me it would be on amazon, cannot wait.  Once you taste this you too will become a fan........

column9: Love it Love it Love it
column10: Once you open the bag, prepare to finish the whole thing!  This product is made by a great family company that believes in awesome family/business values!  The carmel corn is to die for, sweet, crunchy but not too heavy.  The cheese corn melts in your mouth and is a great savory compliment to the sweet caramel corn taste.  It is a new combination of classic flavors!

Tried a sample at Costco before buying a bag.  Opened bag at home, and have found through a few 2-cup servings, that the mix is rather heavy on the sweet and lighter on the cheddar (I would prefer the opposite mix - more cheddar corn, please).  Also, these kernels have plentiful hulls.  Don't think I'll buy this again.
This is a wonderful vanilla for baking. The bottle with cork stopper is a nice touch and adds to the effect as a gift. Good product with a great taste.
Have used this product for a number of years and have found it to be the best as my taste buds go

My children brought me a bottle of this vanilla after visiting Mexico.  It is great stuff and I actually find that due to the concentration of flavor I can generally use 1/2 of the amount called for in recipes.  The handblown glass bottle makes a terrific vase or decoration when emptied.

I was able to get a huuuuge version of this for $3 more  when I went to Cancun, unfortunately I had accidentally packed it on the carry on and it was confiscated.  I personally don't think paying $21 for 7 oz is worth it.......
These bars are the best for school lunches, traveling, or just to have have if you are in a hurry.  No added ingredients, no wheat, no gluten, no dairy, JUST FRUIT.  We think they are best

column9: Only wish it was made in the US
column10: It is so nice to get 8 bottles of this at a time! We live in a small town, with limited options for organic juices. This is a lifesaver since our toddler loves her apple juice. I only wish it were made in the US, rather than Turkey.
Sorry but I think natural organic and Made in China does not mix for my children. I think American apple concentrate is what I want.

Can you imagine while I was drinking a glass of Hansens "Natural " apple juice, I noticed on the plastic container the words" made from concentrate from USA or .........CHINA...!!!!!!. The bottom line must be most important to them,
This is an Amway product. You can buy it for $6 less off the Amway website. Don't buy this product here.

My kids go through this apple juice like it's going out of style.  In fact I need to order more.  It's organic which is great and no sugar added, because fruit doesn't need help.  Definitely a must in our house.

I eat these in salads.  They are pretty plain all by themselves but when you mix them in with a great salad, with a good salad dressing, they really do the trick. It's impossible to find any stuffed grape leaves in any of the grocery stores in my area.  I had to travel to another state, although only a half hour away, to get them, but then they changed the brand they carried to a different one. I didn't like them at all.  So I was very happy to see that I could purchase them on Amazon.  Amazon is now my favorite place to shop...I buy so much stuff here that I never knew they had.

column9: Not the product, but the dated product
column10: First of all I want to say that my dog loves the Wellness treats and I think they are one of the best treats out there for your dogs health.  However, I ordered this item in a three-pack in August, and they sent me items that expired in September.  These are normally dated out a year or more since they are a jerky.  Not cool.
I am eating these figs from the last one month. These figs are dried inside and out and taste very good

These are very dry, lightweight small figs that taste just like the inside of a Fig Newton. One of the best trail snacks ever. They're nearly impossible to find outside an Iranian market. I was delighted to find them on Amazon!

I was a bit disappointed with these figs.  The price was good no doubt but the product was not the highest quality.  The figs are dried out and not the freshest.  I've purchased these shirazi figs before from a Middle Eastern store and fell in love with these little gems.  Those were so delicious but way too expensive for an on-going habit.  I think it's worth it though for a little treat once in awhile.  If I have a craving for these figs I'll purchase them from the store next time and pay a little extra.

column9: sadaf dried figs shirazi white dried figs
column10: very hard to find item bt its a good thing I found it at this website good price & shipped wellthis is delicious when your drinking your tea no sugar needed bec of the sweetness of the figs
I bought these peas and carrots for my children and they got a kick out of them. I served them in a little toy pan and it went over very well. They look realistic and taste great.
You need to try this sauce ASAP! It is drop dead delish! I eat it on pasta and throw in some field roast veggie sausage. Great combo!

I can't buy the small jars of Oomas because my husband loves it so much he wants to eat the leftovers with a spoon right out of the pot. Perfect as is over pasta, but you can add your favorite extras or take a tried-and-true recipe to a new level of yum. Very smooth. Not too sweet. Just all around delicious. It is the only marinara sauce we eat. Better than anything I make myself.

Better than any other marinara sauce in the stores. Made by hand in the Berkshires, and before now, available in Whole Foods, Dean and DeLucca, and small stores selling top notch food products. So glad it is now fearured by Amazon!!!!!
I'm such a fan of Ooma Tesoro's marinara sauce that I've started giving it as gifts for friends. Nice way to spread the word of a great product!

Not all marinara sauces are created equal, and Ooma Tesoro's is the perfect example of this.  We first discovered it in a small beachside cafe, and ever since then we search it out whenever we are in the area.  The last time we discovered it at a farmer's market we bought a whole case.  Now that Amazon carries it we will never run out!

This tomato sauce is delicious!  It has a nice thin consistency which makes it versatile for different dishes.  Very nice flavor and made with good quality ingredients.  It tastes very good on it's own, too.

This is one delicious sauce! It's one of the few marinara sauces one can pour straight from the jar on the most simple thing and have it be turned into a gourmet meal. Pour over ravioli, tortellini, use on pizza or as a dipping sauce, and you are ready to eat! So easy and good. Would also make a great gift for the discerning cook. Highly recommend you get sauced by Ooma's!

I really love this sauce.  I use it in a variety of recipes - made a pizza with swiss chard, mozzarella and Ooma's last week.  Used it for a zucchini parmesan this week.  It's versatile, fresh and tastes homemade.
Can't get enough of this incredible marinara. Kids and adults love!! So fresh and flavorful. It is a must have in the pantry.

Ooma's is delicious- pure and simple. I have tasted most marinara's out there, and Ooma's is the best.Made by hand in the Berkshires. True Italian sauce.Fresh and no added " filler" ingredients.I have a jar waiting in my cabinet at all times.Delicious with pasta, fish, seafood. Eat with fresh bread- yum!Buy it, Try it, Eat it! It won't disappoint. It will become a culinary staple in your kitchen.I hope Ooma Tesoro's makes more products!

column9: Best Sauce Ever, A Must Have!
column10: A must order for everyone! This sauce tastes SO homemade. It is great not only on pasta, but a marinade for many other things. It tastes especially delicious on quinoa with fresh grated cheese! This sauce is a staple I always have in stock in my cabinet! Yay for Ooma's!
Fresh, just enough herbs and spices. The grandchildren REQUIRE it on everything. Now I use it in place of ketchup. I cannot recommend it more highly. You get what you pay for.

I LOVE Ooma Tesoro's Marinara Sauce!!!!  Not only for pasta but I have used it with chicken and pork.  Fantastic.  You must try it!I also am so happy that I can buy it on Amazon, because I buy everything on Amazon.
This sauce is crazy good. I picked up a few jars on a whim, and now my children ask for it by name. HIGHLY recommended; delicious without being too overpowering.

I love this white chocolate. I make my white chocolate mochas with it and they turn out great...so much better than starbucks or any other coffee taste. I make my kids drinks with just milk and the chocolate powder also and they love them. It saves so much money making lattes from home, I highly recommend this to any coffee lover (I don't use it for anything else) And the box lasts so much longer than any can!

I'm on at least my 4th box of this awesome stuff.  I used to own a coffee shop, and we never used anything but this for our mochas.  It has no chemical taste like the other brand's white chocolate "goo" does.  Always mixes perfectly with nothing left at the bottom.  Shipping is super-fast, and the price is right!
This is what you want, if you want the best white mocha cappuccino or a really great white hot chocolate. Stay away from the white chocolate syrups, they can't compare.

column9: Perfect for hot or cold drinks
column10: I love this powder for the ease of use. It is great for hot or cold drinks and has reach taste and flavor. Great quality as Chirardelli always do.

I have been using this stuff for over 12 years now. Used to be able to get it locally around Seattle when I lived there. Living in central Ohio now(I hate Seattle), I cant find it anywhere so I have to order it online(not a big deal though, still worth it). Why spend 5$ for a white mocha at Starbucks which in my opinion doesn't even taste as good as the ones I make at home with this white chocolate powder? you do the math. I have tried the Ghirardelli white chocolate sauce but I still like the powder more.I don't know if the Ghirardelli Chocolate Premium Hot Beverage Mix, White Mocha is the same as this white chocolate powder or not. I saw one reviewer say they were different. If anyone knows, let me know.This with smuckers caramel syrup 2.50$ and the 40$ Mr Coffee espresso maker and 20$ Mr coffee grinder(optional). You're set.
Always enjoyed the liquid but a lady at my coffee place that I ordered it at recommended the powder and now i Love it better than the liquid!!

I use this for making white mocha's with my espresso machine and there really is no other white chocolate that compares!  The white chocolate syrup or any other powdered white chocolate just doesn't do it for me.  I'm afraid I'm hooked for life!  My only problem is, I drink too much espresso now!
We use this as a falvorful addition to the espresso my wife makes (she used to be a barista) and it works well with a medium roast bean.
Fast shipping every time! Great product! Thank you! I would definitely recommend Ghirradelli white chocolate to anyone that loves coffee as much as I do!!

I have searched high and low for cotton candy flavoring to make cotton candy ice cream.  well I happened upon this product and ordered it.  When it finally arrived I tried it out in some vanilla ice cream and vanilla yogurt.  It tastes nothing like cotton candy and doesn't even have a candy like flavor to it...more of a strawberry.  It is horrible and I am very upset since there is no returns on grocery items.  If you are looking for cotton candy flavoring that tastes like real cotton candy or cold stone ice cream this is not the product, it is a big let down!!

I am lucky my food store no longer carried the US produced tangerine juice I was purchasing, because it caused me to look for tangerine juice at Amazon.  And their I found Volcano Tangerine Juice produced in Italy, and at a reasonable price.  This juice is sweet/tangy and is delicious, much better than the US juice I had tried previously.  I would recommend it without reservation.

column9: Very good, strong flavored, tangerine juice
column10: More flavor than the stuff you find at Wal-Mart or such. As close to fresh as you can get without being in Italy on Mt. Edna. Most definitly on my shopping list for the special breakfast after the "Big Night".
This is a high quality juice.  But the top is hard to screw on and off.  The juice is very good.
Loved the cranberry-like flavor and slightly crunchy texture.  Worked well with wheat bread. A little on the expensive side but my kids like it too.
I LOVE Nutorious Nuts!  Super tasty!  I have tried the cherry and blueberry/Lemon Merange varietys and I will be trying others.WARNING:  HARD TO STOP EATING ONCE YOU START!

I was amazed at the taste..the butter combined with egg whites and then the blueberry surprise....it was difficult to stop eating it...so I had to give the rest away..I couldn't trust myself alone with it any longer.  But I tell you what - when I need a really stupendous special gift for someone -- this is what I get them.  A lady saved my dog's life recently - so guess what I bought her --- THIS irresistible confection of course.

This Cinnamon Roll coffee by Donut House tastes Delicious!!  One of my favorites!  I love to mix it with either the Cinnabon Creamer (which is wonderful itself with any flavor of coffee) or the sugar-free version of Torani Syrup in the Brown-Sugar Cinnamon Vanilla (now, this one has a SPICY kick to it!).  If you haven't tried this flavor of K-cups, you are really missing out!!  :o)

column9: Delicious! These didn't last long in our house!
column10: These make the other peanut butter cups taste bad. Once you have the Newman's you'll never go back! The peanut butter is smooth and creamy and then covered in chocolate is amazing! These didn't last long in our house because everyone (including the kids) liked them so much. As a bonus, you can actually pronounce the ingredients. We've also had the dark chocolate peanut butter cups and those are just as good.
I love Zatarain's products.  The 4 oz crab and shrimp boil was just right amount, I will defintely buy again.

These are the same mushrooms that come sliced in soup and other dishes when you order Chinese take-out.  They are delicious.  These mushrooms rehydrate very quickly, have a more neutral taste than other mushrooms so they won't overpower your dishes, and the water left over from the re-hydration process can go into soup for extra flavor.  Nothing is wasted here.  Also, these are not little pieces.  They are the whole mushroom.  These are $13.95 for 3 ounces where I shop in a little cellophane bag.  I won't pay that, so when I saw these at this price for a whole pound, I ordered 8 bags.  They come well sealed in a heavy plastic bag, so they will keep well.  I like them in omelets.  It's a steal of a price.  Go Amazon!

This rum has great flavor, a gorgeous nose and is smooth as silk.  It's a super-premium liquor, comparable to the older McAllan Scotches, in that it's more like a cognac than it is a rum.  Best sipping rum I've had.
El Do,Best rum in Guyana & the world. Every time I want to get drunk I drink only El do yoooooo(y)
This is without doubt the best rum in the world.  Every time I go to Guyana I bring a bottle home.
I ordered these as a gift for a guy who loves all things spicy and they were a hit! I would highly recommend these as a gift for that guy/girl who's hard to shop for. He loved them!

For the person who is hard to buy for and has everything. This gift was perfect. If some like it HOT, well, it is in there. Burn your Butt Hott! LOL!He enjoyed this and will continue to for at least a few more weeks, before he will probably ask for more!

column9: Spoiled Yogurettes wasn't what I seeking to buy...
column10: I love this chocolate and it's not sold in stores.  I purchased 10 boxes and not one was edible.  The chocolate was whitish, dry and crumbling.  The inside filling was dry and crumbling.  If you have ever had spoiled chocolate...this was it.  It was a huge disappointment and waste of $30!!  Beware Yogurette lovers!

column9: If you do not want expired product, DO NOT ORDER FROM BURBANK :"OTTOS (EUROPEAN) FOOD STORE".
column10: The item arrived in January 2012, with expiration date of NOVEMBER 2011. After few emails with dismissive statements like :"the chocolates are still good for several months after the sell by expiration dates", I decided to accept 50% discount. I have suspicion that this was not a innocent mistake, because the bottoms of all 10 packages look like rubbed off so that the expiration dates were very faint. I was not happy with how the matter was handled and did not appreciate the attitude of representative, which I did expressed in my "Sellers feedback". Today I received 2 PHONE CALLS - first to me, but after I refused to discuss anything by phone, my husband , who picked up second call minutes later (which I see as harassment !!!), had to listen the threat that if i would not remove my review, they will set the lawyer on me !!! I do have my phone companies record for that. I never heard of so offensive handling of complaint !!! I do not want anything from this company <<Otto's Euopean Import Store>>> and will not buy from them in the future. All of a sudden the page here has different seller.

column9: Candy very close to expiration date
column10: I usually love Yogurette, but these bars arrived only one month before the expiration date printed on the packaging.  Whether because it was getting old or because it had been slightly melted at some point, the filling was dry and crumbly rather than creamy as usual.  Not bad enough for me to go through the fuss of trying to return it, especially since it was officially within the expiration time, but bad enough for me to think twice about ordering it another time.On the other hand Parthenon Foods shipped it very quickly after receiving my order.
Hi, the chips are fine, but 5 of the packages of the 12 were cracked upen.  If I was going to store them for awhile, they would have spoiled.

column9: a taste of the french countryside ;
column10: french country spread at it's  best ,the creamiest  texture with a little sweetness spread over toast or sweet breakfast bread or better yet french baguette, it's the closest thing to my mothers homemade chestnut recipe, made me feel just a little homesick if you love chestnut at the holidays this is one to not forget .
almost impossible to find in the USA... next year i ll go back to france and intend to bring back as many as i can!
This is great stuff!!!  So glad I found it.  I read sbout it in an Italian cookbook.  I recommend it highly!

I had been eating the Chestnut Jam for a number of years.  It has been harder and harder to find.  Now you can not get it in the stores as it isn't very popular in the US.  Will have to order it on line when available.  I miss the taste on a good English muffin.

Chestnuts and products are hard to find in Southern California and they are as much a part of my Christmas season as the tree. Have tried this type of product before in Europe and loved it. This is my first try of this brand and it was delectable. Smooth. Rich. Divine. Better than a fine Gentleman.

column9: Not the same as the can
column10: Very disappointed.  I went by the picture and description.  I should have read the reviews.  This is not the same as someone else stated.  It has creamer with partially hydrogenated oil in it.  I don't want that stuff. I wanted the same as what is in the can that looks the same. Won't buy this again - doesn't even taste close to the other stuff.

column9: Hot COCOA not hot chocolate mix
column10: This product is fine.  I wanted hot chocolate mix that is made with milk this the general hot cocoa mix that you mix with water.  Good but not the same product - be more careful than me and order the one you want.
Ridiculously good hot cocoa. You taste the signature Ghiradelli chocolate, not some sugary sweet artificial flavor. Marshmallows optional, great for mochas too!

I was expecting the hot chocolate that you make with milk.  This is a regular mix that you add water too.  The flavor is no where near as good as the one I got before.  The package looks the same and you can't read the fine print online to see that it's a different cocoa. My kids enjoy this, but I like the other one.

This is totally different from the mix in the can, even though they have the same title "Ghirardelli Chocolate Premium Hot Cocoa Mix, Double Chocolate".This mix has particle-like powder, feels like sand, and the mix in the can (Ghirardelli Chocolate Premium Hot Cocoa Mix, Double Chocolate, 16-Ounce Tins (Pack of 4)) is more real, which is powder-like powder (the powder will stick to your dry finger if touch it.)For the taste, this one is not as thick & smoothy as the mix in the 16oz-can.Try the mix in the can (Ghirardelli Chocolate Premium Hot Cocoa Mix, Double Chocolate, 16-Ounce Tins (Pack of 4)) and you will see the difference.

column9: Made for the chocoholic in all of us...
column10: I love Ghirardelli chocolates: for eating, baking and now for drinking.  This product is an intense, creamy, chocolatey powder mix that you can make using hot water for a rich chocolate drink, or make it with milk for an extra creamy taste.  It's great to take with you when you're away from home (it also comes in pre-measured packets that you can mix into 8oz of hot water), or keep it at work, or in your dorm room for that quick chocolate break.The 32oz packages are very cost-effective.  I keep the powder in a canister on the counter next to my Keurig beverage machine, and it's been hit hard this cold, blustery winter!PLEASE BE ADVISED, if you're expecting this item to contain ground chocolate and cocoa, you need to be looking at the Ghirardelli Chocolate Sweet Ground Chocolate & Cocoa, 3 Pound Can product instead.

This cocoa is not the same as the cocoa in the can with the same name and label. It has no ground chocolate in it and that's what makes it good. This cocoa isn't any better than Swiss Miss. In fact, Swiss Miss is probably better. A real disappointment and I feel cheated because it's not as advertised.

I have the Krueig coffee maker but love hot chocolate.  To date I have not found a K-cup hot chocolate that I like.  I tried this.You put the contents of the package into your cup and run hot water from the Krueig coffee maker.  When it it finished, stir the cup.The richness and the chocolaty flavor is absolutely the "bomb".  I love it.

column9: Finally! Full-on Heat, but with FLAVOR
column10: UPDATE:The review below was written in May of '09. We are still big fans of Barn Burner, but the price increase (to more than $6.20 per jar) and the frequent unavailability of the product have sent us searching again. No change in the star rating - it's great stuff - but value and availability can be deal-breakers.So we're looking to Pico Planet products. They're a solid company, use first-rate, locally sourced and/or fair trade ingredients, are priced a bit below Barn Burner's new pricing, and are locally available in stores.Oh, well. It was good while it lasted ...******Original 5/'09 review:Few things are worse for lovers of hot peppers than bottled "hot sauce" or salsa that's laced with oleoresin capsicum (basically, MACE, the liquid in pepper spray canisters for self defense.) They have all the irritants, but no flavor.This carefully conceived salsa is savory, spicy, HOT, flavorful, and is in all ways the real deal. We've been enjoying this salsa side-by-side with two or three others we often buy, and this one stands above the rest. We'll be shipping some to friends.

column9: Great salsa - what's up with the new price?
column10: This stuff is great. I ordered a three pack last week for $13.39 here at amazon. I went to re-order today and's it's $18.74. What's up with that? This stuff is good, but at the new price ...I will definitely pass.

column9: Lives up to the HOT name!
column10: If you enjoy hot salsa, hot sauce or hot peppers, this salsa is for you.  I have not found anything with this level of heat at the local grocery store - for the average person it is probably too hot.  But, if you are looking at this item, you are likely not the average person and you'll enjoy the heat level just fine.

I just finished my first serving of this salsa and was inspired to sit and write this review. This salsa is nicely hot and spicy thanks to the habanero and jalapeno peppers.  It also has good tomato flavor, not over-run by the heat.  It has no unnecessary sugars or sweet flavor, and is perfect for those of us who want a robust, spicy salsa.  Keep a cold drink nearby when you eat this salsa!!

I've been on the hunt for several months now for a salsa full of flavor and exhilerating heat -- but it had to be something my wife could purchase on a regular trip to the grocery store.  So far, trying various 'boutique' salsas have left me disappointed.  Well, my wife brought home Barn Burner yesterday she picked up at Kroger and I tried some.  Wow!  Back in the saddle!  The flavor is amazing and the heat is intense enough to make eating it require 'strategic dipping' to stay in the 'hot zone' and not get into trouble.  But, the heat is nothing worse than the next-to-hottest wing sauce you typically encounter at buffalo wing places.This salsa is not watery like many others, nor is it 'all hot and no flavor'.  This stuff is good like the secret salsas many Mexican food places will serve you by request.The price is a little high at $5 or so for 16oz, but I quickly realized that 16oz of this stuff will ignite more chips with good hot flavor than other jars in the $3 range.  So, I think the total value is good.
This is a very flavorable salsa with a punch. It's probably a little hot for newbies in the world of hot sauce. But for experienced pepper sauce users, this should hit the spot!

The title of the bottle tells it - screaming hot. If you like burning hot salsa, this is the one for you. I am looking for very hot salsa for a long time. I've tried different brands of salsa on the market, but most of them are too mild for me. This one sure is the hottest I have ever tried. And it is not just plain hot, but also has rich flavors.Be careful it really burns. (If you are not very used to extreme hot flavor)

column9: Tasty but not as hot as described
column10: I ordered this for my husband because we are unable to find salsas hot enough for him in the store. The reviews seemed promising. He says that it's packed with flavor, but doesn't have as much burn as he'd like. Now, before you think this salsa is mild, please note that my husband likes to eat fresh habaneros, serranos and jalepenos in vinegar just for the fun of it. All hot sauces used here are habanero. He likes things hotter than your avg person. For me, this stuff was beyond my threshold. Overall, all good buy!
Holds up to the name. Super spicy but very tasty. I buy it all the time and keep coming back for more.

The salsa tastes good as noted in other reviews but after phrases such as "barn burner", "call 911 screaming hot" and "remember the Alamo" I expected something really really hot. Ends up I can eat it with a soup spoon. Compared to Jose Madrid crazy hot salsa this is cat nip.

I just wanted to add that this is a very tasty salsa.  Now some people I've let try this say it is way too hot.  However, even if it is too hot theoretically speaking, you could just add it to things like sauces or other salsas to pep them up.  Quality ingredients also...three different types of hot peppers in one jar.  Much more flavorful than the standard salsas in the store that are usually jalapeno based only.  I'm giving this 5/5 no question.

I'm giving this 5 stars because this is exactly what I wanted.Really enjoying this salsa!  It is quite spicy, but also quite flavorful, with strong tomato and pepper flavors.  I really enjoy it on my burritos.One of the best salsas I've ever enjoyed.  I spent a long time looking for something with kick, but which was not composed entirely of vinegar.  No vinegar taste here!Regarding spiciness level - it is far from the hottest thing I've ever tried, but it is plenty hot for eating with food or with chips.  This is a very personal decision; make your own choice here.  It IS spicy, but not overwhelmingly so.  I can slather quite a lot on my burritos, and not have any serious issues.  As with many hot sauces, I occasionally have some mild pain as it makes its way through the digestive tract - but it's worth it for the wonderful flavor going down!

column9: Perfect Party Favors or Stocking Stuffers
column10: Great for gifts. Variety of Hershey's chocolate bars in small bags. Great for party favors, holiday stocking stuffers, etc.
This spice was pungent, spicy, and flavorful. You'll be able to taste that fruity and sweet habanero flavor along with that top-tier spicy kick. Use with care.

I love beef jerky , i wanted to try something different . i found this Marlin fish jerky i bought it once ,and now i ordered another bag. I think 15.00$ plus the shipping is a little crazy in price , def worth it though . thoroughly enjoyed it!!!

I became acquainted with smoked marlin when I was working in the Republic of Mauritius.  This has a somewhat milder flavor.  The teriyaki flavor is OK, but I would rate the overall flavor somewhat lower than other products available, such as SeaBear Smoked Salmon Jerky, 1.25-Ounce Units  (Pack of 4).  It's all a matter of personal preference.  They are products that pack a lot of food value in a relatively low weight, and are convenient to carry in a day pack.  They are also something that you can keep around for a quick snack.

column4: notAyesperson "Always in search of good books"
column10: Did not like this.  I threw 95% of it away.  It is very thin slices of marlin covered in sugar and soy sauce.  All I was tasting was sugar and soy sauce masking the marlin flavor.  The jerky also had so much sugar that it was sticking together in the package.  Will not order again, a waste of money because I'm left still with no definitive taste of marlin.

column9: Great tasting stuff, but price maybe too high.
column10: The teriyaki flavor marlin fish jerky is very, very good.  If I'm hiking, sometimes I'll just take a bag of this jerky, water, and fruit, and that's all I'll have for the day.  One bag (whole thing) has 800 calories, 2.5g fat, 10g sugar, 180g protein.  Of the three flavors, this is the best.But, at the stores here in Hawai'i, it sells for like $8 a bag.  $17 seems like a lot of markup.

This dressing is sensational, probably the best on the market.  And note that this 16oz bottle is easier to shake up than the smaller size glass bottle, which for some reason tends to have the ingredients settle on the bottom no matter how hard you shake it.

column9: Best marinade for grilling Shrimp and Chicken
column10: When I lived in Florida I used to buy this dressing (the Oil based Paul Newman Caesar) to marinate my shrimp and chicken before grilling them.  Since I have moved to the mountains of NC I haven't been able to find a store that has this exact dressing.  I just thought to try Amazon.  I don't know why I didn't think of it sooner.FYI: Marinate the shrimp and/or cubes of chicken for 2+ hours making sure all sides get seasoned.  Cut up veggies (onions, bell peppers are best) and marinade them too.  Make kabobs and grill. Everyone loves them!!!BTW  Paul Newman was awesome.  Great earth friendly products.  I buy his products as often as I can.  All proceeds go to Charities.

column9: Delicious and flavorful... all natural - what more could you want?
column10: Great dressing.  We have also tried the ranch AND the parmesan and roasted garlic flavors.  They are all of tremendous quality and flavor.  Finally a brand that is NOT trying to poison us with hydrogenated oils and/or high fructose corn syrup.  It is such a nice change of pace when I don't have time to make my own dressing!  I suggest you try these!

column9: Jake and Amos Bread and Butter Pickles
column10: Love these pickles, closest to the taste that my friend makes from an old amish recipe.  Will order again if I don't find this product close to where I live.
Great alternative to oatmeal, especially when spouse cannot eat oatmeal due to IBS.

I grew up in Seattle, home of Krusteaz which made Zoom as well as pancake mixes breads, etc, so I have eaten this wonderful cereal all my life.  When I left home I tried lots of different cereals and eventually returned to Zoom as my favorite; nothing else measures up.  Recently I left the West Coast to live in Middle America where there is NO ZOOM.  After working myself through everything available I just gave up and ordered a 6 box pack to make it through the winter--it gets COLD here and I miss my cereal  Give it a try - you'll love it if you don't like bland, mushy cereals.  Great with addition of nuts, will hold you all day with the bonus of being very good for you as well.
Zoom Quick Hot Cereal I have purchased this cereal for my Dad.  He loves it! It tastes great and is a good source of fiber.

I'm from California and I grew up on Zoom. This is the best wheat cereal out there and it holds you all day. When I moved to Texas, I couldn't find Zoom anywhere, but as they say, 99.99% of the time you can always find what you're looking for on Amazon: so I searched, there it was, and I have been buying the 6 Unit Pack ever since. Try it, you won't be disappointed.

I usually make mine from scratch but this is an excellent fast alternative.  I found a full can of milk makes the soup to watered down so I cut back to 1/2 a cup.  I add some chopped chives and a TBS of sherry.  To really kick it up, I add some cayenne pepper and imitation lobster meat -- making it into a full meal.This soup tastes exactly how I expected it to and I already ordered another case.

This lobster bisque is delicious with little pieces of lobster found throughout.  Lobster has a very delicate flavor but this soup brings it forth very nicely.  Just add some milk or cream and pepper to the mix and you have a really rich, scrumptious soup.  I highly recommend this bisque.

This is as fine a bisque as you can find in a can.  I punched it up with a little wine, and diced fresh lobster meat. I ordered a case and have already used at for two dinner parties.  All of the guests were impressed and thought it was made from scratch.  If you really like a bold-tasting traditional type bisque, you'll like this brand.  I would not hesitate to buy it again.

Disappointed, nothing like I expected.  It was as different as expecting New England-style clam chowder and then getting Manhattan-style.  This was not creamy, it smelled bad, and had a sour taste to it.I even made a second can with cream because the first one tasted so bad.  No improvement.
This lobster bisque is delicious.  I added some chives and a little cayenne pepper. I haven't had soup and a sandwich for years; I intend to have it more often with this lobster bisque.

This is not bad but not really good either. I tried to doctor it up with Sherry and little cayenne pepper. I even used half and half and not as much as it called for but still rather bland.  Would not order it again but will finish the cans I have.

column9: Too much candy coating, not enough almond
column10: Sure they look nice, but the coating is so think you just suck and suck and wonder why, since they should be mainly almonds, after all.Grecian Imports Brand - Jordan Almonds - Super Fine (Best Grade) - Assorted Colors - Polished (shiny) 1 pound
Awesome tasting.  The candy shell is just right--not too hard or sweet.  Perfect to snack on.
really good  the best as all rougie products  have allways bouth from them in france and usa also when i lived in spain

These mini candies are very hard to keep around, especially if I have a house full of granddaughters (who don't get the opportunity to snack as often at home)...my bad!! The variety bag is the best because not every likes all of the different kinds of candy...very fresh and a great item to freeze for the next time grandkids visit.

This is an amazing balsamic vinegar. I tried it just a few short weeks ago at Toscano restaurant on Charles Street in Boston. Paired with a lovely olive oil, it was the perfect combination for dipping warm, delicious bread.
Just Rubio and some fresh bread. My kids learned how to say the word before they were two. It really is worth the money. But it is pricey. If it were $30.00 I would buy it more often.

I absolutely LOVE this 12 year aged balsamic. It has a great full flavor and zero bitterness. I have tried several other cheaper aged balsamic  and Rubio blows them all out of the water. It is by far worth the few extra bucks over any other brand.

I had this balsamic last night at a great Italian restaurant on Charles St. in Boston. It's very thick, slightly sweet, very good flavor. I was taking a picture of the label when the waiter was cleaning the table, and made him put it back so I could get a picture.

Doesn't unclog sinuses, but it tastes VERY good! I love original Sleepy Time and this sleepy time tea as well. Soothing, cool and minty to the tongue, palate and throat but still has the familiar taste of Sleepy Time.

I love this drink i had this stuff at food truck festival...I've been wanting to buy some of this stuff when i found out what they are charging it blew my mind away. They charge somewhere between 1 dollar to 1.50 per bottle plus shipping will run you easily over 2 dollars a bottle...on here they are charging 17 bucks for shipping...are you guys stupid or something thats more than the item cost itself...RIDICULOUS!!!!

I LOVE Dry soda and Juniper Berry is my very FAVORITE flavor, or was that  Lavender ? NEVER-MIND I LOVE em both. Less sweet is much better this stuff actually quenches your thirst almost as well as regular water and tastes a lot better. I wish regular soda companies would get a clue from Dry that if you want less calories all you have to do is add less sugar NOT fill it with nasty chemicals.
This is the best coffee I ever tasted. I am giving it as gifts for my friends.

column9: Drink this coffee or I'll punch u in the face !!
column10: Period, best the is, ever was, or ever will be, taste is perfect, and this stuff will wake the dead. I only drink this stuff, and I buy it for all my friends for X-mad that way when I visit them I know there's some there to drink.

This is really yummy instant coffee. I like the fine, powdery texture. However, I am not convinced it is organic coffee.....as the amazon description states. The can does not say anything regarding organic ingredients. Maybe since it is produced outside the US, it's not labeled as such?? But, I will not be re-ordering due to that.

column9: Great Coffee!  Can't believe it's Instant!
column10: We recently came back from a Safari in Tanzania and while there enjoyed Africafe coffee in various camps.  This stuff is potent!  I have had all the "instant" coffee you can think of here in the US and it is nasty nasty stuff.  This is not that stuff.Overall I am very satisfied with my transaction with the seller.  I received the item promptly and in excellent condition/quality.Will come back when time to re-order!

At first I was not sure about trying this, as I am not a fan of instant coffee. But my husband told me to try it, he is from Africa. Well got it in the mail today and I have to say that it is some of the best instant coffee that I have had. I just hate that the only place that I can get it is on amazon.

We had this coffee on safari in Tanzania.  It was great early morning out in the brush as we watched zebra and elephants. Drinking it in the United States brings back a lot of memories.  I love it here just as much as there.

Not sure if it's really organic... I know the amazon description does say it is, but it doesn't mention anywhere on the product itself that it's organic. But I am giving this review a 5-star anyways for its amazingly good taste; probably one of the best tasting instant coffees out there!

I initially tasted this coffee this past summer when my daughter returned from a volunteer teaching trip in Tanzania.I was amazed at the delicious flavor for instant coffee as I have never found an instant coffee that I enjoyed.Now that our supply is diminished,its nice to know we can order more thru Amazon.

column9: Better than Starbucks- brewed or instant!
column10: My husband came back from Tanzania with this in tow. Now, when I feel like going to Starbucks, I literally think, "Why bother?"The coffee is better at home. That's a first - thanks Africafe!

I got hooked on this stuff last year while spending some time in Tanzania. I loved it so much, I brought some canisters back to the States. However, I'm running alarmingly low! If anyone has any idea how to get some Africafe in the States, please post! :)To those who have not had this (not sure how you got to this page, but congratulations), if my preceding sentence is any indication, this is the best instant coffee around. I still have Nescafe (a.k.a. Taster's Choice) every now and then, and it pales in comparison to Africafe. Africafe has no bitterness whatsoever, tastes great with or without cream or sugar, I just love it.If you have not tried Africafe...you need to. Seriously.

I first encountered Africafe while in Tanzania.  I'm not a fan of instant coffees, but found Africafe to be a very satisfactory way to get a quick coffee fix without brewing.  In fact, it tastes like strong brewed coffee.  It's not the same as french press, but not bad for coffee on the fly.
Haven't bought Africafe on line yet, but got it in Tanzania and fell in love with it.  Overjoyed to hear that it is now available online!

Tried this for the first time in Tanzania years ago, LOVED it, and brought some home with me.  Was so sad when I drank the last cup.  At the time it couldn't be purchased anywhere but Tanzania.  So excited to see it on Amazon!!
I went to Tanzania recently and was given this coffee. It is excellent instant coffee! I highly recommend it!

This coffee really is as good as the reviews suggest.  I tried it as part of my search for a truly tasty instant coffee.  That search is officially over.  This coffee is so balanced and smooth, it beats the vast majority of regular coffees, let alone instant coffees.  You won't be disappointed!

We first had this instant coffee in Tanzania, and I buy as many containers as I can get in my suitcase to bring home. Smooth, not bitter, small amount makes a great cup of coffee! Recommend this to anyone who drinks coffee. Makes a great iced coffee as well.

I do not normally drink instant coffee.  But when staying with friends that are from Tanzania they offered a cup of Africafe.  It is the smoothest coffee that I have ever had. It only takes a tiny bit for an entire mug.  A must have for all coffee lovers!

column9: Very Good Cookies, Anoher Satisfied Amazon Customer
column10: very, very good chocolate chip cookies, a great value at an even bette price.  I got these yesterday because my Amaazon Prime membership guarantees two-day delivery and they were fresh, delicious, chocolatey and are insanely addictive.  My Father and I have already eaten a row of these and we have 2 rows left.  I should stop feeding him these cookies cos he's going to get fatter than he already is!  I can't say enough good things about how delcious these cookies are, the only reason I gave them 4 stars is because they came in a package, but otherwise they taste just like they're homemade.  Another excellent purchase from Amazon.com, I love this website!

column9: Great snack to send to your soldier....
column10: Naturally I love these cookies myself, they are soft and chewy and just plain delicious for not being homemade. The good thing about buying them in bulk like this is that they make a great snack to send overseas they don't melt all over the place and they usually have a few months of guaranteed freshness stamped on each pack. They also got here fast and well packaged so you can certainly buy these with confidence.

Grandma's Chocolate Chip Cookies - 33 pks - Total 66 Cookies I bought 120 of these cookies and found them soft, mushy and having no "character."  I pondered about how I (also a Grandma) could transform them into a true cookie treat.  Finally, i realized that they were merely "undercooked."So, I placed them on a cookie sheet and baked them in the oven at 325 degrees for 8-10 minutes.  When they cooled, they were of perfect consistency, had great taste and were, indeed, transformed into homemade TOLLHOUSE COOKIES.Happiness is a perfect chocolate chip cookie from Grandma!!

column9: Yummy treat for the Grandma's cookie lovers
column10: I ordered these and had them sent to my son because I didn't make him some homemade ones.  He thinks Grandma's are almost as good as mine, and he has thoroughly enjoyed them.

Different types of treats have different advantages.  Bits of raw or cooked meat are great as a "high value" reward during initial training or for training under distraction.  A softer, manufactured treat is good for rapid and involved work, when you don't want chewing to slow down the action.  And a dry, crunchy treat like these biscotti provide a wonderful, practical, general-purpose solution.  They don't need special storage and they don't go bad.  They are low-cal.  They are clean to handle.  They are easy to deal with during the winter, when wearing gloves.Regarding the user photo posted, of fractured bits of biscotti, I'd say that based on my experience that problem was likely one of poor luck with the shipping.  As with any sort of dry grain food, some does end up damaged, much as is the case with breakfast cereal.  Each bag does end up with some crumbs at the bottom, even in the best case.  Personally, I've never felt ripped off by this, as the vast majority of the treats have been in good shape.  And the crumbs can be added to the dog's food, or mixed in with peanut butter for a treat toy, to add a little interest.

Our 3 Old English Sheepdogs have been spoiled rotten by this product since we first discovered it at Pet Food Express in Walnut Creek, CA, 2002.  All natural ingredients, made entirely in the U.S.A. (Benicia, CA), and we've never met a canine who didn't want "MORE, please!"  5# bags are a great deal through Amazon. Small handful before bed, and our babies are happy campers.Kathy, Texas

Our dog really loves these treats & they are only 3 calories each!! They are quite expensive though & hard to find. It is much more economical to buy them in a 5 lb. bag. Product is great & my shipment came very quickly.

This is a high end treat that is by far the favorite of my dogs.  The "original bite size" is perfect for medium to large dogs at about 1/4 inch cubes.  After a few times, my dogs would perform the "expected" behavior as soon as I would rattle the container.  The spare treats keep well in the freezer for months.  Very healthy ingredients without fat to upset their digestion.
Our old biscotti was a bit bigger than the new one and we liked the old size better!
Have been using this product for two years and am very satisfied.  It is very good for dogs with food allergies and it's low-cal.

My Puppy Max is totally addicted to the Liver Biscotti. It is a great treat and keeps a beagle's nose very occupied. I spent 3 weeks trying to locate these where we live before ordering them. The shipment was prompt and very quick....all leading to a very happy puppy

We have been using the Premier Liver Biscotti for over 8 years.  Our dogs just love this treat and because of the size, we can give them a few at a time and they don't gain weight from over-snacking!!  They are really crunchy and that seems to satisfy our dogs very well. Ordering them from Amazon, and saving some money sure helps.  I know this is a pricey snack, but our babies are well worth the money spent.

I orginally purchased these treats at a speciality dog boutique and found my dog loved them. They are perfect for training - small and hard so you can keep them in your pocket without a mess. Buying them in the 5 pound bag is a real savings and everyone I have shared them with has remarked on how much their dog responds to them. My dog likes them almost as much as fresh chicken.
I had a sample pack of the liver biscottin and my dogs loved it.  So I bought the large bag and it is a good value and the dogs cannot wait to get their treat.  It is great.

This product is hard to find on the market. I found it in a small pet store in Oregon, but couldn't find it in California. The stuff is bite sized and crunchy and lasts forever. The dog loves it. Highly recommended.

My dogs, my pet sitting dogs and dogs I meet about town love Liver Biscotti!  And I dont have to be concerned about giving it out to a dog with a sensitive tummy.  Superb training treat, you can carry so very many in a pocket!

column9: My Dog L_O_V_E_S these treats. And no others will do.
column10: It is unbelievable!  My dog loves these treats!  Treats?  I feel like they are better for her than dogfood.I ordered a small package of these... they were an add-on item with an order for flea meds that I purchased on another doggie web-site. If you have a fussy dog, I do too !!  I can tell you that one of my 2 cockapoos will walk away from every doggie treat, every dog biscuit, any dogfood!! She hates dry dogfood, she only eats her special canned food....  she gets upset tummy pains often.... She has skin allergies from fleas and wheat.  And I get frustrated.  I have never dealt with this stress.BUT, Wait!!!!  I got that small bag of Liver Biscotti's.... and she loved them.  She L-O-V-E-D them.  She gets starry eyed when the dog treat jar comes out.  And they are good for her.  So, I bought THE LARGE BAG (wheat free).  She loves them!And I bet yours will too!
These are fantastic! My children have a combination of nut, milk and egg allergies, so this is a great protein alternative (to milk) for breakfast, or anytime.

I have bought quite a few of these and other of Enjoy Life's bars in the past.  I'm planning on curtailing my consumption of them since: 1) I received an empty, but sealed, box  2) There are quality and consistency problems.  (e.g.  bars with debris or other food material on them; bars of varying sizes; inadequate or sloppy packaging)  3) varying quality of customer service (e.g. was supposed to receive a coupon for the empty box, but haven't etc.)They are, however, a very convenient snack.

I am allergic to peanuts and so was thrilled to see there is a Sunbutter bar version. However, I'm pretty let down. The bars are tiny - about 1/2 of the packet is bar and the other 1/2 is air. They are also, like a previous review said, random in their sizing - some are a full inch bigger or smaller than others. The taste is kind of bland, but I do think they're nice for a hiking/camping situation to have something with protein that is allergen-safe and easy to toss in a backpack.

column9: great on the go snack or quick breakfast
column10: I always keep one or two in my bag, my son likes these. Also makes a nutritious breakfast when you're in a hurry
I don't like really sweet fruity breakfast bars so when I found these I was ecstatic!  They are great for on the go.  I take them everywhere with me.

column9: Versatile snack bar with solid nutrition
column10: I really like these Chewy bars by Enjoy Life.  I first purchased a few boxes at the local grocery store, but figured I could shave off some of the cost by going through Amazon.  I noticed a lot of other customers have complained about the small size.  Yes, the bars are small and, therefore, are kind of pricey.  But you get a good texture and flavor - difficult to find on a gluten-free diet - and a decently portioned snack for on-the-go, all with the benefits of useful nutrition.  Certainly a good balance for a snack or to round out a meal.I recommend giving these a try by buying a box at the grocery store to make sure you like them.  The "Cocoa Loco" flavor is excellent too.
They work good for a quick gluten free, low sugar snack. The presto log taste lets you know they are good for you.
To be a Chewy item. It taste good and I liked it but I Needed to have something to drink with it. A little more juice in it may fix that. Good try Good Life.
These taste fantastic!! And Amazon sells them for a less expensive price than my local health food store! Thank you Amazon!

Although these aren't "full of flavor", I personally don't mind.  I am very happy with these as sometimes I need a quick breakfast that is more mild for the stomach.  Great for people with allergies to certain foods too!

It is difficult for people with multiple food allergys to find a quick snack.this does fit that need,but I probably  wont be buying this again. Very small servings and not very tasty.It does fills the need for something safe to eat.

Great GF snack. I love carrying these in my work bag or purse for a quick energy snack. I was expecting that these would be soft and chewy like advertised on the box, but in reality, they are a lot tougher and harder. But, they taste great, and I can't find many GF snacks that fit that bill.
Finally something that doesn't have chocolate and is allergen free.  These are great if you are heading out the door and need a quick snack.

My son has peanut allergy.  Enjoy Life has become a staple at our home.  I was very excited to see the sunbutter option for these bars.  They provide a little more protein than the other bars.  I had hoped the kids would like them as much as the other flavors since they do  like sunbutter itself.  However, they were not too keen on these.  I liked them, my son liked them and my daughter just was not interested.  I love their products and just wished Amazon would offer them on the subscribe program.  Thier new chocolate bars are very tasty too!
These used to be my favorite bars from any brand. The company changed the recipe, and now I am really disappointed with the taste. I'm going to cancel my order subscription or reduce it.
I received these timely.  I was disappointed in the taste and texture of this product. Not to my taste! The product was too dense in texture and gummy. The taste was pasty.

My daughter (who is 5 and so didn't elaborate) said it tastes ok, but didn't finish the bar.  That's saying something considering how TINY the bars are.  These are about half the size of a typical SMALL snack bar.  I signed up for a "subcribe and save" and am cancelling.  Not worth the cost.

I bought these going by reviews online, but now I have boxes of something inedible.  I guess I will be out the money for this one.  Can't think of what else to do with them...........don't waste your money.  I know it is hard to find things without allergens, but it wasn't worth it for me!!

I was so excited to see these, because I love Sunbutter. But these have a really weird taste that is nothing like sunbutter! It's almost plastic tasting, difficult to describe. I do like the chewy texture, and the fact they don't have much sugar, but I won't be buying these again because of the taste.

column9: Great portable nutrition for allergy sufferers
column10: I have to eat gluten and dairy free, and my husband and kids are nut allergic.  It is real difficult to eat on the go.  We keep these bars handy (I eat one every day at work).  I always keep a few in my purse and more on long road trips.  They are not the greatest tasting, but for the being gluten free and having less sugar than similar snack bars they aren't bad (ie don't expect a cookie or candy bar taste like those overly sweetened snack bars).  The sun butter crunch is my fav flavor, but The differences between flavors are not all that great.  They are however just the right amount of nutrition to get me through a few more hours of work, travel, or errrands until I can get home to safe food.  I have noticed the differences in bar shapes.  Seems like sometimes they are longer and thinner and other times shorter and fatter.  The shorter and fatter size can make a person feel like they've been cheated on product because there is so much space left in the packaging, but I could not be certain that the actual weights were any different.  This is definitely the cheapest place I've found to buy them.

column9: Excellent dog food; especially good for dogs with health problems
column10: We have three dogs- a small robust and healthy Coton de Tulear, and two large dogs with health issues: a nearly 7 year old German Shorthaired Pointer, who was diagnosed as diabetic two years ago, and an 8 year old  collie mix who has irritable bowels.  Trying to find the right food so that I didn't have to purchase too many kinds of dog food for two dogs with disparate health issues was not easy, but this Wellness Simple Solutions, along with the Wellness Core Dry does the job.If you suspect that food triggers allergic or stomach/bowel reactions, as any pediatrician will tell you, feed a simple diet with as few ingredients as possible, and only add ingredients as needed, after waiting for a time to watch for reactions.  Simple Solutions is the way to do this, and for a dog with irritable bowels, it is truly THE best way of feeding a commercially prepared dog food, instead of you cooking chicken and rice for your dog.  The dogs love the taste, and Wellness brand is excellent quality.

column9: Healthy choice for dog w/ food allergies/sensitive stomach
column10: My 8-year old Cocker Spaniel has been on several types of food (Nutro, Iams, Natural Balance, Chicken Soup for the Dog Lovers Soul, and regular Wellness). The bag that I ordered in early January 2012, arrived nicely packaged and with an expiration date of July, 2012.I'm happy that not only am I getting a wonderful food, made in the USA, but I can count on getting a fresh shipment too.

column9: A true classic candy bar with a controversial name
column10: You have heard the story about how the Baby Ruth candy bear was not named for Babe Ruth but for Ruth Cleveland, daughter of President Grover Cleveland.  Well, sorry to disappoint you, but that story is not true.  The first Baby Ruth bars were made by the Curtiss Candy Company, which was founded in Chicago in 1916 by Otto Schnering, who used his mother's maiden name since it was much more American-sounding and would not cause the problems that a German surname would during World War I.  The first confection made by Curtiss was the Kandy Kate, which featured a pastry center topped with nuts and coated with chocolate.  Then in 1921 revised the product so that was now a log-shaped bar made of caramel and peanuts, covered in chocolate.  Priced at only five cents, half the cost of competing candy bars, Schnering named it the Baby Ruth bar, which soon became one of the hottest selling candies on the market.Now, the explanation that the candy bar was named for "Baby" Ruth Cleveland, the former President's first-born daughter, has been the official explanation proffered by the Curtiss Candy Company since the 1920's while the Babe Ruth legend has been the obvious explanation, especially since Ruth had joine the Yankees in 1920 and in 1921, the year the Baby Ruth debuted, he hit a then-record 59 home runs.  However, the idea that the Baby Ruth bar was named after Ruth Cleveland is rather morbid given she died of diptheria at the age of 12 in 1904, seventeen years before the candy bar was named.The more reasonable explanation seems that the Curtiss Candy Company did indeed find a way to link their product to the Yankee slugger who was becoming the most famous person in the country.  Ironically, Curtiss had to fight off a challenge from a competitor who was attempting to market the Babe Ruth Home Run Bar, endorsed by the Babe himself.  The Curtiss claim that the bar was named for Ruth Cleveland was enough to fight off the challenge, since the names were too close to one another to allow the new product to be marketed that way.  The fact that Curtiss maintained for years that the Baby Ruth bar came out before years before Babe Ruth became famous is enough to pop the balloon since in 1920 Ruth had broken his single season home run record of 29 by hitting 54 round trippers.Of course all that matters now is that this is still a classic American candy bar.  Beneath the milk chocolate coating of Nestles popular 2.1 ounce candy bar is a chewy, peanut-covered center, wrapped in a nougat that is really more of a white or blonde fudge.  In terms of caloric ration the Baby Ruth is 46% Carbs, 48% Fats, and 6% Protein.  The candy bar is low in Sodium and very low in Cholesterol, which is good, but high in Saturated Fat, which is supposedly bad (where do people think the taste comes from?).  A large portion of the calories come from the sugars, which is how nature intended it.  If you want a candy bar with actual peanuts in it, the Baby Ruth is still a good choice.Ironically, I did find a Champion Cocker Spaniel named Baby Ruth, whelped in 1892, who was in all probability actually named for President Cleveland's daughter, Ruth, who had been the first child to be born in the White House the previous year.  She was bred by Joseph Smith of Canada and sold to Andrew Laidlaw and became the foundation on which Mepal built one of the strongest kennels in the United States.  All three Best in Show Cocker Spaniels at the Westminster Dog Show could trace their pedigree back to this particular Baby Ruth.

You won't regret it! Yum!Some history on the candy bar from Hershey's:William H. Luden (1859-1949) launched his fledgling candy business in 1879 and offered an extensive line, including cough drops, hard and soft candies, chocolates and marshmallow products. Unlike many confectioners during that time, Luden manufactured his own chocolate for his chocolate novelties and chocolate-coated candies. In 1936, he introduced the 5TH AVENUE candy bar, a milk chocolate bar with a crunchy peanut butter center.World War II forced Luden's to concentrate production efforts on Luden's menthol throat drops and 5TH AVENUE candy bars for military use. Immediately following the war, Luden's reverted to producing a full line of confectionery products including the famous Luden's menthol throat drops and 5TH AVENUE candy bar, as well as penny candy consisting of ladyfingers, pillowcases, mint patties, penny jujube novelties, penny hard candy, penny coconut novelties, cast marshmallow novelties, and a line of penny sugar-rolled jellies.Timeline1859  William H. Luden, founder, born.1879  W. H. Luden Candy Company established.1928  Acquired by Food Industries of Philadelphia, a holding company owned by the Dietrich family.1936  5TH AVENUE candy bar introduced.1980  Queen Anne Candy Company, Hammond, IN, acquired by Luden's Inc.1986  Acquired by Hershey Foods Corporation.

column9: The Swedish Chef Would Be Proud!
column10: Let me start by saying that I am a huge fan of all things swedish, from Lingonberries to salt cod to Lutefisk to those yummy red candy fish. When I saw that Jules Destrooper had invented yet another Swedish delectable, I could not wait for my package to arrive!After assaulting the UPS driver and absconding with my "butter waffles" (which are more like cookies), I went into my kitchen and sat down in my breakfast nook to eat them. A hearty glass of milk was all I needed to drench the entire box and consume it. In reality, I ended up saturating the cardboard box and must have eaten that as well, because when I was done there was nothing left save for some soggy nuggets stuck to my ceiling. I assume they are from my delicious waffles and not from my earlier experiment of stuffing a cornish game hen with popping corn to "make its own stuffing." I am still picking bits of hen from my bushy, inappropriately dark eyebrows.Also, some recipe ideas for these waffles include topping them with olives, tuna salad, anchovy and pretzel (an old Slavic favorite) and peanut butter. Sometimes I give these to the neighbor children when they behave themselves, and actually I have only given one out to one neighbor child. My neighbor's kids are usually misbehaving and absolutely do not deserve any of my tasty cookies! Anyway, it turns out the one kid I gave it to was actually a lawn jockey statue, which makes sense because my neighbors, the "Davenports," have very light skin. They are actually quite pasty and I am waiting for the day when one of them develops melanoma, because they are always out in the sun, in their pool, having a "heck of a time," under the sun's deadly rays, oblivious to the cellular damage they are inflicting on themselves. I prefer to stay inside during the daytime and nighttime hours, usually venturing from my house every fortnight to collect my mail. However, when I know a delivery of Jules Destrooper Butter waffles are arriving, I am on "high alert" and spring from my rascal mobility scooter whenever I hear a car door close.Overall, I LOVE these waffles. Buy them, and If you don't love them too, send them off to me!!!

And, if you have a taste for a nice corn snack with a, virtually, nonexistent Cheddar flavor, then here they are.  But, most are here looking for Cheddar Flavored Snacks vs others because we want to taste the Cheddar!  So, 2stars off for the makers neglecting this crucial fact. I really wanted to like these- cause, yes, admittedly, I am trying to get skinny and need a good cheddar flavored healthy snack.  How cheap can you be to call something Cheddar, then, when you make it- barely include a cheddar taste within it??  The makers of this product need to SERIOUSLY read the reviews and consider putting some Cheddar Flavor in this product before they can be honest about calling it Cheddar. I'm disappointed- but this makes an ok corn snack.  You want something that, truthfully, advertises itself having a certain flavor and lives up to it:  Like Doritoes or Cheetos? Or, even near that? Then, honestly, you need to keep looking.  I hope that I've been helpful.

column9: These saw me through some very hard times.
column10: A person should completely ignore the price here.  To be truthful, if you use coupons and watch for sales, you can get these much cheaper. I love the flavor and eating a few handfuls with a nice crisp apple and a glass of tea is yammers.I want to say though that not only are these delicious, they are also very filling. Let me tell you that a box of these things and a glass of water can take you far.  It fills an empty belly quite well and if you have every had an empty stomach and were truly hungry, you will know that it is not a pleasant experience.There were many days that these things were the only thing I had to eat and they saw me trough. column9: Great price for NYC better than regular cheez-its  (more crisp!)
column10: For a family who loves cheez-its, this is an excellent way to keep them stocked.  I use the "subscribe and save" and the cheez-its cost less than NYC area grocery stores (nearly 5 dollars a box here).Some reviewers claim that they are over priced - but this is a great deal for my area!!My husband likes reduced fat cheez-its better than the regular.  He does not buy them for dietary reasons - he is in excellent shape.  He prefers the reduced fat variety because they are MORE CRISP than their counterparts.  Highly recommended!

My absolute snacking staple - they simply don't get old! I prefer the reduced fat over the regular because they're slightly crispier, as well as lighter on the stomach. Buying them from Amazon with Subscribe and Save provides a good price per box, as well.
The ability to subscribe and save is amazing, because in all honesty who doesn't love cheez-its, especially reduced fat they're so much crisper

I love cheez-its and using Amazon's Subscribe and save I save a good amount of money every month having 4 boxes delivered to my home automatically. I eat Cheez-its like they are going out of style so went with the reduced fat to try and lesson the effects of the habit. Great tasting, always fresh.

We've always been good fans of Cheez-Its, and while we try to stay away from more processed foods such as this, we found that we still love Cheez-Its every now and then. We found that the reduced fat Cheez-Its taste about the same as the regular Cheez-Its. We will keep buying Cheez-Its at this price, that's for sure.

I used to eat these things by the box (and my waistline started to show it!), so I stopped buying these for awhile. I have started getting these again as a good "low-cal" snack. They did, however, do something to the recipe. They simply don't taste the same as before. Not saying they don't taste good, but just don't taste the same as before. What happened? I have no idea. Maybe it's an attempt to simulate more cheese flavor, but put it back to what it was.
Salty, crunchy goodness... reduced fat are noticeably less greasy and go well with a cold drink in front of the tube.

First of all, Cheez-Its are better than Nips because they aren't covered with that gross powder.Second, Reduced Fat Cheez-Its are better than Cheez-Its because they have a smokey, woodsy taste, like standing outside in autumn when someone far away is burning leaves. I try now to imagine the taste of Reduced Fat Cheez-Its, and I feel my hands sitting warm in the pockets of my wool coat, arriving at my grandmother's house in South Carolina for Thanksgiving dinner. The sun sets earlier now; in fact, the sun seems always to be setting this time of year, even at midday. Yellow-orange light reflects softly off everything. I know that inside the house, my grandmother is stirring mashed potatoes on the stove. She doesn't know that I've arrived yet. When I walk through the front door, there will be happiness in her eyes, sincere happiness at seeing me. A kind of happiness that, here in New York in my late twenties, feels so distant. People here are just not that happy to see anyone - certainly not me.Third, regular Cheez-Its and Better Cheddars are too buttery for my taste. They taste sort of greasy.
I live out of the country and can no longer buy reduced fat Cheez-its. I was so excited to learn that I can still enjoy my favorite snack while I am thousands of miles away from the US. Thanks!!

column9: Great way to help parents on fixed income
column10: My mother lives in Colorado and is on a very fixed low income.
