I was just two pounds shy of my Weight Watchers goal when I fell off the weight loss wagon and gained four additional pounds.  Life was busy, and I wanted a fuss-free way to lose those last pounds before swimsuit season.  Since I enjoy Special K products, I thought I'd put the Special K 2-Week Weight Loss Challenge to the test.  I ate Special K cereal for two meals, snacked on fruits and veggies (instead of the recommend Special K snack products) and made healthy dinner choices.  I didn't expect to lose 6 pounds as advertised, since my weight loss had slowed from months of dieting and I was near my goal weight.  To my surprise, I lost 6 pounds and have finally reached my goal weight!ABOUT THE DIET:It's convenient and doesn't require much planning.  However, it could get a little boring in the long run.  It could also be difficult to meet daily nutritional requirements.  Also, rapid weight loss could be difficult to maintain in the long run.  If you've been dieting and just can't lose those last few pounds, or if you need to lose a few pounds fast for a big event, give Special K a try.ABOUT THE CEREAL:One can usually find a box of Special K in my kitchen cabinet.  Most often, it is the Red Berries variety.  I enjoy the Fruit and Yogurt flavor, as well, but the serving size is 1/4 cup less.  The original flavor is also nice from time to time, but the Chocolatey Delight is just not a good idea, in my opinion.  But back to the Red Berries.  The cereal consists of the usual Special K flakes with dehydrated strawberries.  Once I pour on my Silk Light soy milk, the berries plump up to add lots of real strawberry flavor.  There are generous amounts of berries and the flakes stay crispy in milk.  All in all, this is an excellent cereal that I highly recommend.

Kellogg's Special K Cereal, Red Berries, 16.7-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 4), is a delicious cereal.  Since Kellogg is number one  -- the number one producer of convenience food in the world --we know Kellogg will give us what we want while ignoring the things that do not matter to us.What do we want?(1) Flavor.  Those real freeze dried strawberries are so delicious that we are tempted to eat them dry out of the box and leave the cereal.  The cereal tastes good too.  It is sweet, and there is malt flavoring that we love.(2) Nutrition.  With 110 calories per cup, we can measure out a cup and use it for diet food.  It has vitamin A, vitamin C, iron, calcium, B vitamins, and minerals.(3) Grain.  There are crispy rice and wheat flakes.What does not matter to us? (Or does it?)(1) Sugar.  The cereal is loaded with it, but if we did not have it in the cereal, many of us would spoon in a generous application. The second ingredient is sugar.  Is that cane or corn?  Also listed in the ingredients is high fructose corn syrup.(2) Nutrition.  It is hard to stop with one cup full because we are used to feeling full.  A cup of light cereal takes us through the motion of eating slowly . . . that's a plus . . . but does not satisfy the way whole grain cereal does.  About the added nutrition:  some of us don't need all of what it gives us, or maybe we really do prefer to take them in pill form so we know we exactly what we are getting.  Many of us take in more iron than is considered healthy for our specific needs.  What your physician will tell you about this issue may be surprising.(3) Grain. If we are allergic to wheat, we need to pay attention to the label.  Also there is corn in the form of fructose.  What we are getting is highly refined grain products when whole grain would be better for our health by providing fiber.With the price out of the range of what we usually spend on breakfast foods, I don't find it a good value.

If you're concerned about HFCS, you may decide this isn't for you.

It's also a convenient way to get real strawberry taste in my cereal and it stays fresh.  It's one of my go to cereals out there. The only negative is that it's a tiny bit too sweet for me (it looks like they spray a very light sugar coating on the flakes, not like frosted flakes, but still not needed for my taste).It may not beat the sale price of boxed cereal at Costco or a discount supermarket outside NYC, but compared to typical boxed cereal prices in NYC, $3.39 per 16.7 oz box is a very good price (most brand cereal in a non-discount supermarkets here cost about $5.99/box, and they are rarely above 14 oz per box).

column9: Great tasting but there's a reason for it!

I love to eat breakfast and I'm a cereal lover from way back! My kids would rather have oatmeal or granola bars, but give me a good ol' bowl of cereal with milk and I'm good to go! I could eat cereal for every meal and not get tired of it, so I try a lot of different kinds. My latest love fest is with Kellogg's Special K Red Berries cereal.Kellogg's Special K promotes itself as being good for part of a weight loss program. The back of the box says that if you eat a serving of this cereal with skim milk, fruit and coffee that you'll have a meal that has less than 250 calories (although I don't know why you would want to add more fruit when you already have strawberries)! It's also fast free and cholesterol free. That's not why I bought it though. I bought it because it looked good on the box and I love strawberries.Kellogg's Special K Red Berries cereal is made with crunchy rice and wheat flakes and has dried strawberries in it. Yummy - I love strawberries! Never before have I had a cereal with freeze dried fruit in it where the fruit actually tastes real and fresh. When I first saw the shriveled strawberries in my bowl the first time I ate this cereal, I was not eager to put them in my mouth. But then I poured the milk in the bowl and the strawberries actually plumped up and almost looked like I had freshly sliced them! Then I took a big bite and wow, the strawberry taste was awesome! The cereal is just sweet enough to not be like a kid cereal but still enough to satisfy my sweet tooth. And there are a ton of strawberries in the box - enough to where I always get at least one strawberry with every bite of cereal.Now let's move on to the flakes. They are a good size but not so big that they are hard to eat. Some cereals make their flakes too big for my liking but this one is just right. Plus the flakes stay crunchy until the last bite is gone from the bowl, unlike some of the other flakes made by Kellogg's and other brands.So for now, Kellogg's Special K Red Berries is my top choice for cereal every morning ... until I burn myself out on it and then I'll switch to something else for a while!

column9: Essential for making Chocolate Whoopie Pies
column10: I've been using Marshmallow Fluff for many years and especially like using it in icing recipes. Sure you can just eat it straight from the bottle by the tablespoon which I've been guilty of doing on occassion. I hear people put it on toast but what I really think it was made for was to make Whoopie Pies.Two baby-sitters taught me to make a similar recipe when I was 8 years old and I have never forgotten it. Black cocoa is used to darken the cake. King Arthur flour from the Baker's Catalogue is essential to the flavor and texture. The not-too-sweet cake develops more flavor and is balanced by the rich icing.CHOCOLATE WHOOPIE PIESChocolate Cake  1/2 cup Hershey's or Van Leer Dutch-process cocoa  1 tablespoon Dutch-process black cocoa  1 cup fat-free milk, warmed to 130  1 cup low-fat buttermilk  1/2 cup corn oil  2 large eggs  1 cup golden brown sugar  1 cup dark brown sugar  1 tablespoon vanilla extract  3 1/2 cups King Arthur all-purpose flour  2 teaspoons baking soda  1/2 teaspoon saltVanilla Frosting  1/2 cup unsalted butter, softened  3 cups confectioners' sugar  3 tablespoons half-and-half  1/2 teaspoon colorless double-strength vanilla  1 cup Marshmallow Fluff1.  Preheat the oven to 350 .2.  Cake batter: In a large bowl, use a mixer on low speed to  beat cocoa, black cocoa and milk. Beat in the buttermilk, oil,  eggs, golden brown sugar, dark brown sugar and vanilla.  Measure the flour, baking soda and salt into a sifter. Sift over  the batter, then beat batter on low for 2 minutes.3.  Cover baking sheets with baking parchment. Use a 1/4 cup  measuring cup and spatula to scoop up batter and drop it onto  a baking sheet. If the batter won't stay in place add up to 1/2  cup more flour to make a thick batter which holds its shape  when dropped onto the baking parchment and only spreads to  a 4-inch diameter round. I don't advise premeasuring onto the  parchment. Just measure and bake for the best results.4.  Swirl batter with spatula to make a round pie. You will fill  three baking sheets at about six rounds a sheet. In between  scooping the batter, set the measuring cup in a 1/2 cup size  measuring cup to keep things from getting messy.5.  Bake in a preheated oven for 10 minutes. Cakes are done  when tops bounce back when pressed. Cool completely.6.  Frosting: In a deep medium bowl, beat butter and sugar on  low speed. Beat in the half-and-half and vanilla, then  Marshmallow Fluff. Continue beating frosting for  one to two minutes or until fluffy.7.  Spread frosting on cakes, then sandwich together and pile on a  large plate. Sprinkle with confectioners' sugar in a sifter.  Hint: For a kid's birthday party, make miniature pies by  using tablespoonfuls of batter. Pies may be made days ahead  and frozen. Set them out on the counter to thaw and then frost  before serving. To quick thaw, watch carefully in microwave.  Makes 9 or more whoopie pies~The Rebecca Review, who loves to bake

column9: In terms of flavor it was better than expected
column10: My husband and I drink a good amount of Crystal Light powdered beverages. I was initially very leery of purchasing this particular flavor.  The combination, particularly for a powder based beverage, sounded like a disaster in the making.  In the end, I can say that it was better than expected.  In terms of flavor, I think a kid (or the kid at heart) would enjoy this more than an adult.Some notes on flavor, color, and packaging:Flavor:  Compared to other Crystal Light beverages, the flavor of strawberry orange banana is actually quite complex.  You can taste each of those flavors in the beverage.  While a fine combination of flavors, something about it screams "kid".  It is just not what I would serve to a fellow adult on a hot day.Color: Like many of the flavors in the Crystal Light Light, the Strawberry Orange Banana is a rather vibrant color once mixed; it is a deep pink color.  It looks very artificial (which, admittedly, this beverage is).  If color is important to you, Crystal Light does have some subtlety colored options.  For example, Crystal Light Moctails Mojito, 1.41-Ounce (Pack of 4) looks like cloudy water but tastes like mint and lime.Packaging: One negative with all of the Crystal Light products relates to packaging. First, the container is a #5 plastic. Unless you live in a relatively progressive place, #5 plastics are typically very difficult to recycle. I know Whole Foods engages in a recycling initiative to collect #5 plastics but if you don't live near one and you care about recycling, these can be a challenging item to deal with. Additionally, if you like Crystal Light, it can be very easy to go through these containers quickly. Some Crystal Light flavors, like the strawberry orange banana, have six packets and others have five. The container could hold more flavor packets, which would reduce the overall number of containers that the user has to dispose of.Overall, a fine beverage that is encased in packaging that is not very green. If you are looking for a more adult option, I would suggest Crystal Light Moctails Mojito, 1.41-Ounce (Pack of 4),Crystal Light Ruby Red Grapefruit Drink Mix (10-Quart), 3.4-Ounce Packages (Pack of 4), or Crystal Light Pink Lemonade Drink Mix (8-Quart), 1.9-Ounce Canisters (Pack of 4).3.5 - 4 stars

Everyone can benefit from the cleansing power of Flor Essence and, after seeing what it did for my father's pain, I would recommend it to anyone fighting a painful disease.  And, please, don't trust in the effectiveness of other Essiac tea products.  I learned the hard way and will always regret that I caused my father pain he need not have had in his final days.  Flor Essence is the Real Deal.One final note.  If you have cancer, or any other painful disease, may God Bless You, and may you find this review to be helpful to you.

The next day, they did extensive tests and determined that he has aggressive lymphoma.I was devastated.  I had lost his sister, Shadow, in June to a different attack, apparently from the same cause.  The vet who came to euthanize her said she thought that a large lymph gland in her abdomen had ruptured and caused a huge infection which was untreatable.In Whisper's case, they told me that with chemo, he might have weeks, and without it, he probably had days.  They managed to get him stable enough to take home with steroids and a special compounded prescription to restore function to his bowels, but the prognosis was grim.A friend of mine who had a cat who was diagnosed with a hard-tumor cancer, given two months to live and when put on essiac tea, lived 18 months and passed peacefully of heart failure told me about this brand and recommended I try it.I ordered it, and by the time it arrived, although he was still alive, he had become anorexic, lethargic, and I really didn't think it would do any good.  He also had caught an upper respiratory infection in the hospital.  I gave him his first four doses with an irrigating syringe, and he started eating again, coming out socially and began taking it with juice from canned salmon.Now, just over a month since he was released and three weeks into the tea protocol, he takes two doses with salmon juice and he and my dog, Spirit, who I found out at the same time had a mass on his rectum, both get it in one of their water dishes to drink during the day.Whisper has gotten back to his old sweet, loving, playful personality, has a great appetite, and plays like a kitten, running to me like a puppy!  Spirit has responded to the point that I can't locate the mass.  I've been able to take him off Rimadyl.  He was starting to have soreness after hikes and play. He can travel up the stairs with no problem, jump into the back seat of our SUV, and doesn't have the risk of upset stomach he had with Rimadyl.This is amazing stuff!  If I ever develop cancer, I will use it first, and ignore chemo and radiation therapies.  Until now, I had simply believed when cancer was diagnosed, it was going to get you someday, somehow...sooner or later.With essiac tea, I believe we have an amazing weapon, which, if it doesn't outright cure it, works better than anything I have ever seen with anyone or any animal diagnosed with cancer and from reports I have read may actually cure soft cancers such as lymphoma.I don't know how advanced Whisper's is, but I have seen pretty much miraculous changes in him over the shortest of times.  I will update this review as we continue using the tea, but in three short weeks, I have come from feeling despair and huge grief to believing he may be with me for a very long time!  I bond to my animals almost as much as my daughter, and I am still not over Shadow's passing.  If I had lost Whisper, I don't know what would have happened to me emotionally or spiritually.Over the last fifteen years I have lost nearly everyone of importance in my life except my daughter, and I am saturated with the pain of loss.Essiac tea has already bought me more time than I expected to have with Whisper and the fact that he has become so vital again in such a short time gives me hope that we will be together for a long time to come!I will update this review as I watch Whisper's progress, but right now this may be the best $25.00 I ever spent!  It cost me almost $3,000.00 to find out what he had and stabilize him.  If I had known about this when Shadow passed, I would have started him on it prophylactically.  If you or a loved one are suffering from any form of cancer, please try this.  It's a bit of a project to brew, but worth every penney and every ounce of effort!

column9: You can make your own for cheaper at home
column10: I bought this here, but then I found out that you can make your own for cheaper at home.Here's the recipe:1.5 lbs of burdock root powder1 lb of sheep sorrel powder0.25 lb of slippery elm powder1 oz of Turkish rhubarb root powder1 oz wartercress1 oz kelp powder1 oz blessed thistle1 oz red clover herbYou can buy these herbs organic and in bulk online (google bulk organic herbs).Mix these ingredients thoroughly and store in glass jar in dark dry cupboard.Take a measuring cup, use 1/4 cup of herb mixture to 4 cups of water depending on the amount you want to make. (eg: 1 cup of herb mixture in a gallon of water)Use a "Visions" glass pot. Boil hard for 10 minutes (covered) then turn off heat but leave sitting on warm plate over night (covered).In the morning heat steaming hot, then strain through fine strainer into glass bottles and sit to cool. Store in refrigerator.Basic single daily does: 1/8 cup herbal tea diluted in 1/8 cup hot water, taken on an empty stomach (at bedtime or when you get up.)

This is the best instant oatmeal I've ever had and our go-to choice when we don't have time for steel cut oats.  It has a fresh, natural blueberry flavor, just the right amount of sweetness and a great texture.  Kids and adults both love it in our household.  I haven't been able to find it locally since the first time I bought it, so I'm happy to have found it here!We've loved every flavor we've tried from Better Oats, but this is our favorite!
LOVE this oatmeal! It has REAL tiny wild blueberries in it and flax seeds. One of only a few that I don't have to add anything to. I found it much cheaper in store, but wanted to say that I love it.

This is delicious.  Steaming fresh blueberry muffins with that dipped-sugar crust top flavor with only 2 minutes of microwave time and no mixing?  Amazing.  Mine blew up in the microwave and the tiny office kitchen smelled like a whole rack of muffins baking even though there's no oven in there.Of course, the "natural and artificial flavors" help.I would ignore the artificial flavors and continue eating this convenient breakfast favorite if not for the my wheat-senses tingling.  I handle gluten better than most celiac sufferers, but this oatmeal really set me off.  Many of the other "Better Oats" deliberately have wheat in them.  This doesn't, but I suspect it has a fair bit by accident.  My condolences to other wheat-free folk, as this is quite possibly the most delicious oatmeal I've ever eaten.

This is a great oatmeal.  I recommend it highly! It is easy to make, and it has real blue berries in it.  You just add water using the measuring cup pouch and microwave it for 2 minutes.  It makes a great meal or snack!

This is the best instant oatmeal I have ever tasted. And its all natural made with 100% whole grain oats (unlike most other brands) including quinoa and barley, and even has flax seeds.I found it cheap at target.  Buy it before its not available anymore

I love Better Oats muffins oatmeal and I'm not a fan of oatmeal at all.  I eat it every day when possible.  As much as I love Amazon, I have to say that this price is a rip-off. I purchase it for $1.00 a box at Wal-Mart.
This is a great product. It's delicious and healthy wid real oats. I have also found this product at food Max. I eat it everyday and have not gotten tired of it

column9: JUST DISCOVERED MY FAVORITE INSTANT OATMEAL
column10: I eat all kinds of oatmeal -plain,  flavored,  instant,  steel cut - and this is by far my favorite. The oats aren't sad little flecks and the blueberries are whole and real. The texture is great chewy but not tough and the taste is great -real oat taste that is not overwhelmed by sweetness. I also like that the pouch has a water measuring line on it.I've tried every oatmeal from this brand that my store carries and I like them all.

I was excited to find this oatmeal made of real, easy to pronounce ingredients which came in a short list.  The oatmeal cooks up well and tastes great.  Unfortunately the amount of flax seed in this oatmeal made me nauseous.  Unfortunately the flax seeds were also whole, which means they're offering very little nutritional benefit.  Whole flax seeds are most likely to pass through mostly undigested.  Needless to say, I won't be purchasing the oatmeal again, but I've now been inspired to make my own, healthier version.  It is as simple as tweaking the recipe to my liking, and measuring out the dry ingredients into snack sized ziploc bags.  Super easy to grab a bag for work and it's not hard to estimate the amount of water needed.  If it weren't for the amount of (whole) flax seeds, I'd definitely buy this oatmeal again.

It's pretty good tahini from Israel, very creamy, not bitter at all.  The price was low, which is what made me try it.  The only thing weird about it is that it comes in a plastic jar with a pop-on, not screw-on lid, but it seems secure enough unless you turn it upside down (which I have not tried and don't intend to).

column9: Love this Tahina! Great for making dressings
column10: I purchased this Tahina to try out a recipe one of my friends brought to potluck. Great creamy consistency, perfect for topping on chicken! Also used it to make hummus at home, and tahina dip for appetizers. Must say very happy with this product!
I make hummus often and the quality of tahini can make or break it.  This was really creamy and enhanced the flavor of the hummus.  Getting ready for my second order this week.
I tried differnt brand and I didn't like it.Lior Tahini tast very good and it's very good value.I'm very happy wih the Israelis products I buy on amazon.

Living in Seattle it is not easy to find good raw Tahini especially if you are an Israeli who knows how the real thing should taste. We tried Al Wadi but found it to find a strange after taste. Also tried the MIDEAST brand (not on Amazon) but found it to be bland. For a while we were able to purchase the excellent "Prince Tahini" online but now it is almost impossible to find in a reasonable price. This Tahini on the other hand is surprisingly good, reasonably priced and very close in taste to "Prince Tahini". The label indicates it is manufactured by "Achdut" in Israel which is the same factory that manufactures the "Achva" Tahini and Halva.  It arrived well packaged with no leaks or dents. Will definitely buy again.
kkk...not bad but doonno y the hummus i make with  this tahini doesnt taste like the hummus at Pomeranian restaurants......

I use a lot of Italian seasoning in my cooking, so I'm always looking for an inexpensive source.  We have a large family so I like to buy it in bulk.  Some of the cheaper brands I've tried have had lots of dust from the crushed herbs, and some seemed old and less pungent.This Spice Appeal Italian Seasoning seems to be fresh and strong, and it has very little powder in the bottle.  It comes in three large containers, each containing 6 oz. of product.  The contents are Basil, Rosemary, Savory, Oregano, Marjoram, (no fillers) in just the right proportions.  I have one of the containers in my pantry and the other two in the freezer (in ziplock bags) to preserve the freshness.I used it last night to make spaghetti and was very happy with it.  Just two tablespoons full seasoned a whole pot of sauce.  I also used it sprinkled on top of mozzarella slices with tomato and olive oil, as an appetizer.I will definitely look for this item again when I'm ready to order more Italian seasoning.  If you add something else to your order to total over $25, you will get your order shipped free.  This makes it a good value even when compared to Costco and the big box stores.

For not boiling any ingreidients this is a great beer. Just add some hot water, syrup, malt, sugar, pitch the yeast and let ferment. Thats it. I have made a lot of beer and have never had a canned extract turn out so good. Usualy when you cook beer you are in the kitchen for hours. With coopers it only takes about 10-15 minutes and you are done not to mention it tastes as good if not better than cooked beer. Once you have taken a few sips it is very similar to Guiness. It has nice flavor and finishes with a slight bitterness. Make sure to age it properly. For maximum flavor age for at least a month. The flavor will improve greatly! Enjoy.
Very easy recipe, turns out fantastically, as do all the Cooper's products I have used.

This is so good, Surprisingly good, and it gets even better with age. I added the whole package of sugar into the brew with the dry malt "Oops,I didn't read all instructions", The instruction recommended 300g and I used 1kg, But it turned out awesome, just more alcohol.So far this is my 4th brew, and I have been very happy with all Coopers products.

My dad has just gotten into making beer and this made a great christmas present for him.

column9: Cold Raspberry Ice Tea is the most refreshing Summer drink
column10: Crystal Light Raspberry Tea Drink Mix (12-Quart) 1.6-Ounce Packages (Pack of 4)Crystal Light Raspberry Iced Tea is the drink that we use for a thirst buster while working in the hot humid summer sun or enjoyed with our meals. Raspberry flavoring is very pricy from my market.  Crystal Light is easier, faster and provides better value for my family with the same flavor that I would get if I took the trouble to make it myself.  Give it a try.

I am happy with the home delivery of this raspberry tea powder which is my primary drink.  It is frequently hard to find it in stores.  They seem to have dropped my favorite in favor of newer flavors.

Also I discovered I could subscribe, receiving it at regular intervals by mail, which means I no longer have to make an extra stop, since the store that carries it is not where I normally trade. column4: Angel_Boy "Treat the people around you the wa...
column10: This taste very similar to lipton iced tea with a touch of rasberry- not enough to ruin the tea taste though. it doesn't really change the flavor any more than a twist of lemon or lime changes the flavor_$10 for 4- 12 quart containers is a good price. I love the Crystal Light Raspberry Tea Drink Mix and am unable to buy it in local stores.  I'm so glad Amazon has it and I can have scheduled shipments.  I arrange the shipments when I'm almost out of tea and everything is smooth.  I recommend Amazon's program.

Crystal Light Raspberry Iced Tea is my favorite Crystal Light drink. My family and I love it and go through it quickly. Unfortunately, for the past couple of years I haven't been able to find it anywhere close to me at all. I am thrilled to be able to order it here. The shipping was quick:)

Our family absolutely loves the Crystal Light Raspberry Tea Mix.  Our local grocery stores have started carrying only the green tea version and it just is not very good at all.  I was so happy to find this product on Amazon.  Will definitely be ordering again.

I have a friend who came to visit me that insisted that she did not like powdered tea. Well guess what? This is all she buys and drinks. She told me she did not really know what she was expecting but she did not expect what she got and I agree with her. This tea is the only tea in my fridge all summer long. Not only do I love the ingredients in this coffee, I love the taste. That being said, I can taste the herbs and the orange peel in this coffee so if that bothers you, you may not like it. Personally, I think it tastes great and I love the fact that it's nourishing my adrenals instead of depleting them like all other coffees.

I used to have a cup on my desk all the time. I have lost weight and my energy level is way up, highly recommend.

This jam tastes like you went out into the raspberry patch and picked your own.  It reminds me of freezer jam, more taste and less sugar. These canisters are about the size of a Rockstar can and contain enough mini croutons to dress several family sized salads for the dinner table, depending how heavy handed you are with the shaker. I got home to Maryland and couldn't find it!!!  I got on trusty old Amazon.com and bought two cases!!!  Definitely worth the buy!

column9: Great to have a chance to sample
column10: I love Think Thin bars, but had only tried the chocolate peanut butter.  This seemed like the perfect way to sample a couple other types and still know that I had my favorites on hand.  I still like the chocolate pb best, but I also liked the brownie flavor.  The white chocolate was my least favorite, but still tasty.  It is coated with white chocolate, but the inside is more dark chocolate.  I really appreciated being able to order a variety pack.
I use this olive oil all the time and am very happy with it for everyday cooking needs. Paid $16.99 today at Costco.
This is a great oil at a fraction of the cost of lesser oils in pretty bottles.

I use to like this olive oil - I've been buying it from Costco for the last 10 years - and used to think it's great oil (I still buy it sometime, just because I cannot always find my other favorite ones) ,  until I tried another middle eastern variety(from Greece, especially Lebanon). Wow, what a difference. This Berio oil is like just a colored water, tasteless, odorless. It's basically a colored water as any italian olive oil, even the Bertolli brand which is more expensive. Italian olive oil are expensive,  but in my opinion they are much less in quality than their other middle eastern counterpart. If you like the real aroma and the strong taste of olive oil, you should try either a Greek or Lebanese. I doubt anybody will be able to try the Lebanese(the best) variety because it's so expensive and rare, and people over there keep it for themselves. But the Greek oil is much more available, affordable in price, and much better than any Italian one. Just google olive oil and you will seeEveryone taste is different... .....

column9: Great starter pack for the undecided buyer
column10: I was first introduced to the Mighty Leaf Marekkesh Mint Green Tea by a co-worker and I enjoyed the taste & Aroma of the Tea.  I did an online search which lead me to Amazon & the Mighty Leaf official site, which listed a variety of flavors.  I decide to purchase the variety pack in order to try each type before puchasing an individual type.  The variety pack is an excellent choice for those who want a different flavor every day or for those who are undecided about the taste.  The price is quite reasonable for the tea.
IMHO this is the most wonderful group of teas I have ever tasted and I have tasted a few. The Green Jasmine is to die for...
Great quality product. A perfect way to sample the wide range of Mighty Leaf teas. I highly recommend for the tea lover in your home.

I received a box of this tea as part of a Christmas gift and was excited to try it.  I really like it but find each bag is only good for one cup of fairly weak tea.  I like my tea to have a lot of flavor so this was a little disappointing for me.  I liked it enough that I bought more but find it to be fairly expensive because I often use more than one tea bag when one should be enough.
Product arrived in a timely fashion.  Tootsie rolls were just the right size.  Not too big and not too small.  Just enough to cure my chocolate craving.
The candy met my expectations and as it should be; good product! It arrived exactly as described and tastes as I have always remembered it!

I wanted a caviar that I had not tried, and in my price range. The caviar was not overly salty and had a slight fishiness to it. The blinis were good, and creme fraiche was excellent...in fact better than I've ever had elsewhere. I loved the spoon, delicate with a sea shell look. I think for the money, this is a great deal. Of course, I could have done without the exorbinant shipping fees.
44 dollars for one can of corned beef.... are you crazy this is not a bad price for corned beef... but 40 dollars for postage....  you have got to be kidding.
This is by far my favorite and the best chocolate bar I have ever eaten!!!!!  YUM!!!

I have tried several Chai Tea mixes over the years, and even experimented with making Chai tea from scratch, so I was curious to try  Jaipur Avenue's Chai Tea. I must say that it is great, the best Chai Tea mix I have had so far! Easy to make, not too sweet and doesn't taste artificial. It comes in several interesting, rich flavors.  I initially ordered the variety pack and the vanilla flavor. I like them all, but Cardamon is my favorite. The design of the packaging is very nice, too, so it'll make a great stocking stuffer.

I have tried a few of the flavors in the variety pack and just love them! I've never been a chai tea fan before but I think I have converted.  I think I will be giving the variety pack as a Christmas gift to some family members. Great, great product!

column9: First review for a product worth it
column10: I typically do not find enough time to write a review about a product on Amazon but I thought Jaipur Avenue definitely deserved it. After moving to Seattle, I realized I didn't have a lot of options for instant chai powder - something I used to get fairly easily in Chicago. So I did some research online and ordered this variety option and have been loving it since.I didn't know what to expect - products in nicely designed boxes tend to underwhelm, but this was a pleasant surprise. The saffron variety is delicious and while I haven't gone through the entire box yet, I'm looking forward to the rest. The box has become a fixture on my office desk - I drink it twice a day.Chai is one of the few things I will splurge on and Jaipur Avenue one of the fewer I don't feel guilty about.

Making chai on the stovetop is a luxury I rarely have time for.  Sure, it's wonderful to meditatively stir the pot and smell the aroma of spices and simmering tea, but that's not going to happen when it's 2 in the afternoon and I'm stuck in front of my office computer.  Enter Jaipur Avenue.  No, it doesn't taste like chai made from scratch, but it's pretty close, and it's delicious.  The best part is that it has the flavor profile of the chai that you drink in India--the sweet, milky kind, not the super-spicy, hastily brewed "chai lattes" that you get at the local coffee shop.  Needless to say, I'm a fan!

I received a package of samples for this product at it's launch party.  One in every flavor.  Each one was delicious in it's own right.  My favorites were the Saffron and Cardamom.  Rich in flavor and invigorating!  I highly recommend this product.  The only thing I would change is the amount of packaging.  It would be better served for the packages containing only one flavor were not individually wrapped in foiled plastic as the waste is not recyclable.  Waxed paper would be better as it's at least compostable.

This is the best chai mix I have ever tried. The Masala and ginger are wonderful. The Cardomon is bitter but OK. The saffron tasted horrible! We go to an Indian restaurant each year for my birthday and I look forward to drinking their chai. Now I can have it at home too! Tried the ginger on ice today and it was heavenly.
This chai has fine ground tea leaves, not just spiced sugar syrup concentrate like some other mixes in the market. Love it.

I bought the multi-pack for work since measuring and mixing Trader Joe's chai tea latte mix can be a hassle when I'm in a hurry.  These chai tea packets meet my needs perfectly.  They blend easily and quickly for a quick pick-me-up in the middle of the day.  I really enjoy the cardamom and masala flavors, but I dislike the saffron.  I think it's because I have not been able to transfer my love of savory saffron dishes to this sweet rendition.That said, there are one thing that would make this product even better: include all of the flavors Jaipur Avenue offers.  That way, I only have 3 packets of a flavor I dislike, and my curiosity about the vanilla and ginger flavors will be sated.  I will probably order them once I finish off this box, but I would like to have more confidence ordering them since I will have 15 packets of one flavor to contend with.
Minty flavor with no after-taste like some of the flavored coffees, a little light on the chocolate, overall a nice change of pace.
If you like Starbucks, you may like this. So strong I could hardly taste the choc. mint.

When someone first gave me one of these candies, I thought it was a joke because it tasted like soap.  But after they assured me it's real candy, I gave it a chance, and it grew on me.  The flavor is intense and complex, and it hangs around in your mouth long after you finish the candy.The texture is similar to Pez, that of a semi-hard compressed-powder candy.  The flavor is unlike anything and must be experienced to be understood.  I did find single packs of these candies available at a nearby World Market store.  I recommend trying one pack before buying a whole case--the flavor is really strong, so you'll either love these or hate them!

My husband loves these candies and they are getting harder and harder to find.  I was terribly disappointed that this - as well as the scented gum that I ordered- was horribly stale.  They were just plain old.  I expected a lot more from Amazon and would be hesitant to order any perishable products through Amazon again in the future.

column9: Love these delicate and sophisticated candies
column10: I remember these from my childhood and they are nearly impossible to find.  The flavor is delicate and sophisticated. You won't be left feeling like you just swallowed toothpaste and your breath won't smell like fruit or whatever else most chewing gum companies think smells fresh and lovely.  No.  You will smell like violets and the flavor of these candies has that unique taste.  If you've ever tasted a violet (pesticide free/organic), you will adore these.  and you won't have to worry about your little ones gobbling them down.  These are not made for little children and adult taste buds will be delighted while younger children will find the taste peculiar.

Hirts ships the products fast and I received them in 3 days via usps (tiny envelope).  The product itself - theyre seeds.  Cant really say much more, only planted 3 of them in a tube that acts as a tiny terrarium, all 3 sprouted within 2 weeks and the root looks very strong.  High quality seeds I suppose.  TIP:  I am not very familiar with botany or trees for that matter, but when these seeds began germinating they gave me the notion that the seed was rotting. The Shell cracked all over (think drought stricken dirt) and had sticky hairlike strands all over one side.  This is actually normal for these seeds apparently as they are now reaching for the sky 3 weeks later. Overall - if you're looking for a new tree that's "exotic" and certainly different from the normal tree, this one takes the cake and its very easy to start from a seed. 5 stars

the seeds arrived on time and with directions on how to germinate. i used a heat mat and these seeds were some of the first to pop up. i only planted 5(half) of the seeds and of those 3 germinated in about a week. they are very healthy and are growing very fast at the moment.

I've been feeding this to my dog for a few weeks now. I see more energy from my older dog. He likes it and he is losing weight. He is overweight and I have tried different things to knock off the weight. This is actually working. So it must be the no grain recipe. People need grain-Dogs don't. Acts like carbs in their system. I've also been feeding him the Natural Balance Alpha dry dog food.No grain in it either. He likes the taste even without mixing it with wet food. I may go straight dry food if this keeps up. So-I am happy with the dog food and with Amazon's prices. Also the shipping was free with a faster shipping time for some reason. Thanks Amazon.

Of my 3 dogs only the less finicky would eat it. The other two prefer chunks instead of ground. Smelled really good (slightly smoky). The best part of all was this was the ONLY wet food that produced PERFECTLY formed stools!
My dog loves the food.  Some cans were dented on the top making them harder to open.  Still, worth the effort considering price and quality.

column9: Best brownie mix in the world.
column10: This brownie mix creates dense, chewy, chocolatey, deliciously San Franciscan brownies. It is amazing. The Ghirardelli chocolate makes the difference. Also, the batter (before you bake it) is very very tasty. The best brownie batter I have ever eaten. All chocolate lovers must try these brownies once in their lives. You will never use another brownie mix again.
This is the only brownie I've ever eaten where I've had to stop at one.  It's so rich you just can't believe it.

I am SO thankful that Amora is available through the web...this mustard is absolutely the BEST!!!  Like one of the other reviewers, we ration our Amora since we don't know when we'll be able to get to France to buy more.  We'd load our suitcases with the stuff!  One taste and you won't use anything else...

Amora is to the French what Heinz ketchup is to Americans - a national institution and the preferred condiment of choice for everything from frites to you-name-it. I've enjoyed Amora mustard since I first tried it in Paris 30 years ago. I add it to everything: barbecue sauce, salad dressing (try a teaspoon of it in your Caesar dressing!), marinades, and by itself on lots of foods. Everyone I have ever shared it with raves about it, and now you can have it without having to go to France (or pay exorbitant shipping) to get it.Many years ago, it was available in specialty and gourmet food shops, but when the original family-owned company changed hands some years ago (they were bought out by Maille, I believe, which was then bought out by an American company), there was apparently a trademark issue that prevented them from importing it directly to the United States. Like other reviewers, I packed it home by the case when I visited France and begged friends to bring some for me when they could. A few years ago I began buying their small jars by the case (to save on shipping costs) from an outfit in NYC; recently, though, a local Northwest company began offering the larger jars, and now one can buy it on Amazon.Try a small jar if you're uncertain, or just plunge in and buy a big jar and enjoy it. And buy lots of little jars to give as gifts - any "foodie" you know will be grateful to have this! Yay, Amazon!

I'm not a huge mustard fan when it comes to vinegary tastes, but this mustard is just brillant. Really. It's perfect for dipping pretzles in, and it's great with cheese. Very strong, but has a great flavor.
This is THE REAL THING just like back home in France. Worked with French food, works with American hot dogs and BBQ briskets !!

I lived in Europe for 50 years before I retired and came home.  Like many of you I miss many foods that I had gotten use to eating regularly.  I love Amora mustard as I use it when I make salad dressing and mayonnaise.  Being a lover of French foods I miss not getting many things that we like.  I have found a web site that you can get many of the things from France.  It is frenchselections.com Try it.

Finally I am able to buy a large jar (or several) online in USA.  Carting jars to USA from France has become tedious.  If you use Maille, you are short changing yourself.  Try the real, pungent dijon....Amora

I put myself on a wait list, didn't get notified but ended up finding the 1025g jar at the International Market on Park Ave. in Memphis TN.  I'm not sure if it is worth waiting for or not but our friend is going to love us for finding it.  I'm now curious but don't dare open the jar.

This is by far the best mustard around...One taste will convert you... Guaranteed...I grew up on the stuff in Europe and when I came over to the states, I could not find it to my dismay...well 30 years later, and after many filled suitcases with jars of this "gold" I can get Amora online.  Thank you Amazon!

column9: Why Can't You buy this in the US
column10: What in the world is the problem with this producer. No store on-line or off-line in the States seems to have. Surfas in LA had for a while some time back buy now they can't get. When some friends were buying a case to take back from Paris we thought they were nuts. They gave us a bottle, now were hooked, and it is nowhere to be found. Stop the madness.

A friend of mine gave me a jar as a gift when she returned from Paris. It was amazing! So naturally I raved about it to her. She gave me another jar. I'm afraid to open it till I have to. I have looked all over the internet and there is none to be found. I thought my savior was here when I ran across it on Amazon.com, but alas no. Now I'm frustrated and having cravings.

Excellent product, delivered on time, reasonable price, some of the grana and reggiano here in the States at the supermarket does not taste right - this cheese was genuine. Now if they could deliver some dry Lambrusco as well we would not have to run off to Italy all the time.

column9: Japan's healthier alternative to caffeinated energy drinks
column10: This is a healthier alternative to those high-calorie, carbonated cans of caffeine that pass for energy drinks. I first tried Ukon Energy in Japan, where I spent roughly seven years living and working in both Yokohama and Tokyo. The drink is known as morning, hangover cure for Japanese businessmen. It is slightly sweet (but only 30 calories per serving) and earthy with no carbonation. This tastes better than Red Bull or the other energy drinks ubiquitous in the United States.The active ingredient in tumeric root is curcumin. Tumeric root is widely used in Asia, where it is prized as a detoxifier. Claims are that it provides health benefits for stomach irritation, heartburn, inhibiting the formation of gallstones (the body more easily digests fats) and ulcers. Tumeric root is also used to treat liver and skin conditions, including cirrhosis, jaundice, eczema, psoriasis and acne.Ukon Energy contains vitamins E and B, has only 30 calories per serving and is caffeine-free. Sold in a conveniently compact bottle, this herbal drink is especially popular among Japanese businessmen, who see it as the ideal beverage for their on-the-go lifestyle.BTW: House Foods previewed its turmeric-based Ukon Energy beverage at the 2010 Korean Music Festival in Hollywood last May. More than 120 million Ukon Energy bottles were sold in Japan in 2009.Rating: Five stars.

column9: Great for hangover or a sleepless night the next morning!
column10: This drink is labeled for those tough mornings... I totally agree! Not getting much sleep, or having a little too much to drink the night before this drink helps wake me up in the morning, so I am able to get moving and get things done. It tastes good, just like other energy drinks and I have ordered on subscribe and save every month so I can save some money, and keep it in my fridge for when I really need it!Its pricey, but really works and gets me moving and feeling great in the AM ( have only taken in the morning )  :)  Five stars!!

My buddies and I tried it one night and it was better than I thought.Some people said it tasted like cough syrup so it may not be for everybody.HOWEVER! It did help with the headaches after partying out!We used the Subscribe & Save and Promotion and got it for about $12!Totally worth it.

I 1st tried a ukon energy drink at the 5th annual lee's discount tequila and beer experience and i sure was mixing tequila and beer for 3 hours got drunk and they had a stand of these little bottles of ukon energy bottles claiming its good for hangover ..i've tired hangover drinks in the past and they weren't that great but ukon the next day felt like i haven't touch any tequila and beer the day before ..it was amazing i'm one of those people that have horrible hangovers that can last up to 2 days and this product is by far the best and it really works ..im lucky to find them at lee's discount here in my hometown ..i will definitely stock up on this and people should try this product i suggest drinking one before you sleep just dont throw up or it wont work so that you have have a refreshing feeling the next morning this little bottle works wonder and is so healthy.

House Foods Ukon Energy Drink, 3.4-Ounce Bottles (Pack of 6)So taste-wise, its not amazing (I have weird tastes, though: I LOVE the taste of 5 Hour Energy), and you can definitely taste the turmeric in it. BUT, it's real use is not as an energy drink but as a hangover preventer. Take a bottle before you start drinking and your hangover will be much lessened. I've got a friend who swears by it, and it worked OK for me... but I suspect the only reason it didn't work better was because we split a bottle between like 4 people, and I drank a TON. I feel like even that small amount helped, though!
This is drink is great at helping preventing hangovers, we always get one on our way to downtown Tokyo. Drink it before you go out and you will feel the diference in the morning!
It tastes good and provided me with a noticeable amount of increased energy. I like the convenient size, unique look, and will probably order it again.

This isn't really designed to be an "energy drink". I don't even think there is any caffeine in it. I don't know why it is marketed that way in America. If you drink one of these while you are out drinking, you won't feel hung over the next morning. (drinking one after being hung over is probably too late) I've tested this concept out a LOT and it seems to really help. My friends agree too.
My husband was able to tolerate the taste, he felt a decent amount of energy. I on the otherhand couldn't stomach the taste nor felt any energy.
I really like these and think the really help the morning after.  I still can't decide if it's useful to drink them before u drink or not

I bought these on a Gold Box - must admit somewhat of an impulse buy.  I love SF Red Bull so at that price, this was a cheaper alternative.  I'm pretty sure it gives me a bit of a headache but I can't say for certain.  Works like any other energy drink so it's fine.

Nothing listed for nutrition or ingredients so this is what I found on asianfoodgrocer.com:INGREDIENTS: Water, fructose, dextrin, turmeric extract, citric acid, turmeric oleoresin, xanthan gum, natural and artificial flavors, gellan gum, inositol, niacin, sucralose, tocopherol (vitamin E), pectin, acesulfame-k, pyridoxine hydrochloride (vitamin b6).Apparently it's thought that "turmeric" has some sort of benefit.  Caffeine free, 30 calories, 7 carbs, 6 g sugar and 35% vitamin B6 (single serving can).  I'd really like to know someone's experience with this before ordering. :)
One little bottle of this (and they are little), and I had a gallbladder flare-up. I didn't get any extra energy.

Mediocre "health" drink as it is...but at this price?????  This is mental when the same thing in Japan is about $0.50-0.80 per can.  The most expensive available was of course on Amazon Japan at about $150 per can.  Save your money and buy something local. Basically you are drinking curry powder, so yeah...if people are insane enough to believe this has serious health or energy benefits, then I'm sure the price also seems reasonable to those people.
I had never tryed Nueva Del Sol organic coffee beans.But these beans are beyond my expectaions.these are medium bodied beans,the taste is very pleasing,smooth,not bitter,i will buy again.
no flavor at all, tastes like regular coffee from a grosery,try Jeremiah's Pick Coffee Organic French Roast instead.

so after seeing the great sale price ($30 value for $10) and reading the item title (12 pk- 2 pack), i assumed i was getting a total of 24 meals (12 pack x 2).  since this item runs about $1.10 at target normally. column9: Old Cape Cod Soy & Ginger dressing
column10: This was a great transaction.  I applaud anyone who will ship to an APO address and support their military.

This is an outstanding fat-free dressings.  I normally don't like fat-free dressings but this one is an exception.  I make a salad with chicken, pecans and fruit (pineapple and mandarin oranges) and I could imagine topping it with anything else.  It's also good with fast food Asian style chicken salads.

I bought this because it's the product they use at a local donut shop to make my son's favorite smoothies.  Add ice, water and smoothie concentrate, and you've got a yummy smoothie for WAY less than you'd pay in a store (with tax, it was $4.75 a smoothie.)  I can make 8 of the same size at home with one bottle of the concentrate.  It has a guide on the back to make various sizes, so there's no guesswork.  As an added bonus, now that I can make these at home I'm no longer tempted by the donuts.

Lundberg rices in our 4 years of experience with them have been excellent.  This particular variety may be a bit blander than some of the others, but some dishes need that.  We have a highly allergic son who cannot eat any food run on the same equipment as other grains and Lundberg provides us with VERY safe food for our son who can only eat a limited number of foods.  We order it by the 25lb bags often.  Good stuff!

column9: An utter disappointment and waste of money
column10: I live in Central Asia, in a place where brown rice is unknown.  I come back to the US and buy supplies for a year, paying for product and airfreight.  This rice has almost no taste.  There seems to be neither energy nor nutritional value.  Eating it gives me nothing but irritation to have spent so much money and confined myself to a year of dead rice or no rice.  Actually, it has accustomed me to not eating rice.The package was intact.  The sell-by date was okay.  I had never bought this brand before and I never shall again.

I love Celsius. Granted, I've failed to continue any workout regiment for over 2 years now and I've barely put on weight. I don't have a fast metabolism. At all. But for me, Celsius is kinda like my safety net. I worry about what I put in my body, about the lack of exercise I do. And this takes away the guilt feeling for a little while.But. I haven't been receiving what I've paid for. I've recently been receiving 2 Sparkling Cola, 3 Raspberry Acai Green Tea, 3 Sparkling Orange, 2 Orange, 2 Sparkling Wild Berry. Where is my favorite Peach Mango Green Tea? Or Strawberry Kiwi, Iced Lemon Tea, Apple Orchard Blend? I've recently been getting 2 Iced Lemon tea but I didn't get any this time! I prefer the non-carbonated ones more but I'm not even getting those.It should list what you're getting instead of false information. The product itself is fantastic. But I'm not getting what I paid for.

I have horrendous commutes (often 2 hours each way), and was finding that my energy level was dropping during the drive.  I needed something that had enough caffeine to just give me a kick, and since I don't like coffee and regular cola wasn't doing the job, I started looking for alternatives.  I ran into this as a single flavor in my local drugstore, and gave it a try.  I was reasonably impressed with it, but wanted to try other flavors if I could since I don't like to drink the same flavor all the time; a variety pack was attractive to me.  By putting a couple in an insulated bag in my car, it gave me one can for the morning (if I wanted it), and another for the drive home.  BE AWARE: because of some of the "natural" ingredients in this product, you may have some GI (stomach or intestinal) discomfort if you overdo it; I can only drink two cans a day for this reason (hence the 4 stars and not 5).  But for what I use it for, it has been very very helpful.  If you don't mind drinking the same thing/same flavor every day I'm sure you can find something local that will fit your needs (Monster, 5-hour energy, etc), but I have been very pleased with this product.

I do love this product.I don't know about how much the calorie burner aspect has worked, but I do like the energy boost on a long day.My issue is not with the product but the description of the variety pack. I did get 12 cans nicely packaged and arrived on time. However not all the flavors in the description are in the pack.Product FeaturesTwo Cans Strawberry Kiwi, Iced Lemon Tea, Apple Orchard Blend and One Can Orange, Green Tea Raspberry Acai, Wild Berry, Green Tea Peach Mango, Ginger Ale, and ColaWhat I received2 Iced Lemon Tea, 2 Orange, 2 Green Tea Acai, 2 Wild Berry, 2 Sparkling Orange, and 2 Cola.Basically to summarize I did not get; Strawberry Kiwi, Apple Orchard Blend, or Ginger Ale.If the description said the flavors were random that would be fine. But with it being that specific I just expected what I paid for.As I said I do like Celsius. And I'll order again. I was just hoping to try the different flavors.

I tried this product and must admit it is not for me...it does give me a surge of energy but it has a negative effect on my stomach and the crash for me is horrible after about 6 hours...I run and eat a low carb diet right now so maybe the combination is not right.  I purchased 12 cans and tried 4 of them...the remaining cans are still in the fridge as I can not take the feeling this product gives me...I hate to write negative reviews but felt compelled to share my experience

column4: Lynette355 "Have you ever noticed the age 40 ...
column10: Last week at my request he tried out Celsius in replace of his sugar filled energy drinks.  And to also see if he was able to drop a lil more weight while doing so.  His tummy filled out a bit this last year and he has fussed that he is not too comfortable about it.  I don't mind.  But he does and he is working his tush off.  Why not see if I can give him a lil help.You see Celsius is different.  Now with Celsius, you can burn double the calories and be energized. Celsius is the world's first and only negative calorie drink. Studies show that drinking a great tasting Celsius before exercise helps you burn up to 100 calories and more per serving, boosts metabolism, reduces body fat, increases endurance and provides lasting energy.So he agreed.  He had been weighing in regular already without any weight loss.  Day one he worked as usual with a weigh in before work and after work too.  He did drink his usual 2 energy drinks too.  Then for days 2, 3 and 4 he did the same weigh in and had 3 of the Celsius drinks.  They come in seven delicious flavors, carbonated and non-carbonated, and also in powder stick packets that can be mixed with water. Celsius contains no sugar, no high fructose corn syrup, no aspartame, no artificial preservatives, flavors, or colors, and is low in sodium.  He said that he did not care for the Strawberry Kiwi too much.  But that the Sparkling Cola was close to Coke flavor than off brand sodas are.Also he said he could really feel the energy kick in that he was NOT getting from his previous energy drinks.  That even though he was sweating at work it seemed that it also increased.  He did make sure he had plenty of water to drink too!  At the end of the week he had lost 1.5 lbs. I have tried other garlic products and they were so mild that you could not taste any garlic flavor. However, the garlic cloves from Delicias were better. They tasted like garlic without being overpowering.

column9: Garlic as a garnish, snack or for a cocktail accent
column10: I used to have access to 'armstrong garlic' in a tangy pickling solution, but that company seems to have stopped making pickled garlic cloves. They are firm and crunchy out of the jar, and can add some zip to a condiment tray, or make a unique contribution to a dirty martini.

This item is one cats adore and its good for them as well.. you can add it too food or just give it to them as a treat on its own.. running out in this house.. NOT an option

Good tasting chocolate, like from europe.These are different, and from Japan.I ordered 10 boxes for $20.I will eat my share.

It is definitely worth the buy. I would buy it over and over again if I wasn't watching my weight!
We used them as a treat during potty training & I had to have some also since they were so good.

column9: Fun to eat, fun to share
column10: I saw these in a local grocery and picked them up because I thought they were cute.  Once I tried them I had to share them with everyone!  They aren't too sweet but will hit the spot if that's what you're craving.  Every time I send a care package to my sister, I make sure to pack some of these!

I bought these cookies at Cost Plus World Market when they were running a promotion.  The picture on the box is larger than life: these treats are only about an inch tall.  The stem is a light and crispy little biscuit barbell that reminds me of classic Pocky.  The cap is made of some cheap waxy chocolate, on par with a Hershey's kiss -- note that the packaging never claims this is actual chocolate, just "chocolaty," so it probably doesn't have the requisite amount of cocoa butter to call itself real chocolate.  The flavor doesn't have much depth or complexity, it's just sweet.  All the appeal is in the shape.  They're just so darn cute!  They make me want to decorate a cake to look like a forest glade and stick these mushrooms in it, and I'm not even into cake decorating.

column9: Delicious, beautiful, and more economic than it sounds.
column10: I tried this tea in a Teavana store where samples were available.  Not only is the blossom beautiful and exotic, but the tea is delicious.  It's smooth, uniform, and though delicate the peach flavor was definitely at the forefront.  I don't know if the pot I tried had been sweetened or not, but I was floored.  It's easily the best tasting tea I've ever tried (though admittedly that isn't saying much; I'm not a frequent tea drinker).The economic part comes in with the multiple infusions.  This isn't a makes-one-pot product; you can refill the pot and brew again with the same blossom and get multiple pots out of each 'ball.'

I originally tried this tea in the Teavana store, and was surprised at the wonderful scent. I'm not usually one for peach teas, but this was so mellow and fragrant, I couldn't pass it up. I didn't even realize it was a blooming tea until the gal at Teavana explained it to me.Not only does this tea taste good and is good for you, but it's beautiful, and more affordable than you'd think. The blossom it creates when you brew it is very pretty, it's half of why I drink it. And, each blossom is good for 5-6 brews, which means the 2 ounces in a pack (about 8 blossoms) is about 50 cups of tea. I use 1 blossom in Teavana's Perfect Tea Maker (the 16 ounce size) and I can fill the tea maker full 5-7 times before I consider the flavor and scent to be pretty diminished. For an artisan tea, that's an excellent value.

This was my first experience with blooming tea, and it made me into an enthusiastic believer!  My boyfriend had wanted me to look for chrysanthemum tea, without caffeine, at the new Teavana store at one of the local malls, and this was the tea I was told had the most chrysanthemum in it.  It looks absolutely beautiful when it blooms underwater, it smells wonderful, and it has a wonderful peach and jasmine flavor.  Unlike traditional teabags, teaballs can be used for at least three brewings, and one ball is even enough to brew an entire pot of tea.  This particular blooming tea might be on the pricy side for just two ounces, but in the long run it saves more money than getting a lot of teabags that might be cheaper but which can only be used for one cup of tea and still retain much flavor.  This tea still packs its full flavor after the first use and after the first day!  This was also my first time experiencing white tea, which, as it turns out, is lowest in caffeine of any of the other types of tea and is the highest in antioxidants.  And the fancy teaballs just make one want to brew this tea, since the presentation is so much prettier and more elegant-looking than a regular teabag, which one just throws in a cup of hot water.  It also helps that in Chinese culture, the chrysanthemum is believed to have the power to help a drinker to live to one hundred!

As stated, this tea is lovely.  Watching it bloom in it's pot (I have a clear glass teapot just for these blooming teas) is a a lot of fun.  How did it taste?  Not bad, flavor did not match looks, but I could taste a hint of peach and it was fun to chomp on the little candy bits.  I don't know that I would repurchase.  It wasn't tasty enough for me to be more than a novelty, your mileage may differ.  Shipping was rapid and the item was well packaged.

column9: A delicate, delicious and beautiful cup of tea
column10: This tea is so delicious. Very smooth with a light hint of peach (not "fake" or fruity). We also love the Strawberry Misaki blooming tea. I actually like the Misaki a tiny bit more.And it is lovely to watch the teas "bloom." We don't have a glass tea kettle, but they had some blooming teas in one at a Teavana store, we visited and it is pretty! The other poster is correct about multiple uses too. We use each ball about 6 times (in a cup of tea, not a whole pot). I've found all of the Teavana tea yield multiple uses (generally at least 5 or 6).These teas are so yummy. We don't add any sweetener. They are just perfect as they are!
This tea is wonderful to drink and is beautiful when you make it. It opens into a flower. If you make it in a glass pot it makes a great center piece when you serve it.
This is a delicious, light white tea with sweet peach flavor. Great to relax with in the evening as it naturally has very little caffeine. Tastes like summer.

column10: Tuscan Herbs: mixture of aromatic herbs original from the Mediterranean region.Ingredients: rosemary, sage, thyme, basil, bay, marjoram.Use directions: grind directly onto meats, fish, sauces, vegetables.Drogheria & Alimentari provided spices, aromatic herbs and exquisite blends of fragrances from Mediterranean bottled in very attractive glass jar with a patented built-in grinder top . column9: I use this on virtually everything I cook
column10: Ok, so I first bought this to use as a bread dipper but quickly discovered it was way better as a cooking spice. Simply put, this spice is good on EVERYTHING. I've recently been cooking a citrus herb trout:- start with a dressed trout, or two trout filets. Spray or coat each side with olive oil and liberally coat with salt, pepper, and Tuscan spice mix. Stick a sprig of thyme and rosemary on the fleshy side of one filet along with several lemon slices. Either fold the other filet on top (if a dressed trout) or place the other filet on top. I usually coat the top at this point separately and add thyme leaves as well. Bake at 350F for 15 mins or until skin starts to brown.I also use this on steak:-season one side liberally with garlic salt, ground pepper, and Tuscan herb mix. Place this side against a hot grill. Season the other side in a similar fashion, then wait 4 mins (grill time will vary with grill). After 4 mins, give the steak a quarter turn for good grill marks. Wait 3 mins then flip. Once flipped, paint Dijon mustard on the upside (use the backside of a spoon to spread it if you don't have a brush, I like to use a horseradish mustard). Sprinkle more ground pepper and liberally add Tuscan mix.  Wait 3 mins, then give a quarter turn. Wait another 3 minutes then pull off the grill.There you have it- my two best recipes with this spice. But again, I use this on everything: Parmesan Brussels sprouts, goat cheese sautéed mushrooms...

column9: All Natural Spice Grinder Tuscan Herbs at Amazon
column10: Have used 1 & 1/2 bottles already. Money well spent. The spice herbs enhance the cooking flavors. Will definitely buy again. The grinder bottles make it easier to grind across the food being cooks. Prefer that over open bottle pouring.

I purchased this several years ago in Italy called "Erbe di Toscana". When I ran out I was devastated ... then I found this and ordered it. It's exactly the same. It tastes like being in Italy and adds a distinctive taste to all of my dishes. You can't beat this price for a three pack of wonderful!

column9: IN TUSCANY WITH NO RETURN FLIGHT!
column10: Not enough good can be said about D & A TUSCAN herb mill. This TUSCAN has absolutely NO bitterness as can be found in some Italian blends and it is as good to Italian food as D & A's PROVENCE is to EVERYTHING else. And they are all organic and all made in Italy where blending herbs is a true, true art form.
