Since you only have to let it rise 1 time you can make it quicker than some other styles of bread. Being able to purchase from Amazon will make it more convenient and I am grateful more people will become familiar with this great product. For those that suffer with Gluten Free intolerance this is a really good product that works with most recipes that you already have in your kitchens.

Domata Living Flour put the joy back in my gluten-free cooking.  I was introduced to it four years ago, through a local celiac support group.  It is a cup-for-cup replacement for all-purpose flour in your own favorite recipes.  You can even use it to make a roux.  In some recipes, I find it best to add a tad more flour or a tad more liquid -- but I can tell whether I need more of either as I am mixing the ingredients.  And, with some recipes, I do need to increase the baking time as gluten-free flours do tend to take longer to bake.  I use it for cakes, cookies, muffins, bread and breading for fried foods, pie crusts and other pastries, gravies and roux, waffles, whatever.  I have noticed that foods fried with Domata Living Flour do not absorb as much oil as foods fried with all-purpose wheat flour, so they are crisper and they reheat well without turning soggy.  I don't need extra gluten for pie crusts, but you can add a tad more xanthan gum if you find that it is not quite stretchy enough for your pastry recipes.  The taste and texture are equal to all-purpose wheat flour.  Baked goods may not rise quite as much as with a wheat flour, but I find that the cakes and muffins are still the same size as they were when I made them with all-purpose wheat flour.  I have shared this with many celiacs or those who cook for celiacs, and it has been a hit with each and every one.  One note:  if you are using an old bread recipe, remember that gluten-free dough has no gluten to be developed by kneading and does not benefit from the second rise that some recipes include.  You can do either without harm, but there is no advantage to doing so.This is the one gluten-free flour I must have in my kitchen.

Thanks to Domata Living Flour I LOVE cooking and preparing foods once again.  I can take any recipe and wherever it calls for regular flour, I just reach for this gluten-free flour and measure cup for cup.  How EASY is that!

My favorite dark chocolate bar is Ghiradelli Sea Salt Soiree', but sometimes it just costs too much. When I don't splurge on something more intense and expensive, this is always my second pick unless somebody has another brand that's more concentrated on sale. It's just rich enough to win over all those milk chocolate fans who are hesitant about going too severely dark, and it's not repellently sweet like a Cadbury can often be.  Just like Coke Classic, it's hard to beat a Hershey bar in price and quality, so if you find the gourmet bars a bit too harsh and pricey, this may be the way to go. Anyway, my quest for a non-pill form of Glucosamine and Chondroitin led me to Zuke's Hip Action.I love that it's wheat, corn and soy free. After all the issues with Chinese-made dog treats, avoiding treats from China is important to me and the health of my dog.For a small 46 lbs and under dog (like my Ozzy), only one treat is necessary per day.  For a medium dog of 98 lbs and under, 2 treats a day is necessary.  For a giant dog of 138 lbs and under, 3 treats are needed per day.  Each package has about 23 treats in it.  If you have a larger size dog, it definitely can get pricey.I feed Ozzy the peanut butter flavor, because, well, peanut butter is one of his favorite things in the world.  Each treat is square and has a moist look to it.  It has an interesting smell - not one of my favorites, but not completely a turn-off either.  Just...interesting.  But the best part is he LOVES them.  His eyes actually bug out more than the usual chihuahua buggy-eyed look, and he happily grabs it and runs off to enjoy it.  He looks forward to it every day.Ozzy recently had surgery on his ear, and during the time after his surgery, he was pickier than ever with food.  He refused to eat even the raw beef patties that he usually loves.  He barely even took the peanut butter hiding his eye vitamins, probiotics and antibiotics (and this is a dog that loves peanut butter)  But these Zuke treats?  Heck yeah! Never a problem.  Just goes to show how much he loves these treats.

column9: Pedigree Dog Food, why I give if 5 Stars
column10: I have a four year old dog who loves Pedigree Canned Dog food.  We have been using it the last six months.  I have purchased some of the most expensive canned dog foods at a local pet store and he will not eat the stuff.  If I have a bag of high quality kibbles and mix it in with the Pedigree, he will not eat his food.  We tried Wellness, Blue Buffalo, Eagle Pack, Holistic Select, Innova, Merrick, and Natural Balance.  I don't know what is in these higher quality cans of dog food he does not like.  Maybe too many vegetables??  He will even hide and pout if I put that stuff in front of him.  One time I left the food out for 15 min., put it away, and tried the next day.  He just would not eat the food.  He just loves the smell and taste of Pedigree, and he will even eat Alpo on occasion, but he will not eat the expensive dog foods, which I am more than willing to purchase for him.  I talked to two vets about this.  They tell me dogs go by odor.  The worse something smells the more they like it.  This is why many dogs will roll in dead things out of doors.  We do try to balance out his diets with apples, carrots, etc., if he will eat them, plus the dog gets a vitamin with minerals each day.  Of course he will eat cooked meat if I give it to him, and often we will give this to him with some rice or whole wheat pasta mixed in.  If someone can tell me how to get him to eat the better canned or kibble dog food that so many folks think dogs should be on, then I would like to know this.  Also, the reason we started using Pedigree is because we have some friends (and their relatives) who have had many dogs over the years and feed them Pedigree.  These dogs have lived to a ripe old age.  The biggest thing that got them down was arthritis, but the Pedigree never killed them.  So, this dog food may not be high quality, which I agree when compared to Blue Buffalo, etc., but it does not seem to affect their life span.  I am sure there will be folks who will tell me differently, but for those folks I know personally, they have not found any problems with this food for their dogs.  Amen.

I received a sample of this dry dog food from the company and I have to admit - it is a very good product.  My dogs all loved it eespecially the little "bits" of additional antionidants and nutrients.  All my dogs practically fought over who would get the most!!!!!  Never before have I had a dog food that my dogs liked so much.  And the list of ingredients - wow!!!  I rate this product very high and so do my dogs!!!

...but of course, "Jacob" the exuberant, 16-month old Weimaraner rescue has a VERY broad definition of "edible":-)Full disclosure: everything we place in his dish fills him with delight.We purchased this brand based on the recommendations of the local breed club and a local dog specialty shop. Although our dog is a pet, and neither a show nor field dog, it was clear that owners with major investments in their show and field animals had high regard for this food.While I haven't sampled it, the manufacturer's emphasis on "human-grade" primary ingredients appeals to us. In the workplace, we often talk about "eating our own dog food"  in evaluating services and products delivered to customers, and this is also true for the food we choose for out pets.An additional note about this food. Without getting too graphic, cleaning up after your dog might present a slightly different experience. We've noted a slightly softer consistency overall. Just be prepared for a change in what your dog leaves behind...

I was told from a friend of mine, how great blue buffalo dog food was. I kept telling her I would try it, but never did. The problem was, I would always have a full bag of dog food when she would remind me. I didn't want to waste the dog food I had just bought. Anyway, one day I was ordering off Amazon and said, "what the heck, I'll give it a try." I ordered it, it arrived and my dogs LOVE IT!!! I am never going back! the other (no names) dog food would literately go right through them..YUCK! They weren't getting the proper nutrition and they were not as energetic. Thank you and I am going to keep purchasing BLUE BUFFALO!!!!

These are great straight from the can and I found my favorite condiment to go with these Octopus is catchup of all things.Reese Spanish Octopus have a LOT of Olive oil you will need to drain (not extra virgin) and you will need to be very cautious when opening these cans because they are a little difficult to open (I open mine over the sink).Great value and a tasty and convenient treat with a very long shelf-life.

Never had octopus before...but I love most other seafood-in-a-tin ( sardines, oysters, etc )Before buying 100 cans,  I bought one at a local store for $2.49Tasty !Bought the 100 cans when they were on sale for $71Wish I would of bought 300 cans.I eat one a day,  right out of the can.My girlfriend cant even stay at the table when I eat them...so definitely try them out before buying online.

column9: Ahh..Cupella Morning Blend is great coffee!
column10: Excellent flavor.  Wonderful fragrance.  One of the best coffeesI've ever had!  So glad it's available on Amazon.com!!  I can't imagineanyone who tries it will be disappointed.

I've tried a couple of different dark chocolate and cherry bars and this is the only one that has delicious chewy dried cherry pieces right in the chocolate.  And they are large enough pieces to really taste the cherry (not tiny bits or just cherry flavoring like you get in other bars).  This has become my favorite chocolate fix (although Godiva Key Lime truffle is a close second)...

This organic chocolate is so dark and delicious without a trace of bitterness.  The added dimension of the dried cherries is terrific.  And, as an added bonus, I know I'm supporting a business which is doing its' best to make our planet a better place, both environmentally and socially through the Fair Trade certification.  Thanks Green & Black!!

Of all of the Green and Black flavours, Cherry Chocolate is probably my favorite.  Green and Black's Dark Chocolate is superb, and here it is mixed with large pieces of dried sour cherries.  Perfect with tea, particularly after an opulent dinner that needs to be capped off by something tart.

column9: great if it didn't almost break my tooth
column10: I almost broke my tooth on this bar and have been having major tooth pain for months since.  I bit into something very hard and crumbled, which I'm assuming was a broken cherry pit...and at this point I hope it was cause that would be gross not knowing what I bit into.  They mentioned that you may encounter them on their website...but nowhere on the package. Be warned so you don't need dental work after buying an expensive chocolate bar!

I've got to be honest, I don't care at all about free trade. I do care deeply about taste and this stuff takes two things I love and somehow screws them both up beyond recognition. what an awful disappointment. I don't think "tart" is a fair description, mouth puckeringly sour and acidic (not in a good cooking way, more like a stomach acid way) would be a more accurate description of the flavors. I don't taste any chocolate and not really any cherry (even tart) it's more just a chemical reaction with no flavor. it's actually similar to their chocolate chili bars - I love both of those things too and love the combination but rather than getting chili flavor and heat you somehow only get the unpleasant heat and no flavor.

Finally I found a food that doesn't give my 1 year old Giant Schnauzer diarrhea. I have a 7 year old mini schnauzer who is very picky and has bad teeth, but always enjoyed Blue Buffalo, but poor Conrad had upset tummy every few days. So I switched him to Diamond brand, same deal. We tried probiotics, pumpkin, rice but nothing worked. A friend has the most beautiful boxer and told me about Ultramix so I decided to give it a whirl.  Both dogs gobble it up! In fact I think I will have to get a "slow down" feeder for Conrad. His stool hasn't been loose since which makes us both happy! :) yay! Yes, it is a bit pricey but I love my dogs and care for them as I do my 5 children so I want their diet to be the best it can be. I do super saver shipping and have it auto shipped each month which also saves a few bucks. Very pleased!!Castor & Pollux Natural Ultramix Large Breed Adult Dog FoodCastor And Pollux Natural Ultramix Adult Dry Dog Food

Thanks to Amazon, I received the second bottle of this drink mix to replace the first one that was tasted funny to me. The second one was exactly the same, nothing resembled to the "almond" flavor I used to.  I had to throw both of them away.

column9: I love it in my tea!
column10: I add a heaping teaspoon of Badam Drink Mix to a large mug of black tea, then add half & half and a little sugar. Yes, Badam mix has sugar, but I was going to add sugar to my tea anyway, so I just add less. Makes a yummy tea, morning or later!

column9: Not healthy, lot of sugar and no trace of saffron!
column10: We bought this as our 2 year old son was didn't like to drink milk. We saw the ad on on tv and decided to buy this. When we opened the package it was merely sugar mixed with traces of badam (almonds) and cardamom. However there was no trace of saffron! Even one strand of saffron makes the milk yellow and emits nice fragrance. Apparently MTR  is indulging in deceptive advertising. This is not healthy for kids as it is full of sugar. I have written to the company, but so far no reply.

Rarely can I say that a GF product tastes better than the gluten version.  Thse cookies do, though.  Melt in your mouth delicious, and just the right amount of lemon.  I am confident tht if you gave these to gluten eaters, they would not be able to tell the difference.

Although at first I wasn't sure about the texture of the wafers, I found these lemony wafers to be really addicting. The lemon filling flavoring is delicious and much better than the chocolate version of the same wafer. i would definitely buy this again!
We really like these. The lemon flavor is heavenly. The cookies are crisp and light... VERY VERY good.

When I first ate one I thought Wow... that is lemony and not sure if I liked it but by the end of "just trying one more" I was addicted. I have to hide them from my non-gluten free husband. He likes them better than the vanilla or lemon ones I used to buy for him in the grocery store that are not gluten free. I am trying to get a local store to carry them.

column9: The best gluten-free cookies I have ever had
column10: I feel like have tried every gluten-free baked good out there. Since I am allergic to dairy, eggs, soy, and bananas as well this product is a lifesaver for when I need a cookie. They taste really , really good and don't make me sick.  I love these things I pray they never stop making them.
These are actually superior to any similar vanilla cookies I've had - they are absurdly addictive, so watch out for that...
These cookie and the chocolate version are the best gluten free substitutes for Oreo cookies on the market. Filling very creamy and cookie is nice and light.
My two little boys love these.  I can't tell them apart from the real gluten version.

column9: Vanilla wafers -- beware they can melt in shipment!!!
column10: These tasty chocolate coated wafers are a great way to get a chocolate fix without too many calories. Be warned however that if the weather is sunny and in the 70's or higher, you're likely to be disappointed when you open the box because the chocolate melts. You'll have three solid blocks instead of 18 wafers, even if you used next day delivery. Best to order this product when cloudy weather is forecast, and high temps will be in the 60's or less -- apparently those brown UPS trucks get pretty warm in the sun!

These are so good.  I love them as a quality , gluten free sweet treat.  My kids , who are also gluten free, just think they are great cookies. They have a great lemon taste.  I dont know of any afater taste or any particular potato smell.  They are just real good cookies in a gluten free world!
The lemon flavored wafers ARE really good, but the STRAWBERRY are BEST!I'm going to ask Amazon.com to get them on the subscribe & save program.J.

These wafers are awesome, if you like the ones you buy normally in a local grocery store or use to buy you will love these, but be careful, very addictive, just like the others.yummy Great product that is free of gluten.
my kids were thrilled to have this kind of treat gluten free and tasty.  It has become a favorite in our family.3

column9: Gluten free, but NOT taste free
column10: I got these for my daughter who has celiac.  I usually can tolerate the gluten free foods, but rarely do I find something that I would choose to eat.  These go beyond that.  They are so good.  Now, I LOVE sugar wafers and so I was skeptical.  But, you'll not be disappointed.  The biggest problem was stopping myself from eating them and saving them for my daughter.

These wafers remind me of those regular chocolate, vanilla, and strawberry wafers I was addicted to as a child...now if Glutino could only make those flavors gluten-free!  Yummy!!  Lemon flavored is a great start!
These wafer cookies are every bit as good as the ones I used to eat that are wheat-based.  They are light and airy and just plain good!

These are the best gluten-free cookies that I have ever tasted.  They are as good as the regular wafer cookies (or better!).  The only problem is that in shipment (during the summer months) the chocolate all sticks to the paper and the container that the cookies are in.  If they could be put on ice packs for shipment, they would get to the customer in much better shape.
I never thought I'd bother to review a cookie, but . . .  These are terrific, indistinguishable from 'real' cookies.  We go through a lot of these.
These remind me so much of a KitKat, which I can't have anymore due to a gluten intolerence.  I literally have to hide these from my daughter so I know I'll get some!!

I bought these cookies because I love lemon, I'm always looking for something that tastes good and is gluten-free. These cookies had everything up until the after taste - they had this funky fake lemon taste that wasn't there at the beginning. I was disappointed in the box and never bought another.
Chocolate Chip has a nasty smell and taste. I would never buy this flavor again. But the oreo ones are very good.
These are wonderful.  I had low expectations for some reason, but wow, very good.  I'm thinking I might make them into a crust for a cheesecake for Thanksgiving ... yum.
Delicious "oreos".  A little less sweet than regular oreos, but I think thats a good thing.  Overall, very excited, even my non-gluten-free friends enjoy these oreo-ish cookies.

My daughter has a wheat/gluten allergy so we have purchased a large number of gluten free cookies for her, trying to find something to serve as a substitute to real cookies.  Of all the brands and types of cookies, these are her favorite.  I have tried one as well and as far as prepackaged, store bought cookies are concerned, these are great.  The cookie is made up of alternating layers of waffers and chocolate creme and the whole cookie has been dipped in chocolate.  If you like chocolate I think you are going to love these cookies.

column9: To make good even better - keep them in the freezer!
column10: These are very good, but in the very warm weather the filling can go soft.So I keep mine in the freezer.  Try and keep them sealed to avoid moisture -all I do is fold the silver packet over - and they are really good. Thereis not enough to them to taste cold - but they are crisper.  I only keepthe packet I have open in the freezer.  See what you think.

Before becoming a Celiac and switching to a gluten free diet, I used to love Trader Joe's Vanilla Joe Joe's. I found these on sale at the Grocery Outlet the other day and decided to give these a try. These were so much better than the Trader Joe's Vanilla Joe Joe's and significantly better than Vanilla Oreo's. Even my gluten eating friends said they were addicting. They are great dipped in hot chocolate, milk or tea but are even better on their own. Will definitely buy again.
I bought these locally.  The price was high and I don't like the licorice taste!  I couldn't even finish the box...  I prefer the Schar brand vanilla wafers.

I've purchased most of the gluten free cookies available on Amazon and in local stores.  These are best of the bunch.  If you like wafer cookies -- they're good whether you can eat gluten or not (I grew up eating cookies with wheat and these compete with any "normal" wafer cookie (I wouldn't go as far as I would with Blue Diamond's Nut-Thin crackers, which I would say are better than regular crackers -- but they are at least as good as most cookies -- if you serve them to friends they won't wince (or even know they are eating gluten free) when they bite into them).  The other Glutino flavors aren't bad either but the chocolate is the best -- I find chocolate tends to help mask the glutin free flour taste in most cookies.I would recommend some caution in shipping them during the summer as you are more likely to recieve a cookie block rather than individual wafers (although the cookie block was pretty tasty too).  Also, an added bonus for anyone shipping to APO or DPO, they will ship to these addresses(again a caution about the heat, especially if you are shipping to Afghanistan during the summer).

column9: Might just be better than Oreos!
column10: Love these cookies!  I finally found one that tastes just as good as Oreos.  I think I can handle being on this gluten-free diet now as long as there are decent tasting cookies like these around!  I don't feel nearly so deprived.  Just made my day!

We have been on Gluten Free for a few months now, and when you first start, many things are hit or miss. I don't usually like vanilla "Oreo" type cookies anyway, and worried that my boys (6 and 4 years old) would never go for them... BUT- they are so sweet, flakey, and delicious that our whole family (my husband included) couldn't get enough of them.BUY THESE COOKIES, for real.
Crispy, light, but overloaded with sugar.Sweeter then any GF product I have tried!!!  The price is one the high side, but Amazon has a good deal.

CHOCOLATE. When going GF 10 years ago, I was bummed cause there was suck a lack of store bought goodies. I once had an addiction to Keebler Fudge Shop, Fudge Sticks. I was hesitant at first to but these cause of the price, but they are worth it if you have the craving. I like them frozen/refrigerated the best. I gave them to a GF co-worker and she really liked them too. The only problem I have is once I open one box, I have trouble not finishing the whole thing. oops. I've also tried the vanilla ones, but they are not that good. Buy these!!!
These vanilla creme cookies taste great! Some gluten free items lack taste and texture, but you'd never know these cookies are gluten free and they are a favorite of ours.

column9: Best gluten-free vanilla cream filled cookie ever!
column10: I have been on a gluten-free diet for nearly ten years,and these Glutino Vanilla Creme Dream Cookies are by far the best I have ever tasted!  Try them for yourself and if you like vanilla filled cookies,you won't be disappointed.

Ok I am a chocolate snob. If things have chocolate in them they have to taste really good. and these do. I bought a box and the local grocer today, there are about 16 wafers in a box and now there are just 2 left.

I'm surprised! These are awesome! They are just like the organic ones I used to buy for my kids before we stopped eating gluten. They're crunch and tasty. They are quite sweet though. Not something you could eat a lot of in one sitting. I'm done at 2. Maybe that's a good thing though. :)

I love these!  They have the same flavor as Oreos, with a very similar texture.  As with most gluten-free things, they are a tad grainy, but this is easily overlooked!!!  Definitely something to keep on hand (and in hand).
These wafer have a very bright lemony filling and dont taste like they are gluten free cookies. I have to keep them away from my kids!
There are very few "good" gluten free cookies out there.  These are quite good, nice and chocolaty, but not too sweet.  Ps. don't forget the milk...

These dark chocolate covered wafers are wonderful. I don't even realize they are gluten free. With a rich dark chocolate covering and good tasting crunchy wafers they are the same as regular wheat wafers but without the problems for my condition.
These wafers are delicious.  My daughter has celiac so I buy them for her, but I love them too!
Best cookie ever - if there are Glutino Lemon  Wafers on my kitchen shelf, I can sleep well at night... best dessert .... fabulous fix for the sweet tooth. Top notch cookie that deserves top praise.

column9: These cookies are to die for.
column10: Since going gluten free, what I have missed the most is a good cookie.  The gluten free breads and cookies on the market are not very good.  When I found these, I thought I had died and gone to heaven.  Can't live without them.

These are good, rich cookies, but I would not buy them from amazon again because they were so poorly packed that half of them were falling apart or already crumbs. I'll go back to buying them locally.

I keep these on auto-ship and hope I don't run out! But once a box gets opened here...they disappear at once. Crisp, light, so flavorful....and gluten-free! Whole family is hooked on the entire brand..but this flavor cookie is the MUST have. Especially refreshing refrigerated on a hot summer day.
These are delicious and such a treat if you are on a gluten-free diet.  I could eat the entire box at one sitting!
The cookies are okay in taste. They are a little too sweet for me. They also came completely crushed which didn"t help the texture.

I've been gluten free for about 10 years now and love my cookies!  I generally order Schar products and love their vanilla sandwich creams which really are as good as or better than gluten cookies.  With Glutino I feel it's hit and miss.  Their crackers are generally delicious and I love their pretzels but these cookies tasted like styrofoam and the icing was super sweet.  Not my favorite product from Glutino.  If you didn't care for these, you might try the Schar vanilla cremes.  They're amazing!

column9: Very close to Nabisco Sugar Wafers taste
column10: The wafer part tastes very close to Nabisco sugar wafers but it's so much lighter. The light, crispy wafer combined with the strawberry flavor is not too sweet, like most GF products are, it's just right. We love them.
DELICIOUS. In summer heat they get soggy rather quickly, but freshly opened they are amazing.
these little cookies taste fantastic! not too sweet, just right....chocolate melts easily, so we will be ordering these in the cooler months only

I love these! After discovering a familial gluten intolerance, premade items that are gluten free have been difficult to obtain. Therefore, I now order these by the case each month. Light, refreshing, sweet and no grainy aftertaste. Yahoo! I don't have to break my dient now and I might not starve to death! I am so weary of lettuce....
a great gluten free product wityh a real taste of lemon. This is not a washed out flavor but a excellent mix of sweet and tart in a light crunchy wafer cookie.
I got these not expecting much but they were realy good. For gluten free they were great. I am so glad i found these. There great for when your craving something sweet.

column4: Marc S. Gibian "Enjoying the outdoor world"
column9: gluten-free and corn-free cookies that truly satisfy
column10: These are cookies that give a satisfying crunch, taste great, yet still are both gluten-free and corn-free. Finally, something to satisfy my sweet tooth while also providing some of the hard to find gluten-free crunch.

Having tried a couple of other brands of gluten-free sandwich cookies, these are the best of the bunch.  They're crunchy and true to the texture of the other "real" cookies that aren't gluten-free.  Some might think that the filling makes them a bit too sweet, but for me that just means I've satisfied my sweet tooth sooner!  The chocolate version from Glutino is just as good and has a true "chocolatey" taste - something that isn't there with the other gluten-free brands out there.
These chocolate wafers are delicious.  It's hard to find gluten free products that taste great, but these hit the mark.  They are a staple in my pantry.

This product is very tasty but if you are also lactose intolerant, better forgo the pleasure.  Milk is not listed on the allergy advisory (May contain traces of...) but the ingredients section lists whole milk powder as a component of the chocolate coating.  Otherwise, it's a great product.
These wafers melt in your month!  I buy by the carton.  we all love them.  Highly recommended.

column9: Wow! Just like the real stuff!
column10: These are absolutely wonderful, great tasting cookies. People who are not celiacs can't tell the difference. You'll like them, too!

It's really hard to believe that these cookies are gluten-free.  They are like those really yummy cream-filled vanilla wafer cookies from childhood, only these have a heavy chocolate coating. Extremely good and if you're gluten sensitive, they are oh so good for you ! Indulge yourself.
It isn't easy to find really delicious cookies that are gluten-free, dairy-free, nut-free, and don't contain chocolate. These lemon wafers are all that -- truly yummy.

column9: Excellent- but do yourself a favor and try them from the fridge!
column10: I loved these cookies when I first tried them, but found that in the humidity they will get soggy and gross if left open for too long.  Easily fixed with a Ziploc, but one time I tossed them in the fridge to keep them extra fresh.  That was when I fell IN love with these cookies.  When cold the creamy layers really hold up against the crunchy wafer and make a wonderful combination.  They are truly addicting.  Also, because we keep our entire house allergen free for my boys, these cookies are some that I can confidently serve when entertaining gluten-eating friends.  They often ask where they can get their own!

I recently had to go gluten free.  I have disliked so many products, because I can't get used to the tastes of some of the flours.  I would NEVER had guessed these were gluten free.  They are delicious!  I really have to use self control so that I don't eat them all in one day. If only I could find a gluten free bread that tastes good.
The cookies are the best GF packaged cookies.  The only complaint I have about them is they seem to disappear!

These are excellent. Expensive, but so good. You'd never know they were gluten-free. I don't know what the person was talking about them smelling like potatoes. They really do taste like a Kit Kat. So good!
These are my favorite gluten-free cookies, and I have tried a lot of brands. What more can I say?!

I have a three-year-old celiac who knows more about GF cookies than most adults, and these are his favorite cookies.  I like them too.  They really taste just like regular wafer cookies.  Totally worth the cost.

With 3 Celiacs in the family, the entire house is gluten free. Friends and family can't believe when I tell them that these cookies are gluten free. Another note, the cookies are packaged well, so they arrive INTACT, not in pieces, like other cookies out there.

Well, my kid who isn't gluten free likes them, and my kid who is won't touch them.  I cook and bake most of what we eat, so desserts are very homemade and natural in their flavor.  These are really, really artificial-lemon flavored....they remind me of my dish soap every time I try one.  I really don't like the flavor, but the texture is nice.  I'm a little dizzied that I have so many boxes of something I don't care for... it was worth a try, though.
My hubby and daughter LOVE these cookies. They are kinda spendy though. I did not enjoy them as much as I like gluten containing cookies!!!!

My son is 6 and he has celiac.  He loves sweets, however when he took a bite of this wafers he was done with it.  He said that it just was not good.  I tasted it and had to agree with him.  The only thing I could taste was the extreme sweetness and the fat sticking to the roof of my mouth.

column9: Very good.  Also, they smell like potatoes.
column10: I really shouldn't complain:  the world would be a sadder place without these.  They are like gluten-free Kitkats, which is wonderful.However, they also smell like potatoes.  The chocolate covers the potato taste and smell, for the most part, but, it's still a little bit like eating chocolate-covered crispy potatoes.However, as you are probably aware, there are variations in what people can taste and smell.  Personally, I can tell what vodka was made from--potatoes, wheat, whatever--even though it's so finely distilled that there shouldn't be any way to distinguish that.  If you're not super-sensitive to tastes and smells, you probably won't notice the potato at all, in which case, these would be fabulous.

column9: It's good junk food.  They also smell like potatoes.
column10: First, let me say that I love this company.  They have somehow managed, with very difficult flours, to make normal junk food.  (These kinds of cookies are sold in American supermarkets in packages that are three times the size.)The packaging is pretty;  the cookies are crispy, light, and very appealing in your hand.  They are an exact duplicate of the wheat version.  However, once you get them up to your nose, you can smell the potato flour they are made from.Pull them away from your nose, and you have a very pretty cookie.  Bring them back in to your nose, and it's a surreally icky potatoey experience.  Cookies like this shouldn't smell like potato vodka.They do have a chocolate-covered version of this that you can't really smell, because the flour is covered. It's such a sugar rush that you may not care what it tastes like, particularly because it has an excellent chocolate-sugar-bomb wafer cookie texture.Just hold your nose.

My son and I who are both Celiacs loved Glutino wafers in both chocolate and dark chocolate varieties. We were on our 3rd box when I opened one of the bars and went to bite into it. It was the equivalent to biting into some sort of spongy rock. I immediately spit out what chocolate had fallen into my mouth while biting it. The bar itself seemed extremely stale to me. I went ahead and opened the remaining 3 bars in the box and the rest were normal. I also noted on the package that the product is made in Israel then processed in Canada, then sent to USA to be bought. It seems to me like one of the bars I had floated around a facility for quite some time before it was actually packaged and sent. Or worse who knows. I'm glad it was me and not my 3 year old son who bit into it.I tried contacting Glutino about what happened. I tried calling several times as well as sent messages via the internet. But no response. It went from being suspicious to down right scary, what are they hiding and if this is how they treat their costumers- how do they treat their food?Please be forewarned. Going gluten free isn't easy and Glutino is a big brand on the celiac's grocery list but since our incident we avoid Glutino at all costs.
I love my Sweet Raspberry coffee in the morning.  Just sweet enough so don't need to add anything.  Just brew & go.  This purchase is my winter stock since it is a summer coffee.

I absolutely love this coffee. It gives the taste and aroma of raspberry without being overpowering and without the sugary taste of syrups.  My day is not the same without a cup of this coffee in the morning.  Because this is just a seasonal item, be sure to stock up for those months when it is not readily available.
My dog loves it. It is a great high quality dog food product. It goes a long way. My dog's vet said excellent choice. Highly recommended. My shipment had about a 1 1/2 year freshness date on the bag.

column9: Great to keep in the pantry!
column10: I was very happy to find this product on Amazon. As living in a small Midwest town, I don't have access to a health food grocer like Whole Foods Market unless I drive 1 hour each way. Only mushroom I can buy locally is regular mushroom, but now I can keep this in my pantry for whenever I need to use it in a recipe. I just made a Pasta with one of the packs and that was great! Just enough for 4 people, and the mushrooms are ready to use after soaking them in hot water for 30 minutes. The left over liquid can be used to make a recipe like cream of mushroom soup or something as it has great extract from them. Considering they are organic, price is good for me. I also bought Shiitake and Matsutake too.
you can buy this at Trader Joes for $1.00 a bottle; this joker is asking $2.50 per bottle.

I am not a water drinker at all! I am a bonafide coffee and soda addict. I have never liked the taste, or lack there of, of water.  As a child I did enjoy Naya but that was discontinued.  I have always had for force myself to drink water.  That was until I came across Smart Water!  There is something about the tatse that makes it feel like you are not drinking plain water.  I even use it in my coffee machine and when I make tea.The only down side, is the cost.  But this proves that old saying "You Get What You Pay For" is true and you can usually find it on sale at a grocery store.I personally feel much better drinking more water, and would not have done so without Smart Water.

column9: Smart Water is one of the best-tasting brands out there
column10: Smart Water is my favorite brand of bottled water. I enjoy its taste better compared to other bottled waters. It just taste smoother to me. column9: Protein content too high... gave my dog acute renal failure.  RIP Ollie
column10: About 3 months ago I researched all the different foods and finally decided to purchase EVO because I thought it was what was best for my dog.  He is 3 1/2 and healthy (or at least he WAS until recently).  He has routine physicals including bloodwork for kidney problems so I didn't worry when I read that this food can cause problems with underlying kidney disease.  One day he began having diarrhea and refused to eat... I thought, no big deal dogs get tummy upsets once in awhile, right?  But he didnt get better.  His Belly and hind legs started to swell so much that the skin looked like it would tear...  multiple labs and fecals showed kidney disease of unknown cause.  He has had ultrasounds, multiple blood and urine cultures, a plasma transfusion and is now on multiple medications.  His BUN/CREAT has shot up and he now refuses to eat ANYTHING.  His entire diet consists of water, pills and whatever vitamin paste I can force him to take.  My heart is breaking for him...  I can't do anything and feel helpless.  If it goes on much longer without improving I will face the horrible decision of humane euthanization.  I feel that it was caused 100% from the high protein diet.  We can find NO other cause and he has no underlying kidney disease.  Please choose a different food and save the pain that my dog and I are going through right now.UPDATE>>> Not long after I made this review Ollie lost his battle to acute renal failure at the young age of 3.  No other underlying condition was found and my vet feels that the extremely high protein content in EVO is what shut his kidneys down.  RIP Ollie... :-(

column10: Procter & Gamble - A Probing Look at Corporate EthicsIams and Eukanuba Dog Foods In 1999, P&G purchased the Iams Company, which included the Eukanuba dog food brand, for $2.3 billion.Prior to the buyout, Iams was a respectable family owned and operated dog and cat food company. Iams and, Eukanuba in particular, were a cut above other mass market dog food brands, and were only available through specialty pet stores and veterinary clinics. (Note, one can't compare their original foods with the quality of our present products, as premium all natural dog food, as we know it today, did not exist in the 1990s).Shortly after the acquisition, P&G expanded both Iams and Eukanuba to the mass market, making it widely available in supermarkets and retail stores such as Costco, K-Mart and Walmart, across the globe.Within months of the takeover, it became very apparent that changes had been made to the formulation of the foods. There were numerous accounts of dogs and cats suddenly developing various health issues and dog food allergies -- from diarrhea to intense itching, brittle and poor quality coats, skin rashes, hot spots, and even blown coats.The packaging remained unchanged, and no notification was given to retailers, pet owners or vets. (Note: Pet food companies are not required to list ingredient changes on dog food labels for 6 months -- a legal loophole for P&G).After much publicity and a huge public backlash, P&G admitted to switching ingredients from rice to barley, but denied making any other formula changes. They went as far as adding a PR page to their website in an attempt to dispel what they referred to as "rumors", and insisted they were continuing to use the same quality ingredients as before!In April 2000, P&G implemented another strategy in an attempt to further reassure the public of their "emphatic commitment to maintaining the premium quality of Iams and Eukanuba dog and cat foods" - and that - "any product changes that occured were designed to enhance the product". They convened an independent seven-member panel, known as the Iams Quality Review Board, consisting of veterinarians, breeders, research nutritionists and pet specialty store owners. The members met at the Company's Ohio plant to observe and review the manufacturing process and analyze and compare ingredients lists against product samples obtained over the past twelve months

The manufacturer, Faerie's Finest, has confirmed with me, that there are "TRACE ELEMENTS" in this product that may cause an allergic reaction.  I have been using this product for some time now and really like it and I wanted to make a peanut butter flavored cake for a friend who has allergies to peanuts, so I called the manufacturer as to what the actual ingredients are.  I waited almost 2 weeks for an answer.  I finally had to call them back and had to wait for the owner to reply later in the day.  The person answering the phone read me the ingredients stating there were natural ingredients but this is NOT WHAT THE LABEL STATES. The label says ARTIFICIAL flavors. But she "assured" me it "should be fine"!!  I waited to hear from the owner/manufacturer.  When I got the call back I was informed that the ingredients were naturally derived and contained trace elements that may cause an allergic reaction!  I am SO GLAD I CALLED!  The labeling is not accurate and poses a severe health risk to those with peanut allergies.  The product should be discontinued/recalled until proper labeling can be established.  Otherwise - if you have no allergy to nuts it is a good extract.

I had been so excited to try a very famous brownie from a company in Chelsea Market when we were in NY a couple years ago and was horribly disappointed so I was a bit gun shy to try another media hyped brownie, but curiosity got the better of me.  These are indeed very delicious...moist and full of flavor.  I've only tasted the chocolate chunk, but the box came with caramel pecan and peanut butter as well.  I gave these 5 stars based on the chocolate chunk.  However, since they all have the same chocolate base I expect the other two will be just as yummy.  No disappointment here - - these are terrific!
This is great tea. I am thankful to have found it on-line as our local tea shop source closed after Christmas.

column9: Most Delicious Apple Chips Made by Seneca
column10: 16 dollar for a 12 pack of these chips is a steal =D!!!! These chips are freaking delicious if you want something sweet to snack on.

I absolutely LOVE these apple chips. My order of 12 (2.5 oz bags) came on Wednesday and they were gone by the following Saturday. I actually just placed another order today as well. I can't get enough! I'm not even a big fan of apples but there is just something so delicious about these apple chips. I've tried most of the flavors and the original and cinnamon are the best. I suggest everyone try these, but know you will probably be addicted after the first bag. Yum!

These apple chips have good flavor, they're just a little bit sweet, and they have a bit of a crunch.  That being said, I was a bit turned off by the product quality.  Every bag has had stem and seed fragments, and well, the apple peel is a little overwhelming.  I don't think I'll have a problem using all 12 bags up.  In fact, I have eaten a few bags in one sitting without realizing it (not great since 2.5 servings per bag) but I am not sure this will be a regular item in my pantry.  If you feel like a fried apple makes a better (i.e. healthier) snack than a fried potato, then this product is probably worth trying, but I personally prefer freeze-dried apples to these fried apples.

These are by far the best chips ever. They satisfy a sweet tooth without being overloaded with calories or fat. The hard part is not eating the whole bag at one sitting. I love these as a mid-afternoon  snack and buying them in the 12-pack is so much cheaper. If you like a light cinnamon flavor, these are for you!
I am in love with this product,  tastes great , I take them with me everywhere,  the price was much cheaper than in the stores!
my family loves these apple chips. We always take them camping and any kind of weekend trip. Very tasty treat and does a good job at satisfying the munchies.
This chips weren't as crispy as I'd hoped.  The package and box indicate they are 'crispy', but they seemed a bit stale.
you can get the apple chips any where for like two dollars a bag 64 dollars for 12 thats a little much man I sure love apple chips but it's so not worth it !

These are for people that cannot tolerate sugar. They are not low cal, just slightly lower cal. The regular Coffee Rio Original Coffee Caramels made with sugar average 15 calories per piece or 60 calories per 17.3 grams, which is 4 pieces. The sugar free version averages 12.5 calories per piece or 50 calories per 16.5 grams, which about 4 pieces. Thatt's 20% fewer calories per piece.They are slightly softer as the regular Rios and much less sweet and much less flavorful. In terms of flovaor, there is no comparison -- the regular are rich; the sugarfree are bland, emphasis on the "bla". Eating these is a big sacrifice for 20% fewer calories. If you want to reduce caloric intake, the if you can work up the discipline to skip one piece for every 4 you eat, you total enjoyment might be much greater with the 20% fewer calories.They are made with real coffee and milk and Splenda sweetener, and other things.If you have partial fillings or crowns or braces, etc. you will want to avoid chewing these even though the are sotftler than the sugared version.For more general review on the Rio coffee candy, se my review of Coffee Rio Original Coffee Caramels.

column9: Sugar free and it tastes good
column10: Coffee Rio Sugar Free candyI work the graveyard shift and sometimes I need a some extra caffeine to get me through the night.  Instead of getting a soda, I chew on the sugar free coffee chews.  It give me a little boost but doesn't make me jittery. No strange after taste either.

column9: A home run - even our cats love it
column10: We started buying Beneful tubs about a month or so ago and, as expected, our dogs just love them. The amazing part came when the cats started jumping up on the counter to get a head start on the dogs' food as we'd prepare it. I might add that these are cats so fussy they won't eat half of the varieties Fancy Feast offers. Now we get extra tubs of Beneful so we have enough to supplement the cats' dry food as well as for the dogs.

column9: sUPER FAST SHIPPING AND A REALLY GREAT PRODUCT
column10: OUR DOGS LOVE BENEFUL AND NOW WITH THE PREPARED MEALS WE MIX WITH THE DRY AND BOY DOES IT GO FAST !
These cost half what you're charging in the supermarket. Are you just ripping off people who can't do their own shopping?

column9: WOULD NOT PURCHASE AGAIN HYDROGINATED OILS
column10: THIS IS A DANGEROUS PRODUCT TO PURCHASE IT HAS HYDROGINATED STARCH OR OILS AND IS VERY UNHEALTHY FOR THE BODY TO CONSUME.  IT IS NOT FIT FOR HUMAN CONSUMPTION DUE TO THE HYDROGINATED OILS.  I WOULD NOT PURCHASE THIS AGAIN GOLITELY MUST CHANGE THEIR FORMULA IF CONSUMERS ARE TO PURCHASE THIS PRODUCT.
Good candy for someone with a sweet tooth that has to watch how much sugar he consumes.  My husband loves this product.

i highly recommend this hard  candy-so far i have tried 5 favors and love them all--well worth the price for great taste-i have 4th stage cancer and they suggest to stay away from sugar so about 5 pieces of candy is my treat all through the day-worry free-sugar free

I've developed a love of anything with pumpkin spice in it over the past couple of years, so when I saw this tea I had to try it.  First of all, I'm a fan of Bigelow teas.  They're always full of flavor and the individual foil packages keep the tea fresh for a very long time.  This tea has become one of my favorites.  It has a great pumpkin spice flavor and I found it's the best with a little milk and sugar.  It's good without adding anything, but adding milk and sugar (or whatever sweetener you may use) makes it taste almost like pumpkin pie.Many pumpkin-flavored beverages out there fall flat when it comes to the pumpkin spice flavor, but this tea nailed it.  I'm glad it comes in a pack of 6 boxes because I'm sure it's going to be hard to find once winter is over.

column9: Delicious iced tea, only availble locally in season.
column10: This pumpkin spice tea makes a great pitcher of Iced Tea, with a bit of Truvia or Splenda to sweeten it.  The only down side is I couldn't find it after the fall in my area, but now that I found amazon has it, I've got it on a subscription so I'll be sure to have plenty!Oh, and if you will only use a given flavor occasionally, Bigelow is the way to go, since each Tea Bag is individually foil wrapped to keep it fresh.

I just bought a box of this tea last week to  keep at work and it was gone within 2 days.  It is so delicious and the smell is unbelievable, I had it this morning with almond milk and it was just fantastic.  I have to say Bigelow  makes great  teas, I have been a faithful Bigelow Earl Grey drinker for years.  The individually sealed packs make all the difference.

So here's my OMG Tom and Jerry:  4 cups brewed Bigelow Pumpkin Spice Tea; 1 cup fat free half and half; 3oz. Rum. You'll need to hide this if you want some for yourself. (Tis the season to be a little greedy).
This is my favorite pumpkin tea!  The flavors are perfectly balanced!  Great with a little honey.
I love this one and it really does smell like pumpkin pie.  I love to drink this one from early fall through early spring, it really hits the spot during the cooler weather.
I love this tea. I tried it a couple of years ago, but I  can find it locally only in the fall. I was thrilled when I found it on Amazon's subscribe and save program. Thank you Amazon!

column9: Great stuff, but a bit too much licorice
column10: great product, but the hint of licorice isnt very "traditional" with pumpkin and may turn off a few traditionalists.But I thouroughly enjoyed this tea.

I was a little concerned when I first opened the tea packet, because the aroma reminded me a little of bubble gum.  I was pleasantly surprised to find that the taste is actually pretty well balanced, if not a little sweet.  The cinnamon component is borderline artifical, but I do not consider it off-putting.  I sweetened it with a little maple syrup (100% real syrup, that is), and found it quite drinkable this way.  I'd be intetested to see what it is like with a drop of milk, but it really doesn't need it.

Usually the only outstanding teas are the ones produced in England.  But Bigelow's Pumpkin Spice is the exception---easily the best of the American-made teas---a strong and very pleasant flavor.  I can't understand why it's not sold in more supermarkets, but I'm glad Amazon makes it available.

I love pumpkin and pumpkin spice products, so I was very excited to order this tea when I saw it available on Amazon.  Unfortunately, it has fallen very short of my expectations.  I cannot detect any pumpkin flavor.  It simply tastes like a basic chai.  I don't dislike chai, but that's not what I thought I was buying based on all the glowing reviews here.  I cannot recommend this product.

I won't be finishing this.  I'm not sure if it's the quality of the tea itself or the quality of the spices added to it.  I tried 4 bags and ended up with a lousy cup of tea with a hint of spice and a bad aftertaste every time.  I was expecting pumpkin pie spice.  Maybe cinnamon?  Nutmeg? A little cloves? Ginger?  I, nor any of the people I shared this with detected any of that, one said it tasted like a rotten pumpkin before even seeing the bag or the box, does that count?  I'm no tea snob, this just absolutely didn't do it for any of us, straight or sweetened.  I figured this was a sure bet, and foolishly ordered this 6 pack.  Don't make that mistake, try one box first!

If you need to have the taste of Autumn/Fall in a cup/mug this tea is for you!! I like it plain, just a little milk or with French Vanilla Creamer.  Bigelow Flavored Teas are some of my faves!! Will be ordering the Eggnog'n next!! Thanks Amazon for carrying this brand!!  :)

column9: Not bad, but there is better out there
column10: Bigelow Pumpkin Spice (Autumn tea)Caff-O-Meter: 30-60mg according to boxIngredients- Black Tea, natural pumpkin flavors with other natural flavors (soy lecithin), cinnamon, licorice root, clove, ginger, pumpkin flakes**Very important on the first steep you do not go over 4 minutes, it produces a very bitter cup-Smell:  In packet(2)/ Steeping (2) Has a scent somewhat reminiscent of pumpkin but falls rather  flat something else overwhelms the pumpkin I may be off but I think it's the clove (scent intensifies when over ice)-Taste+Unsweetened : Hot (1)/Cold (2) Flavor of tea is rather bland, I detect very little pumpkin flavor,+Sweetened: Hot(3)/Cold (3)-Flavor and body of tea really improves with the sweetener. Taste is still a little bland, but there is something very slightly bitter to it (perhaps the licorice, I do not like licorice root).*I prefer my teas Iced and  1 cup to .5 packet of sweetener. So unless it wows me, without sweetener will always be lower in points so to compensate I add .5 points to the unsweetened taste average.-2nd steep (3.5) - On the second steep the flavors and scents finally come through and produce a more respectable cup however still on the weaker side for me.  It should be noted the 2nd steep will stand up to a longer steeping time. Tried a 3rd steep and it was too weak.Summary- I paid more for this than on Amazon by ordering a holiday tea collection direct from Bigelow (the single box on here was to much and I wanted variety. I love Halloween and as such pumpkin things tend to suck me in, for the price it is on here I would not discourage purchase however just know there is better out there. If you are looking for something to get you in the mood for fall, this will do. I will happily finish the box, but unless it is clearance at a store I do not plan to purchase more.If you must have some pumpkin tea now, here is a decent method to get you by (don't expect a miracle of flavor). Pumpkin pie spice (I prefer 1 tsp) "steep" it for 5 minutes hot water then add your preferred tea for a normal steep time. Strain/Sweeten to preference.  I use plain lipton loose leaf for now but I can't wait to try this with plain rooibos when I get it.Feel free to check out my other tea reviews this is only my 2nd so far.

column9: A pleasant licorice-based tea, not only for fall
column10: This tea is excellent for licorice tea lovers, since that is its base.  The licorice gives a natural bit of sweetness without any sugar, and is delightful.  Cardiac patients or those with high blood pressure, be warned that this tea might raise BP and is possibly not for you.  Ask your physician before drinking this, OK?Anyway, the pumpkin flavor is noticeable and the spices complement it well.  Some others have compared this tea to chai tea (more accurately called "masala chai") but this doesn't taste enough like chai to make such a comparison, for me.Licorice fans, pumpkin fans, spice tea fans - go for it.  You probably won't be disappointed.

column9: One of my favorite teas of all time
column10: In the last few years I've developed a love for pumpkin.  This tea is absolutely delicious.  Not bitter like some teas but full of flavor.  My favorite is to make my own rendition of a pumpkin tea latte.  Heat the tea and water in the microwave and let the tea steep for several minutes for full flavor.  It's optional, but when I brew, I like to add just a touch of chai tea flavoring (I use the Torani syrup).  Once ready, I add a sweetener packet and top it off with a little milk.  It's a skinny version of what would be an expensive and fattening tea latte from a coffee shop.  A morning treat.  I offered my sister some of my pumpkin tea, and now she drinks it every morning, too.

I don't drink caffine, and I don't generally favor Bigalow. I was introduced to this tea at a Christmas Tree Stand. It is my alltime favorite tea. Something about the smokey background flavor. Not too spicy or strong ( I like strong, but not too strong). Just really good! It is now usually my first cup in the morning. I can't find it anywhere but Amazon.

I LOVE this tea.  I actually drink it without sugar!  It is not super sweet, but the flavor is such that if you want to be healthier, or don't need the added calories, that it is great without anything added!!  A great contemplative tea and winter companion that you don't want to be without!! :)  PS I did a taste test with all of the other pumpkin teas on the market as a comparison and REALLY did not care for them. I ended up throwing them out because I could not bring myself to drink them! :p
Bought two cases and already went through one of them. It also appears cheaper hear than on the company website.
I have tried other spiced teas buy I keep going back to this one. The spices are wonderful, they are strong but don't leave an aftertaste in your mouth. I enjoy it both hot and as an ice tea.

I'm enjoying this Autumn Spice tea blend--it's different, has a wonderful aroma, and a great flavor to sip on a chilly day or night. It was a better price (for multiple boxes) on Amazon, than it was from Bigelow. Not available in any stores around me, for some reason. I do wish they had a decaffeinated version, though.
This tea is great warm with a little bit of whipped cream on top, taste like pumkin pie in a cup. Made it for my parents when they visited and they loved it as well.
This tea has the real flavor of pumpkin.  It is nicely spiced and perfect for an autumn afternoon.  It is quite highly caffeinated so I do not drink it late at night.  But overall, a lovely tea.

This is a great drink for these cold fall months. It doesn't have as much of a pumpkin taste as I would like. It is more just a spicey flavor. If you want a really big pumpkin burst, this is not what you are looking for.
A friend shared some of this tea with me in the Fall but after Christmas couldn't find it in stores anymore. Great to find it here! Love the taste of it.

Bigelow is know for their quality teas.  this one is no exception.spicy, festive and holiday-evoking in both taste and aroma.  it is also a gluten free product for those of use who are celiac.  well done!
This is probably one of my favorite teas.  It has a subtle flavor that is neither sweet nor bitter.

I had this tea on a trip I took, and HAD to find it. Surprisingly, no stores in my area carried it, but of course, Amazon had it!! Tastes delicious, doesn't even need sugar. Great product - it's the only tea I drink now!

I've been drinking this tea, seasonally, for awhile now and it is my absolute favorite, either sweetened or non-sweetened, with milk or without. What makes this tea stand out from others is that it is actually pumpkin flavored. I tried the Stash Pumpkin Spice tea when my local store ran out of the Bigelow and it was basically cinnamon tea, not at all what I was looking for. If you want cinnamon tea there are lots of teas out there that will give you that flavor. For those like me, whodetest cinnamon, this one is perfect. Delicious!
Was at a restaurant in Wisconsin and they served this tea.  I was certain I could find it in the store when I got home.  No such luck.  Then I searched Amazon and there it was!  Love this tea!

This is a great tea for when there's a chill in the air.  The best of the pumpkin spice teas... I've tried them all.  I was so excited to find this on Amazon as it is somewhat of a treasure hunt looking for it in stores.  Not readily available in our area.  You won't be disappointed with this tea!

column9: Pleasantly surprised by a unique tea!
column10: I bought this tea (as well as the apple cider variety) as favor gifts for an autumn tea party bridal shower. I wasn't sure if I would like it myself as I can never seem to get home brewed chai tea to taste like coffee/tea house chai. I was pleasantly surprised to find that this tea can stand alone without the milk, and although it is similar to chai, it has it's own unique flavor. I have tried it both with and without milk and enjoyed it thoroughly each time. Although this won't replace my favorite black teas, I found it a very welcome addition to my cabinet as a flavorful treat.

I was hoping this would have a smell/flavor with a hint of the spices used in pumpkin pie. Unfortunately the flavor and smell is nothing like that. It was worth a try but 120 packets of this will last me forever. I much prefer the vanilla chai and cinnimon flavors by Bigalow.

My girlfriend loves this tea and it's hard to find in the stores, especially when it's not the Thanksgiving/Christmas season, so I was thrilled that Amazon had it.  The girlfriend loves it and was very happy to have six boxes.  If you're worried about the over quantity, it lasts for a year and a half, so you're good to go.
I just love the Pumpkin spice tea! I hope that you keep making them for the holiday season! They are a nice winter drink.
I love this tea! It is so good and even better paired with pumpkin creamer!

This tea has a nice mellow taste.  I like it sweet with cream and boy is it good on a cold Winter or Fall day.  You can only buy it where I live in the Fall or Winter so I was happy to find it here at Amazon, so I can drink it all year long.  When brewing it makes the whole room smell nice.  I drink it at school and my Kindergarteners love the smell and try to talk me into giving them sips, but of course I don't (and I do keep it safely out of their reach).

I can only find this flavor of tea in specialty stores from October through March, and only when they have it in stock.  I think other people like the flavor too.  When I found out that Amazon carried Pumpkin Spice tea, I ordered all six boxes.  When I am on my last box, I will reorder.  Thank you Amazon for carrying my favorite tea.
I was a little disappointed with the tea.  The taste of the pumpkin spice that I enjoy so much in Starbucks Pumpkin Spice lattes was sadly not the same.

Usually, this tea is only available in stores during October and November. But I like it all year long. It's got a rich, spicy taste and tastes like pumpkin pie when you add a milk product and a sweetener.I'm also glad that the order is for six boxes, so I don't have to ration myself.

I bought a box of this at the grocery store a few weeks ago and was very pleased with the flavors.  There are pumpkin flakes as well as cinnamon, clove, and ginger, so you really get a pumpkin pie flavor with it.  Add a little cream, and it's even more like pumpkin pie.  I liked it so much, I bought a case of 6 from Amazon so when the stores stop selling their holiday tea flavors, I'll still have some.

Bigelow is apparently in the scented water business. And people who can't tell the difference between an aroma and a flavor are giving this high marks.It has a nice scent.It has no flavor whatsover.Be warned... after you buy a huge box of this A mazon won't take it back.

I ordered a single box of this tea and received it today.  The aroma of the tea is fantastic.  It is very similar to pumpkin pie which reminds me of Thanksgiving and Autumn in general.  However the flavor of the tea is too weak.  I can barely taste the spices or any pumpkin flavoring.  Note:  I drink all my tea without cream, milk or sweetners.I will finish the box I ordered, but I doubt I will order any more.

This tea reminds me more of gingerbread than pumpkin pie -- as others have noted, this is pretty much just a chai variant with the spices you'd put in in pumpkin pie.  Nonetheless, it's quite tasty and I'll buy it again.  I've also tried the Stash pumpkin flavor, which is quite similar to this.  However, I think the Bigelow wins -- the Stash always seems a bit weak to me no matter how long I brew it, perhaps because it's a decaf.

Background - I typically drink Celestial Seasonings tea.  My absolute favorite is the blend "Nutcracker Sweet" which is a black tea, but usually drink some variety of their green or white tea.  I love pumkin pie and was very excited when I saw this blend!  Bought two boxes of this tea and have tried it both hot and over ice... I think the flavors and smell are too overwhelmingly strong.  Perhaps sugar and/or milk would make it more pleasing to your palette, but I just plan to offload the rest my boxes!

column9: Delicious but not what I expected
column10: This is really delicious, and I suspect it would be great in baking. I am giving it 3 stars only because the description made it sound like it would be more like traditional hot chocolate. Well, it's more like your traditional cocoa powder.
Most delicious cookie to have with tea EVER. And their light making it less guilty to snack.I had these when I was in London, just glad their is a place a can get them in the states!

This is the best airbrush shimmer I've ever used.  It's a very nice, subtle shimmer that you can build on depending on how shiney you want it.  It's very smooth, and has never clogged my airbrush like AmeriMist does.  Adds an absolutely georgeous sheen, and works equally well on fondant and buttercream.

I love these little mints made in France.  They have a core anis seed with a hard candy covering.  I like all the flavors - violet, orange, lemon, mint, rose and blackcurrant. They are hard to find and I am grateful to be able to find them on Amazon.

column9: Best Tea on Earth (No, I don't own company stock!)
column10: Everyone in my house is addicted to this tea. We drink it iced. Make one or two pitchers of it a day. It's not sweetened, but has a subtle, natural sweetness to it. Feels refreshing and clean. It was also one of the few things I tolerated well when I was pregnant and routinely nauseated. I've heard this from other mothers too. Love it.

I was introduced to this tea at a local restaurant and went absolutely crazy about it. Its unique flavor and healthifying blend of green and black teas and yerba mate, along with a light touch of ginger, is a wonderful thirst quencher.  As a tonic for health and energy, I now find myself drinking it daily instead of my usual afternoon coffee. It perks up the body and brain without the jittery effects of caffeine. I find I get a delightful pick-me-up later in the day--when I need it--without the negative affects of keeping me up at night.  While a tad expensive, I will continue to buy SPORtea and enjoy its delicious brew.  It is now a part of my every day routine.

This is a great vegetable stock. Sometimes I enjoy a spoonful right out of the tub!  It has a rich yet balanced flavor without the artificial sweetness found in may canned and boxed stocks.  It is a 20 times reduction of a classic vegetable stock made from carrot, onion and celery stocks, wine, tomato paste, lemon juice, garlic and onion powders and seasonings.Although I am a devout carnivore I have often cooked for vegetarians.  In doing so I have found that this stock reduction will replace a meat based glace or demi-glace in a sauce, (however, they also make a Roasted Vegetable demi-glace which contains a food starch which will thicken a sauce better than this one and has a stronger flavor) and it can be used as a base for soups and stews.  I often add a little of More Than Gourmet's Mushroom Stock for a more complex taste.  I use this so often that I buy it in the 16 oz. tubs.  They keep well in the fridge once opened.  A great product to have on hand.More Than Gourmet Veggie-glace Gold® Roasted Vegetable Demi-glace, 16-Ounce Units (Pack of 2)More Than Gourmet Essence De Champignon Gold® Mushroom Essence, 1.5-Ounce Units (Pack of 6)

DO NOT WASTE YOUR MONEY!  There are no seals around or under the lids.  The lids on both paprikas and on fennel (also this brand) came loose during shipment spilling the contents.  I do not feel safe using these products but they cannot be returned.  I'm waiting to hear from Amazon on whether or not I can at least get a refund.

This a quality product. No fillers or weird ingredients, which is really important to me since I have a lot of food allergies. I keep a pack in my handbag for when ever I'm out and about and need a snack. I Will definitely order these again, my whole family loves them.
These do have dairy, but are some of the best GF chips I have ever had.  A bit on the pricey side, but for a flavored chip really good!  Highly suggest you get a bag or a dozen!

column9: Better than any chips I've ever tasted!
column10: Wow, I was hungry and grabbed these on the run. Just had to ask my hubby to confiscate them before I chewed down the who bag. The CEO and company motto made me like them even more! I'm never eating Doritos again! Can't wait to try other late July products!!

These are probably the best chips I have ever had! They are multigrain, organic, gluten free, and with a lot of flavor. Only 5 grams of fat per serving. The seasonings don't over power the grains, it's a good balance of both. I got these at Whole Foods on sale. I am going back for more! When not on sale, they cost the same as the ones from this seller. I have IBS and they don't upset my tummy at all.

column9: Lots of flavor and a seemingly innocent ingredient list.
column10: These chips pack a lot of flavor. It's just not a flavor I'm entirely crazy about. They have a bit of a sour taste for me--not rancid sour, more like sour creamish. I like sour cream but this is a little more concentrated than that. I have to say though they definetly satisfied a craving. I feel better about eating these than Doritos which I stopped eating years ago and dearly miss. The bag is pretty small though. It's like two man servings or like 5 girly servings (if you actually restrain yourself to the serving size).I also tried the Green Chile kind and liked those better. Those were almost a little addicting. I didn't notice anything harmful in the ingredient list (such as MSG) but if you do please let me know.

Far better than the aggressively mundane flavor of the Peanut Butter and Banana `monkey bar', these Strawberry Vanilla bars at least have a pleasant and refreshing flavor.  The lightness of the flavor is delicate but I will admit that it isn't anything special.  I am still left a little iffy on these bars.  The frosted coating on the underbelly is nice and sweet, and the nuttiness of the bar itself has more depth than a standard health bar, that can come off tasting like cardboard, but I still want something more.  I don't know, maybe my expectations are unrealistically high, but when you call yourself a Monkey Bar and have that playful critter on the cover of your box you'd think that maybe you could have a little bit more fun with your flavors.

column9: You have to try this tea!
column10: The best experience for this tea is at the actual Pike Place Market where they brew it so you can sample it in their charming little store past the flying fish and florist.  It is also really great to have any other time in your life and to share with everyone you meet.  Since every grocery store doesn't stock this wonderful tea you will have to order it and stock your kitchen/office/cabin/whatever with it and enjoy.

This tea has the most fragrant, soothing flavor...when it is fresh.  But BEWARE, as the label warns, it has a short shelf life and must be stored in a glass jar in the freezer or refrigerator.Make the mistake of not heeding this warning and your tea will spoil very quickly.

My husband and I were vacationing in Alaska, and on one of our tours, our tour guide took us to a nursery where different types of Alaskan plants and flowers were growing.  The couple who owned the nursery had snacks and hot tea for all of us.  We tried the hot tea (MarketSpice Tea), and it was absolutely wonderful!  This tea is from Seattle, Washington, and is very popular there.  We are from Syracuse, NY, and have not found any tea like this here. This tea doesn't have any preservatives, and has an absolutely amazing cinnamon flavor!  You can get this tea either regular or decaf.  We are hooked!  We are so happy that we can get it through Amazon.com.
We use to live in Washington State and my daughter loves this tea.  We have lived several places because of my husband being in the military and we have not found anything that tastes as good.

We had this tea while on vacation in Seattle and were instantly hooked!  It is our family's favorite iced tea and numerous friends have since asked me for ordering info to purchase it too.We have ordered both loose and teabags (also in decaf) ---it is all excellent.  So thankful we can order off Amazon!

The tea is excellent.  The flavor is strong unlike some decaf products that seem weak and lack almost any flavor. Was happy to find it here last time I searched and searched before I had a friend pick it up in Seattle for me.

column9: Yummy tea, some bags more potent than others
column10: I love this tea.  Its flavor is usually super potent (cinnamon and orange), although some of the 50 tea bags (which I store in a glass jar in my freezer) are more potent than others.  I'll be buying more fairly soon.  Yum.  I wish it qualified for Free super saver shipping, though!

I'd had Market Spice Tea at a friends home and when I found I could obtain it  in the DeCaf  I was sold for sure!  I love having a cup in the evening, watching TV before bed time!It is delicious!  You have to love oranges and spices and I store mine in glass jars that seal  (they must be GLASS) in my freezer taking one out at a time.  I can not tell any difference  in taste between the regular and the DeCaf!
This tea I originally found at my hair dressers! I had to have it, Amazon had it, quick shipped, and I enjoy it every day!

column9: Yes it does have an odor that some will find disagreeable, but it works for me and I will continue to purchase it
column10: I read some of the reviews on here and I almost didn't purchase. So I bit the bullet and purchased this at a local B&M store.  When I got home after work, I boiled some water and opened the package. It doesn't smell as bad as some of the other reviewers made it out to me but then again my nose has been wonky for some time so it could be me.  Yes I will admit that it does has a funky odor but it is not that strong to me.  To me, smells like this health food store I used to frequent in the Hyde Park neighborhood.  Very musky but weirdly comforting.  I have tried it with peppermint, turmeric (for a different affliction) and I have tried it plain with stevia and it taste okay to me.  I wouldn't say I have an iron stomach because I can easily get sick if food is left out in the open not at the proper temperature.  For me, this product took about two days for it to kick in and I am now able to sleep for a full eight hours straight instead of sleeping in fits of four hours here, wake up for about two hours, sleep for three, wake up for a hour and sleep for another four hours.  For those with sensitive noses and sense of taste, you have been amply warned by other reviewers.  For others, I say give it a shot or at least pair it with some other teas to dilute the taste a bit.  For example, mints like peppermint or spearmint will help.  Some folks will use lavender to mask the smell.

column9: White chocolate with crunchy chocolate cookie... yum!

column9: Great Food for a Healthy Diet and a Happy Dog
column10: We did a lot of research before switching to Blue Buffalo and found both the fans and the critics of the product. column9: Much lighter cereal than the Crunch flavor.
column10: #1 thing to mention is Flavor vs Fiber in these breakfast cereals. In shopping around I have looked for different breakfast cereals I always search for one that is high in fiber without sacrificing loads of flavor. Please note that most of my purchases are for office employee use, since I work roaming construction there are jobs where breakfast options are very limited and products like these come in handy.  In comparison with Special K, Frosted Mini-wheat's, All-Bran, Raisin Bran Crunch, Fiber One, and Grape nuts we have come up with the brands that match our needs. The need is simple, a balance between flavor and fiber. The usual picks that come out on top are Raisin Bran Crunch, Frosted Mini-Wheat's and Kashi Go Lean Crunch. But for as much Fiber (10g) and flavor as Kashi Go Lean crunch had, the 240 Cal/ 3.5g of fat factor was keeping it on edge to being dropped. Thankfully this lighter version made a good impression with only 130 Cal and only 1g of fat but still has 9g of Fiber! Although I will admit I like the flavor of the Crunch more, I have to balance my purchases to a 2 to 1 ratio in favor of the regular Go Lean vs the Go Lean Crunch. Construction workers are getting more health conscious and do look out for things like nutrition facts in cereal now a days.
While the taste and portion are great, I'm really disappointed by the multiple reports that this cereal contains a high % of GMOs.  Why pay more for natural when it's anything but?!

This is a wonderful product. I enjoy having the convenience of an easy breakfast a couple of times a week. The cereal is tasty and remains crunchy. It is a great way to get a reasonable amount of fiber. Thank you!

I was really excited to find this product but was disappointed in the results.  I used it to sweeten some carbonated soda and the first sip was great.  Every sip after that had less and less root beer flavor and more and more of the artificial sweetener/alcohol taste.  So now I'm looking for another root beer extract to try!
