column9: Ajvar is one special and very tasting spread
column10: This Home made Ajvar food is good quality and delicious. There are no junk stuff, chemicals, fillers and other harmful elements. I tried it and did not regret it at all. It is superior to many-garbage-food spreads sold in the regular food stores. It has mostly roasted papers and eggplant;

I just tried this spread this week and it is authentic.  I haven't had ajvar this good since I visited Yugoslavia as a young girl. This is a different recipe from other vegetable spreads; this product is made in Macedonia.

This really is a DELICIOUS product and if you like peppers especially roasted peppers you will not regret trying it.  However, it is overpriced even without considering the shipping charges.  I'm taking one star off because I have been buying the same item at a local market for much less.

This is a good product, don't get me wrong.  I spread it on three-grain bread for a really nutritious snack.  But of the three jars I ordered, one arrived totally broken with the product a mess in broken glass in the package.  In my opinion, it was poorly packaged, just thrown in a USPS Priority Mail box too small for three jars with only minimal protection.  No bubble wrap.  Nada.  To their credit, I complained and was given a 1/3 refund right away.
This is a wonderful ice cream topping, my family goes through it like crazy so I was very pleased to see it available here, at a great price.
I loved this as a kid, and I have now rediscovered it.  Tastes great and turns my ice cream into a nostalgic treat!

When the grocery stores in my area were having trouble keeping it in stock, or simply did not carry it, I turned to amazon.com.The subscribe and save feature allows me to purchase it at HALF the going store price. I Love Amazon.com!

My mother is a huge believer in home remedies, in herbs and plants to help soothe away your aches and pains. Burn your hand? Break off a bit of the aloe plant. Stomach ache? A soothing tea made of sarsaparilla root (which is apparently kinda dangerous...oops). My minor in college was Folklore, and I love this kind of stuff, different plants that supposedly help with different aches...I've seen it firsthand in my wife. She gets crazy bad migraines, and a good cup of mint tea can help her keep things under control. But I love the Red Leaf Teas website, especially their matchas, that list everything the plant involved in the flavoring can do. Take this tea for instance:Did you know that studies showed that pomegranate juice destroys breast cancer cells while leaving healthy cells alone? It may also prevent breast cancer cells from forming.Pomegranates also offer the following benefits to list a few :Lung Cancer PreventionSlows Prostate CancerKeeps PSA Levels StableProtects the Neonatal BrainPrevention of OsteoarthritisProtects the ArteriesAlzheimer's Disease PreventionLowers CholesterolLowers Blood PressureDental Protectiontaken from the Red Leaf Teas website.Now, part of me just brushes most of that off, but the part of me that is my mother's hippie daughter drinks this matcha just in case. My aunt recently started chemo to deal with her breast cancer, and one of the things that helped speed up the end of my grandmother's life was breast cancer, so I don't mess around with it. If there's even a slight possibility something might help prevent breast cancer in my body, I'm there. I've already had that scare once, so it's not something I take lightly. And pomegranates are just a good idea all around. If I can get that great, juicy pomegranate flavor without having to deal with the hassle of getting in to an actual pomegranate, even better.The smell is wonderful. Nice and strong and juicy, I can already taste the delicious smoothies that will come from this. But I'm moving away from the smoothies more and more, as I used to think the only way I would enjoy matcha would be in a smoothie and I have since learned that that is decidedly not true. I'm on my third cup today!I don't know how to describe the taste other than juicy, which I feel like I've been using too much lately. But it's true! All of the fruit blends I've had from Red Leaf Tea have been juicy! This one especially...and I can just see a Matcha Pomtini in my future. Or mix this with a little orange juice? Yum. This tea is definitely one I want to spend a bit of quality time with.

I ordered this cake to deliver for my daughter's birthday who lives in another city. I was concerned about on-time delivery because it was Tuesday and her birthday was on Thursday. The cake was actually delivered on Wednesday! It was extremely tasty and very fresh. I am very happy I ordered from this company.
Definitely one of the best. I was a little scared alot of people say they are the best but this was really good!

column9: S & W Carrots ordered from Amazon
column10: The carrots came with no dented cans.  Everything was usable.  This product is so good and is almost impossible to find locally.  I didn't like carrots until I tried this brand and also the Julianne variety.  They're both good-tasting and now I can get better nutrition by using carrots in my diet.  I am an invalid and was so happy not to have to ask anyone to again go out looking for these carrots.

column9: Different flavor, not sure if want to acquire it or not
column10: Different flavor - not sure if want to acquire a taste for this, and would have to work at it.

This rice was great! We cooked it plain and added some olive oil, delicious.  My wife also cooked it using her traditional Puerto Rican recipe with "sofrito" and included olives and red pimentos. It was smashing!  As we say in Spanish, "buen provecho"!Vialone Nano Rice by Gazzani
This is bar FAR the best Crystal Light I have EVER had!!! I'm going to try it with vodka next - lol!!!!

This will double as an indelible dye (DO NOT spill it on anything you want to wear in company), but I am crazy over it.  Of course, after I mix up a batch, I add at least an ounce each of lemon juice & lime juice.  It takes that to bring out the most refreshing quality & counteract the sickening sweetness that most Americans other than me apparently crave.  I keep a jug of it in the refrigerator at all times, & it's rare a day will pass that I don't have a glass or 2 (or 3).  Stores around here stopped carrying it, as they do with anything that I really like (except for Safeway, which hit me up for $5.30 a cannister for it).  I was delighted to find it here, & I signed on for auto-delivery, because the price is so reasonable & I just GOTTA have it!
Nice flavor and the antioxidants are a bonus, but each canister only contains 5 tubs (~10 quarts)
This is my favorite of the Crystal Light drinks.  I add a little fruit (oranges, lemons, limes) and it is yummy!
I had to start drinking water or I could use a sugar free drink.  This flavor is awesome!  We were having trouble finding it where I live, this was a good buy!
This is my favorite crystal light flavor - it is so refreshing and yummy tasting.  I have this almost daily at work!!!

Of all the flavors of Crystal Light I've tried, this one is my all-time favorite so far.  It's not overly sweet like a fruit punch flavor, and the blend of cherry and pomegranate go perfectly together.

I have no idea why I like this drink so much. I usually stay away from espartame, but I make an exception for this one Crystal Light drink. Cherry Pomegranate... need I say more? It's low in calories and carbs and has the immunity on the go thing going for it with antioxidents. I liked the little tubs better, but these work fine. I make a big pitcher of it in the summer and we drink it daily. Regardless of whether we are getting antioxidized or not, we found a drink that we like.

Great product but for some reason this flavor is more expensive than the others. I wont get it again just because of the price. Also I tried to order more than one to save on the shipping and they said 1 was the max you could order at a time.
My favorite of the Crystal Light mixes.  Cannot (despite asking) get in Kroger (at least the one I use) so have to order from Amazon.

I love this stuff.  Everyone who has a glass of it at my house loves this stuff.  Invariable they'll say "What is this?  It's delicious!"  I am hooked completely.  I've been drinking it now for about six months and I haven't had a cold in that time... hmmm coincidence?  I don't know.  But it sure helps keep down my craving for fattening sweets.

I've always liked the Raspberry Tea, and the Pink Lemonade is good, but the Cherry Pomegranate is beyond delicious. It's so full bodied and flavorful that it's hard to believe it's sugar-free. Unfortunately I can no longer find this flavor in a canister at the grocery stores, except for the small boxes of little packets. Glad to find the canister on Amazon, though. I've been craving an ice cold pitcher of it!

I really like the flavor and the vitamins are a great plus.  But, the red food coloring they put in can badly stain things when the kids spill their drink.  I'd give it 5 stars if it had no food coloring.
The Cherry Crystal Light is a bit strong but makes the regular lemonade so much better.  So do 1/2 lemonade and 1/2 cherry and you have a great low calorie drink.
Love the flavor, don't like the way it stains my counters if it spills, or my teeth if I drink too much!
Of all the crystal light flavors I have tried (and I might just about have tried them all) this one is the best! My kids love it too!

Great flavor! Delicious. This is excellent with a good vanilla ice cream. Very good crunchiness (from the toffee bits) and great chocolate flavor.Be sure to shake well before using. Don't store in the fridge.Also, NO TRANS FATS.
The price per oz.in the ad is $.35.>---->12 jars X 8 oz.(per jar) = 96 oz. @ $.35 (per oz.)=(ONLY)$33.60 not $93.89!

I think poppadums are the best part of any Indian meal.  While Amazon sells papad by Lijjat for a very reasonable price, that product, like most papad, needs to be fried or toasted.  This product allows for quick, immediate consumption with your favorite chutney (I really like Swad's chutney, particularly the mint).  The poppadums in the container are quite small -- about the size of a half dollar coin.  While small, each has a nice satisfying crunch.  Truly Indian makes several different poppadum flavors but the Lentil with Cumin is my favorite.As a product of India, you can expect to pay a premium.  I first bought a containers of these from my local Meijer and they were around 5 dollars.  So, with Amazon's subscribe and save, you are getting a fairly good deal.  I think fresh papad is always the best but if I want a fast snack that tastes great, I reach for these.
I highly recommend this great product.  Authentic.  I love these with Trader Joe's chutney.  Great with an Indian dinner or just as a snack. Enjoy!

If you enjoy the mustard typically found in 'vats' :-) at Chinese restaurant buffets, this is for you. It is killer good and wicked hot. I mix one heaping teaspoon of the mustard powder, around 2 teaspoons of water, and 1 teaspoon of Kikkoman soy sauce in a small bowl. Mix together with spoon for a couple of minutes (may need to add additinal water/soy sauce to get desired consistency) until mustard is completely smooth (no lumps). Finally & very importantly, let it set up for 5-7 minutes. Then get ready for awesome mustard. Be careful though, it's way HOT in a horseradish kind of way. Enjoy.

This is close third to PF Changs Mustard.  Colemans being a close second.  Follow the directions on the can, This is a dry mustard powder that needs to be mixed with a liquid. In a separate bowl I add water to the dry powder to bring it together.  Some people use red or rice vinegar in combination to water to cut the heat, or even soy sauce. Please note* a little goes a long way as this is Hot mustard. The heat is not like a chili pepper at all. It is reminiscent to a horseradish heat that comes on strong and instant, but also dissipates just as fast.  This does have a slight bitter after-taste when the heat dissapates. I have found mixing in a small amount of prepared Dijon makes this a smoother product, and less acrid.  It also is a bit grainy straight out of the can mixed/prepared. I only use one Tablespoon of dry mustard at a time with 1 Tablespoon of prepared.  I prefer buying COLEMANS Dry mustard, because it is not as acrid, has a better heat to it and is not as grainy.

Hey - real quick...I have been looking for the hot mustard that I could only seem to find at restaurants.  Where the heck were they getting this stuff????  Well - here it is in all its "burn your sinuses and water your eyes" glory.  Just follow the instructions and sit back & enjoy the pain!FYI - I add a pinch of salt, but that's just me.

This is the best mustard for dipping egg rolls. I've tried numerous other mustard looking for that kick. This one definitely has it. I use a little soy sauce and rice wine vinegar with a little water to make my dipping sauce. Tastes just like the hot mustard in authentic Chinese restaurants. I highly recommend this product A++.

When we switched from dairy to soy milk, we tried the many choices available in our area and selected Better Than Milk, Soy, Original as our favorite. It didn't take long to find the convenience of the 25 pound box. We go through several boxes a year. It is easy to mix up, tastes great, and I never have to get milk on the way home to feed the family supper! Perfect for backpacking and canoe camping too - sprinkle on your bowl of granola, pour on filtered water and stir.

column9: Am I the only one seeing this price???? [revised]
column10: $30 is an outrageous price to expect for only seven squeeze packs. I know the food is organic, but give me a break! I could make the same food myself for a tenth of that! Don't let Ella's get away with this rip off. No matter how good the product may be, I refuse to support this company until their prices become A LOT more reasonable.^^ This was my review BEFORE the seller reduced the price. I've adjusted my rating accordingly, and I'm glad they took my and other negative reviews into consideration.

column9: "The crazy kid eats the stuff..." and Mom is happy.
column10: My older kids won't eat it if we paid them and it tastes kinda borderline to me.  But my 15 month old (who is picky) loves it.  I try to feed my kids food I prepare from my own kitchen, but this little guy wasn't getting enough iron.  The doc has put him on a high iron diet.  He always analyzes his food visually and won't let us pry open his mouth if it doesn't pass inspection.  But he willingly tasted this before he saw the green puree and was instantly sold!  I suspect he likes the cool delivery system. I'm checking with the manufacturer to see if it really is 120% DV for iron, or if it's a misprint.*** Update!  Yes, Ella's reports that it was a misprint and the company is working hard to fix the problem.  4% is the actual number.  That fits more with spinach's DV's.  Only way to get that high is to add iron supplements!  Glad I checked.  Got a quick and honest answer from them.  Hope they are able to fix labeling issues soon. It's still on our list of foods to boost iron levels.***I found some on sale in a local grocery store.  Amazon's price came pretty close, and is still cheaper than other online places I've found.  Including the manufacturer's website.Each kid has their own tastes, so don't write it off because it looks or tastes nasty to others.  Worth a try at least once (it might help to not look disgusted when you give it to your kids).  Seems to be a good product.  Now the frugal mom in me is trying to figure out if I can trick him by making my own puree and using a syringe to re-fill the bag so he'll eat!

I make all my daughters food and thankfully she prefers what I make over jar food.  I do have those times when I need something quick to grab on the go.  Ella's Organics is a great go to. Paying this much for one pouch is a huge huge rip off.  Usually Babies R Us has them for $1 - $1.40 most likely on sale for a dollar though.  I am really happy with the Happy Baby brand too ... also almost $2 a pouch but usually on sale. Just last night my local grocery store had a 10/$10 sale on this brand.Seek out this product just never for this price!! Yikes.

This babyfood pretty much tastes like applesauce.  I am so tired of things being labeled as something else being mostly applesauce!  It's good for on the go, but if you're not careful, it will make a mess.  Don't accidentally hit it or let baby squeeze it too hard!

I use these for on-the-go snacks for my preschooler every day (yes, it's an expensive habit).  I can't get my 6 year old to eat them anymore, but please don't stop using these when you baby starts on solids!  If s/he will eat applesauce, there's no reason not to throw some veggies in with the applesauce pack!

I can hardly contain my excitement so I had to post a review. My baby is almost 17 months old. When she first started solids at around 6 months, she was adventurous and tried and ate everything, including a great amount of veggies. When she turned a year old, she got really fussy and turned her little nose up at every single veggie we tried to give her. She would only eat fruit and yogurt with her cereal in the morning and for the rest of the day she would only accept meat. This has been going on for so long now that I began to get really really worried that she wasn't getting enough good nutrition. I had seen Ella's pouches, but hadn't tried them. A friend highly recommended them to us this weekend so I figured we should try it. I decided to go full on veggie and try this flavor (spinach, apple, rutabaga), and just give them away if she really hated it.Ok, so I'm only giving it 4 stars just in case things change, BUT i tasted one just now and thought, yuck, ok, this is REALLY strongly spinach flavored, she is NOT going to eat this, but I gave her the pouch and she gobbled it DOWN! She was still trying to get some out of the empty pouch! I can't believe it. I'm a very pleased mama. My fussy baby ate spinach, woohoo! :)I'll see how things go over the next few pouches, but so far I recommend them for fussy eaters. If she continues to like this one, I will try a few more. Thanks Ella's kitchen!

The product is great.  I have purchased it in retail specialty stores for $1+ per pouch, and my daughter LOVES them!However, when I purchased it here I assumed it would be less expensive and maybe I was getting 4 or 6 pouches for $4.  Not so much.  $4 per pouch is RIDICULOUS!

My daughter LOVES Ella's Kitchen.  The food isn't watered down like a lot of baby food out there.  However, Babies R Us (which is slightly more expensive than other retailers) sells these for a dollar and change.  $4.00+ per pouch is a total rip off!

I too, thought I was getting 4 pouches, and because they are so easy and nutritious I ordered 5 different pouch recipes. Boy was that a rough day. I usually so look forward to getting my amazon packages. This was a let down, a major let down. Way overpriced, and confusing to order. DO NOT order these, unless you are prepared to pay that for 1 pouch.

column9: Warning about Ella's organic baby food !!! Read all please!!!
column10: As simple as that: nutritional information is NOT accurate !!!Iron content is only 2%, NOT 45% as stated on the pouch itself !!!!!!!!!!!Actualy, green pouch "Rutabagas" contains Iron: 4%, NOT 120% stated on the package itself !!!!!!!We have fed 2 packs daily: 1 light green "rutabagas" and 1 purple one - "pumpkins" to our girl since she was 3.5 month old.What a disappointment !!! This company should be held accountable for causing anemic, malnutritioned infants.Wow, I can hardly keep my emotions !!!FDA control anyone ...

Am I the only one seeing this price? $30 is an outrageous price to expect for only seven squeeze packs! I know the food is organic, but give me a break! I could make the same food myself for a tenth of that! Don't let Ella's get away with this rip off. No matter how good the product may be, I refuse to support this company until their prices become A LOT more reasonable.^^ This was my review BEFORE the seller reduced the price. I've adjusted my rating accordingly, and I'm glad they took my and other negative reviews into consideration.

column9: $1 to $2 everywhere else, don't buy here
column10: This is my son's favorite food brand but we buy it at Whole Foods and Babies R Us for about $1.75 each.  I can't figure out why Amazon is charging almost triple. ???

column9: DO THE MATH: $5.70 each!!! Can YOU afford this?
column10: Be sure you understand they are asking you to give them about $40 for only **7** squeezies. That makes them nearly $6 each!!!! For fruit sauce??? There are SEVERAL other brands which offer the same thing--pureed fruits and vegetables in soft squeezy packages that can be sucked out by toddlers in carseats--and they are selling for around $35 for ***24***packages of squeezies. See that difference? The stuff tastes just as good, I've tried them. In fact, the broccoli one of Ella's is disgusting, in my opinion. I like the brand that starts with a "P", second word Organics. Not the bunny. These get one star for pricing. The star is given because the product is nice, but 4 stars are taken away because of the complete highway robbery of offering these in a pack of only 7 for $39.95. Don't encourage them.

column9: I am so disappointed with this company - buyer BEWARE indeed
column10: After reading the reviews here stating that the Iron content of Ella's Kitchen Spinach packs was incorrect, I checked out their website to see for myself. Hmm.. no announcement there stating that an error had been made. So, I contacted the company wondering if it was a misunderstanding. No, it's true. The Spinach flavor only has 4-6% DV of Iron... NOT 120% as has been clearly indicated on the pouches I have been buying for my son for OVER A YEAR! I have been purchasing these packs by the case thinking that if my son did not eat enough other Fe-rich foods on a particular day, at least he would eat this. I mean you know how difficult it can be to get little ones to take in enough iron, so I thought this was a great option. IF I HAD KNOWN that it only contained 4 or 6%, then I would have given my son other additional Fe-rich foods or continued making my own purees. I guess I should have known it was too good to be true when I noticed that the first ingredient is in fact APPLES not Spinach as the front of the pouches would have you believe.What upsets me the most is that there is not even a warning or announcement on Amazon or at Target stores stating that there has been a mistake?!! If the company knows, why isn't this info passed on to the consumer?!!? Here I thought I was purchasing (a more expensive) but also more nutritionally complete product for my baby and to find out it's just as void of nutrients as all of the other brands on the shelves. I really thought this company was exciting and different and focused on kids' nutrition and health. I guess not. I am asking for a refund at the very least. Honestly, the company is lucky if parents don't decide to take up a lawsuit for their negligence in getting the word out. The incorrectly labeled packs should be recalled like anything else- not left on the shelves to trick parents! Normally, I am not one to overact and am certainly not litigious in the least. Humans (and companies run by humans) make mistakes. It's natural. But as a physcian and a mother, I am really annoyed by the lack of respect shown to consumers in failing to notify the community of this error.

column9: Warning about Ella's organic baby food iron content !!! Read all please!!!
column10: As simple as that: nutritional information is NOT accurate !!!Iron content in purple bag is only 2%, NOT 45% as stated on the pouch itself !!!!!!!!!!!Light green pouch "Rutabagas", contains Iron: 4%, NOT 120% stated on the package itself !!!!!!!We have fed 2 packs daily: 1 light green "rutabagas" and 1 purple one - "pumpkins" to our girl since she was 3.5 month old.What a disappointment !!! This company should be held accountable for causing anemic, malnutritioned infants.Wow, I can hardly keep my emotions !!!FDA control anyone ...

This flavor does not actually contain 120% of daily iron for babies, as still listed on most packaging.  This was a grievous error (a "printing error" according to the company).  This flavor only contains 6% iron, in the realm of most other baby food pouch products.  Unfortunately, this company has failed to pull mislabeled products or notify distributors of the long running error.

Great product.  For my older daughter, I made all organic baby food homemade.  Since we moved after the birth of my second child, we aren't able to get a nice fresh variety of organic fruits and veggies like we used to, so I decided to try buying organic baby food instead. My kids love these pouches (give or take a few of the flavors). I love the pouch packaging for easy clean-up, compact travel and not having to worry about carrying glass jars around.Both my infant (9 months old) and toddler (2.5 years old) love this flavor of Ella's the best, much to our surprise.  I think it's probably b/c it one of the few foods without bananas added.  It is a bit runny, so keep that in mind when using a spoon to feed.  But since it's so runny, it's good for younger ones that aren't used to thicker solids.The Spinach, Peas and Pears from Plum Organics is similar in taste, but is a little thicker, if the consistency of this one isn't right for you.  Also, we often mix this with some rice cereal to thicken it up if needed.I would recommend buying the variety pack to see which ones your kids might like.  Also, if they don't like it at first, don't give up, give them some time and try it again later.  They might change their minds.

column9: Great baby food - buy somewhere else
column10: Even I think that this baby food tastes good.  My 9 month old agrees.  I love that the ingredients are literally sweet potatoes, pumpkin, apples, and blueberries.  The only ingredient not in the title is lemon juice.  No crazy preservatives or other ingredients.  The problem is the company that is selling them on Amazon.  Don't take it out on Ella's.  You can find it MUCH more reasonably priced on diapers.com, or at Target.  I agree w/ another reviewer that the Plum organics baby food is also good, and a little cheaper, but this is still a staple in our son's diet.

I think some of the other reviewers are reviewing the price and not the product. This product is terrific, and currently it is less than $2 per pouch. My baby loves this flavor even though I was not sure when I read all of the fruit/vegetables that are in it. She eats it up every time! The product is great, you decide on the price when you are buying!

column9: Great product but not at this price.
column10: This is a great product, my daughter will not eat her vegetables, but she will fly through this pouch in just a few seconds.However, it does not make sense that the seller is selling these at $30 for just seven pouches.  We buy these at target for about $1.20 per pouch. Sure with sales tax here in Chicago that turns out to be about $1.30 per pouch, but still quite a bit less than the $4+ that this merchant is charging.In short, if you are thinking about getting this product, do so!  However, do not pay this price for it.

I bought this and fed this mix to my baby for months under the assumption that the packaging, which stated 120% RDA of Iron was correct.  No.  Actually, according to Ella's Kitchen's website there is only 4%!  A huge difference!!!!!!  I am gobsmacked there wasn't a sticker on the box or an email from Amazon.  Shame on the Ella's Kitchen AND Amazon!  Iron is so crucial to a baby's growth and development.  What a terrible thing to let slide.  Leaving a Mama thinking one important nutritional category was covered.  I am furious!

column9: Some mothers might look at this review funny, but...
column10: ...I don't have any human children. I purchased organic baby food...for my beloved pet cat. Yes, I know it strange, but I thought, "Well, why not?" ...After all, if I'm going to be spending money on baby food, why not spend it on the best product I can buy?I add baby food to my cat's food for extra fiber, because my cat is fat. Plus you can't beat the antioxidant goodness found in these baby food pouches. My cat eats her food with more gusto if I mix it into her food, and tends to not eat as much as before. She misses her teaspoon of Ella's if I don't mix it into every meal.By the way, it is the best baby food I've ever eaten. I always sneak a teaspoon or three when I'm fixing up my cats food.

I have been buying these for about a year now for my 2 boys now 2 and 4yo.  These are a great on the go snack that a mom can feel good about serving up.  It is neat and resealable.  My younger son started on these earlier and will eat any version of the pouches.  The older son is a little more picky and wants only the fruity version.  I just wish my local grocery store would carry but I can usual find a great selection at babys/toys-r-us, [...] and amazon. This site is great and I am a happy consumer but....amazons price is higher than most on this product.

I can only echo other parents - I have been buying this product only because of the Iron content shown on the package. My daughter actually hates the flavor, but I was trying to make her eat a pouch every other day hoping it will keep her iron levels high. Very disappointed that this mistake wasn't announced or anyhow made noticable; I found out about it just by luck - was bragging about these pouches and showing the iron information to my parents, and noticed that the last shipment (I have it on subscribe and save) has only 4% of Iron listed on the pouch.

column9: Main ingredient is apples, not carrots
column10: My daughter loves these and most Ella products, but the main ingredient is apples, not carrots, like you would assume from the package.

My boys love love love this brand and this particular one!! Except Target online does sell it cheaper than even the "subscribe and save" price on amazon and diapers.com. Some of the Ella's brand is cheaper on amazon if you do "subscribe and save" but check target online too, bc they give free shipping on orders %50 or too!!

column4: Zenism "It is better to conquer yourself than...
column9: Happy baby makes a happy mommy!
column10: My son LOVES the Ella's kitchen line of organic baby foods. By far his favorite has to be the Spinach, Apple and Rutabaga. I'm always tasting his foods before I give it to him and this is something I would eat! My son was EBF until 6 months, and I started out making his own organic baby food, but working full time and being a single mom it was taking up too much time that I could be spending with my son. I researched the Ella's kitchen organic baby food and decided to try it out, and we haven't found a kind he dislikes! This has made feeding time a joy for both of us.

I will say that my son has enjoyed this product.  HOWEVER, i'm extremely disappointed to see that the nutrition facts on the package are incorrect.  The package says 45% of iron RDA but if you check the website, it only has 4%.  It feels like the company is intentionally misleading (similar error occurred on other flavors) to get people to buy this product.  Disappointed in the company.
I am disappointed in Ella's.  This product originally at 100% iron on the label, but now has 4%.  Wow--pretty bad.  Will not buy again.

My 6 month old son's favorite flavor.  Whenever he is teething or has a stuffy nose & doesn't want to eat, I give him this.  Works every time.  He loves the flavor & I was comfortable with the ingredients after already trying all the stage 1 foods.These cost $1.89 each at Target, we got them for about $1.50 each with subscribe & save.  Still pricey, but worth it when I see how much he loves this combo.
I have a 8 month old and a 27 month old.... they both love it! My 27 month old has become a picky eater so to get her to eat something besides the junk she wants is a miracle!

I love this product. First of all it's a great blend of fruits and vegetables.  My daughter loves it.  She is now almost 1.  I didn't get why it was so expensive at first. But after trying Happy Baby and Plum pouches I realized that this product stands alone.  The other organic baby food pouch manufacturers really thin it out with water. This is much more concentrated.  My daughter loves it and we're getting more nutrition in every pouch.  It's also a lot easier to control and prevent spills because a gentle squeeze doesn't send the food oozing out everywhere.  I love it and highly recommend it.

column9: Great Anytime Baby, Toddler, Kid Snack
column10: Absolutely love Ella's Kitchen pouches.  The sweet potato, pumpkin, apples and blueberry one is my 12mo son's favorite, although my 5yo loves it as well.  I wish I had discovered them sooner.  Squeeze into a bowl for spoon feeding or let your little one drink directly from the pouch.  They're convenient and healthy - highly recommend!

I found these wondering the isle of Target one day.  I'd decided to try baby food again because all of a sudden she stopped eating fruits and veggies.  Won't touch them if she recognizes them.  I don't know if a carrot or a pea chased her in one of her dreams, but it's been a nightmare trying to force her to eat them.  So for a time I just gave up and then she gained weight...oh no.  So went to find some baby apple sauce and stumbled upon these.  Best. Discovery. Ever.I take 2 with me when we're out, and give them to her when we're in the car or in between plays on the playground.  The best part of these is that I can 'inject' these into her when we're rushed. She's loved all of the flavors except for the Sweet Potatoes, and gets a kick out of eating them herself.After calculating what it would cost for me to make such concoctions (cheap but time consuming) and taking into consideration the method of delivery (the spouted pouch, which is about 50% of this product's wow factor) that I can not imitate, Amazon is the very best place to buy these yummy pouches.  Amazon's price makes my daughter consuming 2-3 of these a day affordable.

I have been buying these for about a year now for my daughter.These are a great on the go snack that anyonecan feel good about serving up.It is neat and resealable.She can use this all by herself and it helps her learn how to eat, we can keep these anywhere and no longer need a jar and spoon so saves space.

column9: 2.5 yr old and 11 month loves this flavor the most
column10: I am a dad who likes to get things in bulk so I can stock up and save while getting quality stuff for my kids. My wife does the picking of which organic stuff we buy. She tries them all with the kids and the best match up so far has been the Ella line. They haven't gotten bored of them for 6 month straight now. Not bad. But within that brand, it's the sweet potatoes, pumpkin, apples, and blueberries that both kids will gobble up. I think it's the combination of the purple packaging and the blueberry flavor. But that's just my opinion.
My 5 month old daughter is so picky with her solid food but she loves this flavor!  She opens her mouth wide and gulps it down each time!  I tasted some and I must say it's sweet and delicious!
Can't say enough about these products...Amazingg...my daughter throws these back like nothing..Absolutely loves them!..I just wish Stage 2 was more readily available
Can't say enough about these products...Amazingg...my daughter throws these back like nothing..Absolutely loves them!..I just wish Stage 2 was more readily available

I LOVE Ella's pouches and my son does too, but the look of horror on his face when he first tried this flavor was hilarious. You'd have thought I tried to feed him poison.  Curious to know what flavor could have produced such a strong response from him, I tried the pouch myself.  EWWWWWWWWWWWWWWWWWE!!!!!  I've never tasted anything so vial in my life.  Had we not been out in public at the time I would have spit it out on the floor.  Instead I forced myself to swallow, threw the package away immediately, and apologized profusely to my son for trying to make him eat it.  I shudder just thinking about that one awful bite I had to endure.  Blech.

column9: Weird combo, but baby likes it
column10: I always taste the baby food before offering it to my baby. I thought this one tasted gross and had a grainy texture. I was expecting the baby to spit it out, but he loved it. He doesn't like many veggies, so that is a plus. We'll be buying this one again.

column9: Don't stop using these just because your baby get older!
column10: I give these to my toddler, call them Applesauce, and he loves them still.  They are the perfect on-the-go snack, they take no prep, don't need to be refrigerated, and even have vegetables.  I'll use this over a bag of chips any day of the week.

I purchased these for my sons, 19 mos and 4 years to eat as snack before dinner so that I knew they were getting a fruit serving.  I tried some before I gave any to them and they are pretty good.  There is definitely a distinct banana taste which is fine for us.  I like the containers.  I do think that Plum Organics or Happy Baby have comparable products and are less expensive than the Ella's Kitchen products.  I would definitely buy these again, though.

column9: little bit watery and sour in taste.
column10: I purchased this item at local target store before I buy from amazon.The Ella's Strawberries and apples taste bit sour and watery compare to Ella's Sweet Potatoes, Pumpkin, Apples + Blueberries(The purple pouch).I tried to feed my twins and they both did not like it.They really liked Ella's Sweet Potatoes, Pumpkin, Apples + Blueberries. They constantly ate the purple pouches but not this red one.However, my twins ate it right after they finished purple pouch which was sweet, thicker and tasty.I end up ate them all my self.

I normally make my own baby food, but when we travel my stuff doesn't hold up very well so I give my baby this and she LOVES it. She hates jarred food and I normally can't get her to eat it. But she will eat this stuff. I have even tasted it myself and it is pretty good.

column9: The best flavor... not too sweet
column10: My twins love apples and carrots, so this was an easy win.  Also, much less sweet than all the other flavors (also try Plum Baby's carrot apple). Great for car & stroller snacks. They've been slurping these down since they were 12 months.

I've compared this product to the competition (Plum, Earth's Finest, Happy Baby) and none came close to the exceptional nutritional value.  120% iron - that's amazing.  I pack one of these in my toddler's lunch boxes every day, and she views eating her spinach as a treat - even more amazing.  So although this product is far more expensive than alternatives, given the taste and nutrition, this has become the one 'vegetable' I am guaranteed my daughter will consume every day.

We tried all of Ella's flavors, my 6 month old loved them all.  I tasted them too, yummy!!  My only complaint is that this product is very expensive. If money isn't an issue for you, I highly recommend this product.  If money is an issue and you want organic I recommend Earth's Best or Plum.  I've decided to just make my own.

I started my daughter on these when she was 7 months old- she is 12 months old now and she still sucks these down in one breath! So glad that she loves these- they are super easy to carry around and they are healthy for her! Thanks, Ella's Kitchen!!

column9: BUYER BEWARE! Read the nutrition label on Ella's website
column10: This stuff is garbage and Ella's Kitchen should be ashamed for false advertising. I was really surprised to see a fruit product like this one had so much calcium (10%) on the package compared to most of the other baby fruits out there (usually 0-2% unless veggies or yogurt's added in) and chose this over other products, thinking the extra calcium would be worth the extra $ for my baby in the long run. When you check it against Ella's website, it HAS NO CALCIUM%! Same goes for all the other stage 1 Ella's fruits (butternut squash, carrots, apples, prunes: 30% calcium on package but 2% on the website, carrots, apples, parsnips 30% calcium on package vs. 0% on website all the same serving size) -- there were other differences too in protein, iron, etc. It does cost a lot more than some of the other organic baby fruits out there and tastes awful. If your baby is just as content with the other less expensive organic baby fruits out there, go with the cheaper alternative because nutrition wise, Ella's no better!What a disgusting marketing ploy by Ella's Kitchen to get parents to choose their products because it is falsely more nutritious when it's the same as other organic baby fruits in terms of nutritional value.

I am very happy with this product. It tastes really yummy and doesn't have lots of "extra" ingredients. I love the variety in the Ella products and that my baby is getting lots of healthy foods in one meal. Also, it is very easy to just squeeze it onto a spoon to feed. No mess!

I almost stopped giving my son iron drops thinking that this product was giving him much of his daily iron needs. The sweet potato/pumpkin flavor says it contains 45% of the daily iron needs but really it only has 2%. I don't understand how this company can just lie on the nutrition label.

My 14 month old loves this stuff.  i tasted it and it seems healthy and delicious enough.  My only reservation is about not being able to visually see and inspect what she's ingesting with these new tetra packs.
My son had a little trouble on occasion with constipation and when he did, this would be our go to meal. The prunes always seemed to help, and he loves the taste.
My two Year old LOVES these pouches!! She sheen eating them since she started on solids. Ill continue to buy until she's doesn't want them anymore!  Very healthy! And they have a great huge variety!

I worry about genetically modified foods, and Ella's doesn't contain any.  In the long haul, this is really important for my grandchildren, and is just one more reason to give them Ella's Organics.  The more you know, the safer the child in your life is!
I wish these were cheaper so I don't order them as much as I would but they do taste good and is a unique combination of flavors. Baby loved it!

I thought broccoli and peas are good for my baby, but pears seem to be the most ingredient. It tastes sweety. I don't hope my daughter has a sweet tooth. BTW, the package edges may be not safe as teether.

Purees are not supposed to be this thin.  What a mess!!  I make most of the food for my twins, but bought a few organic pouches to try while we were on vacation for Memorial Day.  I had an assortment of Plum Organics, Earth's Best and a few Ella's Organics.  The Plum are a much more normal consistency AND taste better all around.  I mixed this with Brown Cow cream top plain yogurt (as I have done with all the other fruit pouches I brought for the weekend). This particular packet was so runny it was like spoon feeding them a bottle! Can you say disaster?! Won't buy again.

Organic food pouches are wonderful. They are easy to carry and to eat (children can manipulate them on their own as soon as they can hold things with both hands). My child enjoyed Ella's kitchen pouches a lot till she was almost 18 months old.  She seemd to like apples+bananas the best.

That is what these are called in our house.  After naps each little tike gets one from the fridge and they think it's a smoothy.I give them all sorts of fruit and veggie mix flavors and they never fail me.  It's the incentive to get the nap in there too.I recommend putting them in the fridge, just popping the top of and handing it over to any baby who's done with their bottle.I started giving them directly to the kids at age 13 months.  A bit messy for the first week, but the youngest is 15 months now andshe knows exactly what to do with her "sak ouwt"

When my son was an infant he willingly ate a wide variety of fresh fruits and vegetables.  Now that he's a toddler he refuses almost all fresh fruits and vegetables, even the ones that he used to love.  I use these to sneak healthy food into him!  I keep some organic baby food pouches in the car, so that I always have a healthy snack on hand for him.  He loves them!Note that these aren't as sweet as some of the other organic baby food pouches (such as Happy Tot's Spinach, Mango, and Pear).  If I give my son a sweeter pouch first, and then this pouch, he refuses this one.  If you think your child will eat more than one pouch, offer this sweet potato/pumpkin pouch first!  I am so grateful for these!

column9: The Only Veggies My Daughter Will Eat!
column10: A little expensive, but theses pouches are great on the go. They are BPA free and all organic. My daughter wouldn't eat the jar food (peas, carrots, etc.), but when mixed with fruit she will. Great product!

My son is now one, and looooves these little pouches. I can't even go through the baby food aisle at the grocery store without him seeing these and crying for one. I love the packaging because it is so easy for him to hold and eat off the spout. Plus, these are great to put in his diaper bag for snacks when we're out running errands or to feed him at a restaurant. He loves all the flavors of these, there are other brands out there that he didn't like and when I tried them they were not very good. I have tried these and they are very tasty, which I was surprised because some of the combos don't sound like they would taste good (spinach, apple, rutabaga?). I am from Dallas and I get them from a grocery store here called Central Market and they normally sell them at less than $2 but will have sales where you can get them at around $1, so that is when I stock up. The product is excellent, but I think the price you pay on Amazon is very high compared to other places where you can get a better price.
Can't say enough about these products...Amazingg...my daughter throws these back like nothing..Absolutely loves them!..I just wish Stage 2 was more readily available
Can't say enough about these products...Amazingg...my daughter throws these back like nothing..Absolutely loves them!..I just wish Stage 2 was more readily available

I have twin 14 month old girls and they have been eating Ella's Organic fruit/veggie pouches since they were about 4 months old. They LOVE them and they are a great snack to take on the road or outside. While I would prefer for the girls to eat actual fruit and veggies, they are going through a picky stage right now and these pouches are the next best thing. We buy them in bulk and can't keep up with the demand from our girls.

It is hard to get my 9 month old to eat vegetables, but luckily she likes this blend! As another review mentioned, it is pretty runny but I just thicken it up with rice cereal. I'm a little torn on what I think of packages like this - I am glad they are BPA free, and they are convenient for when we're out and about, but in general I prefer glass containers that we can recycle or reuse.

This food is not as smooth as some of the others and is a mixture of 4 foods, so I didn't start feeding it to my baby until he was 6-7 months old.  He's 9 months old now and still loves it, and I think it's better now that it isn't as smooth.  I could see feeding him this for awhile longer alongside solids or as a snack.  The only downside is the price, but I guess it's not much more than other pouches.

column9: Looks and smells gross, but my baby wouldn't stop eating it!
column10: Our pediatrician recommended this flavor combination when we first started solids because it has 120% of daily iron needs.  Well, when I sat down to feed it to my baby, all I could was, wow, this is so gross!  It looks pretty much the same way going in as it does coming out, if you know what I mean.  To my surprise, my picky eater gobbled it up!  She ate more of this than any other baby food flavor we had offered.  A 2-3oz package of anything else was lasting two days, but she ate almost the whole 3.5oz package of this in one sitting.  I did taste it, and the apples make it sweet and appetizing (and I really do not like spinach).  We've had more success with Ella's Kitchen than any other brand, but this flavor especially has been great.  Looks gross, smells gross, sounds gross, but I say, give it a try.

column9: Helpful for kids with special needs, too
column10: My son is 8 but due to his disability is on a very low calorie diet and has issues chewing many low calorie foods such as raw veggies.  These packets are a fun way for him to enjoy a low calorie snack when we are on the go (only 35-40 calories for many of the packets).  He loves the taste and of course there is no worry about choking hazards.  I gave it 4 stars instead of 5 because they are extremely pricey, even at the lowest price I could find it really adds up.

When my 4 month old son sees these brightly colored pouches he sits straight up in his high chair and starts to get excited. All the flavors are really yummy. ... I've tried everything that he's eaten at this point.I really like that these have no additives... They didnt even add water. Just pure organic fruit and vegetable purée. I figure that he's going to have so many processed food options in the future that I might as well give him the best I can now.I purchased the Boon Spoons (got a 3 pack of the 2-spoon sets from the big T for less than a 2 pack here on amazon) and they work perfectly with these pouches too. Very convenient to take on the go.I continue to purchase these pouches, though I usually buy a couple individual packs from T before buying the 7 packs here on Amazon so I can make sure he likes them.
My 7 month old son likes this. We tried this after first doing peaches and bananas separately, and he likes them together too.
When I can't get my son to eat anything else (fussy, teething, etc) he'll always eat this.  Tastes delicious with a mix of baby cereal and formula.

I have been buying Ella since my son was 6 months old. Once I moved back to the States I was pleased to find the Ella product here. I was also buying Gerber Organic and then one day I studied the label and realized that only Ella was truly just pure veg and fruit whereas the other organic baby food as other random things to help the shelf life. Ella is worth the price and is so easy to mix in with chicken or fish to make it easier for your little one. Although my son is now 16months, I still use Ella when I am short on time and don't have time to make fresh veg or fruit.
My baby loves this product. I even tried it and it was very yummy. I cant wait to get more for him.

column9: Like eating a tube of jam!
column10: My daughter is a strawberry fiend so I thought this would be perfect for her, but she just spits every bite out pretty violently, LOL! I tried it myself in exasperation and it really tasted like a spoonful of strawberry jam. GROSS.
when my son is teethy and/or fussy and won't eat anything else, this is the one thing he will eat.  Awesome!  I tasted it and it really gets five stars for something that's got veggies in it, too.

I love Ella's Kitchen organic baby food. It's easy to take on the go. It is also the first baby food my child ever ate. She refused Earth's best and Gerber. The sweet potato, pumpkin, apple, blueberry flavor was always her favorite. I tasted it...and it is actually really good!  Great product and healthy!

I was hesistant about such a mixture but I want what's best for my baby so I bought it.  It doesn't look the most appetizing but my baby LOVED it!  This will be a constant food for him until he moves on to the next stage - love, love, love this brand!
I orig. bought this for my 6 month old, but my 2 year old loves it too! She has been hard to feed lately... picky 2 year old. She loves the pouches... I guess it's a new novelty. What ever it takes!

My 5 month old LOVES these mixtures. Great job ELLAS I promised I would never feed him something that I wouldn't eat myself. They ALL taste good. I would eat any of them if I was so inclined to eat a pureed meal. They are easy to pack & throw in the diaper back/suit case for travel. I had no worry about them leaking (like a small plastic tupperware). The price is right, shipping was quick, and they store really well in the pantry in the ready made box. Happy Baby = Happy Mommy

BUT HE LOVES IT. My 5 month old LOVES these mixtures. Great job ELLAS I promised I would never feed him something that I wouldn't eat myself. They ALL taste good. They are easy to pack & throw in the diaper back/suit case for travel. I had no worry about them leaking (like a small plastic tupperware).  The price is right, shipping was quick, and they store really well in the pantry in the ready made box.

column9: Best snack out there, but buy elsewhere!
column10: We love Ella's! Amazingly pure and delicious portable snack. But this price is crazy - it is cheaper at our Whole Foods in Manhattan! Eek!

column9: My Baby Doesn't Care For It
column10: But I love that it is organic. I didn't think it was that bad, I will just stick to other flavors ;)
I hope it's really healthy because my 1 yr old seems to love them - we just tried them and the package is already gone!  recommend!
My son LOVES these but Amazon's price is ridiculous!!!  You can get them on sale for a dollar a piece.  Yikes!!  I'm shocked!!

column9: Healthy food, happy Kids, no mess - happy mom too.
column10: My kids love Ella's Kitchen Apple Banana sauce.  We have purchased various flavors and various brands of this type of product - fruit sauce in a pouch.  There are only a couple they like.  And this is one of their favorites.  They are older children (not babies).  They love the taste and the packaging.  They like it so much that they beg for it.  It is so easy to give this to them in the car.  Healthy food, happy Kids, no mess - happy mom too.

My baby LOVED the Ella's kitchen items, especially the peaches & bananas.  I love that it is all organic!  The consistency is very runny...so it mixes well with things like oatmeal & other baby cereals.  The cap will go back on the package, but must be kept upright in the fridge or it will leak.
Love all Ella's Kitchen products...my babies LOVE it.......can't find stage 2 in the stores or online....but the Drugstore 911 prices are really outrageous..more than half the normal cost ><
My baby is a picky eater and LOVES, especially this flavor.  I try everything that I give her and these are something I would eat too!

column9: Ella's Kitchen Organic Baby Food Strawberry and Apples
column10: My son loved this. He actually likes this more than any other baby fruit. This is also very convenient. If you do not use it all at one time, then you just put the cap back on and put it in the fridge. They also take up less space in the diaper bag, and you do not have to worry about the jar busting.

column9: My Toddler Vegetable Snob is a BIG Fan!
column10: These little pouches are great for toddlers who refuse to eat their vegetables in the conventional way. My son started getting picky around 18 months and I was on the verge of desperation when I found these at BRU. (They are also carried at a certain big box store that has a bulls eye logo.) Yes, they are marketed for babies, and are almost two bucks a pop, but my son ALWAYS finishes these pouches, which is more than I can say for most things he eats, and I feel much better knowing he ingested something green! Yay for Ella's kitchen! Oh. and I also recommend the pumpkin version. Super yummy!

My toddler, my 9yo daughter, and I all love this!  Delicious.  A little pricey, but worth it right now while my little guy won't really eat "real" fruits and veggies :)  The Subscribe and Save price here is the best I've found.
Tastes just like what it is, but my will not even touch a vegetable nevermind eat one daughter sucks these down. I'm happy!

My 21 month old son absolutely loves these - he will happily eat them right out of the package, but I also use them to make yogurt smoothies or to flavor oatmeal and he love that as well.  I love that there really isn't a lot of sugar and that they have so many truly YUMMY flavors - we've probably been using them since he was about 12 months old - only wish I had known about them even sooner!

I have an 11 month and 3.5 year old. These pouches make for a great yummy snack. My kids love to eat them right out of the pouch. My older child eats her whole veggies and also these pouches. My baby, is not a huge veggie fan like my eldest.. she loves these however. When I cook for the baby if I don't hide the veggies well, she will reject the meal. So, when I can't get my baby to eat the organic veggies I have made or when I need a quick snack while shopping or out and about, Ella's takes great care of us! Def a must have. Oh, I just give my baby the whole tube and she sucks it all out.. great for the baby who had always refused me feeding her.
My toddler loves these, great snack for during the day and easy to take in the car as a bribe :)

My son is almost 18 months old and these are great for healthy snacks on the go. They are a great combination of fruits and vegetables without all the extra water and junk that comes in other baby food.  It's like a special treat for my little guy and I'm happy he's eating something healthy.  Only complaint is I wish they weren't so expensive.

My child took to this flavor of Ella's immediately, moaning with delight with every slurp. Soon enough, she was able to drink down the container on her own using the spout, which was a new skill of hers I can attribute to the spinach, apple and rutabaga Ella's!

I just started buying this product. It is not available in local stores. I went to Target last Sunday and saw these so I decided to gave it a try. My baby happen to love these as much as Happy Baby products. I am surprised to see it here on Amazon. So next time I will buy it from here. It tastes great. My baby loves it. Yeah it is kind of expensive but if your child loves it then I would buy it for the child. They do go on sale too. If you have WIC ( Women , Infant and Children) You can buy these from Target Because only Target carry these here. I am not sure if Amazon accepts WIC.  Over all a great product I would recommend it.
Product is great.  Amazon price was overpriced- once calculated on per pouch, it turned out to be twice that of Whole Foods pricing.  Not worth it.
I mix this with nonfat plain yogurt and it's the best dip around -- I can eat veggies all day with this stuff.  Hard to find in grocery stores so I'm THRILLED it's on Amazon!
Our family loved spinach dip with Knorr Leek Soup mix, but it is a bit difficult to find in small towns! I ordered a case so that I'd have plenty on hand!

column9: Very tasty and we use it to mix with fresh vegtable
column10: Good price compared to safeway, so it worth to buy it from here. Though not all kind of knorr soup is in safeway! I should check the wallmart perhaps?

This stuff is delicious and hard to find here in VT, so I ordered a case!  Mix 1 packet w/ a pint of sour cream and voila!, you've got "Mom's Dip."  It must be eaten w/ Ruffles potato chips for maximum effect.  It's freakin' delicious.  Not the fastest processing in the world, but that's kind of normal for this site.  Also not the fastest shipping, but it's free, so you can't complain there.  It did arrive on time.  Thanks Amazon!

column9: Great for recipes, hard to get at stores.
column10: Knorr leek soup mix makes the best chip and veggie dip; better than French onion! You just mix a packet of mix with 1 pint sour cream, stir, and let sit a couple of hours. Completely addictive. However, it's hard to find in grocery stores, so I turn to Amazon and buy boxes of the stuff. Perfect service, good expiration dates.BTW, for the low-fat version, whip up cottage cheese and a little milk in the blender until it's the consistency of sour cream and use that with the Knorr mix instead. Really good!
Can't find this in stores anymore (knor leek soup mix), and can't cook without it - so glad I found a source
Pear's Gourmet Colombia Supremo Ground Coffee, 8-Ounce Bags (Pack of 6)has an excellent price but the taste is not so good. This product has a funny chocolate after taste that is not a good taste.
The tea tastes great and is very soothing. It's one of the teas I reach for when I want to relax.

I got hooked on candy-coated fennel seeds when I first tried them through a purchase I made with an online Indian cooking supply store. They were delicate and delish and addictive. I finished them up and then I bought theses packages of fennel seeds to stock up, also from India.  They are good, but apparently all sugar-coated fennel seeds are not created equally. The candy coating on these is much thicker and because of this, they are like little rocks to chew on, VERY crunchy, borderline "hard" crunchy. You can visually see the difference in the size of the individual seeds from the two different purchases; it's not my imagination. It isn't helping me any that I am going thru costly dental issues for the past year, so I am more sensitive now than ever about what I'm chewing on. The packaging is very nice, though; they have very user-friendly, slide-lock tops, very secure, nothing will come out. I was impressed with that.  When it's time to replenish these, however, as I eventually will, I will seek out the ones that I tried first and preferred. I will use these as little giftables since I have five bags of them left!

These are wonderful. I shared them with a class of mine (I teach at a college) to share some of the flavors of the world. Of course it was different then what most of them had been exposed to, but even then a majority liked them.

These sugar coated fennel seeds are much more tasty than the ones I originally became enamored with from nutsonline.com.  These seeds are very tiny and the coating is delicate so a very easy and tasty mouth feel.  They are like "Good and Plenty" candies only all grown up.  I would highly recommend.Update:  I think the company might have gotten some other kind of seeds mixed in.  I keep thinking I taste possibly cumin seeds, possibly others.  For sure, not all of the seeds are fennel.  It spoils the taste a bit, but still a good after dinner snack.
Really good product, they are sweeter than other ones I've tried and that disguises the fennel flavor a little bit so they're good for people not used to spicy flavors.

column9: Delicious! Good For You! Tastes like candy!
column10: These are great! Ever since we were first introduced to eating them in an Indian restaurant we have ordered them here online at Amazon.com. We always found Amazon helpful and trustworthy, no matter what we order. For years now we order from them and are always satisfied. No matter what you want or need it seems to always be on Amazon! Amazing! Anyway; After the meal they had these candy fennel seeds for a last minute treat for breath and digestion, at the cash register. We enjoyed them so much ever since!

Yummy! I bought these awhile ago and a little go a long way. Eat a small handful on their own or mixed with plain dried fennel seeds after dinner, helps with digestion & much better for you than M&Ms. When I run out, I'll be buying this brand again.

column9: Excellent Product but Watch Out Price Keeps Increasing
column10: We absolutely LOVE all the Plum Organics Pouches. They are awesome for lunch boxes. I am a parent of 3 1/2 yr. old twins. One cannot process fresh fruits and veggies but with these products I don't have to worry. He will now eat five different varieties. The only complaint I have is that they keep saying the item is no longer available for subscribe and save then one day later it becomes available at a higher price.
Was easy to order, got what i wanted in no time !Barista Coffee: Making the Perfect Cup of Coffee and Delicious Cakes to Have with It

Last time I ordered two 7 lb. bags of these Mexican Hat candies.  They are always so fresh and chewy.  Everytime my grandsons come to visit they always bring a few friends along, because they know I will always have these spicy flavorful little hats handy for them.I'm 66 years old and have loved the different spicy taste each color has since I was just a kid myself.  Orange is my personal favorite, because it taste like clove.Please send it asap.  Like one of the neighborhood kids, I can't wait to eat one.S.Kay Cook
Used it for the first time...love it!!!! Locally, red food color is $1.78 an 1 ounce! Crazy! You have a shopper for life, Ozbo!

column9: McCormick Large bottle of red food coloring.
column10: At the cost of $2.89 per ounce at the store, this was a much better price for a baker like me. The cost was very reasonable.
Nice product like the 1 oz bottle but a lot more for the money. We bake a lot of red velvet cakes and it gets expensive buying the 1 oz bottles. This large bottle goes a long way for the money.

There is nothing like the look and taste of a homemade red velvet cake! Box versions or bakery knock-offs will not do. You can make the cake at home without the color. But who's ever heard of a tan velvet cake? But the cost of the tiny bottles of red food coloring sold at grocery stores adds over $5 to the cost of each cake. So what are you to do? Get this big bottle and make lots of cakes for a fraction of the cost. A feast for the eyes and the mouth. Enjoy! Mmmm!

column9: A toy, designed for a child to play with
column10: This item is not a collector's item.  It is a plastic toy racecar with candy.  Great if you are trying to give a little novelty gift to a young boy.  Seller was wonderful to work with.

This flavor is the sweetest Orbit gum I've had so far, almost like mint candy. It seems to last a little less long than flavors like wintermint, but it's almost more of a treat if you're a fatso on a diet like me. I usually use another flavor for a post-meal breath freshener though, but I love the flavor.

I like orbit gum and it is vegetarian friendly. This bulk pack gives me an abundance and keeps me from having to buy a Costco membership. Even Walmart doesn't carry this quantity packaging so it's a good deal.
Housemate specifically wanted this flavor and thought it was a good deal.I like it too... good chew, good flavor, nice size, lasts long enough. Lots of it!
Doesn't get much more affordable than this!  The gum arrived fine, and lasts forever so why not buy it in bulk and save it.  Beats paying 3 times as much in a drugstore.
This was a great way to buy gum.  It is much better priced than buying it at the store in 3 packs.

In my opinion, the Sweetmint Sugarfree Gum is the best flavor made by Orbit.  The taste is wonderfully sweet and flavorful and lasts longer than any other brand of sugar-free gum I have tried.  The fact that it is better for your teeth, being free of sugar, is only icing on the cake!
This is one of my top flavors of gum. It is smoother than most and won't make your eyes water (there's a time and a place for that) but still has a minty taste.

column9: One of my favorite flavors of gum
column10: Orbit's Sweetmint gum has a very unique flavor that almost reminds me of mint chocolate.  It's definitely not too sweet of a flavor, and you'll feel like you're chewing mint gum still.  The best way I can describe the flavor is a toned-down mint; the sweetness is noticeable but not overpowering.  I'm a fan of Orbit gum because after trying everything else out there, the flavor really does last the longest out of all the gum brands.  If you're looking to try a new gum flavor then you should give this a shot.

these are delicious and full of green foods-what could be bad? my daughters fight over these bars, i had to get a case. the flavors are natural and realistic, not too sweet. true, the chocolate coating may melt in a toddler's hand or on their face, but that always happens.  i keep them in the fridge to keep that at bay. enjoy!

I was a little dubious...I couldn't believe that green stuff would taste good since I'm kind of veggie-phobic, but these things are great!  They don't taste like green stuff at all, just a nice chocolate peanut butter flavor.  The bars have a tiny bit of crunchiness, but in a pleasant way and aren't too sweet.  I just found a tasty way to get more green in my diet, I'm so happy!  The bars are greenish inside, but if you don't look you'd never know it.

OK, so its a green bar and you have to take that into consideration. It's not a dessert by any means, but it is loaded with good stuff so when Im hungry and need a pick me up, I feel better about eating these than junk food. Plus, they keep my blood sugar in check for a pre-work out meal.

Love the taste and the nutrition of these..  great product.Regarding the concerns about alfalfa use, I emailed the company, and within a few hours they nicely described how the alfalfa they use is safe:Thanks for taking the time to write in with your questions and feedback.  We chose to add alfalfa into our products because of all the amazing benefits from it. We harvest the alfalfa leaves for our greens. Alfalfa is one of the world's deepest roots plants absorbs many trace minerals and nutrients from the soil. It's root structure that can grow up to 20 ft. deep, letting it absorb minerals in the sub-soil that many plants can never reach. It also contains all essential amino acids and is a great source of Vitamins A, D E and K. The alfalfa leaf also contains:. Calcium- bone and tooth formation, muscle contractions, heartbeat.. Phosphorus- needed for normal bone and tooth structure. Interrelatedwith action of calcium and Vitamin D. Improves nourishment of nerve and tissue.. Silicon Magnesium- constipation, steadies the nerves, has protectiveeffect on skin and body, stimulates brain functionTo add to that, we don't produce or incorporate ANY alfalfa seeds or sprouts into our products.  The negative info you've likely seen only refers to the seeds or sprouts.  Whole Leaf alfalfa has long been revered for it's incredible green leafy vegetable properties and incredible trace minerals.  There isn't any controversy about it that I've ever heard of.

These bars are so healthy you would think they would taste plain.  They are fantastic.  Wonderful chocolate and high in protein with the peanut butter.  I originally purchased them for a snack....they can be a meal replacement anytime.....you never feel hungry.

I am not sure why others are complaining about the taste. This tastes great to me! I have also tried some vegan bars and those are pretty hard to eat. Sure, the chocolate is probably the unhealthiest part of this bar, but it really improves the taste. The only reason I am giving the product 4 stars is because it is a bit pricey.

column9: A Visit to the Peppermint Room
column10: Several years ago, I went on a tour of the Celestial Seasonings tea factory in Boulder, Colorado.  The guide showed us the bales of tea as they arrived, machines that ground and mixed the tea, and a machine that put the tea in tea bags.  The tour included a visit to the room where the peppermint tea was stored.  Our guide told us that peppermint was stored separately so that it would not contaminate the other teas.  He did not tell us what was to come.The doorway into the peppermint room was surrounded by bright red stripes. This should have served as a warning to us.  We all innocently strolled into the peppermint room.  The smell of peppermint was overpowering.  It entered my nose, my head, my lungs, and then my whole being was infused with peppermint.  What a rush!  The crowd stampeded out of the room in a hurry.  For the rest of the day and into the next, all I could smell and taste was the mint.I am now addicted to Celestial Seasonings Peppermint Tea.  Every time I have some, I am reminded of that fateful day in Boulder.  The events of that day have changed my life forever.  Amazingly, the tea is still legal, openly sold in stores and on the Internet.  I think that the tea is great, but then again I am not an unbiased observer.  On your next visit to Boulder, take the tour.  Or go a safer route; buy the tea from Amazon.
