I bought this coffee given it's cost and that it is a bold brew.  I openend the box and thought the whole batch of coffee was made incorrectly as the pods are very light and not full, not even close.  I emailed the company and a rep called me back and explained that the pods are light as this is a new brew process.  I decided to try them and they are actually pretty good.  My daughter really likes them to make iced coffee.  They are strong and richly flavored.  I prefer other bold pods to these, though.  Buy them if you like espresso, really strong coffee, or want to brew over ice.

column9: They make nice rattles for a 2 year old
column10: This is the worse coffee I have ever had. I admit I drank it many times because I had nothing else to drink and I wanted caffeine. It kind of taste like hickory or something. If you like instant coffee then get this item. But if you like instant coffee you probably don't have a fancy coffee maker to use them in. My 2 year old daughter loves playing with then though. shake shake shake
These are instant coffee cups, not traditional K-cups. When I originally purchased these it did NOT say instant coffee. This was added after the many complaints on here.

Stay away from the Grove Square products. I ordered this because I'd been so happy with the Amazon Subscribe and Save service in the past and these were the only K-cups available at the time I placed the order.Shame on Amazon for making this the only brand available! These are not "true" K-cups with the filter inside, etc. They are basically instant coffee sealed in the K-cup packaging.Many times when you put them in the machine, the cup doesn't fill all the way. I estimate I didn't get a full cup out of 15-20 of the K-cups and had to start the process over with a new K-cup, wasting a lot of time and money.The flavor of the coffee is also bad, and has the exact taste you'd expect from instant coffee. Ick.To sum up, save yourself some time and money. If you want instant coffee flavor and lots of hassle, these are for you. If not, get another brand of "real" K-cups.
The flavor was OK but I didn't like the way the cups leaked after taking them out of Keurig. I have never had this problem with other Keurig cups. Dripping on the counter and on the floor.

column9: It tastes like what it is: instant coffee
column10: Like many of you, I'm tired of paying big bucks for K-cups and when I saw this product on my grocer's shelf, I just had to give it a try. How bad could it be? Well, it tastes just like what it is: a spoonful of instant coffee in a plastic cup that kinda-sorta works in a Keurig coffee machine. It's not the most vile thing I've ever tasted, and I'm going to finish the box I purchased, but I won't be buying it again. Besides, even if I liked the flavor of this product, it would be more economical to buy a jar of instant and use the Keurig to dispense hot water.

I got lured in by the subscribe and save, but it's nothing but freeze dried crystals of coffee. To top it off, the coffee "grounds" end up at the bottom of your cup so you get a thick swill of a finish. I would not purchase this again.
It is instant coffee... I did not realize this when I bought it so the price is a huge ripoff and I cannot understand why a kcup with instant coffee in it would even be made

column9: Don't bother, unless you actually like instant coffee
column10: What would have been a 1 Star review, is now a 3 Star review only because Amazon and/or the manufacturer have corrected several information listing problems. When I purchased these K-cups at the beginning of January 2011 there were no reviews and in the Product Name or Product Features it did NOT say Instant Coffee.  Because we do have an abundance of K-cups in our pantry it took over a month before I tried these out. I didn't even need to drink it to know that something wasn't right.  The weight and sound of the K-cup was the first tip off, then watching the brewing of it and finally the taste - Yuck! Now if you like instant coffee then you will probably like these, BUT you could save money by buying Nescafe Clasico Instant Coffee, adding a spoonful to your cup and then brewing just hot water through your Keurig. Either way I won't be purchasing any more, but it wasn't a total waste as my daughter did like them and has used them up.

I was very disappointed with this purchase, it is not fresh coffee, like I expected. It looks, smells, and tastes just like Folgers instant freeze dried crystals!!If you like freeze-dried instant coffee, then this is for you, but I got my Keurig machine because I like real, fresh coffee and this just doesn't do it for me.

column9: "Instant Coffee" is Instant Coffee is Instant Coffee........
column10: So I ordered this stuff fairly quickly and I thought that the "Instant Coffee" on the label was just a marketing thing as all K-cups brew instantly right... BIG MISTAKE!This is actual freeze-dried, Instant coffee there is no filter no coffee smell and the taste is pitiful.The packaging is exactly like the other Keurig K-cup "real" coffees, but what a huge disappointment...It wasn't even significantly cheaper than any a good Timothy coffee..In my opinion Instant coffee should not be allowed into a K-cup, I got my Keurig to replace my Auto-Drip coffee maker not my tea-kettle!I also strongly believe this Grove Square nonsense is just a trick to dump cheap instant coffee on the unsuspecting Keurig owner, What a rip off!

I don't drink coffee, but I bought this for my husband who was very disappointed with it. Like me, he thought it was "the ususl" K-Cup and was very surprised when he brewed a cup and discovered it was not. Now he's stuck with 47 "imposter" K-Cups that he doesn't like. We both really wish this product had been advertised in such a fashion that would have made it obvious that it was instant coffee. I would never have purchased it had I realized what it was.

column9: A Sad Excuse For Instant Coffee
column10: I am sorry, but this was not ground coffee.  Amazon should clearly identify that this is mostly instant coffee.  Knowing that, when you compare it to other instant coffee products that are available this stuff is at or near the bottom of the flavor quality you expect from instant. So... that means it is cheaper to get yourself a cup of hot water from you coffee brewer, then add your favorite instant coffee.  There are two additional benefits of using your own favorite instant coffee - your cup of Joe will taste better and you will not have to clean your coffee brewer as this stuff leaves a residue in the brewer.

I didn't look at the reviews before I bought this terrible product.  I wish I had.  It's hard to believe that someone would put instant coffee in a k-cup.  Even harder to believe that Amazon would sell it.  I have requested a refund.  Amazon should not dupe their loyal customers with products like this.  I would rate it a -1 if it was possible.

column9: Not at good as I would expect
column10: I do regret this purchase because I could have gotten a better value with generic brand and still get the same thing.  This product is truly awful.

It is beyond me why anyone owning a keurig coffee brewer would want instant coffee.I usually read all reviews (unfortunately I did not have time that day and did not want tomiss this "friday special.)"  This is the way it was marketed to buyers on Amazon-"Grove Square (TM) Single Cup Coffee - Dark Roast - 24 ct Box".  I find this deceptive and unfairto unsuspecting customers.  This is instant coffee.  If you go onto Amazon, it now 2/22 it states on someof the grove square products that it is instant coffee.  I use my keurig for makingtea and hot chocolate and have even bought the chai cups.  Don't buy it is worse thanany instant coffee I have ever tasted and amazon will not let you return!  It does notdeserve the 1 rating I had to give it to get this to post!  Thank you and I hope this is helpful.
Absolutely the worse coffee ever. Instant coffee in a K-Cup.  And it doesn't even flow through correctly in the machine.

If you want instant coffee go out and by Sanka. This is nothing more than instant coffee. The week after I purchased it I noticed it was on sale for only $10 for a pack 0f 2 24count boxes. I would not even pay that for it. Don't waste your money on aweful coffee!!!

What a rip off ... Kuerig should ban this stuff.  It is basically instant coffee in a plastic shell.  There is no filter, it's just hot water pouring through chunks of busted up freeze dried crystals.  Don't waste your money.  The cheap price got me hooked.  If I wanted instant coffee I would have bought Sanka.  Stick with COFFEE PEOPLE brand ... now that some good stuff!

Not what we were expecting in a k-cup.  This is weak coffee that tastes like instant coffee.  There is a reason it is cheap - buyer beware!  I would have given it a negtaive rating if it was possible to do so.
Don't be fooled. This is not brewed coffee but instant coffee. Although it does not taste too bad, it still has that instant coffee taste. Don't waste your money.
I am extremely disappointed by this coffee.  It has a terrible taste and it seems like instant coffee is inside that pod.  I will never buy this again.
Did not like flavor.  Left significant residue in cup and flow was limited into cup.  Tried 2 and plan to return.  Very disappointing

When I received Grove Square coffee, I was, at first, very happy about the price. However, it was before I tasted the coffee; this is garbage. For those of you who appreciate a cup of aroma and flavorful cup of coffee in the morning it would deliver you NEITHER AROMA NOR FLAVOR. It is colored water to say the least; exact flavor of diluted, bitterly aftertaste, instant coffee. I would not recommend this product even to my worst enemy.

I bought this to try out when it went on sale for $15/box here at Amazon.  The flavor is decent, but it really is just instant coffee with a few grounds packaged into a K cup.  For way less money and packaging, you can get instant coffee and just use the Keurig to heat the water.

They say this is "Micro Brewed"....in other words-instant cooffee in a thin flimsy k-cup.  You would be better off buying a jar of instant and using the hot water out of the Keurig.  I feel this is a deceptive product.  I would give it Zero stars if I could.  Don't waste your money.
Anyone can go to the store and buy instant coffee for a lot less than this, it SUCKs. You need to stop ripping off the people.I would not even give it 1 star but I can't send this if I don't.

column9: "Soluble and microground coffee with natural flavors"
column10: This is basically the same technology as Starbucks VIA (whether it tastes better or worse is your call - I don't like VIA; this stuff is OK but not great.)  It's essentially freeze-dried instant coffee (that's the "soluble" part) mixed with ultrafine coffee powder to give it more body... and to leave that little extra dust in the bottom of your cup and grit between your teeth.The actual box does tell you - but you won't figure it out from the listing here on Amazon unless you read the reviews, so I'm pretty irritated.  It's a decent price for real coffee, but it's actually pretty damn expensive for instant.Now, as for what really matters: flavor.  It's actually not terrible; it reminds me of Douwe Egberts toddy coffee - full body and a fairly rich, mild flavor.The medium roast Grove Square is better than the Dark, IMO, and the Dark is a lot grittier in your mouth.Would not have bought this stuff if the listing had been up-front; will not buy again.

Do not buy this "coffee!"  I bought some at Walmart because of the price only to find that it's literally instant coffee in a K-Cup package.  Tastes awful.  Why buy an expensive single-cup dispenser only to use instant coffee???  This company should be shut down or sued for false advertising.
Bought this at a store because of the price. It is an Awful tasting instant coffee. Don't waste your time or risk your tastebuds.

Just had my first cup of this coffee.  It is strong, just how I like it, and has a nice aroma.  Because this is micro-ground it comes through the brewer much faster than the regular K-Cups.  I am not a coffee snob but do enjoy a good strong cup in the morning to get my motor running, this fits the bill just fine.  The price makes it a deal breaker, I just ordered more to add to my collection of different varieties of coffee.  I am well satisfied and hope you will be too.____UPDATE from my original review.  After using this for several weeks, I will have to agree that this is not up to snuff with regular K-Cups---I don't think it's as bad as some think but is not as good as the regular ground coffee.  Some people drink instant coffee and have no problem with it and others just don't like it.  This will wake you up in the morning, but does lack the flavor of the regular ground varieties.

column9: READ CLOSELY!!! This is instant coffee.  If you like instant coffee than you will like this.  If not, DO NOT BUY!!
column10: I bought this because of the great value.  I didnt read this very closely.  This is INSTANT COFFEE. If you like the taste of instant coffee than this is for you.  If you are like me and you like the real deal, Do NOT buy.

column9: Poor quality control and it's instant coffee
column10: I have two complaints about this product.First, for some reason, every one of the 24 cups brewed in my Keurig came out at four ounces instead of 12 ounces. I have no idea why. I pressed the large cup of coffee button on my machine, and four ounces of coffee came out.  I pressed the small cup of coffee button on the machine and four ounces of coffee came out.  After two years of using the Keurig, the Grove Square is the only product line this happens for.Second, it's instant coffee. For being instant coffee, it has a decent flavor.Very, very disappointed with this product. I wouldn't recommend this for anyone.

I do realize I missed the part where it said instant coffee, well I saw it but I thought it meant instant in the kuerig, not actually Folgers type instant coffee. However the so-called k-cups aren't kcups at all. They caused my Kuerig to malfunction and clog. And as if that weren't bad enough the actual coffe tasted burnt.Don't be like me, read and heed the reviews!!!! It's not worth a nickel let alone $20.

I can only get a little comfort in the fact that I wasn't the only one that missed the fact this is INSTANT coffee!  (Who would buy instant coffee in a K-Cup?  Not me - at least not knowingly!)  Having said that, I can't really rate the flavor, since I never (until this morning) drink instant coffee - but the double-sized cup I brewed this morning paled in comparison with my normal real K-Cup coffee.  The other 22 K-Cups of this *stuff* went right into the garbage can!
I hope you are reading these reviews.  I did not.  This is instant coffee inside a K-cup container.  The description is deceptive.
Avoid!!!  This is a bait and switch.  This is INSTANT coffee, about 1 tablespoons worth, in a K-cup.  Not even air sealed.  Folgers in a can is better than this.  Please, don't waste your money!

Anyone who owns a Keurig Coffeemaker obviously enjoys good, rich coffee.  Why anyone would market and sell this stuff is beyond me.  The first thing I noticed upon receiving my order was that the k-cups were extremely light; and when you shake them, you can hear the granular substance inside.  This is clearly, without a doubt, INSTANT COFFEE.The amount charged per box for these is ridiculous.  Two boxes down the drain, which in any case is still way better than in my cup.
This coffee smells and tastes like the old fashion instant coffee in a glass jar my parents used to drink when we were litte! Sanka comes to mind. Don't buy this unless you like instant coffee!

column9: OK coffee, but clogs the Keurig
column10: This Grove Square coffee tastes fine, when it brews.  The problem is that the coffee is ground too coarse.  Other brands are typically ground finer, allowing it to work with the Keurig machine.I cancelled my subscription to Grove Square, and went back to Coffee People.

This particular coffee had little flavor and generally only worked on the middle setting of the Keurig machine. Sometimes I had to run it a 2nd time using the first button[smallest amount.] It was not worth the aggravation and i would not recommend purchasing it.
This was a disappointing order. The coffee taste like instant coffee which is stated on the product. It dose have a good instant coffee taste if you want an instant coffee.

Saw a box of this coffee at the grocery store next to the Green Mountain K-cups and noticed it was a lot cheaper so I figured I'd give it a shot. Well the old sang 'you get what you pay for' doesn't even do justice here because this coffee is not worth $1 a box, never mind the $8 or so I spent on it.The taste of this coffee is what I imagine it would be like if you used a Green Mountain Coffee K-Cup, discarded of the used K-Cup in the trash, let it sit in the trash for a few weeks, and then took it out and tried to use it again.

column9: Terrible coffee, and clogged my coffee maker
column10: Not only does this "coffee" (instant crystals" taste terrible, but it clogged up my machine so badly that it took me about 2 hours to get it clean.  Avoid at ALL cost.
love this formula, its the best and when you buy in bulk, the price cannot be beat and really, your child will go through formula pretty quickly.

column9: Perfect cup of tea every time
column10: YUM, YUM, YUMMMY!!! I have a cup before I goto bed every night. I LOVE the k-cup system. Waaaay more affordable on Amazon too. I do the auto ship for the extra discount...believe me you will go through it.
I would recommend this tea for anyone who enjoys a good tasting cup of chamomile. Good value with the 2 pack.

I am so sorry I purchased a 24-pack of this tea for my new Keurig. It is absolutely tasteless. Celestial Seasoning's Sleepytime Tea is far superior in every way. Before I switched to Keurig, I used STASH Camomile, and it was great. This one is tepid and tasteless. I am never going to order any Bigelow product for my Keurig. It's too expensive to waste. Right now I use the Sleepytime and put an "Espresso" shot of the Bigelow Camomile in to use up the 24-pack. If you love Camomile, don't buy this one.

column9: Buy it here all the time!
column10: I love this tea for the Keurig and I always get the best value on Amazon!  I think this is the 3rd or 4th time I've purchased it here.
I drink this tea everynight before I go to bed and it helps to relax me and get the troubles of the day off of my mind.  The flavor and aroma are awesome as well.

This is a little strong for me on "setting 1" but perfect on the more diluted "setting 2." The price is right, a little more or less than $0.50/cup based on what I paid... wish k cups were a little more affordable but I'm beginning to consider Chamomile one of my "necessities" in life.

Number two is Timothy's. Number three by far is Twinnings, which was a disappointing cup of chamomile. I also tried I Love Lemon and Mint Medley and love both. All three flavors don't taste watered down like some others.

column9: Bigelow Tea Cozy Chamomile K-Cup For Keurig Brewers, 24-Count, Boxes (Pack of 2)
column10: Mmmm Yummy! Nice if you own a Keurig.  I only wish K-Cups were less expensive.  Less expensive would have given this product 5 stars.  Since I can only find the Chamomile Tea K-Cups online, I'll likely buy this product again.
This is fairly good, but the Timothy's version is better and costs a bit less.
I have always liked Campbell's Green Pea Soup.  It is smooth and doe not have those annoying split peas that other pea soups have.
The product tasted good.  I enjoyed them.  I would order again.  I love red velvet cake so I knew I would like red velvet petits fours.

This is my first time trying petit fours, and I must say they lived up to what I expected. If you like or want to try petits fours, I don't think you can go wrong with the Swiss colony brand. The whole cake was fresh and had a good taste to it.

column9: Strange name, but I enjoy Ashwagandha matcha every day
column10: A very nice tea. Strange name, great benefits. Must like Matcha tea in general to enjoy this one. Recommended for everyday use.

column9: Acai Matcha by RedLeafTea carries more protein than eggs!
column10: I hate eggs. I developed this aversion to them because my mother used to make me drink them raw when I was a kid. I felt more punished than healed and nothing in the world can make me eat an egg, no matter how well it is cooked. One problem, though, their protein source is excellent. I need the protein but not the egg. My online search finally bore fruit the other day when I came upon Acai matcha tea. This fine tasting tea has more protein than eggs. Hurray! What a relief...

column9: SKIMPY for the price charged!!  Shocked!
column10: Was shocked at the skinny size of this item!! They are five inches long as I expected, because that's the size I wanted and ordered, but can't be any bigger around than even a pencil and that's a BIG stretch!! WOW, I'm sure disappointed considering the cost ~~ $7 and shipping. Won't be ordering these again.  Of course my dog likes them ok, but wouldn't call them her fav by any means. :(  Will I send them back? Don't know if it's worth the hassle at this point. But I will NOT recommend them either. Because of the size quality and high price compared to so many other products to choose from!  Keep looking is my advice. :)  The other Beefeaters' products I ordered well met my standards. This one was a DUD!!  What's the old saying?  Buyer beware?  I fell into that trap big time!  Here's the product link at this time:  Beefeaters Great Fillin Porkhide Rolls with Meaty Chicken Filling, 5-Inch  Wish you luck if you try this product...but again "Buyer Beware!!"UPDATE 2.15.2012: My little dog got VERY SICK not too long after I wrote this review...I contacted Cust. Service with even more reason to not like this item and they refunded my money!! How's that for Customer Care?? :) Great!! Thank you Amazon.com ~~ you are TERRIFIC!!

My Scottish Terrier inhaled hers in about 2 hours, but my finicky Pomeranian, who usually turns his nose up at chew toys, loved it! It kept my Pom busy for a few weeks, but he really enjoyed it!Affordable price, fast shopping, great product!

It not like fresh- but how much time and energy do you have to find real buttermilk and have it on hand for spontaneous baking frenzies? This is great to have around, just keep it in an airtight  canister in a cool place. No, it's not for drinking. But powdered milk has never been for drinking, it's for preople who need to drive 30 miles to a grocery and need to cook a dinner party at the last minute.  I love this stuff, better biscuits and life easier.Keeping kitchen inventory up can be tough with perishables. This is a great idea.

i have tried other dry milk powdered  bobs non fat and buttermilk are the best  people say its not for drinking but since moving to ohio this tastes better then the milk you buy fresh. my fussy 20 yr old even likes this better

I already own the regular milk powder and used it in a white bread dough. It worked so now I am splurging ($22.93) on the buttermilk.  I keep buttermilk on hand in the fridge but fresh milk prices are always rising and I like not worrying about inventory.

I bought this buttermilk at the same time I bought Bob's Non-Fat Dry Milk. They both came in the same box in a few days. I don't use buttermilk other than for cooking, but it seems you have to make a trip to the store if you need some, or plan ahead. It tastes reasonably close to the store-bought variety, but is not that thick oozy stuff that comes from the store. So far I have used it to marinate chicken and it seems to work great, and augment or replace regular milk in other recipes. Seem fine. The plan is it check it out as a scratch mix substitute for store bought box mixes and dressings, but first I have to use up the store box mixes and dressing. The four bags from Amazon may last quite a while, but according to Bob's shelf life specifications, it should be fine.

I am echoing what others have said, but needed to put my 2- cents' worth in. This is great to have on hand, especially around the holidays or if you do a lot of baking.  Not for drinking, as others have said, but works just fine for your baking needs, or, as one baker put it, during a "baking frenzy"....
Great stuff. I always have it on hand for cooking anything that calls for buttermilk.

column9: Buttermilk when you can't get fresh.
column10: Great stuff, cooks like fresh buttermilk, easy to store in freezer. Buttermilk is not readily available in Central American countries, so I cook with this.

I ordered one pkg of Bob's Red Mill Buttermilk Powder a couple of months ago to try it.  I love it.  I can make as much as I need for baking, whenever I need it.  I don't have to throw out soured milk that I purchased from the store, and didn't use in time.  Taste's great, too. So, this time I bought several packages to store.

column9: Does this product contain Bovine Growth Hormone (BGH)!??
column10: Where does this milk powder come from?  Bob's Red Mill grinds flour in the Northwest but many of their products are "packaged" at their location but are not made there.This buttermilk powder did nothing for me.  It didn't make a better biscuit or waffle and it made my loaf bread less tasty than if I had used regular milk powder.  This wasn't a successful product for me and I still have not finished the first package.  I won't restock it when/if I run out of it.
I sent this to my Mother to store for emergency situations. She said it did not taste like buttermilk at all. OK for cooking but not drinking.

column9: Advertised as "White Coffee"... it is not
column10: The product is advertised as "white coffee" but in fact the name comes from the owner's name "White"... Has nothing to do with the "white coffee" whatsoever.It is as if my name would be "Kona" so the coffee that I would sell would be named "Kona coffee"...Other than that, a decent coffee.

I have switched my dog's from the terrible treats that come from China, and am glad that I found these Salmon Sticks!  My American Bulldog goes crazy for them!  Have already ordered more!  Highly recommend to give these a try!  Your dog will love them!

My 3 month old Labradoodle loves these. (I break them in half for her, but she gobbles them down in no time at all.) The only problem is you have to hold your nose when you open the bag - it smells like dead fish.  "The smell only a dog could love."
My dogs went crazy over these. They have a very strong fish smell, but if you like to make your dog happy, it's a great treat.

I have three little dogs. They love these sticks so I break pieciecs off as rewards for good behavior. they love it and look forward to thier reward.I have purchased these for a while and like to get them via amazon so easy.

It's sooooooooooooo good.  I love it.  When I've finished a bottle, I have to remind myself to stop at the bottom of the bottle, because the plastic does not taste good.  It tastes like plastic.  And after you eat the plastic, you usually get down to the countertop.  We have a cheap formica countertop and it tastes horrible.  And beneath that is a particle board-type substance that is very dry.  And it swells too.  So when you get to the bottom of the bottle, where the sauce stops, stop and open a new bottle, then begin eating again.  I'm currently working on a helmet that would hold 2 bottles (minimum) and dispense the crimson yumminess at my mere thought that some Sriracha might be nice.  But it's ruined several T.V. remotes so far in testing.  I know what you're thinking, but it takes weeks to get the smell out of your truck.  So, for now, I'll continue my work, and most folks should just stick to normal containers.

column9: The last reviewer was right on the money! Excruciatingly good! Ha!
column10: This is the best Sriracha sauce EVER! The heat is addictive because there is also sweet, salty and notes of garlic and tanginess of vinegar in this sauce that just makes you want to tip the bottle and pour it in your mouth.I'm seriously considering trying this as a topping on vanilla ice cream just to see what it would be like to have the heat with the cool-down of dairy. What? What? You think I'm crazy now? *innocent look*Obviously, anyone who forks out the dough for a 12 pack of 28-ouncers is a hard-core sriracha sauce addict and this was super fresh and bright red like I expect it to be and this tall order was shipped in perfect packaging.Anyone want to lick some sriracha sauce off my finger? *pulls finger away* Oh no you can't! You have to buy it for yourself! *wink*What is sriracha sauce good for?Stir friesEgg dishesRice dishesMeat dishesBarbecuesFish dishesVeggiesSoupsStewsPastaSaladsSalad dressingsSpicy mayoSpring rollsEtc. ad infinitumThe possibilities are limited only to your imagination.If you already know you love this stuff, this is an excellent deal!As of this review: 3.80 for each 28 0z bottle at the $45.60 w/free shipping via amazon.com.Viva the hot stuff and may you all sweat a little, burn a little and love a little.;)

I love this stuff!  I put it on just about every thing I eat.  It's the perfect amount of heat, but not over-powering.  My only complaint is the packaging.  Of the 12 bottle in my order, 2 had been busted open and went everywhere (this stuff turns in to concrete when it dries so it was quite a task to clean the remaining 10 bottles).I realize that this may be more of a complaint better directed to the shipper (i.e. UPS), but as the customer, I feel this is Amazon's battle to wage.  On that topic; I submitted this information to Amazon, along with a couple photos of the mess, but they never even responded with a confirmation, let alone offered a partial refund.  I'm not sure why Amazon even bothers to offer a way to submit satisfaction issues if they just ignore it.Regardless, still a great product...I might suggest you just buy it at your local grocery store instead of purchasing it here since there's no guarantee you'll get every thing you paid for from Amazon.

column9: I would eat this off of a dead hobo's finger.
column10: Perfect combination of hot, tangy, and a zest of garlic.Rice, Eggs, Pizza, Stir Fry, Burgers, anything you normally put Tobasco or what you've used to put on your food this can do better.Anything else....is just weak sauce.

column9: Part of our Dubai Survival Kit
column10: We can buy almost anything in Dubai except Sriracha sauce, so when I convinced my mom to visit us here for the holidays, I had my sauce delivered to her house, and she "smuggled" it here.My wife even plans on "smuggling" a couple of bottles to Vietnam when she goes home for Tet. Now isn't that an example of how good the sauce is?

Seriously, you don't want to live without it. This sauce is not that hot - well, it is hot, but it is also full of flavor, it goes on just about everything. I keep a bottle at work as well, it makes even so-so lunch taste better. I say even if you don't like hot food, give this a try - it will grow on you. Maybe you should not start with 12 28-oz bottles, but give it a try, really.

column9: I cannot live with out this stuff
column10: Best sauce on the planet and I believe this is the best price you'll find it at.  My favorite food enhancement, it goes into everything I make - including popcorn.

column9: Bow wow review of Dog Biscuts
column10: I have 2 sixty pound American Staffordshire Terriers, aka Pitt Bulls. Mugsy and Spookey seem to realy enjoy the Biscuts. I ordered 2 boxes of Biscuts, which in the future, I'll only order one box at a time. As I did not relize how much twenty pounds of dog biscuts are.Wells SPORTMiX Golden Dog Biscuit Treats, Extra Large - 20 lb. Bag A lot to say the least.

I ordered two boxes of these bones for my commercial kennel.  I chose the Sportmix products because I was assured by their customer service rep (who responded to my inquiry within the hour) that the ingredients and manufacturing are US-based.  I do not purchase foreign pet food ingredients - particularly China-made pet products.  I am thoroughly happy with the apparent palatability of the bones.  The dogs fall over each other to get one.  I am a little dissatisfied with the condition of many of the bones - about 20% of them are broken due to packaging.  They are not stacked - just loosely placed in the box to be knocked around during delivery.  This is the only thing I can fault, though.  Otherwise, a fair priced, quality, USA MADE product.

Generally the dog biscuits are great if not such a high percentage would be broken. The point in buying extra large biscuits is the "extra large", small pieces miss the reason for buying theme in the first place. There has to be a better way to pack the biscuits better than this.

Wow! Elephant seasoning is an instant classic. I use Elephant on my burgers, dogs, fires, veggies, steaks, fish.... on and on. My lovely girlfriend can't live without it. This is a great savory seasoning to use on everything. I really like it for fish but it's also great for red meat and all kinds of veggies. It's a new label design from what they used to sell at Joe Patti's Seafood but it's the same stuff.

column9: Elephant Seasoning by Chef Carlos is the best
column10: I'm so happy to find the Elephant Seasoning online. I moved to Nashville and couldn't buy it here.  I love this stuff! It is wonderful on everything.  I'm lucky enough to have eaten food prepared by Chef Carolos and his daughter.  They always used this seasoning and everybody raved about the meal.  You will not be disappointed in this product.  This seasoning is a must-have for serious cooks.

column9: medium-grade tea with no distinctive apricot taste
column10: [Edit to add: A friend stayed at my house for a week recently and said "This is the most delicious tea I've ever had in my life."  She's a huge tea fan, so that is definitely saying something.  So, I've upped my star rating to a 4 (that's the average of my opinion (3) and her opinion (5)).  In light of her reaction, this tea may well be worth a try.]Original review:I live in Japan where we drink oolong tea daily.  I usually buy my flavored teas in the US, because here in Japan they emphasize the aroma of the tea as it is brews rather than the taste, whereas in the US they emphasize the quality of the taste over the quality of the aroma.  This offers nothing outstanding in either area.  The aroma is present but nothing fantastic, and I can't taste the apricot in this at all.This is an upper medium-grade oolong tea, not the delicate high-grade Chinese oolong I was expecting at this price.  This is important because oolong tea is stunning when high-grade, perfectly nasty when low-grade, and merely OK when medium-grade.  It's upper medium-grade, so still very good, but not the stunning flavor I was expecting at this price.  (On reflection, perhaps the high price comes from the fact that it is organic, rather than from using only the highest-grade tea leaves.)Visually all the teas from this series are very appealing and they are ready to give "as is" if you need a housewarming gift, gift for your child's teacher, etc.  The package closes securely so you don't need to worry about the tea leaves not keeping well.

We purchased this from Amazon as our local store was only carrying this occasionally. It is the exact same product. It is a fast dinner that you can throw in a crock pot and do the rest when you get home. My family loves this. We have a problem, half the family cannot have dairy products, so we make the first part which is dairy free. Then we split it in two and add the sour cream to the one half. Both ways are very good. I chop the mushrooms finely and our picky eaters never know they are in there. I put the entire thing over egg noodles to complete the meal. We usually use two packets to make a double recipe because it gets eaten so fast. We never have any left overs. I highly recommend this product. McCormick has a real winner here.

The bags leave tiny shreds of cotton from the bag lining and string attachments in the tea while brewing. I guess the cotton they use is too fluffy.  Also the tea is too light and not as full bodied/full flavored as I would prefer.

This green tea has a nice robust but complex flavor that can be enjoyed hot or cold. Some green teas have a good flavor, like Stash green tea, but the flavor is very subtle and simple so you don't get the full green tea experience. This tea is very refreshing, and calming even. Green tea has one of the most potent antioxidants known to man, EGCG, it also has L-Theanine which is a unique, calming amino acid found almost exclusively in green tea. As is mentioned in the detailed info, the teabags are entirely compostable.
Delicate, fragrant, delightful. The tea leaves are contained in delicate, upscale silky tea bags. The taste is not too thick or heavy, but it's not tasteless either. Perfect - just too pricey.
I fell in love with this green tea, has a unique flavor.  It's light like a green tea should be, and has a slight fruity flavor.  Best Green Tea i've had yet.

column10: This is by far my preferred tea. It is great at any time of the day and it preserves it flavor even when it is cold. This brand is available only in a few stores where it goes for $9.99 the box.

Table is big and heavy, don't know how some reviewers are claiming to be just over 5 feet and pick this up with no problem. I am 5'4 and have trouble with this. However, it is very good quality, nice massage table, I love using it.
Hard to find a tapenade without capers or other common GI irritants.  Tasty and works well on sandwiches.  So, this is great..

This is  delicious, aromatic maple syrup like I remember in my childhood.  It is not super thick like the grocery store sells, but a thinner, tastier syrup.  We especially like the two jugs - one the use now and one to save, for a little while!  We definitely will buy more later.

column9: Excellent black tea for brewing Kombucha
column10: My Kombucha scoby babies seem to go crazy for this very basic black tea. They also like Tetley but the Lipton seems to be their food of choice. column9: Black Tea is Beautiful!  The Jewel in Lipton's Crown
column10: I love tea and have been a tea drinker since childhood. When I had my first sip of tea, I knew tea was for me!Lipton was the tea I was introduced to many years ago.  As one of the few tea drinkers in a family of coffee drinkers, Lipton and I go back a long ways.  Over the years, I have gotten to know and love many other brands and flavors of tea.  If you want a good, healthy staple, then you want to drink this tea.I love oolang; white, black, green, and herbal tea.  I found that this tea is quite good, iced or piping hot and fresh in your tea pot.  I love it!  Black tea also has many health properties and I highly recommend black tea.  It is very soothing and if you are drinking your black tea while listening to some soothing George Harrison, it doesn't get any better than that!  It is an ideal stress buster and a nice part of your day.Excellent tea.  I highly recommend it!

column9: Not the best black tea, but the best value.
column10: I think my title sums it up. This is far from the best tea, and I routinely drink better tea. Deference is that tea cost more, were as this tea taste just fine and is cheap. ordinary black tea.not very brilliantsmells good but the taste is fair.312 bags could last a year for meDDDDD

Excellent value for the dollar when on sale - makes a wonderful cup of tea. Product arrived promptly and of the same quality as in supermarkets.
This is a very good item.I will my friends about this great buy.
A lifetime favorite that never disappoints.  The package arrived as expected and cost was a great deal.  I would definitely order the Lipton tea again.
My favorite tea of all time I totally enjoy drinking Lipton tea before and after I wake in the morning

The taste and the packaging is great. It came in three boxes so you can store the rest. The tea bags are a bit smaller, that makes it less strong for average drinker and you don't waste as much when you serve individual cups.
Ready for the Summer. Put 8 bags in a large pitcher of water, put it in the fridge over night and remove the Tea bags in the morning. Perfect, flavorful clear tea all day long.

column9: Ice tea quenches thirst like nothing else
column10: I must admit I love my Jasmine Tea (Ito En Jasmine Japanese Green Tea, 16.9-Ounce Bottles (Pack of 12) but I can't down more than a bottle of it a day, it gets a bit cloying if I do.So I switch over to this old standby and I can drink a gallon of it a day.  One tea bag will honestly make an entire gallon if you have a jar that big and let it steep for a few minutes.I live in a very hot humid subtropical environment and we all love our iced tea here.  I don't use sugar but I mix in so much lemon juice it's almost half lemonaid.  And it must be ice cold.  This can be watered down or made very strong depending on your taste.  I like mine on the watery side.  This can be a bit acidic if you make it strong.  It is a very strong tea with a strong flavor so making it weak works well with this.I probably have a dozen types of teas on my shelf but along with my daily bottle of jasmine tea I drink this the most.It has a distinctive flavor I never get tired of.  It's almost like a comfort food to me, as I grew up drinkingLipton Tea.  It's  been around forever.  Constant Comment Bigelow Constant Comment Tea, 20-Count Boxes (Pack of 6)is another old standby tea worth trying.

I found the quality of tea inconsistent. I think it is a Lipton issue rather than anything to do with Amazon.I have had one experience like this with store-bought Lipton tea bags before. I wish I had remembered that before I ordered this.I would recommend going in for some other tea like Tazo Awake or some other English Breakfast tea.
This is a premeium product at a great price.Hot or cold, it will perk you up!  Brew this tea everyday!

I have found that Lipton has almost no flavor (it used to, some years ago).  I currently have about 20 different teas on hand, most from English or Asian manufacturers, which have a noticeable flavor.  If you love tea, try one of the imports.  You'll be surprised how bland Lipton really tastes.

Lipton has been my tea of choice for many years.  I drink it English style, with milk & sugar.  In my experience, Lipton's is the only brand that holds it fabulous flavor after adding the accoutrements.  Great price and nice to have a subscription so I never run out.
Fantastic for making good old southern style sweet tea. Consistent quality and a good price from subscribe and save. This black tea is the one I always reach for.
My purchase of Lipton Tea 312-Count Bags was a great value. The same product at a North Jersey supermarket would cost much more. Amazon.com prices are very reasonable.

Getting the 312 count, three boxed set of Lipton black tea sent at regular intervals saves me time and money.  Thanks Amazon my most trusted online store for offering me this service

This is truly a great product and at a great price. Great product! I drink alot of this tea. Highly recommended.

column9: Crunchy. Tasty. Good Nutrients. Nice Snack.
column10: I'm always looking for snacks that might be tasty and nutritionally good at the same time. A month or so ago I found "Majans Bhuja Cracker Mix" and liked it very much. As such I continued looking and found "Majans Buja Original Mix. It's a rather similar assortment of rice crackers, crisp noodles, green peas, peanuts, and sultanas. Plus, there's an assortment of flavors and other minor ingredients. It's crunchy and  chewy and tastes good. The calories are not particularly high and the snack has a good protein and fiber content. It's low fat with no cholesterol. The sodium content is fairly low. Nice mixture of characteristics. One thing I might add that this snack is fairly filling. I've had little tendency to eat the whole bag at one sitting such as I can often do with potato chips and things of that sort. It's a product of Australia. I discovered it in a nearby Fresh and Easy Store, which happens to be and English company. It's good to find a few snacks like this and Bhuja come in several varieties, juist in case you like to switch around a bit. I find these a bit spicy and prefer the other variety I had.Gary Peterson

column9: Its pretty good. Tasty and delicious
column10: Nice snack for tea or coffee time in afternoon. right amount of spicy. its not oily as other spicy gram noodles you get in Indian stores across US

I received this item today and it came in great condition..with ice ice packs. Nice chocolate! I plan on using this with Mint flavored brownies.
I made a mistake and thought this was shampoo and it was conditioner. It works good as such. It smells good and makes fur soft.
This conditioner works well with the companion shampoo. It really makes my Maltese soft AND white!  Love it! Smells good too!
This conditioner is light and works great.Its not heavy and wont weight down my dogs coat- leaves it nice and fluffy and soft.Smells terrific!I recommend it!

I would send it back but with the damaged bottle, there would just be more leaking and it might damage something else.  Fortunately, I was able to rinse the rest of the contents off and there was no damage.  The crack is not very noticeable with the bottle being in the bag. I can see why it was missed. I am just glad I did not have anything that would have been ruined.  I hate returning products.

column9: 13 flavors, nice sampler, long use by dates, great for K-cup starter
column10: I received this as a gift for xmas 2011. I also posted a picture of the sampler. There are 13 flavors included in this 20 tea sampler:2 - Celestial Seasonings lemon zinger2 - Celestial Seasonings Green tea with white tea for smooth taste2 - Gloria Jean's Peppermint Herbal*2 - Twinings Pure Peppermint2 - Timothy's English Breakfast*2 - Bigelow Mint Medley*2 - Green Mountain Naturals Hot Apple Cider1 - Twinings English Breakfast1 - Twinings African Rooibos Red1 - Twinings Pure Camomile1 - Twinings Earl Grey1 - Bigelow Orange & Spice Herb*1 - Timothy's Lemon Blueberry Passion** does not specifically indicate decaf on the package -- this is a little concerning to me. I would have preferred a little less duplication...how about 20 different teas!? We are just starting out with a Keurig, so wanted to try samplers first. I bet that almost every box that goes out is different. So, I'd likely buy again (and hope that there is less peppermint options if it's not holiday time, but that's just personal preference!). Not sure if Tazo or Traditional Medicinals makes K-cups, but would love to see some of those in the box! Was also happy to see apple cider in the box.Also important to note, the use by dates on the teas range from 4/12 to 2/13!4 stars for nice packaging, decent variety, and long use by dates. Would give 5 stars for 20 different teas!!

I bought this item for my in-laws for Christmas as they don't drink caffinated beverages. It arrived and at least half were not decaf. One actually said on the label "Contains Caffeine". So, I contacted Amazon and they sent another, free of charge, over night. It arrived and 4 of them were not decaf. Be careful to check that you get what you ordered.

I'll be buying another one soon!  Just a side note, this product comes in a regular cardboard box and probably shouldn't be labeled as a 'gift pack'.  Be aware if you are purchasing as a gift.

column9: Great if you prefer decaf tea.
column10: Decaf is our first choice which is why we purchased this product.  Nice variety for when you want to sip a cup!

Got this product for a gift. It was received with GREAT THANKS. She LOVED the variety and looked forward to enjoying all of the flavors included. If there is a tea lover in your family or friend list, you won't go wrong in giving this to them. Go for it if YOU LOVE TEA. Since I use Amazon Prime, this came in in the two day FREE delivery time frame. I LOVE AMAZON PRIME.

This Decaf sampler gave me a wonderful opportunity to taste some teas I may not have ordered otherwise.  The sampler itself came in a really nice box in which each K-Cup was inserted into its own slot.  It would make an excellent gift box.  The sampler also led me to a couple of teas that I liked so much I purchased.  I don't think you'd go wrong trying this for yourself.

I received my 2 tea Samplers sets today and they were nicely packaged, in a flip top box in individual spots. This would be suitable for gift giving. There's a nice variety in there with no more than 2 of any given flavor. All were labeled as decaf. I'll be ordering them again, if they come up at the price I paid.

I hoped to be different, but like other reviewers I did not recieve a very good mix of "samples". I recieved 6 mints, 8 earl grays, etc leaving me with just a few to try instead of 10 different kinds like i hoped. Luckily, i really did like the mint so it sorta kinda worked out in the end.

Since it's extremely difficult to buy caffeine free teas, except Sleepytime, at stores, I decided to purchase the variety pack on Amazon.  What a great variety of teas and every one was wonderful.  I also bought a box of decaf green tea on Amazon and was happy with that one too.

I was quite embarrassed when my wife opened the box and the K-cups were just thrown in the cardboard box.  An earlier reviwer's comments regarding the deceptive wording about the packaging apply here.  At least our adult children that were over for the holidays got quite a laugh out of it. I like teas and my husband and I wanted an assortment for out K-cup maker.  It included Earl Grey, English breakfast, red rooibos, orange spice, mint, camomile, and others. Very tasty.

Received this in the mail today.  This is exactly what I was looking for, a variety of teas with no rhyme or reason.
