If it were cheaper, I would probably buy more to see if I could cook with it.  However, had I known just how small the bag is, and just how few pieces of chocolate I was getting, I would not have purchased this.  I gave it 3 stars because it does taste good, but it is just way too pricey for what you get.  If you have a diabetic friend and want to splurge on a treat, this would be a nice gift.

This mix has a good assortment of flavorful mushrooms that are great in stews.  I especially enjoy them in stews made with beef or lamb.  The can also be used in pasta sauces (try soaking, draining, sauteing to bring out more flavor).Can't beat the price for a good supply of dry mushrooms!

column9: A good bunch of mixed dried mushrooms
column10: I tried the Angenlina's Gourmet wood ears, which were OK but not great, and these as well. These are a good mix of a variety of dried mushrooms. The bag had a bit of powder and some very small bits in it, but aside from that all of the mushrooms were of good quality.A few had stems that never really re-hydrated (a good fresh shitake often has a tender enough stem you can eat it along with the rest of the mushroom), so that was a waste of money, but most were good.These wood ears are not quite the same as the tree ears I am used to (re-hydrating to a brown color and not being quite as crispy as the tree ears I have used before).On the whole, this is a good price of a whole bunch of dried mushrooms in one bag.

column9: Dried tart cherries from the Cherry Capital of the World!
column10: My first experience with dried tart cherries was when I went to visit a friend from Traverse City, Michigan about ten years ago.  As a teenager, she had worked in the cherry plant removing pits from the fruit, not uncommon for natives of the Cherry Capital.  She took me down to Meijers to buy a box of dried tart cherries to carry home on the plane as a special treat.Then a few years ago, I began buying cherries at Trader Joe's and they became a pantry staple for me. Once I realized my friend could get them on sale at Meijers and ship them to me for a significant savings and slight quality advantage over the ones I had been buying, I asked her to do that several times.  It never occurred to me to look for them on Amazon where the cost is about the same as having them shipped from Traverse City and I won't have to bother my friend.Normally I do not buy sweetened fruit of any kind but the slight amount of sugar is necessary due to the tartness of the cherries, much as lemonade or cranberry juice must be sweetened, and it is completely unnoticeable.  A slight bit of oil is also required to keep them from turning into a solid mass of moist chewy goodness!A few of these are great in smoothies, but not too many, as the flavor is very intense.  I also enjoy them in oatmeal and cold cereals, with milk chocolate, and out-of-hand as a snack.  Once, after carelessly mistaking them for raisins and adding them to scones, I got a very pleasant surprise!  They are great in rice pudding, crème brûlée, ice cream, and chicken salad.A wonderful one-dish lunch or light summer supper is "Barley, Bacon and Avocado Salad with Roasted Chicken", but with these dried tart cherries added.  The recipe is easy to find on the internet.If you ever have the chance to go to Traverse City to see the cherry blossoms or the fall leaves up on the peninsula, please take advantage of the opportunity as you will surely enjoy it.  Now if I could just get Honeybell tangelos from Amazon, I'd be set!These are the smaller half-pound containers that make great little gifts.  The bulk box is a bit less expensive by weight:  Traverse Bay Dried Cherries, 4-Pound Box.

As you can see from the reviews for the other sized containers of these cherries, they are really something special!  I used to choose my breakfast cereal from a cupboard full of 20 or so assorted varietes of cold cereals to keep more morning meal interesting, but now that I have these cherries, I actually look forward to having the same oatmeal with cherries every morning!  I sprinkle a handful in the bowl with 3/4 c. quick oats and 1 cup milk (for the calcium), microwave for 2 minutes, and it just makes my morning; and I am fully satisfied until lunch.  The cherries have the perfect amount of tartness and are soft enough to chew easily (not dried and leathery like some dried fruit).  Also, they don't come in bags, as advertised here, but in clear round containers with replaceable lids.  And they are cheaper than the bagged SunMaid ones in the grocery store!  This quantity lasted me about two months, so I just bought some more.

I loved these.  They did look a lot like raisins...but tasted better.  Some were more dried up than others.  Some were really "meaty".  They came in 4 plastic sealed transparent plastic tubs. The plastic tubs were about the size of a normal tub of store-bought pimento cheese spread. There were no pits or stones in any of the ones I got. I understand that finding pits or stones is not an unusual occurrence with dried cherries, but I didn't have any. I wouldn't like to chew down on one unknowingly.  Next time I plan to order the larger box of these.  I didn't use them as any thing but a snack, but I would like to try them in a dessert bread.  I have had them in salads before and if they are given time to "plump up" they are very good.

I bought these because my toddler loves to snack on dried cherries, but the cost of getting dried cherries can be a little rough.  I was buying Mariani (sp?) brand bags from the store, which ran almost 4 dollars for just a couple ounces.  I figured there had to be something better. So I ordered this to see if it would work out, as 2 lbs for 14.00 and change (using subscription), was quite a bit cheaper. I have to agree with the other ratings: these cherries are awesome!  They have much better "cherry" flavor than the Mariani ones, have better color, and are just a tad softer to boot.  They're dried, but not so dried out that they're ridiculously tough like dried fruits can be.  The tart cherry flavor comes through really well, while not being bitter eating. I've been tempted to snack on them myself a few times! Having them in small containers versus all in one bag is also extremely handy for keeping the supply fresh.  If Amazon keeps the price this good, I won't be buying from the store ever again.

These dried cherries, along with the blueberries from this same company, are soft and a nice texture and flavor. They are not the typical tough, dry, chewy, dried fruit you normally get from other places. These work very well in homemade breads or just to snack on. I'm anxious to try some of Traverse Bay's other products as well now that I'm so happy with their dried fruits. Very good quality product.

column9: Plump, Delicious, and an Excellent Value
column10: Product: Traverse Bay Dried Cherries (4pk of 8oz each, 2lbs total)A quick glance though my 100+ oookbook reviews will show I'm no slouch when it comes to global cuisine, and diverse ingredients.  This product (both the cherries and the blueberries) marked the very first instance where I  bought a dried fruit product online, and was not disappointed.The cherries are all evenly ripe, tart, plump, deeply flavorful, and only lightly sweetened.  They also have a very light coating of oil to seal in their moisture, and prevent clumping.  They're perfect for snacking, and wonderful in oatmeal, muffins and scones.  I've also minced them into sauces, stir fry, and salads, muddled them into lemonade (imparting a pink color and a fruity note), and I also plan to use a few of them to add a subtle nuance to an upcoming homemade mead and a cherry-infused liqueur.I'm very happy with this product, and given that I own a vaccum sealer and plenty of glass jars with universal lids, they should have an excellent shelf life.Highly recommended.

I also wasn't aware first that Amazon has variety of dried fruits and berries to offer. I used to buy dried cherries in Trader Joe for months but wasn't particulary excited about them. I'm on my own diet for cholesterol reduction where both almonds and cherries are playing significant role as powerfull antioxidants. Since fresh cherries available only very limited time during summer, dried cherries became a great alternative. I'm using them everywhere - cereal, oatmeal, bran muffins, cakes, goose stuffing etc... you name it.. Traverse Bay offers very convenient packaging - resealable 8 oz caps. Usually 1 cap is enough for 1-1.5 weeks... Taste is great, they don't even feel like dried, cherries are very moist with incredible texture. Highly recommended.

I actually live in Michigan and every year head up to Traverse City for the cherry fest. It was during a cherry fest like 6-7 years ago that I was introduced to Traverse Bay dried cherries and cranberries. I have never eaten another brand since. If you like dried fruit then look no further. Traverse Bay sells Dried Cherries, Dried Organic Cherries, Dried Organic Blueberries, Dried Wild Blueberries, Dried Red Raspberries, and Dried Strawberries. Just check out the companies homepage. They even offer subscription based shipping just like Amazon. They also sell a bunch of other stuff as well including antioxidant fruit based vitamins, Jams, fruit concentrates, etc..Dried cherries and dried cranberries are my favorites and I have actually tried a lot of different brands over the years. None of them have the quality, freshness and flavor that Traverse Bay has. I eat them out of the box, on cereal, in salads, and even in homemade ice cream. Dried cherries, or any other dried fruit for that matter, is a great snack.The bottom line - If your looking for high quality dried cherries then look no further. By the way if you love cherries and have never been to the cherry fest in Traverse City then I highly recommend you check it out. Its a great time!!5 Stars!
Enjoyed these, just like other dried cherries i've had.  no high fructose corn syrup so that's nice

If you enjoy dried fruit, do not hesitate. This is an awesome product. Fast shipping. Well packaged. The 8oz plastic tubs the cherries come in are the perfect size to set in a desk drawer so you have a healthy snack at work. Great on the bland oatmeal I'm supposed to eat in the morning. I would consider buying the larger bulk box (cheaper by quantity) and just get a re-sealable container to put them in. Delicious!

I bought these from amazon because it is cheaper to buy in bulk than to buy expensive little bags from the grocery store. These cherries have the perfect blend of sweetness and tartness and they retained their moisture well. Just a note: they do have added sugar, but I don't have a problem with that. They would probably be great for baking and salads etc. but I just eat them plain and they make a great snack!

We visit Northern Michigan every summer, and cherries are such a big part of our trip.  For Christmas this year I bought Grand Traverse cherries for my friends here.  It is so nice to support family businesses and American farms.

These are the best dried cherries I've ever had.  Moist, chewy, and a great combination of tart and not overly sweet.  I enjoyed them much more than the typical brands of dried cherries available in most supermarkets.  I would absolutely buy these again.
These arrived in good condition and they were delicious.  I sent them as a hostess gift and they were veyr well received.  I am going to order them again for holiday gifts.
These dried cherries taste great.  We eat them in cereal, chutneys, by themselves, and in other dishes.  Now that I can buy them online, I will never run out.

I love love LOVE these cherries!  I was visiting friends in Davison, Michigan (just outside of flint) and they had these cherries in their grocery store. I would always stock up when I visited (5 hours is a bit of a drive). So, when I found out I could order these cherries, I was so excited! Four easily portable containers come in the box and they're absolutely delicious.

I have been getting these cherries and the dried blueberries from Traverse Bay Fruit Co for over a year.  I actually have a subscription to get the package of 4 containers of cherries and 3 containers of blueberries once a month.  They are sooooo gooood. I have them with oatmeal, cheerios, in salads and just as a snack.  They are not sweetened, but they are very satisfying for the sweet tooth.  Walnuts compliment the dried cherries quite well. I would recommend these good fruit products to anyone who was looking for a snack that was also beneficial to your health.

I use dried fruit when baking and cherries are my favorite.  These are excellent.  My only complaint would be that they contain a bit more sugar than I desire.  I buy an order twice a year and find they maintain their quality well.  The taste is great.  The fruit stays moist and juicy.  It works well for making sauces and added to salads.  I will continue to order them through Amazon's subscribe and save program as I think they are a good deal.

Excellent product.  I've been buying these cherries for a long time now. I get them once a month.  And sometimes I can't wait for more so I order an extra shipment. The cherries are very sweet and tart at the same time.  I'm very happy with the taste and will continue to buy them.  Amazon ships them fast and in very good condition.

Wow. My husband and I are speechless. He is a huge dried cherry fan & we spend our lives trying to find The Kind. They are always in small bags, expensive, pitted, or just gross. To say the least, I'm not a fan in general of dried cherries. I decided to search dried cherries on amazon a few weeks ago and went through all the reviews for each kind. The reviews for this item were all super great, so I figured- why not? They weren't that expensive.Then we got them. Now, they are gone. OMG THEY ARE SO DELICIOUS. I actually ate more than my husband, he was pissed (lovingly so). I don't even like dried cherries- but these are SO good! If kids delicious fun-fruit snacks had a baby with oversized super plump raisins- this would be the demi-god child.Pros:- I've never tasted anything SO DELICIOUS for a dried fruit, my husband agrees- Sweetened enough to be "sweet" but bland enough to know it's a healthy dried fruit- No Pits found in any of our containers so far (and we've had a ton)- Nice packaging, four small little stackable containers- Good arrival time & packaging- GREAT priceCons:- We are going to eat so much that we will either turn into a dried cherry... or... end up hating them forever because we are stuffing our faces full.- You are still reading this and not clicking Buy Item haha

I wanted cherries because they help sleep.  These are very good as snack or in food.  And indeed I am sleepier after eating a few.  Being dried they are handier to keep and easy to use.  These have a good flavor and are not tough or plastic in texture.I will buy them again.

column9: Traverse Bay Dried Cherries are the best
column10: This is an excellent product. There should be extra stars for the rating.  They make perfect tasty giftsthat everyone enjoys.Thank you Traverse Bay...Maureen

I love dried fruit, and eat a lot of it. I have found cherries to be a bit tricky to find in a reasonable price and not be overly sweetened or overly dried or just plain mushy. The good reviews of others on the site spurred me to try this product and I am glad to say that I am now a devotee...The cherries come in small enough containers to cart around if I need to take a snack with me, and the quality of the dried fruit is the best I've had of cherries in a long time. They are just the right amount of 'dry' and just the right level of 'tart' and just the perfect sweet treat.I eat them as is, but I also added them to cereal, yogurt, muffins, and scones. They are AMAZING with vanilla icecream, and are just plain lovely in an orange-pound-cake that I recently made for the holidays. Everyone commented on the cherries in the pastry and asked for more.The price of the two pounds total (four tabs of 8oz each) is also very reasonable as far as dried fruit in general, and cherries in particular. This is a keeper.I will be getting more of those, that's for sure!
These are much better than the dried cherries at my local grocery store.  Delicious and very addictive!

Wonderful dried cherries. It's sweet with a slight tartness. I ordered and dried blueberries to see which one I like more. The next time I'm in the states, I'm going to order the bigger box of both. That's the only draw back to these item; Amazon won't ship to APOs.

Best dried cherries I have found so far. Arrived in good condition. Not too dry, not too sweet not too tart.  Great for bread baking. Note that Traverse soaks the cherries in a sugar solution so they are considerably sweeter  than unsweetened dried cherries. From what I call tell from websites selling unsweetened cherries the impact on calories is negligible.

I LOVE these dried cherries from the cherry capital, Traverse City, Michigan!  I have purchased them many times before, but in 4lb containers.  These smaller, resealable containers are much more convenient and each have just the amount you'd normally use at a time.
These dried cherries are delicious. They are so moist and plump. Good to eat alone or mixed in cereal, muffins, scones, etc.
Loved it! It is smooth creamy with pieces of fig and raspberries throughout it. I had a hard time just eating one piece!I would definitely recommend this chocolate bar!
I usually don't like coconut water/juice but this was awesome! It's sweet and refreshing. SunTropics in general is so awesome at packing real fruit taste.

column9: Clean sweet flavor without off flavored aftertaste
column10: I like the clean sweet flavor of this coconut juice. No off flavor aftertaste. I've probably tried 90% of all coconut waters commercially available in the United States. I usually rate them by garbage, bad, okay, and superior. This coconut water would fall under the superior category. Note, pulp means there's small soft easily swallowed pieces of coconut floating throughout the beverage. The first time I tried pulp it took some getting used to. Now I like drinking pulp but if you've never tried it I would not recommend starting out with a case.

column9: Ain't no coconut water better than Sun Tropics Coconut water
column10: This is like young coconut in a can! It tastes like a young coconut freshly picked.  Has the electrolyte of Gatorade without all the unnatural sugar and sodium! How can you beat that?
This is by far the best coconut juice I've ever had.  I've tried many different kinds and SunTropics' is the best!

We love this!  We've purchased all the ones in the market like Vita Coco, Taste Nirvana, ONE, C2O, Amy & Brian and found that this one tastes the freshest.  It's the closest in taste to drinking right out of the coocnut.  I also wish there is subscribe and save for this.  Would love the additional savings and the auto ship on this.
tastes is clean and crisp!  i like the pulp - it's a very nice touch.  no aftertaste, and healthy as well.  am looking to add it as an ingredient for making smoothies.
I have used this salt for years. Wonderful product. I have both coarse and fine.Coarse I use in a grinder while cooking. Fine, I use at the table, or to finish a dish if needed.

I bought this, lured in by the price and organic nature of the product.  It is awful.  Very bitter taste, with a acid finish.  From first drop to last, it just isn't good, even with cream and sugar added.  Look for Jeremiah's coffee instead.  Much better.
I was really looking forward to this coffee since the San Francisco Blend was good.  However, this decaf is tasteless even if you double the amount of beans to grind.

column9: Very good coffee...love that it's organic and comes right to my door at a reasonable price!
column10: I'm a rather avid coffee drinker and have purchased many different brands over time. Though this is not quite as good as what we brought back ourselves from Costa Rica, both my husband and I really enjoy this coffee and have it shipped regularly. Overall good value.

column4: natural momma "Mom to many, wife to 1"
column10: Got this on an Amazon deal...ended up with 6 pounds of organic coffee for less than $4/pound.  SHoudl have bought more...it is a great coffee.

about 50% of the time the beans are bone dry and the flavor speaks for itself.  I have told customer support and hopefully there will be a change.  When the beans are fresh and oily this is a great coffee.
This is my favorite coffee to buy online. I blend it with several other coffees and it always greatly improves the blend. I do not know how it tastes alone.

Very good product, was surprised at the very good condition of the item'sarrival, nothing broken or leaking.Bought item for my wife for Christmas and have had to hide it from friendsto have any left for her.Would buy this item again.

I used to purchase liquor-filled chocolate bottles for X-mas for quite a few years.  They were excellent and hoped to get them THIS year.  The product web site was being upgraded so I had to 'settle' for these.  What a nice surprise to find that they truly were NOT 'second best'  These 'bottles' were much larger than the ones I used to get, hence, more liquor filling.  I'm not that familiar with all the true tastes of the different 'spirits' but I felt they were all very good.  I'd recommend these to anyone.
These are freakin amazing.  The Grand Mariner alone is worth the cost.  Buy one for yourself, and one for the rest of the family.

We had received the Anthon Berg 64 piece Chocolate Liqueurs with Original Spirits as a gift for Christmas 2008.  When I saw these on Amazon I ordered them for my mother right away (for Christmas 2009).  The price was very competitive, best I'd seen actually, and we already knew the chocolates were superb.  Well, there was a problem with almost all of the chocolates arriving damaged which dries them out.  I made a remark on Amazon and the Candy Shoppe contacted me to get in touch with them.  I'd like to mention that The Candy Shoppe was professional, polite and cheerful, explaining to me that in an effort to be more "green" they were working out issues finding suitable packaging. That's understandable and commendable. What was even more impressive was that they had my replacement order packed and shipping WHILE I WAS ON THE PHONE WITH THEM.  The chocolates arrived undamaged and as delicious as we remembered them. We will most definitely be buying from them again in the future when we are looking for this wonderful product.

Just a quick note. The item is great. The party I gave it to loved it.Now the bad. I tried 3 times to contact the seller to make sure the item was received on time, which was Xmas. After 3 attempts and no replies the item arrived on the 30th of December. I have yet to hear from this seller and would advise steering clear of this person or company whatever the case may be.If you want it on time pay a bit extra and let Amazon handle it I'm sure you'll be much more satisfied unless of course you do not care to get it where it's going sometime or whenever this seller deems it appropriate and convenient to him and not you.

After reading the reviews of this product I was slightly reluctant to spend so much on chocolates, but after buying them I have nothing but good things to say.  The package shipped almost immediately after the order was placed, everything arrived in great shape, and the Galliano bottles are absolutely awesome!  The only slightly yucky flavor was the tequila, but only because tequila and dark chocolate are not a wise combination.  I would definitely buy these again for a special occasion.

column9: Contents not as listed, but still looks and tastes great!
column10: Received this today. I purchased it as a gift so I won't be able to rate it for tastiness until Christmas, but I did want to note that the included liquors are not as listed in the description. While it does include the Cointreau, the Grand Marnier, the Cutty Sark, the Jack Daniels', and the Galliano, the other three are different than what is described. The description says the other three are Danzka Cranberyraz Vodka, Drambuie, and Borghetti, but instead they are Sauza Tequila Gold, Malibu Caribbean Rum, and Southern Comfort. Just be aware.Updated 1/1/11: We ate some of these last night, trying the Galliano, the Cointreau, the Grand Marnier, and the Malibu Caribbean Rum. The foil on the bottles looks great and is easy to remove without looking cheap. Tiny and adorable. The bottles are made with a very smooth and delicious dark chocolate which I really enjoyed, almost needed some milk to wash that down. I spilled just a little of the liquor when I got to that part of the bottle, but my husband didn't spill anything, so it's not a constant. I loved the Galliano and Grand Marnier chocolates; the flavors of the liqueurs went great with the chocolate and the Galliano was only a little boozy. My husband liked the Malibu Caribbean Rum, but found the Cointreau to be a bit too strongly boozy for his tastes.Love these, would absolutely buy again.

This is the Best Buy! Irresistible flavors and nice dessert during parties, enough for a small group (and a good discussion topic!)The box arrived in pristine condition within 3 days for regular delivery. Very good service from the seller! Will recommend as a good gift item for the holidays.
these are incredible chocolates they taste very good I recommend these for anyone looking for a stoking stuffer.

I ordered these for our family Christmas celebration after reading other positive reviews - and they are great! The similar chocolates I ordered year before last were okay but the Anton Berg chocolates were "gourmet".  You can actually taste, and discern, the liqueurs in each one and the chocolate alone is delicious. I was especially pleased at the quantity as well as the quality for the money.

The candies were a big hit with my Husband. He loves these candies and I surprised him for our 25TH Wedding Anniversary with these lovely little liqueur chocolates.  They came to us in excellent condition and I would us the same source again, for future gift giving.Very Satisfied,D Raiskin
These are great to have around on the holdays...the people who say that they don't want any dessert love these...good chocolate and nice liquor inside...

I will confess I didn't read the description closely enough before I ordered these.  I was under the impression I was getting plastic bottles filled with chocolate liquor.  What I actually got was chocolate bottles filled with non-chocolate liquor.  No big deal, I am still happy with the purchase and my girlfriend's mother loved these.  They were a big hit during the holidays this year.Be aware though that the product is mostly chocolate, with a little bit of liquor inside.  It's enough liquor just to give you a taste of it - which is to say it isn't very strong.  You would get a sugar high long before you got tipsy off of these.Overall a nice novelty gift, though I wish they had a bit a little more liquor and a little less chocolate.
I purchased 5 of them for gifts during the Holidays.  Guess what, not one of them requested info to exchange or return them.  Most of them and their friends asked where they could get some.

I ordered this product nearly a month in advance of my party.  The seller, "The Natural Shoppe" took sooooo long to ship the product that I didn't receive it in time for my party :o(  I wrote to them, but they were less than concerned.  The products is great, chocolate filled with real liquor, what could be better?!?  BUT, order from a different company!!!

A touch of home. Reminds me of holiday in Denmark. This product in awesome, and for adults only.  Packaged very nice and shipping was in a timely fashion.  Very nice chocolate, Anton Berg is in my opinion the best chocolate maker there is.  Love all their products.  First Class all the way.
From time to time I buy similar small liquors for friends, usually at Christmas.  I discovered these during a random search on Amazon, and now have a superior product available.

My order came quickly,was properly wrapped. Very beautiful for the Christmas season. I was very pleased with my order, and so was all my family and guest.  I even ordered a second box. I am  getting ready to order a third box to take to London, England. Thanks awfully.Dr. Winnie Payne.

I bought these chocolates for my 25 yr old son and he really enjoyed them.  The size of each "bottle" was quite large when you think about chocolates.  There was a nice selection of different liqueurs also.
I purchased this for my sister for Christmas.She loved it, a real conversation starter.And they taste great.I would definitely purchase again.

column9: Wonderful gift for the chocolate lover!!!!
column10: These little bottles are a real treat.  Not commonly found in stores, this find on amazon was a pleasure.  Each brand bursts with flavor and pairs with the chocolate perfectly.  Actual spirits in each bottle (not just flavored syrup). These are a MUST have for any chocolate lover who also enjoys fine liqueurs..............

These chocolate liqueurs are a favorite stocking stuffer for the adults in my family.  Everyone enjoys finding them in their stocking on Christmas morning.  Again this year all the comments have been positive, as usual!

The price was great, and my mom loved them for her birthday. Her friends actually told her she shouldn't be eating them because they were too pretty. lol. I didn't see them myself since she lives out of state, but she thought they were very expensive. And she said they tasted great.One note, my mom just assumed it was from me. I did mark it as a gift, and they didn't include the price on the box. So that was good, but it didn't have my name on it anywhere and they don't give you the option to write a little note.They gave me a 5 day window for delivery. It got there 2 days earlier than the last day on the window, which happened to be exactly on her birthday. So I was very happy.
since i bought these as a gift i havent tried them but they look very nice in the box, none look out of place from being shipped,  they r little bottles, but very cute

column9: Lacking of a proper product description
column10: I specifically bought this set due to the description saying there were Drambuie filled chocolates. Being as that is a favorite of a good friend of mine, and I will be at his house for thanksgiving. It was very disappointing to find that the actual assortment varies. I also bought a separate assortment with Malibu, just to find that it was already in this one.Now I will have to mail sellers and ask them what assortment they have prior to ordering, as silly as that sounds. I tried mailing JollyCandy and politely explaining my misfortune. I asked if I could buy a second box possibly with a different assortment, including Drambuie. They only took the time to send back a very rehearsed list of what their assortment was, referring to me as "Dear Customer", and not even taking the time to apologize or even acknowledge my question. I guess since I wasn't "Mad", there was no reason for consolation.As for the actual chocolates inside, they are pretty good, as good or better then I remember them a few years ago.

I have enjoyed this product and it has been a big hit whenever I take it to a party.  The only problem I have had is that sometimes when you peel the foil off, the chocolate bottle will break and all the good stuff runs all over the place.  My suggestion is that when you open one do it over a sink or something like that because it can be very messy.

column9: Anthon Berg Liquor Filled Chocolate Bottles
column10: I have bought these for the last several years at Costco. This last time I bought 4 boxes of 64. They were $16.59 + tax.  I preferred the other brand that comes in a gold colored box a bit better, but for the price I will settle for the Anthon Berg. I like to freeze them and then take out whatever amount I want and eat them.  Costco started to tax them this year due to the state because of the liquor content in them.  One would have to eat a whole box to get drunk and one would get sick before they got drunk.  These are pretty good and I would recommend them to anybody who has a yen for them.

column9: Great Product, Worthy of the Price
column10: This selection of dark chocolate liquors is the best I have ever purchased. They last a long time, especially if you only have 1 or 2 a day. Well worth the price, and would make an excellent party dessert!

I love chocolate liqueurs but I had never tried this brand before - well, it is exceptional.  The bottles are a little larger than others I have tried and the liqueur inside the bottle is real, not just some sugary mixture.  I had a bottle of Cutty Sark, and that little bit, I can tell had the real stuff, and the chocolate is excellent.I will say though that the packaging was not the best and it arrived a little damaged.  Since it is for myself, I do not mind, but if it was to be a gift, it would be a little bit of a problem.  I had to tape the corners and replace the bottles that were not inline. Being a native of Louisiana, I am a diehard coffee drinker; however, during my nine years in the Navy and 11 in the Army, I developed the habit of drinking whatever coffee was available. Then after all my travels, I had a double homecoming: I came home to Louisiana and to Louisiana coffee, in particular Community New Orleans Blend of Coffee & Chicory.To those of you who may be trying New Orleans blend for the first time, let me tell you that you don't prepare or drink this rich, smooth blend the way you would even the best of other coffees.  First, you use approximately one-half as much coffee as you are used to using with other types.  Right away, you begin to save money, but that's just a side benefit.  Even by using much less coffee, you experience a warm, dark, satisfying drink with never a trace of the bitterness that you would have even if you used more of even the most expensive, faddish brands.People who prefer their coffee "black" will immediately notice that this is not your ordinary cup of coffee; in fact, some may shy away from it because they simply aren't accustomed to the pure, strong flavor of a serious coffee beverage.  I urge those who experience that surprise, to try drinking it with--and I know this is somewhat like heresy to the black coffee drinker--warmed milk (or even better, half and half)and sugar to taste. Suddenly coffee drinking becomes an event, not just a habit.  You'll find yourself holding it in your mouth just a little longer than usual, savoring it much like a beautiful cabernet sauvignon!Now, regarding saving money! I buy my Community New Orleans Blend Coffee & Chicory on subscription from Amazon.com and save about $2.00 per pound over even discount store prices who often don't even carry the full 16 ounce package.So do yourself a favor if, instead of the habit of grabbing a cuppa Joe, you truly enjoy a flavorful coffee treat AND enjoy saving money:  Subscribe to Amazon.com's easy automatic purchase plan.  It's so nice to know that when I open my last "brick" of coffee my fresh two-month supply of this great product will arrive before it's even half empty!

I bought this tea yesterday. I was a hot day and since I'm pregnant, I've been avoiding regular and diet soda, and I think water, at least here in Akron, tastes terrible, so I've been making sun tea. I drink almost an entire tea jar every day. But the delicious red tea I'd been drinking was getting tiresome and I was looking for something new when I saw this tea. It is SO refreshing as an iced tea. I'm SURE I'd drink it even if I wasn't pregnant because it tastes so delicious. As far as the "claims", who knows... the ingredients like raspberry leaf, etc, seem harmless.

My first-time pregnant wife saw this tea and thought that it couldn't hurt, even if she doubted the efficacy of its claims. She offered me a sip of the tea, and I must say that I liked the combination of mint, fruit, lemon, and spicy flavors. I bought some more tea, and together my wife and I would each enjoy a cup in the evening while sitting out on our back porch and watching the sun set.About a month after drinking this delicious tea, I woke up one morning feeling very queasy. When I told my wife why I looked green in the face, she smiled at me with great compassion and love. "You're having sympathy symptoms." I looked at her blankly. She continued, "It's called Couvade syndrome, from the French `couver', meaning `to hatch'. It's when men feel and experience the physical symptoms associated with pregnancy." "Oh," I said, "I wonder how far it goes." My wife looked at me with loving eyes, laughed, and gave me a hug. "I love you," she said.A few weeks later I found out just how far Couvade syndrome can go when I gained twenty pounds; began suffering backaches, stomachaches, cramping, and mild incontinence; and started craving some foods while finding others nauseating. My wife found my symptoms amusing and endearing, and in that spirit I took a home-pregnancy test, for fun. When the results came back positive, I became concerned. My wife thought I was playing a joke on her, but when then next two tests also came out positive, she also became worried. On our next visit to her OB/GYN, we asked her doctor about my positive results. She looked at me with some concern and told us that elevated human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG--the hormone tested for in at-home pregnancy tests) levels in men are sometimes indicative of testicular cancer. I think I fainted, because I next remember waking up on an exam bed. The doctor recommended an oncologist to me and I set up an appointment right away.The oncologist explained how hCG may be produced by germ cell tumors and had some of my blood drawn for tests. That night was the most terrifying of my life as I waited for the lab results. When I saw the doctor the next day, she gave me the happiest news of my life: besides the hCG, all the other tests were negative for the most common testicular cancers. She still wanted a biopsy to be safe, and I consented, even though the idea of extracting it was not pleasing, to say the least. The biopsy results also came back clean, but the oncologist recommended that I come back in a month to monitor any changes. In the meantime, my wife and I went back to her OB/GYN for an ultrasound, and just for fun, I asked if I could have one too. The doctor humored me and scanned my lower abdomen. When she saw the screen, however, she nearly dropped the probe. "What is it?" I asked. "It looks like you have a uterus," she said, "with a fetus inside of it." I think I fainted. When I woke up, my wife and her doctor were both looking down at me with concern. "Is he always like this?" the doctor asked. "Yes," answered my wife, "but it's been especially bad since the pregnancy." "Whose?" the doctor asked. Everybody laughed. I asked her how this could have happened, and she mentioned intersexualism and chimerism, but I assured her that I was as male as male can be. Nonetheless, she suggested genetic testing.I began to think very hard about when my pregnancy symptoms began, and I realized they all started with the tea. I immediately stopped drinking it, and I began to notice my symptoms slowly disappearing. I had the genetic testing done and all my cells were typically XY male, with no abnormalities. The second ultrasound showed only the appropriate abdominal organs for a male, with no trace of a uterus or fetus. In fact, the only evidence that I had ever been pregnant is a grainy photo from the first ultrasound. The medical community has dismissed my case as mass hysteria, or "folie à deux". They may be at a loss to explain what happened, but I know the truth.
