Large dogs that are super active would do well on super high protein and calories, but I have a pug and this food works awesome for him.

My dogs have been raised on Blue. It is all I will feed them because of quality, ingredients, method of cooking (cold-formed bits), and smell/flavor.I do keep it in an airtight container so it stays fresh longer but I recommend you buy the size that will last a month or so. After a month of being open, it loses it's 'oomph'. The food is still good, but it won't smell as strongly (I'm not sure how smell and flavor diminish but I know every time we open a new bag my dogs act very happy and jump around)I have two doxies, one is 10 lbs and one is 8 lbs. This bag lasts me a month and I feed them each 3 oz. a day.

column9: The BEST dog food out there
column10: Since my furry friend was a pup, she has had a very sensitive stomach.  I tried various dog foods and regardless of the time frame she was on the food, she still had stomach problems.  A friend told me about Blue Buffalo and once I switched her to this food, her stomach problems are few and far between.  The life protection pieces she is not a fan of, but she scarfs the rest of the food down.  The all natural ingredients and no fillers is also really great.  I definitely recommend Blue Buffalo to anyone looking to change their dogs diet.

Tried several other brands and my dog just didn't seem to like any of them.  Did some research on dog foods and was quite surprised by what I found.  This "Blue Buffalo" brand kept coming up as a recommended brand so I decided to give it a try.  Must be something to it as my dog began eating it on the very first bowl.  I was impressed and he was a happy camper.  What more do you need?  We're now on our second bag and he still likes it.  Combine Amazon's decent price with free shipping (Prime Member)and I can save gas on the trip to the store.

I have 2 little rescued Miniature Poodles..and I HAVE been feeding them an excellent food: Chicken Soup for the Dog Lover....it's great food and the little female eats like a little pig---but the little male, Leo is tiring of it (after over a year)..so I did my homework and settled on Blue.I mixed half and half to get them started..and I will be doing this for a couple of weeks to use up all the Chicken Soup.Leo SNARFED his food--yesterday and today..looks like PICKY EATER has exited the building<sigh> thank you Lord!Several bags later--happy to report both dogs are HAPPY CAMPERS - they love their food - and I see healthy coats and good bowels---important to any dog person!

column9: Quality food perfect size for small Chihuahua.
column10: I have two Chihuahuas.  One of them was have trouble with gland ruptures.  I needed to change food to benefit the one dog.  I've read many good things about this product.  One word of warning.  My dogs pick out the healthly black bits and leave them around the bowl.  LOL, my trick is to not serve them more food until they finish them...kind of like a kid who won't eat there vegetables.

column9: Great food for our furry little babies!
column10: We have 2 small breed dogs whom we love as part of our family.  This is a very nutritious high quality food for my babies, and it's one of the very few dry dog foods that my doggies will eat.

My Maltese was on Eukanuba before I noticed that he stopped eating as much food, then I switched him over to a BilJac brand and at first he seemed like he liked it but then after awhile he threw up consistently. After reading reviews I switched over to Blue Buffalo and he loves it, there wasn't any problems switching him over. The kibble isn't big so he can eat it easily and his stool is healthy, I'll be sticking with this one for awhile.

I started our feeding my pup Royal Canin. It was a hit or miss, some days I tried adding chicken broth, warm water or soft food just to make it appealing and he would sniff and walk a way. I started getting concerned because he was refusing at least 1-2 of his 3 meals a day. I also didn't like the fact the it had corn in it.Finally I decided to switched to Blue Buffalo. He has never missed a meal since and I've had no problems with his stool.Everyone is happy!

My rat terrier (10 lb) is allergic to the world in general.  This is a high quality food that doesn't make her hair fall out.  We order it once a month from Amazon.  Sometimes, the bag bursts in transit, but I usually just put the food back into the bag...this is not ideal and I wish it was packed differently.  However, this review is about the food, and the food is great :)

We just got a new snorkie.  She was just picking at the food the previous owner had been feeding her.  We purchased Blue Lamb flavor for her and she went nuts over it.  My husband was as stunned as I was.  I don't know what it is about this stuff, but I have never seen this kind of reaction over dog food before.
Best food on the market and he prefers it to other dry food choices.  No corn or gluten - tasty and healthy.  It is worth the extra cost.
If you have a fussy dog try this.  My dogs love it and it is good for them.  You can mix in any other food with it.  Small bites are great for your tiny dog.

column9: Works for our dogs, but be careful...
column10: Our dogs like this and it works well... but we feed them half of this and half homemade meat and rice. I read some people have issues with dog sickness and foods... it's worth it to give your dog the best and find food that works. IMHO, it better to error on the side of less vitamins and not have organ failure or major sickness.
The product seem to be a great product, but when I fed it to my dogs, one of them got sick. So I had to discontionue it use and gave it to a friend to donate to someone who could use it.

I am writing this review to warn other dog owners of Blue Buffalo for dogs and what it has done to my  5 yr. old Miniature Dachshund named "Calla".  Back in late October 2011 I switched to Blue Buffalo after it was recommended by a family member. By mid-November Calla started to cry out at night.  We thought it might be a back issue and our "Three" yes three Vets agreed that it could be Intervertebral Disc Disease.  We had blood work done in November and everything looked fine with the exceptions that she was a "little" dehydrated. After months of treatments, with little to no improvement we thought it might be a stomach issue and I started to think about the timing of the change to Blue Buffalo, then I went and goggled "Consumer complaints about Blue Buffalo Pet Foods" and started to really connect the dots.  Yesterday she was diagnosed with "Pancreatitis" and needs to be in the hospital for days for treatment.  I have spent over 3K to this point and do not know if Calla will ever recover fully from this.  She was a completely healthy dog before we changed to Blue Buffalo and since have been living in Hell with nighty episodes.  Please read up on this issues people are having with this product before you buy. I wish I could give a product -minus 5 stars!!!!

My dogs, Storm (Blue Weimaraner 20 months) and Riley (Dalmatian 12 yrs)love this food.  I mix in a little with their dry food.  My only complaint is, it's a bit smelly, but then again it's the fish flavor.  I prefer the Duck and Sweet Potato. I have not been able to find it on Amazon for the same price. They have never had stomach upset from this food. You save about 30 cents a can plus no tax and free shipping to your door when you order a case from Amazon.

Certainly the quality of this dog food is very good.The Wellness Lamb and Sweet Potato is by far their favorite canned food.  It has protein content of 37% and a fat level of 23% (which is a little higher fat level than I would like but...).  I use an independant dog food advisory site when considering any dog food I buy and the Wellness canned dog food was rated a 4.5 (out of 5) stars and was highly recommended.I feed my dogs dry food (consistently the same), but for their evening meal I split a can for my 2 large dogs.The bottom line for me is it is a very good quality dog food and my dogs love it.
I enjoy the premasured packs and I am sending some to our soldiers as they find the packs better to serve them.

column9: best product ever ever ever and ever!
column10: I've been using these for a few years and since they're not always easy to find I decided to order in bulk from Amazon and am quite happy to have my stash :)
If you enjoy cinnamon this is an excellent coffee. It is smooth but leans toward a bold roast packed with a cinnamon kick.

I use this product on chicken and pork.  I rub the meats first with EVOO and chopped rosemary and pressed garlic and then sprinkle a few teaspoons of the rub on the meats.  It's a can't miss addition to your kitchen.

This salt is amazing!  You put just a tiny bit on any piece of meat or fish before you bake or grill it and PRESTO! - a couple side dishes and you're done.  My husband and I use it all the time for a quick, easy dinner.  REALLY good on steaks, delicious on pork, makes boring chicken taste great.  We gave it out to our friends and family for Christmas and got all of them hooked.  Get some!  You won't regret it.
As always, this brand makes me happy with its products, in this case, 2 56-ounce canisters of the best salted peanuts I have ever tasted.

After months of trying, my wife finally developed a potato soup from scratch last year that was pretty tasty. My wife agrees that this soup base is as good or better than her recipe and it is VERY easy to make. Before simmering the soup per the instructions, we added two bunches of raw broccoli, 5 small potatoes (diced and boiled for 8 minutes), added some fresh ground pepper and a small amount of salt and served it with crumbled bacon and cheddar cheese over the top. It was fantastic. We highly recommend this soup, it is now a regular part of our meal rotation.
I really love Bear Creek Soup Mixes.I just wish I could still get them in the cans with the largest number of multiple servings.  2 of these large packs is too much while 1 is just not enough.JABC

Have tried most all of Bear Creek soup mixes and it is hard to tell which one is my favorite. This one tops the list for sure. Nice cheesy flavor with a great bite of potato. I like to boil up a few new potatoes and dice them into the soup while it is simmering. Guess I just like a tad more potato. This soup, as others have stated is a great base for any addins that you would like! Experiment with it and come up with your families favorite mix. Can't beat the taste and the price is comparable to the supermarket. Occasionaly comes and sale and when it does I stock up!

I had this Bear Creek Cheddar Potato Soup Mix in my pantry for ages, unsure whether a powdery mixture could constitute a real bowl of soup. Finally, I gave it a shop and found that this soup is surprisingly rich and creamy!  It has a lucsious, rich flavor and is vegetarian to boot. This soup takes about 25 minutes from start to finish, and only has 3 steps (boil water, whisk mix into water, stir occasionally).  I made 2 pouches in one week and wish there were more vegetarian soups by Bear Creek.**WARNING**Please note the plain POTATO soup by Bear Creek is NOT vegetarian.  I bought a 6 pack and will not be eating it because if the chicken in the ingrediants.  As far as I have been able to find out the Cheddar Potato is the only soup they make that doesn't have beef or chicken parts.

column9: Hard Not to Eat the Whole Batch Yourself!
column10: This is my latest discovery from Bear Creek.  Very tasty!  I had a tiny bit of corn and asparagus in the house, so I added those.  As other reviewers have said, it is terrific as is or with some added chicken, meat, or vegetables.  Love to have this on hand for a super quick and tasty meal when everyone is running different directions.  Two thumbs up!!
Simple quick review.I was looking for a replacement cheddar soup from our local natural food store which we loved.This is a great soup.Easy to make and creamy!

column9: "cheddar potato" not bad for a quick meal (GLUTEN FREE)
column10: On my quest to find some easy Gluten Free meals to add to the ''easy list'' I happen to come across this and figured it would be worth a try (at Giant Eagle for $4.00). I was actually pretty excited to try it after reading all the positive reviews, but I really hate to say it....but it wasn't as good as I was hoping for. I'm wondering if maybe it was just the "Cheddar Potato" flavor kind??? I did add some bacon to it, but it just had an 'after taste' to it??? Don't get me wrong... for a quick/easy meal I'm sure you could doctor it up some, as I also added some cheddar cheese which 'did' help take away the after taste some... guess there's just nothing to compare to homemade?!

I use this soup mix as a base for pot pie filling. I purchased it first at Costco and was sorely disappointed when they discontinued carrying it. Finally, I searched Amazon and viola! It is good even by itself on cold days, though I add spices for a pop. For my pot pies, I add a variety of things like cooked and diced chicken, veggies, white pepper, fresh minced garlic, minced onion, etc. Line little pie tins with dough from scratch, fill with prepared  soup concoction, top with dough, press finger marks along the the edges and it's ready to pop in the oven or freezer for future use (from freezer, great for home cooked last minute meals). I highly recommend this soup mix.

I usually add a cup of whipping cream to the cheddar broccoli soup and everyone loves it.  The last time I made the potato soup, I microwaved a bag of Ore Ida "Steam 'n Mash Russet Potatoes" (do not mash the potatoes) and added them to the soup. I usually serve it with shredded cheese and crumbled bacon on top.

This is one of my favorite soups.  It is so delicious and easy to make.  I have tried most of the Bear Creek soups which are all delicious but this is one of the best.  Just add 8 cups of water (for the 12.1 ounce bag) and it makes a lot of product for the money.  I make it just for my husband and myself and we each have a great big mug and store the rest in the fridge.  It lasts for many days and tastes just as delicious after a few days.I also use the left over soup as broth to make a fish stew.  I simply put the soup in a pot on top of the stove and add cut up fish fillets, cut up shrimp, some crabmeat if available and add steamed vegetables like peas, carrots, corn niblets, cut up potatoes and whatever else is handy.  It only needs to cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until the fish fillets are flaky.All I can say is FANTASTIC.  Try this soup and any other flavors that appeal to you.  You can't go wrong.  In case you are wondering; I don't work for the company.  I am a foody that knows delicious when I find it.  Enjoy!Bear Creek Country Kitchens Cheddar Potato Soup Mix, 12.1 Ounce Bags (Pack of 6)

column9: Bear Creek Cheddar Potato Soup Mix
column10: All you have to add is water and the soup is done!  Of course I add a few scallions and real bacon bits to make it taste even better!  You can't tell it's not like the first course in a 5 star restaurant!  I'm not advertising for Bear Creek!  Try it for yourself if you don't believe me.  My son invited us over for lunch one afternoon and said he was having "potato soup" and I was a bit hesitant at first... but after the first bite, I was a believer!  Don't forget the real bacon bits, and scallions...... (and he added a bit of grated cheese).  All of these extra ingredients were sort of a topping!  Mmmmmmnnnnhhhhh........ Good stuff!

This Potato-Cheddar is my first encounter with Bear Creek soup mixes and now I'm hooked.Our Country Club restaurant used to make a wonder Beer Cheese soup so next time I'll pull part of the soup and use it to experiment by adding Beer and bacon.  Maybe it'll work and maybe not.  Has anyone else tried this?

column4: Jolly Green Giant "You can try Birchbox too! ...
column10: For an easy to make warm Fall/Winter soup this satisfies the entire family.To make this, I heat 8 cups of water (10 if I'm doing add-ins) and then add the hot water to the crock pot, then wisk in the soup mix. Within a half hour the soup is ready to eat, but the flavor profile improves tremendously with a veggie and a meat add-in and a few hours on low in the crock pot. I either add shredded chicken and broccoli (or asparagus) OR a pound of Hillshire Farm Miller High Life Beer Brats and a 16 oz bag of frozen corn. I pre-grill and slice the brats first to add a slightly grilled flavor to the soup.Either way, the soup is yummy, warm, and very filling. To complete the meal you can add a green salad and some crusty bread.
Bear Creek Soups are outstanding...much less expensive via Amazon in my opinion than from local stores and quick shipping.Easy to make and add other items to the soup.

If you've not tried this product and like soup, you're missing out.  We had some at work...add product and water to crockpot in the morning and for lunch have some excellent soup.  I'm picky and I've not been disappointed in this soup.

I bought this after reading many positive reviews, and because I'd bought the potato soup in single-serving size envelopes many years ago.  The product page in Amazon describes it as "lower sodium," and the preparation instructions end with "salt and pepper to taste."  Folks, this has almost 1000mg of sodium in a one-cup serving.  A more realistic two-cup bowl is almost 2000--that's higher in sodium than any of the canned soups I eat.  It's my own fault for not checking the nutrition info before ordering, and I'd have sent it back--but it's not eligible for return.  If you're looking for "lower sodium" soup look elsewhere.
If you need a gluten free mix this one is VERY good. The best price I've found is on Amazon.People who do not need to be gluten free eat and enjoy it. No one suspected there was a difference.
7 in our family.  2 with celiac disease.  ALL love it - even the picky eaters!

I absolutely loved corn bread and thought that I would have to stop eating it when I went gluten free. Then Pamela's came out with this super easy and versitile corn bread mix. I immmediately ordered a case having never tried it before because it was a Pamelas product and I have yet to find something I don't like of hers. Anyway, I would definate recommend that if you love corn bread because you will not be disappointed.

I make a mexican style cornbread that is amazing with this mix.  Instead of water, I add 1 jar of pimentos, and 1/2 cup jalepenos with the juice, and add 1 cup of frozen (do not thaw) corn.  I also add 1/4 cup sugar, and 1/2 teaspoon vanilla. Then it has to bake for 45 minutes.  It comes out very moist, and very addicting!

For years, I've been looking for cornbread like Mom used to make.  I've finally found it.  Pamela's cornbread mix has it all.  It's quick and easy to prepare and it tastes heavenly.  All the make-from-scratch recipes I've tried tend to be rather dry.  Pamela's cornbread is delightfully moist and it stays moist if you don't get it all eaten at once.  In fact, it's so moist it tastes good even without butter.  It has just the right degree of sweetness.  You can also make cornbread muffins from it and I've discovered they freeze well.  In addition, Pamela provides variations on the recipe if you're looking for something a little different.  I have no hesitation in giving this product a resounding five stars.  I like it so well I order it from Amazon in bulk.

column9: Gluten free cornbread mix from Pamela's Products
column10: Loved this mix, easy to make, ok to use extra or different ingredients. Added walnuts and bananas, used apple sauce instead of butter or oil, used honey in place of the sugar, added granola, nuts, dried cranberries and cherries, and flax seed to have some variety. Served to company many times.
This is really a good cornbread and muffin mix. It is moist and not crumbly like some others are. This mix is so easy to make and is so tasty, especially for being gluten free.
Love this cornbread!  I make the buttermilk recipe listed on the bag and no one notices that it is gf!

This mix is wonderful-its one of the many items that Pamela's makes that has the taste and texture I was used to before the non gluten diagnosis. I have never felt as though I was missing anything since I found these products...

column9: quality of the product is great, but a bit gritty in finished product
column10: I like the fact that the recipe provides alternative to some of the ingredients like sugar (replace with honey) and butter (replace with canola oil), which we did since we have moved into more consciousness in the ingredients we are consuming.  The honey option definately tastes better than cane sugar (our other alternative to white and refined sugar); otherwise, it was not that sweet and a bit gritty.I am just pleased to have a package ready that I only need to throw in a few addtional ingredients and I have cornready within 30 minutes.  The mixture made two very small loaf tins, which is enough for four-six people: nice portions.
I love Pamela's and this is a great new addition to their other wonderful products.Thanks!!!!!!!!!!!!!! so much for making tasty stuff.Don Mueller

fantastic! tastes great! Best cornbread mix I have had since going on gluten free diet (and that includes from scratch recipes) Even non-gluten free family members loved this cornbread! Will be buying this in the future and all of Pamela's other great products

column9: It's not Jiffy, but it's not bad
column10: When you're in your fifties and find out that you can never eat gluten again, it's depressing.  By this age, we are used to foods tasting a certain way.  Gluten-free foods seldom (if ever) taste like we think food should taste, but all said, this Pamela's cornbread isn't bad.  It's certainly the best G-F cornbread mix I've found. My nieces loved it and were happy to take home the left-overs.So thanks, Pamela.

I replaced the 1/2 cup of water with 1 cup of milk and used it as a dipping batter. Then I deep fried in Peanut oil at 325 degrees until light brown. Then we used frozen mozzarella sticks to do the same. Next I'm gonna try onion rings. I know it isn't healthy, but for a treat after 5 years of living without, who cares? The kids say they're better than the wheat kind they remember, so this isn't a compromise at all.
I love this cornbread mix.  I had just been making a cornbread from scratch substiting a non wheat flour, but it was more dry.  This is delicious and I like the little chuncks of corn in it.
This is great cornbread.  It's easy to make and freezes well.  I usually cook it in muffin pans and freeze what isn't eaten at that time.  When I want cornbread it's easy to defrost, warm and enjoy.

We LOVE this mix!  I use it for muffins all the time, to have with soups, stews, etc.  Two hints:  use UNSALTED butter, and use the full amount -- don't try to go low-fat or they're no good.  Also, because I'm usually serving them with savory things and don't want them sweet, I use only  2 T of sugar.  They come out perfectly every time.  If you were serving them for breakfast you'd probably want at least 1/3 c. sugar.

After going gluten free/ casein free last year I've been on a mission for cake mixes, bread mixes, etc that don't leave a bad after taste.  I finally found the BEST cornbread in this mix and everyone in our family was pleased! I used 1/3 C honey instead of 1/2 C sugar and unsweetened Coconut Milk (SoDelicious brand) instead of the water.  They were extremely moist and tasted like true cornbread.  If you are wary of spending more $ on trying out yet another mix (I've been there plenty of times) then I would suggest buying a single bag at the store (I think mine was $3.99 at WholeFoods) to see if you like it. I think you'll be impressed!

I was delighted to find this product as I really enjoy corn bread.  This corn bread is gluten free; easy to make and tastes so darn good.  In fact, if you make corn bread stuffing, use this and you will have a holiday dish your guests will be RAVING about!Pamela has been batting a thousand with her products and this one is no exception.

I still can't believe it's gluten free! I made this for the first time today.  I am eating a piece (actually my 5th!!!) right now and sooo happy cause I thought I had to choose between cornbread and abdominal pain/bloating, which is a tough choice for a stereotypical African American like me who grew up on soul food. What was I going to eat beans and greens with?  I used halved the sugar in the sweet cornbread recipe since I don't like sweet cornbread.  My only complaint was that it wasn't brown on the top the way I like, but that was quickly rectified with some Pam spray on top and popping it in the broiler for a minute. The sides and top were crispy, and the inside was soft and delicious!I know one reviewer complained about grains, this is because Pamela's used organic cornmeal, which is not as processed. I do the same thing when I make it, and I love it that way!I guarantee you I could serve this to my family and they wouldn't know the difference, except maybe the absence of the heavy feeling cornbread usually gives us.

There's no way to tell that this is gluten-free. It is amazing as cornbread, muffins and to replace bread for stuffing (just don't add sugar). We add chopped pecans and it's difficult not to eat the entire thing when it comes out of the oven. The texture has a nice bit of crunch from the corn. It is superb.

My whole family loves this cornbread!  It is moist and so tasty that it doesn't even need butter or honey.  It's honestly better than the cornbread that I used to make that contained gluten.  Thank you Pamela's!

I am accustomed to baking and cooking from scratch.  Since being diagnosed with Celiac Disease, learning to navigate this new dietary highway, and experiencing some dismal failures in the kitchen, I was delighted to find that this product tastes very much like my old cornbread recipe.  I would recommend it highly as my dinner guests seem to enjoy it as much as I.

My son said this is the best cornbread you have ever made and I agreed with him. It is even better than cornbread that isn't glutten free.  It was very moist and sweet.  You could eat it without syrup or honey it was so good.  I will continue to buy this product.
This mix is excellent.  I don't tell my friends it is gluten free and they love it.

I was soo craving some cornbread dressing to go with my turkey....I thought I would have to give it up. I knew I liked Pamela's products and took a chance and bought the 6pack on here. It was SOOO great! I am the only one who needs gluten free and sometimes my friends complain about foods I make or can tell right away that it's GF. NOT WITH THIS MIX!!  I waited until dinner was almost complete and asked if everyone was satisfied and if everything tasted like it should....they all said it was amazing! That's when I told them the cornbread dressing was GF and the gravy was as well since I used Pamela's baking mix to make the gravy!!The other day I was making chili and told me husband how nice it would be to have some cornbread with it. In NO time he whipped up a mix and it made a dozen muffins.We are not used to sweet cornbread so I did not put the sugar in the dressing...but we tried half of what was suggested in the muffins and they were good too.I feel like I got a part of my life back and am able to enjoy the things I love to eat now. So happy!!
I bought several baking goods from Pamela's and all of them are really good!! It shows that healthy doesn't have to taste bad.

This cornbread is so excelllent that my entire family loves it.It saves me having to cook a second "gluten" cornbread for those that can eat gluten.I would rate this and virtually everything Pamelas makes with 5 stars!

I SO appreciate Pamela's Co...Offering us Non GMO gluten free products means alot to me and the taste is excellent!....Everyone in my family LOVES all her products including this one.The price is good and i am hoping it stays this way considering all i keep hearing about corn stuff going up on reg products..
Once again Pamela's has produced a great product! Even family who can have gluten like this! Keep up the good work!

I love Pamela's products.  I get consistently tasty results that please even the non-gluten free eaters, the cornbread is no exception.  In addition to making cornbread and corn muffins with this mix, I also make corn pancakes and waffles.  When the bread is done it is very moist and stays together well for gluten free bread.

column9: you won't believe it's gluten free
column10: The best gluten free cornbread mix by far. Just add eggs, oil (or butter) and water.  It's not dry like other gluten free mixes I've tried. We almost always use the cheese cornbread recipe (on the bag).  I really like the low fat version - then I don't feel so guilty adding the cheese!

This is a great cornbread mix! There are recipes for a few different variations on the bag. My boys are big Krusteaz cornbread fans and didn't even complain when we switched to Pamelas. You almost can't tell that it's gluten-free.

Pamela's is the Cadillac of Gluten Free Mixes.  Haven't had a bad one yet!The first bag I made cornbread, the second cornbread muffins.  I might just get creative and do cheese and jalapenos in the next one.And Amazon has made purchasing these products a lot easier on the budget!Blessings,Judy
This is the best cornbread mix I have tried. My family loves it, and no one complains about missing gluten at all. I use agave so it is not too sweet. I recommend this highly

This is one bread product that both the gluten free and non gluten free family members in my house love.  I don't even make any gluten corn bread anymore.  My family's favorite recipe is the cheese corn bread recipe found on the bag.  This corn bread comes out so moist and delicious.  We are very familiar with products that taste "gluten free" and this isn't one of them.  We are big fans of Pamela's in our house.

Amy's GF products are the best that I have found anywhere. Having to eat GF was not near as tasty prior to finding Amy's products. My wife actually enjoys eating the GF pancake and GF Corn Bread Muffin made from Amy's better than regular gluten full products! Excellent, Excellent, Excellent!!
Proves you don't have to give up flavor or texture to be gluten free.  Pamela's Cornbread tastes great.  My family loves the waffle mix too.

I really like this cornbread and muffin mix fro Pamela's products. The consistency is really good and the flavor is great too. I always end up with a good batch of corn bread when I use this mix. I like that I can get good healthy food that tastes good and does not take a whole lot of time to prepare.

I'm new at this Glutten free diet so I ordered the Cornbread and muffin mix thinking that it was probably not going to be that good but I made the Cranberry Orange muffin recipe on the side of the package and I was pleasantely suprised at how good they taste. I even used Splenda instead of sugar and they turned out ok. I think I will increase the cranberries to a cup the next time I make them.

Tried a couple different ones, and they were ok. I thought Pamela's cornbread was really good. Also think that bit of sugar and melting the butter instead of oil really gives it a moist sweet taste. You wouldn't think it would be hard to find a gluten free cornbread. This is suppose to be corn and not wheat!!!!

A friend was recently diagnosed with celiac disease and I wanted to help her find food she can eat.  So I purchased this product and tested it to see if it was OK before I gave to her.  I don't like a really sweet cornbread so used half the sugar.  Wow, it was so good.  The butter gave it such a great flavor that it was perfect alone.  My husband is picky about everything and I gave it to him and he ate it.  (Though he prefers the sweet Jiffy mix.)  I will be purchasing this for us to eat, even though we don't need to be gluten free.

column9: I used to bake this product in an 8" pan
column10: Finally tried it as muffins with wonderful results. Easier to serve. Easier to freeze. And more of the exterior surface gets that little bit of crispiness. Yum. This mix is so good my foodie friends cannot tell it is gluten free.

This is good for gluten-free, but not as delicious as Pamela's other products.  I wish I hadn't bought this in bulk, as now I have four un-eaten packages taking up space!  Wouldn't buy in bulk moving forward.
I'm not a big corn bread person but my gluten eating husband is and he loved it. In fact he bought 2 more packages on his own.

Love this product! Texture is just right -- touch gritty yet not heavy. If you plan on eating it with honey and butter, the sugar recommended in the recipe is enough, but for folks who prefer a sweeter cornbread, I would add more sugar or a bit of honey.

I haven't been on a gluten free diet long, and am still finding out which products are good.  Pamela's cornbread mix is definitely a winner!  My husband didn't even want to try it, knowing it was gluten free, but ended up eating 4 pieces!!  My daughter didn't even know it was gluten free and loved it.  I could not tell the difference between this and the cornbread I used to make when I was still eating gluten.  Thanks, Pamela's!!

I have to say, though I like Pamela's cookies, I was skeptical about this mix. I screwed it up and it still came out delicious so it won me over. It can come out a bit grainy or crunchy but if you get the ingredients and timing on the oven just right, it comes out very taasty!
These mixes make yummy cornbread without any gluten. Cornbread is one thing that entices me even though I know it contains wheat.  Glad to have something this good so I won't give in at restaurants.

I tried this as I had previously tried the Brownie mix which is outstanding. It was easy to mix up, love the wide variety of choices concerning the added ingredients and when it came out of the oven...OMG! I was going to start experimenting with gluten free corn bread recipes but now I won't bother. The mixes are kind of pricey, but as a special treat they are well worth it.

This is a very soft cheese, with 35 calories per wedge and about 1.5 grams of fat. So if you love cheese, but you don't love the fat, you can spread this on your crackers with good conscience.If you can find the Queso Fresco & Chipotle version (not sold here yet), I highly recommend it. The chipotle flavor is snappy and gives a mild heat; the queso fresco is not like Mexican fresh cheese but it is a creamy mild white cheese that goes well with Triscuits or toasted pita.

I love this cheese. All the flavors taste great and the best part, 2 wedges are just 1 point (Weight Watchers PointPlus). The problem here is the cost. I can get the same thing from Safeway for $3.99 (in store OR delivery) and it's $2.49 from Trader Joe's. What makes it so expensive here? Just curious.
This is perfect to keep in the fridge at work.  Have some of this with crackers, a yogurt and a salad and you good to go.  I live off the Swiss cheese!  Love it!

I have been on a high protein, low carb diet called Medifast for several months and the Laughing Cow cheese wedges have been a life saver. Swiss is my favorite flavor because I can dip both the sweet and savory Medifast pretzels in them.  I have also melted them down to pour over grilled chicken.  Amazing product for very little calories and little to no carbs.However, this price is quite high in contrast with typical retail prices.

I'm tired of products that promise more than they can deliver. Advertising should tell me what to expect in the real world, not in some happytime fantasy land where money grows on chia pets and all my pants fit and supermodels frolic on the shores of the lazy Guinness river. I bought this product specifically to test the claims made in their marketing.I know that laughter can be contagious. And the little heifer on the Laughing Cow package looks like she just heard a real udder-slapper of a doozie. But the 'have you laughed today' slogan? Can a nibble of cheese really give you the giggles? I doubted it.I tried some on a cracker, and felt myself chuckle. Another bite, and the yuks kept coming. By the time I was halfway done, I was cackling like a hyena hopped up on laughing gas. The cheese was tasty enough, but the experience was sort of uncomfortable.(If you've ever laughed so hard you shot milk out your nose, take a word of advice: it's a whole lot easier in the liquid phase. Upsnorting cheese feels like passing kidney stones through your nostrils -- and everything around me smelled like a wedge of cheddar for a week.)To my surprise, this is one product slogan that's actually true, in an unnerving sort of way. It's delicious with crackers, but you might want to try pairing it with a sad movie or a funeral dirge. Or a Heimlich maneuver. Otherwise, it may be the cheese that has the last laugh.

So this item is decribed as a red barn bully sticks - sticks not stick - is is only 1 stick.  The price with shipping comes out to $10.63 for 1 bully stick, not worth it.  It has the worst smell ever I actually took it from my dog and threw it away.  Beware this item is garbage

Had this when on a winery tour.  Couldnt find it anywhere except online (even at the Bussetto factory).  It's a little expensive for the size but it's the best salami you'll ever taste.  Will continue to purchase about 4 at a time.

I buy Roland peppers at a local restaurant supply store, but the prices from Amazon are better so I'm switching.  Roland roasted red peppers have a deep pepper flavor, and the texture is always just right.  Unlike some other brands of roasted red peppers, these do not have vinegar or additives that might interfere with your recipe.  I use them in many recipes that I would fresh peppers, adding to the recipe at the last minute.  I find them almost addictive!

column9: nice firm peppers in the past - not so firm now
column10: It is now 2012 -- I will leave my original review below, but need to note that the last time I purchased the Roland peppers I was very disappointed because they were on the mushy side.  Not totally mushy, but definitely not as firm as they were a couple years ago.  Things do change over time.  And -- Amazon has the DeLallo brand in oil with garlic in stock again so that is what we are eating.Here is the original review I wrote in 2009:These are the second best roasted red peppers I've purchased.  The best ones were DeLallo, lightly marinated in olive oil and whole garlic....but I can't find that particular brand anymore.The texture is very firm and the cans are packed quite full so you really get your money's worth.  You can even divide the large can and put portions in small freezer containers and they are just as good after being frozen and then thawed. I use red peppers in a lot of salads and spreads because we don't eat tomatoes and I will definitely purchase these again.The only thing I would criticize is that there is a bit too much of the charred skin on the peppers, but it is not too difficult to clean off -- and you expect some of that when you get roasted peppers.

These roasted red peppers are the same as I've purchased in smaller glass jars under different brands.  They are good for salads, with cold cuts, and in various recipes.  The peppers are flavorful, firm, and the skin has been roasted enough so it it not tough.  My only disappointment was that the can showed a picture of whole peppers so I thought I would be receiving large pieces of peppers.  The can contains narrow roasted strips.

i had one dented can that i transferred to a jar after receiving shipment. i was impressed by the very large size of the peppers, they can easily be stuffed or folded. after removing the peppers the remaining liquid was roughly a quarter or fifth of the can. i have never purchased products by Roland before but will in the future. overall it is the same price and quality as other roasted peppers at a grocery store but with the convenience of being delivered to your home. a must have pantry addition.
We love them! Have used them in panini, on pizza, and in salads. They are wonderful. Highly recommended!
Good quality product. Convenient and affordable.I found the taste on the bitter side though. Perhaps it's me...Clearly not as tasty as fresh peppers, but convenience comes with a price :-)

I got my first bonsai back in 1973, and I know quality when I see it.  The trident maple bonsai forest which I received from them was definitely high quality - beyond what I expected.I highly recommend them to anyone - new or experienced - looking to buy a bonsai forest which is truly a work of art.I thank you sincerely.....Mike

column9: Far Exceeds the description and photo
column10: I was sold on the description and photo that one finds in the listing. But upon arrival they do not do it justice. I was greatly impressed with the Trident Maple Forest.Great price for an excellent bonsai.

I purchased this bonsai grouping for my husband for his birthday.  He loved it!  I was a little dissappointed with the way it was boxed and the handling of it by the delivery man.  Despite the rough treatment, it recovered within a week and is now doing great.  It is not the same as the photo, however.  It is nice and has lots to work with, but it is definately not the one in the photo.  I think it should at least be posted that they are going to send one Similar to the one in the photo.All in all, we are pleased with our little forest.

column9: Excess packaging is kept to a minimum and tastes great
column10: While individual bagged teas are convenient for traveling, they produce a good deal of waste.  When at home, I prefer loose teas.  SerendipiTea makes some of the best teas.  They are fragrant and fresh and use earth-friendly packaging.  After trying SerendipiTea Burroughs' Brew, Organic Black Tea & Coconut, 4-Ounce Box and SerendipiTea Buccaneer, Indian Black Tea, Toasted Coconut, Chocolate, Vanilla & Rooibos Tea, 4-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 2) and drinking cup after cup, I felt confident their Mint tea would be just as good and it has met expectations.The SerendipiTea Organic Mint is delightfully fresh.  I love dipping a few of Anna's Thins, Chocolate Mint, 5.25-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 12)in this tea. It is a simple tea. You know what you are drinking.  There is no flavor confusion that accompanies some teas. I'm a huge fan and recommend it to any mint fan.  For brewing purposes, I use a Finum Goldton Filters, Blue and Green.If you don't want to fiddle with loose teas while traveling, two brands exist that are also very fresh and very minty.  They are Taylors of Harrogate Herbal Peppermint Tea Box 20 Tea Bags and Harney & Sons Fine Teas Organic Peppermint - 50 Tea bags.As an aside, while some have had difficulty with bags breaking open after being shipped from SerendipiTea, I've never had a problem.  I started buying the company's products in the spring of 2011 and they did use a thinner plant-derived material for the inner bag that held the tea, which I could see might be prone to breaking open.  The last several purchases I have made from the company still use a plant-derived bag for holding the tea but this bag is much sturdier in composition.
Fresh and fantastic. I usually brew mint with some sencha and then refrigerate for a refreshing tea.

column9: Tea is GREAT, buying from amazon, NOT! BEWARE OF HOW THEY PACK IT.
column10: This tea is great. I've had it before so I know. I'm from Singapore and use a forwarding service to get items I can't get here. Amazon shipped this 4 ounce item in such a huge packet that the forwarding service has classified it as a 2.5kg item and is charging me 2x what this cost me to ship it to me.SO RIDICULOUS. I don't know why Amazon has to take up so much volume in their packaging. Now I'm contemplating dumping the item as its not worth it to ship to myself!!!
This sauce has sufficient heat and a good flavor, that is not so strong, that it over powers what food it is put on.  The heat may be too much for some, so go sparingly at first!  I really enjoy it.

I tried this sauce the other day that a friend of mine had at lunch.  WOW!!!  While the heat was intense, it was pleasant with a smokey flavor unlike other habanero sauces I have tried before.  I would highly recommend this sauce with meat, chicken, chili, and stews.  Make your taste buds come alive!!

The Habanero chile is one of the hottest chilies known to man. So it comes as no surprise that this sauce is very hot on a drop by drop basis. There is nothing wrong with that! In fact, I prefer a very potent hot sauce. However there is a nasty and bitter aftertaste to this sauce which I don't think anyone would like.Note: there is no smoke flavor to this sauce despite what another reviewer says. I suspect this reviewer was confused and was thinking of a chipotle sauce (which is made by this manufacturer and many others). A chipotle sauce has a wonderful smoked flavor to it but this sauce does not use that chile and there is not even a hint of a smoked taste to this one.This sauce is very potent but beyond that considerable heat there is little else other than a nasty and bitter aftertaste.Not recommended
Another very fine whole wheat pasta product. Worth the little extra you may have to pay. Taste and quality are excellent.

column9: Palatable, but cheats on the wheat.
column10: I'm loyal to De Cecco for regular semolina pasta. Unfortunately its whole wheat fusilli (this product is fusilli despite the wrong picture) is only better than OK.  The taste is fine, not bitter at all, but the texture is difficult to get right, and resists binding with sauce.  I suggest creamier sauces that bring their own cling.  Note also that De Cecco's "whole wheat" pastas are not made with 100% whole wheat, but "enriched whole wheat" flour -- an euphemism for highly processed wheat.
These are delicious. My husband put this product on lamb and crusted it with rosemary and it was heavenly!
My husband & I have absolutely fallen in love with this rice. It is so easy to prepare and tastes so wonderful. If you like this type of rice then try it. You will not be disappointed !
These are good but needs the water to make them rejuvenate again.  You can eat them in place of candy.

I love the organic ingredients & portability.  They love the taste.  Every flavor we have tried so far has been a hit - grape, strawberry, sour apple (think granny smith - just tart enough but not really sour), mixed berry & tropical.A winner all around for us in the snack catagory.Price here on Amazon is very, very good compared to my grocery store where you can buy these individually for about a dollar each.I think you can also find these at Starbucks for about the same dollar a piece if you want to try before buying.I find them to be very similar to Stretch Island fruit strips in both flavor, texture & stickiness.Not too sticky for eating out, but wet wipes always come in handy!We used to be on the subscribe program for a monthly delivery for additional savings, but the 4 variety pack is no longer in stock & this one isn't being offered on S&S.  (Which is a darned shame!)  You can get the single flavors on S&S but we really like the variety packs best.

We are a first grade class (ages 6-7).  We bought these Fruit Ropes to try as part of our opinion writing unit.  We ended up having different opinions after sampling each flavor.  Here are our thoughts::) These Fruit Rope snacks were very good.  We would buy them again.  Although the flavors tasted similar, they were all deliciously tart.  The strawberry flavor was our favorite because it tasted sweeter and smelled like real strawberries.:( We didn't really like the Fruit Ropes so much.  The taste of all three flavors was sour.  They got stuck in our teeth and were kind of hard to bite.  We wish that you could make them taste more like the fruit shown on the wrapper.

column9: Ok, but should really call all these apple fruit ropes.
column10: I bought these as a sweet treat for lunch boxes. Cliff is a favorite at our house, so I wasn't too concerned about quality. When I got these and read the ingredients, I was completely miffed that all 3 flavors have no other substance but apple. I will probably go back to buying the stretch island fruit because they actually include in the ingredients the fruit that is the flavor on the front label.

I have been a big fan of these ever since I first tried them. They are a very good quick snack, and if you are a fan of fruit snacks then you won't be disappointed. Some people feel that may be a little bit sweet, but I think they are fine.

These are so incredibly good.  Love the new grape flavor much better than the tropical fruit ones that come in the other mixed box (I like the apple flavor twist, but don't miss it in this box) .  Will definitely buy this assortment again.  I give these to both my kids - the 2.5 year old loves them just as much as the 7 month old ;-)

column9: Remember how flavorful the original Fruit Roll-Ups were years ago?
column10: The Clif Kids Twisted Fruit is impressively reminiscent of the original Fruit Roll-ups I enjoyed during my childhood. I have tried many different fruit snacks as an adult and could not find any that had that great zing of flavor that I remember Fruit Roll-Ups had in the 1980's. Well, these fruit ropes are what those Roll-Ups used to be!! They are tangy and fruity. They are wonderful. I highly recommend these despite the cost. Fruit Roll-Ups are now plastic and sugar flavored. Clif Kids are THE BEST fruit snack you will taste. I promise! I've tried them ALL.
These are great snacks for the kids, but I hoard them myself because they're only 1 weight watchers point each and they're so tasty.  Much cheaper to buy them on Amazon than at a store.
My boys love these fruit snacks! Anything by Clif is good and Amazon is the only place we can get them. The price is good, and the product is terrific.

column9: Great snack but the price is too high.
column10: The snack gets 5 stars but the price gets 1 star (hence the 3 star rating).  You can buy the same exact thing at Sam's club for $10.58.  Amazon should lower their price to be more competitive with other bulk retailers.

Love this product. Great snack, healthy. My sons loves these and so do I.They are a little more than at Costco, but I couldn't get them at Costco this last time and they are definatley cheaper here than at the grocery store.

column9: Thought they would be close to twizzlers, but not so lucky
column10: I have a kid who comes home from school, when Dr. Oz comes on, so she pays a lot of attention to nutrition information and ingredients wants to eat healthier.  We saw these at Costco and read some reviews on Amazon for a healthier alternative to Twizzlers because she really likes Twizzlers and it got a low score on the Fooducate App.  My daughter ripped them open and tasted them, but she didn't like them, said there was an after taste.  However, I did give them to my other daughter's track coach and they have become pretty popular with some of the middle school kids, which will probably be the only reason why I would buy these again.
I had, i think, 1 grape one.  The next day, i woke up to find that my roommate ate the rest of the entire box.  so i guess it's pretty good.

I love these snacks!!!  I cannot find them in the stores around me so I order them here.  Very good for you and absolutely delicious.  Every kid and adult that I have let try them love them.  All the flavors are good too!  YUMMMMMMYYYY!!

I've been buying these for my family for awhile now. The taste is great,and I like the fact that they are organic. I hate giving my kids fruit chews because of all the artifical ingredients. These are a great alternative. They're very portable too. I store a couple in my purse for a quick snack.

I love these twizzlers..they're soft enough for little ones (my nephew is 16 mo) and for me too!. Some of the flavors are a litle "tart" but I personally like that taste so it's up to your own preferences

I confess, I find sometimes when I stick these in a purse or diaper bag for the toddler snack, I might snag one or two myself.  These are portable, easy to hold for little hands, the ropes as opposed to fruit strips can also come in handy with teething.  Like all fruit rollup style creations they are sticky, so a hand wipe can be helpful, mostly if you have a messy eater.

I used to get these at Sams Club every now and then, but got tired of them after a bit. They are quite tangy and very chewy. I tried sharing with my seven and eight year old nieces, but only one would eat them. She thought they were okay, but her sister took a bite and decided she hated them. I would recommend buying a few different flavors as singles if you can find them locally. It's a bit too expensive to buy them that way all the time, but you should try the different flavors before you commit to buying them here. Some people love them, others hate them.
If there's a problem with these fruit sticks...it's that they are too delicious! Our 2.5 year old loves his fruit sticks! They do have 15g or so of sugar.
These are so delicious, and don't leave your fingers a sticky mess because they're easier to eat using the wrapper to hold it than other fruit leathers.

this is a better alternative to those red twisting treats that my daughter loves.  This also keeps her occupied and happy during those long trip rides.  of course i'm still limiting the amount of treat she can have, because this should not replace an actual healthy snack.  :)
Yummy fruit ropes. Great for school lunches or when you need a snack on the go. My boys really like them.  Not as tough like a fruit leather. Great value when purchased as a variety pack.

column9: great healthy snack for the kids
column10: Our kids just love these all natural fruit snacks. We would buy the regular fruit snacks in the store with all the sugar and the kids would bounce off the walls. These are so much better for them. With the subscribe and save program it is so nice to just have them shipped to the house.
My children and husband love these fruit twist. They are not too sweet, they taste great and are a great snack for my child's school lunch.
My kids like these even better than fruit leather.  I think it is the rope design.  We keep them in the fridge, in a "snack drawer" and the boys choose them first most times.
my son barely eats anything and he would eat like 5 of these at a time if I let him. They are delicious and I feel comfortable letting him have them. By far his favorite snack.

My kids love these as an after school snack. While they may not be the perfect healthy snack, they are better than fruit snacks that don't actually have fruit IN them. They are tasty, portable and my kids love them. Definitely maintaining my Subscribe and Save for these because we go through them!

My grand children and husband love these fruit twist.  We live in the country and it is not easy to find good healthy treats.  These fruit twist fit the bill.  They store easy, pack easy and are a great treat.

My whole family loves to eat these fun fruit ropes.  They are a great snack, and make lunchboxes fun.  Also love that it comes in a variety pack so that my kids can have the flavors they want.  Keep up the great work Clif!

...adults too!These are very like fruit leather that has been rolled into a Twizzler-like shape, making it somehow much more appealing to my young sons. In my local grocery store, these are $.99 each, so buying them in bulk like this (especially if you do Subscribe & Save) really saves money.All the flavors are very nice, and not too sweet. They hold up very well as a snack to shove in a backpack or purse and are fun enough to keep my kids from begging for the artificially-colored "fruit" snacks so many of their friends bring to school. Good stuff!

These were on one of the Amazon Friday sales and I decided to give them a try. They're tangy and sweet, I quite like them. The 3 flavors all have a core taste to them though, which makes sense if you read the ingredients. The core of this product is apples in all 3 cases... and it's there in every bite. Fortunately, I like apples, but if you're looking for variety in flavor you'll be disappointed here.

my son is a year and 8 months and he loves these.  They are a little sticky but not enough to get things messy.  I like that they are not like the other fruit snacks that are thin and hardly anything there, these are thick enough that you feel like it is a snack not just a taste.  I will be buying more.
These are great for my work lunches or just to have in a purse as a snack.  I love the fact that these are organic and taste fantastic.  Highly recommend!
each flavor better then the last. great for a grab and go healthy snack. will reorder for school lunches for the children and sneak a few for myself! shhh!

Amazon's subscribe and save program has the best deal on these that I have found so far.  These taste very good and I feel good about my kids snacking on these when we are out and about.  They are so easy to toss in your purse.  I do not keep candy around so my kids view these as their sweet treat.

These fruit twists are excellent.  My 4 year-old grandaughter is allergic to artificial colors and this product has none.  It is all natural and organic, and Lexi loves them.  Finally a fruit snack she can eat.  All of the flavors are very tasty.  Hooray for Clif Kids.
My son LOVES them and so do I. I use the auto delivery system with AMAZON and it is the best. I get the best pricing and it ships just when we are about to run out! Awesome job AMAZON!

To be honest I was a bit skeptical at first as I tend to be weary about snacks with the word healthy or natural associated because they so often dissapoint in the taste department. I was very pleased with these snacks and they are absolutely delicious. My first thought when I ate one was that I was eating my grandmothers homemade preserves. They are wonderful.
These are really good and it tastes like fruit!  No sugary or bad after taste like some other fruit snacks!  Glad I found something healthy to give my kids!
My son is a 18 months and I bought these instead of the not so healthy other snacks available, he loves them!

I got these especially for my 3 yr. old son. I like that they are organic. He especially likes the strawberry ones so if I reorder I won't bother with the variety pack. The only drawback is that they are pretty chewy for his little teeth to bite and chew up. From that perspective, a bite-size fruit snack would be better than the rope.
So they're still pure sugar...but a less-horrible way to let my kids have a guilty pleasure! This is a much more economical way of buying them, too!
This is a quality product. Kids love it and it is good for them. I also have not been able to find it cheaper.

These were great snacks for my son...........they are a "healthy" fruit roll up.Buying from Amazon saved me a fortune!! These cost about $2 each at a health food store.Thank you for the options Amazon!!

These fruit ropes are fantastic! No sugar added, just extreme fruit flavors that my whole family loves. Not too sweet, not to sour. They are a treat, though, because at 57 cents a piece with subscribe and save it's still a little pricey. We ration them because 24 pack would be gone in a week if we all had our way!
These are really good, even though they ship it as a kid item...the parents love it. It says with ya after you eat it as well.

this product is very good! much better then the other brand which have a lot of sugar and high in crabs (even for one little roll) being a diabetic theses are a very nice snack and a yummy fruit treat,all natural

I like Clif products because they always use mostly organic ingredients. These fruit snacks are my wife's favorite. Normally our trip to Whole Foods we make every couple months (70 miles away) is when we buy them and try to stock up. This a very good price for it though, and should last longer. My wife likes these flavors, especially Strawberry and Mixed Berry. Although there are some other flavors that she likes, this is a good deal for these flavors.

The product comes in a timely manner-My daughter and I love them-She has  3 kids who actually like all the flavors(which is a miracle in itself). We are sorry we can only order 3 boxes a month,but that is a minor inconvenience.  Thank you for your product.  We will continue to enjoy!  The price is good also.  TaTa for now!

These are a wonderful snack for my kids, although they have a hard time wrangling them out of my hands!  Great for school lunches too (if you pack)  Clif Kids has numerous great tasting, healthy kid friendly snacks!
I'm an adult and I love this product, so it's not just for kids. :)Great for satisfying a sweet craving while still being healthy and low-calorie. Excellent price on Amazon as well.

These taste amazing, almost like candy to me.  Add in the fact that they're made from fruit and count as a serving of fruit and this is one great product.  Ideally I'd get my fruit by eating fresh fruits, but when that isn't an option, these are a wonderful alternative.  If you're looking for a sweet snack that is made from real fruit, definitely give these a try.

My kids love these healthy and tasty snacks.  They keep them in their backpacks and in the car.  No crumbs, no mess, nutritious.  No corn syrup or artificial anything.  I think they are too strong flavored/sour, but the kids love them.
These are a fantastic snack for your toddler, child or even an adult!!  They taste amazing and are all organic.  Completely love this product and will continue to by!
My son loves these as a special snack treat.  I don't mind giving them to him because the ingredients are pretty good.  The Amazon price is by far better than the price in our local markets.
My 2 yo loves it. Great way for her to get some organic fruit in her system.

My son is serving with the Army in Iraq and this is his favorite snack. The candy is a bit over priced, but my son loves it. I only wish they shipped to APO (Military) address. I have to have shipped to my home and then I ship it to my son in Iraq.

column9: Great, organic, no added sugar or dyes, but expensive.
column10: The only thing keeping me from giving these 5 stars is the price.  My kids love them, and I order a couple of boxes every time amazon has them on sale.  I love that they are all fruit, no weird fillers, dyes, sugars, etc. but they taste like a treat or candy.  Highly recommend.....
The product is a hit with my kids, age 7 & 6.  They liked all 3 flavors.  We're happy to have them eating foods without added sugar.

column9: Doesn't taste good, texture is weird
column10: I bought these to pack in my preschooler's lunch because I thought they would be a good replacement for cookies or crackers.  We pack real fruit also, but sometimes it is nice to have a different type of treat.  The only problem is that my kid took a bite of one of them and was disgusted by it.  I thought maybe she was being a little resistant to a new food, so I decided to try it out myself.  I tried the strawberry one and it was rather bitter, not at all sweet.  In addition, the texture was weird.  It's really hard to explain the texture.  I was expecting it to be like licorice, but it was more like eating a gummy worm that had been sitting in the sun or something - squishy, grainy, and not at all like licorice.
Nom.Lots of themand they tasted great. Cheaper than buying them for a $1 each at the grocery store:-)

column9: The only twisted thing here is that they are making money off of this
column10: I bought these looking for a healthy alternative to fruit roll-up type snacks, and they are insomuch that healthy means they dont poison you, however they have nothing to offer more than a heaping 15g of sugar (half a soft drink), more or less the same taste for each flavor, little to no nutritional value (being mostly apple juice), and all that at $.66 a piece. Not a big deal given that there are no real alternatives, except wait, they taste exactly like prunes, which have 10x less sugar, alot of nutritional value, and cost about a 1/3 of the price of this pathetic attempt of pushing empty sugar on kids under the guide of being healthy organic food.Clif Co. stooped to the level of major corporations and attempted to manipulate its customers through deceptive marketing practices. They have certainly lost my business.

My 13-month old loves these!  They almost always satisfy her in the car or stroller.  They do have a larger portion of sugar than I like, so I try to give her 1/2 at a time... but it's sugar from the fruit, not added sugar, so I don't mind as much.  They have great taste and are easy to take along in the diaper bag or a pocket.  Hands will be sticky after your kid is done with this snack...This is a 5-star product except for the sugar content... although I'm not sure I'm being fair deducting a star for natural sugar.  It's not more than an actual apple or banana... it's just that there's more sugar than she usually eats in one snack.

column9: Will be keeping this one on the menu
column10: I started purchasing Merrick cat food for my cats about a month ago. The Merrick 5 star Gourmet is what they've been eating, and they love it. I guess they were stopping stocking the item and just wanted to get rid of the ones they had. Well, I'll certainly give it a try. column9: PBA-free cans! Hi quality, organic papaya chunks
column10: Update 1/19/12: Native Forest organic canned fruit is now PBA-FREE cans!  I love their organic papaya packed in pineapple juice--great taste,  and organic.  I've opened 6 cans so far, and so far the quality of the papaya chunks has been very high--no mushy overripe or green peel.  Amazon's price is the lowest price I found currently if you do Subscribe and Save.  Really like Amazon's Subscribe and Save: you can cancel at any time; change shipment dates; Amazon gives you email alert prior to shipment so you can cancel if you're not yet ready for a refill; even if you decide to cancel after only 1 order, you still get the low Subscribe and Save price.  Way to go Amazon.I was excited when I found these organic papaya chunks on Amazon.  I like the taste of papaya, and its a great digestive aide, with anti-acid effects.  But organic ones are hard to find fresh at decent prices, and the season for "fresh" ones is very short.  So we ordered a pack of these from Amazon to try.  Amazon's pack price subscribe and save was a bargain.  But after I'd already ordered and the order was in shipment, my wife said, "By the way, did you check with the manufacturer to see if the cans are PBA-free?"  Duhhh!  For us, it's a priority to try to avoid toxins like PBA in our foods.  And I certainly knew that most canned foods were in PBA-lined cans, and that recent research proved that the PBA leached from the can linings into the food.  I also knew that the best food manufacturers are in the process of converting to non-PBA cans.  I must have been in a real brain fog In my feverish excitement at finding affordable organic papaya, because I totally forgot the PBA question prior to clicking "order" at Amazon.  So I called "Edward & Sons"--the company that produces "Native Forest" brand organic foods [805-684-8500; [...]; Carpenteria, CA].  The pleasant staff told me that they were in the process of converting their products to PBA-free cans, but the organic papaya had not yet been converted to PBA-free cans, and they suggested I check back in a few months.  Bummer!  Summary: I temporarily give these a 1 star because of the PBA in the cans--very bad toxin; we won't eat any more until they're in PBA-free cans.  But for taste, quality, being organic, and reasonably priced, we would rate them 5 star.  So once Edward & Sons converts them to PBA-free cans, we'll rate them 5 star.  We applaud Edward & Sons for their commitment to being a leader in eliminating PBA in their cans.

column9: best dog treat-- great for training---  all dogs love them
column10: Freeze dried liver has a hypnotic effect on dogs. They LOVE it and will do just about anything for it, so it is a great treat to use for training. (Powdered freeze dried liver is even added to many dog medicines nowadays-- heartworm and arthritis tablets, etc.-- because it causes the dog to scarf the medicine down like a treat.)Freeze dried liver has a dry, hard, yet powdery/easy to chew consistency. It comes chopped/cubed. It is extremely lightweight due to the fact there is so little moisture in the product (thus the low weights on product labels).Even though your dog will love liver treats, you shouldn't overfeed it. The manufacturer recommends 1-2 cubes daily for small dogs, 2-3 cubes for medium dogs, and 3-4 cubes for large dogs.The largest package sizes of liver treats tend to be far more economical. I recommend buying the larger tubs, as you will save lots of money, you'll have a handy treat supply around for a longer time, and your dog will never tire of this product.There is really zero waste with this product. When you near the end of the tub you'll find some powdery bits of dried liver at the bottom. Your dogs will go CRAZY if you sprinkle this dust over their dog food-- it's a wonderful reward that is easy to use.I'm not sure you need the "center cut" round style-- my dogs don't care what the treat looks like, and all of this company's products are equally good.~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~Here's the nutritional analysis:-100% freeze dried liver-NO additives or preservatives.-Crude protein..... not less than 50%-Crude fat..... not less than 5%-Crude fiber..... not more than 3%-Moisture..... not more than 6%

This is NOT a review for coffee connoisseurs...While this coffee may not win any awards, it's not so bad either.  I think it's best to set our expectations first. Let's define what BAD coffee is.  Think about the coffee usually available in the breakrooms of Corporate America. They're usually extremely watered down and taste bitter and acidic so people end up drowning them with creme and sugar. I'm not sure if you can call that drinking coffee at that point as opposed to some concoction of sugar-milk-coffee that kinda sorta resembles coffee. When you open the cabinets, you'll be staring at a box of corporate coffee usually with the labels "Folgers", "Maxwell House" or [insert another brand here]. Yes, they are BAD coffee.  Let's keep that disgusting drink in mind when reviewing the Community Decaffeinated coffee.At a price point of 4 bucks and change for each bag, it's a bargain since you'll see that most decent coffee will cost you $7-9 for a 12oz bag at your local grocery store. I suppose you can stop by Starbucks and get your grande cup and pay $2-3 each time. But if you have a coffee brewer and a grinder, you can easily recreate the Starbucks experience right at home for so much less. I like sniffing the fresh aroma after grinding the beans.I always drink my coffee black. Good-enough coffee can be had without sugar and creme and that is what this coffee is. It is not intense in flavor and aroma but I like mine light bodied without that strong overpowering taste of French Roast.  I deliberately choose decaffeinated b/c I like to drink lots of coffee and this allows me to drink much more coffee than caffeinated coffee. I might down 8 cups in a day and not worry about getting the jitters and a racing heart followed by intense heart burn all due to having consumed too much caffeine. I only wish there were more flavors in decaffeinated form.4/5 stars. It's not the best but good enough and good bang for the buck. It may not work for everyone but it works for me.[Update 4/2012]: I've seen the prices of Community Coffee fluctuate a lot since buying my first batch. Now each bag is not $3 but more like $5.50 (if you subscribe). At this price point, it's not the stellar deal as before but it's still respectable, although I would perhaps consider paying up $2-3 to get a "better" bag of coffee from the grocery store. Just a thought.

A mix of two-thirds flavored coffee and one-third Community Coffee dilutes the flavor to the right level for my taste.If you're looking for a robust, tasty decaf brew, with rich flavor you need to look elsewhere - this is not the one. Other reasonably-priced ones I'd recommend are Weaver's, Lavazza, Coffee Bean Direct and Mayorga.
