I have long sought out coffee that would taste as good as the coffee that every restaurant seems to be able to make.  Well, I have found it!I originally ordered this coffee because Amazon had some nice coupons that made the coffee insanely cheap.  I wasn't expecting much since it was so cheap.  But, I was pleasantly surprised at the smoothness of the coffee.  Also, the coffee I usually buy has a slight bitter taste to it, but this coffee has an almost sweet taste to it, which I love!  It's one of the only coffees I can drink without adding any creamer, sugar, or milk.I'm keeping my subscribe and save on this product because not only is it cheap, it's as good as restaurant coffee!
Some decafs taste weak and acidic to me - this one is surprisingly good. I would buy it again if it were on sale again.

My wife drinks mainly decaf. I got this coffee for her with no previous experience with the Community Coffee brand.The price was really good with an available Amazon Coupon & subscribe and save, so I bit.This coffee is pretty amazing for it's current price and the fact that it is decaf. I like some pretty exotic coffees sometimes for their aroma and flavor. Decaf coffees usually smell horrible and a lot don't taste much better. This is good decaf coffee.

Growing up in Louisiana, this was simply "coffee."  Served by family, friends, neighbors, churches, restaurants, it was a link to the past and the present.  Smooth and robust flavor, never too bitter.  I'm excited to get it again even though I live halfway across the country.  This is coffee worth trying if you're bored of Starbucks and want something made with care for the final product.

column9: A decaf that tastes like REAL coffee!
column10: Title pretty much says it all! I finally found a decaf that I can grind myself, that actually tastes more like coffee than cardboard, and doesn't cost an arm and a leg!

We drink several cups of coffee per day.  We decided to try this after getting a good price for it.It's so bad (per our taste buds) that we'll probably end up tossing it.  We don't buy Folgers or Maxwell House so we can't compare those.

I bought two six packs when this was on special recently and since the reviews were few and all over the place, the price was low enough that I took a gamble.If you buy this, keep in mind that you need two tablespoons of beans per cup.  This is twice the amount of coffee usually called for and these are the instructions on the Community Coffee bag.  The good thing is that you'll go through this coffee twice as quickly, so as long as you brew regularly...you'll use it up relatively quickly.The taste is on the bitter side, so I have been compensating with cream and more stevia than I usually use with my coffee.  I have been using Zero Water to brew my coffee and even that doesn't help this coffee to taste great.It's not great, it's not terrible.  My son will drink it with me, my wife will not.  It certainly isn't dishwater as the one and two star reviews for this product indicate, it IS better than that.  I was disappointed that this didn't live up to the four and five star reviews.  This certainly does not hold up to the taste and quality of beans that I have gotten from Dunkin' Donuts although since DD runs about $6 per pound and this ran about that for 2 1/4 pounds, it seems like a good deal.  Again, since you use twice the amount of this brand vs. DD, the per cup price ends up about the same just absent the qualityI am almost done my first bag and it has lasted about two weeks.I really wanted to love this coffee, but alas I just can't get there.  If I have a better experience with the remaining bags, I will post an update to this review.

I've had worse but not much. A lot like Royal Cup or Maxwell House. Very dishwater like.For economy decaf beans I'll stick with Costco's Seattle's Finest Columbian. Way better than this weak stuff. I can't even give the other 2 bags to friends.

I always drank community coffee when I live in LA, but now that I'm out of state, its hard to find.  Amazon is made it much easier, especially with subscribe and save.  This is a full flavored but smooth coffee, and its tasty even though it's decaf.  I highly recommend for those who want a better cup of coffee.

I have been using this brand for a while. I drink a lot of coffee and good, affordable decaf whole beans are hard to find. This makes a good, everyday coffee at an affordable price. I also sometimes mix it with some of my more expensive beans to make a very nice blend at less cost. I used to order it direct from the company and was happy when Amazon started selling it, with Prime shipping I save a lot of money over the course of a year.  If you are having a hard time finding beans you can afford to grind and brew, try these.
But VERY delicious just the same. If you're looking for a wee bit of a different flavor in the old favorite Oreo -- this is just what you're looking for! LOVE the size of the mini's too.

A little pricey but if you're like me and absolutely love trying new things with food then it will be well worth the money. It was well packed and they delivered it right away. All in all, a great experience. If they came down on the price I would purchase a lot more assortments of this nature. I good one time purchase as a treat but for the price it won't be something I will buy over and over again.
Wonderful collection of extremely good salt.  We have enjoyed experimenting with the different flavors.  Thanks for the very fast delivery.  We are happy with the product.

column9: I have found Ambrosia.  This is the best Ginger ale in the world.
column10: I do not drink alcohol and having a very delicate stomach, I often find myself drinking ginger ale when I am at social functions or after a heavy meal.  I tasted fever tree ginger ale on my last night out and I knew I had never really tasted ginger ale before that moment, it was just fantastic.  It does not have the sickly sweet taste of Canada dry or Schweppes.  The ginger is not so concentrated as to give you heartburn after consumption.  It is simply perfection in a bottle.  Cheers!

column9: Terra Medi - Delicious Olive Oil from Greece
column10: Terra Medi is amazing olive oil from Greece, not Italy.  It is more flavorful than the Italian oils that most Americans associated with olive oils. Cook's Magazine ranks it number one.

These are a great beverage to serve instead of soda at parties and gatherings. We used to get them at the local health food store, but now can only find them on Amazon. They are really worth it! I would particularly recommend both the peach and guava flavors. They're delicious on their own, mixed into smoothies, frozen into sorbet or popsicles, and added to fruity cocktails (definitely try making Bellinis using Kerns peach nectar, it's so good!!) They sometimes taste a little bit like aluminum if you're drinking it straight from the can, but this goes away once you pour it into a glass. They are also very very sugary; not the thing if you're looking for something lightly fruit-flavored! But they're great if you're looking for a treat that doesn't have quite as much refined sugar in it as soda.

column9: This is an addicting juice ever!!
column10: This drink is rare to find at stores, even though the taste is superb. I drink one can almost every day as much as I enjoy coffee.It's got plenty of sugar from concentrated fruits, and it makes you relaxed when you are tired. This company offers differentflavors, yet I personally recommend this peach flavor. If you are hesitating buying a whole box, don't worry. You will easily finisheverything and would want to order another one.

column9: Kerns-the Best Drink I've ever tasted!!!!!
column10: If your wondering were to get this amazing beverage, you can most likely get it at your local donut shop or at your local supermarket. There are many wonderful flavors, but my favorite are the apricot and mango. If you like fruit juices or smoothies  this will be like going to heaven and back, I do recommend poring this in the cup to maximize the flavor possiblities.  I gave this five stars for a reason, you Must try KERNS, you won't be sorry. They wil be coming up with better things soon,also folow them on Facebook!;)
Mix with vodka,oceans ray cranberry pom juice and kern's peach nectarNew summer drink.Can't find in Ohio

I've been using this product for at least a decade. You clear the area of weeds first, apply by sprinkling the grains, then lightly water. Depending on rainfall it lasts 3-4 months. Do wish they could make it last 6 months since here in the Midwest it sometimes gets warm in March or early April; if applied then, one would have to put down another application in July or so. The label lists the plants around which it can be used: the list is very long. I usually put it in and around my hedge, flowers, lilac and forsythia bushes, tomato and bell pepper plants as well as along the fence. It saves a lot of work.

I really love this stuff. I have a very big yard, a demanding job, a chronically ill husband to care for and a 15 year old who is being home schooled. Needless to say, I don't have time to be in the yard all day everyday, but when we bought our first home in the winter I was stunned and overwhelmed by the forrest that grew in the yard in the summer. My neighbor gave me a really hard time about the weeds as well. We were first time home owners and didn't know what to do. My approach would have been to offer advice rather than pick a fight, but I guess some people would rather be bullies. But anyway...I did my research and found Preen which is just wonderful. I used the preen on the hill in our back yard and along the sides of my home where weeds grow. I did notice grass growing where I used the Preen. Apparently the weeds were choking out the grass. But I love how Preen makes my yard look nice and neat. Now my neighbor can shut her mouth about my yard and my yard now looks better than hers. Just wait until the summer when I mulch, plant, and trim!We have decided to sell the home though b/c it is too much work that I don't have time to do. Preen helped me keep my sanity though. I HIGHLY recommend it. The only reason I gave it a 4 is becaue I so wish it had weed killer and preventer as well. Seems when you buy the two combinations together the killer or the preventer action is diminished.

We followed the directions to the tee. We put it down before we mulched. And a few months later we put it down again. When we came back from the North in Sept., we found many weeds and grass. We were kinda disappointed as preen is expensive.Sue/Dan

column9: Preen doesnt work at all, bucket is good for washing cars and windows
column10: Yes I did follow the directions to the letter.  Read ALL the enclosed warnings and pamphlets.  Sort of seems like I got more weeds using this product.  I will say though that the one really good thing is the bucket it cam in.  Makes a great car wash and windown was bucket.  Squeegee fits right in it.  Really the only thing I can say good about it.

I did everything right. I plowed my garden with my tractor completly turning under the dirt and weeds. I then disked till any weeds were pulversized and then roto tilled with the tractor and a 5 foot rototiller until there was not a sign of weeds left after this process. I spread the PREEN even heavier than recommended. THE WEEDS IN MY TOMATOES and PEPPERS ARE DOING GREAT THOUGH. DO NOT WASTE YOUR MONEY ! DO NOT TRUST THE ONE OR TWO GLOWING REVIEWS LISTEDE UNDER THE SEVERAL LISTINGS FOR THIS PRODUCT. Ask yourself if you trust these reviews/reviewers. I say they have "skin in the game" and cannot be trusted. Who are they really-actually buyers or shills for the Manufacturer/sellers ? I know where I'd put my money. I'm fortunate in that I did not pay the full overpriced amount for mine. I bought it at the end of the season when Sam's Club was practically giving it away for pennies on the dollar. I used it the next spring so it really should not have been affected by any expiration date or anything like that. IT JUST DOES NOT WORK.
This is the best tasting and best eating gluten free spaghetti I have ever had.  I really look forward to spaghetti again.

column9: Almost undrinkable due to the artificial sweetener taste
column10: Each package comes with 8 milk creamer discs and 8 chai tea discs, making a total of 8 drinks.  You use the creamer disc first, then the tea disc.  Tassimo recommends that you run the brewer through a cleaning cycle after making a milk drink (you don't want to spoil your next non-milky drink).I love Chai (or spiced) tea with a little sugar or honey, so I was really looking forward to a Chai Latte made with my brand new Tassimo Brewer.  Boy was I disappointed!I don't see it in the description, but the tea contains sucralose (that's the sweetener in Splenda).  While I generally avoid artificial sweeteners in general, as I don't like the taste, I do make some exceptions.  It's possible to use them and have an enjoyable flavor if the flavors are balanced.They aren't in this Twinings Chai.  There is definitely too much sweetener.  I would prefer that they err on the side of not enough sweetener---after all, everyone has their own preferences, but I can always add more, I can't remove what's already there.The balance between the milk and tea was also off and the milk has a decided reconstituted dry milk taste to it.  Not my fave. ;0)  Between the sweetener overkill and the milk, it was hard to even tell that this was spiced tea or tea at all.I won't be purchasing again.

I don't taste the artificial sweetener the others have mentioned. Maybe it's because I use it. What I encountered was too much nutmeg? over a cheap assam or whatever tea they use. Despite that initial taste, it wasn't long before this became my favorite of the two T-disc flavors I've had so far (Maxwell House House Blend & Geavalia Cap.). I discovered that if I add more sugar or sweetener or a tiny bit more water, to this tea, it improved the taste. If I want a coconut taste, I squirt some light whip cream in it. After trying the undrinkable Gevalia cappaccino, I was relieved to find something I liked, because I didn't want to return my Tassimo machine. The creamer isn't bad in this one. I don't know if it's a different kind or if it is a good combination of seasoning. I gave it 3 stars because for this price, Twinings should have used a better grade of tea. It tastes pretty good now, but there is that subtle aftertaste of earthy tea. With the milk, it fills my insulated glass 3/4 of the way full. One other feature, it smells wonderful brewing! It IS Thanksgiving in a cup! (Thermal glass, I mean.) Unless amazon lowers their price, you can get a better deal at Walmart for $8.48. I think it's catching on because they were sold out in two of the Walmart's I went to. In a pinch, I can also order it at Bed, Bath, & Beyond, and after using their 20% coupon, it is $8.79 (regular price: $10.99 for the 16 disc (8 servings) pkg.). BBB has free shipping to your house. If you have Walmart online send it to your local Walmart, then shipping is free. If your store doesn't carry it, bring in the barcode to customer service and make sure someone in the grocery department gets it. If amazon had an equal price or better than Walmart, I would buy it from them, because I like amamzon.

column9: Hard to find at a decent price.
column10: I feel like t-discs are going out. They seem very hard to find now. However, I have found them on Amazon for a decent price. I am not a big tea drinker but I LOVE this Chai Tea Latte! Perfect for when I don't want as much caffeine as coffee.

I love these!  A little pricier than I would like but they are worth it.  I have tried buying all kinds of chai teas at the grocery store to make my own lattes, but they just don't taste as good as these. The price here is cheaper than I was paying on the tassimo site too.

Great taste and with the subscription saved money. Recommend to all Tassimo owners. Hopefully Tassmio will; survive the latest issues with the brans. I will hate to be out of the great flavors it offers.

I have always loved Panera's Chai Tea but have never found anything like until now. Oh, is this good! It got cold here in Maryland this past weekend. So great to enjoy a delicious chai latte and relax after being outside. Yum!

column9: So good it should be illegal!
column10: Wow this stuff is crazy good, well worth the price!  I am torn between this and the Jacobs latte as being my favorite.  Love it!
The "Subscribe & Save" option is great but would be even better if you changed this to a pack of 4 because I always run out before the end of the month is up! (I use one pack a week) Thank you!

I was skeptical about trying these chocolate cups because they are dairy free and I was afraid that they would not taste very good.  I made some delicious pudding shots (seriously, it tastes like there is no alcohol in the pudding), and the cups are delicious.  Unfortunately, I can't stop eating them (I've already had three today), and when my boyfriend comes home from work, he heads straight for the freezer, where they are currently stored.  He loves the chocolate cups, I love the chocolate cups, my friends love the chocolate cups.....no complaints all around.

This is a beautiful tea set and I love making tea in it and serving to my friends in the adorable matching cups. My only disappointment was the very first time I used the cups, the hot tea actually cracked the glaze on the bottom of the cup, creating a spiderweb effect. Every single cup! I could hear the glaze cracking after I poured. I've never had glazed teacups before, so maybe this is normal, but I kind of doubt it. They still look pretty, even with the cracks, but I worry about their integrity.

This tea set has a beautiful color and design. It small and cute!! The perfect amount. When i order this tea set it came very quickly and didn't have to wait long for it to arrive. For the amount you get with this tea set is a reasonable price. The only bad part is that you have to buy a strainer with this set.
This teapot set looks amazing, and is the perfect size. The only problem I had with it was it didn't come with the metal strainer. Other than that, excellent tea set!

At one time you could purchase garlic spread at your supermarket, but the places I go do not carry such items. I have used garlic spreads in the past and you can do many things with garlic spread. I picked this item because of the parsley and of course the garlic flavor. I am pleased that I did. I haven't used the spread that much but it makes great garlic toast. I believe you will be pleased with this product.
We have been using the Badia garlic and Parsley spread for some time and we like it.  I wiil recommend you to try it.

column9: USE THE CUPS MORE THAN ONCE!!! EXTRA VALUE!
column10: I don't know if most people know this or not, but in Japan we put loose green tea leaves in a pot and just keep pouring hot water over it until the "taste" is too weak. All the water must be poured out after no more than 3 minutes or else the tea will be biter. Thats why most Japanese tea sets are so small. Green tea isn't meant to be left in a teapot like english teas. So my first cup of green tea was actually a little stronger than I am used to and I actually got 3 uses out of ONE k-cup. I highly recommend using them more than once if you are making the tea one cup after another....and it will save you MONEY!

column9: It's good stuff, better than expected.
column10: I usually buy numi green tea mao feng. And the tea from this k-cups is comparable. Numi tastes a little better, but the k-cup is more convinient. Thus, I am most likely going to buy this tea from now on.

Reading the reviews for this tea, I was skeptical, but made the purchase anyway.  Really glad I did.  If you're used to the watered-down "green" tea they serve at chinese buffets or cheaper restaurants, you may find it bitter.  Stick to water, this isn't for you.While not the same quality as good Japanese teas, It is the best I've had from the K-cups, and better than most of the tea bags I can get in the states.If you like REAL green tea, you'll probably love this.  If you're A WIMP, try Snapple.

I admit to being sceptical about having an instant tea that I would normally let steep for 5 minutes.  This is the most bitter green tea I have ever drank.  Maybe it's too concentrated, or the water's not hot enough.  I tried different drink size options, and that didn't work.  Maybe the black teas are better.  I'll stick to a different green tea, and brew it the old fashioned way.
Makes a great cup of green tea.  I use the middle setting and it is just right.  I tend to like my tea strong and this does not turn out too watery, very impressive for a green tea.

I've tried two different types of green tea in my Keurig B60 and this one is my favorite.  I usually drink it iced by filling a 20oz cup full of ice and letting it brew directly into that cup.  20 seconds later I have my "morning tea" and I'm ready to face the day.

I really enjoy this Green Tea. Has great taste and not too strong. I see others have found this bitter but that is not what I find.  I love Green Tea more than any other tea but sometimes it is hard to find in the K-cups.  Have been using various green teas for years and I find this to be one of the best!  It is currently available on Subscribe & Save.

By far my favorite k cup. In fact, I like to brew a cup of this and a cup of Timothy's English Breakfast, mix them together, throw Stevia in and then ice cubes in a big tumbler. Such a delicate tasting green tea. Yum.
Very bitter, takes a adding ton of sugar to make it drinkable. Will probably just go back to regular tea bags...

I really like these K-cups for iced tea for the Keurig Brewer. I wanted a green tea like the Celestial Seasonings Green Tea but was looking for a better price than Green Mountain coffee website offers. I do not drink hot tea so I cannot comment on how it is for a cup of hot tea. I drink my iced tea plain - no sugar or lemon and I found this tea very crisp and refreshing but not strong like the black tea. I would say the taste compares to the Celestial Seasonings green tea. I have 2 brew sizes on my Keurig and I brew on the large cup and just add ice ~ if you wanted a stronger tea, of course you could brew on the smaller cup.
This tea is the best for my Keurig. It is stronger then the others offered which I prefer. Absolutely love it!!!!!!!!!

I've tried other k-cup green teas and find that the Twinings was the least bitter.  Every morning before I go to work, I use a small Rubbermaid Mixermate container and fill it up at 11 oz with one flavored herb tea bag at the bottom.  Green tea generally doesn't have alot of flavor so I add something to it so I still get the benefits.
I'm a tea junkie but was nervous buying such a large quantity of tea that I had never tried.  It's great!  Not bitter at all.  Smooth!
Unlike some reviews I found this tea a little weak at first .... now I got used to it and I love it!
I was looking for a good green tea that is ready for keurig brew. I ordered this from Amazon and it is a good tasting product. I get about 16 oz of brew in one go and it is consistent.
Could never figure out why some teas are green.  Then the answer came to me on a back country road, there was a bright light, swirling wind and some odd creatures.  They told me why and now I know!
I love my keurig coffee/tea maker nut the k-cups are really expensive so i thought id try Amazon. Great product... Good price... I'll be back!!
Love the flavor. Perfect strength in my brewer - will be ordering again.Wish that it came in loose leaf to be more eco-friendly

i love these green tea k-cups---  they have great flavor and are not bitter at all like some green teas can be.  i also love the pack of 2 with 25 cups each, very economical!  i would definitely buy again, and would recommend it to others.

I had tried this in a smaller quantity and wanted more. It's been great, came fast, no problems.  I'd highly recommend this one as most of the brands of caffeinated green tea K-Cups have been very bitter and this one is perfect and a great drink!

I wanted to find an alternative to coffee to avoid the sugar & cream, and this product fits exactly that.It was delivered on time, and the taste was excellent.  Moreover, I thought the packaging and the cup itself looks pleasing.I am sure my guess will enjoy the tea.  For me, I can drink this w/o feeling bad about the sugar.  Perfect.

Bought this Green Tea pack for my wife.  She's not much of a coffee drinker and wanted to brew tea in our Keurig.  She likes the flavor, and is able to get multiple glasses of tea out of one k-cup.  Good value for the price too.  We get it on Subscribe and Save.
Great value for green tea.  It is not the most exotic of teas, but a good solid-not bitter tea.
It tastes bitter, a typical sign of low-quality green tea leaves. Shouldn't have bought green tea from a black tea company. I'm left with 49 k-cups I don't want to consume...

Twinings Green Tea is decent.  It's not too bitter (as others have stated) and has just enough tea flavor.  I haven't tried the Bigelow for comparison, but I'll probably re-order Twinings through Amazon's subscribe & save.

The tea is loose in the cup and the tea comes out into the cup.  Not drinkable.  It's like pouring loose tea into your cup and filling with hot water.  It needs to be strained!  I wanted to return the tea but it's not a returnable item, so now I am stuck with it.

A great tasting tea, in a perfect delivery device.  What could be better?  As soon as I received my first delivery, though, the auto-delivery option was cancelled.  I'm dismayed.  An outrage, to be sure.  I agree with whoever it was that recommended making ice tea directly into an ice-filled glass.  Tasts, easy, tidy.  One of life's happiest experiences.
I tried the Bigelow green tea first and wasn't too impressed. The Twinings Green Teahad a better flavor and was not bitter
I agree with the reviewers who said the tea was bitter. When I to add lemon and additional hot water to the tea, it's relatively good though.
I did like the green tea in k-cups ...I do agree it is a bit stronger than the tea bags...however all you have to do is add a bit more water ...I like it lots!

I'm mostly a coffee drinker but I do try to drink a cup of green tea everyday. 50 Count seemed like a lot but in the grand scheme it's a month to six week supply so very affordable. The tea is great tasting and same quality as in the bags. The only problem I have with tea from the Keurig is that I like my tea hotter than a cup of coffee. Coming through the k-cup doesn't really seep the tea.  If that's not a big deal to you, then this is great for your keurig.
Just a wonderful cup of green tea.  What more needs to be said?  Enjoy!
Green tea is a favorite for me and to find it for K-cups is awesome. The flavor is great and the strength is perfect. Love it.

I first discovered this product in our local Food Lion grocery store, but they stopped carrying them.  I searched everywhere, because my 3 1/2 year old granddaughter loved them.  I am trying to offer her snacks that are healthful and she is exposed to so much junk.  I looked online and found them.  I bought 2 packs of 2 different flavors and she was so excited that her "Gran" bought them just for her!  I highly recommend them.  You can always keep the excess quantity in the freezer until you need them.Very happy grandmother.
My almost 3 year old really enjoys these for a snack or dessert. The only downside is, they are pretty crumbly and can make quite a mess!
I love the idea of these and I was so sure my toddler would love them (he loves all bars). He tried them a few times but after a bite he would toss it. They are bite size- think fig newton size.

My kids get one of these in their lunch almost every day. They are an easy snack that I don't have to feel guilty about. Even the "healthy" cereal bars at most stores have added chemicals, food dyes, and high fructose corn syrup. Love these!

column9: Kids love'em, All be it a little messy.
column10: Jammy Sammys are like minature ceral bars for small hands.  They can crumble and fall apart, so not a good car travel snack.  Kids love these things though.  So if you are looking for an organic option, that is small hand friendly, portable and fun - these fit the bill.
Perfect size for my toddler, but even my 5 & 6 year olds love them. Great to throw in the purse or backpack for a healthy on-the-go snack.

column9: Jammy Sammy - Blueberry & Oatmeal - great on-the-go snack
column10: Both my 1.5 and 3.5 year olds love these snacks.  They are a bit on the sweet side but no more so than most packaged kid snacks, and the ingredients in this item are pretty straightforward (i.e. not a lot of weird chemicals or fillers), so that makes me feel a bit better.  I also don't give them out all the time.  I tend to use them when I need a snack when we're going out and about.  This also makes sense because they aren't cheap, so to use them all the time at home would be a waste of packaging plastic and money.  I actually discovered these when one child was having a meltdown at Target and I needed something FAST to quell the outbreak and this is what was handy.  After that discovery, I found Amazon to have the best deal in bulk.UPDATE 3/6/2012 - Kids still love these snacks.  I alternate them with other stuff, but especially good size for younger kido.  Not too big.

column9: Daughter Loves these, but they seem pricey
column10: My daughter loves her Jammy Sammy Snacks, and they arent too bad for her which makes me feel better about giving them to her; however they are a little procey for what you get. My daughter is 2.5 and always asks for these as a snack, the only con I see is that they contain nuts so she cant take them to a lot of the places that now ban peanuts (havent seen a soy not alternative). But, it is definitley a favorite at home.

Got these for snacks for kids at school and they love them. Great bite sizey snack for little ones who aren't looking for an entire meal as a snack. They are about 4 adult sized bites worth, only slightly larger than a fig newton, but perfect as a children's snack (My kids are 6,5,3 and 1 and they all love them).

I bought these from a local grocery store and my son loved these. I tasted them but found them too sweet, so these are definitely for kids. I feel good about giving these to my 1.5 year old because they are organic and healthy. I couldn't find them in my grocery store next time I went to buy, so I checked here and I'm glad that they are sold here! A little more pricey at amazon than my local grocery.

column9: Super picky 2 year old loves them and mom approves
column10: We love these. Not only does our super picky 2 year love these, but they are organic and perfect for on the go. Another bonus it saves us the 45 min drive to babiesRus in our SUV!!

These are SO yummy!  We have no toddlers.  Yesterday, I bought these from my local store (they are cheaper on amazon).  I have a very pick 8 year old.  I thought she would like them.  I went to give one to her, and I took a bite, to show her how good they are...  Well, to my surprise, they were REALLY good.  I am happy to offer these to anyone of any age in my family for a snack.  They taste great, and have healthy ingredients- So, why not?

My 20 month old LOVES these, they are a little crumbly in her little hands, but luckily she insists on eating it out of the package, so that helps contain some of the crumbs. I definitly would not recommend using this food if your child is going to be walking around while snacking. As long as she's contained the mess doesn't matter. I have tried these as well, and think they're tastey as well. Blueberry is her favorite, the Chocolate Grammy Sammy is also a family favorite.

*** Buyer Beware: Note that all negative reviews are from Amazon verified purchases. column9: The Best Milk Chocolate Outside of Belgium!
column10: The Dove milk chocolate is the creamiest and finest chocolate I can get my hands on without going international. I discovered these bars about a month ago and they are just the right size (about 1.4 ounces each). The bars are large enough to satisfy a chocolate craving without being too much. I recently ran a marathon in November and trained all summer using Clif Shot Energy Gels during my LR's.  However, during one of the races I ran this summer they gave out PowerBar Gels and I loved them.  I recently bought an entire box of PowerBar Gels to train for a marathon in January and I can't see myself ever switching.  Here are the pros/cons:PowerBar PROS * thinner consistency which makes it easier to swallow * great taste - I have the Strawberry/Banana and found them to be the best tasting gel I ever had yet. 9.5 out of 10 * easy to open - the packaging is very easy to open, even with sweaty hands during a runPowerBar CONS * haven't been able to come up with one yetClif Bar PROS * Litter Leash on side of package to keep from ripping the top off.  Keeps the entire package in one piece to prevent littering. * Overall I can't complaining about the taste.  8 out of 10Clif Bar CONS * Hard to open - these Gels are almost impossible to open once your hands get wet. * Thick consistency - these Gels get thicker in cold weather and become very hard to swallow.  Plus the gel itself is a bit more powdery (Chocolate) then PowerBar.

I used these gels while training for my first marathon and finally during the marathon 4 days ago.  They were an invaluable tool in helping me finish.  If you take one every 45 minutes, your energy level stays constant throughout the run.  The Strawberry Banana flavor is also very tasty.

I must preface this review with: I am a Gu fan. I've tried so many different brands, flavors, and types of gels/blocks/cubes, whatever, and I love Gu to get the job done. For PowerBar, I've tried the Vanilla, which is really delicious. It tastes like cake frosting! However, the vanilla does not have caffeine, so this does not fill my needs. I have tried the Double Latte, which I abhor--I thought it was AWFUL. It just stuck to my teeth and wouldn't go down, and yuck yuck yuck. I love coffee, too. But as a liquid, in a mug! :) I have heard from many runners that they enjoy the Green Apple, so I might try these in the future. The PowerBar brand is a thinner consistency than Gu or Clif, so sometimes I think it goes down a lot easier, especially if you're not near a water fountain or aid station. If the vanilla had caffeine, I would probably stick with that one. I couldn't run the distances I do without gels. I take one on a daily run of 7-8 miles, I'll take 2 gels on a weekend run of 14-16 miles, and I'll take 3 on a run longer than 20 miles (in addition to Clif Bars). I hope this helps someone make a gel decision!Oh, in addition, I want to point out that PowerBar gels are made in a facility that manufactures dairy products, whereas Gu does not. I hope this helps the allergy sufferers out there!

column9: Best tasting caffeinated gel. Flimsy on a bike.
column10: If form factor was not a concern, the tangerine PowerBar Gel would be hands down my favorite all around gel. The taste is great, it packs enough caffeine to pick you up if you're about to bonk, and the wrapper is thin enough so that it is easy to squeeze out every last drop of gel from the wrapper. The thin, low profile wrapper is great if you put gels in your pocket, as most exercise clothing is thin and low on space. It's also less likely to poke you than other rigid gel packages.That said, if you tape gels to your bike frame like I do, the thin wrapper that works so well for squeezing works against you if you want them to stay flush on the bike frame. They end up sagging over the side of the bike which not only can be an aerodynamic issue (okay, maybe not a major concern for everyone), but the added stress on the side of the package ends up prematurely tearing the gel open. I haven't actually experienced the wrapper leaking on my bike yet, but I have noticed the beginnings of a tear on the wrapper.In conclusion, if you don't tape gels to you bike post, the tangerine PowerBar gels rock. If you do, consider Hammer Energy Gel (12 pack) instead (but Hammer Gels are a little more difficult to squeeze and get the gel out, and have a thicker texture).

column9: Not Horrible, Gets the Job Done
column10: These aren't the most delicious things you'll ever eat - the taste is a little bit off and chemically.But they're certainly better than tolerable. And that fact that you're going to want to wash them down with plenty of water? That's a good thing - you're working hard, and you could use the extra H20.Best of all, these get the job done. They keep me from bonking during my workout..the carbs are great and the caffeine can't hurt. Amazon's price is good, too.

I've tried many others over the past 5 marathons but my body loves the strawberry banana power gels the best for those long runs and races. They are easy to carry, store well in pockets or under gloves, and digest well with some water or light sports drink.Hint - I enjoy keeping the gels in the fridge or freezer before taking out on warm days. I like to keep them on the "solid" side if possible.

OK, I ate some of this stuff before the last 10 miles ofan 87 mile ride. I don't know if this gel is the reasonor not, but my legs quit feeling very tired, and I pulledmy two riding partners the last 10 miles at 18-23 mphagainst a mild headwind. Several others who were behind mefell off.  We ended up with a 20mph average.I like the flavor too.  I think I responded well to thecaffeine!

column9: Great for a long run or bike ride
column10: I started running a couple years ago, and I ran my first marathon last year.  I always carry PowerGel with me on my long runs.  Yes PowerGel is just sugar and caffine, but when I'm bonking 15 miles into a 20 mile run, I am super glad I have one in my pocket.  I think the benefit comes mainly from the sugar, but I do tend to buy the flavors with 25mg of caffine.  In general I give PowerGel 4 to 5 stars, but I'm giving the Tangerine flavor two stars because I didn't like the taste.  All the other flavors are much better.

I'm an avid cyclist and XC mountain bike racer.  Like most gels this has all the clean burning fuel one needs for a quick boost pre-ride or, most importantly, during an endurance experience.  The taste is great, but what I like most of all is the texture...not at solid as the others so it goes down much easier, especially when one is gasping and grasping for breath and water bottle to wash it down.  It feels more organic and easier on the gut also.  It's the best I've found.

My boyfriend bought this flavor and I tried one. After that I was hooked.  I bought the PowerBar Strawberry banana gels for my racing. I love the flavor. Some gels are too thick and some too thin, but these have just the right consistency.  I am able to carry a lot of these packets in my waterbelt, because they are so small.  I plan on buying these again. I would definitely recommend these to anyone that runs long distances.

I used them when training for my first marathon and took them every 30-45 minutes on my long runs. I felt great. They have a good taste too, like eating strawberry banana yogurt. They really kept me going. I definitely recommend them.
Powerbar gel is easy to get down, the taste is not bad and it really gives you an instant burst of energy,  especially when riding up a steep hill on my bike

This is a fantastic product.  I'm relatively new to long distance running (my long runs are only 10k) and this is the first gel product I've used, but it did not disappoint.It's hard to credit my gains solely to this, so I will give a wrap-up of my experience and let you decide.  The first time I ran 10k, I had a time of 55:25 (I know that's slow, but I'm a bigger guy).  The second time I tried it, there were a few differences: I wore running shorts (the first time I wore basketball shorts) and I had a fuel belt equipped with a 20oz water bottle and two Strawberry Banana PowerBar Power Gel Packets; temperature and environment were similar during both runs.  Anyway, I popped these gel packs at around the 20 minute and 40 minute mark and my time dropped to 52:21!  I don't know about you, but I think an improvement of over 3 minutes is fantastic...  Especially if you consider that is nearly 30 seconds per mile.Okay, so I know the shorts (they were quite a bit lighter and didn't get soaked with sweat) and liquid helped quite a bit, as well as my muscles being a little more broken in from the first time I tried 10k, but the biggest thing I noticed was my consistency.  My third mile on my first run was a horrific 9:37 and way off the rest of my mile times.  During my second run, each mile ranged from around 8:17 (my 5th mile) to 8:37 (my first mile); I think the fact that my mile times improved as my run went on also illustrates the effectiveness of this product.  I track my time and distance with a Garmin Forerunner 205 (another fantastic product).Anyway, I highly suggest this product if you are new to long distance running or a veteran that competes.  If you dont' want to commit to an entire box, I bought a couple of individual packets at REI for $1.25 a piece just to see if I noticed an improvement.  Compared to the other reviews, I don't think this is hard to swallow at all.  If you spray a little water in your mouth before consuming the packet, it goes down even easier.  My one and only con would be that it is kind of sticky, so if you get any on your hands it's quite annoying; small price to pay in my eyes.

I like PowerBar gel more than most other brands, mainly because of the viscosity/consistency. Competing brands like Gu are way too thick for eating on a run I think - especially in cold weather. The formulation I think could use improvement - it's a little sugary for me, and my stomach feels a little upset after consuming 3 or more on a long run, but it's not too bad (I don't know of anything better at the moment).The Banana strawberry flavor is one of the best, and has just the right of caffeine (1 shot), if you're looking to consume many during a long run.  Vanilla (no caffeine) and Tangerine (2 shots caffeine) are also among my favorites as well.Product came very quickly; I'm happy with the purchase.

I ordered this based on others reviews that it tasted great. I force myself to use it prior to a run and can force down one during the run but the flavor is not good. Texture is fine and I think the caffeine is great however a terrible flavor.

column9: My goto fuel source for endurance training

Here's why I like them:- Flavor - The tangerine isn't too sweet and doesn't leave a bad aftertaste.- Consistency - The gel isn't too thick so it's easy to get down even with a dry mouth.  I still suggest chasing with fluids.- Caffeine - There's just enough to help get me over the hump on those tough days.This 24 pack is a great deal if you are training for marathons or other endurance races and plan on multi hour training sessions.See you on the trails!

I've also used Gu and Hammer, and don't have any complaints about them other than much fewer calories per package. Suggest you try a few of each to come to your own conclusions.

column9: The best Gels on the market
column10: I have completed 3 Ironman races - these are the base of my nutrition in training and racing. I use them throughout the year and try different flavors. My favorite is Chocolate yum!

Since I require supplementation every 6 miles or so, I like something that provides long-lasting energy and tastes decent, and this gel does both.  The taste is orangy with an undertone of caramel, which may sound a bit strange, but it's actually pretty good.  I'll buy this again.

It was especially useful during a long group ride, I was about 40 miles into an especially windy and hilly ride, and started cramping up and breaking down.  Two packs of this picked me up in about 5 minutes, and fueled my last 15 miles very well.  Taste is ok, not gross, but needs to be washed down with water
Is not as yummy as the other flavors, the chocolate has a bit of an after taste, but the product works.

I've been training with PowerBar products for several years.  PowerBar delivers with this!  The energy bounce comes on very fast and lasts about 30 minutes.  I use these for marathons and moutain bike races.  There are alot of gels on the market, but PowerBar has the best tasting.  I prefer the plain.  They are easy to put down and it doesn't make me sick.

The common variable during the bad runs(no pun intended)was cold, rainy weather which drasticly reduced my sweat rate. Normal gel ingestion rate is one every half hour. At 75 years old my 24 mile run lasts around 4 hours or 7 gels. That is a lot of sodium even on a hot day. Next run is 16 miles and will also be cold and probably wet. I will try one gel every 45 to 60 minutes. THe next marathon is in 2 weeks so no chance to experiment with another gel. During 7 other marathons I used another gel with no upset and may go back to that gel if problems persist. This powerbar gel is easier to swallow(not as thick and gooey)and very close to the same ingrediants as the other gel, sogave it a try.

column9: Probably works well. Taste... well not so good.

This is the perfect burst of energy before a long run.  It is not overwhelming with some flavor that chokes or consistancy that is hard to swallow.  It is my new "Fav" before my Saturday long run!!! I strongly recommend it.

I have really like this product.  The strawberry taste really good and is by far my favorite flavor. It is not as thick as cliff gel which to to me is a good thing.  The biggest thing I wish it had was some type of litter hanger for the top.  Other than that I have no issue opening and eating while mountain biking.  It helps keep my hypoglycemia under control.  I keep a pack or 2 in my backpack at school for the same reason to keep me from getting hit with a low blood sugar moment.

column9: Great gel at a good price.

Stuff works great and the caffeine gives a great pick-me-up when you get down in the spirits on the long runs...

column9: Easy to carry for endurance events

Your body will thank you.

Thinner consistency than Gu, and nice to mix it up on those long runs. Goes down a little easier when its cold out. Caffeine is a nice touch as well (for those of you addicted to coffee but don't like to down a pot before an early morning run...)

column9: I always bring these on my long runs

PowerBar Energy Gel has help many people set new personal records and that's what I've done with this.
Great taste and it does its work, 28 grs of carbs with only 1.5 grs of fat, combined with an energy drink it gives me the right amount of carbs I need in an hour for a bike ride.

This so-called natural sushi ginger includes the preservative, potassium sorbate, which is a synthetic preservative.  That's not exactly "natural" in my opinion and had I know that this product contained that preservative, I would not have purchased it.You will notice that the photo of the package does not include the term, "natural," on the package itself.  That term is only in the title and write-up here on Amazon.  I don't know who is responsible for these write-ups but I would suspect it is the specific vendor/provider of the product and not an Amazon's employee, but I don't know.You will also notice that the ingredients are not listed in the "information about product" area, unlike the other Roland sushi ginger product, which does list potassium sorbate as an ingredient. For those of us who seek out foods without preservatives, the product information provided here plus the use of "natural" is misleading, at best.Clearly, this product should not be touted as "natural."  To be clear, fundamentally, potassium sorbate is non-toxic and is regarded as safe. However, its synthetic characteristic is not looked upon favorably by many nutritionists and health-conscientious consumers.  Prolonged use of the preservative could lead to allergic reactions, nausea, diarrhea and nutrient loss in food. Toxicity of potassium sorbate is equivalent to that of table salt.Given the large amount of sushi ginger that you will receive if you order this--a total of 96  ounces, you will indeed consume it, and its preservative, for a prolonged period of time.Unless you toss it out, like I will be.

I started a LID for my dog when after a regular yearly check up, my vet noticed that her paws were tinged a redish color. We have been using this food for about 4 months now and we have noticed remarkable results. She no longer constantly licks her feet and they are returning to their normal color. Worked perfectly for our dog!!

Our rat terrier was losing her fur, had pinkish skin, and sores.  The vet put her on a hypoallergenic food, but in time she started vomiting that.  We found Wellness Simple Solutions and now her skin is normal, fur is growing back, no sores, no vomiting. I highly recommend this product.
My dogs do well on Wellness Simple Solutions; it's great for dogs with allergies.  Purchasing through Amazon is easy and reliable.

I have used Wellness SFS for some time - I have two cocker spaniels and one with bad allergies.  This is the only food that helpsIt may be pricey - but I'll pay the price to keep him comfortable and good food means less vet bills !!!

My dog is allergic to wheat and grain products. It would manifest as constant nasty ear inflamations. My vet prescribed a dog food that is only available from vets but after 3 months I saw no improvement.Finally I researched on my own and tried Wellness Simple Solutions and after 3 months I noticed that her ear problems subsided. I supplement her evening meals with the Wellness Simple Solutions dry food and she loves it.Compared with the stuff the vet prescribed, which looked like a waxy tube coming out of the can, the Wellness Simple Solutions canned dog food looks and smells like real food. It contains no wheat, corn, soy, dairy, or eggs and yet is high in nutrients.The first ingredient listed on the back of the can is duck and it states " This is a naturally preserved product". Considering that, I am very happy that the best by dates average about 2 years out because I keep extra dog food on hand in case of an emergency.

Wellness is an incredible food.  I have used it for both of my dobes for almost 7 months.  They were shedding before I switched to this brand but no more.  Since the switch almost 7 months ago, their coats are amazing - like silk and I have no shedding at all.  I have one dobe with a sensitive stomach so switched him over to this formula when I saw it came out.  He loves it - sure, its a little pricy but so worth it - no loose stools, no throwups and no shedding - I get comments on them all the time about how beautiful their coats are!

I've been feeding this dog food to my older female pug for several months now. In the fall of this year she began to experience allergy related skin and stomach issues. These allergies resulted in excessive licking and nibbling at her feet as well as occasional throwing up. She hasn't thrown up since she started eating this food, and overall her skin issues have lessened (that could be a result of the change in seasons as well). She is always excited to eat her food, but what pug isn't? I mean they're always hungry right? Also, as she never seems to drink enough water, I'm glad she's getting some moisture as part of this soft food as well. The only thing I find displeasing out this product is that we buy it in cases, and the cans frequently arrive dented. I wouldn't buy dented cans for my own food, for fear of the food being tainted in some way. So I feel a little nervous feeding my dog some of these dented cans. Oh well, she seems fine thus far and the smell and look of the food is fairly consistent, so we're going to stick with this food for now.
this product is clean & good but oh, so very expensive.  may have 2 find a more reasonably priced food.

column9: not much better than I the salmon flavored one.
column10: Obviously, any dog's reaction to various foods are dependent on their own allergies.  I switched from Wellness Simple Salmon because of the fishy smell of the food and my pit/lab's fishy breath. If it wasn't for the fishy breath, I would have kept him on it. I was actually very pleased with the results of that food.  I decided to switch to the duck flavor hoping that his breath would improve.  His breath for sure has improved and has been normal for a dog, but he has had diarrhea and loose stool on it since we put him on it for the past 4 weeks.  He has also been biting his paws and itching more than he had been on the salmon flavor.  We have had to mix 1/2 a cup of the duck flavor with boiled chicken, rice, and sweet potato in order for his stools to return to normal. But at any time we feed him just this dog food, he will have extremely watery diarrhea.  Quite disappointed with this and would definitely recommend purchasing a small bag first to see if your dog can tolerate it.Not quite sure what we're gonna do next. We might have to put our hyper allergic pit/lab mix on a homemade diet because that seems like the only thing that works for him.

Not fresh fresh, But PERFECT for a dried herb product. This is great whipped with sour cream and a pinch of salt. Or to use when making any types of rubs sauces or marinades.. and lastly its a good full jar. I will buy from again and again!! Also try their jerk rub spice its also amazing..

I love this Italian seasoning I will recommend this every one I love how the food cooks with this seasoning it gives it great flavor. thank you amazon for allowing me to taste this best seasoning that i ever had.

This is the best substitute sweetner I have ever tried.  I use it in my tea, Koolaid, coffee, or whatever needs sweetening.  I like it better than any other artificial sweetner out there (I have tried them all).  it doesnt leave that aftertaste that most sweetners leave.  And this price is too good to pass up.  It got here within a few days after ordering too.  Thanks Amazon!
This is an excellent sugar substitute.  It has no aftertaste and spoons just like sugar. Buying it at Amazon is most satisfactory.

Wanting to cut back on sugar my family tested practically every artificial sweetner on the shelf and decided to go with Sugar Twin. We like it because it is sweet without a bitter after-taste and because it is inexpensive ( at least though Amazon ). The box says it can also be used in baking, but if too much is used ( one cup say ) some bitterness can be detected. To counter this we use a 1/2 & 1/2 mix with sugar and all works well ( cutting sugar intake by half so we can enjoy my wife's cakes is, well, okay by me and the kids ). The box says Sugar Twin will work in baking and for the most part it does. Run some tests though and taste your results.  To those who are going to purchase Sugan Twin for the first time it is packaged in a pliable cardboard box. For ease of use we use one of those quick seal lid containers for the kitchen and simply fill this by sqeezing the box which forces the product to flow very quickly. To measure and dispense from the box itself is somewhat messy because of Sugar Twin's very fluffy texture.  As to health concerns about using an artificial sweetner ( there's always someone with a health concern ) I simply say we like the cost, the taste and the versatility of the product without reservation. Looking for a sweetner for your coffee in the morning that leaves a minimal amount of after taste? This product is worth a try.
I've been using Sugar Twin Spoonable for many years. I was very happy to fine the large box at a reasonable price.

column9: as good as the real thing

column9: Easy to mix, easy to drink!

I have used many times. great for making all kinds of desserts. It is regular sweetened condensed milk. Not Dulce De Leche as pictured. However you can make your own Dulce De Leche by following the steps below.The product gets 5 stars because I like it. However because most of the order was damaged and useless I give it 3 stars. Confusing? Maybe but that's my story err rating and I'm sticking to it. ;)Dulce De Leche1 - 14 oz can of Sweetened Condensed MilkFill a large stockpot with cold water. Remove the label from the can of milk, and do not open the can. Place the can in the center of the pot; be sure that the water completely covers the can.CAUTION: The can becomes pressurized when cooking, so for safety reasons, don't allow the water to boil vigorously. Simmer gently for about 1 1/2-2 hours for runny Dulce de Leche, or up to 4 hours for more solid consistency, adding more water, as necessary, when the water level decreases.Remove the can with tongs, and cool 15-20 minutes. Carefully pierce the top with a can opener. The tan or brown caramel will ooze slightly from the can when opening. Transfer to an air-tight container, with the lid off, to cool completely. Store refrigerated for up to two weeks.

column10: I love this brand of gluten free gravy mixes.  They taste good and it makes things taste great.  By purchasing in bulk it is less expensive than those on the average grocery store.

With Amazon's Subscribe & Save option these are well below $1 per package!  I am able to make 1/2 of the packet if I don't need the whole thing. This is also more cost effective than going out to eat every night.

My wife  and I were looking for these over the internet since our local grocery store quit selling them and we found the best deal again right here on Amazon. We shouldn't run out for awhile because we bought a bunch.  When we do run out, i'll be back for more.

column9: Had to search for this.. Amazon to the rescue!
column10: Got hooked on this item and the local stores took it off the market. It is not as salty as other Taco mixes. Kraft(who makes it) told me to check Amazon. And your price was the better of the 2 options I was given.Great item & great price= win, win!
My family has used the "Taco Bell Taco Seasoning" for many years, but it is no longer sold in any stores in our area. We were very happy to find it on Amazon.com.

I needed this seasoning packet to make a great tasting Chicken Tortilla Soup and the grocery stores in this area don't carry it. I bought a case on Amazon.com and was able to share with my sister and mom. We've used it to make tacos with both ground beef and ground turkey. All was very delicious. Making soup is up next. My product arrived in a timely manner and I am pleased.

This was easy to prepare. It only took a couple of minutes...and it tasted really good! Very close to the original. I noticed it tasted even better the next day after sitting in the refrigerator over night. The seasonings must of really marinated into the meat.... Great for soft tacos,taco salads or just crunchy tacos.........Recommend 5/5 stars. Taco bell taste at home...How delicious!

I feel kinda nasty using this since it's Taco Bell and fast food is gross, but this stuff tastes good! When you use it in lean beef it tastes just like Taco Bell, only it's actually made out of beef instead of what they use, LOL. I would recommend this stuff for sure.
I love the taco seasoning but my  local stores have all stopped selling it!  The other brands are sucky compared to this.

I travel for work, and have long enjoyed Coffee-Mate's French Vanilla creamer in many forms, none of which are nearly as convenient as these single-serve, dry packages. No mess, no measuring, no fuss, just add to coffee and enjoy!I purchased a 12-pack of boxes of 5 from this seller, and my order was filled and shipped quickly, and was at my door on the promised day.I shall be purchasing more of these, from this seller, in the future.

I have to rate this product high even though I am not a coffee drinker. My daugthers just loved this convenient product that can be used at school or in the college dorm. They both said that the Coffee-Mate brand is the best flavor. I will buy again because of the great deal on Amazon.

Original Jan/6/2012:$33.99 / 6 = $5.667Seems a bit much for a 2L bottle of soda. You can get this from a local grocery store for around $1 per bottle.Updated Jun/17/12:It's still overpriced; however, it's far more reasonable ($2.33 per bottle).

Eagle Pack Giant Breed Puppy Food is the only dog food I will feed my English Mastiff, Reba.  She is a happy, healthy, 120 lb., 11 month old puppy. We plan to continue feeding her Eagle Pack GB until she is two years old.
This is one of my German Shepherd's favorite dog foods.  The ingredients are great and the price is usually competitive.
I gave this caviar to one of my relatives as a gift and she absolutly loved it. She said it tasted better than the caviar she had in Russia!

Tonight I again shopped  for a take-out meal at my nearby Fresh and Easy Neighborhood Market. I chose a packet of 8 California Shrimp Tempura Rolls with a nice soy sauce and bit of wasabi. For a drink, I went to the drink display and chose a 16.9-ounce bottle of Ito En Oi Ocha Green tea. Nice combination. Went down well. column9: Never knew a tea could taste this good
column10: Its pricey, true. but after trying over a dozen other lower priced teas, and others that were only lower because of a pre purchased certificate, I decided it was less expensive just to buy what I wanted than try to save.  If I didnt think it was a good value in the long run, I would have had to go with 4 not 5 stars, no matter how much I love it.  But it earns that last star when you get down to it.  I first tasted this at a mall walking by a teavana shop.I was so dazed that this was a tea I was tasting...it just didnt seem real.  I didnt buy any that day, and kept hurrying to my destinatation.  Later I couldnt get it out of my head, and finally went back to be sure, and to buy it.then i went shopping around.  I can usually find things for waaaay below retail, without sacrificing quality.  But not with this.  I wasted a couple of hundred dollars on less expensive blends with no luck.  Eventually I found one that was a close second.  But the same was true in price... other than a prepaid half off certificate I had for that store.I was almost "enchanted" by the runner up.  But once I tried the Teavana again, the other just wasnt in the same district.  It was just too floral.  The teavana tea is more delicate and balanced. If I ever find a deal like that again, I'll try the other tea for use in blending with the distant third place winners.  If even the youthberry is a bit floral for you, tevana sells a lighter blended version with orange.But for me , by itself in the youthberry, you taste each flavor as a separate note, fruity, warm, then aromatically fragrant. I know they say taste is mostly smell.  I actually smell the roses more than taste them... Then at either the beginning or the end of the sip (or so I found, varying by whether hot or cold, may not be there at all for you) there is a brief moment when the notes make a chord or perhaps symphony.  All too short, leaving you wanting more, but at the same time, perfectly filled.If I sound like I'm reviewing a wine..  I have had that pleasure, and I think out of the hundreds of wines I tried, including most of the wines considered among the finest, I never enjoyed a wine more than this tea for flavor.  And at almost no calories!Then again, once I had to pay for the wines myself..for some reason my love for them waned. This tea is one of the few things I think is worth paying retail for.If you hate all things floral, including the scent of flowers, perfume etc...this isnt for you.  I dont know many who do, other than allergically.This is like drinking a cup of sweet fruit tea while visiting a fine florist.  sitting in a garden, or holding a rose.  But somehow it isnt girly, unless you want it to be.  I just found something totally new and different for me when I tasted it, and it was an unexpected pleasure that brought me into the tea afficiando world like never before.  I only like herbals I make myself usually.Oh the other two of my 4, had nothing in common with this, were just herbals I picked up to qualify for free shipping in hopes of finding something I could tolerate that had the benefit of some of the herbs within.  I actually found two I like for two things I knew I should either drink or eat, but hated the taste.The youthberry may have beneficial things in it.  (In fact it does, or so my herbal books say of the ingredients) but its a drink for pure pleasure.  I recently had to give up all forms of soda. diet or not, and was using tea for a flavor substitute.  It didnt really do the job, until I found this.  I like it better than the soda and dont miss it at all now.  I really only switch out from the youthberry for plain water, or something I need the benefit of, and to cleanse my taste buds to go back to this.  Leaves easily yeild two batches of water. I find that adding only about 25% as much I can stretch that to 4 or 5.  In the long run, I'm actually saving money vs soda.

So, some friends said this was the best tea ever.  As a tea lover, I thought I would give it a shot.  First, the tea leaves and bits of fruit and what not, are large.  It's probably best to brew this tea loose in a small pot and strain it into a cup to let the flavors really develop.  However, for the size of the tea product the flavor was not very strong.  I have never been to a Teavana shop, but apparently they really sweeten the teas they serve.  I used a little agave for mine and I found it to be just OK.  In summary, not the best tea ever, but not bad, it certainly beats Lipton by a mile.  It's also costs a lot more than Lipton...so, there's that.  As for shipping, my products arrived quickly and safely packaged.
I used to be able to buy this locally and I was thrilled to find it on Amazon, love the taste with fresh fruit and caprese salad
I expected that at the price I paid, I would get candy that was sweet and tasted of licorice. This is very bland, hard and flat tasting, very little licorice flavor at all.
Are these guys really crazy enough to sell this product at this price????This is more then twice the retail price. Oh well, maybe SOMEONE will actually fall for it!

Our family includes three darling Shitzus.  They know what it means when asked, "How about a boney?"  It means that they are going to enjoy a favorite treat and immediately line up, jumping for joy!!  Ordering from Amazon ensures that these treats will arrive on or ahead of schedule every time we order.  Thank you.

I purchased these for my dog...first of all, they're a disgusting black/brown color. Definitely not appetizing. They smell HORRIBLE. I could barely get one out before I had to throw the bag away from me because I thought I was going to be sick. My dog refuses to go anywhere near these things. Do not buy! Make your own!

These banana slices are high quality and my dog goes nuts for them. They are convenient and very healthy. I have been buying these for over a year now and plan on using them indefinitely!

Our 3 year old toy poodle loves fruit. She loves these!  Nice back up to having to buy fresh fruit that sometimes get eaten in time.  Plus it gives her a variety instead of just blueberries for a week.  The smell when opening the bag is overwhelming but other than that great product.

column9: Fine but salt added. Why add salt to these?

If you're the type of person that likes to be mugged or have your purse stolen, then go ahead and buy from these people. OUTRAGEOUSLY Expensive for what you get.
We can't find Hansen in our area, so are happy to order through Amazon and get a high quality soda with no high fructose corn syrup.

column9: Have loved it for a year.
column10: I have tried all kinds of decaf coffee & this is my favorite POD decaf coffee by far.  It's just a nice medium strength coffee w/out that nasty, sharp decaf taste.  It is not bitter.  Keep in mind that I usually drink it either black w/a bit of honey & sometimes with cream.

Absolutely disappointed with this product. I was so excited to see it finally at my door. Then I opened the box and the smell of cheap plastic was overwhelming. I said "hmm it will go away eventually", but then I noticed the bowl where you would put the tomatoes was cracked, completely unusable!! This is one of my favorite teas.  The peach is tasty, but not overbearing like many fruity teas and the ginger is mild.  It's a lovely way to start the day--and if you are familiar with the Tao of Tea brand, you already know what a great deal this is!

This is a nice tea, but I was disappointed in the lack of "peachiness".  There is a nice aroma andslight ginger flavor, but I wouldn't be able to recognize "peach" if it wasn't listed on the label.I will enjoy it but it wasn't what I was looking for.  I will try a different brand next time.

Do not let the picture fool you. The jar will not be filled once you receive the product. I know products settle in transit, but I think this settled way too much. The jar is 3/4ths filled. For the price, the jar should have been stuffed. I would have given this product 5 stars, but considering in my opinion 1/4 is missing, I did not.
