I bought the 12 pack of Italian roast decaf at the nearby Starbucks store, which I love and go to frequently, for those rare occasions when I want a cup of decaf at night but don't want to brew it.  But this product is not SB's best effort.  First, the packaging isn't well designed.  Tearing the top off at the "tear here" line always leaves part of the top intact, making getting the coffee out a chore, and trying to tear off the rest of the sticky top is not worth the effort.  Next, the flavor.  I know Italian is supposed to be bold and bitter, but this stuff takes bitter to a whole new level.  Not good.  Then there's the expiration.  I didn't plan to use this very often, but I'd better, because it expires in less than a month.  What?  Finally, the cost.  At nearly a dollar a cup, this wouldn't be worth it even if it didn't suffer from its other inadequacies.  A definite DO NOT RECOMMEND.
This is the best instant coffee I have ever tasted. It cannot be beat as far as I am concerned. Enjoy!

BEST INSTANT, PERIOD! BUT... I can't drink VIA made according to it's instructions. It's just way, WAY, too strong. (I'm talking seriously stronger than what you get at a local Starbucks.) Let me explain. When I make brewed coffee, I freshly grind beans to a very fine texture, using two or three tablespoons of grounds per 6 ounces of water. So I'm used to a strong cup of coffee. Since one packet of VIA makes even a large mug of water into an un-drinkablly strong brew, I use only half a packet. The problem is, a couple hours later, the left-over half becomes an unusable blob that won't come out of the packet. No great loss... I've had a GREAT cup of coffee, and I can just toss the other half packet, right? Well, acutally, that's a problem for me. I'm of the 'clean your plate / starving kids in Biafra' generation. I would prefer a smaller packet at a smaller price. So one star off from someone who was taught 'waste not, want not' and is too old to change ;-)

I am a serious coffee drinker, I grid my beans just before I brew the coffee, and yes, I taste the difference between burr grinder and blade grinder. Oh, yeah, I am that serious. So you probably can imagine why I have been against instant coffee for years. Becasue they normally taste aweful! Sour and chemical taste, no fragrance at all. So, when a friend told me about VIA, I giggled, called her "one of those" and joked about how she used coffee to flavor her milk. (I applogize! I do i do). Until one day, another friend ask me to buy instant coffee for him. I laughted at him too. But no request from a friend is too much. I bought the smallest VIA package possible, and tasted it. To my surprise, it doesn't have that sour taste, and the chemical taste was very low and can be ignored, especially if you drink your coffee with sugar (which I strongly against).I like the skinny long bag. when I was choosing between scissors and teeth to open the bag, the bag was teared open so easily from the top with just my fingers. Of course, that alerted me to hide it away from my toddlers. Next thing I did was no brainer, I dumped the powder into a coffee mug, and poured the hot water in it. I doubted if I really needed to stir it, but I did it anyway. The smell was not as strong as my fresh burr grinded cofee, but good enough to believe that it was coffee. I confess, I almost helded my breath when I had my first sip, ready for all sorts of aweful taste. But to my surprise, the taste was not sour at all. I had no trouble drinking the whole cup down and licked my lips and thinking "hmm, not bad". the second thought was "I am only hot water away from another cup".Now, here comes to final judgement:For instant coffee, this is awesome! No grinder, no loud noise. You can carry it with you anywhere you go. no scissors needed. a good cup of coffee is just some hot water away. But, can it replace the old fashioned fresh grinded coffee? No, No No. Still not there yet. But I am keeping them around th house now for the time when the house needs to be dead quiet and I was craving for a cup of coffee.4 star because it is still not as good as fresh grinded coffee.

I admit, I am a starbucks Via addict. It is fast, convenient and now affordable. I used to buy this product at Costco, now I don't have to drive there to get it for the price. I do drink one or two daily so this will last me for about a month. The expiration date on this was March 2013, almost 9 months. I would order again. 5 stars for the cost and convenience! thanks starbucks and amazon!

column9: Take a sharp object to defend your self
column10: Unlike most people, I prefer not a weak coffee but a milder roast than the burnt stuff most coffee houses make that requires many accoutrements to mask like cream, sugar and artificial flavors. Therefore, I purposely only tried the Columbian.I work in a place that has poorly serviced coffee "dispensing machines." They are fun in that you never know what will come out in a day-to-day basis. Some time just your coins back. A few people have illicit electric coffee pots, others use a French press, and still others sneak out for the real thing.Now that I discovered the Columbian Via. I have to defend my cup from all those noses that circle my cup. I know there are directions on the pack; however, I now have my own ritual. Clean cup, fill 2/3rds filtered water. 90 seconds in the microwave. Shake contents to bottom of pack. Rip the whole top off the pack with teeth. Pour pack in coup and watch sizzle. Stir for a few seconds. Add a tad of ice. Hope I can make it back to my desk before the cup empties.I was never a fan of reconstituted coffee however I think it is the addition of the micro-ground coffee that adds the edge necessary.In any event you owe it to yourself to try it.
This instant coffee is quite simple the best I've ever tasted.  The flavor is rich, dark and full.  I keep it at work and have a cup when I want to be happy :)
Unbelievably good for instant, and a great price at a little over $.50/cup when purchased in bulk. Great for my office and at home when I don't have the time to brew a whole pot.

column9: Lives up to the Starbucks name
column10: If you don't believe the words "quality" and "instant" belong in the same sentence, get ready for a surprise. The best cup of instant coffee I've ever had. In fact, it can hold it's own against brewed.

I had to save money by breaking my $30-a-week Starbucks habit. These are great value - I bought the 50 pack for about $30 - so that's 60 cents a cup! This is by far the best-tasting instant coffee I have found, after trying lots of premium instants. I will probably buy a Keurig or Tassimo once they figure out how to produce K-cups that are recyclable. Until then, I'm very happy with my Vias.
Usually brew coffee but this is convenient for work. Coffee is great and the price is the best I could find.

Used this very handy product for gift bags for my daughter's wedding.  The guests really were appreciative of having an easy cup of coffee to prepare and all enjoyed the rich flavor.  Convenient and tasty product.

column9: Great Starbucks Taste for a Quick Fix!
column10: Starbucks has outdone themselves on their VIA line of products.  As a full-time medical student, I am definitely a caffeine addict.  Coffee is my drink of choice when I need to stay awake during long stretches in the semester, but I frequently study with classmates that don't drink coffee.  Starbucks VIA packets are the PERFECT solution for me.  I don't need to bring a coffee maker and coffee.  I just pack a few packets into my bag and go.  I must say that I was genuinely surprised at how fresh and full this coffee tastes.  Whenever I make a cup, I'm amazed because I never get that instant coffee bitterness/staleness found elsewhere.  If you like coffee, have an unpredictable schedule, or travel, I highly recommend picking up a pack of Starbucks VIA packets.  You won't be disappointed.

Once a diehard bean-grinder, I'm now a convert to Starbuck's instant Italian roast coffee; it makes a lovely dark, robust brew that tastes utterly real. It's also a great way to flavor homemade ice cream. I'm not so crazy about the milder flavor or their instant iced coffee, but this one's a winner.

Starbucks Via instant cofffee is convenient, mixes in cold water, strong and tasty. The price at Amazon is good however this batch expires in three months. I'm not sure how stable this product is and I'll have finished it anyway but if you don't use much I'd take a pass.

Starbucks tested this coffee in 2 markets almost 2 years ago. I fell in love. I now carry it in my purse and my luggage at all times.(some hotels have the worst coffee) I also put a pack in my Earthquake/disaster bag. A good cup of coffee always helps in any situation and this is GREAT coffee. The taste is always just like a fresh brewed cup!

Love the extra dark type. I like to keep packets on hand at work, the deli coffees are too weak for me. VIA pack, 8 oz of water even + ~2 oz creamer still makes a nice strong cup. Found here on Amazon for 62 cents per pack, grocery had for $1. $20 savings for a month's supply!

Always fresh opened flavor. Not crazy about lots of packaging but its handy to travel with and instant coffee in the jar always seems to taste fine when first opened but seems to go stale right away. This is the best instant I've found.  The decaf is great too.
not bitter, robust. easy to carry with you, so you always have a GOOD cup of coffee available.

column9: This is not your Dad's instant coffee
column10: I lived on instant coffee all through college, and came to know its taste and texture all too well.  Because of that, I was skeptical about Starbucks "instant" coffee.  That skepticism was short lived though, after a friend gave me a small batch of Via packets as a gift.  You pour it in the cup and add hot water, give it a little stir, and presto, you have real coffee, not "instant."  I was very surprised.  It tastes good, smells good, and feels good.  It doesn't have that unpleasant, overly watery and grimy texture of the world's most famous instant coffee brand.  I would rate Via at about 94% of the quality of a cup of traditional brewed coffee. I don't use it as a replacement for my brewed coffee, but if the coffee pot at work is empty and I need a quick pick-me up, Via is just the ticket.  This could work just fine as a substitute for brewed coffee, but as long as I have a coffee pot, it is a bit cheaper than Via.
This is very good, convenient coffee to make.  I use only 1/2 of a packet with about 3/4 cup of water; because it is a little strong for me to use the whole packet.  Try it - you will like it!
This instant coffee is very good.  However, it is very, very bold; I use about 1/3 of a packet for 3/4 of a cup of coffee.  I prefer to use them this way; and, they last longer too.

I am not an avid coffee fan but drink it on ocassion.  I use half the packet and it is perfect for my palate.  I buy VIA to have on hand for guests since I don't own a coffee maker.  Worth the extra cost for quality taste.

This Starbucks instant coffee is delicious!  It really is deep, dark, and very flavorful.  I love the taste but if you ask my sister....she hates it.  So I guess it really is up to one's own taste buds as to whether it is as enjoyable for you as it is for me. I have noticed that the first package of this instant coffee seemed to have a richer odor than the one I am using now but the taste is the same.  It's expensive but I am worth it and I really love the flavor as my first cup of liquid in the morning.  I'd recommend you try it and decide for yourself!

I bought two of these 50 packs of Starbucks VIA in August of 2010 for my husband who is deployed to a part of the world where coffee (he claims) is not good. He has loved having a good cup of coffee a couple times a day. Not quite the same as a real cup of Starbucks, but when you are looking for a bit of home every morning it is an excellent substitute.
Starbucks VIA® Ready Brew Italian Roast Coffee is just like brewed coffee without the wait.

This is probably the best instant decaf I've ever had. It has a rich flavor and doesn't taste likeinstant. I gave it a 4 because of the cost and the packaging. It would be much more cost efficient ifit came in a jar, rather than individual packets. Also, each packet is too strong for one cup (for me)so I use only 1/2 now and have to save the other half. Packets are great for traveling, but for home useit's unnecessary.

I have been buying this product from Starbucks for the last couple of years.  A few years ago, my daughter bought me a Keurig Coffeemaker for a holiday gift.  I gave it back to her because the Starbucks coffee is so superior & so easy, not to mention inexpensive.  Actually, when you purchase the Starbucks VIA from the internet it costs about 53 cents for 1 cup of coffee.  Which is more than 30 cents less than buying it at Starbucks itself.  The coffee is AMAZINGLY delicious.  The delivery is outstanding as well.

column9: Yum, but packet difficult to use
column10: Man is this instant coffee delicious.  I love a strong coffee taste and this is almost at my limit for too strong, but not quite.  It's wonderful as iced coffee.  I didn't have a problem with the expiration date.  First order was in March and expired in December; second order in May, expired end of November and anyway, how bad can coffee get in individual packets even 5 years after the expiration date really?My problem is that the description says 1. POUR IN PACKET 2. ADD HOT WATER 3. STIR AND ENJOY - which is fine if you use a tea kettle.  If you microwave water in the mug first and try to use the pencil-sized opening at the top of the packet as indicated (which isn't super easy to use anyway), it steams up the opening and the coffee gets stuck.  It's messy to work around it by prying open the rest of the packet so the opening is larger, or cutting diagonally with scissors.  Even heating the water in a separate container the packet gets five out of ten for ease of use as the video demonstrates.Starbucks - this could easily be resolved by adding another quarter inch at the top and engineering a wider opening at the top.
Easy to buy and rec'd quickly thru on line purchase which arrived quickly at door with no problems and a great feed back system
When I need a cup of coffee (but not the caffeine) - its normally in the afternoon and these instants by Starbucks (VIA) really do the trick.  They are fast and taste fresh every cup.

column9: Great product, but near expiration date
column10: I really like these instant Starbucks decaf tubes.  They make a pretty good tasting cup of coffee, and are very easy.  My 4 star rating is simply because I received product from Amazon that had less than 3 months before the expiration date; I usually see 11-12 months when I buy it in the store.

column9: I wasn't a big coffee drinker until I tried this. Now I'm hooked
column10: I wasn't much of a coffee drinker before. Once in awhile I'd go to Starbucks to get an iced coffee but that was probably once a month and for awhile not having any coffee at all for a year. So it's not something I drank much.I have tried some other instant coffees from my girlfriend but didn't like them so much.Then we tried the Starbucks VIA. The flavor of it is perfect for what I like! It's so easy to make. The instant coffee tastes better than anything I can buy at Starbucks so I never go and buy a coffee. This saves me a lot of money.Since I don't drink much coffee, one cup of this has enough "kick" to keep me up all day long.Now I drink a cup of coffee but I go running and it makes me feel like I can run much longer.So I would highly recommend this. Again I wasn't a two cup of coffee per day person but now 2-3 times a week, I enjoy a cup of Starbucks VIA.

This product, Starbucks Via, is a Starbucks Product. It's good stuff.  I live in Seattle, the home of Starbucks.  This price was cheaper than anywhere I've found for this quantity so I ordered.  I thought it would take a few days to get here in a plastic envelope.  Nope, 12 (TWELVE) days later it arrived and was shipped from Tennessee with a packing slip with the official starbucks maiden on the invoice.  Come on, Starbucks, Does all of your roasted coffee ship to your coffee shops from the same location.....no distribution centers or anything that could mail a package a little more efficiently.  12 days from time of order to receipt is a long time for a package.  I mail letters from Seattle to the Southeast every week that arrive in 3 days.  This was slower than media mail.
It is bought for my parents and we need to get it as soon as possible. It is so soon to get the product! Thanks a lot!
This is the best coffee ever love the flavor and this is the best way to buy it! Will buy it from here again for sure :)

I was worried about those negative comments about expiration date, but my local Costco did not carryany of this, and those at Starbucks stores were too expensive! So, I gave it a shot and ordered Italian Roast 50ct on 6/20. They arrived on 6/23, and the expiration date is 11/23, which leaves a plenty of time to drink all of these goodies!!!
It tastes good for the convenience and has enough caffeine to get me through a work day.  It comes in packets that are easily split up if you are sharing, or good if you need them on-the-go.
I am not a big coffee drinker but my wife is.  She absolutely loves this. It is a  regular part of her morning.
Deep, rich flavor to make waking up feel good!  Convenient, quick way to make a hot soy beverage in the morning!

column9: Don't Listen to the negative reviews
column10: So before I ordered this I was reading the reviews worrying about how some people said that when they got the coffee it was already or close to expiring.Not true. I got mine today (june 16th) and mine are going to expire March 28th 2013.And also people said that the coffee packets came in all messed up and it looked like they just threw it in the box.Not true. Mine came in a amazon box and inside is another box and the receipt. Inside the smaller box is the VIA container that is just like the picture. All little packets were still inside the starbucks packet.I would def ignore all those negative comments because this is a pretty good product to order! =)

I purchased this for work because I work at night, and can't drink an entire pot of coffee on my own, (don't like to waste). I hadn't tried instant coffee in ages because I'd never had a positive experience with any brand, until now. Starbucks Italian Roast instant has a strong robust flavor, and will perk you up before you've finished the first cup. I'll definitely be keeping this on hand!

column9: perfect for the office and school
column10: these are great little coffee packets.  I have one box at home for those days where I do not want to make a full pot of coffee, and one at school for those days when I need another cup of coffee.  tasty and worth it.
My husband Loves this coffee. It tastes great and he does not waste a whole pot when he only wants a cup.

I am obsessed with VIA.  It tastes just like Starbucks Fresh Brewed Coffee.  I highly recommend it for those on a budget or hurry.  Amazon has a great 50 count purchase deal.  I have tried both Columbia and Italian Roast.  Both are great just depends on how strong you like your coffee.

I LOVE THE QUICK SIMPLE GREAT TASTE OF STARBUCKS IN AN INSTANT. BUT THEY CAME UP WITH THE LOUSY ELONGATED AND SKINNY PACKETS. THEY ARE HARD TO HOLD, DIFFICULT TO EASILY OPEN AND WHEN YOU HAVE HOT WATER IN A CUP--THE STEAM CLOGS THE NARROW OPENING OF THE PACKET MAKING IT DIFFICULT TO POUR IN YOUR CUP.. WHY CANT STARBUCKS PUT IT INTO A WIDE PACKET LIKE EQUAL OR SWEET AND LOW? GREAT PRODUCT--DUMB PACKAGING.
The photo is for the 10 item package, not the 3.  Just be aware that amazon is using the wrong item in the photo.
Nothing wrong with this product. It is instant coffee. Can't complaint. "Nothing good, nothing bad". Price is little bit high.

The caramel flavor I bought at a Starbucks store led me to try more. This one however was much weaker and only one in a cup was too weak. So I used two packets for one cup, and when you figure the unit cost, that's about $1.25/cup for instant. Also, when you open the package, the coffee really doesn't seem to flow smoothly and often I would get some on the counter.Not planning to purchase again.

column9: Bad Packaging of a Fine Product
column10: Starbucks again has made an exceptional product and almost ruined it with bad packaging!The instant coffee is in a new world of flavor (for instant) better than most of the coffee in hotels for example.BUT BUT BUTthe tube package is a disaster.It is hard to open.It does not open across the entire width of the tubeSO the powder is very very difficult to get out of thetube.Indeed, the tube shape is about the worst imaginable foreasy emptying.WHO IN STARBUCKS HAS SUCH TROUBLE WITH PACKAGING?

column9: Starbucks Italian roast decaf ready brew coffee, purchased at Amazon
column10: I was somewhat disappointed with this coffee purchased thru Amazon, as I had got previously the Starbucks VIA ready brew coffee, decaf Colombia Roast which I enjoyed very much.
LOVE this product.  I can take it on trips, and I heat milk at home to make:  "Poor Woman's Latte".  I have bought them several times.
This is *NOT* six of the items pictured, which contain 6 instant packets.This is six sample packages, which contain 3 instant packets.

column9: Why is the decaf almost twice as expensive?
column10: I loved the Italian Roast and I was excited to see the 50 count available in Decaf - until I saw the price NEARLY DOUBLE the regular.
I did not like this coffee. At the beginning I thought I was ordering kcups. I tried one of  the packets. I am sending them back. Ordered from amazon.com
This product tastes like a mouthful of dirt. It is worse than most instant coffees, and in no way comparable to brewing coffee.

I RECEIVED A PACKAGE.  I DIDN'T KNOW WHAT WAS IN IT BUT OPENED IT AND THERE WERE STARBUCKS VIA PACKETS ALL TOSSED IN.  I SORTED THEM AND REPACKED AS IT WAS FOR A GIFT.  IN THE AD IT LOOKS LIKE THE PACKETS COME OUT OF A BAGN OR BOX.  IF SO PLEASE SEND ONE.  THEY ARE A MESS ALL OVER THE DRAWER. THIS IS NOT TOO LATE FOR YOU TO FIX.  IF YOU DO I WILL WRITE YOU A NEW REVIEW.  I REALLY WANTED TO GIVE THIS AS A GIFT.DISAPPOINTED IN STARBUCKS.

I bought the Columbian and the Espresso 3-packs locally for travel because motel/hotel coffees are so bad as are fast-food chain coffees, but both versions of the Starbucks VIA instant coffees are absolutely disgusting. I am not a soda drinker, but when I travel I prefer a Coca Cola or Pepsi to this foul "coffee". It reminds me of the old Sanka instant coffee, but is much stronger and much more bitter. Totally disgusting! The only people who could drink this crap are those who use flavored creamers and/or loads of sugar so they don't taste any of this foul coffee.
My wife is the coffee nut and she loves this. The aroma smells so good I'm temped to have some.  Easy to use.
I purchased these so If I dont want to make a pot of coffee I can still have a great cup -I keep a few packets at work too

This is my absolute favorite coffee, period! I just wish that Amazon would add it to the Subscribe and Save program so I would never have to wait for my next batch.Easy, convenient and delicious. Even better than brewed coffee.

I was a little worried about all the short shelf life comments.  I just bought a pack of 50 Columbia Vias from Amazon and the best before date is 9 months from now!  I will definitely finish 50 by then!  I have bought these before from Amazon (and Starbucks stores) and they are great!  They arrived in an oversize retail style box with a dispensing hatch at the bottom... very convenient.

I'm so happy with this order!  I love Starbucks VIA but I can only have decaf now.  I hated how the stores usually only carry the small packages.  This 50 pack is great and it has a nice little dispenser.  It's on my counter now and I'll probably go through it quickly!The expiration date on my package is for 1 year from now.  So, I'm very happy about that!

column9: no issues with expiration date here!
column10: I've seen multiple reviews re: the expiration date is too close...I've ordered this 3x's now and all 3x my expiration date is atleast 9 months out.  I love these little jems!

column9: Tastes Like Real Coffee - Really Good Coffee
column10: It's true!  Starbucks VIA  is delicious!  I have it every morning, upstairs, by simply heating water.Everyone who tastes VIA says the same thing, "This is great coffee!"  I never drink instant coffee - would rather skip coffee than have instant,  but someone gave me a cup of Starbucks VIA at their home because their coffee pot was broken and I loved it.I have noticed if I just tell people to take a sip when I make the first cup  - they light up - they don't/won't give the cup back so I make the next cup for me.  I was never a Starbucks person before,  but VIA is great.Try it just once!  I put my coffee pot away downstairs - put in a hot water dispenser and always have really good coffee or tea.Enjoy!

Starbucks instant tastes like Starbucks fresh - strong and satisfying. The problem is the expiration date.  I bought this in January and have only until May to drink 50 of them. As I use 2 at a time, that's no problem. I noticed the box was packaged in May 2010, so it's already 6 months old.

In my search for instant java fix, I have sampled French, German, Italian, US, Israeli, Turkish produced instant coffees and this is, by far, the best instant coffee I have tasted.  The reason? It does not taste "instant". Rather, it tastes like a freshly brewed, dark, strong, rich cup of real coffee. For a less "potent" taste, packets should be used in venti-sized cups or rationed for more than one regular cup. This is an excellent product.
Like another reviewer, I too received a box of nearly expired product.  If you will consume this within a month of ordering it is a good deal, otherwise buy it elsewhere.

Strangely enough but this Starbucks' instant coffee tastes better than the instant coffee I purchase in the Starbucks coffee shops. I often worry that the coffee may be old and have a wierd taste -- which has occurred twice. So, of course I was nervous about ordering this large amount online but said what the heck. It was a good choice. I do wish they would instant package the Breakfast Blend. That is my very favorite. Pike's Place is my next fav -- but not to be had in the instant variety either. This Columbian, medium roast, is quite tasty though. I'm having a cup right now and really enjoying it. Oh by the way, for the person who said the coffee is too strong and uses only half the package and the remainder of the coffee turns to goo. Tip: Do not pour the coffee into a cup of hot water. The steam from the water instantly makes the coffee hard to pour from the package and indeed starts to dissolve the coffee. Pour the coffee into the empty cup and then seal the package. A small paper clip works well.

column9: I love that Amazon ships directly to soldiers overseas!
column10: I didn't order this product for myself, but this coffee was on my son's "wish list" as he began a six month deployment in Afghanistan.  I love that Amazon ships directly to an APO address, so I was able to order this product and get it to him quickly.  Thanks, Amazon!

column9: I'm impressed. Tastes like real coffee. Still not better than brewed, but hey.
column10: I have two positive reviews for this product -- me as a coffee drinker, and after polling a number of training participants at my work after switching 100% to via products.I drink very dark french press coffee at home, and often espresso. I am very picky about my coffee. So, for me to find this instant coffee very drinkable is quite impressive. I like the italian roast, and can't really drink the medium roast. I drink this at work when I have trainings, and think it's pretty close to the real thing, but still not the same as getting a fresh brewed cup. However, in a pinch, it's a great substitute. My husband likes the Via so that he doesn't have to make noise making coffee in the morning at home -- we have a 3 month old son -- and grinding and boiling water can get loud.I work in a business where we previously had a caterer bringing us coffee (very subpar) and it was costing us $20-50 per class. Now people are impressed that the Starbucks Via is out. They seem to like the coffee (all flavors) and say it's an improvement over the catering coffee. And, we are saving SO much money because people only consume what they need, rather than paying per person with a caterer. A win-win! Thanks for making it taste good, Starbucks!

1. AMAZON MAKES THESE AFFORDABLE. I am so excited they started selling them and are PRIME items!!! I could make back the money on my Prime membership on these alone.  At the time of this writing 66 cents for one packet! A little bit more than a k-cup (.43) but i dont have to carry around a machine in my purse to enjoy it.2. They are super convenient for camping / backpacking.3. I throw some in the car - so if I am traveling, I can stop at a gas station with hot water, instead of plunking down $4 on crap coffee.4. They do NOT taste like instant coffee. They taste delicious! And strong!5. Easy to open.6. Throw them in your purse when you need a coffee fix and your clients, friends, family dont like strong or good coffee.7. You don't have to clean a coffeepot or throw away a more bulky kcup.

I bought these because they are a quick and easy way to get my coffee fix.The price on Amazon was 50% cheaper than what I saw at StarBucks stores.They are not as good as fresh brewed coffee, but the result is still impressive.This is not the rancid instant coffee that has been around for decades.I gave this three stars because the flavor is adequate only.These will not replace brewed coffee, but will definitely be useful when I'm short on time or options!

Definitely convenient and tastes very close to brewed coffee.  However, it's very pricey @ nearly .60 cents per cup.... Most instant coffee costs about 1/3 as much.  I would not expect Starbucks to match their prices, but would prefer about .40 cents per cup.

I drink this all the time in the morning especially since I don't have time to go all the way to Starbucks before classes. It's a great pick me up and convenient for me to take with me in my travel mug. I end up using half a package because otherwise it is way too strong for me. I definitely recommend this product!
I haven't tasted anything comparable to the VIA brand. Makes a nice large cup from a small packet. Great stuff.

This is hands down the best cup of coffee. It helps me not drink a whole pot of coffee, because 1) It is too expensive to drink more than one via a morning. Even though I often cheat and have two. 2) It is so satisfying, i don't need to sit and drink 4 cups of okay coffee to get a good coffee fix. Great product. And AWESOME to travel with. So you can go anywhere and have a great cup of coffee.

column9: Wow!  Now that's a cuppa coffee!
column10: This stuff rocks!  Absolutely fabulous cup of coffee.  I do wish that it were a lot less expensive than $1 per cup, though...like maybe Starbuck's would make it available by the pound!

I'm a confessed coffee snob of 20 years or more and brew my own daily from beans.  I prefer the bold to extra-bold coffees, but enjoy most of Starbucks (non-flavored) varieties. I completely avoided instant coffee until I tried Starbucks Via. I was amazed! In the time it takes to boil water, I can have a full-flavored, aromatic cup of coffee. My office has a Bunn hot-water dispenser which cuts the time to seconds! Now I take the VIA packs camping, boating and always have a few in my brief case when traveling on business. They are pricey when bought at the local supermarket, but the Amazon price on the 50-pack brings the cost down to .65 per cup.

column4: Barbara Lundeen "there can't be enough books"
column10: Starbucks VIA Ready Brew Coffee is the BEST instant coffee on the market and Amazon's "pack of 50" is a humungous good deal.  I don't use instant all the time but when I need to for convenience (in a hurry etc) VIA is the only coffee I've ever tried that hits the mark. column10: I love this stuff! column9: Great value for awesome instant coffee
column10: I love having Starbucks VIA around to supplement my brewed coffee.  Personally, I start out with a pot of fresh ground extra bold coffee in the morning.  It usually lasts me until around 3 in the afternoon, at which point I switch to using my VIAs.  They taste the most like fresh brewed coffee from any instant I've ever tried.  I also use the VIAs when I'm working late at night, heading out early for a meeting, or for Church on Sundays so I can avoid the "burner coffee".  ;)Being able to by them in bulk at $0.70 per packet makes this habit much more economical!  A big thanks to Starbucks for offering them through Amazon as well as their own store.  Finally, I received my pack of 50 on May 2nd, and it has an expiration date of October, if that helps any of you who are concerned about the expiration date problems described by others.  Perhaps it was just a backlog of product as people were discovering VIA available on Amazon?
The electricity was off this morning and I still wanted my coffee. I put the Starbucks Ready Brew in a cup- added cold water- some Stevia and it was great. The flavor is soooo good hot or cold.

If you already know about VIA, let me just say that this is the decaf version, and it's fabulous -- 'nuff said!  :)If you don't know about VIA, boy, are you in for a treat.  VIA is Starbucks' trademark name for their new version of instant coffee.  Before you give up in disgust, stop and think:  would they really blow their name by bringing out something undrinkable like ordinary instant?  No, they're not that stupid, right?  So... there must be something unlike ordinary instant going on here.  Bingo!  Here's how I discovered it:My coffee maker (a Cuisinart GRIND-n-BREW, less than 2 weeks beyond the warranty period, naturally) gave up the ghost just before a big dinner party, and my husband and I aren't eager to make big purchases these days, to put it mildly.  At Sam's Club I ran across a large-sized pack of single-serving little tubes of Columbian VIA and thought, hey, why not -- gives us some more time to decide on our new coffeemaker.  Sam's doesn't sell any decaf VIA, so I had to admit to being out of decaf at the dinner (most of our guests gave up at that point, not wanting to caffeinate themselves so late in the evening), but the few who still wanted coffee were served VIA without knowing it.  All 3 praised our coffee, and I personally thought it was terrific!!  I 'fessed up to everyone's surprise and gave them each a single-serving packet to take home.Since then, I've had nothing but VIA.  Not only do I enjoy it as much as brewed fresh-ground Starbucks coffee, but I absolutely love the convenience of "brewing" a single serving whenever I want it, instead of waiting for a whole pot, throwing some of it out after it lingered for an hour or two, and then waiting for a whole new pot later if I want more.  Needless to say, we haven't replaced the Cuisinart, and that was months ago.  (Note:  a single serving is 8 oz., and our porcelain coffee mugs hold 10 oz., so it works beautifully for us, whether a single cup or a dozen:  just put a tube's worth into each mug and add steaming hot water to what you've predetermined is the 8 oz. point).  I also love not having to wonder whether my big bag of whole beans is still fresh or whether to throw out the rest and plunk down serious cash on the next one:  the VIA is fresh each time, so I'm actually spending less per cup than I had been before.  Not to mention the serious pain previously of cleaning the grinding mechanism on the GRIND-n-BREW for every new pot... :(The only problem I originally had was no decaf, so I was giving up drinking any coffee at all after 3 or 4 in the afternoon.  Then, naturally, I found the decaf on Amazon -- HOORAY!!!  I'm about to order my sixth case of this wonderful decaf, which tastes as good as any decaf I've ever had.  The only other place I've ever found the decaf is on Starbucks' own website, and it's cheaper from Amazon, especially if you're a Prime member.  Amazon scores again, and then some.The best part?  How portable it is!!  If you end up agreeing with me that it's as good as "brewed", then just imagine being able to take one of these little tubes with you anywhere you go, just add it to 8 oz. of steaming hot water, and then end up with a fresh cup of fabulous-tasting coffee?  Ymmmm...  (Especially nice to have some in my bag for "emergencies", such as when a restaurant tells us at the end of a nice dinner out that they don't have any more decaf...)Try both the caffeinated and the decaf -- I'll bet you end up being incredibly glad you did, and I'll bet the two combined save you a lot of time, money and inconvenience.  Go for it!  :)
It may not be saying much, but this is 10x better than the coffee we have at work.  I like that it's quick and convenient and has good strong flavor.

I have to confess I am a Lazy Cook.  One of THE laziest cooks in history, I would guess.  I suppose my lack of enthusiasm for cooking comes from the fact that the effort in making any dish is soon demolished as the receipe involved is devoured either by other hungry people, or one's self.  Nothing remains for all that work and effort!  John Fiedler, (I think), once told Julia Child that cooking and music are similar, in that after the effort is expended, the work soon disappears.  But Mr. Fiedler, (or perhaps John Williams -- or whoever else said this), was wrong.  Because music can be RECORDED -- and listened to over and over again.  Sadly, the same cannot be said for food.  You can make it over and over...but the effort involved is always the same.  Food cannot be "recorded", then "played back" in an instant.  Unless, I guess, you make a lot and freeze some of it.  But when the frozen portion is gone -- you've got to make the receipe all over again.Yes -- I AM a lazy cook.  A very, very, very, VERY lazy cook.  To me, making a tuna salad is an effort.  (Forget about anything more complicated to make!)  However, I will ALWAYS make the effort to make a tuna sandwhich, and take my own home-made "liquid refresment" with me, (ice tea, lemonade, iced coffee, etc.) -- "brown-bagging" whenever possible, to save a few pennies, which, day after day, and year after year, DO add up!Yes, even I will make tea.  With tea bags, (or even with lose tea), it is very, (VERY!) simple to make, after all!  (Even simpler than intant coffee....because, to make GOOD tea, the water should come just to boiling, whereas in instant coffee, the longer the water boils, the more tasty the instant coffee will be.Therefore, even I see absolutely NO reason to buy bottled tea!  OK -- maybe once, so that you can use the empty bottle(s) into which to pour your own, "home-made" tea, after the bottles are empty. All that is required is to rinse out the glass bottles, (IMMEDIATELY!) a few times, with very hot water, or put dish-detergent soap into the glass bottles, fill with water, leave overnight, and THEN rinse with very hot water.  Or put the empty glass bottles in the dishwasher to get them clean.  Not very hard -- even very lazy me can do these things.But, I suppose if you are going to get some bottles to put your tea in, you might as well get HONEST TEA COMMUNITY GREEN TEA, offered here on Amazon in a 12-bottle pack.  This tea is rated the No. 1 tea in one of a very famous series of diet -- or make that, non-diet -- books, (you know, the ones with all the pretty pictures in them).  Anyway, the authors of this book are very, er -- authoritative -- being editor-in-chief, and food and nutrition editors of some very well known, and famous, men's and women's health magazines.  HONEST TEA COMMUNITY GREEN TEA gets their highest marks.  I also note that there is a nice wide mouth and screw cap on this bottle -- easy for refilling and opening and closing, (keep a sterilized funnel handy, if needed).  This green tea has maltese oranges in it, (to sweeten the flavour and add to the health benefits), and is certified kosher by the Orthodox Union, and certified organic by the USDA.  It tastes pretty good for a green tea -- and the anti-oxidents in green tea have been proven to increase metabolism, and do other good things.  If you still don't like the taste of green tea, you can, (after finishing this product), COMBINE green tea with other tea, (orange pekoe, English Breakfast, jasmine, etc.), for a better taste.  More cheaply -- with your own brewed tea from bags or lose-leaves.HONEST TEA COMMUNITY GREEN TEA comes in a 16 ounce bottle.  If you have a thermos of this size, (or larger), you might want to use it instead -- but this way, you will have many, (that is, 12!), eventually-empty bottles, and perhaps thus be able to fill, (and refrigerate), several at a time, thus saving yourself some extra work.  (There's "Lazy-Cook" me again!)To your health -- and your saving money, making for more leisure, now and in the future!  : )

column4: Angel_Boy "Treat the people around you the wa...
column9: I Wanted The CHEESE_but these were good
column10: These are tasty. they're not like home made so don't expect that.  they're the top of the line for canned pasta. and it only takes 90 seconds to heat the whole can (once you dump contents into microwave safe container). they are plump with meat- so they are BIG BEEF_ the meat mix is creamy but the sauce has meat chunks in it- like regular pasta sauce might if the meatballs break up in it. the cans came with 1 1/2 years till expiration date- so if you order extra you don't have to eat them all right away- so if they're on sale_ buy, buy, buy. good source of protien, veggies and fiber- i read the label. if you eat the whole can it's about 500 calories- but you're filled up and it's good.

I bought this to keep at work. I didn't want to spend $10 on lunch every day so this sounded like a good idea at the time. I've tried this both on the stove and by microwave but the results have been pretty bad. To clarify, it's not that it tastes bad, but it doesn't taste good either. The sodium intake is sky high so at the very least it could tasty delicious like all the other food that's not good for you. It's so bland that I started drenching it in hotsauce and even hot cheetos.I guess it's back to ramen noodles until there is a cheap and tolerable food that doesn't take 10 years off my life.
Thought this heavy stuff would cost a lot to ship but with Prime it did not.  I'm finding most of my dry goods on here and it is well worth it!

column9: What's for dinner?  The Chef?  Again?
column10: Chef Boyardee Big Beef Ravioli, Overstuffed, 15-Ounce Cans (Pack of 12)I bought these as a back-up when inspiration escapes me and I don't want to cook...They're pretty good for a canned pasta and each can has a lot of sauce so I add angel hair pasta (microwaved in my BPA free Fasta Pasta), canned mushrooms and sometimes black olives and cheese to the whole thing, mix it around a bit and end up with enough for two dinners...The ravioli becomes a square meatball and canned or frozen veggies (microwaved again) rounds out the meal...I try not to use this stuff very often but it's nice to have on the shelf just in case...The sausage ravioli is probably tastier but pork makes me sick, darn it...I'm a single person so don't have the pressure of providing meals for a family and occasionally slip into the "grab and fix quick" category...I could just eat it cold out of the can as well and may have to in an emergency...Not much in the way of clean up at the end and that suits me just fine!
My order came very quickly, and was packaged very well so there were no dented cans. I received just what I expected.

I would buy this product again. The sauce is so flavorful, I don't season it. There aren't many products that I don't have to add a lot of seasoning to, especially in a can.  These are handy to have around as a snack or a meal. I am adding this sentence because I am disappointed with the number of dented cans in the case.  I just pulled out one that is dented on the top, and I think I'll have difficulty getting it open.  Drat.

No, I wouldn't eat these on a regular basis, but for an emergency food source, they are excellent.Everyone should have a 3 day Disaster Kit in their home. Let's face it, there are problems everywhere. Hurricanes, Tornadoes, Floods, Earthquakes etc.etc.etc. Do you have 3 days of food, water, medicine, fuel, and cash? If not, you should.These ravioli's are cheap, pre-cooked, and ready to eat out of the can. No, you don't have to heat them up, but it does help the taste somewhat.
hey this is great to have in the house,also it's great with other quick meal idea's and best of all you can eat it anytime of the day.

For the record, I am (cut and paste) the same info for a few of these canned goods cause it's all good and I am a single male that can cook really great meals but have no time to do so, so I don't.  Open the can, dump in a bowl, nuke it, eat it, clean the bowl, end of day.

I remember eating this product many years ago when I was a kid. Sometimes you can't go home again. No flavor at all.Even my dog wouldn't eat it. I gave it to my neighbor who has kids. They will eat anything.
You cant go wrong with the chef! I like having these on hand for days where i am to broke to go out and buy food but to lazy to cook anything. hey i'm just being honest.

This product is pretty bland and tasteless.  I was disappointed, the pasta is mush and there is no distinct Italian spice flavor.  The meat part was tasteless as well.  I would not purchase this product again.
ALL THE CANS HAD DENTS,CLOSE TO THE RIM OF THE CAN.NOT FROM SHPPING.LOOK LIKE FACTORY REJECTS.HOW CAN PEOPLE GET AWAY WITH SELLING THESE DAMAGED CANS TO PEOPLE.
I bought a bunch of this and I found "High Fructose Corn Syrup" in the ingredient list. I would not feed that to my dog, and I won't eat it.

I bought these as a joke to top cupcakes for a pork party I was hosting.  I really just wanted any pig shaped candy.  When they came, they were such a pastel pink that I expected them to taste kind of like Pepto-Bismol.  At the best, I expected them to be cheap, kind of chalky, gummy candy.  But, in addition to being adorable, they're pretty good tasting.  And they're soft and chewy.  Everything you could possibly desire in a gummy pig...
I have used both the Red Raspberry and the Huckleberry  Pioneer Sugar Free jams and both are excellent!
We won't be ordering these again.  Our beans had a bitter aftertaste and the coffee became sour as it cooled.

original review below *****finally made coffee drink from coffee bean direct sumatra blend; otherwise only espresso with milk. so was able to taste this sumatra coffee naked. it is not good, but i would not rate it in taste any worse than starbucks, whose house coffee is poor. but then i am comparing it to italian coffee beans -Moreno, LavAzza and illy- and Kenya AA, all medium roast.changed rating from 3 stars to 2 stars.*************medium roast, taste is lighter, ergo not as bitter, as typically burnt american beans.but found on the company website that the decaf process is Methylene Chloride.Wikipedia describes in depth the dangers of this chemical. hopefully coffee bean direct will encourage their suppliers to switch to the CO2 or swiss water decaf process.

These coffee beans are rich, full-bodied, and economical.  This is the second time I have ordered them, and both times, was pleased with the flavor.  I had to cut back some on the amount I used, because the coffee was almost too strong, even though I like strong coffee.  There was no bitterness or after-taste.  I highly recommend this product.
I GOT THIS REVIEW MIXED UP WITH THE OTHER COFFEE A REG. COFFEE, I BOUGHT FROM THE SAME MAKER, I LIKE IT OR I NEVER WOULD HAVE BOUGHT MORE OF THE SAME BRAND.
THIS COFFEE IS AWESOME THE BEST I HAVE EVER BOUGHT IN 4 YRS ON AMAZON!! IT CUPS WELL THE BEANS ARE FRESH AND IT IS A TRUE CITY ROAST
Tawny says they are great, not old, and taste just like they used to.Miss you Tawny!!!
My puggle can devour most bones in minutes. These last a long time.  I love this brand and it is the only one that I will buy for my dog.

I love this coffee! It is the ONLY fairtrade, low acid coffee. One can buy a fairtrade coffee or a lowacid coffee but this is the one and only fairtrade AND lowacid coffee. It is my favorite coffee ever. Without this coffee, I would have to give up coffee altogether. Not a happy though! Instead I get to shop responsibly, take care of my stomach, and enoy this delicious brew every morning!

I've been looking for a low acid coffee for some time & this lives up to all the claims.  I can actually drink coffee again!  It isn't the best coffee I've ever tasted, but the benefit of being able to drink coffee again far out weighs taste.  I will be ordering more.

And no heartburn!!!  I used to drink Folgers Simply Smooth, which was always easy on my stomach.  But I wanted to try something organic, and this says it's also Fair Trade, so I tried it and I really like it!  Great flavor.  Not as bland as Simply Smooth, but not too strong either, depending on how you brew it of course.  But I would definitely buy more of this coffee.  Great find!
I love it.  It's a full-bodied, flavorful coffee, and I don't need to worry about indigestion after drinking it.  I also remain guilt free since it's fair trade and organic.

I was a barista for 15 years and sold excellent coffee while living in San Francisco.  I love coffee. When I developed gastrointestinal issues coffee became something I couldn't drink without suffering immensely.  I began a search for coffee I could drink.  I bought a Toddy system which removes 70% of the acid and will still use that method, but it isn't always convenient and a pound of coffee doesn't go as far with that system in my experience.  A friend brought me some low-acid beans and I enjoyed waking up in the morning and grinding beans for a fresh cup. It still gave me heartburn but was easier on me than regular coffee, somewhat.  But I SO enjoyed making fresh coffee again, so I searched for a low-acid coffee when my little stash ran out, and that's when I found Puroast.  I have never bought ground coffee, always whole bean, so had very low expectations on all counts.  But that's how desperate I was to have fresh coffee, I figured it's worth a try.  This coffee really is low acid and I can enjoy a cup or two each morning.  I don't feel as if I'm drinking an inferior coffee and I LOVE that it's organic, free trade.  I loved Peet's french roast, so if Peet's is a 10 then this coffee is a 7 or 8, which I think is incredible for a low-acid coffee and not even a dark french.  This is coffee I don't have to apologize for when sharing it with friends.  I am ordering more.

I was very satisfied with Puroast Low Acid Coffee. Thetaste was very smooth and not bitter. I could notice a differencein the acid content, yet the taste still met my expectations.I have problems with gastric reflux and am very careful aboutwhat I eat, however i can't give up my morning coffee. AfterwardsI drink a lot of water and I am fine.
This products flavor was ok and still tasted like real coffee which is great.  Unfortunately, it was still way too acidic and hurt my stomach which didn't make it a worthwhile purchase for me...

column9: Still my favorite Extra Virgin Olive Oil
column10: I have been buying the standard L'Olivier olive oil in the crock container for years. It is a beautiful oil with a great taste. It's not something I'd cook with - high heat kills the subtle flavors - it is a finishing oil.Having bought the drums more recently, I prefer them to the crock. While the spout does leave much to be desired, getting  the wax off the crock was a pain. What I'd recommend (if you really love this oil like I do) is buy the crock, get the wax off (you can melt the final bits with a flame to get it nice and clean), and then buy these drums as refills for the crock. Best of both worlds!I highly recommend this product! I'd make it 4.5 stars because of the drum, but since that's not an option, I have to round it up to 5.

column9: Love the oil. The drum? Not so much
column10: L'Olivier makes a lovely, fruity olive oil.  I've used it (whenever I could find it) for years.  This drum 2-pack is a great value, for the volume and quality of the olive oil.  The drum looks handsome on the counter, too, but is terrible for dispensing the oil.  The pull-out spot on the top is too short to keep the oil from dribbling across the top and down the side of the drum.  Buy it for the oil, but decant into another container.
Great quality olive oil.  The only downside is that often the drum comes dented so not the best gift.  Other than that, fantastic!

I've bought L'Olivier before when I could find it, & Amazon's price is great. I think French olive oil, even though extra virgin, has a light taste that's excellent to use when you don't want to change the taste of your food, almost like regular "light olive oil", but richer & with the health benefits of EVOO.I did have trouble with the pull-up pour spout coming out the second time I used it. No big deal, just transferred the oil to another container.
Great olive oil at an unbelievable price.  I used to buy this in the L'Olivier store for twice as much.  This olive oil has great flavor - perfect for cooking or salads.

this very fragrant olive oil adds depth to recipes and melds especially well with the summer bounty of tomatoes and basil.  It is also great with any Mediterrean, Provencal, or Italian recipes.  Althought a bit pricey, its flavor and versatility make it worth the cost for cooking with quality ingredients.  It is  probably my favorite olive oil.
I thoroughly enjoyed this EVOO and the decorative drums are an excellent addition to a more masculine kitchen! Great Value too!
Not much else to say than that the product was perfect just like buying it at the store. Shipping was fast too! I am very please and will definately return as a customer at a later time.

column9: 13 flavors, nice sampler, long use by dates, great for K-cup starter
column10: Most coffee drinkers want caffeine...I am one of those rare people that LOVES coffee (especially dark and bold), but just doesn't need the caffeine at all. Finding decaf K-cups is a challenge, so I was happy to receive this as a gift for xmas 2011. I also posted a picture of the sampler. There are 13 flavors included in this 20 decaf coffee sampler:2 - Green Mountain French Vanilla2 - Green Mountain Breakfast Blend2 - Green Mountain Extra Bold Dark Magic2 - Tully's House Blend2 - Tully's French Roast2 - Emeril's Jazzed Up2 - Caribou Caribou Blend1 - Green Mountain Vermont Country Blend1 - Green Mountain Hazelnut1 - Coffee People Donut Shop Decaf1 - Donut House Decaf1 - Newman's Own Special Decaf1 - Timothy's HazelnutVery happy that all packages specifically say decaf since these will likely get mixed in with hubby's cafs in our K-cup drawer!Overall, I think this is a good sampler. The packaging was nice for a gift...with 4 recipes printed inside the box (although they didn't correlate with the coffees in the box). I would have preferred a little less duplication...how about 20 different coffees!? We are just starting out with a Keurig, so wanted to try samplers first. I bet that almost every box that goes out is different. So, I'd likely buy again (and hope that there is a Wolfgang Puck in the mix). Would have liked to see a hot cocoa in the box, just for variety (like the tea samplers often have cider).Also important to note, the use by dates on the pagkages range from 5/12 to 9/12!No comments on taste just yet since we are new to the K-cup world and because coffee flavor is based so much on personal preference.4 stars for nice packaging, decent variety, and long use by dates. Would give 5 stars for 20 different coffees!!
The order arrived on time and I am very pleased with the selection.  Just wish more manufactures would realize we decaf drinkers need more variety!!

column9: Great packaging and a nice variety of decaf options
column10: I received this as a gift, and was very pleased with it. It comes packaged in an attractive box, with each cup in an individual holder. While there were a few decaf options that I have tried before (such as Donut Shop and Green Mountain) there were also several that I've never had, such as Tully's, Newman's Own, and Emeril's.Great way to try out a wide range of decaf options to see which ones you like (and which to avoid) before spending money on a whole box of one variety. The packaging also makes for a nice gift presentation. Highly recommend.
Ordered this product so I could have a variety of decafs to sample.  Received exactly what was described by seller.  Nicely packaged and good variety. enjoyed all of the flavors.
It is a nice variety of various decaf products. A must if you are not sure what your favorite decaf will be!
I was very happy with the selection of coffee. It gave us the chance to try different brands. I will order again.

This was a fine sampler, but the the per unit of K-cup is way too much.We had a fairly reasonable mix of varieties, but they were quite expensive.  This sampler did come in a nice cardboard "display" box.

While I recently purchased a Keurig and I've been looking to sample as many different coffee brands and flavors as possible before I start stocking up.  With this 20 K-cup sampler pack, I thought it would be a great opportunity to try a large variety.  There are only 9 different types of coffee in a 20 sample pack.  The packaging is fine and would be acceptable as a gift and the dates are reasonable- some expire in August with others expiring in January.Variety:(2) Newman's Special Decaf(2) Green Mountain Extra Bold Dark Magic(2) Donut Shop Decaf(3) Wolfgang Puck Chef's Reserve(2) Green Mountain Vermont Country Blend Decaf(2) Donut House Decaf(2) Green Mountain Hazelnut Decaf(2) Green Mountain Breakfast Blend Decaf(3) French Vanilla Decaf

column9: Crazy Cups Decaf Sampler for K-cups
column10: This item from Amazon.com is a good buy for anyone who wants to try out many different flavors of decaf or for one who likes having a varity of flavors to choose from.  The sample arrives in a nicely layout single-layer container so all the flavors can be easily seen.  We used it to decide which flavors we liked so we could order that flavor in a larger container.

column9: Try it again...very nice gift box and good variety
column10: From some of the previous reviews, I was expecting a standard Amazon cardboard box with the K-cups just tossed inside.  Instead, there is a nice presentation box with a design including a bamboo print on it with each K-cup fitted into its own hole (20 cup).It is also a very good sampling of the available decafs out there:  Caribou (2); Donut House (2); Donut Shop (2); Emeril's Jazzed Up (1); Green Mountain Breakfast Blend (2); Green Mountain Vermont Country (2); Green Mountain French Vanilla (1); Green Mountain Hazelnut; Newman's Own Newman's Special Decaf; Tully's House (1); Tully's French Roast (1); and finally, Wolfgang Puck Chef's Reserve Columbian (2).These folks are paying attention to and responding to people's comments.A very nice presentation!  You should not hesitate to give as a gift.

column9: Good way to find the coffee you like
column10: I bought this for my wife who drinks Decaf coffee.  We made our first purchase of a K-cup single type coffee maker and she wanted to try different brands. This sampler was one solution. She found several brands she liked and disliked.  I think it was worth the money and the coffee was shipped fast and was fresh.

column9: Crazy Cups Decaf Sampler, K-Cup Portion Pack for Keurig K-Cup Brewers (Pack of 20)
column10: This sampler package was purchased as a gift for my parents to go with their new Keurig brewer. The sampler was nicely packaged in a box with the individual K-cups resting in cardboard & plastic packaging. My parents were pleased with the variety of 13 different decaf coffees to try - they were very happy with this gift!

column9: Of all the Cajun foods I can cook at home, this tops everything
column10: I prefer to use crawfish or shrimp. I've tried other brands but this is the flavor I fell in love with in Louisiana. I started buying the Etouffee by the case when it was in a can that included the liquid. Now its a dry mix but it still provides a flavor second to none. Of course if you want it to have a hot bite, just add some Chachere Creole Seasoning. And I only serve this over rice out of my rice cooker.

I don't always have time or energy to do everything from scratch for dinner and these tomato flakes are fabulous! Great flavor, they rehydrate quickly and add tremendous depth and zest to recipes. So quick, I love them. They are much easier to use than typical sundried tomatoes because you don't have to get out scissors to cut them into bits. I highly recommend for soups, vegetable dishes, stews, just about anything.

I have used a pretty good size line of Barry Farms dehydrated veggies for more than a decade now.  Although I occasionally have used them when cooking in my kitchen, the vast majority of time I use them for campfire cooking when I am hiking.  I love carrying dried products such as this on my hikes for they are light, easy to carry, and you can just use what you want and reseal the bag.  (Unlike canned veggies and such that don't take kindly to being bagged and toted along as leftovers).  Best of all, these tomato flakes are very flavorful.  Make that downright delicious.  I add about a third of one bag to any stew or soup I am making on an open fire, and the rich taste of fresh tomato is your reward in every spoonful. A little of these flakes goes a long ways as to flavor, so keep that in mind if your a beginner with them.  They have a much fresher taste than you would imagine, and have been a part of some of the best meals I have ever put together in the wilderness.  My only recommendation when ordering these flakes is to get at least 3 bags at once to make the shipping worth it.  You can order 3 of them for the same shipping cost as one.  Really rich tasting and well worth your money in my opinion...
Very good tasting, they hold their shape well.  I have enjoyed cooking with these.

column9: Not a pleasant drink, contains glucose EDIT: not too bad
column10: This infusion is of reasonable quality, however the taste is at best questionable (stronger/less pleasant than most similar beverages I have tried), and it contains glucose. Even if it's a small amount, it's something I would rather do without. It does rather well when it comes to its properties of keeping you alert and energized, but the bad taste is not easy to overcome.EDIT: 30ish bags of this later, it has grown on me a bit. It is still not the best drink, but it keeps me fairly energized and I do not dislike it any longer.

I could not find this Tea anywhere including Asian Stores and Health and Vitamin Stores. Was glad to find it thru Amazon. My Son is in Afghanistan and requested this Tea, I was so tickled to find it for him. I tried it and it is good.

You will want to share it. It is delicious instant Ginseng tea. It is the best instant Ginseng tea I have had. And I have tried several, not just from Amazon, but also from the Korean Market near IHOP in Daly City California(now that was pure water, not even color was added). I'm sorry but this one is the best I've had so far. I have used 3-4 packs of other instant Ginseng teas and not come near the flavor of Prince of Peace. It also comes in very nice boxes of 10 packs so sharing is very easy and convient. I gave some to my sister and my mother. My mom likes it so much she doesn't want to share it with me(because I already have some). I plan to by this tea again.
Loved the Natural flavor, no sweetner or anything that will alter that yummy earthy flavor of ginseng. You can also drink it cold, grate for Bikram :D

Now the reason I bought this tea was when I was in Puerto Rico visiting family, my brother inlaw told me he uses it for energy, but Little did I know that it also works to enhance the male sexual function if you know what I mean. I notice that when I stopped drinking it about 2 months ago I just did not have much desire for sex and when I started drinking it again I feel like im 20 years old again. wink. Now Im not 100% sure its the tea but you have to look at your body like a computer, whenever something seems wrong with it, then go back and figure out what have you taken or stopped taking and problem solved. the taste is not horrible. I mainly drink one pack before working out for energy and it delivers without the jitters.

I haven't had crawfish in 11 years and wanted some of my family to try them. They all agreed that while they stink in the kitchen, they taste much better than they smell and have an earthy and slightly shrimpy flavor to them. They also tend to have a shrimp like texture in the tail. I found about 4 bad or slightly decaying crawfish in this package....which is EXCELLENT for crawfish. Especially considering that you can EASILY get a bad one in a restaurant without the cooks realizing that it was less than KOSHER. In all, I had several dozen in this 3 pound order and can say that out of roughly 40 crawfish, only 4 or 5 were less than appetizing. You can generally tell by the odor and color of the flesh once cooked. I used a cajun seafood boil from Zatterans to flazor mine. I just boil about 1/2 gallon of water with 1-1/2 cups of their seasoning. Once boiling is under way, drop in crawfish and let boil about 7 minutes....then shut of heat and allow to rest about another 3 minutes to absorb more spice. Excellent spice that was just meant for these. Overall, I found these crawfish to be a very reasonable buy and well shipped for the price. If you don't live where crawfish are easily bought at low prices....then this place is were to go for these!

This is WAY too much for crawfish.3LBS should run you between $9-$13.This is $30... plus another $30 for shipping.You could get 3LBS of live crawfish mailed to you(much better than pre-cooked) for the same price.

I have been drinking Berres Brothers coffee for years. Streusel cake was the first Berres Brothers flavored coffee I ever drank. It has always been my favorite. It has a very nice cinnammon flavor with a hint of brown sugar. Unlike some flavored coffees, this one is not overpowering; the flavor is just right.

column9: Great Coffee!!  Love Berres Brothers coffee
column10: While Berres Brothers Highlander Grogg is my all time favorite coffee, this has now become my second favorite.Can't beat Berres Brothers coffee for consistently good, high quality coffee.We have our own small business, and everyone raves how good our office smells because of our coffee.  I then show them how we pour it - I like to use a Primo Latte Frother, and have found that International Delight sugar free creamer works best.  Pour creamer in the cup, add any Splenda or sugar desired, and then froth it with the latte frother.  Pour the coffee after that.  It makes a cup of coffee that I think is better than any Starbucks you can get!
BEST COFFEE EVER.  After tasting these fresh ground beans, I can't go back to the regular stuff.  Great pricing on Amazon (vs grocery store or Berres website).  Try it, just need a grinder...

The review for this product alone is going to be short: it is effective, but tastes awful and bitter.  I ordered this product to focus on studying, etc but I found that "get charged" is just as effective plus wakes me up a bit more and tastes a whole lot better.  If you are considering "get smart", I would strongly suggest trying "get charged" first.  I have inserted my review for "get charged" below so you can see why..."'Get charged' works wonders and tastes amazing, even without sugar, whether hot or cold. I ordered a cup of this on a whim while working on application essays for grad school. I figured (especially being caffeine free) that it would just be a gimmick and that I'd just move onto a latte afterward. Well...I never needed the latte. This woke me up and made me focus better than anything I have ever tried before. Now instead of taking my ADHD meds, which work but give me migraines, I usually just grab a cup of this instead. I'm about to finish up my first can and will definitely be purchasing another one. Whether looking for energy, focus, or both, this tea absolutely delivers! I cannot recommend it enough.***Word of caution*** One cup is plenty to get you going; a little goes a LONG way. Two cups in a row made me a little jittery, dizzy, and gave me stomach pain."

This tea is fantastic for individuals who have suffered memory loss, for whatever reason.  Mine personally is due to a few concussions over the years that have rendered my brain mushy and unreliable at times.  Within half an hour of drinking the tea, I felt this huge weight lifted off of my shoulders.  I was calmer, more relaxed, and I truly had an easier time with conversation and using my brain for basic tasks.  I will buy this tea again.  But only likely at the big box store, as it is cheaper.

column9: Weak, least favorite Republic of Tea tea
column10: I found this tea to be very weak flavored; not necessarily bitter like other reviews have commented, just...weak.  Whenever I use this (mostly at this point just to use it up), I have to use 2 tea bags or combine this with The Republic of Tea, Get Charged Tea, 36-Count (which, again like other reviews have commented, is much better flavored and the effects are similar).  I would pass on buying this again.  The container IS lovely though :).

column9: Excellent flavor, still waiting for the effect
column10: I love the flavor of this tea. I'm not sure it whether it has helped my memory or focus to any significant degree. When I drink a tea like Tazo's focus, I get a great focused feeling that doesn't give me a crash. I was hoping this would do something like that, but it hasn't (probably because it has zero caffeine).
Package sealed and powder was fresh and free of clumps. Bitter when mixed with water but unoticeable in with juice or protein shake. Exellent way to add antioxidants to any diet.

I love this stuff! I sprinkle some into the bottom of a cup I am about to brew green tea in, add a green tea teabag, sprinkle in a little stevia, add hot water, and enjoy! The green tea extract kicks up the green tea a notch or two (making the tea flavor more intense) and the stevia counteracts any bitterness making it nicely sweet without any calories ... just don't add too much, a little goes a long way (true both for the extract and the stevia).

I'm no "health nut", but my wife and I both figure our toddler doesn't need to be consuming large amounts of refined sugar yet, so we are very thankful that he loves these Kashi crackers. He can snack on them for a long time if allowed because they taste great. In fact, so can I, yet as best I can tell they don't have anything in them except good wholesome stuff. He screams sometimes when we take them away. If you're looking for a genuinely health snack food for your child, we highly recommend these.

When they changed their packaging, they must have changed their recipe too because they don't taste as good as way back when the company first started up. I can taste the difference. Will stop buying these.

The item is not sour patch as the description and picture suggests. After I eagerly awaited for the order to arrive it instead turned out to be Haribo fruit salad, total disappointment. Even better no return Label.

So I had my first taste of Jamaica blue mountain coffee today and can honestly say it's the best, most smooth cup of coffee i've had. The smell when you first open the bag is divine, when you grind down the beans it only gets better. I use a Bruville single cup coffee maker to make my coffee so i'm not exactly sure if it would taste different with a drip coffee maker, i'll have to use one and then update this review. Not only can you smell the difference from your run of the mill coffee but you can see the difference as well,a dark rich looking cup but not overbearing or bitter just really smooth. The only thing about buying this bag from Amazon is that your paying close to 20$ more than you should. I got the same bag from coffeeforless.com for 54$ and free shipping.

column9: Not worth it for the money
column10: First a little background on me. I Am a coffee drinking fiend. I probably keep several countries coffee production up, so I know coffee. I don't mind strong coffee or so so tasting coffee I just dont expect it to be expensive so so tasting coffee. I have had and love Jamaican Blue mountain coffee before but it was a lot more expensive than this. column9: one of my favorite childhood memories
column10: My great aunt used to brew this in the percolator on the stove every morning, and she'd serve it with sugar and evaporated milk. we'd have grits, eggs, country sausage or bacon and maybe biscuits with cane syrup. Mmm Mmm good times.

This is an excellent coffee that is very similar to Cafe Du Monde but it is much more available. I can find this at my local grocery store whereas I have to order Cafe Du Monde through Amazon. (Which I do on occasion)I find Cafe Du Monde just a tad bit smoother and a little "earthy", but that said this is still top notch, and has notes of caramel.Remember as with all coffee with chicory to use less then you would normal coffee, perhaps half of what you normally would. Using less you will still get a dark coffee as it is almost impossible to get a light coffee with this. That being said, it still contains less caffeine as normal coffee and is certainly less bitter and taste less acidic.Try this today if you are like me and love a good, bold, robust, great tasting coffee with chicory. You will not be disappointed.

I am passionate about good coffee, and I've traveled around the world and been fortunate to taste the coffees of many lands. There are great coffees in Italy, Kenya, Ethiopia, Colombia, and many other countries, but in the USA there is no finer coffee than French Market Coffee & Chicory. I've been drinking this for over 40 years and it is a staple in my home. It never disappoints, and I always get unsolicited rave reviews from guests about the coffee I brew.There are a couple of things you should know. Even though this is a blend of coffee & chicory, it makes a robust pot of coffee. Pay attention to the advice that's printed on the lid of every can: "Use 1/3 to 1/2 as much coffee as you would normally use to brew a pot." My standard recipe these days is 2 level scoops per 8 cups of water for an automatic drip brewer, but if your coffee maker will take 10 or 12 cups of water, I'd still recommend using just 2 level scoops; then adjust to your own taste.You get great value from a can of French Market coffee. The can is 16 oz., not 12 oz. like many other cans on your grocer's shelf. And by using only 2 level scoops per pot, that can will last for weeks.The company that makes French Market coffee was acquired by another New Orleans-based company, but I trust that they will respect the heritage and tradition of this great New Orleans brand. Try French Market coffee and see if you agree with me that it's simply the best.

Our favorite brand of coffee at the best price available.  Have been buying this for years.  If you like a good strong cup of coffee...try it. It also is economical as you will need less to brew a good cup.

But now that we no longer live in New Orleans we have more trouble finding it.  Thank goodness for Amazon!  This coffee is in a league of it's own. I can't imagine a morning without my French Market coffee!

column9: Excellent coffee - brings back memories of Bangalore
column10: French Market is one of the best Chicory blended coffee that I have tasted in the US - really love the thick strong crema/decoction is makes.Anyone who has visited/grew up in South India - specifically Chennai/Madras and Bangalore - you would noticed that these are the 2 cities in India where coffee is a staple drink.  While the rest of India drinks Tea - these two cities swear by their coffee.Drop by at one of the Darshinis (Fast food restaurants) and they make super strong coffee - mixed with Milk and sugar.  The specialty of this coffee is the right blend of Coffee and Chicory which was popularized by the British when they were ruling India.  Most of the restaurants/coffee houses prepare the crema/decoction made with coffee in a 5 liter stainless steel container - then when a coffee order comes through they mix the thick crema/decoction with milk and sugar and serve it in a small stainless steel cup with an inverted bowl - it is a unique experience in itself !Chicory is cheaper than coffee and different 'blends' offer different proportion - typically it is 70-80% coffee and 20-30% chicory.  The best restaurants and coffee house make the right mix of coffee/chicory depending on the coffee type - it is an art.  Until the advent of 'Coffee Day' and 'Barista' chain of modern cafe - the old Bangalore coffee was coffee/chicory blends.Until I came to the US, I had never tasted 100% coffee - I love 100% coffee at Starbucks/Dunkin Donuts.  But once in a way, I get my memories back with French Market Coffee and enjoy it - it does have the right blend of Coffee and Chicory and amazingly rich and flavorful.Here are a few tips on how you prepare a good cup of coffee with the French Market Chicory blended coffee:  * Use only 50-75% of this coffee/chicory blend as compared to using 100% coffee powder  * Preferably add 2% or whole milk to the resulting crema/decoction
