Blackberry, in my own opinion, is the best tasting!  Some have worried about the sugar content but I don't believe it is a real big issue considering that even "real" fruit contains its own sugar and anything beats that aspartame poison!  Good product... OK price... and its backed by amazon!

column9: Natural juice better than normal soda
column10: Tasty drink! Very addicting and no reason not to; it's good for you...well, compared to the high fructose corn syrup sodas, at least.

My husband and I love Izze sparkling juices, especially the sparkling Blackberry. It is refreshing anytime, especially on a hot day. We really like it that there are no food colorings in this product. I have recommended it to friends and neighbors and they really like this product as well. I'm so glad to be able to get it on Amazon; we used to purchase it at Costco but they don't always have it. Now it is delivered right to my door once a month. There is no corn syrup or sugar added either so this product is much better than soda and I think more thirst-quenching. Thanks, Amazon, for offering this product to be shipped to my residence on a regular schedule of my choice.

column9: Great stuff and not bad for you either.
column10: I enjoy one or two of these a day and don't feel guilty about it.  It tastes great and is way less damaging than soda.
I love the flavor and the sleek look of the can. I try not to drink soda and this was a good alternative. I would definitely recommend.
I was so happy to find this at Amazon in these convenient cans!  Very nice to have on hand for guests.  I drink soda only rarely but it would be easy to become addicted to THIS stuff!

When I first noticed this product at Panda Express, I didn't know what to expect but when I tried Izze, it was something I haven't had before.  It was so refreshing to have a drink to have real sugar in it and not artificially sweetener. I recommend people to buy the product especially the blackberry brand.

IZZE has seemed to find the balance between healthy fruit taste and the sensation of carbonated soft drinks with their sparkling juice line.  I haven't had a soft drink in over a year since discovering these wonderfully refreshing, healthy alternatives to carbonated soft drinks.  Since it's pure fruit juice, it's also naturally weet (but not too sweet) so it also satisfies that "sweet tooth" as well.  Although not a substitute for plain ol' H2O, this beverage definitely satisfies and quenches my thirst.  Can't get enough of these beverages.......

I was excited when I heard you can now subscribe to certain items on Amazon and get shipments on regular intervals. My friend shared a link for a coupon for the service involving izze drinks and I went for the 2 month plan. It would be nice to have a variety pack choice though.But anyways what can I say other than blackberry happens to be my favorite flavor and it never disappoints. I like these since they are fruit juice and sparkling water. Most other juice beverages list water as there main ingredient so it's nice to see the flip side. I also don't really drink soda and it's nice to have a healthier alternative. So try all the flavors!
Sparkling blackberry hasn't gotten me off cola as i'd hoped, but it is a nice drink as an alternative to all of the highly sweetened drinks out there.
This beverage is soooooooo good - fresh blackberry taste and good portion size.  Diered by Amazon, especially with auto ship.

I like this flavor best, refreshing and just enough fruit flavor to satisfy.  Good size can, not too big that it gets warm.  Highly recommend for those who want something refreshing and good for you.  Counts as a serving of fruit.

There really aren't that many choices available for those of us looking for natural sparkling juices.  Lucky for us, there's IZZE!  Naturally sweetened, naturally colored, and suprisingly delicious.  There's just one drawback to these otherwise perfect drinks...  they're a little on the small side.  About the same size as those Red Bull energy drinks.  They are also available in a larger size, though not in cans but rather glass bottles.  Either way, get some!
I love Izze's, I am not much of a pop drinker & Izze's have the corbination like pop but are much better for you.
I've enjoy'd izzes for a long time, and thought this was a good deal.  I was right.
I love this product and this flavor. It has completely replaced my soda addiction and I now drink no soda. It's a smaller size and is just right when I am craving a soda. Love it!
A wonderful flavour and the 8.4 fl oz is enough to quench my thirst on most occasions.
I have always liked Izze, but when it started to be marketed in the can I liked it evn more.  It is just the right amount and I am happy about the price that Amazon offers for the case.
This beverage is more than curiously refreshing. It packs a wallop of taste and quick energy.  I would highly recommend it!

I bought this @ my grocery store and found it was a weak soda, but very tasty as a pop. It could be mixd in a tea or used in a punch mix too. It works well if your doctor has stopped your water intake due to low blood sodium to quench your thrist, because there is a small amount of salt in it. Caffine free so you can drink at night. I'll buy with the 15% off through Amazon it is apprx. $.75 a can.UPDate:I have gotten my thrid case of this Blackberry Juice by Izze. We love this product.

Delicious! I usually don't like flavored waters and avoid them and was afraid that this product would be something similar, but this blackberry sparkling juice is quite good. It's best when very cold and hits the spot with a not-too-sweet flavor. My beverage of choice would usually be soda, but I am trying to wean myself off caffeine. This is a great caffeine-free drink for when I just have to have something other than water. I appreciate that there are no artificial ingredients - especially those suspicious artificial sweeteners - in fact, you can actually read the ingredients list without needing a scientist standing next to you.All in all, I was pleasantly surprised by this drink, and I'll definitely try the other flavors (I have my eye on the grapefruit next). I think this will be a good alternative beverage for the summer months, and although I'll choose water over this most of the time, as a little bit of "something" extra, this drink fits the bill.

Wow.  Very refreshing drink, and it's from my brothers back in Boulder, Colorado.  Blackberry, huh?  Pretty good.  I'm glad that, all these years later, they are still coming out with new Coltrane albums and new fruits.  These little cans are nice, not big enough to count against you and a nice quick chug.  I enjoyed the drink but especially enjoyed getting a case of fruity drinks in the mail.  Purchasing this drink will add years to your life, cleanse your colon, get your fingernails looking bright and shiny again, increase your stamina, reduce your carbon footprint, improve your bowling game, and save a Daubentonia madagascariensis paw.

These drinks are pretty tasty a bit on the tart side but not too sweet which is nice in the current market of way to sweet beverages. I'll be trying more of the flavors fo these drinks. They also make good mixing drinks for vodka and other stronger drink!
We are huge fans of the IZZE sparkling juice's but hands down, this flavor is our favorite. It is sweet, and heavy on the juice and we love it. Try it with crushed ice or ice cold.

This review is written by a non soda-drinker; it's not that I never drink pop, it's just that I know it's not that good for my teeth or my body, so, up until receiving a bunch of Izze through Amazon Vine, I probably have drank at most 1 pop a month (probably less) for about the past 5 years.  Since I'm not an everyday soda drinker, I'm not particularly concerned when I do drink one that it's low in calories, "diet," or anything else--it's just gotta satisfy my very occasional desire for a soda.  With this in mind, I'll keep my reviews (yeah, I did request 4 different ones--should last me about 10 years at this rate!) of Izze short and simple.Of the two I've tried, I like this blackberry one less.  I do like it, but the flavor is less reminiscent of actual blackberries and more reminiscent of that generic blackberry flavor that comes in soda and other products.  I actually like the very small (8.4 oz) cans a lot, since it doesn't take much for me to get a soda fix, and I probably don't need twice as much refined sugar that comes in a larger can.  It's soda, and it tastes good--if you buy your soda from Amazon.com(!?!), I recommend giving this a try.

This blackberry sparkling juice is delicious.It's nice and sweet.I liked it and my friends liked it very much. It tastes just like dark cherry soda.On the can is printed "We partner with Global Education Fund to help provide education and resources to needy children around the world." That alone is a good reason for me to buy this beverage.Highly recommended.

column9: A Nice, Refreshing Alternative... And It's Natural
column10: Amazon sent me an entire case of Izze Fortified All Natural Sparkling Juice in Blackberry, so I decided to pass it out to my co-workers and elicit their opinions as well.It is nice to see a readily available product made with all natural flavors and no refined sugar. It tastes good and would make a nice addition to a picnic or lunch outside, providing a nice, mellow drink to go along with a sandwich or salad.I was honestly expecting, and hoping for, more of a punch of blackberry soda. It tastes a little like a blackberry tea, a little light in flavor. But the flavor is nice.It also bothers me a little that an all natural soda would be 'fortified'. Yes, with vitamins, but if something is going to be all natural, leave it alone and don't add things you wouldn't normally find there.I first became aware of the Izze brand through their bottled soft drinks, which I believe are also all natural and use no refined sugar. The difference between those and these new cans seems to be the size and the addition of the vitamins. Other than that, I think it is probably the same product.My co-workers seemed to like the taste, but I got the sense they weren't blown away. I don't think this would convert Coke or Pepsi drinkers.I would buy it again, because it provides a nice, lighter alternative to something like Coke or Pepsi.

This is like the perfect thirst quencher when you're tired of soda, but you'd like something with a little fizz. It's the right balance of juice taste, fizziness, and content: the 8-ounce or so can really DOES an incredible job of getting rid of your thirst.I tried the clementine and the blackberry. The latter is just amazing! Not too sweet, not too tart, just perfect! The clementine I liked slightly less (it was a little too tart for me), but it was still very good nonetheless. The added vitamins and natural contents are just bonuses to the amazing taste.The only reason this isn't a five-star review is because of the calorie count. This beverage would be perfect if only for that!Highly recommend (esp. the blackberry!)

column4: Leah M. Brown "Leah Marie Brown, Author"
column10: Although I found this product to be not as fizzy or filling as a soda, my children (ages 9 and 12) absolutely loved Izze Fortified All Natural Sparkling Juice in Blackberry.  My son thought it tasted like a less sweet version of Clearly Canadian and my daughter thought it tasted like "fizzy grape juice" and was "totally awesome."I allowed my children to take a can to school to drink with their lunches, instead of juice boxes, and they were thrilled.  They even took some for their friends, who proclaimed Izze the best non-soda fizzy drink around.  Granted, I would not allow them to take this drink everyday, but as a particular treat, it's healthier than most juice boxes, kool aid, soda, and a whole lot more fun to drink than warm cafeteria milk.At 8.4 ounces, there's just enough in a can to quench any thirst.  The slender can makes it easy to slip into a bag.

I'm afraid this review is destined to be boring in its straightforwardness. This is a lovely, refreshing beverage with a fresh fruit taste. It's not overly sweet. Everyone in my family loves the stuff, and that's that.My ten-year old has noticed that the non-standard-sized cans (they're somewhat thinner than regular 12oz soda cans) tip over a bit too easily for kids; that's really the only complaint we can come up with.

I jumped at the chance to review this product because it's right up my alley: a sweet, carbonated soft drink that doesn't contain HFCS (this line is sweetened with grape juice concentrate, hence it's not kosher). I chose the blackberry on the basis of its being a flavor that's not yet ubiquitous, and I wasn't disappointed.This strikes me as more appropriate for adults than children because the all-natural flavor is tart and a bit dry. It's not terribly sweet and is very refreshing. The carbonation level isn't very high and the bubbles are small, which seems appropriate for a drink of this type. The cans only contain 8.4 ounces, but this is more of a sipper than a quaffer anyway. I often put away rather large quantities of soda, especially when it's washing down a meal, but I don't feel the urge to do so with this (which is no doubt for the best). A little satisfies quite nicely.I thought, after the first can, that I detected an aftertaste but I think this was due to its not having been cold enough--make sure that it's very well chilled. One serving contains 90 calories, so it's not appropriate for those who are watching their weight. It's Vitamin C enhanced, but makes no claim to be healthful (which it undoubtedly isn't). However, it has more going for it than the vast majority of soft drinks on the market due to its being an all-juice product, and it really is delicious, plus IZZE partners with a charitable organization. Bottom line: this is one I'd actually spend money on, it's that good.

It took me about one week to gulp down 24 cans of Izze's Blackberry juice. I absolutely love this product!  I was a fan of the bottled version, and the cans have reaffirmed my love for it.  Truth be told, I have yet to try any other flavors.  Having spent the past week only drinking the blackberry flavored ones, I can say with confidence that I'd probably love the other flavors too.  The blackberry taste is not too sweet, as one would probably expect from fruit-flavored juices.  The only criticism I have is the size of the can: 8.4 ounces isn't enough!  (I usually gulped down 2 cans at once.) I would love to see a jumbo size version.  It surprised me that the drink is fortified with vitamin C, B6 and Niacin - I'll take it though.  Bottom line: this drink is so good and so refreshing.  It's the perfect refreshment for any occasion.  I highly recommend!

My nephews who are 6,4 and 2 love this.  My husband who isn't really into fruit juice likes it.  He even mixes it with his beer now.  Izzy's blackberry drink is fantastic.  It is only 90 calories, tastes refreshing and delicious.  It is wonderful over ice or right out of the can.  This will be a newly house stocked favorite.

This is a slightly sweet drink that will leave you wishing it had a bit more flavor.  While pleasant enough, you will probably find yourself wishing it had a bit more fruity kick to it; it's only slightly more flavorful than seltzer-water.On the other hand, the lack of powerful flavor probably means that you won't feel cravings to keep drinking and drinking and drinking more of the drink.

This is a delightful sparkling juice that is naturally refreshing. The lightly-carbonated drink has a lovely scent and color, courtesy of the blackberry juice. The portion is just right to make 1 glassful, and at 90 calories is a nice alternative to a regular, high calorie soda.There is no added sugar; all the flavor and calories come from the blackberry juice itself. I didn't think it was overly sweet, but my husband did.Now this isn't what I would call fruit juice. It's flavored water, and very nicely flavored as well! But for people (like me) who prefer their water to be 0 calories, 90 calories per serving may be too much, which is why I rated it only 4 stars.

I have had many different kinds of sparkling juice drinks, most of them too sweet or not fruity enough.  Rarely can they reach the balance of sweetness and fruitniness perfectly.  Admittedly, this is not the first time I tried Izze, but it has been a long time.  Ininitially, when I tried the Blackberry this time, it was very bland tasting.  It tasted a lot like Mineral water with juice essence in it.  It was barely sweet, and I am sure I could've made something taste better had I grabbed a bottle of mineral water and a can of juice...  But, I of course, gave it another try and it tasted much much better the second go around!  It tasted refreshing and fruity, and maybe a little bitter, but bitter in a good way.  The nice thing about this juice is that it is like drinking soda without the sugar hangover.  It doesn't make you feel dirty after you drink it, it is quite refreshing.  If you don't mind the cost, and you are looking for an alternative to soda, I would try Izze.  The blackberry is very good, a nice crisp blackberry taste with apple and pear undertones, it is worth the money.  God Bless ~Amy

The Izze Fortified All Natural Sparkling Juice (Blackberry) was a very pleasant surprise for me.  I had a few preconceptions which turned out to be misconceptions.  However, if the drink had turned out the way I was expecting, I probably wouldn't have enjoyed it so much.The first surprise to me was the carbonation, or lack thereof.  When the writing on the can says sparkling, they're speaking the truth.  This is much less fizzy than, say, a can of Coke or Pepsi.  And for a fruit drink, that's a good thing.  The sparkling does not draw away from the taste of the liquid.The other nice surprise was the taste of the blackberry fruit.  It's a more subtle flavor that I had expected.  It's not overly sweet, yet it has a strong enough flavor.  It's crisp and refreshing.The biggest drawback to this beverage is not the drink itself, but the container it comes in.  The can is only 8.4 fluid ounces.  This makes it a better size for children (the lack of artificial junk is also a benefit for the little ones).  However, speaking as a person who is somewhat larger than the average child, I would not have complained if the cans had been the standard 12 fluid ounce size.This is a moderate, yet extremely nice beverage.  It's moderate in flavor, moderate in carbonation and moderate in size.  The fact that it's natural, has no artificial sweeteners, no high fructose corn syrup, etc. is a very welcome bonus.

column9: A good faith Blackberry flavor. Not easy to do!
column10: I love blackberries and blackberry flavor. It is a very tricky taste to impart as I have found in my candy making/baking/ice cream making efforts. It is so easy for blackberry flavor to end up just sweet or overpowered by the manufacturing process.I feel like the Izze blackberry drink does a very respectable job in producing a true blackberry flavor. The white grape juice does produce a somewhat jarring "top note" that lingers after the blackberry taste is gone. However, I have to give the company major credit for not using artifical flavoring.I'm not one to drink my calories so I see this product as an occasional indulgence with a tiny squirt of vitamins. I did find it very refreshing after mowing the lawn. I happen to like the size of the can a lot and it fits into my lunch bag with ease.I'd be very tempted to buy this again, calories and all.

A blend of grape, apple, blackbery, lemon and raspberry juice with sparkling spring water, these are tasty and refreshing.If you are watching the calories be aware that these little 8.4oz (248ml) cans pack 90 calories in fruit sugars, but gives a nice little boost after some exercise.

column9: NATURAL JUICE WITH SPARKLING WATER IS A WINNER!
column10: Four HEALTHFUL Stars!! Izze Fortified All Natural Sparkling Blackberry Juice is a great tasting all natural juice, which is bursting with antioxidants, with a splash of sparkling water to add a little carbonation to the flavor. It is fortified with Vitamin C and B6.  Low sodium, caffein-free, and 70% fruit juice, it's actually a mixture of apple, white grape, blackberry, lemon, and raspberry juices from concentrate, not just blackberry juice. I like the taste and the fact that the sugar in the juice is all natural. The taste, physical color, and smell is somewhat like a wine cooler (without the alcohol, of course) and could be poured into a wine glass at a party as an alternative for non-drinkers. The sugar content is high, so allowances should be made in that respect. I would buy this product especially for the antioxidants in the juice and the different taste that it presents. Highly Recommended. Four SPARKLING Stars!!

First I have to admit that I don't drink juice very often outside of breakfast or the occasional glass of apple juice etc at other times of day. I also don't drink very many soft drinks anymore and try to avoid high fructose corn syrup.Anyway, I wasn't sure what to expect what I tried this Izze drink. I had hoped for a stronger Blackberry taste, but find the different fruits blend  together well for a slightly sweet taste that would be good to drink inbetween meals or maybe with lunch.

While I wouldn't classify this drink as "health food," it is an excellent alternative to soda for both kids and adults.  You won't find high fructose corn syrup here, but you will find real fruit juices, lightly carbonated and delicious.  My children love it and the 8 ounce cans are perfect for sack lunches.  It's not cheap, but if you buy it by the case the cost is reasonable.

column9: Refreshing alternative to sodas and juiceboxes
column10: The Blackberry Juice is a tasty sparkling juice drink.  I like it and my daughter likes it.  It has a bit of a bitter after taste though.  Because it has no artifical stuff in it we can feel good about drinking this. The grapefruit juice is excellent--no after taste or bitterness at all.  The size of the can is just right for one serving.

I've been sharing this product with the rest of my family since it's arrival in the mail.  Everyone seems to be enjoying it.  In fact, I started taking a can to work every day.  The flavor that I tried first is Blackberry.  I'm quite tempted to try the remaining flavors.  Best of all this product consists of all natural flavors and ingredients, including 70% fruit juice from concentrate.  I'm not really a big fan of sparkling juices, but this Izze Blackberry is better than I had expected.  It's become quite addicting.  Give it a try.

I like soda pop. Diet Coke used to be my favorite but the extreme carbonation has made me look elsewhere for a soda to enjoy. Diet coke would hurt my mouth and actually take the breath away from my vocal cords unless I poured out some of the bottle and shook out the carbonation.I have tried many sodas over the years, and found the Diet Mountain Dew has a good taste and not as much carbonation as Diet Coke. Of course it also has a boat load of caffeine.I did try some of the "natural" soda's available from Fresh Fields and other high end grocery stores but found most of them too expensive.I am not too concerned with all natural ingredients or calories and I have found 12 once cans of Orangina to be my favorite so far.IZZE Fortified would have to rank a close 2nd for me.A case of 24 will cost you about $1 a can or so once the shipping is figured in. Note that the cans are 8.4 ounces and not the familiar 12 once size of a coke can.IZZE is pretty proud of itself and that cockiness is deserved from the case I sampled.From the can:PURE FRUIT JUICE & SPARKLING WATER FORTIFIED WITH VITAMINS. NATURALLY FLAVORED JUICE BEVERAGE FROM CONCENTRATE.NO REFINED SUGARS, NO CAFFEINE, NO PRESERVATIVES, 70% PURE FRUIT JUICE WITH A SPLASH OF SPARKLING WATER AND FORTIFIED WITH VITAMINS.INGREDIENTS: PURE JUICE MADE FROM WHITE GRAPE, APPLE, BLACKEBERRY, LEMON AND RASPBERRY JUICE CONCENTRATES, SPARKLING WATER, CITRIC ACID, NATURAL FLAVOR, RED GRAPE JUICE CONCENTRATE (COLOR), ASCORBIC ACID (VITAMIN C) NIACINAMIDE, PYRIDOXINE HYDROCHLORIDE (VITAMIN B6).One can is one serving and contains 90 calories.I had a case of the Sparkling Blackberry but it tasted more like grape soda to me. None the less I found it tasty and the carbonation level was just about right. If I were concerned with the calories (I am not) I could see cutting it with some water.I feel good about recommending this product to Amazonians.

Izze Sparkling Blackberry is a natural sparkling fruit drink that has a very pleasing taste.  Made with 70% fruit juice and no refined sugars...the sweetness must come from fructose. This drink passed the kid's taste test with flying colors.  It has low sodium and is fortified with vitamins C, B6 and Niacin. This is one drink that I would get again. Well worth having on hand for lunches or after school snacks.

I have been trying to wean off of soda pop and this is the way to go.  With only 90 calories in a can, it is bubbly and berry flavored without being too sweet.  In additon, it is made with 70% fruit juice, which then gets at least one serving of fruit in my diet when the bananas are too yellow for my liking.  And the cans are still ones that can be recycled.

column4: Mary Jo Sminkey "15 years of Amazon Reviews!"
column9: Nice sparkling drink that isn't overly sweet
column10: I like to pay attention to the glycemic index of the foods and drinks I consume (basically determines how fast the sugars in something are converted to glucose in the body) so was pleased to find this line of sparkling fruit drinks that doesn't have any refined sugars added. Sparkling juice is one of my favorite "sweet" drinks and these compare very nicely to others I had tried, including some fairly premium brands. If you are like most of us that have to watch our waists, this is a great alternative to soda, and is fortified with some extra vitamins as well (C, B6 and Niacin). The size of the can I find a more reasonable size for me to drink in a single sitting...and some of the flavors make great ice cream sodas as well! The apple is my favorite of the ones I have tried, with a surprisingly complex apple flavor much like a sparkling apple juice I get from a local craft show vendor. The blackberry was very nice as well, not quite as sweet as the apple, but very refreshing (and makes a great ice cream soda!) Compared to other premium sparkling juices, the price per ounce of Izze is very reasonable as well. Definitely recommended.

Besides trying it myself, I let my wife, three sons, one daughter-in-law, and one soon-to-be daughter-in-law try it, and all seven of us liked it.  It was sweet enough, but not too sweet, and the flavor was very good.watziznaym@gmail.com

column9: A Superior Beverage - a review of Blackberry Izze
column10: The Blackberry Izze is a good product.  My whole family -- with the exception of my 6 y.o. son who doesn't like fizzy beverages of any kind-- thought it was delicious and refreshing.As a mom I like the fact that there isn't any corn syrup or disguised sugar in any of the Izze beverages.  This means that I can offer Izze to my daughter and her friends without guilt.  They aren't downing sugary colas and they don't miss them!The only downside I can think of is that the product is somewhat acidic, so those with ulcers, or who have acid sensitive stomachs, might want to moderate their consumption.Conclusions:::  Juice, fizzy water, and vitamins makes this a superior drink.  It's not dietetic, but I have to tell you that after coming in from yard work, it is very refreshing.

column9: Several flavors are too sweet to drink uncut.
column10: It's nice to see this product made with all-natural ingredients, with proceeds going to benefit educational institutions around the world.  The blackberry flavor is quite tasty although to all of us in the family it's more of a generic sweet fruit, not specifically blackberry-flavored.  But it's too sweet.  I tried cutting it with tap water but of course that flattens it (but makes it less sweet and more enjoyable); then I tried cutting it with plain seltzer water, and that was fine.  It retained the fizz.  But we probably won't buy this product (or any of the other Izze flavors) because when you want to grab a can of something to drink, you don't want to have to fiddle with mixers.Unfortunately the grapefruit flavor is the same.  There's a nuance of grapefruit flavor to it, but it's mostly just a too-sweet drink that makes our teeth feel funny.We also tried the Clementine flavor which is good in an unobtrusive, not-too-sweet way.  It's not as overly sweet as the blackberry, but still, this has as much sugar as a can of Coke, and Coke is much cheaper, comes in larger cans, and more easy to come by.  I was hoping this product would be less caloric, but it isn't.  So, this is not going to be a repeat purchase for us.

column9: Refreshing, not too sweet, convenient size
column10: This is a review of Izze's "Sparkling Blakberry".When I was younger I would often try mixing fruit juice with seltzer.  We always had a lot of both in our refrigerator.  The problem for me in my 'mixology' experiments was finding a balance between the juice and the seltzer. If I used too much juice the drink tasted flat; if I didn't use enough juice the mix would not be sweet enough.  It was fun to experiment but, like roulette, the odds of finding a drink that was consistently satisfying were against me.Izze has taken the guess work of of the process and the result is a drink that is thirst-quenching and 'fizzy' but not too sweet.  The Blackberry I tried out does have a nice fruity taste. It is not pure blackberry but a blend that also contains grappe, apple, lemon and rasberry juice. Despite the fact that this is a blend, the result does have a berry-ish flavor.On the plus side: I do like carbonated beverages, including soda and I liked the fact that this drink had the carbonation I like but did not have as much suger (20g) as that found in a regular non-diet soda. I prefer a less-sweet drink with sugar to a sweeter drink with artificial sweeteners and the Izze Blackberry filled the bill.  I also liked the fact that the cans are 8.4 ounces.  I don't like jumbo drinks, I like just enough to quench my thirst.  This relatively small size works for me. I also prefer the metal packaging to glass. This cools quicker in the refrigerator and stays cool longer.On the down side: My only negative is the one negative side-effect of the drinks being only 8.4 ounces.  The can is narrower than your average soda can and it just does not travel well in the cup-holder of my car. The cup holder seems designed for your standards soda can or cup of coffeee and the Izze can bumped around a lot while I drove.All in all I very much enjoyed this Izze product. It was tasty wihtout being too sweet, the balanace between the jucie and sparkling water is a good one, and it quenched my thirst.

column9: Blackberry has good flavor, but what's up with the fizz?
column10: I am not a fan of the fruit-flavored sparkling waters sold by so many soda and water bottlers. If you are going to carbonate a beverage, why not really carbonate it instead of the halfway carbonation of sparkling water? Izze has the light "fizz" of those sparkling waters, but the flavor is much better because it is 70% juice.Overall, I enjoyed the taste. I keep a supply in the refrigerator and, although I do not drink it every day, I find that it is a nice change from water or soda. The 8.4 oz. cans are just right, and they chill quickly. As others have pointed out, the flavor is much better cold than at room temperature.So would I buy it again? Maybe. My husband and I both thought it was "OK." We liked drinking it, but would not go out of our way to buy more. And we do not feel any sense of urgency to try other flavors.If you are looking for a somewhat healthier soda replacement, Izze may be a good choice. For juice, I will stick to plain, old-fashioned juice.

These fruit snacks are very tasty and considering that they are made up of 66% juice this is great.  However....I noticed that the front of the package states that they are made from "American Grown Fruit"  and when you flip the package over it states "Made responsibly in China".  ?????  This is very disappointing.  It is difficult to think that fruit is grown in the US, shipped all the way to China, made into fruit snacks, and shipped all the way back to the US.

Great item, My daughter came back from summer camp and wanted these "healthy" fruitsnacks loaded with vitamin C.  Couldn't find them in local stores but found them on amazon and bought a couple cases.
I love these chewy little snacks. They satisfy my craving for something sweet without giving me that sugar crash later.

I picked out the Valentine's Day snacks for my kids to share with their friends in daycare for the holiday thinking they were healthier than candy. Maybe slightly, but what really bothered me was when I got home and happened to see, on the side of the box, "Made in China." Gross.

These are awesome fruit snacks!  There is so much fruit in them that they count as a serving of fruit and the flavor is amazing.  For some reason, we can't buy them in our area!  Thank goodness for Amazon!

When it's right around the end of the day at the office and I need a little pick-me-up, I usually try to eat a piece of fruit to get the natural sugar rush.  When fruit is not available, I reach for these fruit nuggets and they do the trick.  They totally satisfy my need for something sweet and I don't get the nasty sugar crash that I normally get from candy.  They come in the perfect amount and yield only 50 calories.  My local grocery store caries the 24-pk variety box and they last quite a while.  They can sometimes be hard to find, so I'm really glad to see that I can order them from Amazon.
These are very bit good as advertised. Terrific to take while on the run somewhere.

column9: Great treat - better than candy, too!
column10: This is perhaps the coolest product I've ever stumbled on. I bought two boxes at Target locally, and assumed the purple ones were grape (they're blueberry, but they taste grape-y if you're not sure about the blueberry flavoring). I used to buy Skittles or some other fruit flavored candy late afternoon, and was looking for an alternatve - these are better, taste, serving size and health wise. Small nuggets of INTENSE flavor - more than three or four is too much to have at once (gives you that 'cheeks sucked in sour' feeling) - and even though each packet is only less than an ounce, you'll feel surprisingly satisfied at the end. 66% juice, gluten free, kosher, vegan, low calorie - they can make any mom happy (except those who are paranoid about HFCS - there is some, but not much). Unsurprisingly, considering these are made by a company known for it's orange juice, the orange are by far the best, but the others are great too. No apple in this assortment, though. As my mom always says - Try them, you'll LOVE them!

A neighbor gave us a one pack of these nuggets to try and my 2 year old daughter loved them!  They are the perfect size for little hands!  They aren't all messy and mushy like the other brands, which is great for mom.  She thinks she's eating candy, but it's full of vitamins!  The problem is that we can't find them in the local grocery stores, so thank heavens for Amazon.  My little one has been asking for "More fruit" which is great to hear.
Great treat for the kids, they love them and it is a better alternative to all the junky stuff thats on the market!

column9: Fun snack that really satisfies your sweet tooth!
column10: The Box contained 12 individual cartons, each with approximately 6-10 pouches of candy.  Each pouch was a different flavor and contains a small handful of delicious chewable candy.You can't help yourself from chewing it all into one extremely sweet mass.  It does however stick to your teeth rather easily, but it will come off with just a little effort of your tongue.Even though there was an assortment of flavors including Blueberry, Orange and Strawberry, It doesn't included Apple!!!  The Apple flavor of this candy is their best flavor of all. My entire family agrees.Overall though, It will take a while for me to work through this entire box, enjoying myself the entire way!Apparently they are made from 66% fruit juice with lots of vitamin C and loads of Sugar. (That just makes it better for me - yeay!)I recommend this candy to anyone who is looking for something very sweet other than Hard Candy or Chocolates.

These were good through the first carton, but after that, I got tired of the work required to chew them! They are harder than just chewy, although they taste good and I was hoping they were also good for you. I think they are mostly glorified candy. They only come in small packets which is wasteful packaging. So, they are good, but you can get tired of them quickly.I won't buy them again.

My cat has been eating the original for a while and after reading some of the reviews on here I was concerned about the smell of the fishy flavor.He did notice it was a different smell at first but he really enjoys it, just as much as the original.I do not notice any kind of smell coming from the bag and I leave it near the cat dish.Grain free is so much better for animals. Try it.

I had spent that past 7 years of my cat's life feeding her $5 Purina cat food. She was coughing up hairballs, shedding like all her hair would fall out, her coat wasn't very shiny, her playfulness was minimal and I thought "well, she isn't a kitten anymore". Until I happened across a pet food supply store that explained to me that not all cat food is created equal. I had no idea that most cat foods were corn based, that cats really shouldn't eat corn, and that the special hairball senior vitality cat food really doesn't do anything. So after taking note of the brands this store carried, I did some research and was absolutely floored by the care and science put into Orijen cat food! Visit their website, they have 30 page pdf files explaining each ingredient. So after a year now of my cat eating Orijen 6 Fish she has not had one hairball, she attacks my toes at night, her fur and figure looks like a model cat and she loves her food! She is picky eater when it comes to kibble, but she can't get enough of this stuff. My only complaint is that it smells to high heaven! Awful, rotting fish, litterbox smell. It smells as soon I open the jar, the first two hours it's in her bowl, and again we she eats it. I tried the original formula, it smells much less, but her coat lost a bit of its luster, so I went back. The smell is worth her health. I 100% recommend that everyone should feed their cat this food.

I switched to this cat food after reading how bad cat food you can buy in the grocery store is for cats, the health problems it can cause. I read the ingredients on the label of the so called premium off the shelf cat food I had been buying and was appalled at what I had been feeding my cats. After apologizing to my cats for the stuff I had been feeding them I switched to this after researching brands on the net. I did it by adding this food to the brand I had been using over time (only a few days), making the mix more Orijen each feeding. (I was concerned about abruptly changing their food). It turns out I didn't need to do that, they took to this food right away. They eat less of it because they are getting better nutrition and as a bonus neither one of my cats has "yarked" up since I switched! My male cat used to eat fast and occassionaly throw it all back up, now he no longer does. The food does not smell fishy to my sensitive nose. The manufacturer recommends freezing it and taking out what you need but I've never done that and have had no problem with it keeping just fine.

I have three cats and currently feeding many cats on streets that were deserted by runaway foreclosed home owners. I have first tried feeding Organix, Spots Stew dried Salmon and Chicken, and ended up with Orijen from the recommendation by a local pet store owner. I have one cat that seems to be very picky. She hated Spot Stew's Salmon dried cat food but loved the dog food version of Salmon. I still can not figure out why. Since it may not be healthy to keep feeding dried dog food, I have decided to buy 6-fish and tried to convert her to hopefully better cat food. Well my picky cat really hated it and even got angry when I tried first with just 6-fish then with mixing of dog food with it. My other two cats ate it reluctantly. After over a week of persistent effort, well my cat got really upset and even gave up eating all together. Feeding dried Chicken food from Orijen solved the problem. So since I have so much leftover of 6-Fish, I have decided to use it to feed hungry cats that visits my house during wee hours. Strangely enough, with exception of 2 out of 10+ different cats, They would not even touch it.I am sure there are cats out there that would love 6-fish. There are also those that don't. It may be impossible to create a cat food that every cats love. Maybe the town I live in may have only strange cats that do not love 6-fish. I don't know. I am not complaining about the quality of ingredients. If what the label states is true and honest, then I will continue purchasing Orijen's product.The other problem I have noticed was that my two other cats started having more discharge from eyes after feeding 6-fish than from other dried cat food. When switched to the raw diet, the problem went away.

column9: I liked it, my cat...not so much
column10: There's no question that this food is high quality. I bought it to transition my kitten off of Royal Canin, which is expensive but lists chicken meal as the first ingredient. Unfortunately, Orijen proved too rich for my cat and the vet recommended Science Diet for sensitive stomachs, which is better, but still not great. I wish that there was a smaller, less expensive trial size of Orijen so that I didn't end up with a half-eaten bag, but it was worth a try.

column9: Definitely worth the extra cost in comparision with in-store brands
column10: Great cat food like the ziplock bag feature to maintain freshness, my cat attacks the bowl as soon as I pour it in. Its got everything from salmon, whitefish, vegetables, fruits, juniper berries, healthy ingredients that you will not find from any of the companies that sell in-store cat food brands, if your worried about the price being too high don't because it beats out Iams, Purina,, 10 out of 10 times. Or any other in-store cat food brand by a mile, mainly cause its unavailable in stores, since it comes from Canada so there's no retail price to put on it, and you really can't put a price on your cats health especially considering with all the corn/meat fillers, with chemicals that are injected in many in-store cat food brands these days, so that's why Im strongly reccomending orijen over in-store cat food brands.
I have been feeding this to my two small dogs for the last few years and they have been doing super well! They don't have any health problems and they are nice and trim! Definitely recommend it!
I bought a bunch of the powder from the company for soups. I am very happy. It seems high quality.

You'll need a cup of buttermilk, almond and vanilla extract, eggs, and butter to prepare this, which is a little more than regular gluten containing cake mix. The batter is thick and must be smeared onto cake pan, not poured. But the end product is worth it! Cake was moist and delicious. I've never had gluten free cake taste exactly like the real thing. Very happy I bought a 6 pack!

column9: THIS IS GLUTEN FREE! Description is for another  product with Hodgson Mill!
column10: Why the product is listed as having whole wheat flour I don't know!  I hope there is some way for Amazon to be notified and change that. There is another Hodgson Mill's wheat product and hopefully only the description is mixed up.  The ingredients in this mix are as follows:  Sugar, Brown Rice Flour, Cocoa, Tapioca Starch, Cornstarch, Baking Soda, Xanthan Gum, Flake Salt, Baking Powder.  NO WHEAT.  It is thick and they tell you this on the box.  I made this the other day and it is the best gluten free chocolate cake I have ever had.  I also tweaked the recipe a little and used it to make whoopie pies and everyone cannot tell they are gluten free-they tasted like soft Drakes devil dogs and had that consistency, moist smooth and chocolatey(and I added an instant coffee packet). Yes it uses buttermilk, but you can get powdered buttermilk and reconstitute just what you need, so that you don't waste buying a carton and only using a cup just for this mix.  Also, because my family doesn't like almond extract I didn't put it in.
I have not tried this product because I noticed that it contains stone ground WHEAT FLOUR.  This is NOT GLUTEN FREE. Please use caution.

column9: SKIMPY for the price charged!!  Shocked!
column10: Was shocked at the skinny size of this item!! They are five inches long as I expected, because that's the size I wanted and ordered, but can't be any bigger around than even a pencil and that's a BIG stretch!! WOW, I'm sure disappointed considering the cost ~~ $7 and shipping. Won't be ordering these again.  Of course my dog likes them ok, but wouldn't call them her fav by any means. :(  Will I send them back? Don't know if it's worth the hassle at this point. But I will NOT recommend them either. Because of the size quality and high price compared to so many other products to choose from!  Keep looking is my advice. :)  The other Beefeaters' products I ordered well met my standards. This one was a DUD!!  What's the old saying?  Buyer beware?  I fell into that trap big time!  Here's the product link at this time:  Beefeaters Great Fillin Porkhide Rolls with Meaty Chicken Filling, 5-Inch  Wish you luck if you try this product...but again "Buyer Beware!!"UPDATE 2.15.2012: My little dog got VERY SICK not too long after I wrote this review...I contacted Cust. Service with even more reason to not like this item and they refunded my money!! How's that for Customer Care?? :) Great!! Thank you Amazon.com ~~ you are TERRIFIC!!

My Scottish Terrier inhaled hers in about 2 hours, but my finicky Pomeranian, who usually turns his nose up at chew toys, loved it! It kept my Pom busy for a few weeks, but he really enjoyed it!Affordable price, fast shopping, great product!

These are great for a reward, for training, for "just because"!  My 1 year old loves them and I know they are a healthy alternative to other "treats".  They break easily into smaller pieces for training purposes and I don't have to worry about my pup getting tired of them!

column9: Bold, yet subtle, and refreshingly unique.
column10: I've never tasted anything so unusual in the world of tea as this. Tazo Focus is an indescribable melange of orange, chocolate, and something . . . else, je ne sais quoi. It is at once bold and subtle, sweet and strong, spicy and mild. I've never tasted a tea like it before, and I doubt I will again once I run out. This product is no longer on shelves in my area. Some things are too good to last. Quel Dommage.

I wanted to give up coffee so I found this tea and it does exactly what the name says. It helps me focus without getting jittery. It tastes great too without adding the creamer or whatever else I needed to drink coffee. It's too bad that the only place to find it is online.

While a fresh brewed cuppa is always good, sometimes there's not enough time to put the kettle on for a proper one. While the taste is similar to fresh, it does taste freeze-dried (but then again, that's what it is). PG Tips granules work best when you're pressed for time, or simply don't like the fuss. I like to put mine in a Thermos, add hot water, then off I go. If you can find it, get it.

column9: Way overpriced and broken up in shipping.
column10: Tried ths pasta at my mother-in-laws and fell in love with it. She got hers at Sams Club awhile back. No longer available at our Club so, not knowing the price at Sams, I ordered these. They arrived half broken in crumbs and I notified Amazon, who graciously refunded my money. On a mission, I went to SamsClub.com and called them. The pasta is a little over $6 a bag and available in a few states. I suggest anyone wanting these contact Sam's or the manufacture at [...]. Their website says they are available at WalMart and other store. They really are delicious, but not worth $30.

column9: Great pasta if you can find it at a reasonable price
column10: The pasta is great.  It is heartier than regular grocery store pasta.  It takes longer to cook, but it does not get mushy and is more difficult to overcook.  It keeps an al dente texture even after reheating.  We love it and hope to find it again sometime at a price we can afford.

I have been looking for this for a long time, used to buy it in the city for use in all my asian dishes. I'm pretty sure this is the same item I used to purchase, although I did not see shoya bean extract on the label. This gives this condiment it's special flavor. It makes a great teriyaki sauce which you cannot purchase at the grocery, also great in sauces and fried rice.

I've been looking all over for this sauce to make my fried rice. I am a little disappointed in the flavor. I used to use LaChoy, but I can no longer find it. It had a wonderful flavor and made my fried rice real authentic tasting.

I hate leaving negative reviews, but in this case have no other option. I wish I had purchased a single box of 6 instead of 12 boxes of 6, because 11 boxes will now be trashed. As soon as I opened the case box, all I could smell was dirty grease. I went ahead and filled 6 shells, my husband and I each tried one &  threw the remaining 4 filled shells away. The filling did not over ride the nasty flavor and odor of the shells. In addition, several shells came broken. If anyone knows of a good brand to try, please advise. Thank you!

column4: Venera Di Bella Barles "Venera C. Barles"
column10: I bought a large amount and was worried they wouldn't measure up to the ones I had growing up in New York - but I was pleasantly surprised at the delicious and fresh tasting flavor of the cannoli shells.  I filled them with my favorite ricotta/whip cream recipe and did I have raves.  Easy dessert to make. Thanks for the find.Venera
These cannoli shells have a very good taste.  They are crunchy, easy to fill, and ALMOST as good as homemade.  It sure beats having to make them.  I just wish that I could buy them somewhere again!

I found the overall quality of this product to be quite good. While the shells were not as crisp as homemade, they were flavorful and easy to fill. Although about 20% of the shells were broken in shipping, they were still a bargain compared to similar products.

Muir Glen makes the best canned tomatoes I've tasted. Ripe and firm, they hold their shape better than other canned tomatoes, and the fire-roasted ones have a delicious smoky flavour reminiscent of hot paprika. These are excellent for any recipe requiring that little extra zing.

When I opened the can, I thought the product had a plastic smell. I wondered if the fire roasting made them smell different than I'm used to. I went looking for reviews to see if others had this experience. One reviewer on this site says the cans are lined with plastic and leach BPA. I don't know if that's true, but based on how the tomatoes smell I'm inclined to believe it. They also have a plastic undertone to the taste. I've decided not to use these tomatoes.

Muir Glen has the best quality tomato products on the market. They are a bit more expensive than the cheap brands at the grocery stores, but well worth the difference. Since I "subscribe" to regular shipments from Amazon, it is cheaper to have Muir Glen products delivered to my door, than what it costs to buy Muir Glen at the grocery stores. Not many stores carry Muir Glen anyhow, so buying through Amazon is, by far, the best way to get these delicious tomato products.

My husband makes salsa from these tomatoes.  The fire roasted specs add alot to the flavor.  I've bought Muir Glen for years and never had a problem.  Cases of cans from Amazon tend to arrive with at least a few dented though.

i use these to make pizza, pasta sauce, ratatouille, chili, beef stew and a cooked spicy tomato ranchero sauce for beef/cheese enchiladas. the tomatoes have a great added depth from being roasted. whole tomatoes for pizza, i just slice them, lay flat, topped with crumbled oregano/basil like as if i were using fresh. buying whole tomatoes really allows to decided the final texture of the outcome. anyway very versatile ten times better than most canned tomatoes.
I always use muir glen this particular type and blend it before using it. I love it - thanks.
I love these tomatoes, the slightly roasty flavor is really nice is a tomatoes sauce.
These are the best tasting canned tomatos.  I was a little disappointed that some of the cans were dented, but they tasted great!!

Muir Glen cans are lined in plastic and leach Bisphenol A. Too bad because this was a great product and was a standard in my household. My initial conversations with them they contradicted this fact, which to me was misleading. General Mills owns Cascadian Farms as well and now I don't buy there either.Now we use BioNature in jars or Pomi products in Tetra Pak cartons. All canned tomato products use BPA and so do many of the lids of jars used in food containment.Now I also just make from scratch which is made simple by chef Andrew Carmellini in Everyday Italian. Lydia Bastianich is another favorite chef that deserves mention for simple yet big flavors.Boil, peel, freeze and store. Can manufacturing companies that I corresponded with said they were working on a solution for later this year or next year.

We received this coffee for Christmas, and can't bear to see the bag empty!  I'm so glad to find it on Amazon. This coffee smells and tastes nicely spiced and delicious to the very last sip.  We love it!
Love this hot sauce, in the garlic flavor. I have a hard time finding it, but it is delicious. Not to hot, but great flavor!

Make sure you try this one, particularly if you have a fussy eater.  This was a huge surprise for me when he gobbled the stuff down like he'd never eaten before.  He normally doesn't go for the mixed fish varieties but this one is definitely a go.  The grilled varieties in Fancy Feast seem to be a huge hit here and this one is no different.  Can't say enough good about them - they're a higher quality food, you can smell that when you open the can, and they're more protein enriched than all the other cat foods, including Iams which Friskies now owns.  Anyway, highly recommend!

column9: My cat won't eat anything else
column10: We all know how finicky cats can be--one day they eat with relish and the next turn their noses up at whatever earlier enthralled them. My aged cat and I have been down this route before many times--starting and then abruptly stopping different cat foods. But not this one! She loves it--so much so I sometimes have to order extra shipments in between my regular subscription. The seller is always very responsive and on time.

column9: My little guy LOVES this food!
column10: I had been buying a selection of Fancy Feast at my local pet store, but was pleased when I saw I could buy some cases on Amazon and save money. PLUS the extra money you save when signing up for auto delivery. Great!! And my cat so far hasn't gotten tired of eating three varieties rather than the 6 or 7 I had been buying at the local store.

column9: Incredible: THE BEST pepper vodka out there, bar none....
column10: Many other pepper vodka's are just HOT. Crater Lake (formerly MAZAMA.....personally....THIS was a great brand name....if it ain't broke....don't fix it....) has niched itself out with this great sweet and hot roasted pepper taste...great in martini's and of course, Bloody Mary's.....trouble is: they seem to have no distribution in Manhattan/NYC!...Whassupp witt datt?????The CEO is a great guy, though.......

column9: Tasty but a little extra on the wafer.
column10: These are a real treat for the kids. Personally I think there is more wafer than chocolate but that's just my preference. Having said that I still buy them ,lol.

good taste, not a strong salty taste .I make a mixture of this with grated onions about one tea spoon. and smother a saltine cracker with creme fraiche or cream cheese and spread the caviar over the top.

This was a pretty good sample pack. They even put it in a fancy box before sending it off. Which I do appreciate.What I have a problem with, is the fact that 5 of the 20 cups were decaff samples. I ordered coffee. Not crap.I know, I ordered a sample pack. But I don't recall seeing anywhere that they would not all be full power.Other than that little detail, they were great. It was a nice selection fo different companies, and brews. And I enjoyed tasting them.

1. It took 10 days fromt he time the order was placed until it was recieved.2. The pack was 1/3  decaf. It does not say anywhere in the description that decaf will be included.3. The expiration date on the box is 6/12/12, and today is 6/25/12. The order cannot be returned. So, I am stuck with expired decaf.4. Shipping costs could have been cut in 1/2, if the seller had not wasted so much space with the sampler box.5. Therereally is not much variety. I am truly disappointed. I should have spent 3 more dollars and ordered the real deal from keurig.com.5. I don't know if it is the box or what, but something smells bad. It smells like wet towels out of a smoking lounge, which is not really appetizing.

When I purchased this there was not a 'warning' review that this would contain decaf coffee.  *sorry to all the decaf lovers out there*I guess if you like decaf and regular coffee you will like this sampler - I would have LOVED this sampler had there been NO decaf!  They really should state that this sampler contains decaf!

When company comes over it is great for me to be able to offer then not just the maxwell house coffee I used to serve but now they change choose from the different varieties and enjoy the one they like best.  Some people enjoy stronger coffee while others enjoy it more on the mild side.  With this sampler it was great so we could choose the type we liked best and then just ordered more of that specific brand.  A great way to taste and try till you find the one that you like the best.

I got this as a gift for my husband for Christmas and when it came I could not have been more pleased!  The box they came in was absolutely perfect!  It looked like a clothing box, but decorated on the outside and when you opened it all of the K-cups were in each of their own little holders.  I loved it!  We do our Christmas early with our kids so we don't wind up hauling stuff across the state so I gave it to him already and he LOVED it!  I would recommend this item a million times over and would buy it again and again!

column9: Sweet N Low Sugar Free Candy . . .
column10: These candies are delicious.  Plus they do not have Nutra Sweet or Spendain them.  They are just perfect for that little treat.  Thank you!

My son has GERD and is having trouble with gaining weight and spitting up. I was told to get this formula for him. I looked everywhere for the best price. NutraBulk had the best price and my shipment arrived 1 day before it was supposed to. My son for the first time has not spitten up after a bottle. I recommend this seller to anyone.
This gumbo is fantastic.  Everyone that ate it loved it and wanted to know where I got it from.  I will order this item again!!!!

I was in whole foods in Seattle Washington and saw this gumbo for sale. Being a Louisiana native, I know what good Gumbo tastes like. I am no fool, I knew if I purchased Gumbo in a jar it would not be nearly as good as homemade Gumbo. I was utterly shocked at how bad it actually was. It had such an overbearing taste (I think it was bay leaves or Okra) that it ruined the entire gumbo. I fed this to 2 others in my household and they had the same thoughts. I never waste food, and I even tried to reheat it and eat it the next day....it promptly went in the trash. I don't want to hurt anyone's feelings, but it was so bad that I had to look it up online and see if others had the same experience!

I love this mix. As close to homemade without spending time on a roux & simmering for hours. I just add chicken breast chunks, sausage & baby shrimp...simmer according to directions serve over steamed rice and voilà - a delicious dinner in less than 30 minutes.

Sugar Ray's Honey Chipotle is my absolute favorite jerky available in average/common stores.  Its not too soft or too hard. Just enough density to give a satisfying chew without overworking my jaw muscles. And the flavor is fantastic! A little sweet with a gentle kick of spice. You say "gentle kick", what is that? Enough spice to warm my mouth, but not tear me up or make my nose run. Also enough spice to keep the vultures (my kids) from wanting more than just a taste.The only reason I'm giving this 4 of 5 stars is the price.  This jerky is a little bit more expensive than comparable products...I just can't resist the flavor! Haha.  So if you don't like the price, don't try it.  Like me, you might not be able to go back to your old jerky.

I was looking for a snack that was high in protein but low in fat so I started looking at Beef Jerky, but all the other brands have at least some sort of fat in them, usually a minimum of 1g, which may not sound like much, but when you're dieting, every gram counts. So when I found this brand I was very pleased. It tastes great and did I mention it has zero fat? Oh yeah, I did. But each service (28 oz) only has 50 calories, no carbs and some good protein. Switch to this brand/style. You won't be displeased.

I have been on a beef jerky kick lately, and this is one of my new favorites. It starts with the tenderness of the meat. The meat is on the soft side but still has a nice chew to it. It's real pieces as apposed to the artificial looking variety. The flavor has a nice smoky BBQ base and the sweetness of the honey and the mild heat from the chipolte is perfect. I've tried multiple Sweet Baby Ray products and have yet to be disappointed. Grab a bag or two, you won't be disappointed.

They carry this at Walmart and it's outstanding.  It tastes just like sweet baby rays.  I especially like it because the jerky is on the softer end... none of those endlessly chewy pieces.  It has a really great after taste too. Try it out!

This is the best jerky I have ever tasted!  To the guy who gave this a two star rating because they changed the flavor from the 80s?  They didn't mass produce Sweet Baby Rays until the mid 90's so your product review is based on a completely different product or you clicked on the wrong link/product to review.

They had to go and change the recipe. I used to buy this in the smaller package when I would travel to work back in the early 80's. I guess they've new and improved it because it isn't the same and doesn't taste near as good.

We like the ranch and bacon flavor, but it is not what we usually think of when we think pasta salad. We think of something more Italian than ranch when we have pasta.  Try it, though.  You may love it if you are fond of ranch flavors.

column9: Instead of mayo, use Banana Yoplait Yogurt instead.
column10: This is a delicious, easy pasta salad to make and it only takes 21 minutes to make until you put it on the table.  The Bacon taste really its the spot.  Just follow the easy directions on the back.  Health Hint: May I suggest instead of adding 1/2 cup of mayonaise, use Banana Creme Pie Yoplait Yogurt instead for a real tasty treat.  Put it in the freezer for 7 minutes to serve cold.

column9: Does anyone else taste rubbing alcohol in the new ranch sauce recipe
column10: I have always LOVED this and all of a sudden I made it last night and both my son and I had an after taste of rubbing alcohol when we ate it. I am not sure if it is the new ranch seasoning (because they have changed it from when we used to get it back in the 90's) or what the deal is. I was just wondering if anyone else noticed this?

column9: I'd rather be served a plate of garbage from the dumpster.
column10: I am a HUGE fan of Suddenly Salad Classic.  In fact, I probably make it 2-3 times a week.  I often add things in like cheese, or sunflower seeds - I've tried it and loved it all.Sooooo, I thought why not try a different flavor?  That was a terrible idea.I should be clear that I am in love with bacon.  I could eat it for nearly any meal.  This tasted like imitation bacon flavored dog food as opposed to a refreshing bacon/ranch blend.  I mean to tell you, it's as if you are eating something that is ransid and synthetic all at the same time.I rarely find any foods I don't like.  I am a gourmet eater, I love all kinds of flavors, textures, etc.  This was hell on earth.I don't understand it.  It's just a pasta salad.  Ranch = safe.  Bacon = safe.  Pasta = safe.  This combination should be......safe.Don't waste your money, or risk your health.  If you are interested in something like this, I suggest the following:Boil 8 cups of water.  Cook one pound of pasta.  Drain, and rinse with cold water.  Blend in 1 to 1.5 cups of ranch dressing.  Mix in chopped up bacon (made in advance).  Then stir in whatever else you want (peas, celery, etc.).As far as Suddenly Salad Classic, that is really refreshing and tasty.  Go for it!!!

We tried this a couple times, but we have a SUBSTANTIAL preference for the Kraft Bacon Ranch Pasta Salad.  It's the same idea as this, but for some reason the Betty Crocker Suddenly Salad gave our family upset stomachs both times we tried it.  In fact, my kids started calling it "Suddenly something down your leg", which is what it is known as to this day in our house.  The sad part is the Kraft version is MUCH harder to find, but definitely superior.  Check out the Kraft one - more delicious and less crampy results.

Love this...its my fav w/ the ranch and bacon flavor.  i add goya small red beans, onion and diced tomatoes to it.  grocery store is always sold out or does not carry so i find it convenient to order it by the subscribe & save option.

column9: Gulden's Natural Zesty Honey Mustard tastes Awful!
column10: I just tried Gulden's so-called Zesty Honey Mustard, and it was AWFUL!-The first 2 ingredients are Vinegar & Sugar (Amazon should list ingredients!), with a "hint" of mustard...On top of that, it left a slimy coating in my mouth!

We love Guiden's Zesty Honey Mustard and it's so hard to find at the market.  We are thrilled to get it and we are enjoying it.  The seller is fantastic and we are so pleased.Thank You Very Much, Dan and Kathy

This is by far the yummiest maple syrup we have ever tried...and we have tried many! I'm having trouble keeping my husband from over-dosing on the stuff! You can order without worry and be assured of a great product.
This is a wonderful tasting syrup.  Is great on pancakes as well as ham. It is well worth the money.

This is a really nice, rich tasting maple syrup. Those new to maple syrup should try the B grade because it has more authentic flavor and is thicker than the lighter grades. Goes farther on pancakes and in recipes, too.

Wow! This really hurts me to do this, but I have to give this syrup the lowest review it has gotten yet. This was my first time ordering  Hidden Springs Vermont Maple Syrup, and I did so because the other brands weren't available in the 1 Half Gallon variety. I wanted to go with 1 Half Gallon this time because I go through the 32 oz. containers too quick and the Hidden Springs Maple Syrup also saved me money by buying it in bulk. Now to the bad part, I usually purchase either the Coombs Family Farms or Highland Sugarworks brands of maple syrup and I love their taste; it was a bitter disappointment when I first tasted the Hidden Springs Maple Syrup and realized I'd made a huge mistake.I do not cook with these syrups, I use them for one thing and one thing only -- pancakes, waffles, or French-Toast. The aforementioned brands I usually purchase are awesome on my breakfast products, but the Hidden Springs Maple Syrup had a very funny off-putting taste that made it impossible to enjoy my breakfast. Don't get me wrong, it isn't nasty, but in comparison to Coombs or Highlands it is terrible.Unfortunately, I feel like I wasted $36 on maple syrup, as I now have about 60 oz. of Hidden Springs Maple Syrup that I won't eat. Perhaps it'll make a good cooking syrup and I can find some good recipes calling for maple syrup. But in summation, if you're going to spend this much money on maple syrup, buy Coombs or Highlands, there's a reason they are the top purchased syrups on Amazon.

Thought I'd take a chance on this, as my grocery store does not know about maple syrup grades (light amber is best).  Price is beautiful -- grocery store charged as much for two 8-ounce bottles as this whole quart.  Shipping time was amazing -- super saver in 1.5 days -- and yum!  Reminded me that it's been years since I bought a 3-pound box of maple sugar candy...  Time to search again... <grin>Forgor to mention -- definitely grade "A" Fancy -- not grade "B" (the cooking grade).Hidden Springs Maple Vermont Maple Syrup, 1 Quart - Fancy Grade - Light Amber
This is one of the very finest maple syrups I have ordered and enjoyed. I bought the Fancy Grade, for the light amber color. It has a very great taste. I will reorder.
This is our second order from Hidden Springs for maple syrup for our B&B.  If they continue with the great price and quick turnaround, not to mention great syrup, we will stay regular customers!

Hidden Springs Vermont Maple Syrup is excellent!  There isn't anything on the label that states that this is from anywhere else but Vermont...(some syrups that claim to be pure maple syrup also have labels that state that they may be a product of Canada or Vermont).  The price per oz. is about 81 cents and as I use at least one ounce on my waffles, this bottle will last for about 16 servings.  I will be buying this one again!

My wife became spoiled when we were on a fall trip with the taste of light maple syrup. It is not available in the south, so she was very happy to find it from Amazon.com. Hidden Springs is very high quality and have fast shipping. Thank You.

column9: Vermont maple syrup at its best
column10: This fancy grade is as good as it gets. You will not be disappointed. This priouct supports the proud Vermont tradition.

I ordered the Grade B Hidden Springs Syrup -- Grade B is my favorite for baking.  I love the strong, rich maple flavor.  This is my favorite amongst several maple syrups that I've ordered from Amazon.  Maple syrup is understandably expensive, but this syrup is a good value among its' competitors.

column9: Love the taste!  Best bang for the buck maple syrup!
column10: Tastes great, and it's a quality product at a price a few dollars cheaper than the alternatives, even at our local supermarkets.  It's tough to find Grade A medium amber syrup in pints.  I'll probably just keep ordering these a few times a year.

Living on Guam can at times leave much to be desired. We were sitting here talking about when we visited our family in Wisconsin and had some home made ice cream at an Amish farm. I remembered how good it tasted and I remembered I had some Maple syrup ice cream while there, sooooo. I got on line and found this 1/2 gallon, price wasn't bad  (here at a local store a pint of REAL Maple syrup will cost $12.00) and it had free shipping. I had it in a few days, and made the ice cream right away. By the way I also made pancakes and sausage for dinner, and this here Maple syrup was as good if not better than what I had 8 years ago. VERY well packaged, and really fast shipping. Nice bouqet, great light amber color, great job to the cooker. Oh yea, by the way, the ice cream came out wonderfully.
Better than the medium or dark amber grades, also would be a great gift.  Go ahead and try it.  I use it on waffles with some butter

Best maple syrup I have had.  Im not a pro and bought some at cosco and threw out what was remaining when this arrived.  I literally have been putting it into a tablespoon and eating it.  This product is "out of this world."  I hope the producers dont change a thing.

This maple syrup is delicious and so flavorful -- Did you know grade B maple syrup has so many vitamins and minerals you could almost not feel guilty about having french toast for breakfast. I also try and use maple syrup where I can for sweetener instead of sugar. The company was wonderful about the shipping and the product arrived packaged well and on time! Enjoy.

This is only the second time I have ever tried grade B maple syrup. I liked this one better than Now Foods grade B. I think it has more maple flavor. I only give it 4 stars because of lack of experience compared to others. I think its priced well and it was shipped well.  I really love it on plain yogurt as well as pancakes and waffles. Would definetly buy again.
Good price for the size I wanted and great quality.  It was just what I needed for a mead project.  Items was delivered quickly.
We enjoy our maple syrup with waffles and pancakes on Sundays.  This is a great product made in a small farm in Vermont.  The syrup is natural and tasty.  No complaints here!

My husband and I are quite fussy about our maple syrup and we usually buy ours from Canada.  We ran out and decided to try this one and what a surprise it was.  The Grade A Medium Amber from Hidden Springs Maple Vermont is simply fabulous.  Great and fast service.
Not as good as the reviews led me to expect. Despite great color and good viscosity, the syrup's flavor lacked intensity.  I'll continue my quest elsewhere.

I am so disappointed.  I ordered Hazalnut flavor and received another flavor. I have no way of reaching anyone. I feel I have been ripped off. I need help.  someone please help me. My money is gone. who can I blame?

Like the last person to review this product, I also find that the flavor on the Spitz seeds is very short lived. It tastes like the seeds are lightly roasted (not roasted enough for me, the flavor of the seed is close to raw) with no salt or flavoring. Then a light coating of flavoring is put on at the end. It does taste like dill pickle, but only the outside of the seed. Despite this, I was still a fan of this product until I tried Bigs brand. Bigs Dill Pickle is so superior to this product that it puts it to shame. If you are buying from Amazon anyway, you should buy the Bigs since local availability isn't the problem. One thing I will say about Spitz brand is that because the flavor is mild, I can eat a lot more of them before my mouth becomes raw from too much salt. This is nice since I usually eat sunflower seeds in a setting where I'm just passing the time. Still, I'd take the good flavor of Bigs and a raw mouth over Spitz any time.

Bigs Dill 12 packs always seem to be on back-order, so I figured instead of heading to a Sports Authority (the only retail store I KNOW has my Bigs Dill packs) again and again for too much mark up, I'd try a case of these.  While the initial flavor is OK, it wears off really fast, and if you eat sunflower seeds the proper way, by stuffing a handful into your cheeks, you'll find it's quite like what happens when you are chewing bubble gum...good at first, but quickly becomes a bland, mushy mess.  Bigs brand is WAY better.  Bigger seeds, better tasting, and the last one in a cheekful still actually tastes like dill pickle.  I think even David's might be better, and that's saying something! I've gone through 2 packs of my case of Spitz, and I've already ordered a new case of Bigs brand.  I will throw these out or give them away when the new case arrives...they are that inferior.

column9: PLEASE PUT CRACKED PEPPER SEEDS ON AMAZON PRIME
column10: This is an open letter to anyone at Spitz and or Amazon.com,Please put Spitz cracked pepper sunflower seeds on Amazon Prime.Let me say I freaking love Spitz cracked pepper sunflower seeds, frankly they are the reason I get out of bed in the morning. I sit at my desk all day and chew seeds, seriously it is the only thing that gets me through the day and prevents me from attacking my co-workers. I need them and not having the cracked pepper flavor on amazon prime is really becoming a problem for me.Seriously what is the deal? Every other flavor of Spitz sunflower seeds are offered on amazon prime EXCEPT for cracked pepper. Why would you not make your best and most addictive flavor more easily accessible to your customers, its just un-American! I have tried to cope without the cracked pepper. I tried the other flavors they just don't cut it. Seasoned was ok, but it did not come close to satisfying my need for that rich and full bodied cracked pepper taste.So this is me down on my knees begging that you can have mercy on Spitz Nation, and put cracked pepper on amazon prime. I know you can do it, You have the technology! I am willing to forgive you for your mistake if you can get those deliciously little seeds to me with burdening me with having to wait 5-7 days and paying eleven dollars in shipping to feed my addiction.If my demands are not met i will be forced to switch to David's Original. But be sure this will hurt me and much as it does you. thank you and goodnight

I have always liked sunflower seeds, until I have had the Dill Flavored ones, NOW IM IN LOVE WITH THEM!  these are truly amazing...I honestly have a bag every two days!  I cannot stop eating them!  *CAUTION: HIGHLY ADDICTIVE*
My daughter introduced me to these seeds. I was shocked by their rich and light flavor. Be aware,  if you are on a low sodium diet these are seasoned with sea salt and MSG.

column9: Spitz Dill Pickle Sunflower Seed, 6-Ounce (Pack of 12)
column10: I love Spitz sunflower seeds! I think the Dill Pickle is the best flavor. I can eat a lot of these without getting sores on my tongue like i do when i eat the David sunflower seeds. I have tried a few other flavors of Spitz and there pretty good to.
Thank you so much for always carrying my favorite sunflower seeds.  Also thank you for the quick delivery.  you rock.
These dill pickle sunflowers seeds are the best by far!! They are so delicious and so addictive!! Can't go a day without eating a few!!  I would totally recommend them!
These are very addicting! They have a great dill pickle flavor and are not too salty. I highly recommend them if you enjoy sunflower seeds and love dill pickles.

These seeds are so delicious!  The pickle flavor is subtle, and they aren't overly coated with salt to numb your mouth.  Great for the baseball games, soccer games, during mowing the gras, while sunning on the beach...oh let me count the many ways I enjoy eating these seeds :)

Being a fanatic at eating sunflower seeds, I've tried just about all of the brands and many flavors. Without a doult, Spitz's Dill Pickle seeds are my favorite. So much so, I used to buy them by the case from a grocery store in a city about 100 miles away because grocery stores in my area did not carry them. Then I found out I can get them online and have been purchasing them there ever since.
