I have owned or lived with more than a dozen dogs in my life and hands down his was the most funky breath I have ever smelled.I tried the "Checkups" from Costco (also sold on Amazon) and they simply didn't do anything for him.  I was desperate to find something to give him to help clean his teeth while also taming that horrible breath of his.  I came across these Dingo's and decided to give it a try since they love the double meat Dingo's.I give him two per day (regular size) and he is 31 lbs.  I didn't try to look for any improvements in his breath or teeth for at least a  week, but I definitely noticed it before the second week.  The results were borderline unbelievable.  His breath doesn't smell bad at all.  His teeth are no longer brown.I also supervise him while eating his treats (which he absolutely loves).  To the other person who commented, my condolences to your friend; I too have had a close friend lose a dog (choking on a tennis ball).  While I believe that these can be dangerous if not used properly, I also believe that a tennis ball too can do harm.  The bottom line is you have to watch your dog while they eat treats and use common sense when determining if they seem inappropriate for your dogs size and eating (he eats treats like we starve him). These go through both dogs without any problems (such as gas)!

column9: Maybe I'm being unfair because of my dark roast bias, but...
column10: ...this coffee tastes horrible.Having not learned my lesson to never look a gift horse in the mouth, I complain every chance I get about this smelly swill my employer buys to caffeinate the troops. In fact, it is this sort of indiscretion that lead me to bringing my own press pots, digital gram scale, and Costco french roast (yes, lowly mass-batched beans!) to work.If all you're looking for is a caffeine buzz, this will do the trick. But the cost is an acidic after taste that camps out on the tongue for the next few hours. Usually, I equate lighter roasts such as these with "inoffensive," i.e. suitable for general audiences, including those who don't want a coffee to overwhelm them. Some (myself included) might even say "bland."  In acts of desperation when supplies are running low, I've supplemented my mellow dark roast with a scoop or two of this -- and its "flavor" adds a sour exclamation point that can't be masked.I'm not the only one who detests this brew: a few of my coworkers have similar sentiments, though are either too cheap to bring their own, or just aren't as passionate (aka abnormal) as I. And maybe this is work's way of cutting down on coffee consumption, which isn't all bad since there are Peet's and Starbucks nearby.

I use Adagio's IngenueTea to steep, which has a micro fine filter it in, so that doesn't bother me. Could be an issue with other types of filters though.

column9: One of Best Earl Greys Out There
column10: I've been drinking this tea on a almost daily basis for the past 6 months. I've tried several different brands but like this one the best. I use a Breville to Brew the tea and sweeten with agave nectar. Makes a great cup of ice tea too.

I thought that the addition of Grapefruit would bring a nice flavor to the traditional Earl Grey tea, but this was not the case.  The tea tastes sour and it ruins the earl grey.  I am sad to say that I do not recommend it.

I'm British, and this is one of the most popular candy bars in the UK (along with Cadbury's Flake).  This bar does not contain either rice or 'popping candy' as stated in the description.  Crunchie bars are old-fashioned 'honeycomb toffee' otherwise known as 'cinder toffee' covered in creamy milk chocolate.  Honeycomb toffee is basically a regular toffee to which a very small amount of vinegar and bicarbonate of soda is added, causing the toffee to puff up into an airy, crunchy, light toffee full of tiny holes.  The tiny amount of vinegar and bicarbonate of soda added does not adversely affect the toffee taste.
Ever since I was a child, Crunchie candy bars have been a big treat. Now being middle aged they still are. I'm extremely happy, I found the British Shoppe site, so I could order these candy bars.
I don't much like chocolate or even candy bars in general, but I love Crunchie bars.

I bought a box of Milka white chocolate because I love white chocolate and there are a ton of good reviews on Milka chocolates.  Well, I am afraid that for me, these Milka bars are nothing special.  They are somewhat hard in texture and do not taste as creamy/buttery as other white chocolate.  I would almost call these waxy.  I still prefer Toblerone white chocolate, even though the bits of nougat in them is somewhat of a distraction.
I got hooked on Milka white chocolate when I went to Austria in 1997.  Now, I visit Germany and Austria about every two years and come back each time with a sack full of Milka.
I love this chocolates, they taste great and amazon has the best price so i definitely buy again.

column9: Delicious white chocolate - some of the best!!
column10: This is a VERY delicious white chocolate bar.  Like potato chips, it's hard to stop at one.
MT FAVORITE TREAT DECADES AGO AS A KID. BUT, WHITE CHOCOLATE IS GETTING HARDER TO FIND.THIS BRAND IS REASONABLY PRICED, VERY FAST SHIPPING, AND JUST HAS A TASTE THAT KNOCKS YOU OUT.

I adore white chocolate. I admit the price of Milka is abit high(well, alot high) but if you don't pig out onany candy all the time, the price is worth it. Problem iswhen you finish one bar, next day you want another one.And forget eating half a bar and putting away the otherhalf for any length of time. You can always find it.
i ate all ten bars by myself. For the proce it is so worth it. The chocolate is high quality and there's lots of it for you or whomever else you want to give it to.
Not porous or particularly soft. Should work well for cooking or anything that would require melting it. By itself it's too hard to eat.

Very delicious (scrumptious). I wanted to eat the entire 10 bars in 1 week but resisted temptation. I placed the one bar I have left in the freezer in order to save it for a later time. It goes well with placing a coating of "White Chocolate Peanut Butter" or "Dark Chocolate Peanut Butter" from "[...]".

I'm not normally a chocolate lover.  While in Germany I got hooked on these bringing dozens home with me.  The chocolate is sooo much better there.  I was excited to see them for sale here.  But very disappointed that the bars here didn't taste like the ones in Germany.  It tastes like US white chocolate not European.I guess it's like how some products are different between the US and Canada.  (Ever try Canadian Oreos?  Even better than the US ones!)Disclaimer: The US product I tried was not from Amazon.  I'm confident that Amazon is selling the same American version though.  For a small sample get just one bar at Target.

I havent actually purchased these here yet, but I grew up with the Milk Brand in Europe, and I am SOO pleased to see them here for sale. All I can say is if your a chocolate lover, you WILL LOVE MILKA, its in no way close to any of the chocolate I've had here of just regular store brand typs. So if you need a small push, here it is, you wont regret it, I dont know anyone how doesnt absolutely love it when they taste it.

Bought today at a local carribean grocery store.  I had never heard of a cucumber soda and wanted to try it because i want to make healthy choices.  I was surprise how crisp it was and it really tasted like a fresh cucumber.  I can't believe it's not in all the stores. Anyway, I would have rated it 5 stars but the sugar content was too hight for me; but, at least it uses real cane sugar and NOT HIGH FRUITOSE CORN SUYRP.

column9: Good - a bit strong for me, but good
column10: I am a big fan of the Teavana flavor. They are pricy, but worth it. I've always loved oolong tea. This isn't my favorite. It's a bit strong. I blend it with other flavors and that has worked well. I won't buy it again. But I'll defintely drink up what I have. :)

For years I had been looking in grocery stores for horseradish powder, which used to be available, but now that my husband and I are on a vegan diet, it is important to be able to add the horseradish to soy (vegan) maynooaise, so this is a wonderful product for me - and I can help Pa Dutch General Store, a small business in Virginia where I grew up!  I put one double-plastic-bagged packet in the freezer and have the other one in a small plastic container with my spices.It's true, Amazon has everything!Horseradish Powder Culinary Spice - 8oz

This is the exact same restaurant quality Chinese Hot Mustard.  I searched everywhere for it.  I love this stuff as you cannot find this easily and it tastes good on almost everything plus the convienance packets enable you to take this as a packed lunch/dinner or on camping or trips traveling or a big event such as a wedding/reunion etc.  The ingredient label is as follows : water, mustard, strach, salt, vinegar, turmeric, capsicum, 1/10 of 1% sodium benzoate.  NO MSG.  Now,  only if I could locate the matching sweet and sour packets as nothing on the market is as sweet as the restaurant brands.  I give this 5 stars & will order again for a big event as there are 500 packets.

One of my cats, Hermione, received this as a present last Christmas.  It was her favourite out of all the toys she received and she had a blast chewing and kicking it.It is constructed of pretty durable fabric so it hasn't been torn up; even a year later.  I don't know if it's cleaning her teeth or not, but she sure does have fun!The other cat just liked the paper it was wrapped in.

My male cat, Timmy, loves to chew.  But let's be honest.  When you go into the pet store, looking for toys, what do you find? There are things that roll, things to hunt, feathers and fur to tantalize and tickle.  Only PetStages has recognized that, yes, sometimes cats do enjoy the feeling of chomping down on something and giving it a hard shake for good measure.  That's why I love this company so much.  Their toys are not only unique, they are also intuitive to what cats both enjoy and need.  As for this particular item, my Timmy has never outgrown it.  From kittenhood to almost 4 years old, he's gone through a long string of Catnip Chew Toys.  In fact, many's the morning when he's hopped out of bed, groomed himself momentarily, and started chewing and tossing his catnip ring.  I think he likes this one better than the other chewing rings by Petstages because the cloth is smooth and has a firm filling of fibers.  He will literally drive his teeth through the cloth as hard as he can.  Personally, I'm happy because:  A# He's happy.  B) He's cleaning his own teeth.  C)I'd much rather he be chewing on a ring then on my fingers or somewhere inappropriate!  #Which has never been a problem, btw.  Then again, he's always had one of these toys!)  Anyway, when my local pet store stopped carrying them, I panicked.  Thank goodness Amazon and KV sells them online.  And for a far cheaper price, I might add!!!

column9: No joy with the chew ring
column10: I ordered three catnip chew rings, mostly to justify the shipping expense.  As it turns out, the ring is not large and easily could have been shipped in a padded mailer for a fraction of the cost.  I had hoped my new kitten would use this as a teething ring and my older cat would also enjoy one.  Neither cat has the slightest interest.  Thinking perhaps the catnip was past its prime, I rubbed them in some fresh to entice the cats to at least play with them.  One mouthful of the fringe was enough for each cat.  I gave the third ring to a friend who fosters kittens.  Not one of the five she has would use the ring.  I sure can't call these a good deal.

column4: Pamela L. Howell "expert tech writer&uber geek"
column10: My teething 8 week old babies really like this thing, they even play tug of war with it. By far the cutest thing is when they drag it around by the ribbons, it's almost as big as they are. Shows up nicely in photos with my black and grey darlings. Also a good full-body work out for them, they can chew it but also get the back paws involved.

This tea from Good Earth has a lovely delicate flavor of mainly pineapple.  The other two fruit flavors are very subtle, and stay in the background while drinking this tea.  Any flavors of green tea detected are mild as well, and this tea is not at all bitter.  I can steep a tea bag for five or more minutes and the tea never takes on a bitter flavor.I like that this tea is organic.  It is rare I purchase decaffeinated, but I make an exception when the tea is of unique flavor as this one is.~~~ Overview ~~~~PROS:- Organic- Sweet flavors (mainly of pineapple)- Not bitter- DecaffeinatedCONS:- Slightly disappointing if you're expecting lots of fruitiness from the mango and peach.

Can we preach about the merits of canned beets here?  This isn't a fresh beet so you won't be happy if that is what you are looking for in a can.  This is canned and for being canned it is very good.  As I'm cooking dinner, I open a can of these to nibble on...I do save a few to put on a plate for others for a burst of color on their dish.  I don't heat them, just open the can, drain and enjoy.  They are small and whole, so they are tender, and the best for a canned beet.  They don't need slicing since they are bite sized.  Makes a perfect little snack.** I also eat the pickled whole beets from Libby's straight out of the can for snacks instead of candy.And I eat hole green beans for snacks, again from the can.Hint: put drained whole green beans into the pickled beet juice and marinade for a day.

i expect there is a less expensive way to buy beets, but i live in a rural village, fifteen miles from a supermarket [tho we have a nice mom and pop store here] and twenty miles from a big box discount store. i'm delighted about being in a cozy comfy community, away from the wiz and glam, and glad i gave up my car in retirement for a three wheeled bike. its amazing how much easier it is to live in retirement without a gas-hogging car! so, having my box of beets appear on my porch is a treat..so, to canned beets. i love them. and all of you know libbys is / was and will be a trusted brand for quality. and they are so darned good for our health! i could go on and on about their antioxidants and fiber etc, but you all can Google beet nutrition and get it all spelled out. and what a great food if you are on a diet! a splash of balsamic vinegar changes the hefty bland sweetness to a sparkling kicking tongue tang.so i suggest setting yourself up as a repeat buyer thru amazon for a 12-pack of libbys beets, even if you DO have a car and can drive to the market . .  you KNOW you're not going to pick up a dozen cans, even if theyre on sale... a beet is not a sexy veg! So, go with the internet order: the price is right and you'll be glad you did as you dip into your beet supply a lot more regularly with them on the shelf [unless you can't stand beets, of course].
These are some of the best beets that I've tried. Love the flavor, outstanding value, fast shipping, I'm on my 4th case already and will continue buying this product.

I have no clue why I hated beets as a kid and avoided them on the salad bar as an adult. I'm adding more veggies to my diet, broadening my horizon so beets were tried again. I like them, they're great plain or with a vinagarette and orange sections. In the past month I've ordered cut beets and now whole beets. These yummy little morsels are tastier than the cut ones to me. Like Sailor I've begun eating them out of the chilled can. I'm happy I've revisited beets.

I figured these would be good because of the Libby brand name and I certainly am not disappointed. Every can that I've opened has had nice, unblemished, small whole beets filling the can.  The amount of liquid is not out of proportion either.  Good tasting and make a really nice presentation.  Nice for the upcoming holidays!

Small and tender beets, sweet and delicious.  Each can contains aprox. 13-15 baby beets.  Amazon price is actually cheaper than in the supermarkets, and delivered right to my door.  Will be ordering this again soon.I drink the beet broth as well because it's packed full of anthocyanins, a good antioxidant. Add a bit of butter because fat helps absorption.

Libby's Small Whole Beets, 15-Ounce  Cans (Pack of 12)Fresh beets in the grocery stores are large, expensive, time consuming, and a mess to prepare...Voila!  Enter: Libby's small whole canned beets...With these delicious little guys you can serve them whole, sliced or pickled...They enhance salads and other foods at mealtime...The cans hold beets to capacity and you can leave them whole or slice them and serve them plain or add apple cider vinegar,a little sugar, and a dash of cinnamon to the canned juice, heat them to a boil for a few minutes, let them sit for a short time  and you've got yourself very tasty pickled beets..If you dice them and add corn starch at the end of your heating and pickling process, cook until thickend to taste, and you've got Harvard beets...Actually, these are good enough to eat cold right out of the can as is...Canned whole beets are more expensive in the stores and you also pay more for the sliced pickled beets...For me, the Libby's beets are a winning option...They are nutritious, easy to work with, economical and available in lots of 12 cans so you have them at home when you want them...Amazon delivers them free with Prime and they arrive quickly...What's not to like unless you don't like beets?!

column9: Beets! Another 5-Star Diet Essential and Cheap
column10: With a slightly earthy taste these gems are a nutritional powerhouse even in the can. Via Amazon Subscribe & Save with an expiration date of "DEC 2014" I got a good deal. Always better fresh but beets are a mess to prepare. Go with canned. As I usually mention in many of my reviews, we are in the produce wholesale business in Japan and Hawaii, and generally know what we're talking about versus casual consumers. So get these beets and eat! One beet uncooked out of the can and sliced in half works in a salad easily. Aloha,  John
My wife and I really love these small red beets. Natural sweetness. so nice to enjoy them knowing they are also very good for us in getting a good vegetable.5 stars for this one.
What more is there to say? This container came quickly and in good condition. The goldfish were fresh. Good deal to buy all of these goldfish at once.
I'm eating these delightful mini delights and they are ASTOUNDING it's like eating pure joy when one devours them in excess accounts. These things are freaking amazing
My children loves these quick fun little goldfish snacks. The quantity lasts my family of six for a good period of time. So for the price, quantity and enjoyment factor these fish are a great buy.

column9: Great for traveling with your allergic child!
column10: My daughter is allergic to many foods and has a pretty restricted diet.  She absolutely loves this spaghetti.  It's very tasty and so easy to prepare.  When we travel, finding food on the road for her is almost impossible.  I take these and have always been able to find a microwave either at the restaraunt where we are eating or even a corner mini-mart.  I do think they are a little on the pricier side, but worth the convenience.

Gluten-free pasta varies in quality. This is pretty good. The sauce is delicious. It's a very small serving, an ideal snack, but not a meal for me, anyway. Good for multiple food allergies: Gluten Free, Wheat Free, Dairy Free, Egg Free, Soy Free, Peanut Free, Tree Nut Free, Fish Free, Shellfish Free.
The portion is really small.  It might work for a toddler.  We opened a pack with our family of 5 present and it looked so unappetizing.  No one really wanted to taste.

column9: Finally, Good Fast Food for the GFCF Crowd
column10: I purchased this product as well as the Allergaroo spyglass noodles for my grandson who has asperger's syndrome and is on the GFCF (gluten free and cassein free)diet.  It's hard to find good food that he can have so I was delighted to find these.  The best part is that he loves them.  He does need two packages for a meal because they're rather small.  By purchasing online in bulk the price is much more reasonable than buying individual packages at the grocery store. It's difficult to give a child a tasty meal when on this diet without doing a lot of home cooking and health food store shopping, but the Allergaroos are a nice break from all that; sort of "fast food" for the GFCF diet.

Unless it's just not labeled correctly, this is the ONLY gum I have found (besides bubble gum) that does not contain aspartame.  I have literally checked every package of gum at all of our stores in town and every single one has aspartame, even the non sugar free!  Way to go Dentyne Classic!!

I love Dentyne Classic Gum. Unfortunately the only way I can purchase it now is online. I love the cinnamon flavor. It's not overpowering, which can be the case with a lot of cinnamon-flavored gums. It's the only gum I chew.

This is the gum I sadly realized awhile back they stopped selling in stores.  Everything has to be "Ice" or "Blasted" now.  This is the gum I know and love to chew.  It always seems fresh so I don't know where it's made or if it's just leftover stock but it tastes like the same gum as before.  KCC.
The sevice was fast, and the product was fresh. I couldn't get this gum anywere local.

This gum is fantastic. With almost all other chewing gum having artificial sweetners, this is one I can use. I have had horrible experiences with any food item containing sweetners; Dentyne Classic...never.  Thank you Dentyne & Amazon.com!

This is the original Dentyne gum--the kind you can't find in stores anymore.  My Dad quit smoking using this stuff (as an oral substitute for a cigarette), and has loved it ever since.  I wanted to get him some for Christmas, and found the best prices on Amazon.  He was absolutely thrilled to get it.
Excellent classic gum! Why did it ever get taken off the shelf & simply replaced with that 'fire & ice' mumbo-jumbo or whatever? Should've just kept it along with the others, because it's GREAT!

For years Dentyne was the only gum I would ever purchase.  Then it disappeared from shelves everywhere. I tried the new Dentyne, but it's just not the same.  Dentyne should not be in chiclet form. Looked up Dentyne on the internet. Finally found my gum again and will no doubt order again and again.  Still the best gum, no extra added chemicals.  Just a great treat.  Also, will not stick to any dental work so anyone can chew and enjoy. Thank you Amazon..... Dentyne Classic Cinnamon Chewing Gum, 20-Piece Packages (Pack of 24)

I love this gum!  It has a wonderful cinnamon flavor and no artificial sweeteners snuck into the ingredients without warning.  Check out Wrigley's brand gums and see what I mean.  This is a good compromise for my family without having to buy expensive gum at the health food stores.  Yippee!

column9: Dentyne classic from the old days
column10: If you are old school then you remember this gum. I grew up on it and don't know why Dentyne stopped making this gum. I can't find any store that carries it. Thank goodness for the Internet. The gum was GREAT!!!
It is fantastic to be able to obtain the classic Dentyne gum that I have loved for years but can no longer find easily in stores in Wisconsin.
This gum is absolutely delicious.  I love that they use real sugar rather than all the crappy artificial sweeteners in other gum.  I will continue buying this until it's no longer available.

The old Original Dentyne Chewing Gum is still the best. The Cinnamon is good for the digestave system and fresh breath. Dentyne has come out with many other flavors, but none are as good as the original. I can't understand why Dentyne has made it hard to find in stores. I've been chewing it for fifty years and will continue to do so, as long as it is made.Charles, from GA.
It was fantastic to find a nostalgic favorite at a reasonable price. I love the diversity of shopping with Amazon!

My dad loves the original Dentyne gum and was disappointed when it was discontinued on the store shelves. Since he does not have a computer, I went online and did a search to find that Amazon.com carries the product. It is fantastic to know that products that people love so much are still available online. My dad was blown away to have me ship him 4 boxes of the gum. He is stocked for a year and is chewing his way to happiness. Thanks!

column9: This is what Dentyne is supposed to be
column10: This is what Dentyne is supposed to be.  When they decide to change a product, it should be renamed.  This is the Dentyne we all grew up with and thank goodness we can find it through the internet.  Please do not stop making this.The service was also prompt and exact.

column9: Original DENTYNE Gum is as good as ever
column10: So glad I was able to buy this favorite gum through amazon and Always Direct.So much better tasting than the new gums with artificial sweeteners.Product was received promptly and was fresh stock.Chewing this gum stops me from snacking and that's a good thing.

We can not purchase Dentyne anywhere!  Being able to find it here on Amazone allows my family to continue to enjoy the great long lasting taste of the gum we all grew up on!!  We appreciate the fast service in getting us the product.  This paticular order was a Christmas gift. Thank you!!

I realize it is not the most popular thing, but I cannot stand sugar-free gum. This has always been my favorite and is not sold in stores. (Not in California anyway). So this is the 2nd time I have ordered and will certainly be back for more..
I have always enjoyed Dentyne gum and it's difficult to find the original version.  The price and dedvlivery were good.

I love the spicy cinnamon taste when you start to chew it in your mouth. It has been like my favorite gum for years and I'm 14. I am extremely impressed with this gum and would definitely buy again for the third time! It's a great deal. It tastes the same as it used to back then.

The old gum had sugar and glucose syrup which is why I ordered this gum. Trying to avoid the Aspartame which is in Most gum out there. Unfortunately the new Dentyne classic that i received has sugar AND High fructose corn syrup. which was a disappointment for me. Oh well. the search continues for sugar only gum.

column9: I found my chewing gum on Amazon.com
column10: For some reason, Dentyne Classic chewing gum was suddenly out of stock and unavailable in my midwestern area of the country.  I would not say that I am addicted to using this gum, but it does give me pleasure along with fresh breath and a clean-feeling mouth, so I was very determined to find another source for this gum.  In my search I was led to Amazon. com and there I found what was purported to be the very last package of Dentyne Classic in stock.  After placing my order, the shipment came promptly as promised and in great condition.  I am now satisfyingly chewing again and thankful for the wide range of merchants available through Amazon.com.  I am completely satisfied with this purchase.

column9: I thought they quit making it
column10: I decided to contact Dentyne about my favorite gum.  I couldn't figure out why all of a sudden all I could find was Dentyne ICE, which is SUGARLESS!!  I want my Dentyne with sugar in it for heavens sake.  Dentyne answered me saying I should ask my favorite store to carry it, yeah right, like they are going to listen to me.  All they care about is carrying the "latest and greatest (not)" junk.  It's ridiculous that I have to order it and pay postage when all stores SHOULD still sell this!  At least they sell Beemans throughout the year (if you're lucky enough to run across it), of course, they want twice the price of any other gum, I suppose that's what they'd do with Dentyne if they sold it.
anybody out there know were i can find the original spearmint. unlike the new product with fake posionus sweetners ty mangosox9589@yahoo.com
GREAT PRODUCT AND SHIPPED QUICKLY AS PROMISED. GOOD JOB, WILL PROBABLY ORDER FROM THEM AGAIN IS PRICE REMAINS COMPETITIVE.

I did some research on this gum and found that the flavor crystals can burn or hurt your gums. One of my gums began having a problem shortly after I began to chew this old classic favorite of mine. I threw the whole big package of it into the garbage when my Dad said his mouth bothered him from chewing it as well. I suggest that if you feel anything different in your mouth you discontinue chewing this gum. Maybe there is a reason why it is no longer sold in stores, and this is it.

column9: why I took Dentyne gum off my wish list
column10: Unfortulately due to restrictions at the border crossing,from USA to Canada, I am not allowed to buy this product, therefore I took it off. I would buy it if I could.

This syrup is really good. It has a lot of flavor without being overly sweet. One or two pumps is enough to give my espressos a rich butterscotch flavor. I would recommend it if you are looking for a syrup that will compliment your concoctions without overpowering it with sugar.

This item works a little too well in fact.  The little sticky traps are covered so I actually need to order more!  They work well because you are able to push them as far down into the pot as you need to unlike other traps you would just hang in the general area.  They seem to be helping control our gnat problem though I would recommend a pesticide to go along with them.  The sticky paper helps cut down on the number of flying adults but eggs still exist in the pot that need to be taken care of as well.

column9: sticky stakes do the job well
column10: After we switched to all organic potting soil, fungus gnats and/or flying mites were trying to take over our house.  Sticky stakes have all but eliminated them!

These little guys are great. Less mess than other brands I've tried. They are small and pre-cut. I put one in all my plants and within a week my white fly issue was gone without having to use any chemical spray that could harm my dog. Highly recommend!!!!

The production description did not mention the size of the traps. SAFER previously sold "Sticky Whitefly Traps", which I liked a lot but couldn't find in my store any more. So I ordered these traps, assuming that the size of the traps would be similar. But these traps (1.25"x3.75") actually came less than 1/5 of the size of the previous traps (6"x4"). Besides, these traps are only sticky on one side, while the previous ones were sticky on both sides. So counting the sticky surface, these traps are 1/10 of the size, but I paid 1/2 of the price comparing to the previous ones. These did come with stakes which were not included with the previous product, but I don't seem to care much for them. I think the size information will be very helpful for consumers to decide whether the product meets their needs.

4 stars only because I think they're too expensive, however, it is an effectice and convenient product - easy to use (the yellow flags have a small area on the edges that aren't sticky, which makes them easy to grab and bend in half to fit onto the stake - you'll learn that quickly, as grabbing the yellow flags in the sticky area is something you'll want to avoid)If using insecticide, these are a great aide/indicator as they'll let you know if the plant is free or still infested.  When I used these to catch white flies, I staked all my plants.  Within days, the flags in the two plants that were most infected were full - letting me know which soil(s) were the ones that needed complete repotting.Then, after using insecticide, I checked the flags each day to see if more flies were getting trapped and thus still present.If you think you have an infestation these flags will catch the little ***kers and help you determine if more insecticide treatments are necessary.
These thing are great.  They all but eliminated the gnat problem that developed on my orchids.  It took about a week or two and those things were covered with gnats..... all dead!!  Problem gone!!!

Just got these in the mail today and immediately tried it out. I have to admit I was disappointed  that a packet only contains 7 yellow stickies, while it has 7 pegs each with two slots for stickies. So technically they should've supplied 14 yellow stickies to complete the set.However, within 10 seconds it already caught 1 fungus gnat...few minutes it caught another. By 15 minutes, it's got 4 total. I had tried the Safer Kitchen Pest kits, but they didn't work. I guess the yellow color really does attract the flying pests.Don't care about the price....I just wish it came with more stickies

These do catch fungus gnats as advertised, and they are relatively inexpensive.  If you have more than just a few gnats I would recommend you get some of the larger two sticky sided traps available from amazon and elsewhere.  They cost a bit more but are a much better value.  These traps are small and one sides, and are quickly filled up and no longer of use.  Most double sided commercial versions are about 3 times as large or larger, and have sticky material on both sides.
Worked OK but these Stakes catch only a few of the irritating critters and certainly won't eliminate them. We ended up throwing away our few houseplants and starting over with new ones.

column9: Works as advertised, but isn't enough on its own.
column10: I goofed! I didn't know you could (or should) sterilize new potting dirt fresh from the hardware store before adding it to a small indoor garden.  I'm now older, wiser, and dealing with a fungal gnat infestation.In two weeks, I've caught 25 gnats on these yellow suckers.  I'm using all of them in a 6-8 sqft indoor garden.  That's even after I cut way back on watering, a measure the mint and bell peppers aren't too happy about.I know that sounds like a success story, but it isn't sufficient: the emerging adults avoid capture long enough to lay eggs.  The situation has improved, but I'll have to use gnatrol or other means to finish the job.These are SO very sticky that woe betide any plant that brushes up against it.  It's quite like sticking your tongue to the frozen flag pole, I'm afraid.  Any dirt that splashes up also sticks.  This doesn't *sound* surprising, but I'm continually surprised by how often one of the leaves I try to carefully keep out of the way gets stuck and rips away.Conclusion:  this helps, and could be useful to keep a nuisance (i.e., fruit flies) from being too bothersome.  For more harmful fliers like fungal gnats, however, you'll have to use it in conjunction with other methods or skip this and head straight for the larger guns.  I'm glad I tried it, but I'm moving on.

column9: They immediately show you why you bought them.
column10: I thought I had a gnat problem, once I put these in my plants, I realized I actually had a gnat catastrophe on my hands. These things were covered in dead gnats in no time.Mixed with gognats, and a thin layer of sand and rocks in my plants, I've finally been able to go a whole day without swatting at the air.

I have quite the infestation of fungus gnats.  These certainly work, catching about a zillion million gnats.  Though, apparently I need to catch a gillion zillion million jillion fungus gnats.  I liked they were kinda small & cute -- but for what it is (yellow tape and a plastic stick), I think they could be a bit cheaper.

Purchased these to combat fungus gnats that appeared in big numbers after repotting plants.  The little black gnats are pesty and seem to land in any open glasses of fruit juice etc. you might have. After reading an article recommending another brand for gnat control I decided to purchase these after researching info on the Amazon site.  The concept is quite simple, has no pesticides to endanger pets and isn't obtrusive in your plant pots.  It helps control but not eliminate the gnats.  Additionally limit watering of plants and allow top two inches of soil to remain dry to put a dent into the gnat population. Although it doesn't seem like you get a lot with these pest strips they are worth having and I have already reordered.

I read in the descriptions of this product that it would help with fruit flys, but so far I have had no luck.  It may work great for other flying bugs, but if you have fruit flys I would recommend looking at other products.  It seems like it would work to contain bugs that are attracted to it but I can't say for sure.

I had an infestation of flour moths and black beetles during the summertime due to the fact that there has been renovations to the area around where I live. And these buggers are all over my flour, plants and just flying around being annoying to myself and my hubby. Therefore, we ordered this houseplant stakes and put the in all the houseplants around the living room and kitchen. I am surprised to say that the stickey stakes caught a lot of the nasty buggers. I must advise that the stakes are not exactly easy. The stake to put the stickey in is small and sometimes the tape gets stuck to your fingers, but with persistence, once the tape is attached, you show find it yields good results.
These seem to work pretty well. Unfortunately, my cat kept getting into them and they would get stuck to his fur...oh well.
i have gnats in my indoor plants and this sticky paper works ok, but i think my money would be better spent on regular fly paper.

For some reason we have had tiny little black flies all over the house. I placed the strips as directed and the very next day the strips were full of the tiny little buggers. I just ordered two more packs (wish I could find just the strips) for my other plants. Im hoping to break the life cycle of the flies.

I use the sticker for more than 3 weeks. One sticker a week on one plant. It helps minimize the flies a lot but cannot stop them all. I still saw a few flies everyday. One package only has 7 stickers. I hope the flies will be gone after I finish all stickers.

Our houseplants were loaded with gnats, and so was every room in our house. We placed these easy to set up traps in the soil (two in the larger pots) and within a few hours we had our first victims. 24 hours later all of the traps had snagged some gnats. 48 hours later they were loaded with them! A great inexpensive way to take care of the problem.

Every time I repot plants, or buy new ones, I get little gnat things flying all over. This product will get rid of them. There is not odor, and they are easy to use. You just put one in the dirt with provided stakes in each plant. When you no longer see gnats, you can just toss these in the garbage. Make sure to have some on hand for when you need them again. They keep the gnats from spreading if you put them out right away. Very reasonably priced. (If you are unable to watch the gnats dying, and it makes you sad, do not look at the strips.) I have given many of mine away, because as soon as someone asks me what it is, they want some!

I've been using one of the strips for a few weeks now and just caught my first fruit fly a few days ago. The flies seem to not notice it or be uninterested because they fly near it, but not on to it. I've had better luck creating my own traps with vinegar in a bowl and poking holes in saran wrap on the top of it.

This sticky trap is way smaller than I have in mind but it really traps small insects in the garden. I was having some gnat problems and some other small garden insects that's why I purchased this. The next day after I put it a little under the leaves, I found a lot of insects trapped in it. There was even a moth, which was also another problem I had. When I put a new one again I didn't realized that it would be raining that night and it got wet. When I checked it though it was still really sticky enough to trap some more insects later so I didn't changed it. I didn't have to change each and everyone of it until full. I would suggest to put it in a place where butterflies won't get to it as the color seems to attract them too.

column4: D. D. Booth "Fighting Back One Gadget At A Time"
column9: Got a bunch of those buggers
column10: I would have given these 5 stars but I believe they are expensive for just 7, although I ended up ordering a second set anyway.  The first set got covered with gnats.  My gnat population reduced significantly after using these but I still felt there were more gnats than I wanted so like others I ordered the Bonide Product 951 Systemic House Plant Insect Control 8 Oz. in the Patio, lawn, and garden section. (sorry I couldn't get insert a product link to find this, although I can search and still find it.)  The Bonide product really got rid of almost all the gnats left around after using these sticky traps so like other reviewers I would say if you are trying to eliminate all your gnats you should probably use both.  My review of the bonide product shows how much of the product you'll need according to the size of your house plant containers if you're interested in using it.

I've seen gnats blunder into these and pull free, which defeats the purpose of having them to begin with.  Sure, they catch some gnats, but they don't catch them all.  I bought these because they were cheaper than my usual brand (which has to be purchased in larger quantities), but it's not worth it if they don't work effectively.

Does work : ) Not very attractive but can't see anyway to be different... maybe not yellow ... maybe brown would be more hidden...  but better than those vinegar holding things that never work for me.

column9: If you have a fly problem these wont do the trick
column10: I used all of these on 3 plants.  They catch a few bugs but if your having fly issues they wont eliminate your problem.  Plus they are gross after you catch 20 or so.

I live in a colder climate where our plants need to be brought indoors during the winter.  These little traps do a GREAT job at keeping the house flies at bay.  We had a big problem with the house flies when we first brought our plants inside, so I bought these after reading the other reviews.  Within a week, the traps were full and I ordered more.  Great product, and no more house flies! Yay!

Of course my husband was skeptical that these would do any good in catching our swarm of fungus gnats that came in on my plants that I brought inside this winter.  We'd tried all different methods to get rid of them to no avail.  I saw this product being reviewed in a gardener's video blog, and thought 'why not?'Within hours those pesky gnats were getting stuck, and over the course of a week, have traps filled with these pests. We've definitely had a decrease in gnats flying around in our faces when we're trying to watch TV. Now we just need a solution to kill the larvae, so we can end their life cycle completely.

These sticky traps work great and captured lots of the gnats we had in our houseplants.  Unfortunately, we waited too long to use them and had to resort to additional means to get rid of the problem.  If your problem is just starting, these should do the trick.  We, also, use them to keep track of the decrease in gnat population as we treated our plants.  Good product.  Because they are bright yellow, they are a little unsightly in the plant pot but it's better than having gnats flying around the house.  Would definately purchase these again.

Pros: I have tried poison sprays to get rid of fungus gnats in my houseplants. So far I think I poisoned our home and killed more plants than any gnat. These little sticky traps are the only thing I have found that will alleviate the problem by 50 to 75%. They are not gone, it does help that it is freezing here right now. Gnats can't live below 65F, so between the cold and traps I have slowed them down considerably.Cons: They are a bit pricey @7USD with only 7 per pack. This time I bought 4 packs. It would be nice if they offered a larger package at a bulk price.
Works great, caught hundreds of gnats!just wished it came with more sticky cards but for the price not too bad.

If you want something that is eco-safe, these are a great way to go.  They're not going to kill all your fruit flies, but they'll make the problem more manageable.
Bought these a few times for my indoor pepper plants and I can say they definitely do the job.  Just wish they were a little bigger.

column9: Works great to catch adult fungus gnats!

column9: These are great but be careful

column9: A crowd pleaser with a nice mix of different olives
column10: These are always popular with guests. After I open the bag, I just keep them in a big jar in the fridge. They keep for a long time and alongside a bowl of nuts, are an easy and popular booze-absorbing snack to serve with cocktails.

The olives are a pleasant assortment and the caperberries, garlic, peppers and rosemary make this product different from the olive bar products at the store. Few restaurants have this quality. Delicious and a good value.WHAT IT ISI was at first put off by the description "antipasta".  I've purchased Spanish mixes which were mostly pearl onions and tiny cucumbers---tasty, but not cost-effective for the olives.  I've purchased "Mediterranean" mixes which were bare edible because the flavor was dominated by hot peppers and garlic.  However, this "mix" is almost entirely olives, with some tasty capers, a few garlic cloves, a few slices of bell pepper and some spices.  It is flavorful, but the mild flavoring does not overwhelm the taste of the olives.COMPARISION TO "BYZANTINE COUNTRY OLIVE MIXThe similar "Byzantine Country Olive Mix"  Byzantine Country Olive Mix, 5-Pound Bag is about the same product without the capers, garlic, and bell peppers, and larger ratio of green olives (about 50% green with the BCOM, 40% green with the BFOA).  Although I like the green olives better, I like the flavor of the "Byzantine Fresh Olive Antipasto" better, so the choice is is a close call.  (I have subscriptions for both, on alternating months).PACKAGINGThe packaging (into a heavy plastic bag) apparently consisted of draining the olives and then coating them with olive oil.  Amazon packages the bag (folded in half) in a standard ca 3" x 8" x 12" cardboard box.  The first order I placed (about 9 months ago) arrived with some of the softer olives a bit mashed, but Amazon has been improving packaging.  The plastic bag is now wrapped in large bubble-wrap packaged in a box which is packaged in a larger box.  The improved packaging greatly reduces damage to solf olives.REPACKAGINGThe olives are very salty, saltier than the "Byzantine Country Olive Mix".  You may be tempted to soak them in plain water to reduce the salt content.  Unless you plan to eat the olives in the next few hours, resist the temptation.  First, you'll leach out too much salt and flavor.  Second, the olives will rot in a few weeks.  Really.MAKING YOUR OWN BRINEI suggest gently but thoroughly rinsing the olives when you receive them, ideally in a bowl of warm-hot water (to cut the excess olive oil).  Then drain and repackage them in your own light brine and white vinegar mix in your own jars, and refrigerate.  The light brine will reduce the saltiness of the olives to an appropriate level in a day or two.  It will take about 5 cups of water, about 1/4 cup (4 tbsp) of salt, and 1/3 cup (6 tbsp) of white vinegar to your taste.  Some people like olives salty, some like them vinegary, so adjust to your preferance.  It is best to use "sea-salt" or pickling salt (if you have any handy), because brine made from regular processed salt can get cloudy.EVALUATIONSome of the olives are firm, some are soft---that's simply the nature of a true mix. Most Americans (like myself), raised on pimento-stuffed queen olives think that they don't like soft olives.  Indeed, mushy queen olives are yucky.  However, some types of olives are meant to be soft, and are best soft.  It is an acquired taste, worth acquiring.  The mix includes a large variety of olives, both firm and soft.  It is said that the key to oriental cuisine is variety---a variety of colors, textures, and flavors.  The same is true of an olive mix meant for snacking or as the basis of a light meal.If you eat olives regularly, Amazon's subscription service is worth considering.  I'm signed up for monthly shipments and have recieved 3 shipments so far, with no problems.ADDITIONSThe bell peppers go so well that I often slice up another red bell pepper and add it to the mix.  I also often add Cerignola and Queen olives to the mix to increase the variety.  I've never seen "American style" ripe olives in any European olive product (although they probably exist).  What Americans call "black olives" (more accurately ripe ripe olives) are entirely different from the black and brown olives in this mix.  American-style ripe olives (black or green)(both are Queen olives allowed to ripen, but in different ways) are a nice addition to the mix, but are preserved in brine only and so, are best mixed when served for a greater contrast of flavors.  Ripe black olives are found in almost any American grocery.  Ripe green olives (see below) are hard to find outside California.  Unpitted are always more flavorful.  I'm not a great fan of Kalamatra olives (also brine-only olives), but a few are a nice addition to a mix.Recommendation 1:  A half-can of chick-peas, a diced tomato, a half-cup of these mixed olives, all mixed together with a little olive oil is a wonderful, tasty, health, lunch.  Alternatively, I often eat these with a dish of mixed nuts, diced cheeze squares, and apple slices.Recommendation 2:  There is a whole world of olives out their worth exploring.  As just example, Grabers Ripe Green Olives are more different from stuffed queen olives than you can imagine, but are marvelous.  Mild and nutty.  Graber Olives Size 14 7.5 oz. Can

though i did not purchase this through amazon, i did get this recently from thw grocery store, and have to admit im really disappointed.  i followed the instructions the first evening EXACTLY as instructed with the included paper, and no results.  the second day, i brewed just a little longer, still no luck, (basing this off some other comments from other users here on amazon) then today i only did 6oz, not 12 as the paper instructs, and even brewed this for 6 minutes.  still nothing.i really wanted this to work for me like it has for others, i had heard good things and was so excited, but still no luck.  i guess im one of those people this doesnt affect. ill keep trying it daily till i run out, but looks like ill have to try something else.as for taste, its not bad. just tastes like tea leaves, not deliciously fantastic, but not nose-pinchingly undrinkable. good luck to anyone else. hope you have more success with this than i did

i got this tea hoping it would be better than my dieters delight china slim tea but it isnt. it does make you use the bathroom but not enough for you to feel cleansed for that particular day...i have no choice but to finish thus package but i will be going back to my regular tea afterwards
This tea is ok but it's not nearly as potent as the original product that was available 5-10? Years ago.

I have no idea what all these reviews for this brand of dieters tea are talking about. I followed the directions nothing happened. Brewed a stronger cup-still nothing.Even measured out the water to 6oz and let the tea bag seep for five minutes-nothing just stronger tasting tea. On the box it tells you not to drink more than 1 cup in a 24 hour period- I drank three the other day not even thinking about it and nothing happened! Just tasted like cranberry tea and nothing else. Strange.

I bought this product based off reviews saying it tastes great and I was extremely disappointed. As soon as I started steeping it this smell filled my kitchen (my daughter even asked what the horrible smell was). Sadly, it was this tea. I tried it and it tastes like sweaty socks also. It is so gross. I have tried adding honey, drinking it cold, drinking it hot, etc and they all taste horrible. As far as a diet aid, I don't think so. I guess if you had a lot of excrement in you, possibly. I even doubled the suggested amount and I still did not anything happen (and no, I was not on the toilet a lot either). All in all, this product was a big thumbs down to me.
I was very happy with my order.  It arrived on time and as described.  Thank you!!
This is the typical tobiko you have at any Sushi restaurant. It was fresh and delicious. I used it on homemade sushi, eggs and salads. I loved it!
At the Hodgson Mill website they are seling a case of 6 for the same price.  talk about rip-offs.

column4: Silverfish "Book lover, now learning to listen!"
column10: I don't like hot cereal with sugar and milk.  An addict of oat bran, I make mine with chicken broth (+half water) and a couple of added herbs and onion flavoring.  Every morning it's like being allowed to eat all the delicious stuffing out of the turkey with no guilt!Hodgson's Mill Oat Bran seems to be the best of the lot -- it tastes freshly milled and it cooks quickly.  But it's hard to find in certain areas and the company's customer service is not helpful when it comes to finding retailers.  Thank goodness for Amazon.As a regular user for several months now, it's nice to report a weight loss, even during the holiday season and cold winter.  Could that be because a bowl of oat bran (with no added fat) is so filling that snacks and even lunch become unnecessary?

I used to eat Quaker Oat Bran but one day discovered Hodgson's. I eat it every morning and it is the best, brown and crunchy compared to the bland whiteness of Quaker or Mother's. I add water and a few peach slices, some ginger and a pinch of pepper, then two minutes in the microwave and it's a great way to start the day. When my local supermarket stopped carrying it, for some reason, I found this offer and immediately bought 10 boxes.  And when they're gone, I'll buy 10 more!
I can't believe I paid here over $11..big mistakeon my part should checked local first...just paid under $ 3.00 for 16 oz at our local Publixrated a 5 * for the item...

This is the BEST OAT Bran cereal.  But one star because it is over-priced!  Should be less than $3.00 a box, if purchased from your local grocery store, such as Harris Teeter or Publix.  Or order directly from Hodgson Mill website for a case with 6 boxes for a total of $11.50, though shipping costs are high. Or order from iherb website at $2.07 a box, lower shipping charges.  Still this is the best Oat Bran cereal in the market.

column9: Big rip-off, do not buy from Hoosier Farms
column10: If I could leave negative stars about this seller I would.I found this product last week while after getting a cookbook that was published by the Hodgson Mill company.  This product came up in my searches and was originally listed at 8.43 (0.0439 unit price).  In the desciption it said this was for 12 boxes of 16oz oat bran.  That correctly added up to the .0439 unit price 8.43/(12*16).  I sent an email to Hoosier Farms to make sure that was correct before dering becuase it was a really good deal and I waited until the next day but did not get a personal response.The following day after I sent the email I decided to go ahead and order this and I then saw that the price had increased to 10.22 with a unit price of .053229 but the description was unchanged, still had 12 boxes (16oz).  So I placed my order.I received my shipment last night and I only received 1 box of 16oz oat bran and then when I logged onto my account and checked I see that the decription had been changed to state it was for only one box with a unit price of 10.22.I will be returning this box ASAP since I can buy this same product locally for half the price.Bad, bad business practices. I will leave a bad review for Hoosier Farms everywhere I can.  If they had personally responded to my original email this could have been avoided

column9: item is wonderful, don't buy here though
column10: i was looking to see if i can get a better deal than 2.79 a box that i pay at my local, regular, supermarket. i will check the hodgson mill website, thanks other reviewer :) sorry amazon, usually i do very well here but not for this.
Delicious, nutritious, and filling.I like mine with honey and soymilk.I purchased this at a local grocery and it wasn't at all expensive.

This stuff is delicious. I eat it most mornings and it keeps me completely satisfied until lunch time. If you have a very busy day ahead of you and don't know when you'll be able to eat next, add one tablespoon of peanut butter, and half a tablespoon of honey. That will really make it stick to your ribs and energize you for hours!

My husband and I have eaten this excellent brand of Oat Bran every morning for many years. It has a nice, slightly chewy texture rather than being overly powdery--which makes us gag. We prefer to cook it with enough water to make it soupy, pour it into tall glasses, and drink it while we're on the computer or doing our morning reading. We also drink it in the car when we're on the run. We recently moved to another state and had trouble finding it locally. Amazon delivers right to our door for less than we could buy it in the grocery store.

We really enjoyed this pizza.The order arrived quickly,well packed on ice and was still frozen.I was really happy with the fact that it was all pure ingredients and even good for vegetarians.Not skimpy on the toppings.It was slightly peppery and that made it extra good.Each slice is the perfect size/shape as one nice lg. slice of a pizza house pizza.Loved the crust. Even my 16 yr old grandson loved it.I hope they get more in quickly and it goes on the "subscribe and save" mode,which I like because I would order it at least once a month.Try it you will love it too.

I first saw this in Ross, strange place for dog food but I grabbed one. My dog loved it so much. I had to search for it since it was not available anywhere in other stores. I finally found in on Amazon. Kind of expensive. but my dog loves it and I love my dog. What can I do ...

My shitzu pups love these treats but I just read the fine print and discovered that the California company imports this from china. Given what is put in baby formula in china I can't imagine what they might put in dog treats. Sadly, we won't purchase again for this reason.

I am lucky in that my 1 year Chihuahua isn't picky about his snacks and will eat just about anything. This product is no exception. I gave him one and he promptly took it to his favorite "eating spot" on the rug and went at it. I like the fact that it is low in fat and has somewhat natural ingredients as well as being good for the teeth. Since Chihuahuas can have dental problems, I am all for products that keep their teeth in good condition, since dental cleanings are quite expensive. Anyhow, he knows where his treats are kept and will eagerly anticipate getting one of these or some other tasty snack. Although it's made in China, my dog hasn't had any adverse reaction to the product. The product can get expensive but you can probably find a deal on it at your local pet store. That's how I first discovered these.

I HAVE AN 8 YEAR OLD CHIHUAHUA AND HE HAS NEVER BEEN A CHEWER.  HE DOESNT CHEW HIS TOYS AND DOES NOT EVEN LIKE TO EAT DRY FOOD.  I HAVE HAD TO HAVE HIS TEETH CLEANED EVERY YEAR WHICH IS VERY EXPENSIVE!!!  I HAVE TRIED ALL THE DENTAL CHEWS AND STILL NOTHING.  MY DOG LOVES THESE TREATS!!!  I AM VERY PLEASED AND LUCKY TO HAVE FOUND THEM!  WONDERFUL PRODUCT!

I have bought these many times for my two hungry golden retrievers.  This is one of their favorite treats.  They have had before the rice balls that are on the ends of these dumbbells and the treat in the middle is an added bonus.  They are crunchy so it helps keep their teeth clean.  Will be back buying these as they go thru these quickly.

I have two dogs, a Cairn Terrier/Chihuahua and a Yorkie/Chihuahua. Both are rescue dogs, and both love treats. Chik 'n Dumbells are their favorites by far. I have to ration them in order to make them last as long as possible. I would be willing to buy a larger size, or buy a larger quantity, if the price would come down. They are easily the most expensive treats I buy. Great product.

column9: Good size  for a favorite treat
column10: My Jack Russell loves the dumbbells.  I like them because they are relatively small, as she has a tendency to gain weight.

MY dog doesn't like many treats so I was delighted when I found the small packs at Petsmart.  They no longer carry them. Going online, I discovered that you sell them. I don't know if this is a one time thing or the change is permanent.  I am very, very disappointed. The other treats I bought at the same time are the same, or at least she eats them sometimes.So I probably won't be purchasing the dumbbells again, especially since the price has gone from under $30 to $40...ThanksMarye
Great product especially for small dogs.  They are, however, somewhat fragile but as they are shipped in the plastic container, they arrive in great shape.  This was my second order.

My Shih Tzu, who is such a finicky eater, would eat these instead of a meal if I let her.  I gave it five stars from her as I have never tasted them and have no intention of doing so (although if you read the ingredients they are fit for human consumption).

Although I was a lil skeptical about the quality and the type of stuff being sent at such an amazing price, but all my worries were gone when my wife received it and loved each and every bit of the stuff included in the package. The packaging is gr8 and the quality of the stuff is a bargain for the price.Highly Recommended if someone looking for quick all-in-one package :)
I'm always on a diet (lost 20 pounds this summer).  At night, when I'm starving, I toss one of these in the microwave - only 100 calories and filling.  I've gone thru 2 big cartons of it!

As a self-proclaimed popcorn addict, I cannot imagine life without the delicious smell and satisfying crunch of popcorn.  Yet I am also a Weight Watcher and I don't want to squander tons of calories every day on buttery, fattening snacks.  These 100-calorie mini bags are perfect to satisfy my craving.  I eat a bag EVERY single night (usually while I catch up on all my recorded shows).  The built-in portion control ensures that I never overdo it on my favorite treat.  I eat it slowly and savor every piece.For some reason, I can never, ever find this product in stores.  Most will carry the Healthy Pop Butter in the big bags only, or sometimes the 100-calorie bags of Kettle Corn...but the 100-calorie bags of butter are few and far between.  When I find them in stores, I buy every box, but usually, I just order by the case from Amazon.This popcorn doesn't taste like "diet food".  Try it with a sprinkling of flavored popcorn seasoning, a drizzle of Extra Virgin Olive Oil, a pinch of shredded parmesean cheese, or chili powder and garlic powder. I bought these pods because they were rated the highest quality to use with the Senseo. The pods do work great,with the 2 pod holder. You need to finely grind the coffee. I did find the lid hard to close. I bought another brand that cost less to compare. The lesser expensive ones worked just as well and were easier to close. If you want good pod coffee with the foam,these work well,and you won't loose the lid.

I tried this product, I like the concept, but it's a waste of your money. Making coffee this way is just a big hassle and it doesn't even come close what the pods offer. It's a messy process, and you need to really pack it down to get any halfway decent result.From a reputable brand like Melitta, I found this very disappointing.Note on the pods;I actually have my coffee pods shipped over from the Netherlands (Douwe Egberts) - the pods there are cheaper (even after shipping it to the US!), and they offer pods that have a much richer coffee taste.A good backup for these are (believe it or not) the "Columbian" pods from Folgers.

These pods are great! Don't allow the $20 price for these to sway you not to purchase them. You will not only save fortune at the end of year but will actually have a superior cup of coffee. These will allow you to purchase the coffee/tea of your choice and adjust the strength to suit you. They fit perfectly in the new Senseo Supreme machine and are a snap to clean up. For home use of pod coffee makers, these are the best way to get the most from your pod machine.

column9: Works great after a little experimenting!!
column10: I just got the Padfilter and the first time I tried it the coffee was a little weak. But, that was my fault because I packed the coffee in there. After that I filled it, but with room to spare. To better understand, fill it and close it, if you can shake it and hear the coffee moving around, then you have it right. After doing it that way from the second time on, I have had one great cup after another! And yes, you do get the creamy foam! I have been using Starbucks Sumatra and it comes out tasting great! The only reason for not giving it 5 stars.....Because if you have a big mug, you have to fill both pods and run the machine twice. But that's just me.

I have been using a Melitta Pod filter I brought back from Europe several months ago. I enjoy the possibility to use the coffee I like thanks to this ingenious device. It might take a little practice to not overfill the pod (or it would leak), but it now makes my favorite coffee every day. I am glad to finally find it on Amazon, as I thought it would be a good gift idea for several of my friends.

I just received the product, did not expect much from it but was very suprised at the coffee it produced.The Senseo HD7820/65 Deluxe that I purchased was great at first but the coffee pods available together with the expense soon led to it gathering dust.I tried the MyPod unit which did not fit my HD7820/65 model at all.The Melitta Padfilter makes a perfect fit and a wonderful brew of coffee as long as you follow the instruction of how much coffee per cup to use.Over all I am very pleased and would recommend this to other buyers.Sheldon

column9: Tried several similar fill-your-own pods, this is the best
column10: Tamp down the coffee a little bit, make sure you have no loose grains. Makes good coffee, and unlike the others you get the nice frothy foam just like the "official" pods. Last forever- I'm still using the first one I took out of the package a couple of years ago.

column9: I don't understand the bad reviews....
column10: Because these filters have been the best thing I have bought since getting the Senseo machine. Now I am not a terribly "green", crunchy sort of person but I did find the waste involved with the paper used for the individual use pods kind of disconcerting. Not only was there the waste of throwing away the pod after 1 use, there was the packaging for the pods themselves. And consider if you drank just one cup a day just what sort of waste that is producing. And the pods were not recyclable due to the coffee grounds, because even in my liberal, tree-hugging neck of the woods, food scrap recycling plans are still not very wide spread. And of course there is the money issue too. These filters have already paid for themselves, considering how many times I have used them vs. what it would have cost to buy as many coffee pods. I can buy a half a pound of ground coffee (even with the coffee costing more than 8 dollars a pound) and get more than a *month's* worth of cups of coffee vs. spending just as much on a bag of 16 pods that will only last me 2 weeks.The issues mentioned with the pods can be solved by two simple steps that a lot of people fail to do---read and then actually follow the directions. Make sure the pods are snapped firmly shut, clean off any loose coffee grounds, and do not pack the coffee down, and these filters will work wonderfully in your Senseo machine. I have not experienced leaks, weak or bad coffee, or any of the bad experiences others have mentioned.

The product does what it advertises.  As other reviews note, it can be a little tricky to get the right amount of coffee in the device to get the coffee to taste just right.  You also need a fine grind, and be aware that it takes up the 2 cup slot to make a 1 cup serving.  As long as you know these things before you buy it, you won't be dissapointed with the product itself.

These reusable filters are great.Pros:Use your favorite brand of coffee(starbucks), easily mix your own flavors(french vanilla/columbian), less expensive than the disposable pods(in long run), easy to use(just fill them up), and great on environment(used coffee grounds make good compost).Cons:Can only use one pod at a time(trust me) and having to clean them(that is the reason I'm giving four stars).I bought these in 2008 for $20 they are still good. The key is to pack them up and use one pod per 4oz(I like my coffee a little bit stronger)

I have a Cafe Invento machine, not a Senseo.  After trimming 1/8 inch from around the edge, it fits perfectly and works like a charm.  The lid seems to close easier than the EcoPad, and the design of the filter allows for better flow-through and drainage.  I like the EcoPad, but this one just seems to work better.

Can't beat the speed of a quick brew of my own blend.  Although a little pricey, I expect the cost to be worthwhile.  I've used Fine Ground coffee and have used a grinder for my own coffee beans --- excellent results.  Clean up is a quick rinse, and prep work takes a little time and patience.  I plan on buying more, and I'll be set for the rest of the week!

column9: Doesn't work in the Bunn machine

I read the part about it not fitting other machines but assumed that was written back before there were copycat machines.  The Bunn uses the Senseo pods and they fit quite well.  It would help if the description gave the dimensions of the product instead of the packaging.

Wanted something that is pretty much hassle free and I got it. I just put a regular teaspoon full if coffee grounds in the reuseable filter and away I go. I don't over pack the filter, there is a little breathing room. The only down side I see is when I am done using the filter. The cleaning... I usually set it aside to dry/drain... Then I empty the filter and let it air dry. Then after a bit I will take a dry napkin or paper towel to "brush" out the remaining grounds. I do see that if it is not rinsed out frequently it will start to clog and will take longer for the coffee to sift through the grounds.In short.... Don't over pack. Let dry before emptying. Empty, then let dry again before brushing out with paper towel or napkin. Wash and rinse throughly frequently.

Purchased these to use with my Senseo Pod Coffee Maker.  Filled it with my favorite coffee, dropped it into the two pod holder and brewed.  Easy to use and will save money over using pre-packaged pods.  My only complaint is the cost.  Expensive for the two that you get.

column9: Now I can enjoy real New Orleans coffee and chicory just like I like it. C'est bon!

I absolutely love this product for my Senseo coffee maker. I have to say it makes a great cup of coffee - i get a little of the foam that i missed in the past and it's an easy clean up just by dumping and rinsing it out. I highly recommend these!

I purchased it to replace my CoffeeDuck (which leaked at first if I put in too much coffee... then the seal broke, and it leaked worse than before.)The Padfilter is easy to use and hard to overfill. only prob for me is it doesnt fit my gevalia coffee pod maker that i bought on woot so i had to mod it a bit. otherwise great!

column9: A wonderful flavor to help diabetics make a good tasting treat or snack!
column10: If you are a diabetic and have ever attended a nutrition class for diabetics you probably have heard of this product. We have a whole collection of the different flavors and I have posted a photo of some of the ones we use the most. This is an ideal additive to diabetic cooking, baking of foods or the mixing of drinks. It is sugar free and calorie free and extremely low in sodium.These mixes are ideal for use in coffee, tea drinks, Italian sodas, cocktails, pancakes, waffles, diabetic cakes and muffins. You can find a lot of diabetic recipes and substitute these flavorings for ingredients that have more sugar and calories. The result is surprisingly good and it will help reduce your sugar and calorie intake while helping you add more flavor to your food.We miss shakes and ice cream and this is a good flavor to use to make such a treat.  Peel and freeze a banana in 3 to 4 pieces in a zip lock bag.  Put it into a blender with 6 to 8 ounces of skim milk, a couple of tablespoons of vanilla or banana instant sugar free pudding, one to two table spoons of this flavoring and  ¾ cup of crushed ice.  Blend this until smooth and you have a good tasting dietetic fruit smoothie that makes a good snack.  You can even freeze this and have a sort of banana ice cream treat. We also used to add in a vanilla protein mix that we would add into one of these to make a light meal.Flavorings like these are nice to spice up your low calorie drinks and food and the Da Vinci Gourmet brand is the best we have found. They are internationally recognized as the highest quality flavoring made and one tablespoon = a free food exchange for a diabetic.I strongly recommend this to you as a great product!
I have two yorkies and every morning we break one of these in two and split it.They love these, and expect their "yambones" every morning.

My three small dogs get these many nights before bed. I purchased the four pack of two pancake mixes and two hot cereal blends and the 5-grain pancake is a delicious blend.I found that I prefer using the recipe from my Betty Crocker Cookbook with two eggs, and other minor differences, rather than the recipe listed on the package which uses only one egg. this hotcake mix is some of the best i have come across. pretty picky since we make most from scratch but in a pinch it beats the competition. very hearty and fluffy. i found the recipe a little off but no big deal. i used a combo of organic milk and organic soy milk for liquid (adds a very good flavor) and non stick spray instead of oil on griddle. serve up with REAL maple syrup or fruit preserves and no complaints. next will try the buckwheat/buttermilk mix.

This pancake mix is ok. It makes very fluffy pancakes, the problem it they aren't really yummy.  It's not a bad mix if you dress them up by adding fruit or something else, but I found by themselves the pancakes are a little bland.

We were preparing a dinner for 160 people of mixed faiths in our community (Jews, Muslims and Christians) and went with what we considered an appropriate Mediterranean theme common to all 3.  As a treat to add zest to an otherwise very low cost collection of foods on the buffet, we splurged and bought 2 bags of these olives, hoping that we'd interpreted the reviews correctly.  To our delight, the olives were extraordinary.  We couldn't believe our good fortune.However, we had had no idea how much 5 lbs would be in terms of volume.  To our chagrin, there were clearly not enough olives for generous servings for 160 people, even with two bags.  So... we extended them, by adding in an equal amount of a carefully drained mix of ordinary green and pitted black olives from the grocery store, stirring thoroughly and refrigerating it all for 24 hours, so that the heady aromas from these antipasto delights would spread to the more plebian ingredients we had added.  Guess what?  It worked!  So... for any of you who love these olives but can't afford them often enough to suit you -- try extending them the same way.  I think you'll be very pleasantly surprised.For those of you who aren't worried by the price, forget about extending them, but don't miss these spectacular olives -- they're truly fabulous.  We didn't have much in the way of leftovers, but we were able to take home a cup or so after the event and have been rationing them for ourselves.  They're that good!  We will buy more for ourselves sometime and divide them into small packages for long term storage, just as many reviewers have suggested.P.S.  From this experience, we've concluded that 5 lbs. equals 40 generous servings, so, if money hadn't been an object, we'd have needed 4 bags for 160 people.  That makes it just a hair over $1 a serving, which we consider an extraordinarily good value, given how fabulous these olives really are.

One dog took a couple bites, and refuses to eat it..The other dog wont even take a bite.I tried mixing it with their favorite can food, but this only made matters worse. These are very tasty, but Bed Bath and Beyond has 18 packs for $9.95 - much better than the 48 for $44.95 here on Amazon.

I love the Pumpkin Spice K-Cup!  I typically drink bold and extra bold coffees - and the Pumpkin Spice doesn't qualify as either.  But it smells just like pumpkin pie....and tastes pretty close to it as well.  One thing I found out though is to definitely add some kind of sweetener (whether it be artifical sweetener or sugar).  I always drink coffee with just cream...and when I did so with the Pumpkin Spice, I really didn't think much of it.  However, as soon as I added a packet of artificial sweetener, the pumpkin flavor just came to life and I loved it!  So even if you don't typically add sweetener, try it with and without - and I'd be willing to bet that you'll like it much better with the sweetener.On a side note, do a little price shopping.  Amazon typically has good prices on a number of things, but not always on K-Cups.  Normal pricing is $13.95 for boxes of 22 or 24 (some kinds come in quantities of 22...others are 24).  If you sign up for the "Subscribe and Save", you'll save 15%....so that's a good deal.
