these cookies are a favorite of mine.  crisp, with just the right amount of ginger.  I don't know what the other comment is talkin about not havin enough ginger, my mouth gets very tingly when I eat them, and I think I like a lot of spice.

Mi-Del is the real deal and are great with coffee.Ingredients:  Organic unbleached wheat flour, organic dehydrated cane juice, canola oil, unsulphured molasses, ginger, baking soda, sea salt, soy lecithin (used as an emulsifier).  Product of Canada.Update:  I placed my order about 6-months ago and finally worked my way through the 12-pack.  They are not as fresh tasting now, of course but they still go great with my coffee and I consider them a healthy snack.  My sister thought they were too spicy but I love that ginger spice and just placed another order.

These cookies have a clean, crispy chocolate taste -- without the chemical-laced aftertaste of other commercially produced cookies. They are all-natural and made with canola oil, as opposed to the oils that can add to cholesterol problems. The ingredients are mostly organic and they are sweetened with dehydrated can juice, as opposed to the less-healthy commercial alternatives.Now, for the problem: I have never found these cookies in a market near me, and we have only purchased them through Amazon. Because these wonderful cookies are not pumped-up with weird chemical preservatives, the necessity of purchasing them in such big lots means that you are going to be eating a lot of cookies in a short period of time, or going in with a friend on sharing the case! However, given the high quality of this product, you should have no problem splitting up the order.Yummy and highly recommended!

column10: This is the cookie that is the bain of my existence. I absolutely love it.They taste best when they are really fresh so if you buy this 12 pack dont wait 6 months to eat them all ... they dont have a long shelf life ... they get hard and loose flavor even if you never open the bag. This is probably because they are made with natural ingredients and dont have the preservatives found in other cookies.But honestly i love these cookies they are sweet, crisp and very gingery ... even my sister and brother in law who don't eat anything "healthy" or "organic" because they think it wont taste good, where impressed with the taste of these cookies.Now they are hooked too and buy them all the time.

This cookie stands up very well to dunking in milk (about three dunked bites per cookie), and with mostly organic ingredients is about as guilt-free as possible in a cookie. We like a crisp ginger snap, and while the bag isn't self-sealing it seals well if you have a clip. We find the ginger level to be just right -- not overpowering, but definitely there.One correction to the ingredient list posted on this site -- there's no grape juice concentrate in the cookie, according to the bag I'm looking at right now and the Mi-Del website.Per serving size of 5 cookies: Calories 140; Total Fat 4g; Carbs 22g; Fiber 1g; Sugars 11g.

column4: Shop-til-you-drop DIANE "I want it ALL-I want...
column9: So good people are taking them from me!
column10: These cookies seemed to be a pretty good deal when I saw that there was a special offer on them. I LOVE cookies (who doesnt??) but am kinda picky about texture. I dislike soft mushy cookies although if desperate...but I know that "snap" cookies are usually not soft so I took a chance and ordered a case!  I live alone so a case of cookies was, at once, both frightening and decadent---but I think I am going to have to order another case!  Everyone who tasted these asked me "so where did you find these?"  Of course, since I am the online shopper from hell, everyone figured I found some obscure website and paid a fortune. "Natural" and "Organic" are buzz words for "gonna cost ya more" but the price was great per bag. After I told my friends and family who tasted them that I ordered a case---the bags started disappearing pretty fast! I got hit with guilt---What are YOU going to do with 12 bags of cookies? (duh--eat them!) and everyone was very happy to lighten up my stash by taking a bag so I dont overeat! Dont I have the BEST friends and family??? LOL  Seriously--I was happy to hand them over! I enjoy turning people on to new finds. I gave a bag to my Parcel Post guy and my UPS guy (after all--they lug all the boxes to my apartment!) and they were happy! And there is a method to my giving-away madness (especially to the carriers)! Less dropping and throwing around of MY boxes!Ok--they are nice and lemoney (?) but they could even be a bit more lemon-like for me! They are made with more healthful ingredients (no trans-fat) so even though I am pigging out on cookies--I dont feel nearly as guilty! And at less than $2 a bag--I think they are a greal deal! Plus it never hurts to have extra cookies in the house because a cookie emergency can happen at any given moment!  So--order them!  I think you will be pleased!

Crispy, chewy and intensely flavorful -- WOW, they are just great. I've loved ginger snaps since... forever. So, I've tasted lots of brands both good and bad. Some of them have no ginger taste at all -- We like to call them "flour snaps!"Mi-Del Old-Fashion, Swedish Style Ginger Snaps have great taste, healthful ingredients, and I highly recommend dunking in some hot coffee or tea for even more of that comfort food feel!If you don't like them... Well, I can only quote The Lovin' Spoonful:"It's like tryin' to tell a stranger 'bout rock and roll!"

Mi-Del Old-Fashion "Swedish Style" Lemon Snaps are a crispy, chewy, lemony delight! If you are always in search of healthy snacks that aren't short on flavor, these are the cookies for you.These Lemon Snaps are made with organic unbleached wheat flour, canola oil and natural lemon flavor -- there's no artificial "lolly-pop" lemon taste here. You can just imagine squeezing the lemon into the mix, yourself.Five cookies have 140 calories, so it's not too much for a little something to get you through your day, or after dinner as a light dessert without the guilt.Highly recommended. Yum!
i have to agree that these are delicious tasty cookies.  i'm not a vegan & i don't have a problem eating gluten. i just like yummy cookies & these cookies are yummy!
ya cant stop eatin them,they are so good,my friends are addicted to them,,were all gonna explode

These are healthful, smallish (about the size of vanilla wafers), tasty and flavorful snappy cookies.  They are sweet but not overly so and have a bit of that molasses taste that ginger snaps are known for.  They have a really nice ginger bite too.  They are great to have with some tea, milk or even coffee.

Look, I love ginger. Ginger ale/beer, pickled ginger at sushi restaurants, ginger salad dressings... and I love ginger cookies. I have tried who knows how many other brands of ginger snaps and _none_ are as good as these. Mi-Del ginger snaps are the MOST gingery. Spicy. I love how snappy they are.If you are really a fan of ginger, real spicy ginger, then these cookies are for you.

Mi-Del Swedish style ginger snaps are delicious and nutritious!  They are made with organic flour and ginger, and are great with any meal- especially with coffee or tea.  It is not easy to find these treats in a market- and ordering from Amazon is quick, easy, and cost effective.  They arrived promptly, without one broken ginger snap. Thanks, Amazon!

I eat these snaps by the pound, everyday, all day.  Anything ginger tastes good to me.  I'm signing up for the auto-ship, otherwise I'd make umpteen trips to the store.  Finding a cookie with unsulphured molasses is difficult & a requirement for me - I'm anaphylactic to sulphur.My husband is now munching them too, so I'll have to double my order!Thanks Mi-Del!  :)Kristina
These are great. You can't tell they are gluten free, they are just great ginger snaps. No after taste.  Super crispy.  May have to try some of the other flavors.

About five or six years ago I used to buy mi del cookies weekly hoping that the cookies wouldn't add inches to my waist line. From what I rememeber , it was really yummy but had to stop buying them because it's expensive.
I've been eating these cookies for years and years and they are so good - perfect texture, perfect taste - this is a great price - you can't go wrong with these healty ingredients.

I love to bake but I don't always have time.  When I'm really busy, I buy MI-DEL cookies because they taste as good as homemade. My favorite are the ginger snaps. They're crunchy with a real authentic ginger snap taste. I love knowing that they're all natural and the kids LOVE them.

Yes, they're hard and really spicy, but I like it!  And what other cookie can you eat 5 of for only 140 calories and 11 grams of sugar?  And ginger is an anti-inflammatory spice that is good for headaches, arthritis, high blood pressure, you name it!  And they're made with whole wheat and no refined sugar... Wow, this is the world's most perfect cookie!
Love them, very "gingery".  Great with your favorite tea or coffee.  Love that they are using natural ingredients.

column9: The Greatest Snap I Have Ever Snapped
column10: I dip these in my coffee -- alone they are probably a bit too crisp.  However, these have excellent flavor and a great ginger burn after you've had 5-10 of them.  Highly recommended.
Cookies are a little to hard for for me they taste okay but would not buy again sorry that's my review !

column9: Not Very Chocolately, A disappointing texture and flavor
column10: I bought these cause I'm a chocolate snap lover, and I had been craving some. The lack of trans fats and description drew me in.Let's just say this: I took these over to a family party, and none of the kids liked it. NOT ONE. And most of the adults, the best they could say was, 'Eh.' I think two folks had more than one.I'd have to say skip these cookies. They don't make your mouth sing with chocolatey snappy joy.
I received the Lemon Snaps faster than expected, but one of the bags was missing from the order. The cookies are ok, but not much lemon flavor. I give them a 5 out of a 10 rating.

column9: Not My Idea of Vanilla Snaps
column10: I absolutely love the Mi-Del ginger snaps, so I thought I'd try these in vanilla, thinking they'd be just as tasty.  Unfortunately, they didn't have the vanilla flavor I'd hoped for, and I wasn't crazy about their consistency.  They almost seemed stale, although I'm sure that's not the case.  As I actually prefer the name brand vanilla snaps, I gave these away to my local food pantry.

column9: Healthy snaps that taste good, too
column10: I ordered both the vanilla and the ginger snaps, and like both kinds. The high quality organic ingredients provide a "guilt-free" eating experience. I'm not sure if kids would go for them, but will try them out on my nephews next time I get a chance. I ordered two 12-packs so will have cookies for quite a while. Mine expire 6/20/08 so don't buy TOO many in advance.

I like the fact that the Mi-Del cookies are low-fat and use some organic ingredients.  I love the Mi-Del lemon and vanilla flavors, and their ginger snaps are ok -- BUT these chocolate snaps are no good.  I'm a chocolate lover, so this is rather disappointing.  The taste is similar to the ginger snap, but it's off quite a bit - slightly bitter.  It's as if they didn't put enough sugar in these snaps to counter the bitterness of cocoa powder. It also has a poor aftertaste that's slightly bitter (the lemon snap aftertaste is awesome keeps me wanting more).Gotta give it 1 star - yeah, I ate 10 of these to give them a chance, but I threw away the rest of the bag. The crunch and texture is the same as the other Mi-Del Snaps, but the flavor is off.  Not Recommended.
These cookies are hard & somewhatlacking in taste. We threw out half the bag.Mostly because my children did not likeginger snaps & my husband and I did not care for these.
Good aroma, good mouth feel, but the taste...flavorless.  Like a crunchy lump of flour.  Might help if they put some ginger in it.

column9: Still looking for the right on the run food
column10: I thought I would give these jelly beans a try after seeing numerous ads in my running/health magazines.  I thought, hey I love jelly beans why not give it a go.  I have used cliff shots, GU, power bars, almost every kind of endurance treats out there.  This was my latest trial.  They were not the best but they were not terrible.  I did notice a bit of a late run boost, but the taste is medicore at best.  I thought I was trying to swallow vitamins.  If taken without water beware of a gagging sensation.  However, I have a very sensitive stomach and low tolerance when I am distance running, so that might be the reason.  If you think they will taste like jelly beans beware, they do not.  I would just stick to the old reliable jelly belly jelly beans if you are looking for a tasty on the go treat.

column9: Grew up eating this and was glad to try it again!!
column10: I loved eating this soup growing up in CA.  I haven't lived in CA for many years and had not seen this soup in Colorado, until recently. Unfortunately, the store I found it at only carried it for a short time.  Thank Goodness for Amazon!  Found it on Amazon no problem and ordered 2 cases!  This soup may not be for everyone but my teenage daughters who had never eaten it before tried it recently, reluctantly and they both loved it! This soup is low calorie, no fat, high protein and filling. No wonder my health nut 70's mom loved this stuff! Pretty close to perfect I'd say!

column9: NO CONTEST; BEST PEA SOUP IN THE WORLD!!!!
column10: When I lived in Los Angeles I used to travel up to Buellton with a friend of mine and we always stopped at Andersen's for their fabulous food and of course, the pea soup for which they are deservedly famous. It is just like going to a friend's house who prepares home cooked food superbly (or has a private chef); it has a flavor like no other pea soup and I could tell it from all others blindfolded, it is fresh, subtle, wonderfully lacking in processed taste and is positively addicting. You need add nothing to it, no seasoning, no water no milk, etc, it stands on its own and very well without any supporting cast. I went with my Mom once and she raved about it too and she was very picky. Now it is available to buy and I am in Heaven just waiting for it to arrive.You are in for a real treat if you have never had it it is satisfying and rich and will keep you full and happy for a long time; the 15 oz size means you can get 2 meals out of it if you live alone like me; if you have more people of course it won't last as long, but when you buy it by the case, you can plan on buying it regularly as it will be in high demand. Bon appetit!
if you've ever eaten at one of their california restaurants, and like pea soup, this is as close to original as you can get.

I grew up eating this salame!  I have tried others but they never measure up to the Molinari brand.  This makes a GREAT Christmas gift for those on your list that you have no ideas for.  I give it every year to my boss and friends, they look forward to it every Christmas.

column9: For over 100 years the best salame in America
column10: My family has been eating Molinari salame and other Italian cold meats for well over 100 years - there are no better salami made in America and none that even remotely compare in value.  It's hard to find outside of Northern California, but worth ordering online!  When I was in college, my parents sent me whole salame and San Francisco sourdough care packages.

I had high hopes for this salame, but was really let down. Bland and tasteless, and I mean REALLY tasteless,your tongue searches your mouth for a hint of flavor and it's like nothing's there except a chewey, tasteless mass. The only thing I can think of is that Molnarihas terrible quality control to let a product likethis out of the plant. I have wasted money before, (I bought TWO of these 12 oz salamis which cost me more than $30), and this purchase takes the Grand Prize for stupidity.Deane E. Kogelschatz

This is my new favorite energy gum! Jolt Gum is good too, but Rockstar is just as good and contains NO SUGAR! The perfect blend of Caffeine, Taurine, and B-vitamins really gives me the energy and cognitive ability I need in a pinch ...and it tastes great! I highly recommend this product!

Product Packages on the back side of each and every gum pack had a black sharpee mark. I cleaned with acetone and underneath proved to be more than 2 years outdated. Old product will not stick in my mouth. Not healthy to chance
This is the best caffeinated gum I have tried.  It seems to work much more effectively than Jolt gum (maybe just larger pieces).I will keep ordering it.
Excellent energy gum.  Why is it not on the shelves.  Please consider.  Have not been able to find it anywhere locally

I was introduced to this product from a fellow colleage who drives 50 miles one-way to work! A long stretch of highway on a sunny day can be very monotonous, leading to drowsiness. One of these gum pieces relieves me of feeling drowsy. It has saved me many times.

I had been looking for something to give me some energy that wasn't a drink to keep from getting weighed down. This gum was just the fix I was looking for. When it's time to work out, I'm driving long distances and start to fade, I'm dragging at work, or I just need a kick in true pants I pop two pieces and feel like a champ!!

The gum is a nice ice mint (almost like the black Dentyne Ice flavor) flavor, however, after only about 5-10 minutes, it has lost the majority of the flavor, and the gum becomes somewhat gritty.  For those used to caffeine, this gum is not a great source of energy.  It is, however, a good starter for those who do not commonly ingest caffeine.  Being mildly sensitive to caffeine myself, I found the buzz from a single piece (40 mg of caffeine) to be the perfect amount.
This gum is very minty and powerful. It gives you a little kick after you chew it for a small period of time. It does get nasty after a while of chewing tho. The gum shipped fast too.
This gum does the job and  more.The taste isn't the greastest but I got used to it quick. Great product!
As far as energy gum goes, this is cheap. But, it contains aspartame. Beware of aspartame!!! Sucralose is good...if they'd stuck with that instead it's be fine.

I feed my dog go endurance grain free daily and he loves that but when a can of this comes out of the box..oh you gotta watch his excitement. Its got excellent ingredients and it also have plenty of fiber which give him decent soft poo. Highly recommend this.
This harissa is really a 'Super Sauce'. It's fantastic on everything I put it on. I can't have enough of it. Great product Mina.

column9: Cheap ingredients = you get what you pay for
column10: I've had many harissas and often have made my own.  While this isn't the worst I've had (that stuff in the yellow tube is), it just doesn't have the robust flavor of a true harissa.  The addition of bell pepper and vinegar make it less versatile and pure if you're looking for the real deal.

column9: Honest Tea Organic Peach White Tea Great Tea
column10: Loved it! Great mild organic tea and very convenient to have a case or 2 delivered to your front door for free!! Saves time and money. This tea has a mile sweet taste, not to overbearing. It is made with white tea which has the least amount of fluoride in it of all the teas since white tea leaves are the youngest of the tea leaf plant, which is something that green or black tea leaves are not. (Just something extra to think about when you are drinking green tea, lots of fluoride, black tea is the worst for you!). Get it you won't be sorry.

I've been drinking Honest Tea since last year when I discovered it while searching for a good quality bottled tea (when I can't get freshly brewed).It tastes really good, despite the fact I'm a Southerner and ya'll know how we like our sweet tea! Think syrup.Try one and see for yourself-plus you've got the added bonus it's organic.
Great Peach Flavor , not too sweet Just right  All flavors are great that this company makes ,would buy this item again

Love this tea! I love the delicate taste and the not-too-sweet combination of white tea with peach. And it's not so loaded with caffeine that I can't sleep at night. Only problem is keeping the hubby from drinking my stash!

Great taste, super healthy for you.  So much better than the "corporate' brands of teas, like Lipton's and Snapple.  White tea leaves have the most anti-oxidants and the addition of a little organic sweetener and peach flavor makes this a perfect thirst quencher.  MMmm.

In the search for a reasonably healthy way to get a *mild* caffeine kick in the morning, this is by far the best I've found. 85 calories and 30mg of caffeine. Coffee may give you fewer calories but for me it has way too much caffeine. Soda is too caloric and I'm not a fan of the carbonation. This stuff fits the nutrition parameters I've been looking for and tastes pretty good too. Another thing I like is that it doesn't taste so great that I want to down 10 bottles in a morning. I usually open one up at 8am and finish it around 10:30am.So far this (amazon) is the only place I've been able to find it in bulk.  At ~$1.50 a bottle (and 1 bottle per day), it's more expensive than I'd like it to be, but that is about the only knock I can give this drink.

Love the product, but for the second shipment in a row, Amazon packaging has been deficient.  First time one of the twelve bottles of tea was cracked and the contents had leaked out all over the other bottles.  This time, the box was torn open and the bottles were rolling around loose inside.Amazon: you need to do a better job here!

column9: I use it to make a face mask
column10: I do not use this spice to cook. I use it to make a face mask due to the antioxidants, along with chick pea flour and almond oil and bit of milk. It does wonders for the skin. I have combination skin and this helps with breakouts and oil control. I use it weekly and since i've began using it gives my skin a youthful glow and elasticity. I recommend you try it.
I ordered the turmeric because I was tired of paying a big price for a tiny container.  This product is a great value for the size and the money spent!
You get a very large supply in this order. Dr. Oz recommends using turmeric and I have often tasted it as an ingredient in curry powder. Very happy with the amoung received and the fast service.
But it ships fast and does a great job for seasoning and other needs.  I got it in less than a week, the price was great.

i just receive this today,and i love it ,i got way more than expected for the price. thank you so much. although it took a week and half to get to me,but its okay since its coming from India,i understand. Anyway i dont cook,i store sweaters in my stove,so ill be using it for a face mask.

column9: The Coffee Cake recipe was amazing!
column10: I am surprised by the other reviews. We found this at our local grocery store and we were pleasantly surprised by the price which was way cheaper than most gluten free foods. My two boys and I made the coffee cake recipe on the back of the box and we really liked it. It had great texture and was just like "normal" coffee cake. I am going to put this on my "subscribe and save" list and make the coffee cake a regular weekend treat.

column9: Hodgson Mill Gluten Free Multi Purpose Baking Mix
column10: To say my wife is allergic to foods is an understatement. It would be easier to list the foods to which she does not have an allergic reaction. The Hodgson Mill Gluten Free Multi Purpose Baking Mix is one of them.Note that the Product Features listed for this product on-line state that it is made with ... soy ...  But the box does not list soy as an ingredient. My wife is allergic to soy. I first saw this product at a store and the actual 4 ingredients listed on the box, my wife did not have any known allergic reactions. So I bought it for her to try. She loves it and has no problems with it. She also adds a little honey when mixing and helps to give a sweeter taste.She makes a bunch of waffles with it at one time and keeps them in the refrigerator and takes one with her whenever she goes someplace to munch on when she needs a little snack.Also note that the ingredients list under the Important Information heading on-line states the true contents. I also buy it with the Amazon Subscribe & Save option and get it cheaper.

This is my favorite all purpose GF flour mix.  What this is great for are those times you just need a bit of flour for something where it's not the main feature, like apple crisp topping.  I like the mix because it's made with whole grain flours (healthy), no bean flours are included (yuck), and it's a reasonable price.  I have used it in a number of recipes with success. I wouldn't make loaf bread with it though.  Best used in combination with other flours/ingredients.  I never used bisquick or any other baking mixes before going gluten free so it doesn't bother me that it's not that type of mix.

column9: Still trying to scrape the flavor out of my mouth :-P
column10: If this was the only gf mix available, I'd probably kill myself. I tried using it to make the brownies on the box a couple of weeks ago and they came out awful. Dry and with a definite dirt flavor. It was terrible!!! Anyway, I wasn't sure if I'd made some type of mistake so I just tried it again in a chocolate cake recipe. I'm literally sitting here sucking on candy and trying to get that god awful flavor out of my mouth. Totally money down the drain because the cake is sitting in the garbage. I bought this one because it didn't have sugar added to it and I prefer to use xylitol, but if sugar is not an issue then I'd definitely buy the betty crocker gf cake mix boxes or the one that comes in a brown paper bag. I can't remember the name but it's delicious unlike this atrocity.

I bought this mix and made mini rum cakes using the Bacardi Rum recipe. OMG. My dad is going to REALLY love these. He hasn't had rum cake in a LONG time due to his need for gluten free diet. Thanks for such a wonderful mix.

I received this baking mix as a gift, and I tried it with a soft and chewy molasses cookie recipe.  I shared the cookies with a mixed group of friends: some that have to eat gluten-free some that do not.  They all loved the cookies and no one mentioned any bitter after taste that another reviewer mentioned.  I would recommend these for dark breads, cookies, and cakes, of the spice variety, such as banana bread, zucchini bread, molasses cookies, gingerbread cookies, carrot cake etc.  This works well for dark colored doughs and should work well to bake a gluten-free alternative to whole wheat bread.  I would NOT recommend this for light and fluffy buttermilk pancakes, white cakes, or other baked goods where a few simple flavoring ingredients like chocolate chips or peanut butter need to shine through.  For the right application, this is a whole grain, healthy, easy-to-use gluten-free alternative to traditional flour mixes.

column9: best gluten free baking mix i have ever tried!
column10: I am not sure what others are tasting but this mix exceeded my expectations.  I am a very experienced baker and have missed  the taste of wheat for too long! So far I have made pancakes and muffins using this flour blend and it tastes like their whole wheat cousins.  White rice was never meant to be a flour and this mix proves it.  It contains whole grains that are used for flours all over the world and have a real taste and flavor, unlike white rice flour.  I am very pleased.
This has been a good substitute for wheat flour in quick breads like biscuits. It helps to add some xanthum gum with it though because it can be a little crumbly.

I am a veteran Bob's Red Mill All-Purpose GF Flour user, who has recently switched to Hodgson.There are benefits and drawbacks I've noticed.Benefits:It does not have the weird bean-y smell that Bob's mixes have.It crisps nicely, for crispy tops on cookies, brownies, ect.I find that I need less sugar in recipes with this mix.Drawbacks:Can't use it in everything.Needs more baking soda in recipes or yeast to rise more.Don't know if I need to store it in the fridge or not!Final verdict: Better than Bob's Red Mill, but still looking for the ultimate GF all-purpose mix.

column9: Coffee Cake recipe got rave reviews from my non-gluten-free friends.
column10: I would have to agree that this mix is great. I just made the coffee cake this past weekend and was worried that my non-gluten free friends wouldn't like it.  They loved it! 1 person even asked me for the recipe. ( I even made it sugar-free with Stevia.) I highly recommend this mix as well.

A friend made me pancakes out of this mix when we came over for a "breakfast for dinner" night--and I was surprised by how normal they tasted! Now, granted, it's not wheat--but it's not bad. Even the husband liked them, and he's quite picky about GF cooking (we've been burned in the past). It's nicer than having to buy the individual flours and mix them yourselves, and the flavors blended nicely--and no gritty bean flours!

I have been gluten free for almost ten years, and this is probably # 5 in the top ten worst substitutes I have ever tried. It had a weird, bitter aftertaste that was very prevalent in the waffles, not as much in the sweeter coffee cake but still very off-putting. Also, the cake batter was too thick to pour and I had to smear it into the pan. Hodgson Mill needs to change this produce or lose it all together. It is sad because I love their gluten free oats, buckwheat cereal, flax seed, baking powder, xanthan gum, etc. I would try Pamela's multi-purpose baking mix, it tastes more like the real thing.

A BAD mix from a GOOD company. Hodgson Mills makes many good products. This IS NOT one of them. It is NOT the "gluten free" version of Bisquick or any other quick baking mix. There is nothing quick about this. All that is in this product is a few varieties of Gluten free flours. There is no sugar, baking powder, baking soda, egg, guar or xanthan gum (nothing to hold the finished product together for those of you who are new to Gluten Free Baking). Items you try to make with this mix as is will fall apart and taste bad. In other words, this is a mix you HAVE to experiment with in order to make things come out looking or tasting good at all. Most of us who have to eat Gluten Free foods are looking for shortcuts like every other busy person on the planet. This mix will add to your busy time, not relieve you. Try Bob's Red Mill Baking Mix or the Gluten Free Pantry Baking Mix for a better experience.

column9: Bitter aftertaste with chocolate chip cookies
column10: Being new to GF cooking, I purchased this recipe to make my GF toddler the chocolate chip cookies from the recipe on the box.  The consistency is fine but there's a very bitter aftertaste.  When a two year old doesn't even finish one cookie, you know something is wrong!  it may be better in other recipes, but I don't recommend the chocolate chip cookies.

This is the most horrendous mix I have ever used.  I have been gluten-free for two years now, and I was excited to see this mix.  It is significantly less expensive than other mixes.  Sadly, it tastles like potting soil smells.  I tried making the coffee cake recipe that one of the earlier reviewers loved, and it was rancidly bad.  I got goosebumps it was so bad--no lie.  Thirty minutes later I still feel that I should have daisies planted in my mouth.  Buy the Gluten-free Pantry flour.  It is pretty close to what I remember regular flout tasting like without the dirtlike aftertaste.

column9: Bought via Groupon...not as fresh as I hoped.
column10: I bought these macarons through Groupon and only spent $24. When they arrived, the cool pack was warm to the touch. The macarons were wrapped in plastic in sets of 12. I was excited to have that fresh macaron taste, but I was sorely disappointed. They lacked the typical moisture and the flavors were a bit bland. Even though I put them in the fridge, they are getting harder and less tasteful by the minute. I guess nothing beats fresh macarons from Paris!

I can't say how the macaron tastes because my groupon order never arrived but I can comment on the companies lack of customer service.  It appears by the other reviewer that I got lucky that the macarons never came but it was completely frustrating that I was waiting for them for a birthday present.  The birthday came and went and finally found out after that the macarons were delivered elsewhere.  I called and emailed Dessert Hub repeatedly, no one answered the phone, called me back or responded to my emails.  I would never deal with that company again.

My English bully is on a wheat flour free diet and this is perfect for his tummy. I have tried mixing it with Holistic Select to try to get him off of it because there aren't any local dealers who order this for me & I can only purchase online... however he LOVES this food & it is the only food that doesn't make him sick. So I am going to sacrifice for my baby & continue to purchase it. It is a little more expensive however there isn't a cost on my bullies health & happiness!

column9: Locally hard to find GREAT PRODUCT ! ! !  GREAT SERVICE!
column10: This puppy food is not sold locally where I live so Amazon and Wag.com came through with gold star standards! After a fair amount of research online this is the best way to get your puppy food delivered to your door on time or actually 2 days EARLIER than scheduled!!! Great experience!

Tried these for the first time at dinner tonight(with fish), they are an unusual vivid green colour, however, their taste is excellent. My 3 children also liked them alot. I will definately have these again.
I'm in college and decided to "splurge" on some decent ramen, this turned out to be delicious, but at 4 bucks a pop, I minus well buy a footlong at subways.. too expensive for my blood

I was actually surprised to find that I love this stuff.  I use it in tea and coffee and find that it is just as good as sugar with no aftertaste like other "alternative sweeteners".  I also used it in my Oatmeal cookies for most of the sugar and the kids didn't even notice.  Awesome.  If you use a lot, you do get a slight taste that reminds me of brown sugar - but that's not a bad thing.  I will be buying more!  (but not for a while - you'd be surprised how long this little bottle lasts!)

column9: Yummy! (at least the cats think so)
column10: I have four cats, and trying to get them all to eat the same food was a real chore.  They were on the Wellness Core kitten/cat formula, but my older two were not gaining the weight that they needed to for some reason.  So I decided to switch their food after over a year.  I really agonized over the change since I do have one cat that is a VERY picky eater.  I can't even begin to describe how delighted I was when I put this in their bowl and she was the first one to run over and start to gobble it up.  They have been eating it for a couple of months now, and the two older cats have started to gain their weight back.  I am a happy owner and my cats are happy fuzzballs.  :)

column9: This is my Cats' favorite Blue Cat Food
column10: Although my cats will eat other Blue Cat food types.  This one they like best. They eat less and slower than the Purina cat food I was giving them.  I like that they are not getting meat by-products, corn and wheat since 1 cat has some food allergies.  He also used to gorge on the purina and then promptly throw it up.  This is expensive, but since they eat it much slower, it appears to equal out some in price and have much better ingredients for them.  We'll stick with this one for a while!

I do not have finicky cats, but I liked the thought of getting them extra scrumptious food. It might as well be tuna to them, they go crazy over it- even compared to Blue Buffalo's other flavors and other premium pet foods. The ingredients are comparable with more expensive pet foods. It still seems a little pricey at first, but my cats seem satisfied with the small portions recommended on the bag. Small portions = less litter waste too. The LifeSource Bits were a major selling point for me, but I wish the information on them was less ambiguous. The only thing I did not like was that my cats didn't seem to feel the need to chew the tiny kibbles very often.

I have NEVER tasted a substance like this that is so addictive.  I have eaten it on bread, pretzels, crackers, chips, veggies, fruit....this mustard is in a class all of it's own.  I don't even think of it as a mustard...it is more like a food frosting.  Once you try this, you will be hooked.  It is not hot, it is sweetly spiced...I cannot even describe this...but I can tell you, that I could eat it by the spoonfuls.  I never write reviews, but I HAD to on this one.  We bought it on a recent trip to North Carolina and devoured a jar in one week.  Do yourself a favor and get some of this stuff, you will be SOOO glad you did!  My next jar, I will be mixing some curry into it and drench it on Thai noodles...

Cherith Valley Red Rasberry Wasabi Mustard is our favorite  condiment on anyculinary snack, sandwich, meats, etc..  Three of us (and Friends)have consumed 18 jars in the last two years.Should keep it on hand year round.

If it were not so much trouble I would return this product. I am a great blue cheese lover but these olives do not contain anywhere near the blue cheese I am accustomed to. The cheese is so mild it might as well not even be in the olives. The olives are OK but to pretend they are stuffed with blue cheese is a grossly misleading statement.  Purchasing this product is a waste of money.
I had Blue Cheese olives at a party and thought to buy these...these are not good olives let alone blue cheese...do not buy these they are horrible!
Very tasty, smallish and classy stuffed olives for martini's.  I've tried all of he flavors and there're great but I like the blue cheese the most.  Definitely ordering more.

column9: PERFECTLY DELICIOUS OLIVES FOR SNACKING & ALL USES!!
column10: I like to consider myself an olive connoisseur.  I just love olives and have tasted just about every kind.  These have got to be the most perfect olive because they have the right amount of brine and firmness to make it such.  So many other olives I have tasted were usually too salty and too soft.  But these are absolutely delicious.  I bought them for martinis but found myself eating them like a snack and I cannnot stop eating them ~ they are actually addictive!  I will be sure to stock on these goodies because they will be gone very soon.  Plus the extremely fast free prioirty mail shipping from Amazon makes it a great and convenient deal!!
Great flavour! The size of container was a bit smaller than I expected. The canister itself is a flat surface but looks very nice. Would make for a good finishing oil or to use in dressings.

column9: Organic Hawaiian Red Alaea Sea Salt
column10: A friend mentioned to me about this sea salt so I decided to try it.  It is delicious with a little bang in flavor.

column9: Love that combonation of sea salt, and clay.
column10: This is a mixture of sea salt, natural sea salt, and clay, very good tasting salt, great for adding to purified water along with baking soda to alkalize it.

Years ago, they used to sell packaged brownies at the dollar store, dime stores, etc. They came 12 or so to a flat. They were the cheapest treat you could buy in the store, at about a nickle each. That's what these brownies remind me of and that's not a good thing. These things are very dense, not in a GOOD "chewy-chocolaty-moist and gooey" kind of way, but more along the lines of "grainy-gummy-rubbery and nasty. The is very little flavor and no distinction between the cream filling and the chocolate shell. These are not terrible, but for the name Oreo and the steep price point, I expected much, much, much more!

Okay, so these brownies are not exactly the healthiest snacks in the world but you get a lot of them for a good price. A pack of 4 with 10 brownies in each box is more than enough to satisfy your chocolate cravings.
Very delicious! Of course I didn't buy them from Amazon. I'm sure they'd still be good though if they didn't get smashed in the mail.

This tastes exactly like it is homemade. The jar is so generous with artichokes, I was shocked. The seasoning is mild and it is tasty on chicken with added fresh Parmasean cheese. I also tried it with bruschetta bread and found I ate too many pieces! In fact it was dinner one night with a salad.There are so many uses for this sauce. If you like tomatoes and artichokes, you will love this product. When you read other reviews you will see adverse comments on packaging. I think the manufacturer must have corrected it since the jars came in a nicely made, well fitting box lined with styrofoam on the top and bottom and dividers.  The product containers are thick plastic with a screw on lid that could also be reused. I washed a couple in my DW and they held up perfectly.

I found this product to have a heavy olive brine flavor to it.  The product had little tomato flavor and while there are plenty of artichokes all I really taste is olive.  I added fresh diced tomato prior to using with guests.

I have bought Artichoke Bruschetta spread at Costco and I have made it myself. I love the stuff. I was pretty excited to see this available on amazon. It even comes beautifully packaged. Unfortunately this is a poorly seasoned tomato sauce with a few chunks of pitted olives and artichokes floating in it. It is not really thick enough to be a bruschetta topping and I really did not care for the way it was seasoned at all. It had an almost licorice taste to it that overpowered everything else. I am not even sure how I can doctor it into something we will eat. I am bummed.

I've tried many Scarpetta products but this one is truly scrumptious!  Some of the other reviews stated that the jars arrived outdated.  I've had that happen to me too.....once before..... and just ended up throwing out the four jars since they were UNDOUBTEDLY spoiled.  Unfortunately I never thought to complain to Amazon and ask for replacements......live and learn.....I knew food could not be returned but replacing bad, outdated food.....I should have realized I could do that!!  However, those were the sauce, not this bruschetta topping.  This topping has a wonderful fresh home-made tomato flavor and the artichokes are whole and delicious.  I ate two of the jars on bagel chips but just used a spoon on the third.  Mmmmmm good!!  The fourth jar I gave as a gift to my uncle.  He did not care for this bruschetta as much as the ones his many friends make for him becaue they use lots and lots of garlic and black olives which he loves much more than artichokes.  This topping is mild but so very flavorful.  If I don't eat it all just by itself, I'll try it on fish or chicken like some of the other reviewers suggested.  It really is a very versatile topping.  I highly recommend it to everyone.

I hate to be the bearer of bad news, 2 of the containers lost their seal and went bad. I looked at the other 2 containers and the expiration date was Jan 08. Gimme a break! They arrived 04/25/08. I'll give them the benefit of the doubt and will negate this bad review if the replacement is fine.

column9: Scarpetta Tomato and Artichoke Bruschetta Topping
column10: I first had bruschetta at a house warming. I was stunned by how fantastic it was. This particular product does have a generous amount of artichokes and is very yum, but not quite as good as fresh homemade. Goes well with toasty garlic rubbed bread. The container has a tamper-evident seal under the screw-down lid that needs to be fully removed before it is safe for the microwave. Even the smallest bit that remains on the edge can spark up and release some nasty smoke that not only smells bad, but can flavor your bruschetta in a bad way.

I ordered a total of 6 Scarpetta products.  4 arrived fine and 2 were leaking.  Amazon's great customer service promptly sent a replacement (but that has a leaking jar too).  This stuff tastes fantastic.  Check it upon arrival and if it arrives with a broken seal the request a replacement.

This is SO GOOD!!!  I froze the containers and break one out every so often--and it's just like I spent all day long making it at home.  It's good for you, and tastes like something really special.  I served it with fish and chicken, with a nice crackly french bread and a salad... So good!!!
Amazing on everything: chicken, fish, pasta. And for a late night snack: just spoon it out of the jar.

This sauce is terrific!  It was sent promptly, well packaged in re-usable plastic jars.  It has a robust taste and a nice consistency.  I cooked up some ground turkey and chopped onions, made a spaghetti squash and pulled out the "spaghetti" part, and mixed it all up in a casserole with the Bruschetta topping.  I added a little mozzarella cheese and baked it - yummy and very healthy!  I will be ordering this sauce regularly.

Restaurant quality, homemade taste. Quick and easy appetizer, try on grilled or toasted italian bread and top with parmesan cheese...has an equally nice amount of black olives.  Great to top on firm fish and bake or to toss with pasta as a quick meal.  I've had no problems with the containers not being sealed on any of their products.

We love this sauce and are so glad we bought it.  I wish it were still on sale!It has a homemade, pure taste.We enjoyed it as a bruschetta the other night andjust had it over Barilla whole wheat penne pasta last night......délicieux, delizioso, delicioso!(On the side...The jars are great... can be reused for all sorts of things).

I was away from almost all civilization and wanted chrysanthemum tea so amazon.com saved me by selling it online. I received it in great strong packaging (perhaps too much since it was a box with the product and filler within another box). The flowers looked clean and fresh and when brewed it produced a nice light yellow tea. It tastes just as good or better than the usual Chinese chrysanthemum tea I'm used to, so I'm very happy with this product. I would also highly recommend buying loose leaf or loose flower teas so you can adjust it to your own or guest's tastes!
This is my first chrysanthemum tea, and I enjoy it for a smooth tea.  It goes down easy, with a subtle flavor, and looks great in a glass mug.

column9: Extremely Helpful for Eye Strain - Terrific Natural Remedy
column10: I was really developing a problem with computer eye strain/syndrome.  I am pretty well-read on this subject and I was trying to address it in different ways, but NOTHING helped the way that white chrysanthemum tea does.To quote thelistlady: "The chrysanthemum has long been used in traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) for eye care. The flower is beneficial for correcting imbalances in kidney and liver function that is a cause of dry eyes, blurred vision, dizziness, spots in front of the eyes and excessive tearing. One of my favorite TCM doctors, Dr. Maoshing Ni, writes in his book "Secrets of Longevity" about how chrysanthemum flowers reduce pressure buildup in the eyes.Some flowers are awfully beneficial for the eyes.  Many eye supplements contain marigold extracts.Leave it to God's garden to provide awesome remedies for the things that ail us.Chrysanthemum blends well with "clean" green and white teas if you are in the market for caffeine.  Otherwise you can drink it on its own for its fantastic health benefits.
The Chrysanthemu Tea reched me well, unfortunaltely have two packages been openend and reclosed. The tea otself is very well, of good flavour and well dried.

column4: dan "there is more than one way to skin a cat"
column10: This makes excellent and aromatic tea. All you need is a tea strainer and this wonderful tea is yours. The tea leaves come a bit bunched up however, you need to do some separating. However, this is not difficult to do and the tea tastes great!

I will definately be repurchasing this lime juice. .while it does taste pretty good I don't just use this for drinking but I use it as a deodorant I just put it in a spray bottle and do a couple squirts under each arm and I put a lil of the roll on crystal mineral deodorant and I will be fresh all day!!! I could never just use the crystal alone a get the same results. .I also have been using this to make an aspirin paste for my tragus piercing bump and I have tried everything and the aspirin alone wasn't good enough until I put this lime juice in it and my bump is pretty much gone as well as swelling. .I can't wait to use this for something else. .I love it!!

Cherrystone clams are great--smaller, more tender, and more flavorful than regular clams.  There are plenty of them in this chowder along with plenty of potatoes.  In that respect I disagree with the previous reviewer.  I like this so much I have a subscription for a new shipment every 6 months.
to many potatoes, if I wanted potatoe soup I would have order it  -----  Chuck

Besides being smaller than runts, they look the same and have the same consistency.  Unfortunately, they taste nothing like banana runts...nor do they even taste good.  Yucky stuff.  Trying to return with vendor.
just like the runtsgreat flavor, def worth gettingI even ordered again 2 wks latter (all gone)just like I remember :)

The item over all was fine, but the Banana Heads are not just like Banana Runts they are alot smaller. Also when I received the item, the packaging was not great. The Banana Heads had come open during shipping and were all over the packing envelope.
I purchased as a giveaway for a baby shower with Jungle theme! They worked out perfect for 25 small bags of candy. I purchased 5#. If you want more than 25 small bags, I would purchase a larger bag.

The product itself is good. Supposed to be different fruit flavors but I can't tell the difference. However my local grocery has these for $2 each and had a $1 off coupon a while ago. I suppose if you can't find them anywhere then you might have to pay this price...

With God's helping hand, we recently walked the 500 miles from St. Jean Pied de Port, France to Santiago de Compostela, Spain. I bought a bag of Facundo Extra Grandes Pipas (or Sunflower Seeds as we know them here in the States)and was hooked.I sometimes couldn't find this brand to buy along the way, and didn't enjoy the other brands in comparison, either they were too salty, or not fresh enough. So when I found a Tienda that carried this brand I would by 4 or 5 packs at a time, even though keeping pack weight as light as possible was so crucial.I just finished my last pack now that we are home and went online to find more. But all the sources available are sold out. I will have to go back to my regular brand, which in no way compares to these Extra Grandes.By-the-way, this Pilgrimage was an amazing undertaking. And enjoying the sunflower seeds as I walked was very insignificant in the whole scheme of things. If you would like to know more, read "Hiking the Camino, 500 miles with Jesus" by Fr. Dave.
This is my favorite iced tea.  I hate that I cannot find it in stores.  I ordered it for my mom, because she loves it too.  Of course I would come over her house just to drink some.

It's pretty much the only thing we drink at home.  Tastes great and everyone likes it.  It doesn't need to be made as strong as the instructions and actually taste better with a lighter dose then recommended.
LOVE this product!!  If you are looking for something tasty without caffeine, get this!  It's AWESOME!! I can't live without it!

My daughter served this tea (4C Iced Tea Mix Red Tea Antioxidant Peach)when we visited her in CT where the humidity and heat was high...since then, she moved back to CO where I live.  She surprised me with a can at Christmas as a funny present....My husband and I love this tasty drink! Don't be fooled by the "peach" flavor....it tastes great!

The 12" size takes my 5 month lab up to a week to work through. She did just get all of her permanent teeth in, so maybe that time will speed up given some months. Yes, they do have a bit of a smell, but it's more like I get an occasional whiff when she's chewing on it.  If the chew is just lying around, I don't smell anything.  They haven't left any stains on my carpets, and she hasn't lost interest in them.

I am a frequent user of bully sticks from other vendors online and from pet stores. These are listed as "THICK" bully sticks. I usually buy thick ones from another vendor and my German Shepherd pup loves them and they last a couple of days. These arrived and I was immediately disappointed. Many of them are the thickness of a pencil or slightly thicker. They are about 1/3 the thickness of the "thick" bully sticks I usually buy. But I did not want to deal with sending them back so I gave one to my pup. It smelled HORRIBLE, like a person who had not washed in weeks. My pup liked them okay but because they are so thin she can eat an entire, 12" one in under an hour. Will NOT buy these again.

Straight from my two Incredibly wonderful and literate Basengi girls: They are not as hard as others but they smell just the same. They have have helped sparing many corners of furniture. Bring them on! Bailey and Brandy.
My dog loves them!  They are perfect to keep her busy for a long time.  They do smell a little, so best to give them to your dog outside or in separate room.

column4: K. Likins "The Further we go the Stranger it ...
column10: Having a puppy means having enough things for him to chew on. I love these bully sticks because they last a really long time and can keep him busy chewing for what seems like forever. Because they last so long they are economical as you don't have to buy them week after week. Bottom line is he loves them and I lvoe that he loves them.

Great chew toy, long lasting, dogs loved them. Would highly recommend, especially as an alternative to rawhide chews.- these are much easier to digest and therefore easier on the stomach for my dogs with sensitive tummies

My dog loves bully sticks and we try to find good natural ones for her to chew on.  They are healthy and good for dog's teeth.  I am very pleased with the purchase, and my dog loves them.  No bad smell when she eats them.  Will definitely buy again!
I have 2 dogs that love these things.  Nice to get a large quanity, because buying them at the store individually can cost 2-3 times as much.

First of all, the sizes vary a bit, which in fact I love especially if you have different sized pups. Most of them are very thick with some smaller sized mixed in.  Love that they are grass fed and hormone/antibiotic free. This is EXTREMELY important to me!!! The length was near perfect on every one. The smell was minimal. My dog loved them and I recently purchased more. The price is out of this world!!!! I was paying over $7.00 for one, locally. Great product, great price, great value!

My dog loves these bully sticks, she is a 20 lb beagle and usually takes a few days to finish one but for some reason with these she is going through them within a day.  I received the product quickly and in great condition.  Thanks!

I purchased the 12" bully sticks (7 pack) from Downtown Pet Supply about a week ago.  One of my two dogs recently passed away, and the other was feeling a little depressed.  I wanted to give her a "special treat", but also hoped that these would help perk up her poor appetite since her sister's passing.  Boy have these done the trick!  I let her chew on the stick for about 30 minutes & then took it away.  Low and behold, she remembered she was hungry and ate all of her food!  She is a 50lb Lab mix who is very healthy at 13.5 years old.  In the past I had purchased 6" bully sticks at a local pet supply store for $5 each.  These sticks come out to be just under $3.50/stick and are twice the size!  This purchase was well worth it -- quality product for a great price.  I will re-order again.  Thank you!

column9: Great Value, but the smelliest so far.
column10: My 13 week old GSP puppy loves bully sticks. He loves to chew and will chew these for hours. I ordered the 7 pack of 12."  They are nice sized, and 1/2 the price of the local pet shop's brands.  But, they smell the worst out of all the brands I have tried so far. So, we will not be ordering them again.  I won't describe the smell. Its vulgar.

column9: Downtown Pet Supply 12" Bully Sticks 20 pk. thick
column10: The dogs absolutely love them but their odor is awful - like rotting fish. I have bought this product many times and noticed that some batches smell much worse than others.

This product is the same price as a bag of 15 to 20 bully sticks and yours comes 4 in a package for this price.  It was my mistake to not see 4 in a package but I saw instead 12" bully sticks with a photo of a large bag of bully sticks.  Very deceptive.  Why not put a photo of the 4 bully sticks one receives.  I will never buy them from you again.

I was hesitant to purchase this product after reading other reviews about them not being "thick".  But, since I couldn't find any other thick bully sticks on here, I thought I'd give them a shot.  Well, I am very disappointed!  They are not thick at all.  They are the same, "slim jim" thickness as every other bully stick I've bought before.  I'm not even sure why they advertise them as thick.  The thickest one is MAYBE as big around as a dime.  Not at all what I expected, and I won't order them again. I kept them just because they are at least cheaper than the same size ones I can get at the store - and it's a pain to have to return them.  My 10 month old beagle consumed one in less than an hour, start to finish.  I was hoping to find something that would last longer than that!

My brother suggested I try some of this BBQ sauce. It's literally the best I've ever had. Sweet yet just a little tangy and full flavored. I'd recommend it highly to anyone. You'd think that there couldn't be a new great BBQ sauce with everything that's on the shelves, but this is special.
Love this BBQ sauce... can't wait for this to be more available, I buy it up if I see a few at the local stores.

I love this dressing, although I'm not a salad eater...I don't buy it for salad dressing. I put in in sour cream for dip with veggies and unsalted chips or if you like Lays Potatoe Chips. My family loves it when I do it for Thanksgiving...its the first thing that goes.

I LOVE this stuff.  I used to get it at my local Kroger, but it disappeared from the shelves one week and never came back.  I was so happy to find it on Amazon.  I use raspberry balsamic vinegar with it.  HEAVEN!

column9: Dress it Up, Dress it Down - The Very, Very Best Salad Dressing Ever
column10: I'm a salad nut and picky about what I put in and on my daily salads.  I grew up on Good Seasons dressings and have used them for well over forty - ok, almost fifty years now  - yes, they have been around that long!  They are the best tasting salad dressings out there, and while I've used many, many other dressings over the years - from bottled to homemade - the Good Seasons Salad Dressing family is my favorite.Back in the 60s I think we always made the dressings with vegetable oil and apple cider vinegar, but after I got out on my own and widened my food horizons, I find I love Good Seasons even more. Vinegar is the big secret with these dressings - change the type of vinegar you use and you dramatically change the flavor!  In the 80s I started using red wine and white wine vinegars, which gave it a whole new taste.  In the 90s Basalmic vinegar was the way to go and my foodie friends were never so impressed!  Now my vinegar of choice is a rice vinegar, especially with the Zesty Italian and this flavor - Garlic and Herb.  But other vinegars are great too - try it with malt vinegar for a change of pace.My other trick is that I now make my dressing with a healthier canola oil, rather than the vegetable oil of the old days.  I've also made it with olive oils, but I don't use olive oil as a general rule, only because the oil solidifies in the refrigerator and you have to take it out ahead of time to soften it.  I'm just not that good at planning ahead, so I'll stick with canola.  I also use a bit more of both the oil and vinegar than the package recommends - I like the taste a bit better and I get a wee bit more dressing for each package.And now that I've found my favorite salad dressing on Amazon, life just got better yet.  The prices in the grocery stores had gone way up over the years to over $2.25 a pack, but now I can buy 16 to 24 packages of dressing for over a buck per package less.  Thanks Amazon!

I have used this family favorite dressing mix flavor for YEARS.  In the past year, it has become more and more difficult to find it in the grocery stores.  Thank goodness for the internet and Amazon!!!  I was able to order and received in very timely manner.

I've been using Good Seasons Garlic & Herb Salad Dressing for years.  It is especially good for pasta salads and 3 or 4 bean salads.  I use canola oil and rice wine vinegar and I'm sure those two make a difference too.  But Garlic & Herb isn't sold anywhere I can find it around Boise, Idaho so I was delighted to find it on Amazon.  I've tried other dressings - bottled and packaged but none can compare to this one. Good Seasons Salad Dressing & Recipe Mix, Garlic & Herb, 0.75-Ounce Packets (Pack of 24)  I've stocked up.

We find the Garlic and Herb salad dressing to be tasty and when using olive oil, healthy as well. We not only use it on salads, but the dry mix itself can be  lightly sprinkled on sword fish along with a small amount of butter before grilling the fish - the finished product is fabulous!
My "secret" dressing the family loves--only found on Amazon--Thank You Amazon for saving me and my "secret" dressing.....Peggy

This is pretty much the only salad dressing that my husband will eat.  it's difficult to remember to pick it up from the grocery, and it's never on sale.  Purchasing through the Subscribe and Save method is the way to go, and with a pack of two dozen, running out is not a problem.As for the product itself, I'll admit it's one of the tastier commercially-available dressings on the market, and especially tasty when prepared with canola oil.  Highly recommend this flavor over the original Italian, and very much recommend it over the too-sour-tasting Zesty Italian.  The garlic flavor is pervasive throughout, and it is very easy to prepare.I'm a fan of homemade salad dressing myself, but like I say, this stuff is my hubby's fav.

This dressing is fantastic, I mix it with red wine vinegar, sunflower oil and eat it over a garden salad or pasta salad. It is the best, this will make sure that you eat your daily vegetables. You can't get enough with this dressing. I love it.

I've always loved making this fresh Garlic and Herb dressing.  While in Seattle, WA, I could not find it.  The dressing is terrific on any salad that dictates a mild dressing.  When I returned to Florida, I had difficulty locating it here.  This box of 24 packets was priced well below any sale price that I could find in the grocery stores.  Thanks for the chance to ensure that we will have wonderful salad dressing for months to come.

column9: Good Seasons Garlic and Herb Dressing
column10: This is my favorite among all the dressings........But it is hard to find in the stores. The shelves are loaded with GS Italian Dressing. It is rare when I can find my favorite. The only place I found it was Walmart....and they don't keep enough in stock. I found it availible on Amazon. So, I ordered a whole box of it along with a box of the Garlic and Cheese. I would like to know why the stores don't carry a varity. Even COSTCO & BJ's only carry the Italian. That is NOT my favorite.JTD

Good Seasons Garlic & Herb dressing is the very best salad dressing ever.  Every time I serve it someone will comment on how delicious it is and "you must give me the recipe,"  It is not carried in most the of super markets in my area so when I see it I buy all they have.  You will always find in my pantry.  Except today, I used my last packet last night and have to go to town to get more.  Hope they have it.

column9: Great on chicken, steak, and even salad dressing!
column10: If used as a dry rub it's great sprinkled on grilled chicken, steak and even pot roasts in the crockpot.  It's also great as a salad dressing, mix with olive oil and balsamic vinegar and it's the best.  I use this for a lot of different dishes.  It's great in spaghetti sauce it adds the perfect kick, sour cream and make a potato chip dip, and with a little olive oil dip for bread.  This is the most versatile and best tasting of all the Good Seasons dressings.

This salad dressing mix from Good Seasons is excellent!  It is very hard to find in my local grocery stores.  I use it as a marinade for chicken, and as a salad dressing.  It is super on pasta salads!
This is an excellent review.  I even use it when I make cucumber salad.

column9: Garlic and Herb Salad Dressing Mix
column10: This is almost as good as the Italian dressing ~ we love it. And it's so easy to make.

I expected something a little different from some of the other reviews, but this flavor was very similar to the Zesty Italian that we have in my stores. I didnt find the flavor very garlicy, which is what I was expecting. Still a great salad dressing , our favorite brand.

The grocery stores are no longer carrying this product for some reason, so I order it from Amazon.  It makes the best vinegrette I have tasted.  I use white basalmic vinegar and olive oil, and mix it according to the "lower fat" instructions on the envelope.  It is fantastic!
I think this is the best salad dressing product on the market.  I give it 5 stars for taste and quality.

For whatever reason, not a single grocery store in my region carries this particular Good Seasons Garlic & Herb mix.  All the stores have Good Seasons Italian and Spicy Italian and seldom any others, certainly no others in the past two years anyway.I must admit that I've never taken out a subscription for salad dressing in my entire life, but now I will get a mailing of packets of this great flavor of salad dressing every couple months, AND at a cheaper price than what the supermarkets charge, too.  Another plus!!

column9: Always asked to Bring a Green Salad
column10: I have been using this salad dressing for years.  Whenever anyone asks me to bring something to a party it is always my green salad.  Granted, I put a lot of great ingredients in my green salad, avocado, kidney beans, garbanzo beans, whole kernel corn, grated cheese, black olives but so do other people. column9: Good, but not much variety overall
column10: I'm not going to comment much on the quality of the chocolate, since it's Ghirardelli-- it's good stuff, and you're probably already pretty familiar with it.The thing to keep in mind about this basket is that it relies very heavily on the square chocolates; the other products are an afterthought. There are four types of squares in this basket: Milk & Caramel Filled, Dark & Caramel Filled, Dark & Mint Filled, and Dark & Raspberry Filled. (The item description claims that it also contains Milk & Truffle, but the basket I ordered did not have that item.)Besides the squares, there are also two chocolate bars: one Dark & Caramel Bar and one Milk & Caramel Bar. However, the individual "components" of these chocolate bars are exactly the same as the individual chocolate squares; they're just joined together to form something bar-shaped.So basically, if your intended recipient likes chocolate squares, then great! Just keep in mind that there are no solid chocolate pieces, no truffles, no nut-based chocolates, etc. All of the "solid" chocolate is just squares.The only non-chocolate-square product in the basket are the three individual serving packets of Double Chocolate Hot Cocoa Mix. It's good hot chocolate. Three packets is a very awkward number, though. It's too few for a family of four, and if the basket is for a couple, one person gets two packets and one person only gets one.Or you can do what my wife and I did: Have one cup of hot cocoa each, then make chocolate pancakes with the last packet of powder!My wife and I enjoyed this basket, but I was just a little bit disappointed at the overall lack of variety in the items and the fact that there was an odd number of hot cocoa packets.Bottom line:Pros: High-quality chocolate; pretty good variety of flavors of squares; reasonable amount of treats for the money; attractive presentationCons: Not much variety overall (just square-based chocolate and some hot cocoa); amount of hot cocoa is awkward (either too much or too little for most cases)(If this review was helpful for you, please choose "Yes" below!)

column9: The naysayers overstate the 'problems', and the bottom line is, this stuff WORKS. No sugar, no crash. It's true.
column10: Alright folks, so I'm just gonna lay all my cards on the table, because that's what you're supposed to do in an honest review right? I'm terminally ill, and I mean REALLY sick. I'm fighting hard, but it's a rough time. Part of that includes loss of muscle control, which includes the bladder, etc... Sheesh! LOL I was watching a review one morning on Fox News, after having been using this stuff for awhile, where the doctor they had on just TORE the energy drink business apart. He talked about how dangerous all of them were, and untested and how they basically don't work...Well I'm here to tell you otherwise. I went and got the EXACT bottle of 5 Hour Energy, Extra Strength, that I always buy, and which he was talking about. He was going on and on about how it was loaded with caffeine and was therefore bad for your heart. PLEASE! I've got the bottle IN MY HANDS right now folks. It states right on it, and this is the extra strength mind you, that it contains caffeine comprable to 12 oz. cup of coffee. That's not much! And yes, he was right that most of them work by being LOADED with sugar to go with the caffeine, and come with a REALLY bad crash afterwards. I experimented with some of the other products, and they taste delicious, but come with an AWFUL crash. This stuff doesn't taste so great because it has NO SUGAR, but it's just a tiny shot, and it works dammit.And then the doctor told the audience that it stimulates the nerves, and has been shown to cause nerve damage. I literally did a spit take. I was HORRIFIED. But low and behold, I talked to my own team of FIVE Neurologists that work on my case, and they disagreed. They said that a lot of the other drinks are unhealthy, diet-wise. This stuff causes what is called a Niacin Flush, and most of the energetic affects are from megadoses of vitamins. My Neurologists said that this stuff wasn't going to be hurting me, and at worst just might not work.But it DOES WORK! As I mentioned, I'm very sick. And that includes days when I am so weak I can't get out of bed or my chair. When I'm having nerve spasms, and can't control my muscles, I will sometimes have accidents when I fall asleep. I know the feeling well enough now to know, without doubt, when it will happen. Come on folks, I just admitted something really personal, and you can't get much more down in the dirt than that. LOL So when I feel that feeling, but am also really tired, I will drink one of these. It will keep me up and focused, and most importantly accident free, for between 3 and 5 hours while my nerve medications can kick in. And as those of us who have these problems can attest, that peace of mind, that time that is bought for us, ANYTHING to not make us incontinent if we can help it, is worth a LOT. Certainly the price of these little gems.The drink wakes me up, and it does NOT give me the jitters or make me edgy. I do not feel overwhelmed or hyper. It simply gives me the energy to get through my rough patch without falling asleep and waking up in a mess. LOLIf there is one downside to this, it's the price. But I ask you this... How many of us are Starbuck's or expensive coffee fanatics? I was for YEARS. And we buy those mostly to help us to stay alert and awake through our day, and also because they are delicious. LOL These cost, per bottle, less than a Venti coffee. And seriously, they work. And that's what they are advertised to do, and that's JUST what they do. And that's all I NEED them to do. Not every product out there does what it says it will do. So that's a boost in my book right off the bat.I thank you for your time folks. Give these a try if you were needing a safe and least minimally harmful boost to your day during the more tired moments that we ALL have. I don't think you'll be disappointed.Sincerely, R.A. McDowell

It is easy to prepare and can be mixed with so many other food items.Israeli couscous is like an entirely different food. It plumps up into luscious individual pearls that pop in your mouth.
