I don't know about Whitening affect by chewing gum and I didn't really expect much from gum anyway. I purchased this gum from Amazon because of great price. You would save so much and this gum will make your mouse very fresh!

column9: Good gum at a good price!
column10: This gum is good. I still prefer a fruit taste gum but at the price they had this listed for I couldnt pass up.

column9: Great Gum at a Great Price
column10: I bought this as soon as I saw it was available on Amazon. Not sure about the negative reviews from last year.Gum came exactly as advertised. Buy with confidence. Saved over .40 cents a pack compared to buying it at the store.
I like this type of gum, but Trident's flavor didn't last as long as Orbit White, nor was it as intense. I prefer Orbit White better.
I keep a box of these at work and enjoy them throughout the day. Great price!
I loved the price, too, until I realized I can buy it cheaper at our Local Target store.  :(
I keep these at work and then have gum whenever I want .  Everyone else knows where my stash is too - so better keep alot on hand.  great price and love hte delivery straight to me!!

I bought this for my kids.  I buy a pack for me and I never get a piece.  I have to buy a case of them, so that I can get a piece for myself.  Good sugarless gum.  Holds up to the heat of my vehicle.  Stick gum usually gets very hot and soft.

I have been purchasing Trident White sugarless gum for some time, and I'm quite satisfied with it.  I do prefer the Wintergreen over the Peppermint flavor because it is a little milder, but only the Peppermint was offered when I made this purchase.  It does clean well after eating when you can't brush, and I believe it does whiten some.  I never chew gum with sugar, so this is another plus from Trident.  I will continue to buy it.

column9: Decent gum, but I don't like the hard-shell coating
column10: Don't know what it is, but the tell-tale crunch you get when you bite down on one of these little pieces of gum is annoying.  It's like Chicklets, but worse.  The gum does taste good after the preliminary crunching ends (10-15 seconds).  The pieces are small, and last a good 2-3 hours.  They do work well when you don't have time to brush after a meal or coffee (at work, school, etc).
I am gonna buy this again for the future for myself, when I ate this completely. Thank you so much for this product in Amazon.com.
This gum took 8 days even with amoazon prime thats too long will never order from this site again.8 days ?
This yogi tea has an acquired taste.  Not everyone will like it.  I like it.  I can get it from the grocery store for $4 for one 16 bag package.

I feel a little strange spending a moment to review a box of tea, but I have to say: this stuff really works. I've been drinking this tea on and off for years, and I'm not sure if it's a placebo effect, but I always feel calmer and can fall asleep after having a mug of this.
it works really well, it helps me a lot to manage the stress after work

This is my favorite coffee. It is smooth, never bitter and if you think it's bitter then put a pinch or smaller of salt on top-of the grounds before brewing - it will remove that bitterness. It's also best if you grind it really fine right before brewing. Best coffee ever.

Of all the Starbucks coffees, I like the Italian Roast the best.  Partly because I'm Italian, and partly because the smokey flavor isn't over bearing and the dark roast isn't too acidic.  I hope they never drop this flavor.
We have been ordering Starbuck's Italian Roast whole bean and via instant since we first found it on Amazon.  Excellent product.  Not shipped by Amazon, but service is excellent

It's pricey, but I like this salt a lot. It has a different, more subtle flavor than just straight up saltiness of the typical crap white salt you find in the grocery store. Supposedly this is actually good for you (in moderation). I use it all the time now, recommended.

I have two great food loves, chocolate and tea. This is my favorite regular chocolate bar and I always keep a few in the cabinet. The flavor is intense and satisfying enough that it's easy to eat 1-3 squares and put it away. The cocoa content is high and fair-traded so considering the high antioxidant properties of pure cocoa (four times that of wild blueberries per 100 grams, USDA), it's nearly a guilt-free treat. (Add that to the recent research findings that cocoa is more effective for treating colds than echinacea, and I'm pretty sure I can justify eating 1-3 squares a day, which is 28-80 calories.) The rhino chocolate bar is the perfect blend of bitter and sweet, of dry and creamy. I highly recommend it, however, I understand that like wine, chocolate is a matter of personal taste.
Tasty, not too sweet, great to snack on during a movie. The packing makes it hard to save for later, but it seems to keep well in the fridge even exposed to the air.

column9: Endangered Species Chocolate with Hazelnut Toffee
column10: Absolutely delicious, contains healthy antioxidants, 72% cacao, and supports endangered species conservations.  I love it!

column9: Fast, easy and delicious for breakfast!
column10: If we have company for breakfast it is not uncommon to make a batch or two of muffins for breakfast with coffee.  Everybody seems to like muffins and these packets are just right to make for two people for a couple of days breakfast or to make several packets of different flavors to have a mixture of different muffins to have for a larger group of people.With this mix you just add ½ cup of milk and bake and in 14 to 17 minutes you have a fast and delicious muffin to enjoy.  Each pouch makes 6 servings and they are really good.  Eat them warm with a little melted butter and you will get a smile on your face.I have included a photo of the nutrition data for your review.  Making these muffins is fast and easy and it will make your breakfast something special to start the day with.  We love this product!Just a note, the product is very good but the price here is high in comparison to other sources.  When combined with the shipping costs it is less expensive at other outlets.

column9: WONDERFUL stuff-- you'll never go back to plain table salt after you try this!
column10: Tasty AND good for you, what more could you want from a salt?  Good price too.  Definitely get the coarse kind and grind it yourself for the best flavor.  Heaven on a ripe summer tomato!
Great price for Himalayan salt, very beautiful too. I grind it or use it whole in soups and mashed potatoes.
This is the perfect sugar for espresso.  I have looked for it for years a very long time and I am delighted to find it through Amazon.

I was served this sugar in my favorite restaurant in Eureka, California,  Hurricain Kate's,  and loved it.  I searched every where, finally gave up and asked the wonderful staff at Kate's.  A quick google led me to Amazon and my source.  Thanks so much Amazon, I am giving this for gifts to some of my favorite people.

column9: La Perruche Rough Cut Brown Sugar Cubes
column10: These are great sugar cubes.  They taste sweet and they don't disintegrate quickly in your mouth when you have them with tea.

Any of us who have had espresso at a restaurant and wondered where they got those lovely brown sugar squares will find this product is what you are looking for.  They add a slightly different sweetening to your coffee and it is a delightful taste.  Use them for regular coffee as well, you will definitely enjoy it so much more.Shirley Hanson

If you like coffee with a little cream and sugar, don't miss these wonderful little treats.  They give the coffee a warm rounded flavor of almost brown sugar, but mellower.  It is simply a wonderful indulgence. I have a cup mid-morning (otherwise no sugar), and it makes the coffee more of an interlude than a "break".  When times are tough, small indulgences are important - so get some!

Just bought a bag of the plain variety at Whole Foods for $7. As a diabetic with limited snack choices (no meds), these healthy crackers have great flavor and are fairly low in net carbs - 4g of carbs for 5 crackers (1 serving). Great snack in moderation for diabetics succeeding on diet alone or in combo with meds. Just be conscious when you are eating. Set yourself a limit, say 5 or 7, whatever you can accept. At 5 crackers per sitting, the bag will last you 9 sittings. Digging into the bag, hand to mouth, while your attention is somewhere else, phone or tv, and these bags will start costing a lot of money over the long haul.

Coffee is very much like wine as it is very much a question of preference.  This is by far my favorite coffee.  I used to be a 2x daily Starbucks drinker and this Sweet Espresso is much more refined while remaining very flavorful.  Done right in a Bodum/French Press there is no coffee that taste better to me!!! Hope you enjoy it as much as I do!!! Cheers!
As espresso goes it's not too bad. Not as an oily bean as I like. I also like my espresso to be a little richer in flavor. Otherwise better then most I have been testing.

This soup is DELICIOUS!  I have tried "bagged/boxed" soups and they usually aren't very good.Plus they usually have maltodextrin and yeast or other things in them I want to avoid.This soup is VERY simple, tasty and healthy. The ingredients are:dehydrated black beans, corn, red and green peppers, onions, garlic, epazote, and chili spices.  It seems that they got the balance of spices and veggies just right.  I find that difficult to do on my own.  Also since it packaged up nicely you don't have to go "scavenging" in your spice cabinet for all the spices.  I use my own chicken broth I make after roasting a chicken and it's a very healthy meal. (There is no added salt so if you are restricting salt you decide how much to add and what type of salsa you use.)So hurry up Amazon and get this in! :0)

I don't usually write reviews because I purchase items that already have at least dozens of rave reviews. I can't believe this soup only has one! I made a chicken tortilla soup on my own that was just a little bit better than this. But it took a lot of time to shop for and cook with all those ingredients and the cost was much higher.This soup tastes great and all you need to have is 6 cups of broth, pre-cooked chicken breast and some tortilla chips to throw on top. (FYI- I'm glad it's not hot/spicy. Throw in chili powder if you're into that.) These are really healthy, tasty ingredients. I ran into this in a nice local market and it was $7 or $8! I figured it was worth a try because making it on my own takes so long. I'm really glad I checked Amazon and can get two soups for that price.I need to try other flavors now...

This soup I tried at a fair and have been addicted ever since.  I like that you have the flexability to chose the spiciness with the salsa that you add.  We have made some additions where we add avacados and queso fresco.  I saw that amazon now carries it and I can get it cheaper than from the actual company big win.

I'm a tortilla soup nut anyway but have never attempted it on my own.  I just search it out on menus at Mexican restaurants.  This soup mix is not only quick and easy but it is downright delicious!  It rivals the soup I find at the Mexican restaurants for twice the price.  If you're on the fence, try it - you will not be disappointed and as another reviewer said, it makes a great gift.  I wish someone had gifted it to me years ago!  Serving suggestion: alongside a frozen Margarita.  Cheers!

Finding anything that is gluten free that the whole family can enjoy is reason enough to rejoice.  Soups have been a let down in the past because usually you want something just as quick as it is tasty.  This soup fit the bill perfectly for quick and delicious AND gluten free!  SO tasty my husband and I both had seconds and quick enough to make a difference to the usual lengthy cooking time for us back to basics gals.  I will definitely be reordering and have put out the good word to all my gluten free soul sisters.You won't be disappointed..

My husband & I LOVED this soup. The vegetables tasted fresh after cooking & the seasonings were just right. It's not easy to find no salt added mixes & the Frontier line is one of the best. I also used no salt tomatoes & put crumbled whole grain baked Tostitos tortilla chips in the bowl. Topped with a little shredded sharp cheddar cheese. Delicious & healthy.
Bought this on a whim and it is AMAZING! i substituted chicken soup for chicken stock because I didn't have any and used Frontera salsa (green) because I love Rick Bayless. AMAZING!

This soup is better than any I've ever made from scratch, and is incredibly economical.  I used left over rotisserie chicken, added a can of black beans, a can of white shoe peg corn, and a package of frozen cream style corn to the soup to make it more robust and topped my bowl off with shredded cheddar and a small dab of sour cream.  YUMMMM!  I'm back for more and to try other products by Frontier.

My family loves this soup. I bought a bag at a local apple orchard and we loved it so I ordered a box of it from Amazon. We serve with tortilla chips, sour cream and cheese.  My favorite this is it is all natural so there are no junk in there!  We have several allergies in our home and it is great to find a product we can all eat and tastes so good!

Great soup!!!  I put in the recommended amount of chicken broth but eliminated the cup of water because I don't like my soup to be watery.  I sprinkled some shredded Mexican style cheese on top and then put the tortilla chips on top of the cheese (the directions tell you to put the tortillas in the bottom of the bowl, but this would cause the chips to be too soggy).  I garnished the soup with chopped tomato and green onions.  It was delicious!!!

column4: RagenRat "A man's only as good as his word !!"
column9: Frontier Soup, Soup Tortilla South Of Brdr, 4.5-Ounce package
column10: Frontier Soup, Soup Tortilla South Of Brdr, 4.5-OunceThis folk's is one of the best soup's I've ever tasted !!!!I just can't get enough of this stuff, Be a great friend and give this for a gift that you will always be remembered for.We always have this stocked and ready for when the mood hits.Buy great product with confidence.RagenRat :0)

This was my first order of Frontier soup mix and I am very impressed! It is very flavorful and easy to make. I'm a vegetarian, so I made it without chicken and it is delicious! I'll be ordering more Tortilla Soup and trying their other mixes.
I added some chicken to this soup along with a cut up avacado.  It was excellent!  And very easy to make.

We first came across this soup at a winery around Pismo Beach, CA.  We purchased one and several weeks later went back and purchased more.  I gave some to my daughter because this is a gluton free product as my grandson has Celiac's.  I am now ordering online.  The whole family is hooked!  Try it..... you'll love it!
Quite a tasty soup.  I added chicken, and it make a thick, hearty soup.  Topped with the Corazonas tortilla chips and a little sour cream, it was a nice meal on a cold afternoon.
I ordered this tortilla soup and haven't tried it yet.  It sounds so simple to make and it looks so good. Can't wait to try it.
This is a medium roast - light brown - roast. Best used in a 50/50 mixture with a very dark roast like espresso or French.
the Product arrived as described and is used especially around Christmas time for various deserts.

I ordered Halter Sugar free candies for about fifteen bucks. Coffee flavor is my favorite hard candy, and sugar free was a must. This is the biggest Rip Off I have spent on amazon! The candies are great, but you get these eight little tiny boxes, the size of something you would give away as Halloween treats. Really liked the taste, Extremely disappointed on the cost for the amount. I will give it three stars, but only recommend if you are not concerned on price.
I did not like the taste of the Halter sugar free coffee candy. Won't reorder. On the flip side, their sugar free blackcurrant candies are one of my favorites.

column9: Our Son Loves Them, Very Convenient
column10: Granted, these are a little expensive, but they are very convenient for feeding while out and about or when you don't want to run the risk of food getting everywhere. We like that they are pure fruit and organic. Our son thinks they taste good and likes to suck on them. The novelty is nice. I wouldn't buy them to eat all the time because of the cost, but when you are in a hurry or on the run, they are super-helpful.

My 7 month old has just started eating  the strawberry Mish Mash and loves it.  I find the packaging so easy and even though I make 90% of her baby food myself this is a great supplement.I would recommend this for older babies.  My daughter's doctor said because she has been doing so well with solids we could start her on this but usually they don't eat strawberries until later.

My kids loved the plum tots Strawberry packs.  They are perfect for tossing in a lunch box or toting around in the car.  Plus- it's FRUIT!  (without the sticky hands and juice all over the place)  When you can't access real fruit- or you need a quick and convenient alternative- PLUM TOTS is it!  Wish they had even more flavors!
Great on the go snack to make my 2 year old happy when she's getting fussy. We keep them constantly stocked :)

column9: delicious, nutritious, and no mess! LOVE them.
column10: We absolutely love these. My son (11 months) would never eat processed baby food.  I tried many different kinds--organic, fruit, vegetables, different brands, jarred, non-jarred, meats, etc.  I gave up and started just giving him "real" food diced up in teeny tiny pieces.  A friend of mine had these and said her baby and toddler both loved them so I decided to give them a try. I ordered using the Subscribe and Save option to save money, assuming and hoping my kids would love them and they do! My son smiles when he sees me grab one from our pantry and immediately opens his mouth like a bird. Makes me laugh.  My 3 year old likes them too, especially if they're cold. She can just grab one from the fridge and suck on them after playing outside for a refreshing and healthy snack.  The S&S option makes them much more affordable, and the free shipping is an added bonus.  There is a wide range of flavors to choose from, and we'll be trying them all.

column9: This item is the BEST for new toddler
column10: I bought one of these from the store and my 13 month old sucked the packaging flat in 5 seconds.  She loves them anytime and they are good for her, healthy and organic.  This is a must try!
Of the Plum tots pouches I have had this is by far the best tasting. These are a little pricey but when they are on sale they are worth every penny. Great for throwing in a diaper bag or purse.

I discovered these when my daughter was about 15 months old.  I wish I had found them earlier.  They are organic, taste great, are easy for toddlers to handle and very convenient!  I always keep some in my purse and in the car when we're out and about.  They are not messy, unless of course they decide to squeeze the pouch, which only happens for us when she's not hungry.The Plum Organics line also includes some varieties with fruits and vegetables mixed together.  They taste surprisingly good and are one way to get my picky eater to eat some veggies.  You can find some varieties at reasonable prices on Amazon, others are more expensive for some reason.  Babies R Us has had a sale every other month or so where you can get them for $1 each if you buy them in sets of 8.  That is usually when I stock up for the next two months. :)

these are a great product--they taste good and the packaging is very well designed. when my daughter was younger I would toss one and a spoon in the diaper and we had food for the road. now that she is older, all we need is the pouch--she can squeeze/suck it out herself (she started being able to without making a huge mess around 14 months). they taste good (yes, I tried them) and the package makes them perfect for on the road.as far as expense goes--when they are available through amazon itself, they are competitively priced.
I would highly recommend this item!  My 10 month old loves the taste.  So does my 6 year old!  They are so portable and taste so fresh!

I have twin 18 month olds and they love this stuff! I wish I had learned of it sooner. I give it to them for snacks when we are out and about or at home. I just have to tell them to "be careful" as I hand it to them because if they grab and squeeze it too hard there's mish mash all over the walls.
Mix this up with some vanilla yogurt and Cool Whip Lite and serve it as a dessert to a totally unsuspecting finicky eater. HUZZAH!

This is an all natural product which comes in very handy: snack, lunch box etc. It is drinkable and should your little one(s) leave some, you can close it back and use it later on in the day. It does not take a lot of room at all (diaper bag, lunch box, purse...) and it does not need to be refrigerated, plus no spoon / straw needed! This is a great product for the summer: no need to keep it in a cool place and very handy on the beach (no sand can get in plus even sandy hands can hold the pouch). We love this product so much and so do our little ones that we have it shipped automatically: great service! It is really a must have; we also like the peach flavor.

My daughter first tried a similar organic fruit snack in a pouch at Starbucks and had to have more.  These little pouches are very yummy, healthy and the packaging is very convenient.  I bought a case of them and she requests them all the time.  However, they are quite expensive, so I limit how many she can have in a day.

For those who like smooth and creamy double-chocolate mousse that takes 5 min. and 1 cup of milk to make, then this is your answer..After 5 min. prep time, then put into fridge for an hour or 2, and then eat...it only has 120 calories per serving (4 per box)...I usually have 2 servings with whipped cream (in the can).  So 240 calories for a delicious and super-chocolaty dessert that you could serve to Presidents and Kings, and they would think it was home-made!!!

It looks like old pack when it was delivered on Feb 15 2012.I found that it was made on  the 29th week of 2011.It was compared to the same chocolate pack from SAM'S CLUB, which is made on 2nd week of 2012.I would like to return this package to AMAZON.

column9: a good start to your day-even when you don't have much time...
column10: This is one of my favorite in the Erin Baker line of Breakfast cookies, the cookie has an oatmeal base but is not a "heavy" cookie. It is nice and moist and has little pieces of caramel in the cookie. I like the fact that the cookie packs a lot in a little package- 280 calories for this cookie, no transfat, 20% of your daily fiber, no cholesterol and chock full of healthy ingredients to get you started (it does however have 23 gr. of sugar, so if you are looking for low sugar, this probably isn't for you). I have to say I was skeptical that this would carry me to lunch because it is just one large cookie, and not like one of those overly heavy, hockey puck like items you expect when you see something is full of fiber, it also didn't have that saw dust kind of texture you get from some power bars. This definitely has enough of the right stuff to keep me full for several hours. My favorite way to eat these cookies are to stick them in the microwave for 20-25 seconds so they get soft and the caramel melts just a little.I pretty much like all of the flavors, but overall this one is probably my most favorite. The other nice thing is that these cookies are meant to freeze and can freeze up to a year. The box of twelve cookies are all individually wrapped and I take them straight from freezer to microwave, for a quick, nutritious breakfast that is both satisfying and delicious.I'm happy to see that amazon seems to be carrying more of the Baker line, which also saves tremendously on the shipping costs!

As with a lot of older people, my 85 year old mother tends to skip breakfast and since she takes several medications, I thought she should have something to eat with the meds. She lives in MO, I live in TX so I can't run over to take her breakfast.  I have ordered Erin Baker's Breakfast Cookies and had them sent to her a couple of times.  She has enjoyed all of them.  I have to eat gluten free so I have not personally tasted them but she says all of the flavors I have sent were very good.  They make a great "gift" for her - once you are that age, there is very little that you need as a gift for an occasion, birthday, Mother's Day, Christmas, etc. - I have found that giving her something edible makes way more sense than giving her something that will just clutter up her house.

My husband and I have tried to change our eating habits this year and part of that has been making sure we have something for breakfast.  I don't know about everyone else, but we are not friends with our alarm clock.  We have a slap fight every morning with it until we realize we must obey if we want to keep our jobs.  Needless to say, there is no time for breakfast before we rush out the door.This is where these cookies come in very handy.  The first time we bought them we kept them in our pantry (I think we bought 60 that time to try a variety of flavors).  Unfortunately, by the time we reached the last dozen, they had gone bad and were a bit fuzzy.  Now this is actually a good thing!  Mold can't grow without moisture, so this tells you the cookies are moist!  Because they are all natural and are not made with preservatives, it is only reasonable that they would have a shorter shelf life.Next order we popped a weeks worth in the fridge and put the rest in the freezer.  We did this because my husband likes to eat them in morning traffic on his way to work so frozen cookies wouldn't work for him.  I on the other hand work in a very small office so I brought a variety to work and put them in our freezer.  In the morning I just pop one into the microwave for 45 seconds and I have a warm, tasty breakfast.  I especially like the gooeyness of the melted caramel and chocolate from those varieties.At an average of 300 calories it is a good meal alternative and is very filling.  It is a nice alternative to drinking a slim fast for breakfast, though I do sometimes still do Slimfast for breakfast and have a cookie for lunch.I would like to see them come in a variety dozen.[...]

column9: Good Breakfast Cookies-- and BTW, corn syrup is not HFCS!
column10: My wife and I have tried just about all the flavors of Erin Baker's Breakfast Cookies.  They're all good -- moist, filling, and they keep well in the freezer as well as in tins.  They're easy to warm in the microwave, too; about 30 seconds if frozen, about 12-15 seconds otherwise. Just clip off the end of the individual package and zap. (Those who complain about about dryness may have put one in a toaster for too long.)  As to the ingredients, I looked at the list on the back of the 'Caramel Apple' version to see the dreaded "corn syrup" someone complained about. First, it's NOT HFCS. Second, it's in the caramel!  Most of the cookies don't have any.The only reason we don't give this cookie 5 stars is that they are very, very sweet for our tastes.  The sweetness may even prevent some from being able to detect all the other flavors.  Dried apples and unsweetened apple sauce are good ingredients, prune puree isn't bad either, the apple pie-type spices are very nice, and a little molassas is traditional.  It's the evaporated cane juice and brown rice syrup in the cookie and the liquid sugar and corn syrup in the caramel bits that may take the sweetness over the top for some.  The way we see it, this is a highly portable breakfast for when you're in a hurry, and it may be low fat/high fiber, but don't kid yourself -- it's a cookie.  We'd recommend drinking something like V-8 as well as something hot like tea with milk or a skinny latte to round out this quickie cookie breakfast. (Just watch your sweet intake for the rest of the day ....)

Bought these so I could eat them for breakfast when I'm really short on time or to eat during break time from work and wow, they are so good!!  Also brought a couple of them over to a trip to Europe and they were perfect!  I never got tired of these at all!  I haven't tried the other ones but this Caramel Apple breakfast cookie is so delicious!  The ingredients that are in here are the real thing: whole grain oats, dried apples, caramel bits and apple pie spice, to name a few.  No high-fructose corn syrup, trans-fats or artificial anything will you find in these, which is even more awesome.  Nice that they're individually wrapped and just the right size!  Since there's no preservatives, you may want to freeze them so they'll last longer - just heat them up in the microwave and they'll taste great!  I do not regret buying these at all - very happy to have bought these!!

column9: Healthy, Tasty Goodness on the Run
column10: This is one of my favorite Erin Baker Breakfast Cookies. I freeze them as soon as they arrive and microwave one each morning for 20 seconds. Seconds that don't come fast enough when you want one. Toasting then in the toaster on the Darkest setting is pretty good too. These make me WANT to eat breakfast every day even though it's not IHOP or a fancy breakfast!

column9: Great substitute for a bowl of oatmeal, just don't let the word "cookie" fool you
column10: Judged as COOKIE cookies, Erin Baker's Breakfast Cookies would be heavy and dense. But they're not. They're an alternative to a bowl of oatmeal (and MUCH better than the almost-as-expensive Quaker Oats Breakfast Cookies, which to us are practically inedible). According to my wife, they're indispensable for anyone with hectic mornings who CANNOT skip breakfast. She says they last her about as well as a standard size bowl of oatmeal.Based on reviews, we tried the Caramel Apple ones first. Heating benefits these more than the other varieties because it melts their little caramel "bombs". I don't like nuts, so I didn't try the Fruit & Nut ones. My wife says they're good too, but more along the lines of traditional hippie fare. They have a higher fat content than some flavors, as do the Double Chocolate Cherry. She would love to see these sour cherries make a solo appearance, without chocolate as a partner. The Gingerbread flavor is quite gingery, enough to overcome the inevitable molasses (which she doesn't care for). These last two flavors, along with Pumpkin Spice, are seasonal. She says of the three, she gives the Pumpkin Spice a very slight edge over the other two. When it comes to the sweet spices, we like them strong, and the Pumpkin has plenty cinnamon.Interestingly, the primary sweetener in all of these cookies is prune puree. My wife, who is not especially fond of prunes, doesn't notice it. Ditto for the chicory extract, which is also in all varieties.One important note: the instructions say to freeze the cookies right away, and that's what we do. If they could all be eaten within a few days, this might not be necessary, but since they last us awhile and are preservative-free, we want them in tip top shape. All we have to do is snip open the wrapper and pop them in the microwave for fifteen seconds. They're labelled "toaster friendly" but we haven't tried that. During wintertime, placing them on the dashboard with the defroster on high might even do the trick.

I was hoping for a quick and delicious, easy to grab-n-go breakfast. These were definitely quick and easy, just not exactly delicious. When I kept them at room temperature, they tasted a little card-boardish. Microwaving didn't help. The packing recommended that they be kept frozen, so I did, and I actually liked them better from the freezer. They didn't need defrosting, they weren't rock hard, and I think the flavor improved.I probably won't try this flavor again, but I am willing to try one of the other Erin Baker Breakfast Cookie flavors to see if I like one of them better.
I really enjoy all of Baker's breakfast cookies, but this by far is my favorite! Very filling, very delicious.

column9: I LOVE THEM ALL! PARTICULARLY THIS ONE.
column10: I am so addicted to these cookies! Love them! They are great for a meal substitute or snack .  Not too sweet-just right. They are good for you too.  What else could you want?  No more dessert store bought cookies for us. We have disabilities in our home so 'easy' is a word we love. At first we tried the Morning Glory Cookies and loved those so ordered 4 more different kinds, caramel apple, banana nut, peanut butter with chocolate, fruit and nut . We all loved them all.  The Caramel Apple went first though. My son's favorites are caramel apple, peanut butter with chocolate and banana nut. Frozen we heat in microwave 25 seconds.  I love the gooey flavor and texture of the caramel apple.  I want one right now but unfortunately we are out Darn it! Do not hesitate to try these in any flavor.  They are a bargain. In doing so, you do not have to worry about lines, traffic, and finding out if what you are looking for is still stocked on the store shelves.To the people out there who are looking for something that is great to eat in the morning or anytime, you cannot go wrong with Erin Baker's Caramel Apple Breakfast Cookie.

I usually eat this cookie as soon as I leave work and by the time I get home I can just change and go for a run and I dont have to worry about how much I have eaten. This is a great way for me to get some good nutrition before a run. I love this product.

So far, I have tried caramel apple, fruit & nut, morning glory, and banana walnut flavers. I have also ordered, (but not yet received) the pumpkin spice cookies. All of them are an excellent meal replacement or nutritious snack. The ingredients are wholesome, there is no high fructose corn syrup, and they have a good supply of protein & fiber to stave off hunger for several hours. The caramel apple is probably my favorite because it seems to be the moistest, but I really love all of the flavors. Like other reviewers, I freeze them, and then microwave a cookie for 20 seconds when I am ready to eat it. I find the cookies taste best warmed up. Even though the calorie count is higher than many cookies, I think you get a lot of nutritional "value" with these.

Gooey to the point of being appalling. I fail to understand how or why anyone could justify paying over a dollar a piece for these things. Sure, the instructions are dead-on with the freeze-before-toasting method, but they have more ingredients than healthy cookies I can make at home for MUCH cheaper, and with superior texture and without the garbage. column9: Quick and easy for on the go!
column10: I got this for those mornings I am in a rush or running late. Saves time and is very healthy. They taste a lot better than I expected. Also would be a great afternoon snack for children. column9: Surprisingly filling and larger than expected!
column10: I realize that the product description said 3 oz.  however, in my mind these were going to be smaller cookies than they are.  Big, thick and wonderful.  When the instructions state that the cookies hold up to the toaster, they are serious and when toasted (I was a skeptic and stood hovering about the toaster expecting **flames**, which sadly, there were none of) this cookie became even better.It is possible to eat this cookie quickly (I observed my son do so), however, it took me 10 min or so to finish mine while enjoying my cuppa coffee. These cookies are delicious!  They freeze well and are especially good warmed in the microwave for a few seconds.  I eat these mainly for breakfast but are great as in between meal snacks too.

column9: A nice alternative to other breakfast bars
column10: After eating cereal and breakfast bars for so long, I wanted to try something different so I ordered this. Of course, I questioned the idea of a breakfast cookie however, I was pleasantly surprised. The cookie is soft and tastes like apple. The texture is kind of like a oatmeal cookie. Only downside is that I can't find the expiration date on these cookies so I had to stick some in the freezer like it said, which didn't really change the taste.

I've had no problem with them going bad, but I put them in the freezer and take a few out at a time. They toast up perfectly from frozen, too. Great for on-the-go breakfast! My son loves them, too.

column9: Breakfast Cookie - wish it was organic
column10: I was pleased with the price of these breakfast "cookies" since I generally try to find a larger granola-bar-type item to each each morning.  The cookie is a good size, and it kept me full until lunch.I also like my bar to be healthy, and this one fits the bill.  I only wish it was organic.As for the taste - it was slightly above average. If you love caramel, this is the breakfast cookie for you! Similar to Erin Baker's other cookies, but with a delicious goo of caramel to surprise you in random bites. The apple taste is what you'd expect in a breakfast cookie, and the texture is the same as her others.

WOW these were very good! I've ordered several of the varieties of breakfast cookies from Erin Baker's, and this is my favorite so far! They were very fresh and moist, quite flavorful. The package suggests freezing for freshness so I put them right in the freezer when I got home. These are really great, would be good for hiking or camping.

These are one of the few breakfast bars that actually fill me up and get me ready for the day until lunch.  The flavors are outstanding, and the consistency is that of a home made cookie.  All in all, a great start to the day.
This product is not only great tasting, but also very nutritious!  Our employees really enjoy them.
I was leary about getting them, being "healthy" and all, but me and my kids (my son whom is very picky) love them.

This has become my new favorite Baker's Breakfast Cookie flavor when I used to prefer the chocolate flavors. I heat it in the microwave for about 10-15 seconds so the caramel bites become gooey. I highly recommend this flavor!

column9: Where Have These Been All My Life?

this will fill the hole in your tummy!!..microwave thirty seconds and eat with a fork..you can't pick this baby up with your fingers. The combination of apple and caramel flavors is supremely primo!!!!

a lovely tea to drink hot or cold. you can really smell/taste the honey, apricot, and chocolate notes. also economical used one batch to make 4 pots of tea.

I loooove this oolong. I have tried to find one that compares to this one from other retailers but with no luck. This is the best oolong I have ever tried.It is mellow and you can taste the honey. column9: My diabetic dog LOVES these cookies!
column10: I have been purchasing diabetic cookies from The Old Dog Cookie Company for my 13 year old rhodesian/doberman for the last 6 years.  She was diagnosed with diabetes 7 years ago and has to take 2 shots of insulin a day.  I was so thrilled to find a treat for her that is homemade of natural products for diabetic dogs,  as there is nothing else like it out there!  (And even if there was, I would never stop buying from them as they are the nicest, kindest people I've ever met - by phone as I live in California and they're in Maine!).  Oh and by the way my dog Princess LOVES them!!  P.S., I buy the 5lb bulk as I have a large dog and they last longer.

Dog loves them. Great replacement from her regular treats before she became diabetic. Our dog also got SARDS which left her blind. She is 10 years old and other wise in good health. So this product really helps her quality of life.

When I got these in the mail I wasn't sure if my dog Damon was going to like the Nutritious Diabetic Dog Cookies or not, but he absolutely fooled me!  I have cut back on his insulin from 15 cc's to 10!  I''m so excited to find out his sugar levels are toward the end of the month.  Thank you for making such a good tasting product.

I remember these wafers as a young girl and haven't found any other sugar creme wafer to compare. Other sugar wafers have a harder, thicker wafer that almost scratches the roof of your mouth. These have a very thin wafer that is simply holding the melt in your mouth creme filling together. One bite and you are hooked, you eat the whole pack! They stay crispy and fresh because they are packaged with 3 packs inside each box. They are a great snack by themselves or served with sherbet or crumbled on ice cream for a dessert.

.My wife has been a fan of wafer cookies for many years.  Recently I bought her a box of wafers from a different brand.  I hoped to  surprise her.My wife accepted the other cookies but explained they were not the ones she had when she was young. A disappointment for me, but she did enjoy the cookies. I enjoyed them myself, but in limited servings.These wafers are 140 calories a serving, according to the rating website I found. These sugar wafers are awesome.  Perfect sweetness.  The ones I buy in the grocery store are fresh and crispy.  The ones I received from Amazon are towards the end of their shelf life (less than 60 days).  Not as good as the fresh ones in the store.

column9: These Will Get You Moving - Highly Recommended
column10: Celsius Calorie Burner Drinks are every bit (or more so) as energizing as any of the other energy drinks (Monster, AMP, etc), but they have the added benefit of also being good tasting! This "Variety Pack" contains several flavors, but the Sparkling Cola is my favorite as it has a crisp ginger taste that I really like and makes it very refreshing, especially when served very cold. The other flavors are: Green Tea Peach Mango (good), Green Tea Raspberry Acai (not my favorite), Sparkling Orange (very good), Sparkling Wild Berry (good), and Sparkling Ginger Ale (very good).While I can't really confirm that these actually burns 100 Calories just by drinking a whole can, it certainly would not surprise me since this does pack a serious kick. I now drink a can of this about a half hour before my workouts and it does seem to give me more energy throughout the whole hour and half or so. On occasions where I don't have time to grab a cup of my morning coffee, one of these does the job of waking me up just fine.A note of caution: I do have a high caffeine tolerance (cultivated through years of drinking "too much" coffee) so while this is fine for me, my teenage son tried one before his workout and got "jittery". Also, while not an issue about the drink, the cans are made of very thin aluminum and are prone to ripping if you crush them, causing sharp edges that can (and did) cut fingers.Overall, these are a very good tasting energy drinks that really do get you moving!Highly Recommended!CFH

My regular energy drink is RockStar, which I feel gives a great deal of energy. The downside to it is alot of bloating though, along with enough sugar to literally rot your teeth right out of your mouth if you drink it regularly.I saw this variety pack of Celsius on sale here at Amazon and decided to give it a try.Some flavors are better than others, so the variety pack is the way to go so that you can decide which ones you like or don't like.Green Tea Peach mango was pretty good and I don't even like teas in general, so that was surprising to me.Green Tea Raspberry Acai was yummy. Tasted like a good tea with a touch of sweet berry taste.Sparkling Orange tasted sort of like a diet orange soda. It felt/tasted like it had a tad of carbonation too, even though none of these are really carbonated.Sparkling Wildberry was pretty good too. Sort of a not too sweet berry flavor.Sparkling Cola was so-so. Sort of like drinking a semi-flat, not so sweet soda. Not terrible, but not my pick of the litter either. reminded me a little of the one sip taste I had of Red Bull.Sparkling Ginger Ale was pretty good. Again, sort of like drinking a semi-flat version, but still good.Oddly enough, I seemed to notice different amounts of energy with the different flavors, too. I don't know if that was "all in my head" or not.The cans are smaller than RockStar or Monster cans, but they do give a little bit of energy. I do not feel as bloated when I drink Celsius, that's for sure. As for the calorie burning claim, I can't say as I believe in that. I think that the only way it could burn 100 calories is simply by you having the extra energy to be slightly more active and therefore burn an extra 100 calories as opposed to not drinking it and not having the energy to get up and do something. I do not beieve at all that if you drink Celsius, then sit on your butt it will magically burn 100 calories. I don't think any product can do that.Overall, I do recommend these, especially for the cost savings as compared to buying RockStar etc. The flavors are pretty good and the energy level was pretty satisfactory. I have tried alot of energy drinks and this is one that I can say I did feel an energy boost with. There was no crash later in the day either, which is great.

If you don't know what flavor to get just get this. It will last you a month. This is different that your avergage spike and crash energy drink. Sure Red Bull is fun and gets you wired, but it's loaded with sugar! Ailments of America is from all the sugar we consume. Celsius has no sugar, that's what I like. It tastes better than any diet make-your-eyeball-bleed or get-massive-migraine aspartame loaded drinks (I hate the taste of diet drinks by the way). NO crash. The energy is sustainable and pleasant for the whole day. But if you do load up on other caffeine products it might make you jittery.I would recommend dieters stick with one product at a time. This does help you go a longer and it also helps you take your fitness more seriously. At first you may drink it and feel the need to clean your home. Then you may feel like you should work out until you can't do anymore. Instead of doing that I would recommend pushing your weights to be heavier and increase your speed on your miles. You will enjoy the results.Oh and if you enjoy a pizza or spicey food once in a while, this can take place of your soda knowing that you are actually helping your metabolism. My friends have told me my face looks thinner like I've lost 10 lbs. I've drank this for less than a month.

column9: Energy boosting assistance for your workouts
column10: Celsius is a product that I've been using faithfully for 15 months to assist me in my fitness goals.  It is a great product, but it's not a miracle product.  It won't make you leaner, faster, stronger, better looking, slimmer or anything else you're not already or likely to be in the future! However if you keep a realistic approach to all supplements, you'll more than likely see benefits over the longterm with this one.Benefits:+No calories.+Has green tea in it, which is thought to have metabolism boosting benefits.+Energy boost that lasts through a hard, 2 hr workout without side effects such as nervousness or jittery feeling.+Loaded with B vitamins for energy, which also support your immune system.The taste on all Celsius products is not the same.  Some are carbonated and for me, those are awful!  I like the non-carbonated Acai Berry flavored Celsius, with Strawberry Kiwi flavor coming in second and Raspberry third.  I've tried others, but keep coming back to these flavors as they are palatable.  None are overly sweet, but most have some sort of aftertaste which is sometimes bitter to me.  I drink them as cold as I can stand, as quickly as I can.  Frankly, taste isn't why I keep drinking it - it's the energy boost I get from the product.Celsius gives me an energy boost for my workout that is unmatched by other products I use by Monster.  I work out with weights 3-4 times a week and cardio 4-5 times, for total workouts lasting 45-90 minutes depending, but always at high intensity.  I eat a small breakfast high in protein and low in carbs, then drink Celsius on the way to the gym.It gets me through the workout with energy to spare, but I feel no side effects from it other than it's a diuretic - the green tea does it - and thus I'm urinating (fortunately the bathroom is close) frequently for the first 30 minutes of my workout. Not something I'll be drinking prior to running a 5K!It does have caffeine in it and it's recommended you limit intake of all energy drinks because of this, and do not combine them with other caffeinated drinks.  I always have a cup of coffee with my breakfast and then drink this, but notice no problems in doing so.  If you do what works for your body, you're on the right track.The bottom line... to reap benefits from this product you must also incorporate a healthy diet and exercise program. I've lost weight and gotten leaner over time, and while I wouldn't say Celsius did it, it was a 'fitness parter' in my journey and I'll keep using it.5/3/2011 NOTE: this pack is a 'variety' pack, not like the photo shown.  I was disappointed to have ordered 3 packs (looking at the photo instead of fully reading the description...) and to receive the mixed pack.  I really don't enjoy the 'sparkling' varieties of Celsius and have found my favorite to be Acai Berry.  I'll suck it up and deal with my mistake, but just be aware the photo is of the Acai Berry pack - not the variety.
It taste's great.  I can't really say if I've lost weight from it, but it's great to have in the middle of the day. You do feel a pick me up.

Last few months I've added some extra weight. I've decided to start visiting gym more often and with that, I wanted to have that extra something to help me burn calories faster and exercise more. As somebody who's into sports since 5 yo, I fairly well know how things work, so I checked several websites for supplements.I had some bad experiences with caffeine-based supplements, so I tried to steer away from them, but it's hard to find anything decent without caffeine inside. So, I opted to try Celsius, and here's what happened:Fit Strider (alpine skiing machine) - 30 mins daily, every dayDay 1 - 5 mph average speed, 2.5 miles distance, ~280 calories (Peak speed 5.5 mph)Day 2 - 5.5 mph avg, 2.80 miles, ~295 calories (Peak speed around 6 mph)Day 3 - ~6.0 mph avg, 3.1 miles, ~320 calories (Peak speed 6.5-6.7 mph)Day 4 - ~7.0 mph avg, 3.6 miles, ~340 calories (Peak speed approx. 8 mph)Day 5 - restDay 6 - forced rest (long, tiring day @ work - simply didn't have time to exercise)Day 7 - ~7.0 mph avg, 3.7 miles, ~350 calories  (Peak speed 10.5 mph for a short period) <-today, June 1st, 2011Maybe it works, maybe it's just my body slowly waking up, but I like Celsius. I recommend it if you're as me - overweight, sleepy, stressed out at work (I work on a cruise ship - 6 months per contract, no days off).Drink it 10-20 mins before exercise (depends on metabolism really, but 15 mins average sounds correct. Try and see for yourself, that's the best), DO NOT drink it on completely empty stomach! I did that mistake and I was jittery for a few hours - I guess caffeine did it's number on me. If you're caffeine resistant maybe you will have different result, but I really didn't like the feeling so I learned my lesson - eat something hour or two before exercise (something light and HEALTHY!) and then drink thins thing.DO NOT skip your meals, folks. Starving yourself won't help you and Celsius will hit you like a hammer, so you will just suffer. Eat more often, but less food. Trust me, it works.For now, I'm counting on losing some of my 250 lbs and going under 220. It will take time, but I just ordered 2 more cases of Celsius so I'm good to go. Combine it with a good diet, regular exercise, some protein (casein works very good while you sleep and it comes handy as a meal replacement if you're hungry late in the evening like me) and that's about it. Grab a few boxes of quality protein bars to have in your pocket/purse and you will be shipshape in no time :)Good luck y'all!

So i wasn't getting any work out. So i bought a treadmill and been running 1 week of running at 4.0 speed and do only 15 mins. That's all i can do before getting tired. Today i drank my first celsius and after 10 mins felt the energy. I got on the treadmill and jogged and ran at the speed of 6.2 and ran for straight 15 mins without getting tired at all!. I would walk, jog and run and did that for 2.3 hours straight!!! What a difference. After that i still wanted to do regular exercise like stretching and weight lifting and still now, 4 hours later i feel alot of energy on me. It's not the shaky energy feeling you get from other energy drinks like monster. And the drink tastes good. I don't feel any crashing like monster or other energy drinks give and you don't get shaky or anything. You're calmed but are alert. I suggest you get this if you're trying to lose weight or simply want an energy boost without all those calories and sugar those others drinks give.

I don't know if it's just me, but this is the worst energy drink I've ever tried - it did nothing for me at all!  Granted, I love coffee and energy drinks so I may have a bit of a tolerance, but even my fiance who never drinks coffee and hates all red bull-type drinks drank a whole can and did not feel any boost at all.  It seems like it works for some ppl, but my experience was extremely disappointing.  On the positive side, the drinks taste good so at least it wasn't a complete waste of money (just a really expensive can of soda. . . )

Our Jackabee (Russell/Beagle mix)seemed to love the taste of this food more than the "regular over-the-counter" food from the store.  In fact, he couldn't wait to eat it.  He probably would have eaten more if we allowed him to gorge himself on it.  There were no adverse reactions to the switch. You just have to slowly wean your dog off the cheap stuff, otherwise, you dog could experience loose stools.

Eagle Pack has turned my picky eater into an enthusiastic, eager eater! My Chorkie, Sammie, seems to love this new (to her) dog food and devoured it right from the start as if she were offered a treat! The excellent nutrition, great price, and fast shipping guarantees I'll be ordering Eagle Pack from Amazon again!

column9: Not up to the hype, caused bloody stools in my puppy
column10: I purchased this food upon recommendation from my vet. They told me that they had previously used the Holistic brand but it had merged with this company & they did not have experience with Eagle Pack but that they thought it was the same. I slowly added the food to my puppy's old food over the next week and she seemed to like it just fine. Well, she started having a lot of loose stools, many of which were completely liquid and even bloody for the next couple of weeks. I decided to try another food and everything completely resolved. I have since tried a couple of puppy foods equal in quality/price/reputation with no problems. Her stools are completely better, now soft but formed (like they should be!) with no sign of blood whatsoever. She has not had any gastrointestinal problems on numerous different kinds of treats either. She has been fine on 3 puppy foods, a dozen different kinds of treats...you do the math.I have been trying to figure out what the problem may have been from the ingredient list and my concern is the "triple animal proteins" combining chicken, pork and fish meals. This is just an invitation for food intolerance because there are more potential allergens. I think the pork is the problem. I know she tolerates chicken & chicken meal fine, not sure about fish but I've seen that frequently in other foods while I have yet to find another quality food that contains pork meal. Pig does not seem akin to a domestic dog's "natural" diet anyway. If they got rid of the pork, I might consider trying it again but until then I'd recommend you try another food for your puppy. I think (hope) they are generally a good company and I do see that some people's dogs have been fine on this brand, but I'm not sure this is the safest food for baby animals. I will NOT be purchasing this again & I will be contacting my vet recommending that they no longer carry it in their store. There are so many better, safer options out there. If you care about your puppy's health and happiness, save her weeks of misery and buy something else!
My dog that is used to eat only home cooked meals likes this food. I had tried other ones without luck until I found this brand. Good product!

column9: Great company, Great food, but my puppy won't eat it...
column10: We have a picky puppy.  After doing a lot of research on dog food, I chose Eagle Pack.  We tried for 2-3 days, but our puppy just wasn't interested in this food.  We ended up getting him on Taste of the Wild Puppy, which he loves.  Eagle Pack is a great company, thats made great food for a long time, at a great price.  Our dog just wasn't digging it though...

I suppose I shouldn't have ordered these during the summer, but I did.  Since they were not to be shipped for several weeks, I assumed (yes I know) that shipping during August would be taken into consideration by the seller.  It wasn't.  While there was a little cushioning material around the box, there was no insulation at all and no markings on the outside of the box that it should be protected from heat.  Since the Mozart Balls are loose in the box, they melted into a variety of non-spheriodal shapes and the box itself was saturated with cocoa butter that was originally part of the candy.  Removing the foil is akin to untying badly knotted string that has been soaked in water and then dried.  The taste reminds me of Moon Pies.  Maybe in the winter months these are worth while, but I will stick to Reber in the future (each ball in an individual compartment and shipped with cooling packs in the summer).  Thank goodness these weren't a gift!
The name says it all. "Very Cherry" indeed. This jam is rich in flavor and a delight for your tastebuds. My jam arrived in good time, no dings, breaks or spills. Yum!

We first encountered this product at a take out place on Maui. Then we asked our Thai hostess in Tucson about the sauce and she gave us the Mae Ploy recommendation saying that they use it in their kitchen. It is addictive on Salmon, pasta, vegetables and more.

Been using Mae Ploy for years since a Filipino friend introduced us to it.  It's great in and on lots of foods.  We use it mostly on the egg rolls we get from Schwans since our friend is too far away to make us the awesome food we first tasted it on.

What can I say - The order was fulfilled to my satisfaction. Nothing beyond that needs be said.ThanksJoan Kershaw
Tast is more robust than I thought tasts very strong or burnt.  Mabe my way of making it but just not for me.

When we used to vacation in Myrtle Beach, we always visited the Peanut Shop to stock up on their wonderful products.  The ones we ordered from this seller were probably good at one time, however arrived stale and stuck together.  Hopefully this was a fluke; I would hope no one would knowingly sell outdated food products.  Disappointed.

column4: Shop-til-you-drop DIANE "I want it ALL-I want...
column10: I am in serious trouble after ordering a carton of these! I had not seen them in stores for a long time and I did remember how great they were. Well folks--they still are! I think its the fact that the chocolate used to dip these in is really delicious and dark! In fact--they are even better frozen. I got them on sale--these always were the "more expensive" cookies on the shelf! SO now---I have enough to give some to everyone because if I dont--I will have to order new clothes! They are great!

I haven't ever tried these cookies before and  just picked them up as a lark, because after all, what woman on the verge of PMS could resist the lure of chocolate, marshmallow and more chocolate in the form of a cake like 'cookie' on the bottom.  Oh geez, I'm darn lucky I don't have any in the house at the moment...but wait!  I can order them without even leaving the room and be indulging in them in a matter of a day or so.This perfection of a confection consists of a cakey/cookie on the bottom, topped with a nice smooth, soft marshmallow and then drenched with a lovely, lush milk chocolatey candy. These are rather large cookies and  even the most  chocolate deprived of us should be happy with a serving of maybe 2 of them. Unfortunately a real serving is only one...but not to despair; at 120 calories per cookie you won't be doing that much damage if you go crazy and have 2!Okay so by reading the other review I found that they are good frozen, but let me tell you I think they are wonderful if you put them in the microwave for a second or two and  try them with the 'mallow getting a bit oozie!  It's like a s'more but better since you don't have to build a pesky fire or even find a twig so you could roast the marshmallow!I do suggest that if you don't finish the package in one sitting, that you put the leftovers in a Ziploc baggie so they stay fresh. The un-re-sealable packaging is my only complaint with this product.I dare you to try these and to be able to stop at just one!

column9: Decadent Nabisco Pinwheel Chocolate Marshmallow Cookies
column10: My mother used to buy these cookies for us kids when we were little (back in the early 60's).  She would pack a few of them in our school lunch boxes for dessert.  They were sooo delicious back then...I just remember being so excited when I would open my lunch box and find them in there!!!  They are certainly what I consider "Comfort Dessert".  I agree with one of the other reviews...the cookie part is soft and (pseudo) cake-like, the marshmallow is soft and wonderful, and the delicious chocolate they are wrapped in just melts in your mouth.  Wow!  How can something so simple taste so good?  I buy these quite often and I've gotta tell you...I cannot stop at one or two (honest).  Nothing like having a couple with a glass of cold milk after dinner, after work, or for a bed time snack.  They are worth every penny.  I also agree with one of the other reviews...sometimes I too pop one in the microwave for just about 3 seconds (don't over microwave and watch them every second or you'll have a puddle).  The marshmallow barely oozes and it just tastes so good.  Give them a try and you will not regret it.  Hope Nabisco never stops making these.  They are my all time favorite!!

The last time I tried Nabisco Pinwheels was after my favorite store closed and I could no longer buy Mallomars (a great choc/marshmallow cookie). Found the Nabisco Pinwheel enormous and fluffy but many of the shells were already broken and I thought the filling had an off flavor like powdered milk(which I detest). Since then I have discovered Dare brand-pure chocolate Whippet cookies that are also sold on Amazon. They are imported from Canada and they are my new favorite choc/marshmallow cookie with pure choc shell and a tasty marshmallow center on top of a quality base cookie or bisquit as the Canadians call it. It's a premium cookie with none of the tricks used by American bakeries these days to fill the cookie with air or other cost cutting measures. It harkens back to the cookies we remembered from our childhoods in the 50's and 60's and the recipe hasn't changed. If you get the craving, I heartily recommend these Dare Choc Marshmallow whippet cookies. Like the original Mallomars they are a tried and true classic full of the chocolate marshmallow goodness you remembered from childhood.

column9: Pinwheel Chocolate Marshmallow Cookies, 12 ounce pkg (Pack of 12
column10: I love the pinwheel cookies but have been buying the store brand cookies. They were on sale on Amazon so I decided to try then.  Wow I can't believe  the difference.  The Nabisco are so much better the chocolate is so rich. And the cookies are huge. Great having them shipped to your door too. Will buy again.

column9: healthy great snack for on the go!
column10: Sahale Snacks are some of the best around.  They are great to pack along anywhere.  We love to sprinkle them on our salads for an extra special treat.  I prefer the pecans over  the other varieties, but I bet they are all great.  Hope you enjoy them as much as my family does.

But the Lotus Foods rices have broadened my culinary horizons, prompting me to incorporate rice into many dishes where I would have found a substitute for the rice in the past. column9: Mildly fruity, wonderful aroma, smell this oil from the open bottle!!
column10: I like some variety in my olive oils. No, never any other quality than extra vergine, THAT is a MUST ( => do you know how much olive oil must be included by US law in so-called "Pure Olive Oil"?? Huh? Dare to guess? It is 25% - yes, I am not kidding you, 25% olive oil must be included in that blend sold under the name "pure olive oil" in the USA. The 75% other oils in that bottle or tin they don't need to tell you what they are and where those are from...)So, extra vergine only, no compromise - but within that world there are so many various aromas, different tastes available. You can have mild oils from Liguria or Tuscanny, or real fruity ones from the south (called Fruttato). Or those in the middle, which I am calling mildly fruity.This one is a perfect example for that category. It comes from the Abruzzi, a mountain region near the adriatic coast of Italy, made by a very small company. Actually a family business rather than a company. I have just tasted the fresh new harvest of Nov 2010, which is available right now. Wonderful! When you open the bottle first, take the time to smell the oil from the open bottle! Do it! Please, try that! It is like a good wine, it will introduce itself with a note.I am loving this oil from the first beginning when I first smelled it. So fresh, but not sharp! Not tangy, but still fruity enough to leave an impression! (If an oil is too mild you don't taste anything!)This oil is perfect for a fresh salad, or for a drizzle over a finished dish, or mix it with mashed potatoes for a new twist! Or try on toasted bread!Yes, really, toasted bread! Take a fresh raw (not from a jar!) clove of garlic, peel it and rub the clove against the crusty bread. The crust of the toasted bread will work as a grater actually, the clove will disappear in your hands. Then pour this oil over the bread, and enjoy! This freshness, this aroma!Oh, and it is also very healthy, it works like a flu shot, but without the dangerous side effects, and it doesn't hurt at all!
La Quagliera Farm is off to a great start with their new extra virgin olive oil. Expect a consistently product from this family farm.

I had extremely high hopes for Giants BBQ Sunflower Seeds. Every sunflower seed on the market has very little sugar, if any at all. David, Bigs, Jimbeam, Fritolay, and Spitz are the 5 you will find pretty much anywhere. Giants was one seed I had never heard of or tasted, and so I decided to give it a go, and ordered a box. They are very smokey which is 1/2 the test of a good bbq seed. The second half is sweetness, of which there is none to speak of in these seeds. They are very salty, and after one 5oz bag, your tongue is done. Between a bag of Spitz or Giants, i'll take the Spitz every time. Giants have no resealable bag, are very salty, and lack sweetness on any level. Spitz has a resealable back, are much cheaper, have a milder smoke flavor with a pinch of sweet, and the perfect amount of salt. If you have never heard of giants sunflower seeds and are looking to try it, I'd stray away. They are a smokier version of a mainstream David seed but with a little more salt.For an alternative to the common 5, and 6 if you count Giants, there are 2 more companies you can try out. They are Interstate B8, and Zotes. They come in plastic cylindrical jars, and definately don't appear to be mass produced. After I pawn of the remaining 10bags of Giants, I will give Interstate b8s bbq a try. There is one review of them on their website that says they are sweet and smokey, the perfect bbq sunflower seed. I'll be the judge of that!
My son is a college baseball player.  He asks for a big box of these sunflower seeds each season.  He has tasted most brands, and this is his favorite! Giants BBQ!
Havent used it yet, but it looks nice and get along with all the other spices on the shelf...
Great product.  Cat really enjoys the food and the product has kept our eigth year old cat at a lean level.

column9: Good Flour for Biscuits, Pancakes & Pizza!
column10: I made my first dozen biscuits with White Lily Flour this morning. I followed the simple recipe from the website just to verify the degrees my little Breville oven on my countertop only had the highest degrees of 450 so I went with this setting and the biscuits came out perfect! Please follow the website video from White Lily Flour preparation and note a light baking pan makes a less browned biscuit. Result light and fluffy biscuit plus I used buttermilk versus milk.

I've been reading about White Lily flour for years, but was never able to give it a try.  Let me tell you, the biscuits and pancakes in my house have taken a giant turn for the better.  Low protein flour is just unavailable in normal supermarkets up north and it really does make a difference in the final product.  The self-rising option is great, and eliminates any mistakes in measuring baking powder.  Add a little baking soda for your buttermilk biscuits and watch them rise to new heights.  Why, I had to put lead weights on them after baking to keep them from floating away.

This raw organic cacao powder came in one of those electronics static bags you'd normaly see a chipset or hard drive with a recycle symbol 7 & 11-PET, ALU, PE. I was told it was "food-safe" by the seller and that "nestlé uses the exact packaging."I don't see how ROHS (the restricted use of hazardous substances in electrical and electronic equipment) can be food safe. I cannot return it for a full refund as there is a restocking fee and shipping charge so I'm writing this review.  At the least, common sense should tell you that organic powderd foods should not be in contact with impregnated aluminum plastics--especially when it's stamped on the bag itself stating (ROHS compliance) "that it contains the minimum acceptable levels of hazardous substances such as cadmium, mercury, and lead." This is no joke. Industry cares not about your health and therefore uses recycled materials containing these hazardous metals. A packaging containing acceptable levels of hazardous materials for a landfill is not food safe!!

Like the other 1-star buyer, this powder was shipped to me in a ULINE static shield bag which indicates that it is "ROHS Compliant." ROHS compliancy means that certain metals are banned from being used in packaging, but not necessarily lead! There is no indication this bag was not used previously for electronics, there is no origin marking anywhere on the bag and there is no nutrition label. There also is no "organic" label on the bag aside from a shoddily printed sticker that says "Organic Herbal Essence". Because of all of this I can not be sure this product is not adulterated, let alone organic. I will not purchase this product again from this seller and suggest that other buyers beware. The product itself may be fine, but why take a chance (especially if you are looking for what is supposed to be an 'organic' product free of contaminants)?UPDATE 4/12/12:I complained about the improper packaging and submitted photo evidence of the static shield bags to both the seller and Amazon. Originally the seller claimed the product was shipped in food-grade ULINE bags, but after I sent photo evidence to the contrary I heard nothing further from the seller. Amazon granted me a full refund today. If you do order this product, I recommend you double-check that the packaging is safe before opening it!

The chocolate flavor of it is quite light compared to what I'm used to. However, I haven't been doing the raw thing for too often, so I don't know if that is just a consequence of it being raw and I may not be used to that. I'm going to look around and get some opinions on others, but I will probably come back to this one because the price is great, and it DOES make things chocolatey. . . just not like I'm used to.

I was not sure what to expect with cacao versus processed cocoa. The first thing I made I put to much powder in, alot to much...lol. The second thing I made...yup, to much again. My kids and I are loving this stuff. They are much more willing to drink homemade raw almond and rice milk with a bit of cacao and honey in it. She told me that if I would let her drink chocolate almond milk, she could handle raw vegan, but she had to have milk to drink that she enjoyed.
