Just like I remember from my childhood in NJ. A nutty whole grain hot cereal that is filling and easy to prepare. Impossible to find here in Virginia.

I simply love Wheatena!  I have been trying to find it for several years and FINALLY found it in Alabama, now I have to resort to purchasing more online.Yes, Wheatena is an acquired taste...but I season it with cinnamon, nutmeg, chopped walnuts and raisins...simply delicious!
My wife ate this as a young girl and she could only find it on Amazon, not in any local grocery stores.  She was not disappointed.  It brought back very fond memories.
My wife's cousin in FL turned us on to Wheatena this fall. He combined Wheatena with Steel Cut Oats then added raisins, nuts,and a teaspoon of brown sugar. I am now addicted!
Breakfast cereal that is fast to prep, nutritious, palatable with addition of sweetener & hot.  Good for diabetics & prediabetics aswell as those in search of a simple breakfast.

Wheatena is a comfort food for me.  My father used to make it for us kids when I was little on cold wintry mornings before school.  He did the same for my children when he became a granddad.  Now that he is deceased, a warm bowl of Wheatena takes us all back to those happy mornings.  My local store carried it for a long time.  But suddenly it was discontinued.  Life was a little sadder.  Thank goodness for Amazon!  I went online, ordered a four pack and we went through two boxes almost immediately eating a warm filling bowl every morning.  Now that we are satiated, we will do through the last two boxes at a more reasonable pace.  Thank you Amazon and the makers of Wheatena for being around for me and my family for over 50 years.
This hot cereal is no longer available in local grcery stores so I ordered from Amazon.  It is healthy and delicious, especially on a cold morning.
It is My mom's favorite and we can't find it in stores anymore so it was great to find somewhere!

This is the only place left to get Wheatena, which can really be an important quality of life issue, if you know what I mean.  (I can see those of you with lower digestion issues smiling and nodding.)  Thank you, internet (and Amazon)!
AFTER YEARS OF NOT BEING ABLE TO FIND WHEATENA IN MARKETS WHERE IT WAS A STAPLE FOR DECADES I FOUND IT AGAIN ON AMAZON
My favorite hot cereal. Can also be used in place of bread crumbs.  Arrived quickly....on the order of comfort food.

One of the all time greats!  Cooks in little time, healthy & delicious.  I put a bit of butter into the bowl & add 2 pieces of bacon broken into bits..  UMMMMMMMMMMM.  I can't believe it's not on every grocery store shelf!

column9: The foundation of a good hot breakfast cereal is Wheatena
column10: As a child growing up in Philadelphia, PA, I always looked forward to breakfast, because I knew that mom was in the kitchen cooking Wheatena.  There were only three cereals that I grew up with, ate all the time, and never strayed away from during my childhood.  They were Kellogs Corn Flakes, Quaker Oats, and Wheatena, with Wheatena being my favorite.I was able to capture a very important part of my childhood when I rediscovered Wheatena.Thank you Amazon for carrying my cereal.  You don't know how much I missed it!
So happy to find a place to obtain "the cereal of my youth!" And it didn't disappoint me - the distinct rich, nutty flavor, and slightly chewy texture was the same as years past.

I've been eating this for years.  Kind of like Cream Of Wheat but much better tasting.  What can I say about cereal except it's a great way to start the morning (cooks in the microwave) or as an easy low fat meal or side dish like grits.

I cannot find this in any stores anymore. I don't know if they stopped carrying it or what, but I love to have my Cream of Wheat and my box of Wheatena when I want some. I eat it anytime of the day. Lunch, dinner, snack, hmmmmmmmmmmmmmm! I love it! I miss it. I will be ordering me the 4pk of Wheatena. There is no substitute!

column9: Great old Favorite on Discontinued Cereal
column10: So happy to find it still available here. Great cereal; add a touch of salt, sugar (or sugar substitute) and maybe a bit of butter, and you have a meal. Very hearty and substantial. An old favorite, no longer available in stores.

My family has enjoyed Wheatena for years as a cooked breakfast cereal, and an ingredient of home made bread and other items.  When it became unavailable in stores, we were glad to find it online.  I like the free shiping offer, have found the service straight foward and fast. We plan to continue ordering from Amazon so as to enjoy this nutritious and tasty product.

I first tried this cereal at the coaxing of my college roomate over 25 years ago.  It was definitely an aquired taste for me, but she got me hooked by mixing in a small pat of butter!  Although this would not help those who are watching their weight, it certainly made it more palatable!  I'm craving a bowl right now...

I've been looking for this product for years to no avail.  Once found and ordered through Amazon.com I was extreamly delighted to discover that it hasn't changed at all.  Still the delicious wheat taste I remember as a kid.

This is a great tasting product that is good for you. My kids ate it all the time when they were young. Now the BIG THREE cereal makers have succeeded in pushing it off our local shelves. Really too bad.I can choose from any of the twenty two facings of Quaker Oats ( I counted them ) but not one for Wheatena. What a shame.

column9: WHEATENA THAT YOU HAD AS A CHILD
column10: Wheatena Toasted Wheat Cereal, 22-Ounce Boxes (Pack OF 4)THIS WAS A TREAT FROM THE OLD DAYS THAT I COME ACROSS TODAY AS A HEALTHY FOOD THAT'S HIGH IN FIBER AND NUTRITION.  SOME THINGS PASS THE TEST OF TIME AS GOOD FOOD PRODUCTS.  IT'S TASTY TOO.

My first impression of Wheatena was that it tasted like coffee grounds. But then I realized that if they were more filling I would in fact enjoy eating coffee grounds. Wheatena is clearly an acquired taste. Furthermore, the claims of this product being healthy are somewhat neutralized by California's claims that roasted grains cause cancer. Wheatena is a nice change from oatmeal, but it is not as wonderful as the reviews of Wheatena devotees would have you believe.
Best hot cereal ever - lots of fiber and super taste - with sugar and skim milk
I've tried several breakfast products..and this one is the worst one! Its color is dark brown when its ready to be eaten and is tasteless. My husband too tried it..and he too thinks the same.
Amazing and addicting wafers. Perfect mix of sweetness and crunch. Cant eat just one. Puts the local store brought candy to shame.

This bully stick is so small!! It's really light. No substance. I returned it immediately. For the price you can purchase at least two smaller bully sticks that will be thicker. My dog would devour this thing in minutes! Do not purchase.

I have a small (13-lb) dog and one of these seems to last her about 3 weeks.  We've gone through about 3 so far, so I don't feel like the cost is too high.  Also, there is no foul odor like I've discovered with some bully sticks.  I like these & I'll keep buying them.

Enjoy the long lasting flavor as well as the texture of the gum, the different flavors that are represented in the product truly jusitify ,the worthy product. I have a wife who has dentures and she swears by the product as the gum base does not sick to her dentures as so many others do. A happy wife, a happy camper. Thank-you for such a good product.
You can purchase this product at the supermarket for $6.99.  Why would anyone buy this for over $10 a bag on amazon?
We recently purchased this coffee and it was great! Good flavor, not too strong and not too weak with just the right amount of vanilla flavoring. Bonus that its organic too.
I bought this coffee b/c I liked the sound of the flavor - vanilla caramel and the fact that it was organic. But I found the flavor not as good as other brands I've had. I wouldn't buy it again.

I spotted this exquisite treat at a local gourmet food store and had to give them a try. Excellent flavor and texture, quite unique. And now I can't find them locally anymore, so glad to see them here.St. Dalfour raisins and cranberries are completely different from those which are packed dry. These are moist! And tender and truly delightful. The ingredients listed on the label are: "raisins, cranberries and 'a touch of sugar.'" No preservatives (other than the sugar, of course).These raisins and cranberries are vacuum packed in glass jars and remain moist and plump. I don't know how St. Dalfour achieves this, but the resulting product is simply delectable.A tasty treat right off the jar, but even better in desserts (ricotta torte, clafouti, bread pudding).Made in France.

column9: Best Cuppa English Tea (In My Book)
column10: First off, I'll let it be known that I'm English. That means I have spent my lifetime drinking lots and lots of tea, which I think is compulsory when you're English. I've had many different types of tea (mostly tea from England such as PG Tips and Typhoo) and when I finally stumbled upon Yorkshire Tea on a trip back home about 6 years ago I've been hooked. This is by far my favorite tea and I drink 3-5 cups of it a day.Although many reviews say a bag is meant for a pot of tea that is not truly the case. A bag is meant for a single cup of tea. Now, some people may prefer a weaker cup of tea, like my mum who will use a bag twice since she prefers a weaker cup, but one bag is really meant for one cup. Alas, to each his own. I personally like a very strong cup of tea so I use one bag per cup and I allow it to steep for a minimum of four minutes. Then I use a bit of half and half (whole milk at the minimum) and a half teaspoon of sugar. Wallah, the perfect cup.As for price, well, Amazon cannot be beat! I have searched high and low for this tea and have not once been able to find it for less than what Amazon sells it for in the States.Grab a cup and enjoy this very fine tea. You won't be disappointed.

column9: Yorkshire Tea, the best secret in tea
column10: I discovered this great tea in Harrowgate, England. It is smooth, not bitter, and is great hot or cold. The bags are for a pot of tea, not a cup. I can find the tea in a local specialty tea store but pay three times as much for it. Amazon got it to me within 3 days, making it comparable in price to other teas, but so much better. There "gold" tea has also won multiple awards. Give it a try.

I've always had to acknowledge that I can drink bad coffee but I can't drink bad tea. That means, when I go to a restaurant, I always order coffee as I can live with it if it's not great. I can't do that with tea so I only drink tea at home.The blend of teas that Taylors have put together for this bagged tea is phenomenal. Nothing comes close in my opinion and I drink about 5 cups of THIS tea a day. I've given up trying other blends as I'm invariably left disappointed and always end coming back to the original "Yorkshire Tea".For years I've asked my parents who still live in England (actually in Harrogate since they retired) to ship me boxes of this tea regularly as it wasn't available over here in the US (unless you wanted to pay a fortune for it). Now Amazon has made it easy for me to get the ONLY tea I enjoy drinking and at a price comparable with the junk you'll find at the local supermarket.Buy this tea, you won't be disappointed. Don't get the Gold blend thinking you're getting something special. It's an entirely different blend and not as good as it tastes very bitter in my opinion.To enjoy to the fullest, drink with milk and sugar. Oh, and buy a tea pot as the bags make up two cups.

column9: Once you've tried it, nothing else will do.
column10: I first encountered this tea in a random bin of teas. The box looked cool, so I bought some. I enjoyed it. It made a good stout pot with one teabag. The flavor was smooth and bold. The company is socially and ecologically responsible.Then I ran out. There was no more to be found locally. I went back to my old brand, but somehow... it wasn't the same. I tried other brands, but I pined for Yorkshire Tea.Nothing else is quite as good.Thank goodness Amazon carries it.
wow! This is serious tea!  Was a jolt at first, but really is terrific.  It has become my favorite.  I still love the herbbal and flavored ones, but for a really good "cuppa tea" this is it!
I love tea. It is important for me to have a good quality, strong tea. This is the winner! I got 6 packs with the free shipping, it was a very good deal! Will buy again.

column9: The tea that kept Churchill's upper lip stiff!
column10: Well, I'm actually not sure about Churchill, but this tea does brew up strong, dark and fast and stands up nicely to milk and sugar. I'm a coffee drinker normally, but when I am not in the mood for coffee, this wonderful tea gets me through the day. I prefer the Red to the Gold, personally - it seems a bit stronger. Like the other reviewers, this is the only tea I drink now - I used to have a cabinet full of various English Breakfast Teas, Irish Breakfast Teas, various brands - now there's more room, because this one beats them all. Once you've had Yorkshire, you can't go back!

I ordered this tea for my wife, who is English; she enjoys a goodcup of strong tea. I have often visited web sites specializing inBritish goods, particularly food, and have found that AMAZON typicallywill have the lowest available price.
I buy this tea for my wife to give her a little taste of England. Its a good strong English quality tea.

This tea is great in the morning, very strong and guaranteed to wake you up.  There is more tea in the teabag than regular American bags, so it's very strong if you only make a cup.  It is also very full flavored and satisfying, no bitterness.  It's great with a splash of milk or plain by itself.  Also it makes a great flavorful ice tea.

A friend gave me a box of this tea awhile ago and I enjoyed it so much I asked her where she purchased it.  She had gotten it at a local discount grocery store where of course it was no longer available.  I looked up the distributor on the box and when I contacted them I was told that I could buy it from Amazon. What's especially great is there are 6 boxes, so I'll have it for awhile.  I like the tea because it has a stronger flavor than other commercial teas and is more like the teas I had when I lived in England.

This tea is dark, rich and robust. A tea with broad shoulders, if you will.  An excellent sup before the a.m. rush.  Spot on!!!- at any time, though. If you are a coffee drinker, this is your tea. It is quite habit forming. When it comes to teas, the Brits know it best.  Now you can too.Delicious. Well deserved. Give it go, love!!!

I sample many teas when I can, but always return to a dependable cup of Yorkshire. It's smooth, not acidic when steeped properly (please don't squeeze the bag, friends and neighbours) and tolerates much cream when making a strong cup.  It will yield a rich, dark golden colour when displayed in a clear glass.  A very flavourful black tea blend, and never tire of the taste. Also seems forgiving if you steep too long. The teabags, which I estimate are approximately 3 grams, are larger than the tiny American variety, and without the staple and string, so you are getting a genuine British cuppa. Blended and Packed in the UK.

Yorkshire Tea by Taylors of Harrogate is a bold comforting tea.  I've been a tea drinker forever (I'm not a kid) and this is the best tea I've ever found.  I purchased some while in England and didn't try it until I came home.  Well, it was used up immediately and I was so happy to find it on Amazon.  I order it regularly.  It makes a perfect pot of hot tea and also a wonderful iced tea.  It is never bitter and holds it's flavor, hot or cold.  I recommend it highly!

column9: Deep in color, rich in flavor, the best this side of the Atlantic
column10: My mother in law gave me a box of this Yorkshire Tea for Christmas and it is the best tea I have had in years. Deep in color and rich in flavor, the strong taste takes me back to my youth when my mum brewed me a mug with a spot of milk on snowy mornings. I drank tea for forty years until I switched to coffee. I admit to being a Starbucks' addict. Though this in the morning gets me up and running.

YORKSHIRE TEA IS STRONG ENOUGH U ONLY NEED TO USE ONE TEABAG, UNLIKE OTHER TEAS.  I LOVE THE FLAVOUR, REMINDS ME OF BEST OF ENGLAND.  I ENJOY AN EARLY MORNING CUP, DAILY, STRONG WITH ADDED MILK.  TENDS TO BE MORE EXPENSIVE BUT WORTH IT & IS GOOD PRICE @ AMAZON.

I received a box of Yorkshire Tea as a Christmas gift from my daughter in England.  I loved it and HAD to find a source.  The only one I found was Amazon where I have been able to order it in large quantities.  PHEW!  I love the aroma, the color and the flavor.  Bestest ever.

After drinking Tayors of Harrogate Yorkshire Tea on a trip to the UK, I was hooked. For those of us who are true tea conneseiurs,American brands don't cut it. I discovered that it was next to impossible to purchase this tea where I live. On subsequent trips to the UK,I would purchase several boxes of Yorkshire and transfer it to zip storage bags for easier conveyance. I did locate it in a small tea shop a few miles away but at a considerable cost. I had tried to purchase it online but the price was about the same. I, recently, decided to go to Amazon and there it was. I was ecstatic. I purchased 12 boxes and am enjoying my genuine English tea while watching the snow fall. For those who have never had a real cup of tea, I encourage you to try Taylors of Harrogate Yorkshire.

I live in the south (United States) and therefore drink an excessive amount of sweet tea. This tea is absolutely the best tasting tea in the world! It makes a great hot tea but the ice tea is AWESOME. Giving this tea a five rating is by far not high enough! I have a shipment mailed every few months so I will hopefully never run out. If you like tea you must try Yorkshire Tea and be prepared to be hooked...no other tea will do!
I am a hardcore tea drinker and love the strong, non-bitter, full-bodied taste of Yorkshire tea.  My mother tried it and now she can't drink any other brand of tea.

When the British store in our area closed it's doors I didn't think I'd ever get to enjoy my favorite tea again. Wala!!! Thank you Amazon for listing Harrogate Tea and thank you Harrogate for sending it so quickly. I love your tea.

I LOVE this tea....  furthermore the company that produces it is a wonderful group of people that give back to the community.  And because it is the richest, smoothest, most velvety and fragrant cuppa that I have ever found, I've even signed up for a subscription of regular deliveries to prevent the horror of running out.  I am all the happier to read about the charity fundraisers and community events they sponsor, which of course makes me even gladder to support them. They even have a lovely page on FaceBook.  As for this tea, I just got a delivery yesterday, which I might add arrived promptly and well packaged... to my utter delight.  I'd write more but my kettle is going and I'm eager for more tea.  YUM.  =-)!!

Tea taste, like anything else to do with flavor, is completely a matter of opinion. Yorkshire tea is strong, smooth, malty and rich. Irish Breakfast is vaguely similar to it; most quality black teas (PG Tips, Barry's, Lyons, Typhoo) are grassier and more herbal than Yorkshire, though charming in their own ways.Yorkshire tea is specially blended to brew well in hard water. I use filtered tap water, but in the area in which I live the water is hard. The alkalinity of the water may account for the delightful taste of Yorkshire tea to my palate (compared to other teas).That being said, I do enjoy other teas such as those mentioned above, yet Yorkshire Tea remains my perennial favorite. I can leave it to brew an amazing 8 to 10 minutes and it gets strong without being bitter.If you enjoy rich, strong black tea, you will not regret trying Yorkshire.My grandmother would balk at my use of tea bags, but they are so convenient, especially in the mornings. I have also used the loose leaf version of Yorkshire Tea with even better results...smooth, deep, and almost creamy. If you are as pressed for time in the morning as I am and take tea rather than coffee (yech), you will appreciate the convenience of the bags.

column9: Better than Coffee in the Afternoon
column10: A girfreind fomr the UK brought me a large 100 bag box during a recent visit to the US. I was quickly hooked on this excellent afternoon "pick me up." No sugar required, Harrogate's Red LAbel, Black tea is a sure winner. And so glad to find it available through Amazon. The "local" English Pub overcharges in exce$$ for the same product. Three cheers!
I used to buy Tetley's British blend from the supermarket but tried this tea and found it stronger and more to my taste. A little more expensive but worth paying a little extra.
This tea is the best tea I have ever enjoyed!  My daughter introduced me to it a few years ago.  Add a little cream and some stevia...mmmm...GOOD!  Excellent service from the seller!
This is the best tea in the USA probably the best tea in the world nay, the universe. The teamakers in Yorkshire, sure know their leaves. Always welcome, always refreshing. Mmmmmmmm!

E! Network aired Jane Austen's "Pride and Prejudice" movie, the one with Keira Knightley, tonight. I've seen this movie many times over the years, and the Oxygen Network and E! love to air this movie several times, but it never gets old for me. I could watch anything Jane Austen-related numerous times and still be a happy camper. Anyways, anytime I watch anything Jane Austen or British-related, I always find myself grabbing my Taylors of Harrogate Yorkshire Tea. Out of the English tea companies out there, Taylors of Harrogate, is my favorite English tea company, with Twinings of London and Ahmad Tea, second and third, respectively. Taylors of Harrogate's Yorkshire Tea is one of my favorite teas. Like many of the other Amazon reviewers have said, this is a dark, robust, bold black tea. It's like the strong black coffee of teas. This Yorkshire tea smells and tastes wonderful. Even though the Amazon description said that this tea is served best with milk, I find that this tea tastes great alone. I don't need to add anything, including cream or sugar, with this tea. This tea is truly top quality and tastes perfect the way it is. I consider this Taylors of Harrogate Yorkshire Tea an essential tea to have for anyone who drinks and serves tea to guests. Out of all the tea companies out there, Taylors of Harrogate, Harney and Sons, and The Republic of Tea, are my top three favorite tea companies based on the quality of their teas and the comprehensive variety of teas they offer. I also think it's awesome that Taylors of Harrogate are committed to environmental issues such as deforestation and climate change. It's nice to read that Taylors of Harrogate teas are Rainforest Alliance Certified. On the bottom of their tea boxes, they say that they have their own rainforest project, and that they have assisted in helping plant three million trees across the globe. I love that Amazon sells this in packs of six boxes. I have one box at my workplace, and I gave some tea boxes to my co-workers and friends during the recent Royal Wedding of William and Kate. Anyways, this is a nice affordable tea to drink and share with friends and family.

Over many years, I regularly brought back English teas for my family of tea drinkers to sample including Fortnum's Royal Blend, Twinings English Breakfast and, more often than not, this Taylors of Harrogate Yorkshire Tea which became my family's overwhelming favorite. Now we share bulk orders of this beloved tea supplied by Amazon which arrives to my doorstep in perfect condition - the true UK product with a whopping 3+gr of tea per bag and a very favorable expiry date so the 6 individually wrapped cellophane packs of 40 bags will stay fresh for 18 months.  This Yorkshire Tea makes the perfect breakfast tea - the Assam/African tea leaves common to English Breakfast blended to create a rich, smooth, golden brew standing up well to a generous spot of lowfat milk (my English friends NEVER take whole milk with their tea!) In comparison with its rivals, Taylors of Harrogate Yorkshire Tea has 50% more tea per bag than the Twinings USA English Breakfast product. (Twinings USA cuts down the strength of its tea bag from 2.5gr per UK bag to 2.0gr for the USA product.) For eco enthusiasts, Yorkshire Tea is Rainforest Alliance certified. The Tea also holds a the Royal Warrant and is served in the renowned Bettys Cafe Tea Rooms in York. Now if Amazon would only import crumpets to complement my perfect Yorkshire cuppa!
This tea has been a long-time favorite. It's robust without being too strong and has a very smooth flavor. It's a good morning or afternoon tea.
This is the best tea ever!!!!!  Lot's of flavor.  More like the tea I get when I go to England.
Very pleased with Yorkshire Tea.  We've been using Yorkshire Gold and find this to be a better value of excellent quality.  Altogether an outstanding blend of English tea.

column9: Blessing of a good cup tea
column10: I now know what my  mother-in-law who hailed from Scotland meant by the blessing of a Good cup of tea. What a difference from any other tea I have tasted.  It is the highlight  of my  morning and evening, brewing a pot of Yorkshire tea...rich and flavorful and relaxing the senses.  I really love this tea. I am happy to have found it on Amazon.  My first box was found in a town square in a little shop.

This is a very good tea, but does not outplace my favorite tea from the UK (PG Tips). I found the taste of the tea bag material to linger in the tea, so be careful not to let it steep any longer than needed. Yorkshire certainly is better tasting than the average US tea brands, so try it if you are looking for an upgrade, though I would also order a box of PG Tips for a treat!
A good basic black tea, much better than any Lipton's. Tea bags have no string or tag, so have a strainer handy. I think I still like PG Tips better tho.
My 10 year old niece wanted this item for Christmas. She loves this candy! Now she can eat it up and use it for learning ratios at school!

I have used this product for over 15 years. I use it to enhance the flavour of many vegetarian dishes. I also use it for fish and sushi soy sauce. My only problem with it is that I ordered this twice from Amazon in the last 4 years or so, and each time the bottles leaked during transportation. I am not sure what they could do to prevent this from happening in the future. But it is a concern. Do not order any books with it, they shipped everything in the same box, and everything got soaked with it.
Similar to soy sauce, but not as salty and with a lighter flavor.  Superb stand-alone alternative to salad dressings.  Also great on steamed veggies.  I can't get enough of this product!

Bragg's amino acids are very good for digestion. i have put one bottle in a spray bottle to spray on salads and have another bottle opened for measuring teaspoons full into soups and stews. It not only adds flavor to foods, but makes them easier to digest, thus more healthful. I wish I could have bought fewer bottles than 6, but I know that I will use them up before the expiration date.

I purchased 6 bottles and was worried that I had too much and I would be having to store it for a long period.  I have used the sauce extensively over fresh vegetables during sauteing and in homemade sauces.  It is very good and tastes much like soy sauce.  I would recommend it - the vendor shipped the item in a timely manner and it arrived in good condition.

I love Braggs-  This 6-pack seemed liked a real good deal.  Unfortunately, whoever packed my order had no common sense and they put this on top of other items in my order and those items arrived broken.  They put all six bottles in a thin, plastic bag.  When my order arrived, everything in it including the box, was soaked in Braggs.  I will never order Braggs from Amazon again, I will buy it somewhere else.

My family loves the taste of Braggs.  I like that it is lower in sodium than even the light soy sauce I was using.  I like that Amazon has improved upon the shipping of this item.  It used to arrive leaking, but this last shipment was wrapped in plastic and made it to my door in one piece.  I highly recommend Braggs...it tastes great!

column9: So much better than regular soy sauce
column10: This has a better taste and much less sodium than regular soy sauce.  I use it anywhere that I would normally use soy sauce, plus it's also great for vegan gravy recipes, too.
I am pleased with my order.  I received exactly what I ordered and will order this item (Braggs Liquid Amino)again.

My husband and I used Braggs Liquid Aminos prior to moving to our current location.  Since our move we have tried to find this product in health food stores with no luck.  Finally I checked Amazon and found it.  I was so happy.  This product is wonderful added to soup, rice, you name it,  The taste is great and you can eliminate salt.
This is a must for any kitchen.  Great savory flavor.  I use it in casseroles, stir frys and sandwich wraps.  Use sparingly; a little goes a long way.

We always have a bottle of this in the pantry and use it in a variety of ways. Personally I love to sprinkle it on Chinese food and liberally douse my brown rice with it.It is also great for cooking and finds its way into many of my wife's recipes where it adds a special touch we enjoy. We recommded it highly and suggest you give it a try if you haven't tried it yet and you're into a little culinary experimentation.

I don't like stuff to be very salty, so I've always been hesitant when it comes to soy sauce. But, I tend to cook a lot of asian influenced cuisine and of course run into soy sauce and fish sauce very often, both being almost completely made of just salt. So, a friend of mine suggested this alternative and I'll never go back. It's a way more subtle than soy sauce, so it doesn't over power your meal with one salty flavor, and even helps with your digestion. 4 thumbs up. I ordered the 6 pack and I'm glad I did.

****Stash's Chamomile Caffeine Free Herbal Tea is one of their totally natural teas, containing only chamomile flowers. It is rather weak, but a fine tea---just use two teabags. Many people will find this tea too subtle. I think that Stash's more natural teas seem to be a little weak and undistinguished, while their flavored teas are super-powerful, erring on the side of too powerful for me, overwhelming the tea drinker with all types of strong added flavorings. If I had to pick, I'd always take subtle, as you can make these teas, like this chamomile tea, stronger by doubling up on the bags, but you can't make the strongly flavored teas weaker or less annoying.Stash Tea had their 35th anniversary last month, so they've been around a while, and they are moving in the direction of more organic and loose teas, more true flavors instead of added flavorings. I appreciate that their chamomile is so pure, but wish it could be a little more flavorful.Still, recommended.****
Amazon offers this tea at an amazing price compared to our local grocery stores...even when our stores have it on sale.  And with Free Shipping, you can't beat it.

***Stash's Lemon Ginger Caffeine Free Herbal Tea is a basic lemon ginger tea, tasting strongly of ginger, full of flavorings, and oddly, even contains soy. This is one of the better commercial highly processed, non-organic teas. I much prefer organic teas that are made without artificial flavorings and certainly without soy, but if you are not picky about herb teas, and are looking something very strongly flavored as an introduction to the world of teasans and decaffeinated beverages, this would be fine. If you like your tea more subtle, with true pure tastes, and can discern complex differences between natural and commercial teas, then this definitely is not for you, and I would recommend any Numi tea, Yogi Tea, Traditional Medicinals, or even Stash's organic line of teas (which comes in a wonderful Lemon Ginger Organic Tea!)Stash Lemon Ginger Tea contains ginger root, lemongrass, lemon flavor, safflower, hibiscus, citric acid, and soy.Unfortunately, nothing special.***

****Stash's Wild Raspberry Caffeine Free Herbal Tea is strong and fruity, and that's great if you love the taste of raspberry and hibiscus, which I do. It contains hibiscus, orange peel, lemongrass, rosehips, natural raspberry flavor, licorice powder, and citric acid. The package says it also contains soy, but that makes little sense to me. It is a fine tasting herb tea.If you like a more subtle tea, you may not be crazy about Wild Raspberry. But if you like Celestial Seasonings and other commercial teas, I think that this is a good one. The reason I gave this tea four stars instead of five is that it isn't as pure as it could be (contains additives and flavorings) and I can tell. I prefer a more subtle tea. And I save five stars for the very best teas I've tried. But for those of you who like a lot of flavor, and can't taste the additives, it's just fine!Recommended.****

There is something right about this tea. I don't like drinking green tea, only black. But adding green tea to black brought some pleasant sensations to the mix. I love drinking this tea in the morning...

column9: Lemon Ginger Tea with a Zing
column10: I can't drink caffeine after 2PM so I rely on herbal teas for comfort drinks in the afternoon and evening.  But every once in awhile I want a cuppa that has a bit of zing to it.  This tea is how I get it. [ASIN:B003D4IUUW Stash Premium Lemon Ginger Herbal Tea, Tea Bags, 30-Count Boxes (Pack of 6)]] - great flavor and an absolutely fabulous price.  And it's delivered to me...I don't have to go try to find it in the local store.

Wow, this Mango Passionfruit tea is the best herbal teas I have tasted. It is good hot or cold sweetened with a little Agave. We often have it in the late afternoon when we want to limit caffeine. It is a very refreshing beverage.

column9: The Best Earl Grey Bagged Tea I have Had
column10: This tea is flavorful and delicious and became an instant favorite from the first time I have tried it. Stash Earl Grey started me into experiencing tea beyond iced and typical restaurant fare. Today I have 20 varieties of teas, both in bags and loose and Stash Earl Grey is still one of my favorites to this day. (The flavor for Stash Earl Grey loose tea is different from the bagged. The bagged is better IMO.)Some other flavors and brands you might like if you like Stash Earl Grey.Stash Vanilla Nut Decaf. A perfect desert or night time tea.  Sweetened and with milk, it is divine.http://www.amazon.com/Stash-Premium-Vanilla-Tea-30-Count/dp/B003D4GSAQ/ref=sr_1_6?ie=UTF8&qid=1335572191&sr=8-6Teavan Mate Vanna[...]

This combination of green and white tea from Stash is just right.  I don't like but can tolerate the taste of plain green tea.  The trick here is that the white tea as a nice sweetness to that green-tea taste with no sugar!  It's perfect as an after-lunch pick-me-up and as simple as boiling water, just the right amount of caffeine.  The teabags are foil-sealed, so they stay fresh a long time.  I buy in quantity to save money.  Can't go wrong with this choice.

Stash Chamomile Herbal Tea is tea bags with dried, crushed chamomile flowers.Honestly, as far as I'm concerned, chamomile is chamomile.  I suppose that when you use loose flowers you get sediment in the cup and I have seen this happen with some brands of chamomile tea bags, these don't do that.I have also had organic chamomile (this isn't) but I can't taste the difference.Each bag is individually packaged and that is either good or bad depending on how and where you use it and if you are concerned about excessive packaging.If you like chamomile tea, this is a good choice.
I love this tea.  It tastes sweet w/o any sweetener.  I haven't been able to find it at any of the area grocery stores so was very happy to see Amazon carries it.

I've been drinking Stash Moroccan Mint Green Tea for a few years now and it is absolutely delicious!  I drink it hot, but I imagine it would taste good iced as well.  I've been getting it from Stash's website, but I'll get it on Subscribe & Save for $1 less per box!

I love this tea. It doesn't brew as strong as the regular earl grey, but still great. I really like the bergamot, and find the taste strong enough even without buying the double version. Hard to find locally, so thrilled to find it here.
2 bags to 64 ounces of water and stick it in the refrigerator - very refreshing any time of year
I personally prefer a heavier Jasmine flavor to my green tea.However, this is an excellent tea and one that I would recommend.

Just got back from a wonderful tour with go ahead tours in croatia/slovenia.  Our amazing tour director Tamara shared this wonderful decadent treat. I enjoy the richness with not being so sweet. Everyone in our group(40 americans) bought this treat at their local grocery stores..  I am ordering more because my luggage was so small. so glad to see that i can order more. Definitely a great representive of  Croatia!!!

I have not ordered these yet - they are too good.  My husband and I ate at a Croation restaurant in Astoria OR called The Drina Daisy recently.  After our meal - which was amazing - the chef/owner brought us out a box of the Bajadera Nougat Dessert as we were leaving.  The chocoIate is verrrry good and not too sweet - just right.  I would not hesitate to buy this item, but not now since I am trying to lose weight.

My 20 month old absolutely loves these and they are a truly guilt free snack with lots of vitamin C. 5 stars for flavor and product, 2-3 stars for availability and delivery time... also they moisten up quickly so open a bag and use fast. Add to cream of wheat or oatmeal if you want to use up the dust or a bag that's been open too long.

column9: My Shih Tzu's are obsessed with these!
column10: A friend told me about the Windee Rings and how her dogs adored them so I bought some and gave them to my 4 little Shih Tzus.  They are totally obsessed with these treats!  It takes the small breeds a while to eat them thus keeping them happily preoccupied while you watch your favorite show or catch up on email!  They are relatively soft and break off in small bits making them good for small dogs.  Try them and you'll receive lots of adulation from your canine friends!
I don't know how long the product sat on the shelf, but the windee rings smelled a little rancid.  I did not give to the dogs.

I am a ginger fanatic and this is the best candy I have found. Soft, chewy, full of great ginger flavor and 'heat'! And the packaging is the best. With other brands I have tried, while they have been very flavorful, it was difficult to unwrap them without playing tug of war with the wrapping. These are wrapped in powdered parchment and then an outer wrapper, easy to remove and pop in your mouth. And the Amazon 5-pack price cannot be beat. I paid over twice this price in a local health food store. Stock up - they have a long shelf life!
I enjoy the ginger taste of this candy.  And it really helps settle my stomach.  I had originally bought it in a store but found it at Amazon at a much better price.

column9: The Best Pizza Flour on the market
column10: If you like real tasting Italian pizza it starts with the dough  This flour is the best ikf you want the real thing.
It was Expensive and kind of grainy. Will go with king arthur from now on. The dough was thin as well.
Tasty and fresh - Just like Grandma used to make.  Better than the frozen kind.  In a rich marinara sauce, who can resist?  Service was very good.

column9: Inedible chemical flavor. Our guests unanimously agreed.
column10: We purchased a three pack of chocolate caramel, strawberry vanilla, and lemon poppyseed because the package looked so attractive, and I thought it would save me some time. The flavors sounded very appealing.Reality couldn't be farther removed from the picture. The cupcakes were practically inedible. The chemical flavor of the additives was unbearable. I actually spit out the first bite I took of the chocolate caramel. I asked several guests to try a bite of all three flavors (because I wondered if there was something wrong with me. Couldn't imagine three flavors of such an attractive looking mix could be THAT gross), and not a single person liked them. I ended up throwing everything away, and having to buy something else in a hurry.Furthermore, I'm not someone who likes much frosting on cupcakes, but the package provided barely made enough to thinly cover the cupcakes. Very thinly. If you were to put as much frosting on your cupcake as is shown in the picture, about a third of your frosting would already be used up. This is probably a good thing, since the frosting had that horrible quality of coating the roof of your mouth in a layer of revolting grease that is hard to get rid of. (And I used strictly fresh ingredients that I had just bought, added according to the recipe.)What a waste of THREE packages of cupcake mix and fresh ingredients!!

column9: Taste great...look great...and perfect for a party!
column10: I would politely disagree with the above reviewer- I bought each of the three Cobblestone cupcake varieties on a friend's recommendation, and am so glad that I did!I made these cupcakes for my girlfriend's baby shower, and everyone loved them- they were easy to make and were much higher quality than other gourmet brands I've tried. The cupcakes were very light and were the prefect size for a cocktail-like party. One suggestion I have would be to make double the amount of icing they recommend- The amount they suggest is sufficient to cover each cupcake, but I made double the icing so that I could pipe it on (...they ended up looking just like the high-end cupcakes you see in fancy shops.)These delightful cupcakes helped to make my party a success...and the packaging looks so pretty that you are not afraid to hide the box in the recycling bin!

Boots (the most handsome red tom cat you'll ever see!) loves these treats.  We keep them on a shelf in the pantry - only problem is everytime we open the pantry door he thinks he gets a treat.  We've tried other cat treats which he always eats (truth is, Boots eats everything!) but these seem to be his favorite by far.

My cat loved these! But, I don't know how he ever enjoyed them - he just swallows them whole! Not a tooth mark in any of them so he didn't really get to enjoy the gooey centers.  But, he really liked them otherwise and chewed a couple here and there.  They're really small so if your cat has a small mouth, then this one would be a good choice.  I have to buy these for my cat's bad teeth and he really appreciates them! They do a good job in keeping his teeth clean so I don't have to brush them so often.  Love that!

I have tried all the treats available, the natural ones, the gourmet ones, everyone imaginable one listed ... at great expense. My cats will not eat anything else but Whiskas. They love all the flavours but they especially love the beef and the seafood medley. So if you have a bunch of unopened and unfinished cat treats in your cupboard and have reached a point of exasperation as to what next? Go with any of the Whiskas Temptations products. You will not be disappointed, and neither would they.

Probably not. But close. After trying a dozen or so "enticers" I happened upon Whiskas Temptations (the regular salmon and chicken versions). Other reviewers have tried various versions ("natural" and regular) of Whiskas Temptations as treats with similar results. I can echo their critiques in regard to using this line as an appetite booster or flavor enhancer as well. For more detail on my search for an effective "enticer" take a look at my separate review of CAT-MAN-DOO BONITO SPRINKLES.
Since my cats are the only opinions I have to go by, it was a good choice.They have always liked the Whiskas products and this is no exception.

My cats are wild about these treats.  I wish I knew what whiskas put in them to make the cats love them so much.  These treats are supposed to be nutritionally balanced and have 2 calories a snack.  They have a nice little crispy crunch that you can hear when your cat chomps on them.  My two cats are especially crazy about the savory salmon flavor, although they love them all.  You'll probably like that they don't smell horrendous like a lot of cat treats out there.  You might even be able to train your cat to do tricks for these treats.

There is not much to say other than I have tried every treatt imagineable and these are the ones my cas LOVE.  They are small but I don't think that matters.  They are treats so why do they have to be big?  They are hard and crunchy on the outside and soft inside.  My cats try and lick my fingers when I finish giving them a set amount.  If they hear the bag, they come running.  I only tried the beef because I do not think giving fish to a cat is a good idea.  I might try another non-fish flavor but if they love the beef, I may just stick with it.  My only hesitation is the first ingredient is by products but I suppose as a treat once in a while, it cannot hurt.
it was/is really great.  my only complaint is that the amounts sold is not enough to practically cover the shippin g price.
Good stuff, but you'll breathe garlic after it until the next day. Otherwise tasty and easy to cook.

The other reviewer's comments influenced my purchase for the GARLIC to chase the winter colds that may appear. Soups and entrees heavy on the onions and garlic are my family's cure all to get you well. I couldn't wait to this to arrive to try it out. It is very easy to make and will shoo away vampires, germs, "too close for comfort" friends and family dog. There are stove top and microwave (5-7 minute) directions included. It's quick, tasty and a WINNER on sale for about ONE buck a box (free shipping eligible).Psst...I added mixed vegetables, it was liked by all NO LEFTOVERS!

I picked these up at a local bakery before xmas started (as they fly off shelves around here for some reason....) and OH MY GOODNESS they are delicious! Crispy coated frosting on the top/sides, and a nice semi-fluffy moist cake center. The flavor was also subdued and not too overpowering.One of my favorite German cookie treats! I recommend them to anyone.

column9: Great product, good supplier, fair price
column10: I love Devil Dogs. Unfortunately, here in the Seattle area they are not for sale. For the last few years I have odered them online. The product you are viewing is sold by an affiliate merchant with Amazon. Shipping is done by the seller. I wouldn't be surprised if the seller buys the Devil Dogs at a local supermarket, boxes them, and ships. In terms of the product itself, well Devil Dogs are really wonderful. This review is more about buying them than extolling their value as a treat.The first thing to know is that Drakes Cakes short dates Devil Dogs. They have an expiration date less than a month after manufacture. This is their way of assuring freshness. Expect the product you receive from this vendor to have a week or less of time before the "sell before" date. This is not a problem. As long as you get them before the sell-by date, you will be fine. One really nice thing about this product is that you can safely freeze them in their package. I just open the carton, unpack, the retail packs and put them in the freezer. I then pull them out one box at a time as needed. They don't get stale that way and the taste does not change due to freezing.As far as this seller goes, shipping is pompt. In this case they came in a Priority Mail package. No damage of any kind. My one complaint is the shipping cost. As I recall it is nearly $8 per order of 6. Now that isn't too bad all things considered. What did bother me is that when I priced a double order (12 retail packs), the shipping price doubled! There is no savings if you order more. What this means to me is that I will only order 6 boxes at a time. So, if you figure the cost: $26 for the product and $8 for shipping, you are paying $34, which turns out to be about 71 cents each. Well worth it to me.In summary, this is a great treat, fairly priced, and promptly shipped. A good deal all around.

I bought K-CUPSS that contain, Strawberry Burst with Pomergranite in the K-CUPS. Put the K-CUP in thr Kruig Coffee Maker and let it go in the Glass over the Ice, and you will have a brand new bursting drink, that is out of this world. It is delicious.24 K-CUPS, come in a box, and is not exspenive either. You will have a great drink, it is amazing, you can taste the Strawberrys, and the Pomegranite, together. It is a amazing drink for the Summer time, you will enjoy it. (I RECCOMMEND THIS DRINK TO EVERYONE, IT'S DELICIOUS.)Jim in Ohio.

The syrup is in a glass bottle which I think makes the syrup taste much better than those in a plastic bottle.  The seller wrapped the package very well, so no breakage on arrival.  Very quick on shipping the product too.

i first tried this product in my coffee at starbucks and was soon hooked.  it tastes amazing without all the sugar/calories.  i would def recommend this product.  i purchased the pump with it, which makes dispensing the syrup very easy.  i felt like i had my own gourmet coffee shop at thome!

I ordered a bottle of the Sugar Free Vanilla and a Sugar Free Mocha at the same time.  They arrived in a very reasonable amount of time and with no issues.The syrup itself is great - I make homemade "skinny" lattes with this syrup and the trust espresso machine we got for the holidays.  Great way to start the morning and much cheaper than Sta*buck$!

column9: If you like the vainilla bean its for you!
column10: Its incredible the real flavor that has this product,  that besides it is sugar free.I didnt like because this kind of flavor (vainilla bean) is not for me.I like more "normal" vainilla.But congratulations!You have a lot of sugar free flavors and we choose what we like.If you like the vainilla bean this its for you!

While they have a few mustards to choose from I picked this one solely as a dare, to the Fallot people, to disappoint me.  I've had their Dijon and their Dijon with Peppercorn so I knew that they knew what they were doing.  When I saw the Gingerbread variant I figured it was the LEAST appealing.  For me that is always a sign of a way to expand my horizons so I went for it.  It is excellent.  The more detailed ingredients include wheat and spices.  It's not the gingerbread taste I was expecting, which is a good thing.  It is dijon with a very unique zip to it.  I put it on ham with a whole grain wheat bread.  I prefer high tech ingredients like Boar's Head rosemary & sundried tomato ham but it's too delicate for this particular mustard so just use a basic high quality meat.  Serve it to yourself though, unless you know someone who is a total "foodie."  I paired it(LOL) with a French beverage in the form of a Citadelle gin martini.  Look to the French for food and art and you won't be disappointed,
They were smaller than I expected and my Lab mix was reluctant to chew but did finally chew and eat them all. I recommend these chew bones for dogs 40 pounds or smaller.
These are the best gluten free Pretzels I've ever had. Super pricey compared to regular pretzels, but if you can't have gluten, this is the way to go!
My husband uses hazelnut extract to flavor his coffee.He uses one teaspoon for a whole pot. I also use it in baking.I also use other extract for baking thank you so much for you products  Joan
I needed this product for a recipe and couldn't find hazelnut extract in any local grocery stores.  This was a fast, easy way to get the hazelnut extract!

I have been using Giovanni Body Wash (White Tea scent) for several years now. I have extremely sensitive skin, prone to acne, rashes and irritations when using most other soaps. I have wasted tons of money trying soap after soap hoping to find something that wouldn't irritate my skin, lathering well, while leaving me feeling clean. This soap has a really nice, soft scent, washes skin clean of dirt and oil and leaves no soap scum after rinsed off. This is the only soap I have found that does not cause break-outs/irritations and lathers well. I truely wish I could find a more econonmcal product that does the same job as this body wash but still haven't found one. So I try to find really good deals when buying this body wash to help off set the cost.Please note: this soap is a little drying.. so if you already have a dry skin conidtion this may not be the soap for you. I lived in a very warm humid climate when I started using this soap and did not notice the drying effect until I moved to a much cooler and dryer area. With that being said Giovanni also sells one of the best moisturizers I have ever used, it's their body butter (comes in the same scents as the body washes). This body butter works fantasticly! I am in the health care field and have to wash my hands many, many times a day. If I put some of the body butter on at night right before I go to sleep, my hands are moisturized all the next day without reapplying! I have tried many moisturizers that seems to work great until you wash your hands, then its like you never had any on in the first place... the body butter is not like this.

Ok, so I absolutely love the packaging and the nifty description on the back of the bottle, but when I'm paying .64/oz, I expect it to moisturize. Giovanni claims that their washes include "essential oil complex to soothe, smooth and regenerate skin's lost moisture" but the ingredients' list contains no such ingredient, unless they are referring to the "Essential Oil Fragrance" in which case they are blatantly lying because essential oils provide scent, not moisture. Even the dollar bottles of cheapo wash at Walmart contain some type of moisturizer, albeit petroleum. Sometimes I use St. Ives Whipped Silk body wash and it's definitely more moisturizing than Giovanni due to the sunflower oil. I've noticed even JASON's washes contain Sodium PCA to moisturize (although their stuff also has harsh sulfates, so I've never tried them). Or maybe Giovanni deliberately left out any moisturizers out so that we buy their lotions/body butters. Ha!While I sound like I hate the product, I really don't; I just wish it provided some moisture. The good: it looks and feels like a spa product, washes well and rinses cleanly, and smells good and not artificial perfumey like Herbal Essences and all that other junk. Also, it actually works well as a shampoo when in a pinch. In fact, I've taken to using it as shampoo as well since Giovanni keeps changing their shampoo formulas (and for the worse, it seems, judging from the new ingredients) and body washes tend to be more gentle than shampoos. I've tried Raspberry Winter, Lavender Vanilla Snow, Cassifluer White Tea, and D:tox (bar soap form) and they all smell awesome. True aromatherapy in a bottle.

These were so delicious that I ate the entire contents of six tins in less than 2 weeks.As other reviewers have noted, they dissolve very quickly, unlike Spry mints.Although they taste better than Spry lemon-mint flavor, I'm re-ordering only the Spry because I'm just interested in using a few xylitol candies after meals for improved dental health, not losing all control and pigging out night and day.
I am trying to find a little candy that is not bad for you but these are not the ones!  They have an aftertaste that is unpleasant and just don't work for me at all.

I love the citrus and the raspberry flavors of the Ricochet Sours.  They are shaped like Smarties candies, but are a bit more crumbly.  I love sweet and tart, and these certainly fit the bill.  I bought them to help stop my out of control afternoon sweets cravings.  I love that they are good for my teeth.  Yay xylitol!

I love sour candy and since Altoids are not in the market anymore, I gave a try these candy, and boy it was the worst experience ever, they were unedible, the candy wre broken and powderish inside the can, I thought it was only one can, but I opened the six of them and they were same, I called Amazon right away and they refunded me and the candies went to garbage

In a word: FUN. You would not believe how a pair of eyes can transform a bowl of ice cream. And if you really get into it (whip cream hair, sprinkles for a beard, candy for the mouth) it can bring ice cream sundae parties to a whole new high. Plus, they taste good.
Bought these for Thanksgiving and Christmas baking and they worked great on my cookies and crafts.  Cannot wait to see what else they can be used for.
I love these 8.5 oz cans. I remove the pull-off lid and place the can inside a glass cup and snack on the pear halves while watching TV.

Hard fruit candy first enjoyed in England and unable to find in local US shops.  Taste is so fresh as if eating the fruit itself.  A bit expensive so a real treat. Packaged well for freshness.  Highly recommend.
Havent had a 100 grand for over 20 years, thought they faded away.  Was surprized to find them after all these years. Ordered some and they tasted just as good now as I remembered.

I purchased the candy bars for a family function and they were a big hit and they tasted awesome.  I was skeptical that they might taste stale for some reason, but absolutly no complaints here.  Great price for a box of King Size Bars!

I'm so grateful for this coffee.  Not only is it delicious but the acid levels are low enough that I can indulge in my guilty pleasure without the pain.  And it's organic!  I'm so glad to find it on Amazon with the free shipping - I can stock up so I never run out!
I should've known better than to expect fresh coffee from a warehouse buy. There was no expiration date on the bags. I knew as soon as I smelled it that it was undrinkable. I had to throw it away.
I have been on the search for good coffee on Amazon, this one is pretty good, smooth taste, bought it on sale otherwise I might not buy it as it is quite expensive. We shall see!

My puppy LOVES this product. I've been using this for training rewards, and he listens and expedites an order I have given hime EVERYTIME to recieve one! He even goes straight to the counter where the treats are when he is finished with something he's done that I've trained him on. :) He never gets tired of it. Also, filet's are flakey enough where you can break apart to give in pieces. They also make pilets, which I find solid and not as 'brittle' as the flakes. Either way, your dog will LOVE this product and love you for it!

This salsa mix is excellent.  It used to be available at my local store, but they do not carry it anymore.  I have tried others but this one is the best.  I do add a few additional items to the mix.. jalapenos, banana peppers, cilantro, lime & lemon juice, sugar, whatever you like your salsa to taste like, it is just a GREAT base mix.

It seemed like a good idea. Buy in bulk and save some cash, but as it were being shipped it must have warmed up and cooled down. Many of them were stuck together, and colors rubbed off on each other. There was a 2lb mass of beans in the box! Also, beware and don't freak out because the package consists of a cardboard box and jelly beans. No plastic inside the box, no paper lining, nothing. Kind of creepy, but I'm not dead yet, so it must be okay.

Really liked the 10 flavor sour mix from Jelly Belly, but couldn't seem to find them locally anymore.  Now they are selling the sour mix as a 5 flavor mix.  Was concerned following the other review about beans sticking together, but decided it'd be worth it to have 10 flavors.  Box arrived and they were stuck together, but only 5 flavors.  A waste of my time.  Never would have ordered if product had been described correctly by the seller.  Just drive to the store and get the 5 flavor mix that's not already stuck together.

The sour jelly bellies are tasty; however, this item contains the 5-flavor mix. The description for 10 flavors is inaccurate and misleading. Amazon.com, please fix this!!!  Either change the description or provide the 10-flavor mix.
This is a 5 flavor assortment, not the 10 flavor assortment. If your looking for the 10 flavor assortment as I was, DO NOT ORDER THIS!!! False advertising...
I buy these for the office and put them in the candy machine from Brookstone.  The partners love them!

yeah...This came in as a package. Candies are in the paper board package without plastic bags or any sort of containers. Yes, I am still alive, and this is my second package. Everyone is calling me crazy for buying 10 pounds of candy, but for the quantity vs price...I think it's worth it.

Golden Malted makes the best waffles!  We have tried the regular and the blueberry and liked them both.  Thought we'd give the pumpkin a try because we like pumpkin pie.  These came out perfect--crispy on the outside and fluffy on the inside.  They are not overly sweet.  I can't think of any other way to say that they are just right.  Try em, you'll like em!

My family loves this mix.  We normally use it for Belgian waffles, but occasionally also use it for pancakes. I don't often buy mixes, but I have never found a recipe that we like as well as this, so this is one of the exceptions I make. I like it enough to have it on auto refill and sometimes need to have it sent early.  We also like the plain and blueberry mixes by Golden Malt, but this is our favorite.  It has a nice pumpkin flavor, but is not too strong tasting.

These are very mild flavored.  So they don't overpower you.  They come out crispy and just right in my Belgian waffle iron.  I used Dark Amber Maple syrup on top and served up with smoked sausage patties.  They made the perfect Thanksgiving Day Breakfast.  I will be getting more of these.
Great taste at a fraction of the cost you'll pay at retail shops.  Only downside is the sometimes limited quantities and smaller size (as compared to the 32oz).
Very disappointed I usually use Trader Joes punkin pancake mix and this was not the same. I even tried adding pumpkin spice to the mix and it came up short. Very disappointing.

column9: The best stock in the world!
column10: This is marvellous flavouring for soups and gravy ... there is nothing quite like it.However $40 for shipping is ridiculous so I won't be buying it from amazon.
One of the few remaining bubble gums without artificial sweetener. This gum has a great flavor and doesn't leave you with that nasty aftertaste from artificial sweeteners. So good!

This is all the "real grape like flavor" you remember from your childhood....  If you want a tasty gum with no aspartame this is it.  The box comes covered in cellophane.  So it will remain fresh for a long time after you buy it.  Enjoy.

I'm new to ordering food items through Amazon, but I'm already an advocate.  Prices are reasonable and the convenience is awesome - also, I'm able to order some items from home that I used to have to go to separate grocers to purchase therefore this is saving me time and money!  The only negative for me is that Amazon does not yet make nutrition information available on the food pages.  As a mom who is always striving to give her family well balanced meals, I am an avid nurtrition label reader.  This specific item was great - I read other reviews regarding the unhealthy sugar content of some of the cereals Kellogg's makes - this is where I laugh.  Cocoa Krispies are NOT a health food - they're a special treat that we as a family enjoy, what I love about these is the portion control.  It took me a while to track down the exact nutrition information for this specific size portion before purchasing, so to save you all that extra step I've listed that information for you:The serving size for these is 3/4 cup (1 package/bowl)Calories - 130 Calories from Fat - 10Total Fat - 1g (2%) Saturated Fat - 0.5g (3%) Trans Fat - 0gCholesterol - 0mgSodium 200mg (8%)Total Carb. 28g (9%) Fiber - 1g (3%) Sugars - 15gProtein - 1g
loved them and sent some to iraq to my soldier there. made his life more interesting and more like home too.
great for a quick breakfast or to throw in backpack just in case its needed-96 packs in one box means no fighting over the cocoa krispies in the variety pack

column9: Love the taste - Hate the hidden Trans Fat
column10: We love the flavor of this cereal; however, it has hidden Trans Fat.  If you look at the label it says zero grams, but they are rounding the amount down to zero.  The product contains partially hydrogenated oils.
These treats are few that my pups will eat that are made in USA and wheat free!  The size of the treat is just right for both medium and large dogs!

column9: Torani sugar free syrups make food interesting
column10: I love torani sugar free syrups in my protein shakes, oatmeal and cream of wheat.. Salted Carmel is the best! But they are all good!

My son has a life threatening allergy to peanuts and tree nuts.  Tried other soybutter - YUCK!  This product really lives up to it's name, and my son is so excited to be able to eat a sandwich that is as close to a PBJ as he'll get.  It has a soy aftertaste, but on a sandwich, it really lives up to it's name!  Yippee!  We are going to tell all our friends about this product.

I have two girls.. One of them is allergic to peanut and another one misses to eat peanut butter and jelly sandwich. So, after try a sample from its company, my daughter ate it without any problem. She didn't know that it was soybutter. :) But yes, you can tell the difference. It's way better than I ever try with other soy butter. This is BEST ONE. So, I decided to order the package through amazon. I am pleased with it. Shipping is GREAT. Will order it again when we run out of soybutter.

This is a great tasting alternative for those who are allergic to peanut butter or those who just want to try something new. We have allergies in our family, so we don't keep PB in the house. My entire family loves the flavor and texture. I would highly recommend trying it. We got a free sample from the manufacturer's website first, and then purchased the case on amazon.

column9: Used To Do Peanut Butter, Then Sun Butter, Now the WOW!
column10: Before our son was born and we discovered his peanut allergy, we were peanut lovers.  We would buy huge bags of them and make messes cracking them all over the house.  It was like one of those restaurants where people get to feel like foraging animals by throwing their shells on the floor.  OK, so I exaggerate a bit.  You get the point.Then, we learned of my son's peanut allergy at a young age.  Funny how an ambulance ride will get the peanuts out of the house quickly.  We first tried Sun Butter, and we were instantly hooked.  We ate it like there was no tomorrow.  We quit our jobs and just ate Sun Butter in front of the TV.  OK, so I exaggerate a bit.  You get the point.Then, we learned of my son's SUNFLOWER allergy.  Yes, he was allergic to sunflower, for crying out loud.  What next?!?  Well, we love the little bugger, and we decided it was time to clear out the house of anything with sunflower in it.  Soon, I decided it was time to try these soy butter concoctions.  WOWBUTTER seemed like one of the top brands, and the price was right.  Plus, the jars are a tad bigger than those of their competitors.  To our surprise, we found ourselves in a soy butter frenzy after eating a few jars of WOWBUTTER.  It truly tastes like peanut butter to us.  How do they do this with soybeans?  Beats me, but we are believers.  We are more than believers.  We are cult members.  OK, so I exaggerate a bit.Try the stuff.  You'll love it.

column9: Did not like the flavor, does not taste like PB
column10: I was drawn in by the "tastes just like peanut butter", and decided to purchase this at our local store. My peanut allergic daughter was so excited to try it, but we were both sadly disappointed. We did not like the flavor at all, and she refused to eat it on a sandwich. In fact, all three of my kids did not like it. Our house definitely prefers sunflower seed butter to this alternative.

My kids like a peanut butter sandwich for a snack, but their school is "nut free". At the beginning of the year, they were willing to eat this Wowbutter, but by the middle of the school year, they were saying it tastes bad. It doesn't really taste like peanut butter; it's kind of a smokey taste. I think the smokiness was overpowering for the kids. It's not bad, so it still gets 3 stars, but I think adults would enjoy this more than kids. Try Sunbutter instead for kids.

One of my children has life threatening peanut and tree nut allergies.  Hence, like many other families in the same situation, we had to explore other options.  Until recently, we just worked around it for lunches with other food (protein) items until we tried this product.  The whole family now enjoys creamy SchoolSafe SoyButter with Fluff, Jelly, and whatever else they can think of to put it on!  This product is a homerun!  Reading from the label, this product is manufactured in a peanut and tree nut facility.  The listed Ingredients are:  Canadian toasted soy, soy oil, granulated cane sugar, monoglyceride (from vegetable oil), sea salt.

column9: Boy, did I MISS PB until I found this!
column10: I first bought this product at the local grocery store and I'm ready now to buy a case and have my sister-in-law ship it to me here in Okinawa, Japan. I love this Soybutter!  I compared it within a week (because that's what it took me and my son to devour a whole jar) to the IM Healthy Soybutter-NO COMPARISON! The texture, sweetness, and taste that I remembered from before I developed this ridiculous nut allergy is what this product delivered. Maybe it doesn't taste EXACTLY like peanut butter but I've missed PB&J for 15 years and actually tried peanuts to see if I was REALLY allergic (only to discover that I am-OUCH!). I have been waiting to order a case because the cost is pricey to me..it's just so GOOD. I just wish it was sold in the commissary.
This is a great substitute for peanut butter. I have a child with a peanut allergy and we have been eating soy butter for 10 years. This is one of the best yet!

column9: My kids are allergic to peanuts :(
column10: They now feel they are like everyone else with there PB&J sandwiches!  The nutritional content is on par with peanut butter.  It's softer and more smooth than peanut butter, but that just makes for easier spreading.  I've even baked it into cookies and tossed it with melted chocolate and dry cereals for a snack mix.  No one can tell it's not the real thing.Just wish it was less costly.  Worth it to purchase it by the case!

This is as good as it gets!  I'm allergic to peanuts and this is so close to peanut butter that I am amazed.  I really missed PB&J sammies and now I can have that old commfor food again.  Try it, you will be amazed too!

I 1st saw it at a KROGER clearance shelf, priced 1.49, since I love soymilk,soybean...tofu...so I got it to see how it works,  Geez!  it is GOOD!....I always love peanut butter, but this stuff is so tasty! So I bought a box (6 ), and  finally got my super picky eater 6 year old try it...SHE eats nothing but this now for her lunch!  .....just hope they are no as expensive so I can enjoy more.
This is a good tasting product at a good price and I will buy it again!!

This soy butter does really taste great and smells more like peanut butter than any other product I have found.  Our son has a nut allergy, so this is our alternative.  The kids love it.  It also makes great cookies!

column9: It really does taste just like peanut butter!
column10: "WOW, Tastes Just Like Peanut Butter!" All Natural Creamy SCHOOLSAFE SOYBUTTER (SoyNut Butter) KIDS LOVE IT! Beats IM Healthy Soy Nut Butter Hands Down. Bigger 17.6 oz. Jar Gives 1 LB. more/cs than IM H's 15 oz jar--for BIG 20 % SAVINGS! Better Taste-Be...I was really pleased with the great taste and smooth texture of this SchoolSafe SoyButter. Contrary to what many companies would have you believe soy is NOT a health food unless it is fermented (which is common in many asian cultures).  Once fermented it has many health benefits, but unfermented it can cause many health issues, can have negative hormonal effects and has been linked to cancer. My daughter is in a peanut free classroom and loves peanut butter.  I heard about wow butter and thought I would try it, I was a bit skeptical as my 6 yr old is quite fussy, and that 6 jars of something she wouldn't like would be a lot.  But it was much cheaper to buy six and I would give it away if she didn't like it.  well it arrived and we tried it and knew why it was called WOW butter because as we tasted it we said WOW it tastes just like peanut butter. it was delicious.  The only down side is that it is a bit creamier and thinner than real peanut butter.  It also includes small stickers under the jar label so you can  label the sandwich and tell the school it is peanut free. I would highly recommend this product if your child likes peanut butter and is in a peanut free classroom or school.
