column9: Yes it does have an odor that some will find disagreeable, but it works for me and I will continue to purchase it
column10: I read some of the reviews on here and I almost didn't purchase.  But I reached a point where due to my erratic work schedule, trying to fit in my studying time and completing assignments, my sleep pattern was disrupted and it was affecting my mood and concentration.  So I bit the bullet and purchased this at a local B&M store.  When I got home after work, I boiled some water and opened the package.  I noticed that this tea was packaged in a plastic bag so I guess it did has a pungent smell.  I opened the plastic bag and took a big whiff.  I was kind of disappointed.  It doesn't smell as bad as some of the other reviewers made it out to me but then again my nose has been wonky for some time so it could be me.  Yes I will admit that it does has a funky odor but it is not that strong to me.  To me, smells like this health food store I used to frequent in the Hyde Park neighborhood.  Very musky but weirdly comforting.  I have tried it with peppermint, turmeric (for a different affliction) and I have tried it plain with stevia and it taste okay to me.  I wouldn't say I have an iron stomach because I can easily get sick if food is left out in the open not at the proper temperature.  For me, this product took about two days for it to kick in and I am now able to sleep for a full eight hours straight instead of sleeping in fits of four hours here, wake up for about two hours, sleep for three, wake up for a hour and sleep for another four hours.  For those with sensitive noses and sense of taste, you have been amply warned by other reviewers.  For others, I say give it a shot or at least pair it with some other teas to dilute the taste a bit.  For example, mints like peppermint or spearmint will help.  Some folks will use lavender to mask the smell.

column9: Tastes decent...just nothing like butter chicken

column9: Has the be the greatest soft drink EVER!
column10: Ramune has to be one of the coolest and most unique soft drinks that I have ever seen. My kids had been dying to try this stuff ever since they had come across it on J-Box, the popular Japanese import webshop. Ramune is incredibly popular in it's native Japan, and now it looks like the fun is beginning to spread here in the States.To open a bottle of Ramune, you have to remove the top, pop out this little plastic plunger from it's casing, and then use the plunger to pop out a marble that seals the neck of the bottle. The neck of the bottle has two indentions that will hold the marble when you tip the bottle back to drink from it, keeping the neck of the bottle clear. Hold the bottle the wrong way, and the marble will clog things up. You can avoid carbonated overflow when opening by pressing gently on the plunger until it depresses the marble; knock it down with force and you're sure to get a fountain of spray.The original flavor reviewed here tastes a lot like Sprite, but Ramune also comes in several other flavors. It uses high fructose corn syrup and/or cane sugar as a sweetener (It lists both on the label, which usually means that it uses whatever is cheapest on the world market at the time of bottling. Listing both also means that they don't have to change their labeling every time they change sweetener.)This is a way fun product that kids (and most adults) will have a blast with. It's a smaller portion (8 ounces) than what we're used to here in the US, but that actually works out for us as we're trying to limit the amount of soda that our kids consume. Ramune works great as an occasional soda treat and the fun factor alone keeps us coming back for more. Ramune is easy to find at just about any Asian market, but for those who don't have easy access to one, ordering here on Amazon would be recommended.Also, for the safety conscious, I can attest that these drinks are very safe. We've never had a problem with the marble, and I can't find any reports on the internet that would indicate any safety concerns with this drink. It's not a choking hazard, in other words. Ramune means 'carbonated' in Japanese, and I can highly recommend this wonderful and very different drink.

column9: Great Balanced Choice for Dog Nutrition
column10: When we adopted our dog six months ago, we went to both the local big box pet store and the boutique store in our neighborhood to read the ingredient labels of every bag of dog food. Our dog loves it so far, it keeps well in our storage bin and all around it is nice to feed our dog something that we know is giving a solid nutritional foundation every day.As a side note, this food is also a great size to use for training and to put inside chew toys. Yes, many search for a substitute for Dessaux Fils Vinegar, out of business for years, once Julia Childs' only vinegar, with a perfectly aged and balanced flavor and virtually zero vinegar edge.  The Roland review that recommends their aged red wine vinegar as a substitute for Dessaux Fils  is off the mark.  The Roland is fine, but at 7% acidity, it is closer to the Italian style and much too harsh.  The closest we have found is Dutour Red Wine Vinegar (Aged in Wood).  At 6%, it is almost as smooth and balances at Dessaux Fils.

For many years, I used Dessaux wine vinegar exclusively.  I am glad to say that Roland French Aged Red Wine Vinegar is a fine substitute and once again, I enjoy making my own salad dressing.  I was a bit anxious to order vinegar on line but the packaging was more than adequate - I was impressed.

After losing Dessaux Fils vinegar on the market here in the New York region, I searched for several years for a replacement. The Roland works despite its expense, but it is worth every penny, if you want an authentic French vinaigre. Stuff it full of fresh tarragon and pour away.

column9: My favorite tea in the whole world. Period.
column10: Now, I don't presume to say that this is a tea for everyone. I don't quite get it, but obviously, considering the reviews on the t-bag version of this item (Numi Organic Tea Chocolate Puerh, 16-Count Full Leaf Tea Bags (Pack of 2)), many people don't like it at all. (I gave t-bags to 2 co-workers, after raving about how wonderful this is, and their lack of comment 6 weeks later tells me that they didn't like it, either.) It's up to you whether you want to risk disliking it, or missing out on something truly amazing. (Rule of thumb: If you like pu-erh, you might as well try it; if not, this might not be your best introduction to it.) But for godssake, try the small size before buying 1 lb of it!When I'm having a horrible day, when things have turned sour and the world seems to be against me, this is my cup of comfort, my security blanket. It soothes me, calms me with its sheer deliciousness. (Give a child a big bar of chocolate, and he'll stop sulking in no time. That's my equivalent.)Now, this tea is amazing, but far from perfect. I wish there was more pu-erh itself than condiments (chocolate nibs, orange pieces). When I peak inside the bag I really see more pieces of this and that than tea (and chocolate + orange should never cost $43/pound; this is what it comes down to). This works better for re-steepings than the t-bags, but it doesn't go as far as most cooked pu-erhs.In fact, these shortcomings annoy me a bit, and I've been looking for other chocolate teas (pu-erh and non-pu-erh) to substitute it. So far they've all failed. It is next to impossible to find *good* chocolate tea; most are terrible. See: I hate rooibos, so that plus chocolate equals "eeew". I like black tea, but haven't found a good combination yet. Green tea and chocolate sounds gross; I haven't tried it yet. Same for white and oolong. I've only found another brand of chocolate pu-erh (Mighty Leaf) but the flavor just wasn't there.But I found a way to make this perfect: I mix it with regular pu-erh! Rishi Tea Organic Pu-erh Tuo Cha Loose Tea, 5-Ounce Tin (Pack of 2) or a Camel's Breath tuo cha works beautifully. This way I can steep it 3-4 times, and I get the super yummy flavor in a much stronger version. Heavenly!!!
Nice rich flavor, I like it as an addition to my usual Numi Organic Gunpowder Green Tea! A little expensive, but that seems the norm for organic puerh...
We have been drinking Pu Erh tea for over 40 years and this is the best.  The pouch reseals and the tea keeps its flavor until the end.  And its organic!

column9: This is my 1st experience with Puerh tea & I love it!!

It smells like chocolate, orange with a hint of vanilla in when it comes out of the bag and has the subtle taste of all three flavors once brewed. I'm glad I tried this puerh... I'll be back for more!

column9: Don't bother with the tea bags -- go for the full leaf!
column10: Pu-erh is a tricky tea to talk about.  It is part of an ancient tradition of health-giving teas that isn't discussed or researched in the west. It comes from old (reallllly old) tea plants/trees.  It's aged in caves (natural or more lately, man made -- though purists will probably break out into cold sweats and loud fights over that one.)  This is the tea whose long tradition is of being given as a wedding gift -- like the envelopes of money in the Godfather movies.  Everyone brings pu-erh from their own stash, and contributes it to the newlywed's new stash.Pu-erh comes in green and black varieties -- this one is black.  Green is usually milder in flavor, and has less caffeine.  Black is considered more potent.Well -- this is very mild and smooth.  Delicate, in fact, like the best pu-erh touchas I've had.  The chocolate is an added bonus (who is ever going to argue with chocolate -- either for its taste -- or its own healthy attributes!)The chocolate and the pu-erh are both so complex that your best bet is to just dive in.  It tastes good -- especially with a little milk/half and half and a tiny bit of sugar (don't muck around with chemical sweeteners on this one. -- go for natural.)And go for the loose tea over the tea bags. I've had both -- and there's a depth of flavor in the steeping of this loose tea that really makes a difference.

column9: Only buy if you love ORANGE tea
column10: Chocolate?  The strongest flavor of this tea - it's actually quite overwhelming - is ORANGE.  It seems to be of good quality so if you like strong ORANGE tea, then this is for you.  Unfortunately I now have a large bag of tea that I'll never drink because I don't care for the ORANGE taste.

column9: Doesn't Begin To Compare With the Real Thing
column10: I usually buy Pu-erh tea at a store about 40 miles away, it comes in an orange box for less than 1/4 of the price of this (per pound). I haven't been able to get to that store for a while, and was having Pu-erh withdrawal, so I decided to try this. I don't know if this isn't aged, if it comes from inferior trees, or it's something else in how it's processed (or a combination of all of them), but this doesn't even begin to compare with the wonderfully complex and slightly pungent "real" Pu-erh that I've been drinking for the last twenty or so years. A real disappointment, I hope that Amazon gets the "real" product from China for sale someday - until then, I guess I've got a drive to take.

column9: A very good Chinese red tea

column9: Nut-Thins are crunchier than a potato chip!
column10: I originally purchased Nut-Thins as a snack for my cousin who would be visiting and told me she didn't eat gluten. I have never bought any other product that states made in a facility that also manufacturers wheat, however I would buy these again since each box is tested and given the seal of approval to be certified GF by American standards.

column9: If you love Cheetos and Goldfish snacks, you'll love this even more!
column10: This is a great substitute for less healthy, wheat-based, cheese-flavored snacks such as Cheetos, Goldfish and Doritos.I'm not allergic to wheat, but I love these crackers anyway, and I've tried all the flavors. I personally rank them this way in terms of my preference:pecanalmond with a touch of sea salthazelnutregular almondBBQcheddar cheesesmokehousecountry ranchI'm unusual in that I don't rank this at the top, but all the flavors are big winners to me, so my gradations of preference aren't huge.My two crunchy snacks of choice for some time now have been Snyder's Butter Snaps Pretzels and popcorn popped in my Nordic Ware 60120 Microwave Popcorn Popper, but I recently discovered Blue Diamond Nut-Thins, and they've pushed those two treats from the top of my crunch list. In fact, I used to think the Snyder's butter flavor was great, but now in comparison, it just seems bland. The flavor of all of these various Nut-Thins crackers is sublime.In addition, you simply cannot beat this cracker for mouth feel if you like plenty of snap. They are wonderful with dips, but they are so delicious, I actually prefer to eat them plain.At only 8 calories per cracker, Nut-Thins compare favorably to the Snyder mini pretzels I mentioned, which are 5 calories each.Here is a list of the ingredients: Rice flour, almonds, cheddar seasoning [cheddar cheese powder] disodium phospate, salt, maltodextrin, natural cheese flavor, salt, enzymes, yeast extract, xanthan gum, cultured whey, onion, extractive of turmeric, garlic, extractive of annatto, lactic acid, less than 2% soybean oil, potato starch, expeller pressed safflower oil, soy lecithin.Most of these ingredients are self-explanatory, but here is information on some of the ones that are less obvious:Disodium phosphate is disodium hydrogen phosphate (Na2HPO4), a sodium salt of phosphoric acid. It is used commercially as an anti-caking additive and to quicken cooking time in hot cereals such as Cream of Wheat. I did a quick search on it and didn't immediately find anything bad about it.I've seen xanthan gum sold a lot in the spices and baking-supplies section of health food stores. It is used as a natural thickener.The yellow color of the cheddar cheese cracker comes from turmeric, a natural herb that is known for being anti-inflammatory in its effects. Another source of the yellow color is annatto which is derrived from the seeds of the subtropical achiote tree. Like turmeric, its seeds are full of carotenoids (which are very healthy anti-oxidants) of a strong yellow to orange color. Their flavor is described as "slightly peppery with a hint of nutmeg" and "slightly nutty, sweet and peppery."Apparently they use maltodextrin as a sweetener vs. corn syrup which is used in most commercial crackers.I don't see any preservatives listed.The company seems to use essentially all natural ingredients.

column10: I love them crackers especially with cresm cheese.  My husband is addicted to them too.  We buy it by the case.

column10: The Vegetable Variety Pack provides an opportunity to find out what your baby likes.We have twin 7-month olds and their favorite is the sweet potato followed by the carrot jars. column9: Save your money buy at Babies R Us
column10: This same package costs 8.99 at baby's R us.  Save your money.  Asside from that the product works great and is very nice not to have the BPA and toxic chemicals in your little ones food.

I was disappointed to find out that the LIDS of Earth's Best jarred foods are coated with an epoxy lining that contains BPA :(I thought I was avoiding the whole BPA issue because these are in glass rather than plastic containers. If it's in the lids, it's going to get in the food as the food moves around in the jar during packaging, shipping, storage, etc. I was planning on being a devoted Earth's Best jarred food user because it was organic and in glass, but then I found out about the BPA. As a note, if BPA doesn't bother you, most of Earth's Best food is tasty.

column9: False statements about BPA in lids
column10: I started to panic when I read the comment from someone about BPA in the lid of EB glass baby jar foods. I make most of my baby food at home, but when on the road this is such an easy option. I called the company right away to get the facts. I was so relieved to hear that there are no BPA's that come into contact with the baby food. There are two layers of plastic in the lid and the layer that touches the baby food does NOT contain BPA. The layer in between has small traces of it, but their research has shown that it does not leech into the food. I personally feel comfortable with this and am glad I can still support this company.

I bought this line of baby food because it was organic and came in glass jars. I prefer to make my own baby food, but some times you need other options, especially when traveling. It is incredibly disappointing to find out that there is BPA in the lids. I just talked to the company and they confirmed this. My understanding of the canning process is that it requires heating the product to a high temperature in order to create an airtight seal. So not only is the food being exposed to the BPA during this heating process, but then during the entire storage process until an unknowing consumer like me buys it. I feel incredibly dumb for trusting Earth's best to be good for my baby. Get with the program and create BPA free lids! I recommend everyone taking the time to call the company and urge them to change their packaging. Until then I will stop buying this food line.Here is a website that will give you some ideas for other organic baby foods that have BPA free packaging[...]

column9: Nice selection of basic baby food vegetables
column10: I am pleased with the Earth's Best Vegetable variety pack.  These are the standard basic baby food vegetables: Winter Squash, Carrots, Sweet Potatoes, and Peas with Brown Rice. The flavors are bland but palatable and slightly sweet so most babies (mine included) enjoy these vegetables.  The consistency is great for babies from 5-9 months but probably too runny for older babies 10+ months.  Three of these four (squash, carrots, sweet potatoes) are available at my local store but the price is slightly cheaper on Amazon and the variety pack is convenient.  The cardboard tray is great for storing the jars in my pantry so they aren't rolling around everywhere.  I will purchase this product again as long as my child is eating baby food.

column9: Packaging for delivery needs to be better

My 7 month old son seems to like everything and has not rejected any foods I've given him, yet. *knock on wood* Anyway, I'm sure this stuff is good. But if I decide to buy it again, it'll be in the stores.
It's ok, my son eats it, he loves the carrots, he eats all of it. I'm going to move onto stage 3 foods.
Several broke during transit causing mold to grow over all the other jars. Jars are cheaper at Walmart.

This was a real treat and I planned to use the salmon in a dish.  Once I opened it, I could not resist a taste, which led to another and another...gone in a flash! It is expensive but not like the store bought salmon. Last summer a friend shared a can of salmon where he had caught it in Alaska and had it packaged for return.  This was pretty close to that.

It is pricey, but after reading many reviews and trying other Thai teas, finally broke down and treated my kids and I to this brand.  I have to say, it is one of my favorites now.  It brews to nice strong flavor with the dark orange color expected of a good Thai Tea.  It saves alot by being able to make it at home and my kids say it tastes just like the one at our favorite Thai restaurant.  So in the end, although it is pricier than other brands, it's still a significant savings in comparison to buying three Thai Iced Teas everytime we go.  I usually make 8 cup batches (apprx. 16 tspns of tea) which usually yields six iced teas, being you add the milk too.  My kids are very happy that they can have the same great tasting treat, but more often now!
This is great tasting decaf coffee. Lots of taste!! It doesn't have a watered down taste that some decaf coffees have. I love the metal canister that it came in, it is very easy to open.

Very nice - smooth texture, robust taste, excellent body. Very much like the cafe we enjoyed in Italia. In fact, many of the roasterias we frequented had the various colors of Illy packaging adorning the venues' walls. It's the same stuff. Enjoy!

PLEASE, PLEASE, don't try this coffee unless you don't mind getting hooked on it, it is the best by far espresso decaf you can ever try. Lavazza or other brands don't come close to it. Now I am hooked on it and it is so expensive in comparison to other brands. I can't even find it for less than $17 in the Bay Area, CA. THAT'S IF YOU CAN FIND IT AT ALL. DARN IT. If it weren't so good I would give it only one start for the cost. Anybody out there that knows where to get it for less than here, please let me know.

column9: Not extraorinarily different from other decafs. Good vendor.
column10: I use a Chemex coffee maker (filter method) so perhaps a lot of a coffee's character gets lost. I love the way Illy packages the whole beans with normal air pressure using nitrogen(?). This, and their regular and espresso all have great aromas.

Coffee is really great.  In my opinion the coffee is well balanced, not bitter and tastes much better compared to other brands.  I really like the airtight container, not sure why other manufacturers have not embraced this concept.
We love this coffee, it is a very smooth tasting coffee with lots of flavor.
Very smooth and transparent, for all 3. Black tastes a bit dry and bitter.  Red with a subtle nutty.  Mix 3 into different ratio can create more varieties.

column9: Offers the whole espresso experience minus the jolt
column10: I have had bad experiences with decaf coffees and teas from other brands in the past so I was apprehensive about trying illy's Decaf. But surprise! Despite the color of the espresso liquid being just a tinge lighter than illy's medium Red Band, the aroma and taste are quite identical. It also has illy's inimitable velvety sensation on the tongue. I am so delighted. This is the illy I use after 10:30pm. What a sensational decaf.
This is the third darjeeling I have ordered from Amazon and so far my favorite. The other 2 - I just got tired of.  I will re-order this one.
item came with a label on a baggie sthat said "dr. johns sugar free peppermint candies"  i gave it 3 stars as it had no ohter info on it and i threw it away.  It was individually wrapped

Doctor Johns' is the best peppermint candy available, and, incidentally, is sugar-free. My wife, who despises sugar-free candy, could not tell any difference at all when I "slipped" her one of these. Now she is constantly eating them. To the extent, that I just ordered four pounds more of them. And the people at Doctor Johns'? Absolutely the best I have ever dealt with, bar none. Friendly, courteous, and a "customer is always right" method of doing business. Trust me (as Richard Nixon said), this is THE place to buy sugar-free.

These beans are well roasted, moist and shiny and flavorful enough that you can almost forget they're decaf.  The three bag idea is brilliant for someone like me who doesn't always drink decaf.  These beans are an especially good value for the price.

My husband likes strong dark coffee such as Starbucks, and he recently switched to decaf.  I'm always on the hunt for coffee that's less expensive than Starbucks but meets my husband's standards.He loves this coffee.  When we first got it he said it'd be hard to tell a difference between this and Starbucks.  More recently he said, "That coffee is SO good!"  So, we have a winner!  I think it was on particularly good sale the first time I bought it so I'll have to keep my eye on the prices, but as long as it stays lower than Starbucks prices, it's for us!

Always on the search for a good decaf.  This coffee qualifies for that category...robust, not acidic.  Makes a good pot of coffee.  Can be used with flavored syrups and whipped milk for a really special evening drink.
I have tried other companies & found them way more expensive!Entrees meat was phenomenal!  They shipped earlier than theyindicated & the packaging was easy.  Great choice..I willtry them again.
I love this product on broccoli but could no longer find it at grocery stores near me.  I'm glad I could buy a case of six on-line.  I'm set for long while now.

Received my order of pack of 2 of these cruets and 4 total packs of dressing mix.  I LOVE this dressing mix and the top to my old cruet broke... could not beat this price.  The cruet is also a new style compared to my old one, very chic!

Remenber the days of yore, the days when this kind of salad dressing wasvthevrage? Now, we have hundreds if not thousands of brands, ready made to choose from. I loved the tart salad dressing his made. Now I add balsamic vinegar and Excellent olive oil, and this makes such a delicious salad dressing for my salads.The cruet is new and improved and is lovely to place on the table. The dressing is so easy to make, vinegar, water, the dry dressing mix, shake, then add olive oil. What could be simpler? A tasty treat for all of our salads. This brings back mynearlyndays as a home maker.Highly Recommended. prisrob 08-15-12Keeping Good Company: A Season-by-Season Collection of Recipes, with Entertaining and Homemaking Ideas

column9: One of the Best Dressings Around
column10: As stated above, a great salad dressing at a great price,  especially when you purchase the cruet as an accessory included in the package. When ever I serve this to guests, most are not aware that this is a packaged dressing (I doctor it up a bit), until I tell them.A good inexpensive gift for your favorite cook.

I had been looking for this cruet set in local supermarkets without success, so was thrilled to find it on Amazon for such a great price --- especially since I thought I was getting one cruet with two dressing packages, and the price is actually for 2 cruets and 4 seasoning packages! (This is a great price because a single package of dressing mix tends to run about $1.99 in the stores). The cruets are sturdy, come with suggestions for dressing variations, and bring back memories of when my mom used this same cruet to make salad dressing when I was a kid. Definitely recommended --- homemade salad dressing beats store dressing every time!

column9: Good Seasons Cruet and Salad Dressing Kit
column10: The cruet is great it has lines for water, vinegar and oil or low oil with more water.  Makes great salad dressing.  I make my own with it at times.Recommended.

column9: SECOND TIME AROUND AND STILL A 10
column10: One great American ale and continues to be one of our favorites after second time around. Very smooth medium body and refreshing.

column9: EXCELLENT SOURCE OF ORGANIC GREEN NUTRITION AT THE RIGHT PRICE!
column10: I bought this at my local "Sprouts" supermarket this week, NOT based on the various negative reviews of the product on here.  I ALMOST passed on it but basing my purchase on the nutrition facts, I decided to take a chance.  I paid $35 plus tax for it.I plan to use this as part of a lunch time meal replacement.Each serving contains:90  Calories9 g Carbohydrates10g Protein6 g Fiber1 g Sugar (less than)Those are the basic nutrition facts.  I didn't include the ample vitamins and chlorophyll info.Thank the heavens, I decided to take a chance and not follow the rest of these reviews because this shake is superb.  Does it dissolve perfectly? No but who cares?  I'm not sipping or nursing on it. Its not a martini. I mix it up and gulp it down.  Simple.  Also, I feel better knowing that it doesn't dissolve completely.  It gives me the impression that there are more substantial quality ingredients.  I'm not basing this on any scientific fact, just a feeling.Next, the flavor is EXCELLENT.  What are these people talking about? It tastes like its trying to be a "chai" drink but of course I know that it is not and I wouldn't expect it to because I chose this item acknowledging that there was practically no "sugar."  I wouldn't go into this shake expecting a jamba juice (do you know how much sugar is in a jamba juice).  Anyone who is thinking about giving this a shot, I say take the plunge.For my next purchase, I'm going with one of the other flavors from this line (the sugar content in some of the other flavors ranged between 6-10g) that happens to be on sale for $25.  15 meals (per container) that comes to a cost of around $2 a pop AND nutritionally good for me, definitely my kind of lunch.

column9: Great nutrition! Good ... not great flavor.
column10: A nice alternative flavor for this great green meal replacement. The vanilla chai flavor is missing the spicy chai goodness that would make this my favorite. If I had tasted it without reading the label I would have guess it was simply vanilla. I was hoping for more spicy chai. I will absolutely finish the rest of the can, however, I doubt this flavor will be making into regular rotation. It does mix up kinda green in color so if you're not into that you might want to go for something else or try an opaque container. The texture is kinda grainy but no lumps so I am perfectly pleased. I am going to try adding banana or chai concentrate to make it more interesting. I think it could be dressed up very easily so if you like to add berries (esp. blueberries) and such I believe this would lend itself well to that.

Have tried them "all" and this is by far the best shake out there for health, nutrition, taste and price.  Was on the Shaklee cinch shake when I started looking for a cold processed shake that wasn't as pricey.  It has the lowest sugar content of all of the shakes out there and when combined with coconut milk or almond milk it can taste pretty good.  It's a little grainy because of how natural it is but it's worth it.  Busy mom with a busy schedule who needs all of the nutrients this has.  Have tried the higher end stuff which honestly I would love but simply can't afford Shakeology.

I love Amazing Meals!  It is cheaper to buy it on Amazon than it is at Whole Foods.  One serving leaves you so full!  I have been using the product for a year now and I am always saying "this is soooo good!"  I like to mix the Vanilla Chai with Vanilla Almond milk.  Such an easy meal replacement!

After consuming this product for over 2 months, I have more energy and feel healthier.  I do not need to lose weight, per se, but my nutrition was lacking and this product is helping immensely.  I take half a scoop in the morning and half a scoop in the afternoon - it satisfies my appetite and I am feeling stronger, clearer minded and physically better overall (I was suffering from fatigue in general).

I was on the Amazing Grass website and saw a few great recipes there ... this is one I found that I just love!  Put the following in your blender:  Chai Amazing Meal mixed with two teaspoons plain yogurt, 1 whole ripe banana (better for alkalinity as opposed to green-tipped bananas), 3/4 cup frozen blueberries, 1 teaspoon Chia seeds, 1 cup Almond Breeze Almond Coconut flavor almond milk,  and a little stevia.  Mix well, then add a 1/2 dozen ice cubes for a frothy, frozen treat!!  This is a great meal replacement in the morning packed with protein and healthy goodness.

column9: Loved the taste and had great energy!
column10: I tried a sample packet of this and loved it! I mixed it with unsweetened vanilla almond milk and it was very creamy with a slight chai and vanilla flavor. Very drinkable and not spicy. I went to a power yoga class shortly after and had noticably more energy and strength!

I seem to have more energy when I make this as a smoothie in the morning before work.  I read the negative review and don't agree but then this is how I mix it up  . . .  Of course I use my Magic Bullet to mix my favorite new goodie.  Plain Greek yogurt, fat free milk, a scoop of Amazing Meal Vanilla Chai, a table spoon of grade B maple syrup and lots of frozen fruit, I like peaches and mango and pineapple.It's great and seems go have a lasting affect on my hunger.

Mixed nicely and quickly with immersion blender, smooth and tasty. I used almond milk instead of water. Even more delicious if you add i/2 frozen banana. Amazon's price now is better than my local HFS, too.

The meal versions are not good they are grainy and never dissolve. I have tried both the vanilla chai and chocolate both have this texture. :.( I wanted to like it because I love the chocolate and berry amazing grasses. So I thought adding protein would be great. Even if you can get past the texture. this tastes nothing like vanilla chai.

column9: Didn't think any powdered drink could appease my appetite... I was wrong!
column10: I mix Vanilla Chai with milk and a banana, whirl with my stick blender, and I have a pleasantly-flavored, 10 grams of protein, 6 grams of fiber meal.  And unbelievably to me, it DOES appease my appetite until the next mealtime rolls around.  I love the fact that it has very few calories on it's own, so if I use skim milk there is virtually no fat and a small amount of calories.  I have already re-purchased and I will continue to do so.

column9: I guess it's a good product...
column10: I just couldn't get it down.  It tastes nasty--sort of like grassy dirt but the texture is worse.  I tried mixing it in water, milk even yogurt (that was a huge mistake) and it just never tasted ok enough to choke down.  I'm not a picky eater either. I know these powders are funky, I expected that.  But this stuff was over the top funky.  When I mixed it in yogurt, it got super sticky and was sort of like wall paper paste.  It tastes nothing like chai.  I'm not sure why I they call it that.  I haven't tried making into a smoothy with lots of honey and cinnamon and other spices.  Maybe that would help it taste like chai...

I picked this up because I am minding my carbs and at 4g net carbs per serving (9g minus the 4g of fiber), this seemed like a great meal replacement or snack. Reading the reviews I expected it to taste bad but it wasn't bad at ALL! I used 8oz of cold unsweetened almond milk and a handful of ice cubes. I used a high speed blender (vitamix) and it came out so good! Even my husband liked it. Will be buying more. I'd also feel great giving this to my kids.
This is the best and most satisfying protein/meal available...I have tried many!!  I just feel good after I have it!

This stuff smells amazing!  I got the vanilla kind and was excited to try it.  When I opened it, it was actually thick and green.  The texture and consistency was disgusting!  I had to throw it away and bought a different product.

I looked for a protein powder with a good dose of fiber, low sugar, and at least 8 g of protein.  When I opened the canister and saw green powder, I doubted I would like the flavor.  It turned my peach smoothie horribly green.  However, it's actually quite tasty!  I'm also impressed by how filling it is; I don't get hungry before lunch.

I really wanted to like this product.  And in all fairness, I eat many other things people may not find palatable, like hemp protein powder and chia seeds, so I was a little surprised by my reaction to the taste of this powder.  It did mix up into a thick, rich looking smoothie.  I mixed in a banana, hemp oil, orange flavored aminos, stevia, and raw cacao powder (as I commonly mix into my hemp protein smoothie), and it still managed to really taste like nothing.  Well, I shouldn't say it tasted like nothing, it was reminiscent of grass clippings, which actually made me gag a little just thinking about it.  I plugged my nose and chugged it down, and it was filling, and full of good nutrients, but the taste....ugh!  I will definitely NOT buy this again.

column9: inflated inaccurate pricing, but good product
column10: It just ticks me off when amazon does this. there is no one who sells this product for $57 (listed as the regular price at the time of this review). It's sold in stores all the time for $39. But it is a good product - great ingredients and nice flavor, not too grainy.

A friend of mine brought this to work and we decided to try it.  She tried mixing it with water, but the powder didn't seem to mix properly and it turned into this thick green muddy consistency.  She tried a sip and nearly tossed her cookies.  I thought, "How bad could it be?"  So I mixed it up with milk and only used half a scoop.  The flavor was odd, and it left a grainy texture in my mouth which I didn't like.  I looked for ways to make it somewhat enjoyable to eat, so I dumped a packet of hot chocolate mix into it and stirred it up.  Now it tastes amazing!  Thanks Amazing Meal!UPDATE:  I feel really sick now
This is what you need to make your gumbo taste the way it should. It is difficult to find in stores and I was happy to be able to get it from Amazon.

This blend was hard to find. My wife and friends were throwing me a retirement party for my 20 yrs in the USAF. I had a crazy thought ... I'll look on Amazon! Since we live in Delaware, and not Louisiana, filè is hard to find. What do you know it was on there. It came on time and I had an outstanding retirement party.

I would buy from this seller again.  I was happy to receive my product that's is fresh and available.  Its good to know that I have a place to contact for not so availble products.  I will be happy to recommend Southern Jewel's Fab Finds to family and friends.

column9: Total Ripoff (and mistake on my review)
column10: See my last post before reading.I wanted to cook a gumbo that called for a tablespoon of file powder.  Never having heard of this spice I, I looked all over my town and could not find it in any spice sections of the local stores, so I ordered here at Amazon for $11.95  The next day when I was at the local fish market I found the same sized jar for $2.50.  Never having used the spice, I have no comment on its quality, but this is way overpriced.  If you can't find this spice locally, do a internet search to find another seller.  This should not be this expensive.

column9: Fantastic gourmet chip - this flavor is one of the best.
column10: I purchased these chips for my mobile vending cart. Because I have Amazon Prime the cost per bag is really good as far as a reseller goes. Each flavor is really good in its own right. These chips the Asian Sweet and Spicy are just so tasty. Its just the right amount of sweet and the slightest bit of spice that makes these a fantastic tasting chip.Lets talk about details:Chip thickness (+)These are gourmet chips and the quality is there from the moment you open the bag. Each one is crunchy and not too thick but just enough to let you know you didn't buy a bag of Lays.Grease (+)These are NOT greasy chips. Depending on the flavor they are just mildy seasoned and not coated in a heavy grease or oil.Flavor (+)Each flavor stands completely on its own. You could do a blind taste test of each one of these flavors sold by Deep River and I bet you could tell what it was. None of the flavors are overpowering except maybe the Jalapeno flavor which is honestly too hot and I love hot food.Resale (+)You may not resell these but at the current price and using Prime shipping the cost per bag allows you to make a decent profit.Overall:These are great tasting, unique flavored chips that are hands down better than the ones you can get in bulk at a Sams or BJ's. Do yourself a favor and try a bag or two. I bet you'll love em like we do.Thanks for reading my review.
THEY ARE DELICIOUS NOT SALTY YOU CAN SIT AND EAT 2-3 2 OUNCE BAGS AT A TIME I GIVE THESE 5 STARS PLUS I HAVE TO STOP MYSELF FROM EATING THEM THEY ARE DELICIOUS.

I like these chips, even though they are a little different than chips I am used to. I love that they are reduced fat, but be warned, they are extremely crunchy. So crunchy that I have to turn the volume up on the TV to hear it when I'm chewing them. The taste is quite good though and I like crunchy salty food. I will probably order them again.

These chips are the best!! I've tried some of the other flavors and they are ok, nothing special... but the Mesquite BBQ is hands down the best BBQ chips I've ever had! if you like BBQ chips (and are not concerned with the calories most chips bring), then you will not be disappointed in these!

Addictive and totally unexpected. I first tasted these at the Fancy Food Show in New York a couple of years ago. Was amazed to find them on Amazon - and bought immediately for our lunch clients. What you want in a potato chip: the crunch is fantastic and the flavor gives off both rosemary and olive oil, ending in a surprisingly smoky note.

I took a chance on these and they are awesome.  They are crisp and not at all greasy.  I like the Lay's Kettle Chips, but these are really much better, less greasy, maybe a bit more crisp too.  The rosemary is good - it's not overpowering and it tastes like rosemary.  No MSG.  Hits the salty snack craving just right.  I like the size too - it's enough to satisfy a craving but keeps me from eating a whole big bag.  Which I'd probably do with these, if that's what I had.  I'll definitely order them again.  My husband and 16 year old both really like them too.

column9: Don't have to eat just one.......
column10: These are delicious lower sodium/fat chips. Convenient lunch/snack size bag is enough for sharing. Halloween is two months away and the kids will be getting these for trick or treating at our house.  By the case means they're always on hand.
The chips are deliciously spicy and super crispy.  It takes a second for the heat to hit butwhen it does, it's AWESOME!  Love these chips and will continue to buy for a long time.

Just to keep it simple...more of a comparison than a total review.  I love jalapeno chips - look mostly for the level of spice, then pepper flavor, good crunch, and not loaded down with salt.With that said, these Deep River Snacks chips (jalapeno flavor) are:1. Better than the Lays Jalapeno.  (Deep RIver have the same spice level, which is lacking.  Neither have a lot of pepper flavor.)2. About the same as the jalapeno chips that the "World Market" branded chips.  (World Market has a little more spice, but also a lot more salt.)3. Not nearly as good as Tim's Cascade Jalapeno chips.  (Tims has more pepper flavor, more spice, a little bit better crunch...but also have MSG.)It's not to say these chips are bad, but just what the 3-stars says "It's OK."  There are better, there are worse...to me, these are right in the middle of the pack.
Deep river snacks are the best chips ever!!! I'm addicted to the zesty jalapeno and haven't tried other flavors. I recommend this brand to everyone.
These are everything I want in a potato chip; Flavor that jumps out at you and they stay crunchy!!Do yourself a favor(and flavor) and try these chips!!
Whole family loved 'em. Hard enough to break your teeth (in a good way, they are kettle chips after all).  24 for $17? We'll definitely buy again.

column9: Great Tasting, just wish they were thicker cut.
column10: These are very good chips. The Asian Sweet & Spicy--not too sweet, not too spicy, or salty--perfectly balanced seasoning. We received very fresh packages.  I just like thicker cut potato chips especially being kettle cooked, but that will not deter me from ordering again.
I really like these chips and so do my customers. Tangy and spicy chips with a sweet finish.  I look for 2 oz. bags like these.

My husband was just diagnosed as gluten intolerant and he thought his life was over.  Surprize he loved these chips and couldn't believe it.  I did too and am not allergic to foods.  Can't say enough good things about this chip.
I find deep river snacks everywhere but hardly ever find the cracked pepper and sea salt.  Glad that Amazon carries it.  If you like spicy and peppery these are the chips for you.

Deep River Salt & Vinegar chips are thick and crunchy.  Very tart.  So tart that I can't eat them alone. They are perfect with a sandwich though. These chips are well coated with the seasonings, maybe too much seasonings for some folks tastes.  I suggest buying a small bag before purchasing a large quantity of these.  They aren't for everyone.  Enjoy!

column9: Exceeded my expectations. One of the best chips I have had
column10: I was very skeptical about buying a brand of chips I had never tasted before, much less buying it in bulk.However, I had not regretted it.These chips are one of the best I had tried and certainly exceeded my expectations.They're reasonably priced too so that is a big plus!

column9: Awesome Goodness! (deep river kettle chips, swt maui onion [pack of 24])
column10: Before you turn to other name brands out there, give these a try. Although the Maui Onion can be a bit salty at times, i can still say these are amongst the crunchiest and tastiest chips I have ever had. Now i have tried both the barbeque and Asian style flavor, but still I must say these are the best. If you are looking for something to snack on that tastes good, these are the ones for you. Its better than the pringle's commercial, since these are harder to put down once you start.

column9: Pretty good, but prefer other jalapeno chips
column10: I was expecting some "serious flavor" as it was advertised on the bag.. but compared to other jalapeno chips I've had, it's pretty bland. The ingredients list is short, which is a plus, and it's fairly low in sodium (160mg per 1oz serving) which is probably why I prefer this less, as I like saltier chips. Overall I'd say this is a good choice if you like a healthier version of a jalapeno chip.. but if you like strong flavor like I do, stick with Kettle brand jalapeno chips.

column9: Excellent chips, full of flavor and just the right thickness and doneness
column10: I purchased the Salt and Vinegar chips and have been very pleased. There is the right amount of vinegar, virtually every single chip I have tasted is done just right, no burned chips, and they have an excellent thickness to impart just the correct amount of potato taste.They go great with lunches or as a snack. They are very economical. Beats the heck in terms of quality, taste, and price to buying these at work or out and about (I bought the 2 ounce bags). I will be trying some of the other intriguing flavors. Recommended.
This is a heavy kettle style chip that is not as "heavy" as kettle brand chips, but bas good flavor.  I will reorder.

I recently bought these chips.  Came home and only three bags were left in the box.  My whole family loves them.  They have great flavor and better and healthier than more chips. I'm ordering a few more boxes today

These are not the "same old" chips by far and the Asian Sweet & Spicy sparked my imagination too, makes you appreciate the new and improved variety of potatoe chips. This flavor is easily an "8" on the ten-scale.
I love Rosemary chips, but can't find any at my location. I was glad I came across these, at such a great price.

The potato chips are wonderfully tasty.  My sons and I both like the Rosemary and Olive Oil because it is not as spicy.  We also got the Jalapeno.  It is not so much I don't like the Jalapeno.  It is spicy hot for me.  I still love the potato chips.
Being what you would call a chip connoisseur was looking forward to trying these.  Great chips.

column9: just the right size package; great chips
column10: Very nice chips; just the right size to serve with a sandwich and watch my calories.

My order was carried out in a fast and effective manner. I received my shipment of chips within two days and had no problems with the retailer.The chips (Sweet Onion variety) are flavorful and particularly crunchy. The only negative--a subjective one--is that the chips may be too salty. Other than that, I would recommend buying these chips again.

This is a re-post of the review I left for the 5 oz bags ... Addictive and totally unexpected. I first tasted these at the Fancy Food Show in New York a couple of years ago. Was amazed to find them on Amazon - and bought immediately for our lunch clients. What you want in a potato chip: the crunch is fantastic and the flavor gives off both rosemary and olive oil, ending in a surprisingly smoky note.

column9: According to the Manufacturer's own website these have no Olive Oil!!!!
column10: Ingredients on Deep River Snacks's website are: Potatoes, sunflower oil and/or corn oil, whey, sea salt, onion powder, sugar, garlic powder, torula yeast, dried parsley, maltodextrix, canola oil, soybean oil, rosemary extract and "natural flavors".False adversing much?

column9: too much of a good thing
column10: These chips are very spicy to say the least, my tongue burned too much to finish the small individual serving bag. They have an overpowering amount of some Asian spice, perhaps ginger, but it is way too strong and you are left with a very unpleasant taste. I bought 24 of the small size bags but could not bring myself to like the flavor, it all ended up in the trash.  This is definitely a chip that will appeal to only certain palates. I do like the sweet onion flavor of this brand but this Asian flavor was too much of a good thing!

I loved kettle chips from the moment I tried them but I felt absolutely disgusting every time I had the Kettle Brand. Though very tasty and crunchy, they were also very oily. With Deep River Snacks, they've got the crunch and taste without that repulsive burst of oil in your mouth with each crunch that Kettle Brand had. I LOVE the Sweet Onion Maui and Mesquite BBQ. The Jalapeno flavor does spicy justice and the Rosemary & olive Oil is very unique for a chip. I wish they had a sour cream and onion flavor but I love them regardless.

I did a search on Amazon for Kettle reduced fat chips, hoping to find a good deal on Kettle brand chips.  I stumbled upon these Deep River reduced fat kettle chips, and liked the per bag price (works out to about $1.50 per bag, about half the price of a similarly sized bag of Kettle brand chips at my local grocery store).  I am so glad I ordered these.  I love the taste, and I love the texture, and never would have guessed they were reduced fat.  I particularly like the short list of ingredients: Potatoes, Sunflower or Corn oil, and Salt.  That's it.I do wish Amazon would make it easy to find the nutritional information...so, here are the basics: 12-chip serving (28g) is 120 calories, 6g fat, 1g fiber.I will definitely order these again.
They are a healthier chip with less salt and fat, which I like better than the over-salted regular chips on the market.  The flavor is great and they are nice and crunchy. Absolutely worth a try!
Love these chips.  Good for a quick snack and I don't fee TOO guilty eating them since they have less fat and salt than regular chips.  Highly recommended.

You know you have a great salt & vinegar chip when after one individual bag your mouth is all puckered up!Deep River makes a great chip and comes in packages just the right size for one person to enjoy. And, being kettle chips, just makes each bite a great taste and texture combination you are sure to enjoy.Try some now.http://www.amazon.com/gp/product/B002C50XA8/ref=cm_cr_rev_prod_title
The sweet Maui onion tastes like sour cream and onion.  I was hoping to get the delicious chips that I enjoyed in Maui.  Don't wast your time.

Olive oil in large bold print on the front of the bag is misleading!!  Olive oil is NOT the main oil the chips are cooked in.  The product has more sunflower, corn and canola oils than it does olive oil!! The ingredients are NOT listed in the description.  I should have known better.There are other, much better "Olive Oil" potato chips on the market that use ONLY olive oil. I was quite disappointed in this brand.

I love salt & vinegar kettle chips so I decided to try these after reading good reviews. When I received them, I noticed from the very first bag that over half of the chips were inedible due to rotten potatoes! I know how kettle chips should look, and I know what normal marks look like on chips. These were rotten. After waiting over a month for a response from the company, I finally found a phone number and called them, only to be told there was nothing they could do. The sad thing is, the chips that were edible were actually flavorful and tasty. Obviously they just don't care about consistent quality, so stay away from these chips!

column9: FLAVOR TOO STRONG, COATING TOO MESSY
column10: The kettle chip itself is crisp, crunchy and good, although somewhat greasy.  Over coated with the flavoring causing mouth burn when it was not expected in a chip with Rosemary flavoring.  Leaves greasy, gritty residue on fingers after two or three chips.

column9: Crunchy, but a bit on the salty side
column10: I ordered these because I had purchased a bag of Sweet maui Onion chips from the supermarket. They were so good that I had to get another.The order came and I popped open a bag. They are very crunchy, so if you're into that, these are the chips for you. However, they do tend to get really salty. I found myself having quite a few sips of beer when eating these

I bought these potato chips because they sounded tasty and because of the natural sounding ingredients... but also specifically because they are gluten free.  I have a son with food allergies and he cannot gluten... or Milk.  I was so upset when I received these to find out that they contain Milk!  I do not see this information anywhere on the product page.

this product has just 1.5gms fat per serving of 28gand is whole grain.inspite of it, tastes fantastic!one of the very best low fat healthy snacks - 6 stars!(hope they continue to make this product for a long time)/

These are probably my favorite cracker right now. I really like the whole grain, and I also like the rosemary quite a bit.They're not highly processed, so they're very crumbly, is the main thing to watch out for, I think. Some people will not like how crumbly they are.I was afraid that they'd be in pieces by the time they arrived, but no such problem. There's a few broken crackers in each box, but it's about the same as the packages I buy at the local store.They're also much cheaper per box than at my local store.I will definitely buy these from Amazon again.

This stuff tastes amazing. It's lightly sweet with sparse, but juicy raisins. The texture is like bread, but it isn't light and fluffy, more dense and chewy due to the high gluten content. I found that texture extremely satisfying because it makes it feel like you're actually eating something substantial, where as a normal slice of bread this size would never feel like a real snack. I'm very impressed with the nutritional content, and as long as you're not sensitive to gluten, then this stuff is really great. It's dense and chewy, and I loved it!

I don't write a lot of reviews, but this bread is just outstanding in every way.  This bead doesn't feel or taste low carb, and it made some really good french toast.  The shipping cost is high (I chose expedited), but maybe if I buy enough at a time next order and freeze it I can make it less costly...  But lets face it, good bread that is low carb is worth every penny to those of us that must watch the carbs, but love bread.  Well done, folks.

If you're like me, you buy several low-carb products at once and freeze some of them. Perhaps this bread just doesn't hold up well in the freezer but I was disappointed with it. The taste is decent for a low-carb product, the texture is nice, the crust is really pretty, but it's very dry to the point that it's difficult to digest, even when slathered in butter (which I hate to do). I tried toasting it, butter, low fat cream cheese and no dice. It feels like choking down forty saltine crackers. Overall, it's decent as there aren't that many bakeries that sell low-carb breads over the internet that don't taste like manure but I would not buy it again.
This bread is awesome! A little more chewy than your typical bread, but soooo good! I will definitely be getting this from now on.

I bought the six bottle package. It isn't bad, but I will be happy when it's all gone.I tend to eat the "field greens" salad mix. You can't taste the dressing very well compared to other oil/vinegar-type dressings. It seems a little bland. Then again, salads with dandelion greens can overpower salad dressing.On the plus side, it isn't high in fat. And it isn't bad. Just not my thing.
This is the best salad dressing I've ever had. It really does taste like bruschetta, and since it's oil-based instead of cream, it's way healthier. Five stars!

This is one of our favorite green tea's. We drink this tea every day, and Amazon has the best price for it, if you buy it in bulk. If you want to try a small sample of this tea (before you buy 1 pound of it from Amazon) I would suggest that you go to MightyLeaf website and order a sample, which is a few bucks.

I discovered teas with rice a few years ago and am always on the lookout for new combinations.  I really enjoyed Mighty Leaf's blend of popped and roasted rice combined with a smooth green tea and just the right amount of caffeine.  This is definitely one of my new favorites.

This is an excellent product. It's a great tasting natural raw sugar. I particularly like the fact that, due to this robust raw sugar, I am able to sweeten my morning cup of coffee to my liking but with less sugar and that save me money! I also like the fact that this sugar retains more of its natural mineral make-up which in my opinion gives it a bit of a healthful edge over the more refined sugar products or the more questionable sugar substitutes. Also, since this is sugar, it is a product that most of us are accustomed with. Nothing like familiarity. The service is excellent as well. I have ordered this product several times from this vendor and it always arrives ahead of the scheduled delivery date in pristine condition. I have never been disappointed. Thanks folks.

I don't think she quite loves them as much as Pupperoni, but my dog still goes wild for these when I give them to her.  The nice thing about them is that they're quite a small size (just about bite-size for a small 15lb dog like mine) so my dog won't get full up on them or try to take them off to bury them (as she does with larger treats).  They're great for training and seem to be rather good value for money.

I ordered lysine treats from this company, and saw an offer for "free" salmon treats with order--however, I was charged $2 for them.  I had the choice of not buying them, though, and I thought that $2 for salmon treats was an OK deal.  The bag is actually very large, and the cats LOVE the treats....and isn't that all that matters?
My dogs loved these treats and we got them at an amazing price.  Great deal for a healthy snack for your pups.

Having not eaten them myself, this might have been a hard product to review... but my dogs love them and try to stuff their muzzles into the bag if we leave the pantry door open. I think that says it all.Free dog treats are always nice. And as another reviewer mentioned, they are a perfect bite size for small dogs (mine are 16lb and 28lb). This stops my husband giving them super long sticks of pupperoni (which he does if I'm not looking). I would buy these treats again.

Got these free as a promotional item when I ordered a coolaroo pet bed for my beagle.  As my dog would probably say these stink good!  She loves them and our siamese mix cat was attracted by the fishy odor and likes them too!  Definitely real salmon in these things!

I have 4 Chihuahuas and they love these. They have never eaten fish based treats before and at first they just sniffed at them.Finally one took the plunge and the rest followed. Now they love them. They are of of their favorite treats.They do not have a strong fishy odor and are about the size of a wheat chex cereal.They are not crunchy but sort of chewy like a fig newton.I got these free with a bag of dog food I purchased from a seller on Amazon(Coupon code now expired).Unless the code comes back or the price drops again I'm not sure I will buy them again. At over $1 an ounce they aren't cheap.Looking at quality dog treats $1 an ounce seems to be the typical price range.I can't help thinking at $18 a pound maybe I should start cooking up my own home made dog treats for them.
These are fish-source treats for dogs, and my dacshund, Sadie, goes crazy over them. They're much more "gobbled up" than the traditional "baked" treats.

To get these free - you have to remember to put in the promotion code at order time.  The code can be found under 'special offers'.  I've gotten these free a few times with a flossies order.  My dogs seem to really love them and they look healthy.Just remember to keep the bag closed or they will dry out and get hard.

My dog says these are just o.k.  They seems like they are mostly wheat with a little fish.  I wouldn't get them again.  Be careful if "entirely pets" is offering them to you for "free" because they charged me even though it said free with purchase.  I've been trying to get my money back for this "free" product.  We'll see if i do.
I haven't tried other flavors.  But this BBQ flavor tastes not as good as many other brands.What's most frustrating is that the meat is too dry and too hard to chew.

It's amazing that you can't get the most basic pickling ingredients in the grocery stores. Most stores only stock pickling alum mixed with spices and herbs in finished packages. Does this mean we all have the same taste now? Are we all from the same cookie cutter? NO!Thank goodness there are stores which still cater for those who want to cook the old fashioned way....with individuality.

I bought these as a tasty snack after I'd decided not to at food with added sugar. Unfortunately, these do have added sugar. Also, they have wheat flour too if you're sensitive to that kind of thing: beware.Here's the nutritional info:Serving Size: 1/3 Cup (30g), Calories 130 (40 from fat), Total Fat: 0g, Cholesterol 0mg, Sodium 180mg, Total Carbs: 20g, Dietary Fiber: 2g, Sugars 5g, Protein 7g.Ingredients: green peas, starch, glutinous rice flour, wheat flour, sugar, soybean oil. salt, wasabi, artificial color (yellow #5, blue#1)

column9: Great wasabi pease (definitely beats most of the others I've had)
column10: I really like these wasabi peas.  I've recently purchased a few other brands, and this is likely my favorite.  They are crisp and crunchy without tasting stale.  I've tasted some wasabi peas that are so hard that you feel like you might break or chip a tooth.These have a great bite to them.  They can clear your sinuses in any particular mouthful, and they keep me coming back for more.  I can easily eat a whole bag in one sitting, but typically, I get 3-4 servings out of a bag.  What can I say, I love wasabi peas.The only thing that I don't like about these (and most wasabi peas) is that they are artificially colored.  I would be fine with these peas if they didn't have any coloring to make them seem "fresh".  Wasabi peas are wasabi peas... they don't have to look like they were fresh green peas with some wasabi slapped on them.  I'd love to find the Good Sense brand's wasabi peas without the artificial coloring.I will definitely purchase another case (pack of 12) of these particular wasabi peas when I run out, but I am still open to trying new brands (and there are a good number of brands that make them).
These are great if you like the taste of horseradish mixed with the sweetness of peas, perfect for something healthy to crunch on.
Better than the last set I got from here (can't remember the brand right now) since they were coated better and crunchier.  However, had more "hard" peas than that brand - could break a tooth.

Got these on a recommendation from a friend.They are a fantastic healthy snack, very high in protein.  They definately have a kick, so if you don't like spicy you might want to pass.  But great to munch on if you are trying to kick the habit of potato chips.

These are definitely the best wasabi peas I have ordered from amazon.  They aren't the hottest but the pea quality is good.  If you live in the Georgia - Tennessee - North Carolina area, check out a Ingles Grocery.  They have the best peas and hottest wasabi mix.

Very good, but the more you eat, the hotter it gets. Water won't help, if anything it makes it worse. Not like other kinds of heat where holding icewater will help somewhat. Goes up the sinuses, too. They have to be really good to overlook all that.

I am eating these awesome wasabi peas as I write this review. Received my order on time. I have had other brands of wasabi peas, and this Good Sense brand is the best. They have just the right amount of wasabi, edible, but have a zing. They are very crunchy and addicting. I can not say if there is a better price out there in the stores, but I am happy with the price I paid for this product. I hope they last me a couple of months!
I know they were trying because most of their other products are good. But this tasted awful. I'd rather just stick to the real thing with this.
ABSOLUTELY  the worst peanutbutter i've ever tasted! Dont waist your money!this product is worse than dog food! and the smell is even worse!
Excrement mixed with splenda is the best way I can describe this. Its awful. Why not mix a little bit of fat in there to make it edible?

With all the bad reviews, I still wanted to see for myself if this product was in any way passable for a peanut butter replacement, having shed 170lbs with a bit more still to go, I'm constantly looking for ways to eat things I like with as little calories as possible. Well I loves me some peanut butter, but with my new healthy way of eating, it's pretty much absent from my diet these days, even as a very rare treat. With that in mind, I figured what the heck, I'll give this a shot. Boy should I have heeded all the other posters advice! I'm pretty open minded about alternative or food substitutes, but this stuff, well "YUCK" is the word!When I got it, along with several other Walden products I ordered from their site, it was the first thing I wanted to try. When I opened the jar it did have the look of PB so I was hopeful, maybe this WOULD be okay. It wasn't. The first taste was sickeningly sweet, almost didn't go back for a second one, but had to to see if what I tasted was right. Next bite was like an entirely different product. This time there wasn't a super sweet taste, more like metallic or something. After that I thought "oh boy" I think I just blew nearly $50 bucks on this stuff (all the Walden products I had ordered). In fairness I did try pairing it up with other things, since I'd read on here that others advise not eating it on it's own. So at first I tried a PB&J. It was just as bad. I tried with fruit. I tried mixing it with PB2 Powdered Peanut Butter and Powdered Cocoa Peanut Butter - 85% Less Fat and Calories - 6.5 Oz Each - 2 Pack as someone else here suggested (which btw is a peanut butter replacement I do highly recommend). I tried it after I chilled it in the fridge and heated up in the microwave. I kept waiting for any semblance of a peanut flavor, but it never came. And so rather than leave it sitting in my fridge for the next several months, which it would have been as it was never going to get used, I threw it away. It wasn't easy, firstly there was all the money I spent because I not only threw out the Peanut spread, I also tossed the grape and raspberry jams I couldn't stand either. But it was also that I WANTED to have liked this enough to eat it.I will say out of the products I've sampled so far from Walden, I have yet to try the mayo, ketchup, and bacon ranch dressings I bought, I found at least some of them were okay. I'd say the best so far is the chocolate dip. It's nothing like the consistency of melted chocolate, more like a chocolate pudding. But at least it was edible. The French onion dip wasn't too bad either. Thousand Island dressing wasn't all that great, but I'll at least finish the bottle. I also don't really care for the caramel sauce which I did have higher hopes for after the reviews it got.Again, I spent quite a bit on this, and it was pretty much money wasted, as I didn't discover a great new product and won't be buying any of this stuff again. But it hasn't soured me on still trying low calorie alternatives to broaden my diet. I just will probably steer clear of the fake foods, since with tastes like this, the best way to have zero calories in your foods, is to just not have them.

Imagine farmers on earth lose the ability to grow peanuts. And, 10000 years down the road, an alien species who never tasted peanut butter before tries to whip up a batch. I am sure the result would be something like Walden Farms Peanut Spread.It's not very peanuty, not very buttery...it's just the vaguest notion of peanut taste in a very foul paste-like consistency. The after taste is thoroughly horrible, with notes of shredded hubcaps and melted imitation Reeboks from Laos.If you are a dieter and are trying to incorporate some fun alternatives into your eating plan, skip this one. It's truly revolting.

This came as a surprise to me because I have enjoyed many other WF products. However, the texture and smell of this peanut spread (not peanut butter!!) is gross. Slimy, thin and tastes like it contains sugar alcohols. Not pleasant. I can imagine mixing it into a recipe to hide the odd texture (it might be good in peanut butter cookies) but otherwise, skip it.

Being an avid peanut butter lover, I chose this product with enthusiasm, which was short-lived. IMHO this product has an annoyingly cloying sweet flavor and no peanut butter flavor whatosever. I threw it in the trash after one taste.

column9: Creativity helps make this really worth while
column10: OK, so I ordered this without any idea of how it would work. And I have learned a few things about what does work and what doesn't. First, put it in the refrigerator! That is the only way the consistency works. Otherwise, it has a very strange texture. But directly from the refrigerator it is a lot more like the consistency of regular peanut butter.Second, don't expect it to taste like peanut butter! It is a peanut spread - without any calories! I don't know how they do that, but peanuts have calories so this is something else. I tried it with some Walden Farms jelly and I must say it was one of the more unpleasant food experiences I have had. However, peanut butter and jelly sandwiches are not the only use for peanut flavored foods!So I made a peanut satay sauce with it! Added some lime juice, some curry powder, some Braggs (soy sauce equivalent) and some Walden Farms pancake syrup for sweetener (best way to use that is to sweeten other things you are cooking). Heated it all up and served it over roasted chicken for my meat-eating friends and over tofu for the vegetarians. They all raved about it!So I will be ordering this again! Because I have more recipes that call for peanut flavor and this is the best way I know to add it to my cooking without adding all the related fat and excess calories!
Most disgusting stuff ever. Most of the other WF products are ok (except mayo) but the Peanut Butter is not. Dont waste your money.

When I first opened the jar it smelled like some chemical, not peanuts.  I got past that and tried some and it was disgusting.  I had to eat something else just to get the taste out of my mouth. I tried mixing it with PB2 as another  review mentioned, all that did was waste PB2.  This was a complete waste of money since I wouldn't even mix this with other food.

First impression is that it is very runny. Infact, some splashed on the floor when I opened the jar. I called the dog over to lick it up and he turned his nose up to it. This is a dog that eats anything. Should have known that was a bad sign. The only way I can describe it is that it taste like chemicals. Total waste of money!

column9: Why did I think this was a good idea?
column10: I bought some last week and I thought it was retched! I tried mixing it around in my mouth for a few minutes and it was horrible. for the rest of the weekend I could not get the flavor out of my mouth.

Other Walden Farms products are great, but this one is disgusting!  I couldn't get past a tiny taste.  My husband (who will eat ANYTHING) thought it was nasty and wouldn't eat it.  To the trash bin this goes!  Save yourself!  Do not buy this product!  Blech!

I dont know why, but I had a feeling this would taste like crap when I first looked at it.  But I got it anyways.  Instead of cutting corners with peanut butter, splurge your calories on the real stuff.  This is the worst peanut butter ever.

product looks good and smells good.  I wish I could say the same about taste.  perhaps mixed with other ingredients ie for no bake cookies.  but as far as peanut butter sandwiches I will pass.  I TRIED IT WITH THE NO BAKE COOKIES AND IT WAS AWFUL.  ENDED UP THROWING THE BEST PART OF THE JAR AWAY. I WAISTED MY MONEY.

I bought this because I am always looking for a healthy peanut butter substitute. Wow, what a mistake that was. It was by far the worst thing I've ever attempted to eat. I didn't even swallow, spit it out in the trash can. I do eat a fair amount of diet foods, so it's not like I was expecting it to taste like regular Jif, I had realistic expectations considering the nutrition facts. The consistantcy was way off. It was more like a Cool Whip type consistancy. The taste was not remotely peanutty. It smelled like oil based paint. Sorry Walden Farms, you failed on this one. I'm back to reduced fat Jif now and its the best nutritionally as far as the decent tasting peanut butters go. I really like Crazy Richards too, less sugar but a little more fat. But this stuff was nasty, seriously, just don't buy it.

column4: Alison N. Wheat "Runner, Educator, Cuteness E...
column9: Wasting my money never tasted so bad.
column10: I bought this from a local health food store.  I am a runner taking some down time and therefore trying to cut calories.  Thought that perhaps, even if it were not very flavorful, this could be made to work.  Even if it were just pleasant tasting overall, you can add a teeny bit of honey or splenda or something to make it work, and as a seasoned dieter/calorie cutter, there's not much I can't make work.The stuff has a gel-consistency, like several other Walden Farms products I have tried.  I put a small spoon of it in my mouth to try it out and INSTANTLY threw it in the garbage.  A $3 product.  It tastes nothing like peanut butter, or peanuts, or some imitation of either.  It's hard to describe what it tasted like.  Maybe if someone took Vaseline and put something really bitter in it along with some chemicals so there would be a long lasting aftertaste.  It was slightly salty, but mostly it made me feel like I was attempting to eat something not made for human consumption.  If you are able to put this in your mouth and not spit it out, you don't have tastebuds.If you're desperate for PB as a dieter, try one of 3 things:1. PB2 is apparently popular.2. I used to enjoy Better N' Butter, but I'm not sure if they make it anymore.  It IS available on Amazon.  Not the same, slightly syrupy sweet, but OK.3. Take a lowfat PB and cut it with something lower calorie such as sugar free jelly or sugar free pancake syrup.Just whatever you do, don't try this mess.

I understand that certain products in no-sugar form can often have a different taste and/or texture.  There is no excuse for this.  Gross beyond all measure.  On the upside, it made me not want to eat ANY peanut spread/butter for a while, so it did indirectly cut down on peanut butter calories/carbs!

Ew.. I don't know what I was eating, but it sure isn't peanut butter... Weird consistency and flavor... I'm just going to mix it with fluff so it makes it at least somewhat peanut butter-y and dulls the weird taste. Do NOT expect peanut butter from this prouduct. It is just a poor attempt at a duplicate.

Walden Farms Products are nasty, tasteless and always have weird textures. Nothing they make even remotely resembles anything that they're trying to re-create in a ZERO carb, calorie, sugar form. I have tried many many types of Walden Farms products and have not found ONE that didn't make me cringe after I tasted it. BUT, if you HAVE TO EAT THIS STUFF BECAUSE OF A MEDICAL CONDITION (like diabetes), then you may get accustom to it. I just wanted a zero/low calorie alternative to my everyday items and was sadly displeased with the products.
This stuff is horrid!!! I will not buy this stuff again. The only one I would give this stuff to is the DEVIL!!!You buy this stuff at your own risk.

column9: I'm pretty tolerant w/ fat free substitutes, but I couldn't stomach this stuff....
column10: Like the title says, I'm fairly tolerant of low/no fat substitute foods....I don't expect them to taste nearly as good as the original, but imho, this was SO bad, I actually ended up throwing the jar away (which I normally NEVER do with food unless it spoils....). I can't even begin to describe the taste...it was beyond chemical-tasting. I really enjoy the "Better n Peanut Butter" brand of low fat peanut butter.  Although it needs to be kept refrigerated (or else it can get moldy in a few weeks after it is opened), it is fairly close to the original in both texture and taste.

column9: A Good PB Substitute for Special Diets
column10: Please note that his is not peanut butter; it is peanut flavored spread. The consistency is that of a peanut butter flavored ice cream topping.  Of course the consistency and taste are not just like peanut butter, which is loaded with fat and calories. If you have special diet needs and cannot have peanut butter, this is a decent peanutty tasting substitute. I used to consume peanut butter every day without fail. When I had to remove it from diet over a year ago it was very difficult.  This product really helps to fill the PB craving.

Sorry guys, but wake up to realization. There can't be a yummy zero-calorie peanut butter spread out there. And this peanut butter just proves it. I was super excited when I found out that there is a zero-calorie peanut butter. When I bought it, I didn't want to admit that I hated it. I tried to eat it but I ended up giving it away. It is the nastiest thing in the world. First of all, when you open it you can see all the nasty oil excess at the top which just ruins your temptation of having this peanut butter. I hate the texture, it feels 100001% FAKE, It feels like melted gooey plastic in your mouth, and it tastes like a blob of yuck.

I'm not typically a choosy eater, and I like the Walden Farms calorie free salad dressings, so I thought I'd give this stuff a whirl. It is vile. The texture is gross, and it left this awful after-taste in my mouth which I had a hard time getting rid of. Not good.

column4: Barely There "Never regret anything that made...
column9: Good and tasty if you want zero calories
column10: UPDATE: KEEP YOUR RECEIPT.The product is guaranteed...but the process to get a refund is onerous (in my opinion)."I am sorry that you were not satisfied with our "XXXX".  Please send a proof of purchase, a note with the expiration date of the product and an explanation as to why you were not satisfied to the address below and we will gladly refund your money.  Thank you and again, my apologies."Walden Farms1209 W St Georges AveLinden, NJ 07036I spread this on Wasa sourdough crisp as part of an HCG Very Low Calorie diet. I thought it was tasty..and very peanut-like for ZERO CALORIES. It is thin. Goes well with Walden Farms blueberry fruit spread.NOW if you are NOT looking for ZERO calories..look elsewhere.
