This is  hands down the best whole wheat pasta you can buy.  Costco no longer carries the whole wheat style and it is expensive here.  I now buy "bionature" here at Amazon and it is very good also.  Healthy and delicious.  Hope Amazon lists it in their subscribe and save program soon.
Really great product.  Can't get it here so ordered it online.  As a bulk item it will last a long time unless you eat pasta everyday (which isn't a bad idea, I guess).

I have 2 little dogs that go every where with me! So its perfect to keep in my purse or in my car for when I'm on the go.  I'll admit I'm kind of anal about what I feed my dogs. I read all ingredients, make sure I know where its made (kind of sad that I don't really even do that for myself) The ingredients certainly aren't compromised, it's certified organic! I tried it myself and its not bad, just a little bland because there's no sugar. AND.. the best part of all is they help feed doggies in shelters!  :)  Love it!

For every Dogsbar sold one is donated to a dog in need! What a wonderful company. I take these with us when we go hiking and keep some in my purse. They are organic and made in the USA. Also check out the Dogsbutter by the same company.

Salsify is the taproot of a weed (kindof like a carrot or dandelion) called Goatsbeard.  They're okay to eat plain.  But I use them as an easy, lightly flavorful addition to just about any crock pot recipe, or mashed potatoes - I like saute'ed leeks and turnips in them too.  People describe them as having a faint oyster flavor - I wouldn't call it that except for having heard them described that way.  Given this, I want to try them in a Thanksgiving stuffing.Note:  the Roland can is well-made - lined, as I think you'd need for this product.
I missed eating salsifis since I came to the States in 1973 and was delighted to find that Roland carry it and at my favorite market, AMAZON. Will order again and again

column9: Salsify more than a potato alternative
column10: I love this product, it is more than an alternative to the potato.... it's delicious!  I just sauteed them with butter, and am currently thinking of other ways to enjoy them.

I had a difficult time finding salsify in the U.S. I tried to grow it one year but these cans are so much easier. The salsify are delicious and the stalks are great out of the can or heated with browned butter and bread crumbs. The subscription option is convenient.
Edgar Cayce recommends this to eat, product is bland but adds bulk to a salad, try it at least once in your life?????

This product is often called "Oyster Plant" and does indeed have a pleasant, cooked mild oyster flavor.  Roland has packaged the salsify quite nicely in a mild liquid that does not detract or overpower the product.  I've prepared the salsify both scalloped and in a garlic butter sauce and was very pleased with the end results.  This vegetable was very popular in KY and TN in the early 1900's and was grown in country gardens.  My 94 year old mother remembered it well but had not eaten any since she was a child.  Amazon was the only place I could find it until I recently visited an "international grocery store" in a large city.  This was the first time I'd ever heard of it or tasted it.  I bought 12 cans from Amazon and 5 from the grocery store (all they had in stock...).Very pricey through Amazon, but if you're looking for an exotic gourmet side...this is certainly one that will fill the bill.  Use mild ingredients so as to not overpower the delicate flavor of the salsify.One can will serve 2 people nicely as a side, perhaps 3 if a mild cheese and bread crumbs are added.

These salsifis are the best ever, i am so happy to have found at Amazon.com that they actually stock this kind of vegetables that my mother would cook for us when i was living in my country, in Europe, cook them in a pan remove the liquid of the can pour a little bit of butter, and at the end pour some cream and lemon juice and serve immediately with some nutmeg on top,bon Appetit as we say in the french parts of Europe !
Since we moved from the NYC area I can not get this product.  I was so happy to see that I could get it from Amazon.

column9: Very tasty and easy to use!!
column10: This spice blend is amazing!!!!!!  Sauteed some chicken breasts the other night and sprinkled a generous amount of Dukkah spice towards the end then added in a handful of craisins and it was so yummy!!!!

column9: Product looked like it was 1 year old
column10: I recieved this yesterday and was very disappointed...  the milk chohcolate was all white spider-web looking and hard as a rock.  It looked as though they were very old although there was no expiration date on the package.

column9: Sorry for breaking the perfect record
column10: I was gonna give it a three, but I ate 2 more of them before I wrote my review and the second changed my mind. The image shown on the box is very misleading I must say. The actual chocolate looks dry and has a chalky texture. The taste is pretty good, but after reading the exuberant reviews it got, I was really disappointed. It's chocolate with nuts - fine, but it just didn't met my expectations. I bought some hersheys chocolates at the same time that was much cheaper and had much more content and honestly I enjoyed the hersheys much more. That is only emphasized by the fact that the hersheys are all gone and I haven't even completed half this box. Good chocolate, but nothing that special.

Purchased Mauna Loa products for years and never encountered a product like this. The chocolate was a lighter color and did not seem as creamy as previous Mauna Loa products. The color indicated some sort of problem with vendor storage. Wrote email to company but no reply. Will never purchased from this company again. Best quality found direct from factory.

column9: Great for Gifts- if you can give them up
column10: These are very addicting and yummy. The chocolate is fantastic and the Macadamia's taste even better wrapped in the chocolate. It would make great Chrismas Gifts- just be sure to have them shipped directly or you might eat them yourself.

The chocolates taste great but you are better off coming to Hawaii and getting them fresh in the store.  They are sold in almost every shop in Hawaii (Walmart, CVS, tourist shops) and they are much cheaper in Hawaii.  They are at least half the price in Hawaii and you can enjoy it in Paradise nice and fresh.
One of the best chocolate covered nuts i have ever eaten..it just sucks that you can not find these at every grocery stores around my place..i think they should lower the price a little

column9: Bought it for someone as a gift
column10: ... and they asked for another box! I have not tried this myself, but I have no doubt that this would make a great gift.I'm only upset that they raised the price.
I love these! The chocolate is in my opinion a lot better tasting than some of the other companies. The second these little guys get to my house they are gone very quickly. Really good to eat!
I first tried this product when a neighbor gave it to me as a gift and I had to have some. This product came very promptly and the product was fresh and very delicious.
I bought these as a birthday gift for my mother, and she loved them. She said they were delicious, and her only dilemma was how not to eat them all at one time.

Had a bad day?  Your boss is a jerk?  IRS got you down?Buy this!  Fresh from Hawaii.  If you buy the other one from Texas (yuck), it's probably three weeks old and sat in some hot trailer.Mmmmmm..... so good.

column9: Absolutely the best milk chocolate covered macadamia I've had.
column10: Looking for a chocolate nutty taste? This is for you! Reminds me of Hazelnuts but with the distinct crunch you get from macadamia nuts. Always a good decision.

column9: Store Bought, Hawaiian Host Macadamia Nuts.
column10: I just purchased two boxes from a Chinese store in Plano Texas. I could not find a " Do not sell date " unless it is the date on the inside cover of the lid. The date is 7/2010. The chocolate has a white coating and has a old tasting Flavor. I will not purchase this product again. I called the company and the voice said I was next in line, However,five minutes went by and no one activated the line, I hung up and give this a 1.

Picture a warm summer day and you're lying in a comfortable, handwoven hammock tied between two towering coconut trees as the welcoming sun beats down on your glistening face.  Sunglasses drawn, you sip your cool, pineapple-laced mai tai enjoying every gulp as it refreshes your dry, parched mouth.  A cool breeze brushes past as if nature's hand itself wanted to rock you gently as you would a baby in its cradle.  The soft crashes of ocean waves against the white sandy beach beckons you for a short dip in the cool, clear waters of Hanauma Bay.  Ahhhh, paradise....Eyes closed, you feel a presence come up next to you as they cast a shadow across your body.  You open your eyes to find a beautiful island girl dressed in her native garb of Hawaiian grass skirt, coconut shell top and aromatic lei around her neck and forehead.  She greets you with her pearly white smile that shines in contrast against her perfectly tanned, soft skin.  Surely, no mortal deserve such perfection.  She reaches over for a chocolate covered macadamia nut and motions toward you to place one of these little pieces of heaven in your salivating mouth.  Just when the tip of your tongue senses the sweetness of milk chocolate ---SLAP!!!!Inexplicably, your horrible boss appears before you with his arms belligerently crossed against his chest yelling at the top of his lungs, demanding to know where his TPS reports are as he is already 5 minutes late with his appointment with the "Bobs" in the meeting room.  He storms out of your cubicle while contentiously muttering the words, "We'll talk about this later, mmmmkay?"Suddenly, the reality surrounds you like a cheap wet suit as a co-worker passes by insisting you have a bad case of the "Mun-days."  Dejected, you sit back down in your office-appointed chair and reach out for a macadamia nut chocolate and realize this candy is the closest you'll ever get to Hawaii.Sigh...

About two years ago, a relative bought me back a box of these Hawaiian Host Macadamia nuts.  I loved them so much that I decided to purchase some for myself.  You will not be disappointed with this purchase.
You can never go wrong with a box of Hawaiian Host Chocolate Covered Macadamia Nuts.  My wife was in Hawaii a few months ago and fell in love with these chocolates.Good candy.
I have loved these since I lived in Hawaii.  They are just like the ones you can get at Longs Drug in Honolulu.
I ordered this because my local grocery store use to carry it and I loved it.  But when I got it it was not the same thing.  The box is a greenish box and it does not taste the same.

column9: My favorite belgain waffle mix so far
column10: Love this mix. I would pick this one over Williams Sonoma Belgian Waffle and Stonewall Kitchen Pancake and Waffle mix. Waffles come out very light (remember to use sparkling water), and are a great 'base' for various fruit additions: orange zest and chopped strawberries, chopped mango and nuts, etc. I use very basic full-size Belgian waffle maker and one recipe makes 2 waffles. I just wish more stores carried it.

column9: Best Belgian waffle mix I have found
column10: I love Belgian waffles.  However, I have searched for and tried every Belgian waffle mix in the grocery stores in St. Louis.  I even ordered waffle and pancake cook books to whip my own.  Nothing I tried gave me the taste and outside crispiness of what I wanted.  Then I found Maple Grove Farms Belgian Waffle Mix at Schnuck's market (a midwest local grocery chain; we don't have any national grocery chains in St. Louis).  Since I tried everything else, I bought it and tried it.  It was best of any I tried, and I tried quite a few.  Now Schnuck's market doesn't carry it anymore.  Great product, and this is a good price, especially for six boxes.  Use a good Belgian waffle maker for best results, and enjoy.

For years, Sunday breakfast in our house has been waffles or pancakes.  We have had these particular waffles every week since I discovered the Maple Grove Farms Belgian Waffle Mix two months ago.  The malt flavor is a tasty alternative to other mixes and scratch recipes.  The waffles are crispy outside and soft in the middle.  I'm sure we'll return to pancakes for a bit when the blueberries are ripe, but for now, we're happily stuck on these waffles.

This is the yummiest box-mix waffle mix I have found.  Mixing in an egg and some butter yields traditional waffles that are good, and pleasantly  slightly sweet.  I actually never use this in a Belgian Waffle iron, only in a regular waffle iron, where it works great.  Don't know whether a Belgian waffle iron would be better or worse.
Delivered on time. Very tasty.  Made waffles for breakfast and my family loved them.Also made waffles for dessert with ice cream and chocolate sauce...wonderful!
Been buying this for several years and never been disappointed. Next best thing to your favorite waffle house!
This made the worst waffles I have ever tasted and I followed the directions on the package exactly.  It was my first try at Belgian Waffles and I will try again but not with this mix.

column9: Best ever and low cal and organic!
column10: I love this all organic Hot Cocoa.  I first heard of it in reading Prevention Mag. when they recommended it for dark chocolate lovers.  They were right.  My pantry is never without it and when I want something chocolaty I have a cup of this. The trick is to be certain that you don't use more water than it calls for on the label.  I don't have 6oz. mugs but do have a lot of 8 oz. ones so I put in three tbsp. of the cocoa per 8 oz. of water - that's still only 110 calories. There is already organic milk powder in this product so no milk is needed.  Of all the hot cocoa products I have used this is far and away my favorite.

This has a distinctive taste, so I am not saying that it is not chocolate tasting or has no taste, but it IS extremely thin. Quite watery for something you are just supposed to add water to. My family does not like it and I only drink it when made with 1/2 water, 1/2 milk. The taste is not the same as other hot chocolates, this is not to say bad but certainly different. It is simply not to our liking and due to that and the thin, watery consistency we won't be buying again. Amazon's part in purchase and shipping was fine per usual.

I really love this Hot Chocolate. First found it in Whole Foods and bought it as it was organic, fair trade AND low sugar! So many organic hot chocolates are very high in the sugar department which bothers me. This one is not. I think only 11gs of sugar?! When compared to 25gs and up, it's rather good. With the low sugar content it does remind of a more european type hot chocolate which is more creamy than sugary. So maybe bare that in mind?All in all, lovely stuff!
This is a great all-natural hot treat.  I drink it all the time, though I add a small squeeze of maple syrup to my cup of hot brew.

If you love hot cocoa this cannot be beat!Order it once and you will be back. Just add hot water. Delighted to see it on Amazon. It truly is a great gift item.Equal Exchange Organic Hot Cocoa Mix, 12-Ounces (Pack of 3)

I don't understand the negative reviews. I love this hot cocoa. I'm shopping for some hot cocoa that you just add water to as a gift for my super picky sister who doesn't want hot cocoa mix that requires milk. I don't understand that since this stuff and all hot cocoa has milk in powdered form.Anyhow, maybe the negative reviewers are super picky like my sister. Will this be as super rich as Godiva made with milk? Nope. I think it has a great taste though, even better if you add some whipped cream on top. I love that it has less sugar and is organic and fairly traded.

column9: So delicious - a great chocolate flavor
column10: I will never buy swiss miss again. This Equal Exchange Organic Hot Cocoa Mix is delicious- a wonderful chocolate flavor with no junk included.

This is my favorite hot cocoa drink. I really enjoy putting a scoop of it in my coffee; what a nice treat!I hope you'll look into the story behind Equal Exchange - That makes this sweet treat even sweeter. what a nice way to get a warm feeling -TWICE!(The only downside, and it's no biggy, the outside packaging looks nothing like the picture in the information. Not sure why. That did cause me some alarm at first till I tasted the product and it seems just like what I was hoping for.)ENJOY IT!

This tastes just like brown water. It is lacking flavor and leaves a bland feeling in my mouth after I drink it. Being organic doesn't really make a difference in taste. It tastes worst than the conventional hot chocolate. If I were you I would not buy it.

column9: So glad to find an organic hot cocoa mix
column10: I just love this organic cocoa mix. I had been looking for a mix with natural ingredients, less sugar, and more cocoa flavor- this is it! If you like your hot cocoa really sweet, you won't like this mix. If you like it extra creamy, add to hot milk. YUM! And I like the idea of using organic products. Much healthier and more natural. I bought it directly from the company's web site last time, but will order from Amazon when I need more. So glad they are carrying products from this company.

column9: What REAL hot cocoa tastes like, an emotional experience!
column10: Equal Exchange Organic Hot Cocoa Mix, 12-Ounce Tins (Pack of 3)This is what hot cocoa in Europe tastes like, with less sugar and milk than we have in the U.S.  I add one teaspoon of sugar and one tablespoon of milk to mine to suit my American taste buds.  The result is a very rich chocolate taste, unspoiled by all those additives in the other products. It is a powerful emotional experience every time!

The Equal Exchange Organic Hot Cocoa is excellent. It is smooth and full of chocolate flavor. A bit of side news is that the purveyor was a supplier to Trader Joe's. The quality and consistency is better via Equal Exchange. The brand with the chili is delicious as well. Highly recommend this cocoa. Very nice for the cold nights and brisk mornings of winter. Gourmet stuff!!!!!!

column9: Equal Exchange Organic Hot Cocoa Mix
column10: After finishing my can of Rapunzel Organic Cocoa Powder, I couldn't find it again online or in stores.  So, I purchased Equal Exchange.  It has nonfat milk already in the mix which the powder did not.  This is easier when traveling. It also contains organic sugar cane juice so you don't need to add sugar, either. I enjoy the taste of it. It has 70 calories per serving size. You have to order it in a pack of 3 but that wasn't an issue for me.

Always a favorite in the summer months. I've made four of these kits and they never seem to last very long. The kit itself has corks, shrink tops and labels. I'm a red wine drinker but my wife and her friends love this wine.

column9: The BEST peppermint tea I have ever had....
column10: I was raised on tea, by a tea-loving mother and English grandmother, however, I do not consider myself an expert. I know you can go further down the tea-fanatic trail than I have gone. Despite my attempts, my own children refused tea, and I was resigned to the fact that passing on love of tea ended with me.I picked up the Traditional Medicinals Organic Peppermint at the now-gone Henry's chain looking to add variety - as a kid my mother plucked mint plants from the field to dry and turn into tea (I was also raised on chamomile tea procured in the same manner), and have never found a peppermint tea with the same flavor... until now. The tea tastes fresh, it is not too sweet or too strong, nor too weak as some brands I have tried resemble spearmint instead of peppermint. It is perfect on it's own, or with a bit of honey and cream to appease a strong sweet tooth. Best of all, I cannot keep my kids from drinking it, and they have begun branching out, and sampling other teas and even chai as well. It IS expensive, however, so buying in bulk from Amazon is the best money-saving option, as it is eligible for Super Saving Shipping and (for now) tax free to my state. I recommend trying one box to see if it is to your liking - I have found the tea at Sprouts, Trader Joe's and Wild Oats, so similar stores should have it as well.

This is the mintiest, freshest, most perfect-tasting mint tea ever. The peppermint in here is clearly high-quality and very intensely tasty. Opening a tea bag from this box, you are immediately overwhelmed by the pungent and exhilarating mint scent. Steeped in a cup, it doesn't disappoint, and is super-delicious to the last drop.The minty taste is not just cool; it's COLD. Perfect when combined with piping-hot water. Not at all excessive, but a lovely and balanced bold clear taste.This is always a godsend when I am feeling too-full, sick to my stomach, nauseous etc. I'll never buy another brand again.

column9: The best organic tea for stomach gas
column10: I have tried various natural medicines for my long lasting stomach gas problem. Every time after each meals, I have serious burps, farting, and feeling of heavy filled stomach and then soon I start to get headaches. The only way to solve my problem was to do treadmill  for 20 min  and take an Advil. I tried gax-x type of medicines but no long term relief.Since I started drinking peppermint tea, it has helped me to releases any trapped gas from stomach and intestines like jet blast. I love it, its natural and no side effects at-least I know.But always remember, gas, farting, belching is due to indigestion so although peppermint tea will fix your gas problem but you need to fix the underlying problem of indigestion. simple way to solving is to drink lemon juice & yogurt etc right before the meals.

column9: Great Benefits For Your Digestive System
column10: I have a sensitive stomach so I have to be careful what I eat or else I have terrible stomach aches. I came across this tea at Target. It has a pleasant taste, it leaves a great refreshing after taste. I drink this about an hour before bed and I feel great after I drinking 1 cup. I also feel great in the morning; I don't feel sick anymore.Warning* this tea makes me really sleepy. Which is great when I can't fall asleep :)

If you like mint tea or if you just want to drink it for an upset stomach this is the best choice. It's medicinal grade so you know this is as pure as it can get. The flavor is much stronger than any mint tea I've bought before. You can buy it in your local grocery but really the subscribe & save deal on amazon is the best!

I was drinking Twinnings peppermint tea and others, but nothing compares to this one! It is very strong, has a nice aroma and works great for relieving a headache, sore throat, upset stomach, and IBS. It is naturally sweet in taste so no need to add any sweeteners. It also seems to wake me up which is huge plus.
This has become my new favorite tea.  The full minty flavor in this tea hangs around long after the cup of tea is finished.  It's very refreshing and a perfect partner for a cold winter evening.

I never review anything, but I love this company so much that I want to spread the word. Out of the many different brands of mint tea I tried, this one is by FAR the most intense, satisfying and flavorful. I can definitely vouch for the peppermint tea (and I just bought the Eater's Digest and love it too), I haven't tried the other kinds yet, but if you're contemplating which brand to choose, start with Traditional Medicinals before you waste your money anywhere else!
Wonderful mint flavor that does not get bitter or too strong no matter how long you steep it. Great price with subscribe and save.

This truly is the best tasting peppermint tea I have ever tasted. I use the bags twice that is saying a lot for tea. I gave my Mom a box and her words were almost identical to mine. A plus is that it helps those with digestive issues. Try it!
Have been buying this repeatedly for about 2 yrs. I've tried several other brands and always return to this one. Perfect mint flavor and strength.

Yes......this is by far the best tasting Peppermint tea I've tried.  And I think I've tried just about all of them.  I have acid reflux and microscopic colitus so it really helps my stomach and digestive system calm down.  Plus this one tastes wonderful. I drink it every morning before breakfast and sometimes during the day.  But I find it starts my day out in a very calming relaxing way.  I was really excited to find it at Amazon and at such a great price.  I have literally ran around from store to store just to find this Organic Peppermint Traditional Medicinals brand.  So often they are sold out of it and for good reason.  Others must love it as much as I do!!  Try it you'll love it :)

Pure peppermint herbal tea - all you need to perk up that afternoon sluggishness.  I love mint tea - but kept searching for a peppermint tea without other flavors to mask the pure energy.  This one is the best I have found, intense flavor with no additives.

Seems to get rid of stomach acid coming up my throat. forgot what that's called. May just be the placebo effect.I put a tea bag in a 20 oz container with reverse osmosis water before I go to bed. I then drink it in the morning with my breakfast.
I love this tea, it tells you on the package on how to prepare it. It helps when I have an upset stomach or  a headache. I will buying this tea again and again.

My favorite tea is Organic Ginger.  However, recently I had a tummy that needed something more soothing.  This Organic Peppermint tea has a wonderful aroma and flavor and helped soothe my body and mind.  I recommend this tea for when you are stressed or when your tummy needs soothing.

I brought this tea because mint tea is great for cramps.  Well the aroma and flavor is what hooked me.  I drink it, if I just want a cup of tea.  It's not often you get a tea that's medicinal and has great taste.  I've shared this product with a couple co-worker and they even enjoy it (they're not real tea drinkers)

The organic peppermint tea has an intense flavor. This tea has a number of uses for me. I use it in an Iced Spice tea blend that I make; as a single cup of hot tea at night to calm my coughs; as a digestive aid when I eaten food that is a little spicy and to flavor a simple syrup for plain iced tea.
As another reviewer said, this is the best peppermint tea I have ever had.  It really is a cut above other ones I've tried.  I love this tea.

Traditional Medicinals makes some really nice tea, and their organic peppermint is one of the best. It is strong; none of that weak fare you get at your local grocery store. You can really taste the peppermint oil on your tongue, almost as if it were brewed from fresh peppermint. It is not sweet; add some honey or raw sugar if you like it that way. Excellent for your digestive track and memory, peppermint tea is a wonderful study aid and will help you stay focused without getting the jitters of caffeine.A first class tea, and easy to recommend to anyone who enjoys herbals.
I love this tea, It has flavor, and zaz.you should try it.

I grew up on this juice in England. The lemon flavor was the original. Look for the orange and black currant......mmmmmm It is great. In the USA you don't tend to find what we call 'cordials' so much. It is a economical way of getting a great tasting juice. It is so concentrated, it goes a long way. I have a soda stream (again something I grew up with in the UK) and I make a lot of club soda with it. I then add a small amount of Barley water and it is so refreshing.I love it !!!

column9: Really liked it until I read the ingredients: saccharin!
column10: Since the 2nd listed ingredient in this beverage is sugar (behind water), why bother to put saccharin in it as well?  It's the last ingredient listed, so presumably a small amount, but why add it at all?  My child is allergic to sulfa drugs, and people who have allergies to sulpha drugs should stay away from saccharin.

I was introduced to Robinson's Lemon Barley Water by a friend that grew up in the U.K. I cannot attest to any latent "health" benefits of the product, but I agree with the other reviewers that this is absolutely delicious and refreshing when spritzed up with seltzer water in keeping with the directions on the label.

Lemon Barley water is delicious with club soda or seltzer water.  It gives it just that right amount of fizz!  I grew up with Lemon Barley water and am thrilled I can get it stateside.  I have ordered it from here before with great results.  Three bottles last quite awhile.
Lemon and Barley water is a refreshing drink that you dilute to your preference of strength not too sweet and perfect for all year use.

column9: F A M O U S.......B E A U T Y.......S E C R E T !!!!!!!
column10: Barley water is renowned in "knowing" circles, for it's tendency to create faultless complexions.  Some of the MOST famous beauties have used this beverage -- the company, Robinson's, was, as stated on their label, founded in 1823!  At least 2 generations -- probably many more -- of world-famous English beauties have used it.  (A hint as to who these beauties are, and were, is on the back label of the bottle.)I had heard of the value of barley water from a thin red book, which sadly has disappeared during the intervening years. I almost didn't buy this barley water, as I was afraid of a pebbly consistency.  However, I bought it and I am very glad I did!  The barley here is barley meal...very finely ground, and in any event, only 2% of the contents.  It tastes quite smooth and delicious when you drink it, either hot or cold.And this 33.2 ounce bottle is a CONCENTRATE!  The label directions suggest one part Robinson's Barley Water to four parts of water -- more water if it is given to young children.  These directions make emminent sense, as barley is often used in the manufacture of whisky.  No -- I doubt that anyone could ever get drunk from barley water...because the barley is un-fermented.  Still, the barley maes this otherwise lemonade-concentrate quite -- or even middling --strong stuff.  A little goes a long way.So, I'd recommend this for everyone.  Those who wish to have clear and radiant skin, to those who will not drink alchol, and for those who like lemonade.  As I haven't researched this product other than tasting it, I am sure there are many benefits to it that I have missed.  Yes, it does have some preservatives...but these are kept to a bare minimum in the content.The benefits of barley water should be better known, especially in the USA.  Robinson's Barley Water seems to be the very best!  Don't forget to dilute it..and drink it for your health, for good taste, (it's good taste -- and yours!), and for tge legendary benefit of totally beautiful skin!

column9: More like bottled juice with traces of barley
column10: I use to have a lot of lemon barley water as a kid during summers. My physician was of the opinion that barley had a lot of medicinal value in curbing minor infections and strengthening the immmunity of the body.However i was extremely dissapointed with this product as it does not have enough of barley which it should. This can be used with spirits for cocktails if u decide to go ahead purchasing it, but not worth it as there are better and cheaper products out there for your taste buds!

I keep checking Amazon's Subscribe and Save for decent chocolate, because chocolate is the main indulgence in my house. When I saw these, I thought they looked pretty good, and I was not disappointed. The strawberry flavor is intense and the chocolate is good quality, with a smooth mouthfeel.

At first I was not enamored with this tea because of the lack Bergamot essence. After reading the reviews complaining about this issue I had reservations about placing my second order. I am glad I ignored my feelings. The tea is now packed with a plastic cover over the paper packaging. My guess is it is there to preserve the needed additional Bergamot flavoring.This tea is now the way it should be and I applaud Davidson's for making the change to better their product. I am on my third order and intend to remain a customer.Monday Mar 29 2010I just received my latest shipment and what a pleasant surprise. New and better packaging of what seems a more robust and fragrant Earl Gray tea. Kudos to Davidson's for improving on their now very fine product. I now give it five stars.

I've enjoyed this tea so far. I would agree with other reviews that it doesn't have  the strongest bergamot flavor, but steeping a few more leaves is offset by the value provided by this product.The tea has a somewhat floral flavor/scent that I'm not used to in erl grey teas. It is not overpowering, but worth mentioning.

I am very pleased with this decaf Earl Grey.  The tea leaves do have an odd smell - it almost smells like it is green tea - but the flavor is very nice.ETA: My first bag of this tea lasted me about a year, and I just ordered another bag in February 2011. This bag is different - there is a very strong citrus scent from the leaves, which is odd, but I think the flavor is even better than last year's bag. I upgraded my rating from 4 to 5 stars.
Its difficult to find good loose leaf decaf tea, but Davidson has made a wonderful tea with great Earl Grey flavor.  Its smells and tastes delicious.  I am very pleased and will be buying this again.

column9: Davidson's Tea Bulk Decaf Earl Grey
column10: If you like British-style hearty tea that can stand up to cream and sugar or just plain hot comfort, this is one of the best.  Bergamont flavor is well balanced, and the price can't be beat

This tea barely has any taste. It requires two to three times the typical amount of loose leaves to brew a cup.  Even so, the result is something that barely tastes like tea, and certainly not like Earl Grey.

I would say my family is addicted to oatmeal, including my two very young children. We eat oatmeal at least 5 days a week for breakfast and sometimes the kids want it for dinner! This oatmeal is amazing, after purchasing it many times at our local grocery store I decided to see if I could score it cheaper on Amazon and sure enough I did! This oatmeal is delicious, not only for kids but for adults too. It has chunks of real fruit in it and has wonderful flavor. I love that it's organic and is now made with less sugar then before. I recently started making huge batches of homemade oatmeal since we go through so much but I still order and keep this on hand for a variation. Great oatmeal, you won't be sorry if you choose any Country Choice Organic Oatmeal!

My daughters(6&8) Love the Berry Blast oatmeal packets...not so much the Caramel Apple. It seems that I have a stockpile of the caramel apple in my pantry! Also, I usually end up making 2 packets for healthy, active girls. It would be nice if they sold just the berry in a box and added a little more to each packet. That being said, we love the product and support organic growing methods whenever we have the opportunity.

column4: Mrs. K "From the wilds of the Mojave"
column10: This chai is not the same as the chai I had at a great Indian restaurant just south of Golden Gate park in San Francisco. I live in the middle of nowhere -- authentic chai is just something that I'll save for vacations.But for me at home, Bombay Chai is just fine. It tastes good and you can see whole/larger pieces of spices in the bag. The Bombay chai is much more flavorful than Tazo or Good Earth (yuk) that I can find at my supermarket.I live 70 miles from the nearest Whole Foods market where I can buy Bombay Chai, that's why I ordered it here on Amazon. I had purchased a box of it from WF and really enjoyed it.I steep the tea, remove the bag and stir in some sugar free fat free vanilla powder, some nonfat milk and vanilla protein powder. I just love it this way.All you tea purists can go fortify yourself now with some totally authentic tea that was brought from India on the back of sacred cattle that swam across the Ganges before being loaded into a specially blessed cargo container. I'll just sit over here and enjoy my chai with my peanut butter toast.

column9: The tea that started it all
column10: When I was in an upscale restaurant near work one day, I was looking for a tea from their selection, and couldn't find anything basic like English Breakfast or any of the usual black teas.  What I did find was Chai.  I had no clue what Chai tea was, but thought I would give it a try, for lack of any better options.  Am I glad I tried it.  It had a flavor unlike any tea I had ever tried, with a dessert spice taste, without being too overpoweringly spicy.  I liked it so much that months later I had to call that restaurant to ask them what brand of tea they had been serving, to get some for myself and for Christmas gifts.  I have tried other brands of Chai tea but none compare, the worst being whatever brand they were serving in that certain Canadian donut shop that we all go to (it was very watered down and flavorless).  While Chai tea isn't something I drink daily - I usually want something more basic black and not spicy - it is a great treat once in a while when I want something more unusual and desserty.  Although not the traditional way to make it, I prefer drinking it with water, not with milk as the Indian restaurants would serve it.
Bombay Chai is just what I was looking for. I love chai tea, but this one has an outstanding robust flavor that sets it apart from others that I have tried.

column9: I love Mighty Leaf, but this cannot be called "chai" tea
column10: I love Mighty Leaf teas and have found no other teas that can match their quality, taste, and freshness.  However the Bombay Chai falls far below my expectation for an authentic chai tea.  The tea tastes very weak and is lacking the robust black tea taste that a chai tea should have.  The taste created by Bombay Chai departs from the traditional chai tea taste.  In my opinion, this tea cannot even be considered a "chai" tea.  Yes, the spices used are traditional chai spices, however the flavor is not that of chai. After my great experience with other Mighty Leaf teas, I was greatly disappointed with their attempt at a chia tea recipe.Yet in spite of Mighty Leaf Bombay Chai's shortcoming, this tea is still far more healthy and tasty than the boxed chai teas on the market - Oregon Chai and Tazo Chai (sold by Starbucks).  These boxed chai teas are what most Americans consider chai, however they are very far from it.  These boxed chai teas are dessert drinks that are loaded with sugar digest horribly.Chai tea spices are medicinal in nature, supporting the function of different organs and reducing the "dampness" (Chinese Medicine) or "kapha" (Ayurveda Medicine) of the milk used to create a more balanced drink.I have traveled India and tasted authentic chai tea - both in south India and north India (subtly different recipes).  I have even had the pleasure to taste very rare varieties of black tea leaves.  Unfortunately I have never tasted chai tea outside of India that resembles what I have enjoyed in India.  My own experiments with chai spices have created chai tea that is closer than what is sold in America, however there is a uniqueness to chai tea in India that is difficult to replicate.I find that I can create a more authentic chai tea by using Mighty Leaf Organic Breakfast Tea combined with a blend of chai spices (cardamom, cinnamon, ginger and cloves).  Or if I am in a hurry, I skip the spices and use a tea bag of Tulsi Red Chai Masala (caffeine-free Roiboos tea, not black tea).  I find this unique combination of black tea and roiboos a tasty recipe.Organic India Tulsi Red Chai Masala, 18-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 6)Mighty Leaf Tea, Organic Breakfast, Tea Bags, 15-Count Box, Biodegradable Whole Leaf Pouches (Pack of 3)-- My Praise for Mighty Leaf Teas ---Mightly Leaf Tea should be considered in a class of it's own for tea. The leaves and herbs used are extremely fresh. When you open a plastic (not paper that breathes) pouch, you are immediately hit with the sweet aroma of fresh tea. I have never smelled another tea bag that even comes close to the freshness. Even most bulk teas are not packaged correctly or quick enough at the manufacturer to keep this much freshness in the tea.Mighty Leaf Tea is a bit more expensive than other organic tea, however the quality of the leaves and herbs is the highest. Might Leaf Tea uses large pieces of leaves, herbs, and flowers - unlike most teas that use shreds of leaves. Shredded tea oxidizes very quickly due to the increased surface area. This results in tea that loses flavor and smell very quickly.Mighty leaf uses silk bags which have larger pores than paper bags. This means that the water penetrates the tea bags more fully, allowing the newly tea-infused water to spread to the cup more quickly. Brewing tea too long will create a bitter taste. The problem with most paper tea bags is that infused tea water cannot spread quickly enough through the cup to create a bold, full flavor before the 3-5 brewing time has passed. This means that either your tea is not full flavored or is bitter. Mighty Leaf solves this problem by using silk bags.Each Mighty Leaf Tea bag is sealed in a plastic pouch. Since plastic is less porous than paper, these pouches keep the tea and herbs fresher longer.There is nothing to not like about Mighty Leaf Tea. I only wish that Mighty Leaf Tea started selling Tulsi tea and I would be in Heaven.Mighty Leaf Tea is clearly the creation of tea experts who appreciate the highest quality organic ingredients. They have created a tea bag system that is far beyond what any other company has done. Every type of tea that Mighty Leaf Tea offers tastes incredible. So choose your favorite flavor and enjoy tea as it should be experienced - fresh, bold, and delicious.
Ten bags of these will hopefully last quite a while, but they are really good and as long as someone has space, I think its a great deal!

I am a big dried pineapple fan and I have to say that not only is this a great deal, its delicious! Only problem is that its so good that I eat more then 1 pack at a time. Im not sure how Amazon stores or packs the product though, I found small bugs in the box. The pineapple is in a sealed bag so it was fine.

These are good pineapples; they seem fresh, not chewy, etc., but I don't understand why Harmony found it necessary to add so much sugar. For a company that touts itself as healthy and natural, they sure add way more sugar than necessary. The first few bags it didn't bother me so much, but now I can hardly eat them without feeling sick followed by a big sugar crash. Pineapple by itself is sweet, and then when it's dried it's a concentrated sweetness, why on top of that did they feel the need to add more sugar? They are coated with it sort of like those round sunkist fruit candies! I surely wish I could find another brand that is inexpensive and doesn't add sugar...
These are sooooooooooo delicious! It is hard to only have a few. Just sweet enough and very satisfying! Makes for a great snack or for dessert!

This is some of the best dried pineapple I've ever tasted.  Sweet, not to "gooey" as some other dried pineapples are.  Bags are resealable, which is great, and the price is so much cheaper than I've been able to find in stores.  Love it!

I purchase these for hubby to take to work to snack on, and to use in some baking.  What a great deal! The ones we received are absolutely fresh and soft, no hard, old pineapple, here! Very flavorful pineapple, great for cooking and snacking. They send it in the case, that is still factory sealed and our expiration date was in mid 2013. Great price, great product. Can't go wrong with this :-)

I got this with subscribe and save for $21 and saved a ton. I paid almost 4 dollars for a 6oz bag at publix, so the numbers dont lie. The only thing I will say is that I prefer the dried fruits that are a little more chewy. These pineapples aren't soft but they aren't nearly as chewy as the publix ones. I cant say that this is a downside, its just my personal preference. Either way I give 4 stars for the price and taste.

column9: Wonderful product, however too many packs in the bag
column10: this pineapple product is wonderful. However, I wish they had smaller cartons, 12 bags is way too much. This seller also has mixed dried fruits in a carton of 6 bags.  That would be perfect for the pineapple chunks.Something to think about for Emerald Harmony products.

The pineapple was just what I expected since I had purchased this brand locally previously. The only thing I would change is to have been able to buy it in bulk packaging instead of individual bags. The individual bags were a minor inconvenience at best. Will I purchase them again? Definitely!

Not only is this a great deal, but the pineapple is delicious. Emerald does a great job, and each piece looks great and is nice and juicy.I would just warn people to be aware of the sugar content, because there is 20g per serving.

column9: D E L I C I O U S ! ! !
column10: This is our second case of delicious, not-too-sweet dried pineapple at an amazing price that can't be beat!!! One review states that one of the ingredients is a petroleum-derived chemical. This is a bit ambiguous. The ingredients list is as follows (which I copied directly from one of the bags): "Pineapple (pineapple, sugar, citric acid, natural and artificial flavor, sodium metabisulfite and/or sulfur dioxide added as a preservative." First, the list states "and/or," which means it may or may not be in it; and, second, the definition of sulfur dioxide is "a colorless toxic gas (SO2) that occurs in the gases from volcanoes." Despite this remote possibility, it is extremely tasty and contains much less sugar than other brands of dried pineapple. All I can say is: Y U M ! ! !

This would be a great value if it didn't have petroleum derived chemical artificial flavoring in it.What are they thinking? we won't notice?Wake up Emerald Harmony. WE READ LABELS.If you can't make food without petroleum additives, then why bother?

column9: This is more than your instant ramen
column10: Oooh yum yum yum.  The quality of the noodle is excellent and as good as what you would get in a ramen noodle shop!  I love this brand, period.  As to the soup base it is a little saltier than the other ones, but non-the-less delicious!  All love, and not bad value either.
.. This stuff is good! Authentic. Has 2 flavor packets: one liquid, one dry. It's a bit greasy, but that's part of the charm!

Instant ramen is a handy thing to have in the cupboard for a fast and tasty lunch or dinner. With healthy additions like chopped veggies (frozen are fine, just nuke before adding to the broth), I don't feel too guilty about indulging in this quick meal occasionally.The Myojo Chukazanmai line is the best of the best where instant ramen is concerned. The oriental flavor is rich, complex, and slightly seafood-y; it's my favorite. The noodle quality is great, too. In the summer, I'll cook the noodles alone, and when done, shock them cold under running water. Then add a bit of cold Japanese men-tsuyu (noodle broth), a dash or two of sesame oil, and chopped red ginger (beni-shoga). Chop up lettuce and/or cucumbers if you have them; maybe some ham or chicken if available. Great cold pasta dish!

I purchased these hoping they would be a healthier alternative to the cheap Nissan/Maruchan 10 cent noodles you find everywhere. I've consumed literally hundreds of the Nissin/Maruchan, but stopped several years ago because they are just so ridiculously bad for you. I am a recovering addict - on some days I used to eat 6 packs! Make no mistake, these Myojo are healthier for you but they are NOT healthy. One serving has 120% of your DV of sodium (2900mg) and 6 grams of fat/2 grams of saturated fats, 68g of carbs (2g fiber). They also contain MSG in both the dry seasoning and liquid soupbase.Nutrition aside, I was anxious to try these to see how they compare to the cheap ramen. I have an aversion to anything seafood-related so I was dismayed to see the dry seasoning packet contains scallop and clam extract. HOWEVER, I was willing to give these a shot anyway. I cooked up the noodles for the suggested 4 minutes, and stirred in the dry seasoning and liquid (oil/soy sauce) packets. The seafood smell was too much for me - I had to dump it out and then mix it with one of the beef seasoning packets from the Maruchan noodles. As for the liquid packet - it adds a nice smokey, rich flavor to whatever seasoning you choose to use. The texture of the noodles is good and comparable to cheap ramen.The price of these is quite high. You might love the flavor of the seasonings and enjoy that they are not as fatty as cheap ramen, but ask yourself if these are worth up to 24 times the price. If they had lower sodium and less carbs, I could see these being worth it.My next ramen adventure is to try GreeNoodle without seasoning (ASIN: B0054S0P9E).

You can dress this ramen up any way you like.  Ramen itself is perfect and soup base is good.  Use leftover meat, meat of any kind - stir fried or grilled, seafood, soft boiled egg, vegetables of your choice and you would have a perfect bowl of Japanese ramen - almost.

I was really excited to have a blend of peppercorns.  However, since there is allspice mixed in with these it really throws the flavor off of, well, all of my dishes.  You can taste the pepper yet you also taste a earthy, kind of pungent bite as well.  I even tried picking through the peppercorns and removing the allspice.  It was too late, the flavor is still mixed in there.  <shrug>  Too bad.
I found these to be high-quality, more than I expected. Typically the rainbow peppercorns are quite expensive. This was a great deal for all three jars. I will certainly purchase again.

I love the pretzels; I just do not like having to buy such a large quantity at one time. I had to get 12 bags at one time, I have 10 bags left, today is Sept. 17th and the expiration date on the bags is Oct. 10th. There is no way that I am going to eat 10 bags of pretzels in 3 weeks; I am the only one in my family who eats them. Now I know that they will not go "bad," but I do not want stale pretzels. I cannot find them in stores anymore, so I had to buy them because I do love them so much and Amazon.com was the only place that I could find them. I am going to have to cancel my current ongoing order with Amazon and try to find another option where I do not have to get so much at one time.

These are the best Pretzels on the market.We didn't need to know any information about them except how we could get them in West Virginia. we lived in Glen Burnie Md. for 40 years and when we retired and moved to West Virginia there was no one here that sold the Old Tyme Pretzels so I contacted Hanover in PA. and had them shipped to us. Now we are happy customers.Thank You/ The Rollysons

These pretzels have the perfect blend of salt and good pretzel flavor... with the perfect crispy crunch. (not hard!) I picked these because they were a little lower in sodium but the taste beats all I've tried, hands down.

column9: Great flavor, timeless favorite, front door delivery!
column10: These giant pretzels have a great flavor.  Snyder's is a step above Rold Gold and other pretzel brands.  There's something a little exciting for kids about eating a giant pretzel.  My kids love them.  My husband does.  And Amazon delivers them with the subscribe and save program directly to your door with no shipping.  What's not to love?

column9: The best pretzels for the job!
column10: I use these pretzels at Christmas and I fill them with homemade carmel.  They don't sell them in stores by me anymore and I have been so grateful that I have been able to find them on Amazon.  The price and quality are great!

I received my package in tact and could not wait to taste them.  The product was fresh and tasted like it did when I ate it growing up.  You do get a lot for the money.  I will definitely order from this company again.

Ordered what was advertized as 3 lb bulk. Received about 1 1/2 lb. in a box with a shipping weight total of 2.55lbs. It looks like someone opened one of the bags, removed a good portion of the candy and threw the rest in to get shipped. Ad should state that half of what you order will actually ship. I'm very unsatisfied, and wonder if this was not an accident. Is it worth pursuing over such a small $ amount? I'm undecided at this point.
Absolutely love this popcorn and the amount in bag is plenty to share with a friend!  Definitely buy it, you won't be disappointed...

I have not tried the nut version yet- they did not have it at the store here in Canada.I did try the caramel version and the popcorn is tasty, fluffy and addictive!my better than the kind you get at the mall from that "popcorn place".But the funny thing is this popcorn is cheaper in Canada when it is a US product?I do not get that.Still I will be on the hunt for the nut version and may have to order some here!

First of all it was mailed in a soft carton envelope which was broken through when I got it.  It should be mailed in a box. The product is a powdered mix, not a ready to drink liquid, label says 14.1 oz. not 18 oz.  I happen to be having a problem with my hands so opening/closing the envelope and mixing the powder is a problem. Description should say powdered mix.

My dogs love these bones.  I bought all sizes.  My jack russel loves the big ones and the small ones.  My 60 pound mutt loves the big ones. They are great.  They are able to digest them and able to enjoy the bones.  I bought so many of them.  Petsmart for some reason discontinued them I was so upset.  I was so happy to see them on Amazon for a great price. I highly recommend them.

column9: Doesn't last long for agressive chewers
column10: I don't like all the controversy surrounding rawhide bones and don't want take the risk of my Lab getting a blockage so I exclusively give him Booda bones which are safe. My lab is an aggressive chewer and considering this is edible it makes him that much more excited as he LOVES food. He enjoys these bones but devours them in less than 20 minutes. I usually give it to him for a few minutes until he eats half of it and then I take it away to save for next time. This obviously would get very expensive so he has his non-edible Nylabones most of the time and these are special treats.

column9: Great for dogs with stomach problems
column10: My dog gets sick eating a lot of dog treats (even Milkbones), but has always done well with all the Booda bones.  She really loves them & they're good for getting rid of the tartar on her teeth.  I highly recommend these.

Our Siberian Husky is overweight and on a diet.  She also is great at building placque and tartar on her teeth - baad breath! She has a touchy stomach on top of it all.  Tried these bones in all flavors and she loves them.  They help with her teeth and breath.  She gets one bone for her lunch (she's a 3 meals a day gal).  Her other meals are now canned green beans with either yogurt (plain) or low fat cottage cheese.  She has lost about 11 lbs and is doing great!  No more throwing up her food!

column9: Goodbye Rawhides! Hello Peace of Mind - & Dogs Love 'em!
column10: Love these! Well, because...we have 3 dogs (2 were unplanned children ;-) & our 60-LB German Shepherd AND our 40-LB we-have-no-clue-what-she-is dog have both choked on various shapes & sizes of rawhides. The Shepherd choked so badly that, this time, it wouldn't come up. She couldn't cough & started to literally choke to death. I actually straddled her back, attempting the only thing I  knew how to do - the human Heimlich Maneuver! Like where exactly is a dog's sternum, anyway? Well, I tried anyway and thank God it finally did dislodge & we got it out! Was it the Heimlich? I don't know. Probably not. I mean, she still won't tell me... After all, I guess it was very traumatic for her.But in all seriousness, what I do know, is that was the last time any of my dogs have had any kind of regular rawhide bones! Which, I really wanted to let everyone know of my personal experiences; I believe anybody who is at all concerned about giving their dogs rawhides and/or experiencing a similar problem is on the right track to avoid them.Our small part Chihuawa/part something else, first 2 times in-a-row, threw up repeatedly w/rawhide pieces and w/foam. He was VERY sick the 3rd time, so we definitely stopped that! The ONLY kind I did finally take a chance with were granulated rawhide munchy sticks, & they're all fine w/these; though I'm still nervous about them choking on a piece, but neither of them have had any problems with Boodas so far, & they don't swell up in their throats like regular rawhides.So, now... It's Booda Bones!Yes, they are a bit on the pricey side, especially for my 2 larger aggressive chewers. I agree with some other reviewers that they are not very long-lasting. But it's all I'll give them now. But, for my half Chihuahua/half something else(20lbs), I give him the smallest ones and they are like mega-saurus bones for him(it is my hope that the manufacturer will start selling these in bulk packages, for less $). I get 3 different sizes for my 3 different whatever-they-are-dogs. They absolutely love them! This includes the assorted flavors, the bacon-flavored, and the yogurt-flavored. Whichever is cheaper at the time and shipped by Amazon.And I owe a big thank you to Brian Amazon, all of you for all of your reviews, Booda Bones, and Amazon!** Confession: This was originally a comment I posted to a reviewer by the name of "Brian Amazon" a long time ago. I have been buying Bones from Amazon, and, only Booda Bones, ever since. They are so great that I've been wanting to write a review, & now finally have the chance to (I have, however, resorted to copying and pasting much of my original [brief... LOL] comment, with some editing).
My dog loves Booda Bones.  They are a bit pricy so I only give him a couple a week as a special treat.  I'll continue buying them from Amazon for the best price.

We have a dog with a liver shunt - so she can't have a lot of protein / can't digest protein.  Booda Bones are the BEST treat for her (and our other dog loves them as well!).  The only 'downside' whatsoever is that they're a tad expensive - but they're worth it!

column9: More of a treat then something to keep your dog busy.
column10: Let me start by saying our dogs love these. As soon as they see the bag they stop whatever they're doing and run to their crates (where we typically give these to them). However, for our dogs these are definitely more of a treat then an activity. I have one dog who is an aggressive chewer who finishes these in under five minutes. He doesn't chew them as much as bite of chunks of it. My other dog isn't quite as strong of a chewer but it usually takes her just around fifteen minutes to eat the whole thing (this review is specific to the Biggest Boodas). So for my dogs this is less of a chewing experience and more of a treat. And when the eat them this quickly, they do get expensive quick.

My dog loves the chicken, steak, and peanut butter booda bones, but he's not as fond of the spearmint/peppermint variety.  My dog will eat it if offered, but my dad's dog who I often sit for will not even touch these.  I wouldn't recommend for a dog who prefers meat.

column9: My dogs have rated Booda Bones 5 Stars!
column10: I have three King Charles Cavalier Spaniels and they are picky, picky eaters even when it comes to Treats.  They love the peanut flavored Booda Bones and have one every day.  They insisted I write this review on Amazon so their opinions could be known.  They're pushy that way...

I was very disappointed by the product.  They are NOT long lasting as I was lead to believe.  I was going to buy Chewlotta's which take my dog about 2 hrs to go through 1, but I thought it was too pricey at $3 a pop.  My dog could eat this whole bag in less than 2 hours.  He does enjoy them though.

column9: Dog really likes, but they go fast.
column10: I have an 11 pound Couton De Tulear.  Small sharp teeth.Dog loves them.These don't last long.  From a value standpoint, I prefer "Checkups," when Costco has them in stock.

column9: love that these are yogurt flavor!  my dog loves booda bones!
column10: I have no problem w/my dog eating these.  He loves these booda bones. I had never seen the yogurt ones; he loves them.
Our dog, a Siberian Husky, just loves Booda Bones.We give her one for lunch most everyday and shepesters us till we give it to her.

Our Boston Terrier loves these bones - we give them to her as a treat or to keep her busy when we have company.  For a 16 lbs. dog she's a mighty chewer and these last her a couple of hours, with breaks to investigate if she's missing anything!  We'll buy more of these!

column9: My dog goes crazy for these!
column10: My chihuahua loves these, especially the peanut butter, chicken, and bacon varities. They have become increasingly hard to find at pet stores so I was happy to find them on amazon. I like that they are safer than rawhide bones and easy to digest and she really seems to enjoy them more than other bones I've bought for her. I tried a few other brands when I stopped being able to find the booda bones at pet stores and she would not even eat some of them. You can't go wrong with these, they are reasonibly priced, safe, help reduce tartar, and dogs seem to love them.
My 3 year old miniature schnauzer loves these bones. I'm really glad that they started making them wheat-free because he has food allergies.
My dogs beg for these treats every night after dinner.  I always make sure I have plenty of supply at hand.
My dog is addicted to these and they're actually fully digestible and don't hurt anything. I've purchased them from everywhere on the planet and will buy from here from now on!

column9: My dogs do not like the flavor
column10: Regular flavor Budda Bones are great for my dogs but they apparently do not care for the minty flavor on these.
The dog really loved these bones and it seemed to freshen her breath.  It was a good treat for a dog with tummy troubles.
My dog really enjoys the Booda bones.  I was very pleased with the price I received and also the fact that they arrived  earlier than expected.
OUR BEAGLE JUST  LOVES THIS PRODUCTSHE TAKES ONE WITH HER WHEREVER SHE GOESESPECIALLY LIKES O CHEW WHILE IN THE CAR
We have three darling Shitzus.  All of them adore Booda Bones and look forward to this wonderful treat.  Thank you Amazon!!

I have a dog who until we adopted her never had oral care,so her teeth were in bad shape. We brush her teeth every 3 weeks and give her 1 booda bone weekly . Not only are her teeth cleaner but some of the staining has gone away. Our vet told us that these are the best thing for her because they digest easily and do not contain plastics.
These are great, but my dog likes to augment them with other types of bones
These took FOREVER to ship and when they did arrive they were not as durable as advertized.  Was looking for a bone to keep our dogs busy, these were more like a snack.

column9: Quoc Viet Pho soup base is the best
column10: I had doubts about the quality and flavor coming from a jar/can but i was very surprised! This soup base is very easy to use (gallon of water, ginger, onion and beef bones with half of the soup base and their spice bag). Hour later, delicious flavorful pho! Made the smell like a restaurant and you do not have to add other spices.

Quoc Viet Foods Beef Flavored "Pho" Soup Base, 10 oz jars (Pack of 4)Quoc Viet Foods Beef Flavored "Pho" Soup Base, 10 oz jars (Pack of 4)I've loved going to the restaurants that serve pho. I'eve tried every flavor, and to make it at home is the BEST.This base started my soup wonderfully. I just added roasted onion, ginger and one soup bone. I love strawberry green tea, but I can no longer find it in my area. I like black tea so I figured I'd give this product a try. The price is great. I am not a big fan of the flavor. column9: Remove the Salt Shaker from the Table and Store it on  the Back of the Shelf
column10: Mrs Dash Original Salt Free Blend, 6.75-Ounce Units (Pack of 6)  is a tasty solution to the problem of eating too much sodium, the bad stuff in salt.  To flavor our foods, Carol Bernick, Executive Chairman of the Alberto-Culver Company, developed Mrs. Dash back in the 1980's.  She became frustrated with flavoring products that contained large amounts of salt.  She wanted a convenient way to flavor food without using salt.  She went to work and developed . . . by tasting, testing, and tweaking . . . a unique blend of flavorings with the taste she liked.  Mrs. Dash is now the most popular salt-free blend in the seasoning category.It contains onions, black pepper, parsley, celery seed, basil, bay, marjoram, oregano, savory, thyme, cayenne pepper, coriander, cumin, mustard, rosemary, garlic, carrots, orange peels, lemon juice powder, citric acid, tomatoes, and oil of lemon.In addition to the taste that will make you not miss your salt shaker, it has an intriguing rough texture that I enjoy.  There is something amusing on the 6.75 ounce jar:  it has "about 273 servings" of ¼ teaspoon each.It is great for seasoning fish, chicken, and collard greens.We are bombarded on a regular basis with the ever-present threat of hypertension and resultant strokes. The public dietary enemy number one --according to many authorities -- is sodium.  At first, sodium was considered bad for people with high blood pressure and/or congestive heart failure.  Now it is recommended that everyone restrict sodium intake. Massive quantities of sodium are in most mixed spices, canned vegetables, canned meat, processed meat, restaurant food, and cheese. (Read the labels!)While it is difficult to eat in the modern environment without overly salting our bodies, it is possible to use Mrs. Dash when we can.  Those of us with no loss of kidney efficiency can substitute potassium chloride for salt, but many of us have medical problems that do not allow us to make this choice.  Also some people object to the aftertaste of potassium.  A ¼ teaspoon shake of Mrs. Dash has only 10 mg potassium, which is a negligible amount; and it has 0 mg sodium.Even if there were no health concerns related to its use, I'd still choose Mrs. Dash to liven up food.  We eat in a cafeteria three days a week where the food is bland, and we keep a container of Mrs. Dash handy there.

Mrs Dash is  great  to use in tuna salad & chicken salad.  All the spices less the salt  gives these salads a great taste.  It is also a good bargain since the Supermarkets only sell the very small jar.  Carol

column9: A tasty, kosher, healthier alternative to Pop Tarts
column10: First and foremost, these toaster pastries taste great! You get light, crusty pastry and impressive chocolate flavor. But the saturated fat percentage is only 15% of the USRDA 2,000 calorie reference diet, which is relatively low for a toaster pastry. The percent of total calories that come from fat is also relatively low. But you can do that much diet damage with just one or two of some kinds of cookies, and the portion size of these pastries - the nutrition information provided assumes that you're eating an entire pastry - is far more satisfying than a cookie or two. Many people might find just half a pastry to be satisfying. So if you're looking for something sweet to eat, I'd call this a good choice.Kosher certification is provided by COR (Kashrus Council of Canada, based in Toronto, Ontario), and the product is dairy.
