column9: Appears to be culinary grade - good - but not higher grade
column10: The grade of this organic matcha was not noted in the description. From the price and the size (3 oz) I surmised it would be culinary grade. It appears it is. This matcha is more of a split pea soup color compared to the bright green of the higher grade matcha. The taste is different too. Hard to describe the taste. Good, but not the great of the higher grade. I just had to buy this to compare since this matcha is much more economical. I will use this straight as a tea in a pinch, but will relegate this more toward cooking, baking, smoothies -- where the higher grade would be "wasted." Well presented in a nice container. Quality matcha just not the higher grade used in ceremonies and the quality I use in my practice for drinking by itself. The only reason for the 4 star rather than 5 star review is that the grade was not disclosed in the description, or even on the packaging. If "culinary" was disclosed, this would be a 5 star review.

column9: Liquid Jade is fairly good,  but high cost
column10: This morning I taste-tested 3 top-rated Matcha green teas that I recently purchased on Amazon.1. Serendipi Tea matcha culinary grade organic green tea from Japan, 4 oz. costs $17.43(result: *****)2. Tea Zone matcha green tea powder, 8 oz. costs $16.99 (Amazon sells this as `Matcha Green Tea Powder By Malden Tea', but my black foil packaging label says it's made by Tea Zone)(result: ****)3. Liquid Jade powdered matcha green tea 100% organic, 3 oz. Cost $18.46(result: ***)Recipe:I made 3 different cups of  `green tea latte' with the following method:1 tsp tea powder,mixed with filtered water into a smooth paste,added to 1/3 cup hot soymilk + 1/3 cup boiling water + 1 tsp raw agave nectar,frothed into a Latte-style tea with hand-pump device.NOTE: I am a scientist.  Each cup was clearly labeled.  I tasted the teas side-by-side, taking 3 sips of each before proceeding to next sample.  I tasted in random order until all 3 cups were consumed.  Total time: 15 minutes.  I took lots of notes and drew graphs etc.Result:Serendipi Tea (5+ stars)  won for sweet smooth flavor, amazing long lasting froth bubbles, and the fact it's organic!!  Cost: $4.30/oz but worth it.  Note on the packaging: For those reviewers complaining of the green tea powder leaking, I have to point out that it's hand packed, with a note explaining that you must pack it yourself in an airtight and light-blocking container.  Fine with me, since this is the best tea I've found, and the act of packing it myself is itself a ZEN moment in which I feel a connection to the individual soul who packed the brown bag by hand just for me.  You decide.Tea Zone (Malden Tea) (4+ stars) came in second for a very nice flavor, but the frothy bubbles popped sooner than the Serendipi Tea, making for a lower rating, and plus, it isn't organic.  But it gets extra points for its low cost:  $2.12/oz (can't beat this price for a daily tea).Liquid Jade (3 stars) was an O.K. tea, ever-so-slightly more bitter than the other two I taste tested, and almost a chalky feeling (perhaps it was ground into larger particles than the other teas).  Yes it's organic, always a plus, but at a cost of $6.15/oz, no way will I buy this again when I can get TeaZone 4 stars for a third this cost, and Serendipi Tea 5 stars for significantly less money as well.  'Au revoir' Liquid Jade (though I do love your container and I'll save it.)
I found Tao of Tea's "Liquid Jade" matcha to be very fine, with lovely green color, easily dissolved, staying in suspension, and a delightful flavor. I will definitely buy it again!

They responded by saying I should take it up with Amazon.  Not real good customer service for a small company trying to get larger.  Needless to say, I won't be buying any coffee from them in the future.  I read some place that one unsatisfied customer can lose a business 25 customers.  We'll see.  I have since bought some Trader Joes Decaf French Roast (in the soft bag, not the round container).  It wasn't as good as Starbucks high test, but it was fair superior to Jeremiah's.

column9: For the veggie hater in all of us.
column10: Those guys out West can live on a vegan diet, but if you're like me you hate most veggies. V8 is good for catching up on your servings, if you like liquified ketchup.But finally, there is a solution. This drink has a lot of servings of both fruits and veggies, and you can't even taste the vegetables. Instead, it tastes like a berry drink. Plus it isn't sweetened with corn syrup or any of that junk. All the sugars are natural.So get this if you need some veggies in your life.

column9: KIDS LIKE IT BECAUASE YOU CAN'T TASTE THE VEGGIES
column10: MY 4 AND 7 YEAR OLD LOVE THIS JUICE. IT IS SO HEALTHY FOR THEM AND NOT FILLED WITH ALL THE SUGAR AND FILLERS OF THE JUICE "DRINKS". THEY CAN'T EVEN TELL THAT IT HAS VEGETABLES IN IT. THANKS AMAZON FOR CARRYING THIS AT A MORE REASONABLE PRICE THAN THE GROCERY STORE.

I'm not sure how many bottles I have gone through, but I love the taste and love the fact that I get 1/2 serving of fruit and 1/2 serving of veggies each time.  Admittedly, I am not the best at getting my fruit and veggie allowances in everyday, so this at least helps.

I really enjoyed this V8 Fusion. My 4 year old daughter also enjoyed it as well. I found it refreshing. I was never a big fan of the original V8 juice, but I really enjoyed it. I have always enjoyed fruit juices but never got into Tomato juice. Although neither my daughter or I have much of problem eating vegetables, this is a nice alternative.

column9: Tastes more like fruit than veggies
column10: Its hard to believe there is as much vegetable juice as there is fruit juice in these.  I did some rough calculations and I don't think I could make it any cheaper if I bought a juicer.  However I did find store brand stuff at walmart that was a little cheaper and is just as good.

column9: No veggie flavor.  Kids love it.
column10: Our family loves V-Fusion.  It's one way to get fruits and vegetables into the kids without a fight, probably because the vegetable flavors are so well disguised.  Pomegranate/blueberry flavor is delicious.  It's somewhat thick, not watered down at all.  It's a little tart but not too much.  I can taste the carrots and tomatoes, but I think the kids can't pick that out.  It's more overwhelmingly blueberry and pomegranate.  Among all the V-Fusion flavors, my kids like strawberry/banana best, but we buy pomegranate/blueberry for variety.  I personally like them all.

column9: Perfect juice if you want real flavor
column10: I have never been a big juice drinker and in years past I always thought of tomato juice when someone mentioned a V8.  However, after my 2 year old grandson came to live with me and I was in the market for a good juice for him (he has so many allergies!) I stumbled upon the V8 line and thought I'd give it a try.  He really likes it....then I found that I love the flavor(s) too so now I order it in bulk quantities.  This particular Pomegranate Blueberry is one of our favorites.  I also love the Pomegranate with green tea.  I am now a V8 fan!!
It took for ever to go from ready to ship to actually being moved(around 6 days).  Once shipped it only took 2 days so that was good.

My five-year-old is coming off a bad cold which resulted in a slight loss of weight.  His pediatrician suggested that we improve his diet of veggies...a slight task to engage for a child that doesn't care for the healthful foods.I decided to supplement his diet with the V-8 Fusion Pomegranate-Blueberry mix and he loves it, thinking that it's "Kool-Aid."  While I realize that this concoction doesn't take the place of the real thing, it will do for now as a aid in his recovery and a means by which he can get some much-needed nutrients.Thanks, V-8.

I love the Pomegranate and Blueberry V8 Fusion, but why is the light version not available through Subscribe and Save? I should watch my sugar intake and I know it's available, because I checked at the supermarket!  Any reason why?

We saw these on sale at Publix and they are very rich in taste. Particularly this fusion. It's very dark, smooth, and berry-like. When I started to drink this stuff, and lots of it, I started to really feel better. I didn't eat a lot of my fruits anyway, I know I wasn't getting the intake. But this has helped me. I also notice myself actually going to the bathroom more often (which is a good thing... if you don't go everyday something is wrong).What I also like about these V8 fusions, is that they don't have High Fructose Corn Syrup. Some V8 juices did have it, which is very disappointing. I think it's the Splashes that have it so beware if you want a healthy drink.
Another great beverage to quench your thirst in the heat waves heading our way. Time to put the soda down, and hopefully drinking for health and energy.
GREAT TASTE. GREAT PRODUCTS. I  WOULD PREFER THE LIGHT FOR LESS SUGAR CONTENT. GREAT FOR MY ELDERLY MOM WHO HAS NOT DISLIKES ANY FLAVOR SO FAR.

This is a tasty and refreshing beverage. For those on the go, like most of us are these days, it is a valuable supplement to our sometimes neglected daily dietary needs. I take a glass a day, and then try to make good choices at meal times. The big question is; does it work? Does it indeed give you all that your body needs from fruit and veggies? Well, I don't know. If I could be sure that it did, I would raise my rating to five stars. Definitely more palatable than the original V8!

Let me begin by saying I really like most of the flavors of V8 Fusion juice that I have tried. This one is absolutely HORRIBLE. It tastes like a rotten garbage disposal. I brought 6 of the bottles to my office and everyone that took one home agreed that it was awful. I poured the rest out. Get any flavor but this one.

I ordered this tea directly from the manufacturer website, before I knew I could find it on Amazon.  The service was excellent, the shipping was extremely quick.  The product is very fresh and true to the description.  The box it comes in is very nice and would make a very nice gift.  The lid seals nicely, keeping the tea fresh for a long period of time.  I have been enjoying this tea every morning.

We discovered this coffee on a trip to FL and loved it so when we returned home we ordered three cans, all of which were staleand flavorless. We contacted the company and they apologized, suggested we order from their website and promised to send us two cans, gratis.That was about six weeks ago. Still waiting for our delicious coffee.

This fruit tray arrived on time and in excellent condition.  It was even more attractive than I expected and was festive and appealing.  This was a gift for my boss, who expressed gratitude and appreciation for such a thoughtful gift - one that required no refrigeration or special serving plates (it came pleasantly arranged in its own tray), and could be consumed throughout the holidays, and beyond.  I will certainly purchase this item in the future for those 'hard to buy for' people on my list.

column9: Dad loved it! ...but no gift card option
column10: Bought this as a gift for Father's Day and sent it to his work. He said he enjoyed it. The only thing is I wanted to enclose something that said Happy Fther's Day and they seller did not offer this option. They should considering these kind of things are often sent as gifts.
I purchased this tray as a Mother's Day gift and was very pleased with the product. It was large and there was plenty of fruit and nuts to share. The entire  family enjoyed it.

I sent this as a gift for Mother's Day. It's always flowers, flowers, which are tradtional, but Mother (being thrifty) always remarks that flowers don't last long and get the expense gets thrown into the trash in a couple weeks.This is a nice alternative and she said the fruit and nuts were attractive and good quality.  She liked them.I would consider this again.  Recommended.
I ordered this basket as a gift for my mother and grandmother. They both loved it and said it was delicious. I would definitely order it again.

I just ordered this item and need it to arrive within a week.  I was able to order the item all the way through check out.  I got a confirmation email that it was purchased.  5 minutes later I got an email saying it was unavailable.  Last year I ordered a gift from FTD and didn't get the "out of stock" email until the day it was supposed to arrive (a week later).  I now feel confident ordering through "Golden State Fruit" and picked a different basket.  If it's out of stock... no big deal... I'll know in 5 minutes.  I guess the stock is moving fast as it's 10 days to Christmas.
These smoked almonds are so great.  They are really salty which I love.  They have a great smoky flavor.  I definitely suggest trying these for something different to snack on.
Used it for the first time...love it!!!! Locally, red food color is $1.78 an 1 ounce! Crazy! You have a shopper for life, Ozbo!

column9: McCormick Large bottle of red food coloring.
column10: At the cost of $2.89 per ounce at the store, this was a much better price for a baker like me. The cost was very reasonable.
Nice product like the 1 oz bottle but a lot more for the money. We bake a lot of red velvet cakes and it gets expensive buying the 1 oz bottles. This large bottle goes a long way for the money.

There is nothing like the look and taste of a homemade red velvet cake! Box versions or bakery knock-offs will not do. You can make the cake at home without the color. But who's ever heard of a tan velvet cake? But the cost of the tiny bottles of red food coloring sold at grocery stores adds over $5 to the cost of each cake. So what are you to do? Get this big bottle and make lots of cakes for a fraction of the cost. A feast for the eyes and the mouth. Enjoy! Mmmm!

WITH A MEDIUM ROAST THIS BEAN PROVIDES A GOOD CUP OF COFFEE; HOWEVER, ITS FLAVOR IS NOT AS PRONOUNCED AS MOST OTHER COFFEES. I HAVE BEEN ROASTING ALL OUR COFFEES FOR NEARLY 10 YEARS. I DO FIND AMAZON TO HAVE SOME OF THE BEST PRICES AND COFFEES IN GENERAL.

If you haven't tried this particular coffee, you're missing out.  Add to the fact that this is the finest coffee in the world and that you can age the green beans to your specific liking and then roast it to your particular taste - it's to live for!Delivery and packaging was excellent, and the price is right.  I will be buying this product from this supplier for years to come.
These chips are pretty good.  They taste just good enough for me to want to eat some, and just bad enough for me to only want one or two.  Great for a diet.

column9: Very delicious - excellent for gluten free and low carbohydrate diets
column10: The chips are very delicious. They of course has a hint of vegetable taste, and that is because obviously they are made of vegetables. We are on the gluten free diet and specific carbohydrate diet, so the only thing that is "bad" is the potato and potato starch ingredients, but that is only a very little amount and I am just happy to find a snack that is gluten free and low in carbs. Much, much better than potato chips.I give this a 4 instead of a 5 because the labelling does not clearly indicate if there could be any gluten contamination, if good manufacturing processes are used to seggregate ingredients. My son has recovered from autism and he has to be on a strict gluten free diet, so this kind of information would be very important to us.Overall, I highly recommend this product. This is a much better alternative to snacking than potato or corn chips.

column9: Between 3 and 4 stars - nice, but not superbe
column10: Nice but I prefer by far the stick version. If you like veggies, some of them (the green and the orange ones) really taste like a veggie chip... :)

I rarely eat chips because of sodium level, but was happy to discover these Naturals.  Crunchy, flavorful and low in sodium.  Once a day I eat a serving size of these chips and they satisfy my urge to snack.  And I don't feel guilty because they aren't greasy, oily, salty, just good flavor

I've had several other vegetable chips/straws and these were not good.  The spinach was just plain terrible, but my coworker argues that the tomato was the worst.  Unfortunately I still have a whole bag full at the house I need to decide if I'm going to eat or throw away.

I like Snyder's Veggie sticks, but enjoy the "feel" of a "ruffles/wavy" potato chip.  Much lower in calories than regular chips, but with a similar shape, it doesn't feel like you are giving up anything in your effort to lose weight.  Amazon delivers very quickly with Subscribe and Save, and I am really enjoying my first batch, with more to come.

I can find nothing negative about these chips.  They're completely non-greasy and no-mess, so they can be eaten while you're busy doing other things.  They're fresh and high quality.  They taste fantastic.  I'd describe them as vegetable-flavored chips - the crispy crunch of a chip with the clear yet subtle flavors of veggies.

love these chips...they are relatively lower in sodium. but you have to remember that these are in fact chips and shouldn't be considered as HEALTHY snack...maybe just healthier than your typical potato chips. nonetheless, love the taste and would recommend to anyone looking for a substitute for your greasy salty chips

I'm not a vegetarian, but I am a potato chips addict. Recently I decided to start eating less processed food, stay away from gluten, lower my sodium intake, and avoid transfats completely. Although I now snack on carrots, celery, and radishes, I still love chips. So I was astounded to discover Naturals Garden Veggie Crisps, which meet most of my requirements for real, healthy food. The question: how do they taste? Their flavor is more subtle than conventional chips and even whole veggies, but I think they're darned good! Try them for what they are, not for what they aren't!

I'm not really sure what to say about these.  No one in my house would eat the things after trying just one.  They're like deep frying your broccoli after you've sliced it into a wavy potato chip form.  They taste like veggies too so don't buy these with the idea that they'll taste just like a bag of Conn's potato chips - they won't.  They're not bad but again, you'll definitely need some dip with these boys.  I got mine on sale and I had a coupon to boot. But I highly doubt that I'll buy them again.

As mentioned in the above title, its a tasty chip, though WAY TO XPENSIVE. Due to the cost, this is an occasional purchase.For myself an even TASTIER chip would be the POPCHIPS. They taste more like a chip unlike the above, there is starchy after taste.I am not negating that these are tasty in their own right, it's just my personal & automatic choice would be the popchips brand.

As a vegetarian, I'm always searching for healthy, good food in random retail stores or health food stores. These were $2.78 in Walmart and I figured, "Why not?" The problem is even though it said "veggie crisps," I still went in with the mindset that they'd taste somewhat like chips. Fat chance. I like raw vegetables better than cooked ones so eating them as dry "crisps" just wasn't for me. I think if I drowned them in ketchup, they'd be all right, but at this moment, I'm trying to give them away. I'm definitely not buying these again, but I'm sure somebody somewhere will enjoy them so I won't waste them.
We love this stuff... Originally bought it at Costco, but they stopped carrying it. Now we buy the 6-packs from Amazon.
Tastes great, The real stuff, Just like my Mom made some 50 years ago. Would recommend to any lover ofthis type of food. Real Indian  stuff.
These Kidney beans were wholesome and pure bean---tasted excellent and were plumped up enough to be "meaty" with substance but not hard, nor mooshy either. Very nice.

column9: BEST gummy bear ever!! Better than all other brands!
column10: I bought these as soon as I saw them, because organic candy is rare and scarce.  I wasn't sure on the taste, but as soon as I ate them, I was blown away.  They are so delicious!  I love it when they are "harder" and chewier.  These are the best gummy bears I've ever tasted period.  I am so glad that this company exists!  Family loves these as well, and the bags don't last long in our household.  Love them!

column9: THE BEST GUMMI BEARS I EVER HAD!
column10: I am a gummi addict and I am always on the look out for new gummi treats to try. I must say I was skeptical because they are "organic" and I was expexting bland flavors. I was sooooo wrong! They blow Haribo out the water! Try them!

column9: Ugh.  Not the same as in the store.
column10: I found these in a local market a while ago, and fell in love with them, but hadn't been able to find them anywhere in person for a while.  Saw that they were available on Amazon, and ordered a 12-pack.  What arrived is completely different from the product I bought in the store.  The ones I bought at the store were firm but chewy, even-textured, with a nice fruity flavor.  The ones that arrived are crusty on the outside, soft on the inside; the crustiness really makes it hard for me to enjoy the flavor.  I feel bad for wasting food, but I don't think I can stomach these.

column9: Great taste will satisfy kids and adults
column10: I took a chance on these Yummy Earth candies and am pleased to say that they really are good.  Most flavors were liked by the children although the mango tango was a bit too tangy for some.  As usual, you get what you pay for and I hope more people try them so that the factory can produce more and hopefully bring the price down.  Overall a good product that you won't feel guilty giving your children or eating yourself.

I was excited that I found this gummy candy was available on Amazon, I had a bag from Trader Joes and it was sooo good.  Unfortunately, when the Amazon order came in the gummy bears were all hard, dry and crusty.  Very dissappointed in Amazon....  There is no food return so I hope get some type of compensation....!

column9: terrific gummy bears that are actually not bad for you!
column10: I got these for my grand kids, who loved them! I loved them and so did all my office mates. Finding an organic candy is unusual and one that tastes good is phenomenal.

I bought them at Whole Foods for my toddler's Easter basket.  They're dry, hard, and the flavor is unpalatable.  Annie's, though sticky, are much better.  The best are Tasty Brand.  These just went into the trash.  But the Yummy Earth organic lollipops are excellent.

column9: overly chewy, not soft, but tasty
column10: I bought mine at Whole Foods.  They're organic gummies but they're too sticky & too chewy and hard and not soft like the nonorganic Black Forest gummi Bears.  As far as taste, they taste like dehydrated fruit snacks - sweet and tasty, much tastier than the usual mainstream nonorganic gummies.  One good thing is unlike the usual mainstream gummies, you're not putting fructose corn syrup into your body.I bought them again at Marshall's to see if it just wasn't a quality control issue since I had bought the last bag at Whole Foods.  Well, the ones at Marshall's were ALSO hard and chewy.  If you like haribo's gummy bears which are also chewy, then these will be fine, but I prefer the corn syrup laden Jelly Belly's VERY soft gummmy bearsJelly Belly Gummi Bears, Assorted Flavors, 3-Ounce Bags (Pack of 24) or even Black Forest-Gummy Bears, 6lb. bag.A better alternative to YummyEarth is Surf Sweets gummy bears Surf Sweets Gummy Bears, 2.75-Ounce Bags (Pack of 12) which has the soft consistency of Black Forest and Jelly Belly but is"Organic fruit juice, natural colors and flavors, free of Corn Syrup and GMO's, nut free, and gluten free."

These where just plain awful.  White-ish color and crusty.  They had a very bland taste and what taste they had was bad, not sweet or sour just awful.  I gave 1 star only because you can't give ZERO stars.

THe ones I bought from whole foods were the best gummy bears ever, and my son loved them. Our local whole foods store no longer carries them, so i started looking online and I was very happy to find them at amazon. But unfortunately they are not the same - harder texture, chevy, not as flavorful, ... I will give it another shot and order the small packs.

I baught this candy for my son and when it arrived the bags of candy were so stale, my son could not even eat them. i tried to get in contact with the company but they refused to get back to me. After several attemps i just gave up, they will not back up their products, and the candy is not cheap to just keep buying, so i basically threw my money down the toilet, so would not buy here again or from this company. GO TO surf sweets, their candy is WONDERFUL and way better gummy worms ect, than yummy earth and  a way Bigger selection!!

These are the best gummy bears that I have had.  They have great texture and you can really taste the fruit juices.  On top of it, they are organic.  I gave the whole case as a gift to a gummy lover and I'm sure that they will be gone quickly.

Based on the other reviews I was hoping for a nice firm textured gummy but only some of them are really chewy, the others are mushy. They all have a great flavor (although there are only three flavors). I'm not sure if the issue is the heat, it's July on the gulf coast so the problem may be that they were exposed to high heat while being delivered. I don't feel too bad about it since the amazon price was so low. If the texture would be consistent and they added in a few more flavors they would be five stars.

column9: Gummy Bears that taste like they should but without corn
column10: Do you love gummy bears but hate the high fructose corn syrup or the regular corn syrup?  Or are you allergic to corn?  These gummy bears are for you.  I'd picked some up at Whole Foods right before Halloween and hoped they were going to be tasty.  I opened one of the small packets and tasted one.  I had to double check the package that there was no corn.  These are so good and taste just like the gummy bears you remember.  I had to come here and order this 12 pack so I could have more as well as give some away for Christmas.  I will recommend these to anyone who enjoys a tasty gummy bear.

column9: Tasty but too chewy and hard
column10: I was excited to try these as I found them on sale and the flavors sounded yummy!  I didn't even finish my first package of them.  Our family MUCH prefers Annies Homegrown Organic Bunny Fruit Snacks.  These were fruit tasting, yes, but much harder and chewier than Annies.  Annies flavor is superior as well, I think.  Perhaps I got a bad batch of Yummy Earth Organic Gummy Bears, but I don't enjoy fruit snacks that are hard and almost rubbery.  Annies are much softer and somehow "juicier" tasting.  In my opinion.  But as an alternative to the chemically laden and processed fruit snacks out there they are a much better choice!  I'll be sticking with Annies brand, however.
Was looking forward to these as we love the yummy earth lollipops.  Unfortunately I believe that the package I rec'd was exposed to extreme heat.  They were flavorless and disappointing.

column9: Organic, so of course you sacrifice taste
column10: They won't taste the same as other gummies.  And they were less chewy than other gummies like Albanese (best tasting ones I've found) or Haribo.  Chewiness is one of elements I love about gummies, so I will not purchase Yummy Earth again.  But if you are really looking for a  healthier substitute, judge for yourself.

So the Good news first is that these are great alternatives to the traditional fruit snacks, that are loaded in refined sugars. They tasted fresh and were similar to the Haribo Gummy Bears. The first box I bought were perfect, chewy and fresh, no issues.The Bad News: the second time I got some they were white and crusty sugar like on the outside and kind of tasted funny. I also saw these sold in my local markets, however, they all had the white crusty look to them, so I didn't buy them. I'm dissapointed in the quality, and hopes that Yummy earth can do something to be consistent with the product because it really is fantastic, when done correctly.These will also melt on a very warm day which I discovered when I had some on my purse on a warm day at a baseball game. All the bears melted together into a mass blob.

column9: Good the first time but stale the second time
column10: We bought a package of these gummy bears in the store once and they were excellent but expensive. When we saw them on Amazon we bought the 12 pack right away because good organic candy is hard to come by. The first box was excellent, just like they were in the store - chewy with a very good gummy candy texture. We bought a second box 2 months later and they were delivered the other day, and every package looked the same - dry/crusty on the outside of the gummy bears. We opened and tried one package and they were soft and mushy with a sugary crust on the outside and the color was pale. They were shipped in the Texas heat part of the way and this seems to be a common theme on these reviews with gummy bears turning up crusty and bad, so beware!

I was really excited when I found these and wanted to try them right away. I received them in the spring so no heat damage, but unfortunately 2 out of 3 flavors were just no good. The pomegranate pucker is pretty good and the chewiness level of these are great, but the other two flavors are bitter.
I really like this soup. Sometimes i add some vegetables and meat to it fo a real meal.  It's very good.

We first enjoyed this variety at the Gruyere Castle in Switzerland.  This is very similar to what I remember from those delicious samples.  Much more personality than regular Gruyere, rich, with a delightful flavor "edge" that distinguishes it from many other varieties.The purveyor shipped promptly in a well protected package.

THIS PRODUCT AND THE HORSERADISH I ORDER BOTH (CASES) WERE WITHIN 15 DAYS OF OF THEIR EXPIRATION DATE. THE HORSERADISH HAD NO TASTE. CASES SOLD TO INDIVIDUALS SHOULD HAVE SEVERAL MONTHS BEFORE EXPIATION. THIS  IS BAD INVENTORY MANAGEMENT. I NORMALLY DON'T READ DATES BUT THESE JUST DIDN'T TASTE RIGHT. THEN I CHECKED.
this was avaiable at the store. but they quit carrying it so i seen it on amazon and bought qne case i like the sweet taste the pricr was right and intend to buy more

I've been using this mix for years, but in order to get the kind of scone I love - more British than anything else - I don't follow their recipe.  Simply take the mix from the box, add heavy cream instead of water or milk, and flour your board with a half and half mixture of flour and granulated sugar.  After you've formed your scones and put them on a cookie sheet, let it sit for about 10 minutes (to allow rising) before you put it into the oven.  You will be amazed at how much better these scones will be than anything you've ever had before.
this is the most delicious scone mix there is. try these scones with raspberry jam and your taste buds will relish the moist taste of the scones as they crumble in your mouth.

My husband and I run a B&B and are also opening a tea room. Having a good scone mix is important to us. Maddeningly enough, we cannot purchase either the Krusteaz Scone Mix or the Fisher's Scone Mix anywhere locally. So, I have ordered both mixes recently through Amazon.com. The Krusteaz Mix is surprisingly good in quality and very useful to us. It compares favorably with the Fisher's Mix, which is famous in its use at state fairs and other public functions. Thank you.

CONTINENTAL MILLS  produces a number of good products and we feel Krusteaz Scone Mix is one of them.  We have had it a number of times and it is a winner.Served with butter, jam, tea or coffee it is perfect.

These are the quick and easiest scones to make!  I have been making the Krusteaz brand scones for over 10 years and they are always a favorite with my friends and family.  Usually, I add currents to the mix, but I have also added dried cherries, almond extract, and cinnamon chips (not at the same time!).  If I want them a little sweeter, I drizzle a little powder sugar frosting over the top.  I have tried other mixes, but I always return to Krusteaz!  Yum, Yum!!

The this scone mix is the best that I have ever tried. It is hard to find in our local stores, so I was delighted to be able to get it from Amazon. The mix calls for adding milk, but I have also used buttermilk and then the scones are extra fluffy. The scones taste wonderful when served with raspberries and cream.

column9: Easy and versatile mix - love it!
column10: I am converted ... never again will I bother making scones from scratch.  The 12-pack seemed excessive to me, but we're quickly working our way through it.  I don't really like plain scones, so we tried to get creative right off the bat.  With incredibly simple modifications, we've made cranberry orange scones, lemon scones, blueberry (Continental Mills has a few ideas/recipes on its website, too) ... And I also tried one reviewer's (JMce) suggestion for making more British-style scones, and wow - were they right.  Every iteration of this scone has been great.  And it's just the right amount for my Lodge scone pan.  What a wonderful mix.

Krusteaz Scone Mix is fantastic... only add 1 ingredient: 2/3 C. milk &saves $$.The mix is easy to prepare. I voluntered to bake 100 mini scones for church this was the secret to keeping costs down and having the best tasting and most consistant baking scone. Easy to add: white chocolate chips, crasins , raisins.... every batch ...wonderful!  The overall low cost....is amazing for the quality.Best of all I had to only use 5 boxes to produce (120 mini-scones of varied types)...most mixes only allow for 8 scones & you have to add butter and cream to get the same consistancy and cost $4.29-$6 per bag/box, Krusteaz Scone Mix makes 12 scones or 24 mini scones per box.

This dressing is priced a lot higher in the supermarkets in our area. We've tried a lot of balsamic vinaigrettes but prefer this one. Nothing exotic but it works for us. Kudos to Amazon for including it in their subscribe & save offerings.

If you're going to be baking this in your bread machine, then sharing it with friends/family right away, it's yummy with a dab of butter. However, if you let it cool and put it away for the night, it becomes too dense to enjoy, and the flavor changes significantly with the dill.I tried toasting it on day 2, and it still has far too much of the stale dill flavor to work.Most other potato breads I've made have been light, fluffy, and exceptionally soft -- this one is not.These mixes are more expensive than some of the other brands, and makes a much smaller loaf than I'd expected, too -- so I'll be passing on this one in the future.
This is a delicious bread.  I prepare it in my bread machine, and it does make a pretty short loaf, but we enjoy it.

Pros: All you have to do is hold up the bag and our dog runs for his crate. He's so excited about this treat! Smells awesome! Dog parents like it too because they are all natural (nothing you couldn't eat yourself) and they are made in the US (locally if you live near Pennsylvania as we do).Cons: Nothing that should keep you from buying this product! Yes, it's a little more expensive, but you get what you pay for. Also, we'd like a bag that was resealable (the tin tie at the top tends to wear out before we go through a whole bag). The other funny thing is that sometimes people mistake them for people food.
I HAVE TRIED MANY BRANDS OF EARL GREY AND THIS IS THE BEST FLAVOR. I DRINK 3 CUPS A DAY AND THE FLAVOR IS VERY SMOOTH. TRY IT. I PROMISE YOU WILL LOVE IT!DEBBIE

we have been using the store bought version of Ahmad Earl Grey Tea for a long time and had found it superior to other Earl Grey teas e.g. Bigelow, Twinings, Stash etc. By accident I found the 4.41 oz packaged tea on Amazon and immediately ordered 6 boxes. This tea has a much stronger and intense flavor than the one sold in grocery stores, one bag alone makes a wonderful pot of tea. I have found a fabulous product and can recommend it to all tea lovers.
Hello Earl Grey loves . . . welcome to Ahmad Earl Grey.  This is the best brand ever.  I will not drink any other tea but Ahmad.  I'm in LOVE!

I first discovered Ahmad Earl Grey Tea over 25 years ago while visiting Covent Garden in London.  Since then I have tried every brand on the market.This is certainly the best. Especially the tea bags without a tag or string.they are twice the size, and sometimes more than that of usual brands.Give Ahmad a try, you won't be disappointed.
Product was shipped very fast and in excellent condition and tasted wonderful (my London Earl Grey Tea!!).
This is a really great tea. Sweat and very flavorful with a hint of vinilla. It's my go to drink every day.

I love this stuff! I use it in all my italian sauces, but here is a surprise. I put it my meat along with Mexican spices to make some very tasty tacos and burritos. It just adds a smooth flavor. This product is easy to store and to use. Even my 4 year old grandson can add this to a pot when helping Nana. This product is concentrated and a little goes a long way. You never know when a small amount of hi quality paste will be needed and this fit's the bill perfectly every time.  Very handy and accesible, just throw the partially used tube in the fridge for next use.
I ordered this and i love it, it almost has a sundered tomato taste, rich, and i think worth every penny!
Green tea that tastes like green apples and has all the health benefits of green tea. I make it as iced tea and it is just a perfect drink for this summer heat.

column9: Barry Farms:  I can recommend this company.
column10: Barry Farms: I recommend this company as they are reliable with good, fast delivery (ordered 3 times with both small and moderate size orders) and so far all of thier food products have been fine quality and relatively inexpensive.
Absolutely wonderful!The carrot cake was fab! Moist, real carrots, really homemade.Can't reccommend this highly enough.It arrived inplenty of time.

column9: Excellent, reliable yeast and will last a long time!
column10: I keep this yeast in my freezer and it always performs for me (I've had SAF yeast last years in the freezer with no problems). I usually re-vacuum-seal and freeze half of a pound of SAF and then keep the other half also in the freezer in an airtight, stainless steel container. This yeast can last about 9 years sealed in the freezer without losing much oomph at all (and probably STILL more active than most store-shelf yeasts sold at the supermarket).This yeast rises FAST if you put your covered bowl or pan of dough in the sink with some warm water (or placed in a slightly warmed oven) and it works far better than expensive "bread-machine yeast" if you use a bread-machine.If you make a lot of sweet dough which requires more sugar, then add some citric acid and powdered milk to help aid the yeast to rise (about 1/2 teaspoon citric acid and 1 teaspoon powdered milk per batch of bread dough) or you can buy Saf's 'special' yeast (gold package) for doughs that use more sugar.If you've been disappointed with your baking endeavors in the past, it was probably the crappy yeast and not your baking skills, so get thee some quality baking yeast and you'll have success at long last.Happy baking!

I've been using SAF yeast for 15 years.  I keep the unopened pouches in the freezer.  When I open a pouch, I pour it onto a pint-sized plastic jar to keep in the refrigerator.  I use the plastic jar to refill a smaller jar, from which I get yeast when I make dough.  That way, I don't have to open the larger jar often.  It may sit in the refrigerator four years before I finish it.  It still seems as potent as freshly purchased yeast.

I've always used Red Star, which has worked fine in my baking, but I couldn't resist giving this yeast a try. What a value!WOW....does it make some nice bread. I didn't think there would be much difference, but this gives a faster and higher rise than Red Star.My new yeast. Great price, too!

I have been making bread machine bread for about four years now.  Until recently I'd been using the little brown jars of Fleischmann's or Red Star bread machine yeast because I thought that was all there was.  Then my local markets stopped carrying that variety.  The little packets are way too expensive and I had a sad experience with cratered loaves and uneven texture when one cookbook assured me that active dry yeast would work fine with bread machines.This yeast is amazing.  Once I figured out the exact amount to use with my machine I've been getting beautifully rounded, fine textured whole wheat loaves every single time. It's stunningly better than the stuff you buy in the grocery store.  I've been following the other reviewers' advice on how to store and keep the yeast, since I think I've got enough for several years.  I wasn't quite clear on how much yeast I was buying here.  One pound seemed a better deal than the grocery stores offer.  But four pounds . . . it's practically free.

I've bought three one-pound bricks of this Instant Yeast in the last couple of years. They have given consistent results from first to last. I run my automatic bread maker at least twice a week, so I go through a lot of yeast and always make the best bread.

SAF is great yeast to start.  Love it.  If you have problems with your bread not rising, it's probably your yeast.  Who knows how long those packages have been in the store, they don't even have expiration dates on them.  SAF has an expiration date, it's vacuum sealed and there's no chance of water getting in, activating your yeast, and making them useless.Plus, I paid for four lbs what I would have paid for a single jar.  I open up one package, put it in a container in the fridge, and store the rest in the freezer.  My understanding is that they'll last two years past the expiry date that way. :)

SAF instant yeast is the gold standard of baking. Never thought a change in yeast could make that much difference in baking but it does. Breads baked with the SAF yeast come out finer grained and tend to rise better than when baked with other brands of yeast. While this may seem like a lot of yeast, and it is, you can store the yeast in the freezer. I keep it tightly sealed in a plastic freezer container.Highly recommend.

column9: Great value, works same as the expensive jar type for breadmachine.
column10: Since I got myself a bread maker, I use yeast regularly.  The supermarket jar type is just so expensive consider the volume sold.  After reading other's comment, I just fill saf instant yeast into the jar from my previous supermarket-brought yeast and put the remaining in the freezer for future use.  The unopen pouches/bricks can be store anywhere in the kitchen.

I have had excellent results with this yeast.  When I opened the first package, I poured it into 2 glass jars that I store in my kitchen freezer.  The other 3 pounds are in the deep freezer.  I should be set for a long time with this yeast!  The price for 4 lbs was only a few bucks more than I used to pay for just 1 jar.  Very happy with this purchase.
SAF-instant has always been consistent and what a great deal for 4!  Expiration dates are well into the future and I have found that this product works much longer.

column9: Great Yeast for No Kneed Bread
column10: I have been baking great no kneed bread for awhile using recipes from the Artisan Bread in Five Minutes a Day: The Discovery That Revolutionizes Home Baking book using the yeast available from a local "big box" store. Although the results from the yeast available locally has always been great, the price for the yeast has not.Even buying the yeast in the small 4Oz "bulk" jars locally is ~$1 an ounce, and that really adds up over time if you bake a lot.To get this much yeast locally would have been over four times as expensive!This yeast comes in four individual one pound packages. This is great because you can open one package at a time, and you can store the rest sealed in the freezer. I did a bit of research to find out how long these unopened packages can stay fresh in the freezer.Many different websites are claiming that an unopened one pound package of this yeast should stay fresh up to 10 years in the freezer before losing potency. This is good news for most home bakers who are worried about buying so much yeast at once.Overall, I am very pleased with this purchase. The price is very low for how much yeast you get, it's conveniently packaged, you can store it (unopened) for years in your freezer, and the yeast is of very high quality.

I got this for making fast alcohol. 2 12oz cans apple juice concentrate, refill both cans with sugar, add to gallon jug, top with water. add tsp yeast. week later bottle, enjoy 3-5 days later, cold.no smell of bread or other old wives tales. this is a fast fermenting yeast that does the above recipe perfectly, due to speed of ferment it is cloudy even after cold crashing. whatever, this isnt for competitions, just tasty brew in 2 weeks for ~$3 gal

column9: LOVE IT, LOVE IT, LOVE IT!!
column10: I've been using this about a week now.  Works better than any other yeast I've used.  Surprisingly enough, even the flavor is better:  less intrusive, gentler, not quite as "acid" as some of the other fast yeasts I've bought.BUT THE KICKER WAS TODAY'S RYE BREAD.  I used what I thought was a live sourdough starter for a 3-lb. loaf of rye bread.  No go.  In desperation, I FOLDED some of this yeast into the already kneaded dough, kneaded some more to get the yeast hopefully evenly distributed.  I'm sitting here looking at the loaf that's JUST come out of the oven.  Beautifully risen, beautifully scented.  Haven't tasted it yet, but am sure as hell looking forward to it.This stuff is great...and at the PRICE?  It don't get much better'n that.

A very reliable instant yeast. I kept it in a closed jar on a shelf for a over a year and it performed well. This was a great deal considering it costs approximately 4 times more in the grocery stores.

column9: Great value and better than the other option
column10: I bought this because of the positive reviews and I was not disappointed. This is an excelling value and has really brought the cost of baking down for me. I also appreciated the performance of this yeast. It does not have that hideous stench from the regular brand which I did not like. My bread is coming out better and more reliably with this yeast. So, I am very happy all around with this product.

column9: great yeast for a great price!
column10: wow. amazing price. can't beat it anywhere and the convenience of free delivery with amazon price makes it even more affordable.  I make no-knead bread and pizza and this works very well for all sorts of other uses.  Their website also gives tips for storage & uses & conversions with measurements which is helpful when some recipes call for packets of yeast etc.for the frugal gourmet!

I've used this yeast for quite a few years, and it is wonderful.  The thing I love about it the most is that it can be mixed with the dry ingredients, then all the wet ingredients can be added after they've been heated quite hot (too hot to touch for more than a moment).  This yeast can stand the heat as long as it is buffered by the other dry ingredients.  I have often simplified recipes which called for proofing, or for scalding milk, then letting it cool, with this method, with great results.  For example, today I made this bread:[...]Rather than worrying about the temperatures of the milk and water, I simply melted the butter, added the water and milk to it, and heated it until quite hot, then added it to my mixture of yeast and other dry ingredients.  Works like a charm.  I keep it in the freezer in a ziploc bag and it lasts for years.  Highly recommended.

Best yeast on the market. I am always assured that my efforts will be successful with this outstanding product. This comes from years of experience.Also my package arrived quickly and in perfect condition. Nice to have a product and a company you can rely on.

Just received my 4-pack, and baked some bread. I am very happy with the results. Good yeast! I put it in a ziplock bag, and am refrigerating it so I can get more use out of it. The bags are vacuum-packed, so they should stay fresh until they are opened (though the package has a "best if used by" for 2 years after the manufacture date). I ordered this in March, and it was manufactured/produced in November, so it is pretty fresh.  I had previously made the mistake of getting active dry yeast, rather than instant yeast, which didn't work so great.  I guess you have to proof the dry yeast, but the instant yeast can go directly in with the flour.
You can't mess this yeast up.  One of my packages was ripped open however, and I have not received a response to resolve this issue.  That is the frustrating part.  Otherwise, this makes great bread.

column9: So simple even I can use it.
column10: I'm hopeless in the kitchen, but I LOVE homemade whole-grain bread, so it was a happy day when I found Saf Instant Yeast. Anything more complicated than "add exactly these measurements, mix, put in pan, bake" has always terrified me. So now with some good no-knead recipes even a kitchen disaster like myself can bake bread that's super quick, healthy, and tasty, and also way cheaper than that spongy crap you get at the supermarket. This is by far the best price I've found on this yeast as well.

The yeast is great, works very well. I bake some bread every day in my breadmachine, and this brand was recommended by the manufacturer. It is so much cheaper to buy yeast by the pound. I divided the package into four parts, one is in my cupboard, and the others are waiting in the freezer.It seems like most of the time I need to use a little bit less of this yeast then the recipe calls for.

This yeast works great for my bread machine,and much better than my former yeast.I am just a little bit worried if it's too much for me,hope it won't be expired before I use them all.Anyway,thank Amazon for selling this cheap and great yeast!

Delivered quickly, as described, in good condition, packaging didn't tick me off.  Great product.  I originally started using this yeast on the recommendation of King Arthur Flour and I've never quit.  We're not very exciting bakers, just make all our own bread for a family of four and SAF instant is a consistent contributor to the success of our daily loaf.
I purchased this because of the price and the quantity.  We had been buying yeast packets from the store, but it was adding up.  I am much happier with this yeast and how it is working.
This is very good product, I used it for bread, pancake etc. It is easy to use and effective. I highly recommend it to other people, you will not disappoint it.
Works like a charm, In this vacuum packaging it's so economical, I keep them in the freezer & they easily last a year or so.  I love to bake so by then I need more.
what a bargain! i do a lot of baking and we make homemade wine. it works superbly in either. and, as another buyer wrote. it's easy to freeze without any loss of potency.
We recently started baking our own bread and this yeast has been perfect. It rises consistantly every time and has held up great being frozen.
This is some of the best yeast I have used so far. It was very inexpensive if you compare it to buying the little packets. I will difinitly purchase it again.
Saf Instant Yeast, 1-Pound Pouches (Pack of 4)I bought this yeast because you get it cheaper than at about any store it does what yeast is meant to do well worth the money

column9: Fantastic, but way too much of it
column10: I ordered this because I wanted to get something better than the lame dead yeast packets from the supermarket.  So far I've made pizza dough, bagels, and french bread with this yeast, and it seems to work good so far.One thing I've noticed is that I've gotten a very reliable and consistent rise from this yeast whereas the little packets were very inconsistent. If I ever get through that much, I wonder if the last package will still be alive.

Until recently I'd been using the little brown jars of Fleischmann's or Red Star bread machine yeast because that's what was available at my local supermarkets. However I do a lot of baking and the little 4 oz jars just don't last long. So I went online and found this product. You get 16x the amount compared to the little jars. I looked the reviews and then ordered. This yeast is amazing. Rises wonderfully, it has been consistent every time. I like that it has expiration dates that are well into the future. I will continue to buy this yeast in the future once I use what I have.

I am a Home Economist and I owned a bakery many years ago.  Recently I decided to start making bread again at home.  I bought some yeast at the grocery store and was not pleased with it, so I went on-line and looked for the saf-instant yeast that we always used in our bakery.  I was so happy to find it and for such a reasonable price.  It works quickly and just as well as I remembered.  I highly recommend it!

I have little more to say than what other 5 star reviewers have already.  This product deserves 5 stars because of the combination of price/quantity and quality. It is packaged very well, and will store well.  If you bake a lot of yeast breads don't hesitate to buy.

column9: Lasts for years in the freezer, great price and performance!
column10: I do a lot of baking with yeast - bread, rolls, pizza dough - and I like the SAF brand.  A friend told me about this 4-pound value pack and I am very happy with it!Each pound comes vacuum sealed in a heavy mylar bag, and fits perfectly on the door of my garage freezer.  I pour one bag into a sealed glass canister that I keep for daily use, and store that in my kitchen freezer.  I use it right out of the freezer and it works perfectly.  I've used 2 year old yeast without any diminishing of rising power.  SAF yeast produces light, fluffy bread and rolls, and it rises faster than some other brands.This 4-pack is a great deal at $13.63, especially compared to the single use packets or small jars at the grocery store.  Add in free SuperSaver shipping (on orders over $25) and it's a super deal.

column4: Desert Gypsy "A Brooklyn Girl Out West"
column10: I discovered this brand of yeast a few years back when troubleshooting issues with my first bread machine; I found that not only did it solve the problems of less than perfect results from the machine but it improved the results with my hand kneaded loaves as well. I bake in smaller quantities for a single person and only a few times a week so this size was more than I could use but still more economical than the smaller packages. I store it in the coldest part of my refrigerator in an airtight container. At the two year mark it was still "active" and producing good loaves, but I'd rather not discover the hard way when it is truly past its peak so I've purchased it again. Excellent results every time!Pleased with this product and highly recommended.

I just made some crescent roll using Saf Instant Yeast.  I'm not an expert breadmaker and these were wonderful.  I used a recipe from cooks.com and added little notes in the rolls.  I got that idea from a lady that had children write things they were thankful for on Thanksgiving.  Again, thank you for a great economical product.

I do a lot of baking and this yeast has never let me down. I store it in my freezer and keep about 1 cup in my fridge for frequent use. The quality does not seem to deteriorate over time, so long as you freeze it in an air-tight bag.Whenever I run out of yeast, this is what I order. No complaints about Saf Instant Yeast, I'd never use any other brand.
Works well making wheat bread. Price and volume fits the need for making 3-5 units per week. Store it up to nine months after opening in freezer.

I have been using SAF yeast for the last 4 years. I have gone through alot of it. One pouch will last me around 6 months. I make our bread, 8 loaves a week some weeks. Other weeks not so much. I do lots of baking for my family. I usually have one pouch in the freezer and I keep a Tupperware container in the fridge with yeast in it.For about a year to a year and a half, I did not bake anything. The yeast just sat in the fridge, as I had no back up. I used it anyways, worried that it was dead. Lo and behold, it was still good and my bread still raised just fine. No issues. I love the stuff.
use this instant yeast in my culinary class, it seems to be the only thing that works consistantly everytime. i bought 4lbs of it so i gtg now have alot of bread to make =P
Great product for a good price.  I make whole-wheat bread and this makes bread that is light even with lots of whole grains.
This is my favorite yeast and is very hard to find in the area where I live.  The price was wonderful, no shipping and fast delivery what more can you ask for?
This yeast is great. I store it frozen. I find it the best for my bread baking and pizza dough.Also, this is the best price I've found for this great yeast.

column9: Fine, inexpensive option but have freezer space
column10: This is a great inexpensive option, especially with Prime free shipping.  It's about a year's supply of yeast (or more) for this home baker so wrapped three of the packages in foil and put them in the freezer.  Frozen yeast will live for at least a year.  Saf is a widely used brand so I was confident buying this.
Great product, better than envelope yeast packages.  just add to flour mixture, do not need to proof.If you follow the above rule, your breads,buns,etc will turn out very good.

Looks to be a great bargain but I haven't used it yet, so hold your flames.Haven't read all 51 reviews and someone may have mentioned it; but if not, it would have been an honest move to have this consumable described on Amazon as being a Product of Mexico as the packages that I received state.  The package isn't emblazoned with a Made in Mexico tag so they're careful not to advertise the fact, and the single Amazon photo pictured doesn't show the country of origin.  Minus two stars for failure to disclose.For the record, I love Mexican food, have traveled to Mexico and have Mexican friends; I'm not anti-Mexico.  I'm pro disclosure.
it came on time,well packaged however you need to be very careful opening it as the back got damaged quick and I had to transfer it to a well caped dark bottle.

I've baked bread for years, and decided to try this yeast. My loaves had wrinkled tops. I tried slower rises, warmer rises, three rises, slower oven, faster oven, stiffer loaf, slacker dough, more salt, and after 15 tries, I gave up. I'm going back to red star from Costco which gives me a nice smooth dome every time.However, if you have a few pounds of yeast to get rid of, you can have a really bang up day of experiments with the kids. Get out every bowl in the house and vary conditions: warmth, sugar contend, tap vs. distilled water, boiling water (no growth at all!), a bit of WW flour or cornmeal or white, etc. Last fling of the day was rising a whole pound in a huge bowl in the sink and watching it overflow like lava. We charted it all, and suprise! rather warm water with more yeast and sugar did the most vigorous growth.

Not much luck here using in a bread machine; the off-the-shelf offerings at the local grocery are much better.  Note -- this is nothing like the similarly named and stellar SAF Gourmet Perfect Rise Yeast.  Sounds like the same company, but the difference in performance is night and day.
It has been no problem to use it but there are not any date of production or expire.Amazon sent me them again but still no date.I can not understand. I just gave up...

I was skeptical at first -- could we commit to three bags of a coffee we'd never tried? -- but the Organic Mocha Java won us over at first taste. Rich but not overpowering, dark but not bitter, it is among the very best coffee we've had the pleasure of drinking. I'll never crave Starbucks again.

This is very good coffee and is one of my favorites.  The Moca gives it a little different flavor but it goes well with the dark roast beans.  I have purchased this item several times and would recommend this product to others.

This is the only coffee I use. It's a very dark roast, strong and flavorful. Makes great iced coffee, too. Too bad Amazon doesn't offer it in larger bags.Don't confuse it with "mocha" types from chains like McD's and S***buck's, which are made with ersatz cocoa flavoring added to regular coffee.

worst excuse for Mocha Java we have EVER experienced in the past 35 years !  Mary and I couldn't have been more disapointed. We aren't coffee snobs...we just love Mocha Java... and this isn't it for us.

column9: Great coffee, but no Mocha flavor

I would recommend this coffee, just don't buy it if you are expecting a mocha taste.

For years I'd been looking for a chocolately, spicy tea drink that I'd had at an East Indian friend's home. This drink reminds me so much of that tea. Just love it in the evenings after dinner. Highly recommend that you try it if you love chocolate!
I've been drinking this brand of chocolate chai for six years.  I've tried other brands but none matches this one.

Started drinking this at local donut shop! I am hooked. Now have it at home. Fyi it is not only good hot and cold but local donut shop has started doing blended( like a slushy) even better. I buy 1 iced for now and 1 blended for later.

I am a big fan of the Big Train Vanilla Chai and Spice Chai mixes that I used to get from Costco, which they no longer have.. BOO!!!!I can always count on Amazon.com to have their products on the Subscribe and Save Program.  I was checking out some of the different chai products and came across Big Train's CHOCOLATE CHAI! And what the...?  How have I never heard of this?  The other reviewers seemed to like it and figure what the heck, might as well try it.  Love chocolate (entirely too much) and love chai (heck yes!), could be a match made in tea heaven... and guess what?  Yes it is! Holy Hiccups Batman! This stuff is good! I tried it hot with just boiling water and yum! It tastes like a spiced hot cocoa.  Since I live in the desert, had to have it iced and wow!  Yum!  I follow the directions and add enough hot water to mix up the powder and then 1 ice cube (I really don't care for a lot of ice), just enough to bring the temperature down and then add the remainder with Soy milk and wow!  This is a win.  I keep one bag in my desk at work (share it with another coworker) and the two at home.  I am in loooooooooooovvvvvvvvvvvvvvveeeeeeeeeeeeee.  Next, I need to try the Green Tea Chai Latte mix!

column9: Chocolatey, a tad lacking in Chai
column10: Big Train Chocolate Chai Mix, 12-Ounce Bags (Pack of 3)Deliciously chocolately, but somewhat lacking in the spiced flavors of traditional chai. It's quite good, but loses a star for its lack of spiced flavors. If you want a hot chocolate drink with a hint of spice, this should definitely be under consideration.
I love this mix, if you love tea and chocolate you will love this. I got this once at Gloria Jeans and it was double the price so buying it from Amazon is a great deal.

I really enjoy this drink made with warmed milk in the cold months or blended with milk and ice cubes when the weather is hot.  It has a more mild flavor than the original spiced chai.  It saves me money when I can buy the bags of mix from Amazon instead of paying $4.00 a cup at the local espresso shop.

I liked the idea of something that was in between hot chocolate and chai, but in the end it turns out that I would much rather have hot chocolate OR chai. That being said, there's nothing *wrong* with it, per se. It's reasonably tasty, dissolves well, has a nice mouthfeel for a "just add water" mix, and a good level of sweetness (if you're looking for a hot-chocolate-like "treat"). I'd try Big Train's other offerings, but before getting this one, you might want to ask yourself if you'd do better to just have some hot chocolate and chai mixes on hand so that you can drink what you're actually wanting rather than some halfway concoction.

tasted great.  Anyone's idea of a guilty pleasure.  However, ingredient statement a shocker.  Very little in the mix was healthy.  It was not something I would want to indulge in on a regular basis.  Once in a while OK.

This chocolate chai packs a great am punch - gets my energy level up in the morning.  I am a coffee drinker, not tea, but I really love this stuff.  Great taste, just wish it was packed in a bigger container!

I first tried this drink at a coffee shop out of town but then couldn't find it anywhere else. I love it and make it iced. I usually use 1 1/2 cup of milk and 4 tbsp of the mix and blend it and pour over ice. It's much better without the water mixed it.

I was truly disappointed.  If you are looking for Hot Chocolate than order this. There is nothing Chai about this product. Now I find out that this product is not eligible for return.  So I am stuck with 3 bags of hot chocolate.  This makes it hard for me to order other new items from Amazon don't want to waste anymore of my money.

I simply won't buy it again and that is why I give it 3 stars not 4. This was my first time drinking chocolate chai and if this is what it's supposed to taste like I'll stick to either just hot chocolate or just chai tea. I have brands of both I love!
big train choc chai is the best chai tea we've had,can't buy it locally but this is a great deal
A very good combination of chocolate and chai. Great for a desert drink or an iced drink on a hot day. Love this stuff!
This is really good stuff and so relaxing. I'm out of it again so I'mgoing to place my 3rd order for it. Love It !

In my younger days, I tried a dozen times to make authentic Cevapcici (pronounced: Che-VAP-chi-chi) and never succeeded until I learned that the 'best' recipes used this vegetable stock powder, 'Vegeta', as well as a fair bit of WHITE pepper, as important flavouring ingredients. I had 'Vegeta' in my pantry, but didn't have the good sense to add it to my failed attempts. [The name 'Cevapcici' is southern Slavic and is related to the word "kebab" which means, in simplest terms, a dish made from meat--but to most of the people who prepare and eat this dish, especially nowadays, it also implies generally that the meat is grilled.] Cevapcici are small, skinless sausages, usually made from a mixture of different minced meats. Mine are 75% pork and 25% beef, but there are 40-50 popular recipes out there, to cater to local customs and dietary observances.'Vegeta' is a multi-purpose seasoning made from dehydrated vegetables with a bit of sugar, salt, riboflavin, herbs and spices, plus MSG. It makes an excellent vegetable stock, which may be enriched with whatever meat, poultry or seafood that you might want to use for soups, sauces or gravy. It's also a very good addition to any stews, soups, pot roasts, meat pies and casseroles.The manufacturers suggest adding it to 'liquid' dishes about 5 minutes before the end of cooking. However, it may be added directly to meat dishes such as meatballs, stuffed cabbage, rissoles, hamburgers, stuffed peppers and so on. It works really well in almost every European, American or Asian cuisine, particularly in dishes where marinating or mixing meats, the day before cooking, is involved. 'Vegeta' could be just the 'magic touch' that everyone who makes their own sausages has been looking for. 'Vegeta' is not that well-known among my acquaintances, even the ones who do a lot of cooking. However it is, along with 'cajun seasoning', among my "special, secret ingredients"--or at least it WAS, until I wrote this review...Caveats: Recipes that demand 'Vegeta' usually don't specify any extra salt, as the 'Vegeta' is (usually) salty enough. The ingredients are all vegetarian and vegan friendly (as far as I can tell) but the manufacturers do not make a point of mentioning this on the package or accompanying recipes/literature. [Riboflavin? There are many sources...just so you know!]Happy cooking!

Should not be labeled "Key Lime Juice" because it doesn't have Key Limes in it.  The actual labeling on the product is correct:  "Key West Lime Juice", meaning lime juice from Key West.  But if you are looking for juice that comes from Key Limes, this is not it.  Change the description!

The name of the fruit, key lime, simply designates a specific type of lime. There are 2 types of limes commonly available in the US. Persian limes, which are the "standard" larger types of limes that you find in most grocery stores and key limes, which are much smaller, generally very round, and often have a lighter skin color. Because of the smaller size, key limes require a larger number of to yield much juice. While they are often recognized as being grown in florida, key limes are also grown in texas as well as california. You can certainly juice your own key limes in order to make a fantastic key lime pie, but having the pre made product available here definitely save time and effort. I make 20-30 key lime pies every year. I have tried using both fresh limes and this bottled lime juice. There is ultimately no significant difference between the 2.

We lived in Miami in the 80's and this was on the store shelves there but I could never get it when I traveled somewhere else. Now it is!Do not use plain old lime juice when a recipe calls for Key Lime, it is not the same. Nellie & Joe's is the best.Here's the best recipe ever for Key Lime Pie:2 egg yolks, beaten1 (14 ounce) can sweetened condensed milk1/2 cup key lime juicePour into a graham cracker crustThe recipe doesn't even call for baking it. The lime juice thickens the milk and eggs. But I do bake it for about 10-15 minutes at 350º just to be sure.Comment
