The chicken flavor is noticeable when you take them out of the package. I would recommend these bones for medium to large breed dog.

First of all this thing is a lot smaller than "giant" as the title suggests. Second, it is not durable. Within minutes of giving it to my dog, he chewed pieces off it. I was afraid that he was going to swallow the nylon pieces and took it away immediately. It might be a good little toy for a small dog, but definitely not for a big dog. The title is very deceiving, just like the "large everlasting chicken treat".
My little 60 pound Chessapeake had it torn the 4th time we let her play with it. Not very sturdy.

column9: Not for a really agressive chewer
column10: My dog loves to chew!  I figured a product created specifically for dogs that love to chew would be perfect.  Rocky actually ATE this bone.  And then proceeded to throw up pieces of nylabone the next morning.  Horrible!  If your dog is an agressive chewer do NOT purchase this product.

If I ever get what I've ordered I know my dog will love it.  Unfortunately that's not happened yet.This is billed as a 'liver' flavor nylabone but twice now I've received the original flavor. Think twice about ordering from this company that cannot be bothered to pay enough attention to detail to give you what you've paid for.They also will not refund your money but only replace the item.  I will continue to send it back until they actually send me the item I paid for.  I wonder how long that will take.

I was surprised by the fast delivery! It was estimated that it would take about a week but it came within three days.I'm pretty satisfied with the product for now but that's because I just received it. The only problem I find is that my dog thinks its a real bone so he's trying to find a place to hide it. He doesn't get that it's a toy and he should be chewing and playing with it.He has tried chewing it a bit and has only made some dents into it. Oh, by the way, my dog is an American Staff. so he has some powerful teeth. I'm hoping this will last for awhile.UPDATE:It has been about a month since I received this item and my dog has barely touched it. Whenever I show it to him he just ignores it or takes it and hides it somewhere (like under his bed). I'm not sure why since he loves bones but maybe he thinks it's not a toy and he should not chew on it? Or he might just not like it. I'm still surprised that he has barely touched it because he loves to chew!
The only problem I have with this bone is it's too durable.  The pup like to break it down.  The puppy bone was too easiely broken down, would mix the purchase.

column9: tough but not for my dog
column10: it's good for normal dogs like a sheperd or rottie but my 5 month old red nose pit bull killed it in 6 days all that was left was about 3 inches and he  poopped plastic for a week
My dogs love these Nylabones and the price is better than at a pet shop.

My dog, a Labrador had this bones ends chewed and roughed up in no time.  Its ends were rough and cut her gums and when I tried playing with it she pulled and rough ends cut my hand open. Had infection for 4 days.

The Nylabone durable chew is great for power chewers like my dog, she can really go at it in safety with this product. The only problem is that I did not realize that I had to buy 25.00 in pet products to get free shipping (I ordered dvds and cds) so I ended up paying double for the bone and could have purchased it at a regular store for less.  It would be nice if there could be some sort of warning or hint that this rule exsists, I would have purchased more.  Live and learn.

We've had several nylabones for our dogs.  They loved chewing on them and the bones seemed to hold up very well--until a piece broke off and lodged in the small intestine of my dachsund.  Since it's plastic, it doesn't show up in x-rays and the blockage wasn't identified until it was too late.  Always supervise your pet when they are chewing anything that can be chewed up!

column9: The only toy that won't be immediately destroyed
column10: I never liked nylabones before I got them for my dogs. They always seemed dirty, hair sticks to the ends after they've been chewed and dogs will make their gums bleed chewing them. But my dogs make quick work of any chewy (they finish even very large edible chewies in less than one minute), so we got the durable nylabones and the dogs love to chew them. They are not indestructable but they last for months even with daily use. The dogs do make their gums bleed chewing them at first but I was surprised to see how clean their teeth are now. A good thing to have for a serious chewer.

This bone is the tops and best of all not expensive.  I have bought many different toys for my dog and he destroys them all within a few days.  This bone is great because it has actually lasted over two weeks and is still going strong.  The ends are getting chewed up but at a very slow pace.  My guess is this will easily last a month or two, if not longer.  My dog also absolutely loves chewing on this.  If he is inside sitting around this bone is in his mouth being chewed.  That is why I am so surprised it has lasted this long.  Usually if my dog chews something for a whole day it would be in a million pieces.  The only other toy that has been able to last this long is a king size kong, but my dog won't even look at it twice unless it is packed with treats.

These are my dog's "inside bones".  They last and last and last without turning into little chunks all over the rug.  The dog is an 85 pound "working dog" - which means high energy and really annoying when bored.  He's had some of these nylabones for over two years.  I only have to replace them when he sneaks one outside and buries it.Yes, letting the dog out has its own ritual.  "Inside bone!" -clunk- as bone drops to the floor, hopefully missing my foot.In comparison, the "outside" bones tend to be the leg bones of ungulates.  Those things are solid, but he eats them anyway.  I think.  He does seem to enjoy burying them, digging them up, burying them elsewhere, and trying to smuggle those filthy things into the house.  "Outside bone!" -clunk-  He also likes to carry and chew up firewood.  Nothing lasts like a nylabone.  Nothing is less messy inside the house than a nylabone.I buy the "giant" size because it gives me a better grip for those tugs-of-war.Very weird that the dog knew there were nylabones in the amazon box and that they were his.
Great dog bones. My dogs love them. My dogs are "power chewers" and these last longer than anything that I have found.

column9: Received wrong product, but more importantly: Not safe for dogs!
column10: My dogs love nylabones, and we've been buying them for years. I recently decided to stock up and ordered 4 nylabones! They arrived quickly, but one of the packages was partially open. They also had a new textured look that I wasn't sure my dogs would like. The picture indicated that the product I would be receiving would be the same untextured nylabones that my dogs love.However, those aren't the only reasons I'll be returning them. We just took one of our dogs to the vet this week, and had to spend almost $1,000 getting two cracked teeth removed! Our vet said that nylabones are too hard for dogs' teeth, and recommended that we use raw bones from the butcher instead. Nylabones are the only chew toys my dogs have used, so there is nothing else that could have cracked my dog's teeth. Please be cautious, and talk to your vet about whether nylabones are a safe choice for your dog.

column9: Thought it was supposed to be textured?
column10: I ordered this thinking it was textured like the picture here shows. Well, it wasn't, and I found that kind of disappointing because I have a teething American Pitbull Terrier Pup who would have probaby liked the textured part. So, what I basically got was a normal Nylabone. Oh well. This is still great for the Dogs and their chewing needs.

I got this for my Jack Russell/Labrador mix and it has worked exactly as described. I tried many other toys and most only lasted a couple of days before she had the stuffing pulled out or I was finding little pieces of rubber in my carpet, even those designated as teething/chewing type toys. This is well worth the money. I bought two over 3 months ago and she is still on the first one where as before I was buying practically a toy a week.

My dog loves to chew plastic things...eyes on teddy bears and plastic lids.  Before she was a strong chewer I had given her other Nylabone products and she really liked them so I thought I'd try the durable bone.  It has a flavor to it so she will chew on it for long periods of time.  She also hasn't chewed plastic things because whenever she goes for them I throw her a durable bone and she chews that instead.  I think she likes the flavor.If your dog isn't an avid chewer Nylabone makes flexible and other flavored bones that come apart easier.  My dog is a year old and she just started chewing a lot.  She has enjoyed the puppy bones and flexible bones.  Now she has graduated to durable.Nylabone is a great product and I plan on using it for a long time.

I have an American Staffordshire Terrier(aka pitbull) and she is just over one years old and not many toys are tough enough for her. This toy will slowly get chewed away but after having it a month or so there so is little damage to it that it will last a long time. I learned after having my pup that it is definitely worth the money to buy a tougher toy because in the end you save instead of replacing toy or bone after bone. My dog does not chew on this bone constantly but she gets a craving for it and it will keep her busy for a while. She tends to like things she can destruct, I think they are more fun for her but she does enjoy chewing this bone. I ended up going on nylabones website and signed up for emails and received a nice coupon in my email and I went and bought my pup another different one to go with this one. I know she will be all set for a while!

The bone is fine in terms of quality, but I wasn't aware how big a bone this was! Buy this product for a big adult dog, way too large for a corgi's mouth! Apart from it being big, my dog just isn't interested in it.

column9: AN ALMOST PERFECT PRODUCT.  OUR DOGS LOVE THESE THINGS
column10: I say "almost perfect," but to be honest, I cannot find a down side to these chew toys.It has always been a problem keeping our dogs in chew toys.  They either completely reject them (which happens quite often) or they immediately destroy them in a destructive frenzy.  They are all rather picky dogs; spoiled dogs, and we more or less cater to them.These Nylabone bones were absolutely made for our crew.  All the dogs love them and they last and last and last.  With four dogs using them, they actually last well over two months.  As the bones are slowly destroyed, we do not have a problem with "toy fragments" all over the house.Now it in the nature of dogs, when there is more than one, to want what the other one has, even if they have an identical one of their own.  We simply dish them out four at a time and let them work their own pecking order out amongst them selves.  Hey, it works for us.  We always keep a couple of extra ones around as one of our dogs is a hider and hoarder and finds the most interesting places to stash these things.  Sometimes they disappear for days at a time...I think that pup has found a black hole somewhere in the house.Anyway, this is a good product.  This is a good price here.  My dogs recommend them highly.Don BlankenshipThe Ozarks

I just spent $1,400 on dental work for my two dogs, both of whom broke multiple teeth on these bones.  The Bones do prevent tartar build-up but at an unacceptable cost.  I believe this product should carry safety warnings because the vet told us that this is a common problem with the hard bones.
Nylabones are the one "toy" that my Dazey cannot chew to little bits and pieces.  She loves to chew, and these last much longer than anything else I have ever bought.

column9: Nylabones are great - don't discontinue them!
column10: We have been giving our powerful-chewing golden retriever the large original flavor Nylabone for over 10 years, and as all reviewers have noted, this is the only good chew toy for powerful chewers.  One bone lasts about 3 weeks, maybe longer as our guy has gotten older.  However, my biggest peeve is that we have increasingly had to hunt far and wide to find the original flavor large version, and now it is virtually impossible to find on the shelf anywhere.  Thank goodness for Amazon!  Please tell the manufacturer not to discontinue this version - it is irreplaceable.  Our dog didn't like any of the flavored versions, and the new "flex" version is not for powerful chewers like him.  This is the only one that works - don't take it away!!!

column9: Satisfies a dog's urge to chew (and saves furniture and shoes)
column10: I have been buying Nylabones for years for our Doberman and Labradors. When a dog needs to chew, they'll find SOMETHING and I'd rather it be a Nylabone than a table leg or pair of shoes. With three dogs, we always have three available (plus three in the car for trips). I even take one when hiking in the hills with my Doberman (our Labs are now too old to hike). I especially like the Dura Chew model because it lasts. When the small end gets chewed to a point (which is a weapon in a dog's mouth), if the Nylabone is still big enough, I hacksaw and file the end and keep using it until it's too small to be safe (i.e. danger of being swallowed). If your dog's not used to chewing, train them with either a) smearing peanut butter on the bone as an inducement, b) play "keep away" and praise when the dog takes it or c) play tug of war, let the dog win with praise. I've done all three, what works depends on your dog.

The Nylabones are wonderful... I have two incredibly strong chewing Labs and these bones will last at least 4 months of heavy chewing. The bones arrived on time, as promised! The price was far lower than big box pet stores and far cheaper than the online pet businesses I usually frequent.

column9: If you have a Lab - this is the treat
column10: My labradore can chew through any toy.  Nylabone is the only product I have found that he can play with for a very long time.

We just got a new dog.  She's just about a year old and could be classified as an agressive chewer.  She loves these bones and they stand up to her chewing.  She loves it and I love that she is spending her chew time on the Nylabone rather than my furniture.

I would not recommend this product for anyone who cares about  their pet. Apparently the manufacturer of this product does not take measures to insure their product is safe. I ordered the correct size of bone for my Labrador Retriever according to the manufacturers size chart. Brand new out of the package no more than 10 minutes, while my dog was chewing on the bone, a large piece about the size of a marble broke off and my dog swallowed it. I examined the bone and discovered there were numerous air bubbles in the casting making the bone weak and susceptible to breaking. I can only hope that the consumed part of this product will pass without any complications. I will not buy this product again and will be going to normal beef bones in the future.

column9: An All Time Classic Favorite - Great For Agressive Chewers
column10: Nylabone has been producing some of the finest dog toys on the planet for over 50 years.Made in America, these a great alternative to real bone which can splinter and crack. We have two old English Bulldogs both of which can give the "Jaws of Life" a run for the money. This particular toy is a staple in our house, it's been all time favorite for years and dogs just adore this Dura Chew Bone.Each one lasts a good two months - we discard them when they're about 3/4 chomped. The chewed edges do catch on carpet and upholstery and can be difficult to clean. Amazon most always has the best prices - and Prime membership gets you free two day shipping so it's really a steal.This particular toy has been around for decades - it's time proven, safe and again, made right here in the US.Nylabones not only appease your dogs natural instinct to chew - the material does an exceptional job of keeping their in absolute pristine condition.Nylabone does have a line of toys designed for oral health and they're excellent - that said this bone works equally well - our dogs never tire of them.And that's saying quite a lot as their average attention span with most toys is about 15 minutes. Just a wonderfully made, time proven dog toy. The perfect choice for hard core chewers

My Greater Swiss Mountain dog cracked two molars on nylabones. Both had to be surgically removed at a cost of about $1,000. I did not realize that the nylabone was the culprit with the first tooth, but witnessed and heard the crack the second time. I purposely always looked for a "safe" chew toy for my dog, and now my dog has 2 missing molars because of nylabone. Do not buy!

column9: A mainstay in my house for my buddy Odin
column10: My dog can chew!  I'm surprised at the work he can do on this thing.  First of all it's HARD, almost impossibly so.  The one issue I have is that it becomes a landmine for your feet in the dark.  My dog likes to leave them around after he's done chewing and sweet lord it hurts when you step on them.  I now shuffle around in the dark to avoid the pain.  He enjoys chewing on them and I make sure to throw them away when they get too short.  Buy 2 or 3 and change them up so the dog does not get bored with one.

column9: Great product, dogs love them, BUT...
column10: Like I said in the title, it's a great, durable product, but be aware that "Wolf" size, as it states on the package (which I didn't see until after I received the item) is for dogs up to 35 pounds.Not a fault of the seller, more on the manufacturer, but I bought this for my 65# pit bull mix, and ended up letting my pugs have it (It's a little big for them, but they still enjoy the heck out of it!).So if you have a *real* wolf-sized dog, you're best going with a larger sized chew toy.

column9: Dogs loved it... but made them sick! What's the point???
column10: When it says don't leave dogs unattended with this bone they mean it. It also says don't allow them to ingest pieces larger then rice or something like that... they mean that too. My 18 month old Pit was loving this bone and I tried to take every piece that she chewed off away from her as it came off. A few pieces must have got past me and in her tummy and on the floor, because she started having violent vomiting a day latter, then our 8 year old pit started doing the same. We were for sure that we had got some Chinese chicken strips or something then we started going through the vomit (sick what we do for our kids) and found Nylabone chunks in both dogs vomit. Haven't had a issue since. My husband has banned any product from this company from entering our house again.Buyer beware and watch your dogs.

column9: Healthy for your Dog and They Last
column10: I've been buying Nylon bones for my dogs for over 3 decades -- they are safe.  If they swallow the pieces of nylon it passes through their system - it only comes off in tiny pieces.  I've had several large breeds of gnawers - and Nylabones are the only thing on the market I've found they cannot destroy;  Good for cleaning their teeth because they have to work hard and grind.

My Labrador lives inside the house, sleeps on the couch, and is treated like a queen..and then I discovered she had tartar build up on her back teeth!  I freaked!  I have heard how it leads to dental problems that can lead to extremely bad health problems.  I started up again brushing her teeth with an enzymatic toothpaste (she did not like this when she was younger)coupled with this bone and I have to say, this bone did it.  She enjoyed chewing on it, running around the yard with it and the dark brown deposits on her back teeth are almost gone.  I was just trying to prevent it from getting worse, didn't realize they could disappear. This bone is amazing.  How amazing?  She had it outside, over the weekend and now we can't find it (we wondering if something wild walked off with it due to the flavor)so I just ordered another one!  The grooves in it get in there like little toothpicks.  This may be man's best friend!
I bought this for my 45lb heavy chewer and she loves it. It seems to be holding up well. We have tried many brands and types of toys, but Nylabone and extreme Kong are all that last with her.

column9: Dogs may prefer over classic nylabone products.
column10: I don't know if the slight color difference indicates a different taste or texture from the Original Nylabones, or if it's  just the different shape, bumps and ridges, but I think my dogs may prefer the "Dura Chew" over the original. Sometimes I smear peanut butter into the crevices, especially for less enthusiastic chewers.I don't know if Dura Chew offers flavor choices like the Original does, but in the Original, bacon seems to be the most desirable flavor.

Although I've been buying Nylabones for my dogs for many years, I only recently realized that Amazon carried them for a better price than Petco or PetSmart so I now order all our Nylabones strictly from here. Nylabones help curb destructive chewing, ease boredom, and clean teeth.Like ANY toy, Nylabones carry a risk if not used properly. There is no such thing a completely, 100% safe toy.With that said, I've never had a problem with Nylabones, nor do I know anyone who has. It's ALL about being responsible and knowing your dog. (When it all comes down to it, they can be quite child like. They need YOU to use YOUR head.)Make sure you're buying the appropriate size for your dog. (Don't buy one that's too small, simply because it's cheaper.) If you're using a bone that's too small it will greatly increase the chance of your dog biting off pieces that can be harmful.If your dog is an aggressive chewer, then don't leave them alone for extended periods with any toy. Nylabones included.Be safe and smart!! Your dogs depend on you!

The nylabone souper lets the dogs chew all they want without health side effects like rawhide or natural bone products can have.  It's a low enough value toy (to the dogs) that there isn't any possessiveness like I have seen with real meaty bones.

column9: The perfect bone for a Chewer
column10: Our dogs absolutely love this bone and it is the only one that last for our Lab.

We love this bone!  We have a one year old spaniel and he loves to chew stuff.  We've always had plenty of bones/toys etc for him to chew and he's never chewed shoes or any other item he wasn't supposed to.  These bones last forever and he really enjoys them.  We've tried the circle, y-shape and this one, all are good.

Nylabone products are the only thing I've found that can stand up to my two VERY strong chewing dogs.  Even the large rawhide bones were gone in minutes.  And I'm not talking 30 minutes, I'm talking 5-10.  They like chewing on the Nylabone bones and they last for 2-4 weeks.

column9: Classic chew toy at great price
column10: This is the same type Nylabone you'll find at the store but at a better price. Good for doggie teeth while chewing too. My Rottweiler and German Shepherd Dog usually need a new one every month or two since it does wear down (like any chew toy) but I like that it cleans teeth as it does and I've never seen either dog break off a piece anywhere near big enough to choke on, unlike a lot of rubber toys. Also doesn't create the display that rope toys do when it's time to clean up after your dog outside. One of about 2 or 3 toys I try to keep around at all times for the boys to work on so they leave our shoes and such alone :)

column9: Very durable even for hard chewers.
column10: I have a 90 pound lab mix and he loves to chew.  I've had him since he was five months old and he has chewed furniture, rugs, chairs, shoes, etc. in addition to the toys we've gotten him.  None of the toys we've gotten him, including multiple Kongs, ropes, PetSmart branded tennis balls, and some supposedly indestructible toy made from an old fire hose, lasted for more than 20 minutes.  He would start breaking chunks off of Kongs or any rubber toy in about 10-15 minutes.  The first Nylabone I gave him, he began chewing immediately and enthusiastically and it lasted for hours the first night, hours the second night, and after three days, there's still plenty for my dog to chew on and play with.  This product is much more durable than I had even hoped for and should be a good match for all but the very strongest and aggressive chewers.

column9: Not a good replacement for rawhide bones.
column10: I have a 60 pound black lab that is a big chewer and thought that these might be a good replacement for the rawhide bones she loves so much. She doesn't like these at all. She has barely touched it in the four weeks she has had it. I'm giving this 3 stars because it is made well and maybe some dogs do like them, just not mine. So I'm still looking for something she can enjoy but not devour in 1 or 2 hours. Also tried one of the edible Nylabones, this she liked but it was gone in less than 10 minutes.

column9: Stands up to an agressive chewer
column10: My pouch chews and destroys everything she posses. Nothing lasts but nylabones. Thank goodness my pouch likes them otherwise I'd be sunk and so would my possessions!

column9: Best chew for hard core chewers.
column10: I've had Dobermans for the last 30 years. They love a good chew. Have bought these from day 1 and will do so as long as I own a dog. Even dogs that aren't chewers (like Yorkies) love these things. So important for any dog's dental health.Nylabone also has incredible customer service and back up every thing they sell 100%. The only product I ever had a problem with was their dura chew ball, which split in half in 5 min., and they no longer sell. I emailed Nylabone's customer service.  They send me a brand new GIANT dura chew bone as a replacement.  Thank you Christa ! Wonderful job !!!

We have a Pitt Bull and an Alaskan Malamute....both power chewers and destroy every brand of chew toy that has been "designed for power chewers."  The nylabones, although get worn down pretty quick from their powerful jaws, are the only thing we have found that actually lasts a while.  The online price is great too!
I have two vigorous chewers. I've tried so many chews and toys but hardly anything lasts. Nylabones do though. They prefer edible chews, but these last longer and won't make them fat!

We have a female bull terrier mix, about 45 pounds, and she really likes the Nylabone chew toys.  She gets going on them, and just keeps grinding away with her back teeth.  After one month, this toy is hardly different from when new- I expect this to be around for 6 months or more!  It is almost too long for her as she tries to prop it vertically with her front paws to chew on the top.  That also shows you how much she enjoys it, cause it doesn't slow her down!  Good product, will buy more.
This is perfect for my chewy poodle! She'll obsess over it, but only when it's "bone time." And it keeps her away from chewing on, well, everything else.

The Durachew Souper size is perfect for my pit mix. He enjoys both the original and bacon flavors. He chews them several times every day for about 15-20 minutes at a time. And after about 4 months, they are only beginning to get worn down. They do make shavings that get stuck to carpets and things, and fuzz/hair/etc gets stuck on them like velcro, but these and Kongs are the only things that don't get destroyed immediately. My dog (who likes to rip his toys apart and eat the pieces) hasn't tried to break and eat any pieces off these. He just chews until his jaws get tired. After he's done with his current bones, I might try the Big Chews for Big Dogs size of Nylabone.Nylabones are worth every penny.

column9: A very durable bone for dogs. Love these!
column10: I grew up with four large dogs and my parents gave them nyla bones all the time. They'd sit on the living room floor and chew for hours. I now have two dogs (a GSD and an ACD/red heeler) and this is their go-to toy for when they want to chew. As with any toy,  you should always supervise your dogs, but I've never had a problem with any pieces tearing off or breaking. We typically throw them away when they start getting smaller and ratty, just in case-but that takes a long, long time to get to that point. I've seen one single nyla bone last for more than a year. I love these things.
My 80lbs Lab mix loved this Bone! Perfect size for him to chew on. Definitely would recommend this to others!

column9: I ordered this for a dog rescue.
column10: When I saw a dog rescue asking for help needing some things for there dogs I along w others got together & bought them & sent dir to the rescue it's what they asked for & I'm sure the dogs enjoyed them.

I love the nylabones because they are safe and last a long time even with my strong chewing yellow Lab (age 2).  I have tried different variations of shapes and flavors within the Nylabone family, and the Souper Size Dura Chew Bone in Original Flavor seems to be her favorite.  I order 2 at a time so I always have a backup when it finally needs to be replaced.

I love the souper size nylabones! they are sturdy and last with my heavy chewers. Granted, they can chew them down to nothing, BUT, it takes a few months! I have 4 dogs and I buy 4 souper nylabones every 4 months or so. They also get regular raw beef bones, but they actually prefer the nylabones once all the meat/marrow is off the regular bones.

column9: No more teeth cleanings from the vet
column10: This is the only chew toy that I buy for my three dogs ranging from 10 to 50 lbs.After paying for multiple teeth cleanings we tried different chew toys to reduce tarter buildup.  After giving our dogs these bones, we received good checkups at the vet and haven't needed a teeth cleaning in over 2 years.

Our dog usually doesn't chew on the really hard bones and she goes through rawhides so fast. This bone has lasted a couple months (with daily use) and it's still in really good condition. She loves it.

My 18-month old Lab loves this Nylabone. It's the perfect size for him. It has lasted a few months and he normally spends time chewing it each night. He is a strong chewer, but not the strongest I've seen. I recently ordered another since he gnawed his first one to about half the original size. I wouldn't allow him to chew this much past the half way point as it could become a choking hazard. I gave this 4 stars since it is not really a healthy material to ingest. Small pieces are not supposed to hurt the dogs, but there is no nutritional value.A natural alternative to this would be Deer Antlers. They are more expensive, but will last quite a while. Our dog loves those as well, but the Nylabones provide a nice variety so he doesn't get too bored with any one chew.
Product arrived as promised. The quality is the same as at the box stores. Would recommend and will probably buy again.

My 90 lb bloodhound loves to chew on everything. Most toys only last a day or two in our house because he tears them to pieces. This bone lets him chew as much as he wants without destroying anything!
My dog is a powerful chewer, and this is the only toy that has lasted longer than a few days! It still doesn't even have a dent on it, and he chews on it frequently everyday. Definitely recommend!!

My 78 pound baby loves these bones.  It's about the only thing she cannot eat in one sitting and lasts her for several months.  The vet prefers she have something softer, because she's cracked some of her teeth on it... but the softer Nylabones she eats right through. This Dura Chew Bone is part of her morning routine.  She has always had the smooth bone and that is what I thought I was ordering. When it came it was the textured bone...she didn't care.  She's been carring it around with her for a week now, proud of her new bone. Dog Approved!
My dogs love these bones!  The order arrived quickly and was exactly what they wanted.  I will definitely be ordering more.

Great product overall.  Our very strong-mouthed dog, destroys every toy we've bought for him...with the exception of 3: Galileo (by Nylabone), Nylabone Durachew, and Kong products.  Very happy to keep purchasing Nylabone.  Slightly dissatisfied with the new shape.  Beware, even if picture doesn't look like the "new style" online, it will ship as such.  it's textured for more interactive chewing, but our dog doesn't care about anything but the two ends.
Nylabone Chews are awesome! My dog goes crazy over them. They are much better than rawhide and they last way longer too.

column9: Best dog bone I have encountered
column10: These bones are great, I don't have to worry about my lab destroying them in 5 minutes like every other toy besides her kong and nylabone. They start to get a little gross after a few days, but the dogs don't seem to mind. I highly recommend this product.
I have a 40 pound GSP mix who loves to destroy stuff. These bones last him a couple months, where most other toys last hours before he has them torn up. Great product does not break off in chunks.

My black lab puppy loved this. It was her favorite toy and she chewed on it all the time. It keeps dogs busy so they are not trying to chew up your house! It lasted a long time, although she did get it chewed down to a tip (she is a very strong chewer). I do not think she ate any of it and it did not hurt her. But, as with any toy, you should supervise your dog while it is chewing on the toy.

I have a five month old Puggle. I decided to buy this for her because she's a very aggressive chewer. It seemed durable and long lasting. Nope. Not so much. I gave it to her and she had half of it chewed with in 20 minutes. I do not recommend this chew bone for dogs who are very aggressive chewers. It breaks down too quickly. :(

I ordered this for my lab mix that loves to  chew. She is a strong/heavy chewer and usually goes through toys in a matter of hours. This has lasted several months and will probably last many many more.

column9: Great Product, Love the Price Compared to Local Pet Stores
column10: I have two dogs of the same mixed breed, but they are complete opposites. One dog barely chews on anything (even chew toys/bones/rawhide) and the other one is a chewing monster. The one that I dub "chew monster" has been able to chew everything I've thrown at him even since he was a puppy. I've gone through numerous personal items because of his destructive habit and under recommendation by my vet, she mentioned trying some Nylabones.I started out with the puppy Nylabones and then upgraded him to the regular ones, but he went through those too fast (within hours down to spiny nubs). Despite being a 9.6 pound dog, I eventually had to upgrade him to the "Dura Chew" model which is aimed at powerful chewers. Nylabone states that these are the strongest ones they make. With the Dura Chew, I'm able to slow down the speed in which he goes through these to a week or so.Although my dog will still occasionally chew through my personal items I leave on the floor, I can say the Nylabones "Dura Chew" has helped curb his urge to chew on other things and he mostly chews on the Nylabones. They are a lifesaver!Locally (at PetSmart, PetCo, and Pet Supermarket), Nylabones are usually $2.50 each + tax. For some odd reason on Amazon, these are $1.78 each. So by buying on Amazon, I'm saving at least 75 cents each per bone that I know my dog loves.So it's a no brainer that if your dog likes Nylabones and needs the Dura Chew model, you should look compare prices at Amazon first.
The price on these is outstanding. I have a small dog that goes thru one of these every 2 weeks and the price on these was great

This works fantastic for my husky to chew on!  It's a great alternative to raw hide and doesn't show as much wear as quickly as a raw hide does.  He isn't able to break it apart and just gnaws it down slowly over time.  Whenever he is walking around looking for something to chew on we give him this or his nylabone dinosaur (another great chew, but didn't last as long as this one).  I'd say we finally threw this out after about 2-3 months of chewing.  (We decided to throw it out when it was short enough that it looked like he could probably swallow it.)

column9: This Nylabone is a great toy for hard chewing dogs
column10: I have a shih-poo dog and she is a very aggressive chewer. She goes through toys in a matter of minutes. The nylabone chew toy lasts a very long time and she loves to chew them in all flavors. Great bone for the money and it lasts and lasts

My 26 pound puggle loves these, he is an agressive chewer and he prefers these over anything else. The only issue I have is he wears them out in around a week. It is still better than him chewing something else (furniture etc) though!

column9: My dogs love these, and Amazon's price was great
column10: My dogs have chewed on a variety of Nylabone products for years.  We have the durable bones, dinosaurs, and wishbones.  I saw this Giant size Nylabone in a local discount store for $7.99, and Amazon had it for much less so I bought two.  They arrived in just a couple of days, well ahead of the estimated delivery date.  This size is a little large for my 20-something pound dogs, but history tells me it will last a long time.

This bone lasts. Our dog has had it over a month, and it's holding up well.Other bones didn't hol up, but our dog loves to chew this bone, and can't seem to wear it down much. will buy this bone again!

My 1 year-old Golden Retriever shows no interest in this bone.  He loves Kongs, Greenies, rawhide, and other bones, but will not touch these.  He sniffs it for a second, gives me a funny look, sort of like "Where's the beef", then pouts.
I have Rottweilers and beagles , both love the large size bones. I buy the large size becuse of the Rotty but even the smaller dogs chew on them alot. This was a great price.
Looking to order two more because our dogs love this bone and don't like to share it with each other!  And I love the price I paid on Amazon which was half of what they wanted in local stores!

Bought these for my teething 3.5 month old Wheaten Terrier and she went to town on them. Last quite a while and pass through my dogs system pretty easily without causing any heavy diarrhea or making her sick. Def recommend this for a teething dog or just a dog who loves to chew (which is pretty much ALL dogs). My silky terrier finds these extremely uninteresting, but she's a picky brat. If your dog will chew on anything with even a slight flavor, these will work out well.
We have a pittbull that chews everything up quickly. Extreme Kongs last about a day. Nylabones are GREAT! They have lasted up to 2 months for him....definitely recommend.

column9: Durable - but dog is not interested....
column10: My German Shepherd is not really interested in this bone. He likes many natural bones but really is not interested in this one - so it was not really useful to me. However, if your dog goes for this bone it will probably provide hours of pleasure. Recommended with reservations.

column9: exactly what I was looking for
column10: Needed a replacement nylabone and this was exactly the size I was thinking it was. My dog (a smooth collie) is not a real heavy chewer but even at ~50lbs the wolf seems to be the size that fits her mouth well. Haven't got one in the store for a while but it seemed to be a good deal. Gives her something to do when bored besides chew holes in pillows and blankets :)

column9: Your dog will either love it or hate it
column10: I've never had a dog that has been interested in one of these bones. I've had a siberian husky and a mutt in the past and neither one would chomp on one of these nylabones. I have tried the different flavors and textures, but neither one was interested. Years have past and we recently got a new siberian husky since we missed our old one. While he was teething I bought this for him hoping it may work, it didn't. I tried everything to cajole into liking this bone; however, nothing would make him like this thing. My mom told me that her golden retreiver enjoys these, so perhaps it's just a breed thing. It's worth a shot to see if your dog would like this, but be warned that I have had no success.

column9: Great product for big, destructive dogs!
column10: I have two large Rottweilers that have destroyed just about every expensive, so-called non destructive dog toy I have purchased for them.  Nothing beats the durability and long-lasting use that we have gotten from the Nylabone dog chews!  I really like the giant sized bones as it has taken my dogs much longer to go through them than other dog chews and the size is perfect for their large teeth and mouths.  Highly recommend the Nylabones to anyone with large, silly, playful dogs who need a bit more than just your regular dog toys!

Both my dogs seem to enjoy these. I see where other posters say theirs didn't like them to much, mine didnt at first either. Now they both site and happily chew away. Best part is they last for WEEKS. Sometime I will take a little food and smear on one. I would buy again. Would also look for something in same brand that has flavoring or a center mixture to it.

My dog is a very aggressive chewer, and she really went to town on this bone! She loves it! Its the only thing I've gotten for her that she actually likes and has lasted more than a week. She still has put a significant dent in it already, after only two weeks, and you do have to watch for them shredding pieces off (small pieces are said to be all right to pass through, but anything larger than a grain of rice should not be swallowed according to the package). I dont know what I would do without this bone, this can keep her busy for a good long while when I'm working or cooking dinner or doing anything where i can't really watch her.

Easy to say these are my two 50 lb dogs' favorite chew toy.  Nylabones and Kongs are the only thing that last a few months with them.  Have tried other Nylabone shapes and sizes and this is their favorite and my favorite by far.  Don't have issues with them getting chunks off of this unlike some of the hollow ones.
Patrick, my basset, particularly likes the bumps and grooves on the bone.  Much easier for him for playing around and tossing.
My GSD is happy with her new Nylabone chew bone.  She had the smooth one last time and seems to like this one even more, great for keeping those teeth clean.
My dogs have always loved nylabone's and they are a great value as they last for months. My pups will chew on these for hours and hours. Slap a little peanut butter on them for an extra treat!

I love these bones and so do my dogs! They are chewers and this keeps them satisfied! It also cleans their teeth and helps with their breath! Iive in Hawaii and got the bones in less than a week! I'm really happy with this seller! Thanks!

We have gotten two of these for our 7 month old black lab mix.  She goes through about one a month, which is really quite good considering she is one of the most avid and strongest chewers I've ever seen.  As long as your dog enjoys chewing on harder objects such as strong sticks and such, you will get your monies worth from one of these.  I will be purchasing more of these, as well as some of the other shapes that they have to keep things interesting.The only warning I have is if your dog does start to chew the bone down, the edges can be a bit sharp.  Also, this is not a good toy for fetch.

We have 2 Boxers, a French Bulldog and an English Bulldog, and they prefer to chew Nylabones. The Nylabones last about 2 to 3 months before they are worn down on the ends. They keep our furniture safe. Our Frenchie weighs 22 pounds, the bulldog weighs 42 lbs. and the 2 Boxers are about 65 each, and the wolf size is great for all of them, even though they are strong chewers.

I've purchased Nylabones in all shapes and sizes, and my dogs just love them.  They don't chew up the furniture, the baseboards, or the dog beds anymore, because Nylabones are tastier, long-lasting, and portable.  Great products!

I've been buying this dog food in all flavors since my vet told me to switch my dogs to a grain-free diet, which was over a year ago now, and all four of my rescue dogs love it. It may look different than other brands of dog food, but I suspect that's because there are no grains to bind it, just meat and other grain-free, all natural ingredients. I mix it with the Taste of the Wild dry food and all four dogs devour it. Unlike the reviewer who commented on the bad smell, I don't think it smells bad as far as dog food goes--the salmon smells salmony. Maybe the other reviewer had a bad can? In any event, my dogs love this food!

This dog food is not at all what I expected. The "meat" in it is some type of processed spongy looking pale colored blob. My dog would not eat this and I can't say I blame her. It does not have anything in it that remotely resembles salmon. It smells awful too. A waste of money.
There are probably a lot of dogs that would think this is the best in the world.  My maltese, however, is not one of them.

Picked up a couple rolls of these in the Paris - CDG - airport today as I was catching my flight home, not even knowing what they were.  Wow. I'm addicted. They are minty, with just a hint of vanilla. Really a different kind of taste. Also the pastilles last quite a long time, unlike Altoids.

column9: Another great treat for my (less than discerning) dog
column10: Okay, my dog is a bit of a chow-hound, she loves just about everything edible (not mushrooms however...).  BUT, there are some treats she goes particularly nuts over...and the the Blue Buffalo Bites (salmon style) are definitely one of them.  She dances, prances and pretty much carries on whenever this particular package starts opening up.  She has not yet tried sneaking onto the dining room table for these as she has done for other treats (mostly because at the moment we are in transit and don't have a dining room table) but I have no doubt she would try--of course at 55# she's not very sneaky.The biggest benefit, from the perspective of the person who sleeps closest to her, is that There Is No Gas generated.  Some treats/foods are very high on the malodorous-gas producing scale and happily the Blue Buffalos are not among them.  At least not the salmon ones!All I can say, is Greyhound Approved and Highly Recommended!JTG

column9: Love Love Love Love this item for my dog!
column10: My Boston Terrier absolutely loves these treats! She has a sensitive stomach and i have tried so many treats for her and these worked! She absolutely loves them and doesn't have any stomach issues at all. They are soft, chewy and she gobbles them up. I love Blue Buffalo! Very healthy product as well, no junkie ingredients!

My two dogs love this stuff and it seems to agree well with them. My Pomeranian has a somewhat sensitive tummy so I have to be picky about her food in particular. Other reviewers have noted that the food must be refrigerated after opening yet not kept after three days. With two small dogs eating it twice a day, this is not a problem for me.

A striking pale green, bamboo rice is not technically considered sushi rice, but is sometimes used for sushi to lend color to sushi rolls. Bamboo rice should not be cooked like regular sushi rice. To cook bamboo rice, 1.5 cups of water (0.35 L) should be added to each eight ounces (227 g) of bamboo rice. Rice should then be cooked as usual, but allowed to sit for 20 minutes after cooking.

column4: Ms. Mary B. Pirrone V "cookbook junkie"
column10: A MUST BUY for anyone who enjoys FLAVORFUL rice.  Very fragrant alone, yet mild, not distracting. Almost 'meaty' in texture.  Nothing like regular rice. Great protien, low carb, low fat.  Actually, addicting.

I am a rice junkie and so glad that the getting heirloom and unique rices are becoming easy to get in the States.  I was given a bag of this rice as a gift and think it is pretty good.  The flavor is not much different than normal white rice (though I think I can tell a difference).  Also the rice does not stay as green as you would think it would.  I tried some other rice at a fancy foods show by another small company called Lotus Food.  Lotus Foods Organic Jade Pearl Rice, 15 Ounce Bags (Pack of 12) I think the Lotus Food product is perhaps better in taste and color.  If you are willing to buy a 12 pack then the Lotus price is a lot less per pound ($3.15 vs $7.00+).  Overall this product is pretty good and I would encourage anybody to use it to add a little flair to their rice dishes, however I will be buying it from Lotus.
This does taste a bit green - but not alfalfa green.  It was good - we enjoyed it.  It is a bit spendy so only used for times when we need a boost in our life.

column9: Green Bamboo Rice is very good
column10: We enjoyed this rice very much. It has a very pretty green color and tasty...

I have never tried Bamboo before and was curious, it was not what I excpected, I was pleasently surprised at the flavor Bamboo has [somewhat like spinich] and not soft at all but more like Asperagus/Broccoli type of hardness, yet it was good once you got over your conceptions of what you THINK Bamboo should taste like...I liked it in the end....and that it's very nutrious and easy to fix is an added bonus. I just wished they'd include instructions on how to prepare it which they don't so it becomes a trial and error and a waste if you don't quess right, or have never cooked before either.

This had a very miled flavor. Neither my husbund or I liked without adding something to it. There was no cooking instrcutions which meant I had to guess. Boiled like white rice for 30 minutes came out good. I would not buy again.

column9: Will set yer sporran swingin', Jimmy
column10: Made in Scotland from girders. Irn Bru (which is Scottish for "Iron Brew" for all you iggerent Yanks) has more chemicals than the Pripyat river and barely a trace of natural ingredients. Rumour has it that Barrs make the stuff by collecting the rivets that fall off the Forth Rail Bridge into the river below and storing them in barrels of water collected from puddles in the Clyde dockyards for three years.The fizz comes from the little nugget of Plutonium 239 at the bottom of every can. Keep that! If you collect enough of them you could build your own nuclear bomb*. Amaze your friends and strike fear into your enemies' very hearts!And if you ever see someone drinking diet Irn Bru, glass him**.*Joke. But the rest of the review is TRUE, I tell you!*OK that was another joke. But the rest of the review is really is true, I promise.

column9: Irn-Bru... the cheapest soda in Scotland
column10: I ran across Irn-Bru entirely by accident in a grocery store in Aberfoyle.  Coca Cola was nearly 2 quid a bottle.  Irn-Bru had 1 litre bottles for a pound.  Being on a budget, we bought it, not really expecting much.BEST SODA EVER!  I am addicted.  Since then, I've been trying to find an affordable way to get it in the US.  The ideal way would be to go back to Aberfoyle and get some myself, but that's too long to wait!If you haven't tried it.  Do so.
The soda came within a reasonable time, but it's freshness seems compromised.  It's still good, but tastes a bit different then drinking it in Scotland.

I tried this when we went to Scotland and loved it.  I found some in the states at a Scottish festival and bought it on the spot!  Really different that what you get in America - like a Scottish coca-cola with a slight bubble gum flavor. Really reminds me of a great trip!

column9: Not the greatest drink in the world, but it's alright.
column10: As an American, Irn Bru is not readily available to me.  I heard about it a few years ago and wanted to try some.  A good friend of mine went to Scotland and said that it was really good, so I broke down and had a 12 pack shipped to my home.  I chilled one and took a sip.  To me, it tasted like the little sugary bubble gum sodas you can get in grocery stores for about a quarter.  I am aware that it's very popular across the pond, but I personally didn't find it to be amazing.  On the other hand, many people I knew thought it was delicious and began paying me $5 a bottle for the soda and I made my money back plus another 10 dollars.  So, in a way, that was a positive.

I have been trying for years to get my replacement part.  The part with the glass bowl in it broke... not the glass, the handle and part that makes it seal for roasting.About every 6 months I get tired of purchasing "not fresh" coffee, and begin my search.  They always said: "Probably available in 6 months".  Today I went to the site and it says discontinued on all of the parts.Don't just take my word for it, do a search for iroast 2 parts and click on a few.  discussions all over the place about this problem.  Sorry to the seller, but you don't want to pay that price only to find that they have no way of honoring the promise to repair for 1 year, when the part is not available.rating would be a 4 if not for the above stated problem.  It roasted better than my previous $100 Fresh Roast (now $120 at seven bridges)  Not being able to get it fixed drops it down of course.  I think I will be heading over now and order the cheaper model... lasted me a year with pretty regular roasting.  Much better deal in the long run.

I wish Amazon had a policy of also posting the Nutrition Facts label of food products.  This product has 30g of sugar in a 2 oz serving and 140 Calories.  The ingredients List is Quince & Citron Rice Black Vinegar, Fructose, Water, Oligosaccharide, Conc. Apple Juice, Polydextrose, Maltodextrin, Mixed Apple Juice.  If you're fine with that then it does add a certain zing to recipes but I was looking for something simpler.

column9: Black rice vinegar has too much of separate flavors, Didn't feel good swallowing it.
column10: I am a big fan of Drinking vinegar and how versatile they are.I drink Hong Cho(Pulmuwon brand), mostly, and it was good for drinking, diluted in cold water, or served hot, but also it was fantastic salad dressing to my surprise. Hong cho tastes more like a fruit juice, and everyone who tastes it said they would drink it every day.(flavor)However, this sempio(Sempyo, a popular Korean Soy Sauce maker)brand vinegar is below average in taste, and the sweet honey after taste didn't go well with the typical vinegar smell at the beginning. It is hard to describe, but some fermented or cough syrup-like not-so-delightful flavor, that is. Sip vinegar, sip some juice, and sip honey water, and you get sick. That was the experience from it.(packaging issue)This Black Rice Vinegar comes in half the size bottles,in 4 bottles, probably equivalent to 2 bottles of Hong Cho . They arrive in a box, air-tight, in a clear document seal wrap, but it was not too securely packed with other items I ordered through amazon.com, when they were put together. SO, if UPS roughly handled it, any object inside the box would puncture the wrap easily inside the box. They will need some bubble wrap to fill the gap.Not, having too many options of drinking vinegar, I would encourage other users and put some more positive reviews for the benefit of accessible drinking vinegars in US market- I would keep this as my back up option. But, candidly speaking, I would stick to Hong Cho, if they are available on amazon.com again sometime soon.

This product is delicious! Vinegar seems to be the next big thing; also the health benefits it has is great as well! It is all about being healthy.  It seems like they have made black vinegar easier to consume~ I enjoy this product daily!
very tasteful  smells great  and taste great  not very strong  but thats how i like it
This coffee is fantastic, but does anyone else notice that it's cheaper to buy two 24 packs than it is to buy one 48 pack? That's a little confusing...

I ALSO LIKE THE BLEND OF FRENCH VANILLA. IT TASTES JUST LIKE THE NAME. I HAVE AT LEAST 1 CUP A DAY. I SWITCH FROM BREAKFAST BLEND TO FRENCH VANILLA EVERY DAY. NO AFTER TASTE. EVERYONE SHOULD OWN A KEURIG

column9: Vanilla flavor outshines the weak coffee flavor
column10: I'm not someone who needs incredibly strong coffee, but after we received a Keurig as a wedding gift, Green Mountain Hazelnut and French Vanilla were the first two  packs of K-cups we bought.  We were disappinted with both.  The flavoring is good, but the coffee itself is weak, even with the coffeemaker set lower.  Recommend you buy Coffee People Jet Fuel and some flavored creamer instead.
I am struggling to keep this stocked for our office coffee maker. Everyone who likes light roast, flavored coffees is in love with this product.
Very good coffee, rich flavor.  Highly recommend this coffee.  Reasonable priced and would buy again along with many other Green a mountain favors.
Love the French vanilla. Very creamy and flavorful. Price is so reasonable. Will continue to purchase this item. Hope to try other flavors.

I like flavored coffee.  This one is good.  The hazelnut is also Yummy.  Most of the green montain kcups I have tried were delicious, the exception being the caramel vanilla cream, which doesn't taste like vanilla, or caramel, or creak I guess.  This kind does taste like vanilla.
This coffee tastes great, smells wonderful, and the price for 24 of them is very reasonable. Buy it...you'll REALLY like it!
Much cheaper than buying at the only department store in our small town, Wal-Mart.  I was glad to get twice the product for halp the price.  Thanks, Diane HowardI will be back.

column9: Great tasting easy to use coffee
column10: I've heard others who don't like Keurig coffee but I really find it to be some of my favorite and with these cups quite easy to make and quick too. All the flavors are subjective and for me I haven't found any I don't like. I'm the type of coffee drinker who likes coffee shop coffee and not really fond of Star B. if that helps. So if your taste is similar you should like this too.

My wife loves this coffee. She drinks it every morning. Recently a friend declined a cup of coffee. When she saw the vanilla, she changed her mind. She loved the flavor. We will continue to purchase Green Mountain Vanilla coffee.

column9: This is my new favorite coffee
column10: I love this coffee more than any other I've ever tried.  It's simply perfect.I do find it odd that the 48 count is over twice the cost of the 24 count but that's nothing major.  I just think it's weird and only people who are worse at math than me would buy the 48 count instead of the 24 count.  (There can't be many people worse at math than me...  I'm pretty bad.)Fantastic coffee though. I highly recommend it if you want a light, pleasant coffee.

The coffee is excellent. Good flavor. Since there isn't a Starbucks here I can't compare but as far as I remember it is better. They packaged it right and it made it to an  APO address perfectly. Thanks.

I love flavored coffees and that's pretty much all I drink....I'm basically a flavored java fanatic!! LOL  Wasn't sure this one was going to be that great, but I was pleasantly surprised!! It's quite yummy and definitely satisfies my vanilla coffee cravings!

This oh so yummy 2 calorie a k-cup coffee is light and delicious. Pair together with the Torani Sugar-Free Vanilla Sweetener and you can feel good about your morning cup (or in my case - several cups) of coffee. Yummy yummy yummy! Another Cup Please!
I like this coffee anytime during the day.  It has a nice fresh taste. no aftertaste, very enjoyable would recommend this flavor to other customers
We love our new coffee pot, but the K-cups are expensive.  Buying them at Amazon has allowed me to keep using the pot because it is cost effective especially with the free postage.
this coffee is very good. I like the taste. I need a stronger coffee in the moring so I started using another kind but this was very good.

column9: Mild, not wild, about GMC French Vanilla
column10: Green Mountain Coffee's French Vanilla has a nice taste, one that is not synthetic and the vanilla tones are subtle.  I would prefer a slightly more robust coffee roast and/or a stronger sense of the vanilla.  It is a good medium blend and certainly shouldn't offend.
I think Green Mountain is one of my favorite brands for K-cups; not too strong and not too weak.  I drink my coffee  black so the flavor really needs to be perfect for me to like it.
I don't have a lot to say.  It is good, if not great, and the price is reasonable.  I don't taste any vanilla, but that's not a biggy to me..

I love Green Mountain French Vanilla especially with International Delight French Vanilla coffee creamer. Combine the two and you have a commercial quality coffee at a price that is affortable and in your own home. I like my French Vanilla cold so I make it up and put it in the fridge in reused popular brand glass jars and when it is cold it tastes just like the kind you buy in glass bottles in your grocery fridge.

I have always been a big fan of Dunkin Donuts french vanilla coffee!  I got a Keurig machine for Christmas and I think the Green Mountain French vanilla K-cups are excellent!  Smooth, sweet taste!  Not artificial tasting.

We've got 4 coffee drinkers in the house and have tried a variety of french vanilla coffee. Although Dunkin' is still the fave, all four adults drink the Green Mountain French Vanilla over all others in the Keurig carousel. My dad even switched from his lifelong love of Folgers. We like it!

column9: Green Mt. Coffee- French Vanilla  and Caramel Cream
column10: I ordered both coffees, french vanilla and caramel cream for my parents, after purchasing the K cup coffeemaker from Amazon.  The results are that they are both very delicious.
Green Mountain coffee is wonderful, no matter what the flavor!  French Vanilla is the ultimate "go to" when I need my coffee in the morning.  :)
I like this coffee with a few cookies or a little cake. It is sweet and makes a medium strength small cup perfectly in my opinion. I would by it again or give it to a friend.

The Green Mountain French Vanilla K-cup is the best tasting of all the French Vanilla K-cups I have tasted so far! It does not have an overpowering "flavored" taste but instead provides just a hint of vanilla with a rich, inviting smell as the coffee brews!

I absolutely love this coffee. I'm not a coffee drinker until I found this coffee. In some coffee's that say they have flavor you can barely taste anything other than the strong coffee flavor. With this coffee you definitely get the vanilla flavor. It's perfect for me. Now I can barely start my day without having some Green Mountain French Vanilla.I've tried a few different brands and a few different flavors but I always come back to this one. It's delicious. Not too sweet, not too strong but still super flavorful and doesn't remind of me coffee. Which is perfect for me. So if you like French Vanilla you'll really love this coffee.Great price and fast shipping!
After shopping around for the best price for this flavor K-cup, we chose this product.  If you like French Vanilla, we think you'll enjoy this coffee.
I'm already a Green Mountain coffee fan but the French Vanilla is a great way to start the morning!The price was fantastic and the delivery was immediate.  Thank You!

Green Mountain comes through again with a good tasting coffee at a reasonable price.  It is my wife's favorite flavor.  Their decaf version is also very good.  Of all our flavors that we drink (and we drink a lot of different K-Cup flavors), this is probably the best.

column9: Addictive garlic but peeled is better to buy than this
column10: Update 5/4:Culinary Elite brand on Amazon is a better value now over this brand ...Culinary Elite is peeled so you get WAY more black garlic for the price aince there are no cores and peels in the bag.And all those cloves are good quality. I liked this one but it took forever to peel, got wasted by peeling off and sticking to the stems and the cores and peels weighed as much as the garlic so I got about half the garlic for the price by the time I was done when they were in containers side by side.Original Review:Yep, black garlic is addictive.When you get good cloves you can pop a whole clove in your mouth and chew. On this brand, I did have some bad cloves in the bag but most were really good.It takes one month to make a bulb of black garlic...although it's called "fermentation" it's far from anything else you'd think of as fermented. It is kept at a very low oven temp with high humidity for 30 days, wrapped.  This causes the bitterness and pungency of the garlic to subside and concentrates the sugars and antioxidants so you wind up with what tastes like a caramelized garlic or slightly balsamic reduction taste.  It's amazing...spread it on anything, heavy...I love to chop it up in green beans, many put it on a steak at fine restaurants so it's often seen there ( I don't eat steak so I cannot comment on this use, but apparently it's becoming a "thing".)  Mashed potatoes are a work of art.Anything you might sprinkle garlic on just goes to a whole new level with this flavor.The texture is entirely different as well, no more hard cloves, they become almost gel-like.
i ordered it for my father when i was in town and i haven't seen him. he felt bad to tell me but i just asked him and he told me they came slimy and rotten. it's over 30 days so i am beat for $25.

Granted, I'm doing other stuff like no fried foods and the like but my level has been lowered 20 points. I started to give this product a lower rating due to the fact you have to peel the garlic before use. It's a messy process but its one I chose and its not the sellers fault. Just the way it is. Next time I plan on ordering black garlic already cleaned. You folks with high cholesterol should give it a try, you just might be surprised. Oh by the way, if you try this garlic, remember what it is. Its garlic that's been fermented, so don't expect a flavor of ice cream and be sure to have something to wash it down. Pretty tough stuff. No wonder it works. Tastes like medicine.

My favorite tea is Ahmad English Afternoon Tea when I can have a tea with caffeine, such as, in the morning through early afternoon; however, this is my favorite when I need to choose a decaffeinated tea, such as, late afternoon and evening tea drinking.Here's a tip to make your own "Do It Yourself" decaffeinated tea from regular tea.  Prepare your tea as usual and use a stop watch to time its steeping.  At precisely 30 seconds pour out the tea and re-brew the your tea for your normal steeping time (2 to 5 minutes), plus about 30 seconds.  During the first 30 seconds of steeping time about 80% of the caffeine in your regular tea is released, so only about 20% of the caffeine is left.  The resulting taste is about as good as regularly steeped tea.I haven't been able to find a statement of how much caffeine is left in this tea after steeping--my best guess is that about 95% of the caffeine has been removed in the decaffeinating process.Ahmad costs more than most teas, however, as the saying goes "there's nothing like a good cuppa."

I love New England Clam Chowder and Campbell's Soup At Hand version of Clam Chowder is quite tasty and filling.What I liked: with 10 ¾ ounces of soup, this is a great item to have for lunch, especially during a long cold winter.  It only takes a minute and 15 seconds to heat up, so it is a quick and convenient meal. Being able to heat up the container means one less bowl to clean and it's easy enough to rinse out and recycle the can when you are through with it. The soup is filled with potatoes, celery, and clams and is delicious. It's not too salty, which can be a problem with canned soup.What I didn't like: the container. Yes, I love its convenience, but it's too tall. The soup is meant to be sipped, not eaten with a spoon, but you still have to stir it and when you use a spoon to do it, almost the entire spoon goes into the can, which is very messy. Also, the plastic lid on the can is hard to take off and the opening to sip the soup needs to be wider, since items like the potatoes and clams sometimes get stuck and you need to take the lid off to finish the soup - and it's very hard to use a spoon to eat the remainder because of the shape of the can.Nutritional Facts: Each container has one service size that is 160 calories (calories from fat are 90). There are 10 g's total fat, 2 g's of saturated fat, and no trans fat. There are 5 mg's cholesterol and 890 mg's of sodium. Also, there are 13 g's total carbohydrates; 5 g's dietary fiber; 1g sugar; 4 g protein; 2% of the daily value of calcium; and 6% of the daily value of iron.Bottom-line: Campbell's Soup at Hand New England Clam Chowder is very tasty and filling but somewhat inconveniently packaged.

column9: Cheap and convenient but a bit bland
column10: I've been buying these soups as a matter of cheap thrills and convenience. They are probably best used as a no-fuss and light lunch st work and school. Not all of the flavors are created equal, however. I rank the ones I've tried as follows:1. Tomato Parmesan2. Cream of broccoli3. New England clam chowder.The first two are very tasty. The third is a bit bland but still pretty decent.I can think of three advantages of going with this product:1. Cost. Bloom charges me $1.89 a can for this soup. Amazon's subscription plans often make the soup significantly less expensive.2. Ease of preparation. Just shake, microwave for 90 seconds, and you're ready to go. No other cooking utensils or preparation is required. The metal rims on the containers do not cause sparking. Pretty neat.3. Ease of consumption. Just sip from the container, which seems to be a foam material or plastic that doesn't conduct much heat and is easy to hold. It fits easily into car cup holders. column9: Delicious, quick and easy, but watch for swollen foil tops
column10: I love this soup, it's the perfect pick-me-up on a rainy afternoon. It's very rich and creamy with small bits of clams, potatoes, and celery that can be sipped right out of the container if desired.I have found on a few rare occasions (maybe 1 out of 25) the foil top is dome shaped, if you see this do not use!  I preferred the pull-top metal lids to the foil, much safer, but they all seem to be foil now.  Also check expiration dates.  Amazon's price is excellent, especially with a subscription, about $10 delivered for an 8-pack!If you are interested in nutritional information you can find it at [...]The New England Clam Chowder has 10 grams of fat, whereas the Classic Tomato only has 0.5 grams of fat and can be almost as satisfying.The only reason I didn't give it 5 stars is the foil tops, and if you heat it in the container as directed, you should stop and stir it once or twice to keep it from overflowing.  (If it's hot on the bottom, but cold on top it will "spit" and jump around in the microwave.)Highly recommended, great snack!!

column9: Wasted Trees For Twice The Price
column10: I bought this product based on online reviews.  I was disappointed that I paid twice as much for this litter than other name brands.  I didn't find that it clumped any better (actually not as good). I found that it was a lot messier than others because if you've ever seen how sawdust spreads you'll know what I am talking about.  I didn't find this cat litter to be better than any of the others I have tried in any way and after reading another review that said it was horse bedding pellets that could be bought at a feed store for $7 for a 40 lb bagged I feel like a sucker.

I've been using this litter with my rescue kitty. (She showed up at my door one day pregnant, and I, like a sap, gave her some food. The very next day she came into the house and started yowling to be fed again!)You basically have to stick your nose IN the litter box to smell anything, which is a huge plus in my book. Less smell!Now, I do want to address some of the complaints you see in the reviews here.First, people saying "We switched to this, and my cat wouldn't use it, and it was a disaster".Well, cats can be very picky about changes. If your cat is used to a particular type of litter, he or she is not going to want to switch on your say-so. And that doesn't matter what brand they're used to or what you're switching to! A cat raised and litter trained on pine litter would react as badly to being made to use clay litter all of a sudden! Whenever you switch things around with your cat, you have to do it carefully. Put a tiny amount of the new litter on the bottom of the box, and the old litter on top. Then you gradually change the proportions until you're using a tiny amount of the old litter and it's almost all the new litter. (Some people stay at this stage forever. If you have a very old, set-in-his-ways cat that may be best.)So when people say "Oh, my cat didn't know what to do!", I don't take that very seriously unless they tried to gradually transition their cat.Another thing people have mentioned is that they find the poop doesn't get covered. This, to me, is a matter of hygiene. You should really be removing the poop every day, no matter what type of litter you use. If you don't wish to do that, though, you should use a different type of kitty litter. This one isn't going to work for you.The third thing is that some people have trouble cleaning it. The instructions on the bag say to shake the box so the old, used litter goes to the bottom and the top is fresh pellets. Then you dump it all out when the pellets have mostly been used up. You can do that. I've been changing mine more frequently because our darling IS a little picky (only cat I know who prefers to go out to do her business and then comes back in just like a dog) and what I do is scoop it up and then shake it into the garbage bag. The used stuff stays in the scoop long enough to move over the trash bag, and then when I shake it it drops down. I haven't had trouble cleaning the box.Now, with that said, it's not for everyone. For one thing, there are plenty of cats who, raised on clay litter, will find this one uncomfortable and awkward to use. But if your cat is very young or more flexible you should definitely look into this.

I do not see how it could be used as litter. I wasted my money. It is non-returnable so I guess it just goes in the trash and I'm out 16.00 bucks. I thought I was saving money, but actually I wasted money. Not happy.

I bought this for my 10 year old cat because it was listed on all of the consumer reports as the best and most natural litter you could buy.  Yeah.  Well apparently a great deal of cats are allergic to the oils in pine.  So what happens?  They stop eating, stop drinking water and stop pooping.  I am very worried my cat will now suffer lifelong kidney issues due to this.  It isn't just me either.  Since this happened I have talked to several other people, including my Vet who say this is a common occurrence and that Feline Pine is the worst thing you can do for your cat.  If you are anything like me you love your cat and you try to do right by her.  SO AVOID THIS PRODUCT.

column9: 4 stars for a single cat household. Not so much for multi-cat
column10: I used this litter for almost two years for my 3 yr old male cat. It worked great. Never any smells and easy to clean. Plus the larger pellets don't track. However, one problem with this and other "set it and forget it" litters that absorb liquids as opposed to clumps that you remove, is that there is a large grey area in terms of figuring out when to change the litter. The bag mentions that all the pellets will completely break down once they have absorbed litter, but it's hard to determine when that point is. This leaves your cat pawing through a box full of damp(with urine) sawdust if you are not studious about checking the breaking point for the litter. Still, it worked great for one cat with consistent waste(read, nice and dry poop)This ALL changed once I got a new 3 month old kitten with stool issues(more liquid than solid, I'll just say). The problem is, any "moisture rich" cat turds don't really absorb quickly enough into the litter and the pine pellets are too large to effectively cover any waste like that.Sooo..you're left with these pine pellet covered turd mines that my cats would step on and then...well, cat poop is not fun to have spread around the house.On top of all that, the liquid absorbent qualities of the pellets meant having to change out the entire cat box pretty much on a weekly basis and since the litter isn't flushable, this became an issue.Being able to clean out all waste(solid AND liquid) on a day to day basis is the main reason I switched over to Swheat Scoop which I really like(and have reviewed as well). It keeps the cat box truly clean and it's flushable.I will say, that even with two cats, the feline pine kept odors down to a minimum(basically, you'd have to stick your head in the box to smell odors). So, I recommend it, keeping in mind the issues I had above. I think it's more of a one cat litter.

IF (and that's a big if) you can get your cat to like this kind of litter, it's great.  You have to mix clay and the pine pellets together for quite some time before they adjust.  2 of my 3 cats like it, and thankfully the third cat would prefer to go outside.  Well, Feline Pine is a great concept, but it is soooo much cheaper to go to a feed store and buy a 40 lb bag of HORSE BEDDING.  It is the same exact stuff, tightly compacted pine pellets.  I was using Feline Pine for a few months before my coworker suggested I go buy horse bedding instead.  Feline Pine:  20 lbs for $15 OR horse bedding:  40 lbs for $6.  It works exactly the same and lasts just as long.  The only difference is the Feline Pine has a stronger pine smell.  Save yourself some money and go to the feed store.

column9: This is the number one litter!
column10: I have had cats for many years and have used several brands of litter.  When Feline Pine came out I tried it and instantly loved it.  I recently have mixed Tidy Cat Crystals in with it and have found a perfect combination.  Half of a small bag of Feline Pine with one third of the jug of Tidy Cat Crystals for one cat for two weeks.  It doesn't stick to the feet and track like the scoopables, it swells and turns to sawdust as it's used and the smell is very limited especially if you use a covered litter box with swinging door.  I don't scoop or do another thing to it until it's time to dump, rinse, and start all over.  You will find some saw dust outside of the litter box at the end of the two weeks but not tracked all through the house.  It is the best!
Since I found Felline Pine I would not use anything else.It has a pleasant odor & is easy to take care of as needed.

These pellets are the EXACT same as "equine (horse) bedding", and similar to wood pellets for pellet stoves. You can buy a 40  (yes, forty!) pound bag of equine pellet bedding for only $6!!! (vs $10 for 20 pounds of Feline Pine!) I purchase at my local farm/tractor store. Wood stove pellets are even less - can get 40 pounds as cheap as $4.
