However, the day he tasted his first cup of Kicking Horse (Kick Ass), he deemed it the "Best Coffee on the Planet" and has not since found any other that comes close!We first discovered this coffee while on a camping trip in Canada.  There, in the midst of six national parks in the heart of the Canadian Rockies (fondly known as Kicking Horse Country), we purchased our first container of Kicking Horse Coffee, primarily for its name.  We were deeply enjoying the beauty of the land around us and happy to support the local economy.  Back at camp we brewed our first pot and I've never known my husband to enjoy his java more intensely.Since that time, Kicking Horse has come to mean much more to this family than our endeared vacation spot.  The term now resonates as reference to the premier coffee.  I'm so glad we can now purchase it online;  my coffee-loving husband is a happy man and It saves a bit on gas!

I love coffee and this one of the best, if not the best, coffee I have ever tasted. It is a strong & bold dark roast coffee. Excellent flavor, no bitter, acidic aftertaste. Nice & STRONG. 100% worth the price. Buy it, you won't be disappointed.

By far......hands down......the BEST whole bean coffee.  With every can comes the freshest beans and every pot produces the most aromatic, KICK ASS cup of coffee.  My husband and I.....not much on specialty, expensive mochacino types.  We grind our own beans and use only distilled water.  We've tried dozens of whole bean brands and nothing comes close to Kicking Horse Coffee. Each one offers an outstanding flavor.  Try them all.  We highly recommend.

The Woodstock Farmers Market used to carry this coffee.  It is the best I have ever had and I am a very picky Coffee Connoisseur.  I am so glad to find it available at Amazon.  I do prefer to shop locally but this coffee is that good, I will order on line!

column9: Really, really good coffee for the price
column10: Edit: March, 2012 - So it's been a few months since I bought the coffee and I haven't grown tired of it. I still stand by my original review. I have subscribe and save and, depending on whether we have guests, the coffee may run out between shipments. Well, I have to buy an "emergency" bag while I wait for my Kicking Horse. I usually buy new brands trying to discover a better coffee. Well, none have convinced me so far. I'm sticking with Kicking Horse for my everyday coffee needs.---I am a coffee snob and I am not embarrassed to admit it. I never used to drink coffee until I went to graduate school. At that point, I needed coffee and, if I was going to drink it, I was going to drink something good. I also refuse to drink the sock water they try to pass as coffee at work, so I have to take a thermos in every day.This coffee is really good. I know that true coffee snobs do not like dark coffee, preferring to savor the flavor of the beans, without the toasty flavor getting in the way. However, I do like a bold coffee, and this is a good one. Really nice, bold, rich flavor without hardly any acidity. And, for the price (especially the subscribe & save price) it can't be beat.

column9: Some of the best coffee I've had in a long time!
column10: Coming from a family of snooty coffee drinkers, I'm pretty picky on what I drink. My dad ordered and sent me the two pack tins of 454 Horse by Kicking Horse. He did it as a joke thinking it would be too strong and horrible. It turns out that it is fantastic coffee. Not too bitter and less of an aftertaste than that other big name, retail on every corner, coffee shop. After consuming the 454 Horse and being hooked, I decided to try the Kick Ass Dark. It's a touch milder that the 454 but still very good! If you like the dark, oily beans with bold flavors, I'd recommend both of these types.

I tried it and I think it's alright. I personally find the "454 Horse Power" to be much better. Kicking horse is still my preferred Brand of coffee on Amazon, always very fresh and oily. Go with 454, it's just all around better than this.

My son and I love a rich dark cup of coffee and this item fits the bill. A joke there cuz his name is Bill. Give this item a try with your Bodum French Press, Amazon sells that too, and make coffee so strong it will put hair on your chest. I am still hairless, thank you, for those of you that are interested. It comes in a can that can be put to many good uses. Paint it and use it to give Xmas cookies next year.
This is the way dark roast coffee is supposed to taste.  I grind the beans, fairly fine and use my keurig brewer.  I never get tired of this coffee.
Very strong coffee but smooth and great taste. It's also reasonably priced and comes in a sealed can.  I'm glad I bought it.
This is excellent coffee - a bit strong - which I personally like.  Price is good enough for this quality.

I bought the 2 12.3 tins of Kick Ass dark roast whole coffee beans. Now, when I want to buy more, I see that I could have purchased 2.2 pounds of the same coffee at a cheaper price-especially if I use Subscribe and  Save! Am I missing something? I feel like I overpaid the first time, as this seems to be the same product for a much better price, but it did not appear in my first choice? Can you explain please? Thank you.

This Coffee is very good, and very strong. If you like coffee that gives you that high caffeinated effect, this coffee is just for you. The flavor of it is alright. They never asked me if I have a grinder or not, which I don't but I new someone who does have one, and was able to grind it, with giving them some as a thank you. It isn't very acidly which was nice, very bold. All in all this is very good coffee and once that cap is off, your house and your car will smell so good! The company sends fast and great CS.

column9: Great coffee at a great price!
column10: This coffee is a rich dark roast with a smokey flavor to it. If you prefer strong coffee, the Kicking Horse Kick "donkey" coffee is up your ally,  In my office coffee club, we ranked this coffee at 8.5 average score. I have a tin for home and a tin for work, and just recently ordered my second Kicking Horse brand coffee.Great coffee at a great price!
Great flavor and very smooth for a dark roast. I prefer this one to their Three Sisters or the 454 roast. Just my opinion.
My boyfriend and I have tried all types and brands of coffee lately, but Kicking Horse is definitely the best. The beans are nice and oily and it has a wonderful aroma and flavor.

I was excited to find what appeared to be a good quality, whole-bean coffee available through the mail, but was disappointed with the actual product.While the Kick Ass bean is dark and produces a strong cup of coffee, it lacks character and aroma. I will go back to picking up my beans by the bag at the local PEET's.

Wow!The perfect calorie solution to good old Boston Irish Iced Coffee! I make a pot of good dark coffee,put it in a pitcher, add The Agave Irish Cream to taste  we Irish don't measure LOL) Let it get nice an cold, yummy!! The perfect summer drink for the afternoon slump!  Even my friends, the Dunkin Donut  high calorie addicts like this. Amazing what they were spending a week At D &D for the specialty iced coffees.Works great in hot coffee too.I admit, I sometimes add a touch of Jamesons LOL Saves on all those calories from the whipped or coffee cream! Agave is supposed to be ok for diabetics also, I'm not an expert so check it out yourself;)I have alos used it on cearel, oatmeal, icecream, hey be creative! I bet it would make a nice frosting too! 2 day shipping , well packaged and way cheaper than the health food stores! Madhava Organic Agave Nectar Irish Creme -- 11.75 fl oz

We have been cutting back on caffeine as my husband has a caffeine related heart irregularity. This is perfect, he gets just a little caffeine and I get great tasting coffee with no difficulty and all on 1 cup.
The Green Mountain Coffee Half-Caff K-cups are great and delicious.  If you want a great tasting coffee with less caffeine, try these.. I am going to order more right now!!

Several years ago, I went on a tour of the Celestial Seasonings tea factory in Boulder, Colorado. The guide showed us the bales of tea as they arrived, machines that ground and mixed the tea, and a machine that put the tea in tea bags. The tour included a visit to the room where the peppermint tea was stored. Our guide told us that peppermint was stored separately so that it would not contaminate the other teas. He did not tell us what was to come.The doorway into the peppermint room was surrounded by bright red stripes. This should have served as a warning to us. We all innocently strolled into the peppermint room. The smell of peppermint was overpowering. It entered my nose, my head, my lungs, and then my whole being was infused with peppermint. What a rush! The crowd stampeded out of the room in a hurry. For the rest of the day and into the next, all I could smell and taste was the mint.I am now addicted to Celestial Seasonings Peppermint Tea. Every time I have some, I am reminded of that fateful day in Boulder. The events of that day have changed my life forever. Amazingly, the tea is still legal, openly sold in stores and on the Internet. I think that the tea is great, but then again I am not an unbiased observer. On your next visit to Boulder, take the tour. Or go a safer route; buy the tea from Amazon.

I eat pudding every day.  I used to watch for sales & buy coupons.  It finally became a challenge to find the sugar free cook & serve boxes.  Then I discovered Amazon.com had it AND I could order a case AND I could have it automatically delivered every month, every other month or every 3 or 6 months. Amazon.com has the sugar free in two sizes in the cook & serve & the instant and they also have vanilla in the instant & the cook & serve.  I am living in pudding heaven ... no more expeditions to the store ... cost efficient as Amazon.com has it priced less than the store cost and no delivery fee.  Can't beat that.

column9: One of the BEST inventions from KRAFT GF inc
column10: Sugar FREE COOK and serve, Finally a Pudding I can relate to. NO SUGAR, and I can enjoy that thick skin that forms on top of this CREAMY DELIGHT! Aw, it's about time. Priced at nearly the same price as the SUGAR FILLED pudding, but worth it! I can find it in the store, but Here at AMAZON, It was delivered to my door pronto and FREE! I only wish some one would make SUGAR FREE CHOCOLATE MILK!

column9: Jello sugar free cook + serve pudding
column10: Really great. I wish D-zerta pudding was still being made but this is a great substitute. D-zerta also had butterscotch but Jello does not---at least not in sugar free.

One of my sisters turns up her nose at anything sugar free, but even she loves the chocolate Jell-o sugar free cooked pudding. It can be difficult to find in local stores, so I started ordering it from Amazon.com.  Was disappointed to see that they had raised the price recently.

column9: Can be made with soy milk (really!)
column10: Though the package directions say not to make it with soy milk I have no problem getting the pudding to set when using Silk unsweetened soy milk.  Preparing in the microwave is easy and the warm pudding is very tasty, too.  Since I have to watch sugar and carbs very closely this preparation is ideal and though the taste is slightly different I actually think it tastes better than regular milk.Also, try adding a teaspoon of flavored extract (almond, raspberry, orange) for a new twist.
This is a great snack. Easy to prepare in the microwave, just make sure you bring it to a boil or it has a slimey texture. Tastes way better than instant in our opinion.

column9: Not as good as the prepared stuff
column10: This is good, but not as tasty as the stuff you buy in the stores already prepared. It does have a slight aftertaste, and since I'm more calorie-conscious than worried about suger (not diabetic), I went back to the regular pudding; tastes 10 times better and more chocolaty! :)
The product arrived on time and it is great for a quick fixed bottle. Its great for when you are on the go but need a ready bottle made.

This is a delicious Earl Grey tea, the Bergamont really stands out.  It's a full bodied tea lovely to drink any time of day...it has become my standard "go to" black tea particularly at Breakfast time.
My daughter received a few packets of this in a Christmas basket - it was the only "hit" in the gift. Just sweet enough and very creamy; she's a fan.
This yeast has not failed me in any batches of soda or beer yet, which is why I keep using it exclusively.  May try other yeasts when I become more seasoned but will stick with what works until then.
Use this jam with cream cheese and spread on Wholefoods Everything Flatbread crackers....great appetizer.
Such a unique flavor that is a hit at parties.  Just throw it over whipped cream cheese and serve with crackers and you have the perfect appetizer.

I tried this when in CA for my cousins wedding and we had it in her suite to eat with cream cheese and crackers as a snack.  I LOVED it.  It's very good.So, when I came back to Hawaii, I had to order it! AMAZON has the BEST price for this, FYI!  The Earth and Vine company is STELLAR!  ALL their stuff is sooo yummy!  You can really get creative with what you use it for...  I have tried it on warmed brie, its really good that way for sure.  Just warm the brie in the oven, and pour on top in the oven and take out and use some nice CARRS crackers.  This steller is AMAZING!  They will only charge you the $5 or so to ship as many as you want.  I ordered 6 so I wouldnt run out.  It's the perfect appetizer to bring with you to any party to make it seem as if you worked really hard...  lol!  My husband used this on meatballs the other night, and said they were fantastic!
This is the best pepper jelly ever.  If you want a never miss appetizer, just pour some of this over a hunk of cream cheese and watch your guests devour it!

I was happy to find this online since otherwise I'd have to look for it in a specialty store, and for more money.  I bought 3 and the shipping was the same for the 3 as it would be for one.  This is just incredibly delicious.  Serve it on the side of a great creamy goat cheese or double creme Brie and rich crackers.  Put it out for a dipping sauce for Crab Rangoons.  This is the most requested appetizer at any holiday party at my place.  It's a perfect balance of hot and sweet.  Decadent!

Compared to the pepper jelly I have found locally, I think it was good, but still prefer what I have here.  Have to say, I was a lot disappointed that the item was ordered on the 11th of December and wasn't delivered until the 24th.  Too late to give to office mates as intended.  No reply to an email to the seller.  Regardless, those I ultimately did give it to seemed pleased with the quality.

I bought this at my local Whole Foods after trying it from a special holiday display--they don't carry it usually, so I will have to get it from Amazon from now on.  Oh, yes, that is the point:  it is really delicious, and I will have to get more!  I poured it over a log of chevre (similar to others' recommendation on using it with cream cheese) and then warmed the whole thing slightly in the microwave.  It was beautiful and my guests kept asking me where I got the jam.  Not too sweet, not too spicy.
THIS MAKES A WONDERFUL APPETIZER.  SIMPLY POUR OVER CREAM CHEESE AND ADD TRISCUITS.  IT'S PERFECT!
Vendor carried my hard-to-find products at competitive prices.  Super fast shipment, very careful packing.  Excellent transaction!

column9: use it for more than topping cream cheese!
column10: The French Laundry in Fenton, MI (www.lunchandbeyond.com) uses this jam on a warm chicken breast sandwich with brie on a paesano roll from Zingerman's. I now make this all the time at home.

I had this at a friend's house and I am hooked. She just poured it over a whole block of cream cheese and served it with crackers. It was sooo good! I couldn't stop eating it. I would have never thought, based on the name of it, that this jam would be so delicious but IT IS! I will be buying this again and again.

I added a couple of tablespoons of this jam to a marinade for grilled beef steaks along with soy sauce, balsamico, dried mustard, minced garlic and fresh rosemary. The sweetness of the red peppers married with the smokey tang of the ancho chilis made this a true delight.

column9: THE VERY BEST PEPPER JAM AROUND!
column10: I was so happy to find this jam available on Amazon at a lower price than what I normally pay! I used to drive hours to visit my daughter in the Sierra Mts. and purchase from a winery where she works. It is best poured over cream cheese with bread, crackers, bagels or warm muffins. Any way you eat it this jam is a special treat. I've served to guests and everyone goes wild over it. Order in quantity --you won't want to run out!

I love this stuff.  I have always bought this at the World Market and they no longer carry this.  Who new I would find it at Amazon for the best price.  Of course it had to travel from PA to CA to PA for me to receive it, but this is well worth the wait.  Some jam, cream cheese, and french bread.... heaven!!
THIS ITEM IS A GREAT BUY FOR YOUR DOG, MINE LOVES THEM AND THEY ARECHEAPER WHEN YOU BUY THEN IN THE BOX THAN AT THE STORE.

I just added 2 tbsp to the dish and it turned out to be very salty. I am not sure how else I can use this product. Will search for any good recipe that can go with this and will update this review, until then it is a waste.
Easy to use when making rice, adds a nice touch instead of salt. Used it when cooking some broccoli,mushrooms and carrots and I thought it had a great flavor. It is concentrated so use  accordingly.

Gotta say ... I'm impressed.I never purchased prepared baby food for my children, I made my own ... but my little grandson loves this stuff. I bought the fruit variety and vegetable variety packs for my daughter-in-law and also had the same shipped to me because I care for him while mom and dad are at work. The other fruits and veggies he is ok with but he goes bananas for the bananas.  I am ordering a case of just bananas because he likes it so much. I hope to have the time to start preparing homemade baby food by the time he runs out of what I already have.  If not, I will keep supplementing with Earth's Best brand of baby food.

These look, smell, and taste vile.  I try each food first before I give it to my baby and have been very happy with all of the Earth's Best varieties we've tried so far. The bananas however are quite disgusting.  It could be the citric acid used, but it smells and tastes like it is spoiled.  I have been feeding fresh banana up to this point, but bought a 12-jar variety pack of fruit which included banana, so I decided to try it today.  So much for saving money by purchasing the variety pack.  I will be throwing away all four jars of the banana.  I will not feed anything to my baby that I wouldn't eat myself.  Like one of the other reviewers said:  do not stock up on this before you try one jar first.  It's just nasty.  I wouldn't give it any stars if that was an option here.Update:  I still won't buy these bananas again, but I wanted to say that I contacted Earth's Best to complain.  They ended up sending me coupons for a dozen free jars of baby food.  So, I just wanted to add that I really am happy with the company.  Just not this particular product.

This is the first solid food my daughter (4 months 3 weeks) went wild for!  She loved the taste, but previous reviewers are right about this not tasting like an actual banana.  I'm just excited about finally finding a first food she loves!

I am a super picky mommy- wanting best for my baby. I was SO DISAPPOINTED WITH THIS jar. It is pink and doesnt taste like bananas. I tried it and it was not good. From now on I mash a banana with my breastmilk. I do NOT recommend!

column9: Subscribe and Save is great for these
column10: This was the best deal I could find for Earth's Best 1st foods. My twins love every flavor they've had so far.
My(now 11 month) old has been eating this without any fuss for the last few months. this is probably the best apple sauce brand I have found which worked for her.

My baby loves that Earth's Best Carrots. And everything else by them.  Their food is of exceptional quality.  I know--because before it goes in my baby's mouth, I try it first.  I hate peas, but the E.B. First Peas are absolutely sensational.  These carrots cannot be beat.  I have compared Earth's Best baby food to Gerbers and Gerbers Organic, and there is simply no comarison.  The Gerbers food--especially the green vegetables--are simply bland and a bit bitter.  I cannot tell you how wonderful (or maybe I'm trying to now!) the E.B. 1st stage baby foods are.  So good, in fact, that I've already stocked up on the variety packs of 2nd stage foods (also conveniently available on Amazon.com for a great price plus the free shipping).  If you love your baby--and I know you do--and you want him to know just how delicious fruits and vegetables can be, BUY THIS STUFF.
It does look different but both my daughters have enjoyed these bananas when starting on baby food.  My oldest daughter is 2 1/2 and my 5 month now loves them as well!

My 5 month old does not like these at all.  They make her twinge and cringe.  I tasted them and they don't taste like bananas at all.  I do like Earth's best jar food and thought that this was a good deal.  But I think that these jars have been hanging out in a sweltering warehouse somewhere... they are not good at all.

I love all the baby food my baby eats but this tasted horrible.  I think the ascorbic acid in the bananas makes it taste funny.  It's a little bit bitter and doesn't really taste like a fresh mushed up banana.  I'm going to try giving him fresh banana instead.  Don't stock up until you know they love the taste.

Wanted my daughter to keep organic as much and long as possible so we tried this brand first & this veggie when she started solids.  It smells and looks bright, and from the first spoonfull (it's not so runny it won't stay on a spatula style spoon) she loved it!  This is a veggie she doesn't refuse.She'll eat a jar of this even after a full bottle if I let her!  No side effects noticed and I even tasted it & found it barely sweet and wholesome.This is a great deal and cheaper than in store; arrives bubblewrapped to death and no weird or broken jars so far.

These do not taste like banana's and are an odd pink shade. I'm sure it's difficult to preserve pureed banana, but citric acid (predominantly found in citrus and berries) makes this food less than ideal to introduce to an infant. Citrus, berries, fish and egg whites are listed by our pediatrician as "wait until they're old enough" foods due to allergies or the irritation they causes some infants.BTW we normally love Earth's Best products.

column9: Baby loves the taste even though its a little bit sour
column10: we have a 10 month old baby who has been on Earth's Best foods since his 4th month. He loved the stage one foods and likes the stage 2 ones as well.When I tasted the Apples, they are fine but a bit sour and a little more acidic than what I had imagined. However, my son gobbles it up and does not seem to mind the sour taste at all.

I gave this to my son and he loved it - his eyes got all big and he smiled and ate the banannas and fussed when they were gone and wanted more. I think it is up to the kid - if they like it stock up if you arent sure get a variety pack and let them try it before you stock up :)
I recently started feeding solids to my five month old baby boy.He absolutely loves Earth's best carrots! He also loves the sweet potatoes and all the fruit varieties.

column9: Our twin 7-month olds love this one - carrots
column10: I subscribe to the 4 oz. version of this baby food.  Considering price, I think the 4 oz. jars are a better deal.Both our twin babies love this one with carrots as we discovered with the vegetable variety pack.  Other parents have told me their babies like carrots so this one is likely to be a winner.I've tried many Earth's Best baby food in the jars products on my babies.  They like all of them with only a couple exceptions.  I've discovered they're not fond of peas or onions, but I've also discovered that as they get older they will eat more types of foods.  If you get something your baby doesn't like, maybe you can keep it on hand for when your baby is a few months older and try again.Several other varieties of Earth's Best contain carrots.  I think this is to make them sweet so that babies will like them more.The ingredients are simply organic carrots and water.  One 4-ounce jar (not this 2.5 ounce jar) has 40 calories, and daily value: 4% protein, 150% vitamin A and 4% calcium (that's all of it; no iron for example).Compared to other Earth Best varieties, this has very little calories but is very high in vitamin A.  I'm informed that the daily intake percentage is based on an adult.

column9: The perfect size for a side veggie
column10: I really like the glass jars.  As an urban teacher, we use the jars for art classes, but even if we didn't they're more earth friendly than the plastic tubs or bags that other foods come in.  My son LOVES the earth's best carrots.  They're tasty without any of the extras.  I also like the size of the jar.  It's just right to use for two nights of veggie sides.

My girlfriend of 7 years and I recently visited Spain. One of the many things I discovered there is a custard desert the Mexicans there eat. They call it Flan!I kept cracking my girlfriend up by saying "It's Flantastic!" everytime I had flan. She would just laugh and laugh and laugh.When I returned home, I headed to the grocery store to find Flan. I tried several kinds and Goya's is by far the best. Jell-O makes some too, but it's not even close to the authentic Spanish Flan the Mexicans eat in Spain.Get this Goya Flan, it's FLAN-TASTIC!!!!!!!I wish my girlfriend was here to laugh at that. I'll have to get on the internet tonight and show her this review. It will make her night!

Not bad! I used it to make a coconut flan and it was pretty nice. The texture was a bit too gooey, but it wasn't bad.  The instructions on the box said to gradually add milk, bring to a boil stirring constantly, and refrigerate. I can do that, it's flan for dummies! Instead of milk, I used coconut milk to make a coconut flan. I made my own caramel sauce and sprinkled some shredded coconut on top of the chilled, caramel-coated flan. (see photo)Ingredients: Sugar, dextrose, calcium carragheen, salt, vanillin (an artificial flavor) and artificial color including FD & C yellow #5. Contains no eggs.
I've tried em all, and Goya's is not the one to get.  If you're looking for awesome instant Flan, go with Royal.  Goya's just tastes... weird.

I purchased this for work since we go through coffee very fast.  It makes a great cup of coffee and certainly far better than wasting money on more generic brands.  Great for work; it does it's job to help us do our :)
The product I ordered arrived in a timely fashion and the marshmallows were perfectly fresh and super tasty!  I look forward to ordering from this seller again.

I had high hopes for this product. Disappointed... may be the makers should know that adding coconut to anything does not make it 'Kerala Vegetables'. Tasted pretty bland... does not go well with rice. Might go with chappatthi, but then I don't eat chappathi.

Not tasty Not spicyJust some bland mix of vegetables, you can make something better at home even if you are new to using the stove. Try Jyoti brand, i have to try it yet but based on reviews it should be betterEDIT:Tried "Jyoti" and "Truly Indian" brands of Grocery and Gourmet Food. Exceptionally better stuff compared to this trash Tasty Bitehttp://www.amazon.com/s/ref=bl_sr_grocery?_encoding=UTF8&node=16310101&field-brandtextbin=Truly%20Indianhttp://www.amazon.com/s/ref=bl_sr_grocery?_encoding=UTF8&node=16310101&field-brandtextbin=Jyoti

this is one of the best products i have ever had.  It is fresh, nutritious, vegan and i believe kosher.  there are no chemical additives or any ingredients that are not identifiable.  in fact it only has five or six ingredients just the vegetables and spices.

When we come home late and tired it quick bite like this is just what we need.  We just heat it in the microwave and serve it over rice.  We've tried several of the Tasty Bite products and have liked each one that we tried.

column9: St. John's Wort is a miracle.
column10: I really bought this tea thinking the placebo effect would work on me - mostly because I have little faith in marketers promises now-a-days. The results? I really don't think this was a placebo.... It did exactly what it said on the description.I noticed it calmed me down when I was stressed or even worse, depressed. And while I didn't like the taste initially -smells like strong curry with licorice- I soon found myself craving it whenever I needed it and the taste wasn't so bad anymore. Actually I started to like it.I would recommend this to anyone looking for relief from depression. As a sufferer, I know how much a moments relief feels like glorious heaven.-----------------::EDIT:: I left this on the counter and my younger, 15 y/o sister who ISN'T depressed tried this, not knowing what it was. She said she suddenly started feeling giddy and happy inside and that's when she asked me what this tea was. So I'm guessing it really does work...

Just wanted to speak up and say that during a very stressful time, this tea was a life-saver. If you follow the directions, let the bag sit for 5-8 minutes and then squeeze the bag before you throw it away, the calming effects are immediate and thorough.Oh yeah, I happened to like the taste too!

column9: The taste gets sickening after awhile
column10: I don't know if the St. John's Wort herb tastes really bad or something, but this tea definitely covers up the taste. It tastes really licorice-y, it's like a slightly milder version of their Egyptian licorice tea. You can somewhat taste the other spices like cardamom, but the strong licorice taste got to me after awhile and I really did not like it. But if you love licorice tea, then I'm sure you'd like it.I decided to edit this review, since not everyone though it was helpful. Ok, first of all, I mention the licorice part because, well, if you know your herbs, licorice is also good for heart burn, but has the side effect of being a mild laxative. As for the St. John's Wort herb part: the herb is not too strong in Yogi's tea, and I prefer to use pure St. John's Wort from Alvita. Yes, it taste awful and I have to put a teaspoon of honey for half a cup of tea, but it works for me (I use 2 dosages and 4 pills of Enzymatic Therapy St. John's Wort pills because I can't drink that many cups of this herb with its taste. But the tea is more effective for me--I think my body absorbs it better in a natural form, which is normal for vitamins). And another note: just like perscription medication, this does not work in an instant. For me, it takes about a week to truely get the effects. My review is for people who decide to do alterative therapy who are diagnosed with mild to moderate depression.

I'm so happy with this tea!! St Johns Wort works wonders. I drank my first cup of it yesterday evening and very shortly afterwards, my mood was great and I was bouncing around singing and cheerful.My husband came home, hungry and out of sorts. I asked him to drink some, and he drank half a cup. He said he felt calmer and in a better mood just a few minutes after!I normally take 2 capsules of St Johns Wort most days for mood swings and depression, which mostly happen on PMS weeks. I have noticed a great improvement after taking the capsules, which are 300mg each. My symptoms nearly vanish when I keep up on the capsules. I notice if I neglect taking St Johns Wort before and during PMS, I have horrible mood swings.The box says one tea bag contains 843mg of St Johns Wort, which may be why it works so well!I recommend this tea to anybody who needs help with unhealthy moods or depression or PMS.

column9: Tasty and a real pick me up
column10: Great flavor, and it really works. I drink a large amount on the cloudy days and it appears to make my spirits lift at least enough for me to believe it works.

I decided to try this tea after hearing the Consumer Report that it is effective for depression. While not depressed, I do have a lot of anxiety so I thought I would try a tea with St. John's Wort. I was unable to find this tea in my grocery store and I thought this was a really great price for a six pack of tea.I drink this every day and it has a really nice taste. I usually have to add sweetener to tea but this one tastes great on its own, I like the natural sweetness of the licorice. I don't know if the supplement is actually working but I do think I've become less anxious over the time I've been drinking this tea. I will definitely order again when my supply runs out.

I saw the rave reviews for this tea, and I decided to do an experiment and try this tea along with the Traditional Medicinals St. John's Wort Good Mood tea. They should have been similar, although it looks like the Yogi tea has more St. John's Wort in it. I've had several cups of both now, and without a doubt the Yogi tea tastes way too licoricey and like it has a fake sweetener in it. The Traditional Medicinals tastes WAY better to me, with a more subtle licorice flavor and no weird fake sweetener taste. Also, it makes me feel better than the Yogi tea. It gives me a little boost, which I'm not feeling with Yogi. Sorry, but I tried it a few times to make sure! If anyone else wants to try the same experiment, I'd be interested in your opinion as well!!!

St John's wort takes a month or so to begin working in the body so don't expect immediate results. This tea has been a life saver. I've been going through some rough times with my grandma dieing and while it hasn't made it better, it has made it easier to cope with. I wouldn't stop taking this tea for anything!Doesn't taste amazing but I add a little raw honey and it doesn't bother me in the least.

After my first couple cups of this tea, I literally could not wipe the smile off my face.  I drink one or two cups a day and it keeps me smiling even through menial work and boring customers (I work as a bartender in a very un-busy bar).  While I know I'm not experiencing true joy, at least I don't feel depressed while at work.

This tea is a great replacement for the capsule form of St. John's Wort.  One cup a day, with two bags and some honey to sweeten, is a great booster.  I definitely notice the difference on those days when I do not get to have that cup!

column9: Going to sleep today with some Blues away
column10: I was hesitate to buy this product, just from my previous experience with another tea from Yogi. After days of not gettting enough rest and was under alot of stress, I decided to give it a try. The taste is not bad. I can taste the licorice very little. The last 2 nightsI have drinked this and I have slept like a baby. In fact got 7hrs of sleep last night and could have slept longer.

I got this tea to treat my depression and it worked wonderfully! I had one bag a day in the morning and sometimes had another in the evening. I was more productive and I felt happier. I did notice that I became more sensitive to light which is a side effect of using St. Johns' wort, so I'd recommend wearing sun glasses in bright lights and wear protective clothing if you plan be out in the sun for a long period of time.Edit: I ran out of tea and noticed after a week of not using it, I felt very depressed again. Definitely works.

I love everything about this tea.  It tastes wonderful, and I love that there's also lavender in it.  It really helps to relax and calm me, and this also helps me focus on work.  I stockpile this stuff because it's just that good, and it's decaf, thank God.  I can only handle caffiene in small doses, and not more than a cup of tea provides. A+++

I like the taste of this tea. I'm not quite sure if it does anything to help with depression, but overall I just like it. I consider this a good buy, especially since you get about 100 tea packets for such a decent price.
This tea is not only tasty, but it really does work! When I am feeling anxious a cup is guaranteed to calm me down. This could be a placebo effect, but I don't care either way.

This is my favorite tea because it makes my whole office smell wonderful, and it has a simple yet relaxing taste.  This was my first purchase from amazon and I'll note it arrived on time with a minimal packaging and clear labels letting me know it had been checked and rechecked before it arrived.  Well done! You earned another customer.

Here at the office we started a "tea catering club", and we are actually hooked with Yogi teas. We have tasted over 15 different types but I have to say I like this the most. It has a mild flavor (find it a little bit sweet too) and I definitely feel my mood changing after drinking it, I have seen it in others too (Someone asked me right away what this is and after drinking it became a fan too!), so for me, it's not placebo.We continue our tasting with other brands and types of tea, for Yogi I also like hazelnut, spicy and others, but when we make and order I always ask for this one. Best tea I tried.

I have a natural high resistance to everything so I use 2 of these tea bags to brew one cup of tea, it definitely helps me relax when I'm stressed out, nervous or upset. It's my natural way of calming down without taking medications & suffering their side effects, much cheaper too.

you'll like the way this tea tastes.  I don't particularly care for black licorice but it is subtle enough in this tea that I can handle it.  Recently I ran out of Yogi Kava Stress Relief (tastes like chocolate and it's sweet) to which I did not notice anything.  I wanted to give this St. Johns Wort a try and see if it does the job.I just steeped two teabags and put in some blue agave nectar.  I'll report back with an update soon to see if my "blues" have gone away.UPDATE: Been more than a week and well......don't notice anything really.  Used two tea bags a day so they were gone in 8 days (16 tea bags in the box).
